title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.112
description: Formerly in Vraja Lord Kṛṣṇa displayed three ages, namely childhood, boyhood and adolescence. His adolescence is especially significant.
text:
> pūrve vraje kṛṣṇera tri-vidha vayo-dharma
> kaumāra, paugaṇḍa, āra kaiśora atimarma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---in Vraja; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:v:vidha]]---three sorts; [[synonyms:v:vayaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---characteristics of age; [[synonyms:k:kaumāra]]---childhood; [[synonyms:p:paugaṇḍa]]---boyhood; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:kaiśora]]---adolescence; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:m:marma]]---the very core.
translation: Formerly in Vraja Lord Kṛṣṇa displayed three ages, namely childhood, boyhood and adolescence. His adolescence is especially significant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.113
description: Parental affection made His childhood fruitful. His boyhood was successful with His friends.
text:
> vātsalya-āveśe kaila kaumqāra saphala
> paugaṇḍa saphala kaila lañā sakhāvala
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]---of parental love; [[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in the attachment; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:k:kaumāra]]---childhood; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruitful; [[synonyms:p:paugaṇḍa]]---boyhood; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruitful; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking along; [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvala]]---friends.
translation: Parental affection made His childhood fruitful. His boyhood was successful with His friends.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.114
description: In youth He tasted the essence of rasa, fulfilling His desires in pastimes like the rāsa dance with Śrīmatī Rādhikā and the other gopīs.
text:
> rādhikādi lañā kaila rāsādi-vilāsa
> vāñchā bhari' āsvādila rasera niryāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and the other //gopīs//; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking along; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]] [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---fulfilling desires; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādila]]---He tasted; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellow; [[synonyms:n:niryāsa]]---the essence.
translation: In youth He tasted the essence of rasa, fulfilling His desires in pastimes like the rāsa dance with Śrīmatī Rādhikā and the other gopīs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.115
description: In His youth Lord Kṛṣṇa made all three of His ages, and the entire universe, successful by His pastimes of amorous love like the rāsa dance.
text:
> kaiśora-vayase kāma, jagat-sakala
> rāsādi-līlāya tina karila saphala
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaiśora]]-[[synonyms:v:vayase]]---in the adolescent age; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---amorous love; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:s:sakala]]---the entire universe; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---such as the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---by pastimes; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---successful.
translation: In His youth Lord Kṛṣṇa made all three of His ages, and the entire universe, successful by His pastimes of amorous love like the rāsa dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.116
description: "Lord Madhusūdana enjoyed His youth with pastimes on autumn nights in the midst of the jewellike milkmaids. Thus He dispelled all the misfortunes of the world."
text:
> so 'pi kaiśoraka-vayo
> mānayan madhusūdanaḥ
> reme strī-ratna-kūṭa-sthaḥ
> kṣapāsu kṣapitāhitaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:a:api]]---especially; [[synonyms:k:kaiśoraka]]-[[synonyms:v:vayaḥ]]---the age of adolescence; [[synonyms:m:mānayan]]---honoring; [[synonyms:m:madhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sūdanaḥ]]---the killer of the Madhu demon; [[synonyms:r:reme]]---enjoyed; [[synonyms:s:strī]]-[[synonyms:r:ratna]]---of the gopīs; [[synonyms:k:kūṭa]]---in multitudes; [[synonyms:s:sthaḥ]]---situated; [[synonyms:k:kṣapāsu]]---in the autumn nights; [[synonyms:k:kṣapita]]-[[synonyms:a:ahitaḥ]]---who destroys misfortune.
translation: "Lord Madhusūdana enjoyed His youth with pastimes on autumn nights in the midst of the jewellike milkmaids. Thus He dispelled all the misfortunes of the world."
purport: This is a verse from the //Viṣṇu Purāṇa// (5.13.60).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.117
description: "Lord Kṛṣṇa made Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī close Her eyes in shame before Her friends by His words relating Their amorous activities on the previous night. Then He showed the highest limit of cleverness in drawing pictures of dolphins in various playful sports on Her breasts. In this way Lord Hari made His youth successful by performing pastimes in the bushes with Śrī Rādhā and Her friends."
text:
> vācā sūcita-śarvarī-rati-kalā-prāgalbhyayā rādhikāṁ
> vrīḍā-kuñcita-locanāṁ viracayann agre sakhīnām asau
> tad-vakṣo-ruha-citra-keli-makarī-pāṇḍitya-pāraṁ gataḥ
> kaiśoraṁ saphalī-karoti kalayan kuñje vihāraṁ hariḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vācā]]---by speech; [[synonyms:s:sūcita]]---revealing; [[synonyms:ś:śarvarī]]---of the night; [[synonyms:r:rati]]---in amorous pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---of the portion; [[synonyms:p:prāgalbhyayā]]---the importance; [[synonyms:r:rādhikām]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:v:vrīḍā]]---from shame; [[synonyms:k:kuñcita]]-[[synonyms:l:locanām]]---having Her eyes closed; [[synonyms:v:viracayan]]---making; [[synonyms:a:agre]]---before; [[synonyms:s:sakhīnām]]---Her friends; [[synonyms:a:asau]]---that one; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---of Her; [[synonyms:v:vakṣaḥ]]-[[synonyms:r:ruha]]---on the breasts; [[synonyms:c:citra]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---with variegated pastimes; [[synonyms:m:makarī]]---in drawing dolphins; [[synonyms:p:pāṇḍitya]]---of cleverness; [[synonyms:p:pāram]]---the limit; [[synonyms:g:gataḥ]]---who reached; [[synonyms:k:kaiśoram]]---adolescence; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phalī]]-[[synonyms:k:karoti]]---makes successful; [[synonyms:k:kalayan]]---performing; [[synonyms:k:kuñje]]---in the bushes; [[synonyms:v:vihāram]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa made Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī close Her eyes in shame before Her friends by His words relating Their amorous activities on the previous night. Then He showed the highest limit of cleverness in drawing pictures of dolphins in various playful sports on Her breasts. In this way Lord Hari made His youth successful by performing pastimes in the bushes with Śrī Rādhā and Her friends."
purport: This is a verse from the //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (2.1.231) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.118
description: "O Paurṇamāsī, if Lord Hari had not descended in Mathurā with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, this entire creation-and especially Cupid, the demigod of love-would have been useless."
text:
> harir eṣa na ced avātariṣyan
> mathurāyāṁ madhurākṣi rādhikā ca
> abhaviṣyad iyaṁ vṛthā visṛṣṭir
> makarāṅkas tu viśeṣatas tadātra
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:e:eṣaḥ]]---this; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:c:cet]]---if; [[synonyms:a:avātariṣyat]]---would have descended; [[synonyms:m:mathurāyām]]---in Mathurā; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]-[[synonyms:a:akṣi]]---O lovely-eyed one (Paurṇamāsī); [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhikā; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:a:abhaviṣyat]]---would have been; [[synonyms:i:iyam]]---this; [[synonyms:v:vṛthā]]---useless; [[synonyms:v:visṛṣṭiḥ]]---the whole creation; [[synonyms:m:makara]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅkaḥ]]---the demigod of love, Cupid; [[synonyms:t:tu]]---then; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣataḥ]]---above all; [[synonyms:t:tadā]]---then; [[synonyms:a:atra]]---in this.
translation: "O Paurṇamāsī, if Lord Hari had not descended in Mathurā with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, this entire creation-and especially Cupid, the demigod of love-would have been useless."
purport: This verse is spoken by Śrī Vṛndā-devī in the //Vidagdha-mādhava// (7.3) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.119-120
description: Even though Lord Kṛṣṇa, the abode of all mellows, had previously in this way chewed the essence of the mellows of love, still He was unable to fulfill three desires, although He made efforts to taste them.
text:
> ei mata pūrve kṛṣṇa rasera sadana
> yadyapi karila rasa-niryāsa-carvaṇa
> tathāpi nahila tina vāñchita pūraṇa
> tāhā āsvādite yadi karila yatana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---like this; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellows; [[synonyms:s:sadana]]---the reservoir; [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---even though; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the mellows; [[synonyms:n:niryāsa]]---the essence; [[synonyms:c:carvaṇa]]---chewing; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nahila]]---was not; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:v:vāñchita]]---desired objects; [[synonyms:p:pūraṇa]]---fulfilling; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---though; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---were made; [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---efforts.
translation: Even though Lord Kṛṣṇa, the abode of all mellows, had previously in this way chewed the essence of the mellows of love, still He was unable to fulfill three desires, although He made efforts to taste them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.121
description: I shall explain His first desire. Kṛṣṇa says, "I am the primary cause of all rasas.
text:
> tāṅhāra prathama vāñchā kariye vyākhyāna
> kṛṣṇa kahe,---'āmi ha-i rasera nidāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]]---His; [[synonyms:p:prathama]]---first; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:k:kariye]]---I do; [[synonyms:v:vyākhyāna]]---explanation; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---am; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellow; [[synonyms:n:nidāna]]---primary cause.
translation: I shall explain His first desire. Kṛṣṇa says, "I am the primary cause of all rasas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.122
description: "I am the full spiritual truth and am made of full joy, but the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī drives Me mad.
text:
> pūrṇānanda-maya āmi cin-maya pūrṇa-tattva
> rādhikāra preme āmā karāya unmatta
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---made of full joy; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:c:cit]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---spiritual; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:tattva]]---full of truth; [[synonyms:r:rādhikāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---the love; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---makes; [[synonyms:u:unmatta]]---maddened.
translation: "I am the full spiritual truth and am made of full joy, but the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī drives Me mad.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.123
description: "I do not know the strength of Rādhā's love, with which She always overwhelms Me.
text:
> nā jāni rādhāra preme āche kata bala
> ye bale āmāre kare sarvadā vihvala
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in the love; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---how much; [[synonyms:b:bala]]---strength; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---strength; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:s:sarvadā]]---always; [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed.
translation: "I do not know the strength of Rādhā's love, with which She always overwhelms Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.124
description: "The love of Rādhikā is My teacher, and I am Her dancing pupil. Her prema makes Me dance various novel dances."
text:
> rādhikāra prema---guru, āmi---śiṣya naṭa
> sadā āmā nānā nṛtye nācāya udbhaṭa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhikāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love; [[synonyms:g:guru]]---teacher; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:ś:śiṣya]]---disciple; [[synonyms:n:naṭa]]---dancer; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---Me; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:n:nṛtye]]---in dances; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---causes to dance; [[synonyms:u:udbhaṭa]]---novel.
translation: "The love of Rādhikā is My teacher, and I am Her dancing pupil. Her prema makes Me dance various novel dances."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.125
text:
> kasmād vṛnde priya-sakhi hareḥ pāda-mūlāt kuto 'sau
> kuṇḍāraṇye kim iha kurute nṛtya-śikṣāṁ guruḥ kaḥ
> taṁ tvan-mūrtiḥ prati-taru-lataṁ dig-vidikṣu sphurantī
> śailūṣīva bhramati parito nartayantī sva-paścāt
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kasmāt]]---from where; [[synonyms:v:vṛnde]]---O Vṛndā; [[synonyms:p:priyā]]-[[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---O dear friend; [[synonyms:h:hareḥ]]---of Lord Hari; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlāt]]---from the lotus feet; [[synonyms:k:kutaḥ]]---where; [[synonyms:a:asau]]---that one (Lord Kṛṣṇa); [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:a:araṇye]]---in the forest on the bank of Rādhā-kuṇḍa; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:i:iha]]---here; [[synonyms:k:kurute]]---He does; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:ś:śikṣām]]---dancing practice; [[synonyms:g:guruḥ]]---teacher; [[synonyms:k:kaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:t:tam]]---Him; [[synonyms:t:tvat]]-[[synonyms:m:mūrtiḥ]]---Your form; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:t:taru]]-[[synonyms:l:latam]]---on every tree and vine; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:v:vidikṣu]]---in all directions; [[synonyms:s:sphurantī]]---appearing; [[synonyms:ś:śailūṣī]]---expert dancer; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:b:bhramati]]---wanders; [[synonyms:p:paritaḥ]]---all around; [[synonyms:n:nartayantī]]---causing to dance; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:p:paścāt]]---behind.
translation:
"O my beloved friend Vṛndā, where are you coming from?" \\
"I am coming from the feet of Śrī Hari." \\
"Where is He?" \\
"In the forest on the bank of Rādhā-kuṇḍa." \\
"What is He doing there?" \\
"He is learning dancing." \\
"Who is His master?" \\
"Your image, Rādhā, revealing itself in every tree and creeper in every direction, is roaming like a skillful dancer, making Him dance behind."
purport: This text is from the //Govinda-līlāmṛta// (8.77) of Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.126
description: "Whatever pleasure I get from tasting My love for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, She tastes ten million times more than Me by Her love.
text:
> nija-premāsvāde mora haya ye āhlāda
> tāhā ha'te koṭi-guṇa rādhā-premāsvāda
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:ā:āsvāde]]---in tasting; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:ā:āhlāda]]---pleasure; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:h:ha'te]]---than that; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten million times greater; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āsvāda]]---the tasting of love.
translation: "Whatever pleasure I get from tasting My love for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, She tastes ten million times more than Me by Her love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.127
description: "Just as I am the abode of all mutually contradictory characteristics, so Rādhā's love is always full of similar contradictions.
text:
> āmi yaiche paraspara viruddha-dharmāśraya
> rādhā-prema taiche sadā viruddha-dharma-maya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:p:paraspara]]---mutually; [[synonyms:v:viruddha]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---of conflicting characteristics; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]---the abode; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---just so; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:v:viruddha]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---consists of conflicting characteristics.
translation: "Just as I am the abode of all mutually contradictory characteristics, so Rādhā's love is always full of similar contradictions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.128
description: "Rādhā's love is all-pervading, leaving no room for expansion. But still it is expanding constantly.
text:
> rādhā-premā vibhu---yāra bāḍite nāhi ṭhāñi
> tathāpi se kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍaye sadāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:p:premā]]---the love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:v:vibhu]]---all-pervading; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:b:bāḍite]]---to increase; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---space; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---every second; [[synonyms:b:bāḍaye]]---increases; [[synonyms:s:sadāi]]---always.
translation: "Rādhā's love is all-pervading, leaving no room for expansion. But still it is expanding constantly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.129
description: "There is certainly nothing greater than Her love. But Her love is devoid of pride. That is the sign of its greatness.
text:
> yāhā va-i guru vastu nāhi suniścita
> tathāpi gurura dharma gaurava-varjita
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---which; [[synonyms:v:va]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---besides; [[synonyms:g:guru]]---great; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]---thing; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:s:suniścita]]---quite certainly; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:g:gurura]]---of greatness; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---characteristics; [[synonyms:g:gaurava]]-[[synonyms:v:varjita]]---devoid of pride.
translation: "There is certainly nothing greater than Her love. But Her love is devoid of pride. That is the sign of its greatness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.13
description: At that time, therefore, Lord Viṣṇu is present in the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Lord Kṛṣṇa kills the demons through Him.
text:
> ataeva viṣṇu takhana kṛṣṇera śarīre
> viṣṇu-dvāre kare kṛṣṇa asura-saṁhāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇu]]---Lord Viṣṇu; [[synonyms:t:takhana]]---at that time; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śarīre]]---in the body; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇu]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---by Lord Viṣṇu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:asura]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁhāre]]---killing the demons.
translation: At that time, therefore, Lord Viṣṇu is present in the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Lord Kṛṣṇa kills the demons through Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.130
description: "Nothing is purer than Her love. But its behavior is always perverse and crooked."
text:
> yāhā haite sunirmala dvitīya nāhi āra
> tathāpi sarvadā vāmya-vakra-vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than which; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---very pure; [[synonyms:d:dvitīya]]---second; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:s:sarvadā]]---always; [[synonyms:v:vāmya]]---perverse; [[synonyms:v:vakra]]---crooked; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---behavior.
translation: "Nothing is purer than Her love. But its behavior is always perverse and crooked."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.131
description: "All glories to Rādhā's love for Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demon Mura. Although it is all-pervading, it tends to increase at every moment. Although it is important, it is devoid of pride. And although it is pure, it is always beset with duplicity."
text:
> vibhur api kalayan sadābhivṛddhiṁ
> gurur api gaurava-caryayā vihīnaḥ
> muhur upacita-vakrimāpi śuddho
> jayati mura-dviṣi rādhikānurāgaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vibhuḥ]]---all-pervading; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:k:kalayan]]---making; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:a:abhivṛddhim]]---increase; [[synonyms:g:guruḥ]]---important; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:g:gaurava]]-[[synonyms:c:caryayā]] [[synonyms:v:vihīnaḥ]]---without proud behavior; [[synonyms:m:muhuḥ]]---again and again; [[synonyms:u:upacita]]---increased; [[synonyms:v:vakrimā]]---duplicity; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:ś:śuddhaḥ]]---pure; [[synonyms:j:jayati]]---all glories to; [[synonyms:m:mura]]-[[synonyms:d:dviṣi]]---for Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demon Mura; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:a:anurāgaḥ]]---the love.
translation: "All glories to Rādhā's love for Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of the demon Mura. Although it is all-pervading, it tends to increase at every moment. Although it is important, it is devoid of pride. And although it is pure, it is always beset with duplicity."
purport: This is a verse from the //Dāna-keli-kaumudī// (2) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.132
description: "Śrī Rādhikā is the highest abode of that love, and I am its only object.
text:
> sei premāra śrī-rādhikā parama 'āśraya'
> sei premāra āmi ha-i kevala 'viṣaya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of the love; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:parama]]---highest; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]---abode; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of the love; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---am; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---only; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---object.
translation: "Śrī Rādhikā is the highest abode of that love, and I am its only object.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.133
description: "I taste the bliss to which the object of love is entitled. But the pleasure of Rādhā, the abode of that love, is ten million times greater.
text:
> viṣaya-jātīya sukha āmāra āsvāda
> āmā haite koṭi-guṇa āśrayera āhlāda
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:j:jātīya]]---relating to the object; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:ā:āsvāda]]---tasting; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than Me; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten million times more; [[synonyms:ā:āśrayera]]---of the abode; [[synonyms:ā:āhlāda]]---pleasure.
translation: "I taste the bliss to which the object of love is entitled. But the pleasure of Rādhā, the abode of that love, is ten million times greater.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.134
description: "My mind races to taste the pleasure experienced by the abode, but I cannot taste it, even by My best efforts. How may I taste it?
text:
> āśraya-jātiya sukha pāite mana dhāya
> yatne āsvādite nāri, ki kari upāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]-[[synonyms:j:jātīya]]---relating to the abode; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:p:pāite]]---to obtain; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---chases; [[synonyms:y:yatne]]---by effort; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:n:nāri]]---I am unable; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I do; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---way.
translation: "My mind races to taste the pleasure experienced by the abode, but I cannot taste it, even by My best efforts. How may I taste it?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.135
description: "If sometime I can be the abode of that love, only then may I taste its joy."
text:
> kabhu yadi ei premāra ha-iye āśraya
> tabe ei premānandera anubhava haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometime; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of the love; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:iye]]---I become; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]---the abode; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānandera]]---of the joy of love; [[synonyms:a:anubhava]]---experience; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is.
translation: "If sometime I can be the abode of that love, only then may I taste its joy."
purport: //Viṣaya// and //āśraya// are two very significant words relating to the reciprocation between Kṛṣṇa and His devotee. The devotee is called the //āśraya,// and his beloved, Kṛṣṇa, is the //viṣaya.// Different ingredients are involved in the exchange of love between the //āśraya// and //viṣaya,// which are known as //vibhāva, anubhāva, sāttvika// and //vyabhicārī. Vibhāva// is divided into the two categories //ālambana// and //uddīpana. Ālambana// may be further divided into //āśraya// and //viṣaya.// In the loving affairs of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, Rādhārāṇī is the //āśraya// feature and Kṛṣṇa the //viṣaya.// The transcendental consciousness of the Lord tells Him, "I am Kṛṣṇa, and I experience pleasure as the //viṣaya.// The pleasure enjoyed by Rādhārāṇī, the //āśraya,// is many times greater than the pleasure I feel." Therefore, to feel the pleasure of the //āśraya// category, Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.136
description: Thinking in this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa was curious to taste that love. His eager desire for that love increasingly blazed in His heart.
text:
> eta cinti' rahe kṛṣṇa parama-kautukī
> hṛdaye bāḍaye prema-lobha dhakdhaki
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:c:cinti']]---thinking this; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:k:kautukī]]---the supremely curious; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:b:bāḍaye]]---increases; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:l:lobha]]---eager desire for love; [[synonyms:d:dhakdhaki]]---blazing.
translation: Thinking in this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa was curious to taste that love. His eager desire for that love increasingly blazed in His heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.137
description: That is one desire. Now please hear of another. Seeing His own beauty, Lord Kṛṣṇa began to consider.
text:
> ei eka, śuna āra lobhera prakāra
> sva-mādhurya dekhi' kṛṣṇa karena vicāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:l:lobhera]]---of eager desire; [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---type; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---own sweetness; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---consideration.
translation: That is one desire. Now please hear of another. Seeing His own beauty, Lord Kṛṣṇa began to consider.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.138
description: "My sweetness is wonderful, infinite and full. No one in the three worlds can find its limit.
text:
> adbhuta, ananta, pūrṇa mora madhurimā
> tri-jagate ihāra keha nāhi pāya sīmā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---full; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:m:madhurimā]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:j:jagate]]---in the three worlds; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---obtains; [[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---limit.
translation: "My sweetness is wonderful, infinite and full. No one in the three worlds can find its limit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.139
description: "Only Rādhikā, by the strength of Her love, tastes all the nectar of My sweetness.
text:
> ei prema-dvāre nitya rādhikā ekali
> āmāra mādhuryāmṛta āsvāde sakali
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---by means of the love; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]---always; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:e:ekali]]---only; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---of Me; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---the nectar of the sweetness; [[synonyms:ā:āsvāde]]---tastes; [[synonyms:s:sakali]]---all.
translation: "Only Rādhikā, by the strength of Her love, tastes all the nectar of My sweetness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.14
description: Thus the killing of the demons is but secondary work. I shall now speak of the main reason for the Lord's incarnation.
text:
> ānuṣaṅga-karma ei asura-māraṇa
> ye lāgi' avatāra, kahi se mūla kāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānuṣaṅga]]-[[synonyms:k:karma]]---secondary work; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:a:asura]]---of the demons; [[synonyms:m:māraṇa]]---killing; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for; [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---the incarnation; [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---I shall speak; [[synonyms:s:se]]---the; [[synonyms:m:mūla]]---root; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---cause.
translation: Thus the killing of the demons is but secondary work. I shall now speak of the main reason for the Lord's incarnation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.140
description: "Although Rādhā's love is pure like a mirror, its purity increases at every moment.
text:
> yadyapi nirmala rādhāra sat-prema-darpaṇa
> tathāpi svacchatā tāra bāḍhe kṣaṇe kṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---pure; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---of real love; [[synonyms:d:darpaṇa]]---the mirror; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:s:svacchatā]]---transparency; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---every moment.
translation: "Although Rādhā's love is pure like a mirror, its purity increases at every moment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.141
description: "My sweetness also has no room for expansion, yet it shines before that mirror in newer and newer beauty.
text:
> āmāra mādhurya nāhi bāḍhite avakāśe
> e-darpaṇera āge nava nava rūpe bhāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---of Me; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhite]]---to increase; [[synonyms:a:avakāśe]]---opportunity; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:d:darpaṇera]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of this mirror; [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:n:nava]]---newer and newer; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---in beauty; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---shines.
translation: "My sweetness also has no room for expansion, yet it shines before that mirror in newer and newer beauty.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.142
description: "There is constant competition between My sweetness and the mirror of Rādhā's love. They both go on increasing, but neither knows defeat.
text:
> man-mādhurya rādhāra prema---doṅhe hoḍa kari'
> kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍe doṅhe, keha nāhi hāri
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---My sweetness; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love; [[synonyms:d:doṅhe]]---both together; [[synonyms:h:hoḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---challenging; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---every second; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increase; [[synonyms:d:doṅhe]]---both; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---no one; [[synonyms:h:hāri]]---defeated.
translation: "There is constant competition between My sweetness and the mirror of Rādhā's love. They both go on increasing, but neither knows defeat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.143
description: "My sweetness is always newer and newer. Devotees taste it according to their own respective love.
text:
> āmāra mādhurya nitya nava nava haya
> sva-sva-prema-anurūpa bhakte āsvādaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---of Me; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---the sweetness; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]---always; [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:n:nava]]---newer and newer; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]]---according to one's own love; [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---the devotee; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaya]]---tastes.
translation: "My sweetness is always newer and newer. Devotees taste it according to their own respective love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.144
description: "If I see My sweetness in a mirror, I am tempted to taste it, but nevertheless I cannot.
text:
> darpaṇādye dekhi' yadi āpana mādhurī
> āsvādite haya lobha, āsvādite nāri
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:darpaṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādye]]---beginning in a mirror; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]---own; [[synonyms:m:mādhurī]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:l:lobha]]---desire; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:n:nāri]]---I am not able.
translation: "If I see My sweetness in a mirror, I am tempted to taste it, but nevertheless I cannot.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.145
description: "If I deliberate on a way to taste it, I find that I hanker for the position of Rādhikā."
text:
> vicāra kariye yadi āsvāda-upāya
> rādhikā-svarūpa ha-ite tabe mana dhāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---consideration; [[synonyms:k:kariye]]---I do; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:ā:āsvāda]]---to taste; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---way; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]-[[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---the nature of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to become; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---chases.
translation: "If I deliberate on a way to taste it, I find that I hanker for the position of Rādhikā."
purport: Kṛṣṇa's attractiveness is wonderful and unlimited. No one can know the end of it. Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī alone can relish such extensiveness from Her position in the //āśraya// category. The mirror of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's transcendental love is perfectly clear, yet it appears clearer and clearest in the transcendental method of understanding Kṛṣṇa. In the mirror of Rādhārāṇī's heart, the transcendental features of Kṛṣṇa appear increasingly new and fresh. In other words, the attraction of Kṛṣṇa increases in proportion to the understanding of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Each tries to supersede the other. Neither wants to be defeated in increasing the intensity of love. Desiring to understand Rādhārāṇī's attitude of increasing love, Lord Kṛṣṇa appeared as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.146
description: "Who manifests an abundance of sweetness greater than Mine, which has never been experienced before and which causes wonder to all? Alas, I Myself, My mind bewildered upon seeing this beauty, impetuously desire to enjoy it like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
text:
> aparikalita-pūrvaḥ kaś camatkāra-kārī
> sphurati mama garīyān eṣa mādhurya-pūraḥ
> ayam aham api hanta prekṣya yaṁ lubdha-cetāḥ
> sarabhasam upabhoktuṁ kāmaye rādhikeva
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aparikalita]]---not experienced; [[synonyms:p:pūrvaḥ]]---previously; [[synonyms:k:kaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]-[[synonyms:k:kārī]]---causing wonder; [[synonyms:s:sphurati]]---manifests; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---My; [[synonyms:g:garīyān]]---more great; [[synonyms:e:eṣaḥ]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]-[[synonyms:p:pūraḥ]]---abundance of sweetness; [[synonyms:a:ayam]]---this; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:a:api]]---even; [[synonyms:h:hanta]]---alas; [[synonyms:p:prekṣya]]---seeing; [[synonyms:y:yam]]---which; [[synonyms:l:lubdha]]-[[synonyms:c:cetāḥ]]---My mind being bewildered; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:r:rabhasam]]---impetuously; [[synonyms:u:upabhoktum]]---to enjoy; [[synonyms:k:kāmaye]]---desire; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]] [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
translation: "Who manifests an abundance of sweetness greater than Mine, which has never been experienced before and which causes wonder to all? Alas, I Myself, My mind bewildered upon seeing this beauty, impetuously desire to enjoy it like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
purport: This text is from the //Lalita-mādhava// (8.34) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. It was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa when He saw the beauty of His own reflection in a jeweled fountain in Dvārakā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.147
description: The beauty of Kṛṣṇa has one natural strength: it thrills the hearts of all men and women, beginning with Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-mādhuryera eka svābhāvika bala
> kṛṣṇa-ādi nara-nārī karaye cañcala
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mādhuryera]]---of the sweetness; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:s:svābhāvika]]---natural; [[synonyms:b:bala]]---strength; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:n:nara]]-[[synonyms:n:nārī]]---men and women; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---makes; [[synonyms:c:cañcala]]---perturbed.
translation: The beauty of Kṛṣṇa has one natural strength: it thrills the hearts of all men and women, beginning with Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.148
description: All minds are attracted by hearing His sweet voice and flute, or by seeing His beauty. Even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself makes efforts to taste that sweetness.
text:
> śravaṇe, darśane ākarṣaye sarva-mana
> āpanā āsvādite kṛṣṇa karena yatana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---in hearing; [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---in seeing; [[synonyms:ā:ākarṣaye]]---attracts; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---all minds; [[synonyms:ā:āpanā]]---Himself; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---makes; [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---efforts.
translation: All minds are attracted by hearing His sweet voice and flute, or by seeing His beauty. Even Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself makes efforts to taste that sweetness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.149
description: The thirst of one who always drinks the nectar of that sweetness is never satisfied. Rather, that thirst increases constantly.
text:
> e mādhuryāmṛta pāna sadā yei kare
> tṛṣṇā-śānti nahe, tṛṣṇā bāḍhe nirantare
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar of sweetness; [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---drinks; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---that person who; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śānti]]---satisfaction of thirst; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---there is not; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]]---thirst; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:n:nirantare]]---constantly.
translation: The thirst of one who always drinks the nectar of that sweetness is never satisfied. Rather, that thirst increases constantly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.15-16
description: The Lord's desire to appear was born from two reasons: He wanted to taste the sweet essence of the mellows of love of God, and He wanted to propagate devotional service in the world on the platform of spontaneous attraction. Thus He is known as supremely jubilant and as the most merciful of all.
text:
> prema-rasa-niryāsa karite āsvādana
> rāga-mārga bhakti loke karite pracāraṇa
>
> rasika-śekhara kṛṣṇa parama-karuṇa
> ei dui hetu haite icchāra udgama
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the mellow of love of God; [[synonyms:n:niryāsa]]---the essence; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tasting; [[synonyms:r:rāga]]-[[synonyms:m:mārga]]---the path of spontaneous attraction; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---in the world; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:p:pracāraṇa]]---propagation; [[synonyms:r:rasika]]-[[synonyms:ś:śekhara]]---the supremely jubilant; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:k:karuṇa]]---the most merciful; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:h:hetu]]---reasons; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:i:icchāra]]---of desire; [[synonyms:u:udgama]]---the birth.
translation: The Lord's desire to appear was born from two reasons: He wanted to taste the sweet essence of the mellows of love of God, and He wanted to propagate devotional service in the world on the platform of spontaneous attraction. Thus He is known as supremely jubilant and as the most merciful of all.
purport: During the period of Lord Kṛṣṇa's appearance, the killing of //asuras// or nonbelievers such as Kaṁsa and Jarāsandha was done by Viṣṇu, who was within the person of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. Such apparent killing by Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa took place as a matter of course and was an incidental activity for Him. But the real purpose of Lord Kṛṣṇa's appearance was to stage a dramatic performance of His transcendental pastimes at Vrajabhūmi, thus exhibiting the highest limit of transcendental mellow in the exchanges of reciprocal love between the living entity and the Supreme Lord. These reciprocal exchanges of mellows are called //rāga-bhakti,// or devotional service to the Lord in transcendental rapture. Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa wants to make known to all the conditioned souls that He is more attracted by //rāga-bhakti// than //vidhi-bhakti,// or devotional service under scheduled regulations. It is said in the //Vedas// (//Taittirīya Upaniṣad// 2.7), //raso vai saḥ:// the Absolute Truth is the reservoir for all kinds of reciprocal exchanges of loving sentiments. He is also causelessly merciful, and He wants to bestow upon us this privilege of //rāga-bhakti.// Thus He appeared as His own internal energy. He was not forced to appear by any extraneous force.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.150
description: Such a person, being unsatisfied, begins to blaspheme Lord Brahmā, saying that he does not know the art of creating well and is simply inexperienced.
text:
> atṛpta ha-iyā kare vidhira nindana
> avidagdha vidhi bhāla nā jāne sṛjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:atṛpta]]---unsatisfied; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:iyā]]---being; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:v:vidhira]]---of Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:n:nindana]]---blaspheming; [[synonyms:a:avidagdha]]---inexperienced; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---well; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know; [[synonyms:s:sṛjana]]---creating.
translation: Such a person, being unsatisfied, begins to blaspheme Lord Brahmā, saying that he does not know the art of creating well and is simply inexperienced.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.151
description: He has not given millions of eyes to see the beauty of Kṛṣṇa. He has given only two eyes, and even those eyes blink. How then shall I see the lovely face of Kṛṣṇa?
text:
> koṭi netra nāhi dila, sabe dila dui
> tāhāte nimeṣa,---kṛṣṇa ki dekhiba muñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]---ten million; [[synonyms:n:netra]]---eyes; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---did not give; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---to all; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:n:nimeṣa]]---a blink; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---how; [[synonyms:d:dekhiba]]---shall see; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I.
translation: He has not given millions of eyes to see the beauty of Kṛṣṇa. He has given only two eyes, and even those eyes blink. How then shall I see the lovely face of Kṛṣṇa?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.152
description: [The gopīs say:] "O Kṛṣṇa, when You go to the forest during the day and we do not see Your sweet face, which is surrounded by beautiful curling hair, half a second becomes as long as an entire age for us. And we consider the creator, who has put eyelids on the eyes we use for seeing You, to be simply a fool."
text:
> aṭati yad bhavān ahni kānanaṁ
> truṭir yugāyate tvām apaśyatām
> kuṭila-kuntalaṁ śrī-mukhaṁ ca te
> jaḍa udīkṣatāṁ pakṣma-kṛd dṛśām
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṭati]]---goes; [[synonyms:y:yat]]---when; [[synonyms:b:bhavān]]---Your Lordship; [[synonyms:a:ahni]]---in the day; [[synonyms:k:kānanam]]---to the forest; [[synonyms:t:truṭiḥ]]---half a second; [[synonyms:y:yugāyate]]---appears like a //yuga//; [[synonyms:t:tvām]]---You; [[synonyms:a:apaśyatām]]---of those not seeing; [[synonyms:k:kuṭila]]-[[synonyms:k:kuntalam]]---adorned with curled hair; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mukham]]---beautiful face; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your; [[synonyms:j:jaḍaḥ]]---stupid; [[synonyms:u:udīkṣatām]]---looking at; [[synonyms:p:pakṣma]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛt]]---the maker of eyelashes; [[synonyms:d:dṛśām]]---of the eyes.
translation: [The gopīs say:] "O Kṛṣṇa, when You go to the forest during the day and we do not see Your sweet face, which is surrounded by beautiful curling hair, half a second becomes as long as an entire age for us. And we consider the creator, who has put eyelids on the eyes we use for seeing You, to be simply a fool."
purport: This verse is spoken by the //gopīs// in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.15).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.153
description: "The gopīs saw their beloved Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra after a long separation. They secured and embraced Him in their hearts through their eyes, and they attained a joy so intense that not even perfect yogīs can attain it. The gopīs cursed the creator for creating eyelids that interfered with their vision."
text:
> gopyaś ca kṛṣṇam upalabhya cirād abhīṣṭaṁ
> yat-prekṣaṇe dṛśiṣu pakṣma-kṛtaṁ śapanti
> dṛgbhir hṛdi kṛtam alaṁ parirabhya sarvās
> tad-bhāvam āpur api nitya-yujāṁ durāpam
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopyaḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇam]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:upalabhya]]---seeing; [[synonyms:c:cirāt]]---after a long time; [[synonyms:a:abhīṣṭam]]---desired object; [[synonyms:y:yat]]-[[synonyms:p:prekṣaṇe]]---in the seeing of whom; [[synonyms:d:dṛśiṣu]]---in the eyes; [[synonyms:p:pakṣma]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛtam]]---the maker of eyelashes; [[synonyms:ś:śapanti]]---curse; [[synonyms:d:dṛgbhiḥ]]---with the eyes; [[synonyms:h:hṛdi]] [[synonyms:k:kṛtam]]---who entered the heart; [[synonyms:a:alam]]---enough; [[synonyms:p:parirabhya]]---embracing; [[synonyms:s:sarvāḥ]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāvam]]---that highest stage of joy; [[synonyms:ā:āpuḥ]]---obtained; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]-[[synonyms:y:yujām]]---by perfected //yogīs//; [[synonyms:d:durāpam]]---difficult to obtain.
translation: "The gopīs saw their beloved Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra after a long separation. They secured and embraced Him in their hearts through their eyes, and they attained a joy so intense that not even perfect yogīs can attain it. The gopīs cursed the creator for creating eyelids that interfered with their vision."
purport: This text is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.82.39).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.154
description: There is no other consummation for the eyes than the sight of Kṛṣṇa. Whoever sees Him is most fortunate indeed.
text:
> kṛṣṇāvalokana vinā netra phala nāhi āna
> yei jana kṛṣṇa dekhe, sei bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:avalokana]]---looking at; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:n:netra]]---the eyes; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruit; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---other; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---who; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---the person; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---very fortunate.
translation: There is no other consummation for the eyes than the sight of Kṛṣṇa. Whoever sees Him is most fortunate indeed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.155
description: [The gopīs say:] "O friends, those eyes that see the beautiful faces of the sons of Mahārāja Nanda are certainly fortunate. As these two sons enter the forest, surrounded by Their friends, driving the cows before Them, They hold Their flutes to Their mouths and glance lovingly upon the residents of Vṛndāvana. For those who have eyes, we think there is no greater object of vision."
text:
> akṣaṇvatāṁ phalam idaṁ na paraṁ vidāmaḥ
> sakhyaḥ paśūn anuviveśayator vayasyaiḥ
> vaktraṁ vrajeśa-sutayor anuveṇu-juṣṭaṁ
> yair vā nipītam anurakta-kaṭākṣa-mokṣam
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:akṣaṇvatām]]---of those who have eyes; [[synonyms:p:phalam]]---the fruit; [[synonyms:i:idam]]---this; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:p:param]]---other; [[synonyms:v:vidāmaḥ]]---we know; [[synonyms:s:sakhyaḥ]]---O friends; [[synonyms:p:paśūn]]---the cows; [[synonyms:a:anuviveśayatoḥ]]---causing to enter one forest from another; [[synonyms:v:vayasyaiḥ]]---with Their friends of the same age; [[synonyms:v:vaktram]]---the faces; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:ī:īśa]]---of Mahārāja Nanda; [[synonyms:s:sutayoḥ]]---of the two sons; [[synonyms:a:anuveṇu]]-[[synonyms:j:juṣṭam]]---possessed of flutes; [[synonyms:y:yaiḥ]]---by which; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:n:nipītam]]---imbibed; [[synonyms:a:anurakta]]---loving; [[synonyms:k:kaṭa]]-[[synonyms:a:akṣa]]---glances; [[synonyms:m:mokṣam]]---giving off.
translation: [The gopīs say:] "O friends, those eyes that see the beautiful faces of the sons of Mahārāja Nanda are certainly fortunate. As these two sons enter the forest, surrounded by Their friends, driving the cows before Them, They hold Their flutes to Their mouths and glance lovingly upon the residents of Vṛndāvana. For those who have eyes, we think there is no greater object of vision."
purport: Like the //gopīs,// one can see Kṛṣṇa continuously if one is fortunate enough. In the //Brahma-saṁhitā// it is said that sages whose eyes have been smeared with the ointment of pure love can see the form of Śyāmasundara (Kṛṣṇa) continuously in the centers of their hearts. This text from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.21.7) was sung by the //gopīs// on the advent of the //śarat// season.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.156
description: [The women of Mathurā say:] "What austerities must the gopīs have performed? With their eyes they always drink the nectar of the form of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare."
text:
> gopyas tapaḥ kim acaran yad amuṣya rūpaṁ
> lāvaṇya-sāram asamordhvam ananya-siddham
> dṛgbhiḥ pibanty anusavābhinavaṁ durāpam
> ekānta-dhāma yaśasaḥ śriya aiśvarasya
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopyaḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:t:tapaḥ]]---austerities; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:a:acaran]]---performed; [[synonyms:y:yat]]---from which; [[synonyms:a:amuṣya]]---of such a one (Lord Kṛṣṇa); [[synonyms:r:rūpam]]---the form; [[synonyms:l:lāvaṇya]]-[[synonyms:s:sāram]]---the essence of loveliness; [[synonyms:a:asama]]-[[synonyms:ū:ūrdhvam]]---not paralleled or surpassed; [[synonyms:a:ananya]]-[[synonyms:s:siddham]]---not perfected by any other ornament (self-perfect); [[synonyms:d:dṛgbhiḥ]]---by the eyes; [[synonyms:p:pibanti]]---they drink; [[synonyms:a:anusava]]-[[synonyms:a:abhinavam]]---constantly new; [[synonyms:d:durāpam]]---difficult to obtain; [[synonyms:e:ekānta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāma]]---the only abode; [[synonyms:y:yaśasaḥ]]---of fame; [[synonyms:ś:śriyaḥ]]---of beauty; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarasya]]---of opulence.
translation: [The women of Mathurā say:] "What austerities must the gopīs have performed? With their eyes they always drink the nectar of the form of Lord Kṛṣṇa, which is the essence of loveliness and is not to be equaled or surpassed. That loveliness is the only abode of beauty, fame and opulence. It is self-perfect, ever fresh and extremely rare."
purport: This text from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.44.14) was spoken by the women of Mathurā when they saw Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in the arena with King Kaṁsa's great wrestlers Muṣṭika and Cāṇūra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.157
description: The sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa is unprecedented, and its strength is also unprecedented. Simply by one's hearing of such beauty, the mind becomes unsteady.
text:
> apūrva mādhurī kṛṣṇera, apūrva tāra bala
> yāhāra śravaṇe mana haya ṭalamala
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:apūrva]]---unprecedented; [[synonyms:m:mādhurī]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:apūrva]]---unprecedented; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:b:bala]]---the strength; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---in hearing; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭalamala]]---unsteady.
translation: The sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa is unprecedented, and its strength is also unprecedented. Simply by one's hearing of such beauty, the mind becomes unsteady.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.158
description: Lord Kṛṣṇa's own beauty attracts Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. But because He cannot fully enjoy it, His mind remains full of sorrow.
text:
> kṛṣṇera mādhurye kṛṣṇe upajaya lobha
> samyak āsvādite nāre, mane rahe kṣobha
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mādhurye]]---in the sweetness; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---in Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:upajaya]]---arises; [[synonyms:l:lobha]]---eager desire; [[synonyms:s:samyak]]---fully; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---is not able; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:k:kṣobha]]---sorrow.
translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa's own beauty attracts Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself. But because He cannot fully enjoy it, His mind remains full of sorrow.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.159
description: This is a description of His second desire. Now please listen as I describe the third.
text:
> ei ta' dvitīya hetura kahila vivaraṇa
> tṛtīya hetura ebe śunaha lakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:d:dvitīya]]---second; [[synonyms:h:hetura]]---of the reason; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---has been said; [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---description; [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]]---the third; [[synonyms:h:hetura]]---of the reason; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ś:śunaha]]---please hear; [[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---the characteristic.
translation: This is a description of His second desire. Now please listen as I describe the third.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.160
description: This conclusion of rasa is extremely deep. Only Svarūpa Dāmodara knows much about it.
text:
> atyanta-nigūḍha ei rasera siddhānta
> svarūpa-gosāñi mātra jānena ekānta
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]---extremely; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---deep; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellow; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---conclusion; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---knows; [[synonyms:e:ekānta]]---much.
translation: This conclusion of rasa is extremely deep. Only Svarūpa Dāmodara knows much about it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.161
description: Anyone else who claims to know it must have heard it from him, for he was the most intimate companion of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> yebā keha anya jāne, seho tāṅhā haite
> caitanya-gosāñira teṅha atyanta marma yāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---whoever; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:s:seho]]---he; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāhaite]]---from him (Svarūpa Dāmodara); [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]---extremely; [[synonyms:m:marma]]---secret core; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---since.
translation: Anyone else who claims to know it must have heard it from him, for he was the most intimate companion of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.162
description: The love of the gopīs is called rūḍha-bhāva. It is pure and spotless. It is not at any time lust.
text:
> gopī-gaṇera premera 'rūḍha-bhāva' nāma
> viśuddha nirmala prema, kabhu nahe kāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of the love; [[synonyms:r:rūḍha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---//rūḍha-bhāva//; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:v:viśuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---spotless; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at anytime; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---lust.
translation: The love of the gopīs is called rūḍha-bhāva. It is pure and spotless. It is not at any time lust.
purport: As already explained, the position of the //gopīs// in their loving dealings with Kṛṣṇa is transcendental. Their emotion is called //rūḍha-bhāva.// Although it is apparently like mundane sex, one should not confuse it with mundane sexual love, for it is pure and unadulterated love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.163
description: "The pure love of the gopīs has become celebrated by the name 'lust.' The dear devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrī Uddhava, desire to taste that love."
text:
> premaiva gopa-rāmānāṁ
> kāma ity agamat prathām
> ity uddhavādayo 'py etaṁ
> vāñchanti bhagavat-priyāḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---only; [[synonyms:g:gopa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmānām]]---of the women of Vraja; [[synonyms:k:kāmaḥ]]---lust; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---as; [[synonyms:a:agamat]]---went to; [[synonyms:p:prathām]]---fame; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:u:uddhava]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādayaḥ]]---headed by Śrī Uddhava; [[synonyms:a:api]]---even; [[synonyms:e:etam]]---this; [[synonyms:v:vāñchanti]]---desire; [[synonyms:b:bhagavat]]-[[synonyms:p:priyāḥ]]---dear devotees of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "The pure love of the gopīs has become celebrated by the name 'lust.' The dear devotees of the Lord, headed by Śrī Uddhava, desire to taste that love."
purport: This is a verse from //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (1.2.285).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.164
description: Lust and love have different characteristics, just as iron and gold have different natures.
text:
> kāma, prema,---doṅhākāra vibhinna lakṣaṇa
> lauha āra hema yaiche svarūpe vilakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---lust; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:d:doṅhākāra]]---of the two; [[synonyms:v:vibhinna]]---separate; [[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---symptoms; [[synonyms:l:lauha]]---iron; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:h:hema]]---gold; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]]---in nature; [[synonyms:v:vilakṣaṇa]]---different.
translation: Lust and love have different characteristics, just as iron and gold have different natures.
purport: One should try to discriminate between sexual love and pure love, for they belong to different categories, with a gulf of difference between them. They are as different from one another as iron is from gold.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.165
description: The desire to gratify one's own senses is kāma [lust], but the desire to please the senses of Lord Kṛṣṇa is prema [love].
text:
> ātmendriya-prīti-vāñchā---tāre bali 'kāma'
> kṛṣṇendriya-prīti-icchā dhare 'prema' nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:i:indriya]]-[[synonyms:p:prīti]]---for the pleasure of one's own senses; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desires; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---to that; [[synonyms:b:bali]]---I say; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---lust; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:i:indriya]]-[[synonyms:p:prīti]]---for the pleasure of Lord Kṛṣṇa's senses; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---holds; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name.
translation: The desire to gratify one's own senses is kāma [lust], but the desire to please the senses of Lord Kṛṣṇa is prema [love].
purport:
The revealed scriptures describe pure love as follows:

> sarvathā dhvaṁsa-rahitaṁ
> saty api dhvaṁsa-kāraṇe
> yad bhāva-bandhanaṁ yūnoḥ
> sa premā parikīrtitaḥ

"If there is ample reason for the dissolution of a conjugal relationship and yet such a dissolution does not take place, such a relationship of intimate love is called pure."

The predominated //gopīs// were bound to Kṛṣṇa in such pure love. For them there was no question of sexual love based on sense gratification. Their only engagement in life was to see Kṛṣṇa happy in all respects, regardless of their own personal interests. They dedicated their souls only for the satisfaction of the Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa. There was not the slightest tinge of sexual love between the //gopīs// and Kṛṣṇa.

The author of //Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta// asserts with authority that sexual love is a matter of personal sense enjoyment. All the regulative principles in the //Vedas// pertaining to desires for popularity, fatherhood, wealth and so on are different phases of sense gratification. Acts of sense gratification may be performed under the cover of public welfare, nationalism, religion, altruism, ethical codes, Biblical codes, health directives, fruitive action, bashfulness, tolerance, personal comfort, liberation from material bondage, progress, family affection or fear of social ostracism or legal punishment, but all these categories are different subdivisions of one substance-sense gratification. All such good acts are performed basically for one's own sense gratification, for no one can sacrifice his personal interest while discharging these much-advertised moral and religious principles. But above all this is a transcendental stage in which one feels himself to be only an eternal servitor of Kṛṣṇa, the absolute Personality of Godhead. All acts performed in this sense of servitude are called pure love of God because they are performed for the absolute sense gratification of Śrī Kṛṣṇa. However, any act performed for the purpose of enjoying its fruits or results is an act of sense gratification. Such actions are visible sometimes in gross and sometimes in subtle forms.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.166
description: The object of lust is only the enjoyment of one's own senses. But love caters to the enjoyment of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and thus it is very powerful.
text:
> kāmera tātparya---nija-sambhoga kevala
> kṛṣṇa-sukha-tātparya-mātra prema ta' prabala
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāmera]]---of lust; [[synonyms:t:tātparya]]---the intent; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:s:sambhoga]]---enjoyment; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---only; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---for Lord Kṛṣṇa's happiness; [[synonyms:t:tātparya]]---the intent; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:p:prabala]]---powerful.
translation: The object of lust is only the enjoyment of one's own senses. But love caters to the enjoyment of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and thus it is very powerful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.167-169
description: Social customs, scriptural injunctions, bodily demands, fruitive action, shyness, patience, bodily pleasures, self-gratification and the path of varṇāśrama-dharma, which is difficult to give up—the gopīs have forsaken all these, as well as their own relatives and their punishment and scolding, for the sake of serving Lord Kṛṣṇa. They render loving service to Him for the sake of His enjoyment.
text:
> loka-dharma, veda-dharma, deha-dharma, karma
> lajjā, dhairya, deha-sukha, ātma-sukha-marma
>
> dustyaja ārya-patha, nija parijana
> sva-jane karaye yata tāḍana-bhartsana
>
> sarva-tyāga kari' kare kṛṣṇera bhajana
> kṛṣṇa-sukha-hetu kare prema-sevana

They render loving service to Him for the sake of His enjoyment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.17
description: [Lord Kṛṣṇa thought:] "All the universe is filled with the conception of My majesty, but love weakened by that sense of majesty does not satisfy Me.
text:
> aiśvarya-jñānete saba jagat miśrita
> aiśvarya-śithila-preme nahi mora prīta
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]] [[synonyms:j:jñānete]]---with knowledge of majesty; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the universe; [[synonyms:m:miśrita]]---mixed; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:ś:śithila]]---weakened by majesty; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prīta]]---pleasure.
translation: [Lord Kṛṣṇa thought:] "All the universe is filled with the conception of My majesty, but love weakened by that sense of majesty does not satisfy Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.170
description: That is called firm attachment to Lord Kṛṣṇa. It is spotlessly pure, like a clean cloth that has no stain.
text:
> ihāke kahiye kṛṣṇe dṛḍha anurāga
> svaccha dhauta-vastre yaiche nāhi kona dāga
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāke]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kahiye]]---I say; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---in Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---strong; [[synonyms:a:anurāga]]---love; [[synonyms:s:svaccha]]---pure; [[synonyms:d:dhauta]]---clean; [[synonyms:v:vastre]]---in cloth; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kona]]---some; [[synonyms:d:dāga]]---mark.
translation: That is called firm attachment to Lord Kṛṣṇa. It is spotlessly pure, like a clean cloth that has no stain.
purport: The author of //Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta// advises everyone to give up all engagements of sense gratification and, like the //gopīs,// dovetail oneself entirely with the will of the Supreme Lord. That is the ultimate instruction of Kṛṣṇa in the //Bhagavad-gītā.// We should be prepared to do anything and everything to please the Lord, even at the risk of violating the Vedic principles or ethical laws. That is the standard of love of Godhead. Such activities in pure love of Godhead are as spotless as white linen that has been completely washed. Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura warns us in this connection that we should not mistakenly think that the idea of giving up everything implies the renunciation of duties necessary in relation to the body and mind. Even such duties are not sense gratification if they are undertaken in a spirit of service to Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.171
description: Therefore lust and love are quite different. Lust is like dense darkness, but love is like the bright sun.
text:
> ataeva kāma-preme bahuta antara
> kāma---andha-tamaḥ, prema---nirmala bhāskara

translation: Therefore lust and love are quite different. Lust is like dense darkness, but love is like the bright sun.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.172

translation: Thus there is not the slightest taint of lust in the gopīs' love. Their relationship with Kṛṣṇa is only for the sake of His enjoyment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.173
description: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."
text:
> yat te sujāta-caraṇāmburuhaṁ staneṣu
> bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu
> tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit
> kūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavad-āyuṣāṁ naḥ

translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."
purport: This text from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.19) was spoken by the //gopīs// when Kṛṣṇa left them in the midst of the //rāsa-līlā.//

translation: The gopīs do not care for their own pleasures or pains. All their physical and mental activities are directed toward offering enjoyment to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.175

description: "O My beloved gopīs, you have renounced social customs, scriptural injunctions and your relatives for My sake. I disappeared behind you only to increase your concentration upon Me. Since I disappeared for your benefit, you should not be displeased with Me."

> mayā parokṣaṁ bhajatā tirohitaṁ
> māsūyituṁ mārhatha tat priyaṁ priyāḥ

translation: "O My beloved gopīs, you have renounced social customs, scriptural injunctions and your relatives for My sake. I disappeared behind you only to increase your concentration upon Me. Since I disappeared for your benefit, you should not be displeased with Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.177
description: Lord Kṛṣṇa has a promise from before to reciprocate with His devotees according to the way they worship Him.
text:

> ye yaiche bhaje, kṛṣṇa tāre bhaje taiche

translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa has a promise from before to reciprocate with His devotees according to the way they worship Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.178
description: "In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā."
text:
> ye yathā māṁ prapadyante
> tāṁs tathaiva bhajāmy aham
> mama vartmānuvartante
> manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]---those who; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---to Me; [[synonyms:p:prapadyante]]---surrender; [[synonyms:t:tān]]---them; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---so; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhajāmi]]---reward; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---My; [[synonyms:v:vartma]]---path; [[synonyms:a:anuvartante]]---follow; [[synonyms:m:manuṣyāḥ]]---men; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O son of Pṛthā; [[synonyms:s:sarvaśaḥ]]---in all respects.
translation: "In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā."
purport: Kṛṣṇa was never ungrateful to the //gopīs,// for as He declares to Arjuna in this verse from the //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:4:11|(Bg. 4.11)]], He reciprocates with His devotees in proportion to the transcendental loving service they render unto Him. Everyone follows the path that leads toward Him, but there are different degrees of progress on that path, and the Lord is realized in proportion to one's advancement. The path is one, but the progress in approaching the ultimate goal is different, and therefore the proportion of realization of this goal-namely the absolute Personality of Godhead-is also different. The //gopīs// attained the highest goal, and Lord Caitanya affirmed that there is no higher method of worshiping God than that followed by the //gopīs.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.179
description: That promise has been broken by the worship of the gopīs, as Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself admits.
text:
> se pratijñā bhaṅga haila gopīra bhajane
