synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pratijñā]]---promise; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅga]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was broken; [[synonyms:g:gopīra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:b:bhajane]]---by the worship; [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:p:pramāṇa]]---the proof; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:v:vacane]]---by the words from the mouth.
translation: That promise has been broken by the worship of the gopīs, as Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself admits.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.18
description: "If one regards Me as the Supreme Lord and himself as a subordinate, I do not become subservient to his love, nor can it control Me.
text:
> āmāre īśvara māne, āpanāke hīna
> tāra preme vaśa āmi nā ha-i adhīna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---Me; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---regards; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāke]]---himself; [[synonyms:h:hīna]]---low; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---by the love; [[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---controlled; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---am not; [[synonyms:a:adhīna]]---subservient.
translation: "If one regards Me as the Supreme Lord and himself as a subordinate, I do not become subservient to his love, nor can it control Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.180
description: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation."
text:
> na pāraye 'haṁ niravadya-saṁyujāṁ
> sva-sādhu-kṛtyaṁ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ
> yā mābhajan durjaya-geha-śṛṅkhalāḥ
> saṁvṛścya tad vaḥ pratiyātu sādhunā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāraye]]---am able to make; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:n:niravadya]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁyujām]]---to those who are completely free from deceit; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:s:sādhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛtyam]]---proper compensation; [[synonyms:v:vibudha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyuṣā]]---with a lifetime as long as that of the demigods; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:v:vaḥ]]---to you; [[synonyms:y:yāḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:m:mā]]---Me; [[synonyms:a:abhajan]]---have worshiped; [[synonyms:d:durjaya]]-[[synonyms:g:geha]]-[[synonyms:ś:śṛṅkhalāḥ]]---the chains of household life, which are difficult to overcome; [[synonyms:s:saṁvṛścya]]---cutting; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vaḥ]]---of you; [[synonyms:p:pratiyātu]]---let it be returned; [[synonyms:s:sādhunā]]---by the good activity itself.
translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation."
purport: This verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.32.22) was spoken by Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself when He returned to the //gopīs// upon hearing their songs of separation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.181
description: Now, whatever affection we see the gopīs show in their own bodies, know it for certain to be only for the sake of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> tabe ye dekhiye gopīra nija-dehe prīta
> seho ta' kṛṣṇera lāgi, jāniha niścita
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---now; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:d:dekhiye]]---we see; [[synonyms:g:gopīra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in their own bodies; [[synonyms:p:prīta]]---affection; [[synonyms:s:seho]]---that; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi]]---for Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:j:jāniha]]---know; [[synonyms:n:niścita]]---for certain.
translation: Now, whatever affection we see the gopīs show in their own bodies, know it for certain to be only for the sake of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
purport: The selfless love of Godhead exhibited by the //gopīs// cannot have any parallel. We should not, therefore, misunderstand the carefulness of the //gopīs// in their personal decoration. The //gopīs// dressed themselves as beautifully as possible, just to make Kṛṣṇa happy by seeing them. They had no ulterior desires. They dedicated their bodies, and everything they possessed, to the service of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, taking for granted that their bodies were meant for His enjoyment. They dressed themselves on the understanding that Kṛṣṇa would be happy by seeing and touching them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.182
description: [The gopīs think:] "I have offered this body to Lord Kṛṣṇa. He is its owner, and it brings Him enjoyment.
text:
> 'ei deha kailuṅ āmi kṛṣṇe samarpaṇa
> tāṅra dhana tāṅra ihā sambhoga-sādhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---have done; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---offering; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Him; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Him; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sambhoga]]-[[synonyms:s:sādhana]]---brings about the enjoyment.
translation: [The gopīs think:] "I have offered this body to Lord Kṛṣṇa. He is its owner, and it brings Him enjoyment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.183
description: "Kṛṣṇa finds joy in seeing and touching this body." It is for this reason that they cleanse and decorate their bodies.
text:
> e-deha-darśana-sparśe kṛṣṇa-santoṣaṇa'
> ei lāgi' kare dehera mārjana-bhūsaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]]---of this body; [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---by sight; [[synonyms:s:sparśe]]---and touch; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:santoṣaṇa]]---the satisfaction; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for this; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---they do; [[synonyms:d:dehera]]---of the body; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---cleaning; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---decorating.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa finds joy in seeing and touching this body." It is for this reason that they cleanse and decorate their bodies.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.184
description: "O Arjuna, there are no greater receptacles of deep love for Me than the gopīs, who cleanse and decorate their bodies because they consider them Mine."
text:
> nijāṅgam api yā gopyo
> mameti samupāsate
> tābhyaḥ paraṁ na me pārtha
> nigūḍha-prema-bhājanam
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅgam]]---own body; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:y:yāḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:g:gopyaḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---Mine; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus thinking; [[synonyms:s:samupāsate]]---engage in decorating; [[synonyms:t:tābhyaḥ]]---than them; [[synonyms:p:param]]---greater; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:m:me]]---for Me; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O Arjuna; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---of deep love; [[synonyms:b:bhājanam]]---receptacles.
translation: "O Arjuna, there are no greater receptacles of deep love for Me than the gopīs, who cleanse and decorate their bodies because they consider them Mine."
purport: This verse is spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the //Ādi Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.185
description: There is another wonderful feature of the emotion of the gopīs. Its power is beyond the comprehension of the intelligence.
text:
> āra eka adbhuta gopī-bhāvera svabhāva
> buddhira gocara nahe yāhāra prabhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāvera]]---of the emotion of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---nature; [[synonyms:b:buddhira]]---of the intelligence; [[synonyms:g:gocara]]---an object of perception; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---the power.
translation: There is another wonderful feature of the emotion of the gopīs. Its power is beyond the comprehension of the intelligence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.186
description: When the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa, they derive unbounded bliss, although they have no desire for such pleasure.
text:
> gopī-gaṇa kare yabe kṛṣṇa-daraśana
> sukha-vāñchā nāhi, sukha haya koṭi-guṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desire for happiness; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---the happiness; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten million times.
translation: When the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa, they derive unbounded bliss, although they have no desire for such pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.187
description: The gopīs taste a pleasure ten million times greater than the pleasure Lord Kṛṣṇa derives from seeing them.
text:
> gopīkā-darśane kṛṣṇera ye ānanda haya
> tāhā haite koṭi-guṇa gopī āsvādaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopikā]]-[[synonyms:d:darśane]]---in seeing the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---joy; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than that; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten million times more; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaya]]---taste.
translation: The gopīs taste a pleasure ten million times greater than the pleasure Lord Kṛṣṇa derives from seeing them.
purport: The wonderful characteristics of the //gopīs// are beyond imagination. They have no desire for personal satisfaction, yet when Kṛṣṇa is happy by seeing them, that happiness of Kṛṣṇa makes the //gopīs// a million times more happy than Kṛṣṇa Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.188
description: The gopīs have no inclination for their own enjoyment, and yet their joy increases. That is indeed a contradiction.
text:
> tāṅ sabāra nāhi nija-sukha-anurodha
> tathāpi bāḍhaye sukha, paḍila virodha
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]] [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---for their own happiness; [[synonyms:a:anurodha]]---entreaty; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhaye]]---increases; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:p:paḍila]]---happened; [[synonyms:v:virodha]]---contradiction.
translation: The gopīs have no inclination for their own enjoyment, and yet their joy increases. That is indeed a contradiction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.189
description: For this contradiction I see only one solution: the joy of the gopīs lies in the joy of their beloved Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> e virodhera eka mātra dekhi samādhāna
> gopikāra sukha kṛṣṇa-sukhe paryavasāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:v:virodhera]]---of the contradiction; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---solution; [[synonyms:g:gopikāra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---the happiness; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in the happiness of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:paryavasāna]]---the conclusion.
translation: For this contradiction I see only one solution: the joy of the gopīs lies in the joy of their beloved Kṛṣṇa.
purport: The situation of the //gopīs// is perplexing, for although they did not want personal happiness, it was imposed upon them. The solution to this perplexity is that Śrī Kṛṣṇa's sense of happiness is limited by the happiness of the //gopīs.// Devotees at Vṛndāvana therefore try to serve the //gopīs,// namely Rādhārāṇī and Her associates. If one gains the favor of the //gopīs,// he easily gains the favor of Kṛṣṇa because on the recommendation of the //gopīs// Kṛṣṇa at once accepts the service of a devotee. Lord Caitanya, therefore, wanted to please the //gopīs// instead of Kṛṣṇa. But His contemporaries misunderstood Him, and for this reason Lord Caitanya renounced the order of householder life and became a //sannyāsī.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.19
description: "In whatever transcendental mellow My devotee worships Me, I reciprocate with him. That is My natural behavior.
text:
> āmāke ta' ye ye bhakta bhaje yei bhāve
> tāre se se bhāve bhaji,---e mora svabhāve
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāke]]---Me; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotee; [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---worships; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the mood; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the mood; [[synonyms:b:bhaji]]---I reciprocate; [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:s:svabhāve]]---in the nature.
translation: "In whatever transcendental mellow My devotee worships Me, I reciprocate with him. That is My natural behavior.
purport: The Lord, by His inherent nature, reveals Himself before His devotees according to their inherent devotional service. The Vṛndāvana pastimes demonstrated that although generally people worship God with reverence, the Lord is more pleased when a devotee thinks of Him as his pet son, personal friend or most dear fiancī and renders service unto Him with such natural affection. The Lord becomes a subordinate object of love in such transcendental relationships. Such pure love of Godhead is unadulterated by any tinge of superfluous nondevotional desires and is not mixed with any sort of fruitive action or empiric philosophical speculation. It is pure and natural love of Godhead, spontaneously aroused in the absolute stage. This devotional service is executed in a favorable atmosphere freed from material affection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.190
description: When Lord Kṛṣṇa sees the gopīs, His joy increases, and His unparalleled sweetness increases also.
text:
> gopikā-darśane kṛṣṇera bāḍhe praphullatā
> se mādhurya bāḍhe yāra nāhika samatā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopikā]]-[[synonyms:d:darśane]]---in seeing the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:p:praphullatā]]---the cheerfulness; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]]---there is not; [[synonyms:s:samatā]]---equality.
translation: When Lord Kṛṣṇa sees the gopīs, His joy increases, and His unparalleled sweetness increases also.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.191
description: [The gopīs think:] "Kṛṣṇa has obtained so much pleasure by seeing me." That thought increases the fullness and beauty of their faces and bodies.
text:
> āmāra darśane kṛṣṇa pāila eta sukha
> ei sukhe gopīra praphulla aṅga-mukha
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---in seeing me; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---obtained; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---so much; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:g:gopīra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:p:praphulla]]---full-blown; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]---bodies and faces.
translation: [The gopīs think:] "Kṛṣṇa has obtained so much pleasure by seeing me." That thought increases the fullness and beauty of their faces and bodies.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.192
description: The beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa increases at the sight of the beauty of the gopīs. And the more the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the more their beauty increases.
text:
> gopī-śobhā dekhi' kṛṣṇera śobhā bāḍhe yata
> kṛṣṇa-śobhā dekhi' gopīra śobhā bāḍhe tata
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śobhā]]---the beauty of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śobhā]]---the beauty; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much as; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śobhā]]---the beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:g:gopīra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ś:śobhā]]---the beauty; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:t:tata]]---that much.
translation: The beauty of Lord Kṛṣṇa increases at the sight of the beauty of the gopīs. And the more the gopīs see Lord Kṛṣṇa's beauty, the more their beauty increases.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.193
description: In this way a competition takes place between them in which no one acknowledges defeat.
text:
> ei-mata paraspara paḍe huḍāhuḍi
> paraspara bāḍhe, keha mukha nāhi muḍi
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---like this; [[synonyms:p:paraspara]]---reciprocal; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---happens; [[synonyms:h:huḍāhuḍi]]---jostling; [[synonyms:p:paraspara]]---mutually; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhe]]---increases; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---face; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:m:muḍi]]---covering.
translation: In this way a competition takes place between them in which no one acknowledges defeat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.194
description: Kṛṣṇa, however, derives pleasure from the beauty and good qualities of the gopīs. And when the gopīs see His pleasure, the joy of the gopīs increases.
text:
> kintu kṛṣṇera sukha haya gopī-rūpa-guṇe
> tāṅra sukhe sukha-vṛddhi haye gopī-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kintu]]---but; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---the happiness; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---in the qualities and beauty of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Him; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in the happiness; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛddhi]]---increase of happiness; [[synonyms:h:haye]]---there is; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---in the //gopīs.//
translation: Kṛṣṇa, however, derives pleasure from the beauty and good qualities of the gopīs. And when the gopīs see His pleasure, the joy of the gopīs increases.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.195
description: Therefore we find that the joy of the gopīs nourishes the joy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. For that reason the fault of lust is not present in their love.
text:
> ataeva sei sukha kṛṣṇa-sukha poṣe
> ei hetu gopī-preme nāhi kāma-doṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---the happiness of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:poṣe]]---nourishes; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:h:hetu]]---reason; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:p:preme]]---in the love of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:d:doṣe]]---the fault of lust.
translation: Therefore we find that the joy of the gopīs nourishes the joy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. For that reason the fault of lust is not present in their love.
purport: By looking at the beautiful //gopīs// Kṛṣṇa becomes enlivened, and this enlivens the //gopīs,// whose youthful faces and bodies blossom. This competition of increasing beauty between the //gopīs// and Kṛṣṇa, which is without limitations, is so delicate that sometimes mundane moralists mistake these dealings to be purely amorous. But these affairs are not at all mundane, because the //gopīs'// intense desire to satisfy Kṛṣṇa surcharges the entire scene with pure love of Godhead, with not a spot of sexual indulgence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.196
description: "I worship Lord Keśava. Coming back from the forest of Vraja, He is worshiped by the gopīs, who mount the roofs of their palaces and meet Him on the path with a hundred manners of dancing glances and gentle smiles. The corners of His eyes wander, like large black bees, around the gopīs' breasts."
text:
> upetya pathi sundarī-tatibhir ābhir abhyarcitaṁ
> smitāṅkura-karambitair naṭad-apāṅga-bhaṅgī-śataiḥ
> stana-stavaka-sañcaran-nayana-cañcarīkāñcalaṁ
> vraje vijayinaṁ bhaje vipina-deśataḥ keśavam
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upetya]]---having mounted their palaces; [[synonyms:p:pathi]]---on the path; [[synonyms:s:sundarī]]-[[synonyms:t:tatibhiḥ]] [[synonyms:ā:ābhiḥ]]---by the women of Vraja; [[synonyms:a:abhyarcitam]]---who is worshiped; [[synonyms:s:smita]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅkura]]-[[synonyms:k:karambitaiḥ]]---intermingled with the sprouts of gentle smiles; [[synonyms:n:naṭat]]---dancing; [[synonyms:a:apāṅga]]---of glances; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śataiḥ]]---with a hundred manners; [[synonyms:s:stana]]-[[synonyms:s:stavaka]]---the multitude of breasts; [[synonyms:s:sañcarat]]---wandering about; [[synonyms:n:nayana]]---of the two eyes; [[synonyms:c:cañcarīka]]---like bees; [[synonyms:a:añcalam]]---Him whose corners; [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---in Vraja; [[synonyms:v:vijayinam]]---coming; [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---I worship; [[synonyms:v:vipina]]-[[synonyms:d:deśataḥ]]---from the forest; [[synonyms:k:keśavam]]---Lord Keśava.
translation: "I worship Lord Keśava. Coming back from the forest of Vraja, He is worshiped by the gopīs, who mount the roofs of their palaces and meet Him on the path with a hundred manners of dancing glances and gentle smiles. The corners of His eyes wander, like large black bees, around the gopīs' breasts."
purport: This statement appears in the //Keśavāṣṭaka// (8) of the //Stava-mālā,// compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.197
description: There is another natural symptom of the gopīs' love that shows it to be without a trace of lust.
text:
> āra eka gopī-premera svābhāvika cihna
> ye prakāre haya prema kāma-gandha-hīna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:p:premera]]---of the love of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:svābhāvika]]---natural; [[synonyms:c:cihna]]---symptom; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:p:prakāre]]---in the way; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]---without a trace of lust.
translation: There is another natural symptom of the gopīs' love that shows it to be without a trace of lust.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.198
description: The love of the gopīs nourishes the sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That sweetness in turn increases their love, for they are greatly satisfied.
text:
> gopī-preme kare kṛṣṇa-mādhuryera puṣṭi
> mādhurye bāḍhāya prema hañā mahā-tuṣṭi
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:p:preme]]---the love of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhuryera]]---of the sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:puṣṭi]]---nourishment; [[synonyms:m:mādhurye]]---the sweetness; [[synonyms:b:bāḍhāya]]---causes to increase; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:t:tuṣṭi]]---greatly pleased.
translation: The love of the gopīs nourishes the sweetness of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That sweetness in turn increases their love, for they are greatly satisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.199
description: The happiness of the abode of love is in the happiness of the object of that love. This is not a relationship of desire for personal gratification.
text:
> prīti-viṣayānande tad-āśrayānanda
> tāṅhā nāhi nija-sukha-vāñchāra sambandha
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prīti]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in the joy of the object of love; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---of that love; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---the joy of the abode; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchāra]]---of desire for one's own happiness; [[synonyms:s:sambandha]]---relationship.
translation: The happiness of the abode of love is in the happiness of the object of that love. This is not a relationship of desire for personal gratification.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.2
description: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All glory to Lord Nityānanda. All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya. And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya.
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glory; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glory; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glory; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glory; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All glory to Lord Nityānanda. All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya. And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.20
description: " 'In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā.'
text:
> ye yathā māṁ prapadyante
> tāṁs tathaiva bhajāmy aham
> mama vartmānuvartante
> manuṣyāḥ pārtha sarvaśaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]---all who; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:p:prapadyante]]---surrender; [[synonyms:t:tān]]---them; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---so; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhajāmi]]---reward; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---My; [[synonyms:v:vartma]]---path; [[synonyms:a:anuvartante]]---follow; [[synonyms:m:manuṣyāḥ]]---all men; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O son of Pṛthā; [[synonyms:s:sarvaśaḥ]]---in all respects.
translation: “ 'In whatever way My devotees surrender unto Me, I reward them accordingly. Everyone follows My path in all respects, O son of Pṛthā.'
purport: In the Fourth Chapter of the //Bhagavad-gītā// Lord Kṛṣṇa affirms that formerly (some 120 million years before the Battle of Kurukṣetra) He explained the mystic philosophy of the //Gītā// to the sun-god. The message was received through the chain of disciplic succession, but in course of time, the chain being broken somehow or other, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa appeared again and taught Arjuna the truths of the //Bhagavad-gītā.// At that time the Lord spoke this verse [[books:bg:4:11|(Bg. 4.11)]] to His friend Arjuna.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.200-201
description: Whenever there is unselfish love, that is its style. The reservoir of love derives pleasure when the lovable object is pleased. When the pleasure of love interferes with the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the devotee becomes angry toward such ecstasy.
text:
> nirupādhi prema yāṅhā, tāṅhā ei rīti
> prīti-viṣaya-sukhe āśrayera prīti
>
> nija-premānande kṛṣṇa-sevānanda bādhe
> se ānandera prati bhaktera haya mahā-krodhe
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nirupādhi]]---without identification; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:y:yāṅhā]]---which; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---that; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:r:rīti]]---style; [[synonyms:p:prīti]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---of the object of love; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in the happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āśrayera]]---of the abode of that love; [[synonyms:p:prīti]]---the pleasure; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---one's own; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---of love; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---by the joy; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:seva]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---the joy of service; [[synonyms:b:bādhe]]---is obstructed; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:ānandera]] [[synonyms:p:prati]]---toward the joy; [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of the devotee; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:krodhe]]---great anger.
translation: Whenever there is unselfish love, that is its style. The reservoir of love derives pleasure when the lovable object is pleased. When the pleasure of love interferes with the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the devotee becomes angry toward such ecstasy.
purport: As mentioned above, the //gopīs// are the predominated lovers, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the predominator, the beloved. The love of the predominated nourishes the love of the predominator. The //gopīs// had no desire for selfish enjoyment. Their feeling of happiness was indirect, for it was dependent on the pleasure of Kṛṣṇa. Causeless love of Godhead is always so. Such pure love is possible only when the predominated is made happy by the happiness of the predominator. Such unadulterated love is exemplified when the lover deprecates her happiness in service that hinders her from discharging it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.202
description: "Śrī Dāruka did not relish his ecstatic feelings of love, for they caused his limbs to become stunned and thus obstructed his service of fanning Lord Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> aṅga-stambhārambham uttuṅgayantaṁ
> premānandaṁ dāruko nābhyanandat
> kaṁsārāter vījane yena sākṣād
> akṣodīyān antarāyo vyadhāyi
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---of the limbs; [[synonyms:s:stambha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ārambham]]---the beginning of stupefaction; [[synonyms:u:uttuṅgayantam]]---which was causing him to reach; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānandam]]---the joy of love; [[synonyms:d:dārukaḥ]]---Dāruka, the Lord's chariot driver; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:a:abhyanandat]]---welcomed; [[synonyms:k:kaṁsa]]-[[synonyms:a:arāteḥ]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa; [[synonyms:v:vījane]]---in fanning with a //cāmara// fan; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---by which; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]---clearly; [[synonyms:a:akṣodīyān]]---greater; [[synonyms:a:antarāyaḥ]]---obstacle; [[synonyms:v:vyadhāyi]]---has been created.
translation: "Śrī Dāruka did not relish his ecstatic feelings of love, for they caused his limbs to become stunned and thus obstructed his service of fanning Lord Kṛṣṇa."
purport: This verse is from //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (3.2.62).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.203
description: "The lotus-eyed Rādhārāṇī powerfully condemned the ecstatic love that caused a flow of tears that hindered Her sight of Govinda."
text:
> govinda-prekṣaṇākṣepi-
> bāṣpa-pūrābhivarṣiṇam
> uccair anindad ānandam
> aravinda-vilocanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---of Lord Govinda; [[synonyms:p:prekṣaṇa]]---the seeing; [[synonyms:ā:ākṣepi]]---hindering; [[synonyms:b:bāṣpa]]-[[synonyms:p:pūra]]---groups of tears; [[synonyms:a:abhivarṣiṇam]]---which cause to rain; [[synonyms:u:uccaiḥ]]---powerfully; [[synonyms:a:anindat]]---condemned; [[synonyms:ā:ānandam]]---the bliss; [[synonyms:a:aravinda]]-[[synonyms:v:vilocanā]]---the lotus-eyed Rādhārāṇī.
translation: "The lotus-eyed Rādhārāṇī powerfully condemned the ecstatic love that caused a flow of tears that hindered Her sight of Govinda."
purport: This verse is also from //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (2.3.54).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.204
description: Furthermore, pure devotees never forsake the loving service of Lord Kṛṣṇa to aspire for their own personal pleasure through the five kinds of liberation.
text:
> āra śuddha-bhakta kṛṣṇa-prema-sevā vine
> sva-sukhārtha sālokyādi nā kare grahaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---the pure devotee; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---out of love for Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:v:vine]]---without; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---for the purpose of one's own pleasure; [[synonyms:s:sālokya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---the five types of liberation, beginning from //sālokya// (residing on the same spiritual planet as the Lord); [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do not do; [[synonyms:g:grahaṇe]]---acceptance.
translation: Furthermore, pure devotees never forsake the loving service of Lord Kṛṣṇa to aspire for their own personal pleasure through the five kinds of liberation.
purport: A pure devotee of Kṛṣṇa who loves Him exclusively will flatly refuse to accept any sort of liberation, beginning from merging in the body of the Lord and extending to the other varieties of liberation, such as equality of form, opulence or abode and the opulence of living near the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.205
description: "Just as the celestial waters of the Ganges flow unobstructed into the ocean, so when My devotees simply hear of Me, their minds come to Me, who resides in the hearts of all.
text:
> mad-guṇa-śruti-mātreṇa
> mayi sarva-guhāśaye
> mano-gatir avicchinnā
> yathā gaṅgāmbhaso 'mbudhau
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mat]]---of Me; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---of the qualities; [[synonyms:ś:śruti]]-[[synonyms:m:mātreṇa]]---only by hearing; [[synonyms:m:mayi]]---to Me; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:g:guhā]]---in all hearts; [[synonyms:ā:āśaye]]---who am situated; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:g:gatiḥ]]---the movement of the mind; [[synonyms:a:avicchinnā]]---unobstructed; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---just as; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:a:ambhasaḥ]]---of the celestial waters of the Ganges; [[synonyms:a:ambudhau]]---to the ocean.
translation: "Just as the celestial waters of the Ganges flow unobstructed into the ocean, so when My devotees simply hear of Me, their minds come to Me, who resides in the hearts of all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.206
description: "These are the characteristics of transcendental loving service to Puruṣottama, the Supreme Personality of Godhead: it is causeless, and it cannot be obstructed in any way.
text:
> lakṣaṇaṁ bhakti-yogasya
> nirguṇasya hy udāhṛtam
> ahaituky avyavahitā
> yā bhaktiḥ puruṣottame
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇam]]---the symptom; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:y:yogasya]]---of devotional service; [[synonyms:n:nirguṇasya]]---beyond the three modes of nature; [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly; [[synonyms:u:udāhṛtam]]---is cited; [[synonyms:a:ahaitukī]]---causeless; [[synonyms:a:avyavahitā]]---uninterrupted; [[synonyms:y:yā]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bhaktiḥ]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:p:puruṣottame]]---to the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "These are the characteristics of transcendental loving service to Puruṣottama, the Supreme Personality of Godhead: it is causeless, and it cannot be obstructed in any way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.207
description: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me."
text:
> sālokya-sārṣṭi-sārūpya-
> sāmīpyaikatvam apy uta
> dīyamānaṁ na gṛhṇanti
> vinā mat-sevanaṁ janāḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sālokya]]---being on the same planet as Me; [[synonyms:s:sārṣṭi]]---having opulence equal to Mine; [[synonyms:s:sārūpya]]---having the same form as Me; [[synonyms:s:sāmīpya]]---having direct association with Me; [[synonyms:e:ekatvam]]---oneness with Me; [[synonyms:a:api]]---even; [[synonyms:u:uta]]---or; [[synonyms:d:dīyamānam]]---being given; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:g:gṛhṇanti]]---accept; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:s:sevanam]]---My service; [[synonyms:j:janāḥ]]---the devotees.
translation: "My devotees do not accept sālokya, sārṣṭi, sārūpya, sāmīpya or oneness with Me-even if I offer these liberations-in preference to serving Me."
purport: These three verses from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (3.29.11-13) were spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa in the form of Kapiladeva.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.208
description: "My devotees, having fulfilled their desires by serving Me, do not accept the four kinds of salvation that are easily earned by such service. Why then should they accept any pleasures that are lost in the course of time?"
text:
> mat-sevayā pratītaṁ te
> sālokyādi-catuṣṭayam
> necchanti sevayā pūrṇāḥ
> kuto 'nyat kāla-viplutam
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mat]]---of Me; [[synonyms:s:sevayā]]---by service; [[synonyms:p:pratītam]]---obtained; [[synonyms:t:te]]---they; [[synonyms:s:sālokya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---liberation, beginning //sālokya//; [[synonyms:c:catuṣṭayam]]---four kinds of; [[synonyms:n:na]] [[synonyms:i:icchanti]]---do not desire; [[synonyms:s:sevayā]]---by service; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇāḥ]]---complete; [[synonyms:k:kutaḥ]]---where; [[synonyms:a:anyat]]---other things; [[synonyms:k:kāla]]-[[synonyms:v:viplutam]]---which are lost in time.
translation: "My devotees, having fulfilled their desires by serving Me, do not accept the four kinds of salvation that are easily earned by such service. Why then should they accept any pleasures that are lost in the course of time?"
purport: This verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:9:4:67|(9.4.67)]] was spoken by the Lord in connection with the characteristics of Mahārāja Ambarīṣa. Merging into the existence of the Absolute is as temporary as living in the celestial kingdom. Both of them are controlled by time; neither position is permanent.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.209
description: The natural love of the gopīs is devoid of any trace of lust. It is faultless, bright and pure, like molten gold.
text:
> kama-gandha-hīna svābhāvika gopī-prema
> nirmala, ujjvala, śuddha yena dagdha hema
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]---without any scent of lust; [[synonyms:s:svābhāvika]]---natural; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---spotless; [[synonyms:u:ujjvala]]---blazing; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:d:dagdha]] [[synonyms:h:hema]]---molten gold.
translation: The natural love of the gopīs is devoid of any trace of lust. It is faultless, bright and pure, like molten gold.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.21-22
description: "If one cherishes pure loving devotion to Me, thinking of Me as his son, his friend or his beloved, regarding himself as great and considering Me his equal or inferior, I become subordinate to him.
text:
> mora putra, mora sakhā, mora prāṇa-pati
> ei-bhāve yei more kare śuddha-bhakti
>
> āpanāke baḍa māne, āmāre sama-hīna
> sei bhāve ha-i āmi tāhāra adhīna
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---son; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---friend; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pati]]---lord of life; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in this way; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---those who; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---pure devotion; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāke]]---himself; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---great; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---he regards; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---Me; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---equal; [[synonyms:h:hīna]]---or lower; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in that way; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---am; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---to him; [[synonyms:a:adhīna]]---subordinate.
translation: "If one cherishes pure loving devotion to Me, thinking of Me as his son, his friend or his beloved, regarding himself as great and considering Me his equal or inferior, I become subordinate to him.
purport:
In the //Caitanya-caritāmṛta// three kinds of devotional service are described-namely, //bhakti// (ordinary devotional service), //śuddha-bhakti// (pure devotional service) and //viddha-bhakti// (mixed devotional service).

When devotional service is executed with some material purpose, involving fruitive activities, mental speculations or mystic //yoga,// it is called mixed or adulterated devotional service. Besides //bhakti-yoga,// the //Bhagavad-gītā// also describes //karma-yoga, jñāna-yoga// and //dhyāna-yoga. Yoga// means linking with the Supreme Lord, which is possible only through devotion. Fruitive activities ending in devotional service, philosophical speculation ending in devotional service, and the practice of mysticism ending in devotional service are known respectively as //karma-yoga, jñāna-yoga// and //dhyāna-yoga.// But such devotional service is adulterated by the three kinds of material activities.

For those grossly engaged in identifying the body as the self, pious activity, or //karma-yoga,// is recommended. For those who identify the mind with the self, philosophical speculation, or //jñāna-yoga,// is recommended. But devotees standing on the spiritual platform have no need of such material conceptions of adulterated devotion. Adulterated devotional service does not directly aim for love of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore service performed strictly in conformity with the revealed scriptures is better than such //viddha-bhakti// because it is free from all kinds of material contamination. It is executed in Kṛṣṇa consciousness, solely to please the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

Those who are spontaneously devoted to the Lord and have no aims for material gain are called attracted devotees. They are spontaneously attracted to the service of the Lord, and they follow in the footsteps of self-realized souls. Their pure devotion (//śuddha-bhakti//), manifested from pure love of Godhead, surpasses the regulative principles of the authoritative scriptures. Sometimes loving ecstasy transcends regulative principles; such ecstasy, however, is completely on the spiritual platform and cannot be imitated. The regulative principles help ordinary devotees rise to the stage of perfect love of Godhead. Pure love for Kṛṣṇa is the perfection of pure devotion, and pure devotional service is identical with spontaneous devotional service.

Flawless execution of regulative principles is exhibited in the Vaikuṇṭha planets. By strictly executing these principles one can be elevated to the Vaikuṇṭha planets. But spontaneous pure loving service is found in Kṛṣṇaloka alone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.210
description: The gopīs are the helpers, teachers, friends, wives, dear disciples, confidantes and serving maids of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> kṛṣṇera sahāya, guru, bāndhava, preyasī
> gopikā hayena priyā śiṣyā, sakhī dāsī
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---helpers; [[synonyms:g:guru]]---teachers; [[synonyms:b:bāndhava]]---friends; [[synonyms:p:preyasī]]---wives; [[synonyms:g:gopikā]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:h:hayena]]---are; [[synonyms:p:priyā]]---dear; [[synonyms:ś:śiṣyā]]---students; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]---confidantes; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---servants.
translation: The gopīs are the helpers, teachers, friends, wives, dear disciples, confidantes and serving maids of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.211
description: "O Pārtha, I speak to you the truth. The gopīs are My helpers, teachers, disciples, servants, friends and consorts. I do not know what they are not to Me."
text:
> sahāyā guravaḥ śiṣyā
> bhujiṣyā bāndhavāḥ striyaḥ
> satyaṁ vadāmi te pārtha
> gopyaḥ kiṁ me bhavanti na
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahāyāḥ]]---helpers; [[synonyms:g:guravaḥ]]---teachers; [[synonyms:ś:śiṣyāḥ]]---students; [[synonyms:b:bhujiṣyāḥ]]---servants; [[synonyms:b:bāndhavāḥ]]---friends; [[synonyms:s:striyaḥ]]---wives; [[synonyms:s:satyam]]---truthfully; [[synonyms:v:vadāmi]]---I say; [[synonyms:t:te]]---unto you; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O Arjuna; [[synonyms:g:gopyaḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:m:me]]---for Me; [[synonyms:b:bhavanti]]---are; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not.
translation: "O Pārtha, I speak to you the truth. The gopīs are My helpers, teachers, disciples, servants, friends and consorts. I do not know what they are not to Me."
purport: This is a verse from the //Gopī-premāmṛta.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.212
description: The gopīs know Kṛṣṇa's desires, and they know how to render perfect loving service for His enjoyment. They perform their service expertly for the satisfaction of their beloved.
text:
> gopikā jānena kṛṣṇera manera vāñchita
> prema-sevā-paripāṭī, iṣṭa-samīhita
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopikā]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---know; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:manera]]---of the mind; [[synonyms:v:vāñchita]]---the desired object; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---of service in love; [[synonyms:p:paripāṭī]]---perfection; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:s:samīhita]]---achievement of the desired goal of life.
translation: The gopīs know Kṛṣṇa's desires, and they know how to render perfect loving service for His enjoyment. They perform their service expertly for the satisfaction of their beloved.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.213
description: "O Pārtha, the gopīs know My greatness, My loving service, respect for Me, and My mentality. Others cannot really know these."
text:
> man-māhātmyaṁ mat-saparyāṁ
> mac-chraddhāṁ man-mano-gatam
> jānanti gopikāḥ pārtha
> nānye jānanti tattvataḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:m:māhātmyam]]---My greatness; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:s:saparyām]]---My service; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:ś:śraddhām]]---respect for Me; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:g:gatam]]---the intention of My mind; [[synonyms:j:jānanti]]---they know; [[synonyms:g:gopikāḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O Arjuna; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:a:anye]]---others; [[synonyms:j:jānanti]]---know; [[synonyms:t:tattvataḥ]]---factually.
translation: "O Pārtha, the gopīs know My greatness, My loving service, respect for Me, and My mentality. Others cannot really know these."
purport: This verse was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa to Arjuna in the //Ādi Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.214
description: Among the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhikā is the foremost. She surpasses all in beauty, in good qualities, in good fortune and, above all, in love.
text:
> sei gopī-gaṇa-madhye uttamā rādhikā
> rūpe, guṇe, saubhāgye, preme sarvādhikā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---among; [[synonyms:u:uttamā]]---the highest; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---in beauty; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---in qualities; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgye]]---in good fortune; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:adhikā]]---above all.
translation: Among the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhikā is the foremost. She surpasses all in beauty, in good qualities, in good fortune and, above all, in love.
purport: Among all the //gopīs,// Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is the most exalted. She is the most beautiful, the most qualified, and above all the greatest lover of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.215
description: "Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is most dear to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Her bathing place [Rādhā-kuṇḍa] is  also dear to Him. Among all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is supermost and very dear to  Lord Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> yathā rādhā priyā viṣṇos
> tasyāḥ kuṇḍaṁ priyaṁ tathā
> sarva-gopīṣu saivaikā
> viṣṇor atyanta-vallabhā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---just as; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:priyā]]---very dear; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇoḥ]]---to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tasyāḥ]]---Her; [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍam]]---bathing place; [[synonyms:p:priyam]]---very dear; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---so also; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:g:gopīṣu]]---among all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---She; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---alone; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇoḥ]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]-[[synonyms:v:vallabhā]]---most dear.
translation: "Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is most dear to Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Her bathing place [Rādhā-kuṇḍa] is  also dear to Him. Among all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is supermost and very dear to  Lord Kṛṣṇa."
purport: This verse is from the //Padma Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.216
description: "O Pārtha, in all the three planetary systems, this earth is especially fortunate, for on earth is the town of Vṛndāvana. And there the gopīs are especially glorious because among them is My Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."
text:
> trai-lokye pṛthivī dhanyā
> yatra vṛndāvanaṁ purī
> tatrāpi gopikāḥ pārtha
> yatra rādhābhidhā mama
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:trai]]-[[synonyms:l:lokye]]---in the three worlds; [[synonyms:p:pṛthivī]]---the earth; [[synonyms:d:dhanyā]]---fortunate; [[synonyms:y:yatra]]---where; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanam]]---Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:purī]]---the town; [[synonyms:t:tatra]]---there; [[synonyms:a:api]]---certainly; [[synonyms:g:gopikāḥ]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:p:pārtha]]---O Arjuna; [[synonyms:y:yatra]]---where; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:a:abhidhā]]---named; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---My.
translation: "O Pārtha, in all the three planetary systems, this earth is especially fortunate, for on earth is the town of Vṛndāvana. And there the gopīs are especially glorious because among them is My Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."
purport: This verse, spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa to Arjuna, is cited from the //Ādi Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.217
description: All the other gopīs help increase the joy of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes with Rādhārāṇī. The gopīs act as the instruments of Their mutual enjoyment.
text:
> rādhā-saha krīḍā rasa-vṛddhira kāraṇa
> āra saba gopī-gaṇa rasopakaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of mellow; [[synonyms:v:vṛddhira]]---of the increase; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---the cause; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---the other; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---//gopīs//; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:u:upakaraṇa]]---accessories of mellow.
translation: All the other gopīs help increase the joy of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes with Rādhārāṇī. The gopīs act as the instruments of Their mutual enjoyment.
purport: It is said that the //gopīs// are divided into five groups, namely the //sakhīs, nitya-sakhīs, prāṇa-sakhīs, priya-sakhīs// and //parama-preṣṭha-sakhīs.// All these fair-complexioned associates of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, the Queen of Vṛndāvana-dhāma, are expert artists in evoking erotic sentiments in Kṛṣṇa. The //parama-preṣṭha-sakhīs// are eight in number, and in the ecstatic dealings of Kṛṣṇa and Rādhā they side sometimes with Kṛṣṇa and at other times with Rādhārāṇī, just to create a situation in which it appears that they favor one against the other. That makes the exchange of mellows more palatable.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.218
description: Rādhā is the beloved consort of Kṛṣṇa, and She is the wealth of His life. Without Her, the gopīs cannot give Him pleasure.
text:
> kṛṣṇera vallabhā rādhā kṛṣṇa-prāṇa-dhana
> tāṅhā vinu sukha-hetu nahe gopī-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vallabhā]]---beloved; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of the life of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---Her; [[synonyms:v:vinu]]---without; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:h:hetu]]---cause of happiness; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---are not; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //gopīs.//
translation: Rādhā is the beloved consort of Kṛṣṇa, and She is the wealth of His life. Without Her, the gopīs cannot give Him pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.219
description: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa, left aside the other gopīs during the rāsa dance and took Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to His heart, for She is the helper of the Lord in realizing the essence of His desires."
text:
> kaṁsārir api saṁsāra-
> vāsanā-baddha-śṛṅkhalām
> rādhām ādhāya hṛdaye
> tatyāja vraja-sundarīḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaṁsa]]-[[synonyms:a:ariḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa; [[synonyms:a:api]]---moreover; [[synonyms:s:saṁsāra]]---for the essence of enjoyment (//rāsa-līlā//); [[synonyms:v:vāsanā]]---by the desire; [[synonyms:b:baddha]]---tied on; [[synonyms:ś:śṛṅkhalām]]---who was like the chains; [[synonyms:r:rādhām]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ā:ādhāya]]---taking; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:t:tatyāja]]---left aside; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:s:sundarīḥ]]---the other //gopīs.//
translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the enemy of Kaṁsa, left aside the other gopīs during the rāsa dance and took Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to His heart, for She is the helper of the Lord in realizing the essence of His desires."
purport: In this verse from the //Gīta-govinda// (3.1), Jayadeva Gosvāmī describes Śrī Kṛṣṇa's leaving the //rāsa-līlā// to search for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.220
description: Lord Caitanya appeared with the sentiment of Rādhā. He preached the dharma of this age—the chanting of the holy name and pure love of God.
text:
> sei rādhāra bhāva lañā caitanyāvatāra
> yuga-dharma nāma-prema kaila paracāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---the emotion; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---the incarnation; [[synonyms:y:yuga]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---the religion of the age; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---the holy name and love of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:paracāra]]---preaching.
translation: Lord Caitanya appeared with the sentiment of Rādhā. He preached the dharma of this age---the chanting of the holy name and pure love of God.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.221
description: In the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, He also fulfilled His own desires. This is the principal reason for His appearance.
text:
> sei bhāve nija-vāñchā karila pūraṇa
> avatārera ei vāñchā mūla-kāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the mood; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---His own desires; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:pūraṇa]]---fulfilling; [[synonyms:a:avatārera]]---of the incarnation; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:m:mūla]]---root; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---cause.
translation: In the mood of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, He also fulfilled His own desires. This is the principal reason for His appearance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.222
description: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is Kṛṣṇa [Vrajendra-kumāra], the embodiment of rasas. He is amorous love personified.
text:
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya gosāñi vrajendra-kumāra
> rasa-maya-mūrti kṛṣṇa sākṣāt śṛṅgāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:k:kumāra]]---the child of King Nanda; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---consisting of mellows; [[synonyms:m:mūrti]]---the form; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]---directly; [[synonyms:ś:śṛṅgāra]]---amorous love.
translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is Kṛṣṇa [Vrajendra-kumāra], the embodiment of rasas. He is amorous love personified.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.223
description: He made His appearance to taste that conjugal mellow and incidentally to broadcast all the rasas.
text:
> sei rasa āsvādite kaila avatāra
> ānusaṅge kaila saba rasera pracāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---mellow; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---incarnation; [[synonyms:ā:ānusaṅge]]---as a secondary motive; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellows; [[synonyms:p:pracāra]]---broadcasting.
translation: He made His appearance to taste that conjugal mellow and incidentally to broadcast all the rasas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.224
description: "My dear friends, just see how Śrī Kṛṣṇa is enjoying the season of spring! With the gopīs embracing each of His limbs, He is like amorous love personified. With His transcendental pastimes, He enlivens all the gopīs and the entire creation. With His soft bluish-black arms and legs, which resemble blue lotus flowers, He has created a festival for Cupid."
text:
> viśveṣām anurañjanena janayann ānandam indīvara-
> śreṇī-śyāmala-komalair upanayann aṅgair anaṅgotsavam
> svacchandaṁ vraja-sundarībhir abhitaḥ praty-aṅgam āliṅgitaḥ
> śṛṅgāraḥ sakhi mūrtimān iva madhau mugdho hariḥ krīḍati
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśveṣām]]---of all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:a:anurañjanena]]---by the act of pleasing; [[synonyms:j:janayan]]---producing; [[synonyms:ā:ānandam]]---the bliss; [[synonyms:i:indīvara]]-[[synonyms:ś:śreṇī]]---like a row of blue lotuses; [[synonyms:ś:śyāmala]]---bluish black; [[synonyms:k:komalaiḥ]]---and soft; [[synonyms:u:upanayan]]---bringing; [[synonyms:a:aṅgaiḥ]]---with His limbs; [[synonyms:a:anaṅga]]-[[synonyms:u:utsavam]]---a festival for Cupid; [[synonyms:s:svacchandam]]---without restriction; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:s:sundarībhiḥ]]---by the young women of Vraja; [[synonyms:a:abhitaḥ]]---on both sides; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅgam]]---each limb; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgitaḥ]]---embraced; [[synonyms:ś:śṛṅgāraḥ]]---amorous love; [[synonyms:ś:śakhi]]---O friend; [[synonyms:m:mūrtimān]]---embodied; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:m:madhau]]---in the springtime; [[synonyms:m:mugdhaḥ]]---perplexed; [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]]---Lord Hari; [[synonyms:k:krīḍati]]---plays.
translation: "My dear friends, just see how Śrī Kṛṣṇa is enjoying the season of spring! With the gopīs embracing each of His limbs, He is like amorous love personified. With His transcendental pastimes, He enlivens all the gopīs and the entire creation. With His soft bluish-black arms and legs, which resemble blue lotus flowers, He has created a festival for Cupid."
purport: This is a verse from Jayadeva Gosvāmī's //Gīta-govinda// (1.11).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.225
description: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the abode of rasa. He Himself tasted the sweetness of rasa in endless ways.
text:
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya gosāñi rasera sadana
> aśeṣa-viśeṣe kaila rasa āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of mellow; [[synonyms:s:sadana]]---the residence; [[synonyms:a:aśeṣa]]-[[synonyms:v:viśeṣe]]---unlimited varieties of enjoyment; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---mellow; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tasting.
translation: Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya is the abode of rasa. He Himself tasted the sweetness of rasa in endless ways.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.226
description: Thus He initiated the dharma for the Age of Kali. The devotees of Lord Caitanya know all these truths.
text:
> sei dvāre pravartāila kali-yuga-dharma
> caitanyera dāse jāne ei saba marma
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---in that way; [[synonyms:p:pravartāila]]---He initiated; [[synonyms:k:kali]]-[[synonyms:y:yuga]]---of the Age of Kali; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---the religion; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dāse]]---the servant; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:m:marma]]---secrets.
translation: Thus He initiated the dharma for the Age of Kali. The devotees of Lord Caitanya know all these truths.
purport: Lord Caitanya is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Himself, the absolute enjoyer of the love of the //gopīs.// He Himself assumes the role of the //gopīs// to taste the predominated happiness of transcendental mellows. He appeared in that mode, but simultaneously He propagated the religious process for this age in a most fascinating way. Only the confidential devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand this transcendental secret.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.227-228
description: Bowing down with devotion, I hold on my head the lotus feet of Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Murāri Gupta, Haridāsa and all the other devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya..
text:
> advaita ācārya, nityānanda, śrīnivāsa
> gadādhara, dāmodara, murāri, haridāsa
> āra yata caitanya-kṛṣṇera bhakta-gaṇa
> bhakti-bhāve śire dhari sabāra caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]] [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:ś:śrīnivāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---with a devotional attitude; [[synonyms:ś:śire]]---on my head; [[synonyms:d:dhari]]---I take; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet.
translation: Bowing down with devotion, I hold on my head the lotus feet of Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda, Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita, Gadādhara, Svarūpa Dāmodara, Murāri Gupta, Haridāsa and all the other devotees of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya..
purport: The author of //Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta// teaches us that we must offer our respectful obeisances to all such pure confidential devotees of Lord Caitanya if we indeed want to know Him in truth.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.229
description: I have given a hint of the sixth verse. Now please hear as I reveal the meaning of that original verse.
text:
> ṣaṣṭha-ślokera ei kahila ābhāsa
> mūla ślokera artha śuna kariye prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the sixth verse; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---has been spoken; [[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---a hint; [[synonyms:m:mūla]] [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the original verse; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:k:kariye]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---I am revealing.
translation: I have given a hint of the sixth verse. Now please hear as I reveal the meaning of that original verse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.23
description: " 'Devotional service rendered to Me by the living beings revives their eternal life. O My dear damsels of Vraja, your affection for Me is your good fortune, for it is the only means by which you have obtained My favor.'
text:
> mayi bhaktir hi bhūtānām
> amṛtatvāya kalpate
> diṣṭyā yad āsīn mat-sneho
> bhavatīnāṁ mad-āpanaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mayi]]---to Me; [[synonyms:b:bhaktiḥ]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhūtānām]]---of the living beings; [[synonyms:a:amṛtatvāya]]---the eternal life; [[synonyms:k:kalpate]]---brings about; [[synonyms:d:diṣṭyā]]---by good fortune; [[synonyms:y:yat]]---which; [[synonyms:ā:āsīt]]---was; [[synonyms:m:mat]]---for Me; [[synonyms:s:snehaḥ]]---the affection; [[synonyms:b:bhavatīnām]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:m:mat]]---of Me; [[synonyms:ā:āpanaḥ]]---the obtaining.
translation: “ 'Devotional service rendered to Me by the living beings revives their eternal life. O My dear damsels of Vraja, your affection for Me is your good fortune, for it is the only means by which you have obtained My favor.'
purport: Pure devotional service is represented in the activities of the residents of Vrajabhūmi (Vṛndāvana). During a solar eclipse, the Lord came from Dvārakā and met the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana at Samanta-pañcaka. The meeting was intensely painful for the damsels of Vrajabhūmi because Lord Kṛṣṇa had apparently left them to reside at Dvārakā. But the Lord obligingly acknowledged the pure devotional service of the damsels of Vraja by speaking this verse (//Bhāg.// 10.82.44).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.230
description: "Desiring to understand the glory of Rādhārāṇī's love, the wonderful qualities in Him that She alone relishes through Her love, and the happiness She feels when She realizes the sweetness of His love, the Supreme Lord Hari, richly endowed with Her emotions, appeared from the womb of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, as the moon appeared from the ocean."
text:
> śrī-rādhāyāḥ praṇaya-mahimā kīdṛśo vānayaivā-
> svādyo yenādbhuta-madhurimā kīdṛśo vā madīyaḥ
> saukhyaṁ cāsyā mad-anubhavataḥ kīdṛśaṁ veti lobhāt
> tad-bhāvāḍhyaḥ samajani śacī-garbha-sindhau harīnduḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rādhāyāḥ]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]-[[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the greatness of the love; [[synonyms:k:kīdrśaḥ]]---of what kind; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:a:anayā]]---by this one (Rādhā); [[synonyms:e:eva]]---alone; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādyaḥ]]---to be relished; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---by that love; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]-[[synonyms:m:madhurimā]]---the wonderful sweetness; [[synonyms:k:kīdṛśaḥ]]---of what kind; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:m:madīyaḥ]]---of Me; [[synonyms:s:saukhyam]]---the happiness; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:a:asyāḥ]]---Her; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:a:anubhavataḥ]]---from realization of My sweetness; [[synonyms:k:kīdṛśam]]---of what kind; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:l:lobhāt]]---from the desire; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---Her; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āḍhyaḥ]]---richly endowed with the emotions; [[synonyms:s:samajani]]---took birth; [[synonyms:ś:śacī]]-[[synonyms:g:garbha]]---of the womb of Śacīdevī; [[synonyms:s:sindhau]]---in the ocean; [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:i:induḥ]]---like the moon.
translation: "Desiring to understand the glory of Rādhārāṇī's love, the wonderful qualities in Him that She alone relishes through Her love, and the happiness She feels when She realizes the sweetness of His love, the Supreme Lord Hari, richly endowed with Her emotions, appeared from the womb of Śrīmatī Śacīdevī, as the moon appeared from the ocean."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.231
description: All these conclusions are unfit to disclose in public. But if they are not disclosed, no one will understand them.
text:
> e saba siddhānta gūḍha,---kahite nā yuyāya
> nā kahile, keha ihāra anta nāhi pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---conclusions; [[synonyms:g:gūḍha]]---very confidential; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---to speak; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yuyāya]]---quite fit; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kahile]]---speaking; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of it; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---end; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets.
translation: All these conclusions are unfit to disclose in public. But if they are not disclosed, no one will understand them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.232
description: Therefore I shall mention them, revealing only their essence, so that loving devotees will understand them but fools will not.
text:
> ataeva kahi kichu kariñā nigūḍha
> bujhibe rasika bhakta, nā bujhibe mūḍha
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---I speak; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kariñā]]---squeezing; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---essence; [[synonyms:b:bujhibe]]---can understand; [[synonyms:r:rasika]]---humorous; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:b:bujhibe]]---will understand; [[synonyms:m:mūḍha]]---rascals.
translation: Therefore I shall mention them, revealing only their essence, so that loving devotees will understand them but fools will not.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.233
description: Anyone who has captured Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in his heart will become blissful by hearing all these transcendental conclusions.
text:
> hṛdaye dharaye ye caitanya-nityānanda
> e-saba siddhānte sei pāibe ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:d:dharaye]]---captures; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---and Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:s:siddhānte]]---by transcendental conclusions; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that man; [[synonyms:p:pāibe]]---will get; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---bliss.
translation: Anyone who has captured Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu in his heart will become blissful by hearing all these transcendental conclusions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.234
description: All these conclusions are like the newly grown twigs of a mango tree; they are always pleasing to the devotees, who in this way resemble cuckoo birds.
text:
> e saba siddhānta haya āmrera pallava
> bhakta-gaṇa-kokilera sarvadā vallabha
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---transcendental conclusions; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:ā:āmrera]]---of mango; [[synonyms:p:pallava]]---twigs; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kokilera]]---to those who are just like cuckoo birds; [[synonyms:s:sarvadā]]---always; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]---pleasing.
translation: All these conclusions are like the newly grown twigs of a mango tree; they are always pleasing to the devotees, who in this way resemble cuckoo birds.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.235
description: The camellike nondevotees cannot enter into these topics. Therefore there is special jubilation in my heart.
text:
> abhakta-uṣṭrera ithe nā haya praveśa
> tabe citte haya mora ānanda-viśeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:abhakta]]---nondevotee; [[synonyms:u:uṣṭrera]]---of a camel; [[synonyms:i:ithe]]---in this; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is there; [[synonyms:p:praveśa]]---entrance; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---special jubilation.
translation: The camellike nondevotees cannot enter into these topics. Therefore there is special jubilation in my heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.236
description: For fear of them I do not wish to speak, but if they do not understand, then what can be happier in all the three worlds?
text:
> ye lāgi kahite bhaya, se yadi nā jāne
> ihā va-i kibā sukha āche tribhuvane
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi]]---for the matter of which; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---afraid to speak; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:y:yadi]] [[synonyms:n:nājāne]]---if they do not know; [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:v:va]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---except this; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---what; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there is; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvane]]---in the three worlds.
translation: For fear of them I do not wish to speak, but if they do not understand, then what can be happier in all the three worlds?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.237
description: Therefore after offering obeisances to the devotees, for their satisfaction I shall speak without hesitating.
text:
> ataeva bhakta-gaṇe kari namaskāra
> nihśaṅke kahiye, tāra hauk camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I offer; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---obeisances; [[synonyms:n:niḥśaṅke]]---without any doubt; [[synonyms:k:kahiye]]---I say; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:h:hauk]]---let there be; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment.
translation: Therefore after offering obeisances to the devotees, for their satisfaction I shall speak without hesitating.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.238
description: Once Lord Kṛṣṇa considered within His heart, "Everyone says that I am complete bliss, full of all rasas.
text:
> kṛṣṇera vicara eka āchaye antare
> pūrṇānanda-pūrṇa-rasa-rūpa kahe more
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---consideration; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ā:āchaye]]---is; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---complete transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---full with transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:m:more]]---they say unto Me.
translation: Once Lord Kṛṣṇa considered within His heart, "Everyone says that I am complete bliss, full of all rasas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.239
description: "All the world derives pleasure from Me. Is there anyone who can give Me pleasure?
text:
> āmā ha-ite ānandita haya tribhuvana
> āmāke ānanda dibe---aiche kon jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from Me; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---pleased; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---all the three worlds; [[synonyms:ā:āmāke]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---will give pleasure; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---what person.
translation: "All the world derives pleasure from Me. Is there anyone who can give Me pleasure?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.24
description: "Mother sometimes binds Me as her son. She nourishes and protects Me, thinking Me utterly helpless.
text:
> mātā more putra-bhāve karena bandhana
> atihīna-jñāne kare lālana pālana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:p:putra]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the position of a son; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bandhana]]---binding; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---in thinking very poor; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:l:lālana]]---nourishing; [[synonyms:p:pālana]]---protecting.
translation: "Mother sometimes binds Me as her son. She nourishes and protects Me, thinking Me utterly helpless.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.240
description: "One who has a hundred times more qualities than Me could give pleasure to My mind.
text:
> āmā haite yāra haya śata śata guṇa
> sei-jana āhlādite pāre mora mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than Me; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---hundreds of qualities more; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---that person; [[synonyms:ā:āhlādite]]---to give pleasure; [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---is able; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---to the mind.
translation: "One who has a hundred times more qualities than Me could give pleasure to My mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.241
description: "One more qualified than Me is impossible to find in the world. But in Rādhā alone I feel the presence of one who can give Me pleasure.
text:
> āmā haite guṇī baḍa jagate asambhava
> ekali rādhāte tāhā kari anubhava
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than Me; [[synonyms:g:guṇī]]---qualified; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---greater; [[synonyms:j:jagate]]---in the world; [[synonyms:a:asambhava]]---there is no possibility; [[synonyms:e:ekali]]---only; [[synonyms:r:rādhāte]]---in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:a:anubhava]]---I can understand.
translation: "One more qualified than Me is impossible to find in the world. But in Rādhā alone I feel the presence of one who can give Me pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.242-243
description: "Although My beauty defeats the beauty of ten million Cupids, although it is unequaled and unsurpassed and although it gives pleasure to the three worlds, seeing Rādhārāṇī gives pleasure to My eyes.
text:
> koṭi-kāma jini' rūpa yadyapi āmāra
> asamordhva-mādhurya---sāmya nāhi yāra
>
> mora rūpe āpyāyita haya tribhuvana
> rādhāra darśane mora juḍāya nayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:k:kāma]]---ten million Cupids; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---beauty; [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---Mine; [[synonyms:a:asama]]-[[synonyms:ū:ūrdhva]]---unequaled and unsurpassed; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:s:sāmya]]---equality; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---in beauty; [[synonyms:ā:āpyāyita]]---pleased; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---all three worlds; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]]---satisfies; [[synonyms:n:nayana]]---eyes.
translation: "Although My beauty defeats the beauty of ten million Cupids, although it is unequaled and unsurpassed and although it gives pleasure to the three worlds, seeing Rādhārāṇī gives pleasure to My eyes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.244
description: "The vibration of My transcendental flute attracts the three worlds, but My ears are enchanted by the sweet words of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
text:
> mora vaṁśī-gīte ākarṣaye tri-bhuvana
> rādhāra vacane hare āmāra śravaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]-[[synonyms:g:gīte]]---by the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:ā:ākarṣaye]]---I attract; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---the three worlds; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---the words of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---conquers; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---hearing power.
translation: "The vibration of My transcendental flute attracts the three worlds, but My ears are enchanted by the sweet words of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Ādi-līlā 4.245
description: "Although My body lends fragrance to the entire creation, the scent of Rādhārāṇī's limbs captivates My mind and heart.
text:
> yadyapi āmāra gandhe jagat sugandha
> mora citta-prāṇa hare rādhā-aṅga-gandha
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:g:gandhe]]---by the fragrance; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the whole universe; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]---sweet-smelling; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:c:citta]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---mind and heart; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attracts; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---bodily; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---flavor.
