title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.236
description: The two persons who accompanied Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] were Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Dāmodara Paṇḍita.
text:
> balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya, āra paṇḍita dāmodara
> dui-jana-saṅge prabhu āilā nīlācala
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:balabhadra]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---of the name Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Dāmodara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---went back; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]]---to Jagannātha Purī.
translation: The two persons who accompanied Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] were Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya and Dāmodara Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.237
description: After remaining at Jagannātha Purī for a few days, the Lord secretly started for Vṛndāvana at night. He did this without anyone's knowledge.
text:
> dina kata tāhāṅ rahi' calilā vṛndāvana
> lukāñā calilā rātre, nā jāne kona jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:k:kata]]---a few days; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---started; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---for Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:l:lukāñā]]---keeping secret; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---started; [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---did not know; [[synonyms:k:kona]]---some; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---person.
translation: After remaining at Jagannātha Purī for a few days, the Lord secretly started for Vṛndāvana at night. He did this without anyone's knowledge.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.238
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left Jagannātha Purī for Vṛndāvana, only Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya was with Him. Thus He traveled on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa and arrived in Benares with great delight.
text:
> balabhadra bhaṭṭācārya rahe mātra saṅge
> jhārikhaṇḍa-pathe kāśī āilā mahā-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:balabhadra]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---of the name Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Him; [[synonyms:j:jhāri]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the way through Jhārikhaṇḍa (Madhya Pradesh); [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]---in Benares; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---with great delight.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left Jagannātha Purī for Vṛndāvana, only Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya was with Him. Thus He traveled on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa and arrived in Benares with great delight.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.239
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Benares only four days and then left for Vṛndāvana. After seeing the town of Mathurā, He visited the twelve forests.
text:
> dina cāra kāśīte rahi' gelā vṛndāvana
> mathurā dekhiyā dekhe dvādaśa kānana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dinacāra]]---only four days; [[synonyms:k:kāśīte]]---at Benares; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---started for; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---the holy place Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]---the holy place Mathurā; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after seeing; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---visits; [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]]---twelve; [[synonyms:k:kānana]]---forests.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Benares only four days and then left for Vṛndāvana. After seeing the town of Mathurā, He visited the twelve forests.
purport: Those who visit the Vṛndāvana area today also generally visit twelve places, known as the twelve forests. They start at Mathurā, where there is Kāmya-vana. From there they go to Tāla-vana, Tamāla-vana, Madhu-vana, Kusuma-vana, Bhāṇḍīra-vana, Bilva-vana, Bhadra-vana, Khadira-vana, Loha-vana, Kumuda-vana and Gokula-mahāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.24
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Nityānanda Prabhu from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, which was known as Gauḍa-deśa, and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu overflooded this country with the transcendental loving service of the Lord.
text:
> nityānanda-gosāñire pāṭhāila gauḍa-deśe
> teṅho gauḍa-deśa bhāsāila prema-rase
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---Nityānanda Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśa]]---the tract of land known as Gauḍa-deśa, or Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhāsāila]]---overflooded; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:r:rase]]---with ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Nityānanda Prabhu from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, which was known as Gauḍa-deśa, and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu overflooded this country with the transcendental loving service of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.240
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited all twelve places of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, He became very agitated because of ecstasy. Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya somehow or other got Him out of Mathurā.
text:
> līlā-sthala dekhi' preme ha-ilā asthira
> balabhadra kaila tāṅre mathurāra bāhira
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthala]]---all the holy places of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---visiting; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:a:asthira]]---agitated; [[synonyms:b:balabhadra]]---of the name Balabhadra; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---assisted; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mathurāra]]---of the town of Mathurā; [[synonyms:b:bāhira]]---outside.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited all twelve places of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, He became very agitated because of ecstasy. Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya somehow or other got Him out of Mathurā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.241
description: After leaving Mathurā, the Lord began to walk along a path on the bank of the Ganges, and finally He reached the holy place named Prayāga [Allahabad]. It was there that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met the Lord.
text:
> gaṅgā-tīra-pathe lañā prayāge āilā
> śrī-rūpa āsi' prabhuke tathāi mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīra]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---the path on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prayāge]]---in Allahabad; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---of the name Śrī Rūpa; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming there; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---there; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: After leaving Mathurā, the Lord began to walk along a path on the bank of the Ganges, and finally He reached the holy place named Prayāga [Allahabad]. It was there that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.242
description: At Prayāga, Rūpa Gosvāmī fell down on the ground to offer obeisances to the Lord, and the Lord embraced him with great delight.
text:
> daṇḍavat kari' rūpa bhūmite paḍilā
> parama ānande prabhu āliṅgana dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhūmite]]---on the ground; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell; [[synonyms:p:parama]]---great; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in delight; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave.
translation: At Prayāga, Rūpa Gosvāmī fell down on the ground to offer obeisances to the Lord, and the Lord embraced him with great delight.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.243
description: After instructing Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Prayāga at the Daśāśvamedha-ghāṭa, Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered him to go to Vṛndāvana. The Lord then returned to Vārāṇasī.
text:
> śrī-rūpe śikṣā karāi' pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana
> āpane karilā vārāṇasī āgamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpe]] [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karāi']]---teaching Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---toward Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---Himself; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]]---to Benares; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---coming.
translation: After instructing Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī at Prayāga at the Daśāśvamedha-ghāṭa, Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered him to go to Vṛndāvana. The Lord then returned to Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.244
description: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Vārāṇasī, Sanātana Gosvāmī met Him there. The Lord remained there for two months and instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī perfectly.
text:
> kāśīte prabhuke āsi' mililā sanātana
> dui māsa rahi' tāṅre karāilā śikṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśīte]]---at Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---arriving; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---of the name Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:m:māsa]]---months; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---did; [[synonyms:ś:śikṣaṇa]]---instruction.
translation: When Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at Vārāṇasī, Sanātana Gosvāmī met Him there. The Lord remained there for two months and instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī perfectly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.245
description: After fully instructing Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent him to Mathurā with empowered devotional service. In Benares He also bestowed His mercy upon the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs. He then returned to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].
text:
> mathurā pāṭhāilā tāṅre diyā bhakti-bala
> sannyāsīre kṛpā kari' gelā nīlācala
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]---to Mathurā; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:b:bala]]---the strength of devotion; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīre]]---unto the Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---giving; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went back; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]]---to Jagannātha Purī.
translation: After fully instructing Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent him to Mathurā with empowered devotional service. In Benares He also bestowed His mercy upon the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs. He then returned to Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.246
description: The Lord traveled all over India for six years. He was sometimes here and sometimes there performing His transcendental pastimes, and sometimes He remained at Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> chaya vatsara aiche prabhu karilā vilāsa
> kabhu iti-uti, kabhu kṣetra-vāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chayavatsara]]---six years; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in that way; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:kṣetra]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---residing at Jagannātha Purī.
translation: The Lord traveled all over India for six years. He was sometimes here and sometimes there performing His transcendental pastimes, and sometimes He remained at Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.247
description: While at Jagannātha Purī, the Lord passed His time in great joy by performing saṅkīrtana and visiting the temple of Jagannātha in great ecstasy.
text:
> ānande bhakta-saṅge sadā kīrtana-vilāsa
> jagannātha-daraśana, premera vilāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great delight; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with devotees; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---of chanting; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---enjoyment; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visiting; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of ecstasy; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes.
translation: While at Jagannātha Purī, the Lord passed His time in great joy by performing saṅkīrtana and visiting the temple of Jagannātha in great ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.248
description: Thus I have given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā, the middle pastimes of the Lord. Now, O devotees, kindly hear the synopsis of the final pastimes of the Lord, known as antya-līlā.
text:
> madhya-līlāra kailuṅ ei sūtra-vivaraṇa
> antya-līlāra sūtra ebe śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the //madhya-līlā,// the middle portion of His pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---I have made; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sūtra]]---synopsis; [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---description; [[synonyms:a:antya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the pastimes at the end, known as //antya-līlā//; [[synonyms:s:sūtra]]---synopsis; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all devotees.
translation: Thus I have given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā, the middle pastimes of the Lord. Now, O devotees, kindly hear the synopsis of the final pastimes of the Lord, known as antya-līlā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.249
description: When the Lord returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, He remained there and did not go anywhere else for eighteen years.
text:
> vṛndāvana haite yadi nīlācale āilā
> āṭhāra varṣa tāhāṅ vāsa, kāhāṅ nāhi gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---though; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back; [[synonyms:ā:āṭhāra]]---eighteen; [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]---years; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---residence; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went.
translation: When the Lord returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana, He remained there and did not go anywhere else for eighteen years.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.25
description: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu is by nature very much inspired in rendering transcendental loving service to Lord Kṛṣṇa. Now, being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He distributed this loving service anywhere and everywhere.
text:
> sahajei nityānanda---kṛṣṇa-premoddāma
> prabhu-ājñāya kaila yāhāṅ tāhāṅ prema-dāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahajei]]---by nature; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:u:uddāma]]---very much inspired in transcendental loving service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---by the order of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---anywhere and everywhere; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dāna]]---distribution of that love.
translation: Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu is by nature very much inspired in rendering transcendental loving service to Lord Kṛṣṇa. Now, being ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He distributed this loving service anywhere and everywhere.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.250
description: During those eighteen years, all the devotees of Bengal used to visit Him at Jagannātha Purī every year. They would remain there for four continuous months and enjoy the company of the Lord.
text:
> prativarṣa āisena tāhāṅ gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa
> cāri māsa rahe prabhura saṅge sammilana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prativarṣa]]---each year; [[synonyms:ā:āisena]]---visit; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four; [[synonyms:m:māsa]]---months; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:s:sammilana]]---meeting.
translation: During those eighteen years, all the devotees of Bengal used to visit Him at Jagannātha Purī every year. They would remain there for four continuous months and enjoy the company of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.251
description: At Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed chanting and dancing unceasingly. Thus He enjoyed the pastime of saṅkīrtana. He manifested His causeless mercy, pure love of God, to everyone, including the lowest man.
text:
> nirantara nṛtya-gīta kīrtana-vilāsa
> ācaṇḍāle prema-bhakti karilā prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---without stopping; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---of //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---enjoyment; [[synonyms:ā:ā]]-[[synonyms:c:caṇḍāle]]---to everyone, even to the lowest person; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---love of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---manifestation.
translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed chanting and dancing unceasingly. Thus He enjoyed the pastime of saṅkīrtana. He manifested His causeless mercy, pure love of God, to everyone, including the lowest man.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.252
description: Residing with the Lord at Jagannātha Purī were Paṇḍita Gosāñi and other devotees, such as Vakreśvara, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> paṇḍita-gosāñi kaila nīlācale vāsa
> vakreśvara, dāmodara, śaṅkara, haridāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---living; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---of the name Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Dāmodara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---of the name Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: Residing with the Lord at Jagannātha Purī were Paṇḍita Gosāñi and other devotees, such as Vakreśvara, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.253
description: Jagadānanda, Bhagavān, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara were other devotees who also lived with the Lord.
text:
> jagadānanda, bhagavān, govinda, kāsīśvara
> paramānanda-purī, āra svarūpa-dāmodara
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---of the name Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---of the name Bhagavān; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---of the name Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kāsīśvara]]---of the name Kāsīśvara; [[synonyms:p:paramānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---of the name Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---and Svarūpa Dāmodara, His secretary.
translation: Jagadānanda, Bhagavān, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Paramānanda Purī and Svarūpa Dāmodara were other devotees who also lived with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.254
description: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya and other devotees who were residents of Jagannātha Purī also remained permanently with the Lord.
text:
> kṣetra-vāsī rāmānanda rāya prabhṛti
> prabhu-saṅge ei saba kaila nitya-sthiti
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣetra]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---residents of Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---of the name Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:p:prabhṛti]]---and others; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the Lord; [[synonyms:e:eisaba]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]-[[synonyms:s:sthiti]]---permanently living.
translation: Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya and other devotees who were residents of Jagannātha Purī also remained permanently with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.255-256
description: Other devotees of the Lord-headed by Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Mukunda, Śrīvāsa, Vidyānidhi, Vāsudeva and Murāri-used to visit Jagannātha Purī and remain with the Lord for four continuous months. The Lord enjoyed various pastimes in their company.
text:
> advaita, nityānanda, mukunda, śrīvāsa
> vidyānidhi, vāsudeva, murāri,---yata dāsa
> prativarṣe āise saṅge rahe cāri-māsa
> tāṅ-sabā lañā prabhura vividha vilāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---of the name Advaita; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---of the name Nityānanda; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]---of the name Mukunda; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---of the name Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:v:vidyānidhi]]---of the name Vidyānidhi; [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]---of the name Vāsudeva; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]---of the name Murāri; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---all servitors of the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prativarṣe]]---each year; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---go there; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in association; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---four months; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabā]]---all of them; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:v:vividha]]---various; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes.
translation: Other devotees of the Lord-headed by Advaita Ācārya, Nityānanda Prabhu, Mukunda, Śrīvāsa, Vidyānidhi, Vāsudeva and Murāri-used to visit Jagannātha Purī and remain with the Lord for four continuous months. The Lord enjoyed various pastimes in their company.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.257
description: At Jagannātha Purī, Haridāsa Ṭhākura passed away. The incident was very wonderful because the Lord Himself performed the festival of Ṭhākura Haridāsa's departure.
text:
> haridāsera siddhi-prāpti,---adbhuta se saba
> āpani mahāprabhu yāṅra kaila mahotsava
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Ṭhākura Haridāsa; [[synonyms:s:siddhi]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---passing away; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:s:se]]---those; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all incidents; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:u:utsava]]---festival.
translation: At Jagannātha Purī, Haridāsa Ṭhākura passed away. The incident was very wonderful because the Lord Himself performed the festival of Ṭhākura Haridāsa's departure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.258
description: At Jagannātha Purī Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord invested his heart with all transcendental power.
text:
> tabe rūpa-gosāñira punar-āgamana
> tāṅhāra hṛdaye kaila prabhu śakti-sañcāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]-[[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---again coming there; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]-[[synonyms:s:sañcāraṇa]]---invoking of transcendental power.
translation: At Jagannātha Purī Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord invested his heart with all transcendental power.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.259
description: After this, the Lord punished Junior Haridāsa, and Dāmodara Paṇḍita gave some warning to the Lord.
text:
> tabe choṭa haridāse prabhu kaila daṇḍa
> dāmodara-paṇḍita kaila prabhuke vākya-daṇḍa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:c:choṭa]] [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---unto Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---punishment; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---of the name Dāmodara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---unto the Lord; [[synonyms:v:vākya]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---chastisement as a warning.
translation: After this, the Lord punished Junior Haridāsa, and Dāmodara Paṇḍita gave some warning to the Lord.
purport: Actually Dāmodara Paṇḍita was the eternal servant of the Lord. He could not punish the Lord at any time, nor had he any desire to, but He did give some warning to the Lord so that others would not blaspheme Him. Of course, He should have known that the Lord is the Supreme Personality of Godhead and is free to act in any way. There is no need to warn Him, and such an action is not very much appreciated by advanced devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.26
description: I offer innumerable obeisances unto the lotus feet of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, who is so kind that He spread the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu all over the world.
text:
> tāṅhāra caraṇe mora koṭi namaskāra
> caitanyera bhakti yeṅho laoyāila saṁsāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---unto His lotus feet; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---obeisances; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---the devotional service; [[synonyms:y:yeṅho]]---one who; [[synonyms:l:laoyāila]]---caused to take; [[synonyms:s:saṁsāra]]---the whole world.
translation: I offer innumerable obeisances unto the lotus feet of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, who is so kind that He spread the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu all over the world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.260
description: Thereafter Sanātana Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord tested him in scorching heat during the month of Jyaiṣṭha.
text:
> tabe sanātana-gosāñira punar-āgamana
> jyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu tāṅre kaila parīkṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]-[[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---again coming; [[synonyms:j:jyaiṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---in the month of Jyaiṣṭha (May-June); [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣaṇa]]---examination.
translation: Thereafter Sanātana Gosvāmī met the Lord again, and the Lord tested him in scorching heat during the month of Jyaiṣṭha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.261
description: Being pleased, the Lord sent Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana. After that, He was fed wonderfully by the hands of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> tuṣṭa hañā prabhu tāṅre pāṭhāilā vṛndāvana
> advaitera haste prabhura adbhuta bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very much pleased; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent back; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:a:advaitera]]---of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:h:haste]]---in the hands; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---feasting.
translation: Being pleased, the Lord sent Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana. After that, He was fed wonderfully by the hands of Śrī Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.262
description: After sending Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana, the Lord privately consulted with Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. He then sent Him to Bengal to preach love of Godhead.
text:
> nityānanda-saṅge yukti kariyā nibhṛte
> tāṅre pāṭhāilā gauḍe prema pracārite
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:y:yukti]]---discussion; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making; [[synonyms:n:nibhṛte]]---in privacy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love of Godhead; [[synonyms:p:pracārite]]---to preach.
translation: After sending Sanātana Gosvāmī back to Vṛndāvana, the Lord privately consulted with Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu. He then sent Him to Bengal to preach love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.263
description: Soon afterward, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa met the Lord at Jagannātha Purī, and the Lord explained to him the import of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> tabe ta' vallabha bhaṭṭa prabhure mililā
> kṛṣṇa-nāmera artha prabhu tāṅhāre kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thereafter; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---of the name Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmera]]---of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---import; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---explained.
translation: Soon afterward, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa met the Lord at Jagannātha Purī, and the Lord explained to him the import of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
purport: This Vallabha Bhaṭṭa is the head of the Vaiṣṇava //sampradāya// known as the Vallabhācārya-sampradāya in western India. There is a long story about Vallabha Ācārya narrated in the //Caitanya-caritāmṛta,// specifically in the Seventh Chapter of //Antya-līlā// and the Nineteenth Chapter of //Madhya-līlā.// Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the house of Vallabha Ācārya on the other side of Prayāga, in a place known as Ādāila-grāma. Later, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī to explain his commentary on //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.// He was very proud of his writings, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu corrected him, telling him that a Vaiṣṇava should be humble and follow in the footsteps of his predecessors. The Lord told him that his pride in being superior to Śrīdhara Svāmī was not at all befitting a Vaiṣṇava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.264
description: After explaining the transcendental qualities of Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord sent Pradyumna Miśra to the residence of Rāmānanda Rāya, and Pradyumna Miśra learned kṛṣṇa-kathā from him.
text:
> pradyumna miśrere prabhu rāmānanda-sthāne
> kṛṣṇa-kathā śunāila kahi' tāṅra guṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]] [[synonyms:m:miśrere]]---of the name Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---at the place of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śunāila]]---caused to hear; [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---explaining; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---the transcendental qualities.
translation: After explaining the transcendental qualities of Rāmānanda Rāya, the Lord sent Pradyumna Miśra to the residence of Rāmānanda Rāya, and Pradyumna Miśra learned kṛṣṇa-kathā from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.265
description: After this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the younger brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, from being condemned to death by the King.
text:
> gopīnātha paṭṭanāyaka---rāmānanda-bhrātā
> rājā māritechila, prabhu haila trātā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthapaṭṭanāyaka]]---of the name Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:b:bhrātā]]---the brother of Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:m:māritechila]]---condemned to death; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:t:trātā]]---the deliverer.
translation: After this, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu saved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the younger brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, from being condemned to death by the King.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.266
description: Rāmacandra Purī criticized Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's eating; therefore the Lord reduced His eating to a minimum. However, when all the Vaiṣṇavas became very sorry, the Lord increased His portion to half as much as usual.
text:
> rāmacandra-purī-bhaye bhikṣā ghāṭāilā
> vaiṣṇavera duḥkha dekhi' ardheka rākhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---due to fear of Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]---the proportion of eating; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭāilā]]---decreased; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---understanding; [[synonyms:a:ardheka]]---half of the portion; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept.
translation: Rāmacandra Purī criticized Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's eating; therefore the Lord reduced His eating to a minimum. However, when all the Vaiṣṇavas became very sorry, the Lord increased His portion to half as much as usual.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.267
description: There are fourteen planetary systems within the universe, and all living entities reside in those planetary systems.
text:
> brahmāṇḍa-bhitare haya caudda bhuvana
> caudda-bhuvane vaise yata jīva-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahmāṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within the universe; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there are; [[synonyms:c:cauddabhuvana]]---fourteen planetary systems; [[synonyms:c:caudda]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvane]]---in those fourteen planetary systems; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---reside; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as there are; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---living entities.
translation: There are fourteen planetary systems within the universe, and all living entities reside in those planetary systems.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.268
description: Dressing like human beings on pilgrimage, they all used to come to Jagannātha Purī to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> manuṣyera veśa dhari' yātrikera chale
> prabhura darśana kare āsi' nīlācale
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manuṣyera]]---of human beings; [[synonyms:v:veśa]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---dressing themselves; [[synonyms:y:yātrikerachale]]---as if pilgrims; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---visit; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī.
translation: Dressing like human beings on pilgrimage, they all used to come to Jagannātha Purī to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.269
description: One day all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, were chanting the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> eka-dina śrīvāsādi yata bhakta-gaṇa
> mahāprabhura guṇa gāñā karena kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and others; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---qualities; [[synonyms:g:gāñā]]---describing; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---perform; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting.
translation: One day all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, were chanting the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.27
description: Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to address Nityānanda Prabhu as His elder brother, whereas Nityānanda Prabhu addressed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as His Lord.
text:
> caitanya-gosāñi yāṅre bale 'baḍa bhāi'
> teṅho kahe, mora prabhu---caitanya-gosāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāṅre]]---unto whom; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---says; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---elder brother; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:m:moraprabhu]]---My Lord; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---the supreme master, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to address Nityānanda Prabhu as His elder brother, whereas Nityānanda Prabhu addressed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as His Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.270
description: Not liking the chanting of His transcendental qualities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised them as if He were angry. "What kind of chanting is this?" He asked. "Are you leaving aside the chanting of the holy name of the Lord?"
text:
> śuni' bhakta-gaṇe kahe sa-krodha vacane
> kṛṣṇa-nāma-guṇa chāḍi, ki kara kīrtane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord says; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:k:krodha]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---talking in an angry mood; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi]]---leaving aside the transcendental qualities and the name of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:k:kīrtane]]---what kind of chanting are you performing.
translation: Not liking the chanting of His transcendental qualities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised them as if He were angry. "What kind of chanting is this?" He asked. "Are you leaving aside the chanting of the holy name of the Lord?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.271
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised all the devotees, telling them not to show impudence and spoil the entire world by becoming independent.
text:
> auddhatya karite haila sabākāra mana
> svatantra ha-iyā sabe nāśā 'be bhuvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:auddhatya]]---impudence; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:s:sabākāra]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]]---independent; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:iyā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:n:nāśā]] [[synonyms:b:'be]]---will spoil; [[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---the whole world.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised all the devotees, telling them not to show impudence and spoil the entire world by becoming independent.
purport:
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu warned all His followers not to become independent or impudent. Unfortunately, after the disappearance of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, many //apa-sampradāyas// (so-called followers) invented many ways not approved by the //ācāryas.// Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has described them as the //āula, bāula, kartābhajā, neḍā, daraveśa, sāni sahajiyā, sakhībhekī, smārta, jāta-gosāñi, ativāḍī, cūḍādhārī// and //gaurāṅga-nāgarī.//

The //āula-sampradāya, bāula-sampradāya// and others invented their own ways of understanding Lord Caitanya's philosophy, without following in the footsteps of the //ācāryas.// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself indicates herein that all such attempts would simply spoil the spirit of His cult.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.272
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was apparently in a angry mood and chastising His devotees, many thousands of people outside loudly cried in a tumultuous voice, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!"
text:
> daśa-dike koṭī koṭī loka hena kāle
> jaya kṛṣṇa-caitanya' bali' kare kolāhale
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in the ten directions; [[synonyms:k:koṭī]] [[synonyms:k:koṭī]]---many thousands of men; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:h:henakāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:j:jayakṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---all glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---loudly crying; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---make; [[synonyms:k:kolāhale]]---a tumultuous sound.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was apparently in a angry mood and chastising His devotees, many thousands of people outside loudly cried in a tumultuous voice, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.273
description: All the people began to call very loudly, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the son of Mahārāja Nanda! Now You have appeared in order to deliver the whole world!
text:
> jaya jaya mahāprabhu---vrajendra-kumāra
> jagat tārite prabhu, tomāra avatāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jayajayamahāprabhu]]---all glories to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:k:kumāra]]---originally Lord Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the whole world; [[synonyms:t:tārite]]---to deliver; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---incarnation.
translation: All the people began to call very loudly, "All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is the son of Mahārāja Nanda! Now You have appeared in order to deliver the whole world!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.274
description: "O Lord, we are very unhappy. We have come a long distance to see You. Please be merciful and show us Your favor."
text:
> bahu-dūra haite āinu hañā baḍa ārta
> daraśana diyā prabhu karaha kṛtārtha
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:d:dūra]]---a long distance; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:ā:āinu]]---we have come; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---very much; [[synonyms:ā:ārta]]---aggrieved; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---audience; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---O Lord; [[synonyms:k:karaha]]---kindly show; [[synonyms:k:kṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---favor.
translation: "O Lord, we are very unhappy. We have come a long distance to see You. Please be merciful and show us Your favor."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.275
description: When the Lord heard the humble petition made by the people, his heart softened. Being very merciful, He immediately came out and gave audience to all of them.
text:
> śuniyā lokera dainya dravilā hṛdaya
> bāhire āsi' daraśana dilā dayā-maya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of the people; [[synonyms:d:dainya]]---humility; [[synonyms:d:dravilā]]---became softened; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]---the heart; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---audience; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---the merciful.
translation: When the Lord heard the humble petition made by the people, his heart softened. Being very merciful, He immediately came out and gave audience to all of them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.276
description: Raising His arms, the Lord asked everyone to chant loudly the vibration of the holy name of Lord Hari. There immediately arose a great stir, and the vibration of "Hari!" filled all directions.
text:
> bāhu tuli' bale prabhu bala' 'hari' 'hari'
> uṭhila---śrī-hari-dhvani catur-dik bhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhu]] [[synonyms:t:tuli']]---raising the arms; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---says; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:b:bala']]---speak; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---the holy name of the Lord, Hari; [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---arose; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---vibration of the sound Hari; [[synonyms:c:catuḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dik]]---the four directions; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling.
translation: Raising His arms, the Lord asked everyone to chant loudly the vibration of the holy name of Lord Hari. There immediately arose a great stir, and the vibration of "Hari!" filled all directions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.277
description: Seeing the Lord, everyone became joyful out of love. Everyone accepted the Lord as the Supreme, and thus they offered their prayers.
text:
> prabhu dekhi' preme loka ānandita mana
> prabhuke īśvara bali' karaye stavana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the Lord; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstasy; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all people; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---joyous; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---as the Supreme Lord; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---accepting; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---did; [[synonyms:s:stavana]]---prayer.
translation: Seeing the Lord, everyone became joyful out of love. Everyone accepted the Lord as the Supreme, and thus they offered their prayers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.278
description: While the people were offering their prayers unto the Lord, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura sarcastically said to the Lord, "At home, You wanted to be covered. Why have You exposed Yourself outside?"
text:
> stava śuni' prabhuke kahena śrīnivāsa
> ghare gupta hao, kene bāhire prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:stava]]---prayers; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---unto the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:ś:śrīnivāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:g:gupta]]---covered; [[synonyms:h:hao]]---You are; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---manifested.
translation: While the people were offering their prayers unto the Lord, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura sarcastically said to the Lord, "At home, You wanted to be covered. Why have You exposed Yourself outside?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.279
description: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued, "Who has taught these people? What are they saying? Now You can cover their mouths with Your own hand.
text:
> ke śikhāla ei loke, kahe kon bāta
> ihā-sabāra mukha ḍhāka diyā nija hāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāla]]---taught; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---people; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---they say; [[synonyms:k:kon]]---what; [[synonyms:b:bāta]]---topics; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---of them; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---the mouths; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍhāka]]---just cover; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---Your own; [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---hand.
translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued, "Who has taught these people? What are they saying? Now You can cover their mouths with Your own hand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.28
description: Although Nityānanda Prabhu is none other than Balarāma Himself, He nonetheless always thinks of Himself as the eternal servant of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> yadyapi āpani haye prabhu balarāma
> tathāpi caitanyera kare dāsa-abhimāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:h:haye]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord; [[synonyms:b:balarāma]]---Balarāma; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---accepts; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---conception as the eternal servant.
translation: Although Nityānanda Prabhu is none other than Balarāma Himself, He nonetheless always thinks of Himself as the eternal servant of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.280
description: "It is as if the sun, after rising, wanted to hide itself. We cannot understand such characteristics in Your behavior."
text:
> sūrya yaiche udaya kari' cāhe lukāite
> bujhite nā pāri taiche tomāra carite
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sūrya]]---the sun; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just like; [[synonyms:u:udaya]]---appearance; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants; [[synonyms:l:lukāite]]---to hide; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---to understand; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---able; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:c:carite]]---in the character.
translation: "It is as if the sun, after rising, wanted to hide itself. We cannot understand such characteristics in Your behavior."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.281
description: The Lord replied, "My dear Śrīnivāsa, please stop joking. You have all combined together to humiliate Me in this way."
text:
> prabhu kahena,---śrīnivāsa, chāḍa viḍambanā
> sabe meli' kara mora kateka lāñcanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:ś:śrīnivāsa]]---My dear Śrīnivāsa; [[synonyms:c:chāḍa]]---give up; [[synonyms:v:viḍambanā]]---all these jokes; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:m:meli']]---together; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---of Me; [[synonyms:k:kateka]]---so much; [[synonyms:l:lāñcanā]]---humiliation.
translation: The Lord replied, "My dear Śrīnivāsa, please stop joking. You have all combined together to humiliate Me in this way."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.282
description: Thus speaking, the Lord entered His room after glancing auspiciously upon the people out of charity. In this way the desires of the people were completely fulfilled.
text:
> eta bali' loke kari' śubha-dṛṣṭi dāna
> abhyantare gelā, lokera pūrṇa haila kāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---thus saying; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---unto the people; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:ś:śubha]]-[[synonyms:d:dṛṣṭi]]---auspicious glance; [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---charity; [[synonyms:a:abhyantare]]---within the room; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of all the people; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---fulfilled; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---the desire.
translation: Thus speaking, the Lord entered His room after glancing auspiciously upon the people out of charity. In this way the desires of the people were completely fulfilled.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.283
description: At this time, Raghunātha dāsa approached Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and, according to His order, prepared a feast and distributed prasāda composed of chipped rice and curd.
text:
> raghunātha-dāsa nityānanda-pāśe gelā
> ciḍā-dadhi-mahotsava tāhāṅi karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---of the name Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---near; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---curd; [[synonyms:m:mahotsava]]---festival; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅi]]---there; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---performed.
translation: At this time, Raghunātha dāsa approached Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu and, according to His order, prepared a feast and distributed prasāda composed of chipped rice and curd.
purport: There is a special preparation in Bengal wherein chipped rice is mixed with curd and sometimes with //sandeśa// and mango. It is a very palatable food offered to the Deity and then distributed to the public. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who was a householder at this time, met Nityānanda Prabhu. According to His advice, he executed this festival of //dadhi-ciḍā-prasāda.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.284
description: Later, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī left home and took shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī. At that time, the Lord received him and placed him under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara for spiritual enlightenment.
text:
> tāṅra ājñā lañā gelā prabhura caraṇe
> tāṅra prabhu tāṅre samarpilā svarūpera sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---approached; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:samarpilā]]---handed over; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]]---of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place.
translation: Later, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī left home and took shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī. At that time, the Lord received him and placed him under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara for spiritual enlightenment.
purport:
In this regard, Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī writes in //Vilāpa-kusumāñjali// (5):

> yo māṁ dustara-geha-nirjala-mahā-kūpād apāra-klamāt
> sadyaḥ sāndra-dayāmbudhiḥ prakṛtitaḥ svairīkṛpā-rajjubhiḥ
> uddhṛtyātma-saroja-nindi-caraṇa-prāntaṁ prapadya svayaṁ
> śrī-dāmodara-sac cakāra tam ahaṁ caitanya-candraṁ bhaje

"Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who, by His unreserved mercy, kindly saved me from household life, which is exactly like a blind well without water, and placed me in the ocean of transcendental joy under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.285
description: Later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped Brahmānanda Bhāratī's habit of wearing deerskin. The Lord thus enjoyed His pastimes continuously for six years, experiencing varieties of transcendental bliss.
text:
> brahmānanda-bhāratīra ghucāila carmāmbara
> ei mata līlā kaila chaya vatsara
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahmānanda]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāratīra]]---of Brahmānanda Bhāratī; [[synonyms:g:ghucāila]]---vanquished; [[synonyms:c:carma]]-[[synonyms:a:ambara]]---dress of skin; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:c:chayavatsara]]---six years.
translation: Later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped Brahmānanda Bhāratī's habit of wearing deerskin. The Lord thus enjoyed His pastimes continuously for six years, experiencing varieties of transcendental bliss.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.286
description: I have thus given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā. Now please hear the pastimes the Lord performed during the last twelve years.
text:
> ei ta' kahila madhya-līlāra sūtra-gaṇa
> śeṣa dvādaśa vatsarera śuna vivaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---explained; [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the middle pastimes; [[synonyms:s:sūtra]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---a synopsis; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---last; [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]]---twelve; [[synonyms:v:vatsarera]]---of the years; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---the description.
translation: I have thus given a synopsis of the madhya-līlā. Now please hear the pastimes the Lord performed during the last twelve years.
purport: Thus Śrīla Kavirāja Gosvāmī, strictly following in the footsteps of Śrī Vyāsadeva, gives a synopsis of the //līlās// of //Caitanya-caritāmṛta.// He has given such a description at the end of each canto. In the //Ādi-līlā// he outlined the pastimes of the Lord in the five stages of boyhood, leaving the details of the description to Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. Now in this chapter the pastimes that took place at the end of the Lord's life are summarized. These are described in the //Madhya-līlā// and //Antya-līlā.// The rest of the pastimes have been described in a synopsis in the Second Chapter of the //Madhya-līlā.// In this way the author has gradually described both the //madhya-līlā// and the //antya-līlā.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.287
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  First Chapter, summarizing the later pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.29
description: Nityānanda Prabhu requested everyone to serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chant His glories and utter His name. Nityānanda Prabhu claimed that person to be His life and soul who rendered devotional service unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> 'caitanya' seva, 'caitanya' gāo, lao 'caitanya'-nāma
> 'caitanye' ye bhakti kare, sei mora prāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyaseva]]---serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caitanyagāo]]---chant about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lao]]---always take; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caitanye]]---unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---renders; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that person; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life and soul.
translation: Nityānanda Prabhu requested everyone to serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chant His glories and utter His name. Nityānanda Prabhu claimed that person to be His life and soul who rendered devotional service unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.3
description: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.
text:
> jayatāṁ suratau paṅgor
> mama manda-mater gatī
> mat-sarvasva-padāmbhojau
> rādhā-madana-mohanau
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jayatām]]---all glory to; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:r:ratau]]---most merciful, or attached in conjugal love; [[synonyms:p:paṅgoḥ]]---of one who is lame; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---of me; [[synonyms:m:manda]]-[[synonyms:m:mateḥ]]---foolish; [[synonyms:g:gatī]]---refuge; [[synonyms:m:mat]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:s:sva]]---everything; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:a:ambhojau]]---whose lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:m:mohanau]]---Rādhārāṇī and Madana-mohana.
translation: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.30
description: In this way, Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu introduced the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to everyone without discrimination. Even though the people were fallen souls and blasphemers, they were delivered by this process.
text:
> ei mata loke caitanya-bhakti laoyāila
> dīna-hīna, nindaka, sabāre nistārila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---the people in general; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---the devotional service; [[synonyms:l:laoyāila]]---He caused to accept; [[synonyms:d:dīna]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]---poor fallen souls; [[synonyms:n:nindaka]]---blasphemers; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---everyone; [[synonyms:n:nistārila]]---He delivered.
translation: In this way, Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu introduced the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to everyone without discrimination. Even though the people were fallen souls and blasphemers, they were delivered by this process.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.31
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sent the two brothers Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī to Vraja. By His order, they went to Śrī Vṛndāvana-dhāma.
text:
> tabe prabhu vraje pāṭhāila rūpa-sanātana
> prabhu-ājñāya dui bhāi āilā vṛndāvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---after this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---to Vṛndāvana-dhāma; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---the two brothers Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---upon the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duibhāi]]---the two brothers; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana-dhāma.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sent the two brothers Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī to Vraja. By His order, they went to Śrī Vṛndāvana-dhāma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.32
description: After going to Vṛndāvana, the brothers preached devotional service and discovered many places of pilgrimage. They specifically initiated the service of Madana-mohana and Govindajī.
text:
> bhakti pracāriyā sarva-tīrtha prakāśila
> madana-gopāla-govindera sevā pracārila
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:p:pracāriyā]]---broadcasting devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---all the places of pilgrimage; [[synonyms:p:prakāśila]]---discovered; [[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---of Śrī Rādhā-Madana-mohana; [[synonyms:g:govindera]]---of Śrī Rādhā-Govindajī; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---the service; [[synonyms:p:pracārila]]---introduced.
translation: After going to Vṛndāvana, the brothers preached devotional service and discovered many places of pilgrimage. They specifically initiated the service of Madana-mohana and Govindajī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.33
description: Both Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī brought various scriptures to Vṛndāvana and collected the essence of these by compiling many scriptures on devotional service. In this way they delivered all rascals and fallen souls.
text:
> nānā śāstra āni' kailā bhakti-grantha sāra
> mūḍha adhama-janere teṅho karilā nistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---different types of scriptures; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---collecting; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:g:grantha]]---of books on devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence; [[synonyms:m:mūḍha]]---rascals; [[synonyms:a:adhama]]-[[synonyms:j:janere]]---and fallen souls; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---they; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:n:nistāra]]---delivered.
translation: Both Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī brought various scriptures to Vṛndāvana and collected the essence of these by compiling many scriptures on devotional service. In this way they delivered all rascals and fallen souls.
purport:
Śrīla Śrīnivāsa Ācārya has sung:

> nānā-śāstra-vicāraṇaika-nipuṇau sad-dharma-saṁsthāpakau
> lokānāṁ hita-kāriṇau tri-bhuvane mānyau śaraṇyākarau
> rādhā-kṛṣṇa-padāravinda-bhajanānandena mattālikau
> vande rūpa-sanātanau raghu-yugau śrī-jīva-gopālakau

The six Gosvāmīs, under the direction of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī, studied various Vedic scriptures and picked up the essence of them, the devotional service of the Lord. This means that all the Gosvāmīs wrote many scriptures on devotional service with the support of the Vedic literature. Devotional service is not a sentimental activity. The essence of Vedic knowledge is devotional service, as confirmed in the //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:15:15|(Bg. 15.15)]]: //vedaiś ca sarvair aham eva vedyaḥ.// All the Vedic literature aims at understanding Kṛṣṇa, and how to understand Kṛṣṇa through devotional service has been explained by Śrīla Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs, with evidence from all the Vedic scriptures. They have put it so nicely that even a rascal or first-class fool can be delivered by devotional service under the guidance of the Gosvāmīs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.34
description: The Gosvāmīs carried out the preaching work of devotional service on the basis of an analytical study of all confidential Vedic scriptures. This was in compliance with the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus one can understand the most confidential devotional service of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> prabhu ājñāya kaila saba śāstrera vicāra
> vrajera nigūḍha bhakti karila pracāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---upon the order of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---they did; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:ś:śāstrera]]---of all scriptures; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---analytical study; [[synonyms:v:vrajera]]---of Śrī Vṛndāvana-dhāma; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---most confidential; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:pracāra]]---preaching.
translation: The Gosvāmīs carried out the preaching work of devotional service on the basis of an analytical study of all confidential Vedic scriptures. This was in compliance with the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus one can understand the most confidential devotional service of Vṛndāvana.
purport: This proves that bona fide devotional service is based on the conclusions of the Vedic literature. It is not based on the type of sentiment exhibited by the //prākṛta-sahajiyās.// The //prākṛta-sahajiyās// do not consult the Vedic literature, and they are debauchees, woman-hunters and smokers of //gañjā.// Sometimes they give a theatrical performance and cry for the Lord with tears in their eyes. Of course, all scriptural conclusions are washed off by these tears. The //prākṛta-sahajiyās// do not realize that they are violating the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who specifically said that to understand Vṛndāvana and the pastimes of Vṛndāvana one must have sufficient knowledge of the //śāstras// (Vedic scriptures). As stated in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:1:2:12|(1.2.12)]], //bhaktyā śruta-gṛhītayā.// This means that devotional service is acquired from Vedic knowledge. //Tac chraddadhānāḥ munayaḥ.// Devotees who are actually serious attain //bhakti,// scientific devotional service, by hearing Vedic scriptures (//bhaktyā śruta-gṛhītayā//). It is not that one should create something out of sentimentality, become a //sahajiyā// and advocate such concocted devotional service. However, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura considered such //sahajiyās// to be more favorable than the impersonalists, who are hopelessly atheistic. The impersonalists have no idea of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The position of the //sahajiyās// is far better than that of the Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs.// Although the //sahajiyās// do not think much of Vedic knowledge, they nonetheless have accepted Lord Kṛṣṇa as the Supreme Lord. Unfortunately, they mislead others from authentic devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.35
description: Some of the books compiled by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī were the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta, Daśama-ṭippanī and Daśama-carita.
text:
> hari-bhakti-vilāsa, āra bhāgavatāmṛta
> daśama-ṭippanī, āra daśama-carita
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---the scripture named //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa//; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavatāmṛta]]---the scripture named //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta//; [[synonyms:d:daśama]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭippanī]]---comments on the Tenth Canto of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:daśama]]-[[synonyms:c:carita]]---poetry about the Tenth Canto of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.//
translation: Some of the books compiled by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī were the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta, Daśama-ṭippanī and Daśama-carita.
purport:
In the First Wave of the book known as //Bhakti-ratnākara,// it is said that Sanātana Gosvāmī understood //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// by thorough study and explained it in his commentary known as //Vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī// All the knowledge that Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī directly acquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was broadcast all over the world by their expert service. Sanātana Gosvāmī gave his //Vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī// commentary to Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī for editing, and Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī edited this under the name of //Laghu-toṣaṇī.// Whatever he immediately put down in writing was finished in the year 1476 Śaka (A.D. 1555). Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī completed //Laghu-toṣaṇī// in the year Śakābda 1504 (A.D. 1583).

The subject matter of the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa,// by Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī, was collected by Śrīla Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī and is known as a //vaiṣṇava-smṛti.// This //vaiṣṇava-smṛti-grantha// was finished in twenty chapters, known as //vilāsas.// In the first //vilāsa// there is a description of how a relationship is established between the spiritual master and the disciple, and //mantras// are explained. In the second //vilāsa,// the process of initiation is described. In the third //vilāsa,// the methods of Vaiṣṇava behavior are given, with emphasis on cleanliness, constant remembrance of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, and the chanting of the //mantras// given by the initiating spiritual master. In the fourth //vilāsa// are descriptions of //saṁskāra,// the reformatory method; //tilaka,// the application of twelve //tilakas// on twelve places of the body; //mudrā,// marks on the body; //mālā,// chanting with beads; and //guru-pūjā,// worship of the spiritual master. In the fifth //vilāsa,// one is instructed on how to make a place to sit for meditation, and there are descriptions of breathing exercises, meditation and worship of the //śālagrāma-śilā// representation of Lord Viṣṇu. In the sixth //vilāsa,// the required practices for inviting the transcendental form of the Lord and bathing Him are given. In the seventh //vilāsa,// one is instructed on how to collect flowers used for the worship of Lord Viṣṇu. In the eighth //vilāsa,// there is a description of the Deity and instructions on how to set up incense, light lamps, make offerings, dance, play music, beat drums, garland the Deity, offer prayers and obeisances and counteract offenses. In the ninth //vilāsa,// there are descriptions about collecting //tulasī// leaves, offering oblations to forefathers according to Vaiṣṇava rituals, and offering food. In the tenth //vilāsa// there are descriptions of the devotees of the Lord (Vaiṣṇavas, or saintly persons). In the eleventh //vilāsa,// there are elaborate descriptions of Deity worship and the glories of the holy name of the Lord. One is instructed on how to chant the holy name of the Deity, and there are discussions about offenses committed while chanting the holy name, along with methods for getting relief from such offenses. There are also descriptions of the glories of devotional service and the surrendering process. In the twelfth //vilāsa,// Ekādaśī is described. In the thirteenth //vilāsa,// fasting is discussed, as well as observance of the Mahā-dvādaśī ceremony. In the fourteenth //vilāsa,// different duties for different months are outlined. In the fifteenth //vilāsa,// there are instructions on how to observe Ekādaśī fasting without even drinking water. There are also descriptions of branding the body with the symbols of Viṣṇu, discussions of Cāturmāsya observations during the rainy season, and discussions of Janmāṣṭamī, Pārśvaikādaśī, Śravaṇā-dvādaśī, Rāma-navamī and Vijayā-daśamī. The sixteenth //vilāsa// discusses duties to be observed in the month of Kārttika (October-November), or the Dāmodara month, or Ūrja, when lamps are offered in the Deity room or above the temple. There are also descriptions of the Govardhana-pūjā and Ratha-yātrā. The seventeenth //vilāsa// discusses preparations for Deity worship, //mahā-mantra// chanting and the process of //japa.// In the eighteenth //vilāsa// the different forms of Śrī Viṣṇu are described. The nineteenth //vilāsa// discusses the establishment of the Deity and the rituals observed in bathing the Deity before installation. The twentieth //vilāsa// discusses the construction of temples, referring to those constructed by the great devotees. The details of the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa-grantha// are given by Śrī Kavirāja Gosvāmī in the //Madhya-līlā// (24.329-345). The descriptions given in those verses by Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī are actually a description of those portions compiled by Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī. According to Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, the regulative principles of devotional service compiled by Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī do not strictly follow our Vaiṣṇava principles. Actually, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī collected only a summary of the elaborate descriptions of Vaiṣṇava regulative principles from the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa.// It is Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Gosvāmī's opinion, however, that to follow the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// strictly is to actually follow the Vaiṣṇava rituals in perfect order. He claims that the //smārta-samāja,// which is strictly followed by caste //brāhmaṇas,// has influenced portions that Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī collected from the original //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa.// It is therefore very difficult to find out Vaiṣṇava directions from the book of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī. It is better to consult the commentary made by Sanātana Gosvāmī himself for the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// under the name of //Dig-darśinī-ṭīkā.// Some say that the same commentary was compiled by Gopīnātha-pūjā Adhikārī, who was engaged in the service of Śrī Rādhā-ramaṇajī and who happened to be one of the disciples of Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī.

Regarding the //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta,// there are two parts dealing with the discharge of devotional service. The first part is an analytical study of devotional service, in which there is also a description of different planets, including the earth, the heavenly planets, Brahma-loka and Vaikuṇṭha-loka. There are also descriptions of the devotees, including intimate devotees, most intimate devotees and complete devotees. The second part describes the glories of the spiritual world, known as //Goloka-māhātmya-nirūpaṇa,// as well as the process of renunciation of the material world. It also describes real knowledge, devotional service, the spiritual world, love of Godhead, attainment of life's destination, and the bliss of the world. In this way there are seven chapters in each part, fourteen chapters in all.

Daśama-ṭippanī is a commentary on the Tenth Canto of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.// Another name for this commentary is //Bṛhad-vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī-ṭīkā.// In the //Bhakti-ratnākara,// it is said that //Daśama-ṭippanī// was finished in 1476 Śakābda (A.D. 1555).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.36
description: We have already given the names of four books compiled by Sanātana Gosvāmī. Similarly, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has also compiled many books, which no one can even count.
text:
> ei saba grantha kaila gosāñi sanātana
> rūpa-gosāñi kaila yata, ke karu gaṇana

translation: We have already given the names of four books compiled by Sanātana Gosvāmī. Similarly, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī has also compiled many books, which no one can even count.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.37
description: I shall therefore enumerate the chief books compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. He has described the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in thousands of verses.
text:
> pradhāna pradhāna kichu kariye gaṇana
> lakṣa granthe kaila vraja-vilāsa varṇana

translation: I shall therefore enumerate the chief books compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. He has described the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in thousands of verses.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.38

translation: The books compiled by Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī include the Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu, Vidagdha-mādhava, Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi and Lalita-mādhava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.39-40
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the Dāna-keli-kaumudī, Stavāvalī, Līlā-cchanda, Padyāvalī, Govinda-virudāvalī, Mathurā-māhātmya and Nāṭaka-varṇana.

translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the Dāna-keli-kaumudī, Stavāvalī, Līlā-cchanda, Padyāvalī, Govinda-virudāvalī, Mathurā-māhātmya and Nāṭaka-varṇana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 1.4
description: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.
text:
> dīvyad-vṛndāraṇya-kalpa-drumādhaḥ-
> śrīmad-ratnāgāra-siṁhāsana-sthau
> śrīmad-rādhā-śrīla-govinda-devau
> preṣṭhālībhiḥ sevyamānau smarāmi
