title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.209
description: They ate all kinds of cakes and sweet rice, filling themselves up to their throats, and at intervals they vibrated the holy name of the Lord in great jubilation.
text:
> nānā piṭhā-pānā khāya ākaṇṭha pūriyā
> madhye madhye 'hari' kahe ānandita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]-[[synonyms:p:pānā]]---cakes and sweet rice; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eat; [[synonyms:ā:ā]]-[[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]] [[synonyms:p:pūriyā]]---filling up to the throat; [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---occasionally; [[synonyms:h:hari]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---they speak; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---in great jubilation.
translation: They ate all kinds of cakes and sweet rice, filling themselves up to their throats, and at intervals they vibrated the holy name of the Lord in great jubilation.
purport:
It is the practice of Vaiṣṇavas while taking //prasāda// to chant the holy name of Lord Hari at intervals and also sing various songs, such as //śarīra avidyā-jāla.// Those who are honoring //prasāda,// accepting the remnants of food offered to the Deity, must always remember that //prasāda// is not ordinary food. //Prasāda// is transcendental. We are therefore reminded:

> mahā-prasāde govinde
> nāma-brahmaṇi vaiṣṇave
> sv-alpa-puṇya-vatāṁ rājan
> viśvāso naiva jāyate

Those who are not pious cannot understand the value of //mahā-prasāda// or the holy name of the Lord. Both //prasāda// and the Lord's name are on the Brahman platform, or spiritual platform. One should never consider //prasāda// to be like ordinary hotel cooking. Nor should one touch any kind of food not offered to the Deity. Every Vaiṣṇava strictly follows this principle and does not accept any food that is not //prasāda.// One should take //prasāda// with great faith and should chant the holy name of the Lord and worship the Deity in the temple, always remembering that the Deity, //mahā-prasāda// and the holy name do not belong to the mundane platform. By worshiping the Deity, eating //prasāda// and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra,// one can always remain on the spiritual platform (//brahma-bhūyāya kalpate//).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.21
description: "My dear Lord, as soon as the King heard Your holy name, he was immediately overwhelmed by great ecstatic love. Catching my hand, he displayed all the symptoms of love.
text:
> tomāra nāma śuni' haila mahā-premāveśa
> mora hāte dhari' kare pirīti viśeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]---great; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstasy of love; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---my hand; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:pirīti]]---loving symptoms; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---specific.
translation: "My dear Lord, as soon as the King heard Your holy name, he was immediately overwhelmed by great ecstatic love. Catching my hand, he displayed all the symptoms of love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.210
description: After everyone had finished his lunch and washed his mouth and hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally decorated everyone with flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.
text:
> bhojana samāpta haila, kaila ācamana
> sabāre parāila prabhu mālya-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---lunch; [[synonyms:s:samāpta]]---ending; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---washing the mouth; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---on everyone; [[synonyms:p:parāila]]---put; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---a garland and sandalwood pulp.
translation: After everyone had finished his lunch and washed his mouth and hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally decorated everyone with flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.211
description: After thus accepting prasāda, they all went to take rest at their respective residences, and in the evening they again came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> viśrāma karite sabe nija vāsā gelā
> sandhyā-kāle āsi' punaḥ prabhuke mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---going to take rest; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---to their own; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]---residential quarters; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the evening; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After thus accepting prasāda, they all went to take rest at their respective residences, and in the evening they again came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.212
description: At this time Rāmānanda Rāya also came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord took the opportunity to introduce all the Vaiṣṇavas to him.
text:
> hena-kāle rāmānanda āilā prabhu-sthāne
> prabhu milāila tāṅre saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---at the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milāila]]---caused to meet; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him (Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya); [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees of the Lord.
translation: At this time Rāmānanda Rāya also came to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord took the opportunity to introduce all the Vaiṣṇavas to him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.213
description: The great Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, then took all of them to the temple of Jagannātha and began the congregational chanting of the holy name there.
text:
> sabā lañā gelā prabhu jagannāthālaya
> kīrtana ārambha tathā kaila mahāśaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālaya]]---to the temple of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---congregational chanting; [[synonyms:ā:ārambha]]---beginning; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:m:mahāśaya]]---the great personality.
translation: The great Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, then took all of them to the temple of Jagannātha and began the congregational chanting of the holy name there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.214
description: After seeing the dhūpa-ārati of the Lord, they all began congregational chanting. Then the paḍichā, the superintendent of the temple, came and offered flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to everyone.
text:
> sandhyā-dhūpa dekhi' ārambhilā saṅkīrtana
> paḍichā āsi' sabāre dila mālya-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:d:dhūpa]]---//dhūpa-ārati// just in the beginning of the evening; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---they all saw; [[synonyms:ā:ārambhilā]]---began; [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---congregational chanting; [[synonyms:p:paḍichā]]---the inspector of the temple; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto everyone; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---offered; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.
translation: After seeing the dhūpa-ārati of the Lord, they all began congregational chanting. Then the paḍichā, the superintendent of the temple, came and offered flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to everyone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.215
description: Four parties were then distributed in four directions to perform saṅkīrtana, and in the middle of them the Lord Himself, known as the son of mother Śacī, began to dance.
text:
> cāri-dike cāri sampradāya karena kīrtana
> madhye nṛtya kare prabhu śacīra nandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in the four directions; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four; [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---groups; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---congregational chanting; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the middle; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---dances; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śacīra]] [[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the son of mother Śacī.
translation: Four parties were then distributed in four directions to perform saṅkīrtana, and in the middle of them the Lord Himself, known as the son of mother Śacī, began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.216
description: In the four groups there were eight mṛdaṅgas and thirty-two cymbals. All together they began to vibrate the transcendental sound, and everyone said, "Very good! Very good!"
text:
> aṣṭa mṛdaṅga bāje, batriśa karatāla
> hari-dhvani kare sabe, bale-bhāla, bhāla
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]] [[synonyms:m:mṛdaṅga]]---eight //mṛdaṅgas//; [[synonyms:b:bāje]]---sounded; [[synonyms:b:batriśa]]---thirty-two; [[synonyms:k:karatāla]]---cymbals; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---vibrating the transcendental sound; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---every one of them; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---says; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---very good, very good.
translation: In the four groups there were eight mṛdaṅgas and thirty-two cymbals. All together they began to vibrate the transcendental sound, and everyone said, "Very good! Very good!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.217
description: When the tumultuous vibration of saṅkīrtana resounded, all good fortune immediately awakened, and the sound penetrated the whole universe through the fourteen planetary systems.
text:
> kīrtanera dhvani mahā-maṅgala uṭhila
> caturdaśa loka bhari' brahmāṇḍa bhedila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kīrtanera]] [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the vibration of the //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:m:maṅgala]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---all good fortune awakened; [[synonyms:c:caturdaśa]]---fourteen; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---planetary systems; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling up; [[synonyms:b:brahmāṇḍa]]---the whole universe; [[synonyms:b:bhedila]]---penetrated.
translation: When the tumultuous vibration of saṅkīrtana resounded, all good fortune immediately awakened, and the sound penetrated the whole universe through the fourteen planetary systems.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.218
description: When the congregational chanting began, ecstatic love immediately overflooded everything, and all the residents of Jagannātha Purī came running.
text:
> kīrtana-ārambhe prema uthali' calila
> nīlācala-vāsī loka dhāñā āila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ārambhe]]---in the beginning of the //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstasy of love; [[synonyms:u:uthali']]---overpowering; [[synonyms:c:calila]]---began to proceed; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---all the residents of Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---running; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came.
translation: When the congregational chanting began, ecstatic love immediately overflooded everything, and all the residents of Jagannātha Purī came running.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.219
description: Everyone was astonished to see such a performance of saṅkīrtana, and they all agreed that never before had kīrtana been so performed and ecstatic love of God so exhibited.
text:
> kīrtana dekhi' sabāra mane haila camatkāra
> kabhu nāhi dekhi aiche premera vikāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the performance of //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---never; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---see; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformation.
translation: Everyone was astonished to see such a performance of saṅkīrtana, and they all agreed that never before had kīrtana been so performed and ecstatic love of God so exhibited.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.22
description: "As soon as he heard my petition, he immediately granted me a pension without reductions. Thus the King granted me a full salary as a pension and requested me to engage without anxiety in the service of Your lotus feet.
text:
> tomāra ye vartana, tumi khāo sei vartana
> niścinta hañā bhaja caitanyera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:v:vartana]]---remuneration; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:khāo]]---take; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vartana]]---pension; [[synonyms:n:niścinta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---without anxiety; [[synonyms:b:bhaja]]---just worship; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet.
translation: "As soon as he heard my petition, he immediately granted me a pension without reductions. Thus the King granted me a full salary as a pension and requested me to engage without anxiety in the service of Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.220
description: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu circumambulated the temple of Jagannātha and continuously danced about the whole area.
text:
> tabe prabhu jagannāthera mandira beḍiyā
> pradakṣiṇa kari' bulena nartana kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:m:mandira]]---temple; [[synonyms:b:beḍiyā]]---walking all around; [[synonyms:p:pradakṣiṇa]]---circumambulation; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:b:bulena]]---walks; [[synonyms:n:nartana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---dancing.
translation: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu circumambulated the temple of Jagannātha and continuously danced about the whole area.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.221
description: As the circumambulation was performed, the four kīrtana parties sang in front and in the rear. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down to the ground, Śrī Nityānanda Rāya Prabhu lifted Him up.
text:
> āge-pāche gāna kare cāri sampradāya
> āchāḍera kāle dhare nityānanda rāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āge]]-[[synonyms:p:pāche]]---in front and in the rear; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---singing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four; [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---groups; [[synonyms:ā:āchāḍera]]---of falling down; [[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the time; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---captures; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Lord Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu.
translation: As the circumambulation was performed, the four kīrtana parties sang in front and in the rear. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell down to the ground, Śrī Nityānanda Rāya Prabhu lifted Him up.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.222
description: While kīrtana was going on, there was a transformation of ecstatic love and much tears, jubilation, trembling, perspiration and deep resounding in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing this transformation, all the people present became very much astonished.
text:
> aśru, pulaka, kampa, sveda, gambhīra huṅkāra
> premera vikāra dekhi' loke camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:p:pulaka]]---jubilation; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---trembling; [[synonyms:s:sveda]]---perspiration; [[synonyms:g:gambhīra]] [[synonyms:h:huṅkāra]]---deep resounding; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformation; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---all the people; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---were astonished.
translation: While kīrtana was going on, there was a transformation of ecstatic love and much tears, jubilation, trembling, perspiration and deep resounding in the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing this transformation, all the people present became very much astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.223
description: The tears from the eyes of the Lord came out with great force, like water from a syringe. Indeed, all the people who surrounded Him were moistened by His tears.
text:
> pickāri-dhārā jini' aśru nayane
> cāri-dikera loka saba karaye siṅcāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pickāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dhārā]]---like water coming in force from a syringe; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:n:nayane]]---in the eyes; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dikera]]---in all four directions; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:s:siṅcāne]]---moistened.
translation: The tears from the eyes of the Lord came out with great force, like water from a syringe. Indeed, all the people who surrounded Him were moistened by His tears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.224
description: After circumambulating the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for some time remained at the rear of the temple and continued His saṅkīrtana.
text:
> 'beḍā-nṛtya' mahāprabhu kari' kata-kṣaṇa
> mandirera pāche rahi' karaye kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:beḍā]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---the dancing surrounding the temple; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---performing; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:m:mandirera]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---at the rear of the temple; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---staying; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---congregational chanting.
translation: After circumambulating the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for some time remained at the rear of the temple and continued His saṅkīrtana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.225
description: On all four sides the four saṅkīrtana groups chanted very loudly, and in the middle Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced, jumping high.
text:
> cāri-dike cāri sampradāya uccaiḥsvare gāya
> madhye tāṇḍava-nṛtya kare gaurarāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on four sides; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---the four groups; [[synonyms:u:uccaiḥ]]-[[synonyms:s:svare]]---very loudly; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chant; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the middle; [[synonyms:t:tāṇḍava]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---jumping and dancing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:g:gaurarāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: On all four sides the four saṅkīrtana groups chanted very loudly, and in the middle Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced, jumping high.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.226
description: After dancing for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became still and ordered four great personalities to begin to dance.
text:
> bahu-kṣaṇa nṛtya kari' prabhu sthira hailā
> cāri mahāntere tabe nācite ājñā dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for a long period; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---dancing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became silent; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:m:mahāntere]]---to four great personalities; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:n:nācite]]---to dance; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---ordered.
translation: After dancing for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became still and ordered four great personalities to begin to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.227
description: In one group Nityānanda Prabhu began to dance, and in another group Advaita Ācārya began to dance.
text:
> eka sampradāye nāce nityānanda-rāye
> advaita-ācārya nāce āra sampradāye
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāye]]---in one group; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāye]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya Prabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:s:sampradāye]]---in a group.
translation: In one group Nityānanda Prabhu began to dance, and in another group Advaita Ācārya began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.228
description: Vakreśvara Paṇḍita began to dance in another group, and in yet another group Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura began to dance.
text:
> āra sampradāye nāce paṇḍita-vakreśvara
> śrīvāsa nāce āra sampradāya-bhitara
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāye]]---in another //sampradāya,// or group; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---in the middle of a group.
translation: Vakreśvara Paṇḍita began to dance in another group, and in yet another group Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.229
description: While this dancing was going on, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu watched them and performed a miracle.
text:
> madhye rahi' mahāprabhu karena daraśana
> tāhāṅ eka aiśvarya tāṅra ha-ila prakaṭana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---keeping in the middle; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---looks over; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]---miracle; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Him; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭana]]---exhibited.
translation: While this dancing was going on, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu watched them and performed a miracle.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.23
description: "Then Mahārāja Pratāparudra very humbly said, 'I am most fallen and abominable, and I am unfit to receive an interview with the Lord. One's life is successful if one engages in His service.'
text:
> āmi-chāra, yogya nahi tāṅra daraśane
> tāṅre yei bhaje tāṅra saphala jīvane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---very much fallen; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---fit; [[synonyms:n:nahi]]---not; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---for interviewing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---worships; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:s:saphala]]---successful; [[synonyms:j:jīvane]]---life.
translation: "Then Mahārāja Pratāparudra very humbly said, 'I am most fallen and abominable, and I am unfit to receive an interview with the Lord. One's life is successful if one engages in His service.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.230
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood in the middle of the dancers, and all the dancers in all directions perceived that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was looking at them.
text:
> cāri-dike nṛtya-gīta kare yata jana
> sabe dekhe,-prabhu kare āmāre daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on four sides; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---all people; [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---everyone sees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---looking at me.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood in the middle of the dancers, and all the dancers in all directions perceived that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was looking at them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.231
description: Wanting to see the dancing of the four great personalities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited Himself in such a way to appear as if He were seeing everyone.
text:
> cāri janera nṛtya dekhite prabhura abhilāṣa
> sei abhilāṣe kare aiśvarya prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:j:janera]]---of the four persons; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:abhilāṣa]]---desire; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:a:abhilāṣe]]---for that purpose; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---exhibition of a miracle.
translation: Wanting to see the dancing of the four great personalities, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited Himself in such a way to appear as if He were seeing everyone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.232
description: Everyone who saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand that He was performing a miracle, but they did not know how it was that He could see on all four sides.
text:
> darśane āveśa tāṅra dekhi' mātra jāne
> kemane caudike dekhe,-ihā nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---while looking over; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---emotional ecstasy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mātra]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---only knows; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on four sides; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---He sees; [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---one does not know.
translation: Everyone who saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand that He was performing a miracle, but they did not know how it was that He could see on all four sides.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.233
description: In His own pastimes in Vṛndāvana, when Kṛṣṇa used to eat on the bank of the Yamunā and sit in the center of His friends, every one of the cowherd boys would perceive that Kṛṣṇa was looking at him. In the same way, when Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, everyone saw that Caitanya Mahāprabhu was facing him.
text:
> pulina-bhojane yena kṛṣṇa madhya-sthāne
> caudikera sakhā kahe,-āmāre nehāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pulina]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---eating on the bank of Yamunā; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---sitting in the middle; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dikera]]---on four sides; [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---cowherd boyfriends; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---say; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:n:nehāne]]---just seeing me.
translation: In His own pastimes in Vṛndāvana, when Kṛṣṇa used to eat on the bank of the Yamunā and sit in the center of His friends, every one of the cowherd boys would perceive that Kṛṣṇa was looking at him. In the same way, when Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, everyone saw that Caitanya Mahāprabhu was facing him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.234
description: When someone came nearby while dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would tightly embrace him.
text:
> nṛtya karite yei āise sannidhāne
> mahāprabhu kare tāṅre dṛḍha āliṅgane
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---dancing; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes; [[synonyms:s:sannidhāne]]---nearby; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---tight; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgane]]---embracing.
translation: When someone came nearby while dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would tightly embrace him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.235
description: Upon seeing the great dancing, great love and great saṅkīrtana, all the people of Jagannātha Purī floated in an ecstatic ocean of love.
text:
> mahā-nṛtya, mahā-prema, mahā-saṅkīrtana
> dekhi' premāveśe bhāse nīlācala-jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---great dancing; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---great love; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---great congregational chanting; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---float; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---all the residents of Jagannātha Purī.
translation: Upon seeing the great dancing, great love and great saṅkīrtana, all the people of Jagannātha Purī floated in an ecstatic ocean of love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.236
description: Hearing the greatness of the saṅkīrtana, King Pratāparudra went up to the top of his palace and watched the performance with his personal associates.
text:
> gajapati rājā śuni' kīrtana-mahattva
> aṭṭālikā caḍi' dekhe svagaṇa-sahita
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gajapati]] [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King of Orissa; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]-[[synonyms:m:mahattva]]---the greatness of //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:a:aṭṭālikā]] [[synonyms:c:caḍi']]---ascending to the top of the palace; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:s:svagaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sahita]]---along with his personal associates.
translation: Hearing the greatness of the saṅkīrtana, King Pratāparudra went up to the top of his palace and watched the performance with his personal associates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.237
description: The King was very much astonished to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's kīrtana, and the King's anxiety to meet Him increased unlimitedly.
text:
> kīrtana dekhiyā rājāra haila camatkāra
> prabhuke milite utkaṇṭhā bāḍila apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing the performance of //kīrtana//; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---anxiety; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---increased; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---unlimitedly.
translation: The King was very much astonished to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's kīrtana, and the King's anxiety to meet Him increased unlimitedly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.238

translation: As long as the devotees remained at Jagannātha Purī with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the pastime of saṅkīrtana was performed with great jubilation every day.

translation: In this way I have explained the Lord's pastime of saṅkīrtana, and I bless everyone with this benediction: By listening to this description, one will surely become a servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Eleventh Chapter, describing the beḍā-kīrtana pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.26
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "My dear Rāmānanda Rāya, you are the foremost of all the devotees of Kṛṣṇa; therefore whoever loves you is certainly a very fortunate person.
text:
> prabhu kahe,-tumi kṛṣṇa-bhakata-pradhāna
> tomāke ye prīti kare, sei bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhukahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakata]]-[[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---the chief of the devotees of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tomāke]]---unto you; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:p:prīti]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---shows love; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---such a person; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---most fortunate.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "My dear Rāmānanda Rāya, you are the foremost of all the devotees of Kṛṣṇa; therefore whoever loves you is certainly a very fortunate person.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.27
description: "Because the King has shown so much love for you, Lord Kṛṣṇa will certainly accept him.
text:
> tomāte ye eta prīti ha-ila rājāra
> ei guṇe kṛṣṇa tāṅre karibe aṅgīkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāte]]---unto you; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---so much; [[synonyms:p:prīti]]---love; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---for this reason; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---will accept.
translation: "Because the King has shown so much love for you, Lord Kṛṣṇa will certainly accept him.
purport: King Pratāparudra requested an interview with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu through the Bhaṭṭācārya, who duly submitted the request. The Lord, however, immediately refused this interview. Now when Rāmānanda Rāya informed the Lord how eager the King was to see Him, the Lord was immediately pleased. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Rāmānanda Rāya to retire from his government post and come to Śrī Puruṣottama-kṣetra (Jagannātha Purī) to live with Him. When this proposal was submitted to King Pratāparudra, he immediately accepted it and also encouraged Rāmānanda Rāya by allowing him a full pension. This was very much appreciated by the Lord, and this confirms the fact that the Lord is more pleased when one serves the servant of the Lord. In ordinary parlance it is said, "If you love me, love my dog." To approach the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one has to go through His confidential servant. This is the method. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu clearly says, "Because the King loves you, Rāmānanda Rāya, he is very fortunate. Kṛṣṇa will certainly accept him due to his love for you."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 11.28

text:
