translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu first of all called for Kāśī Miśra, then for the superintendent of the temple, then for Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.73
description: When these three people came before the Lord, He begged them for permission to wash the temple known as Guṇḍicā.
text:
> tina-jana-pāśe prabhu hāsiyā kahila
> guṇḍicā-mandira-mārjana-sevā māgi' nila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---in the presence of the three persons; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---said; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:m:mandira]]-[[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---of washing the temple known as Guṇḍicā; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:m:māgi']] [[synonyms:n:nila]]---obtained by begging.
translation: When these three people came before the Lord, He begged them for permission to wash the temple known as Guṇḍicā.
purport: The Guṇḍicā temple is situated two miles northeast of the Jagannātha temple. At the time of the Ratha-yātrā festival, Lord Jagannātha goes to the Guṇḍicā temple from His original temple and stays there for one week. After one week, He returns to His original temple. It is understood by hearsay that the wife of Indradyumna, the King who established the Jagannātha temple, was known as Guṇḍicā. There is also mention of the name of the Guṇḍicā temple in authoritative scripture. The area of the Guṇḍicā temple is estimated to be 288 cubits by 215 cubits. The main temple inside is about 36 cubits by 30 cubits, and the //kīrtana// hall is 32 cubits by 30 cubits.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.74
description: Upon hearing the Lord's request for them to wash the Guṇḍicā temple, the paḍichā, the superintendent of the temple, said, "My dear sir, we are all Your servants. Whatever You desire is our duty to perform.
text:
> paḍichā kahe,-āmi-saba sevaka tomāra
> ye tomāra icchā sei kartavya āmāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paḍichā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the superintendent said; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---we are all; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]] [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your servants; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---whatever Your; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kartavya]] [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---our duty.
translation: Upon hearing the Lord's request for them to wash the Guṇḍicā temple, the paḍichā, the superintendent of the temple, said, "My dear sir, we are all Your servants. Whatever You desire is our duty to perform.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.75
description: "The King gave a special order for me to do without delay whatever Your Lordship orders.
text:
> viśeṣe rājāra ājñā hañāche āmāre
> prabhura ājñā yei, sei śīghra karibāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśeṣe]]---specifically; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---there is; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---upon me; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Your Lordship; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]] [[synonyms:k:karibāre]]---to execute without delay.
translation: "The King gave a special order for me to do without delay whatever Your Lordship orders.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.76
description: "My dear Lord, washing the temple is not service befitting You. Nonetheless, if You wish to do so, it is to be accepted as one of Your pastimes.
text:
> tomāra yogya sevā nahe mandira-mārjana
> ei eka līlā kara, ye tomāra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---of You; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---befitting; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---not; [[synonyms:m:mandira]]-[[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---washing the temple; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastime; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---You perform; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---as You like.
translation: "My dear Lord, washing the temple is not service befitting You. Nonetheless, if You wish to do so, it is to be accepted as one of Your pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.77
description: "To wash the temple, You need many waterpots and brooms. Therefore order me. I can immediately bring all these things to You."
text:
> kintu ghaṭa, sammārjanī bahuta cāhiye
> ājñā deha-āji saba ihāṅ āni diye
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kintu]]---but; [[synonyms:g:ghaṭa]]---waterpots; [[synonyms:s:sammārjanī]]---brooms; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]]---many; [[synonyms:c:cāhiye]]---You require; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha]]---just order; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---immediately today; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:āni]] [[synonyms:d:diye]]---I shall bring and deliver.
translation: "To wash the temple, You need many waterpots and brooms. Therefore order me. I can immediately bring all these things to You."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.78
description: As soon as the superintendent understood the desire of the Lord, he immediately delivered a hundred new waterpots and a hundred brooms for sweeping the temple.
text:
> nūtana eka-śata ghaṭa, śata sammārjanī
> paḍichā āniyā dila prabhura icchā jāni'
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nūtana]]---new; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ś:śata]]---one hundred; [[synonyms:g:ghaṭa]]---waterpots; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---hundred; [[synonyms:s:sammārjanī]]---brooms; [[synonyms:p:paḍichā]]---the superintendent; [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---the desire; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing.
translation: As soon as the superintendent understood the desire of the Lord, he immediately delivered a hundred new waterpots and a hundred brooms for sweeping the temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.79
description: The next day, early in the morning, the Lord took His personal associates with Him and, with His own hand, smeared sandalwood pulp on their bodies.
text:
> āra dine prabhāte lañā nija-gaṇa
> śrī-haste sabāra aṅge lepilā candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the next day; [[synonyms:p:prabhāte]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---His personal devotees; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---by His own hand; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on everyone's body; [[synonyms:l:lepilā]] [[synonyms:c:candana]]---smeared pulp of sandalwood.
translation: The next day, early in the morning, the Lord took His personal associates with Him and, with His own hand, smeared sandalwood pulp on their bodies.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.8
description: "If all the devotees associated with the Lord are favorably disposed toward me, they can submit my petition at the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> sei saba dayālu more hañā sadaya
> mora lāgi' prabhu-pade karibe vinaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of them; [[synonyms:d:dayālu]]---merciful; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:d:daya]]---favorably disposed; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for me; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karibe]]---will do; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---humble submission.
translation: "If all the devotees associated with the Lord are favorably disposed toward me, they can submit my petition at the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.80
description: He then gave each devotee a broom with His own hand, and taking all of them personally with Him, the Lord went to Guṇḍicā.
text:
> śrī-haste dila sabāre eka eka mārjanī
> saba-gaṇa lañā prabhu calilā āpani
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---by His own hand; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto every one of them; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one by one; [[synonyms:m:mārjanī]]---a broom; [[synonyms:s:saba]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the associates; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally.
translation: He then gave each devotee a broom with His own hand, and taking all of them personally with Him, the Lord went to Guṇḍicā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.81
description: In this way the Lord and His associates went to cleanse the Guṇḍicā temple. At first they cleansed the temple with the brooms.
text:
> guṇḍicā-mandire gelā karite mārjana
> prathame mārjanī lañā karila śodhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---to the temple known as Guṇḍicā; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---washing; [[synonyms:p:prathame]]---in the first instance; [[synonyms:m:mārjanī]]---the brooms; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---cleansing.
translation: In this way the Lord and His associates went to cleanse the Guṇḍicā temple. At first they cleansed the temple with the brooms.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.82
description: The Lord cleansed everything inside the temple very nicely, including the ceiling. He then took up the sitting place [siṁhāsana], cleansed it and again put it in its original place.
text:
> bhitara mandira upara,-sakala mājila
> siṁhāsana māji' punaḥ sthāpana karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhitara]] [[synonyms:m:mandira]]---of the interior of the temple; [[synonyms:u:upara]]---the ceiling; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:m:mājila]]---cleansed everything; [[synonyms:s:siṁhāsana]]---the sitting place of the Lord; [[synonyms:m:māji']]---cleansing; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:s:sthāpana]]---setting down; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did.
translation: The Lord cleansed everything inside the temple very nicely, including the ceiling. He then took up the sitting place [siṁhāsana], cleansed it and again put it in its original place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.83
description: Thus the Lord and His companions cleansed and swept all the temple's buildings, big and small, and finally cleansed the area between the temple and the kīrtana hall.
text:
> choṭa-baḍa-mandira kaila mārjana-śodhana
> pāche taiche śodhila śrī-jagamohana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:choṭa]]-[[synonyms:b:baḍa]]-[[synonyms:m:mandira]]---all the small and big temples; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]-[[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---proper cleansing; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---in the similar way; [[synonyms:ś:śodhila]]---cleansed; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:j:jagamohana]]---the place between the original temple and the //kīrtana// hall.
translation: Thus the Lord and His companions cleansed and swept all the temple's buildings, big and small, and finally cleansed the area between the temple and the kīrtana hall.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.84
description: Indeed, hundreds of devotees were engaged in cleansing all around the temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was personally carrying out the operation just to instruct others.
text:
> cāri-dike śata bhakta sammārjanī-kare
> āpani śodhena prabhu, śikhā'na sabāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---all around; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---hundreds of; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:s:sammārjanī]]-[[synonyms:k:kare]]---do the cleansing work; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:ś:śodhena]]---cleanses; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ś:śikhā'na]] [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---teaching all others.
translation: Indeed, hundreds of devotees were engaged in cleansing all around the temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was personally carrying out the operation just to instruct others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.85
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and cleansed the temple in great jubilation, chanting the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa all the time. Similarly, all the devotees were also chanting and at the same time performing their respective duties.
text:
> premollāse śodhena, layena kṛṣṇa-nāma
> bhakta-gaṇa 'kṛṣṇa' kahe, kare nija-kāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:u:ullāse]]---in great jubilation; [[synonyms:ś:śodhena]]---cleanses; [[synonyms:l:layena]]---chants; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Hare Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---chant Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:k:kāma]]---their own duty.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and cleansed the temple in great jubilation, chanting the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa all the time. Similarly, all the devotees were also chanting and at the same time performing their respective duties.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.86
description: The entire beautiful body of the Lord was covered with dust and dirt. In this way it became transcendentally beautiful. At times, when cleansing the temple, the Lord shed tears, and in some places He even cleansed with those tears.
text:
> dhūli-dhūsara tanu dekhite śobhana
> kāhāṅ kāhāṅ aśru-jale kare sammārjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust; [[synonyms:d:dhūsara]]---dirt; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]---body; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:ś:śobhana]]---very beautiful; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---somewhere; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---with tears; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:sammārjana]]---washing.
translation: The entire beautiful body of the Lord was covered with dust and dirt. In this way it became transcendentally beautiful. At times, when cleansing the temple, the Lord shed tears, and in some places He even cleansed with those tears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.87
description: After this, the place where the Deity's food was kept [bhoga-mandira] was cleansed. Then the yard was cleansed, and then all the residential quarters, one after the other.
text:
> bhoga-mandira śodhana kari' śodhila prāṅgaṇa
> sakala āvāsa krame karila śodhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]-[[synonyms:m:mandira]]---the place where food is placed; [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---cleansing; [[synonyms:ś:śodhila]] [[synonyms:p:prāṅgaṇa]]---cleansed the yard; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:āvāsa]]---residential places; [[synonyms:k:krame]]---one after another; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---cleansed.
translation: After this, the place where the Deity's food was kept [bhoga-mandira] was cleansed. Then the yard was cleansed, and then all the residential quarters, one after the other.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.88
description: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu collected all the straw, dust and grains of sand in one place, He gathered it all in His cloth and threw it outside.
text:
> tṛṇa, dhūli, jhiṅkura, saba ekatra kariyā
> bahirvāse lañā phelāya bāhira kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tṛṇa]]---straws; [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust; [[synonyms:j:jhiṅkura]]---grains of sand; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---in one place; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---combining; [[synonyms:b:bahirvāse]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking on His personal cloth; [[synonyms:p:phelāya]]---throws; [[synonyms:b:bāhira]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---outside.
translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu collected all the straw, dust and grains of sand in one place, He gathered it all in His cloth and threw it outside.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.89
description: Following the example of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees, in great jubilation, began to gather straws and dust with their own cloths and throw them outside the temple.
text:
> ei-mata bhakta-gaṇa kari' nija-vāse
> tṛṇa, dhūli bāhire phelāya parama hariṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---similarly; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:v:vāse]]---in their own cloths; [[synonyms:t:tṛṇa]]---straw; [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]] [[synonyms:p:phelāya]]---throw outside; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:h:hariṣe]]---with great jubilation.
translation: Following the example of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the devotees, in great jubilation, began to gather straws and dust with their own cloths and throw them outside the temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.9
description: "By the mercy of all the devotees, one can attain the shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord. Without His mercy, my kingdom does not appeal to me.
text:
> tāṅ-sabāra prasāde mile śrī-prabhura pāya
> prabhu-kṛpā vinā mora rājya nāhi bhāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:p:prasāde]]---by the mercy of all of them; [[synonyms:m:mile]]---one gets; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of the Lord; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:r:rājya]]---kingdom; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:b:bhāya]]---appeal to me.
translation: "By the mercy of all the devotees, one can attain the shelter of the lotus feet of the Lord. Without His mercy, my kingdom does not appeal to me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.90
description: The Lord then told the devotees, "I can tell how much you have labored and how well you have cleansed the temple simply by seeing all the straw and dust you have collected outside."
text:
> prabhu kahe,-ke kata kariyācha sammārjana
> tṛṇa, dhūli dekhilei jāniba pariśrama
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---every one of you; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---how much; [[synonyms:k:kariyācha]]---have done; [[synonyms:s:sammārjana]]---cleansing; [[synonyms:t:tṛṇa]]---straw; [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust; [[synonyms:d:dekhilei]]---when I see; [[synonyms:j:jāniba]]---I can understand; [[synonyms:p:pariśrama]]---how much you have labored.
translation: The Lord then told the devotees, "I can tell how much you have labored and how well you have cleansed the temple simply by seeing all the straw and dust you have collected outside."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.91
description: Even though all the devotees collected dirt in one pile, the dirt collected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was much greater.
text:
> sabāra jhyāṅṭāna bojhā ekatra karila
> sabā haite prabhura bojhā adhika ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:j:jhyāṅṭāna]]---the dirt collected; [[synonyms:b:bojhā]]---load; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---combined in one place; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:b:bojhā]]---the pile of dirt collected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:adhika]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was greater.
translation: Even though all the devotees collected dirt in one pile, the dirt collected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was much greater.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.92
description: After the inside of the temple was cleansed, the Lord again allotted areas for the devotees to cleanse.
text:
> ei-mata abhyantara karila mārjana
> punaḥ sabākāre dila kariyā vaṇṭana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:a:abhyantara]]---inside; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---cleansing; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:s:sabākāre]]---to all of them; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:v:vaṇṭana]]---allotting areas.
translation: After the inside of the temple was cleansed, the Lord again allotted areas for the devotees to cleanse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.93
description: The Lord then ordered everyone to cleanse the inside of the temple very perfectly by taking finer dust, straws and grains of sand and throwing them outside.
text:
> sūkṣma dhūli, tṛṇa, kāṅkara, saba karaha dūra
> bhāla-mate śodhana karaha prabhura antaḥpura
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sūkṣma]] [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---fine dust; [[synonyms:t:tṛṇa]]---straw; [[synonyms:k:kāṅkara]]---grains of sand; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karaha]]---do; [[synonyms:d:dūra]]---away; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---very well; [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---cleansing; [[synonyms:k:karaha]]---do; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:a:antaḥpura]]---inside.
translation: The Lord then ordered everyone to cleanse the inside of the temple very perfectly by taking finer dust, straws and grains of sand and throwing them outside.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.94
description: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the Vaiṣṇavas cleansed the temple for the second time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy to see the cleansing work.
text:
> saba vaiṣṇava lañā yabe dui-bāra śodhila
> dekhi' mahāprabhura mane santoṣa ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---for the second time; [[synonyms:ś:śodhila]]---cleansed; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]]---satisfaction; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was.
translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the Vaiṣṇavas cleansed the temple for the second time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy to see the cleansing work.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.95
description: While the temple was being swept, about a hundred men stood ready with filled waterpots, and they simply awaited the Lord's order to throw the water from them.
text:
> āra śata jana śata ghaṭe jala bhari'
> prathamei lañā āche kāla apekṣā kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---about one hundred men; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:g:ghaṭe]]---in a hundred waterpots; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling; [[synonyms:p:prathamei]]---in the first instance; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---were; [[synonyms:k:kāla]]---the time; [[synonyms:a:apekṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---awaiting.
translation: While the temple was being swept, about a hundred men stood ready with filled waterpots, and they simply awaited the Lord's order to throw the water from them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.96
description: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for water, all the men immediately brought the hundred waterpots, which were completely filled, and delivered them before the Lord.
text:
> 'jala āna' bali' yabe mahāprabhu kahila
> tabe śata ghaṭa āni' prabhu-āge dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]] [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---bring water; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---ordered; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:g:ghaṭa]]---one hundred pots; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before the Lord; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered.
translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for water, all the men immediately brought the hundred waterpots, which were completely filled, and delivered them before the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.97
description: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu first washed the main temple and then thoroughly washed the ceiling, the walls, the floor, the sitting place [siṁhāsana] and everything else within the room.
text:
> prathame karila prabhu mandira prakṣālana
> ūrdhva-adho bhitti, gṛha-madhya, siṁhāsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prathame]]---in the first instance; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mandira]] [[synonyms:p:prakṣālana]]---washing of the temple; [[synonyms:ū:ūrdhva]]---on the ceiling; [[synonyms:a:adhaḥ]]---on the floor; [[synonyms:b:bhitti]]---walls; [[synonyms:g:gṛha]]-[[synonyms:m:madhya]]---within the home; [[synonyms:s:siṁhāsana]]---the sitting place of the Lord.
translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu first washed the main temple and then thoroughly washed the ceiling, the walls, the floor, the sitting place [siṁhāsana] and everything else within the room.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.98
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself and His devotees began to throw water onto the ceiling. When this water fell, it washed the walls and floor.
text:
> khāparā bhariyā jala ūrdhve cālāila
> sei jale ūrdhva śodhi bhitti prakṣālila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:khāparā]]---basin; [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---filling; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:ū:ūrdhve]]---on the ceiling; [[synonyms:c:cālāila]]---began to throw; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:j:jale]]---with that water; [[synonyms:ū:ūrdhva]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhi]]---washing the ceiling; [[synonyms:b:bhitti]]---walls and floor; [[synonyms:p:prakṣālila]]---washed.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself and His devotees began to throw water onto the ceiling. When this water fell, it washed the walls and floor.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 12.99
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to wash the sitting place of Lord Jagannātha with His own hands, and all the devotees began to bring water to the Lord.
text:
> śrī-haste karena siṁhāsanera mārjana
> prabhu āge jala āni' deya bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---with His own hand; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:s:siṁhāsanera]] [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---washing of the sitting place of the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before the Lord; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:deya]]---deliver; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all devotees.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to wash the sitting place of Lord Jagannātha with His own hands, and all the devotees began to bring water to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.1
description: May the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, who danced in front of the car of Śrī Jagannātha, be all glorified! By seeing His dancing, not only was the whole universe held in wonder, but Lord Jagannātha Himself became very much astonished.
text:
> sa jīyāt kṛṣṇa-caitanyaḥ
> śrī-rathāgre nanarta yaḥ
> yenāsīj jagatāṁ citraṁ
> jagannātho 'pi vismitaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:j:jīyāt]]---may live long; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanyaḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:a:agre]]---in the front of the car; [[synonyms:n:nanarta]]---danced; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---by whom; [[synonyms:ā:āsīt]]---there was; [[synonyms:j:jagatām]]---of the whole universe; [[synonyms:c:citram]]---wonder; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthaḥ]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:a:api]]---also; [[synonyms:v:vismitaḥ]]---was astonished.
translation: May the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, who danced in front of the car of Śrī Jagannātha, be all glorified! By seeing His dancing, not only was the whole universe held in wonder, but Lord Jagannātha Himself became very much astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.10
description: The Lord Jagannātha Deity was bound at the waist by a strong, thick rope made of silk. From two sides the dayitās caught hold of this rope and raised the Deity.
text:
> kaṭi-taṭe baddha, dṛḍha sthūla paṭṭa-ḍorī
> dui dike dayitā-gaṇa uṭhāya tāhā dhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaṭi]]-[[synonyms:t:taṭe]]---on the waist; [[synonyms:b:baddha]]---bound; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---strong; [[synonyms:s:sthūla]]---thick; [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---rope made of silk; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:d:dike]]---from two sides; [[synonyms:d:dayitā]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //dayitās//; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāya]]---raise; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that rope; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching.
translation: The Lord Jagannātha Deity was bound at the waist by a strong, thick rope made of silk. From two sides the dayitās caught hold of this rope and raised the Deity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.100
description: The goddess of fortune, Subhadrā, and Lord Balarāma both felt great happiness and ecstasy within Their hearts. Indeed, They were seen smiling at the dancing.
text:
> subhadrā-balarāmera hṛdaye ullāsa
> nṛtya dekhi' dui janāra śrī-mukhete hāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:subhadrā]]---of the goddess Subhadrā; [[synonyms:b:balarāmera]]---and of Balarāma; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the hearts; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---ecstasy; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:janāra]]---of the two persons; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhete]]---in the beautiful mouths; [[synonyms:h:hāsa]]---smiling.
translation: The goddess of fortune, Subhadrā, and Lord Balarāma both felt great happiness and ecstasy within Their hearts. Indeed, They were seen smiling at the dancing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.101
description: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and jumped high, eight wonderful transformations indicative of divine ecstasy were seen in His body. All these symptoms were visible simultaneously.
text:
> uddaṇḍa nṛtye prabhura adbhuta vikāra
> aṣṭa sāttvika bhāva udaya haya sama-kāla
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uddaṇḍa]]---jumping; [[synonyms:n:nṛtye]]---by dancing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]] [[synonyms:s:sāttvika]]---eight transcendental kinds; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstasy; [[synonyms:u:udaya]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---awaken; [[synonyms:s:sama]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---simultaneously.
translation: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and jumped high, eight wonderful transformations indicative of divine ecstasy were seen in His body. All these symptoms were visible simultaneously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.102
description: His skin erupted with goose pimples, and the hairs of His body stood on end. His body resembled the śimulī [silk cotton tree], all covered with thorns.
text:
> māṁsa-vraṇa sama roma-vṛnda pulakita
> śimulīra vṛkṣa yena kaṇṭaka-veṣṭita
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:māṁsa]]---skin; [[synonyms:v:vraṇa]]---pimples; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---like; [[synonyms:r:roma]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---the hairs of the body; [[synonyms:p:pulakita]]---erupted; [[synonyms:ś:śimulīra]] [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]---cotton tree; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭaka]]---by thorns; [[synonyms:v:veṣṭita]]---surrounded.
translation: His skin erupted with goose pimples, and the hairs of His body stood on end. His body resembled the śimulī [silk cotton tree], all covered with thorns.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.103
description: Indeed, the people became afraid just to see His teeth chatter, and they even thought that His teeth would fall out.
text:
> eka eka dantera kampa dekhite lāge bhaya
> loke jāne, danta saba khasiyā paḍaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one after another; [[synonyms:d:dantera]]---of teeth; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---movement; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---there is; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---fear; [[synonyms:l:loke]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---the people understood; [[synonyms:d:danta]]---the teeth; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:khasiyā]]---being loosened; [[synonyms:p:paḍaya]]---fall down.
translation: Indeed, the people became afraid just to see His teeth chatter, and they even thought that His teeth would fall out.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.104
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's whole body flowed with perspiration and at the same time oozed blood. He made the sounds "jaja gaga, jaja gaga" in a voice choked with ecstasy.
text:
> sarvāṅge prasveda chuṭe tāte raktodgama
> jaja gaga' 'jaja gaga'-gadgada-vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarvāṅge]]---all over the body; [[synonyms:p:prasveda]]---perspiration; [[synonyms:c:chuṭe]]---flows; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---along with it; [[synonyms:r:rakta]]-[[synonyms:u:udgama]]---oozing out of blood; [[synonyms:j:jaja]] [[synonyms:g:gaga]] [[synonyms:j:jaja]] [[synonyms:g:gaga]]---a sound indicating the name Jagannātha; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]---choked up due to ecstasy; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's whole body flowed with perspiration and at the same time oozed blood. He made the sounds "jaja gaga, jaja gaga" in a voice choked with ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.105
description: Tears came forcefully from the eyes of the Lord, as if from a syringe, and all the people surrounding Him became wet.
text:
> jalayantra-dhārā yaiche vahe aśru-jala
> āśa-pāśe loka yata bhijila sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:y:yantra]]---from a syringe; [[synonyms:d:dhārā]]---pouring of water; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as if; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---are flowing; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:j:jala]]---tears from the eyes; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---on all sides; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as there were; [[synonyms:b:bhijila]]---become wet; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: Tears came forcefully from the eyes of the Lord, as if from a syringe, and all the people surrounding Him became wet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.106
description: Everyone saw the complexion of His body change from white to pink, so that His luster resembled that of the mallikā flower.
text:
> deha-kānti gaura-varṇa dekhiye aruṇa
> kabhu kānti dekhi yena mallikā-puṣpa-sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:k:kānti]]---of the luster of the body; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:v:varṇa]]---white complexion; [[synonyms:d:dekhiye]]---everyone saw; [[synonyms:a:aruṇa]]---pink; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:kānti]]---the luster; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:m:mallikā]]-[[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---resembling the //mallikā// flower.
translation: Everyone saw the complexion of His body change from white to pink, so that His luster resembled that of the mallikā flower.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.107
description: Sometimes He appeared stunned, and sometimes He rolled on the ground. Indeed, sometimes His legs and hands became as hard as dry wood, and He did not move.
text:
> kabhu stambha, kabhu prabhu bhūmite loṭāya
> śuṣka-kāṣṭha-sama pada-hasta nā calaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:s:stambha]]---stunned; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhūmite]]---on the ground; [[synonyms:l:loṭāya]]---rolls; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]---dry; [[synonyms:k:kāṣṭha]]---wood; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---like; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:h:hasta]]---legs and hands; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---do not; [[synonyms:c:calaya]]---move.
translation: Sometimes He appeared stunned, and sometimes He rolled on the ground. Indeed, sometimes His legs and hands became as hard as dry wood, and He did not move.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.108
description: When the Lord fell on the ground, sometimes His breathing almost stopped. When the devotees saw this, their lives also became very feeble.
text:
> kabhu bhūme paḍe, kabhu śvāsa haya hīna
> yāhā dekhi' bhakta-gaṇera prāṇa haya kṣīṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:b:bhūme]]---on the ground; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---falls down; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:ś:śvāsa]]---breathing; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:h:hīna]]---nil; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing which; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:k:kṣīṇa]]---feeble.
translation: When the Lord fell on the ground, sometimes His breathing almost stopped. When the devotees saw this, their lives also became very feeble.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.109
description: Water flowed from His eyes and sometimes through His nostrils, and foam fell from His mouth. These flowings appeared to be torrents of nectar descending from the moon.
text:
> kabhu netre nāsāya jala, mukhe paḍe phena
> amṛtera dhārā candra-bimbe vahe yena
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---from the eyes; [[synonyms:n:nāsāya]]---from the nostrils; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouth; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fell; [[synonyms:p:phena]]---foam; [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]]---of nectar; [[synonyms:d:dhārā]]---torrents; [[synonyms:c:candra]]-[[synonyms:b:bimbe]]---from the moon; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---flow; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if.
translation: Water flowed from His eyes and sometimes through His nostrils, and foam fell from His mouth. These flowings appeared to be torrents of nectar descending from the moon.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.11
description: Strong, puffed-up cotton pads called tulīs were spread out from the throne to the car, and the heavy Deity of Lord Jagannātha was carried from one pillow-like pad to the next by the dayitās.
text:
> ucca dṛḍha tulī saba pāti' sthāne sthāne
> eka tulī haite tvarāya āra tulīte āne
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ucca]]---puffed up; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---strong; [[synonyms:t:tulī]]---pads made of cotton; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:p:pāti']]---spreading; [[synonyms:s:sthānesthāne]]---from one place to another; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:t:tulī]]---one pad; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:t:tvarāya]]---very soon; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---next; [[synonyms:t:tulīte]]---on the pad; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---bring.
translation: Strong, puffed-up cotton pads called tulīs were spread out from the throne to the car, and the heavy Deity of Lord Jagannātha was carried from one pillow-like pad to the next by the dayitās.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.110
description: The foam which fell from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taken and drunk by Śubhānanda because he was very fortunate and expert in relishing the mellow of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> sei phena lañā śubhānanda kaila pāna
> kṛṣṇa-prema-rasika teṅho mahā-bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:seiphena]]---that foam; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:ś:śubhānanda]]---a devotee named Śubhānanda; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---drinking; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:r:rasika]]---relisher of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---very fortunate.
translation: The foam which fell from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taken and drunk by Śubhānanda because he was very fortunate and expert in relishing the mellow of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.111
description: After performing His devastating dance for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind entered into a mood of ecstatic love.
text:
> ei-mata tāṇḍava-nṛtya kaila kata-kṣaṇa
> bhāva-viśeṣe prabhura praveśila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:t:tāṇḍava]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---devastating dancing; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:v:viśeṣe]]---in a particular ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:praveśila]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind entered.
translation: After performing His devastating dance for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind entered into a mood of ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.112
description: After abandoning the dancing, the Lord ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing. Understanding His mind, Svarūpa Dāmodara began to sing as follows.
text:
> tāṇḍava-nṛtya chāḍi' svarūpere ājñā dila
> hṛdaya jāniyā svarūpa gāite lāgila

translation: After abandoning the dancing, the Lord ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing. Understanding His mind, Svarūpa Dāmodara began to sing as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.113
description: "Now I have gained the Lord of My life, in the absence of whom I was being burned by Cupid and was withering away."
text:
> "sei ta parāṇa-nātha pāinu
> yāhā lāgi' madana-dahane jhuri' genu"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:t:ta]]---that indeed; [[synonyms:p:parāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the master of My life; [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---I have gotten; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for whom; [[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:d:dahane]]---being burned by Cupid; [[synonyms:j:jhuri']] [[synonyms:g:genu]]---I became dried up.
translation: "Now I have gained the Lord of My life, in the absence of whom I was being burned by Cupid and was withering away."
purport: This song refers to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's meeting with Kṛṣṇa at the holy place of Kurukṣetra, where Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and His brother and sister came to visit when there was a solar eclipse. It is a song of separation from Kṛṣṇa. When Rādhārāṇī met Kṛṣṇa at Kurukṣetra, She remembered His intimate association in Vṛndāvana, and She thought, "Now I have gained the Lord of my life. In His absence I was being burned by the arrow of Cupid, and thus I was withering away. Now I have My life again."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.114
description: When this refrain was loudly sung by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began rhythmically dancing in transcendental bliss.

> ei dhuyā uccaiḥ-svare gāya dāmodara

translation: When this refrain was loudly sung by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again began rhythmically dancing in transcendental bliss.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.115

> dhīre dhīre jagannātha karena gamana

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.116

translation: While dancing and singing, all the devotees in front of Lord Jagannātha kept their eyes on Him. Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the end of the procession with the saṅkīrtana performers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.117

> jagannāthe magna prabhura nayana-hṛdaya
> śrī-hasta-yuge kare gītera abhinaya

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.118
description: When Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dramatically enacting the song, He would sometimes fall behind in the procession. At such times, Lord Jagannātha would come to a standstill. When Caitanya Mahāprabhu again went forward, Lord Jagannātha's car would slowly start again.
text:
> gaura yadi pāche cale, śyāma haya sthire
> gaura āge cale, śyāma cale dhīre-dhīre

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.119
description: Thus there was a sort of competition between Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Jagannātha in seeing who would lead, but Caitanya Mahāprabhu was so strong that He made Lord Jagannātha wait in His car.
text:
> ei-mata gaura-śyāme, doṅhe ṭhelāṭheli
> svarathe śyāmere rākhe gaura mahā-balī
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:ś:śyāme]]---Lord Jagannātha and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:doṅhe]]---between both of Them; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhelāṭheli]]---competition of pushing forward; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:r:rathe]]---in His own car; [[synonyms:ś:śyāmere]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keeps; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:balī]]---greatly powerful.
translation: Thus there was a sort of competition between Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Jagannātha in seeing who would lead, but Caitanya Mahāprabhu was so strong that He made Lord Jagannātha wait in His car.
purport: After giving up the company of the //gopīs// in Vṛndāvana, Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, engaged in His pastimes at Dvārakā. When Kṛṣṇa went to Kurukṣetra with His brother and sister and others from Dvārakā, He again met the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is //rādhā-bhāva-dyuti-suvalita,// that is, Kṛṣṇa Himself assuming the part of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī in order to understand Kṛṣṇa. Lord Jagannātha-deva is Kṛṣṇa, and Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Caitanya Mahāprabhu's leading Lord Jagannātha toward Guṇḍicā temple corresponded to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's leading Kṛṣṇa toward Vṛndāvana. Śrī Kṣetra, Jagannātha Purī, was taken as the kingdom of Dvārakā, the place where Kṛṣṇa enjoys supreme opulence. However, He was being led by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Vṛndāvana, the simple village where all the inhabitants are filled with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. Śrī Kṣetra is a place of //aiśvarya-līlā,// just as Vṛndāvana is the place of //mādhurya-līlā.// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's following at the rear of the //ratha// indicated that Lord Jagannātha, Kṛṣṇa, was forgetting the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana. Although Kṛṣṇa neglected the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana, He could not forget them. Thus in His opulent Ratha-yātrā, He was returning to Vṛndāvana. In the role of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was examining whether the Lord still remembered the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana. When Caitanya Mahāprabhu fell behind the Ratha car, Jagannātha-deva, Kṛṣṇa Himself, understood the mind of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Therefore, Jagannātha sometimes fell behind the dancing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to indicate to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī that He had not forgotten. Thus Lord Jagannātha would wait on the //ratha// for their forward march. In this way Lord Jagannātha agreed that without the ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī He could not feel satisfied. While Jagannātha was thus waiting, Gaurasundara, Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in His ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, immediately came forward to Kṛṣṇa. At such times, Lord Jagannātha would proceed ahead very slowly. These competitive exchanges were all part of the love affair between Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. In that competition between Lord Caitanya's ecstasy for Jagannātha and Jagannātha's ecstasy for Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, Caitanya Mahāprabhu emerged successful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.12
description: While the dayitās carried the heavy Jagannātha Deity from one pad to the next, some of the pads broke, and the cotton contents floated into the air. When they broke, they made a heavy, cracking sound.
text:
> prabhu-padāghāte tulī haya khaṇḍa khaṇḍa
> tulā saba uḍi' yāya, śabda haya pracaṇḍa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:ā:āghāte]]---by the kicking of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tulī]]---the pads; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---become; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]] [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]---broken to pieces; [[synonyms:t:tulā]]---cotton from inside; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:u:uḍi']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---rises; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---sound; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:p:pracaṇḍa]]---very much.
translation: While the dayitās carried the heavy Jagannātha Deity from one pad to the next, some of the pads broke, and the cotton contents floated into the air. When they broke, they made a heavy, cracking sound.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.120
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, His ecstasy changed. Raising His two arms, He began to recite the following verse in a loud voice.
text:
> nācite nācite prabhura hailā bhāvāntara
> hasta tuli' śloka paḍe kari' uccaiḥ-svara

translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, His ecstasy changed. Raising His two arms, He began to recite the following verse in a loud voice.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.121
description: "That very personality who stole away my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."
text:
> yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās
> te conmīlita-mālatī-surabhayaḥ prauḍhāḥ kadambānilāḥ
> sā caivāsmi tathāpi tatra surata-vyāpāra-līlā-vidhau
> revā-rodhasi vetasī-taru-tale cetaḥ samutkaṇṭhate
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---that same person who; [[synonyms:k:kaumāra]]-[[synonyms:h:haraḥ]]---the thief of my heart during youth; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---he; [[synonyms:e:eva]] [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly; [[synonyms:v:varaḥ]]---lover; [[synonyms:t:tāḥ]]---these; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:c:caitra]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣapāḥ]]---moonlit nights of the month of Caitra; [[synonyms:t:te]]---those; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:u:unmīlita]]---fructified; [[synonyms:m:mālatī]]---of //mālatī// flowers; [[synonyms:s:surabhayaḥ]]---fragrances; [[synonyms:p:prauḍhāḥ]]---full; [[synonyms:k:kadamba]]---with the fragrance of the //kadamba// flower; [[synonyms:a:anilāḥ]]---the breezes; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---that one; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:a:asmi]]---I am; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:t:tatra]]---there; [[synonyms:s:surata]]-[[synonyms:v:vyāpāra]]---in intimate transactions; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:v:vidhau]]---in the manner; [[synonyms:r:revā]]---of the river named Revā; [[synonyms:r:rodhasi]]---on the bank; [[synonyms:v:vetasī]]---of the name Vetasī; [[synonyms:t:taru]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath the tree; [[synonyms:c:cetaḥ]]---my mind; [[synonyms:s:samutkaṇṭhate]]---is very eager to go.
translation: "That very personality who stole away my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."
purport: This verse appears in the //Padyāvalī// (382), an anthology of verses compiled by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.122
description: This verse was recited by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again and again. But for Svarūpa Dāmodara, no one could understand its meaning.
text:
> ei śloka mahāprabhu paḍe bāra bāra
> svarūpa vinā artha keha nā jāne ihāra

translation: This verse was recited by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again and again. But for Svarūpa Dāmodara, no one could understand its meaning.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.123
description: I have already explained this verse. Now I shall simply describe it in brief.
text:
> ei ślokārtha pūrve kariyāchi vyākhyāna
> ślokera bhāvārtha kari saṅkṣepe ākhyāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning of this verse; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]]---I have done; [[synonyms:v:vyākhyāna]]---explanation; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the same verse; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---purport; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I do; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]]---in brief; [[synonyms:ā:ākhyāna]]---description.
translation: I have already explained this verse. Now I shall simply describe it in brief.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.124
description: Formerly, all the gopīs of Vṛndāvana were very pleased when they met with Kṛṣṇa in the holy place Kurukṣetra.

translation: Formerly, all the gopīs of Vṛndāvana were very pleased when they met with Kṛṣṇa in the holy place Kurukṣetra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.125
description: Similarly, after seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awoke with the ecstasy of the gopīs. Being absorbed in this ecstasy, He asked Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing the refrain.
text:

> sei bhāvāviṣṭa hañā dhuyā gāoyāila

translation: Similarly, after seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awoke with the ecstasy of the gopīs. Being absorbed in this ecstasy, He asked Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing the refrain.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.126
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke thus to Lord Jagannātha: "You are the same Kṛṣṇa, and I am the same Rādhārāṇī. We are meeting again in the same way that We met in the beginning of Our lives.
text:
> aveśeṣe rādhā kṛṣṇe kare nivedana
> sei tumi, sei āmi, sei nava saṅgama
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣe]]---at last; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submission; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You are the same Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I am the same Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:s:saṅgama]]---We are meeting in the same new spirit as in the beginning.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke thus to Lord Jagannātha: "You are the same Kṛṣṇa, and I am the same Rādhārāṇī. We are meeting again in the same way that We met in the beginning of Our lives.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.127
description: "Although We are both the same, My mind is still attracted to Vṛndāvana-dhāma. I wish that You will please again appear with Your lotus feet in Vṛndāvana.
text:
> tathāpi āmāra mana hare vṛndāvana
> vṛndāvane udaya karāo āpana-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---yet; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attracts; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Śrī Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:u:udaya]] [[synonyms:k:karāo]]---please cause to reappear; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the brilliance of Your lotus feet.
translation: "Although We are both the same, My mind is still attracted to Vṛndāvana-dhāma. I wish that You will please again appear with Your lotus feet in Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.128
description: "Kurukṣetra is crowded with people, their elephants and horses, and the rattling of chariots. In Vṛndāvana, however, there are flower gardens, and the humming of the bees and chirping of the birds can be heard.
text:
> ihāṅ lokāraṇya, hātī, ghoḍā, ratha-dhvani
> tāhāṅ puṣpāraṇya, bhṛṅga-pika-nāda śuni

translation: "Kurukṣetra is crowded with people, their elephants and horses, and the rattling of chariots. In Vṛndāvana, however, there are flower gardens, and the humming of the bees and chirping of the birds can be heard.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.129
description: "Here at Kurukṣetra You are dressed like a royal prince, accompanied by great warriors, but in Vṛndāvana You appeared just like an ordinary cowherd boy, accompanied only by Your beautiful flute.
text:
> ihāṅ rāja-veśa, saṅge saba kṣatriya-gaṇa
> tāhāṅ gopa-veśa, saṅge muralī-vādana

translation: "Here at Kurukṣetra You are dressed like a royal prince, accompanied by great warriors, but in Vṛndāvana You appeared just like an ordinary cowherd boy, accompanied only by Your beautiful flute.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.13
description: Lord Jagannātha is the maintainer of the whole universe. Who can carry Him from one place to another? However, the Lord moves by His personal will just to perform His pastimes.
text:
> viśvambhara jagannāthe ke cālāite pāre?
> āpana icchāya cale karite vihāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśvambhara]]---the maintainer of the universe; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthe]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:c:cālāite]]---cause to be carried; [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]---personal; [[synonyms:i:icchāya]]---by His will; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---moves; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to act; [[synonyms:v:vihāre]]---in pastimes.
translation: Lord Jagannātha is the maintainer of the whole universe. Who can carry Him from one place to another? However, the Lord moves by His personal will just to perform His pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.130
description: "Here there is not even a drop of the ocean of transcendental happiness that I enjoyed with You in Vṛndāvana.
text:
> vraje tomāra saṅge yei sukha-āsvādana
> sei sukha-samudrera ihāṅ nāhi eka kaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---of You; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the company; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---what; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---taste of transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:s:samudrera]]---of the ocean of transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here, at Kurukṣetra; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---drop.
translation: "Here there is not even a drop of the ocean of transcendental happiness that I enjoyed with You in Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.131
description: "I therefore request You to come to Vṛndāvana and enjoy pastimes with Me. If You do so, My ambition will be fulfilled."
text:
> āmā lañā punaḥ līlā karaha vṛndāvane
> tabe āmāra mano-vāñchā haya ta' pūraṇe

translation: "I therefore request You to come to Vṛndāvana and enjoy pastimes with Me. If You do so, My ambition will be fulfilled."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.132

> bhāgavate āche yaiche rādhikā-vacana
> pūrve tāhā sūtra-madhye kariyāchi varṇana

translation: I have already described in brief Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's statement from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.133
description: In that ecstatic mood, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited many other verses, but people in general cannot understand their meaning.
text:
> sei bhāvāveśe prabhu paḍe āra śloka
> sei saba ślokera artha nāhi bujhe loka
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of all verses; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---do not; [[synonyms:b:bujhe]]---understand; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people in general.
translation: In that ecstatic mood, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited many other verses, but people in general cannot understand their meaning.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.134

> svarūpa-gosāñi jāne, nā kahe artha tāra
> śrī-rūpa-gosāñi kaila se artha pracāra

translation: The meaning of those verses was known to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, but he did not reveal it. However, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī has broadcast the meaning.

> svarūpa saṅge yāra artha kare āsvādana
