translation: Seeing Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura standing before the King, Haricandana touched Śrīvāsa with his hand and requested him to step aside.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.94
description: Absorbed in watching Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dance, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura could not understand why he was being touched and pushed. After he was pushed again and again, he became angry.
text:
> nṛtyāveśe śrīnivāsa kichui nā jāne
> bāra bāra ṭhele, teṅho krodha haila mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---fully absorbed in seeing the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrīnivāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kichui]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---does not; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---know; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhele]]---when he pushes; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---angry; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind.
translation: Absorbed in watching Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dance, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura could not understand why he was being touched and pushed. After he was pushed again and again, he became angry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.95
description: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura slapped Haricandana to stop him from pushing him. In turn, this made Haricandana angry.
text:
> cāpaḍa māriyā tāre kaila nivāraṇa
> cāpaḍa khāñā kruddha hailā haricandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāpaḍa]] [[synonyms:m:māriyā]]---slapping; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nivāraṇa]]---stopped; [[synonyms:c:cāpaḍa]] [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---getting the slap; [[synonyms:k:kruddha]]---angry; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:h:haricandana]]---Haricandana.
translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura slapped Haricandana to stop him from pushing him. In turn, this made Haricandana angry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.96
description: As the angered Haricandana was about to speak to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Pratāparudra Mahārāja personally stopped him.
text:
> kruddha hañā tāṅre kichu cāhe balibāre
> āpani pratāparudra nivārila tāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kruddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming angry; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants; [[synonyms:b:balibāre]]---to speak; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:pratāparudra]]---King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:n:nivārila]]---stopped; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto him.
translation: As the angered Haricandana was about to speak to Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Pratāparudra Mahārāja personally stopped him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.97
description: King Pratāparudra said, "You are very fortunate, for you have been graced by the touch of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. I am not so fortunate. You should feel obliged to him."
text:
> bhāgyavān tumi-iṅhāra hasta-sparśa pāilā
> āmāra bhāgye nāhi, tumi kṛtārtha hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]] [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you are very fortunate; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]---of the hand; [[synonyms:s:sparśa]]---touch; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---have received; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhāgye]]---in my fortune; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is no such thing; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---have become graced.
translation: King Pratāparudra said, "You are very fortunate, for you have been graced by the touch of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. I am not so fortunate. You should feel obliged to him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.98
description: Everyone was astonished by the dancing of Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and even Lord Jagannātha became extremely happy to see Him.
text:
> prabhura nṛtya dekhi' loke haila camatkāra
> anya āchuk, jagannāthera ānanda apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---everyone; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonished; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:ā:āchuk]]---let alone others; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---there was extreme happiness.
translation: Everyone was astonished by the dancing of Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and even Lord Jagannātha became extremely happy to see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 13.99
description: The car came to a complete standstill and remained immobile while Lord Jagannātha, with unblinking eyes, watched the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ratha sthira kaila, āge nā kare gamana
> animiṣa-netre kare nṛtya daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---stopped; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---forward; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---moving; [[synonyms:a:animiṣa]]---unblinking; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---with eyes; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---of the dancing; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing.
translation: The car came to a complete standstill and remained immobile while Lord Jagannātha, with unblinking eyes, watched the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.1
description: Accompanied by His personal devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the festival known as Lakṣmī-vijayotsava. There He discussed the superexcellent love of the gopīs. Just by hearing about them, He became very pleased and danced in great ecstatic love for the Lord.
text:
> gauraḥ paśyann ātma-vṛndaiḥ
> śrī-lakṣmī-vijayotsavam
> śrutvā gopī-rasollāsaṁ
> hṛṣṭaḥ premṇā nanarta saḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauraḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paśyan]]---by seeing; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛndaiḥ]]---with His personal associates; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:v:vijaya]] [[synonyms:u:utsavam]]---the grand festival; [[synonyms:ś:śrutvā]]---by hearing; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:u:ullāsam]]---the superexcellence of the mellows; [[synonyms:h:hṛṣṭaḥ]]---being very pleased; [[synonyms:p:premṇā]]---in great ecstatic love; [[synonyms:n:nanarta]]---danced; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Accompanied by His personal devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the festival known as Lakṣmī-vijayotsava. There He discussed the superexcellent love of the gopīs. Just by hearing about them, He became very pleased and danced in great ecstatic love for the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.10
description: As soon as the King recited the verse beginning with the words "tava kathāmṛtam," the Lord immediately arose in ecstatic love and embraced him.
text:
> "tava kathāmṛtaṁ" śloka rājā ye paḍila
> uṭhi' premāveśe prabhu āliṅgana kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tava]] [[synonyms:k:kathāmṛtam]]---beginning with the words //tava kathāmṛtam//; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---the verse; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:p:paḍila]]---as he recited; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---embraced.
translation: As soon as the King recited the verse beginning with the words "tava kathāmṛtam," the Lord immediately arose in ecstatic love and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.100
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then ordered Vakreśvara Paṇḍita to dance, and as he began to dance, the Lord began to sing.
text:
> tabe vakreśvare prabhu kahilā nācite
> vakreśvara nāce, prabhu lāgilā gāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvare]]---unto Vakreśvara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---ordered; [[synonyms:n:nācite]]---to dance; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]] [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---Vakreśvara Paṇḍita began to dance; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began; [[synonyms:g:gāite]]---to sing.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then ordered Vakreśvara Paṇḍita to dance, and as he began to dance, the Lord began to sing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.101
description: Then devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara and other kīrtana performers began to sing along with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Being inundated with ecstatic love, they lost all consideration of time and circumstance.
text:
> prabhu-saṅge svarūpādi kīrtanīyā gāya
> dik-vidik nāhi jñāna premera vanyāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:k:kīrtanīyā]]---chanters; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sing; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:v:vidik]]---of time and circumstances; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---knowledge; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:v:vanyāya]]---by inundation.
translation: Then devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara and other kīrtana performers began to sing along with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Being inundated with ecstatic love, they lost all consideration of time and circumstance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.102
description: After thus performing pastimes in the garden for some time, they all went to a lake called Narendra-sarovara and there enjoyed sporting in the water.
text:
> ei mata kata-kṣaṇa kari' vana-līlā
> narendra-sarovare gelā karite jala-khelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---performing; [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes in the garden; [[synonyms:n:narendra]]-[[synonyms:s:sarovare]]---in the lake known as Narendrasarovara; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---they went; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:khelā]]---sporting in the water.
translation: After thus performing pastimes in the garden for some time, they all went to a lake called Narendra-sarovara and there enjoyed sporting in the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.103
description: After sporting in the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to the garden and accepted prasāda with the devotees.
text:
> jala-krīḍā kari' punaḥ āilā udyāne
> bhojana-līlā kailā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---sporting in the water; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---performing; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in the garden; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of accepting //prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---with all the devotees.
translation: After sporting in the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to the garden and accepted prasāda with the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.104
description: For nine continuous days His Lordship Śrī Jagannātha-deva stayed at the Guṇḍicā temple. During this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also stayed there and performed the pastimes with His devotees that have already been described.
text:
> nava dina guṇḍicāte rahe jagannātha
> mahāprabhu aiche līlā kare bhakta-sātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---nine days; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicāte]]---in the temple of Guṇḍicā; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---stays; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in the above-mentioned way; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:sātha]]---with His devotees.
translation: For nine continuous days His Lordship Śrī Jagannātha-deva stayed at the Guṇḍicā temple. During this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also stayed there and performed the pastimes with His devotees that have already been described.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.105
description: The garden of His pastimes was very large and was named Jagannātha vallabha. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took his rest there for nine days.
text:
> 'jagannātha-vallabha' nāma baḍā puṣpārāma
> nava dina karena prabhu tathāi viśrāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:v:vallabha]]---Jagannātha-vallabha; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---very big; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ārāma]]---garden; [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---nine days; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---there; [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---resting.
translation: The garden of His pastimes was very large and was named Jagannātha vallabha. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took his rest there for nine days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.106
description: Knowing that the Herā-pañcamī festival was drawing near, King Pratāparudra attentively talked with Kāśī Miśra.
text:
> 'herā-pañcamī'ra dina āila jāniyā
> kāśī-miśre kahe rājā sayatna kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:herā]]-[[synonyms:p:pañcamīra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the day of Herā-pañcamī; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---was nearing; [[synonyms:j:jāniyā]]---knowing; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśre]]---unto Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:y:yatna]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great attention.
translation: Knowing that the Herā-pañcamī festival was drawing near, King Pratāparudra attentively talked with Kāśī Miśra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.107
description: "Tomorrow will be the function of Herā-pañcamī or Lakṣmī-vijaya. Hold this festival in a way that it has never been held before."
text:
> kalya 'herā-pañcamī' habe lakṣmīra vijaya
> aiche utsava kara yena kabhu nāhi haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kalya]]---tomorrow; [[synonyms:h:herā]]-[[synonyms:p:pañcamī]]---the function of Herā-pañcamī; [[synonyms:h:habe]]---will be; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---welcome; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:u:utsava]]---festival; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---perform; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---did not take place.
translation: "Tomorrow will be the function of Herā-pañcamī or Lakṣmī-vijaya. Hold this festival in a way that it has never been held before."
purport: This Herā-pañcamī festival takes place five days after the Ratha-yātrā festival. Lord Jagannātha has left His wife, the goddess of fortune, and gone to Vṛndāvana, which is the Guṇḍicā temple. Due to separation from the Lord, the goddess of fortune decides to come to see the Lord at Guṇḍicā. The coming of the goddess of fortune to Guṇḍicā is celebrated by Herā-pañcamī. Sometimes this is misspelled as Harā-pañcamī the section known as //ativāḍī.// The word //herā// means "to see" and refers to the goddess of fortune going to see Lord Jagannātha. The word //pañcamī// means "the fifth day" and is used because this takes place on the fifth day of the moon.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.108
description: King Pratāparudra said, "Hold this festival in such a gorgeous way that upon seeing it, Caitanya Mahāprabhu will be completely pleased and astonished.
text:
> mahotsava kara taiche viśeṣa sambhāra
> dekhi' mahāprabhura yaiche haya camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahotsava]]---the festival; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---perform; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---in such a way; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]] [[synonyms:s:sambhāra]]---with great gorgeousness; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---so that; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment.
translation: King Pratāparudra said, "Hold this festival in such a gorgeous way that upon seeing it, Caitanya Mahāprabhu will be completely pleased and astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.109
description: "Take as many printed cloths, small bells, umbrellas and cāmaras as there are in my storehouse and in the Deity's storehouse.
text:
> ṭhākurera bhāṇḍāre āra āmāra bhāṇḍāre
> citra-vastra-kiṅkiṇī, āra chatra-cāmare
synonyms: [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurera]]---of the Deity; [[synonyms:b:bhāṇḍāre]]---in the storehouse; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:b:bhāṇḍāre]]---in the storehouse; [[synonyms:c:citra]]-[[synonyms:v:vastra]]---printed cloth; [[synonyms:k:kiṅkiṇī]]---small bells; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:c:chatra]]---umbrellas; [[synonyms:c:cāmare]]---yak-tail whisks.
translation: "Take as many printed cloths, small bells, umbrellas and cāmaras as there are in my storehouse and in the Deity's storehouse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.11
description: Upon hearing the verses recited by the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "You have given Me invaluable gems, but I have nothing to give you in return. Therefore I am simply embracing you."
text:
> tumi more dile bahu amūlya ratana
> mora kichu dite nāhi, diluṅ āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:d:dile]]---delivered; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---various; [[synonyms:a:amūlya]]---incalculable; [[synonyms:r:ratana]]---gems; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---of Me; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to give; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:d:diluṅ]]---I give; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing.
translation: Upon hearing the verses recited by the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "You have given Me invaluable gems, but I have nothing to give you in return. Therefore I am simply embracing you."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.110
description: "Collect all kinds of small and large flags and ringing bells. Then decorate the carrier and have various musical and dancing parties accompany it. In this way decorate the carrier attractively.
text:
> dhvajāvṛnda-patākā-ghaṇṭāya karaha maṇḍana
> nānā-vādya-nṛtya-dolāya karaha sājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhvajā]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---all kinds of flags; [[synonyms:p:patākā]]---big flags; [[synonyms:g:ghaṇṭāya]]---with ringing bells; [[synonyms:k:karaha]]---make; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍana]]---decoration; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:v:vādya]]---all kinds of musical parties; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:d:dolāya]]---on the carrier; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:sājana]]---decorate attractively.
translation: "Collect all kinds of small and large flags and ringing bells. Then decorate the carrier and have various musical and dancing parties accompany it. In this way decorate the carrier attractively.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.111
description: "You should also double the quantity of prasāda. Make so much that it will even surpass the Ratha-yātrā festival.
text:
> dviguṇa kariyā kara saba upahāra
> ratha-yātrā haite yaiche haya camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making a double portion; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---make; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all kinds of; [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---presentations; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than the car festival; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---so that; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---it becomes; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---more wonderful.
translation: "You should also double the quantity of prasāda. Make so much that it will even surpass the Ratha-yātrā festival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.112
description: "Arrange the festival in such a way that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu may freely go with His devotees to visit the Deity without difficulty."
text:
> seita' kariha,-prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> svacchande āsiyā yaiche karena daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:seita']] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do that; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---taking with Him all the devotees; [[synonyms:s:svacchande]]---freely; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---pays a visit to the temple.
translation: "Arrange the festival in such a way that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu may freely go with His devotees to visit the Deity without difficulty."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.113
description: In the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His personal associates with Him to see Lord Jagannātha at Sundarācala.
text:
> prātaḥ-kāle mahāprabhu nija-gaṇa lañā
> jagannātha darśana kaila sundarācale yāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking His associates; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---visiting Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:s:sundarācale]]---to the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going.
translation: In the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His personal associates with Him to see Lord Jagannātha at Sundarācala.
purport: Sundarācala is the Guṇḍicā temple. The temple of Jagannātha at Jagannātha Purī is called Nīlācala, and the temple at Guṇḍicā is called Sundarācala.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.114
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees returned to Nīlācala with great eagerness to see the Herā-pañcamī festival.
text:
> nīlācale āilā punaḥ bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> dekhite utkaṇṭhā herā-pañcamīra raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---very eager; [[synonyms:h:herā]]-[[synonyms:p:pañcamīra]] [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---performance of the festival known as Herā-pañcamī.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal devotees returned to Nīlācala with great eagerness to see the Herā-pañcamī festival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.115
description: Kāśī Miśra received Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great respect, and taking the Lord and His associates to a very nice place, he had them seated.
text:
> kāśī-miśra prabhure bahu ādara kariyā
> svagaṇa-saha bhāla-sthāne vasāila lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---very much; [[synonyms:ā:ādara]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---offering respect; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with His associates; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in a nice place; [[synonyms:v:vasāila]]---made seated; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking.
translation: Kāśī Miśra received Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great respect, and taking the Lord and His associates to a very nice place, he had them seated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.116
description: After taking His seat, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to hear about a particular mellow of devotional service; therefore, mildly smiling, He began to question Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> rasa-viśeṣa prabhura śunite mana haila
> īṣat hāsiyā prabhu svarūpe puchila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---a particular mellow; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was a desire; [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]] [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling mildly; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]] [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara.
translation: After taking His seat, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to hear about a particular mellow of devotional service; therefore, mildly smiling, He began to question Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.117-118
description: "Although Lord Jagannātha enjoys His pastimes at Dvārakā-dhāma and naturally manifests sublime liberality there, still, once a year, He becomes unlimitedly eager to see Vṛndāvana."
text:
> yadyapi jagannātha karena dvārakāya vihāra
> sahaja prakaṭa kare parama udāra
>
> tathāpi vatsara-madhye haya eka-bāra
> vṛndāvana dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhā apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:d:dvārakāya]]---in Dvārakā-dhāma; [[synonyms:v:vihāra]]---enjoyment; [[synonyms:s:sahaja]]---natural; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]]---manifestation; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:parama]]---sublime; [[synonyms:u:udāra]]---liberal; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]-[[synonyms:m:madhye]]---within a year; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to visit Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---eagerness; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---unlimited.
translation: "Although Lord Jagannātha enjoys His pastimes at Dvārakā-dhāma and naturally manifests sublime liberality there, still, once a year, He becomes unlimitedly eager to see Vṛndāvana."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.119
description: Pointing out the neighboring gardens, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "All these gardens exactly resemble Vṛndāvana; therefore Lord Jagannātha is very eager to see them again.
text:
> vṛndāvana-sama ei upavana-gaṇa
> tāhā dekhibāre utkaṇṭhita haya mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---exactly resembling Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---all these; [[synonyms:u:upavana]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---neighboring gardens; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---those gardens; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---for seeing; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhita]]---very eager; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---His mind becomes.
translation: Pointing out the neighboring gardens, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "All these gardens exactly resemble Vṛndāvana; therefore Lord Jagannātha is very eager to see them again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.12
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to recite the same verse again and again. Both the King and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were trembling, and tears were flowing from their eyes.
text:
> eta bali' sei śloka paḍe bāra bāra
> dui-janāra aṅge kampa, netre jala-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---that verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:janāra]]---of both of them (Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the King Pratāparudra); [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---in the bodies; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---trembling; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---in the eyes; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---flow of water.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to recite the same verse again and again. Both the King and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were trembling, and tears were flowing from their eyes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.120
description: "Externally He gives the excuse that He wants to participate in the Ratha-yātrā festival, but actually He wants to leave Jagannātha Purī to go to Sundarācala, Guṇḍicā temple, the replica of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> bāhira ha-ite kare ratha-yātrā-chala
> sundarācale yāya prabhu chāḍi' nīlācala
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhira]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---externally; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:c:chala]]---an excuse to enjoy the car festival; [[synonyms:s:sundarācale]]---to Sundarācala, the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---leaving; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]]---Jagannātha Purī.
translation: "Externally He gives the excuse that He wants to participate in the Ratha-yātrā festival, but actually He wants to leave Jagannātha Purī to go to Sundarācala, Guṇḍicā temple, the replica of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.121
description: "The Lord enjoys His pastimes day and night in various flower gardens there. But why did He not take Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, with Him?"
text:
> nānā-puṣpodyāne tathā khele rātri-dine
> lakṣmīdevīre saṅge nāhi laya ki kāraṇe?
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in the various flower gardens; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:k:khele]]---He plays; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---both day and night; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devīre]]---Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Him; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---take; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kāraṇe]]---what is the reason.
translation: "The Lord enjoys His pastimes day and night in various flower gardens there. But why did He not take Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, with Him?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.122
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "My dear Lord, please hear the reason for this. Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, cannot be admitted to the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> svarūpa kahe,-śuna, prabhu, kāraṇa ihāra
> vṛndāvana-krīḍāte lakṣmīra nāhi adhikāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa replied; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---O my Lord; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]] [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---the reason for this; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍāte]]---in the pastimes of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---admission.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "My dear Lord, please hear the reason for this. Lakṣmīdevī, the goddess of fortune, cannot be admitted to the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.123
description: "In the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, the only assistants are the gopīs. But for the gopīs, no one can attract the mind of Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> vṛndāvana-līlāya kṛṣṇera sahāya gopī-gaṇa
> gopī-gaṇa vinā kṛṣṇera harite nāre mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---in the pastimes of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---assistants; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---except for the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:harite]]---to attract; [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---no one is able; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation: "In the pastimes of Vṛndāvana, the only assistants are the gopīs. But for the gopīs, no one can attract the mind of Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.124
description: The Lord said, "Using the car festival as an excuse, Kṛṣṇa goes there with Subhadrā and Baladeva.
text:
> prabhu kahe,-yātrā-chale kṛṣṇera gamana
> subhadrā āra baladeva, saṅge dui jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:c:chale]]---on the plea of the car festival; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---departure; [[synonyms:s:subhadrā]]---His sister; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:baladeva]]---His brother; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Him; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons.
translation: The Lord said, "Using the car festival as an excuse, Kṛṣṇa goes there with Subhadrā and Baladeva.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.125
description: "All the pastimes with the gopīs that take place in those gardens are very confidential ecstasies of Lord Kṛṣṇa. No one knows them.
text:
> gopī-saṅge yata līlā haya upavane
> nigūḍha kṛṣṇera bhāva keha nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---all pastimes; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:u:upavane]]---that are in those gardens; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---very confidential; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstasies; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---know.
translation: "All the pastimes with the gopīs that take place in those gardens are very confidential ecstasies of Lord Kṛṣṇa. No one knows them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.126
description: "Since there is no fault at all in Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, why does the goddess of fortune become angry?"
text:
> ataeva kṛṣṇera prākaṭye nāhi kichu doṣa
> tabe kene lakṣmīdevī kare eta roṣa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---since; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prākaṭye]]---by such a manifestation; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---therefore; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---so much; [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---anger.
translation: "Since there is no fault at all in Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, why does the goddess of fortune become angry?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.127
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "It is the nature of a girl afflicted by love to become immediately angry upon finding neglect on the part of her lover."
text:
> svarūpa kahe,-premavatīra ei ta' svabhāva
> kāntera audāsya-leśe haya krodha-bhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī replied; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vatīra]]---of the girl who is too afflicted by love; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---indeed; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---the nature; [[synonyms:k:kāntera]]---of the beloved; [[synonyms:a:audāsya]]---of negligence; [[synonyms:l:leśe]]---even by a fractional part; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---anger.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "It is the nature of a girl afflicted by love to become immediately angry upon finding neglect on the part of her lover."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.128
description: While Svarūpa Dāmodara and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were talking, the procession of the goddess of fortune came by. She was riding upon a golden palanquin carried by four men and bedecked with a variety of jewels.
text:
> hena-kāle, khacita yāhe vividha ratana
> suvarṇera caudolā kari' ārohaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---while Svarūpa Dāmodara and Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu were talking; [[synonyms:k:khacita]]---were bedecked; [[synonyms:y:yāhe]]---on which; [[synonyms:v:vividha]]---varieties; [[synonyms:r:ratana]]---gems; [[synonyms:s:suvarṇera]]---made of gold; [[synonyms:c:caudolā]]---a palanquin carried by four men; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:ā:ārohaṇa]]---riding upon.
translation: While Svarūpa Dāmodara and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were talking, the procession of the goddess of fortune came by. She was riding upon a golden palanquin carried by four men and bedecked with a variety of jewels.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.129
description: The palanquin was also surrounded by people carrying umbrellas, cāmara whisks and flags, and it was preceded by musicians and dancing girls.
text:
> chatra-cāmara-dhvajā patākāra gaṇa
> nānā-vādya-āge nāce deva-dāsī-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chatra]]---of umbrellas; [[synonyms:c:cāmara]]---and whisks; [[synonyms:d:dhvajā]]---and flags; [[synonyms:p:patākāra]]---and big flags; [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---congregation; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:v:vādya]]---varieties of musical parties; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dance; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---dancing girls.
translation: The palanquin was also surrounded by people carrying umbrellas, cāmara whisks and flags, and it was preceded by musicians and dancing girls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.13
description: "My Lord, the nectar of Your words and the descriptions of Your activities are the life and soul of those who are always aggrieved in this material world. These narrations are transmitted by exalted personalities, and they eradicate all sinful reactions. Whoever hears these narrations attains all good fortune. These narrations are broadcast all over the world and are filled with spiritual power. Those who spread the message of Godhead are certainly the most munificent welfare workers."
text:
> tava kathāmṛtaṁ tapta-jīvanaṁ
> kavibhir īḍitaṁ kalmaṣāpaham
> śravaṇa-maṅgalaṁ śrīmad-ātataṁ
> bhuvi gṛṇanti ye bhūridā janāḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tava]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛtam]]---the nectar of words; [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:j:jīvanam]]---life for persons very much aggrieved in the material world; [[synonyms:k:kavibhiḥ]]---by greatly exalted persons; [[synonyms:ī:īḍitam]]---described; [[synonyms:k:kalmaṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:apaham]]---that which drives away all kinds of sinful reaction; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:maṅgalam]]---giving all spiritual benefit to anyone who hears; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mat]]---filled with all spiritual power; [[synonyms:ā:ātatam]]---broadcast all over the world; [[synonyms:b:bhuvi]]---in the material world; [[synonyms:g:gṛṇanti]]---chant and spread; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---those who; [[synonyms:b:bhūri]]-[[synonyms:d:dāḥ]]---most beneficent; [[synonyms:j:janāḥ]]---persons.
translation: "My Lord, the nectar of Your words and the descriptions of Your activities are the life and soul of those who are always aggrieved in this material world. These narrations are transmitted by exalted personalities, and they eradicate all sinful reactions. Whoever hears these narrations attains all good fortune. These narrations are broadcast all over the world and are filled with spiritual power. Those who spread the message of Godhead are certainly the most munificent welfare workers."
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.9).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.130
description: The maidservants were carrying water pitchers, cāmara whisks and boxes for betel nuts. There were hundreds of maidservants, all attractively dressed with valuable necklaces.
text:
> tāmbūla-sampuṭa, jhāri, vyajana, cāmara
> sāthe dāsī śata, hāra divya bhūṣāmbara
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāmbūla]]-[[synonyms:s:sampuṭa]]---boxes containing the ingredients for betel nut preparation; [[synonyms:j:jhāri]]---water pitchers; [[synonyms:v:vyajana]]---fans; [[synonyms:c:cāmara]]---whisks; [[synonyms:s:sāthe]]---along with; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---maidservants; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---hundreds; [[synonyms:h:hāra]]---necklaces; [[synonyms:d:divya]]---valuable; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣāmbara]]---dresses.
translation: The maidservants were carrying water pitchers, cāmara whisks and boxes for betel nuts. There were hundreds of maidservants, all attractively dressed with valuable necklaces.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.131
description: In an angry mood, the goddess of fortune arrived at the main gate of the temple accompanied by many members of her family, all of whom exhibited uncommon opulence.
text:
> alaukika aiśvarya saṅge bahu-parivāra
> kruddha hañā lakṣmīdevī āilā siṁha-dvāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:alaukika]]---uncommon; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]---opulence; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---accompanied by; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:p:parivāra]]---many members of the family; [[synonyms:k:kruddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being angry; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---at the main gate of the temple.
translation: In an angry mood, the goddess of fortune arrived at the main gate of the temple accompanied by many members of her family, all of whom exhibited uncommon opulence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.132
description: When the procession arrived, the maidservants of the goddess of fortune began to arrest all the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> jagannāthera mukhya mukhya yata bhṛtya-gaṇe
> lakṣmīdevīra dāsī-gaṇa karena bandhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]] [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]---the principal; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---servants; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---maidservants; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bandhane]]---arrested.
translation: When the procession arrived, the maidservants of the goddess of fortune began to arrest all the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.133
description: The maidservants bound the servants of Jagannātha, handcuffed them, and made them fall down at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune. Indeed, they were arrested just like thieves who have all their riches taken away.
text:
> bāndhiyā āniyā pāḍe lakṣmīra caraṇe
> core yena daṇḍa kari' laya nānā-dhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]]---after binding; [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:p:pāḍe]]---make them fall down; [[synonyms:l:laksmīra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:c:core]]---a thief; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after punishing; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---take away; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:d:dhane]]---all kinds of riches.
translation: The maidservants bound the servants of Jagannātha, handcuffed them, and made them fall down at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune. Indeed, they were arrested just like thieves who have all their riches taken away.
purport: When Lord Jagannātha starts His car festival, He gives assurance to the goddess of fortune that He will return the next day. When He does not return, the goddess of fortune, after waiting two or three days, begins to feel that her husband has neglected her. She naturally becomes quite angry. Gorgeously decorating herself and her associates, she comes out of the temple and stands before the main gate. All the principal servants of Lord Jagannātha are then arrested by her maidservants, brought before her and forced to fall down at her lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.134
description: When the servants fall down before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, they almost fall unconscious. They are chastised and made the butt of jokes and loose language.
text:
> acetanavat tāre karena tāḍane
> nānā-mata gāli dena bhaṇḍa-vacane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:acetana]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---almost unconscious; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto the servants; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tāḍane]]---chastisement; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---various kinds of; [[synonyms:g:gāli]]---amusement; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---speaks; [[synonyms:b:bhaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vacane]]---various loose language.
translation: When the servants fall down before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, they almost fall unconscious. They are chastised and made the butt of jokes and loose language.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.135
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's associates saw such impudence exhibited by the maidservants of the goddess of fortune, they covered their faces with their hands and began to smile.
text:
> lakṣmī-saṅge dāsī-gaṇera prāgalbhya dekhiyā
> hāse mahāprabhura gaṇa mukhe hasta diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the company of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the maidservants; [[synonyms:p:prāgalbhya]]---impudence; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after seeing; [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---smile; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the companions; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---on their faces; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]---hands; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---covering.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's associates saw such impudence exhibited by the maidservants of the goddess of fortune, they covered their faces with their hands and began to smile.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.136
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "There is no egoistic pride like this within the three worlds. At least I have neither seen nor heard of it.
text:
> dāmodara kahe,-aiche mānera prakāra
> trijagate kāhāṅ nāhi dekhi śuni āra
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī said; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:m:mānera]]---of egoistic pride; [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---kind; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:j:jagate]]---within the three worlds; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---I hear; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "There is no egoistic pride like this within the three worlds. At least I have neither seen nor heard of it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.137
description: "When a woman is neglected and disappointed, out of egoistic pride she gives up her ornaments and morosely sits down on the floor, marking lines on it with her nails.
text:
> māninī nirutsāhe chāḍe vibhūṣaṇa
> bhūme vasi' nakhe lekhe, malina-vadana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:māninī]]---proud, egoistic woman; [[synonyms:n:nirutsāhe]]---because of disappointment; [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]]---gives up; [[synonyms:v:vibhūṣaṇa]]---all kinds of ornaments; [[synonyms:b:bhūme]] [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting on the floor; [[synonyms:n:nakhe]]---with the nails; [[synonyms:l:lekhe]]---marks lines; [[synonyms:m:malina]]-[[synonyms:v:vadana]]---with a morose face.
translation: "When a woman is neglected and disappointed, out of egoistic pride she gives up her ornaments and morosely sits down on the floor, marking lines on it with her nails.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.138
description: "I have heard of this kind of pride in Satyabhāmā, Kṛṣṇa's proudest Queen, and I have also heard of it in the gopīs of Vṛndāvana, who are the reservoirs of all transcendental mellows.
text:
> pūrve satyabhāmāra śuni evaṁ-vidha māna
> vraje gopī-gaṇera māna-rasera nidhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:s:satyabhāmāra]]---of Queen Satyabhāmā; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---I hear; [[synonyms:e:evaṁ]]-[[synonyms:v:vidha]] [[synonyms:m:māna]]---this kind of egoistic pride; [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:m:māna]]---pride; [[synonyms:r:rasera]] [[synonyms:n:nidhāna]]---the reservoir of all humorous mellows.
translation: "I have heard of this kind of pride in Satyabhāmā, Kṛṣṇa's proudest Queen, and I have also heard of it in the gopīs of Vṛndāvana, who are the reservoirs of all transcendental mellows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.139
description: "But in the case of the goddess of fortune, I see a different kind of pride. She manifests her own opulences and even goes with her soldiers to attack her husband."
text:
> iṅho nija-sampatti saba prakaṭa kariyā
> priyera upara yāya sainya sājāña
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṅho]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sampatti]]---her opulence; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---manifesting; [[synonyms:p:priyera]] [[synonyms:u:upara]]---against her beloved husband; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:s:sainya]] [[synonyms:s:sājāña]]---accompanied by soldiers.
translation: "But in the case of the goddess of fortune, I see a different kind of pride. She manifests her own opulences and even goes with her soldiers to attack her husband."
purport: After seeing the impudence of the goddess of fortune, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī wanted to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the superexcellence of the //gopīs'// loving affairs. He therefore said, "My Lord, I never experienced anything like the behavior of the goddess of fortune. We sometimes see a beloved wife becoming proud of her position and then frustrated due to some neglect. She then gives up caring for her appearance, accepts dirty clothes and morosely sits on the floor and draws lines with her nails. We have heard of such egoistic pride in Satyabhāmā and the //gopīs// of Vṛndāvana, but what we see in the goddess of fortune here at Jagannātha Purī is completely different. She becomes very angry with her husband, and attacks Him with her great opulence."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.14
description: After hearing the recitation of this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately embraced the reciter, King Pratāparudra, and cried, "You are the most munificent! You are the most munificent!" At this point Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not even know who the King was.
text:
> 'bhūridā' 'bhūridā' bali' kare āliṅgana
> iṅho nāhi jāne,-ihoṅ haya kon jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhūri]]-[[synonyms:d:dā]]---the most munificent; [[synonyms:b:bhūri]]-[[synonyms:d:dā]]---the most munificent; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---crying; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:i:iṅho]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know; [[synonyms:i:ihoṅ]]---Pratāparudra Mahārāja; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---who.
translation: After hearing the recitation of this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately embraced the reciter, King Pratāparudra, and cried, "You are the most munificent! You are the most munificent!" At this point Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not even know who the King was.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.140
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Please tell me of the varieties of egoistic pride manifest in Vṛndāvana." Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "The pride of the gopīs is like a river flowing with hundreds of tributaries.
text:
> prabhu kahe,-kaha vrajera mānera prakāra
> svarūpa kahe,-gopī-māna-nadī śata-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---please tell; [[synonyms:v:vrajera]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:m:mānera]]---of the egoistic pride; [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---the varieties; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara replied; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:m:māna]]---the pride of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:n:nadī]]---like a river; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---with hundreds of branches.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Please tell me of the varieties of egoistic pride manifest in Vṛndāvana." Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "The pride of the gopīs is like a river flowing with hundreds of tributaries.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.141
description: "The characteristics and modes of love are different in different women. Their jealous anger also takes on different varieties and qualities.
text:
> nāyikāra svabhāva, prema-vṛtte bahu bheda
> sei bhede nānā-prakāra mānera udbheda
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nāyikāra]]---of the heroine; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---nature; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛtte]]---in the matter of loving affairs; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---many; [[synonyms:b:bheda]]---varieties; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhede]]---in each variety; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---various types; [[synonyms:m:mānera]]---of the jealous anger of a woman; [[synonyms:u:udbheda]]---subdivisions.
translation: "The characteristics and modes of love are different in different women. Their jealous anger also takes on different varieties and qualities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.142
description: "It is not possible to give a complete statement about the different types of jealous anger manifest by the gopīs, but a few principles may serve as an indication.
text:
> samyak gopikāra māna nā yāya kathana
> eka-dui-bhede kari dig-daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:samyak]]---fully; [[synonyms:g:gopikāra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:m:māna]]---jealous anger; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is possible; [[synonyms:k:kathana]]---to speak; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dui]]---one, two; [[synonyms:b:bhede]]---in different types; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I make; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---indication.
translation: "It is not possible to give a complete statement about the different types of jealous anger manifest by the gopīs, but a few principles may serve as an indication.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.143
description: "There are three types of women experiencing jealous anger: sober women, restless women and women both restless and sober.
text:
> māne keha haya 'dhīrā,' keha ta' 'adhīrā'
> ei tina-bhede, keha haya 'dhīrādhīrā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:māne]]---on the platform of jealous anger; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---some women; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:d:dhīra]]---are very sober; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---and some of them; [[synonyms:a:adhīra]]---very restless; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:b:bhede]]---and there is a third division; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---some are; [[synonyms:d:dhīra]]-[[synonyms:a:adhīra]]---a mixture of sober and restless.
translation: "There are three types of women experiencing jealous anger: sober women, restless women and women both restless and sober.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.144
description: "When a sober heroine sees her hero approaching from a distance, she immediately stands up to receive him. When he comes near, she immediately offers him a place to sit.
text:
> 'dhīrā' kānte dūre dekhi' kare pratyutthāna
> nikaṭe āsile, kare āsana pradāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhīra]]---the sober; [[synonyms:k:kānte]]---the hero; [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---from a distance; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:pratyutthāna]]---stands up; [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]] [[synonyms:ā:āsile]]---when the hero comes nearby; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:ā:āsana]]---of a seat; [[synonyms:p:pradāna]]---offering.
translation: "When a sober heroine sees her hero approaching from a distance, she immediately stands up to receive him. When he comes near, she immediately offers him a place to sit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.145
description: "The sober heroine conceals her anger within her heart and externally speaks sweet words. When her lover embraces her, she also returns his embrace.
text:
> hṛdaye kopa, mukhe kahe madhura vacana
> priya āliṅgite, tāre kare āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:k:kopa]]---anger; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in the mouth; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweet; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---lover; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgite]]---when embracing; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraces.
translation: "The sober heroine conceals her anger within her heart and externally speaks sweet words. When her lover embraces her, she also returns his embrace.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.146
description: "The sober heroine is very simple in her behavior. She keeps her jealous anger within her heart, but with mild words and smiles she refutes the advances of her lover.
text:
> sarala vyavahāra, kare mānera poṣaṇa
> kimvā solluṇṭha-vākye kare priya-nirasana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarala]] [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---plain dealings; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:m:mānera]]---of jealous anger; [[synonyms:p:poṣaṇa]]---maintenance; [[synonyms:k:kimvā]]---or; [[synonyms:s:solluṇṭha]]---smiling a little; [[synonyms:v:vākye]]---by words; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---of the lover; [[synonyms:n:nirasana]]---refutation.
translation: "The sober heroine is very simple in her behavior. She keeps her jealous anger within her heart, but with mild words and smiles she refutes the advances of her lover.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.147
description: "The restless heroine, however, sometimes chastises her lover with cruel words, sometimes pulls his ear and sometimes binds him with a flower garland.
text:
> 'adhīrā' niṣṭhura-vākye karaye bhartsana
> karṇotpale tāḍe, kare mālāya bandhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adhīrā]]---the restless heroine; [[synonyms:n:niṣṭhura]]-[[synonyms:v:vākye]]---by cruel words; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhartsana]]---chastisement; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:u:utpale]] [[synonyms:t:tāḍe]]---pulls the ear; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:m:mālāya]]---with a garland; [[synonyms:b:bandhana]]---binding.
translation: "The restless heroine, however, sometimes chastises her lover with cruel words, sometimes pulls his ear and sometimes binds him with a flower garland.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.148
description: "The heroine who is a combination of sobriety and restlessness always jokes with equivocal words. She sometimes praises her lover, sometimes blasphemes him and sometimes remains indifferent.
text:
> 'dhīrādhīrā' vakra-vākye kare upahāsa
> kabhu stuti, kabhu nindā, kabhu vā udāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhīra]]-[[synonyms:a:adhīra]]---the heroine who is a combination of sobriety and restlessness; [[synonyms:v:vakra]]-[[synonyms:v:vākye]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:u:upahāsa]]---jokes with equivocal words; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:s:stuti]]---sometimes praise; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---sometimes blasphemy; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:v:vā]] [[synonyms:u:udāsa]]---sometimes indifference.
translation: "The heroine who is a combination of sobriety and restlessness always jokes with equivocal words. She sometimes praises her lover, sometimes blasphemes him and sometimes remains indifferent.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.149
description: "Heroines may also be classified as captivated, intermediate and impudent. The captivated heroine does not know very much about the cunning intricacies of jealous anger.
text:
> 'mugdhā', 'madhyā', 'pragalbhā',-tina nāyikāra bheda
> 'mugdhā' nāhi jāne mānera vaidagdhya-vibheda
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mugdhā]]---captivated; [[synonyms:m:madhyā]]---intermediate; [[synonyms:p:pragalbhā]]---impudent; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:n:nāyikāra]]---of heroines; [[synonyms:b:bheda]]---divisions; [[synonyms:m:mugdhā]]---the captivated; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know; [[synonyms:m:mānera]]---of jealous anger; [[synonyms:v:vaidagdhya]]-[[synonyms:v:vibheda]]---the intricacies of cunning behavior.
translation: "Heroines may also be classified as captivated, intermediate and impudent. The captivated heroine does not know very much about the cunning intricacies of jealous anger.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.15
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy was aroused because of the King's previous service. Therefore without even asking who he was, the Lord immediately bestowed His mercy upon him.
text:
> pūrva-sevā dekhi' tāṅre kṛpā upajila
> anusandhāna vinā kṛpā-prasāda karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---previous service; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---awakened; [[synonyms:a:anusandhāna]]---inquiry; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---of mercy; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---grace; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---bestowed.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy was aroused because of the King's previous service. Therefore without even asking who he was, the Lord immediately bestowed His mercy upon him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.150
description: "The captivated heroine simply covers her face and goes on crying. When she hears sweet words from her lover, she is very satisfied.
text:
> mukha ācchādiyā kare kevala rodana
> kāntera priya-vākya śuni' haya parasanna
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mukha]] [[synonyms:ā:ācchādiyā]]---covering the face; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---only; [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---crying; [[synonyms:k:kāntera]]---of the lover; [[synonyms:p:priya]]-[[synonyms:v:vākya]]---sweet words; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:p:parasanna]]---satisfied.
translation: "The captivated heroine simply covers her face and goes on crying. When she hears sweet words from her lover, she is very satisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.151

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.152

translation: "Some of them are very talkative, some are mild, and some are equipoised. Each heroine, according to her own character, increases Śrī Kṛṣṇa's loving ecstasy.

> sei sei svabhāve kṛṣṇe karāya santoṣa

translation: "Although some of the gopīs are talkative, some mild and some equipoised, all of them are transcendental and faultless. They please Kṛṣṇa by their unique characteristics."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.155
