translation: "When there is an awakening of various ecstatic features on Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's face and in Her eyes, the lalita ornaments are manifest.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.192
description: " 'When the bodily features are delicate and expertly curved, and when the eyebrows are very beautifully agitated, the ornament of charm, called lalita alaṅkāra, is manifest.'
text:
> vinyāsa-bhaṅgir aṅgānāṁ
> bhrū-vilāsa-manoharā
> sukumārā bhaved yatra
> lalitaṁ tad udāhṛtam
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vinyāsa]]---in arrangement; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgiḥ]]---curvature; [[synonyms:a:aṅgānām]]---of bodily limbs; [[synonyms:b:bhrū]]-[[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---due to the pastimes of the eyebrows; [[synonyms:m:manoharā]]---very beautiful; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:k:kumārā]]---delicate; [[synonyms:b:bhavet]]---may be; [[synonyms:y:yatra]]---where; [[synonyms:l:lalitam]]---lalita; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that; [[synonyms:u:udāhṛtam]]---called.
translation: “ 'When the bodily features are delicate and expertly curved, and when the eyebrows are very beautifully agitated, the ornament of charm, called lalita alaṅkāra, is manifest.'
purport: This verse is from //Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi// (//Anubhāva-prakaraṇa// 56).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.193
description: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa happens to see Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī decorated with these lalita ornaments, They both anxiously want to meet one another.
text:
> lalita-bhūṣita rādhā dekhe yadi kṛṣṇa
> duṅhe duṅhā milibāre hayena satṛṣṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lalita]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūṣita]]---decorated with //lalita-alaṅkāra//; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of Them; [[synonyms:d:duṅhā]]---the two of Them; [[synonyms:m:milibāre]]---to meet; [[synonyms:h:hayena]]---become; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇa]]---very anxious.
translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa happens to see Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī decorated with these lalita ornaments, They both anxiously want to meet one another.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.194
description: " 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was decorated with the ornament of lalita-alaṅkāra, just to increase Śrī Kṛṣṇa's love, an attractive curve was manifest by Her neck, knees and waist. This was brought about by Her timidity and apparent desire to avoid Kṛṣṇa. The flickering movements of Her eyebrows could conquer the powerful bow of Cupid. To increase the joy of Her beloved's love, Her body was decorated with the ornaments of lalita-alaṅkāra.'
text:
> hriyā tiryag-grīvā-caraṇa-kaṭi-bhaṅgī-sumadhurā
> calac-cillī-vallī-dalita-ratināthorjita-dhanuḥ
> priya-premollāsollasita-lalitālālita-tanuḥ
> priya-prītyai sāsīd udita-lalitālaṅkṛti-yutā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hriyā]]---by Her attitude of shyness; [[synonyms:t:tiryak]]---going crosswise; [[synonyms:g:grīvā]]---of the neck; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---of the knees; [[synonyms:k:kaṭi]]---of the waist; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]---by the curve; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:m:madhura]]---very sweet; [[synonyms:c:calat]]-[[synonyms:c:cillī]]---of moving eyebrows; [[synonyms:v:vallī]]---by the creepers; [[synonyms:d:dalita]]---conquered; [[synonyms:r:rati]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---of Cupid; [[synonyms:ū:ūrjita]]---powerful; [[synonyms:d:dhanuḥ]]---by which the bow; [[synonyms:p:priya]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---because of the loving attitude of the beloved; [[synonyms:u:ullasita]]---being inspired; [[synonyms:l:lalita]]---by the mood known as lalita; [[synonyms:ā:ālālita]]-[[synonyms:t:tanuḥ]]---whose body is covered; [[synonyms:p:priya]]-[[synonyms:p:prītyai]]---for the sake of pleasing the beloved; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ā:āsīt]]---was; [[synonyms:u:udita]]---awakened; [[synonyms:l:lalita]]-[[synonyms:a:alaṅkṛti]]-[[synonyms:y:yutā]]---possessing the //lalita-alaṅkāra.//
translation: “ 'When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was decorated with the ornament of lalita-alaṅkāra, just to increase Śrī Kṛṣṇa's love, an attractive curve was manifest by Her neck, knees and waist. This was brought about by Her timidity and apparent desire to avoid Kṛṣṇa. The flickering movements of Her eyebrows could conquer the powerful bow of Cupid. To increase the joy of Her beloved's love, Her body was decorated with the ornaments of lalita-alaṅkāra.'
purport: This verse is quoted from the //Govinda-līlāmṛta// (9.14).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.195
description: "When Kṛṣṇa comes forward and greedily snatches at the border of Rādhārāṇī's sari, She is actually very pleased within, but overtly She tries to stop Him.
text:
> lobhe āsi' kṛṣṇa kare kañcukākarṣaṇa
> antare ullāsa, rādhā kare nivāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lobhe]]---in greed; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:k:kañcuka]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākarṣaṇa]]---snatching the border of Her sari; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---very much pleased; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nivāraṇa]]---stopping.
translation: "When Kṛṣṇa comes forward and greedily snatches at the border of Rādhārāṇī's sari, She is actually very pleased within, but overtly She tries to stop Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.196
description: "This ecstatic dress of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's is called kuṭṭamita. When it is manifest, She externally tries to avoid Kṛṣṇa, and She apparently becomes angry, although She is very happy within.
text:
> bāhire vāmatā-krodha, bhitare sukha mane
> 'kuṭṭamita'-nāma ei bhāva-vibhūṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:v:vāmatā]]---opposition; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---anger; [[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:k:kuṭṭamita]]---//kuṭṭamita//; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:v:vibhūṣaṇe]]---ornament of an ecstatic attitude.
translation: "This ecstatic dress of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's is called kuṭṭamita. When it is manifest, She externally tries to avoid Kṛṣṇa, and She apparently becomes angry, although She is very happy within.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.197
description: " 'When the border of Her sari and the cloth veiling Her face are caught, She externally appears offended and angry, but within Her heart She is very happy. Learned scholars call this attitude kuṭṭamita.'
text:
> stanādharādi-grahaṇe
> hṛt-prītāv api sambhramāt
> bahiḥ krodho vyathitavat
> proktaṁ kuṭṭamitaṁ budhaiḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:stana]]---breasts; [[synonyms:a:adhara]]---lips; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:g:grahaṇe]]---when capturing; [[synonyms:h:hṛt]]-[[synonyms:p:prītau]]---satisfaction of the heart; [[synonyms:a:api]]---even though; [[synonyms:s:sambhramāt]]---because of respectfulness; [[synonyms:b:bahiḥ]]---externally; [[synonyms:k:krodhaḥ]]---anger; [[synonyms:v:vyathita]]---aggrieved; [[synonyms:v:vat]]---as if; [[synonyms:p:proktam]]---called; [[synonyms:k:kuṭṭamitam]]---the technical term //kuṭṭamita//; [[synonyms:b:budhaiḥ]]---by learned scholars.
translation: “ 'When the border of Her sari and the cloth veiling Her face are caught, She externally appears offended and angry, but within Her heart She is very happy. Learned scholars call this attitude kuṭṭamita.'
purport: This is a quotation from //Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi// (//Anubhāva-prakaraṇa// 49).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.198
description: "Although Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was checking Her sari with Her hand, internally She was thinking, 'Let Kṛṣṇa satisfy His desires.' In this way She was very pleased within, although She externally displayed opposition and anger.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-vāñchā pūrṇa haya, kare pāṇi-rodha
> antare ānanda rādhā, bāhire vāmya-krodha
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---the desire of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---fulfilled; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---let it be; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:pāṇi]]-[[synonyms:r:rodha]]---checking with Her hand; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:v:vāmya]]---opposition; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---and anger.
translation: "Although Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was checking Her sari with Her hand, internally She was thinking, 'Let Kṛṣṇa satisfy His desires.' In this way She was very pleased within, although She externally displayed opposition and anger.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.199
description: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī externally displays a kind of dry crying, as if She is offended. Then She mildly smiles and admonishes Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> vyathā pāñā' kare yena śuṣka rodana
> īṣat hāsiyā kṛṣṇe karena bhartsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vyathā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā']]---being offended; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]---dry; [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---crying; [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]]---mildly; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhartsana]]---admonition.
translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī externally displays a kind of dry crying, as if She is offended. Then She mildly smiles and admonishes Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gauracandra! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is so exalted!
text:
> jaya jaya gauracandra śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya
> jaya jaya nityānanda jayādvaita dhanya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---to Gauracandra; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---exalted.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gauracandra! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is so exalted!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.20
description: Although within His heart Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew everything that was happening, externally He did not disclose it. Nor did He disclose that He knew He was talking with King Pratāparudra.
text:
> 'rājā'-hena jñāna kabhu nā kaila prakāśa
> antare sakala jānena, bāhire udāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:h:hena]] [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---such knowledge; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---manifested; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---everything; [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---knows; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:u:udāsa]]---indifferent.
translation: Although within His heart Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew everything that was happening, externally He did not disclose it. Nor did He disclose that He knew He was talking with King Pratāparudra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.200
description: " 'Actually She has no desire to stop Kṛṣṇa's endeavor to touch Her body with His hands, yet Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, whose thighs are like the trunk of a baby elephant, protests His advances and, sweetly smiling, admonishes Him. At such times She cries without tears on Her charming face.'
text:
> pāṇi-rodham avirodhita-vāñchaṁ
> bhartsanāś ca madhura-smita-garbhāḥ
> mādhavasya kurute karabhorur
> hāri śuṣka-ruditaṁ ca mukhe 'pi
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāṇi]]---the hand; [[synonyms:r:rodham]]---obstructing; [[synonyms:a:avirodhita]]---unobstructed; [[synonyms:v:vāñcham]]---the desire of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhartsanāḥ]]---admonitions; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweet; [[synonyms:s:smita]]-[[synonyms:g:garbhāḥ]]---containing a gentle smiling attitude; [[synonyms:m:mādhavasya]]---of Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kurute]]---does; [[synonyms:k:karabha]]-[[synonyms:ū:ūruḥ]]---whose thigh is like the trunk of a baby elephant; [[synonyms:h:hāri]]---charming; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:r:ruditam]]---dry crying; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---on the face; [[synonyms:a:api]]---also.
translation: “ 'Actually She has no desire to stop Kṛṣṇa's endeavor to touch Her body with His hands, yet Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī, whose thighs are like the trunk of a baby elephant, protests His advances and, sweetly smiling, admonishes Him. At such times She cries without tears on Her charming face.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.201
description: "In this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is ornamented and decorated with various ecstatic symptoms, which attract the mind of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei-mata āra saba bhāva-vibhūṣaṇa
> yāhāte bhūṣita rādhā hare kṛṣṇa mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:v:vibhūṣaṇa]]---ecstatic ornaments; [[synonyms:y:yāhāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣita]]---being decorated; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attracts; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "In this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is ornamented and decorated with various ecstatic symptoms, which attract the mind of Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.202
description: "It is not at all possible to describe the unlimited pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even though He Himself describes them in His incarnation of Sahasra-vadana, the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa Nāga."
text:
> ananta kṛṣṇera līlā nā yāya varṇana
> āpane varṇena yadi 'sahasra-vadana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is possible; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:v:varṇena]]---describes; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:v:vadana]]---the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa.
translation: "It is not at all possible to describe the unlimited pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, even though He Himself describes them in His incarnation of Sahasra-vadana, the thousand-mouthed Śeṣa Nāga."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.203
description: This time, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura smiled and told Dāmodara Paṇḍita, "My dear sir, please hear! Just see how opulent my goddess of fortune is!
text:
> śrīvāsa hāsiyā kahe,-śuna, dāmodara
> āmāra lakṣmīra dekha sampatti vistara
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---O Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of my goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---just see; [[synonyms:s:sampatti]] [[synonyms:v:vistara]]---the great opulence.
translation: This time, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura smiled and told Dāmodara Paṇḍita, "My dear sir, please hear! Just see how opulent my goddess of fortune is!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.204
description: "As far as Vṛndāvana's opulence is concerned, it consists of a few flowers and twigs, some minerals from the hills, a few peacock feathers and the plant known as guñjā.
text:
> vṛndāvanera sampad dekha,-puṣpa-kisalaya
> giridhātu-śikhipiccha-guñjāphala-maya
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanera]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:s:sampad]]---the opulence; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---see; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:k:kisalaya]]---a few flowers and twigs; [[synonyms:g:giri]]-[[synonyms:d:dhātu]]---some minerals from the hills; [[synonyms:ś:śikhi]]-[[synonyms:p:piccha]]---some peacock feathers; [[synonyms:g:guñjā]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---some //guñjā-phala.//
translation: "As far as Vṛndāvana's opulence is concerned, it consists of a few flowers and twigs, some minerals from the hills, a few peacock feathers and the plant known as guñjā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.205
description: "When Jagannātha decided to see Vṛndāvana, He went there, and upon hearing this, the goddess of fortune experienced restlessness and jealousy.
text:
> vṛndāvana dekhibāre gelā jagannātha
> śuni' lakṣmī-devīra mane haila āsoyātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Vṛndāvana-dhāma; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:ā:āsoyātha]]---envy.
translation: "When Jagannātha decided to see Vṛndāvana, He went there, and upon hearing this, the goddess of fortune experienced restlessness and jealousy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.206
description: "She wondered, 'Why did Lord Jagannātha give up so much opulence and go to Vṛndāvana?' To make Him a laughingstock, the goddess of fortune made arrangements for much decoration.
text:
> eta sampatti chāḍi' kene gelā vṛndāvana
> tāṅre hāsya karite lakṣmī karilā sājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:s:sampatti]]---so much opulence; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---He went; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:h:hāsya]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to make Him a laughingstock; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sājana]]---so much decoration.
translation: "She wondered, 'Why did Lord Jagannātha give up so much opulence and go to Vṛndāvana?' To make Him a laughingstock, the goddess of fortune made arrangements for much decoration.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.207
description: "Then the maidservants of the goddess of fortune said to the servants of Lord Jagannātha, 'Why did your Lord Jagannātha abandon the great opulence of the goddess of fortune and, for the sake of a few leaves, fruits and flowers, go see the flower garden of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī?
text:
> "tomāra ṭhākura, dekha eta sampatti chāḍi'
> patra-phala-phula-lobhe gelā puṣpa-bāḍī
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---your Lord; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---just see; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:s:sampatti]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving so much opulence; [[synonyms:p:patra]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]-[[synonyms:p:phula]]---leaves, fruits and flowers; [[synonyms:l:lobhe]]---for the sake of; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:b:bāḍī]]---to the flower garden of Guṇḍicā.
translation: "Then the maidservants of the goddess of fortune said to the servants of Lord Jagannātha, 'Why did your Lord Jagannātha abandon the great opulence of the goddess of fortune and, for the sake of a few leaves, fruits and flowers, go see the flower garden of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.208
description: " 'Your master is so expert at everything, but why does He do such things? Please bring your master before the goddess of fortune.'
text:
> ei karma kare kāhāṅ vidagdha-śiromaṇi?
> lakṣmīra agrete nija prabhure deha' āni' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:karma]]---work; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:v:vidagdha]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the chief of all experts; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:a:agrete]]---in front; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---your own; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---master; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---present; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing.
translation: “ 'Your master is so expert at everything, but why does He do such things? Please bring your master before the goddess of fortune.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.209
description: "In this way all the maidservants of the goddess of fortune arrested the servants of Jagannātha, bound them around the waist and brought them before the goddess of fortune.
text:
> eta bali' mahā-lakṣmīra saba dāsī-gaṇe
> kaṭi-vastre bāndhi' āne prabhura nija-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---maidservants; [[synonyms:k:kaṭi]]-[[synonyms:v:vastre]]---by their waist clothes; [[synonyms:b:bāndhi']]---binding; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---bring; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---personal servants.
translation: "In this way all the maidservants of the goddess of fortune arrested the servants of Jagannātha, bound them around the waist and brought them before the goddess of fortune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.21
description: Seeing the Lord's special mercy upon King Pratāparudra, the devotees praised the King's fortune, and their minds became open and blissful.
text:
> pratāparudrera bhāgya dekhi' bhakta-gaṇe
> rājāre praśaṁse sabe ānandita-mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pratāparudrera]]---of King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]---the fortune; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:r:rājāre]]---the King; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁse]]---praised; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---with blissful minds.
translation: Seeing the Lord's special mercy upon King Pratāparudra, the devotees praised the King's fortune, and their minds became open and blissful.
purport: This is a characteristic of a Vaiṣṇava. He is never envious if one receives the mercy and strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. A pure Vaiṣṇava is very happy to see a person elevated in devotional service. Unfortunately, there are many so-called Vaiṣṇavas who become envious to see someone actually recognized by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. It is a fact that no one can preach Caitanya Mahāprabhu's message without receiving the special mercy of the Lord. This is known to every Vaiṣṇava, yet there are some envious people who cannot tolerate the expansion of this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement all over the world. They find fault with a pure devotee preacher and do not praise him for the excellent service he renders in fulfilling Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mission.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.210
description: "When all the maidservants brought Lord Jagannātha's servants before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, the Lord's servants were fined and forced to submit.
text:
> lakṣmīra caraṇe āni' karāya praṇati
> dhana-daṇḍa laya, āra karāya minati
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:k:karāya]] [[synonyms:p:praṇati]]---made to bow down; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:l:laya]]---take a fine; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---//also//; [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---make them perform; [[synonyms:m:minati]]---submission.
translation: "When all the maidservants brought Lord Jagannātha's servants before the lotus feet of the goddess of fortune, the Lord's servants were fined and forced to submit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.211
description: "All the maidservants began to beat the Ratha car with sticks, and they treated the servants of Lord Jagannātha almost like thieves.
text:
> rathera upare kare daṇḍera tāḍana
> cora-prāya kare jagannāthera sevaka-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rathera]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the car; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍera]] [[synonyms:t:tāḍana]]---chastisement by sticks; [[synonyms:c:cora]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---almost like thieves; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---they treated; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the personal servants.
translation: "All the maidservants began to beat the Ratha car with sticks, and they treated the servants of Lord Jagannātha almost like thieves.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.212
description: "Finally all of Lord Jagannātha's servants submitted to the goddess of fortune with folded hands, assuring her that they would bring Lord Jagannātha before her the very next day.
text:
> saba bhṛtya-gaṇa kahe,-yoḍa kari' hāta
> 'kāli āni diba tomāra āge jagannātha,
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---all the servants said; [[synonyms:y:yoḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---folding the hands; [[synonyms:k:kāli]]---tomorrow; [[synonyms:ā:āni]]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:diba]]---we shall give; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---of you; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha.
translation: "Finally all of Lord Jagannātha's servants submitted to the goddess of fortune with folded hands, assuring her that they would bring Lord Jagannātha before her the very next day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.213
description: "Being thus pacified, the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. Just see! My goddess of fortune is opulent beyond all description."
text:
> tabe śānta hañā lakṣmī yāya nija ghara
> āmāra lakṣmīra sampad-vākya-agocara
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:ś:śānta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being pacified; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes back; [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to her own apartment; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---//my//; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:s:sampad]]---the opulence; [[synonyms:v:vākya]]-[[synonyms:a:agocara]]---beyond description.
translation: "Being thus pacified, the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. Just see! My goddess of fortune is opulent beyond all description."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.214
description: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued to address Svarūpa Dāmodara: "Your gopīs are engaged in boiling milk and churning it to turn it into yogurt, but my mistress, the goddess of fortune, sits on a throne made of jewels and gems."
text:
> dugdha āuṭi' dadhi mathe tomāra gopī-gaṇe
> āmāra ṭhākurāṇī vaise ratna-siṁhāsane
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dugdha]] [[synonyms:ā:āuṭi']]---boiling milk; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---into yogurt; [[synonyms:m:mathe]]---churn; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---//gopīs//; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurāṇī]]---mistress; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---sits down; [[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:s:siṁhāsane]]---on a throne of gems.
translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura continued to address Svarūpa Dāmodara: "Your gopīs are engaged in boiling milk and churning it to turn it into yogurt, but my mistress, the goddess of fortune, sits on a throne made of jewels and gems."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.215
description: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, who was enjoying the mood of Nārada Muni, thus made jokes. Hearing him, all the personal servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to smile.
text:
> nārada-prakṛti śrīvāsa kare parihāsa
> śuni' hāse mahāprabhura yata nija-dāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nārada]]-[[synonyms:p:prakṛti]]---with the nature of Nārada Muni; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---joking; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---smile; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---personal servants.
translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, who was enjoying the mood of Nārada Muni, thus made jokes. Hearing him, all the personal servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to smile.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.216
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Śrīvāsa, your nature is exactly like that of Nārada Muni. The Supreme Personality of Godhead's opulence is having a direct influence upon you.
text:
> prabhu kahe,-śrīvāsa, tomāte nārada-svabhāva
> aiśvarya-bhāve tomāte, īśvara-prabhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu says; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---My dear Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:t:tomāte]]---in you; [[synonyms:n:nārada]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---the nature of Nārada; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---the mood of full opulence; [[synonyms:t:tomāte]]---in you; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---the power of the Lord.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "My dear Śrīvāsa, your nature is exactly like that of Nārada Muni. The Supreme Personality of Godhead's opulence is having a direct influence upon you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.217
description: "Svarūpa Dāmodara is a pure devotee of Vṛndāvana. He does not even know what opulence is, for he is simply absorbed in pure devotional service."
text:
> iṅho dāmodara-svarūpa-śuddha-vrajavāsī
> aiśvarya nā jāne iṅho śuddha-preme bhāsi'
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṅho]]---here; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]-[[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---a pure inhabitant of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---he does not know opulence; [[synonyms:i:iṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:preme]]---in pure devotional service; [[synonyms:b:bhāsi']]---floating.
translation: "Svarūpa Dāmodara is a pure devotee of Vṛndāvana. He does not even know what opulence is, for he is simply absorbed in pure devotional service."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.218
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara then retorted, "My dear Śrīvāsa, please hear me with attention. You have forgotten the transcendental opulence of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> svarūpa kahe,-śrīvāsa, śuna sāvadhāne
> vṛndāvana-sampad tomāra nāhi paḍe mane?
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara said; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---my dear Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]] [[synonyms:s:sāvadhāne]]---carefully please hear; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:s:sampad]]---the opulence of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---falls; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then retorted, "My dear Śrīvāsa, please hear me with attention. You have forgotten the transcendental opulence of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.219
description: "The natural opulence of Vṛndāvana is just like an ocean. The opulence of Dvārakā and Vaikuṇṭha is not even to be compared to a drop.
text:
> vṛndāvane sāhajika ye sampat-sindhu
> dvārakā-vaikuṇṭha-sampat-tāra eka bindu
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:s:sāhajika]]---natural; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:s:sampat]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---ocean of opulence; [[synonyms:d:dvārakā]]---of Dvārakā; [[synonyms:v:vaikuṇṭha]]-[[synonyms:s:sampat]]---all the opulence of the spiritual world; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:b:bindu]]---one drop.
translation: "The natural opulence of Vṛndāvana is just like an ocean. The opulence of Dvārakā and Vaikuṇṭha is not even to be compared to a drop.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.22
description: Submissively offering prayers to the devotees with folded hands and offering obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the King went outside.
text:
> daṇḍavat kari' rājā bāhire calilā
> yoḍa hasta kari' saba bhaktere vandilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:y:yoḍa]]---folded; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]---hands; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhaktere]]---unto the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---offered prayers.
translation: Submissively offering prayers to the devotees with folded hands and offering obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the King went outside.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.220
description: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead full of all opulences, and His complete opulences are exhibited only in Vṛndāvana-dhāma.
text:
> parama puruṣottama svayaṁ bhagavān
> kṛṣṇa yāhāṅ dhanī tāhāṅ vṛndāvana-dhāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:p:puruṣa]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:s:svayam]] [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---personally the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:d:dhanī]]---actually opulent; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāma]]---Vṛndāvana-dhāma.
translation: "Śrī Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead full of all opulences, and His complete opulences are exhibited only in Vṛndāvana-dhāma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.221
description: "Vṛndāvana-dhāma is made of transcendental touchstone. Its entire surface is the source of all valuable jewels, and the cintāmaṇi stone is used to decorate the lotus feet of the maidservants of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> cintāmaṇi-maya bhūmi ratnera bhavana
> cintāmaṇi-gaṇa dāsī-caraṇa-bhūṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cintāmaṇi]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---made of transcendental touchstone; [[synonyms:b:bhūmi]]---the ground; [[synonyms:r:ratnera]]---of gems; [[synonyms:b:bhavana]]---the original source; [[synonyms:c:cintāmaṇi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---such touchstones; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---foot decorations of the maidservants of Vṛndāvana.
translation: "Vṛndāvana-dhāma is made of transcendental touchstone. Its entire surface is the source of all valuable jewels, and the cintāmaṇi stone is used to decorate the lotus feet of the maidservants of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.222
description: "Vṛndāvana is a natural forest of desire trees and creepers, and the inhabitants do not want anything but the fruits and flowers of those desire trees.
text:
> kalpavṛkṣa-latāra-yāhāṅ sāhajika-vana
> puṣpa-phala vinā keha nā māge anya dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:l:latāra]]---of creepers and //kalpa-vṛkṣa,// or desire trees; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:s:sāhajika]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---natural forest; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---except for fruits and flowers; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:m:māge]]---does not want; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---any other; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---riches.
translation: "Vṛndāvana is a natural forest of desire trees and creepers, and the inhabitants do not want anything but the fruits and flowers of those desire trees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.223
description: "In Vṛndāvana there are cows that fulfill all desires [kāma-dhenus], and their number is unlimited. They graze from forest to forest and deliver only milk. The people want nothing else.
text:
> ananta kāma-dhenu tāhāṅ phire vane vane
> dugdha-mātra dena, keha nā māge anya dhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:d:dhenu]]---cows that can fulfill all desires; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:p:phire]]---graze; [[synonyms:v:vane]] [[synonyms:v:vane]]---from forest to forest; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---deliver milk only; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---wants; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:d:dhane]]---any other riches.
translation: "In Vṛndāvana there are cows that fulfill all desires [kāma-dhenus], and their number is unlimited. They graze from forest to forest and deliver only milk. The people want nothing else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.224
description: "In Vṛndāvana, the natural speech of the people sounds like music, and their natural motion resembles a dance.
text:
> sahaja lokera kathā-yāhāṅ divya-gīta
> sahaja gamana kare,-yaiche nṛtya-pratīta
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahaja]] [[synonyms:l:lokera]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---the talks of all the plain people; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---transcendental music; [[synonyms:s:sahaja]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---natural walking; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---they do; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---like; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:p:pratīta]]---appearing like dancing.
translation: "In Vṛndāvana, the natural speech of the people sounds like music, and their natural motion resembles a dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.225
description: "The water in Vṛndāvana is nectar, and the brahmajyoti effulgence, which is full of transcendental bliss, is directly perceived there in its form.
text:
> sarvatra jala-yāhāṅ amṛta-samāna
> cid-ānanda jyotiḥ svādya-yāhāṅ mūrtimān
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarvatra]]---everywhere; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---the water; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---equal to nectar; [[synonyms:c:cit]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:j:jyotiḥ]]---effulgence; [[synonyms:s:svādya]]---perceived; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:m:mūrtimān]]---assuming a form.
translation: "The water in Vṛndāvana is nectar, and the brahmajyoti effulgence, which is full of transcendental bliss, is directly perceived there in its form.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.226
description: "The gopīs there are also goddesses of fortune, and they surpass the goddess of fortune who abides in Vaikuṇṭha. In Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa is always playing His transcendental flute, which is His dear companion.
text:
> lakṣmī jini' guṇa yāhāṅ lakṣmīra samāja
> kṛṣṇa-vaṁśī kare yāhāṅ priya-sakhī-kāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---qualities; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]] [[synonyms:s:samāja]]---the society of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]---Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's flute; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---in His hand; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:p:priya]]-[[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:k:kāya]]---a dear companion.
translation: "The gopīs there are also goddesses of fortune, and they surpass the goddess of fortune who abides in Vaikuṇṭha. In Vṛndāvana, Lord Kṛṣṇa is always playing His transcendental flute, which is His dear companion.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.227
description: " 'The damsels of Vṛndāvana, the gopīs, are super goddesses of fortune. The enjoyer in Vṛndāvana is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa. The trees there are all wish-fulfilling trees, and the land is made of transcendental touchstone. The water is all nectar, the talking is singing, the walking is dancing, and the constant companion of Kṛṣṇa is His flute. The effulgence of transcendental bliss is experienced everywhere. Therefore Vṛndāvana-dhāma is the only relishable abode.'
text:
> śriyaḥ kāntāḥ kāntaḥ parama-puruṣaḥ kalpa-taravo
> drumā bhūmiś cintāmaṇi-gaṇa-mayī toyam amṛtam
> kathā gānaṁ nāṭyaṁ gamanam api vaṁśī priya-sakhī
> cid-ānandaṁ jyotiḥ param api tad āsvādyam api ca
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śriyaḥ]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:k:kāntāḥ]]---the damsels; [[synonyms:k:kāntaḥ]]---the enjoyer; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:p:puruṣaḥ]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:t:taravaḥ]]---desire trees; [[synonyms:d:drumāḥ]]---all the trees; [[synonyms:b:bhūmiḥ]]---the land; [[synonyms:c:cintāmaṇi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mayī]]---made of the transcendental touchstone jewel; [[synonyms:t:toyam]]---the water; [[synonyms:a:amṛtam]]---nectar; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talking; [[synonyms:g:gānam]]---//song//; [[synonyms:n:nāṭyam]]---dancing; [[synonyms:g:gamanam]]---walking; [[synonyms:a:api]]---also; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]---the flute; [[synonyms:p:priya]]-[[synonyms:s:sakhī]]---constant companion; [[synonyms:c:cit]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānandam]]---transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:j:jyotiḥ]]---effulgence; [[synonyms:p:param]]---the supreme; [[synonyms:a:api]]---//also//; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādyam]]---everywhere perceived; [[synonyms:a:api]] [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also.
translation: “ 'The damsels of Vṛndāvana, the gopīs, are super goddesses of fortune. The enjoyer in Vṛndāvana is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa. The trees there are all wish-fulfilling trees, and the land is made of transcendental touchstone. The water is all nectar, the talking is singing, the walking is dancing, and the constant companion of Kṛṣṇa is His flute. The effulgence of transcendental bliss is experienced everywhere. Therefore Vṛndāvana-dhāma is the only relishable abode.'
purport: This is a quotation from //Brahma-saṁhitā// (5.56).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.228
description: " 'The anklets on the damsels of Vraja-bhūmi are made of cintāmaṇi stone. The trees are wish-fulfilling trees, and they produce flowers with which the gopīs decorate themselves. There are also wish-fulfilling cows [kāma dhenus], which deliver unlimited quantities of milk. These cows constitute the wealth of Vṛndāvana. Thus Vṛndāvana's opulence is blissfully exhibited.' "
text:
> cintāmaṇiś caraṇa-bhūṣaṇam aṅganānāṁ
> śṛṅgāra-puṣpa-taravas taravaḥ surāṇām
> vṛndāvane vraja-dhanaṁ nanu kāma-dhenu-
> vṛndāni ceti sukha-sindhur aho vibhūtiḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cintāmaṇiḥ]]---transcendental touchstone; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇam]]---the ornament; [[synonyms:a:aṅganānām]]---of all the women of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ś:śṛṅgāra]]---for dressing; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:t:taravaḥ]]---the flower trees; [[synonyms:t:taravaḥ]]---the trees; [[synonyms:s:surāṇām]]---of the demigods (desire trees); [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:d:dhanam]]---the special wealth of the inhabitants of Vraja; [[synonyms:n:nanu]]---certainly; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:d:dhenu]]---of //kāma-dhenu// cows that can deliver unlimited milk; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāni]]---//groups//; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhuḥ]]---the ocean of happiness; [[synonyms:a:aho]]---oh, how much; [[synonyms:v:vibhūtiḥ]]---opulence.
translation: “ 'The anklets on the damsels of Vraja-bhūmi are made of cintāmaṇi stone. The trees are wish-fulfilling trees, and they produce flowers with which the gopīs decorate themselves. There are also wish-fulfilling cows [kāma dhenus], which deliver unlimited quantities of milk. These cows constitute the wealth of Vṛndāvana. Thus Vṛndāvana's opulence is blissfully exhibited.' "
purport: This is a verse written by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.229
description: Śrīvāsa then began to dance in ecstatic love. He vibrated sounds by slapping his armpits with the palms of his hands, and he laughed very loudly.
text:
> śuni' premāveśe nṛtya kare śrīnivāsa
> kakṣa-tāli bājāya, kare aṭṭa-aṭṭa hāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:ś:śrīnivāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kakṣa]]-[[synonyms:t:tāli]]---his armpits with his palms; [[synonyms:b:bājāya]]---sounds; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:a:aṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:a:aṭṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hāsa]]---very loud laughing.
translation: Śrīvāsa then began to dance in ecstatic love. He vibrated sounds by slapping his armpits with the palms of his hands, and he laughed very loudly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.23
description: After this, Vāṇīnātha Rāya brought all kinds of prasāda, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted lunch with the devotees.
text:
> madhyāhna karilā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> vāṇīnātha prasāda lañā kaila āgamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---accepted lunch; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]]---Vāṇīnātha; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all kinds of remnants of Jagannātha's food; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---arrival.
translation: After this, Vāṇīnātha Rāya brought all kinds of prasāda, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted lunch with the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.230
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these discussions about the pure transcendental mellow of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Absorbed in transcendental ecstasy, the Lord began to dance.
text:
> rādhāra śuddha-rasa prabhu āveśe śunila
> sei rasāveśe prabhu nṛtya ārambhila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---pure transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āveśe]] [[synonyms:ś:śunila]]---heard with great ecstasy; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in absorption in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:ā:ārambhila]]---began dancing.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these discussions about the pure transcendental mellow of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. Absorbed in transcendental ecstasy, the Lord began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.231
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in ecstatic love and Svarūpa Dāmodara was singing, the Lord said, "Go on singing! Go on singing!" The Lord then extended His own ears.
text:
> rasāveśe prabhura nṛtya, svarūpera gāna
> 'bala' 'bala' bali' prabhu pāte nija-kāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic mellows; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---the dancing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---and singing by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:b:bala]] [[synonyms:b:bala]]---go on speaking, go on speaking; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāte]]---extends; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---own ear.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in ecstatic love and Svarūpa Dāmodara was singing, the Lord said, "Go on singing! Go on singing!" The Lord then extended His own ears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.232
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love was awakened by hearing the songs of Vṛndāvana. In this way He inundated Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī, with love of Godhead.
text:
> vraja-rasa-gīta śuni' prema uthalila
> puruṣottama-grāma prabhu preme bhāsāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---songs about the mellows of Vṛndāvana-dhāma; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:u:uthalila]]---awakened; [[synonyms:p:puruṣottama]]-[[synonyms:g:grāma]]---the place known as Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---with ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāsāila]]---inundated.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love was awakened by hearing the songs of Vṛndāvana. In this way He inundated Puruṣottama, Jagannātha Purī, with love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.233
description: Finally the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. In due course of time, as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, afternoon arrived.
text:
> lakṣmī-devī yathā-kāle gelā nija-ghara
> prabhu nṛtya kare, haila tṛtīya prahara
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:d:devī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in due course of time; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to her apartment; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---dances; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there arrived; [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]] [[synonyms:p:prahara]]---the third period of the day, the afternoon.
translation: Finally the goddess of fortune returned to her apartment. In due course of time, as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing, afternoon arrived.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.234
description: After much singing, all four saṅkīrtana parties grew fatigued, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love increased twofold.
text:
> cāri sampradāya gāna kari' bahu śrānta haila
> mahāprabhura premāveśa dviguṇa bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---four groups of //saṅkīrtana// parties; [[synonyms:g:gāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after singing; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:ś:śrānta]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---were fatigued; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---the ecstatic love; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---twofold; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---increased.
translation: After much singing, all four saṅkīrtana parties grew fatigued, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love increased twofold.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.235
description: While dancing absorbed in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared in Her very form. Seeing this from a distant place, Nityānanda Prabhu offered prayers.
text:
> rādhā-premāveśe prabhu hailā sei mūrti
> nityānanda dūre dekhi' karilena stuti
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:mūrti]]---exactly that same form; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing from a distant place; [[synonyms:k:karilena]] [[synonyms:s:stuti]]---offered prayers.
translation: While dancing absorbed in Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared in Her very form. Seeing this from a distant place, Nityānanda Prabhu offered prayers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.236
description: Seeing the ecstatic love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu did not approach but remained a little distance away.
text:
> nityānanda dekhiyā prabhura bhāvāveśa
> nikaṭe nā āise, rahe kichu dūra-deśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---the ecstatic love; [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---nearby; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---does not come; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---//keeps//; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---a little; [[synonyms:d:dūra]]-[[synonyms:d:deśa]]---far away.
translation: Seeing the ecstatic love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Nityānanda Prabhu did not approach but remained a little distance away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.237
description: Only Nityānanda Prabhu could catch Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the ecstatic mood of the Lord would not stop. At the same time, kīrtana could not be continued.
text:
> nityānanda vinā prabhuke dhare kon jana
> prabhura āveśa nā yāya, nā rahe kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---except for Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---can catch; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---what person; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---the ecstasy; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---does not go away; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---could not be continued; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---kīrtana.
translation: Only Nityānanda Prabhu could catch Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the ecstatic mood of the Lord would not stop. At the same time, kīrtana could not be continued.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.238
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara then informed the Lord that all the devotees were fatigued. Seeing this situation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to His external senses.
text:
> bhaṅgi kari' svarūpa sabāra śrama jānāila
> bhakta-gaṇera śrama dekhi' prabhura bāhya haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgi]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---showing an indication; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:ś:śrama]]---the fatigue; [[synonyms:j:jānāila]]---made known; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:ś:śrama]]---the fatigue; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---become externally conscious.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara then informed the Lord that all the devotees were fatigued. Seeing this situation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to His external senses.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.239
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then entered the flower garden with all His devotees. After resting there for some time, He finished His afternoon bath.
text:
> saba bhakta lañā prabhu gelā puṣpodyāne
> viśrāma kariyā kailā mādhyāhnika snāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in the flower garden; [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---resting; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:m:mādhyāhnika]] [[synonyms:s:snāne]]---bath in the afternoon.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then entered the flower garden with all His devotees. After resting there for some time, He finished His afternoon bath.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.24
description: The King also sent a large quantity of prasāda through Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya.
text:
> sārvabhauma-rāmānanda-vāṇīnāthe diyā
> prasāda pāṭhā'la rājā bahuta kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnāthe]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---through Vāṇīnātha Rāya; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhā'la]]---had sent; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---in a large quantity.
translation: The King also sent a large quantity of prasāda through Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.240
description: Then there arrived in large quantities a variety of food that had been offered to Śrī Jagannātha and a variety that had been offered to the goddess of fortune.
text:
> jagannāthera prasāda āila bahu upahāra
> lakṣmīra prasāda āila vividha prakāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the //prasāda// offered to Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---arrived; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---many; [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---offerings; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmīra]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---food offered to Lakṣmīdevī; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---arrived; [[synonyms:v:vividha]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---all varieties.
translation: Then there arrived in large quantities a variety of food that had been offered to Śrī Jagannātha and a variety that had been offered to the goddess of fortune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.241
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finished His afternoon lunch, and after His evening bath, He went to see Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> sabā lañā nānā-raṅge karilā bhojana
> sandhyā snāna kari' kaila jagannātha daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all the devotees; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in great jubilation; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after taking an evening bath; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visit to Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu finished His afternoon lunch, and after His evening bath, He went to see Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.242
description: As soon as He saw Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to chant and dance. Afterward, accompanied by His devotees, the Lord enjoyed sporting in the lake called Narendra-sarovara.
text:
> jagannātha dekhi' karena nartana-kīrtana
> narendre jala-krīḍā kare lañā bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:n:narendre]]---in the lake known as Narendrasarovara; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---sporting in the water; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---with the devotees.
translation: As soon as He saw Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to chant and dance. Afterward, accompanied by His devotees, the Lord enjoyed sporting in the lake called Narendra-sarovara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.243
description: Then, entering the flower garden, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His meal. In this way He continuously performed all kinds of pastimes for eight days.
text:
> udyāne āsiyā kaila vana-bhojana
> ei-mata krīḍā kaila prabhu aṣṭa-dina
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---to the garden; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---picnic in the forest; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---constantly for eight days.
translation: Then, entering the flower garden, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took His meal. In this way He continuously performed all kinds of pastimes for eight days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.244
description: The next day Lord Jagannātha came out from the temple and, riding on the car, returned to His own abode.
text:
> āra dine jagannāthera bhitara-vijaya
> rathe caḍi' jagannātha cale nijālaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the next day; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]-[[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---coming out from inside the temple; [[synonyms:r:rathe]] [[synonyms:c:caḍi']]---riding on the car; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---returns; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālaya]]---to His own home.
translation: The next day Lord Jagannātha came out from the temple and, riding on the car, returned to His own abode.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.245
description: As previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees again chanted and danced with great pleasure.
text:
> pūrvavat kaila prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> parama ānande karena nartana-kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great pleasure; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting and dancing.
translation: As previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees again chanted and danced with great pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.246
description: During the Pāṇḍu-vijaya, Lord Jagannātha was carried, and while He was being carried, a bunch of silken ropes broke.
text:
> jagannāthera punaḥ pāṇḍu-vijaya ha-ila
> eka guṭi paṭṭa-ḍorī tāṅhā ṭuṭi' gela
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:p:pāṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---the function of carrying the Lord; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:g:guṭi]]---one bunch; [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---ropes of silk; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭuṭi']] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---broke.
translation: During the Pāṇḍu-vijaya, Lord Jagannātha was carried, and while He was being carried, a bunch of silken ropes broke.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.247
description: When the Jagannātha Deity is carried, at intervals He is placed on cotton pads. When the ropes broke, the cotton pads also broke due to the weight of Lord Jagannātha, and the cotton floated in the air.
text:
> pāṇḍu-vijayera tuli phāṭi-phuṭi yāya
> jagannāthera bhare tulā uḍiyā palāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:v:vijayera]]---of the ceremony of Pāṇḍu-vijaya; [[synonyms:t:tuli]]---batches of cotton; [[synonyms:p:phāṭi]]-[[synonyms:p:phuṭi]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---become broken; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]] [[synonyms:b:bhare]]---by the weight of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tulā]]---the cotton; [[synonyms:u:uḍiyā]] [[synonyms:p:palāya]]---floats in the air.
translation: When the Jagannātha Deity is carried, at intervals He is placed on cotton pads. When the ropes broke, the cotton pads also broke due to the weight of Lord Jagannātha, and the cotton floated in the air.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.248
description: Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān were present from Kulīna-grāma, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, with great respect, gave them the following orders.
text:
> kulīna-grāmī rāmānanda, satyarāja khāṅna
> tāṅre ājñā dila prabhu kariyā sammāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kulīna]]-[[synonyms:g:grāmī]]---the inhabitants of the village known as Kulīna-grāma; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:s:satyarāja]] [[synonyms:k:khāṅna]]---Satyarāja Khān; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to them; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave an order; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---showing great respect.
translation: Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān were present from Kulīna-grāma, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, with great respect, gave them the following orders.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.249
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān to become the worshipers of these ropes and every year bring silken ropes from their village.
text:
> ei paṭṭa-ḍorīra tumi hao yajamāna
> prati-vatsara ānibe 'ḍorī' kariyā nirmāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorīra]]---of these paṭṭa-ḍorīs, silken ropes; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---//you//; [[synonyms:h:hao]]---become; [[synonyms:y:yajamāna]]---the worshipers; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---every year; [[synonyms:ā:ānibe]]---you must bring; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---ropes; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:n:nirmāṇa]]---manufacturing.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān to become the worshipers of these ropes and every year bring silken ropes from their village.
purport: It is understood that silken rope was being manufactured by the local inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma; therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Rāmānanda Vasu and Satyarāja Khān to get ropes every year for Lord Jagannātha's service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.25
description: The prasāda sent by the King had been offered at the Balagaṇḍi festival and included uncooked milk products and fruits. It was all of the finest quality, and there was no end to the variety.
text:
> 'balagaṇḍi bhoge'ra prasāda-uttama, ananta
> 'ni-sakaḍi' prasāda āila, yāra nāhi anta
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:balagaṇḍi]] [[synonyms:b:bhogera]]---of food offered at Balagaṇḍi; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants; [[synonyms:u:uttama]]---all of the foremost quality; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---of all varieties; [[synonyms:n:ni]]-[[synonyms:s:sakaḍi]]---uncooked food like milk products and fruits; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---arrived; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---end.
translation: The prasāda sent by the King had been offered at the Balagaṇḍi festival and included uncooked milk products and fruits. It was all of the finest quality, and there was no end to the variety.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.250
description: After telling them this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed them the broken silken ropes, saying, "Just look at this sample. You must make ropes that are much stronger."
text:
> eta bali' dila tāṅre chiṇḍā paṭṭa-ḍorī
> ihā dekhi' karibe ḍorī ati dṛḍha kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to them; [[synonyms:c:chiṇḍā]]---broken; [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---silken ropes; [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing this; [[synonyms:k:karibe]]---you must make; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---the ropes; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very much; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making strong.
translation: After telling them this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed them the broken silken ropes, saying, "Just look at this sample. You must make ropes that are much stronger."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.251
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān that this rope was the abode of Lord Śeṣa, who expands Himself into ten forms and serves the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
text:
> ei paṭṭa-ḍorīte haya 'śeṣa'-adhiṣṭhāna
> daśa-mūrti hañā yeṅho seve bhagavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorīte]]---in this rope; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:adhiṣṭhāna]]---the abode of Śeṣa Nāga; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:m:mūrti]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---expanding into ten forms; [[synonyms:y:yeṅho]]---//who//; [[synonyms:s:seve]]---worships; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Rāmānanda and Satyarāja Khān that this rope was the abode of Lord Śeṣa, who expands Himself into ten forms and serves the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
purport: For a description of Śeṣa Nāga, refer to //Ādi-līlā// (5.123-124).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.252
description: After receiving orders from the Lord for the rendering of service, the fortunate Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu were highly pleased.
text:
> bhāgyavān satyarāja vasu rāmānanda
> sevā-ājñā pāñā haila parama-ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---very fortunate; [[synonyms:s:satyarāja]]---Satyarāja; [[synonyms:v:vasu]] [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Vasu; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order for service; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:p:parama]]---supremely; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---happy.
translation: After receiving orders from the Lord for the rendering of service, the fortunate Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu were highly pleased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.253
description: Every year thereafter, when the Guṇḍicā temple was being cleansed, Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu would come with other devotees and with great pleasure bring silken rope.
text:
> prati vatsara guṇḍicāte bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> paṭṭa-ḍorī lañā āise ati baḍa raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prativatsara]]---every year; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicāte]]---to the Guṇḍicā temple cleansing ceremony; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with other devotees; [[synonyms:p:paṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍorī]]---silken rope; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---came; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---extremely; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---great; [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---with pleasure.
translation: Every year thereafter, when the Guṇḍicā temple was being cleansed, Satyarāja and Rāmānanda Vasu would come with other devotees and with great pleasure bring silken rope.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.254
description: Thus Lord Jagannātha returned to His temple and sat on His throne while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with His devotees.
text:
> tabe jagannātha yāi' vasilā siṁhāsane
> mahāprabhu ghare āilā lañā bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---//going//; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat; [[synonyms:s:siṁhāsane]]---on His throne; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to His residence; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---went back; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees.
translation: Thus Lord Jagannātha returned to His temple and sat on His throne while Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.255
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed the Ratha-yātrā ceremony to His devotees and performed the Vṛndāvana pastimes with them.
text:
> ei-mata bhakta-gaṇe yātrā dekhāila
> bhakta-gaṇa lañā vṛndāvana-keli kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the Ratha-yātrā festival; [[synonyms:d:dekhāila]]---showed; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---pastimes of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed the Ratha-yātrā ceremony to His devotees and performed the Vṛndāvana pastimes with them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.256
description: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited and endless. Even Sahasravadana, Lord Śeṣa, cannot reach the limits of His pastimes.
text:
> caitanya-gosāñira līlā-ananta, apāra
> 'sahasra-vadana' yāra nāhi pāya pāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---without end; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:v:vadana]]---Lord Śeṣa, who has thousands of hoods; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---the limit.
translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited and endless. Even Sahasravadana, Lord Śeṣa, cannot reach the limits of His pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.257
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named Caitanya-caritāmṛta; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Fourteenth Chapter, describing the Herā-pañcamī-yātrā.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.26
description: There was curd, fruit juice, coconut, mango, dried coconut, jackfruit, various kinds of bananas and palm fruit seeds.
text:
> chānā, pānā, paiḍa, āmra, nārikela, kāṅṭhāla
> nānā-vidha kadalaka, āra bīja-tāla
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chānā]]---curd; [[synonyms:p:pānā]]---fruit juice; [[synonyms:p:paiḍa]]---coconut; [[synonyms:ā:āmra]]---mango; [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]---dried coconut; [[synonyms:k:kāṅṭhāla]]---jackfruit; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:v:vidha]]---various kinds of; [[synonyms:k:kadalaka]]---bananas; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bīja]]-[[synonyms:t:tāla]]---palm fruit seeds.
translation: There was curd, fruit juice, coconut, mango, dried coconut, jackfruit, various kinds of bananas and palm fruit seeds.
purport: This is the first list of //prasāda// offered to Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.27
description: There were also oranges, grapefruit, tangerines, almonds, dried fruit, raisins and dates.
text:
> nāraṅga, cholaṅga, ṭābā, kamalā, bīja-pūra
> bādāma, chohārā, drākṣā, piṇḍa-kharjura
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nāraṅga]]---oranges; [[synonyms:c:cholaṅga]]---grapefruits; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭābā]]---another type of orange; [[synonyms:k:kamalā]]---tangerines; [[synonyms:b:bīja]]-[[synonyms:p:pūra]]---another type of tangerine; [[synonyms:b:bādāma]]---almonds; [[synonyms:c:chohārā]]---dried fruit; [[synonyms:d:drākṣā]]---raisins; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:k:kharjura]]---dates.
translation: There were also oranges, grapefruit, tangerines, almonds, dried fruit, raisins and dates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.28
description: There were hundreds of different types of sweetmeats like manoharā-lāḍu, sweets like amṛta-guṭikā and various types of condensed milk.
text:
> manoharā-lāḍu ādi śateka prakāra
> amṛta-guṭikā-ādi, kṣīrasā apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manoharā]]-[[synonyms:l:lāḍu]]---a kind of //sandeśa//; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:ś:śateka]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---hundreds of varieties; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:g:guṭikā]]---round sweetmeats; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:k:kṣīrasā]]---condensed milk; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---of various qualities.
translation: There were hundreds of different types of sweetmeats like manoharā-lāḍu, sweets like amṛta-guṭikā and various types of condensed milk.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.29
description: There were also papayas and saravatī, a type of orange, and also crushed squash. There was also regular cream, fried cream and a type of purī made with cream.
text:
> amṛta-maṇḍā, saravatī, āra kumḍā-kurī
> sarāmṛta, sarabhājā, āra sarapurī
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇḍā]]---a variety of papaya; [[synonyms:s:saravatī]]---a kind of orange; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:kumḍā]]-[[synonyms:k:kurī]]---crushed squash; [[synonyms:s:sarāmṛta]]---cream; [[synonyms:s:sara]]-[[synonyms:b:bhājā]]---fried cream; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:s:sara]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---a kind of //purī// made with cream.
translation: There were also papayas and saravatī, a type of orange, and also crushed squash. There was also regular cream, fried cream and a type of purī made with cream.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.3
description: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the readers who have taken Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as their life and soul.
text:
> jaya jaya śrīvāsādi gaura-bhakta-gaṇa
> jaya śrotā-gaṇa,-yāṅra gaura prāṇa-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jayajaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the devotees of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrotā]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the hearers; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the life and soul.
translation: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the readers who have taken Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as their life and soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.30
description: There were also sweets like hari-vallabha and sweets made of seṅoti flowers, karpūra flowers and mālatī flowers. There were pomegranates, sweets made with black pepper, sweets made with fused sugar, and amṛti-jilipi.
text:
> hari-vallabha, seṅoti, karpūra, mālatī
> ḍālimā marica-lāḍu, navāta, amṛti
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:v:vallabha]]---a sweetmeat like bread fried in ghee (like a doughnut); [[synonyms:s:seṅoti]]---a sweetmeat made of a kind of fragrant flower; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]---a flower; [[synonyms:m:mālatī]]---another flower; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍālimā]]---pomegranate; [[synonyms:m:marica]]-[[synonyms:l:lāḍu]]---a sweetmeat made with black pepper; [[synonyms:n:navāta]]---another kind of sweetmeat, made with fused sugar; [[synonyms:a:amṛti]]---a preparation generally called //amṛti-jilipi,// made with rice powder and chick-pea flour, mixed with yogurt, fried in ghee and immersed in sugar water.
translation: There were also sweets like hari-vallabha and sweets made of seṅoti flowers, karpūra flowers and mālatī flowers. There were pomegranates, sweets made with black pepper, sweets made with fused sugar, and amṛti-jilipi.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.31
description: There was lotus flower sugar, a kind of bread made from urad dhal, crispy sweetmeats, sugar candy, fried rice sweets, sesame seed sweets and cookies made from sesame seeds.
text:
> padmacini, candrakānti, khājā, khaṇḍasāra
> viyari, kadmā, tilākhājāra prakāra

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.36
description: Indeed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fully satisfied just to see how Lord Jagannātha accepted all the food.
text:
> ei-mata jagannātha karena bhojana
> ei sukhe mahāprabhura juḍāya nayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---accepts His food; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in this happiness; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]]---become fully satisfied; [[synonyms:n:nayana]]---the eyes.
translation: Indeed, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fully satisfied just to see how Lord Jagannātha accepted all the food.
purport:
Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, a Vaiṣṇava should be fully satisfied simply to see a variety of food offered to the Deity of Jagannātha or Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa. A Vaiṣṇava should not hunger for a variety of food for his own sake; rather, his satisfaction is in seeing various foods being offered to the Deity. In his //Gurv-aṣṭaka,// Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura writes:

> catur-vidha-śrī-bhagavat-prasāda-
> svādv-anna-tṛptān hari-bhakta-saṅghān
> kṛtvaiva tṛptiṁ bhajataḥ sadaiva
> vande guroḥ śrī-caraṇāravindam

"The spiritual master is always offering Kṛṣṇa four kinds of delicious food [analyzed as that which is licked, chewed, drunk and sucked]. When the spiritual master sees that the devotees are satisfied by eating //bhagavat-prasāda,// he is satisfied. I offer my respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of such a spiritual master."

The spiritual master's duty is to engage his disciples in preparing varieties of nice food to offer the Deity. After being offered, this food is distributed as //prasāda// to the devotees. These activities satisfy the spiritual master, although he himself does not eat or require such a variety of //prasāda.// By seeing to the offering and distribution of //prasāda,// he himself is encouraged in devotional service.
