> 'hari-bola' bali' tāre upadeśa kari
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāṅgālera]]---of the beggars; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅga]]---process of eating; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:g:gaurahari]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---chanting "Hari bol"; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---them; [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---instructs.
translation: Observing the beggars eating prasāda, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chanted, "Hari bol!" and instructed them to chant the holy name.
purport:
In a song, Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura chants:

> miche māyāra vaśe, yāccha bhese',
> khāccha hābuḍubu, bhāi
> jīva kṛṣṇa-dāsa, e viśvāsa,
> ka'rle ta' āra duḥkha nāi

"Everyone is captivated by the waves of the ocean of nescience, but if everyone would immediately accept Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa as their eternal master, there would be no chance of being carried away by the waves of illusion. Then all sufferings would stop." Kṛṣṇa conducts the material world under the three modes of material nature, and consequently there are three platforms of life-higher, middle and lower. On whatever platform one may be situated, one is tossed by the waves of material nature. Someone may be rich, someone may be middle class, and someone may be a poor beggar---it doesn't matter. As long as one is under the spell of the three modes of material nature, he must continue to experience these divisions.

Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu therefore advised the beggars to chant "Hari bol!" while taking //prasāda.// Chanting means accepting one's self as the eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa. This is the only solution, regardless of social position. Everyone is suffering under the spell of //māyā;// therefore the best course is to learn how to get out of the clutches of //māyā.// That is the verdict of the //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:14:26|(Bg. 14.26)]]:

> māṁ ca yo 'vyabhicāreṇa
> bhakti-yogena sevate
> sa guṇān samatītyaitān
> brahma-bhūyāya kalpate

"One who engages in full devotional service, who does not fall down in any circumstance, at once transcends the modes of material nature and thus comes to the level of Brahman."

One can overcome the spell of //māyā// and attain the transcendental platform by agreeing to engage in the devotional service of the Lord. Devotional service begins with //śravaṇaṁ kīrtanam;// therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised the beggars to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra// for elevation to the transcendental position. On the transcendental platform, there is no distinction between the rich, the middle class and the poor.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.46
description: As soon as the beggars chanted the holy name, "Hari bol," they were immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Godhead. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed wonderful pastimes.
text:
> 'hari-bola' bali' kāṅgāla preme bhāsi' yāya
> aichana adbhuta līlā kare gaurarāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---by chanting "Hari bol"; [[synonyms:k:kāṅgāla]]---the poor section of people; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāsi']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---began to float; [[synonyms:a:aichana]]---such; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:g:gaurarāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: As soon as the beggars chanted the holy name, "Hari bol," they were immediately absorbed in ecstatic love of Godhead. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed wonderful pastimes.
purport:
To feel the emotion of ecstatic love of God is to be on the transcendental platform. If one can keep himself in that transcendental position, he will surely return home, back to Godhead. In the spiritual world there are no higher, middle or lower classes. This is confirmed by //Īśopaniṣad, Mantra// Seven:

> yasmin sarvāṇi bhūtāny
> ātmaivābhūd vijānataḥ
> tatra ko mohaḥ kaḥ śoka
> ekatvam anupaśyataḥ

"One who always sees all living entities as spiritual sparks, in quality one with the Lord, becomes a true knower of things. What, then, can be illusion or anxiety for him?"

> mahā-malla-gaṇe dila ratha cālāite
> āpane lāgilā ratha, nā pāre ṭānite
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:m:malla]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto the big wrestlers; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:c:cālāite]]---to pull out; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---engaged; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭānite]]---could not move.
translation: The King then arranged for big wrestlers to try to pull the car, and even the King himself joined in, but the car could not be moved.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.5
description: Following Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's instructions, the King had given up his royal dress. He now entered the garden in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava.
text:
> sārvabhauma-upadeśe chāḍi' rāja-veśa
> ekalā vaiṣṇava-veśe karila praveśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---under instructions; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:v:veśa]]---the royal dress; [[synonyms:e:ekalā]]---alone; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:v:veśe]]---in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:p:praveśa]]---entered.
translation: Following Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's instructions, the King had given up his royal dress. He now entered the garden in the dress of a Vaiṣṇava.
purport: Sometimes members of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness-especially in the Western countries-find it difficult to approach people to distribute books because people are unfamiliar with the traditional saffron robes of the devotees. The devotees have therefore inquired whether they can wear European and American dress before the general public. From the instructions given to King Pratāparudra by Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, we can understand that we may change our dress in any way to facilitate our service. When our members change their dress to meet the public or to introduce our books, they are not breaking the devotional principles. The real principle is to spread this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, and if one has to change into regular Western dress for this purpose, there should be no objection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.50
description: Becoming even more eager to move the car, the King had very strong elephants brought forth and harnessed to it.
text:
> vyagra hañā āne rājā matta-hātī-gaṇa
> ratha cālāite rathe karila yojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vyagra]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---with eagerness; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---brings; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:m:matta]]-[[synonyms:h:hātī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---very strong elephants; [[synonyms:r:ratha]] [[synonyms:c:cālāite]]---to make the car move; [[synonyms:r:rathe]]---to the car; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:y:yojana]]---harnessed.
translation: Becoming even more eager to move the car, the King had very strong elephants brought forth and harnessed to it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.51
description: The strong elephants pulled with all their strength, but still the car remained at a standstill, not budging an inch.
text:
> matta-hasti-gaṇa ṭāne yāra yata bala
> eka pada nā cale ratha, ha-ila acala
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:matta]]-[[synonyms:h:hasti]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the strong elephants; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭāne]]---started pulling; [[synonyms:y:yāra]] [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:b:bala]]---with whatever strength they had; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:p:pada]]---a single step; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:cale]]---does not move; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:a:acala]]---still.
translation: The strong elephants pulled with all their strength, but still the car remained at a standstill, not budging an inch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.52
description: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news, He went there with all His personal associates. They then stood there and watched the elephants try to pull the car.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu āilā nija-gaṇa lañā
> matta-hastī ratha ṭāne,-dekhe dāṇḍāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---after hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with His personal devotees; [[synonyms:m:matta]]-[[synonyms:h:hastī]]---strong elephants; [[synonyms:r:ratha]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭāne]]---trying to pull the car; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---He saw; [[synonyms:d:dāṇḍāñā]]---standing there.
translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this news, He went there with all His personal associates. They then stood there and watched the elephants try to pull the car.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.53
description: The elephants, being beaten by the elephant-goad, were crying, but still the car would not move. The assembled people cried out, "Alas!"
text:
> aṅkuśera ghāya hastī karaye citkāra
> ratha nāhi cale, loke kare hāhākāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅkuśera]]---of the elephant-goad; [[synonyms:g:ghāya]]---by striking; [[synonyms:h:hastī]]---the elephants; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---made; [[synonyms:c:citkāra]]---crying; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:c:cale]]---does not move; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---all the people; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---exclaim; [[synonyms:h:hāhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāra]]---alas.
translation: The elephants, being beaten by the elephant-goad, were crying, but still the car would not move. The assembled people cried out, "Alas!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.54
description: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu let all the elephants go free and placed the car's ropes in the hands of His own men.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu saba hastī ghucāila
> nija-gaṇe ratha-kāchi ṭānibāre dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:h:hastī]]---the elephants; [[synonyms:g:ghucāila]]---let free; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---to His own men; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:k:kāchi]]---the rope of the car; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭānibāre]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave to pull.
translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu let all the elephants go free and placed the car's ropes in the hands of His own men.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.55
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the back of the car and began to push with His head. It was then that the car began to move and ramble along, making a rattling sound.
text:
> āpane rathera pāche ṭhele māthā diyā
> haḍ haḍ kari, ratha calila dhāiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:r:rathera]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---at the back of the car; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhele]]---pushes; [[synonyms:m:māthā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with His head; [[synonyms:h:haḍ]] [[synonyms:h:haḍ]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---making a rattling sound; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:c:calila]]---began to move; [[synonyms:d:dhāiyā]]---running.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went to the back of the car and began to push with His head. It was then that the car began to move and ramble along, making a rattling sound.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.56
description: Indeed, the car began to move automatically, and the devotees simply carried the rope in their hands. Since it was moving effortlessly, they did not need to pull it.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa kāchi hāte kari' mātra dhāya
> āpane calila ratha, ṭānite nā pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kāchi]]---the rope; [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---in the hand; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---run; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---automatically; [[synonyms:c:calila]]---moved; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭānite]]---to pull; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---they had no chance.
translation: Indeed, the car began to move automatically, and the devotees simply carried the rope in their hands. Since it was moving effortlessly, they did not need to pull it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.57
description: When the car moved forward, everyone began to chant with great pleasure, "All glories! All glories!" and "All glories to Lord Jagannātha!" No one could hear anything else.
text:
> ānande karaye loka 'jaya' 'jaya'-dhvani
> 'jaya jagannātha' ba-i āra nāhi śuni
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great pleasure; [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---do; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all the people; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the sound of "all glories, all glories"; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---all glories to Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:ba]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---except for this; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---no one could hear anything else.
translation: When the car moved forward, everyone began to chant with great pleasure, "All glories! All glories!" and "All glories to Lord Jagannātha!" No one could hear anything else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.58
description: In a moment the car reached the door of the Guṇḍicā temple. Upon seeing the uncommon strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the people were struck with wonder.
text:
> nimeṣe ta' gela ratha guṇḍicāra dvāra
> caitanya-pratāpa dekhi' loke camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nimeṣe]]---in a moment; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---indeed; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---arrived; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]---the car; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicāra]] [[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---at the door of the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:p:pratāpa]]---the strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---all the people; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonished.
translation: In a moment the car reached the door of the Guṇḍicā temple. Upon seeing the uncommon strength of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, all the people were struck with wonder.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.59
description: The crowd made a tumultuous vibration, chanting, "Jaya Gauracandra! Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!" Then the people began to chant, "Wonderful! Wonderful!"
text:
> 'jaya gauracandra', jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya'
> ei-mata kolāhala loke dhanya dhanya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---all glories to Gaurahari; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---all glories to Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---a tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---people in general; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]] [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---began to chant, "Wonderful, wonderful!"
translation: The crowd made a tumultuous vibration, chanting, "Jaya Gauracandra! Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya!" Then the people began to chant, "Wonderful! Wonderful!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.6
description: Mahārāja Pratāparudra was so humble that with folded hands he first took permission from all the devotees. Then, with great courage, he fell down and touched the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> saba-bhaktera ājñā nila yoḍa-hāta hañā
> prabhu-pada dhari' paḍe sāhasa kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of all the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:n:nila]]---took permission; [[synonyms:y:yoḍa]]-[[synonyms:h:hāta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---with folded hands; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching the feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---falls; [[synonyms:s:sāhasa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great courage.
translation: Mahārāja Pratāparudra was so humble that with folded hands he first took permission from all the devotees. Then, with great courage, he fell down and touched the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.60
description: Seeing the greatness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Pratāparudra Mahārāja and his ministers and friends were so moved by ecstatic love that their hair stood on end.
text:
> dekhiyā pratāparudra pātra-mitra-saṅge
> prabhura mahimā dekhi' preme phule aṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:pratāparudra]]---King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:p:pātra]]-[[synonyms:m:mitra]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with his ministers and friends; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the greatness; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love; [[synonyms:p:phule]]---eruptions; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body.
translation: Seeing the greatness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Pratāparudra Mahārāja and his ministers and friends were so moved by ecstatic love that their hair stood on end.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.61
description: All the servants of Lord Jagannātha then took Him down from the car, and the Lord went to sit on His throne.
text:
> pāṇḍu-vijaya tabe kare sevaka-gaṇe
> jagannātha vasilā giyā nija-siṁhāsane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---the getting down from the car; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---all the servants; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat; [[synonyms:g:giya]]---going; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:siṁhāsane]]---on His own throne.
translation: All the servants of Lord Jagannātha then took Him down from the car, and the Lord went to sit on His throne.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.62
description: Subhadrā and Balarāma also sat on their respective thrones. There followed the bathing of Lord Jagannātha and finally the offering of food.
text:
> subhadrā-balarāma nija-siṁhāsane āilā
> jagannāthera snāna-bhoga ha-ite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:subhadrā]]-[[synonyms:b:balarāma]]---Subhadrā and Balarāma; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:s:siṁhāsane]]---on thrones; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:snāna]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---bathing and offering food; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to take place.
translation: Subhadrā and Balarāma also sat on their respective thrones. There followed the bathing of Lord Jagannātha and finally the offering of food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.63
description: While Lord Jagannātha, Lord Balarāma and Subhadrā sat on their respective thrones, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees began to perform saṅkīrtana with great pleasure, chanting and dancing in the yard of the temple.
text:
> āṅgināte mahāprabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> ānande ārambha kaila nartana-kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āṅgināte]]---in the yard of the temple; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great pleasure; [[synonyms:ā:ārambha]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---began; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting and dancing.
translation: While Lord Jagannātha, Lord Balarāma and Subhadrā sat on their respective thrones, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees began to perform saṅkīrtana with great pleasure, chanting and dancing in the yard of the temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.64
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was chanting and dancing, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love, and all the people who saw Him were also flooded in the ocean of love of Godhead.
text:
> ānande mahāprabhura prema uthalila
> dekhi' saba loka prema-sāgare bhāsila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:u:uthalila]]---flooded; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all people; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:s:sāgare]]---in the ocean of love of Godhead; [[synonyms:b:bhāsila]]---were flooded.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was chanting and dancing, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love, and all the people who saw Him were also flooded in the ocean of love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.65
description: In the evening, after finishing His dancing in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple, the Lord observed the ārati ceremony. Thereafter He went to a place called Āiṭoṭā and took rest for the night.
text:
> nṛtya kari' sandhyā-kāle ārati dekhila
> āiṭoṭā āsi' prabhu viśrāma karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after dancing; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the evening; [[synonyms:ā:ārati]] [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---observed the //ārati// ceremony; [[synonyms:ā:āiṭoṭā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming to the place known as //āiṭoṭā//; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---took rest for the night.
translation: In the evening, after finishing His dancing in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple, the Lord observed the ārati ceremony. Thereafter He went to a place called Āiṭoṭā and took rest for the night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.66
description: For nine days, nine chief devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, got an opportunity to invite the Lord to their homes.
text:
> advaitādi bhakta-gaṇa nimantraṇa kaila
> mukhya mukhya nava jana nava dina pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Advaita ācārya; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---invited Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]] [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]---chief and important; [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---nine persons; [[synonyms:n:nava]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---nine days; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---got.
translation: For nine days, nine chief devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, got an opportunity to invite the Lord to their homes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.67
description: During the four months of the rainy season, the remaining devotees extended invitations to the Lord for one day each. In this way they shared invitations.
text:
> āra bhakta-gaṇa cāturmāsye yata dina
> eka eka dina kari' karila baṇṭana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the remaining devotees; [[synonyms:c:cāturmāsye]]---in the four months of the rainy season; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---all the days; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---one day each; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:b:baṇṭana]]---shared.
translation: During the four months of the rainy season, the remaining devotees extended invitations to the Lord for one day each. In this way they shared invitations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.68
description: For the four-month period, all the daily invitations were shared among the important devotees. The rest of the devotees did not get an opportunity to extend an invitation to the Lord.
text:
> cāri māsera dina mukhya-bhakta bāṅṭi' nila
> āra bhakta-gaṇa avasara nā pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:m:māsera]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the days of four months; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---the chief devotees; [[synonyms:b:bāṅṭi']] [[synonyms:n:nila]]---shared among themselves; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---other devotees; [[synonyms:a:avasara]]---opportunity; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---did not get.
translation: For the four-month period, all the daily invitations were shared among the important devotees. The rest of the devotees did not get an opportunity to extend an invitation to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.69
description: Since they could not get one day each, two or three devotees combined to extend an invitation. These are the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's acceptance of invitations.
text:
> eka dina nimantraṇa kare dui-tine mili'
> ei-mata mahāprabhura nimantraṇa-keli
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---make; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:t:tine]]---two or three persons; [[synonyms:m:mili']]---combining; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation; [[synonyms:k:keli]]---pastimes.
translation: Since they could not get one day each, two or three devotees combined to extend an invitation. These are the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's acceptance of invitations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.7
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was lying on the ground with His eyes closed in ecstatic love and emotion, and the King very expertly began to massage His legs.
text:
> āṅkhi mudi' prabhu preme bhūmite śayāna
> nṛpati naipuṇye kare pāda-saṁvāhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āṅkhi]] [[synonyms:m:mudi']]---with closed eyes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhūmite]]---on the ground; [[synonyms:ś:śayāna]]---lying down; [[synonyms:n:nṛpati]]---the King; [[synonyms:n:naipuṇye]]---very expertly; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁvāhana]]---massaging the legs.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was lying on the ground with His eyes closed in ecstatic love and emotion, and the King very expertly began to massage His legs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.70
description: After taking His bath early in the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go see Lord Jagannātha in the temple. Then He would perform saṅkīrtana with His devotees.
text:
> prātaḥ-kāle snāna kari' dekhi' jagannātha
> saṅkīrtane nṛtya kare bhakta-gaṇa sātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking a bath; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtane]]---in the performance of //saṅkīrtana//; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---dances; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:s:sātha]]---with the devotees.
translation: After taking His bath early in the morning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go see Lord Jagannātha in the temple. Then He would perform saṅkīrtana with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.71
description: By chanting and dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu induced Advaita Ācārya to dance. Sometimes He induced Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Acyutānanda to dance.
text:
> kabhu advaite nācāya, kabhu nityānande
> kabhu haridāse nācāya, kabhu acyutānande
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:a:advaite]]---Advaita //ācārya//; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---made dance; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:n:nityānande]]---sometimes Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:h:haridāse]] [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---sometimes made Haridāsa Ṭhākura dance; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:a:acyutānande]]---Acyutānanda.
translation: By chanting and dancing, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu induced Advaita Ācārya to dance. Sometimes He induced Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Acyutānanda to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.72
description: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged Vakreśvara and other devotees in chanting and dancing. Three times daily-morning, noon and evening-He would perform saṅkīrtana in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple.
text:
> kabhu vakreśvare, kabhu āra bhakta-gaṇe
> trisandhyā kīrtana kare guṇḍicā-prāṅgaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:v:vakreśvare]]---sometimes Vakreśvara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---other devotees; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]---three times (morning, evening and noon); [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs //kīrtana//; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṅgaṇe]]---in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple.
translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged Vakreśvara and other devotees in chanting and dancing. Three times daily-morning, noon and evening-He would perform saṅkīrtana in the yard of the Guṇḍicā temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.73
description: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt that Lord Kṛṣṇa had returned to Vṛndāvana. Thinking this, His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa subsided.
text:
> vṛndāvane āilā kṛṣṇa-ei prabhura jñāna
> kṛṣṇera viraha-sphūrti haila avasāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa arrived; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---this is consciousness of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---from Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]-[[synonyms:s:sphūrti]]---feelings of separation; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:a:avasāna]]---ended.
translation: At this time Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt that Lord Kṛṣṇa had returned to Vṛndāvana. Thinking this, His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa subsided.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.74
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always thinking of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and He remained personally merged in this consciousness.
text:
> rādhā-saṅge kṛṣṇa-līlā-ei haila jñāne
> ei rase magna prabhu ha-ilā āpane
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---this was His consciousness; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:r:rase]] [[synonyms:m:magna]]---merged in this mellow; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]] [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---remained personally.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always thinking of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, and He remained personally merged in this consciousness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.75
description: There were many gardens near the Guṇḍicā temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees used to perform the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in each of them. In the lake named Indradyumna, He sported in the water.
text:
> nānodyāne bhakta-saṅge vṛndāvana-līlā
> 'indradyumna'-sarovare kare jala-khelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in various gardens; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:i:indradyumna]]---Indradyumna; [[synonyms:s:sarovare]]---in the lake; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:khelā]]---performed sports in the water.
translation: There were many gardens near the Guṇḍicā temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees used to perform the pastimes of Vṛndāvana in each of them. In the lake named Indradyumna, He sported in the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.76
description: The Lord personally splashed all the devotees with water, and the devotees, surrounding Him on all sides, also splashed the Lord.
text:
> āpane sakala bhakte siñce jala diyā
> saba bhakta-gaṇa siñce caudike beḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:s:siñce]]---sprinkles; [[synonyms:j:jala]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with water; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:s:siñce]]---sprinkle; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]] [[synonyms:b:beḍiyā]]---surrounding the Lord on all sides.
translation: The Lord personally splashed all the devotees with water, and the devotees, surrounding Him on all sides, also splashed the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.77
description: While in the water they sometimes formed a circle and sometimes many circles, and while in the water they used to play cymbals and imitate the croaking of frogs.
text:
> kabhu eka maṇḍala, kabhu aneka maṇḍala
> jala-maṇḍūka-vādye sabe bājāya karatāla
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:m:maṇḍala]]---sometimes one circle; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:m:maṇḍala]]---various circles; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇḍūka]]-[[synonyms:v:vādye]]---like the croaking sound of frogs in the water; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:b:bājāya]]---play; [[synonyms:k:karatāla]]---cymbals.
translation: While in the water they sometimes formed a circle and sometimes many circles, and while in the water they used to play cymbals and imitate the croaking of frogs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.78
description: Sometimes two would pair off to fight in the water. One would emerge victorious and the other defeated, and the Lord would watch all this fun.
text:
> dui-dui jane meli' kare jala-raṇa
> keha hāre, keha jine-prabhu kare daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---forming a party of two men; [[synonyms:m:meli']]---joining; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:r:raṇa]]---fighting in the water; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:h:hāre]]---someone is defeated; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:j:jine]]---someone is victorious; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---sees.
translation: Sometimes two would pair off to fight in the water. One would emerge victorious and the other defeated, and the Lord would watch all this fun.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.79
description: The first sporting took place between Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, who threw water upon one another. Advaita Ācārya was defeated, and He later began to rebuke Nityānanda Prabhu, calling Him bad names.
text:
> advaita-nityānande jala-phelāpheli
> ācārya hāriyā pāche kare gālāgāli
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:n:nityānande]]---both Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:p:phelāpheli]]---throwing water on each other; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]] [[synonyms:h:hāriyā]]---Advaita Ācārya, after being defeated; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---at the end; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:g:gālāgāli]]---accusing.
translation: The first sporting took place between Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, who threw water upon one another. Advaita Ācārya was defeated, and He later began to rebuke Nityānanda Prabhu, calling Him bad names.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.8
description: The King began to recite verses about the rāsa-līlā from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam. He recited the chapter beginning with the words "jayati te 'dhikam."
text:
> rāsa-līlāra śloka paḍi' karena stavana
> "jayati te 'dhikaṁ" adhyāya karena paṭhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the //rāsa-līlā// dance; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reciting; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---offers; [[synonyms:s:stavana]]---prayers; [[synonyms:j:jayati]] [[synonyms:t:te]] [[synonyms:d:'dhikam]]---beginning with the words //jayati te 'dhikam//; [[synonyms:a:adhyāya]]---chapter; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:paṭhana]]---recitation.
translation: The King began to recite verses about the rāsa-līlā from Śrīmad Bhāgavatam. He recited the chapter beginning with the words "jayati te 'dhikam."
purport: These verses from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// Canto Ten, Chapter Thirty-one, constitute what is known as the //Gopī-gītā.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.80
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Vidyānidhi also threw water upon one another, and Murāri Gupta and Vāsudeva Datta also sported in that way.
text:
> vidyānidhira jala-keli svarūpera sane
> gupta-datte jala-keli kare dui jane
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vidyānidhira]]---of Vidyānidhi; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---water sports; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:g:gupta]]-[[synonyms:d:datte]]---both Murāri Gupta and Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---water sports; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---two persons.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Vidyānidhi also threw water upon one another, and Murāri Gupta and Vāsudeva Datta also sported in that way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.81
description: Another duel took place between Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and Gadādhara Paṇḍita, and yet another between Rāghava Paṇḍita and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita. Thus they all engaged in throwing water.
text:
> śrīvāsa-sahita jala khele gadādhara
> rāghava-paṇḍita sane khele vakreśvara
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:j:jala]] [[synonyms:k:khele]]---performs this water sport; [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:khele]]---sports; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara Paṇḍita.
translation: Another duel took place between Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and Gadādhara Paṇḍita, and yet another between Rāghava Paṇḍita and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita. Thus they all engaged in throwing water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.82
description: Indeed, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya engaged in water sports with Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, and they both lost their gravity and became like children.
text:
> sārvabhauma-saṅge khele rāmānanda-rāya
> gāmbhīrya gela doṅhāra, haila śiśu-prāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:k:khele]]---sports; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:gāmbhīrya]]---gravity; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---disappeared; [[synonyms:d:doṅhāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:ś:śiśu]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like children.
translation: Indeed, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya engaged in water sports with Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya, and they both lost their gravity and became like children.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.83
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the exuberance of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, He smiled and spoke to Gopīnātha Ācārya.
text:
> mahāprabhu tāṅ doṅhāra cāñcalya dekhiyā
> gopīnāthācārye kichu kahena hāsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]] [[synonyms:d:doṅhāra]]---of these two persons; [[synonyms:c:cāñcalya]]---restlessness; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārye]]---unto Gopīnātha Ācārya; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the exuberance of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya, He smiled and spoke to Gopīnātha Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.84
description: "Tell Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya to stop their childish play because they are both learned scholars and very grave and great personalities."
text:
> paṇḍita, gambhīra, duṅhe-prāmāṇika jana
> bāla-cāñcalya kare, karāha varjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---learned scholars; [[synonyms:g:gambhīra]]---very grave; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:p:prāmāṇika]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---authoritative persons; [[synonyms:b:bāla]]-[[synonyms:c:cāñcalya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---sport like children; [[synonyms:k:karāha]] [[synonyms:v:varjana]]---ask them to stop.
translation: "Tell Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya to stop their childish play because they are both learned scholars and very grave and great personalities."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.85
description: Gopīnātha Ācārya replied, "I believe that one drop of the ocean of Your great mercy has swelled up upon them.
text:
> gopīnātha kahe,-tomāra kṛpā-mahāsindhu
> uchalita kare yabe tāra eka bindu
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Gopīnātha Ācārya replied; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---of Your mercy; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the great ocean; [[synonyms:u:uchalita]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---rises; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:b:bindu]]---a drop.
translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya replied, "I believe that one drop of the ocean of Your great mercy has swelled up upon them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.86
description: "A drop from the ocean of Your mercy can drown great mountains like Sumeru and Mandara. Since these two gentlemen are little hills by comparison, there is no wonder that they are being drowned in the ocean of Your mercy.
text:
> meru-mandara-parvata ḍubāya yathā tathā
> ei dui-gaṇḍa-śaila, ihāra kā kathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:meru]]-[[synonyms:m:mandara]]---Sumeru and Mandara; [[synonyms:p:parvata]]---big mountains; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāya]]---drowns; [[synonyms:y:yathā]] [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]---these two; [[synonyms:g:gaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śaila]]---very small hills; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]] [[synonyms:k:kā]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---what to speak of these.
translation: "A drop from the ocean of Your mercy can drown great mountains like Sumeru and Mandara. Since these two gentlemen are little hills by comparison, there is no wonder that they are being drowned in the ocean of Your mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.87
description: "Logic is like a dry oil cake from which all the oil has been extracted. Bhaṭṭācārya passed his life in eating such dry cakes, but now You have made him drink the nectar of transcendental pastimes. It is certainly Your great mercy upon him."
text:
> śuṣka-tarka-khali khāite janma gela yāṅra
> tāṅre līlāmṛta piyāo,-e kṛpā tomāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:t:tarka]]---of dry logic; [[synonyms:k:khali]]---oil cakes; [[synonyms:k:khāite]]---eating; [[synonyms:j:janma]]---the whole life; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---the nectar of Your pastimes; [[synonyms:p:piyāo]]---You caused to drink; [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your.
translation: "Logic is like a dry oil cake from which all the oil has been extracted. Bhaṭṭācārya passed his life in eating such dry cakes, but now You have made him drink the nectar of transcendental pastimes. It is certainly Your great mercy upon him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.88
description: After Gopīnātha Ācārya finished talking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and, calling for Advaita Ācārya, made Him act like the Śeṣa Nāga bed.
text:
> hāsi' mahāprabhu tabe advaite ānila
> jalera upare tāṅre śeṣa-śayyā kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---smiling; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:a:advaite]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---called for Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jalera]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the surface of the water; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śayyā]]---the Śeṣa Nāga bed; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made.
translation: After Gopīnātha Ācārya finished talking, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu smiled and, calling for Advaita Ācārya, made Him act like the Śeṣa Nāga bed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.89
description: Lying down on Advaita Prabhu, who was floating on the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated the pastime of Śeṣaśāyī Viṣṇu.
text:
> āpane tāṅhāra upara karila śayana
> 'śeṣa-śāyī-līlā' prabhu kaila prakaṭana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:u:upara]]---upon Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lay down; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāyī]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Śeṣaśāyī Viṣṇu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:p:prakaṭana]]---demonstrated.
translation: Lying down on Advaita Prabhu, who was floating on the water, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated the pastime of Śeṣaśāyī Viṣṇu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.9
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these verses, He was pleased beyond limits, and He said again and again, "Go on reciting, go on reciting."
text:
> śunite śunite prabhura santoṣa apāra
> 'bala, bala' bali' prabhu bale bāra bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śunite]] [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---by hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---great satisfaction; [[synonyms:b:bala]] [[synonyms:b:bala]]---go on reciting; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---says; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these verses, He was pleased beyond limits, and He said again and again, "Go on reciting, go on reciting."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.90
description: Manifesting His personal potency, Advaita Ācārya floated about on the water, carrying Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> advaita nija-śakti prakaṭa kariyā
> mahāprabhu lañā bule jalete bhāsiyā

translation: Manifesting His personal potency, Advaita Ācārya floated about on the water, carrying Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.91
description: After sporting in the water for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His place at Āiṭoṭā, accompanied by His devotees.
text:
> ei-mata jala-krīḍā kari' kata-kṣaṇa
> āiṭoṭā āilā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---sporting in the water; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after performing; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:ā:āiṭoṭā]]---to the place named Āiṭoṭā; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---accompanied by the devotees.
translation: After sporting in the water for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His place at Āiṭoṭā, accompanied by His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.92
description: Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī and all the other chief devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took lunch at the invitation of Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> purī, bhāratī ādi yata mukhya bhakta-gaṇa
> ācāryera nimantraṇe karilā bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:purī]]---Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhāratī]]---Brahmānanda Bhāratī; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]---chief; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryera]]---of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇe]]---by the invitation; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---accepted their lunch.
translation: Paramānanda Purī, Brahmānanda Bhāratī and all the other chief devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took lunch at the invitation of Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.93
description: Whatever extra prasāda was brought by Vāṇīnātha Rāya was taken by the other associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> vāṇīnātha āra yata prasāda ānila
> mahāprabhura gaṇe sei prasāda khāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]]---Vāṇīnātha Rāya; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---extra; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---whatever; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the personal associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---ate.
translation: Whatever extra prasāda was brought by Vāṇīnātha Rāya was taken by the other associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.94
description: In the afternoon, the Lord went to the Guṇḍicā temple to visit the Lord and dance. At night He went to the garden to take rest.
text:
> aparāhne āsi' kaila darśana, nartana
> niśāte udyāne āsi' karilā śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aparāhne]]---in the afternoon; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---visiting the Lord and dancing; [[synonyms:n:niśāte]]---at night; [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in the garden; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---took rest.
translation: In the afternoon, the Lord went to the Guṇḍicā temple to visit the Lord and dance. At night He went to the garden to take rest.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.95
description: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also went to the temple of Guṇḍicā and saw the Lord. He then chanted and danced in the yard for some time.
text:
> āra dina āsi' kaila īśvara daraśana
> prāṅgaṇe nṛtya-gīta kaila kata-kṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prāṅgaṇe]]---in the yard; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time.
translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also went to the temple of Guṇḍicā and saw the Lord. He then chanted and danced in the yard for some time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.96
description: Accompanied by His devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went into the garden and enjoyed the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge prabhu udyāne āsiyā
> vṛndāvana-vihāra kare bhakta-gaṇa lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in the garden; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:v:vihāra]]---the pastimes of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all the devotees.
translation: Accompanied by His devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then went into the garden and enjoyed the pastimes of Vṛndāvana.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura has pointed out that this //vṛndāvana-vihāra//---the pastimes of Vṛndāvana-does not refer to Kṛṣṇa's mixing with the //gopīs// or the transcendental mellow of //parakīya-rasa.// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's //vṛndāvana-līlā// in the garden of Jagannātha Purī did not involve association with women or with other people's wives in the fashion transcendentally demonstrated by Śrī Kṛṣṇa. In His //vṛndāvana-līlā,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu conceived of Himself as the assistant of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī. When Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī enjoyed the company of Kṛṣṇa, Her maidservants were very pleased. One should not compare Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's //vṛndāvana-vihāra// in the garden of Jagannātha with the activities of the //gaurāṅga-nāgarīs.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.97
description: There were multifarious trees and creepers in the garden, and they were all jubilant to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, the birds were chirping, the bees were buzzing, and a cool breeze was blowing.
text:
> vṛkṣa-vallī praphullita prabhura daraśane
> bhṛṅga-pika gāya, vahe śītala pavane
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:v:vallī]]---trees and creepers; [[synonyms:p:praphullita]]---joyful; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---by the sight; [[synonyms:b:bhṛṅga]]---bumblebees; [[synonyms:p:pika]]---birds; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chant; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---were blowing; [[synonyms:ś:śītala]]---cool; [[synonyms:p:pavane]]---breezes.
translation: There were multifarious trees and creepers in the garden, and they were all jubilant to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Indeed, the birds were chirping, the bees were buzzing, and a cool breeze was blowing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.98
description: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced beneath each and every tree, Vāsudeva Datta sang alone.
text:
> prati-vṛkṣa-tale prabhu karena nartana
> vāsudeva-datta mātra karena gāyana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath each tree; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dances; [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]]---Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:g:gāyana]]---chanting.
translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced beneath each and every tree, Vāsudeva Datta sang alone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 14.99
description: As Vāsudeva Datta sang a different song beneath each and every tree, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced there alone in great ecstasy.
text:
> eka eka vṛkṣa-tale eka eka gāna gāya
> parama-āveśe ekā nāce gaurarāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---under each and every tree; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---a different; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---song; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---alone; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:g:gaurarāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: As Vāsudeva Datta sang a different song beneath each and every tree, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced there alone in great ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.1
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was accepting prasāda at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Amogha criticized Him. At that time the Lord also showed how much He was obliged to His devotees.
text:
> sārvabhauma-gṛhe bhuñjan
> sva-nindakam amoghakam
> aṅgīkurvan sphuṭāṁ cakre
> gauraḥ svāṁ bhakta-vaśyatām
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhe]]---at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:b:bhuñjan]]---while eating; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:n:nindakam]]---a person who was criticizing Him; [[synonyms:a:amoghakam]]---named Amogha; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkurvan]]---accepting; [[synonyms:s:sphuṭām]]---manifested; [[synonyms:c:cakre]]---made; [[synonyms:g:gauraḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svām]]---His; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vaśyatām]]---obligation to His devotees.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was accepting prasāda at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Amogha criticized Him. At that time the Lord also showed how much He was obliged to His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.10
description: After being worshiped by Advaita Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take the dish containing flowers and tulasī and, with whatever paraphernalia remained, would also worship Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> pūjā-pātre puṣpa-tulasī śeṣa ye āchila
> sei saba lañā prabhu ācārye pūjila
