translation: These are the peculiar characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. Thus the Lord ate in Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's house, and in this way Sārvabhauma's love for the Lord has become very well known.
purport:
As stated in the //Śākhā-nirṇayāmṛta://

> amogha-paṇḍitaṁ vande
> śrī-gaureṇātma-sātkṛtam
> prema-gadgada-sāndrāṅgaṁ
> pulakākula-vigraham

"I offer my obeisances unto Amogha Paṇḍita, who was accepted by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. As a result of this acceptance, he was always merged in ecstatic love, and he manifested ecstatic symptoms such as choking of the voice and standing of the hairs on his body."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.3
description: All glories to the listeners of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta who have accepted it as their life and soul.
text:
> jaya śrī-caitanya-caritāmṛta-śrotā-gaṇa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta---yāṅra prāṇa-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śrotā]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the listeners of //Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---//Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the life and soul.
translation: All glories to the listeners of Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta who have accepted it as their life and soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.30
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was greatly satisfied to see this. Accepting them both as His father and mother, He offered them obeisances.
text:
> dekhi' mahāprabhu baḍa santoṣa pāilā
> mātā-pitā-jñāne duṅhe namaskāra kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---very much; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]]---satisfaction; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---felt; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:p:pitā]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---accepting as father and mother; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---unto both of them; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---offered obeisances.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was greatly satisfied to see this. Accepting them both as His father and mother, He offered them obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.300
description: Thus I have related the ecstatic love of Sārvabhauma's wife, who is known as the mother of Ṣāṭhī. I have also related Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's great mercy, which He manifested by excusing Amogha's offense. He did so due to Amogha's relationship with a devotee.
text:
> ṣāṭhīra mātāra prema, āra prabhura prasāda
> bhakta-sambandhe yāhā kṣamila aparādha
synonyms: [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣāṭhīra]] [[synonyms:m:mātāra]] [[synonyms:p:prema]]---the love of the mother of Ṣāṭhī; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:prabhuraprasāda]]---the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:sambandhe]]---because of a relationship with a devotee; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---where; [[synonyms:k:kṣamila]] [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu excused the offense.
translation: Thus I have related the ecstatic love of Sārvabhauma's wife, who is known as the mother of Ṣāṭhī. I have also related Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's great mercy, which He manifested by excusing Amogha's offense. He did so due to Amogha's relationship with a devotee.
purport: Amogha was an offender because he blasphemed the Lord. As a result, he was about to die of cholera. Amogha did not receive an opportunity to be freed from all offenses after being attacked by the disease, but Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and his wife were very dear to the Lord. Because of their relationship, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu excused Amogha. Instead of being punished by the Lord, he was saved by the Lord's mercy. All this was due to the unflinching love of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Externally, Amogha was Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya's son-in-law, and he was being maintained by Sārvabhauma. Consequently if Amogha were not excused, his punishment would have directly affected Sārvabhauma. Amogha's death would have indirectly brought about the death of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.301
description: Whoever hears these pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will attain the shelter of the Lord's lotus feet very soon.
text:
> śraddhā kari' ei līlā śune yei jana

translation: Whoever hears these pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will attain the shelter of the Lord's lotus feet very soon.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.302
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā,  Fifteenth Chapter, describing the Lord's eating at the house of Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.31
description: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gaurāṅga-sundara, performed various pastimes.

translation: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, known as Gaurāṅga-sundara, performed various pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.32
description: On the victory day celebrating the conquest of Laṅkā-a day known as Vijayā-daśamī-Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dressed up all His devotees like monkey soldiers.
text:
> vijayā-daśamī---laṅkā-vijayera dine
> vānara-sainya kailā prabhu lañā bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vijayā]]---victory; [[synonyms:d:daśamī]]---tenth day; [[synonyms:l:laṅkā]]-[[synonyms:v:vijayera]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the day celebrating the conquering of Laṅkā; [[synonyms:v:vānara]]-[[synonyms:s:sainya]]---monkey soldiers; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---arranged; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---taking all the devotees.
translation: On the victory day celebrating the conquest of Laṅkā-a day known as Vijayā-daśamī-Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dressed up all His devotees like monkey soldiers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.33
description: Displaying the emotions of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took up a large tree branch, and, mounting the walls of the Laṅkā fort, began to dismantle it.
text:
> hanumān-āveśe prabhu vṛkṣa-śākhā lañā
> laṅkā-gaḍe caḍi' phele gaḍa bhāṅgiyā

translation: Displaying the emotions of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took up a large tree branch, and, mounting the walls of the Laṅkā fort, began to dismantle it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.34
description: In the ecstasy of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu angrily said, "Where is the rascal Rāvaṇa? He has kidnapped the universal mother, Sītā. Now I shall kill him and all his family."
text:
> 'kāhāṅre rāvṇā' prabhu kahe krodhāveśe
> jagan-mātā hare pāpī, mārimu savaṁśe'

translation: In the ecstasy of Hanumān, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu angrily said, "Where is the rascal Rāvaṇa? He has kidnapped the universal mother, Sītā. Now I shall kill him and all his family."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.35

text:
> gosāñira āveśa dekhi' loke camatkāra
> sarva-loka jaya' jaya' bale bāra bāra

translation: Everyone became very astonished to see the emotional ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and everyone began to chant, "All glories! All glories!" again and again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.36
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees participated in all the festivals known as Rāsa-yātrā, Dīpāvalī and Utthāna-dvādaśī.
text:
> ei-mata rāsa-yātrā, āra dīpāvalī
> utthāna-dvādaśī-yātrā dekhilā sakali
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---//rāsa// dancing of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:dīpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvalī]]---a row of lights, the day of Dīpāvalī; [[synonyms:u:utthāna]]-[[synonyms:d:dvādaśī]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the festival of Utthāna-dvādaśī; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]] [[synonyms:s:sakali]]---participated in all of them.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees participated in all the festivals known as Rāsa-yātrā, Dīpāvalī and Utthāna-dvādaśī.
purport: The Dīpāvalī festival takes place on the dark-moon night in the month of Kārttika (October-November). The Rāsa-yātrā, or //rāsa// dancing of Kṛṣṇa, takes place on the full-moon night of the same month. Utthāna-dvādaśī takes place the day after Ekādaśī in the waxing fortnight of the moon in the same month. All the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu participated in all these festivals.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.37
description: One day the two brothers, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu, consulted one another, sitting together in a solitary place.
text:

> dui bhāi yukti kaila nibhṛte vasiyā

translation: One day the two brothers, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Nityānanda Prabhu, consulted one another, sitting together in a solitary place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.38
description: No one could understand what the brothers discussed between Themselves, but later all the devotees could guess what the subject matter was.
text:
> kibā yukti kaila duṅhe, keha nāhi jāne
> phale anumāna pāche kaila bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kibāyuktikaila]]---what consultation They had; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of Them; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---no one knows; [[synonyms:p:phale]]---by the result; [[synonyms:a:anumāna]]---guess; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---all the devotees.
translation: No one could understand what the brothers discussed between Themselves, but later all the devotees could guess what the subject matter was.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.39
description: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for all the devotees and asked them to return to Bengal. In this way, He bade farewell to them.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakte bolāila
> gauḍa-deśe yāha sabe vidāya karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabemahāprabhu]]---thereafter Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:b:bolāila]]---called; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---return; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---bade farewell.
translation: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called for all the devotees and asked them to return to Bengal. In this way, He bade farewell to them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.4
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Jagannātha Purī, He constantly enjoyed chanting and dancing with His devotees.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> nīlācale rahi' kare nṛtya-gīta-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---staying at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---chanting and dancing with great pleasure.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed at Jagannātha Purī, He constantly enjoyed chanting and dancing with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.40
description: Bidding farewell to all the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested them to return to Jagannātha Purī every year to see Him and then see the cleansing of the Guṇḍicā temple.
text:
> sabāre kahila prabhu---pratyabda āsiyā
> guṇḍicā dekhiyā yābe āmāre miliyā

translation: Bidding farewell to all the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested them to return to Jagannātha Purī every year to see Him and then see the cleansing of the Guṇḍicā temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.41
description: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Advaita Ācārya, "Give Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotion to Kṛṣṇa, even to the lowest of men [caṇḍālas]."
text:
> ācāryere ājñā dila kariyā sammāna
> 'ā-caṇḍāla ādi kṛṣṇa-bhakti dio dāna'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryere]]---unto Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---ordered; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---with great respect; [[synonyms:ā:ā]]-[[synonyms:c:caṇḍāla]]---even to the lowest of men, known as the //caṇḍāla//; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---Kṛṣṇa consciousness, or devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dio]]---deliver; [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---in charity.
translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Advaita Ācārya, "Give Kṛṣṇa consciousness, devotion to Kṛṣṇa, even to the lowest of men [caṇḍālas]."
purport:
This is Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's order to all His devotees. //Kṛṣṇa-bhakti,// devotion to Kṛṣṇa, is open to everyone, even low-class men like //caṇḍālas.// One should follow this order in the disciplic succession stemming from Śrī Advaita and Nityānanda Prabhu and distribute Kṛṣṇa consciousness without discrimination throughout the world.

There are different kinds of men, beginning with the //brāhmaṇa// and going down to the lowest platform known as //caṇḍāla.// Whatever one's position, everyone in this Age of Kali needs to be enlightened in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. That is the greatest need of the day. Everyone is acutely feeling the pangs of material existence. Even in the ranks and files of the American Senate, the pinpricks of material existence are felt, so much so that April 30, 1974, was actually set aside as Prayer Day. Thus everyone is feeling the resultant pinpricks of Kali-yuga brought about by human society's indulging in illicit sex, meat-eating, gambling and intoxication. Now is the time for the members of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness to distribute //kṛṣṇa-bhakti// all over the world and thus follow the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord has ordered everyone to become a //guru// [[books:cc:madhya:7:128|(Cc. Madhya 7.128)]]: //āmāra ājñāya guru hañā tāra' ei deśa.// Everyone in every town and village should be enlightened by the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Kṛṣṇa consciousness should be distributed to everyone indiscriminately. In this way, the entire world will be peaceful and happy, and everyone will glorify Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, as He desires.

The word //caṇḍāla// actually refers to a dog-eater, who is considered the lowest of men. Even //caṇḍālas// can be enlightened in Kṛṣṇa consciousness due to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's benedictions. //Kṛṣṇa-bhakti// is not the monopoly of a certain caste. Everyone is eligible to receive this great benediction given by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Everyone should be given a chance to receive it and be happy.

The word //dāna,// meaning "charity," is also significant in this verse. Whoever engages in the distribution of Kṛṣṇa consciousness is a charitable person. Professional men recite //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// and discuss //kṛṣṇa-bhakti// for an exchange of money. They cannot distribute such exalted transcendental property to everyone and anyone. Only pure devotees who have no motive other than serving Kṛṣṇa can give such transcendentally valuable benedictions out of charity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.42
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu, "Go to Bengal and, without restriction, manifest devotional service to the Lord, Kṛṣṇa consciousness."
text:
> nityānande ājñā dila,---'yāha gauḍa-deśe
> anargala prema-bhakti kariha prakāśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānande]]---unto Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered; [[synonyms:y:yāha]] [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---go to Gauḍa-deśa (Bengal); [[synonyms:a:anargala]]---without restriction; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service in love of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kariha]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśe]]---manifest.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu, "Go to Bengal and, without restriction, manifest devotional service to the Lord, Kṛṣṇa consciousness."
purport:
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus ordered Nityānanda Prabhu to deliver all the Bengalis to devotional service. In //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:9:32|(Bg. 9.32)]] it is said:

> māṁ hi pārtha vyapāśritya
> ye 'pi syuḥ pāpa-yonayaḥ
> striyo vaiśyās tathā śūdrās
> te 'pi yānti parāṁ gatim

"O son of Pṛthā, those who take shelter in Me, though they be of lower birth-women, //vaiśyas// [merchants], as well as //śūdras// [workers]---can approach the supreme destination." Whoever takes to Kṛṣṇa consciousness and follows the regulative principles can return home, back to Godhead.

In his //Anubhāṣya,// Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes: "There is a class of so-called devotees called //prākṛta-sahajiyās// who think that Nityānanda Prabhu is an ordinary human being. They have spread the news that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Nityānanda Prabhu to return to Bengal from Orissa just to marry and beget children. This is certainly a great offense against Nityānanda Prabhu."

Such an offense is called //pāṣaṇḍa-buddhi,// or an atheistic remark. Offenders consider Nityānanda Prabhu to be like one of them, an ordinary human being. They do not know of Nityānanda Prabhu's identity with the //viṣṇu-tattva.// Thinking Nityānanda Prabhu to be an ordinary human being is the business of mental speculators known as //kuṇapātma-vādīs.// These people accept the material body, which is a bag of three material elements (//kuṇape tri-dhātuke//), as themselves. They think that Nityānanda Prabhu's body was similarly material and that it was meant for sense gratification. Whoever thinks in this way is a candidate for the darkest regions of hell. Those who hanker after women and money, who are self-interested and have the mentality of merchants, can certainly discover many things with their fertile brains and speak against the authorized revealed scriptures. They also engage in some moneymaking businesses to cheat innocent people, and they try to support their business programs by making such offensive statements. Actually Nityānanda Prabhu, being the expansion of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, is the most munificent incarnation. No one should consider Him an ordinary human being or an entity like the //prajāpatis,// who were ordered by Brahmā to increase generation. Nityānanda Prabhu should not be considered instrumental for sense gratification. Although professional so-called preachers support this, such statements are not found in any authorized revealed scriptures. Actually there is no support for these statements made by //sahajiyās// or other professional distributors of //kṛṣṇa-bhakti.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.43
description: Nityānanda Prabhu was given assistants like Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara dāsa and several others. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I give them to You to assist You.
text:
> rāma-dāsa, gadādhara ādi kata jane
> tomāra sahāya lāgi' dilu tomāra sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Rāmadāsa; [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---some people; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---assistants; [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---as; [[synonyms:d:dilu]]---I give; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with You.
translation: Nityānanda Prabhu was given assistants like Rāmadāsa, Gadādhara dāsa and several others. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I give them to You to assist You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.44
description: "I shall also go to see You at intervals. Keeping Myself invisible, I shall watch You dance."
text:
> madhye madhye āmi tomāra nikaṭa yāiba
> alakṣite rahi' tomāra nṛtya dekhiba'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhyemadhye]]---at intervals; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:n:nikaṭa]]---near You; [[synonyms:y:yāiba]]---shall go; [[synonyms:a:alakṣite]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---keeping invisible; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---Your dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhiba]]---I shall see.
translation: "I shall also go to see You at intervals. Keeping Myself invisible, I shall watch You dance."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.45
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita and, with His arm about his neck, began to speak to him in sweet words.
text:
> śrīvāsa-paṇḍite prabhu kari' āliṅgana
> kaṇṭhe dhari' kahe tāṅre madhura vacana

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then embraced Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita and, with His arm about his neck, began to speak to him in sweet words.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.46
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "Perform congregational chanting daily, and be assured that I shall also dance in your presence. You will be able to see this dancing, but not others.

> tumi dekhā pābe, āra keha nā dekhiba

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu requested Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, "Perform congregational chanting daily, and be assured that I shall also dance in your presence. You will be able to see this dancing, but not others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.47
description: "Take this prasāda of Lord Jagannātha's and this cloth and deliver them to My mother, Śacīdevī. After offering her obeisances, please request her to excuse My offenses.
text:
> ei vastra mātāke diha', ei saba prasāda
> daṇḍavat kari' āmāra kṣamāiha aparādha
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eivastra]]---this cloth; [[synonyms:m:mātāke]] [[synonyms:d:diha']]---deliver to My mother, Śacīdevī; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---all these remnants of the food of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kṣamāiha]]---cause to be excused; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]---offenses.
translation: "Take this prasāda of Lord Jagannātha's and this cloth and deliver them to My mother, Śacīdevī. After offering her obeisances, please request her to excuse My offenses.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.48
description: "I have given up the service of My mother and have accepted the sannyāsa order. Actually I should not have done this, for by so doing, I have destroyed My religious principles.
text:
> tāṅra sevā chāḍi' āmi kariyāchi sannyāsa
> dharma nahe, kari āmi nija dharma-nāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up her service; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]]---accepted; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsa]]---the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:d:dharma]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---it is not My religion; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---perform; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:d:dharma]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---destruction of My religious principles.
translation: "I have given up the service of My mother and have accepted the sannyāsa order. Actually I should not have done this, for by so doing, I have destroyed My religious principles.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.49
description: "I am subordinate to the love of My mother, and it is My duty to serve her in return. Instead of doing so, I have accepted this renounced order. Certainly this is the act of a madman.
text:
> tāṅra prema-vaśa āmi, tāṅra sevā---dharma
> tāhā chāḍi' kariyāchi vātulera karma
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---subordinate to her love; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---her service; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---My religion; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up that; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]]---I performed; [[synonyms:v:vātulera]] [[synonyms:k:karma]]---the acts of a madman.
translation: "I am subordinate to the love of My mother, and it is My duty to serve her in return. Instead of doing so, I have accepted this renounced order. Certainly this is the act of a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.5
description: In the beginning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Deity of Lord Jagannātha in the temple. He offered Him obeisances and prayers and danced and sang before Him.
text:
> prathamāvasare jagannātha-daraśana
> nṛtya-gīta kare daṇḍa-paraṇāma, stavana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prathama]]-[[synonyms:a:avasare]]---in the beginning; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing the Deity of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:paraṇāma]]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:s:stavana]]---offering prayers.
translation: In the beginning, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Deity of Lord Jagannātha in the temple. He offered Him obeisances and prayers and danced and sang before Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.50
description: "A mother is not offended by her mad son, and, knowing this, My mother is not offended by Me.
text:
> vātula bālakera mātā nāhi laya doṣa
> ei jāni' mātā more nā karaya roṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vātula]] [[synonyms:b:bālakera]]---of a mad son; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---accept; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing this; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karaya]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---is not at all angry.
translation: "A mother is not offended by her mad son, and, knowing this, My mother is not offended by Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.51
description: "I had no business in accepting this renounced order and sacrificing My love for My mother, which is My real property. Actually I was in a crazy state of mind when I accepted sannyāsa.
text:
> ki kāya sannyāse mora, prema nija-dhana
> ye-kāle sannyāsa kailuṅ, channa haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kāya]]---what business; [[synonyms:s:sannyāse]]---in the renounced order; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---of Me; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---My real wealth; [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at which time; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---I accepted the renounced order; [[synonyms:c:channa]]---deranged; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: "I had no business in accepting this renounced order and sacrificing My love for My mother, which is My real property. Actually I was in a crazy state of mind when I accepted sannyāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.52
description: "I am staying here at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, to comply with her orders. However, at intervals I shall go see her lotus feet.
text:
> nīlācale āchoṅ muñi tāṅhāra ājñāte
> madhye madhye āsimu tāṅra caraṇa dekhite

translation: "I am staying here at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, to comply with her orders. However, at intervals I shall go see her lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.53
description: "Indeed, I go there daily to see her lotus feet. She is able to feel My presence, although she does not believe it to be true.
text:
> nitya yāi' dekhi muñi tāṅhāra caraṇe
> sphūrti-jñāne teṅho tāhā satya nāhi māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nitya]] [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going daily; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---see; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---her lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:sphūrti]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---feeling My appearance; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---she; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:s:satya]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---does not accept as true.
translation: "Indeed, I go there daily to see her lotus feet. She is able to feel My presence, although she does not believe it to be true.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.54-55
description: "One day My mother, Śacī, offered food to Śālagrāma Viṣṇu. She offered rice cooked from śāli paddies, various kinds of vegetables, spinach, curry made of banana flowers, fried paṭola with nimba leaves, pieces of ginger with lemon, and also yogurt, milk, sugar candy and many other foods.
text:
> eka-dina śālyanna, vyañjana pāṅca-sāta
> śāka, mocā-ghaṇṭa, bhṛṣṭa-paṭola-nimba-pāta
>
> lembu-ādā-khaṇḍa, dadhi, dugdha, khaṇḍa-sāra
> śālagrāme samarpilena bahu upahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:ś:śāli]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]]---cooked rice made of //śāli// paddy; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]]---five to seven different kinds; [[synonyms:ś:śāka]]---spinach; [[synonyms:m:mocā]]-[[synonyms:g:ghaṇṭa]]---curry made from banana flowers; [[synonyms:b:bhṛṣṭa]]---fried; [[synonyms:p:paṭola]]---//paṭola// vegetables; [[synonyms:n:nimba]]-[[synonyms:p:pāta]]---with leaves of the //nimba// tree; [[synonyms:l:lembu]]---lemon; [[synonyms:ā:ādā]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]---pieces of ginger; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---milk; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]---sugar candy; [[synonyms:ś:śālagrāme]]---unto Lord Viṣṇu in the form of the //śālagrāma//; [[synonyms:s:samarpilena]]---offered; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---many other varieties of food.
translation: "One day My mother, Śacī, offered food to Śālagrāma Viṣṇu. She offered rice cooked from śāli paddies, various kinds of vegetables, spinach, curry made of banana flowers, fried paṭola with nimba leaves, pieces of ginger with lemon, and also yogurt, milk, sugar candy and many other foods.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.56
description: "Taking the food upon her lap, Mother was crying to think that all that food was very dear to her Nimāi.
text:
> prasāda lañā kole karena krandana
> nimāira priya mora---e-saba vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the remnants of food; [[synonyms:k:kole]]---on her lap; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---was crying; [[synonyms:n:nimāira]]---of Nimāi; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---favorite; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---all these varieties of cooked food.
translation: "Taking the food upon her lap, Mother was crying to think that all that food was very dear to her Nimāi.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.57
description: "My mother was thinking, 'Nimāi is not here. Who will accept all this food?' As she meditated upon Me in this way, her eyes filled with tears.
text:
> nimāñi nāhika ethā, ke kare bhojana
> mora dhyāne aśru-jale bharila nayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nimāñi]]---Nimāi; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]] [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---is not present here; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---who will eat them; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:d:dhyāne]]---on meditation upon Me; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---with tears; [[synonyms:b:bharila]] [[synonyms:n:nayana]]---eyes become filled.
translation: "My mother was thinking, 'Nimāi is not here. Who will accept all this food?' As she meditated upon Me in this way, her eyes filled with tears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.58
description: "While she was thus thinking and crying, I immediately went there with great haste and ate everything. Seeing the dish empty, she wiped her tears away.
text:
> śīghra yāi' muñi saba karinu bhakṣaṇa
> śūnya-pātra dekhi' aśru kariyā mārjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karinu]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---ate; [[synonyms:ś:śūnya]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the dish empty; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---smearing with her hands.
translation: "While she was thus thinking and crying, I immediately went there with great haste and ate everything. Seeing the dish empty, she wiped her tears away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.59
description: "She then began to wonder who had eaten all that food. 'Why is the plate empty?' she wondered, doubting that Bāla-gopāla had eaten it all.
text:
> 'ke anna-vyañjana khāila, śūnya kene pāta?
> bālagopāla kibā khāila saba bhāta?
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:v:vyañjana]] [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---has eaten all this food; [[synonyms:ś:śūnya]] [[synonyms:k:kene]] [[synonyms:p:pāta]]---why is the dish empty; [[synonyms:b:bāla]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Bāla-gopāla; [[synonyms:k:kibā]] [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---did He eat; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---all the rice.
translation: "She then began to wonder who had eaten all that food. 'Why is the plate empty?' she wondered, doubting that Bāla-gopāla had eaten it all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.6
description: After visiting the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would remain outside during the upala-bhoga offering. He would then go meet Haridāsa Ṭhākura and return to His residence.
text:
> 'upala-bhoga' lāgile kare bāhire vijaya
> haridāsa mili' āise āpana nilaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]] [[synonyms:l:lāgile]]---when there is an offering of food known as //upala-bhoga//; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:b:bāhire]] [[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---He remains outside; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:m:mili']]---meeting Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes back; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]] [[synonyms:n:nilaya]]---to His residence.
translation: After visiting the temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would remain outside during the upala-bhoga offering. He would then go meet Haridāsa Ṭhākura and return to His residence.
purport: At noon, when there was an //upala-bhoga// offering in a place called //bhoga-vardhana-khaṇḍa,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go outside the temple. Before going outside, He used to stand near the Garuḍa-stambha column and offer His obeisances and prayers. Afterwards, the Lord would visit Siddha-bakula, where Haridāsa Ṭhākura lived. After visiting with Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the Lord would return to His own place at the abode of Kāśī Miśra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.60
description: "She began to wonder whether there was actually anything on the plate in the first place. Then again she thought that some animal might have come and eaten everything.
text:
> kibā mora kathāya mane bhrama hañā gela!
> kibā kona jantu āsi' sakala khāila?
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:k:kathāya]]---when I was thinking like that; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:b:bhrama]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---I was mistaken; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:j:jantu]]---some animal; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---ate everything.
translation: "She began to wonder whether there was actually anything on the plate in the first place. Then again she thought that some animal might have come and eaten everything.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.61
description: "She thought, 'Perhaps by mistake I did not put any food on the plate.' So thinking, she went into the kitchen and saw the pots.
text:
> kibā āmi anna-pātre bhrame nā bāḍila!'
> eta cinti' pāka-pātra yāñā dekhila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:p:pātre]]---on the plate for food; [[synonyms:b:bhrame]]---by mistake; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---did not put anything; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:c:cinti']]---thinking this; [[synonyms:p:pāka]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the kitchen pots; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---went and saw.
translation: "She thought, 'Perhaps by mistake I did not put any food on the plate.' So thinking, she went into the kitchen and saw the pots.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.62
description: "When she saw that all the pots were still filled with rice and vegetables, there was some doubt in her mind, and she was astonished.
text:
> anna-vyañjana-pūrṇa dekhi' sakala bhājane
> dekhiyā saṁśaya haila kichu camatkāra mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]-[[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---filled with rice and vegetables; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:b:bhājane]]---all the cooking pots; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was doubt; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---wonder; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind.
translation: "When she saw that all the pots were still filled with rice and vegetables, there was some doubt in her mind, and she was astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.63
description: "Thus wondering, she called Īśāna, the servant, and had the place cleaned again. She then offered another plate to Gopāla.
text:
> īśāne bolāñā punaḥ sthāna lepāila
> punarapi gopālake anna samarpila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ī:īśāne]]---to Īśāna, the servant; [[synonyms:b:bolāñā]]---calling; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---the place; [[synonyms:l:lepāila]]---cleaned; [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again; [[synonyms:g:gopālake]]---unto Gopāla; [[synonyms:a:anna]]---cooked rice and vegetables; [[synonyms:s:samarpila]]---offered.
translation: "Thus wondering, she called Īśāna, the servant, and had the place cleaned again. She then offered another plate to Gopāla.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.64
description: "Now whenever she prepares some good cooked food and wants to feed it to Me, she cries in great anxiety.
text:
> ei-mata yabe karena uttama randhana
> more khāoyāite kare utkaṇṭhāya rodana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:u:uttama]] [[synonyms:r:randhana]]---first-class cooking; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāite]]---to feed; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhāya]]---with great anxiety; [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---crying.
translation: "Now whenever she prepares some good cooked food and wants to feed it to Me, she cries in great anxiety.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.65
description: "Being obliged by her love, I am brought there to eat. Mother knows all these things internally and feels happiness, but externally she does not accept them.
text:
> tāṅra preme āni' āmāya karāya bhojane
> antare mānaye sukha, bāhye nāhi māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:preme]]---by her love; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:karāya]] [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---causes to eat; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within herself; [[synonyms:m:mānaye]]---she feels; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:b:bāhye]]---externally; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---does not accept.
translation: "Being obliged by her love, I am brought there to eat. Mother knows all these things internally and feels happiness, but externally she does not accept them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.66
description: "Such an incident took place on the last Vijayā-daśamī day. You can ask her about this incident and thus make her believe that I actually go there."
text:
> ei vijayā-daśamīte haila ei rīti
> tāṅhāke puchiyā tāṅra karāiha pratīti
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:v:vijayā]]-[[synonyms:d:daśamīte]]---on the previous Vijayā-daśamī day; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:r:rīti]]---such an incident; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāke]]---unto her; [[synonyms:p:puchiyā]]---asking; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---her; [[synonyms:k:karāiha]]---make; [[synonyms:p:pratīti]]---belief.
translation: "Such an incident took place on the last Vijayā-daśamī day. You can ask her about this incident and thus make her believe that I actually go there."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.67
description: While describing all this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a little overwhelmed, but just to finish bidding farewell to the devotees, He remained patient.
text:
> eteka kahite prabhu vihvala ha-ilā
> loka vidāya karite prabhu dhairya dharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eteka]] [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vihvala]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became overwhelmed; [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to bid farewell to the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dhairya]] [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---maintained patience.
translation: While describing all this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was a little overwhelmed, but just to finish bidding farewell to the devotees, He remained patient.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.68
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next spoke some relishable words to Rāghava Paṇḍita. He said, "I am obliged to you due to your pure love for Me."
text:
> rāghava paṇḍite kahena vacana sarasa
> 'tomāra śuddha preme āmi ha-i' tomāra vaśa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghava]] [[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]]---unto Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---very relishable; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]] [[synonyms:p:preme]]---by pure devotional service; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i']]---I become; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---under obligation.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next spoke some relishable words to Rāghava Paṇḍita. He said, "I am obliged to you due to your pure love for Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.69
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed everyone, "Just hear about the pure devotional service rendered to Kṛṣṇa by Rāghava Paṇḍita. Indeed, Rāghava Paṇḍita's service is supremely pure and highly accomplished.
text:
> iṅhāra kṛṣṇa-sevāra kathā śuna, sarva-jana
> parama-pavitra sevā ati sarvottama
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sevāra]]---of service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---stories; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---all people; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:p:pavitra]]---supremely pure; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very much; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---well accomplished.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed everyone, "Just hear about the pure devotional service rendered to Kṛṣṇa by Rāghava Paṇḍita. Indeed, Rāghava Paṇḍita's service is supremely pure and highly accomplished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.7
description: Sitting in His room, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant on His beads, and Advaita Prabhu would come there to worship the Lord.
text:
> ghare vasi' kare prabhu nāma saṅkīrtana
> advaita āsiyā kare prabhura pūjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting in His room; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting on beads; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:p:pūjana]]---worship of the Lord.
translation: Sitting in His room, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would chant on His beads, and Advaita Prabhu would come there to worship the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.70
description: "Apart from other commodities, just hear about his coconut offering. A coconut is sold at the rate of five gaṇḍās each.
text:
> āra dravya rahu---śuna nārikelera kathā
> pāṅca gaṇḍā kari' nārikela vikāya tathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:r:rahu]]---apart from the other commodities; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---just hear; [[synonyms:n:nārikelera]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---the incident of offering coconuts; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---at the price of five //gaṇḍās//; [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]---coconut; [[synonyms:v:vikāya]]---is sold; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there.
translation: "Apart from other commodities, just hear about his coconut offering. A coconut is sold at the rate of five gaṇḍās each.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.71
description: "Although he already has hundreds of trees and millions of fruits, he is still very eager to hear about the place where sweet coconut is available.
text:
> vāṭite kata śata vṛkṣe lakṣa lakṣa phala
> tathāpi śunena yathā miṣṭa nārikela
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāṭite]]---in his garden; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---how many hundreds of; [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---trees; [[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:p:phala]]---millions of fruits; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:ś:śunena]]---hears; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---where; [[synonyms:m:miṣṭa]] [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]---sweet coconut.
translation: "Although he already has hundreds of trees and millions of fruits, he is still very eager to hear about the place where sweet coconut is available.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.72
description: "He collects coconut with great endeavor from a place twenty miles away, and he gives four paṇas each for them.
text:
> eka eka phalera mūlya diyā cāri-cāri paṇa
> daśa-krośa haite ānāya kariyā yatana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:p:phalera]]---of each and every fruit; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---price; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:p:paṇa]]---four //paṇas// each (one //paṇa// equals twenty //gaṇḍās//); [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:k:krośa]]---twenty miles away; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:ā:ānāya]]---brings; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---with great endeavor.
translation: "He collects coconut with great endeavor from a place twenty miles away, and he gives four paṇas each for them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.73
description: "Every day five to seven coconuts are clipped and put into water to keep cool.
text:
> prati-dina pāṅca-sāta phala cholāñā
> suśītala karite rākhe jale ḍubāiñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---each day; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]]---five to seven; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruits; [[synonyms:c:cholāñā]]---clipping; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:ś:śītala]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to make it very cool; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keeps; [[synonyms:j:jale]]---in water; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāiñā]]---immersing.
translation: "Every day five to seven coconuts are clipped and put into water to keep cool.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.74
description: "At the time of offering bhoga, the coconuts are again clipped and cleansed. After holes are made in them, they are offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> bhogera samaya punaḥ chuli' saṁskari'
> kṛṣṇe samarpaṇa kare mukha chidra kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhogera]] [[synonyms:s:samaya]]---at the time of offering //bhoga//; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:c:chuli']]---clipping; [[synonyms:s:saṁskari']]---cleansing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---offering; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---at the top; [[synonyms:c:chidra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making a hole.
translation: "At the time of offering bhoga, the coconuts are again clipped and cleansed. After holes are made in them, they are offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.75
description: "Lord Kṛṣṇa used to drink the juice from these coconuts, and sometimes the coconuts were left drained of juice. At other times the coconuts were filled with juice.
text:
> kṛṣṇa sei nārikela-jala pāna kari'
> kabhu śūnya phala rākhena, kabhu jala bhari'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.83
description: " 'After touching the ceiling above the door, you have touched the coconuts. Now they are no longer fit to be offered to Kṛṣṇa because they are contaminated.'
text:
> sei bhite hāta diyā phala paraśilā
> kṛṣṇa-yogya nahe, phala apavitra hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhite]]---on that ceiling; [[synonyms:h:hāta]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---touching your hand; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---the fruit; [[synonyms:p:paraśilā]]---touched; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not fit to be offered to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---the fruit; [[synonyms:a:apavitra]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---has become contaminated.
translation: “ 'After touching the ceiling above the door, you have touched the coconuts. Now they are no longer fit to be offered to Kṛṣṇa because they are contaminated.'
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura states that Rāghava Paṇḍita was not simply a crazy fellow suffering from some cleansing phobia. He did not belong to the mundane world. In lower consciousness, accepting something to be spiritual when it is actually material is called //bhauma-ijya-dhīḥ.// Rāghava Paṇḍita was an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, and everything he saw was related to the service of the Lord. He was always absorbed in the transcendental thought of how he could always serve Kṛṣṇa with everything. Sometimes neophytes, devotees on the lower platform, try to imitate Rāghava Paṇḍita on the platform of material purity and impurity. Such imitation will not help anyone. As explained in //Caitanya-caritāmṛta,// (//Antya-līlā// 4.174): //bhadrābhadra-vastu-jñāna nāhika 'prākṛte'.// On the transcendental platform there is no higher or lower, pure or impure. On the material platform, distinction is made between good and bad, but on the spiritual platform everything is of the same quality.

> 'dvaite' bhadrābhadra-jñāna, saba---'manodharma'
> 'ei bhāla, ei manda',---ei saba 'bhrama'

"In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad, is all a mistake." [[books:cc:antya:4:176|(Cc. Antya 4.176)]]

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.84

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.91

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.93

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.95
description: "Being a householder, Vāsudeva Datta needs to save some money. Because he is not doing so, it is very difficult for him to maintain his family.
text:

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.96
description: "Please take care of Vāsudeva Datta's family affairs. Become his manager and make the proper adjustments.

translation:
"Please take care of Vāsudeva Datta's family affairs. Become his manager and make the proper adjustments.


Both Vāsudeva Datta and Śivānanda Sena were living in the same neighborhood, which is presently called Kumārahaṭṭa or Hālisahara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 15.97

> prati-varṣe āmāra saba bhakta-gaṇa lañā

translation: "Come every year and bring all My devotees with you to the Guṇḍicā festival. I also request you to maintain all of them."
