translation: "His name, Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, is all-auspicious to the world. Everything about Him-His name, form, and qualities-is unparalleled.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.114
description: "Simply by seeing Him, one understands that He possesses all the characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Such characteristics are certainly uncommon. Who will believe it?"
text:
> dekhile se jāni tāṅra 'īśvarera rīti'
> alaukika kathā śuni' ke kare pratīti?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhile]]---simply by seeing; [[synonyms:s:se]]---Him; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I understand; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:ī:īśvarera]] [[synonyms:r:rīti]]---characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:a:alaukika]]---uncommon; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---story; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:pratīti]]---will believe.
translation: "Simply by seeing Him, one understands that He possesses all the characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Such characteristics are certainly uncommon. Who will believe it?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.115
description: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī laughed very much to hear this description. Joking and laughing at the brāhmaṇa, he began to speak as follows.
text:
> śuniyā prakāśānanda bahuta hāsilā
> vipre upahāsa kari' kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prakāśānanda]]---Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]] [[synonyms:h:hāsilā]]---laughed very much; [[synonyms:v:vipre]]---at the //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:u:upahāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---jokingly laughing; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī laughed very much to hear this description. Joking and laughing at the brāhmaṇa, he began to speak as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.116
description: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī said, "Yes, I have heard about Him. He is a sannyāsī from Bengal, and He is very sentimental. I have also heard that He belongs to the Bhāratī-sampradāya, for He is a disciple of Keśava Bhāratī. However, He is only a pretender."
text:
> "śuniyāchi gauḍa-deśera sannyāsī---'bhāvuka'
> keśava-bhāratī-śiṣya, loka-pratāraka
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyāchi]]---I have heard; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśera]] [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---the //sannyāsī// from Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhāvuka]]---sentimental; [[synonyms:k:keśava]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāratī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiṣya]]---disciple of Keśava Bhāratī; [[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:p:pratāraka]]---a first-class pretender.
translation: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī said, "Yes, I have heard about Him. He is a sannyāsī from Bengal, and He is very sentimental. I have also heard that He belongs to the Bhāratī-sampradāya, for He is a disciple of Keśava Bhāratī. However, He is only a pretender."
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was considered //bhāvuka// (sentimental) because He was always seen in the //bhāva// stage. That is, He always exhibited ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. However, foolish people considered Him sentimental. In the material world, so-called devotees sometimes exhibit emotional symptoms. Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love cannot be compared to the imitative emotional exhibitions of pretenders. Such exhibitions do not continue for very long. They are temporary. We actually see that some emotional imitators exhibit certain symptoms, but immediately after their exhibition, they are attracted to smoking and other things. In the beginning, when Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities, he considered them to be those of a pretender. Consequently he called Him a //loka-pratāraka,// a pretender. Māyāvādīs cannot understand the transcendental symptoms exhibited by a devotee; therefore when such symptoms are manifest, the Māyāvādīs equate them with temporary emotional feelings. However, Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī's statement is offensive, and consequently he should be considered an atheist (//pāṣaṇḍī).// According to Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, since Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī was not engaged in the Lord's devotional service, his //sannyāsa// is to be considered //phalgu-vairāgya.// This means that since he did not know how to use things for the Lord's service, his renunciation of the world was artificial.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.117
description: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī continued, "I know that His name is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and that He is accompanied by many sentimentalists. His followers dance with Him, and He tours from country to country and village to village.
text:
> 'caitanya'-nāma tāṅra, bhāvuka-gaṇa lañā
> deśe deśe grāme grāme bule nācāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Caitanya; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His name; [[synonyms:b:bhāvuka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by some sentimentalists; [[synonyms:d:deśe]] [[synonyms:d:deśe]]---from country to country; [[synonyms:g:grāme]] [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---from village to village; [[synonyms:b:bule]]---travels; [[synonyms:n:nācāñā]]---causing to dance.
translation: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī continued, "I know that His name is Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and that He is accompanied by many sentimentalists. His followers dance with Him, and He tours from country to country and village to village.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.118
description: "Whoever sees Him accepts Him as the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Since He has some mystic power by which He hypnotizes people, everyone who sees Him is illusioned.
text:
> yei tāṅre dekhe, sei īśvara kari' kahe
> aiche mohana-vidyā---ye dekhe se mohe
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that person; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:m:mohana]]-[[synonyms:v:vidyā]]---hypnotism; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---anyone who sees; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:m:mohe]]---he becomes illusioned.
translation: "Whoever sees Him accepts Him as the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Since He has some mystic power by which He hypnotizes people, everyone who sees Him is illusioned.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.119
description: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya was a very learned scholar, but I have heard that he also has become a madman due to his association with this Caitanya.
text:
> sārvabhauma bhaṭṭācārya---paṇḍita prabala
> śuni' caitanyera saṅge ha-ila pāgala
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:p:prabala]]---a learned scholar; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---I have heard; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the association of Caitanya; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:p:pāgala]]---has become a madman.
translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya was a very learned scholar, but I have heard that he also has become a madman due to his association with this Caitanya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.12
description: "When You go through the jungle, there will be no brāhmaṇa available from whom You can accept lunch. Therefore please give permission for at least one pure brāhmaṇa to accompany You."
text:
> ana-pathe yāite nāhi 'bhojyānna'-brāhmaṇa
> ājñā kara,---saṅge caluka vipra eka-jana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the forest path; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---going; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:b:bhojya]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---a //brāhmaṇa// whose food can be accepted; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---please give permission; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---along; [[synonyms:c:caluka]]---may go; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---//brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---one person.
translation: "When You go through the jungle, there will be no brāhmaṇa available from whom You can accept lunch. Therefore please give permission for at least one pure brāhmaṇa to accompany You."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.120
description: "This Caitanya is a sannyāsī in name only. Actually He is a first-class magician. In any case, His sentimentalism cannot be very much in demand here in Kāśī.
text:
> 'sannyāsī'---nāma-mātra, mahā-indrajālī!
> 'kāśīpure' nā vikābe tāṅra bhāvakāli
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---in the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---in name only; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:i:indrajālī]]---first-class magician; [[synonyms:k:kāśīpure]]---in Kāśī; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:v:vikābe]]---will not sell; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:b:bhāvakāli]]---sentimental activities.
translation: "This Caitanya is a sannyāsī in name only. Actually He is a first-class magician. In any case, His sentimentalism cannot be very much in demand here in Kāśī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.121
description: "Do not go to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Just continue hearing Vedānta. If you associate with upstarts, you will be lost in this world and in the next."
text:
> 'vedānta' śravaṇa kara, nā yāiha tāṅra pāśa
> ucchṛṅkhala-loka-saṅge dui-loka-nāśa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vedānta]]---the philosophy of Vedānta; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---go on hearing; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---do not; [[synonyms:y:yāiha]]---go; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---near Him; [[synonyms:u:ucchṛṅkhala]]---upstart; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the association of; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---destruction in this world and the next.
translation: "Do not go to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Just continue hearing Vedānta. If you associate with upstarts, you will be lost in this world and in the next."
purport:
The word //ucchṛṅkhala,// meaning "whimsical," is significant in this verse. In //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:16:23|(Bg. 16.23)]], Lord Kṛṣṇa Himself says:

> yaḥ śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya
> vartate kāma-kārataḥ
> na sa siddhim avāpnoti
> na sukhaṁ na parāṁ gatim

If one acts whimsically and does not follow the śāstric principles, he will never attain perfection, happiness or the spiritual world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.122
description: When the brāhmaṇa heard Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī speak like this about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he became very grief-stricken. Chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, he immediately left.
text:
> eta śuni' sei vipra mahā-duḥkha pāilā
> 'kṛṣṇa' 'kṛṣṇa' kahi' tathā haite uṭhi' gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---that //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---became very much aggrieved; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---uttering the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tathā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from there; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---got up and went away.
translation: When the brāhmaṇa heard Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī speak like this about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he became very grief-stricken. Chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, he immediately left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.123
description: The brāhmaṇa's mind was already purified by seeing the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He therefore went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described what took place before the Māyāvādī sannyāsī Prakāśānanda.
text:
> prabhura daraśane śuddha hañāche tāṅra mana
> prabhu-āge duḥkhī hañā kahe vivaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---by seeing personally the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---purified; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---was; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---his mind; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before the Lord; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very much unhappy; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---described the incidents.
translation: The brāhmaṇa's mind was already purified by seeing the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He therefore went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described what took place before the Māyāvādī sannyāsī Prakāśānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.124
description: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mildly smiled. The brāhmaṇa then spoke again to the Lord.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu tabe īṣat hāsilā
> punarapi sei vipra prabhure puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]]---mildly; [[synonyms:h:hāsilā]]---smiled; [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again indeed; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---//brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mildly smiled. The brāhmaṇa then spoke again to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.125
description: The brāhmaṇa said, "As soon as I uttered Your name before him, he immediately confirmed the fact that he knew Your name.
text:
> "tāra āge yabe āmi tomāra nāma la-ila
> seha tomāra nāma jāne,---āpane kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before him; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:l:laila]]---uttered; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---he; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---he said himself.
translation: The brāhmaṇa said, "As soon as I uttered Your name before him, he immediately confirmed the fact that he knew Your name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.126
description: "While finding fault with You, he uttered Your name three times, saying, 'Caitanya, Caitanya, Caitanya.'
text:
> tomāra 'doṣa' kahite kare nāmera uccāra
> 'caitanya' 'caitanya' kari' kahe tina-bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---Your fault; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---describing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nāmera]]---of the name; [[synonyms:u:uccāra]]---utterances; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Caitanya, Caitanya; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---in that way; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---he uttered three times.
translation: "While finding fault with You, he uttered Your name three times, saying, 'Caitanya, Caitanya, Caitanya.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.127
description: "Although he spoke Your name three times, he did not utter the name of Kṛṣṇa. Because he uttered Your name in contempt, I was very much aggrieved.
text:
> tina-bāre 'kṛṣṇa-nāma' nā āila tāra mukhe
> 'avajñā'te nāma laya, śuni' pāi duḥkhe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:b:bāre]]---three times; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---did not come; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in his mouth; [[synonyms:a:avajñā'te]]---in contempt; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:l:laya]]---takes Your name; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:pāi]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---I was very much aggrieved.
translation: "Although he spoke Your name three times, he did not utter the name of Kṛṣṇa. Because he uttered Your name in contempt, I was very much aggrieved.
purport: Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī vilified and blasphemed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Words like //brahma, caitanya, ātmā, paramātmā, jagadīśa, īśvara, virāṭ, vibhu, bhūmā, viśvarūpa// and //vyāpaka// all indirectly indicate Kṛṣṇa. However, the chanter of these names is not actually attracted to the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa and His transcendental pastimes. One may get a little light from these names, but one cannot understand that the holy name of the Lord is identical with the Lord. One considers the Lord's names material due to a poor fund of knowledge. Māyāvādī philosophers and the //pañcopāsakas// cannot in the least understand the existence of the spiritual world and the blissful variegatedness there. They cannot understand the Absolute Truth and its spiritual varieties-name, form, qualities and pastimes. Consequently they conclude that Kṛṣṇa's transcendental activities are //māyā.// Due to this, one has to directly cultivate knowledge about the holy name of the Lord. Māyāvādī philosophers do not know this fact, and therefore they commit great offenses. One should not hear anything about Kṛṣṇa or devotional service from the mouths of Māyāvādī impersonalists.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.128
description: "Why could Prakāśānanda not utter the names of Kṛṣṇa and Hari? He chanted the name Caitanya thrice. As far as I am concerned, simply by seeing You I am moved to chant the holy names of Kṛṣṇa and Hari."
text:

translation: "Why could Prakāśānanda not utter the names of Kṛṣṇa and Hari? He chanted the name Caitanya thrice. As far as I am concerned, simply by seeing You I am moved to chant the holy names of Kṛṣṇa and Hari."

> 'brahma', 'ātmā' 'caitanya' kahe niravadhi
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhukahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:m:māyāvādī]]---the impersonalists; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:aparādhī]]---great offenders; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]---//brahma//; [[synonyms:ā:ātmā]]---//ātmā//; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---caitanya; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---say; [[synonyms:n:niravadhi]]---without stopping.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Māyāvādī impersonalists are great offenders unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; therefore they simply utter the words Brahman, ātmā and caitanya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 17.13
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I shall not take any of My associates with Me because if I choose someone, all the others will be unhappy.
text:
