Gāṅṭhuli-grāma is situated near the two villages Bilachu and Gopāla-pura. According to hearsay, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa first met here. In the //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave), it is stated: //sakhī duṅha vastre gāṅṭhi dila saṅgopane.// It is also stated: //phāguyā laiyā keha gāṅṭhi khuli' dilā.// For this reason the village is known as Gāṅṭhuli.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.38
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'May the left arm of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose eyes are like the petals of a lotus flower, always protect you. With His left arm He raised Govardhana Hill as if it were a toy.' "
text:
> vāmas tāmarasākṣasya
> bhuja-daṇḍaḥ sa pātu vaḥ
> krīḍā-kandukatāṁ yena
> nīto govardhano giriḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāmaḥ]]---the left; [[synonyms:t:tāmarasa]]-[[synonyms:a:akṣasya]]---of Kṛṣṇa, who has eyes like lotus petals; [[synonyms:b:bhuja]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍaḥ]]---arm; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pātu]]---let it protect; [[synonyms:v:vaḥ]]---all of you; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]-[[synonyms:k:kandukatām]]---being like a toy; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---by which; [[synonyms:n:nītaḥ]]---attained; [[synonyms:g:govardhanaḥ]]---named Govardhana; [[synonyms:g:giriḥ]]---the hill.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'May the left arm of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, whose eyes are like the petals of a lotus flower, always protect you. With His left arm He raised Govardhana Hill as if it were a toy.' "
purport: This verse is found in the //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (2.1.62).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.39
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Gopāla Deity for three days. On the fourth day, the Deity returned to His own temple.
text:
> ei-mata tina-dina gopāle dekhilā
> caturtha-divase gopāla svamandire gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---for three days; [[synonyms:g:gopāle]]---Gopāla; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---saw; [[synonyms:c:caturtha]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---on the fourth day; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in His own temple; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the Gopāla Deity for three days. On the fourth day, the Deity returned to His own temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.4
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the local people, "Where is Rādhā-kunda?" No one could inform Him, and the brāhmaṇa accompanying Him did not know either.
text:
> āriṭe rādhā-kuṇḍa-vārtā puche loka-sthāne
> keha nāhi kahe, saṅgera brāhmaṇa nā jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āriṭe]]---in the village known as Āriṭ-grāma; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news of Rādhākuṇḍa; [[synonyms:p:puche]]---inquires; [[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---from the local people; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---could say; [[synonyms:s:saṅgera]]---the companion; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---//brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the local people, "Where is Rādhā-kunda?" No one could inform Him, and the brāhmaṇa accompanying Him did not know either.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.40
description: Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked with the Deity of Gopāla, and He chanted and danced. A large and jubilant crowd of people also chanted the transcendental name of Kṛṣṇa, "Hari! Hari!"
text:
> gopāla saṅge cali' āilā nṛtya-gīta kari
> ānanda-kolāhale loka bale 'hari' 'hari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopāla]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Gopāla; [[synonyms:c:cali']]---walking; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhale]]---in great jubilation; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---say; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Hari, Hari.
translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked with the Deity of Gopāla, and He chanted and danced. A large and jubilant crowd of people also chanted the transcendental name of Kṛṣṇa, "Hari! Hari!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.41
description: The Deity Gopāla then returned to His own temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at the bottom of the hill. Thus all the desires of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were satisfied by the Deity Gopāla.
text:
> gopāla mandire gelā, prabhu rahilā tale
> prabhura vāñchā pūrṇa saba karila gopāle
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:m:mandire]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned to His temple; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]] [[synonyms:t:tale]]---remain at the bottom; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desires; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---made; [[synonyms:g:gopāle]]---the Deity Gopāla.
translation: The Deity Gopāla then returned to His own temple, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at the bottom of the hill. Thus all the desires of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were satisfied by the Deity Gopāla.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.42
description: This is the way of Lord Gopāla's kind behavior to His devotees. Seeing this, the devotees were overwhelmed by ecstatic love.
text:
> ei-mata gopālera karuṇa svabhāva
> yei bhakta janera dekhite haya 'bhāva'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gopālera]]---of the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:k:karuṇa]] [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---kind behavior; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:j:janera]]---of persons who are devotees; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstatic love.
translation: This is the way of Lord Gopāla's kind behavior to His devotees. Seeing this, the devotees were overwhelmed by ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.43
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very anxious to see Gopāla, but He did not want to climb Govardhana Hill. Therefore by some trick the Deity Gopāla personally descended.
text:
> dekhite utkaṇṭhā haya, nā caḍe govardhane
> kona chale gopāla āsi' utare āpane
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was great anxiety; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:caḍe]]---does not go up; [[synonyms:g:govardhane]]---on the hill known as Govardhana; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:c:chale]]---by some trick; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:u:utare]]---descends; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very anxious to see Gopāla, but He did not want to climb Govardhana Hill. Therefore by some trick the Deity Gopāla personally descended.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.44
description: In this way, giving some excuse, Gopāla sometimes remains in the bushes of the forest, and sometimes He stays in a village. One who is a devotee comes to see the Deity.
text:
> kabhu kuñje rahe, kabhu rahe grāmāntare
> sei bhakta, tāhāṅ āsi' dekhaye tāṅhāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:kuñje]]---in the bushes; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---He stays; [[synonyms:g:grāma]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---in a different village; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---that devotee; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming there; [[synonyms:d:dekhaye]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]]---sees Him.
translation: In this way, giving some excuse, Gopāla sometimes remains in the bushes of the forest, and sometimes He stays in a village. One who is a devotee comes to see the Deity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.45
description: The two brothers Rūpa and Sanātana did not climb the hill. To them also Lord Gopāla granted an interview.
text:
> parvate nā caḍe dui---rūpa-sanātana
> ei-rūpe tāṅ-sabāre diyāchena daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:parvate]]---on the hill; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:caḍe]]---do not ascend; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---in this way; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto them; [[synonyms:d:diyāchena]]---has given; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---interview.
translation: The two brothers Rūpa and Sanātana did not climb the hill. To them also Lord Gopāla granted an interview.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.46
description: In ripe old age, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could not go there, but he had a desire to see the beauty of Gopāla.
text:
> vṛddha-kāle rūpa-gosāñi nā pāre yāite
> vāñchā haila gopālera saundarya dekhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛddha]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in ripe old age; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---is not able; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was a desire; [[synonyms:g:gopālera]]---of Gopāla; [[synonyms:s:saundarya]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see the beauty.
translation: In ripe old age, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could not go there, but he had a desire to see the beauty of Gopāla.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.47
description: Due to fear of the Mohammedans, Gopāla went to Mathurā, where He remained in the temple of Viṭhṭhaleśvara for one full month.
text:
> mleccha-bhaye āilā gopāla mathurā-nagare
> eka-māsa rahila viṭhṭhaleśvara-ghare
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mleccha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---because of fear of the Muslims; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]-[[synonyms:n:nagare]]---to the city of Mathurā; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---one month; [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---stayed; [[synonyms:v:viṭhṭhaleśvara]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in the temple of Viṭhṭhaleśvara.
translation: Due to fear of the Mohammedans, Gopāla went to Mathurā, where He remained in the temple of Viṭhṭhaleśvara for one full month.
purport: When the two brothers Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī went to Vṛndāvana, they decided to live there. Following Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's example, they did not climb the hill because they considered it nondifferent from Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. On some pretext, the Gopāla Deity granted Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu an audience beneath the hill, and Gopāla similarly favored Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī. During his ripe old age, when Rūpa Gosvāmī could not go to Govardhana Hill because of invalidity, Gopāla kindly went to Mathurā and remained at the temple of Viṭhṭhaleśvara for one month. It was then that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could see Gopāla's beauty to his heart's content.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.48
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and his associates stayed in Mathurā for one month and saw the Deity Gopāla.
text:
> tabe rūpa gosāñi saba nija-gaṇa lañā
> eka-māsa daraśana kailā mathurāya rahiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking his associates with him; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for one month; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---saw the Deity; [[synonyms:m:mathurāya]] [[synonyms:r:rahiyā]]---staying at the city of Mathurā.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and his associates stayed in Mathurā for one month and saw the Deity Gopāla.
purport:
The following description of the temple of Viṭhṭhaleśvara is given in //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave):

> viṭhṭhalera sevā kṛṣṇa-caitanya-vigraha
> tāhāra darśane haila parama āgraha
>
> śrī-viṭhṭhalanātha---bhaṭṭa-vallabha-tanaya
> karilā yateka prīti kahile nā haya
>
> gāṭholi-grāme gopāla āilā 'chala' kari'
> tāṅre dekhi' nṛtya-gīte magna gaurahari
>
> śrī-dāsa-gosvāmī ādi parāmarśa kari'
> śrī-viṭhṭhaleśvare kailā sevā-adhikārī
>
> pitā śrī-vallabha-bhaṭṭa tāṅra adarśane
> kata-dina mathurāya chilena nirjane

Śrī Vallabha Bhaṭṭa had two sons. The elder, Gopīnātha, was born in 1432 Śakābda Era, and the younger, Viṭhṭhalanātha, was born in 1437 and died in 1507. Viṭhṭhala had seven sons: Giridhara, Govinda, Bālakṛṣṇa, Gokuleśa, Raghunātha, Yadunātha and Ghanaśyāma. Viṭhṭhala completed many of his father's unfinished books, including his commentary on //Vedānta-sūtra,// the //Subodhinī// commentary on //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, Vidvan-maṇḍana, Śṛṅgāra-rasa-maṇḍana// and //Nyāsādeśa-vivaraṇa.// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Vṛndāvana before the birth of Viṭhṭhala. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was very old at the time Gopāla stayed at the house of Viṭhṭhalanātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.49
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī stayed at Mathurā, he was accompanied by Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī and Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī.
text:
> saṅge gopāla-bhaṭṭa, dāsa-raghunātha
> raghunātha-bhaṭṭa-gosāñi, āra lokanātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Gopāla Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:l:lokanātha]]---Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī stayed at Mathurā, he was accompanied by Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī and Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī.
purport: Śrī Lokanātha Gosvāmī was a personal associate of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and a great devotee of the Lord. He was a resident of a village named Tālakhaḍi in the district of Yaśohara in Bengal. Previously he lived in Kācnāpāḍā. His father's name was Padmanābha, and his only younger brother was Pragalbha. Following the orders of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrī Lokanātha went to Vṛndāvana to live. He established a temple named Gokulānanda. Śrīla Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura selected Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī to be his spiritual master, and he was his only disciple. Because Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī did not want his name mentioned in //Caitanya-caritāmṛta,// we do not often see it in this celebrated book. On the E.B.R. Railroad, the Yaśohara station is located in Bangladesh. From the railway station one has to go by bus to the village of Sonākhāli and from there to Khejurā. From there one has to walk, or, during the rainy season, go by boat to the village of Tālakhaḍi. In this village there are still descendants of Lokanātha Gosvāmī's younger brother.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.5
description: The Lord then understood that the holy place called Rādhā-kuṇḍa was no longer visible. However, being the omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, He discovered Rādhā-kuṇḍa and Śyāma-kuṇḍa in two paddy fields. There was only a little water, but He took His bath there.
text:
> tīrtha 'lupta' jāni' prabhu sarvajña bhagavān
> dui dhānya-kṣetre alpa-jale kailā snāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---holy place; [[synonyms:l:lupta]]---lost; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jña]]---omniscient; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:d:dhānya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣetre]]---in paddy fields; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---in not very deep water; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---took a bath.
translation: The Lord then understood that the holy place called Rādhā-kuṇḍa was no longer visible. However, being the omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, He discovered Rādhā-kuṇḍa and Śyāma-kuṇḍa in two paddy fields. There was only a little water, but He took His bath there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.50
description: Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī, Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī, Śrī Yādava Ācārya and Govinda Gosvāmī also accompanied Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.
text:
> bhūgarbha-gosāñi, āra śrī-jīva-gosāñi
> śrī-yādava-ācārya, āra govinda gosāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhūgarbha]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Bhūgarbha Gosāñi; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:y:yādava]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Śrī Yādava Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Govinda Gosvāmī.
translation: Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī, Śrī Jīva Gosvāmī, Śrī Yādava Ācārya and Govinda Gosvāmī also accompanied Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.51
description: He was also accompanied by Śrī Uddhava dāsa, Mādhava, Śrī Gopāla dāsa and Nārāyaṇa dāsa.
text:
> śrī-uddhava-dāsa, āra mādhava---dui-jana
> śrī-gopāla-dāsa, āra dāsa-nārāyaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:u:uddhava]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Śrī Uddhava dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:m:mādhava]]---Mādhava; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Śrī Gopāla dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:n:nārāyaṇa]]---Nārāyaṇa dāsa.
translation: He was also accompanied by Śrī Uddhava dāsa, Mādhava, Śrī Gopāla dāsa and Nārāyaṇa dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.52
description: The great devotee Govinda, Vāṇī Kṛṣṇadāsa, Puṇḍarīkākṣa, Īśāna and Laghu Haridāsa also accompanied him.
text:
> 'govinda' bhakta, āra vāṇī-kṛṣṇadāsa
> puṇḍarīkākṣa, īśāna, āra laghu-haridāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---a great devotee; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Vāṇī Kṛṣṇadāsa; [[synonyms:p:puṇḍarīkākṣa]]---Puṇḍarīkākṣa; [[synonyms:ī:īśāna]]---Īśāna; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:l:laghu]]-[[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Laghu Haridāsa.
translation: The great devotee Govinda, Vāṇī Kṛṣṇadāsa, Puṇḍarīkākṣa, Īśāna and Laghu Haridāsa also accompanied him.
purport:
Laghu Haridāsa should not be confused with Junior Haridāsa, who committed suicide at Prayāga. Generally a devotee is called Haridāsa, and consequently there are many Haridāsas. The chief was Ṭhākura Haridāsa. There was also a Madhyama Haridāsa.

In //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Sixth Wave), there is a list of many of the chief devotees who accompanied Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

> gosvāmī gopāla-bhaṭṭa ati dayāmaya
> bhūgarbha, śrī-lokanātha---guṇera ālaya
>
> śrī-mādhava, śrī-paramānanda-bhaṭṭācārya
> śrī-madhu-paṇḍita---yāṅra caritra āścarya
>
> premī kṛṣṇadāsa kṛṣṇadāsa brahmacārī
> yādava ācārya, nārāyaṇa kṛpāvān
> śrī-puṇḍarīkākṣa-gosāñi, govinda, īśāna
>
> śrī-govinda vāṇī-kṛṣṇadāsa aty-udāra
> śrī-uddhava---madhye-madhye gauḍe gati yāṅra
>
> dvija-haridāsa kṛṣṇadāsa kavirāja
> śrī-gopāla-dāsa yāṅra alaukika kāya
> śrī-gopāla, mādhavādi yateka vaiṣṇava

"The following Vaiṣṇavas were present with Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī: the merciful Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; Bhūgarbha Gosvāmī; Śrī Lokanātha dāsa Gosvāmī, a reservoir of good qualities; Śrī Mādhava; Śrī Paramānanda Bhaṭṭācārya; Śrī Madhu Paṇḍita, whose characteristics are all wonderful; Premī Kṛṣṇadāsa; Kṛṣṇadāsa Brahmacārī; Yādava Ācārya; the merciful Nārāyaṇa; Śrī Puṇḍarīkākṣa Gosvāmī; Govinda; Īśāna; Śrī Govinda; the magnanimous Vāṇī Kṛṣṇadāsa; Śrī Uddhava, who occasionally visited Bengal; Dvija Haridāsa; Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja; Śrī Gopāla dāsa, whose body is completely spiritual; Śrī Gopāla; Mādhava; and many others."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.53
description: It was with great jubilation that Rūpa Gosvāmī visited Lord Gopāla accompanied by all these devotees.
text:
> ei saba mukhya-bhakta lañā nija-saṅge
> śrī-gopāla daraśana kailā bahu-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---chief devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---taking with him personally; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visiting Lord Gopāla; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---performed in great jubilation.
translation: It was with great jubilation that Rūpa Gosvāmī visited Lord Gopāla accompanied by all these devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.54
description: After staying at Mathurā for one month, the Deity Gopāla returned to His own place, and Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana.
text:
> eka-māsa rahi' gopāla gelā nija-sthāne
> śrī-rūpa-gosāñi āilā śrī-vṛndāvane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---staying for one month; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity Gopāla; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to His own place; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---to Vṛndāvana.
translation: After staying at Mathurā for one month, the Deity Gopāla returned to His own place, and Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.55
description: In the course of this story, I have given a description of Lord Gopāla's mercy. After seeing the Gopāla Deity, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Śrī Kāmyavana.
text:
> prastāve kahiluṅ gopāla-kṛpāra ākhyāna
> tabe mahāprabhu gelā 'śrī-kāmyavana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prastāve]]---in the course of the story; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have stated; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpāra]]---of the mercy of Gopāla; [[synonyms:ā:ākhyāna]]---description; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---after this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kāmya]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---to Śrī Kāmyavana.
translation: In the course of this story, I have given a description of Lord Gopāla's mercy. After seeing the Gopāla Deity, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Śrī Kāmyavana.
purport:
Kāmyavana is mentioned in the //Ādi-varāha Purāṇa://

> caturthaṁ kāmyaka-vanaṁ
> vanānāṁ vanam uttamam
> tatra gatvā naro devi
> mama loke mahīyate

In the //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave) it is also said:

> ei kāmyavane kṛṣṇa-līlā manohara
> karibe darśana sthāna kuṇḍa bahutara
> kāmyavane yata tīrtha lekhā nāhi tāra

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.56
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's touring Vṛndāvana has been previously described. In the same ecstatic way, He traveled all over Vṛndāvana.
text:
> prabhura gamana-rīti pūrve ye likhila
> sei-mata vṛndāvane tāvat dekhila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]-[[synonyms:r:rīti]]---method of touring; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:l:likhila]]---I have written; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---similarly; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāvat]] [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---saw all the places.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's touring Vṛndāvana has been previously described. In the same ecstatic way, He traveled all over Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.57
description: After visiting the places of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes at Kāmyavana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Nandīśvara. While there, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love.
text:
> tāhāṅ līlā-sthalī dekhi' gelā 'nandīśvara'
> 'nandīśvara' dekhi' preme ha-ilā vihvala
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---at Kāmyavana; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthalī]]---all the places of pastimes; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---visiting; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:n:nandīśvara]]---went to Nandīśvara; [[synonyms:n:nandīśvara]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---while seeing Nandīśvara; [[synonyms:p:preme]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]] [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---became overwhelmed by ecstatic love.
translation: After visiting the places of Kṛṣṇa's pastimes at Kāmyavana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Nandīśvara. While there, He was overwhelmed with ecstatic love.
purport: Nandīśvara is the house of Mahārāja Nanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.58
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed in all the celebrated lakes, beginning with Lake Pāvana. Thereafter He climbed a hill and spoke to the people.
text:
> 'pāvanādi' saba kuṇḍe snāna kariyā
> lokere puchila, parvata-upare yāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāvana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---Pāvana and others; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍe]]---in every lake; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---taking a bath; [[synonyms:l:lokere]] [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired from persons there; [[synonyms:p:parvata]]-[[synonyms:u:upare]] [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going up a hill.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed in all the celebrated lakes, beginning with Lake Pāvana. Thereafter He climbed a hill and spoke to the people.
purport:
The Pāvana-sarovara is described in the //Mathurā-māhātmya://

> pāvane sarasi snātvā
> kṛṣṇaṁ nandīśvare girau
> dṛṣṭvā nandaṁ yaśodāṁ ca
> sarvābhīṣṭam avāpnuyāt

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.59
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked, "Are there any deities on top of this hill?" The local people replied, "There are deities on this hill, but they are located within a cave.
text:
> kichu deva-mūrti haya parvata-upare?
> loka kahe,---mūrti haya gophāra bhitare
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:m:mūrti]]---deities; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are there; [[synonyms:p:parvata]]-[[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the top of the hill; [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---people said; [[synonyms:m:mūrti]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there are deities; [[synonyms:g:gophāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within a cave.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked, "Are there any deities on top of this hill?" The local people replied, "There are deities on this hill, but they are located within a cave.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.6
description: When the people of the village saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu taking His bath in those two ponds in the middle of the paddy fields, they were very astonished. The Lord then offered His prayers to Śrī Rādhā-kuṇḍa.
text:
> dekhi' saba grāmya-lokera vismaya haila mana
> preme prabhu kare rādhā-kuṇḍera stavana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:g:grāmya]]-[[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of all the people of the village; [[synonyms:v:vismaya]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became astonished; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the minds; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍera]]---of Rādhā-kuṇḍa; [[synonyms:s:stavana]]---prayers.
translation: When the people of the village saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu taking His bath in those two ponds in the middle of the paddy fields, they were very astonished. The Lord then offered His prayers to Śrī Rādhā-kuṇḍa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.60
description: "There is a father and mother with well-built bodies, and between them is a very beautiful child who is curved in three places."
text:
> dui-dike mātā-pitā puṣṭa kalevara
> madhye eka 'śiśu' haya tribhaṅga-sundara
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on two sides; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:p:pitā]]---father and mother; [[synonyms:p:puṣṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kalevara]]---very well-built body; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---between them; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śiśu]]---child; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṅga]]---curved in three places; [[synonyms:s:sundara]]---very beautiful.
translation: "There is a father and mother with well-built bodies, and between them is a very beautiful child who is curved in three places."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.61
description: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy. After excavating the cave, He saw the three deities.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu mane ānanda pāñā
> 'tina' mūrti dekhilā sei gophā ughāḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting great pleasure; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:m:mūrti]]---the three deities; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---saw; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:g:gophā]] [[synonyms:u:ughāḍiyā]]---by excavating the cave.
translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy. After excavating the cave, He saw the three deities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.62
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His respects to Nanda Mahārāja and mother Yaśodā, and with great ecstatic love He touched the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> vrajendra-vrajeśvarīra kaila caraṇa vandana
> premāveśe kṛṣṇera kaila sarvāṅga-sparśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:i:indra]]---of the King of Vraja, Nanda Mahārāja; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:ī:īśvarīra]]---and of the Queen of Vraja, mother Yaśodā; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---worshiping the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:sparśana]]---touching the whole body.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His respects to Nanda Mahārāja and mother Yaśodā, and with great ecstatic love He touched the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.63
description: Every day the Lord chanted and danced in ecstatic love. Finally He went to Khadiravana.
text:
> saba dina premāveśe nṛtya-gīta kailā
> tāhāṅ haite mahāprabhu 'khadira-vana, āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---all the days; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---danced and chanted; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from there; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:khadira]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to the place known as Khadiravana.
translation: Every day the Lord chanted and danced in ecstatic love. Finally He went to Khadiravana.
purport:
Khadiravana is described in the //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave):

> dekhaha khadira-vana vidita jagate
> viṣṇu-loka-prāpti ethā gamana-mātrete

"Behold the forest named Khadiravana, renowned throughout the universe. If one comes to Khadiravana, he can immediately be elevated to Viṣṇuloka."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.64
description: After seeing the places of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, Śrī Caitanya went to Śeṣaśāyī, where He saw Lakṣmī and recited the following verse.
text:
> līlā-sthala dekhi' tāhāṅ gelā 'śeṣaśāyī'
> 'lakṣmī' dekhi' ei śloka paḍena gosāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthala]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the places of pastimes; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---departed; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāyī]]---for seeing Śeṣaśāyī; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍena]]---recites; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After seeing the places of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, Śrī Caitanya went to Śeṣaśāyī, where He saw Lakṣmī and recited the following verse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.65
description: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."
text:
> yat te sujāta-caraṇāmburuhaṁ staneṣu
> bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu
> tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit
> kūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavad-āyuṣāṁ naḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yat]]---which; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your; [[synonyms:s:sujāta]]---very fine; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:ambu]]-[[synonyms:r:ruham]]---lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:staneṣu]]---on the breasts; [[synonyms:b:bhītāḥ]]---being afraid; [[synonyms:ś:śanaiḥ]]---gently; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---O dear one; [[synonyms:d:dadhīmahi]]---we place; [[synonyms:k:karkaśeṣu]]---rough; [[synonyms:t:tena]]---with them; [[synonyms:a:aṭavīm]]---the path; [[synonyms:a:aṭasi]]---You roam; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---they; [[synonyms:v:vyathate]]---are distressed; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kim]] [[synonyms:s:svit]]---we wonder; [[synonyms:k:kūrpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādibhiḥ]]---by small stones and so on; [[synonyms:b:bhramati]]---flutters; [[synonyms:d:dhīḥ]]---the mind; [[synonyms:b:bhavat]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyuṣām]]---of those of whom Your Lordship is the very life; [[synonyms:n:naḥ]]---of us.
translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our life rests only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path."
purport: This is a verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.19) spoken by the //gopīs// when Kṛṣṇa left them in the midst of the //rāsa-līlā.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.66
description: Afterwards, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Khelā-tīrtha and then went to Bhāṇḍīravana. Crossing the Yamunā River, He went to Bhadravana.
text:
> tabe 'khelā-tīrtha' dekhi' 'bhāṇḍīravana, āilā
> yamunā pāra hañā 'bhadra-vana' gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:k:khelā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---Khelā-tīrtha; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bhāṇḍīravana]]---Bhāṇḍīravana; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]] [[synonyms:p:pāra]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---crossing the River Yamunā; [[synonyms:b:bhadra]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---to Bhadravana; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went.
translation: Afterwards, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Khelā-tīrtha and then went to Bhāṇḍīravana. Crossing the Yamunā River, He went to Bhadravana.
purport: In the //Bhakti-ratnākara// it is said that Śrī Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma used to play at Khelā-tīrtha with the cowherd boys during the entire day. Mother Yaśodā had to call Them to take Their baths and eat Their lunch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.67
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited Śrīvana and Lohavana. He then went to Mahāvana and saw Gokula, the place of Lord Kṛṣṇa's early childhood pastimes.
text:
> 'śrīvana' dekhi' punaḥ gelā 'loha-vana'
> 'mahāvana' giyā kailā janma-sthāna-daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---Śrīvana; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:l:loha]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---to Lohavana; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:v:vana]]---to Mahāvana; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:j:janma]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---birth site; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited Śrīvana and Lohavana. He then went to Mahāvana and saw Gokula, the place of Lord Kṛṣṇa's early childhood pastimes.
purport:
Of Śrīvana (also called Bilvavana), the //Bhakti-ratnākara// states, //devatā-pūjita bilvavana śobhāmaya:// "The beautiful forest of Bilvavana is worshiped by all the demigods."

About Lohavana, //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave) states:

> lohavane kṛṣṇera adbhuta go-cāraṇa
> ethā loha-jaṅghāsure vadhe bhagavān

"At Lohavana, Lord Kṛṣṇa used to tend cows. The demon named Lohajaṅgha was killed at this place."

Mahāvana is described as follows in //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave):

> dekha nanda-yaśodā-ālaya mahāvane
> ei dekha śrī-kṛṣṇa-candrera janma sthala
> śrī-gokula, mahāvana---dui 'eka' haya

"Behold the house of Nanda and Yaśodā in Mahāvana. See the birthplace of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Mahāvana and the birthplace of Lord Kṛṣṇa, Gokula, are one and the same."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.68
description: Upon seeing the place where the twin arjuna trees were broken by Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was moved to great ecstatic love.
text:
> yamalārjuna-bhaṅgādi dekhila sei sthala
> premāveśe prabhura mana haila ṭalamala
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yamala]]-[[synonyms:a:arjuna]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṅga]]---the place where the twin //arjuna// trees were broken; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---saw; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sthala]]---that place; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭalamala]]---agitated.
translation: Upon seeing the place where the twin arjuna trees were broken by Śrī Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was moved to great ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.69
description: After seeing Gokula, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Mathurā, where He saw the birthplace of the Lord. While there, He stayed at the house of the Sanoḍiyā brāhmaṇa.
text:
> 'gokula' dekhiyā āilā 'mathurā'-nagare
> janma-sthāna' dekhi' rahe sei vipra-ghare
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gokula]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing Gokula; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]-[[synonyms:n:nagare]]---in the city of Mathurā; [[synonyms:j:janma]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---the birthplace of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---stays; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vipra]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in the house of the Sanoḍiyā //brāhmaṇa.//
translation: After seeing Gokula, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Mathurā, where He saw the birthplace of the Lord. While there, He stayed at the house of the Sanoḍiyā brāhmaṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.7
description: "Of all the gopīs, Rādhārāṇī is the dearmost. Similarly, the lake known as Rādhā-kuṇḍa is very dear to the Lord because it is very dear to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
text:
> saba gopī haite rādhā kṛṣṇera preyasī
> taiche rādhā-kuṇḍa priya 'priyāra sarasi'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:preyasī]]---most beloved; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍa]]---Rādhā-kuṇḍa; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---very dear; [[synonyms:p:priyāra]] [[synonyms:s:sarasī]]---the lake of the most beloved Rādhārāṇī.
translation: "Of all the gopīs, Rādhārāṇī is the dearmost. Similarly, the lake known as Rādhā-kuṇḍa is very dear to the Lord because it is very dear to Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.70
description: Seeing a great crowd assemble at Mathurā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left and went to Akrūra-tīrtha. He remained there in a solitary place.
text:
> lokera saṅghaṭṭa dekhi mathurā chāḍiyā
> ekānte 'akrūra-tīrthe' rahilā āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of people; [[synonyms:s:saṅghaṭṭa]]---crowd; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]---the city of Mathurā; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---leaving; [[synonyms:e:ekānte]]---in a solitary place; [[synonyms:a:akrūra]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrthe]]---at Akrūra-tīrtha; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---stayed; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming.
translation: Seeing a great crowd assemble at Mathurā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left and went to Akrūra-tīrtha. He remained there in a solitary place.
purport:
Akrūra-tīrtha is also mentioned in the //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave):

> dekha, śrīnivāsa, ei akrūra grāmete
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya-prabhu chilena nibhṛte

"Śrīnivāsa, look at this village of Akrūra. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed there in a solitary place."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.71
description: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Vṛndāvana and took His bath at the Kālīya Lake and Praskandana.
text:
> āra dina āilā prabhu dekhite 'vṛndāvana'
> 'kālīya-hrade' snāna kailā āra praskandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kālīya]]-[[synonyms:h:hrade]]---in the Kālīya Lake; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---took a bath; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:praskandana]]---at Praskandana.
translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Vṛndāvana and took His bath at the Kālīya Lake and Praskandana.
purport:
Kālīya-hrada is mentioned in //Bhakti-ratnākara// (Fifth Wave):

> e kālīya-tīrtha pāpa vināśaya
> kālīya-tīrtha-sthāne bahu-kārya-siddhi haya

"When one takes a bath in Kālīya-hrada, he is freed from all sinful activities. One can also be successful in business by bathing in Kālīya-hrada."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.72
description: After seeing the holy place called Praskandana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Dvādaśāditya. From there He went to Keśī-tīrtha, and when He saw the place where the rāsa dance had taken place, He immediately lost consciousness due to ecstatic love.
text:
> 'dvādaśa-āditya' haite 'keśī-tīrthe' āilā
> rāsa-sthalī dekhi' preme mūrcchita ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āditya]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Dvādaśāditya; [[synonyms:k:keśī]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrthe]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Keśī-tīrtha; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthalī]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---visiting the place of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:mūrcchita]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became unconscious.
translation: After seeing the holy place called Praskandana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Dvādaśāditya. From there He went to Keśī-tīrtha, and when He saw the place where the rāsa dance had taken place, He immediately lost consciousness due to ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.73
description: When the Lord regained His senses, He began to roll on the ground. He would sometimes laugh, cry, dance and fall down. He would also chant very loudly.
text:
> cetana pāñā punaḥ gaḍāgaḍi yāya
> hāse, kānde, nāce, paḍe, uccaiḥ-svare gāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cetana]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting His senses back; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:g:gaḍāgaḍi]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---rolls on the ground; [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---laughs; [[synonyms:k:kānde]]---cries; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---falls down; [[synonyms:u:uccaiḥ]]-[[synonyms:s:svare]] [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings very loudly.
translation: When the Lord regained His senses, He began to roll on the ground. He would sometimes laugh, cry, dance and fall down. He would also chant very loudly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.74
description: Being thus transcendentally amused, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed that day happily at Keśī-tīrtha. In the evening He returned to Akrūra-tīrtha, where He took His meal.
text:
> ei-raṅge sei-dina tathā goṅāilā
> sandhyā-kāle akrūre āsi' bhikṣā nirvāhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in this amusement; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---that day; [[synonyms:t:tathā]] [[synonyms:g:goṅāilā]]---passed the day there; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the evening; [[synonyms:a:akrūre]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---returning to Akrūra-tīrtha; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:n:nirvāhilā]]---took His meal.
translation: Being thus transcendentally amused, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed that day happily at Keśī-tīrtha. In the evening He returned to Akrūra-tīrtha, where He took His meal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.75
description: The next morning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Vṛndāvana and took His bath at Cīra-ghāṭa. He then went to Teṅtulī-talā, where He took rest.
text:
> prāte vṛndāvane kailā 'cīra-ghāṭe' snāna
> teṅtulī-talāte āsi' karilā viśrāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prāte]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:c:cīra]]-[[synonyms:g:ghāṭe]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bathing at Cīra-ghāṭa; [[synonyms:t:teṅtulī]]-[[synonyms:t:talāte]]---underneath the Teṅtulī tree; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---took rest.
translation: The next morning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Vṛndāvana and took His bath at Cīra-ghāṭa. He then went to Teṅtulī-talā, where He took rest.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.76
description: The tamarind tree named Teṅtulī-talā was very old, having been there since the time of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes. Beneath the tree was a very shiny platform.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-līlā-kālera sei vṛkṣa purātana
> tāra tale piṅḍi-bāndhā parama-cikkaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:k:kālera]]---of the time of Lord Kṛṣṇa's presence; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]---that tamarind tree; [[synonyms:p:purātana]]---very old; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath that tree; [[synonyms:p:piṅḍi]]-[[synonyms:b:bāndhā]]---a platform; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:c:cikkaṇa]]---very shiny.
translation: The tamarind tree named Teṅtulī-talā was very old, having been there since the time of Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes. Beneath the tree was a very shiny platform.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.77
description: Since the River Yamunā flowed near Teṅtulī-talā, a very cool breeze blew there. While there, the Lord saw the beauty of Vṛndāvana and the water of the River Yamunā.
text:
> nikaṭe yamunā vahe śītala samīra
> vṛndāvana-śobhā dekhe yamunāra nīra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---near the Teṅtulī-talā, or Āmli-talā; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]]---the Yamunā; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---flows; [[synonyms:ś:śītala]] [[synonyms:s:samīra]]---very cool breeze; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:ś:śobhā]]---the beauty of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:y:yamunāra]]---of the River Yamunā; [[synonyms:n:nīra]]---water.
translation: Since the River Yamunā flowed near Teṅtulī-talā, a very cool breeze blew there. While there, the Lord saw the beauty of Vṛndāvana and the water of the River Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.78
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to sit beneath the old tamarind tree and chant the holy name of the Lord. At noon He would return to Akrūra-tīrtha to take lunch.
text:
> teṅtula-tale vasi' kare nāma-saṅkīrtana
> madhyāhna kari' āsi' kare 'akrūre' bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅtula]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath the tamarind tree; [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting down; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---at noon; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming back; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:a:akrūre]]---at Akrūra-tīrtha; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---taking lunch.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu used to sit beneath the old tamarind tree and chant the holy name of the Lord. At noon He would return to Akrūra-tīrtha to take lunch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.79
description: All the people who lived near Akrūra-tīrtha came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and due to the large crowds, the Lord could not peacefully chant the holy name.
text:
> akrūrera loka āise prabhure dekhite
> loka-bhiḍe svacchande nāre 'kīrtana' karite
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:akrūrera]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---the people at Akrūra-tīrtha; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:b:bhiḍe]]---because of such a crowd of people; [[synonyms:s:svacchande]]---without disturbance; [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---was not able; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to perform //kīrtana.//
translation: All the people who lived near Akrūra-tīrtha came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and due to the large crowds, the Lord could not peacefully chant the holy name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.8
description: " 'Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is most dear to Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Her lake known as Rādhā-kuṇḍa is also very dear to Him. Of all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is certainly the most beloved.'
text:
> yathā rādhā priyā viṣṇos
> tasyāḥ kuṇḍaṁ priyaṁ tathā
> sarva-gopīṣu saivaikā
> viṣṇor atyanta-vallabhā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:priyā]]---beloved; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇoḥ]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tasyāḥ]]---Her; [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍam]]---lake; [[synonyms:p:priyam]]---very dear; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---similarly; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:g:gopīṣu]]---among all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---She; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---alone; [[synonyms:v:viṣṇoḥ]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]---very much; [[synonyms:v:vallabhā]]---dear.
translation: “ 'Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is most dear to Lord Kṛṣṇa, and Her lake known as Rādhā-kuṇḍa is also very dear to Him. Of all the gopīs, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is certainly the most beloved.'
purport: This is a verse from the //Padma Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.80
description: Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to Vṛndāvana and sit in a solitary place. It was there that He chanted the holy name until noon.
text:
> vṛndāvane āsi' prabhu vasiyā ekānta
> nāma-saṅkīrtana kare madhyāhna-paryanta
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasiyā]]---sitting; [[synonyms:e:ekānta]]---in a solitary place; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs chanting of the holy name; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]]-[[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---until noon.
translation: Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to Vṛndāvana and sit in a solitary place. It was there that He chanted the holy name until noon.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.81
description: In the afternoon, people were able to speak to Him. The Lord told everyone of the importance of chanting the holy name.
text:
> tṛtīya-prahare loka pāya daraśana
> sabāre upadeśa kare 'nāma-saṅkīrtana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]]-[[synonyms:p:prahare]]---in the afternoon; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:p:pāya]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---get an interview; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto everyone; [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---instructs; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of the Lord.
translation: In the afternoon, people were able to speak to Him. The Lord told everyone of the importance of chanting the holy name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.82
description: During this time, a Vaiṣṇava named Kṛṣṇadāsa came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He was a householder belonging to the kṣatriya caste, and his house was located on the other side of the Yamunā.
text:
> hena-kāle āila vaiṣṇava 'kṛṣṇadāsa' nāma
> rājaputa-jāti,---gṛhastha, yamunā-pāre grāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---a devotee; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---of the name Kṛṣṇadāsa; [[synonyms:r:rājaputa]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---belonging to the //kṣatriya// class; [[synonyms:g:gṛhastha]]---householder; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]]-[[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:g:grāma]]---his residence on the other side of the Yamunā.
translation: During this time, a Vaiṣṇava named Kṛṣṇadāsa came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He was a householder belonging to the kṣatriya caste, and his house was located on the other side of the Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.83
description: After bathing at Keśī-tīrtha, Kṛṣṇadāsa went toward Kālīya-daha and suddenly saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sitting at Āmli-talā [Teṅtulī-talā].
text:
> 'keśī' snāna kari' sei 'kālīya-daha' yāite
> āmli-talāya gosāñire dekhe ācambite
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keśī]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after taking his bath at the place known as Keśī-tīrtha; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that person; [[synonyms:k:kālīya]]-[[synonyms:d:daha]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---going to the Kālīya-daha; [[synonyms:ā:āmli]]-[[synonyms:t:talāya]]---at the place known as Āmli-talā; [[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly.
translation: After bathing at Keśī-tīrtha, Kṛṣṇadāsa went toward Kālīya-daha and suddenly saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sitting at Āmli-talā [Teṅtulī-talā].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.84
description: Upon seeing the Lord's personal beauty and ecstatic love, Kṛṣṇadāsa was very astonished. Out of ecstatic love, he offered his respectful obeisances unto the Lord.
text:
> prabhura rūpa-prema dekhi' ha-ila camatkāra
> premāveśe prabhure karena namaskāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---personal beauty and ecstatic love; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---became astonished; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---offers obeisances.
translation: Upon seeing the Lord's personal beauty and ecstatic love, Kṛṣṇadāsa was very astonished. Out of ecstatic love, he offered his respectful obeisances unto the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.85
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Kṛṣṇadāsa, "Who are you? Where is your home?" Kṛṣṇadāsa replied, "I am a most fallen householder.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---ke tumi, kāhāṅ tomāra ghara?
> kṛṣṇadāsa kahe,---mui gṛhastha pāmara
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord inquired; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---who are you; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---residence; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Kṛṣṇadāsa replied; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:g:gṛhastha]]---householder; [[synonyms:p:pāmara]]---most fallen.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked Kṛṣṇadāsa, "Who are you? Where is your home?" Kṛṣṇadāsa replied, "I am a most fallen householder.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.86
description: "I belong to the Rājaputa caste, and my home is just on the other side of the River Yamunā. However, I wish to be the servant of a Vaiṣṇava.
text:
> rājaputa-jāti muñi, o-pāre mora ghara
> mora icchā haya---'haṅa vaiṣṇava-kiṅkara'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājaputa]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---belong to the Rājaputa caste; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:o:o]]-[[synonyms:p:pāre]]---on the other side of the Yamunā; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---my residence; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---I wish; [[synonyms:h:haṅa]]---to become; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:k:kiṅkara]]---the servant of a Vaiṣṇava.
translation: "I belong to the Rājaputa caste, and my home is just on the other side of the River Yamunā. However, I wish to be the servant of a Vaiṣṇava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.87
description: "Today I have had a dream, and according to that dream I have come here and found You."
text:
> kintu āji eka muñi 'svapna' dekhinu
> sei svapna parateka tomā āsi' pāinu
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kintu]]---but; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:svapna]]---dream; [[synonyms:d:dekhinu]]---saw; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:svapna]]---that dream; [[synonyms:p:parateka]]---according to; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---You; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---I have gotten.
translation: "Today I have had a dream, and according to that dream I have come here and found You."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.88
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then bestowed upon Kṛṣṇadāsa His causeless mercy by embracing him. Kṛṣṇadāsa became mad with ecstatic love and began to dance and chant the holy name of Hari.
text:
> prabhu tāṅre kṛpā kailā āliṅgana kari
> preme matta haila sei nāce, bale 'hari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---bestowed His mercy; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---embracing; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:matta]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became mad; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that Kṛṣṇadāsa; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---chants; [[synonyms:h:hari]]---the holy name of the Lord.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then bestowed upon Kṛṣṇadāsa His causeless mercy by embracing him. Kṛṣṇadāsa became mad with ecstatic love and began to dance and chant the holy name of Hari.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.89
description: Kṛṣṇadāsa returned to Akrūra-tīrtha with the Lord, and remnants of the Lord's food were given to him.
text:
> prabhu-saṅge madhyāhne akrūra tīrthe āilā
> prabhura avaśiṣṭa-pātra-prasāda pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the Lord; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhne]]---in the afternoon; [[synonyms:a:akrūra]] [[synonyms:t:tīrthe]]---to Akrūra-tīrtha; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:avaśiṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---got.
translation: Kṛṣṇadāsa returned to Akrūra-tīrtha with the Lord, and remnants of the Lord's food were given to him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.9
description: "In that lake, Lord Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī used to sport daily in the water and have a rāsa dance on the bank.
text:
> yei kuṇḍe nitya kṛṣṇa rādhikāra saṅge
> jale jala-keli kare, tīre rāsa-raṅge

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.91

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 18.99
description: At that time Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya placed a request at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He said, "Please give me permission to go see Lord Kṛṣṇa directly."
text:
> bhaṭṭācārya tabe kahe prabhura caraṇe
> 'ājñā deha', yāi' kari kṛṣṇa daraśane!'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give permission; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---I shall see Lord Kṛṣṇa directly.
translation: At that time Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya placed a request at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He said, "Please give me permission to go see Lord Kṛṣṇa directly."
purport: The puzzled people who visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were actually seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa, but they were mistaken in thinking that Lord Kṛṣṇa had come to Kālīya Lake. They all said that they had seen Kṛṣṇa directly performing His pastimes on the hood of the serpent Kālīya and that the jewels on Kālīya's hoods were blazing brilliantly. Because they were speculating with their imperfect knowledge, they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as an ordinary human being and a boatman's light in the lake as Kṛṣṇa. One must see things as they are through the mercy of a spiritual master; otherwise if one tries to see Kṛṣṇa directly, he may mistake an ordinary man for Kṛṣṇa or Kṛṣṇa for an ordinary man. Everyone has to see Kṛṣṇa according to the verdict of Vedic literatures presented by the self-realized spiritual master. A sincere person is able to see Kṛṣṇa through the transparent via medium of Śrī Gurudeva, the spiritual master. Unless one is enlightened by the knowledge given by the spiritual master, he cannot see things as they are, even though he remains constantly with the spiritual master. This incident at Kālīya-daha is very instructive for those eager to advance in Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 19.1
description: Before the creation of this cosmic manifestation, the Lord enlightened the heart of Lord Brahmā with the details of the creation and manifested the Vedic knowledge. In exactly the same way, the Lord, being anxious to revive the Vṛndāvana pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa, impregnated the heart of Rūpa Gosvāmī with spiritual potency. By this potency, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could revive the activities of Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, activities almost lost to memory. In this way, He spread Kṛṣṇa consciousness throughout the world.

In exactly the same way, the Lord, being anxious to revive the Vṛndāvana pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa, impregnated the heart of Rūpa Gosvāmī with spiritual potency. By this potency, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī could revive the activities of Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana, activities almost lost to memory. In this way, He spread Kṛṣṇa consciousness throughout the world.
