translation: Hundreds and thousands of people came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There was no counting the number. Because the Lord's residence was very small, not everyone could see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.175
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to take His bath in the Ganges and to see the temple of Viśveśvara, people would line up on both sides to see the Lord.
text:
> prabhu yabe snāne yāna viśveśvara-daraśane
> dui-dike loka kare prabhu-vilokane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:s:snāne]] [[synonyms:y:yāna]]---goes to bathe; [[synonyms:v:viśveśvara]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---or to see the Deity of Lord Viśveśvara; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on two sides; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all the people; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:v:vilokane]]---seeing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to take His bath in the Ganges and to see the temple of Viśveśvara, people would line up on both sides to see the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.176
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed by the people, He would raise His arms and say, "Please chant Kṛṣṇa! Please chant Hari!" All the people received Him by chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa, and they offered their respects to Him by this chanting.
text:
> bāhu tuli' prabhu kahe-bala 'kṛṣṇa' 'hari'
> daṇḍavat kare loke hari-dhvani kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhu]] [[synonyms:t:tuli']]---raising His two arms; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu says; [[synonyms:b:bala]]---please say; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Kṛṣṇa, Hari; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:v:vat]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---offer their respects; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---the people; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---loudly chanting the name of Hari.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed by the people, He would raise His arms and say, "Please chant Kṛṣṇa! Please chant Hari!" All the people received Him by chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa, and they offered their respects to Him by this chanting.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.177
description: In this way, for five days, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the people of Vārāṇasī. Finally, on the next day, He became very eager to leave.
text:
> ei-mata dina pañca loka nistāriyā
> āra dina calilā prabhu udvigna hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:p:pañca]]---five days; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---the people; [[synonyms:n:nistāriyā]]---delivering; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---on the next day; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:udvigna]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very eager.
translation: In this way, for five days, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the people of Vārāṇasī. Finally, on the next day, He became very eager to leave.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.178
description: After rising very early on the sixth day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started to leave, and five devotees began to follow Him.
text:
> rātre uṭhi' prabhu yadi karilā gamana
> pāche lāg la-ilā tabe bhakta pañca jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātre]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---rising at night; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---departed; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---behind Him; [[synonyms:l:lāg]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---began to follow; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:p:pañca]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---five devotees.
translation: After rising very early on the sixth day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started to leave, and five devotees began to follow Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.179
description: These five devotees were Tapana Miśra, Raghunātha, the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa, Candraśekhara and Paramānanda Kīrtanīyā.
text:
> tapana miśra, raghunātha, mahārāṣṭrīya brāhmaṇa
> candraśekhara, kīrtanīyā-paramānanda,-pañca jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tapana]] [[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha; [[synonyms:m:mahārāṣṭrīya]] [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---the Mahārāṣṭrian //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:c:candraśekhara]]---Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:k:kīrtanīyā]]-[[synonyms:p:paramānanda]]---Paramānanda, who used to perform //kīrtana//; [[synonyms:p:pañca]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---these five persons.
translation: These five devotees were Tapana Miśra, Raghunātha, the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa, Candraśekhara and Paramānanda Kīrtanīyā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.18
description: Beginning from the day on which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed His mercy to the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs, there were vivid discussions about this conversion among the inhabitants of Vārāṇasī.
text:
> ye divasa prabhu sannyāsīre kṛpā kaila
> se divasa haite grāme kolāhala haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:d:divasa]]---the day when; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīre]]---to the Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---showed His mercy; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:d:divasa]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---beginning from that day; [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---in the locality; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there were many talks about this incident.
translation: Beginning from the day on which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed His mercy to the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs, there were vivid discussions about this conversion among the inhabitants of Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.180
description: These five wanted to accompany Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī, but the Lord attentively bade them farewell.
text:
> sabe cāhe prabhu-saṅge nīlācala yāite
> sabāre vidāya dilā prabhu yatna-sahite
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---every one of them wanted; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---to all of them; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bade farewell; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yatna]]-[[synonyms:s:sahite]]---with great attention.
translation: These five wanted to accompany Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to Jagannātha Purī, but the Lord attentively bade them farewell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.181
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you want to see Me, you may come later, but for the time being I shall go alone through the Jhārikhaṇḍa forest."
text:
> "yāṅra icchā, pāche āisa āmāre dekhite
> ebe āmi ekā yāmu jhārikhaṇḍa-pathe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of one who; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---there is a desire; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:ā:āisa]]---you may come; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Me; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---but at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---alone; [[synonyms:y:yāmu]]---shall go; [[synonyms:j:jhārikhaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---through the forest known as Jhārikhaṇḍa.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you want to see Me, you may come later, but for the time being I shall go alone through the Jhārikhaṇḍa forest."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.182
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised Sanātana Gosvāmī to proceed toward Vṛndāvana, and He informed him that his two brothers had already gone there.
text:
> sanātane kahilā,-tumi yāha' vṛndāvana
> tomāra dui bhāi tathā kariyāche gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātane]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he advised Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:yāha']] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---two brothers; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:k:kariyāche]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---have already gone.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised Sanātana Gosvāmī to proceed toward Vṛndāvana, and He informed him that his two brothers had already gone there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.183
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "All My devotees who go to Vṛndāvana are generally very poor. They each have nothing with them but a torn quilt and a small waterpot. Therefore, Sanātana, you should give them shelter and maintain them."
text:
> kāṅthā-karaṅgiyā mora kāṅgāla bhakta-gaṇa
> vṛndāvane āile tāṅdera kariha pālana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāṅthā]]---torn quilt; [[synonyms:k:karaṅgiyā]]---a small waterpot; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kāṅgāla]]---poor; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]] [[synonyms:ā:āile]]---when they come to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāṅdera]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:k:kariha]] [[synonyms:p:pālana]]---take care.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "All My devotees who go to Vṛndāvana are generally very poor. They each have nothing with them but a torn quilt and a small waterpot. Therefore, Sanātana, you should give them shelter and maintain them."
purport: Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, we have constructed temples both in Vṛndāvana and Māyāpur, Navadvīpa, just to give shelter to the foreign devotees coming from Europe and America. Since the Hare Kṛṣṇa movement started, many Europeans and Americans have been visiting Vṛndāvana, but they have not been properly received by any //āśrama// or temple there. It is the purpose of the International Society for Krishna Consciousness to give them shelter and train them in devotional service. There are also many tourists eager to come to India to understand India's spiritual life, and the devotees in our temples both in Vṛndāvana and in Navadvīpa should make arrangements to accommodate them as far as possible.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.184
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and began to proceed on His way, and they all fainted and fell down.
text:
> eta bali' calilā prabhu sabā āliṅgiyā
> sabei paḍilā tathā mūrcchita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---began to proceed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]---all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgiyā]]---embracing; [[synonyms:s:sabei]]---all of them; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:m:mūrcchita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---fainting.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and began to proceed on His way, and they all fainted and fell down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.185
description: After some time, all the devotees got up and returned to their homes very much grief-stricken. Sanātana Gosvāmī proceeded toward Vṛndāvana alone.
text:
> kata-kṣaṇe uṭhi' sabe duḥkhe ghare āilā
> sanātana-gosāñi vṛndāvanere calilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---after some time; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---rising; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---in great unhappiness; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned to their homes; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanere]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---proceeded toward Vṛndāvana.
translation: After some time, all the devotees got up and returned to their homes very much grief-stricken. Sanātana Gosvāmī proceeded toward Vṛndāvana alone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.186
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī reached Mathurā, he met Subuddhi Rāya on the banks of the Yamunā at a place called Dhruva-ghāṭa.
text:
> ethā rūpa-gosāñi yabe mathurā āilā
> dhruva-ghāṭe tāṅre subuddhi-rāya mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---there; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Mathurā; [[synonyms:d:dhruva]]-[[synonyms:g:ghāṭe]]---at the bank of the Yamunā known as Dhruva-ghāṭa; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---a devotee of Lord Caitanya named Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī reached Mathurā, he met Subuddhi Rāya on the banks of the Yamunā at a place called Dhruva-ghāṭa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.187
description: Formerly Subuddhi Rāya had been a big landholder in Gauḍa-deśa [Bengal]. Saiyada Hussain Khān was then a servant of Subuddhi Rāya.
text:
> pūrve yabe subuddhi-rāya chilā gauḍe 'adhikāri'
> husena-khāṅ 'saiyada' kare tāhāra cākarī
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:c:chilā]]---resided; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:a:adhikārī]]---a very respectable man; [[synonyms:h:husena]]-[[synonyms:k:khāṅ]]---Nawab Hussain Khān; [[synonyms:s:saiyada]]---named Saiyada; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performed; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]] [[synonyms:c:cākarī]]---service of Subuddhi Rāya.
translation: Formerly Subuddhi Rāya had been a big landholder in Gauḍa-deśa [Bengal]. Saiyada Hussain Khān was then a servant of Subuddhi Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.188
description: Subuddhi Rāya put Hussain Khān in charge of digging a big lake, but, once, finding fault with him, he struck him with a whip.
text:
> dīghi khodāite tāre 'munsīpha' kailā
> chidra pāñā rāya tāre cābuka mārilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dīghi]] [[synonyms:k:khodāite]]---to dig a big lake; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---Hussain Khān; [[synonyms:m:munsīpha]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---appointed as the supervisor; [[synonyms:c:chidra]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---finding some fault; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:c:cābuka]] [[synonyms:m:mārilā]]---whipped.
translation: Subuddhi Rāya put Hussain Khān in charge of digging a big lake, but, once, finding fault with him, he struck him with a whip.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.189
description: Later Hussain Khān somehow or other was appointed Nawab by the central Mohammedan government. As a matter of obligation, he increased the opulences of Subuddhi Rāya.
text:
> pāche yabe husena-khāṅ gauḍe 'rājā' ha-ila
> subuddhi-rāyere tiṅho bahu bāḍāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:h:husena]]-[[synonyms:k:khāṅ]]---Hussain Khān; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was appointed Nawab, or governor, by the central Mohammedan government; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāyere]]---unto Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:t:tiṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍāila]]---increased the opulences.
translation: Later Hussain Khān somehow or other was appointed Nawab by the central Mohammedan government. As a matter of obligation, he increased the opulences of Subuddhi Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.19
description: Crowds of people came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from that day on, and scholars of various scriptures discussed different subject matters with the Lord.
text:
> lokera saṅghaṭṭa āise prabhure dekhite
> nānā śāstre paṇḍita āise śāstra vicārite
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lokera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅghaṭṭa]]---crowds of men; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---come; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:ś:śāstre]] [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---scholars learned in various scriptures; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---used to come; [[synonyms:ś:śāstra]] [[synonyms:v:vicārite]]---to talk on various scriptures.
translation: Crowds of people came to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from that day on, and scholars of various scriptures discussed different subject matters with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.190
description: Later, when the wife of Nawab Saiyada Hussain Khān saw the whip marks on his body, she requested him to kill Subuddhi Rāya.
text:
> tāra strī tāra aṅge dekhe māraṇera cihne
> subuddhi-rāyere mārite kahe rājā-sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:strī]]---his wife; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on his body; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:m:māraṇera]] [[synonyms:c:cihne]]---the mark of the whip; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāyere]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:m:mārite]]---to kill; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in the presence of the King.
translation: Later, when the wife of Nawab Saiyada Hussain Khān saw the whip marks on his body, she requested him to kill Subuddhi Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.191
description: Hussain Khān replied, "Subuddhi Rāya has maintained me very carefully. He was just like a father to me," he said. "Now you are asking me to kill him. This is not a very good proposal."
text:
> rājā kahe,-āmāra poṣṭā rāya haya 'pitā'
> tāhāre mārimu āmi,-bhāla nahe kathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King said; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:p:poṣṭā]]---maintainer; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---just like my father; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]] [[synonyms:m:mārimu]]---shall kill him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---this is not a good proposal.
translation: Hussain Khān replied, "Subuddhi Rāya has maintained me very carefully. He was just like a father to me," he said. "Now you are asking me to kill him. This is not a very good proposal."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.192
description: As a last alternative, the wife suggested that the Nawab take away Subuddhi Rāya's caste and turn him into a Mohammedan, but Hussain Khān replied that if he did this, Subuddhi Rāya would not live.
text:
> strī kahe,-jāti laha', yadi prāṇe nā māribe
> rājā kahe,-jāti nile iṅho nāhi jībe
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:strī]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the wife replied; [[synonyms:j:jāti]] [[synonyms:l:laha']]---then take his caste; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:p:prāṇe]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:m:māribe]]---you will not kill him; [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King replied; [[synonyms:j:jāti]] [[synonyms:n:nile]]---if I take his caste; [[synonyms:i:iṅho]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jībe]]---he will not live (he will commit suicide).
translation: As a last alternative, the wife suggested that the Nawab take away Subuddhi Rāya's caste and turn him into a Mohammedan, but Hussain Khān replied that if he did this, Subuddhi Rāya would not live.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.193
description: This became a perplexing problem for him because his wife kept requesting him to kill Subuddhi Rāya. Finally the Nawab sprinkled a little water on Subuddhi Rāya's head from a pitcher that had been used by a Mohammedan.
text:
> strī marite cāhe, rājā saṅkaṭe paḍila
> karoṅyāra pāni tāra mukhe deoyāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:strī]]---the wife; [[synonyms:m:marite]] [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants to kill Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:s:saṅkaṭe]] [[synonyms:p:paḍila]]---became very perplexed; [[synonyms:k:karoṅyāra]] [[synonyms:p:pāni]]---water from a pitcher especially used by Mohammedans; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---on his head; [[synonyms:d:deoyāila]]---forced to be sprinkled.
translation: This became a perplexing problem for him because his wife kept requesting him to kill Subuddhi Rāya. Finally the Nawab sprinkled a little water on Subuddhi Rāya's head from a pitcher that had been used by a Mohammedan.
purport:
More than five hundred years ago in India, the Hindus were so rigid and strict that if a Mohammedan would sprinkle a little water from his pitcher upon a Hindu, the Hindu would be immediately ostracized. Recently, in 1947, during the partition days, there was a big riot between Hindus and Muslims, especially in Bengal. The Hindus were forcibly made to eat cow's flesh, and consequently they began crying, thinking that they had become Mohammedans. Actually the Mohammedans in India did not come from the country of the Mohammedans, but Hindus instituted the custom that somehow or other if one contacted a Mohammedan, he became a Mohammedan. Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmī were born in a high //brāhmaṇa// family, but because they accepted employment under a Mohammedan government, they were considered Mohammedans. Subuddhi Rāya was sprinkled with water from the pitcher of a Mohammedan, and consequently he was condemned to have become a Mohammedan. Later, Aurangzeb, the Mohammedan emperor, introduced a tax especially meant for Hindus. Being oppressed in the Hindu community, many low-caste Hindus preferred to become Mohammedans. In this way the Mohammedan population increased. Later the British government made it a policy to divide the Hindus and the Muslims, and thus they maintained ill feelings between them. The result was that India was divided into Pakistan and Hindustan.

From early histories it appears that the entire earth was under one culture, Vedic culture, but gradually, due to religious and cultural divisions, the rule fragmented into many subdivisions. Now the earth is divided into many countries, religions and political parties. Despite these political and religious divisions, we advocate that everyone should unite again under one culture-Kṛṣṇa consciousness. People should accept one God, Kṛṣṇa; one scripture, //Bhagavad-gītā;// and one activity, devotional service to the Lord. Thus people may live happily upon this earth and combine to produce sufficient food. In such a society, there would be no question of scarcity, famine, or cultural or religious degradation. So-called caste systems and national divisions are artificial. According to our Vaiṣṇava philosophy, these are all external bodily designations. The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is not based upon bodily designations. It is a transcendental movement on the platform of spiritual understanding. If the people of the world understood that the basic principle of life is spiritual identification, they would understand that the business of the spirit soul is to serve the Supreme Spirit, Kṛṣṇa. As Lord Kṛṣṇa says in //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:15:7|(Bg. 15.7)]], //mamaivāṁśo jīva-loke jīva-bhūtaḥ sanātanaḥ:// "The living entities in this conditioned world are My eternal, fragmental parts." All living entities in different life forms are sons of Kṛṣṇa. Therefore they are all meant to serve Kṛṣṇa, the original supreme father. If this philosophy is accepted, the failure of the United Nations to unite all nations will be sufficiently compensated all over the world by a great Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. Recently we had talks with Christian leaders in Australia, including the Bishop of Australia, and everyone there was pleased with our philosophy of oneness in religious consciousness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.194
description: Taking the Nawab's sprinkling water upon him as an opportunity, Subuddhi Rāya left his family and business affairs and went to Vārāṇasī.
text:
> tabe subuddhi-rāya sei 'chadma' pāñā
> vārāṇasī āilā, saba viṣaya chādiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---upon this; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:c:chadma]]---plea; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting an opportunity; [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:c:chādiyā]]---giving up the implications of material activities.
translation: Taking the Nawab's sprinkling water upon him as an opportunity, Subuddhi Rāya left his family and business affairs and went to Vārāṇasī.
purport: It appears that Subuddhi Rāya was a big landholder and a responsible, respectable gentleman. He could not, however, avoid the social misconception that one becomes a Mohammedan when water is sprinkled on one's face from a Mohammedan's pitcher. Actually he was planning to give up his material life and leave his family. Hindu culture recommends four divisions-//brahmacarya, gṛhastha, vānaprastha// and //sannyāsa.// Subuddhi Rāya was thinking of taking //sannyāsa,// and by the grace of Kṛṣṇa, he received this opportunity. He therefore left his family and went to Vārāṇasī. The system of //varṇāśrama-dharma// is very scientific. If one is directed by the //varṇāśrama// institution, he will naturally think of retiring from family life at the end of his life. Therefore //sannyāsa// is compulsory at the age of fifty.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.195
description: When Subuddhi Rāya consulted the learned brāhmaṇas at Vārāṇasī, asking them how his conversion to Mohammedanism could be counteracted, they advised him to drink hot ghee and give up his life.
text:
> prāyaścitta puchilā tiṅho paṇḍitera gaṇe
> tāṅrā kahe,-tapta-ghṛta khāñā chāḍa' prāṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prāyaścitta]]---atonement; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired; [[synonyms:t:tiṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---among the learned scholars or //brāhmaṇa-paṇḍitas// in Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅrā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---they advised; [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:g:ghṛta]]---hot clarified butter; [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---drinking; [[synonyms:c:chāḍa']]---give up; [[synonyms:p:prāṇe]]---your life.
translation: When Subuddhi Rāya consulted the learned brāhmaṇas at Vārāṇasī, asking them how his conversion to Mohammedanism could be counteracted, they advised him to drink hot ghee and give up his life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.196
description: When Subuddhi Rāya consulted some other brāhmaṇas, they told him that he had not committed a grievous fault and that consequently he should not drink hot ghee and give up his life. As a result, Subuddhi Rāya was doubtful about what to do.
text:
> keha kahe,-ei nahe, 'alpa' doṣa haya
> śuniyā rahilā rāya kariyā saṁśaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---some of the learned //brāhmaṇas// said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---not; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---insignificant; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making; [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---doubt.
translation: When Subuddhi Rāya consulted some other brāhmaṇas, they told him that he had not committed a grievous fault and that consequently he should not drink hot ghee and give up his life. As a result, Subuddhi Rāya was doubtful about what to do.
purport: This is another instance of Hindu custom. One //brāhmaṇa// would give advice condoning a particular fault, and another would give advice to the contrary. Typically, lawyers and physicians differ, giving one kind of instruction and then another. Due to the //brāhmaṇas'// different opinions, Subuddhi Rāya became further perplexed. He did not know what to do or what not to do.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.197
description: In his state of perplexity, Subuddhi Rāya met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when the Lord was at Vārāṇasī. Subuddhi Rāya explained his position and asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu what he should do.
text:
> tabe yadi mahāprabhu vārāṇasī āilā
> tāṅre mili' rāya āpana-vṛttānta kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at this moment; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:m:mili']]---meeting Him; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛttānta]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---explained his personal situation.
translation: In his state of perplexity, Subuddhi Rāya met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when the Lord was at Vārāṇasī. Subuddhi Rāya explained his position and asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu what he should do.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.198
description: The Lord advised him, "Go to Vṛndāvana and chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra constantly."
text:
> prabhu kahe,-ihāṅ haite yāha' vṛndāvana
> nirantara kara kṛṣṇa-nāma-saṅkīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord advised; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from this place; [[synonyms:y:yāha']] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---incessantly; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---perform; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: The Lord advised him, "Go to Vṛndāvana and chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra constantly."
purport: This is a solution to all sinful activities. In this Age of Kali everyone is perplexed by so many inconveniences-social, political and religious-and naturally no one is happy. Due to the contamination of this age, everyone has a very short life. There are many fools and rascals who advise people to adopt this way of life or that way of life, but real liberation from life's perplexities means preparation for the next life. //Tathā dehāntara-prāptir dhīras tatra na muhyati.// One should be situated in his spiritual identity and return home, back to Godhead. The simplest method for this is recommended herein by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. We should constantly chant the holy names of the Lord, the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra.// Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is recommending this process all over the world. We are saying, "Chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra,// be freed from all the complexities of life and realize Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Engage in His devotional service and perfect your life so that you can return home, back to Godhead."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.199
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu further advised Subuddhi Rāya: "Begin chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, and when your chanting is almost pure, all your sinful reactions will go away. After you chant perfectly, you will get shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> eka 'nāmābhāse' tomāra pāpa-doṣa yābe
> āra 'nāma' la-ite kṛṣṇa-caraṇa pāibe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāse]]---by a reflection of the pure chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra//; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:p:pāpa]]-[[synonyms:d:doṣa]] [[synonyms:y:yābe]]---all the sinful reactions will go away; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---then again; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---after chanting purely the name of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:p:pāibe]]---you will get shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu further advised Subuddhi Rāya: "Begin chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra, and when your chanting is almost pure, all your sinful reactions will go away. After you chant perfectly, you will get shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
purport: The ten kinds of offenses should be considered. In the beginning, when one is initiated into the chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra,// there are naturally many offenses. However, the devotee should be very careful to avoid these offenses and chant purely. This does not mean that the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra// is sometimes pure and sometimes impure. Rather, the chanter is impure due to material contamination. He has to purify himself so that the holy names will be perfectly effective. Chanting the holy name of the Lord inoffensively will help one get immediate shelter at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. This means that by chanting purely, one will immediately be situated on the transcendental platform. We should note, however, that according to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's instructions, one should not wait to purify himself before chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra.// Whatever our condition may be, we should begin chanting immediately. By the power of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra,// we will gradually be relieved from all material contamination and will get shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, the ultimate goal of life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.2
description: All glories to Lord Caitanya! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Lord Caitanya! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.20
description: When people came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to discuss the principles of various scriptures, the Lord defeated their false conclusions and established the predominance of devotional service to the Lord. With logic and argument He very politely changed their minds.
text:
> sarva-śāstra khaṇḍi' prabhu 'bhakti' kare sāra
> sayuktika vākye mana phirāya sabāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstra]] [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍi']]---defeating all the false conclusions of different scriptures; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---established the predominance of devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:y:yuktika]] [[synonyms:v:vākye]]---by talks full of pleasing logic and arguments; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:p:phirāya]]---turns the minds; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone.
translation: When people came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to discuss the principles of various scriptures, the Lord defeated their false conclusions and established the predominance of devotional service to the Lord. With logic and argument He very politely changed their minds.
purport: We have been spreading this //saṅkīrtana// movement in the Western countries, and in our recent tour of European cities like Rome, Geneva, Paris and Frankfurt, many learned Christian scholars, priests, philosophers and //yogīs// came to see us, and by the grace of Kṛṣṇa they agreed that this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement, the //bhakti// cult, offers the topmost conclusion. Following in the footsteps of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, we are trying to convince everyone that the devotional service of the Lord is enjoined in every scripture. If a person is religious, he must accept the supreme authority of the Lord, become His devotee and try to love Him. This is the real principle of religion. It does not matter whether one is Christian, Mohammedan or whatever. He simply must accept the sublime position of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and render service unto Him. It is not a question of being Christian, Mohammedan or Hindu. One should be purely religious and freed from all these material designations. In this way one can learn the art of devotional service. This argument appeals to all intelligent men, and consequently this Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is gaining ground throughout the world. Due to our solid logic and scientific presentation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's prediction that Kṛṣṇa consciousness will spread in every town and village throughout the world is gradually being realized.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.200
description: "When you are situated at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, no sinful reaction can touch you. This is the best solution to all sinful activity."
text:
> āra kṛṣṇa-nāma laite kṛṣṇa-sthāne sthiti-
> mahā-pātakera haya ei prāyaścitti
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---further; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra; [[synonyms:l:laite]]---continuously chanting; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]] [[synonyms:s:sthiti]]---being situated in company with Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:pātakera]]---of all kinds of sinful activity; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prāyaścitti]]---atonement.
translation: "When you are situated at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, no sinful reaction can touch you. This is the best solution to all sinful activity."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.201
description: Thus receiving the order from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to go to Vṛndāvana, Subuddhi Rāya left Vārāṇasī and went through Prayāga, Ayodhyā and Naimiṣāraṇya toward Vṛndāvana.
text:
> pāñā ājñā rāya vṛndāvanere calilā
> prayāga, ayodhyā diyā naimiṣāraṇye āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāñā]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---getting this order; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanere]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went toward Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:pra]] [[synonyms:y:yāga]]---Allahabad; [[synonyms:a:ayodhyā]]---Ayodhyā (the kingdom of Lord Rāmacandra); [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---through; [[synonyms:n:naimiṣāraṇye]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Naimiṣāraṇya, (a place near Lucknow).
translation: Thus receiving the order from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to go to Vṛndāvana, Subuddhi Rāya left Vārāṇasī and went through Prayāga, Ayodhyā and Naimiṣāraṇya toward Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.202
description: Subuddhi Rāya stayed for some time at Naimiṣāraṇya. During that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Prayāga after visiting Vṛndāvana.
text:
> kataka divasa rāya naimiṣāraṇye rahilā
> prabhu vṛndāvana haite prayāga yāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kataka]] [[synonyms:d:divasa]]---a few days; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:n:naimiṣāraṇye]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---stayed at Naimiṣāraṇya; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:prayāga]]---to Allahabad; [[synonyms:y:yāilā]]---went.
translation: Subuddhi Rāya stayed for some time at Naimiṣāraṇya. During that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Prayāga after visiting Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.203
description: After reaching Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya received information of the Lord's itinerary. He became very unhappy because he was not able to contact the Lord.
text:
> mathurā āsiyā rāya prabhu-vārtā pāila
> prabhura lāga nā pāñā mane baḍa duḥkha haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---when he came to Mathurā; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:v:vārtā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---got information of the Lord's itinerary; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lāga]]---contact; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---very great; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was.
translation: After reaching Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya received information of the Lord's itinerary. He became very unhappy because he was not able to contact the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.204
description: Subuddhi Rāya would collect dry wood in the forest and take it to the city of Mathurā to sell. For each load he would receive five or six paise.
text:
> śuṣka-kāṣṭha āni' rāya vece mathurāte
> pāṅca chaya paisā haya eka eka bojhāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:k:kāṣṭha]] [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---collecting dry wood from the forest; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:v:vece]]---sells; [[synonyms:m:mathurāte]]---at Mathurā; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]] [[synonyms:c:chaya]]---five or six; [[synonyms:p:paisā]]---paise; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:b:bojhāte]]---in exchange for each load of dry wood.
translation: Subuddhi Rāya would collect dry wood in the forest and take it to the city of Mathurā to sell. For each load he would receive five or six paise.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.205
description: Earning his livelihood by selling dry wood, Subuddhi Rāya would live on only one paise's worth of fried chick-peas, and he would deposit whatever other paises he had with some merchant.
text:
> āpane rahe eka paisāra cānā cābāiyā
> āra paisā bāṇiyā-sthāne rākhena dhariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---lives; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:p:paisāra]]---of one paisa's worth; [[synonyms:c:cānā]]---fried chick-peas; [[synonyms:c:cābāiyā]]---chewing; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---the balance; [[synonyms:p:paisā]]---four or five paise; [[synonyms:b:bāṇiyā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in the custody of a merchant; [[synonyms:r:rākhena]]---keeps; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---depositing.
translation: Earning his livelihood by selling dry wood, Subuddhi Rāya would live on only one paise's worth of fried chick-peas, and he would deposit whatever other paises he had with some merchant.
purport: In those days there was no banking system like the one now found in Western countries. If one had excess money, he would deposit it with some merchant, usually a grocer. That was the banking system. Subuddhi Rāya would deposit his extra money with a mercantile man and spend it when necessary. When one is in the renounced order, saving money is not recommended. However, if one saves money for the service of the Lord or a Vaiṣṇava, that is accepted. These are the dealings of Subuddhi Rāya, who is one of the confidential devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also followed this principle by spending fifty percent of his money in order to serve Kṛṣṇa through //brāhmaṇas// and Vaiṣṇavas. He gave twenty-five percent of his money to relatives, and twenty-five percent he deposited in the custody of a merchant. These are the approved methods recommended in //Caitanya-caritāmṛta.// Whether in the renounced order or in the //gṛhastha// order, a Vaiṣṇava should follow these principles set forth by the previous //ācāryas.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.206
description: Subuddhi Rāya used to spend his savings to supply yogurt to Bengali Vaiṣṇavas who came to Mathurā. He also gave them cooked rice and oil massages. When he saw a poverty-stricken Vaiṣṇava, he would use his money to feed him.
text:
> duḥkhī vaiṣṇava dekhi' tāṅre karāna bhojana
> gauḍīyā āile dadhi, bhāta, taila-mardana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---a poverty-stricken Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:k:karāna]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---gives food for eating; [[synonyms:g:gauḍīyā]] [[synonyms:ā:āile]]---when a Bengali Vaiṣṇava came to Mathurā; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---cooked rice; [[synonyms:t:taila]]-[[synonyms:m:mardana]]---massaging mustard oil on the body.
translation: Subuddhi Rāya used to spend his savings to supply yogurt to Bengali Vaiṣṇavas who came to Mathurā. He also gave them cooked rice and oil massages. When he saw a poverty-stricken Vaiṣṇava, he would use his money to feed him.
purport: There is a special reference for the maintenance of Bengali Vaiṣṇavas. A Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava is a Bengali Vaiṣṇava. Most of the devotees of Lord Caitanya at that time were Gauḍīyas and Oriyās, inhabitants of Bengal and Orissa. There are still many hundreds and thousands of disciples in Bengal and Orissa. Bengalis are habituated to eating cooked rice as their staple food. When they went to Mathurā in the North, they found that the people generally ate chapatis or //roṭi// made of wheat. The Bengalis could not digest this food because they were used to cooked rice. Therefore as soon as Subuddhi Rāya saw a Bengali Vaiṣṇava arriving in Mathurā, he would try to supply him with cooked rice. Bengalis are also accustomed to taking a massage with mustard oil. In any case, Subuddhi Rāya wanted to serve the Vaiṣṇavas according to their needs. Therefore he would supply yogurt to ease the digestion of food eaten in Mathurā, particularly the wheat-made chapatis and //roṭi.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.207
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī arrived at Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya, out of love and affection for him, wanted to serve him in so many ways. He personally took Rūpa Gosvāmī to see all the twelve forests of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> rūpa-gosāñi, āile tāṅre bahu prīti kailā
> āpana-saṅge lañā 'dvādaśa vana' dekhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:ā:āile]]---when he came to Mathurā; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:p:prīti]]---love; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---showed; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking Rūpa Gosvāmī personally with him; [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]] [[synonyms:v:vana]]---the twelve forests of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dekhāilā]]---showed.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī arrived at Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya, out of love and affection for him, wanted to serve him in so many ways. He personally took Rūpa Gosvāmī to see all the twelve forests of Vṛndāvana.
purport: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī had been a minister in the government of Hussain Shah, and Subuddhi Rāya was also known to Hussain Shah, because as a boy, he had been Subuddhi Rāya's servant. It appears that Subuddhi Rāya was elderly, yet while he was living in Mathurā he showed Rūpa Gosvāmī the twelve forests of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.208
description: Rūpa Gosvāmī remained in Mathurā and Vṛndāvana for one month in the association of Subuddhi Rāya. After that, he left Vṛndāvana to search for his elder brother, Sanātana Gosvāmī.
text:
> māsa-mātra rūpa-gosāñi rahilā vṛndāvane
> śīghra cali' āilā sanātanānusandhāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:māsa]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only one month; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:c:cali']] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:a:anu]]-[[synonyms:s:sandhāne]]---to search for Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī remained in Mathurā and Vṛndāvana for one month in the association of Subuddhi Rāya. After that, he left Vṛndāvana to search for his elder brother, Sanātana Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.209
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had gone to Prayāga on the road along the banks of the Ganges, both Rūpa and his brother Anupama went that way to meet the Lord.
text:
> gaṅgā-tīra-pathe prabhu prayāgere āilā
> tāhā śuni' dui-bhāi se pathe calilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīra]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the road on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prayāgere]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Prayāga; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this news; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers named Rūpa and Anupama; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---traveled on that path.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had gone to Prayāga on the road along the banks of the Ganges, both Rūpa and his brother Anupama went that way to meet the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.21
description: As soon as people received instructions from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they began to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. Thus everyone laughed, chanted and danced with the Lord.
text:
> upadeśa lañā kare kṛṣṇa-saṅkīrtana
> sarva-loka hāse, gāya, karaye nartana
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---getting instructions from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---join; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---the //saṅkīrtana// movement; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---everyone began to laugh in pleasure; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chant; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---and dance.
translation: As soon as people received instructions from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they began to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra. Thus everyone laughed, chanted and danced with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.210
description: After reaching Prayāga, Sanātana Gosvāmī, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went to Vṛndāvana along the public road.
text:
> ethā sanātana gosāñi prayāge āsiyā
> mathurā āilā sarāna rāja-patha diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here (at the other end); [[synonyms:s:sanātana]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Sanātana Gosāñi; [[synonyms:p:prayāge]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming to Prayāga; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---he reached Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:s:sarāna]]---directly; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:patha]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---on the government road or public road.
translation: After reaching Prayāga, Sanātana Gosvāmī, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went to Vṛndāvana along the public road.
purport: This is especially significant because when Sanātana Gosvāmī went from Bengal to Benares, due to the political situation he did not go along the public road. After meeting Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Benares, however, he was ordered to proceed to Vṛndāvana along the public road leading to Mathurā. In other words, he was advised not to fear for his political situation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.211
description: When Sanātana Gosvāmī met Subuddhi Rāya at Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya explained everything about his younger brothers Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama.
text:
> mathurāte subuddhi-rāya tāhāre mililā
> rūpa-anupama-kathā sakali kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurāte]]---at Mathurā; [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met him; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:a:anupama]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---news about his younger brothers, Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama; [[synonyms:s:sakali]]---everything; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---described.
translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī met Subuddhi Rāya at Mathurā, Subuddhi Rāya explained everything about his younger brothers Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.212
description: Since Sanātana Gosvāmī went along the public road to Vṛndāvana and Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama went on the road along the Ganges banks, it was not possible for them to meet.
text:
> gaṅgā-pathe dui-bhāi rāja-pathe sanātana
> ataeva tāṅhā sane nā haila milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the road on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers Rūpa and Anupama; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the public road; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---because of this; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with him; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---there was not a meeting.
translation: Since Sanātana Gosvāmī went along the public road to Vṛndāvana and Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama went on the road along the Ganges banks, it was not possible for them to meet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.213
description: Subuddhi Rāya and Sanātana Gosvāmī knew one another before accepting the renounced order. Therefore Subuddhi Rāya showed much affection to Sanātana Gosvāmī, but Sanātana Gosvāmī hesitated to accept his sentiments and affections.
text:
> subuddhi-rāya bahu sneha kare sanātane
> vyavahāra-sneha sanātana nāhi māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:subuddhi]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Subuddhi Rāya; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:s:sneha]]---affection; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---unto Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]-[[synonyms:s:sneha]]---love and affection because of a previous relationship; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---was hesitant to accept.
translation: Subuddhi Rāya and Sanātana Gosvāmī knew one another before accepting the renounced order. Therefore Subuddhi Rāya showed much affection to Sanātana Gosvāmī, but Sanātana Gosvāmī hesitated to accept his sentiments and affections.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.214
description: Being very advanced in the renounced order, Sanātana Gosvāmī used to wander from forest to forest, never taking shelter of any habitation built of stone. He used to live under trees or beneath bushes both day and night.
text:
> mahā-virakta sanātana bhramena vane vane
> prati-vṛkṣe, prati-kuñje rahe rātri-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:v:virakta]]---highly elevated in the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhramena]]---wanders; [[synonyms:v:vane]] [[synonyms:v:vane]]---from forest to forest; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---under every tree; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:k:kuñje]]---in every bush; [[synonyms:r:rahe]] [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---remains day and night.
translation: Being very advanced in the renounced order, Sanātana Gosvāmī used to wander from forest to forest, never taking shelter of any habitation built of stone. He used to live under trees or beneath bushes both day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.215
description: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī collected some books about archaeological excavations in Mathurā, and, wandering in the forest, he sought to renovate all those holy places.
text:
> mathurā-māhātmya-śāstra saṅgraha kariyā
> lupta-tīrtha prakaṭa kailā vanete bhramiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]-[[synonyms:m:māhātmya]]---giving a description of the greatness of Mathurā; [[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---books; [[synonyms:s:saṅgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---collecting; [[synonyms:l:lupta]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---lost holy places; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]]---discovering; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---he did; [[synonyms:v:vanete]] [[synonyms:b:bhramiyā]]---traveling within the forest.
translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī collected some books about archaeological excavations in Mathurā, and, wandering in the forest, he sought to renovate all those holy places.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.216
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī remained in Vṛndāvana, and Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama returned to Vārāṇasī.
text:
> ei-mata sanātana vṛndāvanete rahilā
> rūpa-gosāñi dui-bhāi kāśīte āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanete]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers; [[synonyms:k:kāśīte]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Vārāṇasī (Kāśī).
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī remained in Vṛndāvana, and Rūpa Gosvāmī and Anupama returned to Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.217
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī arrived at Vārāṇasī, he met the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa, Candraśekhara and Tapana Miśra.
text:
> mahārāṣṭrīya dvija, śekhara, miśra-tapana
> tina-jana saha rūpa karilā milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahārāṣṭrīya]] [[synonyms:d:dvija]]---the //brāhmaṇa// of Mahārāṣṭra province; [[synonyms:ś:śekhara]]---Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:t:tapana]]---Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---these three persons; [[synonyms:s:saha]]---with; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---met.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī arrived at Vārāṇasī, he met the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa, Candraśekhara and Tapana Miśra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.218
description: While Rūpa Gosvāmī was staying at Vārāṇasī, he resided at the house of Candraśekhara and took prasāda at the house of Tapana Miśra. In this way he heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's instructions to Sanātana Gosvāmī in Vārāṇasī.
text:
> śekharera ghare vāsā, miśra-ghare bhikṣā
> miśra-mukhe śune sanātane prabhura 'śikṣā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śekharera]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---residence in the house of Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]---//prasāda// at the house of Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouth of Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---unto Sanātana; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]]---instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: While Rūpa Gosvāmī was staying at Vārāṇasī, he resided at the house of Candraśekhara and took prasāda at the house of Tapana Miśra. In this way he heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's instructions to Sanātana Gosvāmī in Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.219
description: While staying at Vārāṇasī, Rūpa Gosvāmī heard of all Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities. When he heard of His deliverance of the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs, he became very happy.
text:
> kāśīte prabhura caritra śuni' tinera mukhe
> sannyāsīre kṛpā śuni' pāilā baḍa sukhe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśīte]]---at Vārāṇasī (Kāśī); [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caritra]]---the activity; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:t:tinera]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouths of the three persons; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīre]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy shown to the Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing about; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---he got; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---very great pleasure.
translation: While staying at Vārāṇasī, Rūpa Gosvāmī heard of all Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities. When he heard of His deliverance of the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs, he became very happy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.22
description: All the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs offered their obeisances unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then began to discuss His movement, giving up their studies of Vedānta and Māyāvāda philosophy.
text:
> prabhure praṇata haila sannyāsīra gaṇa
> ātma-madhye goṣṭhī kare chāḍi' adhyayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:praṇata]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---offered obeisances; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīra]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:m:madhye]]---among themselves; [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---discussed; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']] [[synonyms:a:adhyayana]]---giving up so-called studies of Vedānta.
translation: All the Māyāvādī sannyāsīs offered their obeisances unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then began to discuss His movement, giving up their studies of Vedānta and Māyāvāda philosophy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.220
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the people of Vārāṇasī respected Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he became very happy. He even heard stories from the general populace.
text:
> mahāprabhura upara lokera praṇati dekhiyā
> sukhī hailā loka-mukhe kīrtana śuniyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:upara]]---upon; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of the people in general; [[synonyms:p:praṇati]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing the surrender; [[synonyms:s:sukhī]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very happy; [[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the general public; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing the description.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the people of Vārāṇasī respected Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he became very happy. He even heard stories from the general populace.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.221
description: After staying in Vārāṇasī for about ten days, Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Bengal. In this way I have described the activities of Rūpa and Sanātana.
text:
> dina daśa rahi' rūpa gauḍe yātrā kaila
> sanātana-rūpera ei caritra kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:d:daśa]]---about ten days; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:y:yātrā]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---went back to Bengal; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpera]]---of Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---thus; [[synonyms:c:caritra]]---character; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---I have described.
translation: After staying in Vārāṇasī for about ten days, Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Bengal. In this way I have described the activities of Rūpa and Sanātana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.222
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī, He passed through the solitary forest, and He received great pleasure in doing so.
text:
> ethā mahāprabhu yadi nīlādri calilā
> nirjana vana-pathe yāite mahā sukha pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---on the other side; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:n:nīlādri]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went back to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:n:nirjana]] [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on a solitary forest path; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---traveling; [[synonyms:m:mahā]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---got very great pleasure.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī, He passed through the solitary forest, and He received great pleasure in doing so.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.223
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu happily returned to Jagannātha Purī in the company of His servant, Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya. As previously, the Lord performed many pleasing pastimes with the forest animals.
text:
> sukhe cali' āise prabhu balabhadra-saṅge
> pūrvavat mṛgādi-saṅge kailā nānā-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in a very pleasing atmosphere; [[synonyms:c:cali']] [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes back; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:balabhadra]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the servant of Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:m:mṛga]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the forest animals; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---various pleasing activities.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu happily returned to Jagannātha Purī in the company of His servant, Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya. As previously, the Lord performed many pleasing pastimes with the forest animals.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.224
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at a place known as Āṭhāranālā near Jagannātha Purī, He sent Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya to call for His devotees.
text:
> āṭhāranālāte āsi' bhaṭṭācārya brāhmaṇe
> pāṭhāñā bolāilā nija-bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āṭhāranālāte]]---to a place near Jagannātha Purī named Āṭhāranālā; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]] [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇe]]---the //brāhmaṇa// known as Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāñā]]---sending; [[synonyms:b:bolāilā]]---called for; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---His own personal associates.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at a place known as Āṭhāranālā near Jagannātha Purī, He sent Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya to call for His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.225
description: Hearing news of the Lord's arrival from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya, hordes of devotees became so happy that they seemed to be getting their lives back. It was as though their consciousness had returned to their bodies. Their senses also became agitated.
text:
> śuniyā bhaktera gaṇa yena punarapi jīlā
> dehe prāṇa āile, yena indriya uṭhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the hordes of devotees at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again; [[synonyms:j:jīlā]]---became alive; [[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in the body; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]] [[synonyms:ā:āile]]---consciousness returned; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:i:indriya]]---senses; [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]]---became agitated.
translation: Hearing news of the Lord's arrival from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya, hordes of devotees became so happy that they seemed to be getting their lives back. It was as though their consciousness had returned to their bodies. Their senses also became agitated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.226
description: Being overwhelmed with great pleasure, all the devotees hastily went to see the Lord. They met Him on the banks of Narendra-sarovara, the celebrated lake.
text:
> ānande vihvala bhakta-gaṇa dhāñā āilā
> narendre āsiyā sabe prabhure mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great pleasure; [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---very hastily came; [[synonyms:n:narendre]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming to the shore of Narendra Lake; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: Being overwhelmed with great pleasure, all the devotees hastily went to see the Lord. They met Him on the banks of Narendra-sarovara, the celebrated lake.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.227
description: When Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord offered them His respectful obeisances due to their being Godbrothers of His spiritual master. They both then embraced Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in love and affection.
text:
> purī-bhāratīra prabhu vandilena caraṇa
> doṅhe mahāprabhure kailā prema-āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:purī]]---Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhāratīra]]---and of Brahmānanda Bhāratī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vandilena]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---worshiped the feet; [[synonyms:d:doṅhe]]---both the elderly //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing in love.
translation: When Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord offered them His respectful obeisances due to their being Godbrothers of His spiritual master. They both then embraced Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in love and affection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.228
description: Devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara, Govinda and Vakreśvara all came to meet the Lord.
text:
> dāmodara-svarūpa, paṇḍita-gadādhara
> jagadānanda, kāśīśvara, govinda, vakreśvara
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]-[[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara, the learned scholar; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---//Jagadānanda//; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara.
translation: Devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara, Govinda and Vakreśvara all came to meet the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.229
description: Kāśī Miśra, Pradyumna Miśra, Dāmodara Paṇḍita, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Śaṅkara Paṇḍita also came there to meet the Lord.
text:
> kāśī-miśra, pradyumna-miśra, paṇḍita-dāmodara
> haridāsa-ṭhākura, āra paṇḍita-śaṅkara
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Dāmodara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara Paṇḍita.
translation: Kāśī Miśra, Pradyumna Miśra, Dāmodara Paṇḍita, Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Śaṅkara Paṇḍita also came there to meet the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.23
description: One of the disciples of Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī, who was as learned as his guru, began to speak in that assembly, offering all respects to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> prakāśānandera śiṣya eka tāṅhāra samāna
> sabhā-madhye kahe prabhura kariyā sammāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prakāśānandera]] [[synonyms:ś:śiṣya]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one of the disciples of Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:s:samāna]]---equal in learning with Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī; [[synonyms:s:sabhā]]-[[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the assembly of the //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---explains; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---respecting Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seriously.
translation: One of the disciples of Prakāśānanda Sarasvatī, who was as learned as his guru, began to speak in that assembly, offering all respects to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.230
description: All the other devotees also came and fell down at the Lord's lotus feet. In return, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all with great ecstatic love.
text:
> āra saba bhakta prabhura caraṇe paḍilā
> sabā āliṅgiyā prabhu premāviṣṭa hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the other devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]] [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgiyā]]---embracing all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]]---overwhelmed in ecstatic love and emotion; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became.
translation: All the other devotees also came and fell down at the Lord's lotus feet. In return, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all with great ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.231
description: Thus they all merged in the ocean of transcendental bliss. Then the Lord and all His devotees proceeded toward the temple of Jagannātha to see the Deity.
text:
> ānanda-samudre bhāse saba bhakta-gaṇe
> sabā lañā cale prabhu jagannātha-daraśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:samudre]]---in the ocean of transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---float; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see the Jagannātha Deity in the temple.
translation: Thus they all merged in the ocean of transcendental bliss. Then the Lord and all His devotees proceeded toward the temple of Jagannātha to see the Deity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.232
description: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Jagannātha in the temple, He was immediately overwhelmed with love and affection. He chanted and danced with His devotees for a long time.
text:
> jagannātha dekhi' prabhu premāviṣṭa hailā
> bhakta-saṅge bahu-kṣaṇa nṛtya-gīta kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became overwhelmed with love and affection; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the society of the devotees; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---chanted and danced.
translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Jagannātha in the temple, He was immediately overwhelmed with love and affection. He chanted and danced with His devotees for a long time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.233
description: The priests immediately brought them flower garlands and prasāda. The temple's watchman, who was named Tulasī, also came and offered his obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagannātha-sevaka āni' mālā-prasāda dilā
> tulasī paḍichā āsi' caraṇa vandilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---the priests who were servitors of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:m:mālā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---distributed flower garlands and //prasāda//; [[synonyms:t:tulasī]] [[synonyms:p:paḍichā]]---the temple servant known as Tulasī; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---worshiped the lotus feet of the Lord.
translation: The priests immediately brought them flower garlands and prasāda. The temple's watchman, who was named Tulasī, also came and offered his obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.234
description: When the news spread that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had arrived at Jagannātha Purī, devotees like Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya all came to meet Him.
text:
> 'mahāprabhu āilā'-grāme kolāhala haila
> sārvabhauma, rāmānanda, vāṇīnātha milila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has arrived; [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---in the town; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was spreading of the news; [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]]---Vāṇīnātha; [[synonyms:m:milila]]---came and met Him.
translation: When the news spread that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had arrived at Jagannātha Purī, devotees like Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya all came to meet Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.235
description: The Lord and all His devotees then went to the residence of Kāśī Miśra. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Paṇḍita Gosāñi also invited the Lord to dine at their homes.
text:
> sabā saṅge lañā prabhu miśra-vāsā āilā
> sārvabhauma, paṇḍita-gosāñi nimantraṇa kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Kāśī Miśra's house; [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---invited the Lord to take //prasāda.//
translation: The Lord and all His devotees then went to the residence of Kāśī Miśra. Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Paṇḍita Gosāñi also invited the Lord to dine at their homes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.236
description: Accepting their invitation, the Lord asked them to bring all the prasāda there so that He could eat it with His devotees.
text:
> prabhu kahe,-"mahā-prasāda āna' ei sthāne
> sabā-saṅge ihāṅ āji karimu bhojane"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:ā:āna']]---bring //mahā-prasāda//; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to this place; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with all; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---I shall dine.
translation: Accepting their invitation, the Lord asked them to bring all the prasāda there so that He could eat it with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.237
description: Upon receiving Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's order, both Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Paṇḍita Gosāñi brought sufficient prasāda from the temple of Jagannātha. The Lord then dined with everyone at His own place.
text:
> tabe duṅhe jagannātha-prasāda ānila
> sabā-saṅge mahāprabhu bhojana karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both Sārvabhauma and Paṇḍita Gosāñi; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought the //mahā-prasāda// of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---dined.
translation: Upon receiving Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's order, both Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Paṇḍita Gosāñi brought sufficient prasāda from the temple of Jagannātha. The Lord then dined with everyone at His own place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.238
description: Thus I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ,-prabhu dekhi' vṛndāvana
> punaḥ karilena yaiche nīlādri gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---thus I have described; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---after visiting Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:k:karilena]]---did; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:n:nīlādri]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---coming back to Jagannātha Purī.
translation: Thus I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to Jagannātha Purī from Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.239
description: Whoever hears Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes with faith and love very soon attains shelter at the Lord's lotus feet.
text:
> ihā yei śraddhā kari' karaye śravaṇa
> acirāt pāya sei caitanya-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with faith and love; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---hears; [[synonyms:a:acirāt]]---very soon; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Whoever hears Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes with faith and love very soon attains shelter at the Lord's lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.24
description: He said, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Nārāyaṇa Himself. When He explains the Vedānta-sūtra, He does so very nicely.
text:
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya haya 'sākṣāt nārāyaṇa'
> 'vyāsa-sūtrera' artha karena ati-manorama
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]] [[synonyms:n:nārāyaṇa]]---directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Nārāyaṇa; [[synonyms:v:vyāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sūtrera]]---the codes of Vyāsadeva (//Vedānta-sūtra//); [[synonyms:a:artha]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---He explains; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:m:manorama]]---very nicely.
translation: He said, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Nārāyaṇa Himself. When He explains the Vedānta-sūtra, He does so very nicely.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 25.240
description: I have thus given a summary of the Madhya-līlā, which is a special description of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's travels to and from Jagannātha Purī. Indeed, the Lord traveled to and fro continuously for six years.
text:
> madhya-līlāra kariluṅ ei dig-daraśana
> chaya vatsara kailā yaiche gamanāgamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of this division, known as //Madhya-līlā//; [[synonyms:k:kariluṅ]]---I have done; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---this summary inspection; [[synonyms:c:chaya]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---continuously for six years; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]-[[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---going and coming back.
