title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.291
description: After some moments, they came to their senses and became patient. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Śrī Raṅga Purī about His relationship with Īśvara Purī.
text:
> kṣaṇeke āveśa chāḍi' duṅhāra dhairya haila
> īśvara-purīra sambandha gosāñi jānāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇeke]]---after just a few moments; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstasy; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:d:dhairya]]---patience; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:purīra]]---of Īśvara Purī; [[synonyms:s:sambandha]]---relationship; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jānāila]]---disclosed.
translation: After some moments, they came to their senses and became patient. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then informed Śrī Raṅga Purī about His relationship with Īśvara Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.292
description: They were both inundated by the wonderful ecstasy of love that was aroused in them. Finally they sat down and respectfully began to converse.
text:
> adbhuta premera vanyā duṅhāra uthalila
> duṅhe mānya kari' duṅhe ānande vasila
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of love of Godhead; [[synonyms:v:vanyā]]---inundation; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:u:uthalila]]---arose; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:m:mānya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering respect; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---with great happiness; [[synonyms:v:vasila]]---sat down.
translation: They were both inundated by the wonderful ecstasy of love that was aroused in them. Finally they sat down and respectfully began to converse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.293
description: In this way they discussed topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa continually for five to seven days.
text:
> dui jane kṛṣṇa-kathā kahe rātri-dine
> ei-mate goṅāila pāṅca-sāta dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---both the persons; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speak; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:goṅāila]]---passed; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]]---five to seven; [[synonyms:d:dine]]---days.
translation: In this way they discussed topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa continually for five to seven days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.294
description: Out of curiosity, Śrī Raṅga Purī asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about His birthplace, and the Lord informed him that it was Navadvīpa-dhāma.
text:
> kautuke purī tāṅre puchila janma-sthāna
> gosāñi kautuke kahena 'navadvīpa' nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kautuke]]---out of curiosity; [[synonyms:p:purī]]---Śrī Raṅga Purī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---asked; [[synonyms:j:janma]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---the place of birth; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kautuke]]---as a matter of course; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---said; [[synonyms:n:navadvīpa]]---Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name.
translation: Out of curiosity, Śrī Raṅga Purī asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about His birthplace, and the Lord informed him that it was Navadvīpa-dhāma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.295
description: Śrī Raṅga Purī had formerly gone to Navadvīpa with Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, and he therefore remembered the incidents that took place there.
text:
> śrī-mādhava-purīra saṅge śrī-raṅga-purī
> pūrve āsiyāchilā teṅho nadīyā-nagarī
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhava]]-[[synonyms:p:purīra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Śrī Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅga]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Śrī Raṅga Purī; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyāchilā]]---came; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nadīyā]]-[[synonyms:n:nagarī]]---to the city of Nadia.
translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī had formerly gone to Navadvīpa with Śrī Mādhavendra Purī, and he therefore remembered the incidents that took place there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.296
description: As soon as Śrī Raṅga Purī recalled Navadvīpa, he also recalled accompanying Śrī Mādhavendra Purī to the house of Jagannātha Miśra, where he had taken lunch. He even remembered the taste of an unprecedented curry made of banana flowers.
text:
> jagannātha-miśra-ghare bhikṣā ye karila
> apūrva mocāra ghaṇṭa tāhāṅ ye khāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in the house of Śrī Jagannātha Miśra; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]---lunch; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---took; [[synonyms:a:apūrva]]---unprecedented; [[synonyms:m:mocāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghaṇṭa]]---curry made of plantain flowers; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---ate.
translation: As soon as Śrī Raṅga Purī recalled Navadvīpa, he also recalled accompanying Śrī Mādhavendra Purī to the house of Jagannātha Miśra, where he had taken lunch. He even remembered the taste of an unprecedented curry made of banana flowers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.297
description: Śrī Raṅga Purī also remembered the wife of Jagannātha Miśra. She was very much devoted and chaste. As for her affection, she was exactly like the mother of the universe.
text:
> jagannāthera brāhmaṇī, teṅha---mahā-pativratā
> vātsalye hayena teṅha yena jagan-mātā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Jagannātha Miśra; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇī]]---wife; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---she; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]---great; [[synonyms:p:pati]]-[[synonyms:v:vratā]]---devoted to her husband; [[synonyms:v:vātsalye]]---in affection; [[synonyms:h:hayena]]---was; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---she; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:m:mātā]]---the mother of the whole universe.
translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī also remembered the wife of Jagannātha Miśra. She was very much devoted and chaste. As for her affection, she was exactly like the mother of the universe.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.298
description: He also remembered how Śrī Jagannātha Miśra's wife, Śacīmātā, was expert in cooking. He recalled that she was very affectionate toward the sannyāsīs and fed them exactly like her own sons.
text:
> randhane nipuṇā tāṅ-sama nāhi tribhuvane
> putra-sama sneha karena sannyāsi-bhojane
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:randhane]]---in cooking; [[synonyms:n:nipuṇā]]---very expert; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like her; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is none; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvane]]---in the three worlds; [[synonyms:p:putra]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like to her own sons; [[synonyms:s:sneha]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---she was affectionate; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsi]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---in feeding the //sannyāsīs.//
translation: He also remembered how Śrī Jagannātha Miśra's wife, Śacīmātā, was expert in cooking. He recalled that she was very affectionate toward the sannyāsīs and fed them exactly like her own sons.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.299
description: Śrī Raṅga Purī also remembered that one of her deserving sons had accepted the renounced order at a very young age. His name was Śaṅkarāraṇya.
text:
> tāṅra eka yogya putra kariyāche sannyāsa
> 'śaṅkarāraṇya' nāma tāṅra alpa vayasa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---her; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---deserving; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---son; [[synonyms:k:kariyāche]]---has accepted; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsa]]---the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkarāraṇya]]---Śaṅkarāraṇya; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---little; [[synonyms:v:vayasa]]---age.
translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī also remembered that one of her deserving sons had accepted the renounced order at a very young age. His name was Śaṅkarāraṇya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.3
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's tour of South India was certainly very extraordinary because He visited many thousands of places of pilgrimage there.
text:
> dakṣiṇa-gamana prabhura ati vilakṣaṇa
> sahasra sahasra tīrtha kaila daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dakṣiṇa]]-[[synonyms:g:gamana]]---touring in South India; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very; [[synonyms:v:vilakṣaṇa]]---extraordinary; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]] [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]---thousands and thousands; [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---holy places; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visit.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's tour of South India was certainly very extraordinary because He visited many thousands of places of pilgrimage there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.30
description: " 'The word "kṛṣ" is the attractive feature of the Lord's existence, and "ṇa" means spiritual pleasure. When the verb "kṛṣ" is added to the affix "ṇa," it becomes "Kṛṣṇa," which indicates the Absolute Truth.'
text:
> kṛṣir bhū-vācakaḥ śabdo
> ṇaś ca nirvṛti-vācakaḥ
> tayor aikyaṁ paraṁ brahma
> kṛṣṇa ity abhidhīyate
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣiḥ]]---the verbal root //kṛṣ//; [[synonyms:b:bhū]]---attractive existence; [[synonyms:v:vācakaḥ]]---signifying; [[synonyms:ś:śabdaḥ]]---word; [[synonyms:ṇ:ṇaḥ]]---the syllable //ṇa//; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:n:nirvṛti]]---spiritual pleasure; [[synonyms:v:vācakaḥ]]---indicating; [[synonyms:t:tayoḥ]]---of both; [[synonyms:a:aikyam]]---amalgamation; [[synonyms:p:param]]---supreme; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]---Absolute Truth; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇaḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:a:abhidhīyate]]---is called.
translation: “ 'The word "kṛṣ" is the attractive feature of the Lord's existence, and "ṇa" means spiritual pleasure. When the verb "kṛṣ" is added to the affix "ṇa," it becomes "Kṛṣṇa," which indicates the Absolute Truth.'
purport: This is a verse from the //Mahābhārata// (//Udyoga-parva// 71.4).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.300
description: Śrī Raṅga Purī informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that the sannyāsī named Śaṅkarāraṇya had attained perfection in that holy place, Pāṇḍarapura.
text:
> ei tīrthe śaṅkarāraṇyera siddhi-prāpti haila
> prastāve śrī-raṅga-purī eteka kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:tīrthe]]---in this holy place; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkarāraṇyera]]---of Śaṅkarāraṇya; [[synonyms:s:siddhi]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---attainment of perfection; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became fulfilled; [[synonyms:p:prastāve]]---in the course of conversation; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅga]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Śrī Raṅga Purī; [[synonyms:e:eteka]]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---spoke.
translation: Śrī Raṅga Purī informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that the sannyāsī named Śaṅkarāraṇya had attained perfection in that holy place, Pāṇḍarapura.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's elder brother was named Viśvarūpa. He left home before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and accepted the //sannyāsa// order under the name of Śaṅkarāraṇya Svāmī. He traveled all over the country and finally went to Pāṇḍarapura, where he passed away after attaining perfection. In other words, he entered the spiritual world after giving up his mortal body at Pāṇḍarapura. Śrī Raṅga Purī, a disciple of Śrī Mādhavendra Purī and godbrother of Īśvara Purī, disclosed this important news to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.301
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In My previous āśrama, Śaṅkarāraṇya was My brother and Jagannātha Miśra was My father."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---pūrvāśrame teṅha mora bhrātā
> jagannātha miśra---pūrvāśrame mora pitā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord replied; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśrame]]---in My previous //āśrama//; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---He; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:b:bhrātā]]---My brother; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Jagannātha Miśra; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśrame]]---in My previous //āśrama//; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---My father.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In My previous āśrama, Śaṅkarāraṇya was My brother and Jagannātha Miśra was My father."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.302
description: After finishing his talks with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrī Raṅga Purī started for Dvārakā-dhāma.
text:
> ei-mata dui-jane iṣṭa-goṣṭhī kari'
> dvārakā dekhite calilā śrī-raṅga-purī
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of them; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---discussing many topics; [[synonyms:d:dvārakā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Dvārakā; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---started; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅga]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Śrī Raṅga Purī.
translation: After finishing his talks with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrī Raṅga Purī started for Dvārakā-dhāma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.303
description: After Śrī Raṅga Purī departed for Dvārakā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained with the brāhmaṇa at Pāṇḍarapura for four more days. He took His bath in the Bhīmā River and visited the temple of Viṭhṭhala.
text:
> dina cāri tathā prabhuke rākhila brāhmaṇa
> bhīmā-nadī snāna kari' karena viṭhṭhala darśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]]---days; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rākhila]]---kept; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---the //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:b:bhīmā]]-[[synonyms:n:nadī]]---in the river Bhīmā; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---bathing; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:v:viṭhṭhala]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---visit the temple of Viṭhṭhala.
translation: After Śrī Raṅga Purī departed for Dvārakā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained with the brāhmaṇa at Pāṇḍarapura for four more days. He took His bath in the Bhīmā River and visited the temple of Viṭhṭhala.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.304
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next went to the bank of the Kṛṣṇa-veṇvā River, where He visited many holy places and the temples of various gods.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu āilā kṛṣṇa-veṇvā-tīre
> nānā tīrtha dekhi' tāhāṅ devatā-mandire
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:veṇvā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---to the bank of the river Kṛṣṇa-veṇvā; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---holy places; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:d:devatā]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in the temples of some gods.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next went to the bank of the Kṛṣṇa-veṇvā River, where He visited many holy places and the temples of various gods.
purport: This river is a branch of the river Kṛṣṇā. It is said that Ṭhākura Bilvamaṅgala resided on the banks of this river, which is also called the Vīṇā, the Veṇī, the Sinā and the Bhīmā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.305
description: The brāhmaṇa community there was composed of pure devotees, who regularly studied a book entitled Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, which was composed by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.
text:
> brāhmaṇa-samāja saba---vaiṣṇava-carita
> vaiṣṇava sakala paḍe 'kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:samāja]]---the community of //brāhmaṇas//; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:c:carita]]---pure devotees; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]] [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---study; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]]---the //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta// of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.
translation: The brāhmaṇa community there was composed of pure devotees, who regularly studied a book entitled Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, which was composed by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura.
purport: This book was composed by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura in 112 verses. There are two or three other books bearing the same name, and there are also two commentaries on Bilvamaṅgala's book. One commentary was written by Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī and the other by Caitanya dāsa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.306
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very much pleased to hear the book Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, and with great eagerness He had it copied and took it with Him.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta śuni' prabhura ānanda haila
> āgraha kariyā puṅthi lekhāñā laila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---after hearing the //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta//; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was great happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kariya]]---with great eagerness; [[synonyms:p:puṅthi]]---the book; [[synonyms:l:lekhāñā]]---getting copied; [[synonyms:l:laila]]---took.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very much pleased to hear the book Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, and with great eagerness He had it copied and took it with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.307
description: There is no comparison to the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta within the three worlds. By studying this book, one is elevated to the knowledge of pure devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> 'karṇāmṛta'-sama vastu nāhi tribhuvane
> yāhā haite haya kṛṣṇe śuddha-prema-jñāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]]---the //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta//; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---like; [[synonyms:v:vastu]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is nothing; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvane]]---in the three worlds; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from which; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---knowledge of pure devotional service.
translation: There is no comparison to the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta within the three worlds. By studying this book, one is elevated to the knowledge of pure devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.308
description: One who constantly reads the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta can fully understand the beauty and melodious taste of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> saundarya-mādhurya-kṛṣṇa-līlāra avadhi
> sei jāne, ye 'karṇāmṛta' paḍe niravadhi
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saundarya]]---beauty; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:avadhi]]---limit; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---he knows; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---one who; [[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]]---the book //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta//; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---studies; [[synonyms:n:niravadhi]]---constantly.
translation: One who constantly reads the Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta can fully understand the beauty and melodious taste of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.309
description: The Brahma-saṁhitā and Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta were two books that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu considered to be most valuable jewels. Therefore He took them with Him on His return trip.
text:
> 'brahma-saṁhitā', 'karṇāmṛta' dui puṅthi pāñā
> mahā-ratna-prāya pāi āilā saṅge lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁhitā]]---the book //Brahma-saṁhitā//; [[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]]---the book //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta//; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:p:puṅthi]]---books; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like the most valuable jewels; [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---getting; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Him; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking.
translation: The Brahma-saṁhitā and Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta were two books that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu considered to be most valuable jewels. Therefore He took them with Him on His return trip.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.31
description: "As far as the holy names of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa are concerned, they are on an equal level, but for further advancement we receive some specific information from revealed scriptures.
text:
> paraṁ brahma dui-nāma samāna ha-ila
> punaḥ āra śāstre kichu viśeṣa pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:param]] [[synonyms:b:brahma]]---the Absolute Truth; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---two names (Rāma and Kṛṣṇa); [[synonyms:s:samāna]]---on an equal level; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---were; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---further; [[synonyms:ś:śāstre]]---in revealed scriptures; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---specification; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---is found.
translation: "As far as the holy names of Rāma and Kṛṣṇa are concerned, they are on an equal level, but for further advancement we receive some specific information from revealed scriptures.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.310
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next arrived at the banks of the river Tāpī. After bathing there, He went to Māhiṣmatī-pura. While there, He saw many holy places on the banks of the river Narmadā.
text:
> tāpī snāna kari' āilā māhiṣmatī-pure
> nānā tīrtha dekhi tāhāṅ narmadāra tīre
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāpī]]---in the Tāpī River; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking a bath; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:m:māhiṣmatī]]-[[synonyms:p:pure]]---at Māhiṣmatī-pura; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---many holy places; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:n:narmadāra]] [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank of the river Narmadā.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu next arrived at the banks of the river Tāpī. After bathing there, He went to Māhiṣmatī-pura. While there, He saw many holy places on the banks of the river Narmadā.
purport:
The river Tāpī is presently known as Tāpti. The river's source is a mountain called Multāi, and the river flows westward through the state of Saurāṣṭra and into the Arabian Sea. Māhiṣmatī-pura is mentioned in //Mahābhārata// in connection with Sahadeva's victory. Sahadeva, the youngest brother of the Pāṇḍavas, conquered that part of the country. As stated in the //Mahābhārata://

> tato ratnāny upādāya
> purīṁ māhiṣmatīṁ yayau
> tatra nīlena rājñā sa
> cakre yuddhaṁ nararṣabhaḥ

"After acquiring jewels, Sahadeva went to the city of Māhiṣmatī, where he fought with a king called Nīla."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.311
description: The Lord next arrived at Dhanus-tīrtha, where He took His bath in the river Nirvindhyā. He then arrived at Ṛṣyamūka Mountain and then went to the forest called Daṇḍakāraṇya.
text:
> dhanus-tīrtha dekhi' karilā nirvindhyāte snāne
> ṛṣyamūka-giri āilā daṇḍakāraṇye
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhanusḥ]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---Dhanus-tīrtha; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:n:nirvindhyāte]]---in the river Nirvindhyā; [[synonyms:s:snāne]]---bathing; [[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṣyamūka]]-[[synonyms:g:giri]]---at the Ṛṣyamūka Mountain; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍaka]]-[[synonyms:a:araṇye]]---in the forest known as Daṇḍakāraṇya.
translation: The Lord next arrived at Dhanus-tīrtha, where He took His bath in the river Nirvindhyā. He then arrived at Ṛṣyamūka Mountain and then went to the forest called Daṇḍakāraṇya.
purport: According to some opinions, Ṛṣyamūka is a chain of mountains beginning at the village of Hāmpi-grāma in the district of Belāri. The mountain chain begins along the bank of the river Tuṅgabhadrā, which gradually reaches the state of Hyderabad. According to other opinions, this hill is situated in Madhya Pradesh and bears the present name of Rāmpa. Daṇḍakāraṇya is a spacious tract of land which begins north of Khāndeśa and extends south to Ahmadnagar, west to Nāsika, and east to Aurangabad. The Godāvarī River flows through this tract of land, and there is a great forest there where Lord Rāmacandra lived.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.312
description: Within that forest Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited a place called Saptatāla. The seven palm trees there were very old, very bulky and very high.
text:
> 'saptatāla-vṛkṣa' dekhe kānana-bhitara
> ati vṛddha, ati sthūla, ati uccatara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sapta]]-[[synonyms:t:tāla]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]---seven palm trees; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:k:kānana]] [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---within the forest; [[synonyms:a:ati]] [[synonyms:v:vṛddha]]---very old; [[synonyms:a:ati]] [[synonyms:s:sthūla]]---very bulky; [[synonyms:a:ati]] [[synonyms:u:uccatara]]---very high.
translation: Within that forest Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited a place called Saptatāla. The seven palm trees there were very old, very bulky and very high.
purport: The name Saptatāla is mentioned in the //Kiṣkindhyā// Chapter of the //Rāmāyaṇa// and is described in the eleventh and twelfth sections of this chapter.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.313
description: After seeing the seven palm trees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them. As a result, they all returned to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, the spiritual world.
text:
> saptatāla dekhi' prabhu āliṅgana kaila
> saśarīre saptatāla vaikuṇṭhe calila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sapta]]-[[synonyms:t:tāla]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing the seven palm trees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---embraced; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śarīre]]---with their bodies; [[synonyms:s:sapta]]-[[synonyms:t:tāla]]---the seven palm trees; [[synonyms:v:vaikuṇṭhe]] [[synonyms:c:calila]]---returned to Vaikuṇṭhaloka.
translation: After seeing the seven palm trees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them. As a result, they all returned to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, the spiritual world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.314
description: After the seven palm trees had departed for Vaikuṇṭha, everyone was astonished to see them gone. The people then began to say, "This sannyāsī called Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu must be an incarnation of Lord Rāmacandra.
text:
> śūnya-sthala dekhi' lokera haila camatkāra
> loke kahe, e sannyāsī---rāma-avatāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śūnya]]-[[synonyms:s:sthala]]---the vacant place; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of the people in general; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment; [[synonyms:l:loke]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---all people began to say; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---this //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---incarnation of Lord Rāmacandra.
translation: After the seven palm trees had departed for Vaikuṇṭha, everyone was astonished to see them gone. The people then began to say, "This sannyāsī called Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu must be an incarnation of Lord Rāmacandra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.315
description: "Only Lord Rāmacandra has the power to send seven palm trees to the spiritual Vaikuṇṭha planets."
text:
> saśarīre tāla gela śrī-vaikuṇṭha-dhāma
> aiche śakti kāra haya, vinā eka rāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śarīre]]---with the material body; [[synonyms:t:tāla]]---the palm trees; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:v:vaikuṇṭha]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāma]]---to the spiritual kingdom, known as Vaikuṇṭha; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---power; [[synonyms:k:kāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]---Lord Rāmacandra.
translation: "Only Lord Rāmacandra has the power to send seven palm trees to the spiritual Vaikuṇṭha planets."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.316
description: Eventually Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at a lake known as Pampā, where He took His bath. He then went to a place called Pañcavaṭī, where He rested.
text:
> prabhu āsi' kaila pampā-sarovare snāna
> pañcavaṭī āsi, tāhāṅ karila viśrāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:pampā]]-[[synonyms:s:sarovare]]---in the lake known as Pampā; [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bathing; [[synonyms:p:pañcavaṭī]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi]]---then coming to Pañcavaṭī; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---took; [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---rest.
translation: Eventually Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived at a lake known as Pampā, where He took His bath. He then went to a place called Pañcavaṭī, where He rested.
purport: According to some, the old name of the Tuṅgabhadrā River was Pambā. According to others, Vijaya-nagara, the capital of the state, was known as Pampātīrtha. Yet according to others, the lake near Anāguṇḍi, in the direction of Hyderabad, is Pampā-sarovara. The river Tuṅgabhadrā also flows through there. There are many different opinions about the lake called Pampā-sarovara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.317
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited Nāsika, where He saw the deity of Tryambaka [Lord Śiva]. He then went to Brahma-giri and then to Kuśāvarta, the source of the river Godāvarī.
text:
> nāsike tryambaka dekhi' gelā brahmagiri
> kuśāvarte āilā yāhāṅ janmilā godāvarī
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nāsike]]---at the holy place Nāsika; [[synonyms:t:tryambaka]]---a deity of Lord Śiva; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:b:brahmagiri]]---to the place known as Brahmagiri; [[synonyms:k:kuśāvarte]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---then He came to the holy place known as Kuśāvarta; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:j:janmilā]]---took birth; [[synonyms:g:godāvarī]]---the river Godāvarī.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then visited Nāsika, where He saw the deity of Tryambaka [Lord Śiva]. He then went to Brahma-giri and then to Kuśāvarta, the source of the river Godāvarī.
purport: Kuśāvarta is located in the western //ghāṭa,// at Sahyādri. It is near Nāsika, a holy place, but according to some it was situated in the valley of Vindhya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.318
description: After visiting many other holy places, the Lord went to Sapta-godāvari. At last He returned to Vidyānagara.
text:
> sapta godāvarī āilā kari' tīrtha bahutara
> punarapi āilā prabhu vidyānagara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sapta]] [[synonyms:g:godāvarī]]---to the place known as Sapta-godāvarī; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]] [[synonyms:b:bahutara]]---visiting various holy places; [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vidyānagara]]---to the place where He met Rāmānanda Rāya.
translation: After visiting many other holy places, the Lord went to Sapta-godāvari. At last He returned to Vidyānagara.
purport: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu traveled from the source of the Godāvarī River and eventually visited the northern side of Hyderabad state. He finally arrived at the state of Kaliṅga.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.319
description: When Rāmānanda Rāya heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, he was very much pleased, and he immediately went to see Him.
text:
> rāmānanda rāya śuni' prabhura āgamana
> ānande āsiyā kaila prabhu-saha milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---return; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milana]]---meeting.
translation: When Rāmānanda Rāya heard of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, he was very much pleased, and he immediately went to see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.32
description: " 'Lord Śiva addressed his wife Durgā as Varānanā and explained, "I chant the holy name of Rāma, Rāma, Rāma and thus enjoy this beautiful sound. This holy name of Rāmacandra is equal to one thousand holy names of Lord Viṣṇu."'
text:
> rāma rāmeti rāmeti
> rame rāme manorame
> sahasra-nāmabhis tulyaṁ
> rāma-nāma varānane
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāma]]---Rāma; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]---Rāma; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]---Rāma; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:r:rame]]---I enjoy; [[synonyms:r:rāme]]---in the holy name of Rāma; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:r:rame]]---most beautiful; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmabhiḥ]]---with the one thousand names; [[synonyms:t:tulyam]]---equal; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Rāma; [[synonyms:v:vara]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānane]]---O lovely-faced woman.
translation: “ 'Lord Śiva addressed his wife Durgā as Varānanā and explained, "I chant the holy name of Rāma, Rāma, Rāma and thus enjoy this beautiful sound. This holy name of Rāmacandra is equal to one thousand holy names of Lord Viṣṇu."'
purport: This is a verse from the //Bṛhad-viṣṇu-sahasranāma-stotra// in the //Uttara-khaṇḍa// of the //Padma Purāṇa// (72.335).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.320
description: When Rāmānanda Rāya fell flat, touching the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord immediately raised him to his feet and embraced him.
text:
> daṇḍavat hañā paḍe caraṇe dhariyā
> āliṅgana kaila prabhu tāṅre uṭhāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---like a stick; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fell; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---catching; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---getting up.
translation: When Rāmānanda Rāya fell flat, touching the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord immediately raised him to his feet and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.321
description: In great ecstatic love they both began to cry, and thus their minds were slackened.
text:
> dui jane premāveśe karena krandana
> premānande śithila haila duṅhākāra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of them; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---do; [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---crying; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:ś:śithila]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became slackened; [[synonyms:d:duṅhākāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---minds.
translation: In great ecstatic love they both began to cry, and thus their minds were slackened.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.322
description: After some time they regained their senses and sat together to discuss various subjects.
text:
> kata-kṣaṇe dui janā susthira hañā
> nānā iṣṭa-goṣṭhī kare ekatra vasiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---after some time; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:j:janā]]---people; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---coming to their senses; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---discussions; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---together; [[synonyms:v:vasiyā]]---sitting.
translation: After some time they regained their senses and sat together to discuss various subjects.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.323
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave Rāmānanda Rāya a vivid description of His travels to the holy places and told him how He had acquired the two books named Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta and Brahma-saṁhitā. The Lord delivered the books to Rāmānanda Rāya.
text:
> tīrtha-yātrā-kathā prabhu sakala kahilā
> karṇāmṛta, brahma-saṁhitā,---dui puṅthi dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of His pilgrimage; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---described everything; [[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛta]]---the book named //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta//; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁhitā]]---the book named //Brahma-saṁhitā//; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:p:puṅthi]]---scriptures; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave Rāmānanda Rāya a vivid description of His travels to the holy places and told him how He had acquired the two books named Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta and Brahma-saṁhitā. The Lord delivered the books to Rāmānanda Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.324
description: The Lord said, "Whatever you have told Me about devotional service is all supported by these two books."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---tumi yei siddhānta kahile
> ei dui puṅthi sei saba sākṣī dile
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---conclusion; [[synonyms:k:kahile]]---informed; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]---these two; [[synonyms:p:puṅthi]]---books; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:s:sākṣī]]---evidence; [[synonyms:d:dile]]---gave.
translation: The Lord said, "Whatever you have told Me about devotional service is all supported by these two books."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.325
description: Rāmānanda Rāya was very happy to receive these books. He tasted their contents along with the Lord and made a copy of each of them.
text:
> rāyera ānanda haila pustaka pāiyā
> prabhu-saha āsvādila, rākhila likhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāyera]]---of Rāya Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---happiness; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:p:pustaka]] [[synonyms:p:pāiyā]]---getting those two books; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādila]]---tasted; [[synonyms:r:rākhila]]---kept; [[synonyms:l:likhiyā]]---writing.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya was very happy to receive these books. He tasted their contents along with the Lord and made a copy of each of them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.326
description: News spread in the village of Vidyānagara about the arrival of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and everyone came to see Him once again.
text:
> 'gosāñi' āilā' grāme haila kolāhala
> prabhuke dekhite loka āila sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā']]---has returned; [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---in the village; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---commotion; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came there; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: News spread in the village of Vidyānagara about the arrival of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and everyone came to see Him once again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.327
description: After seeing the people who gathered there, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned to his own home. At noon, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to take His lunch.
text:
> loka dehki' rāmānanda gelā nija-ghare
> madhyāhne uṭhilā prabhu bhikṣā karibāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the people; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāya Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---departed; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to his own home; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhne]]---at noon; [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karibāre]]---to take His lunch.
translation: After seeing the people who gathered there, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned to his own home. At noon, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to take His lunch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.328
description: Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned at night, and he and the Lord discussed topics concerning Kṛṣṇa. Thus they passed the night.
text:
> rātri-kāle rāya punaḥ kaila āgamana
> dui jane kṛṣṇa-kathāya kaila jāgaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at night; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---coming; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---the two of them; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathāya]]---in discourses on topics of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:j:jāgaraṇa]]---keeping awake through the night.
translation: Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya returned at night, and he and the Lord discussed topics concerning Kṛṣṇa. Thus they passed the night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.329
description: Rāmānanda Rāya and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu discussed Kṛṣṇa day and night, and thus they passed from five to seven days in great happiness.
text:
> dui jane kṛṣṇa-kathā kahe rātri-dine
> parama-ānande gela pāṅca-sāta dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of them; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speak; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---five to seven days.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu discussed Kṛṣṇa day and night, and thus they passed from five to seven days in great happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.33
description: " 'The pious results derived from chanting the thousand holy names of Viṣṇu three times can be attained by only one utterance of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.'
text:
> sahasra-nāmnāṁ puṇyānāṁ
> trir-āvṛttyā tu yat phalam
> ekāvṛttyā tu kṛṣṇasya
> nāmaikaṁ tat prayacchati
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmnām]]---of one thousand names; [[synonyms:p:puṇyānām]]---holy; [[synonyms:t:triḥ]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvṛttyā]]---by thrice chanting; [[synonyms:t:tu]]---but; [[synonyms:y:yat]]---which; [[synonyms:p:phalam]]---result; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvṛttyā]]---by one repetition; [[synonyms:t:tu]]---but; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇasya]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---holy name; [[synonyms:e:ekam]]---only one; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that result; [[synonyms:p:prayacchati]]---gives.
translation: “ 'The pious results derived from chanting the thousand holy names of Viṣṇu three times can be attained by only one utterance of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.'
purport: This verse from the //Brahmāṇḍa Purāṇa// is found in the //Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta// (1.5.354), by Rūpa Gosvāmī. Simply by chanting the name of Kṛṣṇa once, one can attain the same results achieved by chanting the holy name of Rāma three times.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.330
description: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, with Your permission I have already written a letter to the King with great humility.
text:
> rāmānanda kahe,---prabhu, tomāra ājñā pāñā
> rājāke likhiluṅ āmi vinaya kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Rāmānanda Rāya said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my dear Lord; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---Your permission; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:r:rājāke]] [[synonyms:l:likhiluṅ]]---have written a letter to the King; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great humility.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, with Your permission I have already written a letter to the King with great humility.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.331
description: "The King has already given me an order to return to Jagannātha Purī, and I am making arrangements to do this."
text:
> rājā more ājñā dila nīlācale yāite
> calibāra udyoga āmi lāgiyāchi karite
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---has given an order; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:c:calibāra]]---to go; [[synonyms:u:udyoga]]---arrangement; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:l:lāgiyāchi]]---began; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do.
translation: "The King has already given me an order to return to Jagannātha Purī, and I am making arrangements to do this."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.332
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "It is for this purpose alone that I have returned. I want to take you with Me to Jagannātha Purī."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---ethā mora e-nimitte āgamana
> tomā lañā nīlācale kariba gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:n:nimitte]]---for this reason; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---coming back; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking you; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:k:kariba]]---I shall do; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---going.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "It is for this purpose alone that I have returned. I want to take you with Me to Jagannātha Purī."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.333
description: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, it is better that You proceed to Jagannātha Purī alone because with me there will be many horses, elephants and soldiers, all roaring tumultuously.
text:
> rāya kahe,---prabhu, āge cala nīlācale
> mora saṅge hātī-ghoḍā, sainya-kolāhale
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāya]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Rāmānanda Rāya replied; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āge]] [[synonyms:c:cala]]---You go ahead; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with me; [[synonyms:h:hātī]]-[[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]]---elephants and horses; [[synonyms:s:sainya]]---soldiers; [[synonyms:k:kolāhale]]---tumultuous roaring.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya said, "My dear Lord, it is better that You proceed to Jagannātha Purī alone because with me there will be many horses, elephants and soldiers, all roaring tumultuously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.334
description: "I shall make arrangements within ten days. Following You, I shall go to Nīlācala without delay."
text:
> dina-daśe ihā-sabāra kari' samādhāna
> tomāra pāche pāche āmi kariba prayāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]]-[[synonyms:d:daśe]]---within ten days; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of this; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---making adjustment; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---You; [[synonyms:p:pāche]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---following; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kariba]]---shall do; [[synonyms:p:prayāṇa]]---going.
translation: "I shall make arrangements within ten days. Following You, I shall go to Nīlācala without delay."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.335
description: Giving orders to Rāmānanda Rāya to come to Nīlācala, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu departed for Jagannātha Purī with great pleasure.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre āsite ājñā diyā
> nīlācale calilā prabhu ānandita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:ā:āsite]]---to come; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving an order; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---with great pleasure.
translation: Giving orders to Rāmānanda Rāya to come to Nīlācala, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu departed for Jagannātha Purī with great pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.336
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned by the same road He formerly took to Vidyānagara, and all the Vaiṣṇavas along the way saw Him again.
text:
> yei pathe pūrve prabhu kailā āgamana
> sei pathe calilā dekhi, sarva vaiṣṇava-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---the path by which; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---came; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---by that way; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned by the same road He formerly took to Vidyānagara, and all the Vaiṣṇavas along the way saw Him again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.337
description: Wherever Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went, the holy name of Śrī Hari was vibrated. Seeing this, the Lord became very happy.
text:
> yāhāṅ yāya, loka uṭhe hari-dhvani kari'
> dekhi' ānandita-mana hailā gaurahari
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---wherever He goes; [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---people stand up; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---vibrating the holy name of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---happy; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---in mind; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:g:gaurahari]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Wherever Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went, the holy name of Śrī Hari was vibrated. Seeing this, the Lord became very happy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.338
description: When the Lord reached Ālālanātha, He sent His assistant Kṛṣṇadāsa ahead to call for Nityānanda and other personal associates.
text:
> ālālanāthe āsi' kṛṣṇadāse pāṭhāila
> nityānanda-ādi nija-gaṇe bolāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ālālanāthe]]---to the place known as Ālālanātha; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāse]]---Kṛṣṇadāsa, His assistant; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent ahead; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---personal associates; [[synonyms:b:bolāila]]---called for.
translation: When the Lord reached Ālālanātha, He sent His assistant Kṛṣṇadāsa ahead to call for Nityānanda and other personal associates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.339
description: As soon as Nityānanda received news of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, He immediately got up and started out to see Him. Indeed, He was very impatient in His great ecstasy.
text:
> prabhura āgamana śuni' nityānanda rāya
> uṭhiyā calilā, preme theha nāhi pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---arrival; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:u:uṭhiyā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---got up and started; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:t:theha]]---patience; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get.
translation: As soon as Nityānanda received news of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's arrival, He immediately got up and started out to see Him. Indeed, He was very impatient in His great ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.34
description: "According to this statement of the śāstras, the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa are unlimited. Still I could not chant His holy name. Please hear the reason for this.
text:
> ei vākye kṛṣṇa-nāmera mahimā apāra
> tathāpi la-ite nāri, śuna hetu tāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eivākye]]---in this statement; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmera]]---of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---glories; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to chant; [[synonyms:n:nāri]]---I am unable; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---just hear; [[synonyms:h:hetu]]---the reason; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that.
translation: "According to this statement of the śāstras, the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa are unlimited. Still I could not chant His holy name. Please hear the reason for this.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.340
description: Śrī Nityānanda Rāya, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara Paṇḍita and Mukunda all became ecstatic in their happiness, and dancing along the way, they went to meet the Lord.
text:
> jagadānanda, dāmodara-paṇḍita, mukunda
> nāciyā calilā, dehe nā dhare ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Dāmodara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]---Mukunda; [[synonyms:n:nāciyā]]---dancing; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:d:dehe]]---the body; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---does not hold; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---happiness.
translation: Śrī Nityānanda Rāya, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara Paṇḍita and Mukunda all became ecstatic in their happiness, and dancing along the way, they went to meet the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.341
description: Gopīnātha Ācārya also went in a very happy mood. They all went to meet the Lord, and they finally contacted Him on the way.
text:
> gopīnāthācārya calilā ānandita hañā
> prabhure mililā sabe pathe lāg pāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Gopīnātha Ācārya; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---departed; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---along the way; [[synonyms:l:lāg]]---contact; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting.
translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya also went in a very happy mood. They all went to meet the Lord, and they finally contacted Him on the way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.342
description: The Lord was also filled with ecstatic love, and He embraced them all. Out of their love, they began to cry with pleasure.
text:
> prabhu premāveśe sabāya kaila āliṅgana
> premāveśe sabe kare ānanda-krandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailaāliṅgana]]---embraced; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---all of them did; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:k:krandana]]---crying in pleasure.
translation: The Lord was also filled with ecstatic love, and He embraced them all. Out of their love, they began to cry with pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.343
description: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also went to see the Lord with great pleasure, and he met Him on the beach by the sea.
text:
> sārvabhauma bhaṭṭācārya ānande calilā
> samudrera tīre āsi' prabhure mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in pleasure; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the beach by the ocean; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met the Lord.
translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya also went to see the Lord with great pleasure, and he met Him on the beach by the sea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.344
description: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya fell down at the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord pulled him up and embraced him.
text:
> sārvabhauma mahāprabhura paḍilā caraṇe
> prabhu tāṅre uṭhāñā kaila āliṅgane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the feet; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---making get up; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgane]]---embraced.
translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya fell down at the lotus feet of the Lord, and the Lord pulled him up and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.345
description: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya cried in great ecstatic love. Then the Lord, accompanied by them all, went to the temple of Jagannātha.
text:
> premāveśe sārvabhauma karilā rodane
> sabā-saṅge āilā prabhu īśvara-daraśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:r:rodane]]---cried; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see the Jagannātha temple.
translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya cried in great ecstatic love. Then the Lord, accompanied by them all, went to the temple of Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.346
description: Due to ecstatic love experienced upon visiting Lord Jagannātha, inundations of trembling, perspiration, tears and jubilation swept the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagannātha-daraśana premāveśe kaila
> kampa-sveda-pulakāśrute śarīra bhāsila

translation: Due to ecstatic love experienced upon visiting Lord Jagannātha, inundations of trembling, perspiration, tears and jubilation swept the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.347
description: In ecstatic love Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted. At that time all the attendants and priests came to offer Him a garland and the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food.
text:
> bahu nṛtya-gīta kaila premāviṣṭa hañā
> pāṇḍā-pāla āila sabe mālā-prasāda lañā

translation: In ecstatic love Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted. At that time all the attendants and priests came to offer Him a garland and the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food.
purport: Those who are priests engaged in Lord Jagannātha's service are called //pāṇḍās// or //paṇḍitas,// and they are //brāhmaṇas.// The attendants who look after the temple's external affairs are called //pālas.// The priests and attendants went together to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.35
description: "My worshipable Lord has been Lord Rāmacandra, and by chanting His holy name I received happiness. Because I received such happiness, I chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma day and night.
text:
> iṣṭa-deva rāma, tāṅra nāme sukha pāi
> sukha pāñā rāma-nāma rātri-dina gāi

translation: "My worshipable Lord has been Lord Rāmacandra, and by chanting His holy name I received happiness. Because I received such happiness, I chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma day and night.

translation: Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya then took the Lord with him to his home, saying, "Today's luncheon will be at my home." In this way he invited the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.355

> sārvabhauma-saṅge āra lañā nija-gaṇa

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His personal associates remained with Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya. They all stayed awake the entire night as the Lord spoke of His pilgrimage.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.356
description: The Lord told Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, "I have traveled to many holy places, but I could not find a Vaiṣṇava as good as you anywhere."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---eta tīrtha kailuṅ paryaṭana
> tomā-sama vaiṣṇava nā dekhiluṅ eka-jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---to so many holy places; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]] [[synonyms:p:paryaṭana]]---I have traveled; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like you; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---devotee; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:d:dekhiluṅ]]---I could see; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---one man.
translation: The Lord told Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, "I have traveled to many holy places, but I could not find a Vaiṣṇava as good as you anywhere."
purport:
In the //Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka// (eighth part) Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Sārvabhauma, I have traveled to many holy places, but I cannot find a Vaiṣṇava as good as you anywhere. However, I must admit that Rāmānanda Rāya is wonderful."

Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "Therefore, my Lord, I requested that You see him."

Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then said, "There are, of course, many Vaiṣṇavas in these holy places, and most of them worship Lord Nārāyaṇa. Others, who are called Tattvavādīs, are also Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa worshipers, but they do not belong to the pure Vaiṣṇava cult. There are many worshipers of Lord Śiva, and there are also many atheists. Regardless, My dear Bhaṭṭācārya, I very much like Rāmānanda Rāya and his opinions."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.357
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "I received much pleasure from the talks of Rāmānanda Rāya."
text:
> eka rāmānanda rāya bahu sukha dila
> bhaṭṭa kahe,---ei lāgi' milite kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---much pleasure; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya replied; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for this reason; [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---I requested.
translation:
Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "I received much pleasure from the talks of Rāmānanda Rāya."


The Bhaṭṭācārya replied, "For this reason I requested that You meet him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.358
description: Thus I have ended my narration about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pilgrimage, describing it in brief. It cannot be described very broadly.
text:
> tīrtha-yātrā-kathā ei kailuṅ samāpana
> saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ, vistāra nā yāya varṇana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of the pilgrimage; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]] [[synonyms:s:samāpana]]---I have finished; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described in brief; [[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---expansively; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---it is not possible to describe.
translation: Thus I have ended my narration about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pilgrimage, describing it in brief. It cannot be described very broadly.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura points out that in the seventy-fourth verse of this chapter it is stated that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Śiyālī-bhairavī, but actually at Śiyālī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Śrī Bhū-varāha. Near Śiyālī and Cidambaram there is a temple known as Śrī Muṣṇam. In this temple there is a Deity of Śrī Bhū-varāha. In the jurisdiction of Cidambaram there is a district known as southern Arcot. The town of Śiyālī is in that district. There is a temple of Śrī Bhū-varāhadeva nearby, not Bhairavī-devī. This is Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura's conclusion.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.359
description: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited. No one can properly describe His activities, yet I make the attempt out of greed. This but reveals my shamelessness.
text:
> ananta caitanya-līlā kahite nā jāni
> lobhe lajjā khāñā tāra kari ṭānāṭāni
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---to speak; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:l:lobhe]]---out of greed; [[synonyms:l:lajjā]] [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---becoming shameless; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of them; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I do; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭānāṭāni]]---some attempt only.
translation: The pastimes of Lord Caitanya are unlimited. No one can properly describe His activities, yet I make the attempt out of greed. This but reveals my shamelessness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Madhya-līlā 9.36
description: "By Your appearance, Lord Kṛṣṇa's holy name also appeared, and at that time the glories of Kṛṣṇa's name awoke in my heart."
text:
> tomāra darśane yabe kṛṣṇa-nāma āila
> tāhāra mahimā tabe hṛdaye lāgila
