> dekhiyā lokera mane haila camatkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śasya]] [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eats the pulp of green coconut; [[synonyms:k:kukkura]]---the dog; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---chants; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing this; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of all the people; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment.
translation: Seeing the dog eating the green coconut pulp and chanting "Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa" again and again, all the devotees present were very much surprised.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.31
description: When he saw the dog sitting in that way and chanting the name of Kṛṣṇa, Śivānanda, because of his natural humility, immediately offered his obeisances to the dog just to counteract his offenses to it.
text:
> śivānanda kukkura dekhi' daṇḍavat kailā
> dainya kari' nija aparādha kṣamāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:k:kukkura]]---the dog; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing there; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---offered obeisances; [[synonyms:d:dainya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---exhibiting humbleness; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---personal; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]---offenses; [[synonyms:k:kṣamāilā]]---was forgiven.
translation: When he saw the dog sitting in that way and chanting the name of Kṛṣṇa, Śivānanda, because of his natural humility, immediately offered his obeisances to the dog just to counteract his offenses to it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.32
description: The next day, no one saw that dog, for it had obtained its spiritual body and departed for Vaikuṇṭha, the spiritual kingdom.
text:
> āra dina keha tāra dekhā nā pāilā
> siddha-deha pāñā kukkura vaikuṇṭhete gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---all of them; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of the dog; [[synonyms:d:dekhā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---did not get sight; [[synonyms:s:siddha]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---obtaining a spiritual body; [[synonyms:k:kukkura]]---the dog; [[synonyms:v:vaikuṇṭhete]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went to the spiritual kingdom, Vaikuṇṭha.
translation: The next day, no one saw that dog, for it had obtained its spiritual body and departed for Vaikuṇṭha, the spiritual kingdom.
purport: This is the result of //sādhu-saṅga,// consequent association with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and promotion back home, back to Godhead. This result is possible even for a dog, by the mercy of the Vaiṣṇava. Therefore, everyone in the human form of life should be induced to associate with devotees. By rendering a little service, even by eating //prasāda,// not to speak of chanting and dancing, everyone could be promoted to Vaikuṇṭhaloka. It is therefore requested that all our devotees in the ISKCON community become pure Vaiṣṇavas, so that by their mercy all the people of the world will be transferred to Vaikuṇṭhaloka, even without their knowledge. Everyone should be given a chance to take //prasāda// and thus be induced to chant the holy names Hare Kṛṣṇa and also dance in ecstasy. By these three processes, although performed without knowledge or education, even an animal went back to Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.33
description: Such are the transcendental pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī. He even delivered a dog simply by inducing it to chant the mahā-mantra, Hare Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> aiche divya-līlā kare śacīra nandana
> kukkurake kṛṣṇa kahāñā karilā mocana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in that way; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---transcendental activities; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:ś:śacīra]] [[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the son of mother Śacī; [[synonyms:k:kukkurake]]---even a dog; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahāñā]]---inducing to chant the holy name "Kṛṣṇa"; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:m:mocana]]---delivered.
translation: Such are the transcendental pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī. He even delivered a dog simply by inducing it to chant the mahā-mantra, Hare Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.34
description: Meanwhile, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana. He desired to write dramas concerning the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ethā prabhu-ājñāya rūpa āilā vṛndāvana
> kṛṣṇa-līlā-nāṭaka karite haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---on the other side; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---upon the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---went; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---a drama on Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to compose; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---it was; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation: Meanwhile, following the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned to Vṛndāvana. He desired to write dramas concerning the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.35
description: In Vṛndāvana, Rūpa Gosvāmī began to write a drama. In particuIar, he composed the introductory verses to invoke good fortune.
text:
> vṛndāvane nāṭakera ārambha karilā
> maṅgalācaraṇa 'nāndī-śloka' tathāi likhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:n:nāṭakera]]---of the drama; [[synonyms:ā:ārambha]]---the beginning; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---wrote; [[synonyms:m:maṅgalācaraṇa]]---invoking auspiciousness; [[synonyms:n:nāndī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---introductory verse; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---there; [[synonyms:l:likhilā]]---he wrote.
translation: In Vṛndāvana, Rūpa Gosvāmī began to write a drama. In particuIar, he composed the introductory verses to invoke good fortune.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura quotes his notes from the //Nāṭaka-candrikā,// wherein he has written:

> prastāvanāyās tu mukhe
> nāndī kāryāśubhāvahā
> āśīr-namaskriyā-vastu-
> nirdeśānyatamānvitā
>
> aṣṭābhir daśabhir yuktā
> kiṁvā dvādaśabhiḥ padaiḥ
> candranāmāṅkitā prāyo
> maṅgalārtha-padojjvalā
> maṅgalaṁ cakra-kamala-
> cakora-kumudādikam

Similarly, in the Sixth Chapter of the //Sāhitya-darpaṇa,// text 282, he has said:

> āśīr-vacana-saṁyuktā
> stutir yasmāt prayujyate
> deva-dvija-nṛ-pādīnāṁ
> tasmān nāndīti saṁjñitā

The introductory portion of a drama, which is written to invoke good fortune, is called //nāndī-śloka.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.36
description: On his way to Gauḍa-deśa, Rūpa Gosvāmī had been thinking of how to write the action of the drama. Thus he had made some notes and begun to write.
text:
> pathe cali' āise nāṭakera ghaṭanā bhāvite
> kaḍacā kariyā kichu lāgilā likhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pathe]] [[synonyms:c:cali']]---walking on the road; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---goes; [[synonyms:n:nāṭakera]]---of the drama; [[synonyms:g:ghaṭanā]]---events; [[synonyms:b:bhāvite]]---thinking of; [[synonyms:k:kaḍacā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making notes; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]] [[synonyms:l:likhite]]---he began to write.
translation: On his way to Gauḍa-deśa, Rūpa Gosvāmī had been thinking of how to write the action of the drama. Thus he had made some notes and begun to write.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.37
description: In this way the two brothers Rūpa and Anupama reached Bengal, but when they arrived there Anupama died.
text:
> ei-mate dui bhāi gauḍa-deśe āilā
> gauḍe āsi' anupamera gaṅgā-prāpti hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī and his younger brother, Anupama; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---reached Bengal, which is known as Gauḍa-deśa; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming to Gauḍa; [[synonyms:a:anupamera]]---of Anupama; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---there was obtainment of the shelter of mother Ganges (passing away).
translation: In this way the two brothers Rūpa and Anupama reached Bengal, but when they arrived there Anupama died.
purport: Formerly when a person died it was commonly said that he had attained the shelter of mother Ganges, even if he did not die on the bank of the Ganges. It is customary among Hindus to carry a dying person to a nearby bank of the Ganges, for if one dies on the bank of the Ganges, his soul is considered to reach the lotus feet of Lord Viṣṇu, wherefrom the Ganges flows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.38
description: Rūpa Gosvāmī then departed to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for he was very eager to see Him.
text:
> rūpa-gosāñi prabhu-pāśe karilā gamana
> prabhure dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhita mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---of the name Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---departed for; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhita]]---full of anxiety; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī then departed to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for he was very eager to see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.39
description: There was some delay because of the death of Anupama, and therefore when Rūpa Gosvāmī went to Bengal to see the devotees there, he could not get in touch with them because they had already left.
text:
> anupamera lāgi' tāṅra kichu vilamba ha-ila
> bhakta-gaṇa-pāśa āilā, lāg nā pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anupamera]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---on account of the passing away of Anupama; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:v:vilamba]]---delay; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---to the devotees in Bengal; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:l:lāg]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---he could not contact them.
translation: There was some delay because of the death of Anupama, and therefore when Rūpa Gosvāmī went to Bengal to see the devotees there, he could not get in touch with them because they had already left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.40
description: In the province of Orissa there is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī rested for a night in that village on his way to Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> uḍiyā-deśe 'satyabhāmā-pura'-nāme grāma
> eka rātri sei grāme karilā viśrāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uḍiyā]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---in the state of Orissa; [[synonyms:s:satyabhāmā]]-[[synonyms:p:pura]]---Satyabhāmā-pura; [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---named; [[synonyms:g:grāma]]---a village; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---one night; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---in that village; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---he rested.
translation: In the province of Orissa there is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura. Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī rested for a night in that village on his way to Jagannātha Purī.
purport: There is a place known as Satyabhāmā-pura in the district of Kaṭaka (Cuttak) in Orissa. It is near the village known as Jānkādei-pura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.41
description: While resting in Satyabhāmā-pura, he dreamed that a celestiaIly beautiful woman had come before him and very mercifully gave him the folIowing order.
text:
> rātre svapne dekhe,---eka divya-rūpā nārī
> sammukhe āsiyā ājñā dilā bahu kṛpā kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:s:svapne]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---he dreamed; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpā]] [[synonyms:n:nārī]]---celestially beautiful woman; [[synonyms:s:sammukhe]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming before him; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---ordered; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---showing him much mercy.
translation: While resting in Satyabhāmā-pura, he dreamed that a celestiaIly beautiful woman had come before him and very mercifully gave him the folIowing order.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.42
description: "Write a separate drama about me," she said. "By my mercy, it will be extraordinarily beautiful."
text:
> āmāra nāṭaka pṛthak karaha racana
> "āmāra kṛpāte nāṭaka haibe vilakṣaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---my drama; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:r:racana]]---write separately; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by my mercy; [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---the drama; [[synonyms:h:haibe]]---will be; [[synonyms:v:vilakṣaṇa]]---extraordinarily beautiful.
translation: "Write a separate drama about me," she said. "By my mercy, it will be extraordinarily beautiful."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.43
description: After having that dream, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī considered, "It is the order of Satyabhāmā that I write a separate drama for her.
text:
> svapna dekhi' rūpa-gosāñi karilā vicāra
> satya-bhāmāra ājñā---pṛthak nāṭaka karibāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svapna]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after dreaming; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---considered; [[synonyms:s:satya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāmāra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order of Śrīmatī Satyabhāmā; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]] [[synonyms:k:karibāra]]---to write a separate drama.
translation: After having that dream, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī considered, "It is the order of Satyabhāmā that I write a separate drama for her.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.44
description: I have brought together in one work all the pastimes performed by Lord Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana and in Dvārakā. Now I shall have to divide them into two dramas."
text:
> vraja-pura-līlā ekatra kariyāchi ghaṭanā
> dui bhāga kari' ebe karimu racanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:p:pura]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes in Vraja and Dvārakā; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---in one place; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]]---I have collected; [[synonyms:g:ghaṭanā]]---all the events; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāga]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---dividing into two different parts; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:r:racanā]]---I shall write.
translation: I have brought together in one work all the pastimes performed by Lord Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana and in Dvārakā. Now I shall have to divide them into two dramas."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.45
description: Thus absorbed in thought, he quickly reached Jagannātha Purī. When he arrived, he approached the hut of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> bhāvite bhāvite śīghra āilā nīlācale
> āsi' uttarilā haridāsa-vāsā-sthale
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāvite]] [[synonyms:b:bhāvite]]---thinking and thinking; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---reached Nīlācala (Jagannātha Purī); [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:u:uttarilā]]---approached; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthale]]---the place where Haridāsa Ṭhākura was residing.
translation: Thus absorbed in thought, he quickly reached Jagannātha Purī. When he arrived, he approached the hut of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.46
description: Out of affectionate love and mercy, Haridāsa Ṭhākura told Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has already informed me that you would come here."
text:
> haridāsa-ṭhākura tāṅre bahu-kṛpā kailā
> 'tumi āsibe,---more prabhu ye kahilā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---of the name Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---showed much affection because of love and mercy; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:ā:āsibe]]---you will come; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---informed.
translation: Out of affectionate love and mercy, Haridāsa Ṭhākura told Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has already informed me that you would come here."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.47
description: After seeing the upala-bhoga ceremony at the Jagannātha temple, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would regularly come to see Haridāsa every day. Thus He suddenly arrived there.
text:
> 'upala-bhoga' dekhi' haridāsere dekhite
> pratidina āisena, prabhu āilā ācambite
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the offering of food to Lord Jagannātha at noon; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsere]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:p:pratidina]]---daily; [[synonyms:ā:āisena]]---comes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---He reached there; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---all of a sudden.
translation: After seeing the upala-bhoga ceremony at the Jagannātha temple, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would regularly come to see Haridāsa every day. Thus He suddenly arrived there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.48
description: When the Lord arrived, Rūpa Gosvāmī immediately offered his obeisances. Haridāsa informed the Lord, "This is Rūpa Gosvāmī offering You obeisances" and the Lord embraced him.
text:
> 'rūpa daṇḍavat kare',---haridāsa kahilā
> haridāse mili' prabhu rūpe āliṅgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---offers You obeisances; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---Haridāsa informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāse]] [[synonyms:m:mili']]---after meeting Haridāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgilā]]---embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī.
translation: When the Lord arrived, Rūpa Gosvāmī immediately offered his obeisances. Haridāsa informed the Lord, "This is Rūpa Gosvāmī offering You obeisances" and the Lord embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.49
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sat down with Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī. They inquired from one another about auspicious news, and then continued to talk together for some time.
text:
> haridāsa-rūpe lañā prabhu vasilā eka-sthāne
> kuśala-praśna, iṣṭa-goṣṭhī kailā kata-kṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in one place; [[synonyms:k:kuśala]]-[[synonyms:p:praśna]]---questions about auspicious news; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---talking together; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---continued for some time.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then sat down with Haridāsa and Rūpa Gosvāmī. They inquired from one another about auspicious news, and then continued to talk together for some time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.5
description: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.
text:
> jayatāṁ suratau paṅgor
> mama manda-mater gatī
> mat-sarvasva-padāmbhojau
> rādhā-madana-mohanau
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jayatām]]---all glory to; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:r:ratau]]---most merciful, or attached in conjugal love; [[synonyms:p:paṅgoḥ]]---of one who is lame; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---of me; [[synonyms:m:manda]]-[[synonyms:m:mateḥ]]---foolish; [[synonyms:g:gatī]]---refuge; [[synonyms:m:mat]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:s:sva]]---everything; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:a:ambhojau]]---whose lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:m:mohanau]]---Rādhārāṇī and Madana-mohana.
translation: Glory to the all-merciful Rādhā and Madana-mohana! I am lame and ill-advised, yet They are my directors, and Their lotus feet are everything to me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.50
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about Sanātana Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "I did not meet him.
text:
> sanātanera vārtā yabe gosāñi puchila
> rūpa kahe,---'ta-ra saṅge dekhā nā ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātanera]] [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī says; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with him; [[synonyms:d:dekhā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was no meeting.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about Sanātana Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī replied, "I did not meet him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.51
description: I came by the path on the bank of the Ganges, whereas Sanātana Gosvāmī came by the public road. Therefore we did not meet.
text:
> āmi gaṅgā-pathe āilāṅa, tiṅho rāja-pathe
> ataeva āmāra dekhā nahila tāṅra sāthe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:ā:āilāṅa]]---I came; [[synonyms:t:tiṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the public road; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:d:dekhā]]---meeting; [[synonyms:n:nahila]]---was not possible; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sāthe]]---with him.
translation: I came by the path on the bank of the Ganges, whereas Sanātana Gosvāmī came by the public road. Therefore we did not meet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.52
description: "In Prayāga I heard that he had already gone to Vṛndāvana." Rūpa Gosvāmī next informed the Lord about the death of Anupama.
text:
> prayāge śuniluṅ,---teṅho gelā vṛndāvane
> anupamera gaṅgā-prāpti kaila nivedane"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prayāge]]---in Prayāga; [[synonyms:ś:śuniluṅ]]---I heard; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---has gone to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:a:anupamera]]---of Anupama; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---getting the mercy of the Ganges (death); [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---he informed.
translation: "In Prayāga I heard that he had already gone to Vṛndāvana." Rūpa Gosvāmī next informed the Lord about the death of Anupama.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.53
description: After allotting residential quarters there to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left. Then all of the Lord's personal associates met Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.
text:
> rūpe tāhāṅ vāsā diyā gosāñi calilā
> gosāñira saṅgī bhakta rūpere mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---to Rūpa; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---offered a residence; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left the place; [[synonyms:g:gosāñira]] [[synonyms:s:saṅgī]]---the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:r:rūpere]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met Rūpa Gosvāmī.
translation: After allotting residential quarters there to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left. Then all of the Lord's personal associates met Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.54
description: On the next day, Caitanya Mahāprabhu again met Rūpa Gosvāmī, and with great mercy the Lord introduced him to all the devotees.
text:
> āra dina mahāprabhu saba bhakta lañā
> rūpe milāilā sabāya kṛpā ta' kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the devotees; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]] [[synonyms:m:milāilā]]---introduced Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---to all of them; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---showing His mercy.
translation: On the next day, Caitanya Mahāprabhu again met Rūpa Gosvāmī, and with great mercy the Lord introduced him to all the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.55
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all, and all the devotees, by their mercy, embraced him.
text:
> sabāra caraṇa rūpa karilā vandana
> kṛpā kari' rūpe sabe kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all the devotees; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---to the lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---offered prayers; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---showing great mercy; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all, and all the devotees, by their mercy, embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.56
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should both show Your mercy wholeheartedly to Rūpa Gosvāmī.
text:
> 'advaita nityānanda, tomarā dui-jane
> prabhu kahe---rūpe kṛpā kara kāya-mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:t:tomarā]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of You; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu says; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---to Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---show; [[synonyms:k:kāya]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---wholeheartedly.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Advaita Ācārya and Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should both show Your mercy wholeheartedly to Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.57
description: May Rūpa Gosvāmī, by Your mercy, become so powerful that he will be able to describe the transcendental mellows of devotional service."
text:
> tomā-duṅhāra kṛpāte iṅhāra ha-u taiche śakti
> yāte vivarite pārena kṛṣṇa-rasa-bhakti
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by the mercy of both of You; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:u:u]]---let there be; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---such; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---power; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:v:vivarite]]---to describe; [[synonyms:p:pārena]]---is able; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---the transcendental mellows of devotional service.
translation: May Rūpa Gosvāmī, by Your mercy, become so powerful that he will be able to describe the transcendental mellows of devotional service."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.58
description: Thus Rūpa Gosvāmī became the object of love and affection for all the devotees of the Lord, including those who came from Bengal and those who resided in Orissa.
text:
> gauḍiyā, uḍiyā, yata prabhura bhakta-gaṇa
> sabāra ha-ila rūpa snehera bhājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍiyā]]---devotees from Bengal; [[synonyms:u:uḍiyā]]---devotees belonging to Orissa; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:snehera]] [[synonyms:b:bhājana]]---an object of love and affection.
translation: Thus Rūpa Gosvāmī became the object of love and affection for all the devotees of the Lord, including those who came from Bengal and those who resided in Orissa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.59
description: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to see Rūpa Gosvāmī, and whatever prasāda He received from the temple He would deliver to Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> pratidina āsi' rūpe karena milane
> mandire ye prasāda pāna, dena dui jane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pratidina]]---every day; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---going; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:m:milane]]---Caitanya Mahāprabhu meets; [[synonyms:m:mandire]]---at the Jagannātha temple; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---prasāda He gets; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---gives; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---to two persons, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go to see Rūpa Gosvāmī, and whatever prasāda He received from the temple He would deliver to Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.6
description: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.
text:
> dīvyad-vṛndāraṇya-kalpa-drumādhaḥ
> śrīmad-ratnāgāra-siṁhāsana-sthau
> śrīmad-rādhā-śrīla-govinda-devau
> preṣṭhālībhiḥ sevyamānau smarāmi
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dīvyat]]---shining; [[synonyms:v:vṛndā]]-[[synonyms:a:araṇya]]---in the forest of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:d:druma]]---desire tree; [[synonyms:a:adhaḥ]]---beneath; [[synonyms:ś:śrīmat]]---most beautiful; [[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:ā:āgāra]]---in a temple of jewels; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āsana]]-[[synonyms:s:sthau]]---sitting on a throne; [[synonyms:ś:śrīmat]]---very beautiful; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ś:śrīla]]-[[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:d:devau]]---and Śrī Govindadeva; [[synonyms:p:preṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālībhiḥ]]---by most confidential associates; [[synonyms:s:sevyamānau]]---being served; [[synonyms:s:smarāmi]]---I remember.
translation: In a temple of jewels in Vṛndāvana, underneath a desire tree, Śrī Śrī Rādhā-Govinda, served by Their most confidential associates, sit upon an effulgent throne. I offer my humble obeisances unto Them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.60
description: He would talk for some time with them both and then leave to perform His noontime duties.
text:
> iṣṭa-goṣṭhī duṅhā sane kari' kata-kṣaṇa
> madhyāhna karite prabhu karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---conversation; [[synonyms:d:duṅhā]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with both Rūpa Gosvāmī and Haridāsa; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:a:ahna]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to execute daily noontime duties; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---left that place.
translation: He would talk for some time with them both and then leave to perform His noontime duties.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.61
description: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dealings with them continued every day. Thus receiving the transcendental favor of the Lord, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī felt unlimited pleasure.
text:
> ei-mata pratidina prabhura vyavahāra
> prabhu-kṛpā pāñā rūpera ānanda apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:p:pratidina]]---daily; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---the dealings of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:r:rūpera]]---of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---unlimited happiness.
translation: In this way Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dealings with them continued every day. Thus receiving the transcendental favor of the Lord, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī felt unlimited pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.62
description: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, taking all His devotees with Him, performed the Guṇḍicā-mārjana [washing and cleansing the temple Guṇḍicā], He went to the garden known as Āiṭoṭā and accepted prasāda at a picnic within the garden.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa lañā kailā guṇḍicā mārjana
> āiṭoṭā āsi' kailā vanya-bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]] [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---cleansing and washing of the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:ā:āiṭoṭā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming to the nearby garden named Āiṭoṭā; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---had; [[synonyms:v:vanya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---a picnic within the garden.
translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, taking all His devotees with Him, performed the Guṇḍicā-mārjana [washing and cleansing the temple Guṇḍicā], He went to the garden known as Āiṭoṭā and accepted prasāda at a picnic within the garden.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.63
description: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the devotees were accepting prasāda and chanting the holy name of Hari, they both were greatly pleased.
text:
> prasāda khāya, 'hari' bale sarva-bhakta-jana
> dekhi' haridāsa-rūpera haraṣita mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eat the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---chant the holy name of Hari; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing this; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:r:rūpera]]---and of Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:h:haraṣita]]---jubilant; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the minds.
translation: When Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Rūpa Gosvāmī saw that all the devotees were accepting prasāda and chanting the holy name of Hari, they both were greatly pleased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.64
description: When they received the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's prasāda through Govinda, they respected it, and then they both began to dance in ecstasy.
text:
> govinda-dvārā prabhura śeṣa-prasāda pāilā
> preme matta dui-jana nācite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---through Govinda; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---they got; [[synonyms:p:preme]] [[synonyms:m:matta]]---overwhelmed by ecstasy; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---both of them; [[synonyms:n:nācite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to dance.
translation: When they received the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's prasāda through Govinda, they respected it, and then they both began to dance in ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.65
description: On the next day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, the omniscient Lord spoke as follows.
text:
> āra dina prabhu rūpe miliyā vasilā
> sarvajña-śiromaṇi prabhu kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---with Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:miliyā]]---meeting; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jña]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the best of the omniscient; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: On the next day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī, the omniscient Lord spoke as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.66
description: Do not try to take Kṛṣṇa out of Vṛndāvana, for He does not go anywhere else at any time.
text:
> 'kṛṣṇere bāhira nāhi kariha vraja haite
> vraja chāḍi' kṛṣṇa kabhu nā yāna kāhāṅte
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇere]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bāhira]]---outside; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---do not; [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---take; [[synonyms:v:vraja]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:vraja]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---leaving Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yāna]]---goes; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅte]]---anywhere.
translation: Do not try to take Kṛṣṇa out of Vṛndāvana, for He does not go anywhere else at any time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.67
description: " 'The Kṛṣṇa known as Yadukumāra is Vāsudeva Kṛṣṇa. He is different from the Kṛṣṇa who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja. Yadukumāra Kṛṣṇa manifests His pastimes in the cities of Mathurā and Dvārakā, but Kṛṣṇa the son of Nanda Mahārāja never at any time leaves Vṛndāvana.' "
text:
> kṛṣṇo 'nyo yadu-sambhūto
> yaḥ pūrṇaḥ so 'sty ataḥ paraḥ
> vṛndāvanaṁ parityajya
> sa kvacin naiva gacchati
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇaḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:anyaḥ]]---another Lord Vāsudeva; [[synonyms:y:yadu]]-[[synonyms:s:sambhūtaḥ]]---born in the Yadu dynasty; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇaḥ]]---the full Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:a:asti]]---is; [[synonyms:a:ataḥ]]---than Him (Vāsudeva); [[synonyms:p:paraḥ]]---different; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanam]]---he place Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:parityajya]]---giving up; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:k:kvacit]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:na]] [[synonyms:e:eva]] [[synonyms:g:gacchati]]---does not go.
translation: “ 'The Kṛṣṇa known as Yadukumāra is Vāsudeva Kṛṣṇa. He is different from the Kṛṣṇa who is the son of Nanda Mahārāja. Yadukumāra Kṛṣṇa manifests His pastimes in the cities of Mathurā and Dvārakā, but Kṛṣṇa the son of Nanda Mahārāja never at any time leaves Vṛndāvana.' "
purport: This verse is included in the //Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta// (1.5.461), by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.68
description: After saying this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to perform His noontime duties, leaving Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī somewhat surprised.
text:
> eta kahi' mahāprabhu madhyāhne calilā
> rūpa-gosāñi mane kichu vismaya ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:a:ahne]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---left to execute noon duties; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in mind; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:v:vismaya]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---there was surprise.
translation: After saying this, Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to perform His noontime duties, leaving Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī somewhat surprised.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.69
description: "Satyabhāmā ordered me to write two different dramas," Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī thought. "Now I understand that this order has been confirmed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> "pṛthak nāṭaka karite satyabhāmā ājñā dila
> jānilu, pṛthak nāṭaka karite prabhu-ājñā haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---different dramas; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to write; [[synonyms:s:satyabhāmā]]---of the name Satyabhāmā; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---ordered; [[synonyms:j:jānilu]]---now I understand; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---different dramas; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to write; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order of the Lord; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was.
translation: "Satyabhāmā ordered me to write two different dramas," Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī thought. "Now I understand that this order has been confirmed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.7
description: Śrī Śrīla Gopīnātha, who originated the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, stands on the shore at Vaṁśīvaṭa and attracts the attention of the cowherd damsels with the sound of His celebrated flute. May they all confer upon us their benediction.
text:
> śrīmān-rāsa-rasārambhī
> vaṁśīvaṭa-sthitaḥ
> karṣan veṇu-svanair gopīr
> gopī-nāthaḥ śriye 'stu naḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīmān]]---most beautiful; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]---of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the mellow; [[synonyms:ā:ārambhī]]---the initiator; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]-[[synonyms:v:vaṭa]]---of the name Vaṁśīvaṭa; [[synonyms:t:taṭa]]---on the shore; [[synonyms:s:sthitaḥ]]---standing; [[synonyms:k:karṣan]]---attracting; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---of the flute; [[synonyms:s:svanaiḥ]]---by the sounds; [[synonyms:g:gopīḥ]]---the cowherd girls; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthaḥ]]---Śrī Gopīnātha; [[synonyms:ś:śriye]]---benediction; [[synonyms:a:astu]]---let there be; [[synonyms:n:naḥ]]---our.
translation: Śrī Śrīla Gopīnātha, who originated the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, stands on the shore at Vaṁśīvaṭa and attracts the attention of the cowherd damsels with the sound of His celebrated flute. May they all confer upon us their benediction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.70
description: FormerIy I wrote the two dramas as one composition. Now I shall divide it and describe the incidents in two separate works.
text:
> pūrve dui nāṭaka chila ekatra racanā
> dui-bhāga kari ebe karimu ghaṭanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---two dramas; [[synonyms:c:chila]]---there was; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---together; [[synonyms:r:racanā]]---composition; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāga]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---dividing into two; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:g:ghaṭanā]]---I shall write the incidents.
translation: FormerIy I wrote the two dramas as one composition. Now I shall divide it and describe the incidents in two separate works.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.71
description: I shall write two separate invocations of good fortune and two different introductions. Let me think deeply about the matter and then describe two different sets of incidents."
text:
> dui'nāndī' 'prastāvanā', dui'saṁghaṭanā'
> pṛthak kariyā likhi kariyā bhāvanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:n:nāndī]]---two invocations of good fortune; [[synonyms:p:prastāvanā]]---introductions; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:s:saṁghaṭanā]]---chains of events; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making separate; [[synonyms:l:likhi]]---I shall write; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:b:bhāvanā]]---thinking about them.
translation: I shall write two separate invocations of good fortune and two different introductions. Let me think deeply about the matter and then describe two different sets of incidents."
purport: The two works are //Vidagdha-mādhava// and //Lalita-mādhava. Vidagdha-mādhava// describes pastimes in Vṛndāvana, and //Lalita-mādhava// describes pastimes in Dvārakā and Mathurā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.72
description: During the Ratha-yātrā ceremony Rūpa Gosvāmī saw Lord Jagannātha. He also saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu dancing and chanting in front of the ratha.
text:
> ratha-yātrāya jagannātha darśana karilā
> ratha-agre prabhura nṛtya-kīrtana dekhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrāya]]---during the function of Ratha-yātrā; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---he saw; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:a:agre]]---the front of the //ratha,// or chariot; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---he saw.
translation: During the Ratha-yātrā ceremony Rūpa Gosvāmī saw Lord Jagannātha. He also saw Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu dancing and chanting in front of the ratha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.73
description: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard a verse uttered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu during the ceremony, he immediately composed another verse dealing with the same subject.
text:
> prabhura nṛtya-śloka śuni' śrī-rūpa-gosāñi
> sei ślokārtha lañā śloka karilā tathāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse uttered during His dancing; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning of that verse; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---composed another verse; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---on the spot.
translation: When Rūpa Gosvāmī heard a verse uttered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu during the ceremony, he immediately composed another verse dealing with the same subject.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.74
description: I have already described all these incidents, but I still wish to add briefly something more.
text:
> pūrve sei saba kathā kariyāchi varṇana
> tathāpi kahiye kichu saṅkṣepe kathana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---words; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---I have described; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:k:kahiye]]---let me say; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]]---in brief; [[synonyms:k:kathana]]---telling.
translation: I have already described all these incidents, but I still wish to add briefly something more.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.75
description: Generally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited a verse while dancing and chanting before the ratha, but no one knew why He was reciting that particular verse.
text:
> sāmānya eka śloka prabhu paḍena kīrtane
> kene śloka paḍe---ihā keha nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāmānya]]---generally; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paḍena]]---recites; [[synonyms:k:kīrtane]]---while chanting; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---that verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---He recites; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---no one knows.
translation: Generally Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited a verse while dancing and chanting before the ratha, but no one knew why He was reciting that particular verse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.76
description: Only Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī knew the purpose for which the Lord recited that verse. According to the Lord's attitude, he used to quote other verses to enable the Lord to relish mellows.
text:
> sabe ekā svarūpa gosāñi ślokera artha jāne
> ślokānurūpa pada prabhuke karāna āsvādane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---only; [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---one; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning of that verse; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]] [[synonyms:p:pada]]---other verses following that particular verse; [[synonyms:p:prabhuke]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karāna]]---causes; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādane]]---tasting.
translation: Only Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī knew the purpose for which the Lord recited that verse. According to the Lord's attitude, he used to quote other verses to enable the Lord to relish mellows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.77
description: Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, could understand the intention of the Lord, and thus he composed another verse that appealed to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> rūpa-gosāñi prabhura jāniyā abhiprāya
> sei arthe śloka kailā prabhure ye bhāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jāniyā]]---knowing; [[synonyms:a:abhiprāya]]---the intention; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:a:arthe]]---in that meaning; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---a verse; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---composed; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bhāya]]---appealed.
translation: Rūpa Gosvāmī, however, could understand the intention of the Lord, and thus he composed another verse that appealed to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.78
description: That very personality who stole my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."
text:
> yaḥ kaumāra-haraḥ sa eva hi varas tā eva caitra-kṣapās
> te conmīlita-mālatī-surabhayaḥ prauḍhāḥ kadambānilāḥ
> sā caivāsmi tathāpi tatra surata-vyāpāra-līlā-vidhau
> revā-rodhasi vetasī-taru-tale cetaḥ samutkaṇṭhate
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---that same person who; [[synonyms:k:kaumāra]]-[[synonyms:h:haraḥ]]---the thief of my heart during youth; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---he; [[synonyms:e:eva]] [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly; [[synonyms:v:varaḥ]]---lover; [[synonyms:t:tāḥ]]---these; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly,; [[synonyms:c:caitra]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣapāḥ]]---moonlit nights of the month of Caitra; [[synonyms:t:te]]---those; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:u:unmīlita]]---fructified; [[synonyms:m:mālatī]]---of //mālatī// flowers; [[synonyms:s:surabhayaḥ]]---fragrances; [[synonyms:p:prauḍhāḥ]]---full; [[synonyms:k:kadamba]]---with the fragrance of the //kadamba// flower; [[synonyms:a:anilāḥ]]---the breezes; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---that one; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:a:asmi]]---I am; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:t:tatra]]---there; [[synonyms:s:surata]]-[[synonyms:v:vyāpāra]]---in intimate transactions; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:v:vidhau]]---in the manner; [[synonyms:r:revā]]---of the river named Revā; [[synonyms:r:rodhasi]]---on the bank; [[synonyms:v:vetasī]]---of the name Vetasī; [[synonyms:t:taru]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath the tree; [[synonyms:c:cetaḥ]]---my mind; [[synonyms:s:samutkaṇṭhate]]---is very eager to go.
translation: That very personality who stole my heart during my youth is now again my master. These are the same moonlit nights of the month of Caitra. The same fragrance of mālatī flowers is there, and the same sweet breezes are blowing from the kadamba forest. In our intimate relationship, I am also the same lover, yet still my mind is not happy here. I am eager to go back to that place on the bank of the Revā under the Vetasī tree. That is my desire."
purport: This is the verse recited by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.79
description: My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."
text:
> priyaḥ so 'yaṁ kṛṣṇaḥ saha-cari kuru-kṣetra-militas
> tathāhaṁ sā rādhā tad idam ubhayoḥ saṅgama-sukham
> tathāpy antaḥ-khelan-madhura-muralī-pañcama-juṣe
> mano me kālindī-pulina-vipināya spṛhayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:priyaḥ]]---very dear; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:a:ayam]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇaḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:saha]]-[[synonyms:c:cari]]---O My dear friend; [[synonyms:k:kuru]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣetra]]-[[synonyms:m:militaḥ]]---who is met on the field of Kurukṣetra; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---also; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that; [[synonyms:i:idam]]---this; [[synonyms:u:ubhayoḥ]]---of both of Us; [[synonyms:s:saṅgama]]-[[synonyms:s:sukham]]---the happiness of meeting; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:a:antaḥ]]---within; [[synonyms:k:khelan]]---playing; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweet; [[synonyms:m:muralī]]---of the flute; [[synonyms:p:pañcama]]---the fifth note; [[synonyms:j:juṣe]]---which delights in; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]---the mind; [[synonyms:m:me]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kālindī]]---of the River Yamunā; [[synonyms:p:pulina]]---on the ban k; [[synonyms:v:vipināya]]---the trees; [[synonyms:s:spṛhayati]]---desires.
translation: My dear friend, now I have met My very old and dear friend Kṛṣṇa on this field of Kurukṣetra. I am the same Rādhārāṇī, and now We are meeting together. It is very pleasant, but I would still like to go to the bank of the Yamunā beneath the trees of the forest there. I wish to hear the vibration of His sweet flute playing the fifth note within that forest of Vṛndāvana."
purport: This is the verse composed by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. It is included in his book //Padyāvalī// (383).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.8
description: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! All glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:ś:śrī]] [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---all glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---all glories to Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---all glories to Advaita Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---all glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! All glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.80
description: After writing this verse on a palm leaf, Rūpa Gosvāmī put it somewhere in his thatched roof and went to bathe in the sea.
text:
> tāla-patre śloka likhi' cālete rākhilā
> samudra-snāna karibāre rūpa-gosāñi gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāla]]-[[synonyms:p:patre]]---on a palm leaf; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---the verse; [[synonyms:l:likhi']]---writing; [[synonyms:c:cālete]]---in the thatched roof; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept it; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bath in the sea; [[synonyms:k:karibāre]]---for taking; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---of the name Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---departed.
translation: After writing this verse on a palm leaf, Rūpa Gosvāmī put it somewhere in his thatched roof and went to bathe in the sea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.81
description: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went there to meet him, and when He saw the leaf pushed into the roof and saw the verse, He began to read it.
text:
> hena-kāle prabhu āilā tāṅhāre milite
> cāle śloka dekhi prabhu lāgilā paḍite
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came there; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]] [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet him; [[synonyms:c:cāle]]---in the thatched roof; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began; [[synonyms:p:paḍite]]---to read.
translation: At that time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went there to meet him, and when He saw the leaf pushed into the roof and saw the verse, He began to read it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.82
description: After reading the verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed by ecstatic love. At that very time, Rūpa Gosvāmī returned, having finished bathing in the sea.
text:
> śloka paḍi' prabhu sukhe premāviṣṭa hailā
> hena-kāle rūpa-gosāñi snāna kari' āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reading this verse; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became overwhelmed by ecstatic love; [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after taking his bath; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.83
description: Seeing the Lord, Śrī Rūpa Gosvāmī fell flat in the courtyard to offer obeisances. The Lord slapped him mildly in love and spoke as follows.
text:
> prabhu tāṅre cāpaḍa māri' kahite lāgilā

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.84
description: My heart is very confidential. How did you know My mind in this way?" After saying this, He firmly embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī.
text:
> 'gūḍha mora hṛdaya tuñi jānilā kemane?'

translation: My heart is very confidential. How did you know My mind in this way?" After saying this, He firmly embraced Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.85

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took that verse and showed it to Svarūpa Dāmodara for him to examine. Then the Lord questioned him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.86
description: How could Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood My heart?" the Lord asked. Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "I can understand that You have already bestowed Your causeless mercy upon him.
text:
> 'mora antara-vārtā rūpa jānila kemane?'
> svarūpa kahe---'jāni, kṛpā kariyācha āpane

translation: How could Rūpa Gosvāmī have understood My heart?" the Lord asked. Svarūpa Dāmodara replied, "I can understand that You have already bestowed Your causeless mercy upon him.

description: No one could otherwise understand this meaning. I can therefore guess that previously You bestowed upon him Your causeless mercy."
text:
> anyathā e artha kāra nāhi haya jñāna
> tumi pūrve kṛpā kailā, kari anumāna"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.92
description: The River Ganges flowing from the heavenly planets is full of golden lotus flowers, and we, the residents of those planets, eat the stems of the flowers. Thus we are very beautiful, more so than the inhabitants of any other planet. This is due to the law of cause and effect, for if one eats food in the mode of goodness, the mode of goodness increases the beauty of his body.' "
text:
> svargāpagā-hema-mṛṇālinīnāṁ
> nānā-mṛṇālāgra-bhujo bhajāmaḥ
> annānurūpāṁ tanu-rūpa-ṛddhiṁ
> kāryaṁ nidānād dhi guṇān adhīte
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarga]]-[[synonyms:ā:āpagā]]---of the Ganges water flowing in the heavenly planets; [[synonyms:h:hema]]---golden; [[synonyms:m:mṛṇālinīnām]]---of the lotus flowers; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:m:mṛṇāla]]-[[synonyms:a:agra]]-[[synonyms:b:bhujaḥ]]---those who eat the tops of the stems; [[synonyms:b:bhajāmaḥ]]---we get; [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpām]]---according to the food; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:ṛ:ṛddhim]]---an abundance of bodily beauty; [[synonyms:k:kāryam]]---the effect; [[synonyms:n:nidānāt]]---from the cause; [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly; [[synonyms:g:guṇān]]---qualities; [[synonyms:a:adhīte]]---one obtains.
translation: The River Ganges flowing from the heavenly planets is full of golden lotus flowers, and we, the residents of those planets, eat the stems of the flowers. Thus we are very beautiful, more so than the inhabitants of any other planet. This is due to the law of cause and effect, for if one eats food in the mode of goodness, the mode of goodness increases the beauty of his body.' "
purport:
One's bodily luster and beauty, one's constitution, one's activities and one's qualities all depend on the law of cause and effect. There are three qualities in material nature, and as stated in the //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:13:22|(Bg. 13.22)]], //kāraṇaṁ guṇa-saṅgo 'sya sad-asad-yoni-janmasu:// one takes birth in a good or bad family according to his previous association with the qualities of material nature. Therefore one seriously eager to achieve transcendental perfection, Kṛṣṇa consciousness, must eat Kṛṣṇa //prasāda.// Such food is //sāttvika,// or in the material quality of goodness, but when offered to Kṛṣṇa it becomes transcendental. Our Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement distributes Kṛṣṇa //prasāda,// and those who eat such transcendental food are sure to become devotees of the Lord. This is a very scientific method, as stated in this verse from //Nala-naiṣadha// (3.17): //kāryaṁ nidānād dhi guṇān adhīte.// If in all one's activities he strictly adheres to the mode of goodness, he will certainly develop his dormant Kṛṣṇa consciousness and ultimately become a pure devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

Unfortunately at the present moment the bodily constitutions of the leaders of society, especially the governmental leaders, are polluted. As described in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (12.1.40):

> asaṁskṛtāḥ kriyā-hīnā
> rajasā tamasāvṛtāḥ
> prajās te bhakṣayiṣyanti
> mlecchā rājanya-rūpiṇaḥ

Such leaders have no chance to purify their eating. Politicians meet together and exchange good wishes by drinking liquor, which is so polluted and sinful that naturally drunkards and meat-eaters develop a degraded mentality in the mode of ignorance. The processes of eating in different modes are explained in the //Bhagavad-gītā,// wherein it is stated that those who eat rice, wheat, vegetables, milk products, fruit and sugar are situated in the elevated quality of goodness. Therefore if we want a happy and tranquil political situation, we must select leaders who eat Kṛṣṇa //prasāda.// Otherwise the leaders will eat meat and drink wine, and thus they will be //asaṁskṛtāḥ,// unreformed, and //kriyā-hīnāḥ,// devoid of spiritual behavior. In other words, they will be //mlecchas// and //yavanas,// or men who are unclean in their habits. Through taxation, such men exploit the citizens as much as possible, and in this way they devour the citizens of the state instead of benefiting them. We therefore cannot expect a government to be efficient if it is headed by such unclean //mlecchas// and //yavanas.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.93
