title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 1.99
description: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."
text:
> tuṇḍe tāṇḍavinī ratiṁ vitanute tuṇḍāvalī-labdhaye
> karṇa-kroḍa-kaḍambinī ghaṭayate karṇārbudebhyaḥ spṛhām
> cetaḥ-prāṅgaṇa-saṅginī vijayate sarvendriyāṇāṁ kṛtiṁ
> no jāne janitā kiyadbhir amṛtaiḥ kṛṣṇeti varṇa-dvayī
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tuṇḍe]]---in the mouth; [[synonyms:t:tāṇḍavinī]]---dancing; [[synonyms:r:ratim]]---the inspiration; [[synonyms:v:vitanute]]---expands; [[synonyms:t:tuṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvalī]]-[[synonyms:l:labdhaye]]---to achieve many mouths; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]---of the ear; [[synonyms:k:kroḍa]]---in the hole; [[synonyms:k:kaḍambinī]]---sprouting; [[synonyms:g:ghaṭayate]]---causes to appear; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:arbudebhyaḥ]] [[synonyms:s:spṛhām]]---the desire for millions of ears; [[synonyms:c:cetaḥ]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṅgaṇa]]---in the courtyard of the heart; [[synonyms:s:saṅginī]]---being a companion; [[synonyms:v:vijayate]]---conquers; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:i:indriyāṇām]]---of all the senses; [[synonyms:k:kṛtim]]---the activity; [[synonyms:n:no]]---not; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---I know; [[synonyms:j:janitā]]---produced; [[synonyms:k:kiyadbhiḥ]]---of what measure; [[synonyms:a:amṛtaiḥ]]---by nectar; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---the name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:v:varṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dvayī]]---the two syllables.
translation: "I do not know how much nectar the two syllables 'Kṛṣ-ṇa' have produced. When the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is chanted, it appears to dance within the mouth. We then desire many, many mouths. When that name enters the holes of the ears, we desire many millions of ears. And when the holy name dances in the courtyard of the heart, it conquers the activities of the mind, and therefore all the senses become inert."
purport: This verse is included in the //Vidagdha-mādhava// (1.15), a seven-act play written by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī describing the pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.1
description: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is always pleased to accept anything given with faith and love by His devotees and is always ready to bestow mercy upon them.
text:
> vande śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanyaṁ
> bhaktānugraha-kātaram
> yena kenāpi santuṣṭaṁ
> bhakta-dattena śraddhayā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vande]]---I offer my respectful obeisances; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanyam]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---to His devotees; [[synonyms:a:anugraha]]-[[synonyms:k:kātaram]]---eager to show mercy; [[synonyms:y:yena]] [[synonyms:k:kenāpi]]---by anything; [[synonyms:s:santuṣṭam]]---pleased; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---by His devotees; [[synonyms:d:dattena]]---offered; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhayā]]---with faith and love.
translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is always pleased to accept anything given with faith and love by His devotees and is always ready to bestow mercy upon them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.100
description: These are some of the finer points of etiquette in devotional service. Only one who has received the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand these principles.
text:
> ei saba haya bhakti-śāstra-sūkṣma marma
> caitanyera kṛpāya jāne ei saba dharma
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---of the system of devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sūkṣma]] [[synonyms:m:marma]]---finer principles; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpāya]]---by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---one can understand; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---principles of devotional service.
translation: These are some of the finer points of etiquette in devotional service. Only one who has received the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu can understand these principles.
purport: //Karmīs,// fruitive workers, cannot understand the finer conclusions of devotional service because they accept only its ritualistic value but do not understand how devotional service satisfies the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The //karmīs// view the formalities as a means of advancing in religion, economic development, sensual satisfaction and liberation. Although these are only material results of following religious principles, the //karmīs// consider them everything. Such ritualistic activities are called //karma. Karmīs// who adopt devotional service very loosely and who therefore remain on the platform of material activities are called //prākṛta-sahajiyās.// They cannot understand how pure devotional service is rendered in paternal and conjugal love, for this can be understood only by the special mercy bestowed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon pure devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.101
description: The Lord is very interested in manifesting the exalted qualities of His devotees, and that is why He engineered this incident.
text:
> bhakta-guṇa prakāśite prabhu baḍa raṅgī
> ei saba prakāśite kailā eta bhaṅgī
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---the attributes of the devotee; [[synonyms:p:prakāśite]]---to manifest; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:r:raṅgī]]---very interested; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:p:prakāśite]]---to manifest; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---He performed; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---such; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]---incident.
translation: The Lord is very interested in manifesting the exalted qualities of His devotees, and that is why He engineered this incident.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.102
description: Thus I have briefly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dancing in the hall of the Jagannātha temple. The servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sing about this dancing even now.
text:
> saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ ei pari-muṇḍā-nṛtya
> adyāpiha gāya yāhā caitanyera bhṛtya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]]---in brief; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pari]]-[[synonyms:m:muṇḍā]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing in the dancing hall of Jagannātha's temple; [[synonyms:a:adyāpiha]]---even up-to-dately; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sing about; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---which; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---the servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Thus I have briefly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's dancing in the hall of the Jagannātha temple. The servants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sing about this dancing even now.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.103
description: Accompanied by His personal associates, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and swept the Guṇḍicā temple, cleansing it as usual.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu lañā nija-gaṇa
> guṇḍicā-gṛhera kailā kṣālana, mārjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---accompanied by His personal associates; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhera]]---of the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kṣālana]]---washing; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---cleansing.
translation: Accompanied by His personal associates, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu washed and swept the Guṇḍicā temple, cleansing it as usual.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.104
description: The Lord danced and chanted and then enjoyed a picnic in the garden as He had done before.
text:
> pūrvavat kailā prabhu kīrtana, nartana
> pūrvavat ṭoṭāya kailā vanya-bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dancing; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭoṭāya]]---in the garden; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:v:vanya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---taking a picnic.
translation: The Lord danced and chanted and then enjoyed a picnic in the garden as He had done before.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.105
description: As previously, He danced in front of the Jagannātha cart and observed the festival of Herā-pañcamī.
text:
> pūrvavat ratha-āge karilā nartana
> herā-pañcamī-yātrā kailā daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of the chariot; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---performed dancing; [[synonyms:h:herā]]-[[synonyms:p:pañcamī]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the festival of Herā-pañcamī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---He saw.
translation: As previously, He danced in front of the Jagannātha cart and observed the festival of Herā-pañcamī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.106
description: All the devotees from Bengal stayed in Jagannātha Purī for the four months of the rainy season and observed many other ceremonies, such as the anniversary of Lord Kṛṣṇa's birth.
text:
> cāri-māsa varṣāya rahilā saba bhakta-gaṇa
> janmāṣṭamī ādi yātrā kailā daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for four months; [[synonyms:v:varṣāya]]---of the rainy season; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---stayed; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:j:janmāṣṭamī]] [[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---festivals like Lord Kṛṣṇa's birth ceremony; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---observed.
translation: All the devotees from Bengal stayed in Jagannātha Purī for the four months of the rainy season and observed many other ceremonies, such as the anniversary of Lord Kṛṣṇa's birth.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.107
description: Formerly, when all the devotees had arrived from Bengal, they all desired to give Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu something to eat.
text:
> pūrve yadi gauḍa ha-ite bhakta-gaṇa āila
> prabhure kichu khāoyāite sabāra icchā haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---the devotees arrived; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāite]]---to feed; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---everyone desired.
translation: Formerly, when all the devotees had arrived from Bengal, they all desired to give Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu something to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.108
description: Each devotee would bring a certain type of prasāda. He would entrust it to Govinda and request him, "Please arrange that the Lord will surely eat this prasāda."
text:
> keha kona prasāda āni' deya govinda-ṭhāñi
> 'ihā yena avaśya bhakṣaṇa karena gosāñi'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---some variety of //prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:deya]]---delivers; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to Govinda; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---that; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---eats; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Each devotee would bring a certain type of prasāda. He would entrust it to Govinda and request him, "Please arrange that the Lord will surely eat this prasāda."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.109
description: Some brought paiḍa [a coconut preparation], some brought sweetballs, and some brought cakes and sweet rice. The prasāda was of different varieties, all very costly.
text:
> keha paiḍa, keha nāḍu, keha piṭhā-pānā
> bahu-mūlya uttama-prasāda-prakāra yāra nānā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:p:paiḍa]]---a coconut preparation; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]]---sweetballs; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]---cakes; [[synonyms:p:pānā]]---sweet rice; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---costly; [[synonyms:u:uttama]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---very palatable food; [[synonyms:p:prakāra]] [[synonyms:y:yāra]] [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---of different varieties.
translation: Some brought paiḍa [a coconut preparation], some brought sweetballs, and some brought cakes and sweet rice. The prasāda was of different varieties, all very costly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.110
description: Govinda would present the prasāda and say to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "This has been given by such and such devotee." The Lord, however, would not actually eat it. He would simply say, "Keep it in storage."
text:
> 'amuk ei diyāche' govinda kare nivedana
> 'dhari' rākha' bali' prabhu nā karena bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:amuk]]---such and such devotee; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:diyāche]]---has given; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---informs; [[synonyms:d:dhari']] [[synonyms:r:rākha]]---please keep them; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---does not eat.
translation: Govinda would present the prasāda and say to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "This has been given by such and such devotee." The Lord, however, would not actually eat it. He would simply say, "Keep it in storage."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.111
description: Govinda kept accumulating the food, and soon it filled a corner of the room. There was quite enough to feed at least a hundred people.
text:
> dharite dharite gharera bharila eka koṇa
> śata-janera bhakṣya yata haila sañcayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dharite]] [[synonyms:d:dharite]]---keeping and keeping; [[synonyms:g:gharera]]---of the room; [[synonyms:b:bharila]]---filled up; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:koṇa]]---one corner; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]-[[synonyms:j:janera]]---of one hundred people; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]---sufficient for feeding; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:sañcayana]]---accumulation.
translation: Govinda kept accumulating the food, and soon it filled a corner of the room. There was quite enough to feed at least a hundred people.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.112
description: All the devotees asked Govinda with great eagerness, "Have you given Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the prasāda brought by me?"
text:
> govindere sabe puche kariyā yatana
> 'āmā-datta prasāda prabhure ki karāilā bhakṣaṇa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:puche]]---inquired; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---with great eagerness; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the //prasāda// given by me; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---have you given for eating.
translation: All the devotees asked Govinda with great eagerness, "Have you given Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the prasāda brought by me?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.113
description: When the devotees questioned Govinda, he had to tell them lies. Therefore one day he spoke to the Lord in disappointment.
text:
> kāhāṅ kichu kahi' govinda kare vañcana
> āra dina prabhure kahe nirveda-vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---to someone; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:v:vañcana]]---told lies; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:n:nirveda]]-[[synonyms:v:vacana]]---a statement of disappointment.
translation: When the devotees questioned Govinda, he had to tell them lies. Therefore one day he spoke to the Lord in disappointment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.114
description: "Many respectable devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, make a great endeavor to entrust me with varieties of food for You.
text:
> "ācāryādi mahāśaya kariyā yatane
> tomāre khāoyāite vastu dena mora sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:m:mahāśaya]]---respectable gentlemen; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:y:yatane]]---with great endeavor; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]] [[synonyms:k:khāoyāite]]---to feed You; [[synonyms:v:vastu]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---deliver varieties of food; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to me.
translation: "Many respectable devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, make a great endeavor to entrust me with varieties of food for You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.115
description: "You do not eat it, but they ask me again and again. How long shall I go on cheating them? How shall I be freed from this responsibility?"
text:
> tumi se nā khāo, tāṅrā puche bāra bāra
> kata vañcanā karimu, kemane āmāra nistāra?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāo]]---do not eat; [[synonyms:t:tāṅrā]]---they; [[synonyms:p:puche]]---inquire; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:v:vañcanā]] [[synonyms:k:karimu]]---how long shall I cheat; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:n:nistāra]]---deliverance.
translation: "You do not eat it, but they ask me again and again. How long shall I go on cheating them? How shall I be freed from this responsibility?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.116
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are you so foolishly unhappy? Bring here to Me whatever they have given you."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'ādi-vasyā' duḥkha kāṅhe māne?
> kebā ki diyāche, tāhā ānaha ekhāne'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord replied; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:v:vasyā]]---you who have been residing with Me for a very long time; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:k:kāṅhe]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---why are you unhappy about this; [[synonyms:k:kebā]] [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:d:diyāche]]---whatever they have delivered; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---all that; [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]] [[synonyms:e:ekhāne]]---bring here.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are you so foolishly unhappy? Bring here to Me whatever they have given you."
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura explains that the word //ādi-vasyā// refers to one who has been living with another for a very long time. Govinda was addressed as //ādi-vasyā// because he had been living with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for a very long time, whereas other devotees, who were mostly new, would come and go. In effect, the Lord told Govinda, "Since you have been living with Me for a long time, you should not be foolishly disappointed in this situation. Bring all the food to Me, and you will see that I can eat it."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.117
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down to eat. Then Govinda offered Him the preparations one after another, and as he did so he spoke the name of the person who had given each one.
text:
> eta bali' mahāprabhu vasilā bhojane
> nāma dhari' dhari' govinda kare nivedane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---sat down for eating; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name; [[synonyms:d:dhari']] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---speaking; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---offers.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down to eat. Then Govinda offered Him the preparations one after another, and as he did so he spoke the name of the person who had given each one.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.118
description: "These preparations-paiḍa, sweet rice, cakes made with cream, and also amṛta-guṭikā, maṇḍā and a pot of camphor-have been given by Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> "ācāryera ei paiḍa, pānā-sara-pūpī
> ei amṛta-guṭikā, maṇḍā, karpūra-kūpī
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryera]]---of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:p:paiḍa]]---coconut preparation; [[synonyms:p:pānā]]---sweet rice; [[synonyms:s:sara]]-[[synonyms:p:pūpī]]---cakes made with cream; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:g:guṭikā]]---sweetballs; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍā]]---a type of round sweetmeat; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]-[[synonyms:k:kūpī]]---a pot of camphor.
translation: "These preparations-paiḍa, sweet rice, cakes made with cream, and also amṛta-guṭikā, maṇḍā and a pot of camphor-have been given by Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.119
description: "Next there are varieties of food-cakes, cream, amṛta-maṇḍā and padmacini-given by Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita.
text:
> śrīvāsa-paṇḍitera ei aneka prakāra
> piṭhā, pānā, amṛta-maṇḍā padma-cini āra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---many varieties; [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]---cakes; [[synonyms:p:pānā]]---cream; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇḍā]]---another type of sweetball; [[synonyms:p:padma]]-[[synonyms:c:cini]]---//padma-cini//; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and.
translation: "Next there are varieties of food-cakes, cream, amṛta-maṇḍā and padmacini-given by Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.12
description: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa also came and joined. Śivānanda Sena took the leadership and thus started taking care of them all.
text:
> kulīna-grāmī, khaṇḍa-vāsī mililā āsiyā
> śivānanda-sena calilā sabāre lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kulīna]]-[[synonyms:g:grāmī]]---the residents of Kulīna-grāma; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---the residents of Khaṇḍa; [[synonyms:m:mililā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---came and joined; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them.
translation: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa also came and joined. Śivānanda Sena took the leadership and thus started taking care of them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.120
description: "All these are gifts of Ācāryaratna, and these varieties of gifts are from Ācāryanidhi.
text:
> ācāryaratnera ei saba upahāra
> ācāryanidhira ei, aneka prakāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaratnera]]---of Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---presentations; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryanidhira]]---of Ācāryanidhi; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---of different varieties.
translation: "All these are gifts of Ācāryaratna, and these varieties of gifts are from Ācāryanidhi.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.121
description: "And all these varieties of food have been given by Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta and Buddhimanta Khān.
text:
> vāsudeva-dattera ei murāri-guptera āra
> buddhimanta-khāṅnera ei vividha prakāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]-[[synonyms:d:dattera]]---of Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]-[[synonyms:g:guptera]]---of Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:buddhimanta]]-[[synonyms:k:khāṅnera]]---of Buddhimanta Khān; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:v:vividha]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---of different varieties.
translation: "And all these varieties of food have been given by Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta and Buddhimanta Khān.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.122
description: "These are gifts given by Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita and Ācārya Nandana. Please eat them all.
text:
> śrīmān-sena, śrīmān-paṇḍita, ācārya-nandana
> tāṅ-sabāra datta ei karaha bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīmān]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:ś:śrīmān]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Śrīmān Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---Ācārya Nandana; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:d:datta]]---given; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---please eat.
translation: "These are gifts given by Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita and Ācārya Nandana. Please eat them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.123
description: "Here are the preparations made by the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, and these have been made by the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa."
text:
> kulīna-grāmera ei āge dekha yata
> khaṇḍa-vāsī lokera ei dekha tata"

translation: "Here are the preparations made by the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, and these have been made by the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.124
description: In this way, Govinda gave everyone's name as he put the food before the Lord. Being very satisfied, the Lord began to eat it all.
text:
> aiche sabāra nāma lañā prabhura āge dhare
> santuṣṭa hañā prabhu saba bhojana kare

translation: In this way, Govinda gave everyone's name as he put the food before the Lord. Being very satisfied, the Lord began to eat it all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.125-126
description: The hard sweets made of coconut, mukuta nārikela, the sweetballs, the many kinds of sweet drinks and all the other preparations were at least a month old, but although they were old, they had not become tasteless or stale. Indeed, they had all stayed fresh. That is the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> yadyapi māsekera vāsi mukuta nārikela
> amṛta-guṭikādi, pānādi sakala
> tathāpi nūtana-prāya saba dravyera svāda
> 'vāsi' visvāda nahe sei prabhura prasāda
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:m:māsekera]]---one month; [[synonyms:v:vāsi]]---remaining; [[synonyms:m:mukuta]] [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]---a very hard sweet preparation of coconut; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:g:guṭikā]]---//amṛta-guṭikā// sweetballs; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---etc.; [[synonyms:p:pānā]]---sweet drinks; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nūtana]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---as if fresh; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:d:dravyera]]---of every preparation; [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---the taste; [[synonyms:v:vāsi]]---stale; [[synonyms:v:visvāda]]---tasteless; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---were not; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the mercy of the Lord.
translation: The hard sweets made of coconut, mukuta nārikela, the sweetballs, the many kinds of sweet drinks and all the other preparations were at least a month old, but although they were old, they had not become tasteless or stale. Indeed, they had all stayed fresh. That is the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.127
description: Within a very short time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate enough for a hundred people. Then He asked Govinda, "Is there anything more left?"
text:
> śata-janera bhakṣya prabhu daṇḍeke khāilā!
> 'āra kichu āche?' bali' govinde puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śata]]-[[synonyms:j:janera]]---of one hundred persons; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]---eatables; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍeke]] [[synonyms:k:khāilā]]---ate within twenty-four minutes; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---is there anything more; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:g:govinde]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired.
translation: Within a very short time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate enough for a hundred people. Then He asked Govinda, "Is there anything more left?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.128
description: Govinda replied, "Now there are only the bags of Rāghava." The Lord said, "Let them remain today. I shall see them later."
text:
> govinda bale,---'rāghavera jhāli mātra āche'
> prabhu kahe,---'āji rahu, tāhā dekhimu pāche'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---Govinda replied; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]] [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---the bags given by Rāghava; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there is; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:r:rahu]]---let remain; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dekhimu]]---I shall see; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later.
translation: Govinda replied, "Now there are only the bags of Rāghava." The Lord said, "Let them remain today. I shall see them later."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.129
description: The next day, while taking His lunch in a secluded place, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu opened the bags of Rāghava and inspected their contents one after another.
text:
> āra dina prabhu yadi nibhṛte bhojana kailā
> rāghavera jhāli khuli' sakala dekhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:n:nibhṛte]]---in a secluded place; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---took His lunch; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]]---of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---the bags; [[synonyms:k:khuli']]---opening; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---saw everything.
translation: The next day, while taking His lunch in a secluded place, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu opened the bags of Rāghava and inspected their contents one after another.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.13
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita came with bags full of food prepared very nicely by his sister, Damayantī.
text:
> rāghava-paṇḍita cale jhāli sājāiyā
> damayantī yata dravya diyāche kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:s:sājāiyā]]---after preparing his bag of food; [[synonyms:d:damayantī]]---his sister; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---all the goods; [[synonyms:d:diyāche]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---cooked and prepared.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita came with bags full of food prepared very nicely by his sister, Damayantī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.130
description: He tasted a little of everything they contained and praised it all for its flavor and aroma.
text:
> saba dravyera kichu kichu upayoga kailā
> svādu, sugandhi dekhi' bahu praśaṁsilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:d:dravyera]]---of all the articles; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:u:upayoga]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---used; [[synonyms:s:svādu]]---tasteful; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhi]]---aromatic; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---very much; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁsilā]]---He praised.
translation: He tasted a little of everything they contained and praised it all for its flavor and aroma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.131
description: All the varieties of the remaining prasāda were kept to eat throughout the year. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate His lunch, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would serve it little by little.
text:
> vatsareka tare āra rākhilā dhariyā
> bhojana-kāle svarūpa pariveśe khasāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vatsareka]]---one year; [[synonyms:t:tare]]---for; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---balance; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]] [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---kept in stock; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the time of lunch; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---administered; [[synonyms:k:khasāñā]]---taking out little by little.
translation: All the varieties of the remaining prasāda were kept to eat throughout the year. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate His lunch, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would serve it little by little.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.132
description: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take some of it at night. The Lord certainly enjoys preparations made with faith and love by His devotees.
text:
> kabhu rātri-kāle kichu karena upayoga
> bhaktera śraddhāra dravya avaśya karena upabhoga
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at night; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upayoga]]---used; [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhāra]]---with faith and love; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---preparations; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upabhoga]]---enjoys.
translation: Sometimes Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would take some of it at night. The Lord certainly enjoys preparations made with faith and love by His devotees.
purport:
Kṛṣṇa is very pleased with His devotees and their offerings. Therefore in //Bhagavad-gītā// the Lord says:

> patraṁ puṣpaṁ phalaṁ toyaṁ
> yo me bhaktyā prayacchati
> tad ahaṁ bhakty-upahṛtam
> aśnāmi prayatātmanaḥ

"If one offers Me with love and devotion a leaf, a flower, fruit or water, I will accept it." [[books:bg:9:26|(Bg. 9.26)]] Herein also we find that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted all this food because it had been offered by His devotees. Sometimes He would eat it during lunch and sometimes at night, but He would always think that since His devotees had offered it with great love and affection, He must eat it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.133
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spent the entire period of Cāturmāsya [the four months of the rainy season] in the happiness of discussing topics of Kṛṣṇa with His devotees.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> cāturmāsya goṅāilā kṛṣṇa-kathā-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His personal devotees; [[synonyms:c:cāturmāsya]] [[synonyms:g:goṅāilā]]---passed the four months of the rainy season; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in the happiness of discussing topics about Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spent the entire period of Cāturmāsya [the four months of the rainy season] in the happiness of discussing topics of Kṛṣṇa with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.134
description: From time to time, Advaita Ācārya and others would invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for home-cooked rice and varieties of vegetables.
text:
> madhye madhye ācāryādi kare nimantraṇa
> ghare bhāta rāndhe āra vividha vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---at intervals; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---Advaita Ācārya and others; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invite; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---rice; [[synonyms:r:rāndhe]]---cook; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:v:vividha]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---varieties of vegetables.
translation: From time to time, Advaita Ācārya and others would invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for home-cooked rice and varieties of vegetables.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.135-136
description: They offered pungent preparations made with black pepper, sweet-and-sour preparations, ginger, salty preparations, limes, milk, yogurt, cheese, two or four kinds of spinach, soup made with bitter melon, eggplant mixed with nimba flowers, and fried paṭola.
text:
> maricera jhāla, āra madhurāmla āra
> ādā, lavaṇa, lembu, dugdha, dadhi, khaṇḍa-sāra
>
> śāka dui-cāri, āra sukutāra jhola
> nimba-vārtākī, āra bhṛṣṭa-paṭola
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:maricera]] [[synonyms:j:jhāla]]---a pungent preparation with black pepper; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---as well as; [[synonyms:m:madhurāmla]]---a sweet-and-sour preparation; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:ā:ādā]]---ginger; [[synonyms:l:lavaṇa]]---salted preparations; [[synonyms:l:lembu]]---lime; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---milk; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]---cheese; [[synonyms:ś:śāka]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]]---spinach of two to four kinds; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:s:sukutāra]] [[synonyms:j:jhola]]---a soup made of bitter melon; [[synonyms:n:nimba]]-[[synonyms:v:vārtākī]]---eggplant mixed with //nimba// leaves; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bhṛṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭola]]---fried //paṭola.//
translation: They offered pungent preparations made with black pepper, sweet-and-sour preparations, ginger, salty preparations, limes, milk, yogurt, cheese, two or four kinds of spinach, soup made with bitter melon, eggplant mixed with nimba flowers, and fried paṭola.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.137
description: They also offered phula-baḍī, liquid mung dhal and many vegetables, all cooked according to the Lord's taste.
text:
> bhṛṣṭa phula-baḍī, āra mudga-ḍāli-sūpa
> vividha vyañjana rāndhe prabhura ruci-anurūpa
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhṛṣṭa]]---fried; [[synonyms:p:phula]]-[[synonyms:b:baḍī]]---a hot //dhal// preparation; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:m:mudga]]-[[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāli]]-[[synonyms:s:sūpa]]---a liquid preparation made from mung //dhal//; [[synonyms:v:vividha]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---varieties of vegetables; [[synonyms:r:rāndhe]]---used to cook; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:r:ruci]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]]---very tasteful for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: They also offered phula-baḍī, liquid mung dhal and many vegetables, all cooked according to the Lord's taste.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.138
description: They would mix these preparations with the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the invitations, He went sometimes alone and sometimes with His associates.
text:
> jagannāthera prasāda āne karite miśrita
> kāhāṅ ekā yāyena, kāhāṅ gaṇera sahita
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---bring; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:m:miśrita]]---mixing; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---somewhere; [[synonyms:e:ekā]] [[synonyms:y:yāyena]]---goes alone; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---somewhere; [[synonyms:g:gaṇera]] [[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with associates.
translation: They would mix these preparations with the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the invitations, He went sometimes alone and sometimes with His associates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.139
description: Devotees like Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Nandana Ācārya, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Śrīvāsa were all of the brāhmaṇa caste.
text:
> ācāryaratna, ācāryanidhi, nandana, rāghava
> śrīvāsa-ādi yata bhakta, vipra saba
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaratna]]---Ācāryaratna; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryanidhi]]---Ācāryanidhi; [[synonyms:n:nandana]]---Nandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all devotees; [[synonyms:v:vipra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all //brāhmaṇas.//
translation: Devotees like Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Nandana Ācārya, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Śrīvāsa were all of the brāhmaṇa caste.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.14
description: Damayantī made varieties of unparalleled food just suitable for Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to eat. The Lord ate it continually for one year.
text:
> nānā apūrva bhakṣya-dravya prabhura yogya bhoga
> vatsareka prabhu yāhā karena upayoga
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:u:upūrva]]---unparalleled; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]]---eatables; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yogya]] [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---just suitable for the eating; [[synonyms:v:vatsareka]]---for one year; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---which; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upayoga]]---uses.
translation: Damayantī made varieties of unparalleled food just suitable for Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to eat. The Lord ate it continually for one year.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.140-141
description: They would extend invitations to the Lord. Vāsudeva Datta, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri Gupta, the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa and many other devotees who were not brāhmaṇas by caste would purchase food offered to Lord Jagannātha and then extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei-mata nimantraṇa karena yatna kari
> vāsudeva, gadādhara-dāsa, gupta-murāri
>
> kulīna-grāmī, khaṇḍa-vāsī, āra yata jana
> jagannāthera prasāda āni' kare nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---like this; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---execute; [[synonyms:y:yatna]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---with devotion; [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]---Vāsudeva; [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Gadādhara dāsa; [[synonyms:g:gupta]]-[[synonyms:m:murāri]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:k:kulīna]]-[[synonyms:g:grāmī]]---the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---many other persons; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of the food of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invite.
translation: They would extend invitations to the Lord. Vāsudeva Datta, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri Gupta, the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa and many other devotees who were not brāhmaṇas by caste would purchase food offered to Lord Jagannātha and then extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma, such as Satyarāja Khān and Rāmānanda Vasu, were not //brāhmaṇas// by caste, nor were the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa, such as Mukunda dāsa, Narahari dāsa and Raghunandana. Therefore they would purchase //prasāda// from the market where the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food was sold and then extend invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whereas Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi and others who were //brāhmaṇas// by caste would cook at home when they invited the Lord. Caitanya Mahāprabhu observed the etiquette then current in society by accepting only //prasāda// cooked by members of the //brāhmaṇa// caste, but on principle He accepted invitations from His devotees, regardless of whether they were //brāhmaṇas// by caste.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.142
description: Now hear about the invitation Śivānanda Sena extended to the Lord. His eldest son was named Caitanya dāsa.
text:
> śivānanda-senera śuna nimantraṇākhyāna
> śivānandera baḍa-putrera 'caitanya-dāsa' nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:senera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākhyāna]]---the story of the invitation; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:putrera]]---of the eldest son; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name is Caitanya dāsa.
translation: Now hear about the invitation Śivānanda Sena extended to the Lord. His eldest son was named Caitanya dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.143
description: When Śivānanda brought his son, Caitanya dāsa, to be introduced to the Lord, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about his name.
text:
> prabhure milāite tāṅre saṅgei ānilā
> milāile, prabhu tāṅra nāma ta' puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:m:milāite]]---to introduce to the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him, //Caitanya dāsa//; [[synonyms:s:saṅgei]]---along; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:m:milāile]]---when he introduced him; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thereupon; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired.
translation: When Śivānanda brought his son, Caitanya dāsa, to be introduced to the Lord, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired about his name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.144
description: When the Lord heard that his name was Caitanya dāsa, He said, "What kind of name have you given him? It is very difficult to understand."
text:
> 'caitanya-dāsa' nāma śuni' kahe gaura-rāya
> 'kibā nāma dharāñācha, bujhana nā yāya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Caitanya dāsa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---what; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:d:dharāñācha]]---you have given; [[synonyms:b:bujhana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---it cannot be understood.
translation: When the Lord heard that his name was Caitanya dāsa, He said, "What kind of name have you given him? It is very difficult to understand."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.145
description: Śivānanda Sena replied, "He has kept the name that appeared to me from within." Then he invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch.
text:
> sena kahe,---'ye jāniluṅ, sei nāma dharila'
> eta bali' mahāprabhure nimantraṇa kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sena]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śivānanda Sena replied; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:j:jāniluṅ]]---whatever I know; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---that name; [[synonyms:d:dharila]]---he has kept; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---gave an invitation.
translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "He has kept the name that appeared to me from within." Then he invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.146
description: Śivānanda Sena had bought very costly remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food. He brought it in and offered it to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who sat down to accept the prasāda with His associates.
text:
> jagannāthera bahu-mūlya prasāda ānāilā
> bhakta-gaṇe lañā prabhu bhojane vasilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---very costly; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:ā:ānāilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking along; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]] [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down to accept //prasāda.//
translation: Śivānanda Sena had bought very costly remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food. He brought it in and offered it to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who sat down to accept the prasāda with His associates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.147
description: Because of Śivānanda Sena's glories, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate all kinds of prasāda to honor his request. However, the Lord ate more than necessary, and therefore His mind was dissatisfied.
text:
> śivānandera gaurave prabhu karilā bhojana
> ati-guru-bhojane prabhura prasanna nahe mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:g:gaurave]]---out of honor; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---ate; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---because of eating too much; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prasanna]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind was not satisfied.
translation: Because of Śivānanda Sena's glories, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate all kinds of prasāda to honor his request. However, the Lord ate more than necessary, and therefore His mind was dissatisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.148
description: The next day, Caitanya dāsa, the son of Śivānanda Sena, extended an invitation to the Lord. He could understand the Lord's mind, however, and therefore he arranged for a different kind of food.
text:
> āra dina caitanya-dāsa kailā nimantraṇa
> prabhura 'abhīṣṭa' bujhi' ānilā vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---next day; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---the son of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invited; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:abhīṣṭa]]---desire; [[synonyms:b:bujhi']]---understanding; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---bought different vegetables.
translation: The next day, Caitanya dāsa, the son of Śivānanda Sena, extended an invitation to the Lord. He could understand the Lord's mind, however, and therefore he arranged for a different kind of food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.149
description: He offered yogurt, limes, ginger, soft baḍā and salt. Seeing all these arrangements, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased.
text:
> dadhi, lembu, ādā, āra phula-baḍā, lavaṇa
> sāmagrī dekhiyā prabhura prasanna haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:l:lembu]]---lime; [[synonyms:ā:ādā]]---ginger; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:phula]]-[[synonyms:b:baḍā]]---soft cake made of //dhal//; [[synonyms:l:lavaṇa]]---salt; [[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing these ingredients; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prasanna]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation:
He offered yogurt, limes, ginger, soft baḍā and salt. Seeing all these arrangements, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very pleased.


PURPORT

By the grace of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Caitanya dāsa understood the Lord's mind. Therefore he arranged for food that would counteract the heavy meal the Lord had eaten the previous day.

Later in life, Caitanya dāsa became a very learned Sanskrit scholar and wrote many books. Among these books, his commentary on //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta// is very famous. There is another book called //Caitanya-caritāmṛta,// which is a work of Sanskrit poetry. It is said that this was also composed by him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.15-16

> āmra-kāśandi, ādā-kāśandi jhāla-kāśandi nāma
> nembu-ādā āmra-koli vividha vidhāna
>
> āmsi, āma-khaṇḍa, tailāmra, āma-sattā
> yatna kari' guṇḍā kari' purāṇa sukutā

translation: These are the names of some of the pickles and condiments in the bags of Rāghava Paṇḍita: āmra-kāśandi, ādā-kāśandi, jhāla-kāśandi, nembu-ādā, āmra-koli, āmsi, āma-khaṇḍa, tailāmra and āma-sattā. With great attention, Damayantī also made dried bitter vegetables into a powder.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.150
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "This boy knows My mind. Therefore I am very satisfied to keep his invitation."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"ei bālaka āmāra mata jāne

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "This boy knows My mind. Therefore I am very satisfied to keep his invitation."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.151
description: After saying this, the Lord ate the rice mixed with yogurt and offered Caitanya dāsa the remnants of His food.
text:
> eta bali' dadhi-bhāta karilā bhojana
> caitanya-dāsere dilā ucchiṣṭa-bhājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---yogurt with rice; [[synonyms:k:karilābhojana]]---ate; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsere]]---unto Caitanya dāsa; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---He offered; [[synonyms:u:ucchiṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhājana]]---the remnants of His food.
translation: After saying this, the Lord ate the rice mixed with yogurt and offered Caitanya dāsa the remnants of His food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.152
description: The four months of Cāturmāsya passed in this manner, with the Lord accepting invitations from His devotees. Because of a heavy schedule of invitations, however, some of the Vaiṣṇavas could not get an open day on which to invite the Lord.
text:
> cāri-māsa ei-mata nimantraṇe yāya
> kona kona vaiṣṇava 'divasa' nāhi pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for four months; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇe]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu keeps His invitations; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---some of the Vaiṣṇava devotees; [[synonyms:d:divasa]]---day; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---could not get.
translation: The four months of Cāturmāsya passed in this manner, with the Lord accepting invitations from His devotees. Because of a heavy schedule of invitations, however, some of the Vaiṣṇavas could not get an open day on which to invite the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.153
description: Gadādhara Paṇḍita and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya had fixed dates on which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would accept their invitations every month.
text:
> gadādhara-paṇḍita, bhaṭṭācārya sārvabhauma
> iṅhā sabāra āche bhikṣāra divasa-niyama

translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya had fixed dates on which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would accept their invitations every month.

text:

> bhagavān, rāmabhadrācārya, śaṅkara, vakreśvara
>

synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Gopīnātha Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---Bhagavān; [[synonyms:r:rāmabhadra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Rāmabhadrācārya; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---at intervals; [[synonyms:g:ghara]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāte]]---with rice at home; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invite; [[synonyms:a:anyera]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---for others' invitations; [[synonyms:p:prasāde]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇa]]---two //panas// of //conchshells// (160 conchshells).
translation: Gopīnātha Ācārya, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara, Bhagavān, Rāmabhadrācārya, Śaṅkara and Vakreśvara, who were all brāhmaṇas, extended invitations to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and offered Him food cooked at home, whereas other devotees would pay two paṇas of small conchshells to purchase Jagannātha's prasāda and then invite the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.156
description: At first the cost of Jagannātha prasāda for an invitation was four paṇas of conchshells, but when Rāmacandra Purī was there, the price was cut in half.
text:
> prathame āchila 'nirbandha' kauḍi cāri-paṇa
> rāmacandra-purī-bha ye ghāṭāilā nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prathame]]---in the beginning; [[synonyms:ā:āchila]]---it was; [[synonyms:n:nirbandha]]---fixed; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇa]]---four //paṇas// of conchshells; [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---because of the restriction of Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭāilā]]---decreased; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---the price of an invitation.
translation: At first the cost of Jagannātha prasāda for an invitation was four paṇas of conchshells, but when Rāmacandra Purī was there, the price was cut in half.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.157
description: The devotees who came from Bengal stayed with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for four consecutive months, and then the Lord bade them farewell. After the Bengali devotees departed, the devotees who were the Lord's constant companions at Jagannātha Purī stayed with the Lord.
text:
> cāri-māsa rahi' gauḍera bhakte vidāya dilā
> nīlācalera saṅgī bhakta saṅgei rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining for four months; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]] [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---to the devotees coming from Bengal; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bade farewell; [[synonyms:n:nīlācalera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅgī]]---associates at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:s:saṅgei]]---with; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained.
translation: The devotees who came from Bengal stayed with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for four consecutive months, and then the Lord bade them farewell. After the Bengali devotees departed, the devotees who were the Lord's constant companions at Jagannātha Purī stayed with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.158
description: Thus I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted invitations and how He accepted and tasted the prasāda offered by His devotees.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura bhikṣā-nimantraṇa
> bhakta-datta vastu yaiche kailā āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]-[[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---the invitation to dine; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]]---offered by the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]---things; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---He tasted.
translation: Thus I have described how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted invitations and how He accepted and tasted the prasāda offered by His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.159
description: In the midst of that narration are descriptions of Rāghava Paṇḍita's bags of food and the dancing in the temple of Jagannātha.
text:
> tāra madhye rāghavera jhāli-vivaraṇa
> tāra madhye pari-muṇḍā-nṛtya-kathana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the midst of that; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]]---of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]-[[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---description of the bags of food; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---along with that; [[synonyms:p:pari]]-[[synonyms:m:muṇḍā]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:k:kathana]]---the description of dancing in the temple of Jagannātha.
translation: In the midst of that narration are descriptions of Rāghava Paṇḍita's bags of food and the dancing in the temple of Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.160
description: One who hears about the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will certainly attain ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without fail.
text:
> śraddhā kari' śune yei caitanyera kathā
> caitanya-caraṇe prema pāibe sarvathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great faith and love; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---the narration of the activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:p:pāibe]]---must achieve; [[synonyms:s:sarvathā]]---without fail.
translation: One who hears about the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with faith and love will certainly attain ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without fail.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.161
description: Narrations of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities are just like nectar to hear. Indeed, they satisfy both the ears and mind. One who tastes the nectar of these activities is certainly very fortunate.
text:
> śunite amṛta-sama juḍāya karṇa-mana
> sei bhāgyavān, yei kare āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---just like nectar; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]] [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---satisfies the ears and mind; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---he is very fortunate; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tastes.
translation: Narrations of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities are just like nectar to hear. Indeed, they satisfy both the ears and mind. One who tastes the nectar of these activities is certainly very fortunate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.162
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Tenth Chapter, describing how Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tasted the prasāda offered by His devotees.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.17
description: Do not neglect sukutā because it is a bitter preparation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derived more happiness from eating this sukutā than from drinking pañcāmṛta [a preparation of milk, sugar, ghee, honey and curd].
text:
> 'sukutā' bali' avajñā nā kariha citte
> sukutāya ye sukha prabhura, tāhā nahe pañcāmṛte
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sukutā]]---sukutā; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---because; [[synonyms:a:avajñā]]---neglect; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do not make; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:s:sukutāya]]---from //sukutā//; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:p:pañcāmṛte]]---in //pañcāmṛta.//
translation: Do not neglect sukutā because it is a bitter preparation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu derived more happiness from eating this sukutā than from drinking pañcāmṛta [a preparation of milk, sugar, ghee, honey and curd].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.18
description: Since Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He extracts the purpose from everything. He accepted Damayantī's affection for Him, and therefore He derived great pleasure even from the dried bitter leaves of sukutā and from kāśandi [a sour condiment].
text:
> bhāva-grāhī mahāprabhu sneha-mātra laya
> sukutā pātā kāśandite mahā-sukha pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:g:grāhī]]---one who accepts the purpose; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sneha]]---affection; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---accepts; [[synonyms:s:sukutā]] [[synonyms:p:pātā]]---in leaves of //sukutā//; [[synonyms:k:kāśandite]]---in //kāśandi//; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---much pleasure; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets.
translation: Since Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He extracts the purpose from everything. He accepted Damayantī's affection for Him, and therefore He derived great pleasure even from the dried bitter leaves of sukutā and from kāśandi [a sour condiment].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.19
description: Because of her natural love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Damayantī considered the Lord an ordinary human being. Therefore she thought that He would become sick by overeating and there would be mucus within His abdomen.
text:
> 'manuṣya'-buddhi damayantī kare prabhura pāya
> guru-bhojane udare kabhu 'āma' hañā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhi]]---considering an ordinary human being; [[synonyms:d:damayantī]]---the sister of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---by overeating; [[synonyms:u:udare]]---in the abdomen; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:ā:āma]]---mucus; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---there is.
translation: Because of her natural love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Damayantī considered the Lord an ordinary human being. Therefore she thought that He would become sick by overeating and there would be mucus within His abdomen.
purport: Because of pure love, the devotees of Kṛṣṇa in Goloka Vṛndāvana, Vrajabhūmi, loved Kṛṣṇa as an ordinary human being like them. Yet although they considered Kṛṣṇa one of them, their love for Kṛṣṇa knew no bounds. Similarly, because of extreme love, devotees like Rāghava Paṇḍita and his sister, Damayantī, thought of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a human being, but their love for Him was boundless. By overeating, an ordinary human being becomes prone to a disease called //amla-pitta,// which is a product of indigestion characterized by acidity of the stomach. Damayantī thought that such a condition would afflict Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!
text:
> jaya jaya gauracandra jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Gaurāṅga.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.20
description: Because of sincere affection, she thought that eating this sukutā would cure the Lord's disease. Considering these affectionate thoughts of Damayantī, the Lord was very pleased.
text:
> sukutā khāile sei āma ha-ibeka nāśa
> ei sneha mane bhāvi' prabhura ullāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sukutā]] [[synonyms:k:khāile]]---by eating the //sukutā//; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ā:āma]]---that mucus; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibeka]] [[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---will be vanquished; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sneha]]---affection; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:b:bhāvi']]---thinking of; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---delight.
translation: Because of sincere affection, she thought that eating this sukutā would cure the Lord's disease. Considering these affectionate thoughts of Damayantī, the Lord was very pleased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.21
description: "A dear lover strung a garland and placed it on the shoulder of his beloved in the presence of her co-wives. She had raised breasts and was very beautiful, yet although the garland was tainted with mud, she did not reject it, for its value lay not in material things but in love."
text:
> priyeṇa saṅgrathya vipakṣa-sannidhāv
> upāhitāṁ vakṣasi pīvara-stanī
> srajaṁ na kācid vijahau jalāvilāṁ
> vasanti hi premṇi guṇā na vastuni
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:priyeṇa]]---by the lover; [[synonyms:s:saṅgrathya]]---after stringing; [[synonyms:v:vipakṣa]]-[[synonyms:s:sannidhau]]---in the presence of an opposite party; [[synonyms:u:upāhitām]]---placed; [[synonyms:v:vakṣasi]]---on the chest; [[synonyms:p:pīvara]]-[[synonyms:s:stanī]]---having raised breasts; [[synonyms:s:srajam]]---a garland; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kācit]]---some beloved; [[synonyms:v:vijahau]]---rejected; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvilām]]---muddy; [[synonyms:v:vasanti]]---reside; [[synonyms:h:hi]]---because; [[synonyms:p:premṇi]]---in love; [[synonyms:g:guṇāḥ]]---attributes; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:v:vastuni]]---in the material things.
translation: "A dear lover strung a garland and placed it on the shoulder of his beloved in the presence of her co-wives. She had raised breasts and was very beautiful, yet although the garland was tainted with mud, she did not reject it, for its value lay not in material things but in love."
purport: This is a verse from the //Kirātārjunīya// by Bhāravī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.22
description: Damayantī powdered coriander and anise seeds, cooked them with sugar and made them into small sweetmeats that were shaped like small balls.
text:
> dhaniyā-mauharīra taṇḍula guṇḍā kariyā
> nāḍu bāndhiyāche cini-pāka kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhaniyā]]---of coriander seeds; [[synonyms:m:mauharīra]]---of anise seeds; [[synonyms:t:taṇḍula]]---grains; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---grinding to a powder; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyāche]]---rendered into //laḍḍus//; [[synonyms:c:cini]]-[[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---cooking with sugar.
translation: Damayantī powdered coriander and anise seeds, cooked them with sugar and made them into small sweetmeats that were shaped like small balls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.23
description: She made balls of sweetmeats with dried ginger to remove mucus caused by too much bile. She put all these preparations separately into small cloth bags.
text:
> śuṇṭhi-khaṇḍa nāḍu, āra āma-pitta-hara
> pṛthak pṛthak bāndhi' vastrera kuthalī bhitara
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuṇṭhi]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]] [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]]---sweetmeat balls made with dried ginger; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:āma]]-[[synonyms:p:pitta]]-[[synonyms:h:hara]]---which removes mucus caused by too much bile; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separately; [[synonyms:b:bāndhi']]---packaging; [[synonyms:v:vastrera]]---of cloth; [[synonyms:k:kuthalī]]---small bags; [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---within.
translation: She made balls of sweetmeats with dried ginger to remove mucus caused by too much bile. She put all these preparations separately into small cloth bags.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.24
description: She made a hundred varieties of condiments and pickles. She also made koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa and many other preparations. How many should I name?
text:
> koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa āra
> kata nāma la-iba, śata-prakāra 'ācāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koli]]-[[synonyms:ś:śuṇṭhi]]---dried ginger and berries; [[synonyms:k:koli]]-[[synonyms:c:cūrṇa]]---powder of berries; [[synonyms:k:koli]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]---another preparation of berries; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---how many names; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:iba]]---I shall call; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---a hundred varieties; [[synonyms:ā:ācāra]]---condiments and pickles.
translation: She made a hundred varieties of condiments and pickles. She also made koli-śuṇṭhi, koli-cūrṇa, koli-khaṇḍa and many other preparations. How many should I name?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.25
description: She made many sweetmeats shaped like balls. Some were made with powdered coconut, and others looked as white as the water of the Ganges. In this way she made many varieties of long-lasting sugar confections.
text:
> nārikela-khaṇḍa nāḍu, āra nāḍu gaṅgā-jala
> cira-sthāyī khaṇḍa-vikāra karilā sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]] [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]]---sweetmeat balls made with coconut powder; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]] [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:j:jala]]---a sweetmeat ball as white as Ganges water; [[synonyms:c:cira]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāyi]]---long-lasting; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---modified forms of sugar-candy sweets; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: She made many sweetmeats shaped like balls. Some were made with powdered coconut, and others looked as white as the water of the Ganges. In this way she made many varieties of long-lasting sugar confections.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.26
description: She made long-lasting cheese, many varieties of sweetmeats with milk and cream, and many other varied preparations, such as amṛta-karpūra.
text:
> cira-sthāyī kṣīra-sāra, maṇḍādi-vikāra
> amṛta-karpūra ādi aneka prakāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cira]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāyī]]---long-lasting; [[synonyms:k:kṣīra]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]---cheese; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍādi]]-[[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---varieties of sweetmeats made from //maṇḍa,// or milk and cream; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:k:karpūra]]---a preparation made with milk and camphor; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---many varieties.
translation: She made long-lasting cheese, many varieties of sweetmeats with milk and cream, and many other varied preparations, such as amṛta-karpūra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.27
description: She made flat rice from fine, unboiled, śāli paddy and filled a large bag made of new cloth.
text:
> śālikācuṭi-dhānyera 'ātapa' ciḍā kari'
> nūtana-vastrera baḍa kuthalī saba bhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śālikācuṭi]]-[[synonyms:d:dhānyera]]---of a kind of fine rice; [[synonyms:ā:ātapa]]---dried in the sunshine; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making flat rice; [[synonyms:n:nūtana]]-[[synonyms:v:vastrera]]---of new cloth; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kuthalī]]---a large bag; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling.
translation: She made flat rice from fine, unboiled, śāli paddy and filled a large bag made of new cloth.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.28
description: She made some of the flat rice into puffed rice, fried it in ghee, cooked it in sugar juice, mixed in some camphor and rolled it into balls.
text:
> kateka ciḍā huḍum kari' ghṛtete bhājiyā
> cini-pāke nāḍu kailā karpūrādi diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kateka]] [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---some of the flat rice; [[synonyms:h:huḍum]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making into puffed rice; [[synonyms:g:ghṛtete]] [[synonyms:b:bhājiyā]]---frying in ghee; [[synonyms:c:cini]]-[[synonyms:p:pāke]]---by cooking in sugar juice; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made into round balls; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---mixing with camphor and other ingredients.
translation: She made some of the flat rice into puffed rice, fried it in ghee, cooked it in sugar juice, mixed in some camphor and rolled it into balls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.29-30
description: She powdered fried grains of fine rice, moistened the powder with ghee and cooked it in a solution of sugar. Then she added camphor, black pepper, cloves, cardamom and other spices and rolled it into balls that were very palatable and aromatic.
text:
> śāli-dhānyera taṇḍula-bhājā cūrṇa kariyā
> ghṛta-sikta cūrṇa kailā cini-pāka diyā
>
> karpūra, marica, lavaṅga, elāci, rasavāsa
> cūrṇa diyā nāḍu kailā parama suvāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śāli]]-[[synonyms:d:dhānyera]]---of rice of a fine quality; [[synonyms:t:taṇḍula]]---the grains; [[synonyms:b:bhājā]]---being fried; [[synonyms:c:cūrṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making it into a powder; [[synonyms:g:ghṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sikta]]---moistened with ghee; [[synonyms:c:cūrṇa]]---the powder; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:c:cini]]-[[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---by cooking with sugar; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]---camphor; [[synonyms:m:marica]]---black pepper; [[synonyms:l:lavaṅga]]---cloves; [[synonyms:e:elāci]]---cardamom; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---and other spices; [[synonyms:c:cūrṇa]]---to the powder; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---adding; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]]---round sweetmeats; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---very palatable.
translation: She powdered fried grains of fine rice, moistened the powder with ghee and cooked it in a solution of sugar. Then she added camphor, black pepper, cloves, cardamom and other spices and rolled it into balls that were very palatable and aromatic.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.3
description: The next year, all the devotees were very pleased to go to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> varṣāntare saba bhakta prabhure dekhite
> parama-ānande sabe nīlācala yāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---at the next year; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala.
translation: The next year, all the devotees were very pleased to go to Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala] to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.31
description: She took parched rice from fine paddy, fried it in ghee, cooked it in a sugar solution, mixed in some camphor and thus made a preparation called ukhḍā or muḍki.
text:
> śāli-dhānyera kha-i punaḥ ghṛtete bhājiyā
> cini-pāka ukhḍā kailā karpūrādi diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śāli]]-[[synonyms:d:dhānyera]] [[synonyms:k:kha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---parched rice from fine paddy; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:g:ghṛtete]] [[synonyms:b:bhājiyā]]---frying with ghee; [[synonyms:c:cini]]-[[synonyms:p:pāka]]---boiling with sugar juice; [[synonyms:u:ukhḍā]]---of the name //ukhḍā//; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---mixing with camphor.
translation: She took parched rice from fine paddy, fried it in ghee, cooked it in a sugar solution, mixed in some camphor and thus made a preparation called ukhḍā or muḍki.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.32
description: Another variety of sweet was made with fused peas that were powdered, fried in ghee and then cooked in sugar juice. Camphor was mixed in, and then the sweet was rolled into a ball.
text:
> phuṭkalāi cūrṇa kari' ghṛte bhājāila
> cini-pāke karpūrādi diyā nāḍu kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:phuṭkalāi]]---fused peas fried in ghee and soaked in sugar juice; [[synonyms:c:cūrṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making into powder; [[synonyms:g:ghṛte]] [[synonyms:b:bhājāila]]---fried with ghee; [[synonyms:c:cini]]-[[synonyms:p:pāke]]---cooking with sugar; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---camphor and other ingredients; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---adding; [[synonyms:n:nāḍu]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made round sweetmeat balls.
translation: Another variety of sweet was made with fused peas that were powdered, fried in ghee and then cooked in sugar juice. Camphor was mixed in, and then the sweet was rolled into a ball.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.33
description: I could not mention the names of all these wonderful eatables, even in a lifetime. Damayantī made hundreds and thousands of varieties.
text:
> kahite nā jāni nāma e-janme yāhāra
> aiche nānā bhakṣya-dravya sahasra-prakāra
