synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I cannot speak; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the names; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:j:janme]]---in this life; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---similar; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---many; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]]---eatables; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---hundreds and thousands of varieties.
translation: I could not mention the names of all these wonderful eatables, even in a lifetime. Damayantī made hundreds and thousands of varieties.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.34
description: Damayantī made all these preparations following the order of her brother, Rāghava Paṇḍita. Both of them had unlimited affection for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and were advanced in devotional service.
text:
> rāghavera ājñā, āra karena damayantī
> duṅhāra prabhute sneha parama-bhakati
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---executes; [[synonyms:d:damayantī]]---Damayantī; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhute]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sneha]]---affection; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakati]]---highly developed devotional service.
translation: Damayantī made all these preparations following the order of her brother, Rāghava Paṇḍita. Both of them had unlimited affection for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and were advanced in devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.35
description: Damayantī took earth from the Ganges, dried it, powdered it, strained it through a fine cloth, mixed in aromatic ingredients and rolled it into small balls.
text:
> gaṅgā-mṛttikā āni' vastrete chāniyā
> pāṅpaḍi kariyā dilā gandha-dravya diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:m:mṛttikā]]---dirt from the River Ganges; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:v:vastrete]]---through a cloth; [[synonyms:c:chāniyā]]---pressing; [[synonyms:p:pāṅpaḍi]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---made into small balls; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---mixing with aromatic agents.
translation: Damayantī took earth from the Ganges, dried it, powdered it, strained it through a fine cloth, mixed in aromatic ingredients and rolled it into small balls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.36
description: The condiments and similar items were put into thin earthen pots, and everything else was put into small cloth bags.
text:
> pātala mṛt-pātre sandhānādi bhari'
> āra saba vastu bhare vastrera kuthalī
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pātala]]---thin; [[synonyms:m:mṛt]]-[[synonyms:p:pātre]]---in pots of earth; [[synonyms:s:sandhāna]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---condiments and other items; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]---things; [[synonyms:b:bhare]]---filled; [[synonyms:v:vastrera]] [[synonyms:k:kuthalī]]---small bags of cloth.
translation: The condiments and similar items were put into thin earthen pots, and everything else was put into small cloth bags.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.37
description: From small bags Damayantī made bags that were twice as large. Then with great attention she filled all the large ones with the small ones.
text:
> sāmānya jhāli haite dviguṇa jhāli kailā
> pāripāṭi kari' saba jhāli bharāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāmānya]]---small; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---bags; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---twice as big; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---bags; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:p:pāripāṭi]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great attention; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---all the bags; [[synonyms:b:bharāilā]]---she filled.
translation: From small bags Damayantī made bags that were twice as large. Then with great attention she filled all the large ones with the small ones.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.38
description: She then wrapped and sealed each and every bag with great attention. The bags were carried by three bearers, one after another.
text:
> jhāli bāndhi' mohara dila āgraha kariyā
> tina bojhāri jhāli vahe krama kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhi']]---binding the bags; [[synonyms:m:mohara]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---she sealed; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great attention; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:b:bojhāri]]---three carriers; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---carried the bags; [[synonyms:k:krama]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---one after another.
translation: She then wrapped and sealed each and every bag with great attention. The bags were carried by three bearers, one after another.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.39
description: Thus I have briefly described the bags that have become famous as rāghavera jhāli.
text:
> saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ ei jhālira vicāra
> 'rāghavera jhāli' bali' vikhyāti yāhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]]---in brief; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have spoken; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:j:jhālira]]---of these bags; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---the description; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]] [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---the bags of Rāghava; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---as; [[synonyms:v:vikhyāti]]---the fame; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which.
translation: Thus I have briefly described the bags that have become famous as rāghavera jhāli.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.4
description: Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi led the party from Bengal. He was followed by Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and other glorious devotees.
text:
> advaitācārya-gosāñi---sarva-agra-gaṇya
> ācāryaratna, ācāryanidhi, śrīvāsa ādi dhanya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Advaita Ācārya Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---of all; [[synonyms:a:agra]]---the chief; [[synonyms:g:gaṇya]]---to be counted; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaratna]]---Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryanidhi]]---Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorious.
translation: Advaita Ācārya Gosāñi led the party from Bengal. He was followed by Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and other glorious devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.40
description: The superintendent for all those bags was Makaradhvaja Kara, who kept them with great attention like his very life.
text:
> jhālira upara 'munsiba' makaradhvaja-kara
> prāṇa-rūpe jhāli rākhe hañā tatpara
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhālira]] [[synonyms:u:upara]]---upon the bags; [[synonyms:m:munsiba]]---the superintendent; [[synonyms:m:makaradhvaja]]-[[synonyms:k:kara]]---Makaradhvaja Kara; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---like his life; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---he keeps the bags; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:t:tatpara]]---with great attention.
translation: The superintendent for all those bags was Makaradhvaja Kara, who kept them with great attention like his very life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.41
description: Thus all the Vaiṣṇavas from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī. By chance, they arrived on the day when Lord Jagannātha performs pastimes in the water.
text:
> ei-mate vaiṣṇava saba nīlācale āilā
> daive jagannāthera se dina jala-līlā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Nīlācala; [[synonyms:d:daive]]---by chance; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---that day; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes in the water.
translation: Thus all the Vaiṣṇavas from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī. By chance, they arrived on the day when Lord Jagannātha performs pastimes in the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.42
description: Boarding a boat in the waters of Narendra-sarovara, Lord Govinda performed His water pastimes with all the devotees.
text:
> narendrera jale 'govinda' naukāte caḍiyā
> jala-krīḍā kare saba bhakta-gaṇa lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:narendrera]] [[synonyms:j:jale]]---upon the water of the lake known as Narendra-sarovara; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Lord Govinda; [[synonyms:n:naukāte]] [[synonyms:c:caḍiyā]]---getting aboard a boat; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---displays His water pastimes; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking.
translation: Boarding a boat in the waters of Narendra-sarovara, Lord Govinda performed His water pastimes with all the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.43
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived with His personal associates to see the jubilant pastimes of Lord Jagannātha in the Narendra-sarovara.
text:
> sei-kāle mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> narendre āilā dekhite jala-keli-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:n:narendre]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived at the Narendra Lake; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---the pastimes on the water; [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in great jubilation.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived with His personal associates to see the jubilant pastimes of Lord Jagannātha in the Narendra-sarovara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.44
description: At the same time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived at the lake and had a great meeting with the Lord.
text:
> sei-kāle āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa
> narendrete prabhu-saṅge ha-ila milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the same time; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees from Bengal; [[synonyms:n:narendrete]]---at the lake known as Narendra-sarovara; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---there was a meeting.
translation: At the same time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived at the lake and had a great meeting with the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.45
description: All the devotees immediately fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord lifted and embraced every one of them.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa paḍe āsi' prabhura caraṇe
> uṭhāñā prabhu sabāre kailā āliṅgane
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fell; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---getting them up; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgane]]---embraced.
translation: All the devotees immediately fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord lifted and embraced every one of them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.46
description: The Gauḍīya-sampradāya, consisting of all the devotees from Bengal, began congregational chanting. When they met the Lord, they began to cry loudly in ecstatic love.
text:
> gauḍīyā-sampradāya saba karena kīrtana
> prabhura milane uṭhe premera krandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍīyā]]-[[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---of the group of Vaiṣṇavas from Bengal; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---perform congregational chanting; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:milane]]---upon meeting Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---rise; [[synonyms:p:premera]] [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---crying in ecstatic love.
translation: The Gauḍīya-sampradāya, consisting of all the devotees from Bengal, began congregational chanting. When they met the Lord, they began to cry loudly in ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.47
description: Because of the pastimes in the water, there was great jubilation on the shore, with music, singing, chanting, dancing and tumultuous crying.
text:
> jala-krīḍā, vādya, gīta, nartana, kīrtana
> mahā-kolāhala tīre, salile khelana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---the pastimes in the water; [[synonyms:v:vādya]]---musical vibration; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]---singing; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank; [[synonyms:s:salile]]---in the water; [[synonyms:k:khelana]]---sporting.
translation: Because of the pastimes in the water, there was great jubilation on the shore, with music, singing, chanting, dancing and tumultuous crying.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.48
description: The chanting and crying of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas mixed and created a tumultuous sound vibration that filled the entire universe.
text:
> gauḍīyā-saṅkīrtane āra rodana miliyā
> mahā-kolāhala haila brahmāṇḍa bhariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍīyā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtane]]---congregational chanting by the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---crying; [[synonyms:m:miliyā]]---mixing; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---a great, tumultuous sound vibration; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:b:brahmāṇḍa]]---the universe; [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---filling.
translation: The chanting and crying of the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇavas mixed and created a tumultuous sound vibration that filled the entire universe.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.49
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the water with His devotees and began His pastimes with them in great jubilation.
text:
> saba bhakta lañā prabhu nāmilena jale
> sabā lañā jala-krīḍā karena kutūhale
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāmilena]] [[synonyms:j:jale]]---got down in the water; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---activities in the water; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:k:kutūhale]]---in great jubilation.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu entered the water with His devotees and began His pastimes with them in great jubilation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.5
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Lord Nityānanda to stay in Bengal, but nevertheless, because of ecstatic love, Lord Nityānanda also went to see Him.
text:
> yadyapi prabhura ājñā gauḍe rahite
> tathāpi nityānanda preme calilā dekhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:r:rahite]]---to stay in Bengal; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Lord Nityānanda to stay in Bengal, but nevertheless, because of ecstatic love, Lord Nityānanda also went to see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.50
description: In his Caitanya-maṅgala [now known as Caitanya-bhāgavata], Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given a detailed description of the activities the Lord performed in the water.
text:
> prabhura ei jala-krīḍā dāsa-vṛndāvana
> 'caitanya-maṅgale' vistāri' kariyāchena varṇana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---activities in the water; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:m:maṅgale]]---in his book //Caitanya-maṅgala,// now known as //Caitanya-bhāgavata//; [[synonyms:v:vistāri']]---describing in detail; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---has narrated.
translation: In his Caitanya-maṅgala [now known as Caitanya-bhāgavata], Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given a detailed description of the activities the Lord performed in the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.51
description: There is no use describing here the activities of the Lord again. It would simply be repetitious and would increase the size of this book.
text:
> punaḥ ihāṅ varṇile punarukti haya
> vyartha likhana haya, āra grantha bāḍaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:v:varṇile]]---if I describe; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]-[[synonyms:u:ukti]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---it will be repetition; [[synonyms:v:vyartha]]---useless; [[synonyms:l:likhana]]---writing; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:g:grantha]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍaya]]---increases the volume of the book.
translation: There is no use describing here the activities of the Lord again. It would simply be repetitious and would increase the size of this book.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.52
description: After concluding His pastimes in the water, Lord Govinda returned to His residence. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the temple, taking all His devotees with Him.
text:
> jala-līlā kari' govinda calilā ālaya
> nija-gaṇa lañā prabhu gelā devālaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after finishing the pastimes on the water; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Lord Jagannātha in His moving form as Govinda; [[synonyms:c:calilā]] [[synonyms:ā:ālaya]]---returned to His place; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---His devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālaya]]---to the temple.
translation: After concluding His pastimes in the water, Lord Govinda returned to His residence. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the temple, taking all His devotees with Him.
purport: The Deity referred to herein as Govinda is the //vijaya-vigraha// in the temple of Jagannātha. When there is a need to take Jagannātha somewhere, the //vijaya-vigraha// is taken because the body of Jagannātha is very heavy. The //vijaya-vigraha// in the Jagannātha temple is known as Govinda. For the pastimes in the Narendrasarovara, the //vijaya-vigraha// was carried there instead of Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.53
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence after visiting the temple of Jagannātha, He asked for a large quantity of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda, which He then distributed among His devotees so that they could eat sumptuously.
text:
> jagannātha dekhi' punaḥ nija-ghare āilā
> prasāda ānāñā bhakta-gaṇe khāoyāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to His residence; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:ānāñā]]---causing to be brought; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:khāoyāilā]]---fed the devotees.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence after visiting the temple of Jagannātha, He asked for a large quantity of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda, which He then distributed among His devotees so that they could eat sumptuously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.54
description: After talking with all the devotees for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them to occupy the individual residences in which they had lived the previous year.
text:
> iṣṭa-goṣṭhī sabā lañā kata-kṣaṇa kailā
> nija nija pūrva-vāsāya sabāya pāṭhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---discussion of spiritual matters; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]---respective; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsāya]]---to the former residences; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---He sent.
translation: After talking with all the devotees for some time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked them to occupy the individual residences in which they had lived the previous year.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.55
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita delivered the bags of eatables to Govinda, who kept them in a corner of the dining room.
text:
> govinda-ṭhāñi rāghava jhāli samarpilā
> bhojana-gṛhera koṇe jhāli govinda rākhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in charge of Govinda; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---the //jhāli,// the bags of eatables; [[synonyms:s:samarpilā]]---delivered; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhera]]---of the dining room; [[synonyms:k:koṇe]]---in the corner; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---the bags; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita delivered the bags of eatables to Govinda, who kept them in a corner of the dining room.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.56
description: Govinda thoroughly emptied the bags from the previous year and kept them in another room to fill them with other goods.
text:
> pūrva-vatsarera jhāli ājāḍa kariyā
> dravya bharibāre rākhe anya gṛhe lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsarera]]---of the previous year; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---bags; [[synonyms:ā:ājāḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---emptying; [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:b:bharibāre]]---to fill with goods; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keeps; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:g:gṛhe]]---to another room; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking.
translation: Govinda thoroughly emptied the bags from the previous year and kept them in another room to fill them with other goods.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.57
description: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with His personal devotees to see Lord Jagannātha when Lord Jagannātha arose early in the morning.
text:
> āra dina mahāprabhu nija-gaṇa lañā
> jagannātha dekhilena śayyotthāne yāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by His personal devotees; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhilena]]---saw Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ś:śayyā]]-[[synonyms:u:utthāne]]---at the time of rising early from bed; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going.
translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went with His personal devotees to see Lord Jagannātha when Lord Jagannātha arose early in the morning.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.58
description: After seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His all-encompassing saṅkīrtana. He formed seven groups, which then began to chant.
text:
> beḍā-saṅkīrtana tāhāṅ ārambha karilā
> sāta-sampradāya tabe gāite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:beḍā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---surrounding congregational chanting; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:ā:ārambha]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---began; [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---seven groups; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:g:gāite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to chant.
translation: After seeing Lord Jagannātha, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began His all-encompassing saṅkīrtana. He formed seven groups, which then began to chant.
purport: For an explanation of the //beḍā-saṅkīrtana,// one may refer to //Madhya-līlā,// Chapter Eleven, verses 215-238.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.59
description: In each of the seven groups was a principal dancer like Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.
text:
> sāta-sampradāye nṛtya kare sāta jana
> advaita ācārya, āra prabhu-nityānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:s:sampradāye]]---in the seven groups; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---danced; [[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---seven persons; [[synonyms:a:advaita]] [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda.
translation: In each of the seven groups was a principal dancer like Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.6
description: Indeed, it is a symptom of real affection that one breaks the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, not caring for the regulative principles, to associate with Him.
text:
> anurāgera lakṣaṇa ei,---'vidhi' nāhi māne
> tāṅra ājñā bhāṅge tāṅra saṅgera kāraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anurāgera]]---of real affection; [[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---symptom; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---the regulation; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---does not care for; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:b:bhāṅge]]---neglects; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:s:saṅgera]]---association; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇe]]---for the purpose of.
translation: Indeed, it is a symptom of real affection that one breaks the order of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, not caring for the regulative principles, to associate with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.60
description: The dancers in the other groups were Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, Acyutānanda, Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa, Satyarāja Khān and Narahari dāsa.
text:
> vakreśvara, acyutānanda, paṇḍita-śrīvāsa
> satyarāja-khāṅna, āra narahari-dāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:a:acyutānanda]]---Acyutānanda; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa; [[synonyms:s:satyarāja]]-[[synonyms:k:khāṅna]]---Satyarāja Khān; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:n:narahari]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Narahari dāsa.
translation: The dancers in the other groups were Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, Acyutānanda, Paṇḍita Śrīvāsa, Satyarāja Khān and Narahari dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.61
description: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked from one group to another inspecting them, the men in each group thought, "The Lord is within our group."
text:
> sāta-sampradāye prabhu karena bhramaṇa
> 'mora sampradāye prabhu'---aiche sabāra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:s:sampradāye]]---in the seven groups; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhramaṇa]]---wanders; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāye]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is in our group; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---everyone was thinking.
translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu walked from one group to another inspecting them, the men in each group thought, "The Lord is within our group."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.62
description: The congregational chanting made a tumultuous roar that filled the sky. All the inhabitants of Jagannātha Purī came to see the kīrtana.
text:
> saṅkīrtana-kolāhale ākāśa bhedila
> saba jagannātha-vāsī dekhite āila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhale]]---tumultuous roaring of congregational chanting; [[synonyms:ā:ākāśa]] [[synonyms:b:bhedila]]---filled the sky; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---the inhabitants of Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came to see.
translation: The congregational chanting made a tumultuous roar that filled the sky. All the inhabitants of Jagannātha Purī came to see the kīrtana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.63
description: Accompanied by his personal staff, the King also came there and watched from a distance, and all the queens watched from the elevated parts of the palace.
text:
> rājā āsi' dūre dekhe nija-gaṇa lañā
> rāja-patnī saba dekhe aṭṭālī caḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---from a distant place; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by his personal staff; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:patnī]]---the queens; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---see; [[synonyms:a:aṭṭālī]] [[synonyms:c:caḍiyā]]---going up high in the palace.
translation: Accompanied by his personal staff, the King also came there and watched from a distance, and all the queens watched from the elevated parts of the palace.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.64
description: Due to the forceful vibration of kīrtana, the entire world began trembling. When everyone chanted the holy name, they made a tumultuous sound.
text:
> kīrtana-āṭope pṛthivī kare ṭalamala
> 'hari-dhvani' kare loka, haila kolāhala
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]-[[synonyms:ā:āṭope]]---by the force of congregational chanting; [[synonyms:p:pṛthivī]]---the whole world; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭalamala]]---trembles; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---chanted the transcendental sound Hari; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people in general; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---a tumultuous sound.
translation: Due to the forceful vibration of kīrtana, the entire world began trembling. When everyone chanted the holy name, they made a tumultuous sound.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.65
description: In this way the Lord had congregational chanting performed for some time, and then He Himself desired to dance.
text:
> ei-mata kata-kṣaṇa karāilā kīrtana
> āpane nācite tabe prabhura haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]] [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---caused //kīrtana// to be performed; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:n:nācite]]---to dance; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu desired.
translation: In this way the Lord had congregational chanting performed for some time, and then He Himself desired to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.66
description: The seven groups began chanting and beating their drums in seven directions, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began dancing in the center in great ecstatic love.
text:
> sāta-dike sāta-sampradāya gāya, bājāya
> madhye mahā-premāveśe nāce gaura-rāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in seven directions; [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---the seven groups; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chant; [[synonyms:b:bājāya]]---play on the //mṛdaṅga//; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the center; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:premāveśe]]---in great ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: The seven groups began chanting and beating their drums in seven directions, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began dancing in the center in great ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.67
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remembered a line in the Orissan language and ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing it.
text:
> uḍiyā-pada mahāprabhura mane smṛti haila
> svarūpere sei pada gāite ājñā dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uḍiyā]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]---a line of a song in the language of Orissa; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:s:smṛti]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was remembered; [[synonyms:s:svarūpere]]---unto Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pada]]---that special line; [[synonyms:g:gāite]]---to sing; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---ordered.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remembered a line in the Orissan language and ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara to sing it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.68
description: "Let my head fall at the feet of Jagannātha in the kīrtana hall known as Jagamohana."
text: > "jagamohana-pari-muṇḍā yāu"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagamohana]]---the //kīrtana// hall known as Jagamohana; [[synonyms:p:pari]]---in; [[synonyms:m:muṇḍā]]---my head; [[synonyms:y:yāu]]---let it be offered.
translation: "Let my head fall at the feet of Jagannātha in the kīrtana hall known as Jagamohana."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.69
description: Simply because of this line, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in greatly ecstatic love. People all around Him floated in the water of His tears.
text:
> ei pade nṛtya karena parama-āveśe
> saba-loka caudike prabhura prema-jale bhāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:pade]]---by this line; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---dances; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in great ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:saba]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---all people; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in all four directions; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---in tears of love; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---float.
translation: Simply because of this line, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was dancing in greatly ecstatic love. People all around Him floated in the water of His tears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.7
description: During the rāsa dance, Kṛṣṇa asked all the gopīs to return home, but the gopīs neglected His order and stayed there for His association.
text:
> rāse yaiche ghara yāite gopīre ājñā dilā
> tāṅra ājñā bhāṅgi' tāṅra saṅge se rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāse]]---at the time of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to return home; [[synonyms:g:gopīre]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa ordered; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:b:bhāṅgi']]---breaking; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in His association; [[synonyms:s:se]]---they; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---kept themselves.
translation: During the rāsa dance, Kṛṣṇa asked all the gopīs to return home, but the gopīs neglected His order and stayed there for His association.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.70
description: Raising His two arms, the Lord said, "Chant! Chant!" Floating in transcendental bliss, the people responded by chanting the holy name of Hari.
text:
> 'bol 'bol' balena prabhu śrī-bāhu tuliyā
> hari-dhvani kare loka ānande bhāsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bol]]---chant; [[synonyms:b:bol]]---chant; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhu]]---His transcendental arms; [[synonyms:t:tuliyā]]---raising; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---chanted the holy name Hari; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]] [[synonyms:b:bhāsiyā]]---floating in transcendental bliss.
translation: Raising His two arms, the Lord said, "Chant! Chant!" Floating in transcendental bliss, the people responded by chanting the holy name of Hari.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.71
description: The Lord fell to the ground unconscious, not even breathing. Then suddenly He stood up, making a loud sound.
text:
> prabhu paḍi' mūrchā yāya, śvāsa nāhi āra
> ācambite uṭhe prabhu kariyā huṅkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---falling down; [[synonyms:m:mūrchā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---became unconscious; [[synonyms:ś:śvāsa]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there was no breathing; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---stands up; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:h:huṅkāra]]---making a loud sound.
translation: The Lord fell to the ground unconscious, not even breathing. Then suddenly He stood up, making a loud sound.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.72
description: The hairs on His body constantly stood up like the thorns on a śimula tree. Sometimes His body was swollen and sometimes lean and thin.
text:
> saghana pulaka,---yena śimulera taru
> kabhu praphullita aṅga, kabhu haya saru
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:g:ghana]]---constant; [[synonyms:p:pulaka]]---standing of the hairs of the body; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:ś:śimulera]] [[synonyms:t:taru]]---the //śimula// tree; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:praphullita]]---swollen; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---body; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:saru]]---lean and thin.
translation: The hairs on His body constantly stood up like the thorns on a śimula tree. Sometimes His body was swollen and sometimes lean and thin.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.73
description: He bled and perspired from every pore of His body. His voice faltered. Unable to say the line properly, He uttered only, "jaja gaga pari mumu."
text:
> prati roma-kūpe haya prasveda, raktodgama
> jaja' 'gaga' 'pari' 'mumu'---gadgada vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]] [[synonyms:r:roma]]-[[synonyms:k:kūpe]]---in every hole of the hair; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was; [[synonyms:p:prasveda]]---perspiration; [[synonyms:r:rakta]]-[[synonyms:u:udgama]]---a profusion of blood; [[synonyms:j:jaja]] [[synonyms:g:gaga]] [[synonyms:p:pari]] [[synonyms:m:mumu]]---the sounds //"jaja gaga pari mumu"//; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]---faltering; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words.
translation: He bled and perspired from every pore of His body. His voice faltered. Unable to say the line properly, He uttered only, "jaja gaga pari mumu."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.74
description: All His teeth shook, as if each were separate from the others. Indeed, they seemed about to fall to the ground.
text:
> eka eka danta yena pṛthak pṛthak naḍe
> aiche naḍe danta,---yena bhūme khasi' paḍe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---each and every; [[synonyms:d:danta]]---tooth; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separately; [[synonyms:n:naḍe]]---shakes; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---like that; [[synonyms:n:naḍe]]---shake; [[synonyms:d:danta]]---the teeth; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:b:bhūme]]---on the ground; [[synonyms:k:khasi']]---becoming loose; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fall.
translation: All His teeth shook, as if each were separate from the others. Indeed, they seemed about to fall to the ground.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.75
description: His transcendental bliss increased at every moment. Therefore even by midafternoon the dancing had not ended.
text:
> kṣaṇe kṣaṇe bāḍe prabhura ānanda-āveśa
> tṛtīya prahara ha-ila, nṛtya nahe śeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---at every moment; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increases; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]] [[synonyms:p:prahara]]---midafternoon; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---the dancing; [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---did not end.
translation: His transcendental bliss increased at every moment. Therefore even by midafternoon the dancing had not ended.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.76
description: The ocean of transcendental bliss overflowed, and everyone present forgot his body, mind and home.
text:
> saba lokera uthalila ānanda-sāgara
> saba loka pāsarila deha-ātma-ghara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of every person; [[synonyms:u:uthalila]]---overflowed; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sāgara]]---the ocean of transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---every person; [[synonyms:p:pāsarila]]---forgot; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]---mind; [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---home.
translation: The ocean of transcendental bliss overflowed, and everyone present forgot his body, mind and home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.77
description: Then Lord Nityānanda found a way to end the kīrtana. He gradually stopped all the chanters.
text:
> tabe nityānanda prabhu sṛjilā upāya
> krame-krame kīrtanīyā rākhila sabāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:s:sṛjilā]] [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---made a device; [[synonyms:k:krame]]-[[synonyms:k:krame]]---by and by; [[synonyms:k:kīrtanīyā]]---the chanters; [[synonyms:r:rākhila]]---stopped; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all.
translation: Then Lord Nityānanda found a way to end the kīrtana. He gradually stopped all the chanters.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.78
description: Thus only one group continued chanting with Svarūpa Dāmodara, and they chanted very softly.
text:
> svarūpera saṅge mātra eka sampradāya
> svarūpera saṅge seha manda-svara gāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---group; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---they; [[synonyms:m:manda]]-[[synonyms:s:svara]]---very softly; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chanted.
translation: Thus only one group continued chanting with Svarūpa Dāmodara, and they chanted very softly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.79
description: When there was no longer a tumultuous sound, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to consciousness. Then Nityānanda Prabhu informed Him of the fatigue of the chanters and dancers.
text:
> kolāhala nāhi, prabhura kichu bāhya haila
> tabe nityānanda sabāra śrama jānāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there was not; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:ś:śrama]]---fatigue; [[synonyms:j:jānāila]]---informed.
translation: When there was no longer a tumultuous sound, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to consciousness. Then Nityānanda Prabhu informed Him of the fatigue of the chanters and dancers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.8
description: If one carries out Kṛṣṇa's order, Kṛṣṇa is certainly pleased, but if one sometimes breaks His order due to ecstatic love, that gives Him millions of times greater happiness.
text:
> ājñā-pālane kṛṣṇera yaiche paritoṣa
> preme ājñā bhāṅgile haya koṭi-sukha-poṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]-[[synonyms:p:pālane]]---by carrying out the order; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:p:paritoṣa]]---happiness; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:b:bhāṅgile]]---when one breaks the order; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:p:poṣa]]---millions of times more happiness.
translation: If one carries out Kṛṣṇa's order, Kṛṣṇa is certainly pleased, but if one sometimes breaks His order due to ecstatic love, that gives Him millions of times greater happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.80
description: Understanding the fatigue of the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the congregational chanting. Then He bathed in the sea, accompanied by them all.
text:
> bhakta-śrama jāni' kailā kīrtana samāpana
> sabā lañā āsi' kailā samudre snapana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śrama]]---the fatigue of the devotees; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---understanding; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:s:samāpana]]---ending the chanting; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---accompanied by all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---in the sea; [[synonyms:s:snapana]]---bathing.
translation: Understanding the fatigue of the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the congregational chanting. Then He bathed in the sea, accompanied by them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.81
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took prasāda with all of them and then asked them to return to their dwellings and take rest.
text:
> saba lañā prabhu kailā prasāda bhojana
> sabāre vidāya dilā karite śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---taking //prasāda//; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---to everyone; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bade farewell; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---to take rest.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took prasāda with all of them and then asked them to return to their dwellings and take rest.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.82
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā, and Govinda came there to massage His legs.
text:
> gambhīrāra dvāre karena āpane śayana
> govinda āsiyā kare pāda-samvāhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gambhīrāra]] [[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the door of the Gambhīrā, the small room within the room; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lying down; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---His personal servant Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging the legs.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā, and Govinda came there to massage His legs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.83-84
description: It was a steady, long-standing rule that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would lie down to rest after lunch and Govinda would come to massage His legs. Then Govinda would honor the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> sarva-kāla āche ei sudṛḍha 'niyama'
> 'prabhu yadi prasāda pāñā karena śayana
> govinda āsiyā kare pāda-samvāhana
> tabe yāi' prabhura 'śeṣa' karena bhojana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---all the time; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there is; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---hard-and-fast; [[synonyms:n:niyama]]---regulation; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---after taking His meals; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lies down; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging the legs; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---the remnants of food; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eats.
translation: It was a steady, long-standing rule that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would lie down to rest after lunch and Govinda would come to massage His legs. Then Govinda would honor the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.85
description: This time when the Lord lay down, He occupied the entire doorway. Govinda could not enter the room, and therefore he made the following request.
text:
> saba dvāra yuḍi' prabhu kariyāchena śayana
> bhitare yāite nāre, govinda kare nivedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---the whole door; [[synonyms:y:yuḍi']]---occupying the space of; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---was lying down; [[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---could not go; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---he requested.
translation: This time when the Lord lay down, He occupied the entire doorway. Govinda could not enter the room, and therefore he made the following request.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.86
description: "Kindly turn on one side. Let me pass to enter the room." However, the Lord replied, "I don't have the strength to move My body."
text:
> 'eka-pāśa hao, more deha' bhitara yāite'
> prabhu kahe,---'śakti nāhi aṅga cālāite'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]] [[synonyms:h:hao]]---kindly turn on one side; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---allow; [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---within; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---strength; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]] [[synonyms:c:cālāite]]---to move My body.
translation: "Kindly turn on one side. Let me pass to enter the room." However, the Lord replied, "I don't have the strength to move My body."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.87
description: Govinda made his request again and again, but the Lord replied, "I cannot move My body."
text:
> bāra bāra govinda kahe eka-dik ha-ite
> prabhu kahe,---'aṅga āmi nāri cālāite'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---requests; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dik]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to turn on one side; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---My body; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nāri]] [[synonyms:c:cālāite]]---cannot move.
translation: Govinda made his request again and again, but the Lord replied, "I cannot move My body."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.88
description: Govinda repeatedly requested, "I want to massage Your legs," but the Lord said, "Do it or don't do it. It depends upon your mind."
text:
> govinda kahe,---'karite cāhi pāda-samvāhana'
> prabhu kahe,---'kara vā nā kara, yei laya tomāra mana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Govinda said; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:c:cāhi]]---I want; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging Your legs; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord replied; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do not do; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:l:laya]] [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---you decide.
translation: Govinda repeatedly requested, "I want to massage Your legs," but the Lord said, "Do it or don't do it. It depends upon your mind."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.89
description: Then Govinda spread the Lord's wrapper over the Lord's body and in this way entered the room by crossing over Him.
text:
> tabe govinda bahirvāsa tāṅra upare diyā
> bhitara-ghare gelā mahāprabhure laṅghiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:b:bahirvāsa]]---outward wrapper; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---over Him; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---spreading; [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---within the room; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]] [[synonyms:l:laṅghiyā]]---crossing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Then Govinda spread the Lord's wrapper over the Lord's body and in this way entered the room by crossing over Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.9-11
description: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Gaṅgādāsa, Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita, Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa, Murāri Gupta, Garuḍa Paṇḍita, Buddhimanta Khān, Sañjaya Puruṣottama, Bhagavān Paṇḍita, Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and many others joined together to go to Jagannātha Purī. It would be impossible to mention the names of them all.
text:
> vāsudeva-datta, murāri-gupta, gaṅgādāsa
> śrīmān-sena, śrīmān-paṇḍita, akiñcana kṛṣṇadāsa
>
> murāri, garuḍa-paṇḍita, buddhimanta-khāṅna
> sañjaya-puruṣottama, paṇḍita-bhagavān
>
> śuklāmbara, nṛsiṁhānanda āra yata jana
> sabāi calilā, nāma nā yāya likhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]]---Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]-[[synonyms:g:gupta]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgādāsa]]---Gaṅgādāsa; [[synonyms:ś:śrīmān]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śrīmān Sena; [[synonyms:ś:śrīmān]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Śrīmān Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:a:akiñcana]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:g:garuḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Garuḍa Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:buddhimanta]]-[[synonyms:k:khāṅna]]---Buddhimanta Khān; [[synonyms:s:sañjaya]] [[synonyms:p:puruṣottama]]---Sañjaya Puruṣottama; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---Bhagavān Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śuklāmbara]]---Śuklāmbara; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānanda]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---persons; [[synonyms:s:sabāi]]---all; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---names; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:l:likhana]]---it is not possible to mention.
translation: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Gaṅgādāsa, Śrīmān Sena, Śrīmān Paṇḍita, Akiñcana Kṛṣṇadāsa, Murāri Gupta, Garuḍa Paṇḍita, Buddhimanta Khān, Sañjaya Puruṣottama, Bhagavān Paṇḍita, Śuklāmbara Brahmacārī, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and many others joined together to go to Jagannātha Purī. It would be impossible to mention the names of them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.90
description: Govinda massaged the Lord's legs as usual. He pressed the Lord's waist and back very softly, and thus all the Lord's fatigue went away.
text:
> pāda-samvāhana kaila, kaṭi-pṛṣṭha cāpila
> madhūra-mardane prabhura pariśrama gela
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging of the legs; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---he performed; [[synonyms:k:kaṭi]]---waist; [[synonyms:p:pṛṣṭha]]---back; [[synonyms:c:cāpila]]---pressed; [[synonyms:m:madhūra]]-[[synonyms:m:mardane]]---by mild pressing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pariśrama]]---fatigue; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went away.
translation: Govinda massaged the Lord's legs as usual. He pressed the Lord's waist and back very softly, and thus all the Lord's fatigue went away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.91
description: As Govinda stroked His body, the Lord slept very nicely for about forty-five minutes, and then His sleep broke.
text:
> sukhe nidrā haila prabhura, govinda cāpe aṅga
> daṇḍa-dui ba-i prabhura hailā nidrā-bhaṅga

translation: As Govinda stroked His body, the Lord slept very nicely for about forty-five minutes, and then His sleep broke.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.92
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Govinda sitting by His side, He was somewhat angry."Why have you been sitting here for so long today?" the Lord asked.
text:
> govinde dekhiyā prabhu bale kruddha hañā
> 'āji kene eta-kṣaṇa āchis vasiyā?
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinde]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing Govinda; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---said; [[synonyms:k:kruddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---in an angry mood; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:e:eta]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for so long; [[synonyms:ā:āchis]]---have you been; [[synonyms:v:vasiyā]]---sitting.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Govinda sitting by His side, He was somewhat angry."Why have you been sitting here for so long today?" the Lord asked.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.93
description: "Why didn't you go to take your meal after I fell asleep?" the Lord asked. Govinda replied, "You were lying down, blocking the door, and there was no way to go."
text:
> mora nidrā haile kene nā gelā prasāda khāite?'
> govinda kahe---'dvāre śuilā, yāite nāhi pathe'

translation: "Why didn't you go to take your meal after I fell asleep?" the Lord asked. Govinda replied, "You were lying down, blocking the door, and there was no way to go."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.94

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.95
description: Govinda mentally replied, "My duty is to serve, even if I have to commit offenses or go to hell.
text:

translation: Govinda mentally replied, "My duty is to serve, even if I have to commit offenses or go to hell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.96
description: "I would not mind committing hundreds and thousands of offenses for the service of the Lord, but I greatly fear committing even a glimpse of an offense for my own self."
text:
> 'sevā' lāgi' koṭi 'aparādha' nāhi gaṇi

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.97
description: Thinking in this way, Govinda kept silent. He did not reply to the Lord's inquiry.
text:

translation: Thinking in this way, Govinda kept silent. He did not reply to the Lord's inquiry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.98

translation: It was Govinda's practice to go take lunch when the Lord was asleep. On that day, however, seeing the Lord's weariness, Govinda continued massaging His body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 10.99
description: There was no way to go. How could he leave? When he thought of crossing over the Lord's body, he considered it a great offense.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.1

> namāmi haridāsaṁ taṁ

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.100

text:
> tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakte vidāya dilā
> harṣa-viṣāde prabhu viśrāma karilā

translation: Thereafter, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bid farewell to all the devotees, and He Himself, with mixed feelings of happiness and distress, took rest.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.101
description: Thus I have spoken about the victorious passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Anyone who hears this narration will certainly fix his mind firmly in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ haridāsera vijaya
> yāhāra śravaṇe kṛṣṇe dṛḍha-bhakti haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have spoken; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:v:vijaya]]---victory; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---by hearing which; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---firm devotional service; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes.
translation: Thus I have spoken about the victorious passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Anyone who hears this narration will certainly fix his mind firmly in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.
purport:
At Puruṣottama-kṣetra, or Jagannātha Purī, there is a temple of Ṭoṭā-gopīnātha. If one goes from there to the sea, he can discover the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura still existing. Every year on the date of Ananta-caturdaśī there is a festival to commemorate the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. At the same place, three Deities of Nityānanda, Kṛṣṇa Caitanya and Advaita Prabhu were established about one hundred years ago. A gentleman named Bhramaravara from Kendrāpāḍā in the province of Orissa contributed funds to establish these Deities in the temple. The management of the temple was under the Ṭoṭā-gopīnātha //gosvāmīs.//

This temple was later sold to someone else, and this party is now maintaining the //sevā-pūjā// of the temple. Near this temple and the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura constructed a small house, called Bhakti-kuṭī. In the Bengali year 1329 (A.D. 1922), Puruṣottama-maṭha, a branch of the Gauḍīya Maṭha, was established there. in the //Bhakti-ratnākara// it is stated:

> śrīnivāsa śīghra samudrera kūle gelā
> haridāsa-ṭhākurera samādhi dekhilā
>
> bhūmite paḍiyā kailā praṇati vistara
> bhāgavata-gaṇa śrī-samādhi-sannidhāne
> śrīnivāse sthira kailā sasneha-vacane
>
> punaḥ śrīnivāsa śrī-samādhi praṇamiyā
> ye vilāpa kailā, tā śunile drave hiyā

"Śrīnivāsa Ṭhākura quickly ran to the seashore. When he saw the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, he immediately fell down offering prayers and almost fainted. The devotees present there pacified him with very sweet and affectionate words, and Śrīnivāsa again offered his obeisances to the tomb. Hearing of the separation that Śrīnivāsa expressed in his lamentation at the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura makes one's heart melt."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.102
description: From the incident of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away and the great care Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took in commemorating it, one can understand just how affectionate He is toward His devotees. Although He is the topmost of all sannyāsīs, He fully satisfied the desire of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> caitanyera bhakta-vātsalya ihātei jāni
> bhakta-vāñchā pūrṇa kailā nyāsi-śiromaṇi
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]---affection for His devotees; [[synonyms:i:ihātei]]---from this; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---one can understand; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---the desire of the devotee; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---fully satisfied; [[synonyms:n:nyāsi]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the crown jewel of the //sannyāsīs,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: From the incident of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away and the great care Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took in commemorating it, one can understand just how affectionate He is toward His devotees. Although He is the topmost of all sannyāsīs, He fully satisfied the desire of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.103
description: At the last stage of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's life, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave him His company and allowed him to touch Him. Thereafter, He took the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa on His lap and personally danced with it.
text:
> śeṣa-kāle dilā tāṅre darśana-sparśana
> tāṅre kole kari' kailā āpane nartana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the last stage of his life; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:d:darśana]]-[[synonyms:s:sparśana]]---interview and touching; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kole]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking on the lap; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dancing.
translation: At the last stage of Haridāsa Ṭhākura's life, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave him His company and allowed him to touch Him. Thereafter, He took the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa on His lap and personally danced with it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.104
description: Out of His causeless mercy He personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and personally begged alms from the shopkeepers. Then He conducted a great festival to celebrate the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> āpane śrī-haste kṛpāya tāṅre vālu dilā
> āpane prasāda māgi' mahotsava kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---with His transcendental hands; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāya]]---out of His causeless mercy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:v:vālu]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---covered with sand; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging //prasāda//; [[synonyms:m:mahotsava]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed a great festival.
translation: Out of His causeless mercy He personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and personally begged alms from the shopkeepers. Then He conducted a great festival to celebrate the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.105
description: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was not only the topmost devotee of the Lord, but also a great and learned scholar. It was his great fortune that he passed away before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> mahā-bhāgavata haridāsa---parama-vidvān
> e saubhāgya lāgi' āge karilā prayāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]---great devotee; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:v:vidvān]]---the most learned; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saubhāgya]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---because of his great fortune; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---first; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:prayāṇa]]---he passed away.
translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura was not only the topmost devotee of the Lord, but also a great and learned scholar. It was his great fortune that he passed away before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport:
Haridāsa Ṭhākura is mentioned here as the most learned scholar, //parama-vidvān.// Actually, the most important science to know is the science of getting out of the clutches of material existence. Anyone who knows this science must be considered the greatest learned person. Anyone who knows the temporary situation of this material world and is expert in achieving a permanent situation in the spiritual world, who knows that the Supreme Personality of Godhead is beyond the jurisdiction of our experimental knowledge, is understood to be the most learned scholar. Haridāsa Ṭhākura knew this science perfectly. Therefore, he is described in this connection as //parama-vidvān.// He personally preached the importance of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra,// which is approved by the revealed scriptures.

As stated in the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:7:5:24|(7.5.24)]]:

> iti puṁsārpitā viṣṇau
> bhaktiś cen nava-lakṣaṇā
> kriyeta bhagavaty addhā
> tan manye 'dhītam uttamam

There are nine different processes of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa, the most important being //śravaṇaṁ kīrtanam//-hearing and chanting. Haridāsa Ṭhākura knew this science very well, and he can therefore be called, technically, //sarva-śāstrādhītī.// Anyone who has learned the essence of all the Vedic scripture is to be known as a first-class educated person, with full knowledge of all //śāstra.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.106
description: The life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are exactly like an ocean of nectar, one drop of which can please the mind and ear.
text:
> caitanya-caritra ei amṛtera sindhu
> karṇa-mana tṛpta kare yāra eka bindu

translation: The life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are exactly like an ocean of nectar, one drop of which can please the mind and ear.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.107
description: Anyone who desires to cross over the ocean of nescience, please hear with great faith the life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> bhava-sindhu taribāre āche yāra citta
> śraddhā kari' śuna sei caitanya-caritra
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhava]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of material existence; [[synonyms:t:taribāre]]---to cross over; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---is; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:c:citta]]---desire; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with faith and love; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Anyone who desires to cross over the ocean of nescience, please hear with great faith the life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.108
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Eleventh Chapter, describing the passing of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.11
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī with His personal devotees and enjoyed the congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā mantra.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhura nīlācale vāsa
> saṅge bhakta-gaṇa lañā kīrtana-vilāsa

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī with His personal devotees and enjoyed the congregational chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā mantra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.12
description: In the daytime Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in dancing and chanting and in seeing the temple of Lord Jagannātha. At night, in the company of His most confidential devotees, such as Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, He tasted the nectar of the transcendental mellows of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.
text:
> dine nṛtya-kīrtana, īśvara-daraśana
> rātrye rāya-svarūpa-sane rasa-āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dine]]---during the daytime; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---dancing and chanting; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visiting the temple of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tasting the transcendental mellows.
translation: In the daytime Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in dancing and chanting and in seeing the temple of Lord Jagannātha. At night, in the company of His most confidential devotees, such as Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, He tasted the nectar of the transcendental mellows of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa's pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.13
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very happily passed His days in this way at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī. Feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, He exhibited many transcendental symptoms all over His body.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhura sukhe kāla yāya
> kṛṣṇera viraha-vikāra aṅge nānā haya

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very happily passed His days in this way at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī. Feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, He exhibited many transcendental symptoms all over His body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.14
description: Day after day the symptoms increased, and at night they increased even more. All these symptoms, such as transcendental anxiety, agitation, and talking like a madman, were present, just as they are described in the śāstras.
text:
> dine dine bāḍe vikāra, rātrye atiśaya
> cintā, udvega, pralāpādi yata śāstre kaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dine]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---day after day; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increase; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]] [[synonyms:a:atiśaya]]---especially at night; [[synonyms:c:cintā]]---anxiety; [[synonyms:u:udvega]]---agitation; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---talking like a madman; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as; [[synonyms:ś:śāstre]] [[synonyms:k:kaya]]---are mentioned in the //śāstras.//
translation: Day after day the symptoms increased, and at night they increased even more. All these symptoms, such as transcendental anxiety, agitation, and talking like a madman, were present, just as they are described in the śāstras.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.15
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, the chief assistants in Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, remained with Him both day and night.
text:
> svarūpa gosāñi, āra rāmānanda-rāya
> rātri-dine kare doṅhe prabhura sahāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:d:doṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---help.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, the chief assistants in Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, remained with Him both day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.16
description: One day Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went in great jubilation to deliver the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food to Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> eka-dina govinda mahā-prasāda lañā
> haridāse dite gelā ānandita hañā

translation: One day Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went in great jubilation to deliver the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food to Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.17
description: When Govinda came to Haridāsa, he saw that Haridāsa Ṭhākura was lying on his back and chanting his rounds very slowly.
text:
> dekhe,---haridāsa ṭhākura kariyāche śayana
> manda manda kariteche saṅkhyā-saṅkīrtana
