translation: When Govinda came to Haridāsa, he saw that Haridāsa Ṭhākura was lying on his back and chanting his rounds very slowly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.18
description: "Please rise and take your mahā-prasāda," Govinda said. Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Today I shall observe fasting.
text:
> govinda kahe,---'uṭha āsi' karaha bhojana'
> haridāsa kahe,---āji karimu laṅghana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Govinda said; [[synonyms:u:uṭha]]---please get up; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---take your //prasāda//; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Haridāsa replied; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:l:laṅghana]]---I shall observe fasting.
translation: "Please rise and take your mahā-prasāda," Govinda said. Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Today I shall observe fasting.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.19
description: "I have not finished chanting my regular number of rounds. How, then, can I eat? But you have brought mahā-prasāda, and how can I neglect it?"
text:
> saṅkhyā-kīrtana pūre nāhi, ke-mate khāiba?
> mahā-prasāda āniyācha, ke-mate upekṣiba?
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---the fixed amount of chanting; [[synonyms:p:pūre]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---is not complete; [[synonyms:k:ke]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]] [[synonyms:k:khāiba]]---how shall I eat; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:ā:āniyācha]]---you have brought the //mahā-prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:ke]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]] [[synonyms:u:upekṣiba]]---how shall I neglect.
translation: "I have not finished chanting my regular number of rounds. How, then, can I eat? But you have brought mahā-prasāda, and how can I neglect it?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.2
description: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is very merciful and who is very dear to Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya dayāmaya
> jayādvaita-priya nityānanda-priya jaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---to the most merciful; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:p:priya]]---to the dear master of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:priya]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is very dear to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories.
translation: All glories to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is very merciful and who is very dear to Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.20
description: Saying this, he offered prayers to the mahā-prasāda, took a little portion, and ate it.
text:
> eta bali' mahā-prasāda karilā vandana
> eka rañca lañā tāra karilā bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---to the //mahā-prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---he offered respect; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:r:rañca]]---one fractional part; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---ate it.
translation: Saying this, he offered prayers to the mahā-prasāda, took a little portion, and ate it.
purport: //Mahā-prasāda// is nondifferent from Kṛṣṇa. Therefore, instead of eating //mahā-prasāda,// one should honor it. It is said here, //karilā vandana,// "he offered prayers." When taking //mahā-prasāda,// one should not consider the food ordinary preparations. //Prasāda// means favor. One should consider //mahā-prasāda// a favor of Kṛṣṇa. As stated by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura, //kṛṣṇa baḍa dayāmaya karibāre jihvā jaya svaprasāda-anna dilā bhāi. Kṛṣṇa// is very kind. In this material world we are all very attached to tasting various types of food. Therefore, Kṛṣṇa eats many nice varieties of food and offers the food back to the devotees, so that not only are one's demands for various tastes satisfied, but by eating //prasāda// he makes advancement in spiritual life. Therefore, we should never consider ordinary food on an equal level with //mahā-prasāda.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.21
description: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Haridāsa's place and inquired from him, "Haridāsa, are you well?"
text:
> āra dina mahāprabhu tāṅra ṭhāñi āilā
> sustha hao, haridāsa---bali' tāṅre puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to his place; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:stha]] [[synonyms:h:hao]]---are you all right; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---O Haridāsa; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired.
translation: The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to Haridāsa's place and inquired from him, "Haridāsa, are you well?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.22
description: Haridāsa offered his obeisances to the Lord and replied, "My body is all right, but my mind and intelligence are not well."
text:
> namaskāra kari' teṅho kailā nivedana
> śarīra sustha haya mora, asustha buddhi-mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after offering obeisances; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he, Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submitted; [[synonyms:ś:śarīra]]---body; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:stha]]---all right; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:a:asustha]]---not in a healthy condition; [[synonyms:b:buddhi]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---my mind and intelligence.
translation: Haridāsa offered his obeisances to the Lord and replied, "My body is all right, but my mind and intelligence are not well."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.23
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu further inquired from Haridāsa, "Can you ascertain what your disease is?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My disease is that I cannot complete my rounds."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'kon vyādhi, kaha ta' nirṇaya?'
> teṅho kahe,---'saṅkhyā-kīrtana nā pūraya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:v:vyādhi]]---what disease; [[synonyms:k:kaha]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:n:nirṇaya]]---can you ascertain; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said; [[synonyms:s:saṅkhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---fixed amount of chanting; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pūraya]]---has not become complete.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu further inquired from Haridāsa, "Can you ascertain what your disease is?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My disease is that I cannot complete my rounds."
purport: If one cannot complete the fixed number of rounds he is assigned, he should be considered to be in a diseased condition of spiritual life. Śrīla Haridāsa Ṭhākura is called //nāmācārya.// Of course, we cannot imitate Haridāsa Ṭhākura, but everyone must chant a prescribed number of rounds. In our Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement we have fixed sixteen rounds as the minimum so that the Westerners will not feel burdened. These sixteen rounds must be chanted, and chanted loudly, so that one can hear himself and others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.24
description: "Now that you have become old," the Lord said, "you may reduce the number of rounds you chant daily. You are already liberated, and therefore you need not follow the regulative principles very strictly.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"vṛddha ha-ilā 'saṅkhyā' alpa kara
> siddha-deha tumi, sādhane āgraha kene kara?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:v:vṛddha]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---you have become old; [[synonyms:s:saṅkhyā]] [[synonyms:a:alpa]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---reduce your number; [[synonyms:s:siddha]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you are already liberated; [[synonyms:s:sādhane]]---in the regulative principles; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kene]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---why are you eager.
translation: "Now that you have become old," the Lord said, "you may reduce the number of rounds you chant daily. You are already liberated, and therefore you need not follow the regulative principles very strictly.
purport: Unless one has come to the platform of spontaneous love of God, he must follow the regulative principles. Ṭhākura Haridāsa was the living example of how to follow the regulative principles. Similarly, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī was also such a living example. In the //Ṣaḍ-gosvāmy-aṣṭaka// it is stated: //saṅkhyā-pūrvaka-nāma-gāna-natibhiḥ kālāvasānīkṛtau.// The //Gosvāmīs,// especially Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, strictly followed all the regulative principles. The first regulative principle is that one must chant the //Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra// loudly enough so that he can hear himself, and one must vow to chant a fixed number of rounds. Not only was Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī chanting a fixed number of rounds, but he had also taken a vow to bow down many times and offer obeisances to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.25
description: "Your role in this incarnation is to deliver the people in general. You have sufficiently preached the glories of the holy name in this world."
text:
> loka nistārite ei tomāra 'avatāra'
> nāmera mahimā loke karilā pracāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:n:nistārite]]---to deliver the people in general; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---your incarnation; [[synonyms:n:nāmera]] [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glories of the holy name; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---in this world; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:pracāra]]---you have preached.
translation: "Your role in this incarnation is to deliver the people in general. You have sufficiently preached the glories of the holy name in this world."
purport: Haridāsa Ṭhākura is known as //nāmācārya// because it is he who preached the glories of chanting //hari-nāma,// the holy name of God. By using the words //tomāra avatāra// ("your incarnation"), Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu confirms that Haridāsa Ṭhākura is the incarnation of Lord Brahmā. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that advanced devotees help the Supreme Personality of Godhead in His mission and that such devotees or personal associates incarnate by the will of the Supreme Lord. The Supreme Lord incarnates by His own will, and, by His will, competent devotees also incarnate to help Him in His mission. Haridāsa Ṭhākura is thus the incarnation of Lord Brahmā, and other devotees are likewise incarnations who help in the prosecution of the Lord's mission.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.26

translation: The Lord concluded, "Now, therefore, please reduce the fixed number of times you chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra." Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "Kindly hear my real plea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.27
description: "I was born in an inferior family, and my body is most abominable. I always engage in low work. Therefore, I am the lowest, most condemned of men.

translation: "I was born in an inferior family, and my body is most abominable. I always engage in low work. Therefore, I am the lowest, most condemned of men.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.28

> raurava ha-ite kāḍi' more vaikuṇṭhe caḍāilā

translation: "I am unseeable and untouchable, but You have accepted me as Your servant. This means that You have delivered me from a hellish condition and raised me to the Vaikuṇṭha platform.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.3
description: All glories to the master of Śrīnivāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the master of Haridāsa Ṭhākura! All glories to the dear master of Gadādhara Paṇḍita! All glories to the master of the life of Svarūpa Dāmodara!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.30
description: "My dear Lord, by Your mercy You have made me dance in many ways. For example, I was offered the śrāddha-pātra that should have been offered to first-class brāhmaṇas. I ate from it even though I was born in a family of meateaters.
text:
> aneka nācāilā more prasāda kariyā
> viprera śrāddha-pātra khāinu 'mleccha' hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aneka]]---in many ways; [[synonyms:n:nācāilā]]---You have made dance; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---by Your mercy; [[synonyms:v:viprera]]---of the //brāhmaṇas//; [[synonyms:ś:śrāddha]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the dish of the //śrāddha// ceremony; [[synonyms:k:khāinu]]---I have eaten; [[synonyms:m:mleccha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---although born in a family of meateaters.
translation: "My dear Lord, by Your mercy You have made me dance in many ways. For example, I was offered the śrāddha-pātra that should have been offered to first-class brāhmaṇas. I ate from it even though I was born in a family of meateaters.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, in his //Anubhāṣya,// quotes from the //Viṣṇu-smṛti// in reference to //śrāddha-pātra.//

> brāhmaṇāpasadā hy ete
> kathitāḥ paṅkti-dūṣakāḥ
> etān vivarjayed yatnāt
> śrāddha-karmaṇi paṇḍitaḥ

According to this verse, if one is born in a //brāhmaṇa// family but does not behave according to brahminical standards, he should not be offered the //śrāddha-pātra,// which is //prasāda// offered to the forefathers. Advaita Ācārya offered the //śrāddha-pātra// to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, not to a //brāhmaṇa// who had been born in a //brāhmaṇa// family. Although Haridāsa Ṭhākura was born in the family of meateaters, because he was an advanced devotee he was shown more respect than a first-class //brāhmaṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.31

translation: "I have had one desire for a very long time. I think that quite soon, my Lord, You will bring to a close Your pastimes within this material world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.43
description: Because He had to perform His noon duties, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to leave, but it was settled that the following day, after He saw Lord Jagannātha, He would return to visit Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> madhyāhna karite prabhu calilā āpane
> īśvara dekhiyā kāli dibena daraśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to perform His noon duties; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:calilā]] [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---aroused Himself; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after visiting Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:kāli]]---tomorrow; [[synonyms:d:dibena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---He would see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: Because He had to perform His noon duties, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up to leave, but it was settled that the following day, after He saw Lord Jagannātha, He would return to visit Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.44
description: After embracing him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left to perform His noon duties and went to the sea to take His bath.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre kari' āliṅgana
> madhyāhna karite samudre karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him (Haridāsa); [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to perform His noon duties; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---toward the sea; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---went.
translation: After embracing him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left to perform His noon duties and went to the sea to take His bath.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.45
description: The next morning, after visiting the Jagannātha temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accompanied by all His other devotees, came hastily to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> prātaḥ-kāle īśvara dekhi' saba bhakta lañā
> haridāse dekhite āilā śīghra kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after visiting Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by; [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---Haridāsa; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---hastily.
translation: The next morning, after visiting the Jagannātha temple, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, accompanied by all His other devotees, came hastily to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.46
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the other devotees came before Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who offered his respects to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> haridāsera āge āsi' dilā daraśana
> haridāsa vandilā prabhura āra vaiṣṇava-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:d:dilā]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---gave His audience; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---offered respect; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---of the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---unto the lotus feet.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the other devotees came before Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who offered his respects to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.47
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "My dear Haridāsa, what is the news?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My Lord, whatever mercy You can bestow upon me."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'haridāsa, kaha samācāra'
> haridāsa kahe,---'prabhu, ye kṛpā tomāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---My dear Haridāsa; [[synonyms:k:kaha]] [[synonyms:s:samācāra]]---what is the news; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Haridāsa replied; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "My dear Haridāsa, what is the news?" Haridāsa Ṭhākura replied, "My Lord, whatever mercy You can bestow upon me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.48
description: Upon hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately began great congregational chanting in the courtyard. Vakreśvara Paṇḍita was the chief dancer.
text:
> aṅgane ārambhilā prabhu mahā-saṅkīrtana
> vakreśvara-paṇḍita tāhāṅ karena nartana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅgane]]---in the courtyard; [[synonyms:ā:ārambhilā]]---began; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---great congregational chanting; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Vakreśvara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---danced.
translation: Upon hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately began great congregational chanting in the courtyard. Vakreśvara Paṇḍita was the chief dancer.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.49
description: Headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu surrounded Haridāsa Ṭhākura and began congregational chanting.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi ādi yata prabhura gaṇa
> haridāse beḍi' kare nāma-saṅkīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the company of the Lord; [[synonyms:h:haridāse]] [[synonyms:b:beḍi']]---surrounding Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performed; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---congregational chanting.
translation: Headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu surrounded Haridāsa Ṭhākura and began congregational chanting.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.5
description: All glories to the transcendental form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Kṛṣṇa Himself, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. My dear Lord, kindly give me shelter at Your lotus feet by Your causeless mercy.
text:
> jaya gaura-deha kṛṣṇa svayaṁ bhagavān
> kṛpā kari' deha' prabhu, nija-pada-dāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]]---to the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:svayam]]---personally; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dāna]]---shelter at Your lotus feet.
translation: All glories to the transcendental form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is Kṛṣṇa Himself, the Supreme Personality of Godhead. My dear Lord, kindly give me shelter at Your lotus feet by Your causeless mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.50
description: In front of all the great devotees like Rāmānanda Rāya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to describe the holy attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> rāmānanda, sārvabhauma, sabāra agrete
> haridāsera guṇa prabhu lāgilā kahite
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:a:agrete]]---in front; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---attributes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]] [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---began to describe.
translation: In front of all the great devotees like Rāmānanda Rāya and Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to describe the holy attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.51
description: As He described the transcendental attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seemed to possess five mouths. The more He described, the more His great happiness increased.
text:
> haridāsera guṇa kahite prabhu ha-ilā pañca-mukha
> kahite kahite prabhura bāḍe mahā-sukha
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---attributes; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---speaking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]---as if possessing five mouths; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---while He was speaking; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increased; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---great happiness.
translation: As He described the transcendental attributes of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seemed to possess five mouths. The more He described, the more His great happiness increased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.52
description: After hearing of the transcendental qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, all the devotees present were struck with wonder. They all offered their respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> haridāsera guṇe sabāra vismita haya mana
> sarva-bhakta vande haridāsera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---by the attributes; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---struck with wonder; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---become; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---minds; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vande]]---worship; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: After hearing of the transcendental qualities of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, all the devotees present were struck with wonder. They all offered their respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.53
description: Haridāsa Ṭhākura made Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sit down in front of him, and then he fixed his eyes, like two bumblebees, on the lotus face of the Lord.
text:
> haridāsa nijāgrete prabhure vasāilā
> nija-netra---dui bhṛṅga---mukha-padme dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Ṭhākura Haridāsa; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:a:agrete]]---in front of himself; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---made the Lord sit down; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:n:netra]]---his eyes; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhṛṅga]]---as if two bumblebees; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:p:padme]]---on the lotus face; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---he fixed.
translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura made Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sit down in front of him, and then he fixed his eyes, like two bumblebees, on the lotus face of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.54
description: He held the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu on his heart and then took the dust of the feet of all the devotees present and put it on his head.
text:
> sva-hṛdaye āni' dharila prabhura caraṇa
> sarva-bhakta-pada-reṇu mastaka-bhūṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---upon his heart; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dharila]]---held; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---of all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:r:reṇu]]---the dust of the feet; [[synonyms:m:mastaka]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---the ornament of his head.
translation: He held the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu on his heart and then took the dust of the feet of all the devotees present and put it on his head.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.55
description: He began to chant the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya again and again. As he drank the sweetness of the face of the Lord, tears constantly glided down from his eyes.
text:
> 'śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya' śabda balena bāra bāra
> prabhu-mukha-mādhurī piye, netre jala-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---vibration; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---speaks; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhurī]]---the sweetness of the face of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:piye]]---he drinks; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---through the eyes; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---a continuous flow of water.
translation: He began to chant the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya again and again. As he drank the sweetness of the face of the Lord, tears constantly glided down from his eyes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.56
description: While chanting the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, he gave up his air of life and left his body.
text:
> 'śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya' śabda karite uccāraṇa
> nāmera sahita prāṇa kaila utkrāmaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---the sound vibration; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:u:uccāraṇa]]---chanting; [[synonyms:n:nāmera]] [[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with the name; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:u:utkrāmaṇa]]---went away.
translation: While chanting the holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya, he gave up his air of life and left his body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.57
description: Seeing the wonderful death of Haridāsa Ṭhākura by his own will, which was just like a great mystic yogī's, everyone remembered the passing away of Bhīṣma.
text:
> mahā-yogeśvara-prāya dekhi' svacchande maraṇa
> 'bhīṣmera niryāṇa' sabāra ha-ila smaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogeśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---just like a great mystic //yogī//; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:svacchande]]---at his will; [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]---dying; [[synonyms:b:bhīṣmera]] [[synonyms:n:niryāṇa]]---the passing of Bhīṣma; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---everyone remembered.
translation: Seeing the wonderful death of Haridāsa Ṭhākura by his own will, which was just like a great mystic yogī's, everyone remembered the passing away of Bhīṣma.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.58
description: There was a tumultuous noise as they all chanted the holy names "Hari" and "Kṛṣṇa." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became overwhelmed with ecstatic love.
text:
> 'hari' 'kṛṣṇa'-śabde sabe kare kolāhala
> premānande mahāprabhu ha-ilā vihvala
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]---the holy name of Hari; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śabde]]---with the sound vibration; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---make; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---great noise; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]] [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---became overwhelmed.
translation: There was a tumultuous noise as they all chanted the holy names "Hari" and "Kṛṣṇa." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became overwhelmed with ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.59
description: The Lord raised the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and placed it on His lap. Then He began to dance in the courtyard in great ecstatic love.
text:
> haridāsera tanu prabhu kole laila uṭhāñā
> aṅgane nācena prabhu premāviṣṭa hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]---the body; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kole]]---on the lap; [[synonyms:l:laila]]---took; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---raising; [[synonyms:a:aṅgane]]---in the yard; [[synonyms:n:nācena]]---dances; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:premāviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming overwhelmed by ecstatic love.
translation: The Lord raised the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and placed it on His lap. Then He began to dance in the courtyard in great ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.6
description: All glories to Lord Nityānanda, who is the life and soul of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My dear Lord, kindly give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.
text:
> jaya nityānanda-candra jaya caitanyera prāṇa
> tomāra caraṇāravinde bhakti deha' dāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---to the life and soul of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:aravinde]]---at Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give; [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---the gift.
translation: All glories to Lord Nityānanda, who is the life and soul of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My dear Lord, kindly give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.60
description: Because of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love, all the devotees were helpless, and in ecstatic love they also began to dance and chant congregationally.
text:
> prabhura āveśe avaśa sarva-bhakta-gaṇa
> premāveśe sabe nāce, karena kīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---because of the ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:avaśa]]---helpless; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in great ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dance; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---and perform congregational chanting.
translation: Because of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic love, all the devotees were helpless, and in ecstatic love they also began to dance and chant congregationally.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.61
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced for some time, and then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī informed Him of other rituals for the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa.
text:
> ei-mate nṛtya prabhu kailā kata-kṣaṇa
> svarūpa-gosāñi prabhure karāila sāvadhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karāila]]---caused to do; [[synonyms:s:sāvadhāna]]---care of other rituals.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced for some time, and then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī informed Him of other rituals for the body of Ṭhākura Haridāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.62
description: The body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was then raised onto a carrier that resembled an airship and taken to the sea, accompanied by congregational chanting.
text:
> haridāsa-ṭhākure tabe vimāne caḍāñā
> samudre lañā gelā tabe kīrtana kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākure]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:v:vimāne]]---on a carrier like an airship; [[synonyms:c:caḍāñā]]---raising; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---to the seashore; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---took; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---performing congregational chanting.
translation: The body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was then raised onto a carrier that resembled an airship and taken to the sea, accompanied by congregational chanting.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.63
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced in front of the procession, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, along with the other devotees, chanted and danced behind Him.
text:
> āge mahāprabhu calena nṛtya karite karite
> pāche nṛtya kare vakreśvara bhakta-gaṇa-sāthe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:calena]]---goes; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---performing; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---behind; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---dances; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sāthe]]---with other devotees.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced in front of the procession, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, along with the other devotees, chanted and danced behind Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.64
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura in the sea and then declared, "From this day on, this sea has become a great pilgrimage site."
text:
> haridāse samudra-jale snāna karāilā
> prabhu kahe,---"samudra ei 'mahā-tīrtha' ha-ilā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---the body of Haridāsa; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---in the water of the sea; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---bathed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]---sea; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---has become a great place of pilgrimage.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura in the sea and then declared, "From this day on, this sea has become a great pilgrimage site."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.65
description: Everyone drank the water that had touched the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and then they smeared remnants of Lord Jagannātha's sandalwood pulp over Haridāsa Ṭhākura's body.
text:
> haridāsera pādodaka piye bhakta-gaṇa
> haridāsera aṅge dilā prasāda-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:u:udaka]]---the water that touched the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:piye]]---drink; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---smeared; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---remnants of sandalwood pulp offered to Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Everyone drank the water that had touched the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and then they smeared remnants of Lord Jagannātha's sandalwood pulp over Haridāsa Ṭhākura's body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.66
description: After a hole was dug in the sand, the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was placed in it. Remnants from Lord Jagannātha, such as His silken ropes, sandalwood pulp, food and cloth, were placed on the body.
text:
> ḍora, kaḍāra, prasāda, vastra aṅge dilā
> vālukāra garta kari' tāhe śoyāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍora]]---silken ropes; [[synonyms:k:kaḍāra]]---remnants of Lord Jagannātha's sandalwood pulp; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of Jagannātha's food; [[synonyms:v:vastra]]---cloth; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:v:vālukāra]]---of sand; [[synonyms:g:garta]]---a ditch; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:t:tāhe]]---within that; [[synonyms:ś:śoyāilā]]---put down.
translation: After a hole was dug in the sand, the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura was placed in it. Remnants from Lord Jagannātha, such as His silken ropes, sandalwood pulp, food and cloth, were placed on the body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.67
description: All around the body, the devotees performed congregational chanting, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita danced in jubilation.
text:
> cāri-dike bhakta-gaṇa karena kīrtana
> vakreśvara-paṇḍita karena ānande nartana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---all around; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---congregational chanting; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Vakreśvara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performed; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in jubilation; [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dancing.
translation: All around the body, the devotees performed congregational chanting, and Vakreśvara Paṇḍita danced in jubilation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.68
description: With His transcendental hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand, chanting "Hari bol! Hari bol!"
text:
> 'hari-bola' 'hari-bola' bale gaurarāya
> āpani sri-haste vālu dilā tāṅra gāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]]---chant Hari, chant Hari; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---chanted; [[synonyms:g:gaurarāya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---with His transcendental hands; [[synonyms:v:vālu]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---placed sand; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---on his body.
translation: With His transcendental hands, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand, chanting "Hari bol! Hari bol!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.69
description: They covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and then constructed a platform upon the site. The platform was protected all around by fencing.
text:
> tāṅre vālu diyā upare piṇḍā bāṅdhāilā
> caudike piṇḍera mahā āvaraṇa kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---upon the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:v:vālu]]---sand; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---putting; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on top; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍā]] [[synonyms:b:bāṅdhāilā]]---constructed a platform; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---all around; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍera]]---the platform; [[synonyms:m:mahā]] [[synonyms:ā:āvaraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made a great protective fence.
translation: They covered the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura with sand and then constructed a platform upon the site. The platform was protected all around by fencing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.7
description: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is treated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as superior due to His age and respectability. Please give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.
text:
> jaya jayādvaita-candra caitanyera ārya
> sva-caraṇe bhakti deha' jayādvaitācārya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:ā:ārya]]---respected by the Lord; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give devotional service; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---to Advaita Ācārya.
translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is treated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as superior due to His age and respectability. Please give me engagement in devotional service at Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.70
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted all around the platform, and as the holy name of Hari roared tumultuously, the whole universe became filled with the vibration.
text:
> tāhā beḍi' prabhu kailā kīrtana, nartana
> hari-dhvani-kolāhale bharila bhuvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:b:beḍi']]---surrounding; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---chanting and dancing; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhale]]---the tumultuous sound of the holy name of Hari; [[synonyms:b:bharila]]---filled; [[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---the entire universe.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu danced and chanted all around the platform, and as the holy name of Hari roared tumultuously, the whole universe became filled with the vibration.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.71
description: After saṅkīrtana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed in the sea with His devotees, swimming and playing in the water in great jubilation.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu saba bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> samudre karilā snāna-jala-keli raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the devotees; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---in the sea; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---took a bath; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---playing in the water; [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in great jubilation.
translation: After saṅkīrtana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathed in the sea with His devotees, swimming and playing in the water in great jubilation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.72
description: After circumambulating the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the Siṁha-dvāra gate of the Jagannātha temple. The whole city chanted in congregation, and the tumultuous sound vibrated all over the city.
text:
> haridāse pradakṣiṇa kari' āila siṁha-dvāre
> hari-kīrtana-kolāhala sakala nagare
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---Haridāsa; [[synonyms:p:pradakṣiṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---circumambulating; [[synonyms:ā:āila]] [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---came to the gate of Jagannātha temple known as Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---the tumultuous sound of congregational chanting; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:n:nagare]]---all over the city.
translation: After circumambulating the tomb of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the Siṁha-dvāra gate of the Jagannātha temple. The whole city chanted in congregation, and the tumultuous sound vibrated all over the city.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.73
description: Approaching the Siṁha-dvāra gate, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spread His cloth and began to beg prasāda from all the shopkeepers there.
text:
> siṁha-dvāre āsi' prabhu pasārira ṭhāṅi
> āṅcala pātiyā prasāda māgilā tathāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming in front of the Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pasārira]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāṅi]]---from all the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:ā:āṅcala]] [[synonyms:p:pātiyā]]---spreading His cloth; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---Jagannātha's //prasāda//; [[synonyms:m:māgilā]]---begged; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---there.
translation: Approaching the Siṁha-dvāra gate, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spread His cloth and began to beg prasāda from all the shopkeepers there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.74
description: "I am begging prasāda for a festival honoring the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura," the Lord said. "Please give Me alms."
text:
> 'haridāsa-ṭhākurera mahotsavera tare
> prasāda māgiye bhikṣā deha' ta' āmāre'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:m:mahotsavera]] [[synonyms:t:tare]]---for holding a festival; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:m:māgiye]]---I am begging //prasāda//; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give alms; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---unto Me.
translation: "I am begging prasāda for a festival honoring the passing away of Haridāsa Ṭhākura," the Lord said. "Please give Me alms."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.75
description: Hearing this, all the shopkeepers immediately came forward with big baskets of prasāda, which they jubilantly delivered to Lord Caitanya.
text:
> śuniyā pasāri saba cāṅgaḍā uṭhāñā
> prasāda dite āse tārā ānandita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:pasāri]]---the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:cāṅgaḍā]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---taking a big basket; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to deliver the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:āse]]---come forward; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---they; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---in great jubilation.
translation: Hearing this, all the shopkeepers immediately came forward with big baskets of prasāda, which they jubilantly delivered to Lord Caitanya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.76
description: However, Svarūpa Dāmodara stopped them, and the shopkeepers returned to their shops and sat down with their baskets.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi pasārike niṣedhila
> cāṅgaḍā lañā pasāri pasāre vasila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pasārike]]---the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:n:niṣedhila]]---forbade; [[synonyms:c:cāṅgaḍā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the baskets; [[synonyms:p:pasāri]]---shopkeepers; [[synonyms:p:pasāre]] [[synonyms:v:vasila]]---sat down in their shops.
translation: However, Svarūpa Dāmodara stopped them, and the shopkeepers returned to their shops and sat down with their baskets.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.77
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara sent Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to His residence, and kept with him four Vaiṣṇavas and four servant carriers.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi prabhure ghara pāṭhāilā
> cāri vaiṣṇava, cāri pichāḍā saṅge rākhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent to His residence; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---four Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:p:pichāḍā]]---four carrier servants; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---he kept with him.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara sent Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu back to His residence, and kept with him four Vaiṣṇavas and four servant carriers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.78
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to all the shopkeepers, "Deliver to me four palmfuls of prasāda from each and every item."
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi kahilena saba pasārire
> eka eka dravyera eka eka puñjā deha' more
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kahilena]]---said; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:p:pasārire]]---to all the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:d:dravyera]]---of each particular type of //prasāda//; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:p:puñjā]]---four palmfuls; [[synonyms:d:deha']] [[synonyms:m:more]]---deliver to me.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to all the shopkeepers, "Deliver to me four palmfuls of prasāda from each and every item."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.79
description: In this way varieties of prasāda were collected, then packed up in different loads and carried on the heads of the four servants.
text:
> ei-mate nānā prasāda bojhā bāndhāñā
> lañā āilā cāri janera mastake caḍāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:b:bojhā]]---load; [[synonyms:b:bāndhāñā]]---packing; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:j:janera]]---of the four persons; [[synonyms:m:mastake]]---on the heads; [[synonyms:c:caḍāñā]]---mounting.
translation: In this way varieties of prasāda were collected, then packed up in different loads and carried on the heads of the four servants.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.8
description: All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for the Lord is their life and soul. All of you, kindly bestow devotional service upon me.
text:
> jaya gaura-bhakta-gaṇa,---gaura yāṅra prāṇa
> saba bhakta mili' more bhakti deha' dāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---the life and soul; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:m:mili']]---together; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to me; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:d:deha']] [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---kindly give the charity.
translation: All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for the Lord is their life and soul. All of you, kindly bestow devotional service upon me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.80
description: Not only did Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī bring prasāda, but Vāṇīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, as well as Kāśī Miśra, sent large quantities.
text:
> vāṇīnātha paṭṭanāyaka prasāda ānilā
> kāśī-miśra aneka prasāda pāṭhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]] [[synonyms:p:paṭṭanāyaka]]---Vāṇīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought in; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---varieties of //prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent.
translation: Not only did Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī bring prasāda, but Vāṇīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, as well as Kāśī Miśra, sent large quantities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.81
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made all the devotees sit in rows and personally began to distribute the prasāda, assisted by four other men.
text:
> saba vaiṣṇave prabhu vasāilā sāri sāri
> āpane pariveśe prabhu lañā janā cāri
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇave]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---made to sit down; [[synonyms:s:sāri]] [[synonyms:s:sāri]]---in lines; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---distributes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:j:janā]] [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four men.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu made all the devotees sit in rows and personally began to distribute the prasāda, assisted by four other men.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.82
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was not accustomed to taking prasāda in small quantities. He therefore put on each plate what at least five men could eat.
text:
> mahāprabhura śrī-haste alpa nā āise
> eka eka pāte pañca-janāra bhakṣya pariveśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---in the transcendental hands; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---a small quantity; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---did not come; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:p:pāte]]---on each and every plate; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:j:janāra]]---of five men; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]---eatables; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---He administered.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was not accustomed to taking prasāda in small quantities. He therefore put on each plate what at least five men could eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.83
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Please sit down and watch. With these men to help me, I shall distribute the prasāda."
text:
> svarūpa kahe,---"prabhu, vasi' karaha darśana
> āmi iṅhā-sabā lañā kari pariveśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting down; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---watch; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all these persons; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:p:pariveśana]]---shall administer.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Please sit down and watch. With these men to help me, I shall distribute the prasāda."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.84
description: The four men-Svarūpa, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara-distributed the prasāda continuously.
text:
> svarūpa, jagadānanda, kāśīśvara, śaṅkara
> cāri-jana pariveśana kare nirantara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---four men; [[synonyms:p:pariveśana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---administer; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---continuously.
translation: The four men-Svarūpa, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara-distributed the prasāda continuously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.85
description: All the devotees who sat down would not accept the prasāda as long as the Lord had not eaten. On that day, however, Kāśī Miśra had extended an invitation to the Lord.
text:
> prabhu nā khāile keha nā kare bhojana
> prabhure se dine kāśī-miśrera nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāile]]---as long as the Lord does not eat; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---no one would eat; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on that day; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśrera]]---of Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---the invitation.
translation: All the devotees who sat down would not accept the prasāda as long as the Lord had not eaten. On that day, however, Kāśī Miśra had extended an invitation to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.86
description: Therefore Kāśī Miśra personally went there and delivered prasāda to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great attention and made Him eat.
text:
> āpane kāśī-miśra āilā prasāda lañā
> prabhure bhikṣā karāilā āgraha kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking //prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---delivered //prasāda// to eat; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great attention.
translation: Therefore Kāśī Miśra personally went there and delivered prasāda to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with great attention and made Him eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.87
description: With Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down and accepted the prasāda. When He began to eat, so did all the Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> purī-bhāratīra saṅge prabhu bhikṣā kailā
> sakala vaiṣṇava tabe bhojana karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāratīra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---honored the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---began to eat.
translation: With Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down and accepted the prasāda. When He began to eat, so did all the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.88
description: Everyone was filled up to the neck because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept telling the distributors, "Give them more! Give them more!"
text:
> ākaṇṭha pūrāñā sabāya karāilā bhojana
> deha' deha' bali' prabhu balena vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ākaṇṭha]] [[synonyms:p:pūrāñā]]---filling to the neck; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---everyone; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---He made to eat; [[synonyms:d:deha']] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---give them more, give them more; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:balena]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---talked.
translation: Everyone was filled up to the neck because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept telling the distributors, "Give them more! Give them more!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.89
description: After all the devotees finished accepting prasāda and had washed their hands and mouths, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu decorated each of them with a flower garland and sandalwood pulp.
text:
> bhojana kariyā sabe kailā ācamana
> sabāre parāilā prabhu mālya-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---after eating; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---washing of the mouth and hands; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:p:parāilā]]---put on; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]---flower garland; [[synonyms:c:candana]]---sandalwood pulp.
translation: After all the devotees finished accepting prasāda and had washed their hands and mouths, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu decorated each of them with a flower garland and sandalwood pulp.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.9
description: All glories to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, and Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, the six Gosvāmīs of Vṛndāvana. They are all my masters.
text:
> jaya rūpa, sanātana, jīva, raghunātha
> raghunātha, gopāla,---chaya mora nātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---to Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]---Jīva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:c:chaya]]---six; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:n:nātha]]---lords.
translation: All glories to Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī, Jīva Gosvāmī, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, and Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī, the six Gosvāmīs of Vṛndāvana. They are all my masters.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.90
description: Overwhelmed with ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered a benediction to all the devotees, which all the devotees heard with great satisfaction.
text:
> premāviṣṭa hañā prabhu karena vara-dāna
> śuni' bhakta-gaṇera juḍāya manaskāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being overwhelmed by ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:v:vara]]-[[synonyms:d:dāna]]---offered a benediction; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]]---became fulfilled; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāma]]---the desires of the mind.
translation: Overwhelmed with ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered a benediction to all the devotees, which all the devotees heard with great satisfaction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.91-93
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave this benediction: "Anyone who has seen the festival of Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away, anyone who has chanted and danced here, anyone who has offered sand on the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and anyone who has joined this festival to partake of the prasāda will achieve the favor of Kṛṣṇa very soon. There is such wonderful power in seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> "haridāsera vijayotsava ye kaila darśana
> ye ihāṅ nṛtya kaila, ye kaila kīrtana
>
> ye tāṅre vālukā dite karila gamana
> tāra madhye mahotsave ye kaila bhojana
>
> acire ha-ibe tā-sabāra 'kṛṣṇa-prāpti'
> haridāsa-daraśane haya aiche 'śakti'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:v:vijaya]]-[[synonyms:u:utsava]]---the festival of the passing away; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---has seen; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---danced; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanted; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---upon him; [[synonyms:v:vālukā]] [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to offer sand; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---came forward; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in that connection; [[synonyms:m:mahotsave]]---in the festival; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took //prasāda//; [[synonyms:a:acire]]---very soon; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibe]]---there will be; [[synonyms:t:tā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---attainment of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---by seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---power.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave this benediction: "Anyone who has seen the festival of Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura's passing away, anyone who has chanted and danced here, anyone who has offered sand on the body of Haridāsa Ṭhākura and anyone who has joined this festival to partake of the prasāda will achieve the favor of Kṛṣṇa very soon. There is such wonderful power in seeing Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.94
description: "Being merciful upon Me, Kṛṣṇa gave Me the association of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Being independent in His desires, He has now broken that association.
text:
> kṛpā kari' kṛṣṇa more diyāchilā saṅga
> svatantra kṛṣṇera icchā,---kailā saṅga-bhaṅga
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:d:diyāchilā]] [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---gave the association; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]]---independent; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṅga]]---He has broken My association.
translation: "Being merciful upon Me, Kṛṣṇa gave Me the association of Haridāsa Ṭhākura. Being independent in His desires, He has now broken that association.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.95
description: "When Haridāsa Ṭhākura wanted to leave this material world, it was not within My power to detain him.
text:
> haridāsera icchā yabe ha-ila calite
> āmāra śakati tāṅre nārila rākhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---the desire; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:c:calite]]---to go away; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śakati]]---My strength; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:nārila]] [[synonyms:r:rākhite]]---could not keep.
translation: "When Haridāsa Ṭhākura wanted to leave this material world, it was not within My power to detain him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.96
description: "Simply by his will, Haridāsa Ṭhākura could give up his life and go away, exactly like Bhīṣma, who previously died simply by his own desire, as we have heard from śāstra.
text:
> icchā-mātre kailā nija-prāṇa niṣkrāmaṇa
> pūrve yena śuniyāchi bhīṣmera maraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:icchā]]-[[synonyms:m:mātre]]---just by desire; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---of his life; [[synonyms:n:niṣkrāmaṇa]]---going away; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:ś:śuniyāchi]]---we have heard; [[synonyms:b:bhīṣmera]] [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]---the death of Bhīṣmadeva.
translation: "Simply by his will, Haridāsa Ṭhākura could give up his life and go away, exactly like Bhīṣma, who previously died simply by his own desire, as we have heard from śāstra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.97
description: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura was the crown jewel on the head of this world; without him, this world is now bereft of its valuable jewel."
text:
> haridāsa āchila pṛthivīra 'śiromaṇi'
> tāhā vinā ratna-śūnyā ha-ila medinī
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Ṭhākura Haridāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āchila]]---was; [[synonyms:p:pṛthivīra]]---of this world; [[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the crown jewel; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without him; [[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:ś:śūnyā]]---without the valuable jewel; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---becomes; [[synonyms:m:medinī]]---this world.
translation: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura was the crown jewel on the head of this world; without him, this world is now bereft of its valuable jewel."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.98
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told everyone, "Say 'All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura!' and chant the holy name of Hari." Saying this, He personally began to dance.
text:
> 'jaya jaya haridāsa' bali' kara hari-dhvani"
> eta bali' mahāprabhu nācena āpani
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---to Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---chant the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nācena]]---dances; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told everyone, "Say 'All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura!' and chant the holy name of Hari." Saying this, He personally began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 11.99
description: Everyone began to chant, "All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who revealed the importance of chanting the holy name of the Lord!"
text:
> sabe gāya,---"jaya jaya jaya haridāsa
> nāmera mahimā yeṅha karilā prakāśa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---everyone chanted; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---to Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:n:nāmera]] [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glories of chanting the holy name; [[synonyms:y:yeṅha]]---who; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---revealed.
translation: Everyone began to chant, "All glories to Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who revealed the importance of chanting the holy name of the Lord!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.1
description: O devotees, may the transcendental life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu be always heard, chanted and meditated upon with great happiness.
text:
> śrūyatāṁ śrūyatāṁ nityaṁ
> gīyatāṁ gīyatāṁ mudā
> cintyatāṁ cintyatāṁ bhaktāś
> caitanya-caritāmṛtam
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrūyatām]]---let it be heard; [[synonyms:ś:śrūyatām]]---let it be heard; [[synonyms:n:nityam]]---always; [[synonyms:g:gīyatām]]---let it be chanted; [[synonyms:g:gīyatām]]---let it be chanted; [[synonyms:m:mudā]]---with great happiness; [[synonyms:c:cintyatām]]---let it be meditated upon; [[synonyms:c:cintyatām]]---let it be meditated upon; [[synonyms:b:bhaktāḥ]]---O devotees; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛtam]]---the transcendental life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: O devotees, may the transcendental life and characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu be always heard, chanted and meditated upon with great happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.10
description: Because Nityānanda Prabhu was preaching in Bengal, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Him not to come to Jagannātha Purī. That year, however, He went with the rest of the party to see the Lord.
text:
> nityānanda-prabhure yadyapi ājñā nāi
> tathāpi dekhite calena caitanya-gosāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:n:nāi]]---there was no order; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:c:calena]]---He went; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Caitanya.
translation: Because Nityānanda Prabhu was preaching in Bengal, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had ordered Him not to come to Jagannātha Purī. That year, however, He went with the rest of the party to see the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.100
description: Whenever Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to visit a devotee's house, that devotee immediately forgot himself in great happiness.
text:
> jagadānanda milite yāya yei bhakta-ghare
> sei sei bhakta sukhe āpanā pāsare
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to a devotee's house; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotee; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āpanā]] [[synonyms:p:pāsare]]---forgets himself.
translation: Whenever Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to visit a devotee's house, that devotee immediately forgot himself in great happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.101
description: All glories to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita! He is so favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that anyone who meets him thinks, "Now I have gotten the association of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu directly."
text:
> caitanyera prema-pātra jagadānanda dhanya
> yāre mile sei māne,---'pāiluṅ caitanya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---recipient of affection; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorious; [[synonyms:y:yāre]] [[synonyms:m:mile]]---whomever he meets; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---he understands; [[synonyms:p:pāiluṅ]] [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---I have gotten Lord Caitanya.
translation: All glories to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita! He is so favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that anyone who meets him thinks, "Now I have gotten the association of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu directly."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.102
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita stayed at Śivānanda Sena's house for some time, and they prepared about sixteen seers of scented sandalwood oil.
text:
> śivānanda-sena-gṛhe yāñā rahilā
> 'candanādi' taila tāhāṅ eka-mātrā kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhe]]---to the house of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:c:candana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil distilled from sandalwood and other substances; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:mātrā]]---one //mātrā// (sixteen seers, or //seras//); [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---prepared.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita stayed at Śivānanda Sena's house for some time, and they prepared about sixteen seers of scented sandalwood oil.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.103
description: They filled a large earthen pot with the aromatic oil, and with great care Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought it to Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> sugandhi kariyā taila gāgarī bhariyā
> nīlācale lañā āilā yatana kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sū]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhi]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making aromatic; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:g:gāgarī]]---a big pot; [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---filling; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:y:yatana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great care.
translation: They filled a large earthen pot with the aromatic oil, and with great care Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought it to Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.104
description: This oil was placed in the care of Govinda, and Jagadānanda requested him, "Please rub this oil on the body of the Lord."
text:
> govindera ṭhāñi taila dhariyā rākhilā
> "prabhu-aṅge diha' taila" govinde kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govindera]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in the care of Govinda; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---the oil; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---was kept; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---over the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:diha']]---put; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:g:govinde]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he advised Govinda.
translation: This oil was placed in the care of Govinda, and Jagadānanda requested him, "Please rub this oil on the body of the Lord."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.105
description: Govinda therefore told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita has brought some scented sandalwood oil.
text:
> tabe prabhu-ṭhāñi govinda kaila nivedana
> 'jagadānanda candanādi-taila āniyāchena
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---before Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submitted; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:candana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:t:taila]]---scented sandalwood oil; [[synonyms:ā:āniyāchena]]---has brought.
translation: Govinda therefore told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita has brought some scented sandalwood oil.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.106
description: "It is his desire that Your Lordship apply a little of this oil on Your head so that blood pressure due to bile and air will be considerably diminished.
text:
> tāṅra icchā,---prabhu alpa mastake lāgāya
> pitta-vāyu-vyādhi-prakopa śānta hañā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---his desire; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---very little; [[synonyms:m:mastake]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāya]]---smears over the head; [[synonyms:p:pitta]]-[[synonyms:v:vāyu]]-[[synonyms:v:vyādhi]]---of blood pressure due to bile and air; [[synonyms:p:prakopa]]---severity; [[synonyms:ś:śānta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---will be decreased.
translation: "It is his desire that Your Lordship apply a little of this oil on Your head so that blood pressure due to bile and air will be considerably diminished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.107
description: "He prepared a large jug of it in Bengal, and with great care he has brought it here."
text:
> eka-kalasa sugandhi taila gauḍete kariyā
> ihāṅ āniyāche bahu yatana kariyā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:k:kalasa]]---one big full jug; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhi]] [[synonyms:t:taila]]---scented oil; [[synonyms:g:gauḍete]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---manufacturing in Bengal; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:āniyāche]]---has brought; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:y:yatana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great care.
translation: "He prepared a large jug of it in Bengal, and with great care he has brought it here."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.108
description: The Lord replied, "A sannyāsī has no use for oil, especially perfumed oil such as this. Take it out immediately."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"sannyāsīra nāhi taile adhikāra
> tāhāte sugandhi taila,---parama dhikkāra!
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīra]]---for a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:t:taile]]---with oil; [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---use; [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---over and above this; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhi]] [[synonyms:t:taila]]---perfumed oil; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:d:dhik]]-[[synonyms:k:kāra]]---immediately to be rejected.
translation: The Lord replied, "A sannyāsī has no use for oil, especially perfumed oil such as this. Take it out immediately."
purport:
According to Raghunandana Bhaṭṭācārya, the spokesman for the //smārta// regulative principles:

> prātaḥ-snāne vrate śrāddhe
> dvādaśyāṁ grahaṇe tathā
> madya-lepa-samaṁ tailaṁ
> tasmāt tailaṁ vivarjayet

"If one who has taken a vow smears oil on his body while bathing in the morning, while observing a ritualistic ceremony like the //śrāddha// ceremony, or on //dvādaśī// day, he may as well pour wine over his body. Therefore, oil should be rejected." This word //vrata// (vow) is sometimes understood to refer to the //sannyāsa-vrata.// Raghunandana Bhaṭṭācārya has also said in his book //Tithi-tattva://

> ghṛtaṁ ca sārṣapaṁ tailaṁ
> yat tailaṁ puṣpa-vāsitam
> aduṣṭaṁ pakva-tailaṁ ca
> tailābhyaṅge ca nityaśaḥ

This means that clarified butter (//ghee//), mustard oil, floral oil and boiled oil may be used only by //gṛhasthas,// householders.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.109
description: "Deliver this oil to the temple of Jagannātha, where it may be burned in the lamps. In this way, Jagadānanda's labor to manufacture the oil will be perfectly successful."
text:
> jagannāthe deha' taila,---dīpa yena jvale
> tāra pariśrama haiba parama-saphale"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthe]]---unto Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---deliver; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:d:dīpa]]---lamps; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---so; [[synonyms:j:jvale]]---burn; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:p:pariśrama]]---his labor; [[synonyms:h:haiba]]---will become; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:s:saphale]]---completely successful.
translation: "Deliver this oil to the temple of Jagannātha, where it may be burned in the lamps. In this way, Jagadānanda's labor to manufacture the oil will be perfectly successful."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.11
description: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura was also there with his three brothers and his wife, Mālinī. Ācāryaratna was similarly accompanied by his wife.
text:
> śrīvāsādi cāri bhāi, saṅgete mālinī
> ācāryaratnera saṅge tāṅhāra gṛhiṇī
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---four brothers; [[synonyms:s:saṅgete]] [[synonyms:m:mālinī]]---accompanied by his wife, Mālinī; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaratnera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---and with Ācāryaratna; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:g:gṛhiṇī]]---his wife.
translation: Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura was also there with his three brothers and his wife, Mālinī. Ācāryaratna was similarly accompanied by his wife.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.110
