description: When Govinda informed Jagadānanda Paṇḍita of this message, Jagadānanda remained silent, not saying even a word.
text:
> ei kathā govinda jagadānandere kahila
> mauna kari' rahila paṇḍita, kichu nā kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---this message; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:j:jagadānandere]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---informed Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:m:mauna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---keeping silent; [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---remained; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---did not reply.
translation: When Govinda informed Jagadānanda Paṇḍita of this message, Jagadānanda remained silent, not saying even a word.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.111
description: When ten days had passed, Govinda again told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "It is the desire of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that Your Lordship accept the oil."
text:
> dina daśa gele govinda jānāila āra-bāra
> paṇḍitera icchā,---'taila prabhu kare aṅgīkāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:d:daśa]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when ten days passed; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:j:jānāila]]---informed; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---the desire of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---accepts.
translation: When ten days had passed, Govinda again told Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "It is the desire of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that Your Lordship accept the oil."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.112
description: When the Lord heard this, He angrily said, "Why not keep a masseur to massage Me?
text:
> śuni' prabhu kahe kichu sakrodha vacana
> mardaniyā eka rākha karite mardana!
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:k:krodha]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---angry words; [[synonyms:m:mardaniyā]]---masseur; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:r:rākha]]---keep; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:m:mardana]]---to give massages.
translation: When the Lord heard this, He angrily said, "Why not keep a masseur to massage Me?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.113
description: "Have I taken sannyāsa for such happiness? Accepting this oil would bring My ruination, and all of you would laugh.
text:
> ei sukha lāgi' āmi kariluṅ sannyāsa!
> āmāra 'sarva-nāśa'---tomā-sabāra 'parihāsa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kariluṅ]] [[synonyms:s:sannyāsa]]---have taken to the renounced order; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---My ruination; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---joking.
translation: "Have I taken sannyāsa for such happiness? Accepting this oil would bring My ruination, and all of you would laugh.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu declared Himself a strict //sannyāsī.// A //sannyāsī// is not supposed to take help from anyone. Retaining a masseur to give Him massages would indicate His dependence on others. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to follow very strictly the principle of not accepting anyone's help for His bodily comfort.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.114
description: "If someone passing on the road smelled this oil on My head, he would think Me a dārī sannyāsī, a tantric sannyāsī who keeps women."
text:
> pathe yāite taila-gandha mora yei pābe
> 'dārī sannyāsī' kari' āmāre kahibe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pathe]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---while passing on the road; [[synonyms:t:taila]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]---the scent of the oil; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:p:pābe]]---anyone who smells; [[synonyms:d:dārī]] [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---a tantric //sannyāsī// who keeps women for sense gratification; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahibe]]---they will speak of Me.
translation: "If someone passing on the road smelled this oil on My head, he would think Me a dārī sannyāsī, a tantric sannyāsī who keeps women."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.115
description: Hearing these words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda remained silent. The next morning, Jagadānanda went to see the Lord.
text:
> śuni prabhura vākya govinda mauna karilā
> prātaḥ-kāle jagadānanda prabhu-sthāne āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:v:vākya]]---the statement of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:m:mauna]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---remained silent; [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came.
translation: Hearing these words of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda remained silent. The next morning, Jagadānanda went to see the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.116
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, "My dear Paṇḍita, you have brought Me some oil from Bengal, but since I am in the renounced order, I cannot accept it.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"paṇḍita, taila ānilā gauḍa ha-ite
> āmi ta' sannyāsī,---taila nā pāri la-ite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---My dear Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---you have brought; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from Bengal; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---but; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---I cannot accept.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, "My dear Paṇḍita, you have brought Me some oil from Bengal, but since I am in the renounced order, I cannot accept it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.117
description: "Deliver the oil to the temple of Jagannātha so that it may be burned in the lamps. Thus your labor in preparing the oil will be fruitful."
text:
> jagannāthe deha' lañā dīpa yena jvale
> tomāra sakala śrama ha-ibe saphale"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthe]]---unto Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---deliver; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:d:dīpa]]---lamps; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---so that; [[synonyms:j:jvale]]---burn; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:ś:śrama]]---labor; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibe]] [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phale]]---will be fruitful.
translation: "Deliver the oil to the temple of Jagannātha so that it may be burned in the lamps. Thus your labor in preparing the oil will be fruitful."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.118
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "Who tells You all these false stories? I never brought any oil from Bengal."
text:
> paṇḍita kahe,---'ke tomāre kahe mithyā vāṇī
> āmi gauḍa haite taila kabhu nāhi āni'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---unto You; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:m:mithyā]] [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---false stories; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Bengal; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---never brought.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "Who tells You all these false stories? I never brought any oil from Bengal."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.119
description: After saying this, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita took the jug of oil from the room and threw it down before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the courtyard and broke it.
text:
> eta bali' ghara haite taila-kalasa lañā
> prabhura āge āṅgināte phelilā bhāṅgiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the room; [[synonyms:t:taila]]-[[synonyms:k:kalasa]]---the jugful of oil; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āṅgināte]]---in the courtyard; [[synonyms:p:phelilā]]---threw; [[synonyms:b:bhāṅgiyā]]---breaking.
translation: After saying this, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita took the jug of oil from the room and threw it down before Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the courtyard and broke it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.12
description: The wife of Śivānanda Sena also came, along with their three sons. Rāghava Paṇḍita joined them, carrying his famous bags of food.
text:
> śivānanda-patnī cale tina-putra lañā
> rāghava-paṇḍita cale jhāli sājāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:patnī]]---the wife of Śivānanda; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---was going; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by her three sons; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:c:cale]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita was going; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:s:sājāñā]]---carrying his bags.
translation: The wife of Śivānanda Sena also came, along with their three sons. Rāghava Paṇḍita joined them, carrying his famous bags of food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.120
description: After breaking the jug, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to his residence, bolted the door and lay down.
text:
> taila bhāṅgi' sei pathe nija-ghara giyā
> śuiyā rahilā ghare kapāṭa khiliyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:taila]] [[synonyms:b:bhāṅgi']]---breaking the pot of oil; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---by the path; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to his room; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:ś:śuiyā]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---lay down; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in the room; [[synonyms:k:kapāṭa]]---the door; [[synonyms:k:khiliyā]]---bolting closed.
translation: After breaking the jug, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to his residence, bolted the door and lay down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.121
description: Three days later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the door of his room and said, "My dear Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, please get up.
text:
> tṛtīya divase prabhu tāṅra dvāre yāñā
> 'uṭhaha' paṇḍita'---kari' kahena ḍākiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]] [[synonyms:d:divase]]---on the third day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---to the door; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:u:uṭhaha']]---please get up; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---My dear Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---saying; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---said; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍākiyā]]---calling.
translation: Three days later, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to the door of his room and said, "My dear Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, please get up.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.122
description: "I want you personally to cook My lunch today. I am going now to see the Lord in the temple. I shall return at noon."
text:
> 'āji bhikṣā dibā āmāya kariyā randhane
> madhyāhne āsiba, ebe yāi daraśane'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:dibā]]---give lunch; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:r:randhane]]---cooking; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhne]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiba]]---I shall come at noon; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:y:yāi]] [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---I am going to see Lord Jagannātha.
translation: "I want you personally to cook My lunch today. I am going now to see the Lord in the temple. I shall return at noon."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.123
description: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita got up from his bed, bathed, and began to cook varieties of vegetables.
text:
> eta bali' prabhu gelā, paṇḍita uṭhilā
> snāna kari' nānā vyañjana randhana karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita got up; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking his bath; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables; [[synonyms:r:randhana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---cooked.
translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita got up from his bed, bathed, and began to cook varieties of vegetables.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.124
description: After finishing His noontime ritualistic duties, the Lord arrived for lunch. Jagadānanda Paṇḍita washed the Lord's feet and gave the Lord a sitting place.
text:
> madhyāhna kariyā prabhu āilā bhojane
> pāda prakṣālana kari' dilena āsane
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---after finishing his noon ritualistic ceremonies; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---to take lunch; [[synonyms:p:pāda]] [[synonyms:p:prakṣālana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after washing His feet; [[synonyms:d:dilena]] [[synonyms:ā:āsane]]---offered a sitting place.
translation: After finishing His noontime ritualistic duties, the Lord arrived for lunch. Jagadānanda Paṇḍita washed the Lord's feet and gave the Lord a sitting place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.125
description: He had cooked fine rice, mixed it with ghee and piled it high on a banana leaf. There were also varieties of vegetables, placed all around in pots made of banana tree bark.
text:
> saghṛta śālyanna kalā-pāte stūpa kailā
> kalāra ḍoṅgā bhari' vyañjana caudike dharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:g:ghṛta]]---mixed with ghee; [[synonyms:ś:śāli]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]]---very fine rice; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]-[[synonyms:p:pāte]]---on a banana leaf; [[synonyms:s:stūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---stacked; [[synonyms:k:kalāra]] [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍoṅgā]]---pots made of the bark of a banana tree; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---all around; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---placed.
translation: He had cooked fine rice, mixed it with ghee and piled it high on a banana leaf. There were also varieties of vegetables, placed all around in pots made of banana tree bark.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.126
description: On the rice and vegetables were tulasī flowers, and in front of the Lord were cakes, sweet rice and other prasāda of Jagannātha.
text:
> anna-vyañjanopari tulasī-mañjarī
> jagannāthera piṭhā-pānā āge āne dhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anna]]---rice; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables; [[synonyms:u:upari]]---on; [[synonyms:t:tulasī]]-[[synonyms:m:mañjarī]]---flowers of //tulasī//; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]-[[synonyms:p:pānā]]---cakes and sweet rice; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:ā:āne]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---brings.
translation: On the rice and vegetables were tulasī flowers, and in front of the Lord were cakes, sweet rice and other prasāda of Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.127
description: The Lord said, "Spread another leaf with a helping of rice and vegetables so that today you and I may take lunch together."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"dvitīya-pāte bāḍa' anna-vyañjana
> tomāya āmāya āji ekatra kariba bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:d:dvitīya]]-[[synonyms:p:pāte]]---on a second leaf; [[synonyms:b:bāḍa']]---deliver; [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---cooked rice and vegetables; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]] [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---both you and I; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---together; [[synonyms:k:kariba]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---will take lunch.
translation: The Lord said, "Spread another leaf with a helping of rice and vegetables so that today you and I may take lunch together."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.128
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept His hands raised and would not accept the prasāda until Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, with great affection and love, spoke the following words.
text:
> hasta tuli' rahena prabhu, nā karena bhojana
> tabe paṇḍita kahena kichu saprema vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hasta]] [[synonyms:t:tuli']]---raising His hands; [[synonyms:r:rahena]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---did not eat; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Jagadānanda said; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words with great affection and love.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept His hands raised and would not accept the prasāda until Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, with great affection and love, spoke the following words.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.129
description: "Please first take prasāda Yourself, and I shall eat later. I shall not refuse Your request."
text:
> "āpane prasāda laha, pāche muñi la-imu
> tomāra āgraha āmi kemane khaṇḍimu?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---Yourself; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:l:laha]]---take //prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---afterwards; [[synonyms:m:muñi]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:imu]]---I shall take; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]]---insistence; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍimu]]---shall disobey.
translation: "Please first take prasāda Yourself, and I shall eat later. I shall not refuse Your request."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.13
description: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Vidyānidhi and many other devotees went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All together, they numbered two or three hundred.
text:
> datta, gupta, vidyānidhi, āra yata jana
> dui-tina śata bhakta karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:datta]]---Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:g:gupta]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:v:vidyānidhi]]---Vidyānidhi; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---all persons; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---two hundred to three hundred; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---went.
translation: Vāsudeva Datta, Murāri Gupta, Vidyānidhi and many other devotees went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. All together, they numbered two or three hundred.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.130
description: In great happiness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then accepted the lunch. When He had tasted the vegetables, He again began to speak.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu sukhe bhojane vasilā
> vyañjanera svāda pāñā kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]] [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat to take His food; [[synonyms:v:vyañjanera]] [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---the taste of the vegetables; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to say.
translation: In great happiness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then accepted the lunch. When He had tasted the vegetables, He again began to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.131
description: "Even when you cook in an angry mood," He said, "the food is very tasteful. This shows how pleased Kṛṣṇa is with you.
text:
> "krodhāveśera pākera haya aiche svāda!
> ei ta' jāniye tomāya kṛṣṇera 'prasāda'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśera]]---in an angry mood; [[synonyms:p:pākera]]---of cooking; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---taste; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---for this reason; [[synonyms:j:jāniye]]---I can understand; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---unto you; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the mercy of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Even when you cook in an angry mood," He said, "the food is very tasteful. This shows how pleased Kṛṣṇa is with you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.132
description: "Because He will personally eat the food, Kṛṣṇa makes you cook so nicely.
text:
> āpane khāibe kṛṣṇa, tāhāra lāgiyā
> tomāra haste pāka karāya uttama kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:k:khāibe]]---will eat; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---for that reason; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:h:haste]]---by your hands; [[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---causes to cook; [[synonyms:u:uttama]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---so nicely.
translation: "Because He will personally eat the food, Kṛṣṇa makes you cook so nicely.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.133
description: "You offer such nectarean rice to Kṛṣṇa. Who can estimate the limit of your fortune?"
text:
> aiche amṛta-anna kṛṣṇe kara samarpaṇa
> tomāra bhāgyera sīmā ke kare varṇana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]]---nectarean rice; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---you offer; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyera]]---of fortune; [[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---limit; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---can describe.
translation: "You offer such nectarean rice to Kṛṣṇa. Who can estimate the limit of your fortune?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.134
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "He who will eat has cooked this. As far as I am concerned, I simply collect the ingredients."
text:
> paṇḍita kahe,---"ye khāibe, sei pāka-kartā
> āmi-saba---kevala-mātra sāmagrī-āhartā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:khāibe]]---He who will eat; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---He; [[synonyms:p:pāka]]-[[synonyms:k:kartā]]---the cook; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---as far as I am concerned; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]]---of ingredients; [[synonyms:ā:āhartā]]---collector.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita replied, "He who will eat has cooked this. As far as I am concerned, I simply collect the ingredients."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.135
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita continued to offer the Lord varieties of vegetables. Out of fear, the Lord said nothing, but continued eating happily.
text:
> punaḥ punaḥ paṇḍita nānā vyañjana pariveśe
> bhaye kichu nā balena prabhu, khāyena hariṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]] [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again and again; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---various vegetables; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---administered; [[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---out of fear; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:balena]]---does not speak; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:khāyena]]---eats; [[synonyms:h:hariṣe]]---very happily.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita continued to offer the Lord varieties of vegetables. Out of fear, the Lord said nothing, but continued eating happily.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.136
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita eagerly forced the Lord to eat so much that He ate ten times more than on other days.
text:
> āgraha kariyā paṇḍita karāilā bhojana
> āra dina haite bhojana haila daśa-guṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great eagerness; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---fed; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---other days; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---the eating; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten times greater.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita eagerly forced the Lord to eat so much that He ate ten times more than on other days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.137
description: Again and again when the Lord wished to get up, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita would feed Him more vegetables.
text:
> bāra-bāra prabhu uṭhite karena mana
> sei-kāle paṇḍita pariveśe vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhite]]---to get up; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---desires; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---gives; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables.
translation: Again and again when the Lord wished to get up, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita would feed Him more vegetables.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.138
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dared not forbid him to feed Him more. He just continued eating, fearful that Jagadānanda would fast if He stopped.
text:
> kichu balite nārena prabhu, khāyena tarāse
> nā khāile jagadānanda karibe upavāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:b:balite]] [[synonyms:n:nārena]]---could not say; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:khāyena]]---eats; [[synonyms:t:tarāse]]---out of fear; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāile]]---if He did not eat; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:u:upavāse]]---would fast.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu dared not forbid him to feed Him more. He just continued eating, fearful that Jagadānanda would fast if He stopped.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.139
description: At last the Lord respectfully submitted, "My dear Jagadānanda, you have already made Me eat ten times more than I am used to. Now, please stop."
text:
> tabe prabhu kahena kari' vinaya-sammāna
> 'daśa-guṇa khāoyāilā ebe kara samādhāna'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]-[[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---submissive respect; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---ten times more; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāilā]]---you have made to eat; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---please stop.
translation: At last the Lord respectfully submitted, "My dear Jagadānanda, you have already made Me eat ten times more than I am used to. Now, please stop."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.14
description: The devotees first saw Śacīmātā and took her permission. Then, in great happiness, they started for Jagannātha Purī, congregationally chanting the holy name of the Lord.
text:
> śacīmātā dekhi' sabe tāṅra ājñā lañā
> ānande calilā kṛṣṇa-kīrtana kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śacī]]-[[synonyms:m:mātā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing Śacīmātā; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking her permission; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---with great jubilation; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---they proceeded; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---performing congregational chanting.
translation: The devotees first saw Śacīmātā and took her permission. Then, in great happiness, they started for Jagannātha Purī, congregationally chanting the holy name of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.140
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and washed His hands and mouth, while Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought spices, a garland, and sandalwood pulp.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu uṭhi' kailā ācamana
> paṇḍita ānila, mukhavāsa, mālya, candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---performed washing of the hands and mouth; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---spices; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]---flower garland; [[synonyms:c:candana]]---sandalwood pulp.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and washed His hands and mouth, while Jagadānanda Paṇḍita brought spices, a garland, and sandalwood pulp.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.141
description: Accepting the sandalwood pulp and garland, the Lord sat down and said, "Now, in front of Me, you must eat."
text:
> candanādi lañā prabhu vasilā sei sthāne
> 'āmāra āge āji tumi karaha bhojane'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:candana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accepting the sandalwood pulp and other items; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---at that place; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Me; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---now; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:karaha]]---perform; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---eating.
translation: Accepting the sandalwood pulp and garland, the Lord sat down and said, "Now, in front of Me, you must eat."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.142
description: Jagadānanda replied, "My Lord, You go take rest. I shall take prasāda after I finish making some arrangements.
text:
> paṇḍita kahe,---"prabhu yāi' karuna viśrāma
> mui, ebe la-iba prasāda kari' samādhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:k:karuna]] [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---take rest; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:iba]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---shall take //prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---after arranging.
translation: Jagadānanda replied, "My Lord, You go take rest. I shall take prasāda after I finish making some arrangements.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.143
description: "Rāmāi Paṇḍita and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa did the cooking, and I want to give them some rice and vegetables."
text:
> rasuira kārya kairāche rāmāi, raghunātha
> iṅhā sabāya dite cāhi kichu vyañjana-bhāta"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rasuira]]---of cooking; [[synonyms:k:kārya]]---the work; [[synonyms:k:kairāche]]---have done; [[synonyms:r:rāmāi]]---Rāmāi; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]---to them; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dite]] [[synonyms:c:cāhi]]---I want to give; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---rice and vegetables.
translation: "Rāmāi Paṇḍita and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa did the cooking, and I want to give them some rice and vegetables."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.144
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Govinda, "You remain here. When the Paṇḍita has taken his food, come inform Me.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---"govinda, tumi ihāṅi rahibā
> paṇḍita bhojana kaile, āmāre kahibā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅi]] [[synonyms:r:rahibā]]---will stay here; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kaile]]---after he has taken his meal; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahibā]]---you should inform Me.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then told Govinda, "You remain here. When the Paṇḍita has taken his food, come inform Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.145
description: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita spoke to Govinda.
text:
> eta kahi' mahāprabhu karilā gamana
> govindere paṇḍita kichu kahena vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---left; [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---said; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words.
translation: After Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had said this and left, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita spoke to Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.146
description: "Go quickly and massage the Lord's feet," he said. "You may tell Him, 'The Paṇḍita has just sat down to take his meal.'
text:
> "tumi śīghra yāha karite pāda-samvāhane
> kahiha,---'paṇḍita ebe vasila bhojane'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---hastily; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to perform; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhane]]---massaging the feet; [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---say; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---just now; [[synonyms:v:vasila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---sat down to eat.
translation: "Go quickly and massage the Lord's feet," he said. "You may tell Him, 'The Paṇḍita has just sat down to take his meal.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.147
description: "I shall keep some remnants of the Lord's food for you. When He is asleep, come and take your portion."
text:
> tomāre prabhura 'śeṣa' rākhimu dhariyā
> prabhu nidrā gele, tumi khāiha āsiyā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---for you; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:r:rākhimu]]---I shall keep; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:n:nidrā]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is asleep; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:khāiha]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---come and eat.
translation: "I shall keep some remnants of the Lord's food for you. When He is asleep, come and take your portion."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.148
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thus distributed remnants of the Lord's food to Rāmāi, Nandāi, Govinda and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa.
text:
> rāmāi, nandāi āra govinda, raghunātha
> sabāre bāṅṭiyā dilā prabhura vyañjana-bhāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmāi]]---Rāmāi Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nandāi]]---Nandāi; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---for all of them; [[synonyms:b:bāṅṭiyā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---distributed; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---vegetables and rice.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thus distributed remnants of the Lord's food to Rāmāi, Nandāi, Govinda and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.149
description: He also personally ate the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then the Lord again sent Govinda.
text:
> āpane prabhura 'śeṣa' karilā bhojana
> tabe govindere prabhu pāṭhāilā punaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---ate; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again.
translation: He also personally ate the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then the Lord again sent Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.15
description: Śivānanda Sena managed the payment of tolls at different places. Maintaining everyone, he guided all the devotees in great happiness.
text:
> śivānanda-sena kare ghāṭī-samādhāna
> sabāre pālana kari' sukhe lañā yāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭī]]-[[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---management of payment of tolls; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:p:pālana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---maintaining everyone; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:y:yāna]]---goes.
translation: Śivānanda Sena managed the payment of tolls at different places. Maintaining everyone, he guided all the devotees in great happiness.
purport: //Ghāṭī// refers to the different toll booths used by the Zamindars to collect taxes in each state. Generally, this tax was collected to maintain the roads governed by the various Zamindars. Since the devotees from Bengal were going to Jagannātha Purī, they had to pass through many such toll booths. Śivānanda Sena was in charge of paying the tolls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.150
description: The Lord told him, "Go see whether Jagadānanda Paṇḍita is eating. Then quickly return and let Me know."
text:
> "dekha,---jagadānanda prasāda pāya ki nā pāya
> śīghra āsi' samācāra kahibe āmāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---see; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---or; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming hastily; [[synonyms:s:samācāra]]---the news; [[synonyms:k:kahibe]]---inform; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---to Me.
translation: The Lord told him, "Go see whether Jagadānanda Paṇḍita is eating. Then quickly return and let Me know."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.151
description: Seeing that Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was indeed eating, Govinda informed the Lord, who then became peaceful and went to sleep.
text:
> govinda āsi' dekhi' kahila paṇḍitera bhojana
> tabe mahāprabhu svastye karila śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---informed; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---the eating of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svastye]]---in peace; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---went to sleep.
translation: Seeing that Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was indeed eating, Govinda informed the Lord, who then became peaceful and went to sleep.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.152
description: The affectionate loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued in this manner, exactly like the exchanges between Satyabhāmā and Lord Kṛṣṇa related in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
text:
> jagadānande-prabhute prema cale ei-mate
> satyabhāmā-kṛṣṇe yaiche śuni bhāgavate
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhute]]---between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---affection; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes on; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:satyabhāmā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---between Satyabhāmā and Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---we learn; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavate]]---in the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.//
translation: The affectionate loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued in this manner, exactly like the exchanges between Satyabhāmā and Lord Kṛṣṇa related in Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.153
description: Who can estimate the limit of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's fortune? He himself is the example of his own great fortune.
text:
> jagadānandera saubhāgyera ke kahibe sīmā?
> jagadānandera saubhāgyera teṅha se upamā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgyera]]---of the fortune; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kahibe]]---shall speak; [[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---the limit; [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgyera]]---of the fortune; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:s:se]]---the; [[synonyms:u:upamā]]---example.
translation: Who can estimate the limit of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's fortune? He himself is the example of his own great fortune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.154
description: Anyone who hears about the loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, or who reads Jagadānanda's book Prema-vivarta, can understand what love is. Moreover, he achieves ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> jagadānandera 'prema-vivarta' śune yei jana
> premera 'svarūpa' jāne, pāya prema-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vivarta]]---loving exchange; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---any person who; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of love; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---identity; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---he knows; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Anyone who hears about the loving exchanges between Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, or who reads Jagadānanda's book Prema-vivarta, can understand what love is. Moreover, he achieves ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
purport: The word //vivarta// means accepting something to be the opposite of what it appears. Here, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita appeared very angry, but this anger was a manifestation of his great love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. //Prema-vivarta// is also the name of a book written by Jagadānanda Paṇḍita. Therefore the author of //Caitanya-caritāmṛta,// Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī, uses the words //prema-vivarta// to refer to one who reads the book or hears about Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's relationships with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In either case, such a person very soon achieves love of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.155
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Twelfth Chapter, describing Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's loving dealings with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.16
description: Śivānanda Sena took care of everyone and gave each devotee places to stay. He knew all the paths leading to Orissa.
text:
> sabāra saba kārya karena, dena vāsa-sthāna
> śivānanda jāne uḍiyā-pathera sandhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kārya]]---business; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---gives; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---place of residence; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:u:uḍiyā]]-[[synonyms:p:pathera]]---of the path going to Orissa; [[synonyms:s:sandhāna]]---junctions.
translation: Śivānanda Sena took care of everyone and gave each devotee places to stay. He knew all the paths leading to Orissa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.17
description: One day when the party was being checked by a toll collector, the devotees were allowed to pass, and Śivānanda Sena remained behind alone to pay the taxes.
text:
> eka-dina saba loka ghāṭiyāle rākhilā
> sabā chāḍāñā śivānanda ekalā rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all the members of the party; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭiyāle]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---were checked by the toll collector; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]---all of them; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāñā]]---causing to be let go; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:e:ekalā]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained alone.
translation: One day when the party was being checked by a toll collector, the devotees were allowed to pass, and Śivānanda Sena remained behind alone to pay the taxes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.18
description: The party went into a village and waited beneath a tree because no one but Śivānanda Sena could arrange for their residential quarters.
text:
> sabe giyā rahilā grāma-bhitara vṛkṣa-tale
> śivānanda vinā vāsa-sthāna nāhi mile
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:g:grāma]]-[[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---inside a village; [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---under a tree; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---residential quarters; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:mile]]---no one could get.
translation: The party went into a village and waited beneath a tree because no one but Śivānanda Sena could arrange for their residential quarters.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.19
description: Nityānanda Prabhu meanwhile became very hungry and upset. Because He had not yet obtained a suitable residence, He began calling Śivānanda Sena ill names.
text:
> nityānanda-prabhu bhokhe vyākula hañā
> śivānanda gāli pāḍe vāsā nā pāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhokhe]]---became very hungry; [[synonyms:v:vyākula]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being disturbed; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:g:gāli]] [[synonyms:p:pāḍe]]---was calling Śivānanda ill names; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting residential quarters.
translation: Nityānanda Prabhu meanwhile became very hungry and upset. Because He had not yet obtained a suitable residence, He began calling Śivānanda Sena ill names.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is all-merciful! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, who is an ocean of mercy!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya dayāmaya
> jaya jaya nityānanda kṛpā-sindhu jaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---all-merciful; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of mercy; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is all-merciful! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, who is an ocean of mercy!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.20
description: "Śivānanda Sena has not arranged for My residence," He complained, "and I am so hungry I could die. Because he has not come, I curse his three sons to die."
text:
> 'tina putra maruka śivāra, ekhana nā āila
> bhokhe mari' genu, more vāsā nā deoyāila'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:p:putra]]---three sons; [[synonyms:m:maruka]]---let them die; [[synonyms:ś:śivāra]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:e:ekhana]]---here; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---he does not come; [[synonyms:b:bhokhe]] [[synonyms:m:mari']] [[synonyms:g:genu]]---I am dying from hunger; [[synonyms:m:more]]---for Me; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]---residential place; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deoyāila]]---he did not arrange.
translation: "Śivānanda Sena has not arranged for My residence," He complained, "and I am so hungry I could die. Because he has not come, I curse his three sons to die."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.21
description: Hearing this curse, Śivānanda Sena's wife began to cry. Just then, Śivānanda returned from the toll station.
text:
> śuni' śivānandera patnī kāndite lāgilā
> hena-kāle śivānanda ghāṭī haite āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:patnī]]---the wife; [[synonyms:k:kāndite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to cry; [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭī]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the toll station; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came.
translation: Hearing this curse, Śivānanda Sena's wife began to cry. Just then, Śivānanda returned from the toll station.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.22
description: Crying, his wife informed him, "Lord Nityānanda has cursed our sons to die because His quarters have not been provided."
text:
> śivānandera patnī tāṅre kahena kāndiyā
> 'putre śāpa dichena gosāñi vāsā nā pāñā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:patnī]]---the wife; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:k:kāndiyā]]---crying; [[synonyms:p:putre]]---on our sons; [[synonyms:ś:śāpa]]---curse; [[synonyms:d:dichena]]---awarded; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting His residential quarters.
translation: Crying, his wife informed him, "Lord Nityānanda has cursed our sons to die because His quarters have not been provided."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.23
description: Śivānanda Sena replied, "You crazy woman! Why are you needlessly crying? Let my three sons die for all the inconvenience we have caused Nityānanda Prabhu."
text:
> teṅho kahe,---"bāuli, kene maris kāndiyā?
> maruka āmāra tina putra tāṅra bālāi lañā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅho]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said; [[synonyms:b:bāuli]]---crazy woman; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:m:maris]]---are you dying; [[synonyms:k:kāndiyā]]---crying; [[synonyms:m:maruka]]---let die; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---sons; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:b:bālāi]]---inconveniences; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking.
translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "You crazy woman! Why are you needlessly crying? Let my three sons die for all the inconvenience we have caused Nityānanda Prabhu."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.24
description: After saying this, Śivānanda Sena went to Nityānanda Prabhu, who then stood up and kicked him.
text:
> eta bali' prabhu-pāśe gelā śivānanda
> uṭhi' tāṅre lāthi māilā prabhu nityānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---standing up; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:l:lāthi]] [[synonyms:m:māilā]]---kicked; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Nityānanda.
translation: After saying this, Śivānanda Sena went to Nityānanda Prabhu, who then stood up and kicked him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.25
description: Very pleased at being kicked, Śivānanda Sena quickly arranged for a milkman's house to be the Lord's residence.
text:
> ānandita hailā śivāi pāda-prahāra pāñā
> śīghra vāsā-ghara kailā gauḍa-ghare giyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very pleased; [[synonyms:ś:śivāi]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:prahāra]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---being kicked; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]-[[synonyms:g:ghara]]---residential place; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---arranged; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to a milkman's house; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going.
translation: Very pleased at being kicked, Śivānanda Sena quickly arranged for a milkman's house to be the Lord's residence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.26
description: Śivānanda Sena touched the lotus feet of Nityānanda Prabhu and led Him to His residence. After giving the Lord His quarters, Śivānanda Sena, being very pleased, spoke as follows.
text:
> caraṇe dhariyā prabhure vāsāya lañā gelā
> vāsā diyā hṛṣṭa hañā kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---the feet; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---catching; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:v:vāsāya]]---to His residence; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---after giving His residential quarters; [[synonyms:h:hṛṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very pleased; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: Śivānanda Sena touched the lotus feet of Nityānanda Prabhu and led Him to His residence. After giving the Lord His quarters, Śivānanda Sena, being very pleased, spoke as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.27
description: "Today You have accepted me as Your servant and have properly punished me for my offense.
text:
> "āji more bhṛtya kari' aṅgīkāra kailā
> yemana aparādha bhṛtyera, yogya phala dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---servant; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---acceptance; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---You have done; [[synonyms:y:yemana]]---as; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]---offense; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtyera]]---of the servant; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---proper; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---You have given.
translation: "Today You have accepted me as Your servant and have properly punished me for my offense.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.28
description: "My dear Lord, Your chastising me is Your causeless mercy. Who within the three worlds can understand Your real character?
text:
> 'śāsti'-chale kṛpā kara,---e tomāra 'karuṇā'
> trijagate tomāra caritra bujhe kon janā?
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śāsti]]-[[synonyms:c:chale]]---on the pretext of chastisement; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---You bestow mercy; [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:k:karuṇā]]---Your causeless mercy; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:j:jagate]]---within the three worlds; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:c:caritra]]---character; [[synonyms:b:bujhe]]---understands; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:janā]]---what person.
translation: "My dear Lord, Your chastising me is Your causeless mercy. Who within the three worlds can understand Your real character?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.29
description: "The dust of Your lotus feet is not attainable even by Lord Brahmā, yet Your lotus feet have touched my wretched body.
text:
> brahmāra durlabha tomāra śrī-caraṇa-reṇu
> hena caraṇa-sparśa pāila mora adhama tanu
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahmāra]]---by Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:d:durlabha]]---almost unattainable; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:reṇu]]---dust of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:h:hena]]---such; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sparśa]]---touch of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---got; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:a:adhama]]---most fallen; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]---body.
translation: "The dust of Your lotus feet is not attainable even by Lord Brahmā, yet Your lotus feet have touched my wretched body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.3
description: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is also an ocean of mercy! All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whose hearts are always filled with mercy!
text:
> jayādvaita-candra jaya karuṇā-sāgara
> jaya gaura-bhakta-gaṇa kṛpā-pūrṇāntara
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:k:karuṇā]]-[[synonyms:s:sāgara]]---the ocean of mercy; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]]---whose hearts are always filled with mercy.
translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is also an ocean of mercy! All glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whose hearts are always filled with mercy!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.30
description: "Today my birth, my family and my activities have all become successful. Today I have achieved the fulfillment of religious principles, economic development, satisfaction of the senses and ultimately devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> āji mora saphala haila janma, kula, karma
> āji pāinu kṛṣṇa-bhakti, artha, kāma, dharma"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---successful; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:j:janma]]---birth; [[synonyms:k:kula]]---family; [[synonyms:k:karma]]---activities; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---I have gotten; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---economic development; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---satisfaction of the senses; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---religion.
translation: "Today my birth, my family and my activities have all become successful. Today I have achieved the fulfillment of religious principles, economic development, satisfaction of the senses and ultimately devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.31
description: When Lord Nityānanda heard this, He was very happy. He rose and embraced Śivānanda Sena in great love.
text:
> śuni' nityānanda-prabhura ānandita mana
> uṭhi' śivānande kailā prema-āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---very pleased; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---standing up; [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]]---unto Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---in love; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing.
translation: When Lord Nityānanda heard this, He was very happy. He rose and embraced Śivānanda Sena in great love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.32
description: Being very pleased by Nityānanda Prabhu's behavior, Śivānanda Sena began to arrange residential quarters for all the Vaiṣṇavas, headed by Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> ānandita śivānanda kare samādhāna
> ācāryādi-vaiṣṇavere dilā vāsā-sthāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---pleased; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---began to arrange things; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavere]]---unto all the Vaiṣṇavas, headed by Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---residential places.
translation: Being very pleased by Nityānanda Prabhu's behavior, Śivānanda Sena began to arrange residential quarters for all the Vaiṣṇavas, headed by Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.33
description: One of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu's characteristics is His contradictory nature. When He becomes angry and kicks someone, it is actually to his benefit.
text:
> nityānanda-prabhura saba caritra---'viparīta'
> kruddha hañā lāthi māri' kare tāra hita
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:c:caritra]]---all characteristics; [[synonyms:v:viparīta]]---contradictory; [[synonyms:k:kruddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming angry; [[synonyms:l:lāthi]] [[synonyms:m:māri']]---kicking; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:h:hita]]---his benefit.
translation: One of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu's characteristics is His contradictory nature. When He becomes angry and kicks someone, it is actually to his benefit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.34
description: Śivānanda Sena's nephew, Śrīkānta, the son of his sister, felt offended, and he commented on the matter when his uncle was absent.
text:
> śivānandera bhāginā,---śrīkānta-sena nāma
> māmāra agocare kahe kari' abhimāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:bhāginā]]---the sister's son; [[synonyms:ś:śrīkānta]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named Śrīkānta Sena; [[synonyms:m:māmāra]]---of his maternal uncle; [[synonyms:a:agocare]]---in the absence of; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---with an offended state of mind.
translation: Śivānanda Sena's nephew, Śrīkānta, the son of his sister, felt offended, and he commented on the matter when his uncle was absent.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.35
description: "My uncle is well known as one of the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but Lord Nityānanda Prabhu asserts His superiority by kicking him."
text:
> "caitanyera pāriṣada mora mātulera khyāti
> 'ṭhākurālī' karena gosāñi, tāṅre māre lāthi"
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:p:pāriṣada]]---associate of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:m:mātulera]]---of the maternal uncle; [[synonyms:k:khyāti]]---reputation; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurālī]]---superiority; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---exhibits; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:m:māre]] [[synonyms:l:lāthi]]---kicks.
translation: "My uncle is well known as one of the associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but Lord Nityānanda Prabhu asserts His superiority by kicking him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.36
description: After saying this, Śrīkānta, who was only a boy, left the group and traveled on alone to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> eta bali' śrīkānta, bālaka āge cali' yāna
> saṅga chāḍi' āge gelā mahāprabhura sthāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:ś:śrīkānta]]---the nephew of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]---a boy; [[synonyms:ā:āge]] [[synonyms:c:cali']] [[synonyms:y:yāna]]---went forward; [[synonyms:s:saṅga]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up their association; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---forward; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After saying this, Śrīkānta, who was only a boy, left the group and traveled on alone to the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.37
description: When Śrīkānta offered obeisances to the Lord, he was still wearing his shirt and coat. Therefore Govinda told him, "My dear Śrīkānta, first take off these garments."
text:
> peṭāṅgi-gāya kare daṇḍavat-namaskāra
> govinda kahe,---'śrīkānta, āge peṭāṅgi utāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:peṭāṅgi]]---shirt and coat; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---on the body; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]]-[[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---offering of obeisances; [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Govinda said; [[synonyms:ś:śrīkānta]]---my dear //Śrīkānta//; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---first; [[synonyms:p:peṭāṅgi]] [[synonyms:u:utāra]]---take off your shirt and coat.
translation: When Śrīkānta offered obeisances to the Lord, he was still wearing his shirt and coat. Therefore Govinda told him, "My dear Śrīkānta, first take off these garments."
purport:
One is forbidden to enter the Deity room or offer anything to the Deity while wearing a shirt or coat. in the //tantras// it is said:

> vastreṇāvṛta-dehas tu
> yo naraḥ praṇamed dharim
> śvitrī bhavati mūḍhātmā
> sapta janmāni bhāvini

"Anyone who offers respects and obeisances to the Deity while wearing garments on the upper portion of his body is condemned to be a leper for seven births."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.38
description: As Govinda was warning Śrīkānta, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Don't bother him. Let Śrīkānta do whatever he likes, for he has come here in a distressed state of mind."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"śrīkānta āsiyāche pāñā mano-duḥkha
> kichu nā baliha, karuka, yāte ihāra sukha"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:ś:śrīkānta]]---//Śrīkānta//; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyāche]]---has come; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---distress in the mind; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:baliha]]---do not say; [[synonyms:k:karuka]]---let him do; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---his; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness.
translation: As Govinda was warning Śrīkānta, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Don't bother him. Let Śrīkānta do whatever he likes, for he has come here in a distressed state of mind."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.39
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Śrīkānta about all the Vaiṣṇavas, and the boy informed the Lord about them, naming them one after another.
text:
> vaiṣṇavera samācāra gosāñi puchilā
> eke eke sabāra nāma śrīkānta jānāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of all the //Vaiṣṇavas//; [[synonyms:s:samācāra]]---news; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired; [[synonyms:e:eke]] [[synonyms:e:eke]]---one after another; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---names; [[synonyms:ś:śrīkānta]]---the nephew of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:j:jānāilā]]---informed.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Śrīkānta about all the Vaiṣṇavas, and the boy informed the Lord about them, naming them one after another.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.4
description: The mind of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always morose because of a continuously manifested feeling of separation from Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ataḥpara mahāprabhura viṣaṇṇa-antara
> kṛṣṇera viyoga-daśā sphure nirantara
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataḥpara]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:viṣaṇṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]]---morose mind; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:viyoga]]-[[synonyms:d:daśā]]---feeling of separation; [[synonyms:s:sphure]]---manifests; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---continuously.
translation: The mind of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was always morose because of a continuously manifested feeling of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.40
description: When Śrīkānta Sena heard the Lord say, "He is distressed," he could understand that the Lord is omniscient.
text:
> 'duḥkha pāñā āsiyāche'---ei prabhura vākya śuni'
> jānilā 'sarvajña prabhu'---eta anumāni'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyāche]]---he has come; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vākya]]---statement; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:j:jānilā]]---could understand; [[synonyms:s:sarvajña]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord is omniscient; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---this; [[synonyms:a:anumāni']]---guessing.
translation: When Śrīkānta Sena heard the Lord say, "He is distressed," he could understand that the Lord is omniscient.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.41
description: As he described the Vaiṣṇavas, therefore, he did not mention Lord Nitya-nanda's kicking Śivānanda Sena. Meanwhile, all the devotees arrived and went to meet the Lord.
text:
> śivānande lāthi mārilā,---ihā nā kahilā
> ethā saba vaiṣṇava-gaṇa āsiyā mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:l:lāthi]] [[synonyms:m:mārilā]]---(Lord Nityānanda) has kicked; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he did not say; [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: As he described the Vaiṣṇavas, therefore, he did not mention Lord Nitya-nanda's kicking Śivānanda Sena. Meanwhile, all the devotees arrived and went to meet the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.42
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received them all, just as He had in previous years. The women, however, saw the Lord from a distance.
text:
> pūrvavat prabhu kailā sabāra milana
> strī-saba dūra ha-ite kailā prabhura daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---meeting everyone; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---women; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from a distance; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing the Lord.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu received them all, just as He had in previous years. The women, however, saw the Lord from a distance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.43
description: The Lord again arranged for the residential quarters of all the devotees and thereafter called them to partake of the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> vāsā-ghara pūrvavat sabāre deoyāilā
> mahāprasāda-bhojane sabāre bolāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]-[[synonyms:g:ghara]]---residential quarters; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto all of them; [[synonyms:d:deoyāilā]]---caused to be given; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the remnants of food from Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---to eat; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto everyone; [[synonyms:b:bolāilā]]---He called.
translation: The Lord again arranged for the residential quarters of all the devotees and thereafter called them to partake of the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.44
description: Śivānanda Sena introduced his three sons to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Because they were his sons, the Lord showed the boys great mercy.
text:
> śivānanda tina-putre gosāñire milāilā
> śivānanda-sambandhe sabāya bahu-kṛpā kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:p:putre]]---three sons; [[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milāilā]]---introduced; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sambandhe]]---because they were sons of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---unto all of them; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---showed much mercy.
translation: Śivānanda Sena introduced his three sons to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Because they were his sons, the Lord showed the boys great mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.45
description: Lord Caitanya asked the youngest son's name, and Śivānanda Sena informed the Lord that his name was Paramānanda dāsa.
text:
> choṭa-putre dekhi' prabhu nāma puchilā
> 'paramānanda-dāsa'-nāma sena jānāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:choṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:putre]]---the youngest son; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired about his name; [[synonyms:p:paramānanda]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Paramānanda dāsa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:j:jānāilā]]---informed.
translation: Lord Caitanya asked the youngest son's name, and Śivānanda Sena informed the Lord that his name was Paramānanda dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.46-47
description: Once before when Śivānanda Sena had visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at His residence, the Lord had told him, "When this son is born, give him the name Purī dāsa."
text:
> pūrve yabe śivānanda prabhu-sthāne āilā
> tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre kahite lāgilā
> "e-bāra tomāra yei ha-ibe kumāra
> 'purī-dāsa' bali' nāma dhariha tāhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---this time; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---that; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibe]]---will be; [[synonyms:k:kumāra]]---son; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Purī dāsa; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---as; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:d:dhariha]]---gave; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---his.
translation: Once before when Śivānanda Sena had visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at His residence, the Lord had told him, "When this son is born, give him the name Purī dāsa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.48
description: The son was in the womb of his wife, and when he returned home the son was born.
text:
> tabe māyera garbhe haya sei ta' kumāra
> śivānanda ghare gele, janma haila tāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:māyera]] [[synonyms:g:garbhe]]---the womb of the mother; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---was; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kumāra]]---that son; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when Śivānanda Sena returned home; [[synonyms:j:janma]] [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---he was born.
translation: The son was in the womb of his wife, and when he returned home the son was born.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.49
description: The child was named Paramānanda dāsa in accordance with the Lord's order, and the Lord jokingly called him Purī dāsa.
text:
> prabhu-ājñāya dharilā nāma---'paramānanda-dāsa'
> 'purī-dāsa' kari' prabhu karena upahāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---under the order of Śrī-Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---held the name; [[synonyms:p:paramānanda]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Paramānanda dāsa; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Purī dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upahāsa]]---began to joke.
translation: The child was named Paramānanda dāsa in accordance with the Lord's order, and the Lord jokingly called him Purī dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.5
description: The Lord would cry, "O My Lord Kṛṣṇa, My life and soul! O son of Mahārāja Nanda, where shall I go? Where shall I attain You? O Supreme Personality who plays with Your flute to Your mouth!"
text:
> 'hāhā kṛṣṇa prāṇa-nātha vrajendra-nandana!
> kāhāṅ yāṅa kāhāṅ pāṅa, muralī-vadana!'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hāhā]]---O; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---My dear Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---My life and soul; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the son of Mahārāja Nanda; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāṅa]]---where shall I go; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:p:pāṅa]]---where shall I get; [[synonyms:m:muralī]]---flute; [[synonyms:v:vadana]]---mouth.
translation: The Lord would cry, "O My Lord Kṛṣṇa, My life and soul! O son of Mahārāja Nanda, where shall I go? Where shall I attain You? O Supreme Personality who plays with Your flute to Your mouth!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.50
description: When Śivānanda Sena introduced the child to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord put His toe in the child's mouth.
text:
> śivānanda yabe sei bālake milāilā
> mahāprabhu pādāṅguṣṭha tāra mukhe dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bālake]]---child; [[synonyms:m:milāilā]]---introduced; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅguṣṭha]]---His toe; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---within the mouth; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---pushed.
translation: When Śivānanda Sena introduced the child to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord put His toe in the child's mouth.
purport: In this connection one may refer to //Antya-līlā,// Chapter Sixteen, verses 65-75, for information about the later manifestations of the Lord's mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.51
description: No one can cross over the ocean of Śivānanda Sena's good fortune, for the Lord considered Śivānanda's whole family His own.
text:
> śivānandera bhāgya-sindhu ke pāibe pāra?
> yāṅra saba goṣṭhīke prabhu kahe 'āpanāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of fortune; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:p:pāibe]] [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---can cross over; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhīke]]---whole family; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]]---His own.
translation: No one can cross over the ocean of Śivānanda Sena's good fortune, for the Lord considered Śivānanda's whole family His own.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.52
description: The Lord ate lunch in the company of all the other devotees, and after washing His hands and mouth He gave an order to Govinda.
text:
> tabe saba bhakta lañā karilā bhojana
> govindere ājñā dilā kari' ācamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took lunch; [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave the order; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---after washing His hands and mouth.
translation: The Lord ate lunch in the company of all the other devotees, and after washing His hands and mouth He gave an order to Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.53
description: "As long as Śivānanda Sena's wife and children stay in Jagannātha Purī," He said, "they must be given the remnants of My food."
text:
> "śivānandera 'prakṛti', putra---yāvat ethāya
> āmāra avaśeṣa-pātra tārā yena pāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:prakṛti]]---wife; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---sons; [[synonyms:y:yāvat]]---as long as; [[synonyms:e:ethāya]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---plate of the remnants of food; [[synonyms:t:tārā]]---all of them; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---must; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---get.
translation: "As long as Śivānanda Sena's wife and children stay in Jagannātha Purī," He said, "they must be given the remnants of My food."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.54
description: There was a resident of Nadia named Parameśvara, who was a confectioner living near the home of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> nadīyā-vāsī modaka, tāra nāma---'parameśvara'
> modaka vece, prabhura vāṭīra nikaṭa tāra ghara
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nadīyā]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---inhabitant of the district of Nadia; [[synonyms:m:modaka]]---one confectioner; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---his name; [[synonyms:p:parameśvara]]---Parameśvara; [[synonyms:m:modaka]] [[synonyms:v:vece]]---does the business of a confectioner; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vāṭīra]] [[synonyms:n:nikaṭa]]---near the house; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---his house.
translation: There was a resident of Nadia named Parameśvara, who was a confectioner living near the home of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.55
description: When the Lord was a boy, He would visit the house of Parameśvara Modaka again and again. The confectioner would supply the Lord milk and sweetmeats, and the Lord would eat them.
text:
> bālaka-kāle prabhu tāra ghare bāra bāra yā'na
> dugdha, khaṇḍa modaka deya, prabhu tāhā khā'na
