synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---when He was a boy; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at his house; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:y:yā'na]]---used to go; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---milk; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]---sweetmeats; [[synonyms:m:modaka]] [[synonyms:d:deya]]---the confectioner used to give; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:khā'na]]---used to eat.
translation: When the Lord was a boy, He would visit the house of Parameśvara Modaka again and again. The confectioner would supply the Lord milk and sweetmeats, and the Lord would eat them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.56
description: Parameśvara Modaka had been affectionate toward the Lord since His childhood, and he was one of those who came that year to see the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> prabhu-viṣaye sneha tāra bālaka-kāla haite
> se vatsara seha āila prabhure dekhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaye]]---in regard to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sneha]]---affection; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of Parameśvara Modaka; [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---since He was a boy; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---that year; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---he also; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see the Lord.
translation: Parameśvara Modaka had been affectionate toward the Lord since His childhood, and he was one of those who came that year to see the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.57
description: When he offered his obeisances to the Lord, he said, "I am the same Parameśvara." Upon seeing him, the Lord asked him questions with great affection.
text:
> 'parameśvarā muñi' bali' daṇḍavat kaila
> tāre dekhi' prabhu prīte tāhāre puchila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:parameśvarā]]---Parameśvara; [[synonyms:m:muñi']]---I am; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---he said; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prīte]]---with affection; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]]---him; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---asked.
translation: When he offered his obeisances to the Lord, he said, "I am the same Parameśvara." Upon seeing him, the Lord asked him questions with great affection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.58
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Parameśvara, may you be blessed. It is very good that you have come here." Parameśvara then informed the Lord, "Mukundāra Mātā has also come."
text:
> 'parameśvara kuśala hao, bhāla haila, āilā'
> 'mukundāra mātā āsiyāche, seha prabhure kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:parameśvara]]---O Parameśvara; [[synonyms:k:kuśala]] [[synonyms:h:hao]]---be blessed; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---it is very good; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---you have come; [[synonyms:m:mukundāra]] [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---the mother of Mukunda; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyāche]]---has come; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---he; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---informed the Lord.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Parameśvara, may you be blessed. It is very good that you have come here." Parameśvara then informed the Lord, "Mukundāra Mātā has also come."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.59
description: Hearing the name of Mukundāra Mātā, Lord Caitanya hesitated, but because of affection for Parameśvara, He did not say anything.
text:
> mukundāra mātāra nāma śuni' prabhu saṅkoca hailā
> tathāpi tāhāra prīte kichu nā balilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mukundāra]] [[synonyms:m:mātāra]]---of the mother of Mukunda; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saṅkoca]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---felt some hesitation; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of Parameśvara; [[synonyms:p:prīte]]---out of affection; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:balilā]]---did not say.
translation: Hearing the name of Mukundāra Mātā, Lord Caitanya hesitated, but because of affection for Parameśvara, He did not say anything.
purport: A //sannyāsī// is restricted from even hearing a woman's name, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu conducted Himself very strictly in His vow. Parameśvara informed the Lord that his wife, Mukundāra Mātā, had come with him. He should not have mentioned her, and therefore the Lord hesitated for a moment, but due to His affection for Parameśvara, He did not say anything. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had known Parameśvara Modaka since His childhood, and therefore Parameśvara did not think twice about informing the Lord of his wife's arrival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.6
description: This was His situation day and night. Unable to find peace of mind, He passed His nights with great difficulty in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya.
text:
> rātri-dina ei daśā svasti nāhi mane
> kaṣṭe rātri goṅāya svarūpa-rāmānanda-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---day and night; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---this situation; [[synonyms:s:svasti]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---no peace of mind; [[synonyms:k:kaṣṭe]]---with great difficulty; [[synonyms:r:rātri]] [[synonyms:g:goṅāya]]---passes the night; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.
translation: This was His situation day and night. Unable to find peace of mind, He passed His nights with great difficulty in the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.60
description: An intimate relationship sometimes makes a person overstep formal etiquette. Thus Parameśvara actually pleased the Lord in His heart by his simple and affectionate behavior.
text:
> praśraya-pāgala śuddha-vaidagdhī nā jāne
> antare sukhī hailā prabhu tāra sei guṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:praśraya]]---due to indulgence; [[synonyms:p:pāgala]]---foolish; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:v:vaidagdhī]]---etiquette; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:s:sukhī]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very happy; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---by that attribute.
translation: An intimate relationship sometimes makes a person overstep formal etiquette. Thus Parameśvara actually pleased the Lord in His heart by his simple and affectionate behavior.
purport: //Praśraya// means affection, humility, faith, a demand for some special concession, or indulgence in such a concession. //Pāgala// means impudence, arrogance, and influence. //Vaidagdhī// means cunningness, humor, beauty, expertise, learning, tricky behavior, and indications.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.61
description: All the devotees engaged in the cleansing ceremony of the Guṇḍicā temple and danced in front of the Ratha-yātrā chariot, just as they had done in the past.
text:
> pūrvavat sabā lañā guṇḍicā-mārjana
> ratha-āge pūrvavat karilā nartana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---the cleaning of the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of the chariot; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---danced.
translation: All the devotees engaged in the cleansing ceremony of the Guṇḍicā temple and danced in front of the Ratha-yātrā chariot, just as they had done in the past.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.62
description: For four consecutive months, the devotees observed all the festivals. The wives, such as Mālinī, extended invitations for lunch to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> cāturmāsya saba yātrā kailā daraśana
> mālinī-prabhṛti prabhure kailā nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāturmāsya]]---for four months; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---all the festivals; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---saw; [[synonyms:m:mālinī]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhṛti]]---ladies like Mālinī, the wife of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---made invitations.
translation: For four consecutive months, the devotees observed all the festivals. The wives, such as Mālinī, extended invitations for lunch to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.63
description: From Bengal the devotees had brought varieties of Bengali food that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu liked. They also cooked various grains and vegetables in their homes and offered them to the Lord.
text:
> prabhura priya nānā dravya āniyāche deśa haite
> sei vyañjana kari' bhikṣā dena ghara-bhāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---dear; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---varieties of things; [[synonyms:ā:āniyāche]]---brought; [[synonyms:d:deśa]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from their country; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---preparing those vegetables; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---offer food; [[synonyms:g:ghara]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāte]]---cooking at home.
translation: From Bengal the devotees had brought varieties of Bengali food that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu liked. They also cooked various grains and vegetables in their homes and offered them to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.64
description: During the day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in various activities with His devotees, but at night He felt great separation from Kṛṣṇa and used to cry.
text:
> dine nānā krīḍā kare lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> rātrye kṛṣṇa-vicchede prabhu karena rodana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dine]]---during the day; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performed pastimes; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vicchede]]---because of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---cries.
translation: During the day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu engaged in various activities with His devotees, but at night He felt great separation from Kṛṣṇa and used to cry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.65
description: In this way the Lord spent the four months of the rainy season in various pastimes, and then He ordered the Bengali devotees to return to their homes.
text:
> ei-mata nānā-līlāya cāturmāsya gela
> gauḍa-deśe yāite tabe bhakte ājñā dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---in various pastimes; [[synonyms:c:cāturmāsya]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---the four months of the rainy season passed; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to return to Bengal; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered.
translation: In this way the Lord spent the four months of the rainy season in various pastimes, and then He ordered the Bengali devotees to return to their homes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.66
description: All the devotees from Bengal would regularly invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch, and the Lord would speak to them in very sweet words.
text:
> saba bhakta karena mahāprabhura nimantraṇa
> sarva-bhakte kahena prabhu madhura vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to lunch; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---speaks; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:madhura]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---sweet words.
translation: All the devotees from Bengal would regularly invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for lunch, and the Lord would speak to them in very sweet words.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.67
description: "All of you come to see Me every year," the Lord said. "To come here and then return must certainly give you great trouble.
text:
> "prati-varṣe āisa sabe āmāre dekhite
> āsite yāite duḥkha pāo bahu-mate
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:v:varṣe]]---every year; [[synonyms:ā:āisa]]---come; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see Me; [[synonyms:ā:āsite]]---to come; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to return; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:p:pāo]]---you get much trouble; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in various ways.
translation: "All of you come to see Me every year," the Lord said. "To come here and then return must certainly give you great trouble.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.68
description: "I would like to forbid you to do this, but I enjoy your company so much that My desire for your association only increases.
text:
> tomā-sabāra duḥkha jāni' cāhi niṣedhite
> tomā-sabāra saṅga-sukhe lobha bāḍe citte
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---trouble; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---understanding; [[synonyms:c:cāhi]] [[synonyms:n:niṣedhite]]---I want to stop this; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---for the happiness of association; [[synonyms:l:lobha]]---desire; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increases; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in My mind.
translation: "I would like to forbid you to do this, but I enjoy your company so much that My desire for your association only increases.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.69
description: "I ordered Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu not to leave Bengal, but He has transgressed My order and come to see Me. What can I say?
text:
> nityānande ājñā diluṅ gauḍete rahite
> ājñā laṅghi' āilā, ki pāri balite?
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānande]]---unto Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:diluṅ]]---I ordered; [[synonyms:g:gauḍete]] [[synonyms:r:rahite]]---to stay in Bengal; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:laṅghi']]---transgressing My order; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---He has come; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:p:pāri]] [[synonyms:b:balite]]---can I say.
translation: "I ordered Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu not to leave Bengal, but He has transgressed My order and come to see Me. What can I say?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.7
description: Meanwhile, all the devotees journeyed from their homes in Bengal to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ethā gauḍa-deśe prabhura yata bhakta-gaṇa
> prabhu dekhibāre sabe karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---on the other hand; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---went.
translation: Meanwhile, all the devotees journeyed from their homes in Bengal to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.70
description: "Out of His causeless mercy upon Me, Advaita Ācārya has also come here. I am indebted to Him for His affectionate behavior. This debt is impossible for Me to liquidate.
text:
> āilena ācārya-gosāñi more kṛpā kari'
> prema-ṛṇe baddha āmi, śudhite nā pāri
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āilena]]---has come; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to Me; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---giving mercy; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---of love; [[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṇe]]---by the debt; [[synonyms:b:baddha]] [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I am bound; [[synonyms:ś:śudhite]]---to pay back; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am unable.
translation: "Out of His causeless mercy upon Me, Advaita Ācārya has also come here. I am indebted to Him for His affectionate behavior. This debt is impossible for Me to liquidate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.71
description: "All My devotees come here just for Me. Leaving aside their homes and families, they travel by very difficult paths to come here in great haste.
text:
> mora lāgi' strī-putra-gṛhādi chāḍiyā
> nānā durgama patha laṅghi' āisena dhāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Me; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---wife; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---sons; [[synonyms:g:gṛha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---home and so on; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---leaving aside; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:d:durgama]]---difficult; [[synonyms:p:patha]]---paths; [[synonyms:l:laṅghi']]---crossing; [[synonyms:ā:āisena]] [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---come here with great haste.
translation: "All My devotees come here just for Me. Leaving aside their homes and families, they travel by very difficult paths to come here in great haste.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.72
description: "There is no fatigue or trouble for Me, for I stay here at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, and do not move at all. This is the favor of all of you.
text:
> āmi ei nīlācale rahi ye vasiyā
> pariśrama nāhi mora tomā sabāra lāgiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:r:rahi]]---remain; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:v:vasiyā]]---sitting; [[synonyms:p:pariśrama]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:mora]]---I have no fatigue; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---due to all of you.
translation: "There is no fatigue or trouble for Me, for I stay here at Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, and do not move at all. This is the favor of all of you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.73
description: "I am a mendicant and have no money. How can I clear My debt for the favor you have shown Me?
text:
> sannyāsī mānuṣa mora, nāhi kona dhana
> ki diyā tomāra ṛṇa karimu śodhana?
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]] [[synonyms:m:mānuṣa]]---in the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kona]]---any; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---money; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṇa]]---the debt to you; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---shall I repay.
translation: "I am a mendicant and have no money. How can I clear My debt for the favor you have shown Me?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.74
description: "I have only this body, and therefore I surrender it unto you. Now, if you wish, you may sell it anywhere you like. It is your property."
text:
> deha-mātra dhana tomāya kailuṅ samarpaṇa
> tāhāṅ vikāi, yāhāṅ vecite tomāra mana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---asset; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---unto you; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---I have dedicated; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:v:vikāi]]---I sell; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:v:vecite]]---to sell; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---your mind.
translation: "I have only this body, and therefore I surrender it unto you. Now, if you wish, you may sell it anywhere you like. It is your property."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.75
description: When all the devotees heard these sweet words of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, their hearts melted, and they began to shed incessant tears.
text:
> prabhura vacane sabāra dravī-bhūta mana
> ajhora-nayane sabe karena krandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---by the words; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:d:dravī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūta]]---melted; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---hearts; [[synonyms:a:ajhora]]---incessantly pouring tears; [[synonyms:n:nayane]]---eyes; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---were crying.
translation: When all the devotees heard these sweet words of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, their hearts melted, and they began to shed incessant tears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.76
description: Catching hold of His devotees, the Lord embraced them all and began to cry and cry.
text:
> prabhu sabāra galā dhari' karena rodana
> kāndite kāndite sabāya kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:g:galā]]---necks; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---began to cry; [[synonyms:k:kāndite]] [[synonyms:k:kāndite]]---crying and crying; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---He embraced.
translation: Catching hold of His devotees, the Lord embraced them all and began to cry and cry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.77
description: Unable to leave, everyone remained there, and five to seven more days thus passed by.
text:
> sabāi rahila, keha calite nārila
> āra dina pāṅca-sāta ei-mate gela
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabāi]] [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---all of them stayed; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:c:calite]] [[synonyms:n:nārila]]---no one could move; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---further; [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]]---five to seven days; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed.
translation: Unable to leave, everyone remained there, and five to seven more days thus passed by.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.78
description: Advaita Prabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu submitted these words at the lotus feet of the Lord: "The entire world is naturally obligated to You for Your transcendental attributes.
text:
> advaita avadhūta kichu kahe prabhu-pāya
> "sahaje tomāra guṇe jagat vikāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---Advaita Prabhu; [[synonyms:a:avadhūta]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāya]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sahaje]]---naturally; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---because of transcendental attributes; [[synonyms:j:jagat]] [[synonyms:v:vikāya]]---the whole world is obligated to You.
translation: Advaita Prabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu submitted these words at the lotus feet of the Lord: "The entire world is naturally obligated to You for Your transcendental attributes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.79
description: "Yet You bind Your devotees again with Your sweet words. Under these circumstances, who can go anywhere?"
text:
> ābāra tāte bāndha'---aiche kṛpā-vākya-ḍore
> tomā chāḍi' kebā kāhāṅ yāibāre pāre?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ābāra]]---again; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---by that; [[synonyms:b:bāndha']]---You bind; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---merciful; [[synonyms:v:vākya]]---of words; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍore]]---by the rope; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---leaving You; [[synonyms:k:kebā]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:y:yāibāre]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can go.
translation: "Yet You bind Your devotees again with Your sweet words. Under these circumstances, who can go anywhere?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.8
description: Headed by Śivānanda Sena, Advaita Ācārya and others, all the devotees assembled in Navadvīpa.
text:
> śivānanda-sena āra ācārya-gosāñi
> navadvīpe saba bhakta hailā eka ṭhāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:navadvīpe]]---at Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all devotees; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---assembled in one place.
translation: Headed by Śivānanda Sena, Advaita Ācārya and others, all the devotees assembled in Navadvīpa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.80
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu peacefully calmed them all and bade each of them farewell.
text:
> tabe prabhu sabākāre prabodha kariyā
> sabāre vidāya dilā susthira hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabākāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabodha]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---pacifying; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---to every one of them; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bade farewell; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being in a peaceful condition.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu peacefully calmed them all and bade each of them farewell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.81
description: The Lord specifically advised Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should not come here again and again. You will have My association in Bengal."
text:
> nityānande kahilā---"tumi nā āsiha bāra-bāra
> tathāi āmāra saṅga ha-ibe tomāra"
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānande]]---unto Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiha]]---do not come; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:t:tathāi]]---there (in Bengal); [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---association; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibe]]---there will be; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your.
translation: The Lord specifically advised Nityānanda Prabhu, "You should not come here again and again. You will have My association in Bengal."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.82
description: The devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began their journey crying, while the Lord remained morosely at His residence.
text:
> cale saba bhakta-gaṇa rodana kariyā
> mahāprabhu rahilā ghare viṣaṇṇa hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cale]]---proceed; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:r:rodana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---crying; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at His place; [[synonyms:v:viṣaṇṇa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very morose.
translation: The devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began their journey crying, while the Lord remained morosely at His residence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.83
description: The Lord bound everyone by His transcendental mercy. Who can repay his debt for the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?
text:
> nija-kṛpā-guṇe prabhu bāndhilā sabāre
> mahāprabhura kṛpā-ṛṇa ke śodhite pāre?
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---by the attribute of mercy; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāndhilā]]---bound; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---everyone; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṇa]]---debt for the mercy; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:ś:śodhite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can repay.
translation: The Lord bound everyone by His transcendental mercy. Who can repay his debt for the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.84
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the fully independent Personality of Godhead and makes everyone dance as He likes. Leaving His company, therefore, all the devotees returned to their homes in different parts of the country.
text:
> yāre yaiche nācāya prabhu svatantra īśvara
> tāte tāṅre chāḍi' loka yāya deśāntara
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāre]]---whomever; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---causes to dance; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]] [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---the fully independent Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---leaving; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---go; [[synonyms:d:deśa]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]]---to different parts of the country.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the fully independent Personality of Godhead and makes everyone dance as He likes. Leaving His company, therefore, all the devotees returned to their homes in different parts of the country.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.85
description: As a wooden doll dances to the will of a puppeteer, everything is accomplished by the will of the Lord. Who can understand the characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead?
text:
> kāṣṭhera putalī yena kuhake nācāya
> īśvara-caritra kichu bujhana nā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāṣṭhera]]---made of wood; [[synonyms:p:putalī]]---doll; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:k:kuhake]]---a magician; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---causes to dance; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---the characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:b:bujhana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---no one can understand.
translation: As a wooden doll dances to the will of a puppeteer, everything is accomplished by the will of the Lord. Who can understand the characteristics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.86
description: The previous year, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, following the Lord's order, had returned to the city of Nadia to see Śacīmātā.
text:
> pūrva-varṣe jagadānanda 'ai' dekhibāre
> prabhu-ājñā lañā āilā nadīyā-nagare
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:varṣe]]---in the previous year; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āi]]---Śacīmātā; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the permission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:n:nadīyā]]-[[synonyms:n:nagare]]---to the city of Nadia.
translation: The previous year, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, following the Lord's order, had returned to the city of Nadia to see Śacīmātā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.87
description: When he arrived, he offered prayers at her lotus feet and then offered her the cloth and prasāda of Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> āira caraṇa yāi' karilā vandana
> jagannāthera vastra-prasāda kailā nivedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āira]]---of Śacīmātā; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---to the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---offered prayers; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:v:vastra]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---cloth and //prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---offered.
translation: When he arrived, he offered prayers at her lotus feet and then offered her the cloth and prasāda of Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.88
description: He offered obeisances to Śacīmātā in the name of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed her of all the Lord's submissive prayers to her.
text:
> prabhura nāme mātāre daṇḍavat kailā
> prabhura vinati-stuti mātāre kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---in the name of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---to His mother; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---he offered obeisances; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vinati]]-[[synonyms:s:stuti]]---very submissive prayers; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---to His mother; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he informed.
translation: He offered obeisances to Śacīmātā in the name of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed her of all the Lord's submissive prayers to her.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.89
description: Jagadānanda's coming pleased mother Śacī very much. As he talked of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she listened day and night.
text:
> jagadānande pāñā mātā ānandita mane
> teṅho prabhura kathā kahe, śune rātri-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---Śacīmātā; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in great satisfaction; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---listens; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night.
translation: Jagadānanda's coming pleased mother Śacī very much. As he talked of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, she listened day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.9
description: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa village also assembled at Navadvīpa.
text:
> kulīna-grāma-vāsī āra yata khaṇḍa-vāsī
> ekatra mililā saba navadvīpe āsi'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kulīna]]-[[synonyms:g:grāma]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---the inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---as well as; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsī]]---the inhabitants of Khaṇḍa; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---at one place; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of them; [[synonyms:n:navadvīpe]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming to Navadvīpa.
translation: The inhabitants of Kulīna-grāma and Khaṇḍa village also assembled at Navadvīpa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.90
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "My dear mother, sometimes the Lord comes here and eats all the food you have offered.
text:
> jagadānanda kahe,---"mātā, kona kona dine
> tomāra ethā āsi' prabhu karena bhojane
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Jagadānanda said; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:e:ethā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming here to your place; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---accepts food.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "My dear mother, sometimes the Lord comes here and eats all the food you have offered.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.91
description: "After eating the food, the Lord says, 'Today, mother has fed Me up to My neck.
text:
> bhojana kariyā kahe ānandita hañā
> mātā āji khāoyāilā ākaṇṭha pūriyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---after eating; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very pleased; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāilā]]---fed; [[synonyms:ā:ākaṇṭha]]---up to the neck; [[synonyms:p:pūriyā]]---filling.
translation: "After eating the food, the Lord says, 'Today, mother has fed Me up to My neck.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.92
description: "I go there and eat the food My mother offers, but she cannot understand that I am eating it directly. She thinks that this is a dream.' "
text:
> āmi yāi' bhojana kari---mātā nāhi jāne
> sākṣāte khāi āmi' teṅho 'svapna' hena māne"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---eat; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---mother; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---cannot understand; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāte]]---directly; [[synonyms:k:khāi]] [[synonyms:ā:āmi']]---I eat; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---she; [[synonyms:s:svapna]]---a dream; [[synonyms:h:hena]]---as; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---thinks.
translation: "I go there and eat the food My mother offers, but she cannot understand that I am eating it directly. She thinks that this is a dream.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.93
description: Śacīmātā said, "I wish Nimāi would eat all the nice vegetables I cook. That is my desire.
text:
> mātā kahe,---"kata rāndhi uttama vyañjana
> nimāñi ihāṅ khāya,---icchā haya mora mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mātā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---mother said; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---how many; [[synonyms:r:rāndhi]]---I cook; [[synonyms:u:uttama]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---first-class vegetables; [[synonyms:n:nimāñi]]---Nimāi; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---may eat; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---my mind.
translation: Śacīmātā said, "I wish Nimāi would eat all the nice vegetables I cook. That is my desire.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.94
description: "Sometimes I think that Nimāi has eaten them, but afterwards I think that I was only dreaming."
text:
> nimāñi khāñāche,---aiche haya mora mana
> pāche jñāna haya,---muñi dekhinu 'svapana' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nimāñi]] [[synonyms:k:khāñāche]]---Nimāi has eaten; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---afterwards; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---I think; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:d:dekhinu]] [[synonyms:s:svapana]]---saw a dream.
translation: "Sometimes I think that Nimāi has eaten them, but afterwards I think that I was only dreaming."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.95
description: In this way, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and mother Śacī talked day and night about the happiness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei-mata jagadānanda śacīmātā-sane
> caitanyera sukha-kathā kahe rātri-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śacīmātā]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with mother Śacī; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---words of happiness; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night.
translation: In this way, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and mother Śacī talked day and night about the happiness of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.96
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita met all the other devotees in Nadia. They were all very happy to have him present.
text:
> nadīyāra bhakta-gaṇe sabāre mililā
> jagadānande pāñā sabe ānandita hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nadīyāra]]---of Nadia, or Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---everyone; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very happy.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita met all the other devotees in Nadia. They were all very happy to have him present.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.97
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thereafter went to meet Advaita Ācārya, who also was very happy to have him.
text:
> ācārya milite tabe gelā jagadānanda
> jagadānande pāñā haila ācārya ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]] [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---very happy.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thereafter went to meet Advaita Ācārya, who also was very happy to have him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.98
description: Vāsudeva Datta and Murāri Gupta were so pleased to see Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that they kept him at their homes and would not allow him to leave.
text:
> vāsudeva, murāri-gupta jagadānande pāñā
> ānande rākhilā ghare, nā dena chāḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]---Vāsudeva; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]-[[synonyms:g:gupta]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dena]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---did not allow to go out.
translation: Vāsudeva Datta and Murāri Gupta were so pleased to see Jagadānanda Paṇḍita that they kept him at their homes and would not allow him to leave.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 12.99
description: They heard confidential narrations about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from the mouth of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and forgot themselves in the great happiness of hearing about the Lord.
text:
> caitanyera marma-kathā śune tāṅra mukhe
> āpanā pāsare sabe caitanya-kathā-sukhe
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:marma]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---confidential talks; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---they hear; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---through his mouth; [[synonyms:ā:āpanā]] [[synonyms:p:pāsare]]---forget themselves; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in the happiness of talks of Lord Caitanya.
translation: They heard confidential narrations about Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu from the mouth of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and forgot themselves in the great happiness of hearing about the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.1
description: Let me take shelter at the lotus feet of Lord Gauracandra. His mind became exhausted and His body very thin from the pain of separation from Kṛṣṇa, but when He felt ecstatic love for the Lord, He again became fully developed.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-viccheda-jātārtyā
> kṣīṇe cāpi manas-tanū
> dadhāte phullatāṁ bhāvair
> yasya taṁ gauram āśraye
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:viccheda]]---by separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:j:jāta]]---produced; [[synonyms:ā:ārtyā]]---by the pain; [[synonyms:k:kṣīṇe]]---thin, exhausted; [[synonyms:c:cā]]---and; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]---mind; [[synonyms:t:tanū]]---and body; [[synonyms:d:dadhāte]]---assumes; [[synonyms:p:phullatām]]---developed state; [[synonyms:b:bhāvaiḥ]]---by ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:y:yasya]]---of whom; [[synonyms:t:tam]]---unto Him; [[synonyms:g:gauram]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āśraye]]---I take shelter.
translation: Let me take shelter at the lotus feet of Lord Gauracandra. His mind became exhausted and His body very thin from the pain of separation from Kṛṣṇa, but when He felt ecstatic love for the Lord, He again became fully developed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.10
description: When it was time for the Lord to go to bed, Svarūpa Dāmodara stayed nearby, but when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the quilt and pillow, He was immediately very angry.
text:
> śayanera kāle svarūpa tāhāṅi rahilā
> tulī-bālisa dekhi' prabhu krodhāviṣṭa ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śayanera]] [[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at bedtime; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅi]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained there; [[synonyms:t:tulī]]---quilt; [[synonyms:b:bālisa]]---pillow; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became very angry.
translation: When it was time for the Lord to go to bed, Svarūpa Dāmodara stayed nearby, but when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw the quilt and pillow, He was immediately very angry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.100
description: Traveling in this way, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa soon arrived at Jagannātha Purī. There, with great delight, he met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell at His lotus feet.
text:
> ei-mate raghunātha āilā nīlācale
> prabhura caraṇe yāñā mililā kutūhale

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.112
description: After eight months, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, the Lord flatly forbade him to marry. "Do not marry," the Lord said.
text:
> aṣṭa-māsa rahi' prabhu bhaṭṭe vidāya dilā
> 'vivāha nā kariha' bali' niṣedha karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for eight months; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---staying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭe]]---to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:v:vidāyadilā]]---bid farewell; [[synonyms:v:vivāha]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do not marry; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:n:niṣedha]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---he forbade.
translation: After eight months, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade farewell to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, the Lord flatly forbade him to marry. "Do not marry," the Lord said.
purport: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya had become a greatly advanced devotee while still unmarried. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could see this, and therefore He advised him not to begin the process of material sense gratification. Marriage is a concession for people who are unable to control their senses. Raghunātha, however, being an advanced devotee of Kṛṣṇa, naturally had no desire for sense gratification. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised him not to enter the bondage of marriage. Generally a person cannot make much advancement in spiritual consciousness if he is married. He becomes attached to his family and is prone to sense gratification. Thus his spiritual advancement is very slow or almost nil.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.113
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, "When you return home, serve your aged father and mother, who are devotees, and try to study Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a pure Vaiṣṇava who has realized God."
text:
> vṛddha mātā-pitāra yāi' karaha sevana
> vaiṣṇava-pāśa bhāgavata kara adhyayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛddha]]---old; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:p:pitāra]]---of the mother and father; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going back; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:sevana]]---engage in service; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---from a pure Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]---//Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:a:adhyayana]]---study.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, "When you return home, serve your aged father and mother, who are devotees, and try to study Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a pure Vaiṣṇava who has realized God."
purport:
One should note how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya to learn //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.// He advised him to understand //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// not from professional men but from a real //bhāgavata,// devotee. He also advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa to serve his mother and father because they were both His devotees. Anyone who wishes to advance in Kṛṣṇa consciousness must try to serve the devotees of Kṛṣṇa. As Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura says, //chāḍiyā vaiṣṇava-sevā nistāra pāyeche kebā:// "Without serving a self-realized Vaiṣṇava, no one has ever been released from the materialistic way of life." Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would have never advised Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa to serve ordinary parents, but since his parents were Vaiṣṇavas, the Lord advised him to serve them.

One might ask "Why shouldn't ordinary parents be served?" As stated in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:5:5:18|(5.5.18)]]:

> gurur na sa syāt sva-jano na sa syāt
> pitā na sa syāj jananī na sā syāt
> daivaṁ na tat syān na patiś ca sa syān
> na mocayed yaḥ samupeta-mṛtyum

"One who cannot deliver his dependent from the path of birth and death should never become a spiritual master, a relative, a father or mother, or a worshipable demigod, nor should such a person become a husband." Everyone naturally gets a father and mother at the time of birth, but the real father and mother are they who can release their offspring from the clutches of imminent death. This is possible only for parents advanced in Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Therefore any parents who cannot enlighten their offspring in Kṛṣṇa consciousness cannot be accepted as a real father and mother. The following verse from the //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (1.2.200) confirms the uselessness of serving ordinary parents:

> laukikī vaidikī vāpi
> yā kriyā kriyate mune
> hari-sevānukūlaiva
> sa kāryā bhaktim icchatā

"One should perform only those activities-either worldly or prescribed by Vedic rules and regulations-which are favorable for the cultivation of Kṛṣṇa consciousness."

Concerning the study of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu clearly advises that one avoid hearing from a non-Vaiṣṇava professional reciter. In this connection Sanātana Gosvāmī quotes a verse from the //Padma Purāṇa://

> avaiṣṇava-mukhodgīrṇaṁ
> pūtaṁ hari-kathāmṛtam
> śravaṇaṁ naiva kartavyaṁ
> sarpocchiṣṭaṁ yathā payaḥ

"No one should hear or take lessons from a person who is not a Vaiṣṇava. Even if he speaks about Kṛṣṇa, such a lesson should not be accepted, for it is like milk touched by the lips of a serpent." Nowadays it is fashionable to observe Bhāgavata-saptāha and hear //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// from persons who are anything but advanced devotees or self-realized souls. There are even many Māyāvādīs who read //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// to throngs of people. Many Māyāvādīs have recently begun reciting //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// in Vṛndāvana, and because they can present the //Bhāgavatam// with word jugglery, twisting the meaning by grammatical tricks, materialistic persons who go to Vṛndāvana as a matter of spiritual fashion like to hear them. All this is clearly forbidden by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. We should note carefully that since these Māyāvādīs cannot personally know the meaning of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// they can never deliver others by reciting it. On the other hand, an advanced devotee of the Lord is free from material bondage. He personifies the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// in life and action. Therefore we advise that anyone who wants to learn the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// must approach such a realized soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.116
description: After taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa returned to Vārāṇasī.
