> svarūpa-ādi bhakta-ṭhāñi ājñā māgiyā
> vārāṇasī āilā bhaṭṭa prabhura ājñā pāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgiyā]]---asking permission; [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned to Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting permission.
translation: After taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa returned to Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.117
description: In accordance with the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he continuously rendered service to his mother and father for four years. He also regularly studied the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava.
text:
> cāri-vatsara ghare pitā-mātāra sevā kailā
> vaiṣṇava-paṇḍita-ṭhāñi bhāgavata paḍilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---for four years; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:p:pitā]]-[[synonyms:m:mātāra]]---of the father and mother; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---rendered service; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from a self-realized, advanced Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]] [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---he studied //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.//
translation: In accordance with the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he continuously rendered service to his mother and father for four years. He also regularly studied the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam from a self-realized Vaiṣṇava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.118
description: Then his parents died at Kāśī [Vārāṇasī], and he became detached. He therefore returned to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, giving up all relationships with his home.
text:
> pitā-mātā kāśī pāile udāsīna hañā
> punaḥ prabhura ṭhāñi āilā gṛhādi chāḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pitā]]-[[synonyms:m:mātā]]---the father and mother; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]] [[synonyms:p:pāile]]---when they passed away at Kāśī (Vārāṇasī); [[synonyms:u:udāsīna]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being indifferent; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:g:gṛha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---leaving all relationships with home.
translation: Then his parents died at Kāśī [Vārāṇasī], and he became detached. He therefore returned to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, giving up all relationships with his home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.119
description: As previously, Raghunātha remained continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for eight months. Then the Lord gave him the following order.
text:
> pūrvavat aṣṭa-māsa prabhu-pāśa chilā
> aṣṭa-māsa rahi' punaḥ prabhu ājñā dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for eight months; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]] [[synonyms:c:chilā]]---remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---after staying for eight months; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---ordered him.
translation: As previously, Raghunātha remained continuously with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for eight months. Then the Lord gave him the following order.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.12
description: After asking Govinda to put aside the quilt and pillow, the Lord lay down on the dry plantain bark.
text:
> govindere kahi' sei tūli dūra kailā
> kalāra śaralā-upara śayana karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govindere]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---by asking Govinda; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:t:tūli]]---that quilt; [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---put aside; [[synonyms:k:kalāra]]---of a plantain tree; [[synonyms:ś:śaralā]]-[[synonyms:u:upara]]---on the dry bark; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---He lay down.
translation: After asking Govinda to put aside the quilt and pillow, the Lord lay down on the dry plantain bark.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.120
description: "My dear Raghunātha, go to Vṛndāvana, following My instructions, and place yourself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.
text:
> "āmāra ājñāya, raghunātha, yāha vṛndāvane
> tāhāṅ yāñā raha rūpa-sanātana-sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---upon My order; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---My dear Raghunātha; [[synonyms:y:yāha]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going there; [[synonyms:r:raha]]---remain; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in the care of Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: "My dear Raghunātha, go to Vṛndāvana, following My instructions, and place yourself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.121
description: "In Vṛndāvana you should chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra twenty-four hours a day and read Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam continuously. Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, will very soon bestow His mercy upon you."
text:
> bhāgavata paḍa, sadā laha kṛṣṇa-nāma
> acire karibena kṛpā kṛṣṇa bhagavān"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]] [[synonyms:p:paḍa]]---read //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:l:laha]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:a:acire]]---very soon; [[synonyms:k:karibena]]---will bestow; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "In Vṛndāvana you should chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra twenty-four hours a day and read Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam continuously. Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, will very soon bestow His mercy upon you."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.122
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, and by the Lord's mercy Raghunātha was enlivened with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kailā
> prabhura kṛpāte kṛṣṇa-preme matta hailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---embraced; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by the mercy; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:matta]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became enlivened.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, and by the Lord's mercy Raghunātha was enlivened with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.123
description: At a festival Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been given some unspiced betel and a garland of tulasī leaves fourteen cubits long. The garland had been worn by Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> caudda-hāta jagannāthera tulasīra mālā
> chuṭā-pāna-viḍā mahotsave pāñāchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caudda]]-[[synonyms:h:hāta]]---fourteen cubits long; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tulasīra]] [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---a garland made of //tulasī// leaves; [[synonyms:c:chuṭā]]-[[synonyms:p:pāna]]-[[synonyms:v:viḍā]]---unspiced betel; [[synonyms:m:mahotsave]]---at a festival; [[synonyms:p:pāñāchilā]]---got.
translation: At a festival Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been given some unspiced betel and a garland of tulasī leaves fourteen cubits long. The garland had been worn by Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.124
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave the garland and betel to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, who accepted them as a worshipable Deity, preserving them very carefully.
text:
> sei mālā, chuṭā pāna prabhu tāṅre dilā
> 'iṣṭa-deva' kari' mālā dhariyā rākhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---that garland; [[synonyms:c:chuṭā]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---the betel; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered to him; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:d:deva]]---his worshipable Deity; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---accepting as; [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---that garland; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave the garland and betel to Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa, who accepted them as a worshipable Deity, preserving them very carefully.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.125
description: Taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa then departed for Vṛndāvana. When he arrived there, he put himself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.
text:
> prabhura ṭhāñi ājñā lañā gelā vṛndāvane
> āśraya karilā āsi' rūpa-sanātane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking permission; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---went to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---took shelter; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---of Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: Taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa then departed for Vṛndāvana. When he arrived there, he put himself under the care of Rūpa and Sanātana Gosvāmīs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.126
description: When reciting Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the company of Rūpa and Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> rūpa-gosāñira sabhāya karena bhāgavata-paṭhana
> bhāgavata paḍite preme āulāya tāṅra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]] [[synonyms:s:sabhāya]]---in the assembly of Rūpa, Sanātana and other Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭhana]]---recitation of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]] [[synonyms:p:paḍite]]---while reciting //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:ā:āulāya]]---becomes overwhelmed; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---his mind.
translation: When reciting Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in the company of Rūpa and Sanātana, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.127
description: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he experienced the symptoms of ecstatic love-tears, trembling, and faltering of the voice. His eyes filled with tears, his throat became choked, and thus he could not recite Śrīmad Bhāgavatam.
text:
> aśru, kampa, gadgada prabhura kṛpāte
> netra kaṇṭha rodhe bāṣpa, nā pāre paḍite
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---trembling; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]---faltering of the voice; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by the mercy; [[synonyms:n:netra]]---eyes; [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]]---neck; [[synonyms:r:rodhe]]---choked up; [[synonyms:b:bāṣpa]]---tears; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:p:paḍite]]---could not recite.
translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he experienced the symptoms of ecstatic love-tears, trembling, and faltering of the voice. His eyes filled with tears, his throat became choked, and thus he could not recite Śrīmad Bhāgavatam.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.128
description: His voice was as sweet as a cuckoo's, and he would recite each verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in three or four tunes. Thus his recitations were very sweet to hear.
text:
> pika-svara-kaṇṭha, tāte rāgera vibhāga
> eka-śloka paḍite phirāya tina-cāri rāga
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pika]]-[[synonyms:s:svara]]-[[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]]---a very sweet voice like a cuckoo's; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---above that; [[synonyms:r:rāgera]]---of tunes; [[synonyms:v:vibhāga]]---division; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---one verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍite]]---reciting; [[synonyms:p:phirāya]]---changes; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:r:rāga]]---three or four different tunes.
translation: His voice was as sweet as a cuckoo's, and he would recite each verse of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam in three or four tunes. Thus his recitations were very sweet to hear.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.129
description: When he recited or heard about the beauty and sweetness of Kṛṣṇa, he would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love and become oblivious to everything.
text:
> kṛṣṇera saundarya-mādhurya yabe paḍe, śune
> premete vihvala tabe, kichui nā jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:saundarya]]---beauty; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:p:premete]]---in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kichui]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know.
translation: When he recited or heard about the beauty and sweetness of Kṛṣṇa, he would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love and become oblivious to everything.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.13
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to the Lord, "I cannot contradict Your supreme will, my Lord, but if You do not accept the bedding, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita will feel great unhappiness."
text:
> svarūpa kahe,---'tomāra icchā, ki kahite pāri?
> śayyā upekṣile paṇḍita duḥkha pābe bhārī'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī said; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---Your will; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---can say; [[synonyms:ś:śayyā]] [[synonyms:u:upekṣile]]---if You do not accept the bedding; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:p:pābe]]---will feel; [[synonyms:b:bhari]]---great.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said to the Lord, "I cannot contradict Your supreme will, my Lord, but if You do not accept the bedding, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita will feel great unhappiness."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.130
description: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa surrendered fully at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda, and those lotus feet became his life and soul.
text:
> govinda-caraṇe kailā ātma-samarpaṇa
> govinda-caraṇāravinda---yāṅra prāṇa-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---he surrendered himself fully; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:aravinda]]---the lotus feet of Lord Govinda; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the life and soul.
translation: Thus Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa surrendered fully at the lotus feet of Lord Govinda, and those lotus feet became his life and soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.131
description: Subsequently Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa ordered his disciples to construct a temple for Govinda. He prepared various ornaments for Govinda, including a flute and earrings shaped like sharks
text:
> nija śiṣye kahi' govindera mandira karāilā
> vaṁśī, makara, kuṇḍalādi 'bhūṣaṇa' kari' dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:ś:śiṣye]]---to his own disciples; [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---by speaking; [[synonyms:g:govindera]]---of Lord Govinda; [[synonyms:m:mandira]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---constructed a temple; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]---flute; [[synonyms:m:makara]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍala]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---earrings shaped like sharks, etc.; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---ornaments; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---preparing; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave.
translation: Subsequently Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa ordered his disciples to construct a temple for Govinda. He prepared various ornaments for Govinda, including a flute and earrings shaped like sharks

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.132
description: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would neither hear nor speak about anything of the material world. He would simply discuss Kṛṣṇa and worship the Lord day and night.
text:
> grāmya-vārtā nā śune, nā kahe jihvāya
> kṛṣṇa-kathā-pūjādite aṣṭa-prahara yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:grāmya]]-[[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---common topics; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---he never heard; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---utters; [[synonyms:j:jihvāya]]---with his tongue; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics on Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:pūjā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādite]]---and in worshiping and so on; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:prahara]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---he passed the whole day and night.
translation: Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would neither hear nor speak about anything of the material world. He would simply discuss Kṛṣṇa and worship the Lord day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.133
description: He would not listen to blasphemy of a Vaiṣṇava, nor would he listen to talk of a Vaiṣṇava's misbehavior. He knew only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; he did not understand anything else.
text:
> vaiṣṇavera nindya-karma nāhi pāḍe kāṇe
> sabe kṛṣṇa bhajana kare,---ei-mātra jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of the Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:n:nindya]]-[[synonyms:k:karma]]---reproachable activities; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāḍe]] [[synonyms:k:kāṇe]]---he does not hear; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:b:bhajana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---are engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only this; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---he understands.
translation: He would not listen to blasphemy of a Vaiṣṇava, nor would he listen to talk of a Vaiṣṇava's misbehavior. He knew only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service; he did not understand anything else.
purport:
Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa never did anything harmful to a Vaiṣṇava. In other words, he was never inattentive in the service of the Lord, nor did he ever violate the rules and regulations of a pure Vaiṣṇava. It is the duty of a Vaiṣṇava //ācārya// to prevent his disciples and followers from violating the principles of Vaiṣṇava behavior. He should always advise them to strictly follow the regulative principles, which will protect them from falling down. Although a Vaiṣṇava preacher may sometimes criticize others, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa avoided this. Even if another Vaiṣṇava was actually at fault, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa would not criticize him; he saw only that everyone was engaged in Kṛṣṇa's service. That is the position of a //mahā-bhāgavata.// Actually, even if one is serving //māyā,// in a higher sense he is also a servant of Kṛṣṇa. Because //māyā// is the servant of Kṛṣṇa, anyone serving //māyā// serves Kṛṣṇa indirectly. Therefore it is said:

> keha māne, keha nā māne, saba tāṅra dāsa
> ye nā māne, tāra haya sei pāpe nāśa

"Some accept Him, whereas others do not, yet everyone is His servant. One who does not accept Him, however, will be ruined by his sinful activities." [[books:cc:adi:6:85|(Cc. Ādi 6.85)]]

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.134
description: When Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī was absorbed in remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he would take the tulasī garland and the prasāda of Lord Jagannātha given to him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, bind them together and wear them on his neck.
text:
> mahāprabhura datta mālā mananera kāle
> prasāda-kaḍāra saha bāndhi lena gale
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:datta]]---given; [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---//tulasī// garland; [[synonyms:m:mananera]]---of remembering; [[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the time; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]-[[synonyms:k:kaḍāra]]---the remnants of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:saha]]---with; [[synonyms:b:bāndhi]]---binding together; [[synonyms:l:lena]]---takes; [[synonyms:g:gale]]---on his neck.
translation: When Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī was absorbed in remembrance of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he would take the tulasī garland and the prasāda of Lord Jagannātha given to him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, bind them together and wear them on his neck.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.135
description: Thus I have described the powerful mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by which Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī remained constantly overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> mahāprabhura kṛpāya kṛṣṇa-prema anargala
> ei ta' kahiluṅ tāte caitanya-kṛpā-phala
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpāya]]---by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]] [[synonyms:a:anargala]]---incessantly overwhelmed with ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---thereby; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---the result of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy.
translation: Thus I have described the powerful mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, by which Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī remained constantly overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.136-137
description: In this chapter I have spoken about three topics: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's listening to the song of the deva-dāsī at the temple of Jagannātha, and how Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī achieved ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagadānandera kahiluṅ vṛndāvana-gamana
> tāra madhye deva-dāsīra gāna-śravaṇa
>
> mahāprabhura raghunāthe kṛpā-prema-phala
> eka-paricchede tina kathā kahiluṅ sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:g:gamana]]---going to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---within that; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsīra]]---of the female singer in the temple of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]-[[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---hearing of the song; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---unto Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---by mercy; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:p:paricchede]]---in one chapter; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---three topics; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: In this chapter I have spoken about three topics: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's listening to the song of the deva-dāsī at the temple of Jagannātha, and how Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī achieved ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.138
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu [Gaurahari] bestows ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa upon anyone who hears all these topics with faith and love.
text:
> ye ei-sakala kathā śune śraddhā kari'
> tāṅre kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana dena gaurahari
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]---one who; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all these; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with faith and love; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of ecstatic love of Lord //Kṛṣṇa//; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---delivers; [[synonyms:g:gaurahari]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu [Gaurahari] bestows ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa upon anyone who hears all these topics with faith and love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.139
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Thirteenth Chapter, describing Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's visit to Vṛndāvana, the Lord's hearing the song of the deva-dāsī, and Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī's achieving love of Kṛṣṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.14
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "You should bring a bedstead here for Me to lie on. Jagadānanda wants Me to enjoy material happiness.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---"khāṭa eka ānaha pāḍite
> jagadānanda cāhe āmāya viṣaya bhuñjāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:khāṭa]]---bedstead; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]]---bring; [[synonyms:p:pāḍite]]---to lie down; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---Me; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:b:bhuñjāite]]---to cause to enjoy material happiness.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "You should bring a bedstead here for Me to lie on. Jagadānanda wants Me to enjoy material happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.15
description: "I am in the renounced order, and therefore I must lie on the floor. For Me to use a bedstead, quilt or pillow would be very shameful."
text:
> sannyāsī mānuṣa āmāra bhūmite śayana
> āmāre khāṭa-tūli-bālisa mastaka-muṇḍana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]] [[synonyms:m:mānuṣa]]---a person in the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:b:bhūmite]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lying on the floor; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---for Me; [[synonyms:k:khāṭa]]---bedstead; [[synonyms:t:tūli]]---quilt; [[synonyms:b:bālisa]]---pillow; [[synonyms:m:mastaka]]-[[synonyms:m:muṇḍana]]---a great shame.
translation: "I am in the renounced order, and therefore I must lie on the floor. For Me to use a bedstead, quilt or pillow would be very shameful."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.16
description: When Svarūpa Dāmodara returned and related all these incidents, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita felt very unhappy.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi āsi' paṇḍite kahilā
> śuni' jagadānanda mane mahā-duḥkha pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---returning; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---felt great unhappiness.
translation: When Svarūpa Dāmodara returned and related all these incidents, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita felt very unhappy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.17
description: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī devised another method. First he secured a large quantity of dry banana leaves.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi tabe sṛjilā prakāra
> kadalīra śuṣka-patra ānilā apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:sṛjilā]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---devised a means; [[synonyms:k:kadalīra]]---of banana; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:p:patra]]---dry leaves; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---in great quantity.
translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī devised another method. First he secured a large quantity of dry banana leaves.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.18
description: He then tore the leaves into very fine fibers with his nails and filled two of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's outer garments with the fibers.
text:
> nakhe ciri' ciri' tāhā ati sūkṣma kailā
> prabhura bahirvāsa duite se saba bharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nakhe]]---with the nails; [[synonyms:c:ciri']] [[synonyms:c:ciri']]---tearing and tearing; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---them; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very; [[synonyms:s:sūkṣma]]---fine; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bahirvāsa]]---covering cloths; [[synonyms:d:duite]]---in two; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all those; [[synonyms:b:bharilā]]---filled.
translation: He then tore the leaves into very fine fibers with his nails and filled two of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's outer garments with the fibers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.19
description: In this way, Svarūpa Dāmodara made some bedding and a pillow, and after much endeavor by the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted them.
text:
> ei-mata dui kailā oḍana-pāḍane
> aṅgīkāra kailā prabhu aneka yatane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two pieces; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:o:oḍana]]-[[synonyms:p:pāḍane]]---one for bedding, one for the pillow; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did accept; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:y:yatane]]---after much endeavor.
translation: In this way, Svarūpa Dāmodara made some bedding and a pillow, and after much endeavor by the devotees, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to the devotees of the Lord!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---unto Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to the devotees of the Lord!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.20
description: Everyone was happy to see the Lord lie down on that bed, but Jagadānanda was inwardly angry, and externally he appeared very unhappy.
text:
> tāte śayana karena prabhu,---dekhi' sabe sukhī
> jagadānanda---bhitare krodha bāhire mahā-duḥkhī
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---on that; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---lies down; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:s:sukhī]]---everyone became happy; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within his mind; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---angry; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]]---very unhappy.
translation: Everyone was happy to see the Lord lie down on that bed, but Jagadānanda was inwardly angry, and externally he appeared very unhappy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.21
description: Formerly, when Jagadānanda Paṇḍita had desired to go to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had not given His permission, and therefore he could not go.
text:
> pūrve jagadānandera icchā vṛndāvana yāite
> prabhu ājñā nā dena tāṅre, nā pāre calite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---did not give; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:c:calite]]---he could not go.
translation: Formerly, when Jagadānanda Paṇḍita had desired to go to Vṛndāvana, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had not given His permission, and therefore he could not go.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.22
description: Now, concealing his anger and unhappiness, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita again asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for permission to go to Mathurā.
text:
> bhitarera krodha-duḥkha prakāśa nā kaila
> mathurā yāite prabhu-sthāne ājñā māgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhitarera]]---internal; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---anger and unhappiness; [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did not disclose; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Mathurā; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgila]]---asked for permission.
translation: Now, concealing his anger and unhappiness, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita again asked Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for permission to go to Mathurā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.23
description: With great affection, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you are angry with Me when you go to Mathurā, you will merely become a beggar and criticize Me."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"mathurā yāibā āmāya krodha kari'
> āmāya doṣa lāgāñā tumi ha-ibā bhikhāri"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:y:yāibā]]---you would go to Mathurā; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---at Me; [[synonyms:k:krodha]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being angry; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---Me; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāñā]]---accusing; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibā]]---will become; [[synonyms:b:bhikhārī]]---a beggar.
translation: With great affection, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you are angry with Me when you go to Mathurā, you will merely become a beggar and criticize Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.24
description: Grasping the Lord's feet, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita then said, "For a long time I have desired to go to Vṛndāvana.
text:
> jagadānanda kahe prabhura dhariyā caraṇa
> "pūrva haite icchā mora yāite vṛndāvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---grasping the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---for a very long time; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to go to Vṛndāvana.
translation: Grasping the Lord's feet, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita then said, "For a long time I have desired to go to Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.25
description: "I could not go without Your Lordship's permission. Now You must give me permission, and I shall certainly go there."
text:
> prabhu-ājñā nāhi, tāte nā pāri yāite
> ebe ājñā deha', avaśya yāimu niścite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the permission of Your Lordship; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---I could not go; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---give; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:y:yāimu]]---I shall go; [[synonyms:n:niścite]]---without fail.
translation: "I could not go without Your Lordship's permission. Now You must give me permission, and I shall certainly go there."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.26
description: Because of affection for Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not permit him to depart, but Jagadānanda Paṇḍita repeatedly insisted that the Lord give him permission to go.
text:
> prabhu prīte tāṅra gamana nā karena aṅgīkāra
> teṅho prabhura ṭhāñi ājñā māge bāra bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prīte]]---out of affection; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---departure; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---does not accept; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---begs; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again.
translation: Because of affection for Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not permit him to depart, but Jagadānanda Paṇḍita repeatedly insisted that the Lord give him permission to go.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.27
description: He then submitted a plea to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. "For a very long time," he said, "I have wanted to go to Vṛndāvana.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñire paṇḍita kailā nivedana
> "pūrva haite vṛndāvana yāite mora mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---made his petition; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---my mind.
translation: He then submitted a plea to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. "For a very long time," he said, "I have wanted to go to Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.28
description: "I cannot go there, however, without the Lord's permission, which at present He denies me. He says, 'You are going because you are angry at Me.'
text:
> prabhu-ājñā vinā tāhāṅ yāite nā pāri
> ebe ājñā nā dena more, 'krodhe yāha' bali
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the permission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am unable; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---does not give; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:k:krodhe]]---in anger; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---you go; [[synonyms:b:bali]]---saying.
translation: "I cannot go there, however, without the Lord's permission, which at present He denies me. He says, 'You are going because you are angry at Me.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.29
description: "Naturally I have a desire to go to Vṛndāvana; therefore please humbly request Him to grant His permission."
text:
> sahajei mora tāhāṅ yāite mana haya
> prabhu-ājñā lañā deha', kariye vinaya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahejei]]---naturally; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---kindly get; [[synonyms:k:kariye]] [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---humbly requesting.
translation: "Naturally I have a desire to go to Vṛndāvana; therefore please humbly request Him to grant His permission."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.3
description: In the company of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would taste various transcendental relationships of pure love.
text:
> hena-mate mahāprabhu jagadānanda-saṅge
> nānā-mate āsvādaya premera taraṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the company of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in various ways; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaya]]---tastes; [[synonyms:p:premera]] [[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---the waves of spiritual loving affairs.
translation: In the company of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would taste various transcendental relationships of pure love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.30
description: Thereafter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted this appeal at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita intensely desires to go to Vṛndāvana.
text:
> tabe svarūpa-gosāñi kahe prabhura caraṇe
> "jagadānandera icchā baḍa yāite vṛndāvane
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---submits; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:i:icchā]] [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---intense desire; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---to go to Vṛndāvana.
translation: Thereafter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted this appeal at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. "Jagadānanda Paṇḍita intensely desires to go to Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.31
description: "He begs for Your permission again and again. Therefore, please permit him to go to Mathurā and then return.
text:
> tomāra ṭhāñi ājñā teṅho māge bāra bāra
> ājñā deha',---mathurā dekhi' āise eka-bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from You; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---permission; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---begs; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---please give permission; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing Mathurā; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes back; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once.
translation: "He begs for Your permission again and again. Therefore, please permit him to go to Mathurā and then return.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.32
description: "You permitted him to go see mother Śacī in Bengal, and You may similarly permit him to go see Vṛndāvana and then return here."
text:
> āire dekhite yaiche gauḍa-deśe yāya
> taiche eka-bāra vṛndāvana dekhi' āya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āire]]---mother Śacī; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---he went; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:ā:āya]]---he can come back.
translation: "You permitted him to go see mother Śacī in Bengal, and You may similarly permit him to go see Vṛndāvana and then return here."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.33
description: At the request of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu granted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita permission to go. The Lord sent for him and instructed him as follows.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñira bole prabhu ājñā dilā
> jagadānande bolāñā tāṅre śikhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bole]]---on the request; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave permission; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bolāñā]]---calling; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---gave instructions.
translation: At the request of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu granted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita permission to go. The Lord sent for him and instructed him as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.34
description: "You may go as far as Vārāṇasī without encountering disturbances, but beyond Vārāṇasī you should be very careful to travel on the path in the company of the kṣatriyas.
text:
> "vārāṇasī paryanta svacchande yāibā pathe
> āge sāvadhāne yāibā kṣatriyādi-sāthe
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]] [[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---up to Vārāṇasī; [[synonyms:s:svacchande]]---without disturbance; [[synonyms:y:yāibā]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---you can go on the path; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---after that; [[synonyms:s:sāvadhāne]]---with great care; [[synonyms:y:yāibā]]---you should go; [[synonyms:k:kṣatriya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:s:sāthe]]---with the //kṣatriyas.//
translation: "You may go as far as Vārāṇasī without encountering disturbances, but beyond Vārāṇasī you should be very careful to travel on the path in the company of the kṣatriyas.
purport: The path from Vārāṇasī to Vṛndāvana was infested with robbers, and therefore in those days there were //kṣatriyas// to protect travelers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.35
description: "As soon as the plunderers on the road see a Bengali traveling alone, they take everything from him, arrest him and do not let him go.
text:
> kevala gauḍiyā pāile 'bāṭapāḍa' kari' bāndhe
> saba luṭi' bāṅdhi' rākhe, yāite virodhe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---alone; [[synonyms:g:gauḍiyā]]---Bengali; [[synonyms:p:pāile]]---if gotten; [[synonyms:b:bāṭapāḍa]]---plundering; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:b:bāndhe]]---they arrest; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:l:luṭi']]---taking; [[synonyms:b:bāṅdhi']]---arresting; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keep; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:v:virodhe]]---do not release.
translation: "As soon as the plunderers on the road see a Bengali traveling alone, they take everything from him, arrest him and do not let him go.
purport: Bengalis are generally not very stout or strong. Therefore when a lone Bengali traverses the roads of Bihar, the plunderers on the road capture him, rob all his belongings and kidnap him for their own service. According to one opinion, the rogues of Bihar know very well that Bengalis are intelligent; therefore these thieves generally force the Bengalis into service requiring intelligence and do not allow them to leave.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.36
description: "When you reach Mathurā, you should remain with Sanātana Gosvāmī and offer respectful obeisances to the feet of all the leading men there.
text:
> mathurā gele sanātana-saṅgei rahibā
> mathurāra svāmī sabera caraṇa vandibā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when you go to Mathurā; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅgei]]---in the association of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:rahibā]]---remain; [[synonyms:m:mathurāra]] [[synonyms:s:svāmī]]---the leading men of Mathurā; [[synonyms:s:sabera]]---of all; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandibā]]---worship the feet.
translation: "When you reach Mathurā, you should remain with Sanātana Gosvāmī and offer respectful obeisances to the feet of all the leading men there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.37
description: "Do not mix freely with the residents of Mathurā; show them respect from a distance. Because you are on a different platform of devotional service, you cannot adopt their behavior and practices.
text:
> dūre rahi' bhakti kariha saṅge nā rahibā
> tāṅ-sabāra ācāra-ceṣṭā la-ite nāribā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---keeping apart; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---show devotion; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in association; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:r:rahibā]]---do not stay; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---their; [[synonyms:ā:ācāra]]---behavior; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---endeavors; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]] [[synonyms:n:nāribā]]---you cannot take up.
translation: "Do not mix freely with the residents of Mathurā; show them respect from a distance. Because you are on a different platform of devotional service, you cannot adopt their behavior and practices.
purport: The residents of Vṛndāvana and Mathurā are devotees of Kṛṣṇa in parental affection, and their feelings always conflict with the opinions of //smārta-brāhmaṇas.// Devotees who worship Kṛṣṇa in opulence cannot understand the parental devotional feelings of the residents of Mathurā and Vṛndāvana, who follow the path of spontaneous love. Devotees on the platform of //vidhi-mārga// (regulative devotional principles) may misunderstand the activities of those on the platform of //rāga-mārga// (devotional service in spontaneous love). Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Jagadānanda Paṇḍita to remain apart from the residents of Vṛndāvana, who were spontaneous devotees, so as not to become disrespectful toward them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.38
description: "Visit all twelve forests of Vṛndāvana in the company of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Do not leave his association for even a moment.
text:
> sanātana-saṅge kariha vana daraśana
> sanātanera saṅga nā chāḍibā eka-kṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do; [[synonyms:v:vana]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visiting the twelve forests; [[synonyms:s:sanātanera]]---of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---association; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍibā]]---do not leave; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---even for a moment.
translation: "Visit all twelve forests of Vṛndāvana in the company of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Do not leave his association for even a moment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.39
description: "You should remain in Vṛndāvana for only a short time and then return here as soon as possible. Also, do not climb Govardhana Hill to see the Gopāla Deity.
text:
> śīghra āsiha, tāhāṅ nā rahiha cira-kāla
> govardhane nā caḍiha dekhite 'gopāla'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---as soon as possible; [[synonyms:ā:āsiha]]---return; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:r:rahiha]]---do not remain; [[synonyms:c:cira]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:g:govardhane]]---on Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:caḍiha]]---do not climb; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---to see the Gopāla Deity.
translation: "You should remain in Vṛndāvana for only a short time and then return here as soon as possible. Also, do not climb Govardhana Hill to see the Gopāla Deity.
purport: In his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya,// Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura advises that one avoid remaining in Vṛndāvana for a very long time. As the saying goes, "Familiarity breeds contempt." If one stays in Vṛndāvana for many days, he may fail to maintain proper respect for its inhabitants. Therefore those who have not attained the stage of spontaneous love for Kṛṣṇa should not live in Vṛndāvana very long. It is better for them to make short visits. One should also avoid climbing Govardhana Hill to see the Gopāla Deity. Since Govardhana Hill itself is identical with Gopāla, one should not step on the hill or touch it with his feet. One may see Gopāla when He goes elsewhere.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.4
description: The unhappiness of separation from Kṛṣṇa exhausted the Lord's mind and reduced the structure of His body, but when He felt emotions of ecstatic love, He again became developed and healthy.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-vicchede duḥkhe kṣīṇa mana-kāya
> bhāvāveśe prabhu kabhu praphullita haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vicchede]]---because of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---in unhappiness; [[synonyms:k:kṣīṇa]]---thin; [[synonyms:m:mana]]-[[synonyms:k:kāya]]---mind and body; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---by ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:praphullita]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes healthy and developed.
translation: The unhappiness of separation from Kṛṣṇa exhausted the Lord's mind and reduced the structure of His body, but when He felt emotions of ecstatic love, He again became developed and healthy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.40
description: "Inform Sanātana Gosvāmī that I am coming to Vṛndāvana for a second time and that he should therefore arrange a place for Me to stay."
text:
> āmiha āsitechi,---kahiha sanātane
> āmāra tare eka-sthāna yena kare vṛndāvane"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmiha]]---I also; [[synonyms:ā:āsitechi]]---am coming; [[synonyms:k:kahiha]] [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---inform Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:t:tare]]---for Me; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---one place; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---so; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---he may make; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana.
translation: "Inform Sanātana Gosvāmī that I am coming to Vṛndāvana for a second time and that he should therefore arrange a place for Me to stay."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.41
description: After saying this, the Lord embraced Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, who then worshiped the Lord's lotus feet and started for Vṛndāvana.
text:
> eta bali' jagadānande kailā āliṅgana
> jagadānanda calilā prabhura vandiyā caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---proceeded; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vandiyā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---after worshiping the feet.
translation: After saying this, the Lord embraced Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, who then worshiped the Lord's lotus feet and started for Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.42
description: He took permission from all the devotees and then departed. Traveling on the forest path, he soon reached Vārāṇasī.
text:
> saba bhakta-gaṇa-ṭhāñi ājñā māgilā
> vana-pathe cali' cali' vārāṇasī āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from all the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgilā]]---asked permission; [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]] [[synonyms:c:cali']] [[synonyms:c:cali']]---traversing the forest path; [[synonyms:v:vārāṇasī]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---he reached Vārāṇasī.
translation: He took permission from all the devotees and then departed. Traveling on the forest path, he soon reached Vārāṇasī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.43
description: When he met Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara in Vārāṇasī, they both heard from him about topics concerning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> tapana-miśra, candraśekhara,---doṅhāre mililā
> tāṅra ṭhāñi prabhura kathā sakala-i śunilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tapana]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:c:candra]]-[[synonyms:ś:śekhara]]---Candraśekhara; [[synonyms:d:doṅhāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---he met both; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from him; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---all; [[synonyms:ś:śunilā]]---they heard.
translation: When he met Tapana Miśra and Candraśekhara in Vārāṇasī, they both heard from him about topics concerning Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.44
description: Finally Jagadānanda Paṇḍita reached Mathurā, where he met Sanātana Gosvāmī. They were very pleased to see each other.
text:
> mathurāte āsi' mililā sanātane
> dui-janera saṅge duṅhe ānandita mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurāte]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---when he reached Mathurā; [[synonyms:m:mililā]] [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---he met Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:janera]]---of both; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in association; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---very pleased within their minds.
translation: Finally Jagadānanda Paṇḍita reached Mathurā, where he met Sanātana Gosvāmī. They were very pleased to see each other.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.45
description: After Sanātana Gosvāmī had taken Jagadānanda to see all twelve forests of Vṛndāvana, concluding with Mahāvana, they both remained in Gokula.
text:
> sanātana karāilā tāṅre dvādaśa vana daraśana
> gokule rahilā duṅhe dekhi' mahāvana

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.61

> rakta-vastra 'vaiṣṇavera' parite nā yuyāya

synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vastra]]---saffron clothing; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---for a Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:p:parite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yuyāya]]---is not fit to put on; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:p:pravāsīre]]---to some outsider; [[synonyms:d:dimu]]---I shall give; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kāya]]---business; [[synonyms:u:uhāya]]---with that.
translation: "This saffron cloth is unfit for a Vaiṣṇava to wear; therefore I have no use for it. I shall give it to a stranger."
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments on this incident as follows: Vaiṣṇavas are all liberated persons, unattached to anything material. Therefore a Vaiṣṇava need not accept the dress of a //sannyāsī// to prove his exalted position. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepted the renounced order from a //sannyāsī// of the //Māyāvāda// school. Present-day Vaiṣṇava //sannyāsīs,// however, never think that by accepting the dress of the //sannyāsa// order they have become equal to Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In fact, a Vaiṣṇava accepts the //sannyāsa// order to remain an eternal servant of his spiritual master. He accepts the //sannyāsa// order knowing that he is unequal to his spiritual master, who is a //paramahaṁsa,// and he thinks that he is unfit to dress like a //paramahaṁsa.// Therefore a Vaiṣṇava accepts //sannyāsa// out of humility, not out of pride.

Sanātana Gosvāmī had adopted the dress of a //paramahaṁsa;// therefore it was inappropriate for him to wear the saffron cloth on his head. However, a Vaiṣṇava //sannyāsī// does not think himself fit to imitate the dress of a //paramahaṁsa// Vaiṣṇava. According to the principles set down by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu //(tṛṇād api sunīcena),// one should always think himself in the lowest stage, not on the level of a //paramahaṁsa// Vaiṣṇava. Thus a Vaiṣṇava will sometimes accept the //sannyāsa// order just to keep himself below the level of a //paramahaṁsa// Vaiṣṇava. This is the instruction of Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura.
