synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:māsa]]---months; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:v:viraha]]---of separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:s:sahane]]---could not tolerate.
translation: They passed two months in Vṛndāvana in this way. Finally they could no longer tolerate the unhappiness of separation from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.65
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita therefore gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the message from the Lord: "I am also coming to Vṛndāvana; please arrange a place for Me to stay."
text:
> mahāprabhura sandeśa kahilā sanātane
> 'āmiha āsitechi, rahite kariha eka-sthāne'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sandeśa]]---message; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---to Sanātana; [[synonyms:ā:āmiha]] [[synonyms:ā:āsitechi]]---I am also coming; [[synonyms:r:rahite]]---for My stay; [[synonyms:k:kariha]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---arrange for one place.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita therefore gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the message from the Lord: "I am also coming to Vṛndāvana; please arrange a place for Me to stay."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.66
description: When Sanātana Gosvāmī granted permission for Jagadānanda to return to Jagannātha Purī, he gave Jagadānanda some gifts for Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagadānanda-paṇḍita tabe ājñā māgilā
> sanātana prabhure kichu bheṭa-vastu dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgilā]]---asked permission; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:b:bheṭa]]-[[synonyms:v:vastu]]---gifts; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---presented.
translation: When Sanātana Gosvāmī granted permission for Jagadānanda to return to Jagannātha Purī, he gave Jagadānanda some gifts for Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.67
description: The gifts consisted of some sand from the site of the rāsa-līlā, a stone from Govardhana Hill, dry ripened pīlu fruits and a garland of small conchshells.
text:
> rāsa-sthalīra vālu āra govardhanera śilā
> śuṣka pakka pīlu-phala āra guñjā-mālā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthalīra]] [[synonyms:v:vālu]]---sand from the place where Lord Kṛṣṇa held His //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:g:govardhanera]] [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]---a stone from Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]---dry; [[synonyms:p:pakka]]---mature; [[synonyms:p:pīlu]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---//pīlu// fruit; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:g:guñjā]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]]---a garland of small conchshells.
translation: The gifts consisted of some sand from the site of the rāsa-līlā, a stone from Govardhana Hill, dry ripened pīlu fruits and a garland of small conchshells.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.68
description: Thus Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, bearing all these gifts, started on his journey. Sanātana Gosvāmī, however, was very agitated after bidding him farewell.
text:
> jagadānanda-paṇḍita calilā saba lañā
> vyākula hailā sanātana tāṅre vidāya diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---proceeded; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:v:vyākula]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very agitated; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---bidding farewell.
translation: Thus Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, bearing all these gifts, started on his journey. Sanātana Gosvāmī, however, was very agitated after bidding him farewell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.69
description: Soon afterward, Sanātana Gosvāmī selected a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could stay while in Vṛndāvana. It was a temple in the highlands named Dvādaśāditya-ṭilā.
text:
> prabhura nimitta eka-sthāna mane vicārila
> dvādaśāditya-ṭilāya eka 'maṭha' pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nimitta]]---for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---one place; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:v:vicārila]]---considered; [[synonyms:d:dvādaśāditya]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭilāya]]---on the highland named Dvādaśāditya; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:maṭha]]---temple; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---got.
translation: Soon afterward, Sanātana Gosvāmī selected a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could stay while in Vṛndāvana. It was a temple in the highlands named Dvādaśāditya-ṭilā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.7
description: He acquired some fine cloth and colored it with red oxide. Then he filled it with cotton from a śimula tree.
text:
> sūkṣma vastra āni' gaurika diyā rāṅgāilā
> śimulīra tulā diyā tāhā pūrāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sūkṣma]] [[synonyms:v:vastra]]---fine cloth; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:g:gaurika]]---red oxide; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with the help of; [[synonyms:r:rāṅgāilā]]---made reddish; [[synonyms:ś:śimulīra]]---of the //śimula// tree; [[synonyms:t:tulā]]---cotton; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pūrāilā]]---filled.
translation: He acquired some fine cloth and colored it with red oxide. Then he filled it with cotton from a śimula tree.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.70
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī kept the temple very clean and in good repair. In front of it he erected a small hut.
text:
> sei sthāna rākhilā gosāñi saṁskāra kariyā
> maṭhera āge rākhilā eka chāuni bāndhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---that place; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept reserved; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:saṁskāra]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---cleansing and repairing; [[synonyms:m:maṭhera]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of the temple; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---kept; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:c:chāuni]]---small hut; [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]]---erecting.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī kept the temple very clean and in good repair. In front of it he erected a small hut.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.71
description: Meanwhile, traveling very quickly, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita soon arrived in Jagannātha Purī, much to the joy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees.
text:
> śīghra cali' nīlācale gelā jagadānanda
> bhakta saha gosāñi hailā parama ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very quickly; [[synonyms:c:cali']]---going; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:s:saha]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---very happy.
translation: Meanwhile, traveling very quickly, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita soon arrived in Jagannātha Purī, much to the joy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.72
description: After offering prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita greeted everyone. Then the Lord embraced Jagadānanda very strongly.
text:
> prabhura caraṇa vandi' sabāre mililā
> mahāprabhu tāṅre dṛḍha āliṅgana kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---lotus feet; [[synonyms:v:vandi']]---offering prayers to; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---he met everyone; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---very strong; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did.
translation: After offering prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita greeted everyone. Then the Lord embraced Jagadānanda very strongly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.73
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita also offered obeisances to the Lord on behalf of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Then he gave the Lord the dust from the site of the rāsa dance and the other gifts.
text:
> sanātanera nāme paṇḍita daṇḍavat kailā
> rāsa-sthalīra dhūli ādi saba bheṭa dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātanera]]---of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---in the name; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---offered obeisances; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthalīra]]---the arena of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and other things; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bheṭa]]---gifts; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---presented.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita also offered obeisances to the Lord on behalf of Sanātana Gosvāmī. Then he gave the Lord the dust from the site of the rāsa dance and the other gifts.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.74
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept all the gifts except the pīlu fruits, which He distributed to the devotees. Because the fruits were from Vṛndāvana, everyone ate them with great happiness.
text:
> saba dravya rākhilena, pīlu dilena bāṅṭiyā
> 'vṛndāvanera phala' bali' khāilā hṛṣṭa hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---gifts; [[synonyms:r:rākhilena]]---kept; [[synonyms:p:pīlu]]---the //pīlu// fruit; [[synonyms:d:dilena]]---gave; [[synonyms:b:bāṅṭiyā]]---distributing; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanera]] [[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruit from Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---because of; [[synonyms:k:khāilā]]---ate; [[synonyms:h:hṛṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---with great happiness.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu kept all the gifts except the pīlu fruits, which He distributed to the devotees. Because the fruits were from Vṛndāvana, everyone ate them with great happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.75
description: Those devotees who were familiar with pīlu fruits sucked on the seeds, but the Bengali devotees who did not know what they were chewed the seeds and swallowed them.
text:
> ye keha jāne, āṅṭi cuṣite lāgila
> ye nā jāne gauḍiyā pīlu cāvāñā khāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]---those who; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---some; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knew; [[synonyms:ā:āṅṭi]]---seeds; [[synonyms:c:cuṣite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---began to lick; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---those who; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---did not know; [[synonyms:g:gauḍiyā]]---Bengali devotees; [[synonyms:p:pīlu]]---the //pīlu// fruit; [[synonyms:c:cāvāñā]]---chewing; [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---ate.
translation: Those devotees who were familiar with pīlu fruits sucked on the seeds, but the Bengali devotees who did not know what they were chewed the seeds and swallowed them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.76
description: The hot chili-like taste burned the tongues of those who chewed the seeds. The eating of pīlu fruits from Vṛndāvana was a pastime for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> mukhe tāra jhāla gela, jihvā kare jvālā
> vṛndāvanera 'pīlu' khāite ei eka līlā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mukhe]] [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---in their mouths; [[synonyms:j:jhāla]]---the taste of chili; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went; [[synonyms:j:jihvā]]---the tongue; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:j:jvālā]]---was burning; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvanera]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:pīlu]]---the //pīlu// fruit; [[synonyms:k:khāite]]---eating; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---a pastime.
translation: The hot chili-like taste burned the tongues of those who chewed the seeds. The eating of pīlu fruits from Vṛndāvana was a pastime for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.77
description: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned from Vṛndāvana, everyone was jubilant. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed His pastimes while residing at Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> jagadānandera āgamane sabāra ullāsa
> ei-mate nīlācale prabhura vilāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āgamane]]---upon the return; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---everyone was jubilant; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastime.
translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned from Vṛndāvana, everyone was jubilant. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enjoyed His pastimes while residing at Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.78
description: One day when the Lord was going to the temple of Yameśvara, a female singer began to sing in the Jagannātha temple.
text:
> eka-dina prabhu yameśvara-ṭoṭā yāite
> sei-kāle deva-dāsī lāgilā gāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yameśvara]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭoṭā]]---to the temple of Yameśvara-ṭoṭā; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---when He was going; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---a female singer of the Jagannātha temple; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began; [[synonyms:g:gāite]]---to sing.
translation: One day when the Lord was going to the temple of Yameśvara, a female singer began to sing in the Jagannātha temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.79
description: She sang a gujjarī tune in a very sweet voice, and because the subject was Jayadeva Gosvāmī's Gīta-govinda, the song attracted the attention of the entire world.
text:
> gujjarī-rāgiṇī lañā sumadhura-svare
> 'gīta-govinda'-pada gāya jaga-mana hare
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gujjarī]]-[[synonyms:r:rāgiṇī]]---the //gujjarī// mode of singing; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by; [[synonyms:s:sumadhura]]-[[synonyms:s:svare]]---in a very sweet voice; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Gīta-govinda, by Jayadeva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pada]]---verses; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings; [[synonyms:j:jaga]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind of the entire world; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attracts.
translation: She sang a gujjarī tune in a very sweet voice, and because the subject was Jayadeva Gosvāmī's Gīta-govinda, the song attracted the attention of the entire world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.8
description: In this way he made a quilt and a pillow, which he then gave to Govinda, saying, "Ask the Lord to lie on this."
text:
> eka tulī-bālisa govindera hāte dilā
> 'prabhure śoyāiha ihāya'---tāhāre kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:t:tulī]]-[[synonyms:b:bālisa]]---quilt and pillow; [[synonyms:g:govindera]]---of Govinda; [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---in the hand; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śoyāiha]]---ask to lie down; [[synonyms:i:ihāya]]---on this; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]]---to him; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said.
translation: In this way he made a quilt and a pillow, which he then gave to Govinda, saying, "Ask the Lord to lie on this."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.80
description: Hearing the song from a distance, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately became ecstatic. He did not know whether it was a man or a woman singing.
text:
> dūre gāna śuni' prabhura ha-ila āveśa
> strī, puruṣa, ke gāya,---nā jāne viśeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---from a distant place; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---song; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---woman; [[synonyms:p:puruṣa]]---man; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---who sings; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---could not understand; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---particularly.
translation: Hearing the song from a distance, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu immediately became ecstatic. He did not know whether it was a man or a woman singing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.81
description: As the Lord ran in ecstasy to meet the singer, thorny hedges pricked His body.
text:
> tāre milibāre prabhu āveśe dhāilā
> pathe 'sijera bāḍi' haya, phuṭiyā calilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---the singer; [[synonyms:m:milibāre]]---to meet; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstasy; [[synonyms:d:dhāilā]]---ran; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path; [[synonyms:s:sijera]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍi]]---thorny hedges; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---were; [[synonyms:p:phuṭiyā]]---pricking; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---He went on.
translation: As the Lord ran in ecstasy to meet the singer, thorny hedges pricked His body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.82
description: Govinda ran very quickly behind the Lord, who did not feel any pain from the pricking of the thorns.
text:
> aṅge kāṅṭā lāgila, kichu nā jānila!
> āste-vyaste govinda tāṅra pāchete dhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body; [[synonyms:k:kāṅṭā]]---thorns; [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---touched; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jānilā]]---did not perceive; [[synonyms:ā:āste]]-[[synonyms:v:vyaste]]---very hastily; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---His personal servant; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---Him; [[synonyms:p:pāchete]]---behind; [[synonyms:d:dhāilā]]---ran.
translation: Govinda ran very quickly behind the Lord, who did not feel any pain from the pricking of the thorns.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.83
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running very rapidly, and the girl was only a short distance away. Just then Govinda caught the Lord in his arms and cried, "It is a woman singing!"
text:
> dhāñā yāyena prabhu, strī āche alpa dūre
> strī gāya' bali' govinda prabhure kailā kole
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---very hastily; [[synonyms:y:yāyena]]---was going; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---the woman; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---was; [[synonyms:a:alpa]] [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---within a short distance; [[synonyms:s:strī]] [[synonyms:g:gāya']]---a woman is singing; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---His personal servant; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:k:kole]]---held in his arms.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was running very rapidly, and the girl was only a short distance away. Just then Govinda caught the Lord in his arms and cried, "It is a woman singing!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.84
description: As soon as He heard the word "woman," the Lord became externally conscious and turned back.
text:
> strī-nāma śuni' prabhura bāhya ha-ilā
> punarapi sei pathe bāhuḍi' calilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:strī]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the word "woman"; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on that path; [[synonyms:b:bāhuḍi']] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---He turned back.
translation: As soon as He heard the word "woman," the Lord became externally conscious and turned back.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.85
description: "My dear Govinda," He said, "you have saved My life. If I had touched the body of a woman, I would certainly have died.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"govinda, āji rākhilā jīvana
> strī-paraśa haile āmāra ha-ita maraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---My dear Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---you saved My life; [[synonyms:s:strī]]-[[synonyms:p:paraśa]] [[synonyms:h:haile]]---if I had touched a woman; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ita]]---there would have been; [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]---death.
translation: "My dear Govinda," He said, "you have saved My life. If I had touched the body of a woman, I would certainly have died.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.86
description: "I shall never be able to repay My debt to you." Govinda replied, "Lord Jagannātha has saved You. I am insignificant."
text:
> e-ṛṇa śodhite āmi nārimu tomāra"
> govinda kahe,---jagannātha rākhena mui kon chāra'?
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṇa]]---this debt; [[synonyms:ś:śodhite]]---to repay; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nārimu]]---shall not be able; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---to you; [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Govinda replied; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:r:rākhena]]---saves; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---the most insignificant person.
translation: "I shall never be able to repay My debt to you." Govinda replied, "Lord Jagannātha has saved You. I am insignificant."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.87
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Govinda, you should stay with Me always. There is danger anywhere and everywhere; therefore you should protect Me very carefully."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"govinda, mora saṅge rahibā
> yāhāṅ tāhāṅ mora rakṣāya sāvadhāna ha-ibā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---My dear Govinda; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]] [[synonyms:r:rahibā]]---you should always remain with Me; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---anywhere and everywhere; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:r:rakṣāya]]---for protection; [[synonyms:s:sāvadhāna]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibā]]---you should be very careful.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Govinda, you should stay with Me always. There is danger anywhere and everywhere; therefore you should protect Me very carefully."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.88
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned home. When Svarūpa Gosvāmī and His other attendants heard about the incident, they were very afraid.
text:
> eta bali' leuṭi' prabhu gelā nija-sthāne
> śuni' mahā-bhaya ha-ila svarūpādi-mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:l:leuṭi']]---returning; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to His own place; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---great fear; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds of Svarūpa Dāmodara and other attendants.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned home. When Svarūpa Gosvāmī and His other attendants heard about the incident, they were very afraid.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.89
description: During this time, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya, the son of Tapana Miśra, gave up all his duties and left home, intending to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ethā tapana-miśra-putra raghunātha-bhaṭṭācārya
> prabhure dekhite calilā chāḍi' sarva kārya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---on the other hand; [[synonyms:t:tapana]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]---the son of Tapana Miśra; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---proceeded; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:s:sarva]] [[synonyms:k:kārya]]---all duties.
translation: During this time, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭācārya, the son of Tapana Miśra, gave up all his duties and left home, intending to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.9
description: Jagadānanda said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "Today please personally persuade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to lie down on the bed."
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñike kahe jagadānanda
> 'āji āpane yāñā prabhure karāiha śayana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñike]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---Your Honor; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karāiha]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---cause to lie down.
translation: Jagadānanda said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "Today please personally persuade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to lie down on the bed."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.90
description: Accompanied by one servant carrying his baggage, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa started from Vārāṇasī and traveled along the path leading through Bengal.
text:
> kāśī haite calilā teṅho gauḍa-patha diyā
> saṅge sevaka cale tāṅra jhāli vahiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśī]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Kāśī; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---proceeded; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:patha]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---by the path through Bengal; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---along with him; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---one servant; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---baggage; [[synonyms:v:vahiyā]]---carrying.
translation: Accompanied by one servant carrying his baggage, Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa started from Vārāṇasī and traveled along the path leading through Bengal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.91
description: In Bengal he met Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa, who belonged to the kāyastha caste. He was one of the king's secretaries.
text:
> pathe tāre mililā viśvāsa-rāmadāsa
> viśvāsa-khānāra kāyastha teṅho rājāra viśvāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmadāsa]]---Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa; [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]]-[[synonyms:k:khānāra]]---of the governmental accounting department; [[synonyms:k:kāyastha]]---belonging to the //kāyastha// class; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---to the king; [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]]---secretary.
translation: In Bengal he met Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa, who belonged to the kāyastha caste. He was one of the king's secretaries.
purport: The word //viśvāsa-khānāra kāyastha// indicates a secretary or clerk belonging to the //kāyastha// caste. //Kāyasthas// were usually secretaries to kings, governors or other important persons. It is said that anyone working in the government secretariat at this time was a //kāyastha.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.92
description: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was very learned in all the revealed scriptures. He was a teacher of the famous book Kāvya-prakāśa and was known as an advanced devotee and worshiper of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra].
text:
> sarva-śāstre pravīṇa, kāvya-prakāśa-adhyāpaka
> parama-vaiṣṇava, raghunātha-upāsaka
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstre]]---in all revealed scriptures; [[synonyms:p:pravīṇa]]---very learned scholar; [[synonyms:k:kāvya]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---of the famous book Kāvya-prakāśa; [[synonyms:a:adhyāpaka]]---a teacher; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---highly advanced devotee; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:u:upāsaka]]---worshiper of Lord Rāmacandra.
translation: Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was very learned in all the revealed scriptures. He was a teacher of the famous book Kāvya-prakāśa and was known as an advanced devotee and worshiper of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra].
purport: Commenting on the word //parama-vaiṣṇava,// Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says that anyone who desires to merge into the existence of the Lord cannot be a pure Vaiṣṇava, but because Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was a great devotee of Lord Rāmacandra, he was almost a Vaiṣṇava. In those days, no one could distinguish between a pure Vaiṣṇava and a pseudo Vaiṣṇava. Therefore Rāmadāsa Viśvāsa was known as a Vaiṣṇava because he worshiped Lord Rāmacandra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.93
description: Rāmadāsa had renounced everything and was going to see Lord Jagannātha. While traveling, he chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma twenty-four hours a day.
text:
> aṣṭa-prahara rāma-nāma japena rātri-dine
> sarva tyaji' calilā jagannātha-daraśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:prahara]]---twenty-four hours a day; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Lord Rāma; [[synonyms:j:japena]]---chants; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tyaji']]---giving up; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Rāmadāsa had renounced everything and was going to see Lord Jagannātha. While traveling, he chanted the holy name of Lord Rāma twenty-four hours a day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.94
description: When he met Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa on the way, he took Raghunātha's baggage on his head and carried it.
text:
> raghunātha-bhaṭṭera sane pathete mililā
> bhaṭṭera jhāli māthe kari' vahiyā calilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with; [[synonyms:p:pathete]]---on the way; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---he met; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]]---baggage; [[synonyms:m:māthe]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking on the head; [[synonyms:v:vahiyā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---carried.
translation: When he met Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa on the way, he took Raghunātha's baggage on his head and carried it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.95
description: Rāmadāsa served Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa in various ways, even massaging his legs. Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa felt some hesitation in accepting all this service.
text:
> nānā sevā kari' kare pāda-samvāhana
> tāte raghunāthera haya saṅkucita mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---serving in various ways; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaged his legs; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---because of this; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:saṅkucita]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---hesitation in the mind.
translation: Rāmadāsa served Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa in various ways, even massaging his legs. Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa felt some hesitation in accepting all this service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.96
description: "You are a respectable gentleman, a learned scholar and a great devotee," he said. "Please do not try to serve me. Just come with me in a happy mood."
text:
> "tumi baḍa loka, paṇḍita, mahā-bhāgavate
> sevā nā kariha, sukhe cala mora sāthe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---a great personality; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---a learned scholar; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgavate]]---a great devotee; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---please do not serve; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---happily; [[synonyms:c:cala]]---go; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sāthe]]---with me.
translation: "You are a respectable gentleman, a learned scholar and a great devotee," he said. "Please do not try to serve me. Just come with me in a happy mood."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.97
description: Rāmadāsa replied, "I am a śūdra, a fallen soul. To serve a brāhmaṇa is my duty and religious principle.
text:
> rāmadāsa kahe,---"āmi śūdra adhama!
> 'brāhmaṇera sevā',---ei mora nija-dharma
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmadāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Rāmadāsa said; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:ś:śūdra]]---a //śūdra//; [[synonyms:a:adhama]]---most fallen; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇera]] [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---to serve a //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---my own religious duty.
translation: Rāmadāsa replied, "I am a śūdra, a fallen soul. To serve a brāhmaṇa is my duty and religious principle.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.98
description: "Therefore please do not be hesitant. I am your servant, and when I serve you my heart becomes jubilant."
text:
> saṅkoca nā kara tumi, āmi---tomāra 'dāsa'
> tomāra sevā karile haya hṛdaye ullāsa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkoca]]---hesitation; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---servant; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:k:karile]]---by rendering; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---jubilation.
translation: "Therefore please do not be hesitant. I am your servant, and when I serve you my heart becomes jubilant."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 13.99
description: Thus Rāmadāsa carried the baggage of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa and served him sincerely. He constantly chanted the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra day and night.
text:
> eta bali' jhāli vahena, karena sevane
> raghunāthera tāraka-mantra japena rātri-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:j:jhāli]] [[synonyms:v:vahena]]---carries the baggage; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:s:sevane]]---serves; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Lord Rāmacandra; [[synonyms:t:tāraka]]---deliverer; [[synonyms:m:mantra]]---chanting of the holy name; [[synonyms:j:japena]]---chants; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night.
translation: Thus Rāmadāsa carried the baggage of Raghunātha Bhaṭṭa and served him sincerely. He constantly chanted the holy name of Lord Rāmacandra day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.1
description: I shall now describe a very small portion of the activities performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mind, intelligence and body when He was bewildered by strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> kṛṣṇa-viccheda-vibhrāntyā
> manasā vapuṣā dhiyā
> yad yad vyadhatta gaurāṅgas
> tal-leśaḥ kathyate 'dhunā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:viccheda]]---of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vibhrāntyā]]---by the bewilderment; [[synonyms:m:manasā]]---by the mind; [[synonyms:v:vapuṣā]]---by the body; [[synonyms:d:dhiyā]]---by the intelligence; [[synonyms:y:yat]] [[synonyms:y:yat]]---whatever; [[synonyms:v:vyadhatta]]---performed; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅgaḥ]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---of that; [[synonyms:l:leśaḥ]]---a very small fragment; [[synonyms:k:kathyate]]---is being described; [[synonyms:a:adhunā]]---now.
translation: I shall now describe a very small portion of the activities performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His mind, intelligence and body when He was bewildered by strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.10
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara wrote short codes, whereas Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī wrote elaborate descriptions. I shall now describe Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities more elaborately, as if fluffing out compressed cotton.
text:
> svarūpa---'sūtra-kartā', raghunātha---'vṛttikāra'
> tāra bāhulya varṇi---pāṅji-ṭīkā-vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sūtra]]-[[synonyms:k:kartā]]---maker of short codes; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:v:vṛttikāra]]---maker of elaborate explanations; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of those; [[synonyms:b:bāhulya]]---more elaborately; [[synonyms:v:varṇi]]---I shall describe; [[synonyms:p:pāṅji]]---fluffing out (as of cotton); [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭīkā]]---explanation; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---behavior.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara wrote short codes, whereas Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī wrote elaborate descriptions. I shall now describe Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities more elaborately, as if fluffing out compressed cotton.
purport: //Pāṅji-ṭīkā// means further explanations of a subject. Writing such explanations is likened to the process of fluffing out cotton.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.100
description: The devotees loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and washed His body with cold water.
text:
> ucca saṅkīrtana kare prabhura śravaṇe
> śītala jale kare prabhura aṅga sammārjane
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ucca]]---loud; [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---within the hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śītala]]---cold; [[synonyms:j:jale]]---with water; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---body; [[synonyms:s:sammārjane]]---washing.
translation: The devotees loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and washed His body with cold water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.101
description: After the devotees had been chanting for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly stood up, shouting, "Hari bol!"
text:
> ei-mata bahu-bāra kīrtana karite
> 'hari-bola' bali' prabhu uṭhe ācambite
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---chanting; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---uttering Hari bol; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---stands up; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly.
translation: After the devotees had been chanting for a long time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly stood up, shouting, "Hari bol!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.102
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, all the Vaiṣṇavas loudly chanted, "Hari! Hari!" in great jubilation. The auspicious sound filled the air in all directions.
text:
> sānande sakala vaiṣṇava bale 'hari' 'hari'
> uṭhila maṅgala-dhvani catur-dik bhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---with great pleasure; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---devotees; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---chanted; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---there arose; [[synonyms:m:maṅgala]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---an auspicious sound; [[synonyms:c:catuḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dik]]---all directions; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, all the Vaiṣṇavas loudly chanted, "Hari! Hari!" in great jubilation. The auspicious sound filled the air in all directions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.103
description: Astonished, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and began looking here and there, trying to see something. But He could not catch sight of it.
text:
> uṭhi' mahāprabhu vismita, iti uti cāya
> ye dekhite cāya, tāhā dekhite nā pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---standing up; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---astonished; [[synonyms:i:iti]] [[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---looks; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---what; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---He wanted to see; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---He could not see.
translation: Astonished, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up and began looking here and there, trying to see something. But He could not catch sight of it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.104
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw all the Vaiṣṇavas, He returned to partial external consciousness and spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> 'vaiṣṇava' dekhiyā prabhura ardha-bāhya ha-ila
> svarūpa-gosāñire kichu kahite lāgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---half-external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---unto Svarūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---began to speak.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw all the Vaiṣṇavas, He returned to partial external consciousness and spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.105
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who has brought Me here from Govardhana Hill? I was seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but now I cannot see them.
text:
> "govardhana haite more ke ihāṅ ānila?
> pāñā kṛṣṇera līlā dekhite nā pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govardhana]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---I could not see.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Who has brought Me here from Govardhana Hill? I was seeing Lord Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but now I cannot see them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.106
description: "Today I went from here to Govardhana Hill to find out if Kṛṣṇa were tending His cows there.
text:
> ihāṅ haite āji mui genu govardhane
> dekhoṅ,---yadi kṛṣṇa karena godhana-cāraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from here; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:g:genu]]---went; [[synonyms:g:govardhane]]---to Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:d:dekhoṅ]]---I was searching; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:g:godhana]]-[[synonyms:c:cāraṇe]]---tending the cows.
translation: "Today I went from here to Govardhana Hill to find out if Kṛṣṇa were tending His cows there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.107
description: "I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa climbing Govardhana Hill and playing His flute, surrounded on all sides by grazing cows.
text:
> govardhane caḍi' kṛṣṇa bājāilā veṇu
> govardhanera caudike care saba dhenu
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govardhane]]---on Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:c:caḍi']]---going up; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bājāilā]] [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---played the flute; [[synonyms:g:govardhanera]]---of Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in four directions; [[synonyms:c:care]]---graze; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dhenu]]---cows.
translation: "I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa climbing Govardhana Hill and playing His flute, surrounded on all sides by grazing cows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.108
description: "Hearing the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all Her gopī friends came there to meet Him. They were all very nicely dressed.
text:
> veṇu-nāda śuni' āilā rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī
> saba sakhī-gaṇa-saṅge kariyā sājani
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāda]]---the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurāṇī]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---accompanied by //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:s:sājani]]---nicely dressed.
translation: "Hearing the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and all Her gopī friends came there to meet Him. They were all very nicely dressed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.109
description: "When Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī entered a cave together, the other gopīs asked Me to pick some flowers.
text:
> rādhā lañā kṛṣṇa praveśilā kandarāte
> sakhī-gaṇa kahe more phula uṭhāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī along; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:praveśilā']]---entered; [[synonyms:k:kandarāte]]---a cave; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:p:phula]]---flowers; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāite]]---to pick up.
translation: "When Kṛṣṇa and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī entered a cave together, the other gopīs asked Me to pick some flowers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.11
description: Please hear faithfully this description of Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic emotions. Thus you will come to know of His ecstatic love, and ultimately you will achieve love of Godhead.
text:
> tāte viśvāsa kari' śuna bhāvera varṇana
> ha-ibe bhāvera jñāna, pāibā prema-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---having faith; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:b:bhāvera]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description of ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibe]]---there will be; [[synonyms:b:bhāvera]]---of ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---knowledge; [[synonyms:p:pāibā]]---you will get; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Please hear faithfully this description of Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic emotions. Thus you will come to know of His ecstatic love, and ultimately you will achieve love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.110
description: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and carried Me from there to this place.
text:
> hena-kāle tumi-saba kolāhala kailā
> tāhāṅ haite dhari' more ihāṅ lañā āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of you; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made a tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from there; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---you have brought.
translation: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and carried Me from there to this place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.111
description: "Why have you brought Me here, causing Me unnecessary pain? I had a chance to see Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but I could not see them."
text:
> kene vā ānilā more vṛthā duḥkha dite
> pāñā kṛṣṇera līlā, nā pāinu dekhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---then; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:v:vṛthā]]---unnecessarily; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to give pain; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāinu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---I could not see.
translation: "Why have you brought Me here, causing Me unnecessary pain? I had a chance to see Kṛṣṇa's pastimes, but I could not see them."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.112
description: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to weep. When all the Vaiṣṇavas saw the Lord's condition, they also wept.
text:
> eta bali' mahāprabhu karena krandana
> tāṅra daśā dekhi' vaiṣṇava karena rodana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---began to cry; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---His state; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---began to cry.
translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began to weep. When all the Vaiṣṇavas saw the Lord's condition, they also wept.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.113
description: At that time, Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī arrived. Seeing them, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became somewhat respectful.
text:
> hena-kāle āilā purī, bhāratī,---dui-jana
> duṅhe dekhi' mahāprabhura ha-ila sambhrama
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:purī]]---Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhāratī]]---Brahmānanda Bhāratī; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing both of them; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:sambhrama]]---respect.
translation: At that time, Paramānanda Purī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī arrived. Seeing them, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became somewhat respectful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.114
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to complete external consciousness and immediately offered prayers to them. Then these two elderly gentlemen both embraced the Lord with loving affection.
text:
> nipaṭṭa-bāhya ha-ile prabhu duṅhāre vandilā
> mahāprabhure dui-jana premāliṅgana kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nipaṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---complete external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ile]]---when there was; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāre]]---to both of them; [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---offered prayers; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---both persons; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---embraced with love and affection.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to complete external consciousness and immediately offered prayers to them. Then these two elderly gentlemen both embraced the Lord with loving affection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.115
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Purī Gosvāmī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, "Why have you both come so far?" Purī Gosvāmī replied, "Just to see Your dancing."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'duṅhe kene āilā eta dūre'?
> purī-gosāñi kahe,---'tomāra nṛtya dekhibāre'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of you; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---have come; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---so far; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Purī Gosāñi said; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---Your dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Purī Gosvāmī and Brahmānanda Bhāratī, "Why have you both come so far?" Purī Gosvāmī replied, "Just to see Your dancing."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.116
description: When He heard this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Then He went to bathe in the sea with all the Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> lajjita ha-ilā prabhu purīra vacane
> samudra-ghāṭa āilā saba vaiṣṇava-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lajjita]]---ashamed; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:purīra]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---by the words of Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]---of the sea; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭa]]---to the bathing place; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with all the Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: When He heard this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Then He went to bathe in the sea with all the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.117
description: After bathing in the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with all the devotees. Then they all lunched on the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> snāna kari' mahāprabhu gharete āilā
> sabā lañā mahā-prasāda bhojana karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after taking a bath; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gharete]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned home; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking everyone with Him; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food from Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---ate.
translation: After bathing in the sea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence with all the devotees. Then they all lunched on the remnants of food offered to Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.118
description: Thus I have described the transcendental ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā cannot describe their influence.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura divyonmāda-bhāva
> brahmāo kahite nāre yāhāra prabhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---transcendental ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:b:brahmāo]]---even Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---cannot speak; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---the influence.
translation: Thus I have described the transcendental ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā cannot describe their influence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.119
description: In his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has very vividly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastime of running toward the Caṭaka-parvata sand dune.
text:
> 'caṭaka'-giri-gamana-līlā raghunātha-dāsa
> 'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe' kariyāchena prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caṭaka]]-[[synonyms:g:giri]]---the sand hill known as Caṭaka-parvata; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---of going to; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastime; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:stava]]-[[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---in the book known as //Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa//; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---has described.
translation: In his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has very vividly described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastime of running toward the Caṭaka-parvata sand dune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.12
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, His condition exactly corresponded to the condition of the gopīs in Vṛndāvana after Kṛṣṇa's departure for Mathurā.
text:
> kṛṣṇa mathurāya gele, gopīra ye daśā haila
> kṛṣṇa-vicchede prabhura se daśā upajila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:m:mathurāya]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when Lord Kṛṣṇa departed for Mathurā; [[synonyms:g:gopīra]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---which condition; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vicchede]]---by separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---that situation; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---happened.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt separation from Kṛṣṇa, His condition exactly corresponded to the condition of the gopīs in Vṛndāvana after Kṛṣṇa's departure for Mathurā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.120
description: "Near Jagannātha Purī was a great sand dune known as Caṭaka-parvata. Seeing that hill, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, 'Oh, I shall go to the land of Vraja to see Govardhana Hill.' Then He began running madly toward it, and all the Vaiṣṇavas ran after Him. This scene awakens in my heart and maddens me."
text:
> samīpe nīlādreś caṭaka-giri-rājasya kalanād
> aye goṣṭhe govardhana-giri-patiṁ lokitum itaḥ
> vrajann asmīty uktvā pramada iva dhāvann avadhṛto
> gaṇaiḥ svair gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati

translation: "Near Jagannātha Purī was a great sand dune known as Caṭaka-parvata. Seeing that hill, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, 'Oh, I shall go to the land of Vraja to see Govardhana Hill.' Then He began running madly toward it, and all the Vaiṣṇavas ran after Him. This scene awakens in my heart and maddens me."
purport: This verse is quoted from the //Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa// (8).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.123
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.

> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa

translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Fourteenth Chapter, describing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental ecstatic emotions and His mistaking Caṭaka-parvata for Govardhana Hill.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.13
description: The lamentation of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī when Uddhava visited Vṛndāvana gradually became a feature of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental madness.
text:
> uddhava-darśane yaiche rādhāra vilāpa
> krame krame haila prabhura se unmāda-vilāpa

translation: The lamentation of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī when Uddhava visited Vṛndāvana gradually became a feature of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental madness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.14
description: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's emotions after seeing Uddhava exactly correspond to those of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He always conceived of Himself in Her position and sometimes thought that He was Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself.
text:
> rādhikāra bhāve prabhura sadā 'abhimāna'
> sei bhāve āpanāke haya 'rādhā'-jñāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhikāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the emotion of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---conception; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---under such a conception; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāke]]---upon Himself; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---consideration as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's emotions after seeing Uddhava exactly correspond to those of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He always conceived of Himself in Her position and sometimes thought that He was Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī Herself.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura explains that the purport of the word //abhimāna,// or "self-conception," is that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thought Himself to be in the position of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and was always ready to render service in that way. Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Kṛṣṇa Himself, He assumed the complexion and emotions of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and remained in that status. He never assumed the complexion or status of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Of course, Kṛṣṇa wanted to experience the role of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; that is the original cause of His assuming the body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore pure Vaiṣṇavas never disturb Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's conception of being Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

Unfortunately, at the present time a group of so-called devotees maintain that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the enjoyer and that they are enjoyers as well. They have actually deviated from devotional service to the Lord. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu manifested Himself to show that cultivation of love for Kṛṣṇa in separation is the easiest way of success for all living entities. Despite this fact, there are some theosophists who declare that because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead, such cultivation is easy for Him but difficult for the living entity and that one can therefore approach Kṛṣṇa in any way he likes. To nullify this idea, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu demonstrated practically how one can achieve love of Kṛṣṇa by adopting Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mood in separation from Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.15
description: Such is the state of transcendental madness. Why is it difficult to understand? When one is highly elevated in love of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes transcendentally mad and talks like a madman.
text:
> divyonmāde aiche haya, ki ihā vismaya?
> adhirūḍha-bhāve divyonmāda-pralāpa haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāde]]---in transcendental madness; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:v:vismaya]]---what is the wonder; [[synonyms:a:adhirūḍha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in highly elevated love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---in transcendental madness; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---talking; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is.
translation: Such is the state of transcendental madness. Why is it difficult to understand? When one is highly elevated in love of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes transcendentally mad and talks like a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.16
description: "When the ecstatic emotion of enchantment gradually progresses, it becomes similar to bewilderment. Then one reaches the stage of astonishment [vaicitrī], which awakens transcendental madness. Udghūrṇā and citra-jalpa are two among the many divisions of transcendental madness."
text:
> etasya mohanākhyasya
> gatiṁ kāmapy upeyuṣaḥ
> bhramābhā kāpi vaicitrī
> divyonmāda itīryate
> udghūrṇā-citra-jalpādyās
> tad-bhedā bahavo matāḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:etasya]]---of this; [[synonyms:m:mohana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākhyasya]]---mood known as //mohana,// or enchanting; [[synonyms:g:gatim]]---progress; [[synonyms:k:kāmapi]]---inexplicable; [[synonyms:u:upeyuṣaḥ]]---having obtained; [[synonyms:b:bhrama]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhā]]---resembling bewilderment; [[synonyms:k:kāpi]]---some; [[synonyms:v:vaicitrī]]---condition bringing about astonishment; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---transcendental madness; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:ī:īryate]]---it is called; [[synonyms:u:udghūrṇā]]---of the name //udghūrṇā//; [[synonyms:c:citra]]-[[synonyms:j:jalpa]]---of the name //citra-jalpa//; [[synonyms:ā:ādyāḥ]]---and so on; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:b:bhedāḥ]]---different features of that; [[synonyms:b:bahavaḥ]]---many; [[synonyms:m:matāḥ]]---described.
translation: "When the ecstatic emotion of enchantment gradually progresses, it becomes similar to bewilderment. Then one reaches the stage of astonishment [vaicitrī], which awakens transcendental madness. Udghūrṇā and citra-jalpa are two among the many divisions of transcendental madness."
purport: This is a quotation from the //Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi// (//Sthāyibhāva-prakaraṇa// 190).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.17

text:
> tribhaṅga-sundara-deha, muralī-vadana

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu saw Lord Kṛṣṇa standing with His beautiful body curved in three places, holding His flute to His lips. Wearing yellow garments and garlands of forest flowers, He was enchanting even to Cupid.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.2

translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead! All glories to Lord Gauracandra, the life and soul of His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.20
description: Seeing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was overwhelmed with the transcendental mellow of the rāsa dance, and He thought, "Now I am with Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana."
text:
> dekhi' prabhu sei rase āviṣṭa hailā
> 'vṛndāvane kṛṣṇa pāinu'---ei jñāna kailā

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.21

text:

> jāgile 'svapna'-jñāna haila, prabhu duḥkhī hailā

translation: When Govinda saw that the Lord had not yet risen, he awakened Him. Understanding that He had only been dreaming, the Lord was somewhat unhappy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.22
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His customary daily duties, and at the usual time He went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple.
text:
> dehābhyāse nitya-kṛtya kari' samāpana
> kāle yāi' kailā jagannātha daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:a:abhyāse]]---as a habit; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛtya]]---the daily duties; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:s:samāpana]]---finishing; [[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the proper time; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His customary daily duties, and at the usual time He went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 14.23

translation: As He viewed Lord Jagannātha from behind the Garuḍa column, hundreds and thousands of people in front of Him were seeing the Deity.

text:
