title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.29
description: "Such a position may befit others, but I do not possess such spiritual power. I belong to a lower class and have not even a pinch of devotion to Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> āmi---nīca-jāti, āmāra nāhi kṛṣṇa-bhakti
> anya aiche haya, āmāya nāhi aiche śakti"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nīca]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---belonging to a lower caste; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotion to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---others; [[synonyms:a:aiche]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---may be such; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---unto me; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:a:aiche]] [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---such power.
translation: "Such a position may befit others, but I do not possess such spiritual power. I belong to a lower class and have not even a pinch of devotion to Kṛṣṇa."
purport:
In his statement, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura presents himself as being born in a low-caste family and not having the qualifications of a bona fide devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He accepts the statements declaring a lowborn person highly exalted if he is a Vaiṣṇava. However, he feels that these descriptions from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// appropriately describe others, but not himself. Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's attitude is quite befitting a real Vaiṣṇava, for a Vaiṣṇava never considers himself exalted, even if he factually is. He is always meek and humble and never thinks that he is an advanced devotee. He assigns himself to a lower position, but that does not mean that he is indeed low. Sanātana Gosvāmī once said that he belonged to a low-caste family, for although he was born in a //brāhmaṇa// family, he had associated with //mlecchas// and //yavanas// in his service as a government minister. Similarly, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura presented himself as someone who belonged to a low caste, but he was actually elevated above many persons born in //brāhmaṇa// families. Not only is there evidence for this in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// as quoted by Kālidāsa in verses 26 and 27; there is also considerable evidence for this conclusion in other śāstras. For example, in the //Mahābhārata, Vana-parva,// Chapter 180, it is stated:

> śūdre tu yad bhavel lakṣma
> dvije tac ca na vidyate
> na vai śūdro bhavec chūdro
> brāhmaṇo na ca brāhmaṇaḥ

"If the characteristics of a //brāhmaṇa// are found in a //śūdra// and not in a //brāhmaṇa,// that //śūdra// should not be known as a //śūdra,// and that //brāhmaṇa// should not be known as a //brāhmaṇa.//"

Similarly, in the //Vana-parva,// Chapter 211, it is said:

> śūdra-yonau hi jātasya
> sad-guṇānupatiṣṭhataḥ
> ārjave vartamānasya
> brāhmaṇyam abhijāyate

"If a person born in a //śūdra// family has developed the qualities of a //brāhmaṇa,// such as //satya// [truthfulness], //śama// [peacefulness], //dama// [self-control] and //ārjava// [simplicity], he attains the exalted position of a //brāhmaṇa.//"

In the //Anuśāsana-parva,// Chapter 163, it is said:

> sthito brāhmaṇa-dharmeṇa
> brāhmaṇyam upajīvati
> kṣatriyo vātha vaiśyo vā
> brahma-bhūyaḥ sa gacchati
>
> ebhis tu karmabhir devi
> śubhair ācaritais tathā
> śūdro brāhmaṇatāṁ yāti
> vaiśyaḥ kṣatriyatāṁ vrajet
>
> na yonir nāpi saṁskāro
> na śrutaṁ na ca santatiḥ
> kāraṇāni dvijatvasya
> vṛttam eva tu kāraṇam

"If one is factually situated in the occupation of a //brāhmaṇa,// he must be considered a //brāhmaṇa,// even if born of a //kṣatriya// or //vaiśya// family.

"O Devī, if even a //śūdra// is actually engaged in the occupation and pure behavior of a //brāhmaṇa,// he becomes a //brāhmaṇa.// Moreover, a //vaiśya// can become a //kṣatriya.//

"Therefore, neither the source of one's birth, nor his reformation, nor his education is the criterion of a //brāhmaṇa.// The //vṛtta,// or occupation, is the real standard by which one is known as a //brāhmaṇa.//"

We have seen that a person who is not the son of a doctor and has not attended a medical college is sometimes able to practice medicine. By practical knowledge of how to perform a surgical operation, how to mix medicine and how to give certain medicines for certain diseases, a person can receive a certificate and be registered as a medical practitioner in the practical field. He can do a medical man's work and be known as a doctor. Although qualified medical men may consider him a quack, the government will recognize his work. Especially in India, there are many such doctors who perform their medical services perfectly. They are accepted even by the government. Similarly, if one is engaged in brahminical service or occupational duties, he must be considered a //brāhmaṇa// despite the family in which he is born. That is the verdict of all the //śāstras.//

In the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:7:11:35|(7.11.35)]], it is said:

> yasya yal lakṣaṇaṁ proktaṁ
> puṁso varṇābhivyañjakam
> yad anyatrāpi dṛśyeta
> tat tenaiva vinirdiśet

This is a statement by Nārada Muni to Mahārāja Yudhiṣṭhira, wherein Nārada says that the symptoms of a //brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya// and //vaiśya// are all described in //śāstra.// Therefore, if one is found exhibiting the symptoms and qualities of a //brāhmaṇa// and serving in a //brahminical// occupation, even if he is not born a //brāhmaṇa// or //kṣatriya,// he should be considered according to his qualifications and occupation.

Similarly, in the //Padma purāṇa// it is said:

> na śūdrā bhagavad-bhaktās
> te tu bhāgavatā matāḥ
> sarva-varṇeṣu te śūdrā
> ye na bhaktā janārdane

"A devotee should never be considered a //śūdra.// All the devotees of the Supreme Personality of Godhead should be recognized as //bhāgavatas.// If one is not a devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa, however, even if born of a //brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya// or //vaiśya// family, he should be considered a //śūdra.//"

In the //Padma Purāṇa// it is also said:

> śva-pākam iva nekṣeta
> loke vipram avaiṣṇavam
> vaiṣṇavo varṇo-bāhyo 'pi
> punāti bhuvana-trayam

"If a person born in a //brāhmaṇa// family is an //avaiṣṇava,// a nondevotee, one should not see his face, exactly as one should not look upon the face of a //caṇḍāla,// or dog-eater. However, a //vaiṣṇava// found in //varṇas// other than //brāhmaṇa// can purify all the three worlds."

The //Padma Purāṇa// further says:

> śūdraṁ vā bhagavad-bhaktaṁ
> niṣādaṁ śva-pacaṁ tathā
> vīkṣate jāti-sāmānyāt
> sa yāti narakaṁ dhruvam

"One who considers a devotee of the Supreme Personality of Godhead who was born in a family of //śūdras, niṣādas// or //caṇḍālas// to belong to that particular caste certainly goes to hell."

A //brāhmaṇa// must be a Vaiṣṇava and a learned scholar. Therefore in India it is customary to address a //brāhmaṇa// as //paṇḍita.// Without knowledge of //Brahman,// one cannot understand the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Therefore a Vaiṣṇava is already a //brāhmaṇa,// whereas a //brāhmaṇa// may become a Vaiṣṇava. In the //Garuḍa Purāṇa// it is said:

> bhaktir aṣṭa-vidhā hy eṣā
> yasmin mlecche 'pi vartate
> sa viprendro muni-śreṣṭhaḥ
> sa jñānī sa ca paṇḍitaḥ

"If even a //mleccha// becomes a devotee, he is to be considered the best of the //brāhmaṇas// and a learned //paṇḍita.//"

Similarly, //Tattva-sāgara// says:

> yathā kāñcanatāṁ yāti
> kāṁsyaṁ rasa-vidhānataḥ
> tathā dīkṣā-vidhānena
> dvijatvaṁ jāyate nṛṇām

"As bell metal is turned to gold when mixed with mercury in an alchemical process, so one who is properly trained and initiated by a bona fide spiritual master becomes a //brāhmaṇa// immediately." All this evidence found in the revealed scriptures proves that according to the Vedic version, a Vaiṣṇava is never to be considered an //abrāhmaṇa,// or //non-brāhmaṇa.// A Vaiṣṇava should not be thought to belong to a lower caste even if born in a //mleccha// or //yavana// family. Because he has become a devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he has become purified and has attained the stage of //brāhmaṇa (dvijatvaṁ jāyate nṛṇām).//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.3
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus stayed at Jagannātha Purī in the association of His devotees, always merged in ecstatic devotional love.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu rahena nīlācale
> bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge sadā prema-vihvale
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahena]]---stays; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---in Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the association of devotees; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vihvale]]---merged in ecstatic love.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus stayed at Jagannātha Purī in the association of His devotees, always merged in ecstatic devotional love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.30
description: Kālidāsa again offered his obeisances to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura and asked his permission to go. The saint Jhaḍu Ṭhākura followed him as he left.
text:
> tāre namaskari' kālidāsa vidāya māgilā
> jhaḍu-ṭhākura tabe tāṅra anuvraji, āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto him (Jhaḍu Ṭhākura); [[synonyms:n:namaskari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:m:māgilā]]---asked permission to go; [[synonyms:j:jhaḍu]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Jhaḍu Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---him; [[synonyms:a:anuvraji']]---following; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---went.
translation: Kālidāsa again offered his obeisances to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura and asked his permission to go. The saint Jhaḍu Ṭhākura followed him as he left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.31
description: After bidding farewell to Kālidāsa, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura returned to his home, leaving the marks of his feet plainly visible in many places.
text:
> tāṅre vidāya diyā ṭhākura yadi ghare āila
> tāṅra caraṇa-cihna yei ṭhāñi paḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him (Kālidāsa); [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---bidding farewell; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Jhaḍu Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---returned to his home; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:cihna]]---the mark of his feet; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---wherever; [[synonyms:p:paḍila]]---fell.
translation: After bidding farewell to Kālidāsa, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura returned to his home, leaving the marks of his feet plainly visible in many places.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.32
description: Kālidāsa smeared the dust from those footprints all over his body. Then he hid in a place near Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's home.
text:
> sei dhūli lañā kālidāsa sarvāṅge lepilā
> tāṅra nikaṭa eka-sthāne lukāñā rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---that dust; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---all over his body; [[synonyms:l:lepilā]]---smeared; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:n:nikaṭa]]---near his place; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in one place; [[synonyms:l:lukāñā]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained hidden.
translation: Kālidāsa smeared the dust from those footprints all over his body. Then he hid in a place near Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.33
description: Upon returning home, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura saw the mangoes Kālidāsa had presented. Within his mind he offered them to Kṛṣṇa-candra.
text:
> jhaḍu-ṭhākura ghara yāi' dekhi' āmra-phala
> mānasei kṛṣṇa-candre arpilā sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhaḍu]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Jhaḍu Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---returning home; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']] [[synonyms:ā:āmra]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---seeing the mangoes; [[synonyms:m:mānasei]]---within his mind; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:candre]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:arpilā]]---offered; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: Upon returning home, Jhaḍu Ṭhākura saw the mangoes Kālidāsa had presented. Within his mind he offered them to Kṛṣṇa-candra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.34
description: Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's wife then took the mangoes from their covering of banana tree leaves and bark and offered them to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura, who began to suck and eat them.
text:
> kalāra pāṭuyā-kholā haite āmra nikāśiyā
> tāṅra patnī tāṅre dena, khāyena cūṣiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kalāra]]---of the banana tree; [[synonyms:p:pāṭuyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kholā]]---leaves and bark; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from within; [[synonyms:ā:āmra]]---mangoes; [[synonyms:n:nikāśiyā]]---taking out; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:patnī]]---his wife; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---gives; [[synonyms:k:khāyena]]---eats; [[synonyms:c:cūṣiyā]]---sucking.
translation: Jhaḍu Ṭhākura's wife then took the mangoes from their covering of banana tree leaves and bark and offered them to Jhaḍu Ṭhākura, who began to suck and eat them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.35
description: When he finished eating, he left the seeds on the banana leaf, and his wife, after feeding her husband, later began to eat.
text:
> cūṣi, cūṣi, coṣā āṅṭhi phelilā pāṭuyāte
> tāre khāoyāñā tāṅra patnī khāya paścāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cūṣi']] [[synonyms:c:cūṣi']]---sucking and sucking; [[synonyms:c:coṣā]]---sucked; [[synonyms:ā:āṅṭhi]]---the seeds; [[synonyms:p:phelilā]]---left; [[synonyms:p:pāṭuyāte]]---on the plantain leaf; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāñā]]---after feeding; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:patnī]]---his wife; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eats; [[synonyms:p:paścāte]]---afterwards.
translation: When he finished eating, he left the seeds on the banana leaf, and his wife, after feeding her husband, later began to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.36
description: After she finished eating, she filled the banana leaves and bark with the seeds, picked them up and threw them in the ditch where all the refuse was thrown.
text:
> āṅṭhi-coṣā sei pāṭuyā-kholāte bhariyā
> bāhire ucchiṣṭa-garte phelāilā lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āṅṭhi]]---the seeds; [[synonyms:c:coṣā]]---that had been sucked; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pāṭuyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kholāte]]---banana leaf and bark; [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---filling; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:u:ucchiṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:garte]]---in the ditch where refuse was thrown; [[synonyms:p:phelāilā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---picked up and threw.
translation: After she finished eating, she filled the banana leaves and bark with the seeds, picked them up and threw them in the ditch where all the refuse was thrown.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.37
description: Kālidāsa licked the banana bark and the mango seeds and skins, and while licking them he was overwhelmed in jubilation by ecstatic love.
text:
> sei kholā, āṅṭhi, cokalā cūṣe kālidāsa
> cūṣite cūṣite haya premete ullāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kholā]]---bark of the banana tree; [[synonyms:ā:āṅṭhi]]---seeds of the mango; [[synonyms:c:cokalā]]---skin of the mango; [[synonyms:c:cūṣe]]---licks up; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:c:cūṣite]] [[synonyms:c:cūṣite]]---while licking up; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was; [[synonyms:p:premete]] [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---great jubilation in ecstatic love.
translation: Kālidāsa licked the banana bark and the mango seeds and skins, and while licking them he was overwhelmed in jubilation by ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.38
description: In this way Kālidāsa ate the remnants of food left by all the Vaiṣṇavas residing in Bengal.
text:
> ei-mata yata vaiṣṇava vaise gauḍa-deśe
> kālidāsa aiche sabāra nilā avaśeṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---reside; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in that way; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:n:nilā]]---took; [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣe]]---the remnants.
translation: In this way Kālidāsa ate the remnants of food left by all the Vaiṣṇavas residing in Bengal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.39
description: When Kālidāsa visited Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed great mercy upon him.
text:
> sei kālidāsa yabe nīlācale āilā
> mahāprabhu tāṅra upara mahā-kṛpā kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---that Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:u:upara]]---upon him; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---great mercy; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---bestowed.
translation: When Kālidāsa visited Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed great mercy upon him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.4
description: The next year, as usual, all the devotees from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī, and, as in previous years, there was a meeting between Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the devotees.
text:
> varṣāntare āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa
> pūrvavat āsi' kaila prabhura milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---the next year; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---meeting with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: The next year, as usual, all the devotees from Bengal went to Jagannātha Purī, and, as in previous years, there was a meeting between Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.40
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been regularly visiting the temple of Jagannātha every day, and at that time Govinda, His personal servant, used to carry His waterpot and go with Him.
text:
> prati-dina prabhu yadi yā'na daraśane
> jala-karaṅga lañā govinda yāya prabhu-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---every day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:y:yā'na]]---goes; [[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:karaṅga]]---a waterpot; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the personal servant of the Lord (Govinda); [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been regularly visiting the temple of Jagannātha every day, and at that time Govinda, His personal servant, used to carry His waterpot and go with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.41
description: On the northern side of the Siṁha-dvāra, behind the door, there are twenty-two steps leading to the temple, and at the bottom of those steps is a ditch.
text:
> siṁha-dvārera uttara-dike kapāṭera āḍe
> bāiśa 'pāhāca'-tale āche eka nimna gāḍe
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārera]]---of the Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:u:uttara]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on the northern side; [[synonyms:k:kapāṭera]] [[synonyms:ā:āḍe]]---behind the door; [[synonyms:b:bāiśa]] [[synonyms:p:'pāhāca']]---of the twenty-two steps; [[synonyms:t:tale]]---at the bottom; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there is; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:n:nimna]]---low; [[synonyms:g:gāḍe]]---ditch.
translation: On the northern side of the Siṁha-dvāra, behind the door, there are twenty-two steps leading to the temple, and at the bottom of those steps is a ditch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.42
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would wash His feet in this ditch, and then He would enter the temple to see Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> sei gāḍe karena prabhu pāda-prakṣālane
> tabe karibāre yāya īśvara-daraśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:g:gāḍe]]---in that ditch; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:prakṣālane]]---washing the feet; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:k:karibāre]]---to do; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---He goes; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to visit Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would wash His feet in this ditch, and then He would enter the temple to see Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.43
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered His personal servant Govinda that no one should take the water that had washed His feet.
text:
> govindere mahāprabhu kairāche niyama
> 'mora pāda-jala yena nā laya kona jana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kairāche]]---has given; [[synonyms:n:niyama]]---a regulative principle; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:j:jala]]---water from washing the feet; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:l:laya]]---does not take; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---anyone.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered His personal servant Govinda that no one should take the water that had washed His feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.44
description: Because of the Lord's strict order, no living being could take the water. Some of His intimate devotees, however, would take it by some trick.
text:
> prāṇi-mātra la-ite nā pāya sei jala
> antaraṅga bhakta laya kari' kona chala
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prāṇi]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---all living beings; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to take; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---do not get; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:j:jala]]---that water; [[synonyms:a:antaraṅga]]---very intimate; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotees; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---take; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:c:chala]]---some trick.
translation: Because of the Lord's strict order, no living being could take the water. Some of His intimate devotees, however, would take it by some trick.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.45
description: One day as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was washing His feet in that place, Kālidāsa came and extended his palm to take the water.
text:
> eka-dina prabhu tāṅhā pāda prakṣālite
> kālidāsa āsi' tāhāṅ pātilena hāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there; [[synonyms:p:pāda]] [[synonyms:p:prakṣālite]]---washing His feet; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:p:pātilena]]---spread; [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---his palm.
translation: One day as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was washing His feet in that place, Kālidāsa came and extended his palm to take the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.46
description: Kālidāsa drank one palmful and then a second and a third. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu forbade him to drink more.
text:
> eka añjali, dui añjali, tina añjali pilā
> tabe mahāprabhu tāṅre niṣedha karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:a:añjali]]---one palmful; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:a:añjali]]---two palmfuls; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:a:añjali]]---three palmfuls; [[synonyms:p:pilā]]---he drank; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:niṣedha]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---forbade.
translation: Kālidāsa drank one palmful and then a second and a third. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu forbade him to drink more.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.47
description: "Do not act in this way any more. I have fulfilled your desire as far as possible."
text:
> "ataḥpara āra nā kariha punar-bāra
> etāvatā vāñchā-pūraṇa kariluṅ tomāra"
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataḥpara]]---hereafter; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---any more; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do not do; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again; [[synonyms:e:etāvatā]]---so far; [[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]-[[synonyms:p:pūraṇa]]---fulfilling the desire; [[synonyms:k:kariluṅ]]---I have done; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---of you.
translation: "Do not act in this way any more. I have fulfilled your desire as far as possible."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.48
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the most exalted, omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, and therefore He knew that Kālidāsa, in the core of his heart, had full faith in Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> sarvajña-śiromaṇi caitanya īśvara
> vaiṣṇave tāṅhāra viśvāsa, jānena antara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jña]]---omniscient; [[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---topmost; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇave]]---unto the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]]---his faith; [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---He knows; [[synonyms:a:antara]]---the heart.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the most exalted, omniscient Supreme Personality of Godhead, and therefore He knew that Kālidāsa, in the core of his heart, had full faith in Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.49
description: Because of this quality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu satisfied him with mercy not attainable by anyone else.
text:
> sei-guṇa lañā prabhu tāṅre tuṣṭa ha-ilā
> anyera durlabha prasāda tāṅhāre karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---that quality; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accepting; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:a:anyera]]---for others; [[synonyms:d:durlabha]]---not attainable; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---mercy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---showed.
translation: Because of this quality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu satisfied him with mercy not attainable by anyone else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.5
description: Along with the devotees from Bengal came a gentleman named Kālidāsa. He never uttered anything but the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> tāṅ-sabāra saṅge āila kālidāsa nāma
> kṛṣṇa-nāma vinā teṅho nāhi kahe āna
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:k:kāli]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---a man named Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---besides; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---say; [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---anything else.
translation: Along with the devotees from Bengal came a gentleman named Kālidāsa. He never uttered anything but the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.50
description: On the southern side, behind and above the twenty-two steps, is a Deity of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. It is on the left as one goes up the steps toward the temple.
text:
> bāiśa 'pāhāca'-pāche upara dakṣiṇa-dike
> eka nṛsiṁha-mūrti āchena uṭhite vāma-bhāge
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāiśa]] [[synonyms:p:pāhāca]]---of the twenty-two steps; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---toward the back; [[synonyms:u:upara]]---above; [[synonyms:d:dakṣiṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on the southern side; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]-[[synonyms:m:mūrti]]---Deity of Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:ā:āchena]]---there is; [[synonyms:u:uṭhite]]---while stepping upward; [[synonyms:v:vāma]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāge]]---on the left side.
translation: On the southern side, behind and above the twenty-two steps, is a Deity of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. It is on the left as one goes up the steps toward the temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.51
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His left side toward the Deity, offered obeisances to Lord Nṛsiṁha as He proceeded toward the temple. He recited the following verses again and again while offering obeisances.
text:
> prati-dina tāṅre prabhu karena namaskāra
> namaskari' ei śloka paḍe bāra-bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---every day; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto the Deity of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---obeisances; [[synonyms:n:namaskari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---these verses; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His left side toward the Deity, offered obeisances to Lord Nṛsiṁha as He proceeded toward the temple. He recited the following verses again and again while offering obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.52
description: "I offer my respectful obeisances unto You, Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. You are the giver of pleasure to Mahārāja Prahlāda, and Your nails cut the chest of Hiraṇyakaśipu like a chisel cutting stone.
text:
> namas te nara-siṁhāya
> prahlādāhlāda-dāyine
> hiraṇyakaśipor vakṣaḥ-
> śilā-ṭaṅka-nakhālaye
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:namaḥ]]---I offer my respectful obeisances; [[synonyms:t:te]]---unto You; [[synonyms:n:nara]]-[[synonyms:s:siṁhāya]]---Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:p:prahlāda]]---to Mahārāja Prahlāda; [[synonyms:ā:āhlāda]]---of pleasure; [[synonyms:d:dāyine]]---giver; [[synonyms:h:hiraṇya]]-[[synonyms:k:kaśipoḥ]]---of Hiraṇyakaśipu; [[synonyms:v:vakṣaḥ]]---chest; [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]---like stone; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭaṅka]]---like the chisel; [[synonyms:n:nakha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālaye]]---whose fingernails.
translation: "I offer my respectful obeisances unto You, Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. You are the giver of pleasure to Mahārāja Prahlāda, and Your nails cut the chest of Hiraṇyakaśipu like a chisel cutting stone.
purport: This and the following verse are quoted from the //Nṛsiṁha Purāṇa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.53
description: "Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva is here, and He is also there on the opposite side. Wherever I go, there I see Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. He is outside and within My heart. Therefore I take shelter of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, the original Supreme Personality of Godhead."
text:
> ito nṛsiṁhaḥ parato nṛsiṁho
> yato yato yāmi tato nṛsiṁhaḥ
> bahir nṛsiṁho hṛdaye nṛsiṁho
> nṛsiṁham ādiṁ śaraṇaṁ prapadye
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:itaḥ]]---here; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhaḥ]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:p:parataḥ]]---on the opposite side; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhaḥ]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:y:yataḥ]] [[synonyms:y:yataḥ]]---wherever; [[synonyms:y:yāmi]]---I go; [[synonyms:t:tataḥ]]---there; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhaḥ]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:b:bahiḥ]]---outside; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhaḥ]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhaḥ]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁham]]---Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:ā:ādim]]---the original Supreme Personality; [[synonyms:ś:śaraṇam]] [[synonyms:p:prapadye]]---I take shelter of.
translation: "Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva is here, and He is also there on the opposite side. Wherever I go, there I see Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva. He is outside and within My heart. Therefore I take shelter of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, the original Supreme Personality of Godhead."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.54
description: Having offered obeisances to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Jagannātha. Then He returned to His residence, finished His noon duties and took His lunch.
text:
> tabe prabhu karilā jagannātha daraśana
> ghare āsi' madhyāhna kari' karila bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---after this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visiting Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---after returning home; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after performing His noon activities; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took lunch.
translation: Having offered obeisances to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu visited the temple of Lord Jagannātha. Then He returned to His residence, finished His noon duties and took His lunch.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.55
description: Kālidāsa was standing outside the door, expecting the remnants of food from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Knowing this, Mahāprabhu gave an indication to Govinda.
text:
> bahir-dvāre āche kālidāsa pratyāśā kariyā
> govindere ṭhāre prabhu kahena jāniyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahiḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---outside the door; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:p:pratyāśā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---expecting; [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---unto Govinda; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāre]]---by indications; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---speaks; [[synonyms:j:jāniyā]]---knowing.
translation: Kālidāsa was standing outside the door, expecting the remnants of food from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Knowing this, Mahāprabhu gave an indication to Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.56
description: Govinda understood all the indications of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore he immediately delivered the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food to Kālidāsa.
text:
> mahāprabhura iṅgita govinda saba jāne
> kālidāsere dila prabhura śeṣa-pātra-dāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:i:iṅgita]]---indications; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---His personal servant; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsere]]---unto Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the remnants of food; [[synonyms:d:dāne]]---presentation.
translation: Govinda understood all the indications of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore he immediately delivered the remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food to Kālidāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.57
description: Taking the remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas is so valuable that it induced Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to offer Kālidāsa His supreme mercy.
text:
> vaiṣṇavera śeṣa-bhakṣaṇera eteka mahimā
> kālidāse pāoyāila prabhura kṛpā-sīmā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇera]]---of eating the remnants of food; [[synonyms:e:eteka]] [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---so much value; [[synonyms:k:kālidāse]]---Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:p:pāoyāila]]---caused to get; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---the supreme mercy.
translation: Taking the remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas is so valuable that it induced Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to offer Kālidāsa His supreme mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.58
description: Therefore, giving up hatred and hesitation, try to eat the remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas, for you will thus be able to achieve your desired goal of life.
text:
> tāte 'vaiṣṇavera jhuṭā' khāo chāḍi' ghṛṇā-lāja
> yāhā haite pāibā nija vāñchita saba kāja
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]] [[synonyms:j:jhuṭā]]---remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:k:khāo]]---eat; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:g:ghṛṇā]]-[[synonyms:l:lāja]]---hate and hesitation; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---by which; [[synonyms:p:pāibā]]---you will get; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---your own; [[synonyms:v:vāñchita]]---desired; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kāja]]---success.
translation: Therefore, giving up hatred and hesitation, try to eat the remnants of the food of Vaiṣṇavas, for you will thus be able to achieve your desired goal of life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.59
description: The remnants of food offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa are called mahā-prasāda. After this same mahā-prasāda has been taken by a devotee, the remnants are elevated to mahā-mahā-prasāda.
text:
> kṛṣṇera ucchiṣṭa haya 'mahā-prasāda' nāma
> 'bhakta-śeṣa' haile 'mahā-mahā-prasādākhyāna'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:u:ucchiṣṭa]]---remnants of the food of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---called //mahā-prasāda//; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---the remnants of a devotee; [[synonyms:h:haile]]---when it becomes; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---great //mahā-prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:ākhyāna]]---named.
translation: The remnants of food offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa are called mahā-prasāda. After this same mahā-prasāda has been taken by a devotee, the remnants are elevated to mahā-mahā-prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.6
description: Kālidāsa was a very advanced devotee, yet he was simple and liberal. He would chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa while performing all his ordinary dealings.
text:
> mahā-bhāgavata teṅho sarala udāra
> kṛṣṇa-nāma-'saṅkete' cālāya vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]---a highly advanced devotee; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:s:sarala]] [[synonyms:u:udāra]]---very simple and liberal; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkete]]---with chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:c:cālāya]]---performs; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---ordinary dealings.
translation: Kālidāsa was a very advanced devotee, yet he was simple and liberal. He would chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa while performing all his ordinary dealings.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.60
description: The dust of the feet of a devotee, the water that has washed the feet of a devotee, and the remnants of food left by a devotee are three very powerful substances.
text:
> bhakta-pada-dhūli āra bhakta-pada-jala
> bhakta-bhukta-avaśeṣa,---tina mahā-bala
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---the dust of the lotus feet of a devotee; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:j:jala]]---the water that washed the feet of a devotee; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:b:bhukta]]-[[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]]---and the remnants of food eaten by a devotee; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bala]]---very powerful.
translation: The dust of the feet of a devotee, the water that has washed the feet of a devotee, and the remnants of food left by a devotee are three very powerful substances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.61
description: By rendering service to these three, one attains the supreme goal of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. In all the revealed scriptures this is loudly declared again and again.
text:
> ei tina-sevā haite kṛṣṇa-premā haya
> punaḥ punaḥ sarva-śāstre phukāriyā kaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---rendering service to these three; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]] [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again and again; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstre]]---all the revealed scriptures; [[synonyms:p:phu]]-[[synonyms:k:kāriyā]] [[synonyms:k:kaya]]---declare loudly.
translation: By rendering service to these three, one attains the supreme goal of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. In all the revealed scriptures this is loudly declared again and again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.62
description: Therefore, my dear devotees, please hear from me, for I insist again and again: please keep faith in these three and render service to them without hesitation.
text:
> tāte bāra bāra kahi,---śuna bhakta-gaṇa
> viśvāsa kariyā kara e-tina sevana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---I say; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:v:viśvāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---keeping faith; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:s:sevana]]---rendering service to these three.
translation: Therefore, my dear devotees, please hear from me, for I insist again and again: please keep faith in these three and render service to them without hesitation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.63
description: From these three one achieves the highest goal of life-ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. This is the greatest mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. The evidence is Kālidāsa himself.
text:
> tina haite kṛṣṇa-nāma-premera ullāsa
> kṛṣṇera prasāda, tāte 'sākṣī' kālidāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from these three; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---of the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:premera]] [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---awakening of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:s:sākṣī]]---evidence; [[synonyms:k:kālidāsa]]---Kālidāsa.
translation: From these three one achieves the highest goal of life-ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. This is the greatest mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. The evidence is Kālidāsa himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.64
description: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, and He invisibly bestowed great mercy upon Kālidāsa.
text:
> nīlācale mahāprabhu rahe ei-mate
> kālidāse mahā-kṛpā kailā alakṣite
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:kālidāse]]---unto Kālidāsa; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---great favor; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---bestowed; [[synonyms:a:alakṣite]]---invisibly.
translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu remained at Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, and He invisibly bestowed great mercy upon Kālidāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.65
description: That year, Śivānanda Sena brought with him his wife and youngest son, Purīdāsa.
text:
> se vatsara śivānanda patnī lañā āilā
> 'purīdāsa'-choṭa-putre saṅgete ānilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---that year; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:patnī]]---the wife; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Purīdāsa; [[synonyms:c:choṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:putre]]---the youngest son; [[synonyms:s:saṅgete]] [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---he brought with him.
translation: That year, Śivānanda Sena brought with him his wife and youngest son, Purīdāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.66
description: Taking his son, Śivānanda Sena went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at His residence. He made his son offer respectful obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> putra saṅge lañā teṅho āilā prabhu-sthāne
> putrere karāilā prabhura caraṇa vandane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:putra]]---the son; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---along; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:putrere]]---his son; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---made to do; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandane]]---worshiping the lotus feet.
translation: Taking his son, Śivānanda Sena went to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at His residence. He made his son offer respectful obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.67
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the boy again and again to chant the name of Kṛṣṇa, but the boy would not utter the holy name.
text:
> 'kṛṣṇa kaha' bali' prabhu balena bāra bāra
> tabu kṛṣṇa-nāma bālaka nā kare uccāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---say Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---said; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]---the boy; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:u:uccāra]]---did not utter.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu asked the boy again and again to chant the name of Kṛṣṇa, but the boy would not utter the holy name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.68
description: Although Śivānanda Sena tried with much endeavor to get his boy to speak Kṛṣṇa's holy name, the boy would not utter it.
text:
> śivānanda bālakere bahu yatna karilā
> tabu sei bālaka kṛṣṇa-nāma nā kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:bālakere]]---unto the boy; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:y:yatna]]---endeavor; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---did; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]---that boy; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---did not utter.
translation: Although Śivānanda Sena tried with much endeavor to get his boy to speak Kṛṣṇa's holy name, the boy would not utter it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.69
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I have induced the whole world to take to the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I have induced even the trees and immovable plants to chant the holy name.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"āmi nāma jagate laoyāiluṅ
> sthāvare paryanta kṛṣṇa-nāma kahāiluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name; [[synonyms:j:jagate]]---throughout the whole world; [[synonyms:l:laoyāiluṅ]]---induced to take; [[synonyms:s:sthāvare]]---the unmovable; [[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---up to; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahāiluṅ]]---I induced to chant.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "I have induced the whole world to take to the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I have induced even the trees and immovable plants to chant the holy name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.7
description: When he used to throw dice in jest, he would throw the dice while chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> kautukete teṅho yadi pāśaka khelāya
> 'hare kṛṣṇa' 'kṛṣṇa' kari' pāśaka cālāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kautukete]]---in jest; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:p:pāśaka]] [[synonyms:k:khelāya]]---plays with dice; [[synonyms:h:hare]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---chanting; [[synonyms:p:pāśaka]] [[synonyms:c:cālāya]]---throws the dice.
translation: When he used to throw dice in jest, he would throw the dice while chanting Hare Kṛṣṇa.
purport: In this connection Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura warns the men of this age not to imitate the jesting of a //mahā-bhāgavata// like Kālidāsa. If someone imitates him by playing with dice or gambling while chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra,// he will certainly become a victim of offenses unto the holy name. As it is said, //hari-nāma-bale pāpe pravṛtti:// one must not commit sinful activities on the strength of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra.// Playing with dice is certainly gambling, but it is clearly said here that Kālidāsa did this only in jest. A //mahā-bhāgavata// can do anything, but he never forgets the basic principles. Therefore it is said, //vaiṣṇavera kriyā-mudrā vijñeha nā bujhaya:// "No one can understand the activities of a pure devotee." We should not imitate Kālidāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.70
description: "But I could not induce this boy to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa." Hearing this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī began to speak.
text:
> ihāre nāriluṅ kṛṣṇa-nāma kahāite!"
> śuniyā svarūpa-gosāñi lāgilā kahite
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāre]]---this boy; [[synonyms:n:nāriluṅ]]---I could not; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahāite]]---cause to speak; [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---to say.
translation: "But I could not induce this boy to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa." Hearing this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī began to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.71
description: "My Lord," he said, "You have given him initiation into the name of Kṛṣṇa, but after receiving the mantra he will not express it in front of everyone.
text:
> "tumi kṛṣṇa-nāma-mantra kailā upadeśe
> mantra pāñā kā'ra āge nā kare prakāśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mantra]]---this hymn; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---have instructed; [[synonyms:m:mantra]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting the hymn; [[synonyms:k:kā'ra]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of everyone; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśe]]---he does not express.
translation: "My Lord," he said, "You have given him initiation into the name of Kṛṣṇa, but after receiving the mantra he will not express it in front of everyone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.72
description: "This boy chants the mantra within his mind, but does not say it aloud. That is his intention, as far as I can guess."
text:
> mane mane jape, mukhe nā kare ākhyāna
> ei ihāra manaḥ-kathā---kari anumāna"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mane]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:j:jape]]---chants; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in the mouth; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:ākhyāna]]---does not express; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---intention; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:a:anumāna]]---I guess.
translation: "This boy chants the mantra within his mind, but does not say it aloud. That is his intention, as far as I can guess."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.73
description: Another day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to the boy, "Recite, My dear Purīdāsa," the boy composed the following verse and expressed it before everyone.
text:
> āra dina kahena prabhu,---'paḍa, purīdāsa'
> ei śloka kari' teṅho karilā prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---another day; [[synonyms:k:kahena]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:p:paḍa]]---recite; [[synonyms:p:purīdāsa]]---Purīdāsa; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---manifested.
translation: Another day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to the boy, "Recite, My dear Purīdāsa," the boy composed the following verse and expressed it before everyone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.74
description: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is just like a bluish lotus flower for the ears; He is ointment for the eyes, a necklace of indranīla gems for the chest, and universal ornaments for the gopī damsels of Vṛndāvana. Let that Lord Śrī Hari, Kṛṣṇa, be glorified."
text:
> śravasoḥ kuvalayam akṣṇor añjanam
> uraso mahendra-maṇi-dāma
> vṛndāvana-ramaṇīnāṁ maṇḍanam
> akhilaṁ harir jayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śravasoḥ]]---of the two ears; [[synonyms:k:kuvalayam]]---blue lotus flowers; [[synonyms:a:akṣṇoḥ]]---of the two eyes; [[synonyms:a:añjanam]]---ointment; [[synonyms:u:urasaḥ]]---of the chest; [[synonyms:m:mahendra]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇi]]-[[synonyms:d:dāma]]---a necklace of //indranīla// gems; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:r:ramaṇīnām]]---of the damsels of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍanam]]---ornaments; [[synonyms:a:akhilam]]---all; [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]] [[synonyms:j:jayati]]---all glories to Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa is just like a bluish lotus flower for the ears; He is ointment for the eyes, a necklace of indranīla gems for the chest, and universal ornaments for the gopī damsels of Vṛndāvana. Let that Lord Śrī Hari, Kṛṣṇa, be glorified."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.75
description: Although the boy was only seven years old and still had no education, he composed such a nice verse. Everyone was struck with wonder.
text:
> sāta vatsarera śiśu, nāhi adhyayana
> aiche śloka kare,---lokera camatkāra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:v:vatsarera]]---seven years old; [[synonyms:ś:śiśu]]---the boy; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:a:adhyayana]]---without education; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---composes; [[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of all the people; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---struck with wonder; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: Although the boy was only seven years old and still had no education, he composed such a nice verse. Everyone was struck with wonder.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.76
description: This is the glory of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy, which even the demigods, headed by Lord Brahmā, cannot estimate.
text:
> caitanya-prabhura ei kṛpāra mahimā
> brahmādi deva yāra nāhi pāya sīmā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāra]] [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glory of the mercy; [[synonyms:b:brahmā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:d:deva]]---the demigods; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---do not reach; [[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---the limit.
translation: This is the glory of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy, which even the demigods, headed by Lord Brahmā, cannot estimate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.77
description: All the devotees remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continuously for four months. Then the Lord ordered them back to Bengal, and therefore they returned.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa prabhu-saṅge rahe cāri-māse
> prabhu ājñā dilā sabe gelā gauḍa-deśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remained; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---for four months; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave the order; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---unto everyone; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---to Bengal.
translation: All the devotees remained with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continuously for four months. Then the Lord ordered them back to Bengal, and therefore they returned.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.78
description: As long as the devotees were in Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu maintained His external consciousness, but after their departure His chief engagement was again the madness of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> tāṅ-sabāra saṅge prabhura chila bāhya-jñāna
> tāṅrā gele punaḥ hailā unmāda pradhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---all of them; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:chila]]---there was; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---external consciousness; [[synonyms:t:tāṅrā]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when they departed; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---there was; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---madness; [[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---the chief business.
translation: As long as the devotees were in Nīlācala, Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu maintained His external consciousness, but after their departure His chief engagement was again the madness of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.79
description: Throughout the entire day and night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu directly relished Kṛṣṇa's beauty, fragrance and mellow as if He were touching Kṛṣṇa hand to hand.
text:
> rātri-dine sphure kṛṣṇera rūpa-gandha-rasa
> sākṣād-anubhave,---yena kṛṣṇa-upasparśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---night and day; [[synonyms:s:sphure]]---appears; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---the beauty; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---fragrance; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---mellow; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]-[[synonyms:a:anubhave]]---directly experienced; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:u:upasparśa]]---touching Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Throughout the entire day and night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu directly relished Kṛṣṇa's beauty, fragrance and mellow as if He were touching Kṛṣṇa hand to hand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.8
description: Kālidāsa was an uncle of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. Throughout his entire life, even in his old age, he tried to eat the remnants of food left by Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> raghunātha-dāsera teṅho haya jñāti-khuḍā
> vaiṣṇavera ucchiṣṭa khāite teṅho haila buḍā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he (Kālidāsa); [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:j:jñāti]]---relative; [[synonyms:k:khuḍā]]---uncle; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:u:ucchiṣṭa]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:k:khāite]]---eating; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:b:buḍā]]---aged.
translation: Kālidāsa was an uncle of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. Throughout his entire life, even in his old age, he tried to eat the remnants of food left by Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.80
description: One day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to visit the temple of Lord Jagannātha, the gatekeeper at Siṁha-dvāra approached Him and offered respectful obeisances.
text:
> eka-dina prabhu gelā jagannātha-daraśane
> siṁha-dvāre dala-i āsi' karila vandane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the gate known as //Siṁha-dvāra//; [[synonyms:d:dala]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---the gatekeeper; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:v:vandane]]---offered respectful obeisances.
translation: One day, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to visit the temple of Lord Jagannātha, the gatekeeper at Siṁha-dvāra approached Him and offered respectful obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.81
description: The Lord asked him, "Where is Kṛṣṇa, My life and soul? Please show Me Kṛṣṇa." Saying this, He caught the doorkeeper's hand.
text:
> tāre bale,---'kothā kṛṣṇa, mora prāṇa-nātha?
> more kṛṣṇa dekhāo' bali' dhare tāra hāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---to him; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---said; [[synonyms:k:kothā]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---where is Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---Lord of life; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to Me; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:d:dekhāo]]---please show Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---catches; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---hand.
translation: The Lord asked him, "Where is Kṛṣṇa, My life and soul? Please show Me Kṛṣṇa." Saying this, He caught the doorkeeper's hand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.82
description: The doorkeeper replied, "The son of Mahārāja Nanda is here; please come along with me, and I shall show You."
text:
> seha kahe,---'iṅhā haya vrajendra-nandana
> āisa tumi mora saṅge, karāṅa daraśana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:seha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]---here; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the son of Nanda Mahārāja; [[synonyms:ā:āisa]]---come; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with me; [[synonyms:k:karāṅa]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---I shall show.
translation: The doorkeeper replied, "The son of Mahārāja Nanda is here; please come along with me, and I shall show You."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.83
description: Lord Caitanya said to the doorman, "You are My friend. Please show Me where the Lord of My heart is." After the Lord said this, they both went to the place known as Jagamohana, where everyone views Lord Jagannātha.
text:
> 'tumi mora sakhā, dekhāha---kāhāṅ prāṇa-nātha?'
> eta bali' jagamohana gelā dhari' tāra hāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---My friend; [[synonyms:d:dekhāha]]---please show; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the Lord of My heart; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:j:jagamohana]]---to Jagamohana; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---hand.
translation: Lord Caitanya said to the doorman, "You are My friend. Please show Me where the Lord of My heart is." After the Lord said this, they both went to the place known as Jagamohana, where everyone views Lord Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.84
description: "Just see!" the doorkeeper said. "Here is the best of the Personalities of Godhead. From here You may see the Lord to the full satisfaction of Your eyes."
text:
> seha bale,---'ei dekha śrī-puruṣottama
> netra bhariyā tumi karaha daraśana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:seha]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---he also said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---just see; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:puruṣa]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa, the best of all Personalities of Godhead; [[synonyms:n:netra]] [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---to the full satisfaction of Your eyes; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---see.
translation: "Just see!" the doorkeeper said. "Here is the best of the Personalities of Godhead. From here You may see the Lord to the full satisfaction of Your eyes."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.85
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed behind the huge column called the Garuḍa-stambha and looked upon Lord Jagannātha, but as He looked He saw that Lord Jagannātha had become Lord Kṛṣṇa, with His flute to His mouth.
text:
> garuḍera pāche rahi' karena daraśana
> dekhena,---jagannātha haya muralī-vadana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:garuḍera]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---behind the Garuḍa column; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---staying; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---He was seeing; [[synonyms:d:dekhena]]---He saw; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---was; [[synonyms:m:muralī]]-[[synonyms:v:vadana]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa with His flute to the mouth.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed behind the huge column called the Garuḍa-stambha and looked upon Lord Jagannātha, but as He looked He saw that Lord Jagannātha had become Lord Kṛṣṇa, with His flute to His mouth.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.86
description: In his book known as Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has described this incident very nicely.
text:
> ei līlā nija-granthe raghunātha-dāsa
> 'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe' kariyāchena prakāśa

translation: In his book known as Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has described this incident very nicely.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.87
description: " 'My dear friend the doorkeeper, where is Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of My heart? Kindly show Him to Me quickly.' With these words, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu addressed the doorkeeper like a madman. The doorkeeper grasped His hand and replied very hastily,'Come, see Your beloved!' May that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rise within my heart and thus make me mad also."
text:
> kva me kāntaḥ kṛṣṇas tvaritam iha taṁ lokaya sakhe
> tvam eveti dvārādhipam abhivadann unmada iva
> drutaṁ gaccha draṣṭuṁ priyam iti tad-uktena dhṛta-tad-
> bhujāntar gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:m:me]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kāntaḥ]]---beloved; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇaḥ]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tvaritam]]---quickly; [[synonyms:i:iha]]---here; [[synonyms:t:tam]]---Him; [[synonyms:l:lokaya]]---show; [[synonyms:s:sakhe]]---O friend; [[synonyms:t:tvam]]---you; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:d:dvāra]]-[[synonyms:a:adhipam]]---the doorkeeper; [[synonyms:a:abhivadan]]---requesting; [[synonyms:u:unmadaḥ]]---a madman; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:d:drutam]]---very quickly; [[synonyms:g:gaccha]]---come; [[synonyms:d:draṣṭum]]---to see; [[synonyms:p:priyam]]---beloved; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---of him; [[synonyms:u:uktena]]---with the words; [[synonyms:d:dhṛta]]---caught; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---His; [[synonyms:b:bhuja]]-[[synonyms:a:antaḥ]]---end of the arm; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅgaḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:u:udayan]]---rising; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---me; [[synonyms:m:madayati]]---maddens.
translation: “ 'My dear friend the doorkeeper, where is Kṛṣṇa, the Lord of My heart? Kindly show Him to Me quickly.' With these words, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu addressed the doorkeeper like a madman. The doorkeeper grasped His hand and replied very hastily,'Come, see Your beloved!' May that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rise within my heart and thus make me mad also."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.88
description: The offering of food known as gopāla-vallabha-bhoga was then given to Lord Jagannātha, and ārati was performed with the sound of the conch and the ringing of bells.
text:
> hena-kāle 'gopāla-vallabha'-bhoga lāgāila
> śaṅkha-ghaṇṭā-ādi saha ārati bājila
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the food offered early in the morning; [[synonyms:l:lāgāila]]---was offered; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkha]]---conch; [[synonyms:g:ghaṇṭā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---bells and so on; [[synonyms:s:saha]]---with; [[synonyms:ā:ārati]]---//ārati//; [[synonyms:b:bājila]]---sounded.
translation: The offering of food known as gopāla-vallabha-bhoga was then given to Lord Jagannātha, and ārati was performed with the sound of the conch and the ringing of bells.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.89
description: When the ārati finished, the prasāda was taken out, and the servants of Lord Jagannātha came to offer some to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> bhoga sarile jagannāthera sevaka-gaṇa
> prasāda lañā prabhu-ṭhāñi kaila āgamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhoga]] [[synonyms:s:sarile]]---when the food was taken away; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the servants; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---came.
translation: When the ārati finished, the prasāda was taken out, and the servants of Lord Jagannātha came to offer some to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.9
description: Kālidāsa ate the remnants of food of as many Vaiṣṇavas as there were in Bengal.
text:
> gauḍa-deśe haya yata vaiṣṇavera gaṇa
> sabāra ucchiṣṭa teṅho karila bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:u:ucchiṣṭa]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---ate.
translation: Kālidāsa ate the remnants of food of as many Vaiṣṇavas as there were in Bengal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.90
description: The servants of Lord Jagannātha first garlanded Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then offered Him Lord Jagannātha's prasāda. The prasāda was so nice that its aroma alone, to say nothing of its taste, would drive the mind mad.
text:
> mālā parāñā prasāda dila prabhura hāte
> āsvāda dūre rahu, yāra gandhe mana māte
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mālā]] [[synonyms:p:parāñā]]---after garlanding; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---in the hand of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsvāda]]---tasting; [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:r:rahu]]---what to speak of; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:g:gandhe]]---by the aroma; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:m:māte]]---becomes maddened.
translation: The servants of Lord Jagannātha first garlanded Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then offered Him Lord Jagannātha's prasāda. The prasāda was so nice that its aroma alone, to say nothing of its taste, would drive the mind mad.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.91
description: The prasāda was made of very valuable ingredients. Therefore the servant wanted to feed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a portion of it.
text:
> bahu-mūlya prasāda sei vastu sarvottama
> tāra alpa khāoyāite sevaka karila yatana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---very valuable; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]---ingredients; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---first class; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---very little; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāite]]---to feed; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---the servant; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---made some endeavor.
translation: The prasāda was made of very valuable ingredients. Therefore the servant wanted to feed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a portion of it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.92
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tasted a portion of the prasāda. Govinda took the rest and bound it in the end of his wrapper.
text:
> tāra alpa lañā prabhu jihvāte yadi dilā
> āra saba govindera āṅcale bāndhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---very little; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jihvāte]]---on the tongue; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---put; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the balance; [[synonyms:g:govindera]]---of Govinda; [[synonyms:ā:āṅcale]]---at the end of the wrapper; [[synonyms:b:bāndhilā]]---bound.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tasted a portion of the prasāda. Govinda took the rest and bound it in the end of his wrapper.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.93
description: To Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the prasāda tasted millions upon millions of times better than nectar, and thus He was fully satisfied. The hair all over His body stood on end, and incessant tears flowed from His eyes.
text:
> koṭi-amṛta-svāda pāñā prabhura camatkāra
> sarvāṅge pulaka, netre vahe aśru-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]---millions upon millions; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar; [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---taste; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---great satisfaction; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---all over the body; [[synonyms:p:pulaka]]---standing of the hair; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---from the eyes; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---flows; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---a stream of tears.
translation: To Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the prasāda tasted millions upon millions of times better than nectar, and thus He was fully satisfied. The hair all over His body stood on end, and incessant tears flowed from His eyes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.94
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu considered, "Where has such a taste in this prasāda come from? Certainly it is due to its having been touched by the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's lips."
text:
> 'ei dravye eta svāda kāhāṅ haite āila?
> kṛṣṇera adharāmṛta ithe sañcārila'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dravye]]---in these ingredients; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---so much; [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---taste; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---has come; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:adhara]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar from the lips; [[synonyms:i:ithe]]---in this; [[synonyms:s:sañcārila]]---has spread.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu considered, "Where has such a taste in this prasāda come from? Certainly it is due to its having been touched by the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's lips."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.95
description: Understanding this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt an emotion of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, but upon seeing the servants of Lord Jagannātha, He restrained Himself.
text:
> ei buddhye mahāprabhura premāveśa haila
> jagannāthera sevaka dekhi' samvaraṇa kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:b:buddhye]]---by this understanding; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servants; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:samvaraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---restrained Himself.
translation: Understanding this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt an emotion of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, but upon seeing the servants of Lord Jagannātha, He restrained Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.96
description: The Lord said again and again, "Only by great fortune may one come by a particle of the remnants of food offered to the Lord." The servants of the Jagannātha temple inquired, "What is the meaning of this?"
text:
> 'sukṛti-labhya phelā-lava'---balena bāra-bāra
> īśvara-sevaka puche,---'ki artha ihāra'?
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sukṛti]]---by great fortune; [[synonyms:l:labhya]]---obtainable; [[synonyms:p:phelā]]-[[synonyms:l:lava]]---a particle of the remnants; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---says; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---the servants of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:puche]]---inquire; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this.
translation: The Lord said again and again, "Only by great fortune may one come by a particle of the remnants of food offered to the Lord." The servants of the Jagannātha temple inquired, "What is the meaning of this?"
purport:
The remnants of Kṛṣṇa's food are mixed with His saliva. In the //Mahābhārata// and the //Skanda Purāṇa// it is stated:

> mahā-prasāde govinde
> nāma-brahmaṇi vaiṣṇave
> svalpa-puṇyavatāṁ rājan
> viśvāso naiva jāyate

"Persons who are not very highly elevated in pious activities cannot believe in the remnants of food [//prasāda//] of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, nor in Govinda, the holy name of the Lord, nor in the Vaiṣṇavas."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.97
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "These are remnants of food that Kṛṣṇa has eaten and thus turned to nectar with His lips. It surpasses heavenly nectar, and even such demigods as Lord Brahmā find it difficult to obtain.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"ei ye dilā kṛṣṇādharāmṛta
> brahmādi-durlabha ei nindaye 'amṛta'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---you have given; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:adhara]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar from the lips; [[synonyms:b:brahmā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---by the demigods, headed by Lord Brahmā; [[synonyms:d:durlabha]]---difficult to obtain; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nindaye]]---defeats; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "These are remnants of food that Kṛṣṇa has eaten and thus turned to nectar with His lips. It surpasses heavenly nectar, and even such demigods as Lord Brahmā find it difficult to obtain.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.98
description: "Remnants left by Kṛṣṇa are called phelā. Anyone who obtains even a small portion must be considered very fortunate.
text:
> kṛṣṇera ye bhukta-śeṣa, tāra 'phelā'-nāma
> tāra eka 'lava' ye pāya, sei bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:b:bhukta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:p:phelā]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name is //phelā//; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:l:lava]]---fragment; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---one who; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---fortunate.
translation: "Remnants left by Kṛṣṇa are called phelā. Anyone who obtains even a small portion must be considered very fortunate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 16.99
description: "One who is only ordinarily fortunate cannot obtain such mercy. Only persons who have the full mercy of Kṛṣṇa can receive such remnants.
text:
> sāmānya bhāgya haite tāra prāpti nāhi haya
> kṛṣṇera yāṅte pūrṇa-kṛpā, sei tāhā pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāmānya]]---ordinary; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]---fortune; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---attainment; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yāṅte]]---unto whom; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---full mercy; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---can get.
translation: "One who is only ordinarily fortunate cannot obtain such mercy. Only persons who have the full mercy of Kṛṣṇa can receive such remnants.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.1
description: I am simply trying to write about Lord Gauracandra's transcendental activities and spiritual madness, which are very wonderful and uncommon. I dare to write of them only because I have heard from the mouths of those who have personally seen the Lord's activities.
text:
> likhyate śrīla-gaurendor
> atyadbhutam alaukikam
> yair dṛṣṭaṁ tan-mukhāc chrutvā
> divyonmāda-viceṣṭitam
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:likhyate]]---they are being written; [[synonyms:ś:śrīla]]---most opulent; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:i:indoḥ]]---moonlike; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very; [[synonyms:a:adbhutam]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:a:alaukikam]]---uncommon; [[synonyms:y:yaiḥ]]---by whom; [[synonyms:d:dṛṣṭam]]---personally seen; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhāt]]---from their mouths; [[synonyms:ś:śrutvā]]---after hearing; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---in transcendental madness; [[synonyms:v:viceṣṭitam]]---activities.
translation: I am simply trying to write about Lord Gauracandra's transcendental activities and spiritual madness, which are very wonderful and uncommon. I dare to write of them only because I have heard from the mouths of those who have personally seen the Lord's activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.10
description: Suddenly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute. Then, in ecstasy, He began to depart to see Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ācambite śunena prabhu kṛṣṇa-veṇu-gāna
> bhāvāveśe prabhu tāhāṅ karilā prayāṇa
