synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly; [[synonyms:ś:śunena]]---hears; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---of Kṛṣṇa's flute; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---the vibration; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:prayāṇa]]---departed.
translation: Suddenly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute. Then, in ecstasy, He began to depart to see Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.11
description: All three doors were fastened as usual, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in great ecstasy, nevertheless got out of the room and left the house.
text:
> tina-dvāre kapāṭa aiche āche ta' lāgiyā
> bhāvāveśe prabhu gelā bāhira hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---in three doorways; [[synonyms:k:kapāṭa]]---the doors; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---as previously; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---are; [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---being closed; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:b:bāhira]]---out; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being.
translation: All three doors were fastened as usual, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in great ecstasy, nevertheless got out of the room and left the house.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.12
description: He went to a cow shed on the southern side of the Siṁha-dvāra. There the Lord fell down unconscious among cows from the district of Tailaṅga.
text:
> siṁha-dvāra-dakṣiṇe āche tailaṅgī-gābhī-gaṇa
> tāhāṅ yāi' paḍilā prabhu hañā acetana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---of the gate named Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:d:dakṣiṇe]]---on the southern side; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there are; [[synonyms:t:tailaṅgī]]-[[synonyms:g:gābhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---cows belonging to the Tailaṅga district; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:a:acetana]]---becoming unconscious.
translation: He went to a cow shed on the southern side of the Siṁha-dvāra. There the Lord fell down unconscious among cows from the district of Tailaṅga.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.13
description: Meanwhile, not hearing any sounds from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda immediately sent for Svarūpa Dāmodara and opened the doors.
text:
> ethā govinda mahāprabhura śabda nā pāñā
> svarūpere bolāila kapāṭa khuliyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---sound; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting; [[synonyms:s:svarūpere]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bolāila]]---called for; [[synonyms:k:kapāṭa]]---the doors; [[synonyms:k:khuliyā]]---opening.
translation: Meanwhile, not hearing any sounds from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Govinda immediately sent for Svarūpa Dāmodara and opened the doors.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.14
description: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī lit a torch, and went out with all the devotees to search for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> tabe svarūpa-gosāñi saṅge lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> deuṭi jvāliyā karena prabhura anveṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with him; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:d:deuṭi]]---lamp; [[synonyms:j:jvāliyā]]---burning; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:anveṣaṇa]]---searching.
translation: Then Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī lit a torch, and went out with all the devotees to search for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.15
description: After searching here and there, they finally came to the cow shed near the Siṁha-dvāra. There they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lying unconscious among the cows.
text:
> iti-uti anveṣiyā siṁha-dvāre gelā
> gābhī-gaṇa-madhye yāi' prabhure pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:a:anveṣiyā]]---searching; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---to the gate named Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:g:gābhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:madhye]]---among the cows; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---found Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After searching here and there, they finally came to the cow shed near the Siṁha-dvāra. There they saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lying unconscious among the cows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.16
description: His arms and legs had entered the trunk of His body, exactly like those of a tortoise. His mouth was foaming, there were eruptions on His body, and tears flowed from His eyes.
text:
> peṭera bhitara hasta-pada---kūrmera ākāra
> mukhe phena, pulakāṅga, netre aśru-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:peṭera]]---the abdomen; [[synonyms:b:bhitara]]---within; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]---the arms and legs; [[synonyms:k:kūrmera]] [[synonyms:ā:ākāra]]---just like a tortoise; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in the mouth; [[synonyms:p:phena]]---foam; [[synonyms:p:pulaka]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---eruptions on the body; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---in the eyes; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---a flow of tears.
translation: His arms and legs had entered the trunk of His body, exactly like those of a tortoise. His mouth was foaming, there were eruptions on His body, and tears flowed from His eyes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.17
description: As the Lord lay there unconscious, His body resembled a large pumpkin. Externally He was completely inert, but within He felt overwhelming transcendental bliss.
text:
> acetana paḍiyāchena,---yena kuṣmāṇḍa-phala
> bāhire jaḍimā, antare ānanda-vihvala
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:acetana]]---unconscious; [[synonyms:p:paḍiyāchena]]---was lying down; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:k:kuṣmāṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---a pumpkin; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:j:jaḍimā]]---complete inertia; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed with transcendental bliss.
translation: As the Lord lay there unconscious, His body resembled a large pumpkin. Externally He was completely inert, but within He felt overwhelming transcendental bliss.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.18
description: All the cows around the Lord were sniffing His transcendental body. When the devotees tried to check them, they refused to give up their association with the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> gābhī saba caudike śuṅke prabhura śrī-aṅga
> dūra kaile nāhi chāḍe prabhura śrī-aṅga-saṅga
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gābhī]]---cows; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---around; [[synonyms:ś:śuṅke]]---sniff; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---the transcendental body; [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:k:kaile]]---if they are taken away; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]]---they do not give up; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---association with the transcendental body.
translation: All the cows around the Lord were sniffing His transcendental body. When the devotees tried to check them, they refused to give up their association with the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.19
description: The devotees tried to rouse the Lord by various means, but His consciousness did not return. Therefore they all lifted Him and brought Him back home.
text:
> aneka karilā yatna, nā haya cetana
> prabhure uṭhāñā ghare ānilā bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aneka]]---many; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---made; [[synonyms:y:yatna]]---endeavors; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was not; [[synonyms:c:cetana]]---consciousness; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---lifting; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---home; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees.
translation: The devotees tried to rouse the Lord by various means, but His consciousness did not return. Therefore they all lifted Him and brought Him back home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of the Lord!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaitacandra! All glories to all the devotees of the Lord!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.20
description: All the devotees began to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra very loudly, and after a considerable time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu regained consciousness.
text:
> ucca kari' śravaṇe kare nāma-saṅkīrtana
> aneka-kṣaṇe mahāprabhu pāilā cetana
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ucca]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---very loudly; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---in the ears; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---perform; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name; [[synonyms:a:aneka]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---after a considerable time; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]] [[synonyms:c:cetana]]---returned to consciousness.
translation: All the devotees began to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra very loudly, and after a considerable time, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu regained consciousness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.21
description: When He regained consciousness, His arms and legs came out of His body, and His whole body returned to normal.
text:
> cetana ha-ile hasta-pāda bāhire āila
> pūrvavat yathā-yogya śarīra ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cetana]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ile]]---when there was consciousness; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]---the arms and legs; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:p:pūrvavat]]---as before; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]]---in complete order; [[synonyms:ś:śarīra]]---the body; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was.
translation: When He regained consciousness, His arms and legs came out of His body, and His whole body returned to normal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.22
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, and then sat down again. Looking here and there, He inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Where have you brought Me?
text:
> uṭhiyā vasilena prabhu, cāhena iti-uti
> svarūpe kahena,---"tumi āmā ānilā kati?
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uṭhiyā]]---getting up; [[synonyms:v:vasilena]]---sat down; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:cāhena]]---looks; [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---Me; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---have brought; [[synonyms:k:kati]]---where.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stood up, and then sat down again. Looking here and there, He inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara, "Where have you brought Me?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.23
description: "After hearing the vibration of a flute, I went to Vṛndāvana, and there I saw that Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, was playing on His flute in the pasturing grounds.
text:
> veṇu-śabda śuni' āmi gelāṅa vṛndāvana
> dekhi,---goṣṭhe veṇu bājāya vrajendra-nandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---after hearing; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:g:gelāṅa]]---went; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I saw; [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhe]]---in the pasturing field; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---the flute; [[synonyms:b:bājāya]]---played; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
translation: "After hearing the vibration of a flute, I went to Vṛndāvana, and there I saw that Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, was playing on His flute in the pasturing grounds.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.24
description: "He brought Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to a bower by signaling with His flute. Then He entered within that bower to perform pastimes with Her.
text:
> saṅketa-veṇu-nāde rādhā āni' kuñja-ghare
> kuñjere calilā kṛṣṇa krīḍā karibāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅketa]]-[[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāde]]---by the signal of the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:k:kuñja]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to a bower; [[synonyms:k:kuñjere]]---within the bower; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]] [[synonyms:k:karibāre]]---to perform pastimes.
translation: "He brought Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī to a bower by signaling with His flute. Then He entered within that bower to perform pastimes with Her.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.25
description: "I entered the bower just behind Kṛṣṇa, My ears captivated by the sound of His ornaments.
text:
> tāṅra pāche pāche āmi karinu gamana
> tāṅra bhūṣā-dhvanite āmāra harila śravaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]] [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---just behind Him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:karinu]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---went; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣā]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvanite]]---by the sound of ornaments; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:h:harila]]---became captivated; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---ears.
translation: "I entered the bower just behind Kṛṣṇa, My ears captivated by the sound of His ornaments.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.26
description: "I saw Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs enjoying all kinds of pastimes while laughing and joking together. Hearing their vocal expressions enhanced the joy of My ears.
text:
> gopī-gaṇa-saha vihāra, hāsa, parihāsa
> kaṇṭha-dhvani-ukti śuni' mora karṇollāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:v:vihāra]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:h:hāsa]]---laughing; [[synonyms:p:pari]]-[[synonyms:h:hāsa]]---joking; [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]-[[synonyms:u:ukti]]---vocal expressions; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---jubilation of the ears.
translation: "I saw Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs enjoying all kinds of pastimes while laughing and joking together. Hearing their vocal expressions enhanced the joy of My ears.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.27
description: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and brought Me back here by force.
text:
> hena-kāle tumi-saba kolāhala kari'
> āmā iṅhā lañā āilā balātkāra kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of you; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making a tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---Me; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]---here; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---brought back; [[synonyms:b:balātkāra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---by force.
translation: "Just then, all of you made a tumultuous sound and brought Me back here by force.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.28
description: "Because you brought Me back here, I could no longer hear the nectarean voices of Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs, nor could I hear the sounds of their ornaments or the flute."
text:
> śunite nā pāinu sei amṛta-sama vāṇī
> śunite nā pāinu bhūṣaṇa-muralīra dhvani"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śunite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---I could not hear; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---exactly like nectar; [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---voices; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---I could not hear; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---of ornaments; [[synonyms:m:muralīra]]---of the flute; [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---vibration.
translation: "Because you brought Me back here, I could no longer hear the nectarean voices of Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs, nor could I hear the sounds of their ornaments or the flute."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.29
description: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Svarūpa Dāmodara in a faltering voice, "My ears are dying of thirst. Please recite something to quench this thirst. Let me hear it."
text:
> bhāvāveśe svarūpe kahena gadgada-vāṇī
> 'karṇa tṛṣṇāya mare, paḍa rasāyana, śuni'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in great ecstasy; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]-[[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---in a faltering voice; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]---the ears; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇāya]]---because of thirst; [[synonyms:m:mare]]---dies; [[synonyms:p:paḍa]]---recite; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyana]]---something relishable; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---let Me hear.
translation: In great ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said to Svarūpa Dāmodara in a faltering voice, "My ears are dying of thirst. Please recite something to quench this thirst. Let me hear it."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.3
description: Absorbed in ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu acted and talked like a madman day and night.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu rātri-divase
> unmādera ceṣṭā, pralāpa kare premāveśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---night and day; [[synonyms:u:unmādera]]---of a madman; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---activities; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---talks insanely; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love.
translation: Absorbed in ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu acted and talked like a madman day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.30
description: Understanding the ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara, in a sweet voice, recited the following verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi prabhura bhāva jāniyā
> bhāgavatera śloka paḍe madhura kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---the emotion; [[synonyms:j:jāniyā]]---understanding; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavatera]]---of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---a verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:m:madhura]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---in a sweet voice.
translation: Understanding the ecstatic emotions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Svarūpa Dāmodara, in a sweet voice, recited the following verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.31
description: " 'My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, where is that woman within the three worlds who cannot be captivated by the rhythms of the sweet songs coming from Your wonderful flute? Who cannot fall down from the path of chastity in this way? Your beauty is the most sublime within the three worlds. Upon seeing Your beauty, even cows, birds, animals and trees in the forest are stunned in jubilation.'
text:
> kā stry aṅga te kala-padāmṛta-veṇu-gīta-
> sammohitārya-caritān na calet trilokyām
> trailokya-saubhagam idaṁ ca nirīkṣya rūpaṁ
> yad go-dvija-druma-mṛgāḥ pulakāny abibhran
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kā]]---what; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---woman; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---O Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:te]]---of You; [[synonyms:k:kala]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]---by the rhythms; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---of the sweet songs of the flute; [[synonyms:s:sammohitā]]---being captivated; [[synonyms:ā:ārya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāt]]---from the path of chastity according to Vedic civilization; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:c:calet]]---would wander; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:l:lokyām]]---in the three worlds; [[synonyms:t:trai]]-[[synonyms:l:lokya]]-[[synonyms:s:saubhagam]]---which is the fortune of the three worlds; [[synonyms:i:idam]]---this; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:n:nirīkṣya]]---by observing; [[synonyms:r:rūpam]]---beauty; [[synonyms:y:yat]]---which; [[synonyms:g:go]]---the cows; [[synonyms:d:dvija]]---birds; [[synonyms:d:druma]]---trees; [[synonyms:m:mṛgāḥ]]---forest animals like the deer; [[synonyms:p:pulakāni]]---transcendental jubilation; [[synonyms:a:abibhran]]---manifested.
translation: “ 'My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, where is that woman within the three worlds who cannot be captivated by the rhythms of the sweet songs coming from Your wonderful flute? Who cannot fall down from the path of chastity in this way? Your beauty is the most sublime within the three worlds. Upon seeing Your beauty, even cows, birds, animals and trees in the forest are stunned in jubilation.'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.29.40).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.32
description: Upon hearing this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, overwhelmed with the ecstasy of the gopīs, began to explain it.
text:
> śuni' prabhu gopī-bhāve āviṣṭa ha-ilā
> bhāgavatera ślokera artha karite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in the emotion of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became overwhelmed; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavatera]]---of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the verse; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to explain.
translation: Upon hearing this verse, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, overwhelmed with the ecstasy of the gopīs, began to explain it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.33
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The gopīs entered the arena of the rāsa dance in ecstasy, but after hearing Kṛṣṇa's words of negligence and detachment, they understood that He was going to renounce them. Thus they began to chastise Him in anger.
text:
> haila gopī-bhāvāveśa, kaila rāse paraveśa,
> kṛṣṇera śuni' upekṣā-vacana
> kṛṣṇera mukha-hāsya-vāṇī, tyāge tāhā satya māni',
> roṣe kṛṣṇe dena olāhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:r:rāse]]---in the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:p:paraveśa]]---entrance; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:u:upekṣā]]-[[synonyms:v:vacana]]---the words of negligence; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---face; [[synonyms:h:hāsya]]---smiling; [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---talking; [[synonyms:t:tyāge]]---renounce; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:s:satya]] [[synonyms:m:māni']]---taking as a fact; [[synonyms:r:roṣe]]---in anger; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---give; [[synonyms:o:olāhana]]---chastisement.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The gopīs entered the arena of the rāsa dance in ecstasy, but after hearing Kṛṣṇa's words of negligence and detachment, they understood that He was going to renounce them. Thus they began to chastise Him in anger.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.34
description: " 'O dear lover,' " they said, " 'please answer just one question. Who among all the youthful women within this universe is not attracted by the sound of Your flute?
text:
> "nāgara, kaha, tumi kariyā niścaya
> ei trijagat bhari', āche yata yogyā nāri,
> tomāra veṇu kāhāṅ nā ākarṣaya?
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nāgara]]---O lover; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---say; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---certain; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:j:jagat]]---three worlds; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling; [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---there are; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many; [[synonyms:y:yogyā]]---suitable; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]---women; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---flute; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:ā:ākarṣaya]]---attracts.
translation: “ 'O dear lover,' " they said, " 'please answer just one question. Who among all the youthful women within this universe is not attracted by the sound of Your flute?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.35
description: " 'When You play Your flute, it acts like a messenger in the form of a yoginī perfect in the art of chanting mantras. This messenger enchants all the women in the universe and attracts them to You. Then she increases their great anxiety and induces them to give up the regulative principle of obeying superiors. Finally, she forcibly brings them to You to surrender in amorous love.
text:
> kailā jagate veṇu-dhvani, siddha-mantrā yoginī,
> dūtī hañā mohe nārī-mana
> mahotkaṇṭhā bāḍāñā, ārya-patha chāḍāñā,
> āni' tomāya kare samarpaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---You have made; [[synonyms:j:jagate]]---in the world; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:s:siddha]]-[[synonyms:m:mantrā]]---perfected in chanting //mantras//; [[synonyms:y:yoginī]]---a female mystic; [[synonyms:d:dūtī]]---a messenger; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:m:mohe]]---enchants; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---the minds of women; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---great anxiety; [[synonyms:b:bāḍāñā]]---increasing; [[synonyms:ā:ārya]]-[[synonyms:p:patha]]---the regulative principles; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāñā]]---inducing to give up; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---to You; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---delivers.
translation: “ 'When You play Your flute, it acts like a messenger in the form of a yoginī perfect in the art of chanting mantras. This messenger enchants all the women in the universe and attracts them to You. Then she increases their great anxiety and induces them to give up the regulative principle of obeying superiors. Finally, she forcibly brings them to You to surrender in amorous love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.36
description: " 'The vibration of Your flute, accompanied by Your glance, which pierces us forcibly with the arrows of lust, induces us to ignore the regulative principles of religious life. Thus we become excited by lusty desires and come to You, giving up all shame and fear. But now You are angry with us. You are finding fault with our violating religious principles and leaving our homes and husbands. And as You instruct us about religious principles, we become helpless.
text:
> dharma chāḍāya veṇu-dvāre, hāne kaṭākṣa-kāma-śare,
> lajjā, bhaya, sakala chāḍāya
> ebe āmāya kari' roṣa, kahi' pati-tyāge 'doṣa',
> dhārmika hañā dharma śikhāya!
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---religious principles; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāya]]---induces to reject; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---through the flute; [[synonyms:h:hāne]]---pierces; [[synonyms:k:kaṭākṣa]]---glancing; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:ś:śare]]---by the arrows of lust; [[synonyms:l:lajjā]]---shame; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---fear; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāya]]---induces to give up; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---at us; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---becoming angry; [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:pati]]-[[synonyms:t:tyāge]]---to give up one's husband; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault; [[synonyms:d:dhārmika]]---very religious; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---religious principles; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāya]]---You teach.
translation: “ 'The vibration of Your flute, accompanied by Your glance, which pierces us forcibly with the arrows of lust, induces us to ignore the regulative principles of religious life. Thus we become excited by lusty desires and come to You, giving up all shame and fear. But now You are angry with us. You are finding fault with our violating religious principles and leaving our homes and husbands. And as You instruct us about religious principles, we become helpless.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.37
description: " 'We know that this is all a well-planned trick. You know how to make jokes that cause the complete annihilation of women, but we can understand that Your real mind, words and behavior are different. Therefore please give up all these clever tricks.
text:
> anya-kathā, anya-mana, bāhire anya ācaraṇa,
> ei saba śaṭha-paripāṭī
> tumi jāna parihāsa, haya nārīra sarva-nāśa,
> chāḍa ei saba kuṭīnāṭī
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anya]]---different; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---words; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---different; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---different; [[synonyms:ā:ācaraṇa]]---behavior; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:ś:śaṭha]]-[[synonyms:p:paripāṭī]]---well-planned cheating behavior; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:j:jāna]]---know; [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---joking; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:n:nārīra]]---of women; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---total annihilation; [[synonyms:c:chāḍa]]---please give up; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kuṭīnāṭī]]---clever tricks.
translation: “ 'We know that this is all a well-planned trick. You know how to make jokes that cause the complete annihilation of women, but we can understand that Your real mind, words and behavior are different. Therefore please give up all these clever tricks.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.38
description: " 'The nectarean buttermilk of Your flute's vibration, the nectar of Your sweet words and the nectarean sound of Your ornaments mix together to attract our ears, minds and lives. In this way You are killing us.' "
text:
> veṇu-nāda amṛta-ghole, amṛta-samāna miṭhā bole,
> amṛta-samāna bhūṣaṇa-śiñjita
> tina amṛte hare kāṇa, hare mana, hare prāṇa,
> kemane nārī dharibeka cita?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāda]]---the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:g:ghole]]---like nectarean buttermilk; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---equal to nectar; [[synonyms:m:miṭhā]] [[synonyms:b:bole]]---sweet talking; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---exactly like nectar; [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiñjita]]---the vibration of ornaments; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:a:amṛte]]---nectars; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attract; [[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---the ear; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attract; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---attract; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---the life; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]---women; [[synonyms:d:dharibeka]]---will keep; [[synonyms:c:cita]]---patience or consciousness.
translation: “ 'The nectarean buttermilk of Your flute's vibration, the nectar of Your sweet words and the nectarean sound of Your ornaments mix together to attract our ears, minds and lives. In this way You are killing us.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.39
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words in a mood of anger as He floated on waves of ecstatic love. Merged in an ocean of anxiety, He recited a verse spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī expressing the same emotion. Then He personally explained the verse and thus tasted the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> eta kahi' krodhāveśe, bhāvera taraṅge bhāse,
> utkaṇṭhā-sāgare ḍube mana
> rādhāra utkaṇṭhā-vāṇī, paḍi' āpane vākhāni,
> kṛṣṇa-mādhurya kare āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in the mood of anger; [[synonyms:b:bhāvera]] [[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---in the waves of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---floats; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---of anxieties; [[synonyms:s:sāgare]]---in the ocean; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍube]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---merges the mind; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]-[[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---words of anxiety; [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reciting; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:v:vākhāni]]---explaining; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tastes.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words in a mood of anger as He floated on waves of ecstatic love. Merged in an ocean of anxiety, He recited a verse spoken by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī expressing the same emotion. Then He personally explained the verse and thus tasted the sweetness of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.4
description: In the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu once passed half the night talking about the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> eka-dina prabhu svarūpa-rāmānanda-saṅge
> ardha-rātri goṅāilā kṛṣṇa-kathā-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]]---half the night; [[synonyms:g:goṅāilā]]---passed; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---of discussing Kṛṣṇa's pastimes; [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in the matter.
translation: In the company of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu once passed half the night talking about the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.40
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear friend, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, has a voice as deep as a cloud resounding in the sky. With the tinkling of His ornaments, He attracts the ears of the gopīs, and with the sound of His flute He attracts even the goddess of fortune and other beautiful women. That Personality of Godhead, known as Madana-mohana, whose joking words carry many indications and deep meanings, is increasing the lusty desires of My ears.'
text:
> nadaj-jalada-nisvanaḥ śravaṇa-karṣi-sac-chiñjitaḥ
> sanarma-rasa-sūcakākṣara-padārtha-bhaṅgy-uktikaḥ
> ramādika-varāṅganā-hṛdaya-hāri-vaṁśī-kalaḥ
> sa me madana-mohanaḥ sakhi tanoti karṇa-spṛhām
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nadat]]---resounding; [[synonyms:j:jalada]]---the cloud; [[synonyms:n:nisvanaḥ]]---whose voice; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---the ears; [[synonyms:k:karṣi]]---attracting; [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiñjitaḥ]]---the tinkling of whose ornaments; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:n:narma]]---with deep meaning; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:s:sūcaka]]---joking; [[synonyms:a:akṣara]]---letters; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---meanings; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgi]]---indications; [[synonyms:u:uktikaḥ]]---whose talk; [[synonyms:r:ramā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādika]]---beginning with the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:v:vara]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅganā]]---of beautiful women; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]-[[synonyms:h:hāri]]---attracting the hearts; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśī]]-[[synonyms:k:kalaḥ]]---the sound of whose flute; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---that; [[synonyms:m:me]]---My; [[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:m:mohanaḥ]]---Madana-mohana; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---My dear friend; [[synonyms:t:tanoti]]---expands; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:spṛhām]]---the desire of the ears.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "My dear friend, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, has a voice as deep as a cloud resounding in the sky. With the tinkling of His ornaments, He attracts the ears of the gopīs, and with the sound of His flute He attracts even the goddess of fortune and other beautiful women. That Personality of Godhead, known as Madana-mohana, whose joking words carry many indications and deep meanings, is increasing the lusty desires of My ears.'
purport: This verse is found in the //Govinda-līlāmṛta// (8.5).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.41
description: "Kṛṣṇa's deep voice is more resonant than newly arrived clouds, and His sweet song defeats even the sweet voice of the cuckoo. Indeed, His song is so sweet that even one particle of its sound can inundate the entire world. If such a particle enters one's ear, one is immediately bereft of all other types of hearing.
text:
> "kaṇṭhera gambhīra dhvani, navaghana-dhvani jini',
> yāra guṇe kokila lājāya
> tāra eka śruti-kaṇe, ḍubāya jagatera kāṇe,
> punaḥ kāṇa bāhuḍi' nā āya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭhera]]---of the throat; [[synonyms:g:gambhīra]]---deep; [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---sound; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:g:ghana]]---of new clouds; [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the resounding; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---the attributes; [[synonyms:k:kokila]]---the cuckoo; [[synonyms:l:lājāya]]---put to shame; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śruti]]-[[synonyms:k:kaṇe]]---particle of sound; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāya]]---inundates; [[synonyms:j:jagatera]]---of the whole world; [[synonyms:k:kāṇe]]---the ear; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---the ear; [[synonyms:b:bāhuḍi']]---getting out; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āya]]---cannot come.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa's deep voice is more resonant than newly arrived clouds, and His sweet song defeats even the sweet voice of the cuckoo. Indeed, His song is so sweet that even one particle of its sound can inundate the entire world. If such a particle enters one's ear, one is immediately bereft of all other types of hearing.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.42
description: "My dear friend, please tell me what to do. My ears have been plundered by the qualities of Kṛṣṇa's sound. Now, however, I cannot hear His transcendental sound, and I am almost dead for want of it.
text:
> kaha, sakhi, ki kari upāya?
> kṛṣṇera se śabda-guṇe, harile āmāra kāṇe,
> ebe nā pāya, tṛṣṇāya mari' yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---please say; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---My dear friend; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---can I do; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---means; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---of the sound; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---the qualities; [[synonyms:h:harile]]---having attracted; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kāṇe]]---ears; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---do not get; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇāya]]---from thirst; [[synonyms:m:mari']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---I am dying.
translation: "My dear friend, please tell me what to do. My ears have been plundered by the qualities of Kṛṣṇa's sound. Now, however, I cannot hear His transcendental sound, and I am almost dead for want of it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.43
description: "The tinkling of Kṛṣṇa's ankle bells surpasses the songs of even the swan and crane, and the sound of His bangles puts the singing of the caṭaka bird to shame. Having allowed these sounds to enter the ears even once, one cannot tolerate hearing anything else.
text:
> nūpura-kiṅkinī-dhvani, haṁsa-sārasa jini',
> kaṅkaṇa-dhvani caṭake lājāya
> eka-bāra yei śune, vyāpi rahe' tāra kāṇe,
> anya śabda se-kāṇe nā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nūpura]]---of the ankle bells; [[synonyms:k:kiṅkinī]]---tinkling; [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the sound; [[synonyms:h:haṁsa]]---swans; [[synonyms:s:sārasa]]---cranes; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:k:kaṅkaṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the sound of bangles; [[synonyms:c:caṭake]]---the //caṭaka bird//; [[synonyms:l:lājāya]]---puts to shame; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---one who; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:v:vyāpi]]---expanding; [[synonyms:r:rahe']]---remains; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:k:kāṇe]]---in his ear; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---sound; [[synonyms:s:se]]-[[synonyms:k:kāṇe]]---in that ear; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---does not go.
translation: "The tinkling of Kṛṣṇa's ankle bells surpasses the songs of even the swan and crane, and the sound of His bangles puts the singing of the caṭaka bird to shame. Having allowed these sounds to enter the ears even once, one cannot tolerate hearing anything else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.44
description: "Kṛṣṇa's speech is far sweeter than nectar. Each of His jubilant words is full of meaning, and when His speech mixes with His smile, which is like camphor, the resultant sound and the deep meaning of Kṛṣṇa's words create various transcendental mellows.
text:
> se śrī-mukha-bhāṣita, amṛta haite parāmṛta,
> smita-karpūra tāhāte miśrita
> śabda, artha,---dui-śakti, nānā-rasa kare vyakti,
> pratyakṣara---narma-vibhūṣita
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]---beautiful; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---by the mouth; [[synonyms:b:bhāṣita]]---spoken; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than; [[synonyms:p:para]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---more nectarean; [[synonyms:s:smita]]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]---camphor; [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:m:miśrita]]---mixed; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]---sound; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---two energies; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---mellows; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:v:vyakti]]---express; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:a:akṣara]]---every word; [[synonyms:n:narma]]-[[synonyms:v:vibhūṣita]]---full of meaning.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa's speech is far sweeter than nectar. Each of His jubilant words is full of meaning, and when His speech mixes with His smile, which is like camphor, the resultant sound and the deep meaning of Kṛṣṇa's words create various transcendental mellows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.45
description: "One particle of that transcendental, blissful nectar is the life and soul of the ear, which is like a cakora bird that lives in hope of tasting that nectar. Sometimes, by good fortune, the bird can taste it, but at other times he unfortunately cannot and therefore almost dies of thirst.
text:
> se amṛtera eka-kaṇa, karṇa-cakora-jīvana,
> karṇa-cakora jīye sei āśe
> bhāgya-vaśe kabhu pāya, abhāgye kabhu nā pāya,
> nā pāile maraye piyāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]]---of that nectar; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one particle; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:cakora]]---of the ear, which is like a //cakora// bird; [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---the life; [[synonyms:k:karṇa]]---the ear; [[synonyms:c:cakora]]---the //cakora// bird; [[synonyms:j:jīye]]---lives; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ā:āśe]]---with that hope; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]-[[synonyms:v:vaśe]]---by good fortune; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:a:abhāgye]]---by misfortune; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāile]]---if does not get; [[synonyms:m:maraye]]---dies; [[synonyms:p:piyāse]]---from thirst.
translation: "One particle of that transcendental, blissful nectar is the life and soul of the ear, which is like a cakora bird that lives in hope of tasting that nectar. Sometimes, by good fortune, the bird can taste it, but at other times he unfortunately cannot and therefore almost dies of thirst.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.46
description: "The transcendental vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute disturbs the hearts of women all over the world, even if they hear it only once. Thus their fastened belts become loose, and these women become the unpaid maidservants of Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, they run toward Kṛṣṇa exactly like madwomen.
text:
> yebā veṇu-kala-dhvani, eka-bāra tāhā śuni',
> jagan-nārī-citta āulāya
> nīvi-bandha paḍe khasi', vinā-mūle haya dāsī,
> bāulī hañā kṛṣṇa-pāśe dhāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---whoever; [[synonyms:v:veṇu]]---of the flute; [[synonyms:k:kala]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the sweet vibration; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---of the universe; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]---of the women; [[synonyms:c:citta]]---hearts; [[synonyms:ā:āulāya]]---become disturbed; [[synonyms:n:nīvi]]-[[synonyms:b:bandha]]---the fastened belts; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fall; [[synonyms:k:khasi']]---becoming loosened; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]-[[synonyms:m:mūle]]---without a price; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---they become; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---maidservants; [[synonyms:b:bāulī]]---mad; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---after Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---run.
translation: "The transcendental vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute disturbs the hearts of women all over the world, even if they hear it only once. Thus their fastened belts become loose, and these women become the unpaid maidservants of Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, they run toward Kṛṣṇa exactly like madwomen.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.47
description: "When she hears the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, even the goddess of fortune comes to Him, greatly hoping for His association, but nevertheless she does not get it. When the waves of thirst for His association increase, she performs austerities, but still she cannot meet Him.
text:
> yebā lakṣmī-ṭhākurāṇī, teṅho ye kākalī śuni',
> kṛṣṇa-pāśa āise pratyāśāya
> nā pāya kṛṣṇera saṅga, bāḍe tṛṣṇā-taraṅga,
> tapa kare, tabu nāhi pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---even; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurāṇī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---she; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:k:kākalī]]---vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes; [[synonyms:p:pratyāśāya]]---with great hope; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---association with Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increase; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]]---of thirst; [[synonyms:t:taraṅga]]---the waves; [[synonyms:t:tapa]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---undergoes austerity; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get.
translation: "When she hears the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute, even the goddess of fortune comes to Him, greatly hoping for His association, but nevertheless she does not get it. When the waves of thirst for His association increase, she performs austerities, but still she cannot meet Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.48
description: "Only the most fortunate can hear these four nectarean sounds-Kṛṣṇa's words, the tinkling of His ankle bells and bangles, His voice and the vibration of His flute. If one does not hear these sounds, his ears are as useless as small conchshells with holes."
text:
> ei śabdāmṛta cāri, yāra haya bhāgya bhāri,
> sei karṇe ihā kare pāna
> ihā yei nāhi śune, se kāṇa janmila kene,
> kāṇākaḍi-sama sei kāṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:ś:śabda]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectarean sound vibrations; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]] [[synonyms:b:bhāri]]---great fortune; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---such a person; [[synonyms:k:karṇe]]---by the ears; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---these sounds; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---drinks; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---these sounds; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---does not hear; [[synonyms:s:se]]---those; [[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---ears; [[synonyms:j:janmila]]---took birth; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kāṇākaḍi]]---a hole in a small conchshell; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---just like; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---those ears.
translation: "Only the most fortunate can hear these four nectarean sounds-Kṛṣṇa's words, the tinkling of His ankle bells and bangles, His voice and the vibration of His flute. If one does not hear these sounds, his ears are as useless as small conchshells with holes."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.49
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in this way, agitation and ecstasy awoke in His mind, and He became very restless. Many transcendental ecstasies combined in Him, including anxiety, lamentation, attention, eagerness, fear, determination and remembrance.
text:
> karite aiche vilāpa, uṭhila udvega, bhāva,
> mane kāho nāhi ālambana
> udvega, viṣāda, mati, autsukya, trāsa, dhṛti, smṛti,
> nānā-bhāvera ha-ila milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:karite]]---doing; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:v:vilāpa]]---lamentation; [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---there arose; [[synonyms:u:udvega]]---agitation; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstasy; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:k:kāho]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:ā:ālambana]]---shelter; [[synonyms:u:udvega]]---anxiety; [[synonyms:v:viṣāda]]---lamentation; [[synonyms:m:mati]]---attention; [[synonyms:a:autsukya]]---eagerness; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---fear; [[synonyms:d:dhṛti]]---determination; [[synonyms:s:smṛti]]---remembrance; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāvera]]---of various ecstasies; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:m:milana]]---combining.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in this way, agitation and ecstasy awoke in His mind, and He became very restless. Many transcendental ecstasies combined in Him, including anxiety, lamentation, attention, eagerness, fear, determination and remembrance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.5
description: As they talked of Kṛṣṇa, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would sing songs exactly suitable for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental emotions.
text:
> yabe yei bhāva prabhura karaye udaya
> bhāvānurūpa gīta gāya svarūpa-mahāśaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---whenever; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:u:udaya]]---rises; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]]---befitting the emotion; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]---song; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:mahāśaya]]---the great personality.
translation: As they talked of Kṛṣṇa, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī would sing songs exactly suitable for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's transcendental emotions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.50
description: The aggregate of all these ecstasies awoke a statement by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī in the mind of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura [Līlā-śuka]. In the same ecstatic mood, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu now recited that verse, and on the strength of madness, He described its meaning, which is unknown to people in general.
text:
> bhāva-śābalye rādhāra ukti, līlā-śuke haila sphūrti,
> sei bhāve paḍe eka śloka
> unmādera sāmarthye, sei ślokera kare arthe,
> yei artha nāhi jāne loka
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śābalye]]---in the aggregate of all ecstasies; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:u:ukti]]---statement; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śuke]]---in Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:sphūrti]]---awakening; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in that ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:u:unmādera]]---of madness; [[synonyms:s:sāmarthye]]---in the capacity; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of that verse; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:a:arthe]]---describes the meaning; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---which meaning; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---do not; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---know; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people.
translation: The aggregate of all these ecstasies awoke a statement by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī in the mind of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura [Līlā-śuka]. In the same ecstatic mood, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu now recited that verse, and on the strength of madness, He described its meaning, which is unknown to people in general.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.51
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'Alas, what shall I do? To whom shall I speak? Let whatever I have done in hopes of meeting Kṛṣṇa be finished now. Please say something auspicious, but do not speak about Kṛṣṇa. Alas, Kṛṣṇa is lying within My heart like Cupid; therefore how can I possibly give up talking of Him? I cannot forget Kṛṣṇa, whose smile is sweeter than sweetness itself and who gives pleasure to My mind and eyes. Alas, My great thirst for Kṛṣṇa is increasing moment by moment!'
text:
> kim iha kṛṇumaḥ kasya brūmaḥ kṛtaṁ kṛtam āśayā
> kathayata kathām anyāṁ dhanyām aho hṛdaye śayaḥ
> madhura-madhura-smerākāre mano-nayanotsave
> kṛpaṇa-kṛpaṇā kṛṣṇe tṛṣṇā ciraṁ bata lambate
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:i:iha]]---here; [[synonyms:k:kṛṇumaḥ]]---shall I do; [[synonyms:k:kasya]]---to whom; [[synonyms:b:brūmaḥ]]---shall I speak; [[synonyms:k:kṛtam]]---what is done; [[synonyms:k:kṛtam]]---done; [[synonyms:ā:āśayā]]---in the hope; [[synonyms:k:kathayata]]---please speak; [[synonyms:k:kathām]]---words; [[synonyms:a:anyām]]---other; [[synonyms:d:dhanyām]]---auspicious; [[synonyms:a:aho]]---alas; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---within My heart; [[synonyms:ś:śayaḥ]]---lying; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]-[[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweeter than sweetness; [[synonyms:s:smera]]---smiling; [[synonyms:ā:ākāre]]---whose form; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:n:nayana]]---to the mind and eyes; [[synonyms:u:utsave]]---who gives pleasure; [[synonyms:k:kṛpaṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpaṇā]]---the best of misers; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]]---thirst; [[synonyms:c:ciram]]---at every moment; [[synonyms:b:bata]]---alas; [[synonyms:l:lambate]]---is increasing.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'Alas, what shall I do? To whom shall I speak? Let whatever I have done in hopes of meeting Kṛṣṇa be finished now. Please say something auspicious, but do not speak about Kṛṣṇa. Alas, Kṛṣṇa is lying within My heart like Cupid; therefore how can I possibly give up talking of Him? I cannot forget Kṛṣṇa, whose smile is sweeter than sweetness itself and who gives pleasure to My mind and eyes. Alas, My great thirst for Kṛṣṇa is increasing moment by moment!'
purport: This statement by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is quoted from //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta// (42).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.52
description: "The anxiety caused by separation from Kṛṣṇa has made Me impatient, and I can think of no way to meet Him. O My friends, you are also deranged by lamentation. Who, therefore, will tell Me how to find Him?
text:
> "ei kṛṣṇera virahe, udvege mana sthira nahe,
> prāpty-upāya-cintana nā yāya
> yebā tumi sakhī-gaṇa, viṣāde bāula mana,
> kāre puchoṅ, ke kahe upāya?
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:virahe]]---in separation; [[synonyms:u:udvege]]---in anxiety; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:s:sthira]]---patient; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:p:prāpti]]-[[synonyms:u:upāya]]---the means for obtaining; [[synonyms:c:cintana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---I cannot think of; [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---friends; [[synonyms:v:viṣāde]]---in lamentation; [[synonyms:b:bāula]]---maddened; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---minds; [[synonyms:k:kāre]]---whom; [[synonyms:p:puchoṅ]]---shall I ask; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---will speak; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---the means.
translation: "The anxiety caused by separation from Kṛṣṇa has made Me impatient, and I can think of no way to meet Him. O My friends, you are also deranged by lamentation. Who, therefore, will tell Me how to find Him?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.53
description: "O My dear friends, how shall I find Kṛṣṇa? What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where can I meet Him? Because I cannot find Kṛṣṇa, My life is leaving Me."
text:
> hā hā sakhi, ki kari upāya!
> kāṅhā karoṅ, kāhāṅ yāṅa, kāhāṅ gele kṛṣṇa pāṅa,
> kṛṣṇa vinā prāṇa mora yāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---O; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---friends; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---shall I do; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---means; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]] [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]]---what shall I do?; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāṅa]]---where shall I go; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:g:gele]]---where going; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:p:pāṅa]]---I can get Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is leaving.
translation: "O My dear friends, how shall I find Kṛṣṇa? What shall I do? Where shall I go? Where can I meet Him? Because I cannot find Kṛṣṇa, My life is leaving Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.54
description: Suddenly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became calm and considered His state of mind. He remembered the words of Piṅgalā, and this aroused an ecstasy that moved Him to speak. Thus He explained the meaning of the verse.
text:
> kṣaṇe mana sthira haya, tabe mane vicāraya,
> balite ha-ila bhāvodgama
> piṅgalāra vacana-smṛti, karāila bhāva-mati,
> tāte kare artha-nirdhāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---in a moment; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes patient; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:v:vicāraya]]---He considers; [[synonyms:b:balite]]---to speak; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:u:udgama]]---awakening of ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:piṅgalāra]]---of Piṅgalā; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]-[[synonyms:s:smṛti]]---remembering the words; [[synonyms:k:karāila]]---caused; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:m:mati]]---ecstatic mind; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:a:artha]]-[[synonyms:n:nirdhāraṇa]]---ascertaining the meaning.
translation: Suddenly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became calm and considered His state of mind. He remembered the words of Piṅgalā, and this aroused an ecstasy that moved Him to speak. Thus He explained the meaning of the verse.
purport: Piṅgalā was a prostitute who said, "To hope against hope produces only misery. Utter hopelessness is the greatest happiness." Remembering this statement, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became ecstatic. The story of Piṅgalā is found in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// Eleventh Canto, Eighth Chapter, verses 22-44, as well as in //Mahābhārata, Sānti-parva,// Chapter 174.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.55
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'If I give up hope of meeting Kṛṣṇa, I shall then be happy. Therefore, let us stop this most inglorious discussion of Kṛṣṇa. It would be better for us to talk of glorious topics and forget Him.'
text:
> "dekhi ei upāye, kṛṣṇa-āśā chāḍi' diye,
> āśā chāḍile sukhī haya mana
> chāḍa' kṛṣṇa-kathā adhanya, kaha anya-kathā dhanya,
> yāte haya kṛṣṇa-vismaraṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:u:upāye]]---this means; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśā]]---hope for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']] [[synonyms:d:diye]]---I give up; [[synonyms:ā:āśā]]---hope; [[synonyms:c:chāḍile]]---if I give up; [[synonyms:s:sukhī]]---happy; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:c:chāḍa']]---give up; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:adhanya]]---most inglorious; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---speak; [[synonyms:a:anya]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---other topics; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorious; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:vismaraṇa]]---forgetfulness of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, " 'If I give up hope of meeting Kṛṣṇa, I shall then be happy. Therefore, let us stop this most inglorious discussion of Kṛṣṇa. It would be better for us to talk of glorious topics and forget Him.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.56
description: "While speaking in this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī suddenly remembered Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, He appeared within Her heart. Greatly astonished, She told Her friends, 'The person I want to forget is lying in My heart.'
text:
> kahitei ha-ila smṛti, citte haila kṛṣṇa-sphūrti,
> sakhīre kahe hañā vismite
> "yāre cāhi chāḍite, sei śuñā āche citte,
> kona rīte nā pāri chāḍite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kahitei]]---while speaking; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:smṛti]]---remembrance; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sphūrti]]---the appearance of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sakhīre]]---to the friends; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:v:vismite]]---being very astonished; [[synonyms:y:yāre]]---He whom; [[synonyms:c:cāhi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍite]]---I want to give up; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that person; [[synonyms:ś:śuñā]] [[synonyms:ā:āche]]---is lying; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:r:rīte]]---by any process; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am not able; [[synonyms:c:chāḍite]]---to give up.
translation: "While speaking in this way, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī suddenly remembered Kṛṣṇa. Indeed, He appeared within Her heart. Greatly astonished, She told Her friends, 'The person I want to forget is lying in My heart.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.57
description: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstasy also made Her think of Kṛṣṇa as Cupid, and this understanding frightened Her. She said, 'This Cupid, who has conquered the whole world and entered My heart, is My greatest enemy, for He does not allow Me to forget Him.'
text:
> rādhā-bhāvera svabhāva āna, kṛṣṇe karāya 'kāma'-jñāna,
> kāma-jñāne trāsa haila citte
> kahe---"ye jagat māre, se paśila antare,
> ei vairī nā deya pāsarite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāvera]]---of the ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---characteristic; [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---another; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---causes Her to do; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---understanding as Cupid; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---as Cupid; [[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---in the understanding; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---fear; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---She says; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---the person who; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the whole world; [[synonyms:m:māre]]---conquers; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that person; [[synonyms:p:paśila]]---entered; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within My heart; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:v:vairī]]---this enemy; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deya]]---does not allow; [[synonyms:p:pāsarite]]---to forget.
translation: "Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's ecstasy also made Her think of Kṛṣṇa as Cupid, and this understanding frightened Her. She said, 'This Cupid, who has conquered the whole world and entered My heart, is My greatest enemy, for He does not allow Me to forget Him.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.58
description: "Then great eagerness conquered all the other soldiers of ecstasy, and an uncontrollable desire arose in the kingdom of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mind. Greatly unhappy, She then chastised Her own mind.
text:
> autsukyera prāvīṇye, jiti' anya bhāva-sainye,
> udaya haila nija-rājya-mane
> mane ha-ila lālasa, nā haya āpana-vaśa,
> duḥkhe mane karena bhartsane
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:autsukyera]]---of eagerness; [[synonyms:p:prāvīṇye]]---because of high development; [[synonyms:j:jiti']]---conquering; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:s:sainye]]---soldiers of ecstasy; [[synonyms:u:udaya]]---arising; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:r:rājya]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the kingdom of Her own mind; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:l:lālasa]]---greed; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---within Her own control; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---in unhappiness; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---to the mind; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhartsane]]---chastisement.
translation: "Then great eagerness conquered all the other soldiers of ecstasy, and an uncontrollable desire arose in the kingdom of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī's mind. Greatly unhappy, She then chastised Her own mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.59
description: " 'If I do not think of Kṛṣṇa, My impoverished mind will die within a moment like a fish out of water. But when I see Kṛṣṇa's sweetly smiling face, My mind and eyes are so pleased that My desire for Him redoubles.
text:
> "mana mora vāma-dīna, jala vinā yena mīna,
> kṛṣṇa vinā kṣaṇe mari' yāya
> madhura-hāsya-vadane, mana-netra-rasāyane,
> kṛṣṇa-tṛṣṇā dviguṇa bāḍāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My mind; [[synonyms:v:vāma]]-[[synonyms:d:dīna]]---unagreeably poor; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:m:mīna]]---a fish; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---in a moment; [[synonyms:m:mari']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---dies; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweet; [[synonyms:h:hāsya]]---smiling; [[synonyms:v:vadane]]---face; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:n:netra]]---the eyes; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyane]]---very pleasing to; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇa]]---the thirst for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---twice as much; [[synonyms:b:bāḍāya]]---increases.
translation: “ 'If I do not think of Kṛṣṇa, My impoverished mind will die within a moment like a fish out of water. But when I see Kṛṣṇa's sweetly smiling face, My mind and eyes are so pleased that My desire for Him redoubles.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.6
description: Rāmānanda Rāya would quote verses from the books of Vidyāpati and Caṇḍīdāsa, and especially from the Gīta-govinda by Jayadeva Gosvāmī, to complement the ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> vidyāpati, caṇḍīdāsa, śrī-gīta-govinda
> bhāvānurūpa śloka paḍena rāya-rāmānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vidyāpati]]---the author Vidyāpati; [[synonyms:c:caṇḍīdāsa]]---the author Caṇḍīdāsa; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the famous book by Jayadeva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]]---according to the ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:p:paḍena]]---recites; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya would quote verses from the books of Vidyāpati and Caṇḍīdāsa, and especially from the Gīta-govinda by Jayadeva Gosvāmī, to complement the ecstasy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.60
description: " 'Alas! Where is Kṛṣṇa, the treasure of My life? Where is the lotus-eyed one? Alas! Where is the divine ocean of all transcendental qualities? Alas! Where is the beautiful, blackish youth dressed in yellow garments? Alas! Where is the hero of the rāsa dance?
text:
> hā hā kṛṣṇa prāṇa-dhana, hā hā padma-locana,
> hā hā divya sad-guṇa-sāgara!
> hā hā śyāma-sundara, hā hā pītāmbara-dhara,
> hā hā rāsa-vilāsa nāgara
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---alas; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---O Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the treasure of My life; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]---alas; [[synonyms:p:padma]]-[[synonyms:l:locana]]---the lotus-eyed one; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---alas; [[synonyms:d:divya]]---divine; [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sāgara]]---ocean of transcendental attributes; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---alas; [[synonyms:ś:śyāma]]-[[synonyms:s:sundara]]---the beautiful, blackish youth; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---alas; [[synonyms:p:pīta]]-[[synonyms:a:ambara]]-[[synonyms:d:dhara]]---one who wears yellow garments; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]]---alas; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:n:nāgara]]---the hero.
translation: “ 'Alas! Where is Kṛṣṇa, the treasure of My life? Where is the lotus-eyed one? Alas! Where is the divine ocean of all transcendental qualities? Alas! Where is the beautiful, blackish youth dressed in yellow garments? Alas! Where is the hero of the rāsa dance?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.61
description: " 'Where shall I go? Where can I find You? Please tell Me. I shall go there.' " Speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began running. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, however, stood up, caught Him and took Him on his lap. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara brought Him back to His place and made Him sit down.
text:
> kāhāṅ gele tomā pāi, tumi kaha,---tāhāṅ yāi",
> eta kahi' calilā dhāñā
> svarūpa uṭhi' kole kari', prabhure ānila dhari',
> nija-sthāne vasāilā laiñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:g:gele]]---going; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---You; [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---I can get; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---please tell; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:y:yāi]]---I shall go; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:c:calilā]] [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---began to run; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:k:kole]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---taking on His lap; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought back; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in His own place; [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:l:laiñā]]---taking.
translation: “ 'Where shall I go? Where can I find You? Please tell Me. I shall go there.' " Speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began running. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, however, stood up, caught Him and took Him on his lap. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara brought Him back to His place and made Him sit down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.62
description: Suddenly Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to external consciousness and said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "My dear Svarūpa, please sing some sweet songs." The Lord's ears were satisfied when He heard Svarūpa Dāmodara sing songs from Gīta-govinda and those by the poet Vidyāpati.
text:
> kṣaṇeke prabhura bāhya haila, svarūpere ājñā dila,
> "svarūpa, kichu kara madhura gāna"
> svarūpa gāya vidyāpati, gīta-govinda-gīti,
> śuni' prabhura juḍāila kāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇeke]]---within a moment; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:svarūpere]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---He ordered Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---My dear Svarūpa; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---make; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweet; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---songs; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings; [[synonyms:v:vidyāpati]]---songs by Vidyāpati; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:g:gīti]]---songs from //Gīta-govinda//; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:juḍāila]]---became satisfied; [[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---ears.
translation: Suddenly Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to external consciousness and said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, "My dear Svarūpa, please sing some sweet songs." The Lord's ears were satisfied when He heard Svarūpa Dāmodara sing songs from Gīta-govinda and those by the poet Vidyāpati.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.63
description: Each day and night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would become deranged in this way and talk like a madman.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu prati-rātri-dine
> unmāda ceṣṭita haya pralāpa-vacane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---every night and day; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---mad; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭita]]---activities; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vacane]]---talking like a madman.
translation: Each day and night, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would become deranged in this way and talk like a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.64
description: Even Anantadeva, who possesses thousands of mouths, cannot fully describe the ecstatic transformations that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu experienced in a single day.
text:
> eka-dine yata haya bhāvera vikāra
> sahasra-mukhe varṇe yadi, nāhi pāya pāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---in one day; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---as many as there are; [[synonyms:b:bhāvera]]---of ecstasy; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---possessing thousands of mouths; [[synonyms:v:varṇe]] [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if describes; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---cannot reach; [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---the limit.
translation: Even Anantadeva, who possesses thousands of mouths, cannot fully describe the ecstatic transformations that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu experienced in a single day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.65
description: What can a poor creature like me describe of those transformations? I can give only a hint of them, as if showing the moon through the branches of a tree.
text:
> jīva dīna ki karibe tāhāra varṇana?
> śākhā-candra-nyāya kari' dig-daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jīva]]---a living entity; [[synonyms:d:dīna]]---very poor; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:k:karibe]]---will do; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description; [[synonyms:ś:śākhā]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]-[[synonyms:n:nyāya]]---the logic of showing the moon through the branches of a tree; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---I make; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing the direction.
translation: What can a poor creature like me describe of those transformations? I can give only a hint of them, as if showing the moon through the branches of a tree.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.66
description: This description, however, will satisfy the mind and ears of anyone who hears it, and he will be able to understand these uncommon activities of deep ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ihā yei śune, tāra juḍāya mana-kāṇa
> alaukika gūḍha-prema-ceṣṭā haya jñāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---anyone who hears; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]]---become satisfied; [[synonyms:m:mana]]-[[synonyms:k:kāṇa]]---mind and ears; [[synonyms:a:alaukika]]---uncommon; [[synonyms:g:gūḍha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---of deep ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---activities; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---he can understand.
translation: This description, however, will satisfy the mind and ears of anyone who hears it, and he will be able to understand these uncommon activities of deep ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.67
description: Ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa is wonderfully deep. By personally tasting the glorious sweetness of that love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed us its extreme limit.
text:
> adbhuta nigūḍha premera mādhurya-mahimā
> āpani āsvādi' prabhu dekhāilā sīmā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---deep; [[synonyms:p:premera]]---of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]-[[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glories of the sweetness; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādi']]---tasting; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhāilā]]---showed; [[synonyms:s:sīmā]]---the extreme limit.
translation: Ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa is wonderfully deep. By personally tasting the glorious sweetness of that love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu showed us its extreme limit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.68
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is wonderfully merciful and wonderfully magnanimous. We have heard of no one else within this world so merciful and charitable.
text:
> adbhuta-dayālu caitanya---adbhuta-vadānya!
> aiche dayālu dātā loke nāhi śuni anya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderfully; [[synonyms:d:dayālu]]---merciful; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]-[[synonyms:v:vadānya]]---wonderfully magnanimous; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:d:dayālu]]---merciful; [[synonyms:d:dātā]]---charitable person; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---within this world; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---we have heard of; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is wonderfully merciful and wonderfully magnanimous. We have heard of no one else within this world so merciful and charitable.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.69
description: Worship the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in all respects. Only in this way will you achieve the nectarean treasure of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> sarva-bhāve bhaja, loka, caitanya-caraṇa
> yāhā haite pāibā kṛṣṇa-premāmṛta-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in all respects; [[synonyms:b:bhaja]]---worship; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---O entire world; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---by which; [[synonyms:p:pāibā]]---you will get; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---of the nectar; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the treasure.
translation: Worship the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in all respects. Only in this way will you achieve the nectarean treasure of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.7
description: At intervals, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would also recite a verse. Then, in great lamentation, He would explain it.
text:
> madhye madhye āpane prabhu śloka paḍiyā
> ślokera artha karena prabhu vilāpa kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---at intervals; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---a verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍiyā]]---reciting; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the verse; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---gives; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vilāpa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---lamenting.
translation: At intervals, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would also recite a verse. Then, in great lamentation, He would explain it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.70
description: Thus I have described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic transformation of becoming like a tortoise. In that ecstasy, He talked and acted like a madman.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ 'kūrmākṛti'-anubhāva
> unmāda-ceṣṭita tāte unmāda-pralāpa
