synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---thus I have described; [[synonyms:k:kūrma]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākṛti]]---of becoming like a tortoise; [[synonyms:a:anubhāva]]---the ecstatic symptom; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:c:ceṣṭita]]---enacted in madness; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---talking like a madman.
translation: Thus I have described Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's ecstatic transformation of becoming like a tortoise. In that ecstasy, He talked and acted like a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.71
description: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has fully described this pastime in his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.
text:
> ei līlā sva-granthe raghunātha-dāsa
> gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe kairāchena prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---this pastime; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:g:granthe]]---in his book; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:stava]]-[[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---named //Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa//; [[synonyms:k:kairāchena]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---has fully described.
translation: Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī has fully described this pastime in his book Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.72
description: "How wonderful it is! Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left His residence without opening the three strongly bolted doors. Then He crossed over three high walls, and later, because of strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He fell down amidst the cows of the Tailaṅga district and retracted all the limbs of His body like a tortoise. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who appeared in that way, rises in my heart and maddens me."
text:
> anudghāṭya dvāra-trayam uru ca bhitti-trayam aho
> vilaṅghyoccaiḥ kāliṅgika-surabhi-madhye nipatitaḥ
> tanūdyat-saṅkocāt kamaṭha iva kṛṣṇoru-virahād
> virājan gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:anudghāṭya]]---without opening; [[synonyms:d:dvāra]]-[[synonyms:t:trayam]]---the three doors; [[synonyms:u:uru]]---strong; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bhitti]]-[[synonyms:t:trayam]]---three walls; [[synonyms:a:aho]]---how wonderful; [[synonyms:v:vilaṅghya]]---crossing over; [[synonyms:u:uccaiḥ]]---very high; [[synonyms:k:kāliṅgika]]---of Kāliṅga-deśa, which is in the district of Tailaṅga; [[synonyms:s:surabhi]]-[[synonyms:m:madhye]]---among the cows; [[synonyms:n:nipatitaḥ]]---fallen down; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]-[[synonyms:u:udyat]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkocāt]]---by contracting within the body; [[synonyms:k:kamaṭhaḥ]]---a tortoise; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:u:uru]]-[[synonyms:v:virahāt]]---because of strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:virājan]]---appearing; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅgaḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:u:udayan]]---rising; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---me; [[synonyms:m:madayati]]---maddens.
translation: "How wonderful it is! Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu left His residence without opening the three strongly bolted doors. Then He crossed over three high walls, and later, because of strong feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He fell down amidst the cows of the Tailaṅga district and retracted all the limbs of His body like a tortoise. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who appeared in that way, rises in my heart and maddens me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.73
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Seventeenth Chapter, describing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastime of retracting His limbs like a tortoise.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.8
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed half the night experiencing varieties of emotions. Finally, after making the Lord lie down on His bed, both Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya returned to their homes.
text:
> ei-mate nānā-bhāve ardha-rātri haila
> gosāñire śayana karāi' duṅhe ghare gela
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in varieties of emotions; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]]---half the night; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---passed; [[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]] [[synonyms:k:karāi']]---making Him lie down; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went home.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed half the night experiencing varieties of emotions. Finally, after making the Lord lie down on His bed, both Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya returned to their homes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 17.9
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's personal servant, Govinda, lay down at the door of His room, and the Lord very loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all night.
text:
> gambhīrāra dvāre govinda karilā śayana
> saba-rātri prabhu karena ucca-saṅkīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gambhīrāra]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's room; [[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the door; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---His personal servant; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lay down; [[synonyms:s:saba]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]]---all night; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:u:ucca]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---loud chanting.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's personal servant, Govinda, lay down at the door of His room, and the Lord very loudly chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.1
description: In the brilliant autumn moonlight, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the sea for the River Yamunā. Greatly afflicted by separation from Kṛṣṇa, He ran and dove into the sea and remained unconscious in the water the entire night. In the morning, He was found by His personal devotees. May that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, protect us by His transcendental pastimes.
text:
> śaraj-jyotsnā-sindhor avakalanayā jāta-yamunā-
> bhramād dhāvan yo 'smin hari-viraha-tāpārṇava iva
> nimagno mūrcchālaḥ payasi nivasan rātrim akhilāṁ
> prabhāte prāptaḥ svair avatu sa śacī-sūnur iha naḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śarat]]-[[synonyms:j:jyotsnā]]---in the moonlight of autumn; [[synonyms:s:sindhoḥ]]---of the sea; [[synonyms:a:avakalanayā]]---by sight; [[synonyms:j:jāta]]---appeared; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]]---the River Yamunā; [[synonyms:b:bhramāt]]---by mistake; [[synonyms:d:dhāvan]]---running; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---He who; [[synonyms:a:asmin]]---in this; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:v:viraha]]---due to separation from Hari; [[synonyms:t:tāpa]]---of suffering; [[synonyms:a:arṇave]]---in the ocean; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---as if; [[synonyms:n:nimagnaḥ]]---dove; [[synonyms:m:mūrcchālaḥ]]---unconscious; [[synonyms:p:payasi]]---in the water; [[synonyms:n:nivasan]]---staying; [[synonyms:r:rātrim]]---the night; [[synonyms:a:akhilām]]---whole; [[synonyms:p:prabhāte]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:p:prāptaḥ]]---was gotten; [[synonyms:s:svaiḥ]]---by His personal associates; [[synonyms:a:avatu]]---may protect; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:ś:śacī]]-[[synonyms:s:sūnuḥ]]---the son of mother Śacī; [[synonyms:i:iha]]---here; [[synonyms:n:naḥ]]---us.
translation: In the brilliant autumn moonlight, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu mistook the sea for the River Yamunā. Greatly afflicted by separation from Kṛṣṇa, He ran and dove into the sea and remained unconscious in the water the entire night. In the morning, He was found by His personal devotees. May that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, protect us by His transcendental pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.10
description: To explain fully all those verses and all the transformations that took place in the Lord's body would require a very large volume.
text:
> se saba ślokera artha, se saba 'vikāra'
> se saba varṇite grantha haya ati-vistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all those; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of verses; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meanings; [[synonyms:s:se]]---those; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of them; [[synonyms:v:varṇite]]---to describe; [[synonyms:g:grantha]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---the book becomes; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---very, very large.
translation: To explain fully all those verses and all the transformations that took place in the Lord's body would require a very large volume.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.100
description: "After performing such wonderful pastimes, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa got up on the shore of the Yamunā River, taking with Him all His beloved gopīs. Then the gopīs on the riverbank rendered service by massaging Kṛṣṇa and the other gopīs with scented oil and smearing paste of āmalakī fruit on their bodies.
text:
> aiche vicitra krīḍā kari', tīre āilā śrī-hari,
> saṅge lañā saba kāntā-gaṇa
> gandha-taila-mardana, āmalakī-udvartana,
> sevā kare tīre sakhī-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:v:vicitra]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---performing; [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:h:hari]]---Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Him; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:k:kāntā]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the beloved //gopīs//; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---scented; [[synonyms:t:taila]]---oil; [[synonyms:m:mardana]]---massaging; [[synonyms:ā:āmalakī]]---of the //āmalakī// fruit; [[synonyms:u:udvartana]]---anointing with paste; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---render service; [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank of the Yamunā; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //gopīs.//
translation: "After performing such wonderful pastimes, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa got up on the shore of the Yamunā River, taking with Him all His beloved gopīs. Then the gopīs on the riverbank rendered service by massaging Kṛṣṇa and the other gopīs with scented oil and smearing paste of āmalakī fruit on their bodies.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.101
description: "Then they all bathed again, and after putting on dry clothing, they went to a small jeweled house, where the gopī Vṛndā arranged to dress them in forest clothing by decorating them with fragrant flowers, green leaves and all kinds of other ornaments.
text:
> punarapi kaila snāna, śuṣka-vastra paridhāna,
> ratna-mandire kailā āgamana
> vṛndā-kṛta sambhāra, gandha-puṣpa-alaṅkāra,
> vanya-veśa karila racana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:punarapi]]---again; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---took; [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bath; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:v:vastra]]---dry cloth; [[synonyms:p:paridhāna]]---putting on; [[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in a small house of jewels; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---arrival; [[synonyms:v:vṛndā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛta]]---arranged by the //gopī// Vṛndā; [[synonyms:s:sambhāra]]---all kinds of articles; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]-[[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:a:alaṅkāra]]---scented flowers and ornaments; [[synonyms:v:vanya]]-[[synonyms:v:veśa]]---forest dress; [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did; [[synonyms:r:racana]]---arrangement.
translation: "Then they all bathed again, and after putting on dry clothing, they went to a small jeweled house, where the gopī Vṛndā arranged to dress them in forest clothing by decorating them with fragrant flowers, green leaves and all kinds of other ornaments.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.102
description: "In Vṛndāvana, the trees and creepers are wonderful because throughout the entire year they produce all kinds of fruits and flowers. The gopīs and maidservants in the bowers of Vṛndāvana pick these fruits and flowers and bring them before Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> vṛndāvane taru-latā, adbhuta tāhāra kathā,
> bāra-māsa dhare phula-phala
> vṛndāvane devī-gaṇa, kuñja-dāsī yata jana,
> phala pāḍi' āniyā sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:taru]]-[[synonyms:l:latā]]---trees and creepers; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]---wonderful; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---their story; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---twelve months; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---produce; [[synonyms:p:phula]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruits and flowers; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:devī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kuñja]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---maidservants in the bowers; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---as many persons as there are; [[synonyms:p:phala]] [[synonyms:p:pāḍi']]---picking fruits; [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all varieties.
translation: "In Vṛndāvana, the trees and creepers are wonderful because throughout the entire year they produce all kinds of fruits and flowers. The gopīs and maidservants in the bowers of Vṛndāvana pick these fruits and flowers and bring them before Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.103
description: "The gopīs peeled all the fruits and placed them together on large plates on a platform in the jeweled cottage. They arranged the fruit in orderly rows for eating, and in front of it they made a place to sit.
text:
> uttama saṁskāra kari', baḍa baḍa thālī bhari',
> ratna-mandire piṇḍāra upare
> bhakṣaṇera krama kari', dhariyāche sāri sāri,
> āge āsana vasibāra tare
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uttama]]---topmost; [[synonyms:s:saṁskāra]]---cleaning; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---big; [[synonyms:t:thālī]]---plates; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling up; [[synonyms:r:ratna]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in the house of jewels; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the platform; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇera]] [[synonyms:k:krama]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making arrangements for eating; [[synonyms:d:dhariyāche]]---have kept; [[synonyms:s:sāri]] [[synonyms:s:sāri]]---one after another; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:ā:āsana]]---sitting place; [[synonyms:v:vasibāra]] [[synonyms:t:tare]]---to sit down.
translation: "The gopīs peeled all the fruits and placed them together on large plates on a platform in the jeweled cottage. They arranged the fruit in orderly rows for eating, and in front of it they made a place to sit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.104
description: "Among the fruits were many varieties of coconut and mango, bananas, berries, jackfruits, dates, tangerines, oranges, blackberries, santarās, grapes, almonds and all kinds of dried fruit.
text:
> eka nārikela nānā-jāti, eka āmra nānā bhāti,
> kalā, koli---vividha-prakāra
> panasa, kharjura, kamalā, nāraṅga, jāma, santarā,
> drākṣā, bādāma, meoyā yata āra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one item; [[synonyms:n:nārikela]]---coconut; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---of many varieties; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ā:āmra]]---mango; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:b:bhāti]]---of many different qualities; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---banana; [[synonyms:k:koli]]---berries; [[synonyms:v:vividha]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---of different varieties; [[synonyms:p:panasa]]---jackfruit; [[synonyms:k:kharjura]]---dates; [[synonyms:k:kamalā]]---tangerines; [[synonyms:n:nāraṅga]]---oranges; [[synonyms:j:jāma]]---blackberries; [[synonyms:s:santarā]]---another type of tangerine; [[synonyms:d:drākṣā]]---grapes; [[synonyms:b:bādāma]]---almonds; [[synonyms:m:meoyā]]---dried fruits; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as there are; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and.
translation: "Among the fruits were many varieties of coconut and mango, bananas, berries, jackfruits, dates, tangerines, oranges, blackberries, santarās, grapes, almonds and all kinds of dried fruit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.105
description: "There were cantaloupes, kṣirikās, palmfruits, keśuras, waterfruits, lotus fruits, bel, pīlu, pomegranate and many others. Some of them are variously known in different places, but in Vṛndāvana they are always available in so many thousands of varieties that no one can fully describe them.
text:
> kharamujā, kṣīrikā, tāla, keśura, pānī-phala, mṛṇāla,
> bilva, pīlu, dāḍimbādi yata
> kona deśe kāra khyāti, vṛndāvane saba-prāpti,
> sahasra-jāti, lekhā yāya kata?
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kharamujā]]---cantaloupe; [[synonyms:k:kṣīrikā]]---//kṣīrikā// fruit; [[synonyms:t:tāla]]---palm or palmyra fruit; [[synonyms:k:keśura]]---//keśura// fruit; [[synonyms:p:pānī]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---a fruit produced in the water of rivers; [[synonyms:m:mṛṇāla]]---a fruit from lotus flowers; [[synonyms:b:bilva]]---bel fruit; [[synonyms:p:pīlu]]---a special fruit in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dāḍimba]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---the pomegranate and other similar fruits; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as there are; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:d:deśe]]---in some country; [[synonyms:k:kāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:k:khyāti]]---of fame; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:s:saba]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---obtainment of all; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---thousands of varieties; [[synonyms:l:lekhā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---one is able to write; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---how much.
translation: "There were cantaloupes, kṣirikās, palmfruits, keśuras, waterfruits, lotus fruits, bel, pīlu, pomegranate and many others. Some of them are variously known in different places, but in Vṛndāvana they are always available in so many thousands of varieties that no one can fully describe them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.106
description: "At home Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī had made various types of sweetmeats from milk and sugar, such as gaṅgājala, amṛtakeli, pīyūṣagranthi, karpūrakeli, sarapūrī, amṛti, padmacini and khaṇḍa-kṣīrisāra-vṛkṣa. She had then brought them all for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> gaṅgājala, amṛtakeli, pīyūṣagranthi, karpūrakeli,
> sarapūrī, amṛti, padmacini
> khaṇḍa-kṣīrisāra-vṛkṣa, ghare kari' nānā bhakṣya,
> rādhā yāhā kṛṣṇa lāgi' āni
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:j:jala]]---the sweetmeat //gaṅgājala//; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---a sweetmeat made of milk; [[synonyms:p:pīyūṣa]]-[[synonyms:g:granthi]]---//pīyūṣagranthi//; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---//karpūrakeli//; [[synonyms:s:sara]]-[[synonyms:p:pūrī]]---a sweet made from milk; [[synonyms:a:amṛti]]---a sweet prepared from rice flour; [[synonyms:p:padma]]-[[synonyms:c:cini]]---a sweet preparation made from lotus flowers; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣīri]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]---sugar sweets made in the shape of trees; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]---varieties of eatables; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---which; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āni]]---brought.
translation: "At home Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī had made various types of sweetmeats from milk and sugar, such as gaṅgājala, amṛtakeli, pīyūṣagranthi, karpūrakeli, sarapūrī, amṛti, padmacini and khaṇḍa-kṣīrisāra-vṛkṣa. She had then brought them all for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.107
description: "When Kṛṣṇa saw the very nice arrangement of food, He happily sat down and had a forest picnic. Then, after Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and Her gopī friends partook of the remnants, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa lay down together in the jeweled house.
text:
> bhakṣyera paripāṭī dekhi', kṛṣṇa hailā mahā-sukhī,
> vasi' kaila vanya bhojana
> saṅge lañā sakhī-gaṇa, rādhā kailā bhojana,
> duṅhe kailā mandire śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakṣyera]]---of eatables; [[synonyms:p:paripāṭī]]---the arrangements; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhī]]---very happy; [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting down; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:v:vanya]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---a picnic in the forest; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in association; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took the remnants; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in the jeweled house; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lying down.
translation: "When Kṛṣṇa saw the very nice arrangement of food, He happily sat down and had a forest picnic. Then, after Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī and Her gopī friends partook of the remnants, Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa lay down together in the jeweled house.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.108
description: "Some of the gopīs fanned Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, others massaged Their feet, and some fed Them betel leaves to chew. When Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa fell asleep, all the other gopīs also lay down. When I saw this, My mind was very happy.
text:
> keha kare vījana, keha pāda-samvāhana,
> keha karāya tāmbūla bhakṣaṇa
> rādhā-kṛṣṇa nidrā gelā, sakhī-gaṇa śayana kailā,
> dekhi' āmāra sukhī haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:v:vījana]]---fanning; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging of the feet; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---made them do; [[synonyms:t:tāmbūla]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---eating a preparation of betel leaves; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nidrā]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went to sleep; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---lay down; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:s:sukhī]]---happy; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: "Some of the gopīs fanned Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa, others massaged Their feet, and some fed Them betel leaves to chew. When Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa fell asleep, all the other gopīs also lay down. When I saw this, My mind was very happy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.109
description: "Suddenly, all of you created a great tumult and picked Me up and brought Me back here. Where now is the River Yamunā? Where is Vṛndāvana? Where are Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs? You have broken My happy dream!"
text:
> hena-kāle more dhari, mahā-kolāhala kari;,
> tumi-saba ihāṅ lañā āilā
> kāṅhā yamunā, vṛndāvana, kāṅhā kṛṣṇa, gopī-gaṇa,
> sei sukha bhaṅga karāilā!"
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:more]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---picking Me up; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:k:kolāhala]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---and making a great tumult; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of you; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---where; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]]---the Yamunā River; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---where; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---that happiness; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅga]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---you have broken.
translation: "Suddenly, all of you created a great tumult and picked Me up and brought Me back here. Where now is the River Yamunā? Where is Vṛndāvana? Where are Kṛṣṇa and the gopīs? You have broken My happy dream!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.11
description: So as not to increase the size of this book, I have not written about all the Lord's pastimes, for He performed them every moment of every day for twelve years.
text:
> dvādaśa vatsare ye ye līlā kṣaṇe-kṣaṇe
> ati-bāhulya-bhaye grantha nā kailuṅ likhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]] [[synonyms:v:vatsare]]---in twelve years; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---moment after moment; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhulya]]---too abundant; [[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---being afraid of; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---book; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]] [[synonyms:l:likhane]]---I have written.
translation: So as not to increase the size of this book, I have not written about all the Lord's pastimes, for He performed them every moment of every day for twelve years.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.110
description: Speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fully returned to external consciousness. Seeing Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, the Lord questioned him.
text:
> eteka kahite prabhura kevala 'bāhya' haila
> svarūpa-gosāñire dekhi' tāṅhāre puchila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eteka]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---while speaking; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---only; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---external consciousness; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñire]]---Svarūpa Gosāñi; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]] [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---He asked him.
translation: Speaking in this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fully returned to external consciousness. Seeing Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, the Lord questioned him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.111
description: "Why have you brought Me here?" He asked. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara answered Him.
text:
> 'ihāṅ kene tomarā āmāre lañā āilā?'
> svarūpa-gosāñi tabe kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:t:tomarā]]---you; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---Me; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---have brought; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: "Why have you brought Me here?" He asked. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara answered Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.112
description: "You mistook the sea for the Yamunā River," he said, "and You jumped into it. You have been carried this far by the waves of the sea.
text:
> "yamunāra bhrame tumi samudre paḍilā
> samudreṛa taraṅge āsi, eta dūra āilā!
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yamunāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhrame]]---in mistaking for the Yamunā; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---in the sea; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell; [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---by the waves of the sea; [[synonyms:ā:āsi]]---coming; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---this; [[synonyms:d:dūra]]---far; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---You have come.
translation: "You mistook the sea for the Yamunā River," he said, "and You jumped into it. You have been carried this far by the waves of the sea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.113
description: "This fisherman caught You in his net and rescued You from the water. Because of Your touch, he is now mad with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei jāliyā jāle kari' tomā uṭhāila
> tomāra paraśe ei preme matta ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:j:jāliyā]]---this fisherman; [[synonyms:j:jāle]]---in the net; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---catching; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---You; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāila]]---rescued from the water; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:p:paraśe]]---by Your touch; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this man; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:matta]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became maddened.
translation: "This fisherman caught You in his net and rescued You from the water. Because of Your touch, he is now mad with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.114
description: "Throughout the night, we all walked about in search of You. After hearing from this fisherman, we came here and found You.
text:
> saba rātri sabe beḍāi tomāre anveṣiyā
> jāliyāra mukhe śuni' pāinu āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---the whole night; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of us; [[synonyms:b:beḍāi]]---walked; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---You; [[synonyms:a:anveṣiyā]]---searching for; [[synonyms:j:jāliyāra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouth of this fisherman; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---we found; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming.
translation: "Throughout the night, we all walked about in search of You. After hearing from this fisherman, we came here and found You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.115
description: "While apparently unconscious, You witnessed the pastimes in Vṛndāvana, but when we saw You unconscious, we suffered great agony in our minds.
text:
> tumi mūrcchā-chale vṛndāvane dekha krīḍā
> tomāra mūrcchā dekhi' sabe mane pāi pīḍā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:m:mūrcchā]]-[[synonyms:c:chale]]---pretending to be unconscious; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---see; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---the pastimes; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:m:mūrcchā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing Your unconsciousness; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of us; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---get; [[synonyms:p:pīḍā]]---agony.
translation: "While apparently unconscious, You witnessed the pastimes in Vṛndāvana, but when we saw You unconscious, we suffered great agony in our minds.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.116
description: "When we chanted the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, however, You came to semiconsciousness, and we have all been hearing You speak like a madman."
text:
> kṛṣṇa-nāma la-ite tomāra 'ardha-bāhya' ha-ila
> tāte ye pralāpa kailā, tāhā ye śunila"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhya]]---half-consciousness; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---crazy talks; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---You did; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:ś:śunila]]---have heard.
translation: "When we chanted the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, however, You came to semiconsciousness, and we have all been hearing You speak like a madman."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.117
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In My dream I went to Vṛndāvana, where I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa perform the rāsa dance with all the gopīs.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"svapne dekhi' gelāṅa vṛndāvane
> dekhi,---kṛṣṇa rāsa karena gopīgaṇa-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:s:svapne]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---dreaming; [[synonyms:g:gelāṅa]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---I went to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with the //gopīs.//
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "In My dream I went to Vṛndāvana, where I saw Lord Kṛṣṇa perform the rāsa dance with all the gopīs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.118
description: "After sporting in the water, Kṛṣṇa enjoyed a picnic. I can understand that after seeing this, I must certainly have talked like a madman."
text:
> jala-krīḍā kari' kailā vanya-bhojane
> dekhi' āmi pralāpa kailuṅ---hena laya mane"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---sports in the water; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---performing; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---had; [[synonyms:v:vanya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---a picnic; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]] [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---talked crazily; [[synonyms:h:hena]]---such; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---takes; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in My mind.
translation: "After sporting in the water, Kṛṣṇa enjoyed a picnic. I can understand that after seeing this, I must certainly have talked like a madman."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.119
description: Thereafter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī had Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathe in the sea, and then he very happily brought Him back home.
text:
> tabe svarūpa-gosāñi taṅre snāna karāñā
> prabhure lañā ghara āilā ānandita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:karāñā]]---causing to bathe; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came back to His house; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very happy.
translation: Thereafter, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī had Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bathe in the sea, and then he very happily brought Him back home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.12
description: As I have previously indicated, I am describing the mad speeches and bodily transformations of the Lord only in brief.
text:
> pūrve yei dekhāñāchi dig-daraśana
> taiche jāniha 'vikāra' 'pralāpa' varṇana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---as; [[synonyms:d:dekhāñāchi]]---I have shown; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---only an indication; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:j:jāniha]]---you may know; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---crazy talks; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description.
translation: As I have previously indicated, I am describing the mad speeches and bodily transformations of the Lord only in brief.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.120
description: Thus I have described the incident of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's falling into the ocean. Anyone who listens to this pastime will certainly attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ prabhura samudra-patana
> ihā yei śune, pāya caitanya-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---thus; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:p:patana]]---the falling into the sea; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this story; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---anyone who hears; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---obtains; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Thus I have described the incident of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's falling into the ocean. Anyone who listens to this pastime will certainly attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.121
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Eighteenth Chapter, describing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's falling into the water of the sea.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.13
description: If Ananta, with His one thousand hoods, tried to describe even one day's pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He would find them impossible to describe fully.
text:
> sahasra-vadane yabe kahaye 'ananta'
> eka-dinera līlāra tabu nāhi pāya anta
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:v:vadane]]---in thousands of mouths; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:k:kahaye]]---says; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---Lord Ananta; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dinera]]---of one day; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---reach; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---the limit.
translation: If Ananta, with His one thousand hoods, tried to describe even one day's pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, He would find them impossible to describe fully.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.14
description: If Gaṇeśa, Lord Śiva's son and the expert scribe of the demigods, tried for millions of millenniums to fully describe one day of the Lord's pastimes, he would be unable to find their limit.
text:
> koṭi-yuga paryanta yadi likhaye gaṇeśa
> eka-dinera līlāra tabu nāhi pāya śeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:y:yuga]]---millions of millenniums; [[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---to the extent of; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:l:likhaye]]---writes; [[synonyms:g:gaṇeśa]]---the demigod Gaṇeśa (son of Lord Śiva); [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dinera]]---of one day; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---can not reach; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---the limit.
translation: If Gaṇeśa, Lord Śiva's son and the expert scribe of the demigods, tried for millions of millenniums to fully describe one day of the Lord's pastimes, he would be unable to find their limit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.15
description: Even Lord Kṛṣṇa is struck with wonder at seeing the transformations of ecstasy in His devotees. If Kṛṣṇa Himself cannot estimate the limits of such emotions, how could others?
text:
> bhaktera prema-vikāra dekhi' kṛṣṇera camatkāra!
> kṛṣṇa yāra nā pāya anta, kebā chāra āra?
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of a devotee; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations of ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---wonder; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---cannot get; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---the limit; [[synonyms:k:kebā]]---who; [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---insignificant; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---others.
translation: Even Lord Kṛṣṇa is struck with wonder at seeing the transformations of ecstasy in His devotees. If Kṛṣṇa Himself cannot estimate the limits of such emotions, how could others?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.16-17
description: Kṛṣṇa Himself cannot fully understand the conditions, the mode of progress, the happiness and unhappiness, and the moods of ecstatic love of His devotees. He therefore accepts the role of a devotee to taste these emotions fully.
text:
> bhakta-premāra yata daśā, ye gati prakāra
> yata duḥkha, yata sukha, yateka vikāra
>
> kṛṣṇa tāhā samyak nā pāre jānite
> bhakta-bhāva aṅgīkare tahā āsvādite
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of the ecstatic emotion of the devotee; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]---conditions; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:g:gati]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---mode of progress; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:y:yateka]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformation; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:s:samyak]]---fully; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:j:jānite]]---cannot understand; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---the mood of a devotee; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkare]]---He accepts; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste.
translation: Kṛṣṇa Himself cannot fully understand the conditions, the mode of progress, the happiness and unhappiness, and the moods of ecstatic love of His devotees. He therefore accepts the role of a devotee to taste these emotions fully.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.18
description: Ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa makes Kṛṣṇa and His devotees dance, and it also dances personally. In this way, all three dance together in one place.
text:
> kṛṣṇere nācāya premā, bhaktere nācāya
> āpane nācaye,---tine nāce eka-ṭhāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇere]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---causes to dance; [[synonyms:p:premā]]---love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhaktere]]---the devotee; [[synonyms:n:nācāya]]---causes to dance; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:n:nācaye]]---dances; [[synonyms:t:tine]]---all three; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dance; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in one place.
translation: Ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa makes Kṛṣṇa and His devotees dance, and it also dances personally. In this way, all three dance together in one place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.19
description: One who wants to describe the transformations of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is like a dwarf trying to catch the moon in the sky.
text:
> premāra vikāra varṇite cāhe yei jana
> cānda dharite cāhe, yena hañā 'vāmana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---transformations; [[synonyms:v:varṇite]]---to describe; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---which person; [[synonyms:c:cānda]] [[synonyms:d:dharite]]---to catch the moon; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---he wants; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:v:vāmana]]---a dwarf.
translation: One who wants to describe the transformations of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is like a dwarf trying to catch the moon in the sky.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.20
description: As the wind can carry away but a drop of the water in the ocean, a living entity can touch only a particle of the ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> vāyu yaiche sindhu-jalera hare eka 'kaṇa'
> kṛṣṇa-prema-kaṇa taiche jīvera sparśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāyu]]---the wind; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:s:sindhu]]-[[synonyms:j:jalera]]---of the water of the ocean; [[synonyms:h:hare]]---takes away; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one particle; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one particle of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:j:jīvera]] [[synonyms:s:sparśana]]---a living entity can touch.
translation: As the wind can carry away but a drop of the water in the ocean, a living entity can touch only a particle of the ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.21
description: Endless waves arise moment after moment in that ocean of love. How could an insignificant living entity estimate their limits?
text:
> kṣaṇe kṣaṇe uṭhe premāra taraṅga ananta
> jīva chāra kāhāṅ tāra pāibeka anta?
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]] [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---moment after moment; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---rise; [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:taraṅga]]---waves; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]---a living entity; [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---insignificant; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:p:pāibeka]]---will get; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---the limit.
translation: Endless waves arise moment after moment in that ocean of love. How could an insignificant living entity estimate their limits?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.22
description: Only a person on the level of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī can fully know what Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tastes in His love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya yāhā karena āsvādana
> sabe eka jāne tāhā svarūpādi 'gaṇa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---whatever; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tasting; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---fully; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees like Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
translation: Only a person on the level of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī can fully know what Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tastes in His love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.23
description: When an ordinary living entity describes the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he purifies himself by touching one drop of that great ocean.
text:
> jīva hañā kare yei tāhāra varṇana
> āpanā śodhite tāra choṅye eka 'kaṇa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jīva]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being an ordinary living entity; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whoever; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description; [[synonyms:ā:āpanā]]---himself; [[synonyms:ś:śodhite]]---to purify; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:c:choṅye]]---touches; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one particle.
translation: When an ordinary living entity describes the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he purifies himself by touching one drop of that great ocean.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.24
description: Thus all the verses about the rāsa-līlā dance were recited. Then finally the verse concerning the pastimes in the water was recited.
text:
> ei-mata rāsera śloka-sakala-i paḍilā
> śeṣe jala-kelira śloka paḍite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:rāsera]]---of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---all; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---recited; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣe]]---at the end; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:kelira]]---of pastimes in the water; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to recite.
translation: Thus all the verses about the rāsa-līlā dance were recited. Then finally the verse concerning the pastimes in the water was recited.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.25
description: "As an independent leader among elephants enters the water with its female elephants, Kṛṣṇa, who is transcendental to the Vedic principles of morality, entered the water of the Yamunā with the gopīs. His chest had brushed against their breasts, crushing His flower garland and coloring it with red kuṅkuma powder. Attracted by the fragrance of that garland, humming bumblebees followed Kṛṣṇa like celestial beings of Gandharvaloka. In this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa mitigated the fatigue of the rāsa dance."
text:
> tābhir yutaḥ śramam apohitum aṅga-saṅga-
> ghṛṣṭa-srajaḥ sa kuca-kuṅkuma-rañjitāyāḥ
> gandharva-pālibhir anudruta āviśad vāḥ
> śrānto gajībhir ibha-rāḍ iva bhinna-setuḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tābhiḥ]]---by them (the //gopīs//); [[synonyms:y:yutaḥ]]---accompanied; [[synonyms:ś:śramam]]---fatigue; [[synonyms:a:apohitum]]---to remove; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---by touching of the bodies; [[synonyms:g:ghṛṣṭa]]---crushed; [[synonyms:s:srajaḥ]]---from the flower garland; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:k:kuca]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṅkuma]]---by //kuṅkuma// on the breasts; [[synonyms:r:rañjitāyāḥ]]---colored; [[synonyms:g:gandharva]]-[[synonyms:p:pa]]---like celestial beings of Gandharvaloka; [[synonyms:a:alibhiḥ]]---by bees; [[synonyms:a:anudrutaḥ]]---followed; [[synonyms:ā:āviśat]]---entered; [[synonyms:v:vāḥ]]---the water; [[synonyms:ś:śrāntaḥ]]---being fatigued; [[synonyms:g:gajībhiḥ]]---by she-elephants; [[synonyms:i:ibha]]---of elephants; [[synonyms:r:rāṭ]]---the king; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:b:bhinna]]-[[synonyms:s:setuḥ]]---beyond the Vedic principles of morality.
translation: "As an independent leader among elephants enters the water with its female elephants, Kṛṣṇa, who is transcendental to the Vedic principles of morality, entered the water of the Yamunā with the gopīs. His chest had brushed against their breasts, crushing His flower garland and coloring it with red kuṅkuma powder. Attracted by the fragrance of that garland, humming bumblebees followed Kṛṣṇa like celestial beings of Gandharvaloka. In this way, Lord Kṛṣṇa mitigated the fatigue of the rāsa dance."
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.33.22).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.26
description: While thus wandering near the temple of Āiṭoṭā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly saw the sea.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu bhramite bhramite
> āiṭoṭā haite samudra dekhena ācambite
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhramite]] [[synonyms:b:bhramite]]---while wandering; [[synonyms:ā:āiṭoṭā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the temple of Āiṭoṭā; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]---the sea; [[synonyms:d:dekhena]]---sees; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly.
translation: While thus wandering near the temple of Āiṭoṭā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu suddenly saw the sea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.27
description: Brightened by the shining light of the moon, the high waves of the sea glittered like the waters of the River Yamunā.
text:
> candra-kāntye uchalita taraṅga ujjvala
> jhalamala kare,---yena 'yamunāra jala'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:candra]]-[[synonyms:k:kāntye]]---by the shining of the moon; [[synonyms:u:uchalita]]---swollen high; [[synonyms:t:taraṅga]]---waves; [[synonyms:u:ujjvala]]---very bright; [[synonyms:j:jhalamala]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---glitter; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:y:yamunāra]] [[synonyms:j:jala]]---the water of the River Yamunā.
translation: Brightened by the shining light of the moon, the high waves of the sea glittered like the waters of the River Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.28
description: Mistaking the sea for the Yamunā, the Lord ran swiftly and jumped into the water, unseen by the others.
text:
> yamunāra bhrame prabhu dhāñā calilā
> alakṣite yāi' sindhu-jale jhāṅpa dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yamunāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhrame]]---by mistaking for the Yamunā; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---began to run very swiftly; [[synonyms:a:alakṣite]]---without being seen; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:s:sindhu]]-[[synonyms:j:jale]]---into the water of the sea; [[synonyms:j:jhāṅpa]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---He jumped.
translation: Mistaking the sea for the Yamunā, the Lord ran swiftly and jumped into the water, unseen by the others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.29
description: Falling into the sea, He lost consciousness and could not understand where He was. Sometimes He sank beneath the waves, and sometimes He floated above them.
text:
> paḍitei haila mūrcchā, kichui nā jāne
> kabhu ḍubāya, kabhu bhāsāya taraṅgera gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paḍitei]]---falling down; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:m:mūrcchā]]---He became unconscious; [[synonyms:k:kichui]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---did not understand; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāya]]---cause to sink; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:b:bhāsāya]]---float; [[synonyms:t:taraṅgera]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the waves.
translation: Falling into the sea, He lost consciousness and could not understand where He was. Sometimes He sank beneath the waves, and sometimes He floated above them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.3
description: While thus living at Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu floated all day and night in an ocean of separation from Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei-mate mahāprabhu nīlācale vaise
> rātri-dine kṛṣṇa-vicchedārṇave bhāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---resides; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---night and day; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:viccheda]]---of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:arṇave]]---in the ocean; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---floats.
translation: While thus living at Jagannātha Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu floated all day and night in an ocean of separation from Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.30
description: The waves carried Him here and there like a piece of dry wood. Who can understand this dramatic performance by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?
text:
> taraṅge vahiyā phire,---yena śuṣka kāṣṭha
> ke bujhite pāre ei caitanyera nāṭa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---the waves; [[synonyms:v:vahiyā]] [[synonyms:p:phire]]---carry here and there; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]] [[synonyms:k:kāṣṭha]]---a piece of dry wood; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can understand; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭa]]---dramatic performance of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: The waves carried Him here and there like a piece of dry wood. Who can understand this dramatic performance by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.31
description: Keeping the Lord sometimes submerged and sometimes afloat, the waves carried Him toward the Koṇārka temple.
text:
> koṇārkera dike prabhure taraṅge lañā yāya
> kabhu ḍubāñā rākhe, kabhu bhāsāñā lañā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:koṇārkera]] [[synonyms:d:dike]]---toward the Koṇārka temple; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---the waves; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---take away; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāñā]]---causing to sink; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keep; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:b:bhāsāñā]]---floating; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---take away.
translation: Keeping the Lord sometimes submerged and sometimes afloat, the waves carried Him toward the Koṇārka temple.
purport: Koṇārka, generally known as Arka-tīrtha, is a temple of Lord Sūrya, the sun-god. It is situated on the seashore, nineteen miles north of Jagannātha Purī. It was constructed of black stone in the beginning of the thirteenth century of the Śaka Era, and it shows expert craftsmanship and architecture.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.32
description: Lord Kṛṣṇa performed pastimes with the gopīs in the waters of the Yamunā, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fully merged in those pastimes.
text:
> yamunāte jala-keli gopī-gaṇa-saṅge
> kṛṣṇa karena---mahāprabhu magna sei raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yamunāte]]---in the River Yamunā; [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]---pastimes in the water; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---Kṛṣṇa performs; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:magna]]---fully merged; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in those pastimes.
translation: Lord Kṛṣṇa performed pastimes with the gopīs in the waters of the Yamunā, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu fully merged in those pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.33
description: Meanwhile, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, lost sight of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Astonished, they began searching for Him, asking, "Where has the Lord gone?"
text:
> ihāṅ svarūpādi-gaṇa prabhu nā dekhiyā
> 'kāhāṅ gelā prabhu?' kahe camakita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---not seeing; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---has gone; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---say; [[synonyms:c:camakita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being astonished.
translation: Meanwhile, all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara, lost sight of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Astonished, they began searching for Him, asking, "Where has the Lord gone?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.34
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had run off at the speed of mind. No one could see Him. Thus everyone was puzzled as to His whereabouts.
text:
> mano-vege gelā prabhu, dekhite nārilā
> prabhure nā dekhiyā saṁśaya karite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:v:vege]]---at the speed of mind; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:n:nārilā]]---no one could see; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---not seeing; [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---doubts; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to feel.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had run off at the speed of mind. No one could see Him. Thus everyone was puzzled as to His whereabouts.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.35
description: "Has the Lord gone to the temple of Jagannātha, or has He fallen down in madness in some garden?
text:
> 'jagannātha dekhite kibā devālaye gelā?
> anya udyāne kibā unmāde paḍilā?
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---whether; [[synonyms:d:devālaye]]---to the temple; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---in a garden; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:u:unmāde]]---in madness; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down.
translation: "Has the Lord gone to the temple of Jagannātha, or has He fallen down in madness in some garden?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.36
description: "Perhaps He went to the Guṇḍicā temple, or to Lake Narendra, or to the Caṭaka-parvata. Maybe He went to the temple at Koṇārka."
text:
> guṇḍicā-mandire gelā, kibā narendrere?
> caṭaka-parvate gelā, kibā koṇārkere?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---to the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---has gone; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:n:narendrere]]---to the Narendra Lake; [[synonyms:c:caṭaka]]-[[synonyms:p:parvate]]---to Caṭaka-parvata; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---has gone; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:k:koṇārkere]]---to the Koṇārka temple.
translation: "Perhaps He went to the Guṇḍicā temple, or to Lake Narendra, or to the Caṭaka-parvata. Maybe He went to the temple at Koṇārka."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.37
description: Talking like this, the devotees wandered here and there looking for the Lord. Finally they came to the shore, accompanied by many others.
text:
> eta bali' sabe phire prabhure cāhiyā
> samudrera tīre āilā kata jana lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:p:phire]]---wander; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:c:cāhiyā]]---looking for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the seashore; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---many; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---people; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---accompanied by.
translation: Talking like this, the devotees wandered here and there looking for the Lord. Finally they came to the shore, accompanied by many others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.38
description: While they were searching for the Lord, the night ended, and thus they all decided, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has now disappeared."
text:
> cāhiye beḍāite aiche rātri-śeṣa haila
> 'antardhāna ha-ilā prabhu',---niścaya karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāhiye]]---looking; [[synonyms:b:beḍāite]]---wandering; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---the night ended; [[synonyms:a:antardhāna]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---has disappeared; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---they decided.
translation: While they were searching for the Lord, the night ended, and thus they all decided, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has now disappeared."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.39
description: In separation from the Lord, everyone felt as though he had lost his very life. They concluded that there must have been some mishap. They could not think of anything else.
text:
> prabhura vicchede kāra dehe nāhi prāṇa
> aniṣṭā-śaṅkā vinā kāra mane nāhi āna
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---from the Lord; [[synonyms:v:vicchede]]---due to separation; [[synonyms:k:kāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in the body; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---there was practically no life; [[synonyms:a:aniṣṭā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śaṅkā]]---doubts of some mishap; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---besides; [[synonyms:k:kāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---there is nothing else.
translation: In separation from the Lord, everyone felt as though he had lost his very life. They concluded that there must have been some mishap. They could not think of anything else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.4
description: During a night of the autumn season when a full moon brightened everything, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered all night long with His devotees.
text:
> śarat-kālera rātri, saba candrikā-ujjvala
> prabhu nija-gaṇa lañā beḍāna rātri-sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śarat]]-[[synonyms:k:kālera]]---of autumn; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---night; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:candrikā]]-[[synonyms:u:ujjvala]]---brightened by the moonlight; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---His own associates; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:b:beḍāna]]---walks; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:s:sakala]]---the whole night.
translation: During a night of the autumn season when a full moon brightened everything, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wandered all night long with His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.40
description: "A relative or intimate friend is always fearful of some injury to his beloved."
text: > "aniṣṭa-śaṅkīni bandhu-hṛdayāni bhavanti hi"
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aniṣṭa]]---of some mishap; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkīni]]---possessing doubts; [[synonyms:b:bandhu]]---of friends or relatives; [[synonyms:h:hṛdayāni]]---hearts; [[synonyms:b:bhavanti]]---become; [[synonyms:h:hi]]---certainly.
translation: "A relative or intimate friend is always fearful of some injury to his beloved."
purport: This is a quotation from the //Abhijñāna-śakuntala-nāṭaka.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.41
description: When they arrived at the seashore, they conferred among themselves. Then some of them sought out Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Caṭaka-parvata.
text:
> samudrera tīre āsi' yukati karilā
> cirāyu-parvata-dike kata-jana gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the seashore; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:y:yukati]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---they consulted among themselves; [[synonyms:c:cirāyu]]-[[synonyms:p:parvata]]---of Caṭaka-parvata; [[synonyms:d:dike]]---in the direction; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---some of them; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went.
translation: When they arrived at the seashore, they conferred among themselves. Then some of them sought out Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Caṭaka-parvata.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.42
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara proceeded east with others, looking for the Lord on the beach or in the water.
text:
> pūrva-diśāya cale svarūpa lañā kata jana
> sindhu-tīre-nīre karena prabhura anveṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:d:diśāya]]---in the eastern direction; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---some persons; [[synonyms:s:sindhu]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the seashore; [[synonyms:n:nīre]]---in the water; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:anveṣaṇa]]---searching.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara proceeded east with others, looking for the Lord on the beach or in the water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.43
description: Everyone was overwhelmed with moroseness and almost unconscious, but out of ecstatic love they continued to wander here and there, searching for the Lord.
text:
> viṣāde vihvala sabe, nāhika 'cetana'
> tabu preme bule kari' prabhura anveṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viṣāde]]---in great moroseness; [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---in everyone; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]]---there was not; [[synonyms:c:cetana]]---consciousness; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love; [[synonyms:b:bule]]---wander; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:anveṣaṇa]]---searching for.
translation: Everyone was overwhelmed with moroseness and almost unconscious, but out of ecstatic love they continued to wander here and there, searching for the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.44
description: Passing along the beach, they saw a fisherman approaching with his net over his shoulder. Laughing, crying, dancing and singing, he kept repeating the holy name"Hari, Hari."
text:
> dekhena---eka jāliyā āise kāndhe jāla kari'
> hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya, bale 'hari' 'hari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhena]]---they see; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:j:jāliyā]]---one fisherman; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes; [[synonyms:k:kāndhe]]---on the shoulder; [[synonyms:j:jāla]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---carrying a net; [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---laughs; [[synonyms:k:kānde]]---cries; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---sings; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---says; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Hari, Hari.
translation: Passing along the beach, they saw a fisherman approaching with his net over his shoulder. Laughing, crying, dancing and singing, he kept repeating the holy name"Hari, Hari."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.45
description: Seeing the activities of the fisherman, everyone was astonished. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, therefore, asked him for information.
text:
> jāliyāra ceṣṭā dekhi' sabāra camatkāra
> svarūpa-gosāñi tāre puchena samācāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jāliyāra]]---of the fisherman; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---activity; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---astonishment; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosāñi; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:p:puchena]]---inquires; [[synonyms:s:samācāra]]---news.
translation: Seeing the activities of the fisherman, everyone was astonished. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, therefore, asked him for information.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.46
description: "My dear fisherman," he said, "why are you behaving like this? Have you seen someone hereabouts? What is the cause of your behavior? Please tell us."
text:
> "kaha, jāliyā, ei dike dekhilā eka-jana?
> tomāra ei daśā kene,---kahata' kāraṇa?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---please say; [[synonyms:j:jāliyā]]---O fisherman; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dike]]---in this direction; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---did you see; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---someone; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---condition; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kahata']]---kindly speak; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---the cause.
translation: "My dear fisherman," he said, "why are you behaving like this? Have you seen someone hereabouts? What is the cause of your behavior? Please tell us."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.47
description: The fisherman replied, "I have not seen a single person here, but while casting my net in the water, I captured a dead body.
text:
> jāliyā kahe,---"ihāṅ eka manuṣya nā dekhila
> jāla vāhite eka mṛtaka mora jāle āila
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jāliyā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the fisherman said; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---man; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---I did not see; [[synonyms:j:jāla]] [[synonyms:v:vāhite]]---while I was working with the net; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:mṛtaka]]---dead body; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:j:jāle]]---in my net; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came.
translation: The fisherman replied, "I have not seen a single person here, but while casting my net in the water, I captured a dead body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.48
description: "I lifted it with great care, thinking it a big fish, but as soon as I saw that it was a corpse, great fear arose in my mind.
text:
> baḍa matsya bali' āmi uṭhāiluṅ yatane
> mṛtaka dekhite mora bhaya haila mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---great; [[synonyms:m:matsya]]---fish; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---thinking to be; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāiluṅ]]---lifted; [[synonyms:y:yatane]]---with care; [[synonyms:m:mṛtaka]]---the dead body; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---seeing; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---fear; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind.
translation: "I lifted it with great care, thinking it a big fish, but as soon as I saw that it was a corpse, great fear arose in my mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.49
description: "As I tried to release the net, I touched the body, and as soon as I touched it, a ghost entered my heart.
text:
> jāla khasāite tāra aṅga-sparśa ha-ila
> sparśa-mātre sei bhūta hṛdaye paśila
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jāla]]---the net; [[synonyms:k:khasāite]]---releasing; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:sparśa]]---touch of the body; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:s:sparśa]]-[[synonyms:m:mātre]]---as soon as I touched it; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhūta]]---ghost; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:p:paśila]]---entered.
translation: "As I tried to release the net, I touched the body, and as soon as I touched it, a ghost entered my heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.5
description: He walked from garden to garden, seeing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa and hearing and reciting songs and verses concerning the rāsa-līlā.
text:
> udyāne udyāne bhramena kautuka dekhite
> rāsa-līlāra gīta-śloka paḍite śunite
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:udyāne]] [[synonyms:u:udyāne]]---from garden to garden; [[synonyms:b:bhramena]]---He walks; [[synonyms:k:kautuka]] [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---seeing the fun; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---songs and verses; [[synonyms:p:paḍite]] [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---reciting and hearing.
translation: He walked from garden to garden, seeing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa and hearing and reciting songs and verses concerning the rāsa-līlā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.50
description: "I shivered in fear and shed tears. My voice faltered, and all the hairs on my body stood up.
text:
> bhaye kampa haila, mora netre vahe jala
> gadgada vāṇī, roma uṭhila sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---out of fear; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---shivering; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:n:netre]]---in the eyes; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---flow; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---tears; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]---faltering; [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---voice; [[synonyms:r:roma]]---body hair; [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---stood up; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all.
translation: "I shivered in fear and shed tears. My voice faltered, and all the hairs on my body stood up.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.51
description: "I do not know whether it was the ghost of a dead brāhmaṇa or an ordinary man, but as soon as one looks upon it, it enters his body.
text:
> kibā brahma-daitya, kibā bhūta, kahane nā yāya
> darśana-mātre manuṣyera paiśe sei kāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---whether; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:d:daitya]]---a //brāhmaṇa// ghost; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:b:bhūta]]---an ordinary ghost; [[synonyms:k:kahane]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---I cannot say; [[synonyms:d:darśana]]-[[synonyms:m:mātre]]---as soon as one sees; [[synonyms:m:manuṣyera]]---of a man; [[synonyms:p:paiśe]]---enters; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kāya]]---that body.
translation: "I do not know whether it was the ghost of a dead brāhmaṇa or an ordinary man, but as soon as one looks upon it, it enters his body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.52
description: "The body of this ghost is very long, five to seven cubits. Each of its arms and legs is as much as three cubits long.
text:
> śarīra dīghala tāra---hāta pāṅca-sāta
> ekeka-hasta-pada tāra, tina tina hāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śarīra]]---body; [[synonyms:d:dīghala]]---long; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---cubits (one cubit approximately equals a foot and a half); [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:s:sāta]]---five to seven; [[synonyms:e:ekeka]]---each and every; [[synonyms:h:hasta]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]---arm and leg; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:t:tina]]---three; [[synonyms:h:hāta]]---cubits.
translation: "The body of this ghost is very long, five to seven cubits. Each of its arms and legs is as much as three cubits long.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.53
description: "Its joints are all separated beneath the skin, which is completely slack. No one could see it and remain alive in his body.
text:
> asthi-sandhi chuṭile carma kare naḍa-baḍe
> tāhā dekhi' prāṇa kā'ra nāhi rahe dhaḍe
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:asthi]]-[[synonyms:s:sandhi]]---the joints of the bones; [[synonyms:c:chuṭile]]---being separated; [[synonyms:c:carma]]---the skin; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:n:naḍa]]-[[synonyms:b:baḍe]]---hanging; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:k:kā'ra]]---whose; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:d:dhaḍe]]---in the body.
translation: "Its joints are all separated beneath the skin, which is completely slack. No one could see it and remain alive in his body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.54
description: "That ghost has taken the form of a corpse, but he keeps his eyes open. Sometimes he utters the sounds'goṅ-goṅ,' and sometimes he remains unconscious.
text:
> maḍā-rūpa dhari' rahe uttāna-nayana
> kabhu goṅ-goṅ kare, kabhu rahe acetana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:maḍā]]---of a dead body; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---the form; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---accepting; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:u:uttāna]]-[[synonyms:n:nayana]]---with open eyes; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:g:goṅ]]-[[synonyms:g:goṅ]]---the sound //goṅ-goṅ//; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:a:acetana]]---unconscious.
translation: "That ghost has taken the form of a corpse, but he keeps his eyes open. Sometimes he utters the sounds'goṅ-goṅ,' and sometimes he remains unconscious.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.55
description: "I have seen that ghost directly, and he is haunting me. But if I die, who will take care of my wife and children?
text:
> sākṣāt dekhechoṅ,---more pāila sei bhūta
> mui maile mora kaiche jīve strī-put
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]---directly; [[synonyms:d:dekhechoṅ]]---I have seen; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---has entered; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhūta]]---ghost; [[synonyms:m:mui]] [[synonyms:m:maile]]---if I die; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:k:kaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:j:jīve]]---will live; [[synonyms:s:strī]]-[[synonyms:p:put]]---wife and children.
translation: "I have seen that ghost directly, and he is haunting me. But if I die, who will take care of my wife and children?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.56
description: "The ghost is certainly very difficult to talk about, but I am going to find an exorcist and ask him if he can release me from it.
text:
> sei ta' bhūtera kathā kahana nā yāya
> ojhā-ṭhāñi yāichoṅ,---yadi se bhūta chāḍāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhūtera]]---of the ghost; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics; [[synonyms:k:kahana]]---to speak; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is not possible; [[synonyms:o:ojhā]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to the exorcist; [[synonyms:y:yāichoṅ]]---I am going; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhūta]]---the ghost; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāya]]---he can cause to leave.
translation: "The ghost is certainly very difficult to talk about, but I am going to find an exorcist and ask him if he can release me from it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.57
description: "I wander alone at night killing fish in solitary places, but because I remember the hymn to Lord Nṛsiṁha, ghosts do not touch me.
text:
> ekā rātrye buli' matsya māriye nirjane
> bhūta-preta āmāra nā lāge 'nṛsiṁha'-smaraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ekā]]---alone; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:b:buli']]---wandering; [[synonyms:m:matsya]]---fish; [[synonyms:m:māriye]]---I kill; [[synonyms:n:nirjane]]---in solitary places; [[synonyms:b:bhūta]]-[[synonyms:p:preta]]---ghosts; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---me; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---cannot touch; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]-[[synonyms:s:smaraṇe]]---by remembering Nṛsiṁha.
translation: "I wander alone at night killing fish in solitary places, but because I remember the hymn to Lord Nṛsiṁha, ghosts do not touch me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 18.58
description: "This ghost, however, overcomes me with redoubled strength when I chant the Nṛsiṁha mantra. When I even see the form of this ghost, great fear arises in my mind.
text:
> ei bhūta nṛsiṁha-nāme cāpaye dviguṇe
> tāhāra ākāra dekhite bhaya lāge mane
