synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:carita]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]-[[synonyms:n:nūtana]]---always fresh; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]] [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---by hearing and hearing; [[synonyms:j:juḍāya]]---becomes pacified; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]-[[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---the ear and heart.
translation: Caitanya-caritāmṛta is ever-increasingly fresh. Continuously hearing it pacifies one's heart and ear.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.112
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Nineteenth Chapter, describing the Lord's devotion to His mother, His mad speeches in separation from Kṛṣṇa, His rubbing His face against the walls, and His dancing in the Jagannātha-vallabha garden.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.12
description: Following the order of Paramānanda Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent His mother the prasāda clothing left by Lord Jagannātha after His pastimes as a cowherd boy.
text:
> gopa-līlāya pāilā yei prasāda-vasane
> mātāre pāṭhāna tāhā purīra vacane
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---in His pastimes as a cowherd boy; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---got; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnant; [[synonyms:v:vasane]]---clothing; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---unto His mother; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāna]]---sent; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:purīra]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---on the order of Paramānanda Purī.
translation: Following the order of Paramānanda Purī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent His mother the prasāda clothing left by Lord Jagannātha after His pastimes as a cowherd boy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.13
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very carefully brought first-class prasāda from Lord Jagannātha and sent it in separate packages to His mother and the devotees at Nadia.
text:
> jagannāthera uttama prasāda āniyā yatane
> mātāre pṛthak pāṭhāna, āra bhakta-gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:u:uttama]]---first class; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of food; [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]] [[synonyms:y:yatane]]---bringing very carefully; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---unto His mother; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separately; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāna]]---sends; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---and to the other devotees.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu very carefully brought first-class prasāda from Lord Jagannātha and sent it in separate packages to His mother and the devotees at Nadia.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.14
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the topmost gem of all devotees of mothers. He rendered service to His mother even after He had accepted the vow of sannyāsa.
text:
> mātṛ-bhakta-gaṇera prabhu hana śiromaṇi
> sannyāsa kariyā sadā sevena jananī
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mātṛ]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the devotees of mothers; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hana]]---is; [[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the topmost jewel; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---even after taking the //sannyāsa// order; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:s:sevena]]---renders service; [[synonyms:j:jananī]]---to His mother.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the topmost gem of all devotees of mothers. He rendered service to His mother even after He had accepted the vow of sannyāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.15
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thus returned to Nadia, and when he met Śacīmātā, he conveyed to her all the Lord's salutations.
text:
> jagadānanda nadīyā giyā mātāre mililā
> prabhura yata nivedana, sakala kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:n:nadīyā]]---to Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---mother Śacī; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---all kinds of salutations; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---everything; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he told.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita thus returned to Nadia, and when he met Śacīmātā, he conveyed to her all the Lord's salutations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.16
description: He then met all the other devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, and gave them the prasāda of Jagannātha. After staying for one month, he took permission from mother Śacī to leave.
text:
> ācāryādi bhakta-gaṇe mililā prasāda diyā
> mātā-ṭhāñi ājñā la-ilā māseka rahiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---he met; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---delivering the //prasāda// of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from mother Śacī; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---took permission to leave; [[synonyms:m:māseka]] [[synonyms:r:rahiyā]]---remaining for one month.
translation: He then met all the other devotees, headed by Advaita Ācārya, and gave them the prasāda of Jagannātha. After staying for one month, he took permission from mother Śacī to leave.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.17
description: When he went to Advaita Ācārya and also asked His permission to return, Advaita Prabhu gave him a message to deliver to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ācāryera ṭhāñi giyā ājñā māgilā
> ācārya-gosāñi prabhure sandeśa kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryera]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgilā]]---begged for permission to leave; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sandeśa]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---sent a message.
translation: When he went to Advaita Ācārya and also asked His permission to return, Advaita Prabhu gave him a message to deliver to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.18
description: Advaita Ācārya had written a sonnet in equivocal language with an import that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand but others could not.
text:
> tarajā-prahelī ācārya kahena ṭhāre-ṭhore
> prabhu mātra bujhena, keha bujhite nā pāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tarajā]]-[[synonyms:p:prahelī]]---a sonnet in equivocal language; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---spoke; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāre]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhore]]---making some indications; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:b:bujhena]]---could understand; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:b:bujhite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---others could not understand.
translation: Advaita Ācārya had written a sonnet in equivocal language with an import that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could understand but others could not.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.19
description: In His sonnet, Advaita Prabhu first offered His obeisances hundreds and thousands of times unto the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He then submitted the following statement at His lotus feet.
text:
> "prabhure kahiha āmāra koṭi namaskāra
> ei nivedana tāṅra caraṇe āmāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---just inform Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]] [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---hundreds and thousands of obeisances; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---this is the submission; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---unto the lotus feet; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My.
translation: In His sonnet, Advaita Prabhu first offered His obeisances hundreds and thousands of times unto the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He then submitted the following statement at His lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Gaurāṅga.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Lord Nityānanda! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.20
description: "Please inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is acting like a madman, that everyone here has become mad like Him. Inform Him also that in the marketplace, rice is no longer in demand.
text:
> bāulake kahiha,---loka ha-ila bāula
> bāulake kahiha,---hāṭe nā vikāya cāula
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāulake]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---please inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is playing the part of a madman in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---the people in general; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---have become; [[synonyms:b:bāula]]---also mad in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bāulake]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---again inform Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the //bāula//; [[synonyms:h:hāṭe]]---in the market; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:v:vikāya]]---sells; [[synonyms:c:cāula]]---rice.
translation: "Please inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who is acting like a madman, that everyone here has become mad like Him. Inform Him also that in the marketplace, rice is no longer in demand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.21
description: "Those now mad in ecstatic love are no longer interested in the material world. Tell Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Advaita Prabhu, who has also become a madman in ecstatic love, has spoken these words."
text:
> bāulake kahiha,---kāye nāhika āula
> bāulake kahiha,---ihā kahiyāche bāula"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāulake]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---again inform the //bāula,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kāye]]---in business; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]]---there is not; [[synonyms:ā:āula]]---persons who have become mad in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bāulake]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---again inform the //bāula,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kahiyāche]]---has spoken; [[synonyms:b:bāula]]---another madman, Śrī Advaita Prabhu Himself.
translation: "Those now mad in ecstatic love are no longer interested in the material world. Tell Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Advaita Prabhu, who has also become a madman in ecstatic love, has spoken these words."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.22
description: When he heard Advaita Ācārya's statement, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita began to laugh, and when he returned to Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, he informed Caitanya Mahāprabhu of everything.
text:
> eta śuni' jagadānanda hāsite lāgilā
> nīlācale āsi' tabe prabhure kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:h:hāsite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to laugh; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---returning; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he told all this to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: When he heard Advaita Ācārya's statement, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita began to laugh, and when he returned to Jagannātha Purī, Nīlācala, he informed Caitanya Mahāprabhu of everything.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.23
description: After hearing the equivocal sonnet by Advaita Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu quietly smiled. "That is His order," He said. Then He fell silent.
text:
> tarajā śuni' mahāprabhu īṣat hāsilā
> 'tāṅra yei ājñā'---bali' mauna dharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tarajā]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing the sonnet; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]] [[synonyms:h:hāsilā]]---quietly smiled; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---that is His order; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:m:mauna]] [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---became silent.
translation: After hearing the equivocal sonnet by Advaita Ācārya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu quietly smiled. "That is His order," He said. Then He fell silent.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.24
description: Although he knew the secret, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī inquired from the Lord, "What is the meaning of this sonnet? I could not understand it."
text:
> jāniyāo svarūpa gosāñi prabhure puchila
> 'ei tarajāra artha bujhite nārila'
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jāniyāo]]---although knowing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:tarajāra]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning of this sonnet; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---to understand; [[synonyms:n:nārila]]---I was not able.
translation: Although he knew the secret, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī inquired from the Lord, "What is the meaning of this sonnet? I could not understand it."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.25
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Advaita Ācārya is a great worshiper of the Lord and is very expert in the regulative principles enjoined in the Vedic literatures.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---'ācārya haya pūjaka prabala
> āgama-śāstrera vidhi-vidhāne kuśala
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]] [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:p:pūjaka]] [[synonyms:p:prabala]]---Advaita Ācārya is a great worshiper; [[synonyms:ā:āgama]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstrera]]---of the Vedic literature; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhāne]] [[synonyms:k:kuśala]]---very expert in the regulative principles.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Advaita Ācārya is a great worshiper of the Lord and is very expert in the regulative principles enjoined in the Vedic literatures.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.26
description: "Advaita Ācārya invites the Lord to come and be worshiped, and to perform the worship He keeps the Deity for some time.
text:
> upāsanā lāgi' devera karena āvāhana
> pūjā lāgi' kata kāla karena nirodhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upāsanā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for worshiping the Deity; [[synonyms:d:devera]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ā:āvāhana]]---invites to come; [[synonyms:p:pūjā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---to perform the worship; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:k:kāla]]---for some time; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:n:nirodhana]]---He keeps the Deity.
translation: "Advaita Ācārya invites the Lord to come and be worshiped, and to perform the worship He keeps the Deity for some time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.27
description: "After the worship is completed, He sends the Deity somewhere else. I do not know the meaning of this sonnet, nor do I know what is in Advaita Prabhu's mind.
text:
> pūjā-nirvāhaṇa haile pāche karena visarjana
> tarajāra nā jāni artha, kibā tāṅra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūjā]]-[[synonyms:n:nirvāhaṇa]]---finishing of the worship; [[synonyms:h:haile]]---when there is; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---at last; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:v:visarjana]]---sends back the Deity; [[synonyms:t:tarajāra]]---of the sonnet; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning; [[synonyms:k:kibā]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---what is in His mind.
translation: "After the worship is completed, He sends the Deity somewhere else. I do not know the meaning of this sonnet, nor do I know what is in Advaita Prabhu's mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.28
description: "Advaita Ācārya is a great mystic. No one can understand Him. He is expert in writing sonnets that even I Myself cannot understand."
text:
> mahā-yogeśvara ācārya---tarajāte samartha
> āmiha bujhite nāri tarajāra artha'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogeśvara]]---the greatest mystic; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:t:tarajāte]] [[synonyms:s:samartha]]---very expert in writing sonnets; [[synonyms:ā:āmiha]]---and yet I; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---to understand; [[synonyms:n:nāri]]---am not able; [[synonyms:t:tarajāra]]---of the sonnet; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning.
translation: "Advaita Ācārya is a great mystic. No one can understand Him. He is expert in writing sonnets that even I Myself cannot understand."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.29
description: Hearing this, all the devotees were astonished, especially Svarūpa Dāmodara, who became somewhat morose.
text:
> śuniyā vismita ha-ilā saba bhakta-gaṇa
> svarūpa-gosāñi kichu ha-ilā vimana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---astonished; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---somewhat; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:v:vimana]]---morose.
translation: Hearing this, all the devotees were astonished, especially Svarūpa Dāmodara, who became somewhat morose.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.3
description: In the ecstasy of love of Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus behaved like a madman, talking insanely all day and night.
text:
> ei-mate mahāprabhu kṛṣṇa-premāveśe
> unmāda-pralāpa kare rātri-divase
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic emotional love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---madness; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---and crazy talk; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---throughout the entire day and night.
translation: In the ecstasy of love of Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus behaved like a madman, talking insanely all day and night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.30
description: From that day on, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's emotional state changed markedly; His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa doubled in intensity.
text:
> sei dina haite prabhura āra daśā ha-ila
> kṛṣṇera viccheda-daśā dviguṇa bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:dine]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from that day on; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---condition; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---from Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:viccheda]]-[[synonyms:d:daśā]]---the condition of separation; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---twice; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---increased.
translation: From that day on, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's emotional state changed markedly; His feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa doubled in intensity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.31
description: As His feelings of separation in the ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī increased at every moment, the Lord's activities, both day and night, were now wild, insane performances.
text:
> unmāda-pralāpa-ceṣṭā kare rātri-dine
> rādhā-bhāvāveśe viraha bāḍe anukṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]---madness; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---craziness; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---activities; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---He performed day and night; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in the ecstatic emotion of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]---separation; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increases; [[synonyms:a:anukṣaṇe]]---every moment.
translation: As His feelings of separation in the ecstasy of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī increased at every moment, the Lord's activities, both day and night, were now wild, insane performances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.32
description: Suddenly there awoke within Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the scene of Lord Kṛṣṇa's departure to Mathurā, and He began exhibiting the symptom of ecstatic madness known as udghūrṇā.
text:
> ācambite sphure kṛṣṇera mathurā-gamana
> udghūrṇā-daśā haila unmāda-lakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---suddenly; [[synonyms:s:sphure]]---there awoke; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]-[[synonyms:g:gamana]]---the departure for Mathurā; [[synonyms:u:udghūrṇā]]-[[synonyms:d:daśā]]---the ecstatic condition known as //udghūrṇā//; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---the symptom of madness.
translation: Suddenly there awoke within Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the scene of Lord Kṛṣṇa's departure to Mathurā, and He began exhibiting the symptom of ecstatic madness known as udghūrṇā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.33
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman, holding Rāmānanda Rāya by the neck, and He questioned Svarūpa Dāmodara, thinking him to be His gopī friend.
text:
> rāmānandera galā dhari' karena pralāpana
> svarūpe puchena māni' nija-sakhī-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānandera]]---of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:galā]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---holding the neck; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:pralāpana]]---begins talking like a crazy man; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]] [[synonyms:p:puchena]]---inquired from Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:māni']]---accepting; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---as a //gopī// friend.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman, holding Rāmānanda Rāya by the neck, and He questioned Svarūpa Dāmodara, thinking him to be His gopī friend.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.34
description: Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī inquired from Her personal friend Viśākhā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, reading that very verse, began speaking like a madman.
text:
> pūrve yena viśākhāre rādhikā puchilā
> sei śloka paḍi' pralāpa karite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:v:viśākhāre]]---unto Viśākhā; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]---Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---that verse; [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reading; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---talking like a crazy man; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to do.
translation: Just as Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī inquired from Her personal friend Viśākhā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, reading that very verse, began speaking like a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.35
description: "My dear friend, where is Kṛṣṇa, who is like the moon rising from the ocean of Mahārāja Nanda's dynasty? Where is Kṛṣṇa, His head decorated with a peacock feather? Where is He? Where is Kṛṣṇa, whose flute produces such a deep sound? Oh, where is Kṛṣṇa, whose bodily luster is like the luster of the blue indranīla jewel? Where is Kṛṣṇa, who is so expert in rāsa dancing? Oh, where is He who can save My life? Kindly tell Me where to find Kṛṣṇa, the treasure of My life and best of My friends. Feeling separation from Him, I hereby condemn Providence, the shaper of My destiny.'
text:
> kva nanda-kula-candramāḥ kva śikhi-candrakālaṅkṛtiḥ
> kva mandra-muralī-ravaḥ kva nu surendra-nīla-dyutiḥ
> kva rāsa-rasa-tāṇḍavī kva sakhi jīva-rakṣauṣadhir
> nidhir mama suhṛttamaḥ kva bata hanta hā dhig-vidhim
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:n:nanda]]-[[synonyms:k:kula]]-[[synonyms:c:candramāḥ]]---Kṛṣṇa, who has arisen like the moon in the ocean of the dynasty of Nanda Mahārāja; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:ś:śikhi]]-[[synonyms:c:candraka]]-[[synonyms:a:alaṅkṛtiḥ]]---Kṛṣṇa, whose head is decorated with a peacock feather; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:m:mandra]]-[[synonyms:m:muralī]]-[[synonyms:r:ravaḥ]]---Kṛṣṇa, whose flute produces a deep sound; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:n:nu]]---certainly; [[synonyms:s:surendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nīla]]-[[synonyms:d:dyutiḥ]]---Kṛṣṇa, whose bodily luster is like the jewel called //indranīla//; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:t:tāṇḍavī]]---Kṛṣṇa, who is expert in dancing in the //rāsa dance//; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---O My dear friend; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:r:rakṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:auṣadhiḥ]]---Kṛṣṇa, who is the medicine that can save one's life; [[synonyms:n:nidhiḥ]]---treasure; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---My; [[synonyms:s:suhṛt]]-[[synonyms:t:tamaḥ]]---best of friends; [[synonyms:k:kva]]---where; [[synonyms:b:bata]]---I am so sorry; [[synonyms:h:hanta]]---alas; [[synonyms:h:hā]]---oh; [[synonyms:d:dhik]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhim]]---condemnation to Vidhi, the maker of my destiny.
translation: "My dear friend, where is Kṛṣṇa, who is like the moon rising from the ocean of Mahārāja Nanda's dynasty? Where is Kṛṣṇa, His head decorated with a peacock feather? Where is He? Where is Kṛṣṇa, whose flute produces such a deep sound? Oh, where is Kṛṣṇa, whose bodily luster is like the luster of the blue indranīla jewel? Where is Kṛṣṇa, who is so expert in rāsa dancing? Oh, where is He who can save My life? Kindly tell Me where to find Kṛṣṇa, the treasure of My life and best of My friends. Feeling separation from Him, I hereby condemn Providence, the shaper of My destiny.'
purport: This verse is found in the //Lalita-mādhava// (3.25) of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.36
description: "The family of Mahārāja Nanda is just like an ocean of milk, wherein Lord Kṛṣṇa has arisen like the full moon to illuminate the entire universe. The eyes of the residents of Vraja are like cakora birds that continuously drink the nectar of His bodily luster and thus live peacefully.
text:
> "vrajendra-kula---dugdha-sindhu, kṛṣṇa tāhe pūrṇa indu,
> janmi' kailā jagat ujora
> kānty-amṛta yebā piye, nirantara piyā jiye,
> vraja-janera nayana-cakora
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:k:kula]]---the dynasty of Mahārāja Nanda in Vrajabhūmi; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---like the ocean of milk; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāhe]]---in that; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---full; [[synonyms:i:indu]]---moon; [[synonyms:j:janmi]]---arising; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---has made; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the whole world; [[synonyms:u:ujora]]---illuminated; [[synonyms:k:kānti]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---the nectar of His bodily luster; [[synonyms:y:yebā]] [[synonyms:p:piye]]---anyone who drinks; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---always; [[synonyms:p:piyā]]---drinking; [[synonyms:j:jiye]]---sustains life; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:j:janera]]---of the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:n:nayana]]-[[synonyms:c:cakora]]---eyes that are like //cakora// birds.
translation: "The family of Mahārāja Nanda is just like an ocean of milk, wherein Lord Kṛṣṇa has arisen like the full moon to illuminate the entire universe. The eyes of the residents of Vraja are like cakora birds that continuously drink the nectar of His bodily luster and thus live peacefully.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.37
description: "My dear friend, where is Kṛṣṇa? Kindly let Me see Him. My heart breaks at not seeing His face even for a moment. Kindly show Him to Me immediately; otherwise I cannot live.
text:
> sakhi he, kothā kṛṣṇa, karāha daraśana
> kṣaṇeke yāhāra mukha, nā dekhile phāṭe buka,
> śīghra dekhāha, nā rahe jīvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakhi]] [[synonyms:h:he]]---O My dear friend; [[synonyms:k:kothā]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---where is Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karāha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---please let Me see Him; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇeke]]---within a moment; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---face; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhile]]---if not seeing; [[synonyms:p:phāṭe]] [[synonyms:b:buka]]---My heart is breaking; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---quickly; [[synonyms:d:dekhāha]]---show; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---My life is expiring.
translation: "My dear friend, where is Kṛṣṇa? Kindly let Me see Him. My heart breaks at not seeing His face even for a moment. Kindly show Him to Me immediately; otherwise I cannot live.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.38
description: "The women of Vṛndāvana are just like lilies growing hot in the sun of lusty desires. But moonlike Kṛṣṇa makes them all jubilant by bestowing upon them the nectar of His hands. O My dear friend, where is My moon now? Save My life by showing Him to Me!
text:
> ei vrajera ramaṇī, kāmārka-tapta-kumudinī,
> nija-karāmṛta diyā dāna
> praphullita kare yei, kāhāṅ mora candra sei,
> dekhāha, sakhi, rākha mora prāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:v:vrajera]] [[synonyms:r:ramaṇī]]---women of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:a:arka]]-[[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:k:kumudinī]]---exactly like lilies becoming very hot in the sun of lusty desire; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:k:kara]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar of hands; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---charity; [[synonyms:p:praphullita]]---jubilant; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---one who; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:c:candra]]---moon; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dekhāha]]---please show; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---O My dear friend; [[synonyms:r:rākha]]---please save; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---My life.
translation: "The women of Vṛndāvana are just like lilies growing hot in the sun of lusty desires. But moonlike Kṛṣṇa makes them all jubilant by bestowing upon them the nectar of His hands. O My dear friend, where is My moon now? Save My life by showing Him to Me!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.39
description: "My dear friend, where is that beautiful helmet with a peacock feather upon it like a rainbow upon a new cloud? Where are those yellow garments, shining like lightning? And where is that necklace of pearls that resemble flocks of ducks flying in the sky? The blackish body of Kṛṣṇa triumphs over the new blackish rain cloud.
text:
> kāhāṅ se cūḍāra ṭhāma, śikhi-piñchera uḍāna,
> nava-meghe yena indra-dhanu
> pītāmbara---taḍid-dyuti, muktā-mālā---baka-pāṅti,
> navāmbuda jini' śyāma-tanu
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:c:cūḍāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāma]]---beauty of the helmet; [[synonyms:ś:śikhi]]-[[synonyms:p:piñchera]] [[synonyms:u:uḍāna]]---upon which there is a peacock feather; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:m:meghe]]---in a new cloud; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---just like; [[synonyms:i:indra]]-[[synonyms:d:dhanu]]---the rainbow; [[synonyms:p:pīta]]-[[synonyms:a:ambara]]---yellow garments; [[synonyms:t:taḍit]]-[[synonyms:d:dyuti]]---like the illumination of lightning; [[synonyms:m:muktā]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]]---pearl necklace; [[synonyms:b:baka]]-[[synonyms:p:pāṅti]]---like rows of ducks; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:a:ambuda]]---a new rain cloud; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:ś:śyāma]]-[[synonyms:t:tanu]]---the blackish body.
translation: "My dear friend, where is that beautiful helmet with a peacock feather upon it like a rainbow upon a new cloud? Where are those yellow garments, shining like lightning? And where is that necklace of pearls that resemble flocks of ducks flying in the sky? The blackish body of Kṛṣṇa triumphs over the new blackish rain cloud.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.4
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was a very dear devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord derived great pleasure from his activities.
text:
> prabhura atyanta priya paṇḍita-jagadānanda
> yāhāra caritre prabhu pāyena ānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]---very; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---affectionate; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]] [[synonyms:c:caritre]]---in whose activities; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāyena]]---gets; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---great pleasure.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was a very dear devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord derived great pleasure from his activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.40
description: "If a person's eyes even once capture that beautiful body of Kṛṣṇa's, it remains always prominent within his heart. Kṛṣṇa's body resembles the sap of the mango tree, for when it enters the minds of women, it will not come out, despite great endeavor. Thus Kṛṣṇa's extraordinary body is like a thorn of the seyā berry tree.
text:
> eka-bāra yāra nayane lāge, sadā tāra hṛdaye jāge,
> kṛṣṇa-tanu---yena āmra-āṭhā
> nārī-mane paiśe hāya, yatne nāhi bāhirāya,
> tanu nahe,---seyā-kulera kāṅṭā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:n:nayane]]---eyes; [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---capture; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:j:jāge]]---remains prominent; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:tanu]]---the body of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:ā:āmra]]-[[synonyms:ā:āṭhā]]---the sap of the mango tree; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds of women; [[synonyms:p:paiśe]]---enters; [[synonyms:h:hāya]]---alas; [[synonyms:y:yatne]]---even with great endeavor; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---does not; [[synonyms:b:bāhirāya]]---come out; [[synonyms:t:tanu]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not an ordinary body; [[synonyms:s:seyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kulera]] [[synonyms:k:kāṅṭā]]---it is like the thorn of the //seyā// berry tree.
translation: "If a person's eyes even once capture that beautiful body of Kṛṣṇa's, it remains always prominent within his heart. Kṛṣṇa's body resembles the sap of the mango tree, for when it enters the minds of women, it will not come out, despite great endeavor. Thus Kṛṣṇa's extraordinary body is like a thorn of the seyā berry tree.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.41
description: "Kṛṣṇa's bodily luster shines like the indranīla gem and surpasses the luster of the tamāla tree. The luster of His body drives the entire world mad because Providence has made it transparent by refining the essence of the mellow of conjugal love and mixing it with moonshine.
text:
> jiniyā tamāla-dyuti, indranīla-sama kānti,
> se kāntite jagat mātāya
> śṛṅgāra-rasa-sāra chāni', tāte candra-jyotsnā sāni',
> jāni vidhi niramilā tāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jiniyā]]---being victorious over; [[synonyms:t:tamāla]]-[[synonyms:d:dyuti]]---the luster of the //tamāla// tree; [[synonyms:i:indra]]-[[synonyms:n:nīla]]---the gem known as //indranīla//; [[synonyms:s:sama]] [[synonyms:k:kānti]]---the luster like; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:k:kāntite]]---by that luster; [[synonyms:j:jagat]] [[synonyms:m:mātāya]]---the whole world becomes maddened; [[synonyms:ś:śrṅgāra]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the mellow of conjugal love; [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---essence; [[synonyms:c:chāni']]---filtering; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:c:candra]]-[[synonyms:j:jyotsnā]]---the illumination of the full moon; [[synonyms:s:sāni']]---mixing; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I know; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---Providence; [[synonyms:n:niramilā]]---made very clear; [[synonyms:t:tāya]]---that.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa's bodily luster shines like the indranīla gem and surpasses the luster of the tamāla tree. The luster of His body drives the entire world mad because Providence has made it transparent by refining the essence of the mellow of conjugal love and mixing it with moonshine.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.42
description: "The deep vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute surpasses the thundering of new clouds and attracts the aural reception of the entire world. Thus the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana rise and pursue that sound, drinking the showering nectar of Kṛṣṇa's bodily luster like thirsty cātaka birds.
text:
> kāhāṅ se muralī-dhvani, navābhra-garjita jini',
> jagat ākarṣe śravaṇe yāhāra
> uṭhi' dhāya vraja-jana, tṛṣita cātaka-gaṇa,
> āsi' piye kānty-amṛta-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:m:muralī]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the vibration of the flute; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:a:abhra]]-[[synonyms:g:garjita]] [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering the vibrations of new clouds; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the whole world; [[synonyms:ā:ākarṣe]]---attracts; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---the hearing; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---standing up; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---run; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---the inhabitants of Vrajabhūmi; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣita]] [[synonyms:c:cātaka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---like lusty //cātaka// birds; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:piye]]---drink; [[synonyms:k:kānti]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---the showers of the nectar of Kṛṣṇa's bodily luster.
translation: "The deep vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute surpasses the thundering of new clouds and attracts the aural reception of the entire world. Thus the inhabitants of Vṛndāvana rise and pursue that sound, drinking the showering nectar of Kṛṣṇa's bodily luster like thirsty cātaka birds.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.43
description: "Kṛṣṇa is the reservoir of art and culture, and He is the panacea that saves My life. O My dear friend, since I live without Him, who is the best among My friends, I condemn the duration of My life. I think that Providence has cheated Me in many ways.
text:
> mora sei kalā-nidhi, prāṇa-rakṣā-mahauṣadhi,
> sakhi, mora teṅho suhṛttama
> deha jīye tāṅhā vine, dhik ei jīvane,
> vidhi kare eta viḍambana!"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]]---of Me; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]-[[synonyms:n:nidhi]]---reservoir of art and culture; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rakṣa]]-[[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:a:auṣaudhi]]---the panacea for saving My life; [[synonyms:s:sakhi]]---O My dear friend; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:s:suhṛt]]-[[synonyms:t:tama]]---the best of friends; [[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:j:jīye]]---My body lives; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]] [[synonyms:v:vine]]---without Him; [[synonyms:d:dhik]]---condemnation; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:j:jīvane]]---to this life; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---Providence; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:v:viḍambana]]---so much cheating.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa is the reservoir of art and culture, and He is the panacea that saves My life. O My dear friend, since I live without Him, who is the best among My friends, I condemn the duration of My life. I think that Providence has cheated Me in many ways.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.44
description: "Why does Providence continue the life of one who does not wish to liver? This thought aroused anger and lamentation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then
text:
> 'ye-jana jīte nāhi cāya, tāre kene jīyāya',
> vidhi-prati uṭhe krodha-śoka
> vidhire kare bhartsana, kṛṣṇe dena olāhana,
> paḍi' bhāgavatera eka śloka
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---that person who; [[synonyms:j:jīte]]---to live; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---does not want; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:j:jīyāya]]---he makes life continue; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]-[[synonyms:p:prati]]---towards Providence; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---awakens; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]-[[synonyms:ś:śoka]]---anger and lamentation; [[synonyms:v:vidhire]]---unto Providence; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhartsana]]---chastisement; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---gives; [[synonyms:o:olāhana]]---accusation; [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reading; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavatera]]---of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---one verse.
translation:
"Why does Providence continue the life of one who does not wish to liver? This thought aroused anger and lamentation. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then


read a verse from Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam that chastises Providence and makes an accusation against Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.45
description: " 'O Providence, you have no mercy! You bring embodied souls together through friendship and affection, but before their desires are fulfilled, you separate them. Your activities are like the foolish pranks of children.'
text:
> aho vidhātas tava na kvacid dayā
> saṁyojya maitryā praṇayena dehinaḥ
> tāṁś cākṛtārthān viyunaṅkṣy apārthakaṁ
> viceṣṭitaṁ te 'rbhaka-ceṣṭitaṁ yathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aho]]---alas; [[synonyms:v:vidhātaḥ]]---O Providence; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---your; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kvacit]]---at any time; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:s:saṁyojya]]---making connections; [[synonyms:m:maitryā]]---by friendship; [[synonyms:p:praṇayena]]---and by affection; [[synonyms:d:dehinaḥ]]---of the embodied souls; [[synonyms:t:tān]]---them; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:a:akṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:arthān]]---without achievement; [[synonyms:v:viyunaṅkṣi]]---you cause to happen; [[synonyms:a:apārthakam]]---separation; [[synonyms:v:viceṣṭitam]]---activities; [[synonyms:t:te]]---your; [[synonyms:a:arbhaka]]---of a boy; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭitam]]---the childish play; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---like.
translation: “ 'O Providence, you have no mercy! You bring embodied souls together through friendship and affection, but before their desires are fulfilled, you separate them. Your activities are like the foolish pranks of children.'
purport: This verse, quoted from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.39.19), was chanted by the damsels of Vraja when Kṛṣṇa left Vṛndāvana for Mathurā with Akrūra and Balarāma. The //gopīs// lamented that providence had made it possible for them to meet Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma in affection and love and had then separated them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.46
description: "Providence, you do not know the purport of loving affairs, and therefore you baffle all our endeavors. This is very childish of you. If we could catch you, we would give you such a lesson that you would never again make such arrangements.
text:
> "nā jānis prema-marma, vyartha karis pariśrama,
> tora ceṣṭā---bālaka-samāna
> 'tora yadi lāg pāiye, tabe tore śikṣā diye,
> emana yena nā karis vidhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jānis]]---you do not know; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:m:marma]]---the purport of loving affairs; [[synonyms:v:vyartha]] [[synonyms:k:karis]]---you baffle; [[synonyms:p:pariśrama]]---all labor; [[synonyms:t:tora]] [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---your activities; [[synonyms:b:bālaka]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---like the childish activities of a boy; [[synonyms:t:tora]] [[synonyms:y:yadi]] [[synonyms:l:lāg]] [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---if I get the opportunity to meet you; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:t:tore]]---unto you; [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:diye]]---I shall give some lessons; [[synonyms:e:emana]]---like this; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---so that; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karis]] [[synonyms:v:vidhāna]]---will not make arrangements.
translation: "Providence, you do not know the purport of loving affairs, and therefore you baffle all our endeavors. This is very childish of you. If we could catch you, we would give you such a lesson that you would never again make such arrangements.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.47
description: "Oh, cruel Providence! You are very unkind, for you bring together in love people who are rarely in touch with each other. Then, after you have made them meet but before they are fulfilled, you again spread them far apart.
text:
> are vidhi, tui baḍa-i niṭhura
> anyo 'nya durlabha jana, preme karāñā sammilana,
> 'akṛtārthān' kene karis dūra?
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:are]]---oh; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---Providence; [[synonyms:t:tui]]---you; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---very; [[synonyms:n:niṭhura]]---cruel; [[synonyms:a:anyo]] [[synonyms:n:'nya]]---for one another; [[synonyms:d:durlabha]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---persons rarely obtained; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in love; [[synonyms:k:karāñā]] [[synonyms:s:sammilana]]---causing to meet together; [[synonyms:a:akṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:arthān]]---unsuccessful; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:karis]]---you do; [[synonyms:d:dūra]]---far apart.
translation: "Oh, cruel Providence! You are very unkind, for you bring together in love people who are rarely in touch with each other. Then, after you have made them meet but before they are fulfilled, you again spread them far apart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.48
description: "O Providence, you are so unkind! You reveal the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa and make the mind and eyes greedy, but after they have drunk that nectar for only a moment, you whisk Kṛṣṇa away to another place. This is a great sin because you thus take away what you have given as charity.
text:
> are vidhi akaruṇa, dekhāñā kṛṣṇānana,
> netra-mana lobhāilā mora
> kṣaṇeke karite pāna, kāḍi' nilā anya sthāna,
> pāpa kaili 'datta-apahāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:are]]---oh; [[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---Providence; [[synonyms:a:akaruṇa]]---most unkind; [[synonyms:d:dekhāñā]]---showing; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānana]]---the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:netra]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind and eyes; [[synonyms:l:lobhāilā]]---have made greedy; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇeke]] [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---drinking only for a moment; [[synonyms:k:kāḍi']] [[synonyms:n:nilā]]---took it away; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---to another place; [[synonyms:p:pāpa]] [[synonyms:k:kaili]]---have performed a most sinful act; [[synonyms:d:datta]]-[[synonyms:a:apahāra]]---taking back things given in charity.
translation: "O Providence, you are so unkind! You reveal the beautiful face of Kṛṣṇa and make the mind and eyes greedy, but after they have drunk that nectar for only a moment, you whisk Kṛṣṇa away to another place. This is a great sin because you thus take away what you have given as charity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.49
description: "O misbehaved Providence! If you reply to us, 'Akrūra is actually at fault; why are you angry with me?' then I say to you, 'Providence, you have taken the form of Akrūra and have stolen Kṛṣṇa away. No one else would behave like this.'
text:
> 'akrūra kare tomāra doṣa, āmāya kene kara roṣa',
> ihā yadi kaha 'durācāra'
> tui akrūra-mūrti dhari', kṛṣṇa nili curi kari',
> anyera nahe aiche vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:akrūra]]---Akrūra; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault to you; [[synonyms:ā:āmāya]]---unto me; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---you do; [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---anger; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---you say; [[synonyms:d:durācāra]]---O misbehaved (Providence); [[synonyms:t:tui]]---you; [[synonyms:a:akrūra]]-[[synonyms:m:mūrti]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---taking the form of Akrūra; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nili]]---you have taken; [[synonyms:c:curi]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---stealing; [[synonyms:a:anyera]]---of others; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---there is not; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---this type of; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---behavior.
translation: "O misbehaved Providence! If you reply to us, 'Akrūra is actually at fault; why are you angry with me?' then I say to you, 'Providence, you have taken the form of Akrūra and have stolen Kṛṣṇa away. No one else would behave like this.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.5
description: Knowing His mother to be greatly afflicted by separation, the Lord would send Jagadānanda Paṇḍita to Navadvīpa every year to console her.
text:
> prati-vatsara prabhu tāṅre pāṭhāna nadīyāte
> viccheda-duḥkhitā jāni' jananī āśvāsite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---every year; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāna]]---sends; [[synonyms:n:nadīyāte]]---to Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:v:viccheda]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkhitā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing her affliction due to separation; [[synonyms:j:jananī]]---His mother; [[synonyms:ā:āśvāsite]]---to console.
translation: Knowing His mother to be greatly afflicted by separation, the Lord would send Jagadānanda Paṇḍita to Navadvīpa every year to console her.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.50
description: "But this is the fault of My own destiny. Why should I needlessly accuse you? There is no intimate relationship between you and Me. Kṛṣṇa, however, is My life and soul. It is We who live together, and it is He who has become so cruel.
text:
> āpanāra karma-doṣa, tore kibā kari roṣa,
> toya-moya sambandha vidūra
> ye āmāra prāṇa-nātha, ekatra rahi yāṅra sātha,
> sei kṛṣṇa ha-ilā niṭhura!
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]] [[synonyms:k:karma]]-[[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---it is the result of My own fate; [[synonyms:t:tore]]---unto you; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---I give accusations; [[synonyms:t:toya]]-[[synonyms:m:moya]]---between you and Me; [[synonyms:s:sam]]-[[synonyms:b:bandha]]---the relationship; [[synonyms:v:vidūra]]---very far; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---the one who is; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---life and soul; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---together; [[synonyms:r:rahi]]---We remain; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sātha]]---with whom; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---that Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]] [[synonyms:n:niṭhura]]---has become so cruel.
translation: "But this is the fault of My own destiny. Why should I needlessly accuse you? There is no intimate relationship between you and Me. Kṛṣṇa, however, is My life and soul. It is We who live together, and it is He who has become so cruel.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.51
description: "He for whom I have left everything is personally killing Me with His own hands. Kṛṣṇa has no fear of killing women. Indeed, I am dying for Him, but He doesn't even turn back to look at Me. Within a moment, He has broken off our loving affairs.
text:
> saba tyaji' bhaji yāṅre, sei āpana-hāte māre,
> nārī-vadhe kṛṣṇera nāhi bhaya
> tāṅra lāgi' āmi mari, ulaṭi' nā cāhe hari,
> kṣaṇa-mātre bhāṅgila praṇaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:t:tyaji']]---leaving everything aside; [[synonyms:b:bhaji]] [[synonyms:y:yāṅre]]---the person whom I worship; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that person; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:h:hāte]]---by His own hand; [[synonyms:m:māre]]---kills; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:v:vadhe]]---in killing one woman; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---there is no fear; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:m:mari]]---I die; [[synonyms:u:ulaṭi']]---turning back; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:cāhe]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Kṛṣṇa does not look; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mātre]]---within a moment; [[synonyms:b:bhāṅgila]]---has broken; [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]---all loving affairs.
translation: "He for whom I have left everything is personally killing Me with His own hands. Kṛṣṇa has no fear of killing women. Indeed, I am dying for Him, but He doesn't even turn back to look at Me. Within a moment, He has broken off our loving affairs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.52
description: "Yet why should I be angry with Kṛṣṇa? It is the fault of My own misfortune. The fruit of my sinful activities has ripened, and therefore Kṛṣṇa, who has always been dependent on My love, is now indifferent. This means that My misfortune is very strong."
text:
> kṛṣṇe kene kari roṣa, āpana durdaiva-doṣa,
> pākila mora ei pāpa-phala
> ye kṛṣṇa---mora premādhīna, tāre kaila udāsīna,
> ei mora abhāgya prabala"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---I am angry; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]---of My own; [[synonyms:d:durdaiva]]---of misfortune; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault; [[synonyms:p:pākila]]---has ripened; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pāpa]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---sinful reaction; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:a:adhīna]]---dependent on love; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---Him; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---has made; [[synonyms:u:udāsīna]]---indifferent; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mora]]---this is My; [[synonyms:a:abhāgya]]---misfortune; [[synonyms:p:prabala]]---very strong.
translation: "Yet why should I be angry with Kṛṣṇa? It is the fault of My own misfortune. The fruit of my sinful activities has ripened, and therefore Kṛṣṇa, who has always been dependent on My love, is now indifferent. This means that My misfortune is very strong."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.53
description: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in the mood of separation, "Alas, alas! O Kṛṣṇa, where have You gone?" Feeling in His heart the ecstatic emotions of the gopīs, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu agonized in their words, saying, "O Govinda! O Dāmodara! O Mādhava!"
text:
> ei-mata gaura-rāya, viṣāde kare hāya hāya,
> 'hā hā kṛṣṇa, tumi gelā kati?'
> gopī-bhāva hṛdaye, tāra vākye vilāpaye,
> 'govinda dāmodara mādhaveti'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:viṣāde]]---in lamentation due to separation; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:h:hāya]] [[synonyms:h:hāya]]---always says "alas, alas"; [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:h:hā]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---oh, oh Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:k:kati]]---where have You gone; [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]] [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---with the ecstatic love of the //gopīs// in His heart; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:v:vākye]]---in their words; [[synonyms:v:vilāpaye]]---He laments; [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]] [[synonyms:m:mādhava]]---O Govinda, O Dāmodara, O Mādhava; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus.
translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in the mood of separation, "Alas, alas! O Kṛṣṇa, where have You gone?" Feeling in His heart the ecstatic emotions of the gopīs, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu agonized in their words, saying, "O Govinda! O Dāmodara! O Mādhava!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.54
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya then devised various means to pacify the Lord. They sang songs of meeting that transformed His heart and made His mind peaceful.
text:
> tabe svarūpa-rāma-rāya, kari' nānā upāya,
> mahāprabhura kare āśvāsana
> gāyena saṅgama-gīta, prabhura phirāilā cita,
> prabhura kichu sthira haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---devising many means; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āśvāsana]]---pacify; [[synonyms:g:gāyena]]---they sang; [[synonyms:s:saṅgama]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]---meeting songs; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:phirāilā]] [[synonyms:c:cita]]---transformed the heart; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---somewhat; [[synonyms:s:sthira]]---peaceful; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya then devised various means to pacify the Lord. They sang songs of meeting that transformed His heart and made His mind peaceful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.55
description: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in this way, half the night passed. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara made the Lord lie down in the room known as the Gambhīrā.
text:
> ei-mata vilapite ardha-rātri gela
> gambhīrāte svarūpa-gosāñi prabhure śoyāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:v:vilapite]]---speaking in lamentation; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---half the night passed; [[synonyms:g:gambhīrāte]]---in the room known as the Gambhīrā; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:ś:śoyāila]]---made the Lord lie down.
translation: As Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lamented in this way, half the night passed. Then Svarūpa Dāmodara made the Lord lie down in the room known as the Gambhīrā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.56
description: After the Lord was made to lie down, Rāmānanda Rāya returned home, and Svarūpa Dāmodara and Govinda lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā.
text:
> prabhure śoyāñā rāmānanda gelā ghare
> svarūpa, govinda śuilā gambhīrāra dvāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śoyāñā]]---making lie down; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---returned to his home; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:ś:śuilā]]---lay down; [[synonyms:g:gambhīrāra]] [[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the door of the Gambhīrā.
translation: After the Lord was made to lie down, Rāmānanda Rāya returned home, and Svarūpa Dāmodara and Govinda lay down at the door of the Gambhīrā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.57
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed awake all night, chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, His mind overwhelmed by spiritual ecstasy.
text:
> premāveśe mahāprabhura gara-gara mana
> nāma-saṅkīrtana kari' karena jāgaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in greatly ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gara]]-[[synonyms:g:gara]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind was fully overwhelmed; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:j:jāgaraṇa]]---wakefulness.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stayed awake all night, chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra, His mind overwhelmed by spiritual ecstasy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.58
description: Feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was so distraught that in great anxiety He stood up and began rubbing His face against the walls of the Gambhīrā.
text:
> virahe vyākula prabhu udvege uṭhilā
> gambhīrāra bhittye mukha ghaṣite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:virahe]]---in the lamentation of separation; [[synonyms:v:vyākula]]---very agitated; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:udvege]]---in great anxiety; [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]]---stood up; [[synonyms:g:gambhīrāra]]---of the Gambhīrā; [[synonyms:b:bhittye]]---on the walls; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---face; [[synonyms:g:ghaṣite]]---to rub; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began.
translation: Feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was so distraught that in great anxiety He stood up and began rubbing His face against the walls of the Gambhīrā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.59
description: Blood oozed from the many injuries on His mouth, nose and cheeks, but due to His ecstatic emotions, the Lord did not know it.
text:
> mukhe, gaṇḍe, nāke kṣata ha-ila apāra
> bhāvāveśe nā jānena prabhu, paḍe rakta-dhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---on the mouth; [[synonyms:g:gaṇḍe]]---on the cheeks; [[synonyms:n:nāke]]---on the nose; [[synonyms:k:kṣata]]---injuries; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there were; [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---many; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic emotion; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---could not understand; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---oozes out; [[synonyms:r:rakta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---a flow of blood.
translation: Blood oozed from the many injuries on His mouth, nose and cheeks, but due to His ecstatic emotions, the Lord did not know it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.6
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, "Go to Nadia and offer My obeisances to My mother. Touch her lotus feet in My name.
text:
> "nadīyā calaha, mātāre kahiha namaskāra
> āmāra nāme pāda-padma dhariha tāṅhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nadīyā]] [[synonyms:c:calaha]]---start for Nadia; [[synonyms:m:mātāre]]---unto My mother; [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---tell; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---My obeisances; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---in My name; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:padma]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:d:dhariha]]---catch; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]]---her.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, "Go to Nadia and offer My obeisances to My mother. Touch her lotus feet in My name.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.60
description: In ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rubbed His face against the walls all night long, making a peculiar sound, "goṅ-goṅ," which Svarūpa Dāmodara could hear through the door.
text:
> sarva-rātri karena bhāve mukha saṅgharṣaṇa
> goṅ-goṅ-śabda karena,---svarūpa śunilā takhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:r:rātri]]---the whole night; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in emotion; [[synonyms:m:mukha]] [[synonyms:s:saṅgharṣaṇa]]---rubbing of the face; [[synonyms:g:goṅ]]-[[synonyms:g:goṅ]]-[[synonyms:ś:śabda]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---makes a peculiar sound, //goṅ-goṅ//; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ś:śunilā]]---heard; [[synonyms:t:takhana]]---then.
translation: In ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rubbed His face against the walls all night long, making a peculiar sound, "goṅ-goṅ," which Svarūpa Dāmodara could hear through the door.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.61
description: Lighting a lamp, Svarūpa Dāmodara and Govinda entered the room. When they saw the Lord's face, both of them were full of sorrow.
text:
> dīpa jvāli' ghare gelā, dekhi' prabhura mukha
> svarūpa, govinda duṅhāra haila baḍa duḥkha
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dīpa]] [[synonyms:j:jvāli']]---lighting the lamp; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in the room; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mukha]]---the face of the Lord; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---and Govinda; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of both of them; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---there was great unhappiness.
translation: Lighting a lamp, Svarūpa Dāmodara and Govinda entered the room. When they saw the Lord's face, both of them were full of sorrow.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.62
description: They brought the Lord to His bed, calmed Him and then asked, "Why have You done this to Yourself?"
text:
> prabhure śayyāte āni' susthira karāilā
> 'kāṅhe kailā ei tumi?'---svarūpa puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śayyāte]]---to the bed; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---made Him pacified; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhe]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---have done; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī inquired.
translation: They brought the Lord to His bed, calmed Him and then asked, "Why have You done this to Yourself?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.63
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I was in such anxiety that I could not stay in the room. I wanted to go out, and therefore I wandered about the room, looking for the door.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---"udvege ghare nā pāri rahite
> dvāra cāhi' buli' śīghra bāhira ha-ite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:u:udvege]]---out of great agitation; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---within the room; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I was not able; [[synonyms:r:rahite]]---to stay; [[synonyms:d:dvāra]] [[synonyms:c:cāhi']]---looking for the door; [[synonyms:b:buli']]---wandering; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---quickly; [[synonyms:b:bāhira]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to get out.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I was in such anxiety that I could not stay in the room. I wanted to go out, and therefore I wandered about the room, looking for the door.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.64
description: "Unable to find the door, I kept hitting the four walls with My face. My face was injured, and it bled, but I still could not get out."
text:
> dvāra nāhi' pāñā mukha lāge cāri-bhite
> kṣata haya, rakta paḍe, nā pāi yāite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvāra]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi']] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not finding the door; [[synonyms:m:mukha]] [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---My face strikes; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhite]]---on the four walls; [[synonyms:k:kṣata]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there was injury; [[synonyms:r:rakta]] [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---blood came out; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---still I could not get out.
translation: "Unable to find the door, I kept hitting the four walls with My face. My face was injured, and it bled, but I still could not get out."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.65
description: In this state of madness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind was unsteady. Whatever He said or did was all symptomatic of madness.
text:
> unmāda-daśāya prabhura sthira nahe mana
> yei kare, yei bole saba,---unmāda-lakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:d:daśāya]]---in such a state of madness; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind is not steady; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---whatever He does; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:b:bole]]---whatever He says; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:u:unmāda]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---simply symptoms of madness.
translation: In this state of madness, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind was unsteady. Whatever He said or did was all symptomatic of madness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.66
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara was very anxious, but then he had an idea. The following day, he and the other devotees considered it together.
text:
> svarūpa-gosāñi tabe cintā pāilā mane
> bhakta-gaṇa lañā vicāra kailā āra dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:c:cintā]]---an anxiety or thought; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---got in his mind; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---among all the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---considered; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---the next day.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara was very anxious, but then he had an idea. The following day, he and the other devotees considered it together.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.67
description: After consulting with one another, they entreated Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to allow Śaṅkara Paṇḍita to lie down in the same room with Him.
text:
> saba bhakta meli' tabe prabhure sādhila
> śaṅkara-paṇḍite prabhura saṅge śoyāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:m:meli']]---all the devotees, meeting together; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:s:sādhila]]---entreated Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]]---Śaṅkara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:ś:śoyāila]]---made to lie down.
translation: After consulting with one another, they entreated Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to allow Śaṅkara Paṇḍita to lie down in the same room with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.68
description: Thus Śaṅkara Paṇḍita lay at the feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord placed His legs upon Śaṅkara's body.
text:
> prabhu-pāda-tale śaṅkara karena śayana
> prabhu tāṅra upara karena pāda-prasāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:t:tale]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---lies down; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of him; [[synonyms:u:upara]]---on the body; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāraṇa]]---extending His legs.
translation: Thus Śaṅkara Paṇḍita lay at the feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord placed His legs upon Śaṅkara's body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.69
description: Śaṅkara became celebrated by the name "the pillow of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu." He was like Vidura, as Śukadeva Gosvāmī previously described him.
text:
> 'prabhu-pādopādhāna' bali' tāṅra nāma ha-ila
> pūrve vidure yena śrī-śuka varṇila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:u:upādhāna]]---the pillow of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's legs; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---calling as such; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---his name; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:v:vidure]]---Vidura; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śuka]] [[synonyms:v:varṇila]]---Śrī Śukadeva Gosvāmī described.
translation: Śaṅkara became celebrated by the name "the pillow of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu." He was like Vidura, as Śukadeva Gosvāmī previously described him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.7
description: "Tell her for Me, 'Please remember that I come here every day and offer My respects to your lotus feet.
text:
> kahiha tāṅhāre---'tumi karaha smaraṇa
> nitya āsi' āmi tomāra vandiye caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kahiha]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]]---inform her; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---please remember; [[synonyms:n:nitya]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming daily; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:v:vandiye]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---offer respect to the lotus feet.
translation: "Tell her for Me, 'Please remember that I come here every day and offer My respects to your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.70
description: "When submissive Vidura, the resting place of the legs of Lord Kṛṣṇa, had thus spoken to Maitreya, Maitreya began speaking, his hair standing on end due to the transcendental pleasure of discussing topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> iti bruvāṇaṁ viduraṁ vinītaṁ
> sahasra-śīrṣṇaś caraṇopadhānam
> prahṛṣṭa-romā bhagavat-kathāyāṁ
> praṇīyamāno munir abhyacaṣṭa
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:b:bruvāṇam]]---speaking; [[synonyms:v:viduram]]---to Vidura; [[synonyms:v:vinītam]]---submissive; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:ś:śīrṣṇaḥ]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:u:upadhānam]]---the resting pillow for the legs; [[synonyms:p:prahṛṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:r:romā]]---whose hairs on the body were standing; [[synonyms:b:bhagavat]]-[[synonyms:k:kathāyām]]---in topics of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:p:praṇīyamānaḥ]]---being induced; [[synonyms:m:muniḥ]]---the great sage Maitreya; [[synonyms:a:abhyacaṣṭa]]---began to speak.
translation: "When submissive Vidura, the resting place of the legs of Lord Kṛṣṇa, had thus spoken to Maitreya, Maitreya began speaking, his hair standing on end due to the transcendental pleasure of discussing topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa."
purport: This is a quotation from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:3:13:5|(3.13.5)]].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.71
description: Śaṅkara massaged the legs of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but while massaging he would fall asleep and thus lie down.
text:
> śaṅkara karena prabhura pāda-samvāhana
> ghumāñā paḍena, taiche karena śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:samvāhana]]---massaging the legs; [[synonyms:g:ghumāñā]] [[synonyms:p:paḍena]]---he falls asleep; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---in that way; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---he lies down.
translation: Śaṅkara massaged the legs of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but while massaging he would fall asleep and thus lie down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.72
description: He would lie asleep without a covering on his body, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would get up and wrap him with His own quilt.
text:
> ughāḍa-aṅge paḍiyā śaṅkara nidrā yāya
> prabhu uṭhi' āpana-kāṅthā tāhāre jaḍāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ughāḍa]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---without a covering over the body; [[synonyms:p:paḍiyā]]---lying down; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:n:nidrā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes to sleep; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:k:kāṅthā]]---His own quilt; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]] [[synonyms:j:jaḍāya]]---wraps him with.
translation: He would lie asleep without a covering on his body, and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would get up and wrap him with His own quilt.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.73
description: Śaṅkara Paṇḍita would always fall asleep, but he would quickly awaken, sit up and again begin massaging the legs of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way he would stay awake the entire night.
text:
> nirantara ghumāya śaṅkara śīghra-cetana
> vasi' pāda cāpi' kare rātri-jāgaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---incessantly; [[synonyms:g:ghumāya]]---sleeps; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very quickly; [[synonyms:c:cetana]]---waking up; [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting; [[synonyms:p:pāda]] [[synonyms:c:cāpi']]---massaging the legs; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:j:jāgaraṇa]]---keeps awake at night.
translation: Śaṅkara Paṇḍita would always fall asleep, but he would quickly awaken, sit up and again begin massaging the legs of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way he would stay awake the entire night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.74
description: Out of fear of Śaṅkara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could neither leave His room nor rub His lotuslike face against the walls.
text:
> tāṅra bhaye nārena prabhu bāhire yāite
> tāṅra bhaye nārena bhittye mukhābja ghaṣite
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---because of fear of him; [[synonyms:n:nārena]]---was not able; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go out; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---because of fear of him; [[synonyms:n:nārena]]---was not able; [[synonyms:b:bhittye]]---on the walls; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:a:abja]] [[synonyms:g:ghaṣite]]---to rub His lotuslike face.
translation: Out of fear of Śaṅkara, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu could neither leave His room nor rub His lotuslike face against the walls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.75
description: This pastime of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's has been described very nicely by Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī in his book known as Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.
text:
> ei līlā mahāprabhura raghunātha-dāsa
> gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣe kariyāche prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---this pastime; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:stava]]-[[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---in his book known as //Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa//; [[synonyms:k:kariyāche]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---has described very nicely.
translation: This pastime of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's has been described very nicely by Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī in his book known as Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.76
description: "Because of separation from His many friends in Vṛndāvana, who were like His own life, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman. His intelligence was transformed. Day and night He rubbed His moonlike face against the walls, and blood flowed from the injuries. May that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rise in my heart and make me mad with love."
text:
> svakīyasya prāṇārbuda-sadṛśa-goṣṭhasya virahāt
> pralāpān unmādāt satatam ati kurvan vikala-dhīḥ
> dadhad bhittau śaśvad vadana-vidhu-gharṣeṇa rudhiraṁ
> kṣātotthaṁ gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svakīyasya]]---His own; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:arbuda]]---uncountable breaths of life; [[synonyms:s:sadṛśa]]---like; [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhasya]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:virahāt]]---because of separation; [[synonyms:p:pralāpān]]---crazy talks; [[synonyms:u:unmādāt]]---because of madness; [[synonyms:s:satatam]]---always; [[synonyms:a:ati]]---very much; [[synonyms:k:kurvan]]---doing; [[synonyms:v:vikala]]-[[synonyms:d:dhīḥ]]---whose intelligence was disturbed; [[synonyms:d:dadhat]]---oozing forth; [[synonyms:b:bhittau]]---on the walls; [[synonyms:ś:śaśvat]]---always; [[synonyms:v:vadana]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhu]]---of His moonlike face; [[synonyms:g:gharṣeṇa]]---by rubbing; [[synonyms:r:rudhiram]]---blood; [[synonyms:k:kṣāta]]-[[synonyms:u:uttham]]---coming forth from injuries; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅgaḥ]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:u:udayan]]---rising; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---me; [[synonyms:m:madayati]]---maddens.
translation: "Because of separation from His many friends in Vṛndāvana, who were like His own life, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman. His intelligence was transformed. Day and night He rubbed His moonlike face against the walls, and blood flowed from the injuries. May that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rise in my heart and make me mad with love."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 19.77
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in this way stayed immersed day and night in an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. Sometimes He was submerged, and sometimes He floated.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu rātri-divase
> prema-sindhu-magna rahe, kabhu ḍube, bhāse
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---day and night; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]-[[synonyms:m:magna]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains merged in the ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍube]]---sometimes drowns; [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---floats.
