synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali]]---saying this; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karāñā]]---inducing to bathe and take //prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]] [[synonyms:b:bhavana]]---to his own place; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:ā:āśvāsiyā]]---assuring him.
translation: Having said this, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī induced Haridāsa to bathe and take prasāda. After thus reassuring him, he returned home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.142
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple, Haridāsa would stay a long distance away and see Him.
text:
> prabhu yadi yāna jagannātha-daraśane
> dūre rahi' haridāsa karena darśane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:y:yāna]]---goes; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśane]]---to see Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining in a distant place; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---sees.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Lord Jagannātha in the temple, Haridāsa would stay a long distance away and see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.143
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the ocean of mercy. Who can understand Him? When He chastises His dear devotees, He certainly does so to reestablish the principles of religion or duty.
text:
> mahāprabhu---kṛpā-sindhu, ke pāre bujhite?
> priya bhakte daṇḍa karena dharma bujhāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of mercy; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---who can understand; [[synonyms:p:priya]] [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---unto His dear devotees; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---makes chastisement; [[synonyms:d:dharma]] [[synonyms:b:bujhāite]]---to establish principles of religion or duty.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the ocean of mercy. Who can understand Him? When He chastises His dear devotees, He certainly does so to reestablish the principles of religion or duty.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says in this connection that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the ocean of mercy, chastised Junior Haridāsa, although Junior Haridāsa was His dear devotee, to establish that one in the devotional line, engaged in pure devotional service, should not be a hypocrite. For a person engaged in devotional service in the renounced order, having intimate relationships with women is certainly hypocrisy. This chastisement was given to Junior Haridāsa as an example to future //sahajiyās// who might adopt the dress of the renounced order to imitate Rūpa Gosvāmī and other bona fide //sannyāsīs// but secretly have illicit connections with women. To teach such men, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu chastised His dear devotee Haridāsa for a slight deviation from the regulative principles. Śrīmatī Mādhavīdevī was a highly elevated devotee; therefore approaching her to ask for some rice to serve Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was certainly not very offensive. Nevertheless, just to preserve the regulative principles for the future, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu enforced the hard-and-fast rule that no one in the renounced order should intimately mix with women. Had Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu not chastised Junior Haridāsa for this slight deviation, so-called devotees of the Lord would have exploited the example of Junior Haridāsa to continue their habit of illicit connections with women unrestrictedly. Indeed, they still preach that such behavior is allowed for a Vaiṣṇava. But it is strictly not allowed. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the teacher of the entire world, and therefore He enforced this exemplary punishment to establish that illicit sexual connections are never allowed by Vaiṣṇava philosophy. This was His purpose in chastising Junior Haridāsa. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is in fact the most magnanimous incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, but He strictly prohibited illicit sex.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.144
description: After all the devotees saw this example, a mentality of fear grew among them. Therefore they all stopped talking with women, even in dreams.
text:
> dekhi' trāsa upajila saba bhakta-gaṇe
> svapne-ha chāḍila sabe strī-sambhāṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---an atmosphere of fear; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---grew; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---among all the devotees; [[synonyms:s:svapne]]-[[synonyms:h:ha]]---even in dreams; [[synonyms:c:chāḍila]]---gave up; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:s:strī]]-[[synonyms:s:sambhāṣaṇe]]---talk with women.
translation: After all the devotees saw this example, a mentality of fear grew among them. Therefore they all stopped talking with women, even in dreams.
purport: In connection with //strī-sambhāṣaṇa,// talking with women, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that talking with women for the purpose of mingling with them for sense gratification, subtle or gross, is strictly prohibited. Cāṇakya Paṇḍita, the great moral instructor, says, //mātṛvat para-dāreṣu.// Thus not only a person in the renounced order or one engaged in devotional service but everyone should avoid mingling with women. One should consider another's wife his mother.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.145
description: In this way a complete year passed for Junior Haridāsa, but still there was not a sign of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy toward him.
text:
> ei-mate haridāsera eka vatsara gela
> tabu mahāprabhura mane prasāda nahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---one year; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:n:nahila]]---there were no symptoms of mercy.
translation: In this way a complete year passed for Junior Haridāsa, but still there was not a sign of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mercy toward him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.146
description: Thus at the end of one night, Junior Haridāsa, after offering Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu his respectful obeisances, departed for Prayāga without saying anything to anyone.
text:
> rātri avaśeṣe prabhure daṇḍavat hañā
> prayāgete gela kāreha kichu nā baliyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]] [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣe]]---at the end of one night; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:p:prayāgete]]---to the holy place known as Prayāga (Allahabad); [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went; [[synonyms:k:kāreha]]---to anyone; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:baliyā]]---not saying.
translation: Thus at the end of one night, Junior Haridāsa, after offering Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu his respectful obeisances, departed for Prayāga without saying anything to anyone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.147
description: Junior Haridāsa had conclusively decided to attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus he entered deep into the water at Triveṇī, the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā at Prayāga, and in this way gave up his life.
text:
> prabhu-pada-prāpti lāgi' saṅkalpa karila
> triveṇī praveśa kari' prāṇa chāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prāpti]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---with a view to getting; [[synonyms:s:saṅkalpa]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---decided definitely; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:v:veṇī]] [[synonyms:p:praveśa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---entering into the water at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā at Prayāga; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍila]]---give up his life.
translation: Junior Haridāsa had conclusively decided to attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Thus he entered deep into the water at Triveṇī, the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā at Prayāga, and in this way gave up his life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.148
description: Immediately after committing suicide in this way, he went in his spiritual body to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and received the mercy of the Lord. However, he still remained invisible.
text:
> sei-kṣaṇe divya-dehe prabhu-sthāne āilā
> prabhu-kṛpā pāñā antardhānei rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---immediately thereupon; [[synonyms:d:divya]]-[[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in a spiritual body; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:a:antardhānei]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained invisible.
translation: Immediately after committing suicide in this way, he went in his spiritual body to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and received the mercy of the Lord. However, he still remained invisible.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.149
description: In a spiritual body resembling that of a Gandharva, Junior Haridāsa, although invisible, would sing at night for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear. No one but the Lord, however, knew of this.
text:
> gandharva-dehe gāna karena antardhāne
> rātrye prabhure śunāya gīta, anye nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gandharva]]-[[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in the body of a Gandharva; [[synonyms:g:gāna]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---he sings; [[synonyms:a:antardhāne]]---without being visible; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śunāya]] [[synonyms:g:gīta]]---he was singing; [[synonyms:a:anye]]---others; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---could not understand.
translation: In a spiritual body resembling that of a Gandharva, Junior Haridāsa, although invisible, would sing at night for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to hear. No one but the Lord, however, knew of this.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.15
description: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the entire three worlds, not only by His personal presence but also by empowering others. I shall briefly describe how He empowered a living being in Bengal.
text:
> ei-mata āveśe tārila tribhuvana
> gauḍe yaiche āveśa, kari dig daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---by empowering; [[synonyms:t:tārila]] [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---delivered the entire three worlds; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---empowering; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:d:dik]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---I shall describe in brief.
translation: In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered the entire three worlds, not only by His personal presence but also by empowering others. I shall briefly describe how He empowered a living being in Bengal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.150
description: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the devotees, "Where is Haridāsa? Now you may bring him here."
text:
> eka-dina mahāprabhu puchilā bhakta-gaṇe
> 'haridāsa kāṅhā? tāre ānaha ekhāne'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:puchilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---inquired from the devotees; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---where is Haridāsa; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]] [[synonyms:e:ekhāne]]---bring here.
translation: One day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the devotees, "Where is Haridāsa? Now you may bring him here."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.151
description: The devotees all replied, "One night at the end of a full year, Junior Haridāsa got up and went away. No one knows where he has gone."
text:
> sabe kahe,---'haridāsa varṣa-pūrṇa dine
> rātre uṭhi kāṅhā gelā, keha nāhi jāne"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---everyone spoke; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa; [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---at the end of one full year; [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi]]---getting up; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---where he went; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---no one knows.
translation: The devotees all replied, "One night at the end of a full year, Junior Haridāsa got up and went away. No one knows where he has gone."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.152
description: While hearing the devotees lament, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was mildly smiling. Thus all the devotees were very astonished.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu īṣat hāsiyā rahilā
> saba bhakta-gaṇa mane vismaya ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]]---slightly; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained smiling; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds; [[synonyms:v:vismaya]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became surprised.
translation: While hearing the devotees lament, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was mildly smiling. Thus all the devotees were very astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.153-154
description: One day Jagadānanda, Svarūpa, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Śaṅkara, Dāmodara and Mukunda all went to bathe in the sea. They could hear Haridāsa singing from a distant place as if calling them in his original voice.
text:
> eka-dina jagadānanda, svarūpa, govinda
> kāśīśvara, śaṅkara, dāmodara, mukunda
>
> samudra-snāne gelā sabe, śune katho dūre
> haridāsa gāyena, yena ḍāki' kaṇṭha-svare
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]---Mukunda; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:s:snāne]]---bathing in the sea; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---could hear; [[synonyms:k:katho]] [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---from a distant place; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:g:gāyena]]---Junior Haridāsa was singing; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāki']]---calling; [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]]-[[synonyms:s:svare]]---in his original voice.
translation: One day Jagadānanda, Svarūpa, Govinda, Kāśīśvara, Śaṅkara, Dāmodara and Mukunda all went to bathe in the sea. They could hear Haridāsa singing from a distant place as if calling them in his original voice.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.155
description: No one could see him, but they could hear him singing in a sweet voice. Therefore all the devotees, headed by Govinda, made this guess.
text:
> manuṣya nā dekhe---madhura gīta-mātra śune
> govindādi sabe meli' kaila anumāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---a man; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---could not see; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---very sweet; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]---singing; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---one could hear; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all the devotees, headed by Govinda; [[synonyms:m:meli']]---coming together; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:a:anumāne]]---guessed.
translation: No one could see him, but they could hear him singing in a sweet voice. Therefore all the devotees, headed by Govinda, made this guess.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.156
description: "Haridāsa must have committed suicide by drinking poison, and because of this sinful act, he has now become a brāhmaṇa ghost.
text:
> 'viṣādi khāñā haridāsa ātma-ghāta kaila
> sei pāpe jāni 'brahma-rākṣasa' haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viṣa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---by drinking poison; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:g:ghāta]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---has committed suicide; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pāpe]]---on account of that sinful activity; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---we understand; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:r:rākṣasa]]---a //brāhmaṇa// ghost; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---he has become.
translation: "Haridāsa must have committed suicide by drinking poison, and because of this sinful act, he has now become a brāhmaṇa ghost.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.157
description: "We cannot see his material form," they said, "but still we hear his sweet singing. Therefore he must have become a ghost." Svarūpa Dāmodara, however, protested, "This is a false guess.
text:
> ākāra nā dekhi, mātra śuni tāra gāna'
> svarūpa kahena,---"ei mithyā anumāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ākāra]]---form; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---we cannot see; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---we hear; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---singing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mithyā]]---false; [[synonyms:a:anumāna]]---guess.
translation: "We cannot see his material form," they said, "but still we hear his sweet singing. Therefore he must have become a ghost." Svarūpa Dāmodara, however, protested, "This is a false guess.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.158
description: "Junior Haridāsa chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra throughout his entire life and served the Supreme Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Moreover, he is dear to the Lord and has died in a holy place.
text:
> ājanma kṛṣṇa-kīrtana, prabhura sevana
> prabhu-kṛpā-pātra, āra kṣetrera maraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ājanma]]---throughout the whole life; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:s:sevana]]---service to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---very dear to the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:kṣetrera]] [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]---his death in a holy place.
translation: "Junior Haridāsa chanted the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra throughout his entire life and served the Supreme Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Moreover, he is dear to the Lord and has died in a holy place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.159
description: "Haridāsa cannot have been degraded; he must have attained liberation. This is a pastime of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. You will all understand it later."
text:
> durgati nā haya tāra, sad-gati se haya
> prabhu-bhaṅgī ei, pāche jānibā niścaya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:durgati]]---a bad result; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---is not his; [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:g:gati]] [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---he must have achieved liberation; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]---a sport of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:j:jānibā]]---you will understand; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---the real fact.
translation: "Haridāsa cannot have been degraded; he must have attained liberation. This is a pastime of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. You will all understand it later."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.16
description: In Āmbuyā-muluka there was a person named Nakula Brahmacārī, who was a perfectly pure devotee, greatly advanced in devotional service.
text:
> āmbuyā-muluke haya nakula-brahmacārī
> parama-vaiṣṇava teṅho baḍa adhikārī
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmbuyā]]-[[synonyms:m:muluke]]---in the province known as Āmbuyā; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---here is; [[synonyms:n:nakula]]-[[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]]---a person known as Nakula Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---a perfectly pure devotee; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:a:adhikārī]]---very advanced in devotional service.
translation: In Āmbuyā-muluka there was a person named Nakula Brahmacārī, who was a perfectly pure devotee, greatly advanced in devotional service.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says that Āmbuyā-muluka is the present Ambikā, a city in the Vardhamāna district of West Bengal. Formerly, during the Mohammedan regime, it was known as Āmbuyā-muluka. In this city there is a neighborhood called Pyārīgañja, and that is where Nakula Brahmacārī used to live.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.160
description: A devotee returned to Navadvīpa from Prayāga and told everyone the details of Junior Haridāsa's suicide.
text:
> prayāga ha-ite eka vaiṣṇava navadvīpa āila
> haridāsera vārtā teṅho sabāre kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prayāga]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from Prayāga; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:navadvīpa]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came to Navadvīpa; [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]] [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---the news of Haridāsa; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---informed everyone.
translation: A devotee returned to Navadvīpa from Prayāga and told everyone the details of Junior Haridāsa's suicide.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.161
description: He explained how Junior Haridāsa had made his resolution and had thus entered the waters at the confluence of the Yamunā and Ganges. Hearing these details, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and the other devotees were very surprised.
text:
> yaiche saṅkalpa, yaiche triveṇī praveśila
> śuni, śrīvāsādira mane vismaya ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yaiche]] [[synonyms:s:saṅkalpa]]---how he was determined; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:t:triveṇī]] [[synonyms:p:praveśila]]---he entered into Triveṇī; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādira]]---of Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and others; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds; [[synonyms:v:vismaya]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was surprise.
translation: He explained how Junior Haridāsa had made his resolution and had thus entered the waters at the confluence of the Yamunā and Ganges. Hearing these details, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura and the other devotees were very surprised.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.162
description: At the end of the year, Śivānanda Sena came to Jagannātha Purī as usual, accompanied by the other devotees, and thus in great happiness met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> varṣāntare śivānanda saba bhakta lañā
> prabhure mililā āsi' ānandita hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---at the end of the year; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming greatly happy.
translation: At the end of the year, Śivānanda Sena came to Jagannātha Purī as usual, accompanied by the other devotees, and thus in great happiness met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.163
description: When Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura inquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Where is Junior Haridāsa?" The Lord replied, "A person is sure to achieve the results of his fruitive activities."
text:
> 'haridāsa kāṅhā?' yadi śrīvāsa puchilā
> "sva-karma-phala-bhuk pumān"---prabhu uttara dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---where is junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura inquired; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:k:karma]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuk]]---sure to accept the resultant action of his fruitive activities; [[synonyms:p:pumān]]---a person; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uttara]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---replied.
translation: When Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura inquired from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Where is Junior Haridāsa?" The Lord replied, "A person is sure to achieve the results of his fruitive activities."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.164
description: Then Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura related the details of Haridāsa's decision and his entering the waters at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā.
text:
> tabe śrīvāsa tāra vṛttānta kahila
> yaiche saṅkalpa, yaiche triveṇī praveśila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:v:vṛttānta]]---story; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---spoke; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:s:saṅkalpa]]---he decided; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:t:triveṇī]] [[synonyms:p:praveśila]]---he entered the waters at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā.
translation: Then Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura related the details of Haridāsa's decision and his entering the waters at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.165
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these details, He smiled in a pleased mood and said, "If with sensual intentions one looks at women, this is the only process of atonement."
text:
> śuni' prabhu hāsi' kahe suprasanna citta
> 'prakṛti darśana kaile ei prāyaścitta'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---replied; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:p:prasanna]] [[synonyms:c:citta]]---being in a happy mood; [[synonyms:p:prakṛti]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:k:kaile]]---if someone sees women with a sensual propensity; [[synonyms:e:eiprāyaścitta]]---this is the atonement.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these details, He smiled in a pleased mood and said, "If with sensual intentions one looks at women, this is the only process of atonement."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.166
description: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, concluded that because Haridāsa had committed suicide at the confluence of the rivers Ganges and Yamunā, he must have ultimately attained shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> svarūpādi mili' tabe vicāra karilā
> triveṇī-prabhāve haridāsa prabhu-pada pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---devotees headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:m:mili']]---coming together; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---discussed; [[synonyms:t:triveṇī]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhāve]]---by the influence of the holy place at the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Junior Haridāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---achieved the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, concluded that because Haridāsa had committed suicide at the confluence of the rivers Ganges and Yamunā, he must have ultimately attained shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura remarks that after one adopts the renounced order and accepts the dress of either a //sannyāsī// or a //bābājī,// if he entertains the idea of sense gratification, especially in relationship with a woman, the only atonement is to commit suicide in the confluence of the Ganges and Yamunā. Only by such atonement can his sinful life be purified. If such a person is thus punished, it is possible for him to attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Without such punishment, however, the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is very difficult to regain.

translation: In this way, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the son of mother Śacī, performs His pastimes, which greatly satisfy the ears and minds of pure devotees who hear about them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.172
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


Instructions from this Chapter

Summarizing this chapter, Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that one should derive from it the following lessons. (1) Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is an incarnation of mercy, He nevertheless gave up the company of one of His personal associates, namely Junior Haridāsa, for if He had not done so, pseudo-devotees would have taken advantage of Junior Haridāsa's fault by using it as an excuse to live as devotees and at the same time have illicit sexual connections. Such activities would have demoralized the cult of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and as a result, devotees would surely have gone to a hellish life in the name of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. (2) By chastising Junior Haridāsa, the Lord set the standard for //ācāryas,// or the heads of institutions propagating the Caitanya cult, and for all actual devotees. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to maintain the highest standard. (3) Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed that a pure devotee should be simple and free from sinful activities, for thus one can be His bona fide servant. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu taught His followers how to observe the renounced order strictly. (4) Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to prove that His devotees are exalted and that their character is ideal. He kindly accepts His faithful devotees and teaches them how much tribulation and disturbance can be produced by even a slight deviation from the strict principles of devotional life. (5) By chastising Junior Haridāsa, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited His mercy toward him, thus showing how elevated was junior Haridāsa's devotion for Him. Because of this transcendental relationship, the Lord corrected even a slight offense committed by His pure devotee. Therefore one who wants to be a pure devotee of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu should give up all material sense gratification; otherwise, the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very difficult to attain. (6) If one dies in such a celebrated holy place as Prayāga, Mathurā or Vṛndāvana, one can be relieved of the reactions to sinful life and then attain the shelter of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. (7) Although a pure or faithful devotee may fall down, he nevertheless ultimately gets the chance to go back home, back to Godhead, by the mercy of the Lord.

//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Second Chapter, describing the chastisement of Junior Haridāsa.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.18
description: Nakula Brahmacārī became exactly like a man haunted by a ghost. Thus he sometimes laughed, sometimes cried, sometimes danced and sometimes chanted like a madman.
text:
> graha-grasta-prāya nakula premāviṣṭa hañā
> hāse, kānde, nāce, gāya unmatta hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:graha]]-[[synonyms:g:grasta]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---exactly like one haunted by a ghost; [[synonyms:n:nakula]]---Nakula Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being overwhelmed by ecstatic love of God; [[synonyms:h:hāse]]---laughs; [[synonyms:k:kānde]]---cries; [[synonyms:n:nāce]]---dances; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---chants; [[synonyms:u:unmatta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---just like a madman.
translation: Nakula Brahmacārī became exactly like a man haunted by a ghost. Thus he sometimes laughed, sometimes cried, sometimes danced and sometimes chanted like a madman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.19

text:

> nirantara preme nṛtya, saghana huṅkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:k:kampa]]---trembling; [[synonyms:s:stambha]]---becoming stunned; [[synonyms:s:sveda]]---perspiration; [[synonyms:s:sāttvika]] [[synonyms:v:vikāra]]---all such transcendental transformations; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---continuously; [[synonyms:p:preme]] [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:g:ghana]] [[synonyms:h:huṅkāra]]---a sound like that of a cloud.
translation: He continuously exhibited bodily transformations of transcendental love. Thus he cried, trembled, became stunned, perspired, danced in love of Godhead and made sounds like those of a cloud.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaita Ācārya! And all glories to all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.20

translation: He advised whomever he met to chant the holy names Hare Kṛṣṇa. Thus upon seeing him, people were overwhelmed with love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.22

text:
> caitanyera āveśa haya nakulera dehe

translation: When Śivānanda Sena heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had entered the body of Nakula Brahmacārī, he went there with doubts in his mind.

translation: Desiring to test the authenticity of Nakula Brahmacārī, he stayed outside, thinking as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.24-25
description: "If Nakula Brahmacārī personally calls me and knows my worshipable mantra, then I shall understand that he is inspired by the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu." Thinking in this way, he stayed some distance apart.
text:
> "āpane bolāna more, ihā yadi jāni
> āmāra iṣṭa-mantra jāni' kahena āpani
>
> tabe jāni, iṅhāte haya caitanya-āveśe"
> eta cinti' śivānanda rahilā dūra-deśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:b:bolāna]]---calls; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I understand; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:m:mantra]]---worshipable //mantra//; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing; [[synonyms:k:kahena]] [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---he says himself; [[synonyms:t:tabe]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---then I shall understand; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāte]]---in him; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---being possessed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:c:cinti']]---thinking this; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:d:dūra]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---a little far off.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.27

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.28
description: Thus people began running here and there, calling in all directions, "Śivānanda! Whoever is Śivānanda, please come. Nakula Brahmacārī is calling you."
text:
> cāri-dike dhāya loke 'śivānanda' bali
> śivānanda kon, tomāya bolāya brahmacārī
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---in four directions; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]] [[synonyms:l:loke]]---people began to run; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:b:bali]]---calling loudly the name of Śivānanda; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kon]]---whoever is Śivānanda; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---unto you; [[synonyms:b:bolāya]]---calls; [[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]]---Nakula Brahmacārī.
translation: Thus people began running here and there, calling in all directions, "Śivānanda! Whoever is Śivānanda, please come. Nakula Brahmacārī is calling you."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.29
description: Hearing these calls, Śivānanda Sena quickly went there, offered obeisances to Nakula Brahmacārī, and sat down near him.
text:
> śuni, śivānanda sena tāṅhā śīghra āila
> namaskāra kari' tāṅra nikaṭe vasila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:s:sena]]---of the name Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---quickly; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---near him; [[synonyms:v:vasila]]---sat down.
translation: Hearing these calls, Śivānanda Sena quickly went there, offered obeisances to Nakula Brahmacārī, and sat down near him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.3
description: In His incarnation as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa descended to deliver all the living beings in the three worlds, from Brahmaloka down to Pātālaloka. He caused their deliverance in three ways.
text:
> sarva-loka uddhārite gaura-avatāra
> nistārera hetu tāra trividha prakāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---all the worlds; [[synonyms:u:uddhārite]]---to deliver; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---the incarnation of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nistārera]] [[synonyms:h:hetu]]---causes of the deliverance of all people; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---His; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:v:vidha]] [[synonyms:p:prakāra]]---three kinds.
translation: In His incarnation as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa descended to deliver all the living beings in the three worlds, from Brahmaloka down to Pātālaloka. He caused their deliverance in three ways.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.30
description: Nakula Brahmacārī said, "I know that you are doubtful. Now please hear this evidence with great attention.
text:
> brahmacārī bale,---"tumi karilā saṁśaya
> eka-manā hañā śuna tāhāra niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---Nakula Brahmacārī said; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---have doubted; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:manā]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---with great attention; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---for that; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---settlement.
translation: Nakula Brahmacārī said, "I know that you are doubtful. Now please hear this evidence with great attention.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.31
description: "You are chanting the Gaura-gopāla mantra composed of four syllables. Now please give up the doubts that have resided within you."
text:
> 'gaura-gopāla mantra' tomāra cāri akṣara
> aviśvāsa chāḍa, yei kariyācha antara"
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]] [[synonyms:m:mantra]]---the Gaura-gopāla //mantra//; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:a:akṣara]]---composed of four syllables; [[synonyms:a:aviśvāsa]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍa]]---give up your doubts; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:k:kariyācha]] [[synonyms:a:antara]]---you have kept within your mind.
translation: "You are chanting the Gaura-gopāla mantra composed of four syllables. Now please give up the doubts that have resided within you."
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura explains the Gaura-gopāla //mantra// in his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya.// Worshipers of Śrī Gaurasundara accept the four syllables //gau-ra-aṇ-ga// as the Gaura //mantra,// but pure worshipers of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa accept the four syllables //rā-dhā kṛṣ-ṇa// as the Gaura-gopāla //mantra.// However, Vaiṣṇavas consider Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu nondifferent from Rādhā-Kṛṣṇa (//śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya rādhā-kṛṣṇa nahe anya//). Therefore one who chants the //mantra// Gaurāṅga and one who chants the names of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa are on the same level.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.32
description: Śivānanda Sena thereupon developed full confidence in his mind that Nakula Brahmacārī was filled with the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śivānanda Sena then offered him respect and devotional service.
text:
> tabe śivānandera mane pratīti ha-ila
> aneka sammāna kari' bahu bhakti kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:p:pratīti]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was confidence; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:s:sammāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering him much respect; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---offered him devotional service.
translation: Śivānanda Sena thereupon developed full confidence in his mind that Nakula Brahmacārī was filled with the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śivānanda Sena then offered him respect and devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.33
description: In this way, one should understand the inconceivable potencies of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Now please hear how His appearance [āvirbhāva] takes place.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhura acintya prabhāva
> ebe śuna prabhura yaiche haya 'āvirbhāva'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:acintya]] [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---inconceivable influence; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---in which way; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:ā:āvirbhāva]]---appearance.
translation: In this way, one should understand the inconceivable potencies of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Now please hear how His appearance [āvirbhāva] takes place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.34-35
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always appeared in four places-in the household temple of mother Śacī, in the places where Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu danced, in the house of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita during congregational chanting and in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. He appeared because of His attraction to the love of His devotees. That is His natural characteristic.
text:
> śacīra mandire, āra nityānanda-nartane
> śrīvāsa-kīrtane, āra rāghava-bhavane
>
> ei cāri ṭhāñi prabhura sadā 'āvirbhāva'
> premākṛṣṭa haya,---prabhura sahaja svabhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śacīra]] [[synonyms:m:mandire]]---in the household temple of mother Śacī; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:n:nartane]]---at the time of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu's dancing; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtane]]---at the time of congregational chanting headed by Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:b:bhavane]]---in the house of Rāghava; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in these four places; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:ā:āvirbhāva]]---appearance; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākṛṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is attracted by love; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sahaja]] [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---natural characteristic.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always appeared in four places-in the household temple of mother Śacī, in the places where Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu danced, in the house of Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita during congregational chanting and in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. He appeared because of His attraction to the love of His devotees. That is His natural characteristic.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.36
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and ate his offerings. Please hear about this with attention.
text:
> nṛsiṁhānandera āge āvirbhūta hañā
> bhojana karilā, tāhā śuna mana diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānandera]]---the //brahmacārī// known as Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before; [[synonyms:ā:āvirbhūta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---appearing; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---He accepted offerings of food; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with attention.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu appeared before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī and ate his offerings. Please hear about this with attention.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.37
description: Śivānanda Sena had a nephew named Śrīkānta Sena, who by the grace of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely fortunate.
text:
> śivānandera bhāginā śrī-kānta-sena nāma
> prabhura kṛpāte teṅho baḍa bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:b:bhāginā]]---nephew; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kānta]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named Śrīkānta Sena; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by the causeless mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---very; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---fortunate.
translation: Śivānanda Sena had a nephew named Śrīkānta Sena, who by the grace of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely fortunate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.38
description: One year, Śrīkānta Sena came alone to Jagannātha Purī in great eagerness to see the Lord.
text:
> eka vatsara teṅho prathama ekeśvara
> prabhu dekhibāre āilā utkaṇṭhā-antara
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---one year; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Śrīkānta Sena; [[synonyms:p:prathama]]---first; [[synonyms:e:ekeśvara]]---alone; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see the Lord; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]]---with great anxiety in the mind.
translation: One year, Śrīkānta Sena came alone to Jagannātha Purī in great eagerness to see the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.39
description: Seeing Śrīkānta Sena, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed causeless mercy upon him. Śrīkānta Sena stayed near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for about two months at Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> mahāprabhu tāre dekhi' baḍa kṛpā kailā
> māsa-dui teṅho prabhura nikaṭe rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---bestowed great mercy; [[synonyms:m:māsa]]-[[synonyms:d:dui]]---for two months; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Śrīkānta Sena; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---stayed.
translation: Seeing Śrīkānta Sena, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bestowed causeless mercy upon him. Śrīkānta Sena stayed near Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for about two months at Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.4
description: The Lord delivered the fallen souls in some places by meeting them directly, in other places by empowering a pure devotee, and in still other places by appearing before someone Himself.
text:
> sākṣāt-darśana, āra yogya-bhakta-jīve
> 'āveśa' karaye kāhāṅ, kāhāṅ 'āvirbhāve'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]-[[synonyms:d:darśana]]---direct meeting; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---perfect devotee; [[synonyms:j:jīve]]---living beings; [[synonyms:ā:āveśa]] [[synonyms:k:karaye]]---empowers with specific spiritual potencies; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---somewhere; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---in other places; [[synonyms:ā:āvirbhāve]]---by appearing Himself.
translation: The Lord delivered the fallen souls in some places by meeting them directly, in other places by empowering a pure devotee, and in still other places by appearing before someone Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.40
description: When he was about to return to Bengal, the Lord told him, "Forbid the devotees of Bengal to come to Jagannātha Purī this year.
text:
> tabe prabhu tāṅre ājñā kailā gauḍe yāite
> "bhakta-gaṇe niṣedhiha ethāke āsite
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---ordered; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---returning to Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:n:niṣedhiha]]---forbid; [[synonyms:e:ethāke]] [[synonyms:ā:āsite]]---to come to this place.
translation: When he was about to return to Bengal, the Lord told him, "Forbid the devotees of Bengal to come to Jagannātha Purī this year.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.41
description: "This year I shall personally go to Bengal and meet all the devotees there, headed by Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> e-vatsara tāṅhā āmi yāimu āpane
> tāhāi milimu saba advaitādi sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---this year; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there (to Bengal); [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:y:yāimu]]---shall go; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:t:tāhāi]]---there; [[synonyms:m:milimu]]---I shall meet; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with.
translation: "This year I shall personally go to Bengal and meet all the devotees there, headed by Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.42
description: "Please inform Śivānanda Sena that this December I shall certainly go to his home.
text:
> śivānande kahiha,---āmi ei pauṣa-māse
> ācambite avaśya āmi yāiba tāṅra pāśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---speak to Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pauṣa]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---in the month of December; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---all of a sudden; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:y:yāiba]]---shall go; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---to his place.
translation: "Please inform Śivānanda Sena that this December I shall certainly go to his home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.43
description: "Jagadānanda is there, and he will give Me offerings of food. Inform them all that no one should come to Jagannātha Purī this year."
text:
> jagadānanda haya tāhāṅ, teṅho bhikṣā dibe
> sabāre kahiha,---e vatsara keha nā āsibe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---will give offerings of food; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahiha]]---inform all of them; [[synonyms:e:evatsara]]---this year; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsibe]]---no one should come.
translation: "Jagadānanda is there, and he will give Me offerings of food. Inform them all that no one should come to Jagannātha Purī this year."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.44
description: When Śrīkānta Sena returned to Bengal and delivered this message, the minds of all the devotees were very pleased.
text:
> śrī-kānta āsiyā gauḍe sandeśa kahila
> śuni' bhakta-gaṇa-mane ānanda ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kānta]]---Śrīkānta Sena; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming back; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:s:sandeśa]]---message; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---delivered; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the minds of the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was great happiness.
translation: When Śrīkānta Sena returned to Bengal and delivered this message, the minds of all the devotees were very pleased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.45
description: Advaita Ācārya was just about to go to Jagannātha Purī with the other devotees, but upon hearing this message, He waited. Śivānanda Sena and Jagadānanda also stayed back, awaiting the arrival of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> calitechilā ācārya, rahilā sthira hañā
> śivānanda, jagadānanda rahe pratyāśā kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:calitechilā]]---was ready to go; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:s:sthira]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being without movement; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:p:pratyāśā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---expecting.
translation: Advaita Ācārya was just about to go to Jagannātha Purī with the other devotees, but upon hearing this message, He waited. Śivānanda Sena and Jagadānanda also stayed back, awaiting the arrival of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.46
description: When the month of Pauṣa arrived, both Jagadānanda and Śivānanda collected all kinds of paraphernalia for the Lord's reception. Every day, they would wait until evening for the Lord to come.
text:
> pauṣa-māse āila duṅhe sāmagrī kariyā
> sandhyā-paryanta rahe apekṣā kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pauṣa]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---the month of Pauṣa (December-January); [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---Śivānanda Sena and Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---making all arrangements; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---until the evening; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:a:apekṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---waiting.
translation: When the month of Pauṣa arrived, both Jagadānanda and Śivānanda collected all kinds of paraphernalia for the Lord's reception. Every day, they would wait until evening for the Lord to come.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.47
description: As the month passed but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not come, Jagadānanda and Śivānanda became most unhappy.
text:
> ei-mata māsa gela, gosāñi nā āilā
> jagadānanda, śivānanda duḥkhita ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:māsa]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---the month passed; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not come; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhita]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became very unhappy.
translation: As the month passed but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not come, Jagadānanda and Śivānanda became most unhappy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.48-49
description: Suddenly Nṛsiṁhānanda arrived, and Jagadānanda and Śivānanda arranged for him to sit near them. Seeing them both so unhappy, Nṛsiṁhānanda inquired, "Why do I see that you are both despondent?"
text:
> ācambite nṛsiṁhānanda tāhāṅi āilā
> duṅhe tāṅre mili' tabe sthāne vasāilā
> duṅhe duḥkhī dekhi' tabe kahe nṛsiṁhānanda
> 'tomā duṅhākāre kene dekhi nirānanda?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---all of a sudden; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānanda]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅi]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came there; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---Śivānanda and Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:m:mili']]---meeting; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:s:sthāne]] [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---caused to sit; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]]---unhappy; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānanda]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda began to speak; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:d:duṅhākāre]]---both of you; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:n:nirānanda]]---unhappy.
translation: Suddenly Nṛsiṁhānanda arrived, and Jagadānanda and Śivānanda arranged for him to sit near them. Seeing them both so unhappy, Nṛsiṁhānanda inquired, "Why do I see that you are both despondent?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.5-6
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered almost all the fallen souls by directly meeting them. He delivered others by entering the body of Nakula Brahmacārī and by appearing before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī. "I shall deliver the fallen souls." This statement characterizes the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
text:
> 'sākṣāt-darśane' prāya saba nistārilā
> nakula-brahmacārīra dehe 'āviṣṭa' ha-ilā
>
> pradyumna-nṛsiṁhānanda āge kailā 'āvirbhāva'
> 'loka nistāriba',---ei īśvara-svabhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]-[[synonyms:d:darśane]]---by direct meeting; [[synonyms:p:prāya]]---almost; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nistārilā]]---delivered; [[synonyms:n:nakula]]-[[synonyms:b:brahmacārīra]]---of a //brahmacārī// named Nakula; [[synonyms:d:dehe]]---in the body; [[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---entered; [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānanda]]---Pradyumna Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:ā:āvirbhāva]]---appearance; [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:n:nistāriba]]---I shall deliver all the fallen souls; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---the characteristic of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered almost all the fallen souls by directly meeting them. He delivered others by entering the body of Nakula Brahmacārī and by appearing before Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī. "I shall deliver the fallen souls." This statement characterizes the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
purport: The Lord always manifested His //āvirbhāva// appearance in the following four places: (1) the house of Śrīmatī Śacīmātā, (2) wherever Nityānanda Prabhu danced in ecstasy, (3) the house of Śrīvāsa (when //kīrtana// was performed), and (4) the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. Lord Caitanya Himself appeared in these four places. (In this connection, one may consult text 34.)

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.50
description: Then Śivānanda Sena told him, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu promised that He would come. Why, then, has He not arrived?"
text:
> tabe śivānanda tāṅre sakala kahilā
> 'āsiba ājñā dilā prabhu kene nā āilā?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said everything; [[synonyms:ā:āsiba]]---I shall come; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---promised; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---has He not come.
translation: Then Śivānanda Sena told him, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu promised that He would come. Why, then, has He not arrived?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.51
description: Hearing this, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī replied, "Please be satisfied. I assure you that I shall bring Him here three days from now."
text:
> śuni' brahmacārī kahe,---'karaha santoṣe
> āmi ta' āniba tāṅre tṛtīya divase'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:santoṣe]]---become happy; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:ā:āniba]]---shall bring; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him (Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu); [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]] [[synonyms:d:divase]]---on the third day.
translation: Hearing this, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī replied, "Please be satisfied. I assure you that I shall bring Him here three days from now."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.52
description: Śivānanda and Jagadānanda knew of Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī's influence and love of Godhead. Therefore they now felt assured that he would certainly bring Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> tāṅhāra prabhāva-prema jāne dui-jane
> ānibe prabhure ebe niścaya kailā mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---influence; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---love of Godhead; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---know; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of them; [[synonyms:ā:ānibe]] [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---he will bring Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---they were greatly assured within their minds.
translation: Śivānanda and Jagadānanda knew of Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī's influence and love of Godhead. Therefore they now felt assured that he would certainly bring Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.53
description: His real name was Pradyumna Brahmacārī. The name Nṛsiṁhānanda had been given to him by Lord Gaurasundara Himself.
text:
> 'pradyumna brahmacārī'---tāṅra nija-nāma
> 'nṛsiṁhānanda' nāma tāṅra kailā gaura-dhāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]] [[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]]---Pradyumna Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---real name; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhānanda]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāma]]---was given by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: His real name was Pradyumna Brahmacārī. The name Nṛsiṁhānanda had been given to him by Lord Gaurasundara Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.54
description: After meditating for two days, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī told Śivānanda Sena, "I have already brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to the village known as Pāṇihāṭi.
text:
> dui dina dhyāna kari' śivānandere kahila
> "pāṇihāṭi grāme āmi prabhure ānila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---for two days; [[synonyms:d:dhyāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after meditating; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandere]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---he said to Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:pāṇihāṭi]] [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---to the village called Pāṇihāṭi; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---have brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After meditating for two days, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī told Śivānanda Sena, "I have already brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to the village known as Pāṇihāṭi.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.55
description: "Tomorrow at noon He will come to your home. Therefore please bring all kinds of cooking ingredients. I shall personally cook and offer Him food.
text:
> kāli madhyāhne teṅho āsibena tomāra ghare
> pāka-sāmagrī ānaha, āmi bhikṣā dimu tāṅre
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāli]] [[synonyms:m:madhyāhne]]---tomorrow at noon; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:ā:āsibena]]---will come; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to your place; [[synonyms:p:pāka]]-[[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]] [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]]---please bring everything necessary for cooking; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:dimu]]---shall cook and offer food; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to Him.
translation: "Tomorrow at noon He will come to your home. Therefore please bring all kinds of cooking ingredients. I shall personally cook and offer Him food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.56
description: "In this way I shall bring Him here very soon. Be assured that I am telling you the truth. Do not be doubtful.
text:
> tabe tāṅre ethā āmi āniba satvara
> niścaya kahilāṅa, kichu sandeha nā kara
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---in this way; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:ā:āniba]] [[synonyms:s:satvara]]---shall bring very soon; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---with certainty; [[synonyms:k:kahilāṅa]]---I spoke; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:s:sandeha]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do not be doubtful.
translation: "In this way I shall bring Him here very soon. Be assured that I am telling you the truth. Do not be doubtful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.57
description: "Bring all the ingredients very soon, for I want to begin cooking immediately. Please do what I say."
text:
> ye cāhiye, tāhā kara hañā tat-para
> ati tvarāya kariba pāka, śuna ataḥpara
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:c:cāhiye]]---whatever I want; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---arrange for that; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:p:para]]---being intent; [[synonyms:a:ati]] [[synonyms:t:tvarāya]]---very soon; [[synonyms:k:kariba]] [[synonyms:p:pāka]]---I shall begin cooking; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]] [[synonyms:a:ataḥpara]]---just hear.
translation: "Bring all the ingredients very soon, for I want to begin cooking immediately. Please do what I say."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.58
description: Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to Śivānanda, "Please bring whatever cooking ingredients I want." Thus Śivānanda Sena immediately brought whatever he asked for.
text:
> pāka-sāmagrī ānaha, āmi yāhā cāi'
> ye māgila, śivānanda āni' dilā tāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāka]]-[[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]] [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]]---bring all cooking ingredients; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:c:cāi]]---whatever I want; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:m:māgila]]---whatever he wanted; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dilā]] [[synonyms:t:tāi]]---delivered everything.
translation: Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to Śivānanda, "Please bring whatever cooking ingredients I want." Thus Śivānanda Sena immediately brought whatever he asked for.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.59
description: Beginning early in the morning, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī cooked many varieties of food, including vegetables, cakes, sweet rice and other preparations.
text:
> prātaḥ-kāla haite pāka karilā apāra
> nānā vyañjana, piṭhā, kṣīra nānā upahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---beginning from the morning; [[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---cooked many varieties of food; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---varieties of vegetables; [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]---cakes; [[synonyms:k:kṣīra]]---sweet rice; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---offerings of food.
translation: Beginning early in the morning, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī cooked many varieties of food, including vegetables, cakes, sweet rice and other preparations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.60
description: After he finished cooking, he brought separate dishes for Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagannāthera bhinna bhoga pṛthak bāḍila
> caitanya prabhura lāgi' āra bhoga kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:b:bhinna]]---separate; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---offerings; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separately; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---arranged; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---offerings of food; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made.
translation: After he finished cooking, he brought separate dishes for Jagannātha and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.61
description: He also separately offered dishes to Nṛsiṁhadeva, his worshipable Deity. Thus he divided all the food into three offerings. Then, outside the temple, he began to meditate upon the Lord.
text:
> iṣṭa-deva nṛsiṁha lāgi' pṛthak bāḍila
> tina-jane samarpiyā bāhire dhyāna kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:d:deva]]---the worshipable Deity; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]---Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separately; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---arranged; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---to the three Deities; [[synonyms:s:samarpiyā]]---offering; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:d:dhyāna]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---meditated.
translation: He also separately offered dishes to Nṛsiṁhadeva, his worshipable Deity. Thus he divided all the food into three offerings. Then, outside the temple, he began to meditate upon the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.62
description: In his meditation he saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu quickly come, sit down and eat all three offerings, leaving behind no remnants.
text:
> dekhe, śīghra āsi' vasilā caitanya-gosāñi
> tina bhoga khāilā, kichu avaśiṣṭa nāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---he sees; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming quickly; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the three separate offerings; [[synonyms:k:khāilā]]---He ate; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:a:avaśiṣṭa]] [[synonyms:n:nāi]]---there were no remnants left.
translation: In his meditation he saw Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu quickly come, sit down and eat all three offerings, leaving behind no remnants.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.63
description: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was overwhelmed by transcendental ecstasy upon seeing Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything. Thus tears flowed from his eyes. Nevertheless, he expressed dismay, saying, "Alas, alas! My dear Lord, what are You doing? You are eating everyone's food!
text:
> ānande vihvala pradyumna, paḍe aśru-dhāra
> "hāhā kibā kara" bali' karaye phutkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]] [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed by transcendental ecstasy; [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]]---Pradyumna Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]] [[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:d:dhāra]]---tears fell from his eyes; [[synonyms:h:hāhā]]---alas, alas; [[synonyms:k:kibā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---what are You doing; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:p:phut]]-[[synonyms:k:kāra]]---began to express disappointment.
translation: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was overwhelmed by transcendental ecstasy upon seeing Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything. Thus tears flowed from his eyes. Nevertheless, he expressed dismay, saying, "Alas, alas! My dear Lord, what are You doing? You are eating everyone's food!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.64
description: "My dear Lord, You are one with Jagannātha; therefore I have no objection to Your eating His offering. But why are You touching the offering to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva?
text:
> jagannāthe-tomāya aikya, khāo tāṅra bhoga
> nṛsiṁhera bhoga kene kara upayoga?
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthe]]---with Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---and You; [[synonyms:a:aikya]]---oneness; [[synonyms:k:khāo]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---You may eat His offering; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhera]] [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the offering of Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:k:kene]] [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:u:upayoga]]---why are You eating.
translation: "My dear Lord, You are one with Jagannātha; therefore I have no objection to Your eating His offering. But why are You touching the offering to Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.65
description: "I think that Nṛsiṁhadeva could not eat anything today, and therefore He is fasting. If the master fasts, how can the servant live?"
text:
> nṛsiṁhera haila jāni āji upavāsa
> ṭhākura upavāsī rahe, jiye kaiche dāsa?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁhera]]---of Lord Nṛsiṁha; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I understand; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:u:upavāsa]]---fasting; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]] [[synonyms:u:upavāsī]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---the master remains fasting; [[synonyms:j:jiye]] [[synonyms:k:kaiche]] [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---how can the servant sustain his life.
translation: "I think that Nṛsiṁhadeva could not eat anything today, and therefore He is fasting. If the master fasts, how can the servant live?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.66
description: Although Nṛsiṁha Brahmacārī felt jubilation within his heart to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything, for the sake of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva he externally expressed disappointment.
text:
> bhojana dekhi' yadyapi tāṅra hṛdaye ullāsa
> nṛsiṁha lakṣya kari' bāhye kichu kare duḥkhābhāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing the eating; [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---within his heart; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---jubilation; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]---Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:l:lakṣya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---for the sake of; [[synonyms:b:bāhye]]---externally; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---expression of disappointment.
translation: Although Nṛsiṁha Brahmacārī felt jubilation within his heart to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating everything, for the sake of Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva he externally expressed disappointment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.67
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. Therefore there is no difference between Him, Lord Jagannātha and Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva.
text:
> svayaṁ bhagavān kṛṣṇa-caitanya-gosāñi
> jagannātha-nṛsiṁha-saha kichu bheda nāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svayam]]---personally; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with Lord Jagannātha and Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:b:bheda]]---any difference; [[synonyms:n:nāi]]---there is not.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself. Therefore there is no difference between Him, Lord Jagannātha and Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.68
description: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was deeply eager to understand this fact. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu revealed it to him by a practical demonstration.
text:
> ihā jānibāre pradyumnera gūḍha haita mana
> tāhā dekhāilā prabhu kariyā bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this fact; [[synonyms:j:jānibāre]]---to know; [[synonyms:p:pradyumnera]]---of Pradyumna Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:g:gūḍha]]---deeply; [[synonyms:h:haita]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---was eager; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dekhāilā]]---exhibited; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---by eating.
translation: Pradyumna Brahmacārī was deeply eager to understand this fact. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu revealed it to him by a practical demonstration.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.69
description: After eating all the offerings, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started for Pāṇihāṭi. There, He was greatly satisfied to see the different varieties of vegetables prepared in the house of Rāghava.
text:
> bhojana kariyā prabhu gelā pāṇihāṭi
> santoṣa pāilā dekhi' vyañjana-paripāṭī
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---after eating all the offerings; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:p:pāṇihāṭi]]---started for Pāṇihāṭi; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---He became very satisfied; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]-[[synonyms:p:paripāṭī]]---arrangement of vegetables.
translation: After eating all the offerings, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu started for Pāṇihāṭi. There, He was greatly satisfied to see the different varieties of vegetables prepared in the house of Rāghava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.7
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was personally present, anyone in the world who met Him even once was fully satisfied and became spiritually advanced.
text:
> sākṣāt-darśane saba jagat tārilā
> eka-bāra ye dekhilā, se kṛtārtha ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]-[[synonyms:d:darśane]]---by direct meetings; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the universe; [[synonyms:t:tārilā]]---He delivered; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---saw; [[synonyms:s:se]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---fully satisfied; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was personally present, anyone in the world who met Him even once was fully satisfied and became spiritually advanced.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.70
description: Śivānanda said to Nṛsiṁhānanda, "Why are you expressing dismay?" Nṛsiṁhānanda replied, "Just see the behavior of your Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> śivānanda kahe,---'kene karaha phutkāra?'
> teṅha kahe,---"dekha tomāra prabhura vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śivānanda Sena said; [[synonyms:k:kene]] [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:p:phut]]-[[synonyms:k:kāra]]---why are you expressing dismay; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he replied; [[synonyms:d:dekha]]---see; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of your Lord; [[synonyms:v:vyayahāra]]---the behavior.
translation: Śivānanda said to Nṛsiṁhānanda, "Why are you expressing dismay?" Nṛsiṁhānanda replied, "Just see the behavior of your Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.71
description: "He alone has eaten the offerings for all three Deities. Because of this, both Jagannātha and Nṛsiṁhadeva remain fasting."
text:
> tina janāra bhoga teṅho ekelā khāilā
> jagannātha-nṛsiṁha upavāsī ha-ilā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:j:janāra]]---of the three Deities; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---offerings; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:e:ekelā]]---alone; [[synonyms:k:khāilā]]---ate; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]]---Lord Jagannātha and Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:u:upavāsī]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---remained fasting.
translation: "He alone has eaten the offerings for all three Deities. Because of this, both Jagannātha and Nṛsiṁhadeva remain fasting."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.72
description: When Śivānanda Sena heard this statement, he was unsure whether Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī was speaking that way because of ecstatic love or because it was actually a fact.
text:
> śuni śivānandera citte ha-ila saṁśaya
> kibā premāveśe kahe, kibā satya haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]]---of Śivānanda; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---there was some doubt; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---whether; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---was speaking something in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:s:satya]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---it was a fact.
translation: When Śivānanda Sena heard this statement, he was unsure whether Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī was speaking that way because of ecstatic love or because it was actually a fact.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.73
description: When Śivānanda Sena was thus perplexed, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to him, "Bring more food. Let me cook again for Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva."
text:
> tabe śivānande kichu kahe brahmacārī
> sāmagrī āna nṛsiṁha lāgi punaḥ pāka kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---upon this; [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]]---unto Śivānanda; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:b:brahmacārī]]---Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī; [[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]] [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---bring more ingredients; [[synonyms:n:nṛsiṁha]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---let me cook.
translation: When Śivānanda Sena was thus perplexed, Nṛsiṁhānanda Brahmacārī said to him, "Bring more food. Let me cook again for Lord Nṛsiṁhadeva."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 2.74
description: Then Śivānanda Sena again brought the ingredients with which to cook, and Pradyumna Brahmacārī again cooked and offered the food to Nṛsiṁhadeva.
text:
> tabe śivānanda bhoga-sāmagrī ānilā
> pāka kari' nṛsiṁhera bhoga lāgāilā
