title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.3
description: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala], He was continuously overwhelmed, night and day, by separation from Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu vaise nīlācale
> rajanī-divase kṛṣṇa-virahe vihvale
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vaise]] [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---resided at Nīlācala; [[synonyms:r:rajanī]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---day and night; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:virahe]]---because of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vihvale]]---overwhelmed.
translation: While Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus resided at Jagannātha Purī [Nīlācala], He was continuously overwhelmed, night and day, by separation from Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.30
description: "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, I do not want material wealth from You, nor do I want followers, a beautiful wife or the results of fruitive activities. I only pray that by Your causeless mercy You give Me pure devotional service to You, life after life.
text:
> dhana, jana nāhi māgoṅ, kavitā sundarī
> 'śuddha-bhakti' deha' more, kṛṣṇa kṛpā kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---wealth; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---followers; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---do not; [[synonyms:m:māgoṅ]]---I want; [[synonyms:k:kavitā]] [[synonyms:s:sundarī]]---a beautiful wife or fruitive activities; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---pure devotional service; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---please award; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---O Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---becoming merciful.
translation: "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa, I do not want material wealth from You, nor do I want followers, a beautiful wife or the results of fruitive activities. I only pray that by Your causeless mercy You give Me pure devotional service to You, life after life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.31
description: In great humility, considering Himself a conditioned soul of the material world, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again expressed His desire to be endowed with service to the Lord.
text:
> ati-dainye punaḥ māge dāsya-bhakti-dāna
> āpanāre kare saṁsārī jīva-abhimāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:d:dainye]]---in great humility; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---begs; [[synonyms:d:dāsya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:d:dāna]]---the awarding of devotion in servitude; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāre]]---to Himself; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:saṁsārī]]---materialistic; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---conception as a conditioned soul.
translation: In great humility, considering Himself a conditioned soul of the material world, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again expressed His desire to be endowed with service to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.32
description: "Oh, My Lord, O Kṛṣṇa, son of Mahārāja Nanda, I am Your eternal servant, but because of My own fruitive acts, I have fallen in this horrible ocean of nescience. Now please be causelessly merciful to Me. Consider Me a particle of dust at Your lotus feet.
text:
> ayi nanda-tanuja kiṅkaraṁ
> patitaṁ māṁ viṣame bhavāmbudhau
> kṛpayā tava pāda-paṅkaja-
> sthita-dhūlī-sadṛśaṁ vicintaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ayi]]---oh, My Lord; [[synonyms:n:nanda]]-[[synonyms:t:tanuja]]---the son of Nanda Mahārāja, Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kiṅkaram]]---the servant; [[synonyms:p:patitam]]---fallen; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---Me; [[synonyms:v:viṣame]]---horrible; [[synonyms:b:bhava]]-[[synonyms:a:ambudhau]]---in the ocean of nescience; [[synonyms:k:kṛpayā]]---by causeless mercy; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---Your; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṅkaja]]---lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:sthita]]---situated at; [[synonyms:d:dhūlī]]-[[synonyms:s:sadṛśam]]---like a particle of dust; [[synonyms:v:vicintaya]]---kindly consider.
translation: "Oh, My Lord, O Kṛṣṇa, son of Mahārāja Nanda, I am Your eternal servant, but because of My own fruitive acts, I have fallen in this horrible ocean of nescience. Now please be causelessly merciful to Me. Consider Me a particle of dust at Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.33
description: "I am Your eternal servant, but I forgot Your Lordship. Now I have fallen in the ocean of nescience and have been conditioned by the external energy.
text:
> "tomāra nitya-dāsa mui, tomā pāsariyā
> paḍiyāchoṅ bhavārṇave māyā-baddha hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---eternal servant; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:p:pāsariyā]]---forgetting Your Lordship; [[synonyms:p:paḍiyāchoṅ]]---I have fallen; [[synonyms:b:bhava]]-[[synonyms:a:arṇave]]---in the ocean of nescience; [[synonyms:m:māyā]]-[[synonyms:b:baddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming conditioned by the external energy.
translation: "I am Your eternal servant, but I forgot Your Lordship. Now I have fallen in the ocean of nescience and have been conditioned by the external energy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.34
description: "Be causelessly merciful to Me by giving Me a place with the particles of dust at Your lotus feet so that I may engage in the service of Your Lordship as Your eternal servant."
text:
> kṛpā kari' kara more pada-dhūli-sama
> tomāra sevaka karoṅ tomāra sevana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---make; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dhūli]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like a particle of dust at Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---as I am Your eternal servant; [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]]---let Me be engaged; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevana]]---in Your service.
translation: "Be causelessly merciful to Me by giving Me a place with the particles of dust at Your lotus feet so that I may engage in the service of Your Lordship as Your eternal servant."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.35
description: Natural humility and eagerness then awoke in Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He prayed to Kṛṣṇa to be able to chant the mahā-mantra in ecstatic love.
text:
> punaḥ ati-utkaṇṭhā, dainya ha-ila udgama
> kṛṣṇa-ṭhāñi māge prema-nāma-saṅkīrtana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---great eagerness; [[synonyms:d:dainya]]---humility; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:u:udgama]]---was awakened; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:thāñi]]---from Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---prays for; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting the //mahā-mantra.//
translation: Natural humility and eagerness then awoke in Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He prayed to Kṛṣṇa to be able to chant the mahā-mantra in ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.36
description: "My dear Lord, when will My eyes be beautified by filling with tears that constantly glide down as I chant Your holy name? When will My voice falter and all the hairs on My body stand erect in transcendental happiness as I chant Your holy name?
text:
> nayanaṁ galad-aśru-dhārayā
> vadanaṁ gadgada-ruddhayā girā
> pulakair nicitaṁ vapuḥ kadā,
> tava nāma-grahaṇe bhaviṣyati
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nayanam]]---the eyes; [[synonyms:g:galat]]-[[synonyms:a:aśru]]-[[synonyms:d:dhārayā]]---by streams of tears running down; [[synonyms:v:vadanam]]---mouth; [[synonyms:g:gadgada]]---faltering; [[synonyms:r:ruddhayā]]---choked up; [[synonyms:g:girā]]---with words; [[synonyms:p:pulakaiḥ]]---with erection of the hairs due to transcendental happiness; [[synonyms:n:nicitam]]---covered; [[synonyms:v:vapuḥ]]---the body; [[synonyms:k:kadā]]---when; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---Your; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:g:grahaṇe]]---in chanting the name; [[synonyms:b:bhaviṣyati]]---will be.
translation: "My dear Lord, when will My eyes be beautified by filling with tears that constantly glide down as I chant Your holy name? When will My voice falter and all the hairs on My body stand erect in transcendental happiness as I chant Your holy name?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.37
description: "Without love of Godhead, My life is useless. Therefore I pray that You accept Me as Your servant and give Me the salary of ecstatic love of God."
text:
> "prema-dhana vinā vyartha daridra jīvana
> 'dāsa' kari' vetana more deha prema-dhana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:v:vyartha]]---useless; [[synonyms:d:daridra]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---poor life; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---accepting as Your eternal servant; [[synonyms:v:vetana]]---salary; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---give; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the treasure of love of Godhead.
translation: "Without love of Godhead, My life is useless. Therefore I pray that You accept Me as Your servant and give Me the salary of ecstatic love of God."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.38
description: Separation from Kṛṣṇa awoke various mellows of distress, lamentation and humility. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a crazy man.
text:
> rasāntarāveśe ha-ila viyoga-sphuraṇa
> udvega, viṣāda, dainye kare pralapana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in the ecstatic love of different mellows; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was; [[synonyms:v:viyoga]]-[[synonyms:s:sphuraṇa]]---awakening of separation; [[synonyms:u:udvega]]---distress; [[synonyms:v:viṣāda]]---moroseness; [[synonyms:d:dainye]]---humility; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:pralapana]]---speaks like a crazy person.
translation: Separation from Kṛṣṇa awoke various mellows of distress, lamentation and humility. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a crazy man.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.39
description: "My Lord Govinda, because of separation from You, I consider even a moment a great millennium. Tears flow from My eyes like torrents of rain, and I see the entire world as void.
text:
> yugāyitaṁ nimeṣeṇa
> cakṣuṣā prāvṛṣāyitam
> śūnyāyitaṁ jagat sarvaṁ
> govinda-viraheṇa me
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yugāyitam]]---appearing like a great millennium; [[synonyms:n:nimeṣeṇa]]---by a moment; [[synonyms:c:cakṣuṣā]]---from the eyes; [[synonyms:p:prāvṛṣāyitam]]---tears falling like torrents of rain; [[synonyms:ś:śūnyāyitam]]---appearing void; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the world; [[synonyms:s:sarvam]]---all; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---from Lord Govinda, Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:viraheṇa]] [[synonyms:m:me]]---by My separation.
translation: "My Lord Govinda, because of separation from You, I consider even a moment a great millennium. Tears flow from My eyes like torrents of rain, and I see the entire world as void.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.4
description: Day and night He tasted transcendental blissful songs and verses with two associates, namely Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.
text:
> svarūpa, rāmānanda,---ei duijana-sane
> rātri-dine rasa-gīta-śloka āsvādane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with two persons; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---night and day; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:g:gīta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses and songs containing the mellows of transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādane]]---in tasting.
translation: Day and night He tasted transcendental blissful songs and verses with two associates, namely Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.40
description: "In My agitation, a day never ends, for every moment seems like a millennium. Pouring incessant tears, My eyes are like clouds in the rainy season.
text:
> udvege divasa nā yāya 'kṣaṇa' haila 'yuga'-sama
> varṣāra megha-prāya aśru variṣe nayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:udvege]]---by great agitation; [[synonyms:d:divasa]]---day; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---passes; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---a moment; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:y:yuga]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like a great millennium; [[synonyms:v:varṣāra]]---of the rainy season; [[synonyms:m:megha]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like clouds; [[synonyms:a:aśru]]---tears; [[synonyms:v:variṣe]]---fall down; [[synonyms:n:nayana]]---from the eyes.
translation: "In My agitation, a day never ends, for every moment seems like a millennium. Pouring incessant tears, My eyes are like clouds in the rainy season.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.41
description: "The three worlds have become void because of separation from Govinda. I feel as if I were burning alive in a slow fire.
text:
> govinda-virahe śūnya ha-ila tribhuvana
> tuṣānale poḍe,---yena nā yāya jīvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:v:virahe]]---by separation from Govinda; [[synonyms:ś:śūnya]]---void; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---the three worlds; [[synonyms:t:tuṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:anale]]---in the slow fire; [[synonyms:p:poḍe]]---burns; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---just like; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---does not go; [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---life.
translation: "The three worlds have become void because of separation from Govinda. I feel as if I were burning alive in a slow fire.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.42
description: "Lord Kṛṣṇa has become indifferent to Me just to test My love, and My friends say,'Better to disregard Him.' "
text:
> kṛṣṇa udāsīna ha-ilā karite parīkṣaṇa
> sakhī saba kahe,---'kṛṣṇe kara upekṣaṇa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:udāsīna]]---indifferent; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to make; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣaṇa]]---testing; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]] [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---all the friends say; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---just do; [[synonyms:u:upekṣaṇa]]---neglecting.
translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa has become indifferent to Me just to test My love, and My friends say,'Better to disregard Him.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.43
description: While Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was thinking in this way, the characteristics of natural love became manifest because of Her pure heart.
text:
> eteka cintite rādhāra nirmala hṛdaya
> svābhāvika premāra svabhāva karila udaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eteka]]---thus; [[synonyms:c:cintite]]---thinking; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]] [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]---possessing a pure heart; [[synonyms:s:svābhāvika]]---natural; [[synonyms:p:premāra]]---of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---the character; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:u:udaya]]---awakes.
translation: While Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was thinking in this way, the characteristics of natural love became manifest because of Her pure heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.44
description: The ecstatic symptoms of envy, great eagerness, humility, zeal and supplication all became manifest at once.
text:
> īrṣyā, utkaṇṭhā, dainya, prauḍhi, vinaya
> eta bhāva eka-ṭhāñi karila udaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ī:īrṣyā]]---envy; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---eagerness; [[synonyms:d:dainya]]---humility; [[synonyms:p:prauḍhi]]---zeal; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---solicitation; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---all these transcendental ecstasies; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in one place; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:u:udaya]]---awoke.
translation: The ecstatic symptoms of envy, great eagerness, humility, zeal and supplication all became manifest at once.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.45
description: In that mood, the mind of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was agitated, and therefore She spoke a verse of advanced devotion to Her gopī friends.
text:
> eta bhāve rādhāra mana asthira ha-ilā
> sakhī-gaṇa-āge prauḍhi-śloka ye paḍilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in that mood; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]]---of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind; [[synonyms:a:asthira]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became agitated; [[synonyms:s:sakhī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before the friends, the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:p:prauḍhi]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---advanced devotional verse; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---She recited.
translation: In that mood, the mind of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī was agitated, and therefore She spoke a verse of advanced devotion to Her gopī friends.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.46
description: In the same spirit of ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited that verse, and as soon as He did so, He felt like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
text:
> sei bhāve prabhu sei śloka uccārilā
> śloka uccārite tad-rūpa āpane ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in that ecstatic mood; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verse; [[synonyms:u:uccārilā]]---recited; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---the verse; [[synonyms:u:uccārite]]---by reciting; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---Himself; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became.
translation: In the same spirit of ecstasy, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu recited that verse, and as soon as He did so, He felt like Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.47
description: "Let Kṛṣṇa tightly embrace this maidservant, who has fallen at His lotus feet. Let Him trample Me or break My heart by never being visible to Me. He is a debauchee, after all, and can do whatever He likes, but He is still no one other than the worshipable Lord of My heart.
text:
> āśliṣya vā pāda-ratāṁ pinaṣṭu mām
> adarśanān marma-hatāṁ karotu vā
> yathā tathā vā vidadhātu lampaṭo
> mat-prāṇa-nāthas tu sa eva nāparaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āśliṣya]]---embracing with great pleasure; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:r:ratām]]---who is fallen at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:pinaṣṭu]]---let Him trample; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---Me; [[synonyms:a:adarśanāt]]---by not being visible; [[synonyms:m:marma]]-[[synonyms:h:hatām]]---brokenhearted; [[synonyms:k:karotu]]---let Him make; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as (He likes); [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---so; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:v:vidadhātu]]---let Him do; [[synonyms:l:lampaṭaḥ]]---a debauchee, who mixes with other women; [[synonyms:m:mat]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthaḥ]]---the Lord of My life; [[synonyms:t:tu]]---but; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---He; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---only; [[synonyms:n:na]] [[synonyms:a:aparaḥ]]---not anyone else.
translation: "Let Kṛṣṇa tightly embrace this maidservant, who has fallen at His lotus feet. Let Him trample Me or break My heart by never being visible to Me. He is a debauchee, after all, and can do whatever He likes, but He is still no one other than the worshipable Lord of My heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.48
description: "I am a maidservant at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. He is the embodiment of transcendental happiness and mellows. If He likes He can tightly embrace Me and make Me feel oneness with Him, or by not giving Me His audience, He may corrode My mind and body. Nevertheless, it is He who is the Lord of My life.
text:
> "āmi---kṛṣṇa-pada-dāsī, teṅho---rasa-sukha-rāśi,
> āliṅgiyā kare ātma-sātha
> kibā nā deya daraśana, jārena mora tanu-mana,
> tabu teṅho---mora prāṇa-nātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsī]]---a maidservant at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:r:rāśi]]---the reservoir of transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgiyā]]---by embracing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:sātha]]---merged; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deya]]---does not give; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---audience; [[synonyms:j:jārena]]---corrodes; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---body and mind; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the Lord of My life.
translation: "I am a maidservant at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. He is the embodiment of transcendental happiness and mellows. If He likes He can tightly embrace Me and make Me feel oneness with Him, or by not giving Me His audience, He may corrode My mind and body. Nevertheless, it is He who is the Lord of My life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.49
description: "My dear friend, just hear the decision of My mind. Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of My life in all conditions, whether He shows Me affection or kills Me by giving Me unhappiness.
text:
> sakhi he, śuna mora manera niścaya
> kibā anurāga kare, kibā duḥkha diyā māre,
> mora prāṇeśvara kṛṣṇa---anya naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakhi]] [[synonyms:h:he]]---My dear friend; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---just hear; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:m:manera]]---of the mind; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---decision; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---whether; [[synonyms:a:anurāga]]---affection; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---shows; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---bestowing; [[synonyms:m:māre]]---kills; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---the Lord of life; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:n:naya]]---and no one else.
translation: "My dear friend, just hear the decision of My mind. Kṛṣṇa is the Lord of My life in all conditions, whether He shows Me affection or kills Me by giving Me unhappiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.5
description: He relished the symptoms of various transcendental emotions such as jubilation, lamentation, anger, humility, anxiety, grief, eagerness and satisfaction.
text:
> nānā-bhāva uṭhe prabhura harṣa, śoka, roṣa
> dainyodvega-ārti utkaṇṭhā, santoṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---all kinds of emotion; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---awaken; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:h:harṣa]]---jubilation; [[synonyms:ś:śoka]]---lamentation; [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---anger; [[synonyms:d:dainya]]---humility; [[synonyms:u:udvega]]---anxiety; [[synonyms:ā:ārti]]---grief; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhā]]---more eagerness; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]]---satisfaction.
translation: He relished the symptoms of various transcendental emotions such as jubilation, lamentation, anger, humility, anxiety, grief, eagerness and satisfaction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.50
description: "Sometimes Kṛṣṇa gives up the company of other gopīs and becomes controlled, mind and body, by Me. Thus He manifests My good fortune and gives others distress by performing His loving affairs with Me.
text:
> chāḍi' anya nārī-gaṇa, mora vaśa tanu-mana,
> mora saubhāgya prakaṭa kariyā
> tā-sabāre deya pīḍā, āmā-sane kare krīḍā,
> sei nārī-gaṇe dekhāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---women; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---control; [[synonyms:t:tanu]]-[[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind and body; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgya]]---fortune; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---manifesting; [[synonyms:t:tā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---unto all of them; [[synonyms:d:deya]] [[synonyms:p:pīḍā]]---gives distress; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Me; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---performs loving activities; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto these women; [[synonyms:d:dekhāñā]]---showing.
translation: "Sometimes Kṛṣṇa gives up the company of other gopīs and becomes controlled, mind and body, by Me. Thus He manifests My good fortune and gives others distress by performing His loving affairs with Me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.51
description: "Or, since after all He is a very cunning, obstinate debauchee with a propensity to cheat, He takes to the company of other women. He then indulges in loving affairs with them in front of Me to give distress to My mind. Nevertheless, He is still the Lord of My life.
text:
> kibā teṅho lampaṭa, śaṭha, dhṛṣṭa, sakapaṭa,
> anya nārī-gaṇa kari' sātha
> more dite manaḥ-pīḍā, mora āge kare krīḍā,
> tabu teṅho---mora prāṇa-nātha
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:l:lampaṭa]]---debauchee; [[synonyms:ś:śaṭha]]---deceitful; [[synonyms:d:dhṛṣṭa]]---obstinate; [[synonyms:s:sakapaṭa]]---with a cheating propensity; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---other; [[synonyms:n:nārī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---women; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---accepting; [[synonyms:s:sātha]]---as companions; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to give; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:p:pīḍā]]---distress in the mind; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Me; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---performs loving affairs; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the Lord of My life.
translation: "Or, since after all He is a very cunning, obstinate debauchee with a propensity to cheat, He takes to the company of other women. He then indulges in loving affairs with them in front of Me to give distress to My mind. Nevertheless, He is still the Lord of My life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.52
description: "I do not mind My personal distress. I only wish for the happiness of Kṛṣṇa, for His happiness is the goal of My life. However, if He feels great happiness in giving Me distress, that distress is the best of My happiness.
text:
> nā gaṇi āpana-duḥkha, sabe vāñchi tāṅra sukha,
> tāṅra sukha---āmāra tātparya
> more yadi diyā duḥkha, tāṅra haila mahā-sukha,
> sei duḥkha---mora sukha-varya
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:g:gaṇi]]---I count; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---own personal misery; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---only; [[synonyms:v:vāñchi]]---I desire; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---His happiness; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---His happiness; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:t:tātparya]]---the aim of My life; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:d:diyā]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---giving distress; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---great happiness; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---that unhappiness; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:v:varya]]---the best of My happiness.
translation: "I do not mind My personal distress. I only wish for the happiness of Kṛṣṇa, for His happiness is the goal of My life. However, if He feels great happiness in giving Me distress, that distress is the best of My happiness.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that a devotee does not care about his own happiness and distress; he is simply interested in seeing that Kṛṣṇa is happy, and for that purpose he engages in various activities. A pure devotee has no way of sensing happiness except by seeing that Kṛṣṇa is happy in every respect. If Kṛṣṇa becomes happy by giving him distress, such a devotee accepts that unhappiness as the greatest of all happiness. Those who are materialistic, however, who are very proud of material wealth and have no spiritual knowledge, like the //prākṛta-sahajiyās,// regard their own happiness as the aim of life. Some of them aspire to enjoy themselves by sharing the happiness of Kṛṣṇa. This is the mentality of fruitive workers who want to enjoy sense gratification by making a show of service to Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.53
description: "If Kṛṣṇa, attracted by the beauty of some other woman, wants to enjoy with her but is unhappy because He cannot get her, I fall down at her feet, catch her hand and bring her to Kṛṣṇa to engage her for His happiness.
text:
> ye nārīre vāñche kṛṣṇa, tāra rūpe satṛṣṇa,
> tāre nā pāñā haya duḥkhī
> mui tāra pāya paḍi', lañā yāṅa hāte dhari',
> krīḍā karāñā tāṅre karoṅ sukhī
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:n:nārīre]]---the woman whom; [[synonyms:v:vāñche]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa desires to have in His company; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:r:rūpe]] [[synonyms:s:satṛṣṇa]]---attracted to her beauty; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---her; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]]---becomes unhappy; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]] [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---falling down at her feet; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:y:yāṅa]]---taking, go; [[synonyms:h:hāte]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---catching the hand; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:karāñā]]---bringing about; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]] [[synonyms:s:sukhī]]---I make happy.
translation: "If Kṛṣṇa, attracted by the beauty of some other woman, wants to enjoy with her but is unhappy because He cannot get her, I fall down at her feet, catch her hand and bring her to Kṛṣṇa to engage her for His happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.54
description: "When a beloved gopī shows symptoms of anger toward Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa is very satisfied. Indeed, He is pleased when chastised by such a gopī. She shows her pride suitably, and Kṛṣṇa enjoys that attitude. Then she gives up her pride with a little endeavor.
text:
> kāntā kṛṣṇe kare roṣa, kṛṣṇa pāya santoṣa,
> sukha pāya tāḍana-bhartsane
> yathā-yogya kare māna, kṛṣṇa tāte sukha pāna,
> chāḍe māna alpa-sādhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāntā]]---the beloved; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---shows anger; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]] [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]]---Kṛṣṇa becomes very happy; [[synonyms:s:sukha]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---obtains happiness; [[synonyms:t:tāḍana]]-[[synonyms:b:bhartsane]]---by chastisement; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]]---as it is suitable; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:m:māna]]---shows pride; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in such activities; [[synonyms:s:sukha]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---obtains happiness; [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]] [[synonyms:m:māna]]---gives up pride; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sādhane]]---by a little endeavor.
translation: "When a beloved gopī shows symptoms of anger toward Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa is very satisfied. Indeed, He is pleased when chastised by such a gopī. She shows her pride suitably, and Kṛṣṇa enjoys that attitude. Then she gives up her pride with a little endeavor.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.55
description: "Why does a woman continue to live who knows that Kṛṣṇa's heart is unhappy but who still shows her deep anger toward Him? She is interested in her own happiness. I condemn such a woman to be struck on the head with a thunderbolt, for we simply want the happiness of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> sei nārī jīye kene, kṛṣṇa-marma vyathā jāne,
> tabu kṛṣṇe kare gāḍha roṣa
> nija-sukhe māne kāja, paḍuka tāra śire vāja,
> kṛṣṇera mātra cāhiye santoṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:n:nārī]]---that woman; [[synonyms:j:jīye]]---lives; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:marma]]---Kṛṣṇa's heart; [[synonyms:v:vyathā]]---unhappy; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:g:gāḍha]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---deep anger; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in her own happiness; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---considers; [[synonyms:k:kāja]]---the only business; [[synonyms:p:paḍuka]]---let there fall; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---of her; [[synonyms:ś:śire]]---on the head; [[synonyms:v:vāja]]---a thunderbolt; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:c:cāhiye]]---we want; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]]---the happiness.
translation: "Why does a woman continue to live who knows that Kṛṣṇa's heart is unhappy but who still shows her deep anger toward Him? She is interested in her own happiness. I condemn such a woman to be struck on the head with a thunderbolt, for we simply want the happiness of Kṛṣṇa.
purport: A devotee who is satisfied only with his own sense gratification certainly falls down from the service of Kṛṣṇa. Being attracted by material happiness, he later joins the //prākṛta-sahajiyās,// who are considered to be nondevotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.56
description: "If a gopī envious of Me satisfies Kṛṣṇa and Kṛṣṇa desires her, I shall not hesitate to go to her house and become her maidservant, for then My happiness will be awakened.
text:
> ye gopī mora kare dveṣe, kṛṣṇera kare santoṣe,
> kṛṣṇa yāre kare abhilāṣa
> mui tāra ghare yāñā, tāre sevoṅ dāsī hañā,
> tabe mora sukhera ullāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:g:gopī]]---any //gopī// who; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:d:dveṣe]]---shows envy; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:santoṣe]]---but satisfies Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yāre]]---unto whom; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:a:abhilāṣa]]---desiring; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---her; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going to the house; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:s:sevoṅ]]---shall render service unto her; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming a maidservant; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:s:sukhera]] [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---awakening of happiness.
translation: "If a gopī envious of Me satisfies Kṛṣṇa and Kṛṣṇa desires her, I shall not hesitate to go to her house and become her maidservant, for then My happiness will be awakened.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.57
description: "The wife of a brāhmaṇa suffering from leprosy manifested herself as the topmost of all chaste women by serving a prostitute to satisfy her husband. She thus stopped the movement of the sun, brought her dead husband back to life and satisfied the three principal demigods [Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara].
text:
> kuṣṭhī-viprera ramaṇī, pativratā-śiromaṇi,
> pati lāgi' kailā veśyāra sevā
> stambhila sūryera gati, jīyāila mṛta pati,
> tuṣṭa kaila mukhya tina-devā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kuṣṭhī]]-[[synonyms:v:viprera]]---of the //brāhmaṇa// who suffered from leprosy; [[synonyms:r:ramaṇī]]---the wife; [[synonyms:p:pati]]-[[synonyms:v:vratā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the topmost of chaste women; [[synonyms:p:pati]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for the satisfaction of her husband; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:v:veśyāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service to a prostitute; [[synonyms:s:stambhila]]---stopped; [[synonyms:s:sūryera]] [[synonyms:g:gati]]---the movement of the sun; [[synonyms:j:jīyāila]]---revived; [[synonyms:m:mṛta]] [[synonyms:p:pati]]---the dead husband; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]---the principal; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:d:devā]]---three deities or demigods.
translation: "The wife of a brāhmaṇa suffering from leprosy manifested herself as the topmost of all chaste women by serving a prostitute to satisfy her husband. She thus stopped the movement of the sun, brought her dead husband back to life and satisfied the three principal demigods [Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara].
purport: The //Āditya purāṇa, Mārkeṇḍeya Purāṇa// and //Padma Purāṇa// tell about a //brāhmaṇa// who was suffering from leprosy but had a very chaste and faithful wife. He desired to enjoy the company of a prostitute, and therefore his wife went to her and became her maidservant, just to draw her attention for his service. When the prostitute agreed to associate with him, the wife brought her the leprotic husband. When that leper, the sinful son of a //brāhmaṇa,// saw the chastity of his wife, he finally abandoned his sinful intentions. While coming home, however, he touched the body of Mārkeṇḍeya Ṛṣi, who thus cursed him to die at sunrise. Because of her chastity, the woman was very powerful. Therefore when she heard about the curse, she vowed to stop the sunrise. Because of her strong determination to serve her husband, the three deities-namely Brahmā, Viṣṇu and Maheśvara-were very happy, and they gave her the benediction that her husband would be cured and brought back to life. This example is given herein to emphasize that a devotee should engage himself exclusively for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa, without personal motives. That will make his life successful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.58
description: "Kṛṣṇa is My life and soul. Kṛṣṇa is the treasure of My life. Indeed, Kṛṣṇa is the very life of My life. I therefore keep Him always in My heart and try to please Him by rendering service. That is My constant meditation.
text:
> "kṛṣṇa---mora jīvana, kṛṣṇa---mora prāṇa-dhana,
> kṛṣṇa---mora prāṇera parāṇa
> hṛdaya-upare dharoṅ, sevā kari' sukhī karoṅ,
> ei mora sadā rahe dhyāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---My life and soul; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of My life; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇera]] [[synonyms:p:parāna]]---the life of My life; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]-[[synonyms:u:upare]]---on My heart; [[synonyms:d:dharoṅ]]---I hold; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---serving; [[synonyms:s:sukhī]] [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]]---I make happy; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:d:dhyāna]]---meditation.
translation: "Kṛṣṇa is My life and soul. Kṛṣṇa is the treasure of My life. Indeed, Kṛṣṇa is the very life of My life. I therefore keep Him always in My heart and try to please Him by rendering service. That is My constant meditation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.59
description: "My happiness is in the service of Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa's happiness is in union with Me. For this reason, I give My body in charity to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, who accepts Me as His loved one and calls Me His most beloved. It is then that I consider Myself His maidservant.
text:
> mora sukha---sevane, kṛṣṇera sukha---saṅgame,
> ataeva deha deṅa dāna
> kṛṣṇa more 'kāntā' kari', kahe more 'prāṇeśvari',
> mora haya 'dāsī'-abhimāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---My happiness; [[synonyms:s:sevane]]---in service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---Kṛṣṇa's happiness; [[synonyms:s:saṅgame]]---by union with Me; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---My body; [[synonyms:d:deṅa]]---I offer; [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---as charity; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:kāntā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---accepting as beloved; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to Me; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:ī:īśvari]]---the most beloved; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---considering His maidservant.
translation: "My happiness is in the service of Kṛṣṇa, and Kṛṣṇa's happiness is in union with Me. For this reason, I give My body in charity to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, who accepts Me as His loved one and calls Me His most beloved. It is then that I consider Myself His maidservant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.6
description: He would recite His own verses, expressing their meanings and emotions, and thus enjoy tasting them with these two friends.
text:
> sei sei bhāve nija-śloka paḍiyā
> ślokera artha āsvādaye dui-bandhu lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in that particular emotion; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:p:paḍiyā]]---reciting His own verses; [[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the verses; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaye]]---tastes; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhu]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with two friends.
translation: He would recite His own verses, expressing their meanings and emotions, and thus enjoy tasting them with these two friends.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.60
description: "Service to My lover is the home of happiness and is more sweet than direct union with Him. The goddess of fortune is evidence of this, for although she constantly lives on the heart of Nārāyaṇa, she wants to render service to His lotus feet. She therefore considers herself a maidservant and serves Him constantly."
text:
> kānta-sevā-sukha-pūra, saṅgama haite sumadhura,
> tāte sākṣī---lakṣmī ṭhākurāṇī
> nārāyaṇa-hṛdi sthiti, tabu pāda-sevāya mati,
> sevā kare 'dāsī'-abhimānī
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kānta]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:p:pūra]]---the service of the Lord is the home of happiness; [[synonyms:s:saṅgama]] [[synonyms:h:haite]] [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:m:madhura]]---sweeter than direct union; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:s:sākṣī]]---evidence; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurāṇī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:n:nārāyaṇa]]-[[synonyms:h:hṛdi]]---on the heart of Nārāyaṇa; [[synonyms:s:sthiti]]---situation; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:sevāya]] [[synonyms:m:mati]]---her desire is to serve the lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---renders service; [[synonyms:d:dāsī]]-[[synonyms:a:abhimānī]]---considering herself a maidservant.
translation: "Service to My lover is the home of happiness and is more sweet than direct union with Him. The goddess of fortune is evidence of this, for although she constantly lives on the heart of Nārāyaṇa, she wants to render service to His lotus feet. She therefore considers herself a maidservant and serves Him constantly."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.61
description: These statements by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī show the symptoms of pure love for Kṛṣṇa tasted by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In that ecstatic love, His mind was unsteady. Transformations of transcendental love spread throughout His entire body, and He could not sustain His body and mind.
text:
> ei rādhāra vacana, viśuddha-prema-lakṣaṇa,
> āsvādaye śrī-gaura-rāya
> bhāve mana nahe sthira, sāttvike vyāpe śarīra,
> mana-deha dharaṇa nā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:r:rādhāra]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---the statement of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:v:viśuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣaṇa]]---the symptoms of pure love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaye]]---tastes; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---because of this ecstasy; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:s:sthira]]---the mind is not steady; [[synonyms:s:sāttvike]]---the symptoms of transcendental love; [[synonyms:v:vyāpe]]---spread over; [[synonyms:ś:śarīra]]---the body; [[synonyms:m:mana]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]]---mind and body; [[synonyms:d:dharaṇa]]---sustaining; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is not possible.
translation: These statements by Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī show the symptoms of pure love for Kṛṣṇa tasted by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In that ecstatic love, His mind was unsteady. Transformations of transcendental love spread throughout His entire body, and He could not sustain His body and mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.62
description: The pure devotional service in Vṛndāvana is like the golden particles in the River Jāmbū. In Vṛndāvana there is not a trace of personal sense gratification. It is to advertise such pure love in this material world that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has written the previous verse and explained its meaning.
text:
> vrajera viśuddha-prema,---yena jāmbū-nada hema,
> ātma-sukhera yāhāṅ nāhi gandha
> se prema jānā'te loke, prabhu kailā ei śloke,
> pade kailā arthera nirbandha
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vrajera]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:viśuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---the pure love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:j:jāmbū]]-[[synonyms:n:nada]] [[synonyms:h:hema]]---the golden particles found in the Jāmbū River; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhera]]---of personal sense gratification; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---there is not even a scent; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:p:prema]]---that love of Godhead; [[synonyms:j:jānā'te]] [[synonyms:l:loke]]---to advertise among the people; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---has written; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloke]]---this verse; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---in different steps; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:a:arthera]] [[synonyms:n:nirbandha]]---has clarified the real meaning.
translation: The pure devotional service in Vṛndāvana is like the golden particles in the River Jāmbū. In Vṛndāvana there is not a trace of personal sense gratification. It is to advertise such pure love in this material world that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has written the previous verse and explained its meaning.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.63
description: Thus overwhelmed by ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman and recited suitable verses.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu bhāvāviṣṭa hañā
> pralāpa karilā tat-tat śloka paḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being overwhelmed by ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---said crazy words; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:t:tat]]---appropriate; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:p:paḍiyā]]---by reading the verse.
translation: Thus overwhelmed by ecstatic love, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke like a madman and recited suitable verses.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.64
description: The Lord had formerly composed these eight verses to teach people in general. Now He personally tasted the meaning of the verses, which are called the Śikṣāṣṭaka.
text:
> pūrve aṣṭa-śloka kari' loke śikṣā dilā
> sei aṣṭa-ślokera artha āpane āsvādilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---composing eight verses; [[synonyms:l:loke]] [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave instruction to the people in general; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:ś:ślokera]]---of the eight stanzas; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]] [[synonyms:ā:āsvādilā]]---personally tasted.
translation: The Lord had formerly composed these eight verses to teach people in general. Now He personally tasted the meaning of the verses, which are called the Śikṣāṣṭaka.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.65
description: If anyone recites or hears these eight verses of instruction by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his ecstatic love and devotion for Kṛṣṇa increase day by day.
text:
> prabhura 'śikṣāṣṭaka'-śloka yei paḍe, śune
> kṛṣṇe prema-bhakti tāra bāḍe dine-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]]-[[synonyms:a:aṣṭaka]]---of the eight instructions; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---the verses; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---recites; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---or hears; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---ecstatic love and devotion; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increases; [[synonyms:d:dine]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day after day.
translation: If anyone recites or hears these eight verses of instruction by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his ecstatic love and devotion for Kṛṣṇa increase day by day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.66
description: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is as deep and grave as millions of oceans, when the moon of His various emotions rises, He becomes restless.
text:
> yadyapiha prabhu---koṭī-samudra-gambhīra
> nānā-bhāva-candrodaye hayena asthira
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapiha]]---although; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:koṭī]]-[[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:g:gambhīra]]---as deep as millions of oceans; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---of ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:c:candrodaye]]---because of the moonrise; [[synonyms:h:hayena]]---sometimes becomes; [[synonyms:a:asthira]]---restless.
translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is as deep and grave as millions of oceans, when the moon of His various emotions rises, He becomes restless.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.67-68
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu read the verses of Jayadeva's Gīta-govinda, of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, of Rāmānanda Rāya's drama Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka and of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura's Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, He was overwhelmed by the various ecstatic emotions of those verses. Thus He tasted their purports.
text:
> yei yei śloka jayadeva, bhāgavate
> rāyera nāṭake, yei āra karṇāmṛte
>
> sei sei bhāve śloka kariyā paṭhane
> sei sei bhāvāveśe karena āsvādane
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:j:jayadeva]]---Jayadeva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavate]]---in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:r:rāyera]] [[synonyms:n:nāṭake]]---in the drama made by Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whatever; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:k:karṇāmṛte]]---in the book named //Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta,// written by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in those ecstatic emotions; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:p:paṭhane]]---reading regularly; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sei]]---in that particular; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ā:āsvādane]]---He tastes.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu read the verses of Jayadeva's Gīta-govinda, of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam, of Rāmānanda Rāya's drama Jagannātha-vallabha-nāṭaka and of Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura's Kṛṣṇa-karṇāmṛta, He was overwhelmed by the various ecstatic emotions of those verses. Thus He tasted their purports.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.69
description: For twelve years, Śrī Caitanya remained in that state day and night. With His two friends, He tasted the meaning of those verses, which consist of nothing but the transcendental bliss and mellows of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.
text:
> dvādaśa vatsara aiche daśā---rātri-dine
> kṛṣṇa-rasa āsvādaye dui-bandhu-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvādaśa]] [[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---for twelve years; [[synonyms:a:aiche]] [[synonyms:d:daśā]]---such a condition; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---transcendental bliss and mellows in connection with Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādaye]]---He tastes; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with two friends, namely Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
translation: For twelve years, Śrī Caitanya remained in that state day and night. With His two friends, He tasted the meaning of those verses, which consist of nothing but the transcendental bliss and mellows of Kṛṣṇa consciousness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.7
description: Sometimes the Lord would be absorbed in a particular emotion and would stay awake all night reciting related verses and relishing their taste.
text:
> kona dine kona bhāve śloka-paṭhana
> sei śloka āsvādite rātri-jāgaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in some emotion; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭhana]]---reciting the verses; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---those verses; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādite]]---to taste; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:j:jāgaraṇa]]---keeping awake at night.
translation: Sometimes the Lord would be absorbed in a particular emotion and would stay awake all night reciting related verses and relishing their taste.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.70
description: Even Anantadeva, who has thousands of faces, could not reach the end of describing the transcendental bliss of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes.
text:
> sei saba līlā-rasa āpane ananta
> sahasra-vadane varṇi' nāhi pā'na anta
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---transcendental mellows of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---the Personality of Godhead Ananta; [[synonyms:s:sahasra]]-[[synonyms:v:vadane]]---with His thousands of faces; [[synonyms:v:varṇi']]---describing; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pā'na]]---gets; [[synonyms:a:anta]]---the limit.
translation: Even Anantadeva, who has thousands of faces, could not reach the end of describing the transcendental bliss of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.71
description: How, then, could an ordinary living being with very little intelligence describe such pastimes? Nevertheless, I am trying to touch but a particle of them just to rectify my own self.
text:
> jīva kṣudra-buddhi kon tāhā pāre varṇite?
> tāra eka kaṇā sparśi āpanā śodhite
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jīva]]---living being; [[synonyms:k:kṣudra]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhi]]---limited intelligence; [[synonyms:k:kon]]---who; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---is able; [[synonyms:v:varṇite]]---to write; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇā]]---one particle; [[synonyms:s:sparśi]]---I touch; [[synonyms:ā:āpanā]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhite]]---to correct myself.
translation: How, then, could an ordinary living being with very little intelligence describe such pastimes? Nevertheless, I am trying to touch but a particle of them just to rectify my own self.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.72
description: There is no limit to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities and His words of madness. Therefore describing them all would greatly increase the size of this book.
text:
> yata ceṣṭā, yata pralāpa,---nāhi pārāvāra
> sei saba varṇite grantha haya suvistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭā]]---all activities; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:p:pralāpa]]---all crazy talking; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pārāvāra]]---there was no limit; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of them; [[synonyms:v:varṇite]]---to describe; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---the book; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---would be; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---very voluminous.
translation: There is no limit to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's activities and His words of madness. Therefore describing them all would greatly increase the size of this book.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.73
description: Whatever pastimes Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has first described I have merely summarized.
text:
> vṛndāvana-dāsa prathama ye līlā varṇila
> sei-saba līlāra āmi sūtra-mātra kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:p:prathama]]---at first; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:v:varṇila]]---described; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all of those; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the pastimes; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:sūtra]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---prepared only the synopsis.
translation: Whatever pastimes Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has first described I have merely summarized.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.74
description: I have only very briefly described the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu not described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. Nevertheless, because those transcendental pastimes are so numerous, the size of this book has increased.
text:
> tāṅra tyakta 'avaśeṣa' saṅkṣepe kahila
> līlāra bāhulye grantha tathāpi bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:t:tyakta]]---left out; [[synonyms:a:aveśeṣa]]---remainders; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---I have described very briefly; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāhulye]]---because of the numerousness of the pastimes; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---this book; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---has increased.
translation: I have only very briefly described the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu not described by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura. Nevertheless, because those transcendental pastimes are so numerous, the size of this book has increased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.75
description: It is impossible to describe all the pastimes elaborately. I shall therefore end this description and offer them my respectful obeisances.
text:
> ataeva sei-saba līlā nā pāri varṇibāre
> samāpti kariluṅ līlāke kari' namaskāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all those; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am not able; [[synonyms:v:varṇibāre]]---to narrate; [[synonyms:s:samāpti]] [[synonyms:k:kariluṅ]]---now I have finished; [[synonyms:l:līlāke]]---to the pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:n:namaskāre]]---offering my respectful obeisances.
translation: It is impossible to describe all the pastimes elaborately. I shall therefore end this description and offer them my respectful obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.76
description: What I have described gives merely an indication, but by following this indication one may obtain a taste of all the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ye kichu kahiluṅ ei dig-daraśana
> ei anusāre habe tāra āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---whatever; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:dik]]-[[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---just to make an indication; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:a:anusāre]]---in this way; [[synonyms:h:habe]]---there will be; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---tasting.
translation: What I have described gives merely an indication, but by following this indication one may obtain a taste of all the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.77
description: I cannot understand the very deep, meaningful pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My intelligence cannot penetrate them, and therefore I could not properly describe them.
text:
> prabhura gambhīra-līlā nā pāri bujhite
> buddhi-praveśa nāhi tāte, nā pāri varṇite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gambhīra]]---deep; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am not able; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---to understand; [[synonyms:b:buddhi]]-[[synonyms:p:praveśa]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---my intelligence cannot penetrate; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---because of this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I am not able; [[synonyms:v:varṇite]]---to describe properly.
translation: I cannot understand the very deep, meaningful pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. My intelligence cannot penetrate them, and therefore I could not properly describe them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.78
description: After offering my respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of all my Vaiṣṇava readers, I shall therefore end this description of the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> saba śrotā vaiṣṇavera vandiyā caraṇa
> caitanya-caritra-varṇana kailuṅ samāpana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:ś:śrotā]]---all readers; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:v:vandiyā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---offering respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---of the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---description; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---I have done; [[synonyms:s:samāpana]]---finishing.
translation: After offering my respectful obeisances to the lotus feet of all my Vaiṣṇava readers, I shall therefore end this description of the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.79
description: The sky is unlimited, but many birds fly higher and higher according to their own abilities.
text:
> ākāśa---ananta, tāte yaiche pakṣi-gaṇa
> yāra yata śakti, tata kare ārohaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ākāśa]]---the sky; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that sky; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:p:pakṣi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all types of birds; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of someone; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---whatever power; [[synonyms:t:tata]]---that much; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:ārohaṇa]]---rises up and up.
translation: The sky is unlimited, but many birds fly higher and higher according to their own abilities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.8
description: In great jubilation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya, know from Me that chanting of the holy names is the most feasible means of salvation in this age of Kali.
text:
> harṣe prabhu kahena,---"śuna svarūpa-rāma-rāya
> nāma-saṅkīrtana---kalau parama upāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:harṣe]]---in jubilation; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---My dear Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kalau]]---in the age of Kali; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---the most feasible means for deliverance.
translation: In great jubilation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "My dear Svarūpa Dāmodara and Rāmānanda Rāya, know from Me that chanting of the holy names is the most feasible means of salvation in this age of Kali.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.80
description: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like the unlimited sky. How, then, can an ordinary living being describe them all?
text:
> aiche mahāprabhura līlā---nāhi ora-pāra
> 'jīva' hañā kebā samyak pāre varṇibāra?
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:o:ora]]-[[synonyms:p:pāra]]---there is no limit above or below; [[synonyms:j:jīva]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being an ordinary living entity; [[synonyms:k:kebā]]---who; [[synonyms:s:samyak]]---fully; [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---is able; [[synonyms:v:varṇibāra]]---to describe.
translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like the unlimited sky. How, then, can an ordinary living being describe them all?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.81
description: I have tried to describe them as far as my intelligence allows, as if trying to touch a drop in the midst of a great ocean.
text:
> yāvat buddhira gati, tateka varṇiluṅ
> samudrera madhye yena eka kaṇa chuṅiluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāvat]]---as far; [[synonyms:b:buddhira]] [[synonyms:g:gati]]---the limit of my intelligence; [[synonyms:t:tateka]]---that far; [[synonyms:v:varṇiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the midst of the great ocean; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---just like; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one particle; [[synonyms:c:chuṅiluṅ]]---I have touched.
translation: I have tried to describe them as far as my intelligence allows, as if trying to touch a drop in the midst of a great ocean.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.82
description: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura is Lord Nityānanda's favorite devotee, and therefore he is the original Vyāsadeva in describing the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> nityānanda-kṛpā-pātra---vṛndāvana-dāsa
> caitanya-līlāya teṅho hayena 'ādi-vyāsa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the favorite devotee; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---in the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---He; [[synonyms:h:hayena]]---is; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:v:vyāsa]]---the original Vyāsadeva.
translation: Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura is Lord Nityānanda's favorite devotee, and therefore he is the original Vyāsadeva in describing the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that all writers after Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura who are pure devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and who have tried to describe the Lord's activities are to be considered like Vyāsa. Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura is the original Vyāsadeva in describing //caitanya-līlā,// and all others who follow in his footsteps by describing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes are also to be called Vyāsadeva. The bona fide spiritual master is called Vyāsa because he is a representative of Vyāsa. Worshiping the birthday of such a spiritual master is called Vyāsa-pūjā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.83
description: Although Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has within his jurisdiction the full store of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, he has left aside most of them and described but a small portion.
text:
> tāṅra āge yadyapi saba līlāra bhāṇḍāra
> tathāpi alpa varṇiyā chāḍilena āra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before him; [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the pastimes; [[synonyms:b:bhāṇḍāra]]---full store; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:a:alpa]]---very little; [[synonyms:v:varṇiyā]]---describing; [[synonyms:c:chāḍilena]]---he left; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---the others.
translation: Although Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has within his jurisdiction the full store of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes, he has left aside most of them and described but a small portion.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.84
description: What I have described was left aside by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, but although he could not describe these pastimes, he gave us a synopsis.
text:
> ye kichu varṇiluṅ, seha saṅkṣepa kariyā
> likhite nā pārena, tabu rākhiyāchena likhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:v:varṇiluṅ]]---whatever I have described; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---them; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepa]]---briefly; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---doing; [[synonyms:l:likhite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pārena]]---Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura was not able to describe; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:r:rākhiyāchena]]---has kept; [[synonyms:l:likhiyā]]---recording in writing.
translation: What I have described was left aside by Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura, but although he could not describe these pastimes, he gave us a synopsis.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.85
description: In his book named Caitanya-maṅgala [Caitanya-bhāgavata], he has described these pastimes in many places. I request my readers to hear that book, for that is the best evidence.
text:
> caitanya-maṅgale teṅho likhiyāche sthāne-sthāne
> sei vacana śuna, sei parama-pramāṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:m:maṅgale]]---in the book named //Caitanya-maṅgala//; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:l:likhiyāche]]---has written; [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in several places; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]] [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear those statements; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:p:pramāṇe]]---that is the foremost proof.
translation: In his book named Caitanya-maṅgala [Caitanya-bhāgavata], he has described these pastimes in many places. I request my readers to hear that book, for that is the best evidence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.86
description: I have described the pastimes very briefly, for it is impossible for me to describe them in full. In the future, however, Vedavyāsa will describe them elaborately.
text:
> saṅkṣepe kahiluṅ, vistāra nā yāya kathane
> vistāriyā veda-vyāsa kariba varṇane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described very briefly; [[synonyms:v:vistāra]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:k:kathane]]---it is not possible to describe them in full; [[synonyms:v:vistāriyā]]---elaborating; [[synonyms:v:veda]]-[[synonyms:v:vyāsa]]---a representative of Vyāsadeva; [[synonyms:k:kariba]]---will do; [[synonyms:v:varṇane]]---describing.
translation: I have described the pastimes very briefly, for it is impossible for me to describe them in full. In the future, however, Vedavyāsa will describe them elaborately.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.87
description: In Caitanya-maṅgala, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has stated in many places the factual truth that in the future Vyāsadeva will describe them elaborately.
text:
> caitanya-maṅgale ihā likhiyāche sthāne-sthāne
> satya kahena,---'āge vyāsa kariba varṇane'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:m:maṅgale]]---in the book named //Caitanya-maṅgala//; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this statement; [[synonyms:l:likhiyāche]]---has written; [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in many places; [[synonyms:s:satya]]---the truth; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---he says; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in the future; [[synonyms:v:vyāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kariba]] [[synonyms:v:varṇane]]---Vyāsadeva will describe them more elaborately.
translation: In Caitanya-maṅgala, Śrīla Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has stated in many places the factual truth that in the future Vyāsadeva will describe them elaborately.
purport:
The statement //āge vyāsa kariba varṇane// is similar to a text in the //Caitanya-bhāgavata// (First Chapter, text 180) in which Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura says:

> śeṣa-khaṇḍe caitanyera ananta vilāsa
> vistāriyā varṇite āchena veda-vyāsa

"The unlimited pastimes of Śrī Caitanya will be described by Vyāsadeva in the future." Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that these statements indicate that in the future, other representatives of Vyāsadeva will elaborately describe Lord Caitanya's pastimes. The purport is that any pure devotee in the disciplic succession who describes the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is confirmed to be a representative of Vyāsadeva.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.88
description: The ocean of nectarean pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is like the ocean of milk. According to his thirst, Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura filled his pitcher and drank from that ocean.
text:
> caitanya-līlāmṛta-sindhu---dugdhābdhi-samāna
> tṛṣṇānurūpa jhārī bhari' teṅho kailā pāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of nectarean pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:a:abdhi]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---exactly like the ocean of milk; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]]-[[synonyms:a:anurūpa]]---according to one's thirst; [[synonyms:j:jhārī]]---the pitcher; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---drank.
translation: The ocean of nectarean pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is like the ocean of milk. According to his thirst, Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura filled his pitcher and drank from that ocean.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.89
description: Whatever remnants of milk Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given me are sufficient to fill my belly. Now my thirst is completely satiated.
text:
> tāṅra jhārī-śeṣāmṛta kichu more dilā
> tateke bharila peṭa, tṛṣṇā mora gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:j:jhārī]]-[[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---the remnants of the milk of Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura's pitcher; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:m:more]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---has given to me; [[synonyms:t:tateke]]---by those remnants; [[synonyms:b:bharila]] [[synonyms:p:peṭa]]---my abdomen is filled; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇā]] [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---now my thirst has gone.
translation: Whatever remnants of milk Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura has given me are sufficient to fill my belly. Now my thirst is completely satiated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.9
description: "In this age of Kali, the process of worshiping Kṛṣṇa is to perform sacrifice by chanting the holy name of the Lord. One who does so is certainly very intelligent, and he attains shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> saṅkīrtana-yajñe kalau kṛṣṇa-ārādhana
> sei ta' sumedhā pāya kṛṣṇera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]-[[synonyms:y:yajñe]]---performing the //yajña// of chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:k:kalau]]---in this age of Kali; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ārādhana]]---the process of worshiping Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---such persons; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:m:medhā]]---greatly intelligent; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---get; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "In this age of Kali, the process of worshiping Kṛṣṇa is to perform sacrifice by chanting the holy name of the Lord. One who does so is certainly very intelligent, and he attains shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
purport: For further information, one may refer to the //Ādi-līlā,// Chapter Three, texts 77-78.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.90-91
description: I am a very insignificant living being, like a small red-beaked bird. Just as such a bird drinks the water of the sea to quench its thirst, so I have touched only a drop of the ocean of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. From this example, you may all understand how expansive are the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> āmi---ati-kṣudra jīva, pakṣī rāṅgā-ṭuni
> se yaiche tṛṣṇāya piye samudrera pānī
> taiche āmi eka kaṇa chuṅiluṅ līlāra
> ei dṛṣṭānte jāniha prabhura līlāra vistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣudra]] [[synonyms:j:jīva]]---a very insignificant living being; [[synonyms:p:pakṣī]] [[synonyms:r:rāṅgā]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭuni]]---just like a little bird with a red beak; [[synonyms:s:se]]---he; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:t:tṛṣṇāya]]---in thirst; [[synonyms:p:piye]]---drinks; [[synonyms:s:samudrera]] [[synonyms:p:pānī]]---the water of the sea; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---in the same way; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇa]]---one small particle; [[synonyms:c:chuṅiluṅ]]---touched; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]]---of the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dṛṣṭānte]]---by this example; [[synonyms:j:jāniha]]---all of you know; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:līlāra]] [[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---expansion of the pastimes.
translation: I am a very insignificant living being, like a small red-beaked bird. Just as such a bird drinks the water of the sea to quench its thirst, so I have touched only a drop of the ocean of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's pastimes. From this example, you may all understand how expansive are the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.92
description: I infer that "I have written" is a false understanding, for my body is like a wooden doll.
text:
> 'āmi likhi',---eha mithyā kari anumāna
> āmāra śarīra kāṣṭha-putalī-samāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:l:likhi]]---I write; [[synonyms:e:eha]] [[synonyms:m:mithyā]]---this is false; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:a:anumāna]]---I can infer; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śarīra]]---my body; [[synonyms:k:kāṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:p:putalī]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---is exactly like a wooden doll.
translation: I infer that "I have written" is a false understanding, for my body is like a wooden doll.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.93
description: I am old and troubled by invalidity. I am almost blind and deaf, my hands tremble, and my mind and intelligence are unsteady.
text:
> vṛddha jarātura āmi andha, badhira
> hasta hāle, manobuddhi nahe mora sthira
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vṛddha]]---an old man; [[synonyms:j:jarā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ātura]]---troubled by invalidity; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:a:andha]]---blind; [[synonyms:b:badhira]]---deaf; [[synonyms:h:hasta]] [[synonyms:h:hāle]]---my hands tremble; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhi]]---mind and intelligence; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---not; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sthira]]---steady.
translation: I am old and troubled by invalidity. I am almost blind and deaf, my hands tremble, and my mind and intelligence are unsteady.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 20.94
description: I am infected by so many diseases that I can neither properly walk nor properly sit. Indeed, I am always exhausted by five kinds of disease. I may die at any time of the day or night.
text:
> nānā-roga-grasta,---calite vasite nā pāri
> pañca-roga-pīḍā-vyākula, rātri-dine mari
