title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.111
description: The Lord asked Sanātana Gosvāmī to offer obeisances to all the devotees in a way that befitted each one. Thus He introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all, just to make him an object of their mercy.
text:
> yathā-yogya karāila sabāra caraṇa vandana
> tāṅre karāilā sabāra kṛpāra bhājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]]---as it is fit; [[synonyms:k:karāila]]---caused to perform; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---worshiping the lotus feet; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhājana]]---object of mercy.
translation: The Lord asked Sanātana Gosvāmī to offer obeisances to all the devotees in a way that befitted each one. Thus He introduced Sanātana Gosvāmī to them all, just to make him an object of their mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.112
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī was dear to everyone because of his exalted qualities in learning. Suitably, therefore, they bestowed upon him mercy, friendship and honor.
text:
> sad-guṇe, pāṇḍitye, sabāra priya---sanātana
> yathā-yogya kṛpā-maitrī-gaurava-bhājana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---in good qualities; [[synonyms:p:pāṇḍitye]]---in learning; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:p:priya]]---dear to everyone; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]]---as it is suitable; [[synonyms:k:kṛpa]]---mercy; [[synonyms:m:maitrī]]---friendship; [[synonyms:g:gaurava]]---honor; [[synonyms:b:bhājana]]---worthy of being offered.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was dear to everyone because of his exalted qualities in learning. Suitably, therefore, they bestowed upon him mercy, friendship and honor.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.113
description: When all the other devotees returned to Bengal after the Ratha-yātrā festival, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> sakala vaiṣṇava yabe gauḍa-deśe gelā
> sanātana mahāprabhura caraṇe rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---devotees; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]] [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---stayed at the lotus feet.
translation: When all the other devotees returned to Bengal after the Ratha-yātrā festival, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.114
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī observed the Dola-yātrā ceremony with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way, his pleasure increased in the company of the Lord.
text:
> dola-yātrā-ādi prabhura saṅgete dekhila
> dine-dine prabhu-saṅge ānanda bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dola]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the festival of Dola-yātrā; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:s:saṅgete]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---he saw; [[synonyms:d:dine]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day after day; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in the association of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---his pleasure increased.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī observed the Dola-yātrā ceremony with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. In this way, his pleasure increased in the company of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.115
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī had come to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī during the month of April-May, and during the month of May-June Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tested him.
text:
> pūrve vaiśākha-māse sanātana yabe āilā
> jyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu tāṅre parīkṣā karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:v:vaiśākha]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---during the month of April-May; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:j:jyaiṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---in the month of May-June; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---tested.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī had come to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Jagannātha Purī during the month of April-May, and during the month of May-June Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu tested him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.116
description: In that month of May-June, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the garden of Yameśvara [Lord Śiva] and accepted prasāda there at the request of the devotees.
text:
> jyaiṣṭha-māse prabhu yameśvara-ṭoṭā āilā
> bhakta-anurodhe tāhāṅ bhikṣā ye karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jyaiṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:m:māse]]---during the month of May-June; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yameśvara]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭoṭā]]---to the garden of Lord Śiva, Yameśvara; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:a:anurodhe]]---on the request of the devotees; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---accepted //prasāda.//
translation: In that month of May-June, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came to the garden of Yameśvara [Lord Śiva] and accepted prasāda there at the request of the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.117
description: At noon, when it was time for lunch, the Lord called for Sanātana Gosvāmī, whose happiness increased because of the call.
text:
> madhyāhna-bhikṣā-kāle sanātane bolāila
> prabhu bolāilā, tāṅra ānanda bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:a:ahna]]---at noon; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at the time for lunch; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---for Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bolāila]]---He called; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:b:bolāilā]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---happiness; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---increased.
translation: At noon, when it was time for lunch, the Lord called for Sanātana Gosvāmī, whose happiness increased because of the call.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.118
description: At noon the sand on the beach was as hot as fire, but Sanātana Gosvāmī came by that path.
text:
> madhyāhne samudra-vālu hañāche agni-sama
> sei-pathe sanātana karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:madhya]]-[[synonyms:a:ahne]]---at noon; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:v:vālu]]---the sand by the sea; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---was; [[synonyms:a:agni]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---as hot as fire; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---by that path; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---came.
translation: At noon the sand on the beach was as hot as fire, but Sanātana Gosvāmī came by that path.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.119
description: Overwhelmed by joy at being called by the Lord, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not feel that his feet were burning in the hot sand.
text:
> 'prabhu bolāñāche',---ei ānandita mane
> tapta-vālukāte pā poḍe, tāhā nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:b:bolāñāche]]---the Lord has called; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---happy; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:v:vālukāte]]---on the hot sand; [[synonyms:p:pā]]---feet; [[synonyms:p:poḍe]]---were burning; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---could not understand.
translation: Overwhelmed by joy at being called by the Lord, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not feel that his feet were burning in the hot sand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.12
description: "After seeing Lord Jagannātha, I shall give up my body under the wheel of the cart in the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This will be the highest benediction of my life."
text:
> mahāprabhura āge, āra dekhi' jagannātha
> rathe deha chāḍimu,---ei parama-puruṣārtha'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']] [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---after seeing Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:r:rathe]]---under the cart; [[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍimu]]---I shall give up this body; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:p:puruṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the highest benediction of life.
translation: "After seeing Lord Jagannātha, I shall give up my body under the wheel of the cart in the presence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This will be the highest benediction of my life."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.120
description: Although the soles of both his feet were blistered because of the heat, he nevertheless went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There he found that the Lord, having taken His lunch, was resting.
text:
> dui pāye phoskā haila, tabu gelā prabhu-sthāne
> bhikṣā kari' mahāprabhu kariyāchena viśrāme
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:p:pāye]]---on the two soles; [[synonyms:p:phoskā]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there were blisters; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after finishing lunch; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:v:viśrāme]]---was taking rest.
translation: Although the soles of both his feet were blistered because of the heat, he nevertheless went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. There he found that the Lord, having taken His lunch, was resting.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.121
description: Govinda gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the plate with the remnants of Lord Caitanya's food. After taking the prasāda, Sanātana Gosvāmī approached Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> bhikṣā-avaśeṣa-pātra govinda tāre dilā
> prasāda pāñā sanātana prabhu-pāśe āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]-[[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]]---of remnants of the food; [[synonyms:p:pātra]]---plate; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered to him; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---after taking the remnants of food; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came.
translation: Govinda gave Sanātana Gosvāmī the plate with the remnants of Lord Caitanya's food. After taking the prasāda, Sanātana Gosvāmī approached Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.122
description: When the Lord inquired, "By which path have you come?" Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I have come on the path along the beach."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'kon pathe āilā, sanātana?'
> teṅha kahe,---'samudra-pathe, kariluṅ āgamana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the Lord inquired; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---through which path; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---you have come, Sanātana; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he replied; [[synonyms:s:samudra]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path by the sea; [[synonyms:k:kariluṅ]] [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---I have come.
translation: When the Lord inquired, "By which path have you come?" Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I have come on the path along the beach."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.123
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "How did you come through the beach where the sand is so hot? Why didn't you come by the path in front of the Siṁha-dvāra gate? It is very cool.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"tapta-vālukāte kemane āilā?
> siṁha-dvārera patha---śītala, kene nā āilā?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:v:vālukāte]]---on hot sand; [[synonyms:k:kemane]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---how did you come; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārera]] [[synonyms:p:patha]]---the path of the Siṁha-dvāra gate; [[synonyms:ś:śītala]]---very cool; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---did you not come.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "How did you come through the beach where the sand is so hot? Why didn't you come by the path in front of the Siṁha-dvāra gate? It is very cool.
purport: Siṁha-dvāra refers to the main gate on the eastern side of the Jagannātha temple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.124
description: "The hot sand must have blistered your soles. Now you cannot walk. How did you tolerate it?"
text:
> tapta-vālukāya tomāra pāya haila vraṇa
> calite nā pāra, kemane karilā sahana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:v:vālukāya]]---by the hot sand; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---on the soles; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there were; [[synonyms:v:vraṇa]]---blisters; [[synonyms:c:calite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---you cannot walk; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:s:sahana]]---did you tolerate.
translation: "The hot sand must have blistered your soles. Now you cannot walk. How did you tolerate it?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.125
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I did not feel much pain, nor did I know that there are blisters because of the heat.
text:
> sanātana kahe,---"dukha bahuta nā pāiluṅ
> pāye vraṇa hañāche tāhā nā jāniluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī replied; [[synonyms:d:dukha]]---pain; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]]---much; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāiluṅ]]---I did not feel; [[synonyms:p:pāye]]---on the soles; [[synonyms:v:vraṇa]] [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---there were blisters; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāniluṅ]]---I did not know.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "I did not feel much pain, nor did I know that there are blisters because of the heat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.126
description: "I have no right to pass by the Siṁha-dvāra, for the servants of Jagannātha are always coming and going there.
text:
> siṁha-dvāre yāite mora nāhi adhikāra
> viśeṣe---ṭhākurera tāhāṅ sevakera pracāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---in front of the main gate, known as Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---there is no right; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣe]]---specifically; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:s:sevakera]] [[synonyms:p:pracāra]]---traffic of the servants.
translation: "I have no right to pass by the Siṁha-dvāra, for the servants of Jagannātha are always coming and going there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.127
description: "The servants are always coming and going without interval. If I touch them, I shall be ruined."
text:
> sevaka gatāgati kare, nāhi avasara
> tāra sparśa haile, sarva-nāśa habe mora"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servants; [[synonyms:g:gatāgati]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---come and go; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:a:avasara]]---there is no interval; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:sparśa]] [[synonyms:h:haile]]---if I touch them; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśa]] [[synonyms:h:habe]] [[synonyms:m:mora]]---I shall be ruined.
translation: "The servants are always coming and going without interval. If I touch them, I shall be ruined."
purport: Herein it is very clearly indicated that priests performing Deity worship should be careful to keep themselves completely pure and not be touched by outsiders. Sanātana Gosvāmī and Haridāsa Ṭhākura, thinking themselves //mlecchas// and //yavanas// because of their past association with Mohammedans, did not enter the temple nor even travel on the path in front of the temple gate. It is customary for the priests of temples in India not even to touch outsiders nor enter the Deity room after having been touched. This is a very important item in temple worship.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.128
description: Having heard all these details, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, greatly pleased, spoke as follows.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu mane santoṣa pāilā
> tuṣṭa hañā tāṅre kichu kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---became very happy; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being pleased; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: Having heard all these details, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, greatly pleased, spoke as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.129-130
description: "My dear Sanātana, although you are the deliverer of the entire universe and although even the demigods and great saints are purified by touching you, it is the characteristic of a devotee to observe and protect the Vaiṣṇava etiquette. Maintenance of the Vaiṣṇava etiquette is the ornament of a devotee.
text:
> "yadyapio tumi hao jagat-pāvana
> tomā-sparśe pavitra haya deva-muni-gaṇa
> tathāpi bhakta-svabhāva---maryādā-rakṣaṇa
> maryādā-pālana haya sādhura bhūṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapio]]---although; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:h:hao]]---are; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:p:pāvana]]---the deliverer of the entire universe; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---you; [[synonyms:s:sparśe]]---by touching; [[synonyms:p:pavitra]]---purified; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:m:muni]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the demigods and great saintly persons; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---the nature of a devotee; [[synonyms:m:maryādā]]---etiquette; [[synonyms:r:rakṣaṇa]]---to protect or observe; [[synonyms:m:maryādā]] [[synonyms:p:pālana]]---to maintain etiquette; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sādhura]] [[synonyms:b:bhūṣaṇa]]---ornament of devotees.
translation: "My dear Sanātana, although you are the deliverer of the entire universe and although even the demigods and great saints are purified by touching you, it is the characteristic of a devotee to observe and protect the Vaiṣṇava etiquette. Maintenance of the Vaiṣṇava etiquette is the ornament of a devotee.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.13
description: Having made this resolution, Sanātana Gosvāmī went to Nīlācala, where he inquired directions from people and approached the residence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> ei ta' niścaya kari' nīlācale āilā
> loke puchi' haridāsa-sthāne uttarilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---ascertaining; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:l:loke]] [[synonyms:p:puchi']]---inquiring from people; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---the place of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:u:uttarilā]]---approached.
translation: Having made this resolution, Sanātana Gosvāmī went to Nīlācala, where he inquired directions from people and approached the residence of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.131
description: "If one transgresses the laws of etiquette, people make fun of him, and thus he is vanquished in both this world and the next.
text:
> maryādā-laṅghane loka kare upahāsa
> iha-loka, para-loka---dui haya nāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:maryādā]]-[[synonyms:l:laṅghane]]---by surpassing the customs of etiquette; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:u:upahāsa]]---joke; [[synonyms:i:iha]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---this world; [[synonyms:p:para]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---the next world; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---become vanquished.
translation: "If one transgresses the laws of etiquette, people make fun of him, and thus he is vanquished in both this world and the next.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.132
description: "By observing the etiquette, you have satisfied My mind. Who else but you will show this example?"
text:
> maryādā rākhile, tuṣṭa kaile mora mana
> tumi aiche nā karile kare kon jana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:maryādā]] [[synonyms:r:rākhile]]---since you have observed the etiquette; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kaile]]---you have satisfied; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---My mind; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---like that; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karile]]---without doing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---would do; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---who.
translation: "By observing the etiquette, you have satisfied My mind. Who else but you will show this example?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.133
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī, and the moisture oozing from the itching sores on Sanātana's body smeared the body of the Lord.
text:
> eta bali' prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kaila
> tāṅra kaṇḍu-rasā prabhura śrī-aṅge lāgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---embraced; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:r:rasā]]---moisture oozing from the itches; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅge]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---smeared the body.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī, and the moisture oozing from the itching sores on Sanātana's body smeared the body of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.134
description: Although Sanātana Gosvāmī forbade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to embrace him, the Lord did so. Thus His body was smeared with the moisture from Sanātana's body, and Sanātana became greatly distressed.
text:
> bāra bāra niṣedhena, tabu kare āliṅgana
> aṅge rasā lāge, duḥkha pāya sanātana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:n:niṣedhena]]---forbids; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---He embraces; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body; [[synonyms:r:rasā]] [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---oozing moisture touches; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: Although Sanātana Gosvāmī forbade Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to embrace him, the Lord did so. Thus His body was smeared with the moisture from Sanātana's body, and Sanātana became greatly distressed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.135
description: Thus both servant and master departed for their respective homes. The next day, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to meet Sanātana Gosvāmī.
text:
> ei-mate sevaka-prabhu duṅhe ghara gelā
> āra dina jagadānanda sanātanere mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the servant and the master; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned to their respective places; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:s:sanātanere]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: Thus both servant and master departed for their respective homes. The next day, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita went to meet Sanātana Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.136
description: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Sanātana Gosvāmī sat together and began to discuss topics about Kṛṣṇa, Sanātana Gosvāmī submitted to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita the cause of his distress.
text:
> dui-jana vasi' kṛṣṇa-kathā-goṣṭhī kailā
> paṇḍitere sanātana duḥkha nivedilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]] [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---both of them sitting; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---discussion; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitere]]---unto Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:n:nivedilā]]---submitted his unhappiness.
translation: When Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Sanātana Gosvāmī sat together and began to discuss topics about Kṛṣṇa, Sanātana Gosvāmī submitted to Jagadānanda Paṇḍita the cause of his distress.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.137
description: "I came here to diminish my unhappiness by seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the Lord did not allow me to execute what was in my mind.
text:
> "ihāṅ āilāṅ prabhure dekhi' duḥkha khaṇḍāite
> yebā mane, tāhā prabhu nā dilā karite
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here (to Jagannātha Purī); [[synonyms:ā:āilāṅ]]---I have come; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍāite]]---to diminish my unhappiness; [[synonyms:y:yebā]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---what was in my mind; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---did not allow me to do.
translation: "I came here to diminish my unhappiness by seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, but the Lord did not allow me to execute what was in my mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.138
description: "Although I forbid Him to do so, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu nevertheless embraces me, and therefore His body becomes smeared with the discharges from my itching sores.
text:
> niṣedhite prabhu āliṅgana karena more
> mora kaṇḍu-rasā lāge prabhura śarīre
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:niṣedhite]]---although I forbid; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:r:rasā]]---my wet sores; [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---touches; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śarīre]]---on the body.
translation: "Although I forbid Him to do so, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu nevertheless embraces me, and therefore His body becomes smeared with the discharges from my itching sores.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.139
description: "In this way I am committing offenses at His lotus feet, for which I shall certainly not be delivered. At the same time, I cannot see Lord Jagannātha. This is my great unhappiness.
text:
> aparādha haya mora, nāhika nistāra
> jagannātheha nā dekhiye,---e duḥkha apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]---offense; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---mine; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]] [[synonyms:n:nistāra]]---there is no deliverance; [[synonyms:j:jagannātheha]]---also Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiye]]---I cannot see; [[synonyms:e:e]]---this; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---great unhappiness.
translation: "In this way I am committing offenses at His lotus feet, for which I shall certainly not be delivered. At the same time, I cannot see Lord Jagannātha. This is my great unhappiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.14
description: He offered his respects to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who knew him and thus embraced him.
text:
> haridāsera kailā teṅha caraṇa vandana
> jāni' haridāsa tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsera]]---of Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---worshiping the lotus feet; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced.
translation: He offered his respects to the lotus feet of Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who knew him and thus embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.140
description: "I came here for my benefit, but now I see that I am getting just the opposite. I do not know, nor can I ascertain, how there will be benefit for me."
text:
> hita-nimitta āilāṅa āmi, haila viparīte
> ki karile hita haya nāri nirdhārite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hita]]-[[synonyms:n:nimitta]]---for benefit; [[synonyms:ā:āilāṅa]]---came; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:v:viparīte]]---it has become just the opposite; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:karile]]---how; [[synonyms:h:hita]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there will be benefit; [[synonyms:n:nāri]] [[synonyms:n:nirdhārite]]---I can not ascertain.
translation: "I came here for my benefit, but now I see that I am getting just the opposite. I do not know, nor can I ascertain, how there will be benefit for me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.141
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "The most suitable place for you to reside is Vṛndāvana. After seeing the Ratha-yātrā festival, you can return there.
text:
> paṇḍita kahe,---"tomāra vāsa-yogya 'vṛndāvana'
> ratha-yātrā dekhi' tāhāṅ karaha gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]]---a suitable place for residence; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing the Ratha-yātrā festival; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---go.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita said, "The most suitable place for you to reside is Vṛndāvana. After seeing the Ratha-yātrā festival, you can return there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.142
description: "The Lord has already ordered both of you brothers to situate yourselves in Vṛndāvana. There you will achieve all happiness.
text:
> prabhura ājñā hañāche tomā' dui bhāye
> vṛndāvane vaisa, tāhāṅ sarva-sukha pāiye
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---has been; [[synonyms:t:tomā']]---you; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāye]]---to the two brothers; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]] [[synonyms:v:vaisa]]---sit down at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---all happiness; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---you will get.
translation: "The Lord has already ordered both of you brothers to situate yourselves in Vṛndāvana. There you will achieve all happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.143
description: 'Your purpose in coming has been fulfilled, for you have seen the lotus feet of the Lord. Therefore, after seeing Lord Jagannātha on the Ratha-yātrā car, you can leave."
text:
> ye-kārye āilā, prabhura dekhilā caraṇa
> rathe jagannātha dekhi' karaha gamana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:k:kārye]]---for which business; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---you have come; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---you have seen; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the feet; [[synonyms:r:rathe]]---on the car; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---go.
translation: 'Your purpose in coming has been fulfilled, for you have seen the lotus feet of the Lord. Therefore, after seeing Lord Jagannātha on the Ratha-yātrā car, you can leave."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.144
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You have given me very good advice. I shall certainly go there, for that is the place the Lord has given me for my residence."
text:
> sanātana kahe,---"bhāla kailā upadeśa
> tāhāṅ yāba, sei mora 'prabhu-datta deśa' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī replied; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]]---you have given good advice; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāba]]---I shall go there; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]]---given by the Lord; [[synonyms:d:deśa]]---residential country.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī replied, "You have given me very good advice. I shall certainly go there, for that is the place the Lord has given me for my residence."
purport: The words //prabhu-datta deśa// are very significant. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotional cult teaches one not to sit down in one place but to spread the devotional cult all over the world. The Lord dispatched Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī to Vṛndāvana to excavate and renovate the holy places and from there establish the cult of //bhakti.// Therefore Vṛndāvana was given to Sanātana Gosvāmī and Rūpa Gosvāmī as their place of residence. Similarly, everyone in the line of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotional cult should accept the words of the spiritual master and thus spread the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. They should go everywhere, to all parts of the world, accepting those places as //prabhu-datta deśa,// the places of residence given by the spiritual master or Lord Kṛṣṇa. The spiritual master is the representative of Lord Kṛṣṇa; therefore one who has carried out the orders of the spiritual master is understood to have carried out the orders of Kṛṣṇa or Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to spread the //bhakti// cult all over the world (//pṛthivīte āche yata nagarādi grāma//). Therefore devotees in the line of Kṛṣṇa consciousness must go to different parts of the world and preach, as ordered by the spiritual master. That will satisfy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.145
description: After talking in this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to their respective duties. The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Haridāsa and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
text:
> eta bali' duṅhe nija-kārye uṭhi' gelā
> āra dina mahāprabhu milibāre āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---talking like this; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:k:kārye]]---to their respective duties; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milibāre]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to meet.
translation: After talking in this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jagadānanda Paṇḍita returned to their respective duties. The next day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu went to see Haridāsa and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.146
description: Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered obeisances to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord embraced him in ecstatic love.
text:
> haridāsa kailā prabhura caraṇa vandana
> haridāse kailā prabhu prema-āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---worshiping the lotus feet; [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---unto Haridāsa; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing in ecstatic love.
translation: Haridāsa Ṭhākura offered obeisances to the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord embraced him in ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.147
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī offered his obeisances and daṇḍavats from a distant place, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called him again and again to embrace him.
text:
> dūra haite daṇḍa-paraṇāma kare sanātana
> prabhu bolāya bāra bāra karite āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from a distant place; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:p:paraṇāma]]---offering obeisances and //daṇḍavats//; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---did; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bolāya]]---calls; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---to embrace.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī offered his obeisances and daṇḍavats from a distant place, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu called him again and again to embrace him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.148
description: Out of fear of committing offenses, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not come forward to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord, however, went forward to meet him.
text:
> aparādha-bhaye teṅha milite nā āila
> mahāprabhu milibāre sei ṭhāñi gela
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---out of fear of offenses; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---did not come forward; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milibāre]]---to meet; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went.
translation: Out of fear of committing offenses, Sanātana Gosvāmī did not come forward to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord, however, went forward to meet him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.149
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī backed away, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught him by force and embraced him.
text:
> sanātana bhāgi' pāche karena gamana
> balātkāre dhari, prabhu kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:b:bhāgi']]---running away; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---back; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---goes; [[synonyms:b:balātkāre]]---by force; [[synonyms:d:dhari]]---capturing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī backed away, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu caught him by force and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.15
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī was very eager to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "The Lord is coming here very soon."
text:
> mahāprabhu dekhite tāṅra utkaṇṭhita mana
> haridāsa kahe,---'prabhu āsibena ekhana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:u:utkaṇṭhita]]---anxious; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Haridāsa said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsibena]] [[synonyms:e:ekhana]]---will come here.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī was very eager to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Haridāsa Ṭhākura said, "The Lord is coming here very soon."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.150
description: The Lord took them both with Him and sat down in a sacred place. Then Sanātana Gosvāmī, who was advanced in renunciation, began to speak.
text:
> dui jana lañā prabhu vasilā piṇḍāte
> nirviṇṇa sanātana lāgilā kahite
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jana]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the two of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāte]]---on the altar; [[synonyms:n:nirviṇṇa]]---advanced in renunciation; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]] [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---began to speak.
translation: The Lord took them both with Him and sat down in a sacred place. Then Sanātana Gosvāmī, who was advanced in renunciation, began to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.151
description: "I came here for my benefit," he said, "but I see that I am getting just the opposite. I am unfit to render service. I simply commit offenses day after day.
text:
> "hita lāgi' āinu muñi, haila viparīta
> sevā-yogya nahi, aparādha karoṅ niti niti
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hita]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for benefit; [[synonyms:ā:āinu]] [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I came; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:v:viparīta]]---it has become just the opposite; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]-[[synonyms:y:yogya]] [[synonyms:n:nahi]]---I am not fit to render service; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]] [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]]---I commit offenses; [[synonyms:n:niti]] [[synonyms:n:niti]]---day after day.
translation: "I came here for my benefit," he said, "but I see that I am getting just the opposite. I am unfit to render service. I simply commit offenses day after day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.152
description: "By nature I am lowborn. I am a contaminated reservoir of sinful activities. If You touch me, sir, that will be a great offense on my part.
text:
> sahaje nīca-jāti muñi, duṣṭa, 'pāpāśaya'
> more tumi chuṅile mora aparādha haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahaje]]---by nature; [[synonyms:n:nīca]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---lowborn; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:d:duṣṭa]]---sinful; [[synonyms:p:pāpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśaya]]---reservoir of sinful activities; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:c:chuṅile]]---if You touch; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is offense.
translation: "By nature I am lowborn. I am a contaminated reservoir of sinful activities. If You touch me, sir, that will be a great offense on my part.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.153
description: "Moreover, blood is running from infected itching sores on my body, smearing Your body with moisture, but still You touch me by force.
text:
> tāhāte āmāra aṅge kaṇḍu-rasā-rakta cale
> tomāra aṅge lāge, tabu sparśaha tumi bale
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---over and above this; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the body; [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:r:rasā]]---from wet, itching sores; [[synonyms:r:rakta]]---blood; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---runs; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:a:aṅge]] [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---touches Your body; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:s:sparśaha]]---touch; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---by force.
translation: "Moreover, blood is running from infected itching sores on my body, smearing Your body with moisture, but still You touch me by force.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.154
description: "My dear sir, You do not have even a pinch of aversion to touching my body, which is in a horrible condition. Because of this offense, everything auspicious will be vanquished for me.
text:
> bībhatsa sparśite nā kara ghṛṇā-leśe
> ei aparādhe mora habe sarva-nāśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bībhatsa]]---horrible; [[synonyms:s:sparśite]]---to touch; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---You do not do; [[synonyms:g:ghṛṇā]]-[[synonyms:l:leśe]]---even a small bit of aversion; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:a:aparādhe]]---because of this offense; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:h:habe]]---there will be; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:n:nāśe]]---loss of everything auspicious.
translation: "My dear sir, You do not have even a pinch of aversion to touching my body, which is in a horrible condition. Because of this offense, everything auspicious will be vanquished for me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.155
description: "Therefore I see that I will get nothing auspicious by staying here. Kindly give me orders allowing me to return to Vṛndāvana after the Ratha-yātrā festival.
text:
> tāte ihāṅ rahile mora nā haya 'kalyāṇa'
> ājñā deha'---ratha dekhi' yāṅa vṛndāvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---because of this; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:r:rahile]]---if I remain; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kalyāṇa]]---auspiciousness; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---kindly give the order; [[synonyms:r:ratha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after witnessing the Ratha-yātrā festival; [[synonyms:y:yāṅa]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---I may return to Vṛndāvana.
translation: "Therefore I see that I will get nothing auspicious by staying here. Kindly give me orders allowing me to return to Vṛndāvana after the Ratha-yātrā festival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.156
description: "I have consulted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita for his opinion, and he has also advised me to return to Vṛndāvana."
text:
> jagadānanda-paṇḍite āmi yukti puchila
> vṛndāvana yāite teṅha upadeśa dila"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]]---from Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:y:yukti]]---advice; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]] [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---has given instruction.
translation: "I have consulted Jagadānanda Paṇḍita for his opinion, and he has also advised me to return to Vṛndāvana."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.157
description: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in an angry mood, began to chastise Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.
text:
> eta śuni' mahāprabhu saroṣa-antare
> jagadānande kruddha hañā kare tiraṣkāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:r:roṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---in an angry mood; [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---at Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kruddha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming very angry; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:t:tiraḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāre]]---chastises.
translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, in an angry mood, began to chastise Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.158
description: "Jagā [Jagadānanda Paṇḍita] is only a new boy, but he has become so proud that he thinks himself competent to advise a person like you.
text:
> "kālikāra baṭuyā jagā aiche garvī haila
> tomā-sabāreha upadeśa karite lāgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kālikāra]]---new; [[synonyms:b:baṭuyā]]---boy; [[synonyms:j:jagā]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---so; [[synonyms:g:garvī]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---has become proud; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāreha]]---persons like you; [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to advise; [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---has begun.
translation: "Jagā [Jagadānanda Paṇḍita] is only a new boy, but he has become so proud that he thinks himself competent to advise a person like you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.159
description: "In affairs of spiritual advancement and even in ordinary dealings, you are on the level of his spiritual master. Yet not knowing his own value, he dares to advise you.
text:
> vyavahāre-paramārthe tumi---tāra guru-tulya
> tomāre upadeśe, nā jāne āpana-mūlya
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vyavahāre]]---in ordinary dealings; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:a:arthe]]---in spiritual matters; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:t:tulya]]---like a spiritual master; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---you; [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---he advises; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---his value.
translation: "In affairs of spiritual advancement and even in ordinary dealings, you are on the level of his spiritual master. Yet not knowing his own value, he dares to advise you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.16
description: At that very moment, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha to see the offering of upala-bhoga [morning refreshments], came with His other devotees to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> hena-kāle prabhu 'upala-bhoga' dekhiyā
> haridāse milite āilā bhakta-gaṇa lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:upala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the //upala-bhoga// offering to Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after seeing; [[synonyms:h:haridāse]]---Haridāsa; [[synonyms:m:milite]]---to meet; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with other devotees.
translation: At that very moment, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, after visiting the temple of Jagannātha to see the offering of upala-bhoga [morning refreshments], came with His other devotees to see Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.160
description: "My dear Sanātana, you are on the level of My adviser, for you are an authorized person. But Jagā wants to advise you. This is but the impudence of a naughty boy."
text:
> āmāra upadeṣṭā tumi---prāmāṇika ārya
> tomāreha upadeśe---bālakā kare aiche kārya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:u:upadeṣṭā]]---adviser; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:p:prāmāṇika]] [[synonyms:ā:ārya]]---authorized person; [[synonyms:t:tomāreha]]---even you; [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---he advises; [[synonyms:b:bālakā]]---boy; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:k:kārya]]---business.
translation: "My dear Sanātana, you are on the level of My adviser, for you are an authorized person. But Jagā wants to advise you. This is but the impudence of a naughty boy."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.161
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thus chastising Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Sanātana Gosvāmī fell at the Lord's feet and said, "I can now understand the fortunate position of Jagadānanda.
text:
> śuni' sanātana pāye dhari' prabhure kahila
> 'jagadānandera saubhāgya āji se jānila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pāye]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---capturing the feet; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---began to say to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagadānandera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgya]]---fortune; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---now; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:j:jānila]]---I understand.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was thus chastising Jagadānanda Paṇḍita, Sanātana Gosvāmī fell at the Lord's feet and said, "I can now understand the fortunate position of Jagadānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.162
description: "I can also understand my misfortune. No one in this world is as fortunate as Jagadānanda.
text:
> āpanāra 'asaubhāgya' āji haila jñāna
> jagate nāhi jagadānanda-sama bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]]---my personal; [[synonyms:a:asaubhāgya]]---misfortune; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---I can understand; [[synonyms:j:jagate]]---within this world; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---fortunate person.
translation: "I can also understand my misfortune. No one in this world is as fortunate as Jagadānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.163
description: "Sir, You are making Jagadānanda drink the nectar of affectionate relationships, whereas by offering me honorable prayers, You are making me drink the bitter juice of nimba and niśindā.
text:
> jagadānande piyāo ātmīyatā-sudhā-rasa
> more piyāo gaurava-stuti-nimba-niśindā-rasa
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānande]]---unto Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:piyāo]]---You cause to drink; [[synonyms:ā:ātmīyatā]]-[[synonyms:s:sudhā]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the nectar of affectionate relations; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:p:piyāo]]---You cause to drink; [[synonyms:g:gaurava]]-[[synonyms:s:stuti]]---honorable prayers; [[synonyms:n:nimba]]-[[synonyms:n:niśindā]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the juice of //nimba// fruit and //niśindā.//
translation: "Sir, You are making Jagadānanda drink the nectar of affectionate relationships, whereas by offering me honorable prayers, You are making me drink the bitter juice of nimba and niśindā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.164
description: "It is my misfortune that You have not accepted me as one of Your intimate relations. But You are the completely independent Supreme Personality of Godhead."
text:
> ājiha nahila more ātmīyatā-jñāna!
> mora abhāgya, tumi---svatantra bhagavān!"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ājiha]]---even until now; [[synonyms:n:nahila]]---there has not been; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:ā:ātmīyatā]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---feeling as one of Your relations; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:a:abhāgya]]---my misfortune; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]] [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the independent Personality of Godhead.
translation: "It is my misfortune that You have not accepted me as one of Your intimate relations. But You are the completely independent Supreme Personality of Godhead."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.165
description: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Just to satisfy Sanātana Gosvāmī, He spoke the following words.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu kichu lajjita hailā mane
> tāṅre santoṣite kichu balena vacane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---somewhat; [[synonyms:l:lajjita]]---ashamed; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:santoṣite]]---to satisfy; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---said; [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---words.
translation: Hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was somewhat ashamed. Just to satisfy Sanātana Gosvāmī, He spoke the following words.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.166
description: "My dear Sanātana, please do not think that Jagadānanda is more dear to Me than you. However, I cannot tolerate transgressions of the standard etiquette.
text:
> 'jagadānanda priya āmāra nahe tomā haite
> maryādā-laṅghana āmi nā pāroṅ sahite
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---more dear; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---to Me; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than you; [[synonyms:m:maryādā]]-[[synonyms:l:laṅghana]]---transgressing the etiquette; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāroṅ]]---can; [[synonyms:s:sahite]]---tolerate.
translation: "My dear Sanātana, please do not think that Jagadānanda is more dear to Me than you. However, I cannot tolerate transgressions of the standard etiquette.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.167
description: "You are an experienced authority in the śāstras, whereas Jagā is just a young boy.
text:
> kāhāṅ tumi---prāmāṇika, śāstre pravīṇa!
> kāhāṅ jagā---kālikāra baṭuyā navīna!
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:p:prāmāṇika]]---authority; [[synonyms:ś:śāstre]] [[synonyms:p:pravīṇa]]---experienced in the learning of the //śāstras//; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:j:jagā]]---Jagā; [[synonyms:k:kālikāra]]---recent; [[synonyms:b:baṭuyā]]---youth; [[synonyms:n:navīna]]---new.
translation: "You are an experienced authority in the śāstras, whereas Jagā is just a young boy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.168
description: "You have the power to convince even Me. In many places you have already convinced Me about ordinary behavior and devotional service.
text:
> āmākeha bujhāite tumi dhara śakti
> kata ṭhāñi bujhāñācha vyavahāra-bhakti
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmākeha]]---even Me; [[synonyms:b:bujhāite]]---to convince; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:d:dhara]]---have; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---power; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in how many places; [[synonyms:b:bujhāñācha]]---you have convinced; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---ordinary behavior as well as devotional service.
translation: "You have the power to convince even Me. In many places you have already convinced Me about ordinary behavior and devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.169
description: "Jagā's advising you is intolerable for Me. Therefore I am chastising him.
text:
> tomāre upadeśa kare, nā yāya sahana
> ataeva tāre āmi kariye bhartsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---you; [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---advises; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:s:sahana]]---I cannot tolerate; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kariye]]---do; [[synonyms:b:bhartsana]]---chastisement.
translation: "Jagā's advising you is intolerable for Me. Therefore I am chastising him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.17
description: Seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they both immediately fell flat like rods to offer obeisances. The Lord then lifted Haridāsa and embraced him.
text:
> prabhu dekhi' duṅhe paḍe daṇḍavat hañā
> prabhu āliṅgilā haridāsere uṭhāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---fell down; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---flat like rods; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgilā]]---embraced; [[synonyms:h:haridāsere]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---after lifting.
translation: Seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, they both immediately fell flat like rods to offer obeisances. The Lord then lifted Haridāsa and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.170
description: "I offer you praise not because I think of you as being outside an intimate relationship with Me but because you are actually so qualified that one is forced to praise your qualities.
text:
> bahiraṅga-jñāne tomāre nā kari stavana
> tomāra guṇe stuti karāya yaiche tomāra guna
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahiraṅga]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---thinking outside My intimate relationship; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---unto you; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---I do not; [[synonyms:s:stavana]]---offer praise; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:g:guṇe]]---by qualifications; [[synonyms:s:stuti]] [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---one is induced to offer prayers; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:g:guna]]---attributes.
translation: "I offer you praise not because I think of you as being outside an intimate relationship with Me but because you are actually so qualified that one is forced to praise your qualities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.171
description: "Although one has affection for many persons, different types of ecstatic love awaken according to the nature of one's personal relationships.
text:
> yadyapi kāhāra 'mamatā' bahu-jane haya
> prīti-svabhāve kāhāte kona bhāvodaya

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.172
description: "You consider your body dangerous and awful, but I think that your body is like nectar.
text:
> tomāra deha tumi kara bībhatsa-jñāna
> tomāra deha āmāre lāge amṛta-samāna

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.173
description: "Actually your body is transcendental, never material. You are thinking of it, however, in terms of a material conception.
text:
> aprākṛta-deha tomāra 'prākṛta' kabhu naya
> tathāpi tomāra tāte prākṛta-buddhi haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aprākṛta]]---transcendental; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:p:prākṛta]]---material; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:n:naya]]---is never; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:p:prākṛta]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhi]]---conception as material; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is.
translation: "Actually your body is transcendental, never material. You are thinking of it, however, in terms of a material conception.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura gives his opinion about how a person completely engaged in the service of the Lord transforms his body from material to transcendental. He says: "A pure devotee engaged in the service of Lord Kṛṣṇa has no desire for his personal sense gratification, and thus he never accepts anything for that purpose. He desires only the happiness of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, and because of his ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, he acts in various ways. //Karmīs// think that the material body is an instrument for material enjoyment, and that is why they work extremely hard. A devotee, however, has no such desires. A devotee always engages wholeheartedly in the service of the Lord, forgetting about bodily conceptions and bodily activities. The body of a //karmī// is called material because the //karmī,// being too absorbed in material activities, is always eager to enjoy material facilities, but the body of a devotee who tries his best to work very hard for the satisfaction of Kṛṣṇa by fully engaging in the Lord's service must be accepted as transcendental. Whereas //karmīs// are interested only in the personal satisfaction of their senses, devotees work for the satisfaction of the Supreme Lord. Therefore one who cannot distinguish between devotion and ordinary //karma// may mistakenly consider the body of a pure devotee material. One who knows does not commit such a mistake. Nondevotees who consider devotional activities and ordinary material activities to be on the same level are offenders to the chanting of the transcendental holy name of the Lord. A pure devotee knows that a devotee's body, being always transcendental, is just suitable for rendering service to the Lord.

A devotee on the topmost platform of devotional service always humbly thinks that he is not rendering any devotional service. He thinks that he is poor in devotional service and that his body is material. On the other hand, those known as the //sahajiyās// foolishly think that their material bodies are transcendental. Because of this, they are always bereft of the association of pure devotees, and thus they cannot behave like Vaiṣṇavas. Observing the defects of the //sahajiyās,// Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura has sung as follows in his book //Kalyāṇa-kalpa-taru://

> āmi ta' vaiṣṇava, e-buddhi ha-ile,
> amānī nā haba āmi
> pratiṣṭhāśā āsi', hṛdaya dūṣibe,
> ha-iba niraya-gāmī
>
> nije śreṣṭha jāni', ucchiṣṭādi-dāne,
> habe abhimāna bhāra
> tāi śiṣya tava, thākiyā sarvadā,
> nā la-iba pūjā kāra

"If I think I am a Vaiṣṇava, I shall look forward to receiving respect from others. And if the desire for fame and reputation pollute my heart, certainly I shall go to hell. By giving others the remnants of my food, I shall consider myself superior and shall be burdened with the weight of false pride. Therefore, always remaining your surrendered disciple, I shall not accept worship from anyone else." Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī has written [[books:cc:antya:20:28|(Antya-līlā 20.28)]]:

> premera svabhāva---yāhāṅ premera sambandha
> sei māne,---'kṛṣṇe mora nāhi prema-gandha'

"Wherever there is a relationship of love of Godhead, the natural symptoms are that the devotee does not think himself a devotee, but always thinks that he has not even a drop of love for Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.174
description: "Even if your body were material, I still could not neglect it, for the material body should be considered neither good nor bad.
text:
> 'prākṛta' haile ha tomāra vapu nāri upekṣite
> bhadrābhadra-vastu-jñāna nāhika 'prākṛte'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prākṛta]]---material; [[synonyms:h:haile]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]---even if it were; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:v:vapu]]---body; [[synonyms:n:nāri]]---I cannot; [[synonyms:u:upekṣite]]---neglect; [[synonyms:b:bhadra]]-[[synonyms:a:abhadra]]---good and bad; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---appreciation of things; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]]---there is not; [[synonyms:p:prākṛte]]---in the material world.
translation: "Even if your body were material, I still could not neglect it, for the material body should be considered neither good nor bad.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Since you are a Vaiṣṇava, your body is spiritual, not material. Therefore you should not consider this body to be subjected to superior or inferior qualities. Moreover, I am a //sannyāsī.// Therefore even if your body were material, a //sannyāsī// should see no distinction between a good body and a bad body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.175
description: " 'Anything not conceived in relationship to Kṛṣṇa should be understood to be illusion [māyā]. None of the illusions uttered by words or conceived in the mind are factual. Because illusion is not factual, there is no distinction between what we think is good and what we think is bad. When we speak of the Absolute Truth, such speculations do not apply.'
text:
> kiṁ bhadraṁ kim abhadraṁ vā
> dvaitasyāvastunaḥ kiyat
> vācoditaṁ tad anṛtaṁ
> manasā dhyātam eva ca

translation: “ 'Anything not conceived in relationship to Kṛṣṇa should be understood to be illusion [māyā]. None of the illusions uttered by words or conceived in the mind are factual. Because illusion is not factual, there is no distinction between what we think is good and what we think is bad. When we speak of the Absolute Truth, such speculations do not apply.'
purport: This is a quotation from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (11.28.4).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.176
description: "In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad,' is all a mistake.
text:
> 'dvaite' bhadrābhadra-jñāna, saba---'manodharma'
> 'ei bhāla, ei manda',---ei saba 'bhrama'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dvaite]]---in the material world; [[synonyms:b:bhadra]]-[[synonyms:a:abhadra]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---understanding of good and bad; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---speculative mental creations; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---this is good; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:manda]]---this is bad; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhrama]]---mistake.
translation: "In the material world, conceptions of good and bad are all mental speculations. Therefore, saying, 'This is good, and this is bad,' is all a mistake.
purport: Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is the Absolute Truth, ever existing with different varieties of energies. When one is absorbed in the illusory energy of Kṛṣṇa and cannot understand Kṛṣṇa, one cannot ascertain what is good and bad for him. Conceptions of good and bad are all imaginations or mental speculations. When one forgets that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he wants to enjoy the material world through different plans. At that time he distinguishes between material plans that are good and those that are bad. Actually, however, they are all false.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.177
description: " 'The humble sage, by virtue of true knowledge, sees with equal vision a learned and gentle brāhmaṇa, a cow, an elephant, a dog and a dog-eater.'

> vidyā-vinaya-sampanne
> brāhmaṇe gavi hastini
> śuni caiva śvapāke ca
> paṇḍitāḥ sama-darśinaḥ

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.178

> kūṭastho vijitendriyaḥ
> yukta ity ucyate yogī
> sama-loṣṭrāśma-kāñcanaḥ

purport: This is also a quotation from //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:6:8|(Bg. 6.8)]].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.179
description: "Since I am in the renounced order, My duty is to make no distinctions but instead be equipoised. My knowledge must be equally disposed toward sandalwood pulp and dirty mud.
text:
> āmi ta'---sannyāsī, āmāra 'sama-dṛṣṭi' dharma
> candana-paṅkete āmāra jñāna haya 'sama'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---in the renounced order of life; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:s:sama]]-[[synonyms:d:dṛṣṭi]]---seeing everything on the same platform; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---duty; [[synonyms:c:candana]]-[[synonyms:p:paṅkete]]---between sandalwood pulp and mud; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---knowledge; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---same.
translation: "Since I am in the renounced order, My duty is to make no distinctions but instead be equipoised. My knowledge must be equally disposed toward sandalwood pulp and dirty mud.
purport: It is the duty of a //sannyāsī,// a person in the renounced order, to be always equipoised, and that is also the duty of a learned man and a Vaiṣṇava. A Vaiṣṇava, a //sannyāsī// or a learned person has no conception of the material world; in other words, he has no conception of anything materially important. He has no desire to use sandalwood pulp for sense gratification, nor does sense gratification make him hate mud. Acceptance or rejection of material things is not the concern of a //sannyāsī,// a Vaiṣṇava or a learned person. An advanced devotee has no desire to enjoy or reject anything. His only duty is to accept whatever is favorable for the advancement of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. A Vaiṣṇava should be indifferent to material enjoyment and renunciation and should always hanker for the spiritual life of rendering service to the Lord.

synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lālya]]---of the maintained child; [[synonyms:a:amedhya]]---stool and urine; [[synonyms:l:lālakera]]---of the maintainer; [[synonyms:c:candana]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like sandalwood pulp; [[synonyms:b:bhāya]]---appears; [[synonyms:s:sanātanera]]---of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:klede]]---unto the moisture of the sores; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:g:ghṛṇā]]---hatred; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:u:upajāya]]---arises.
translation: "The stool and urine of the maintained child appear like sandalwood pulp to the mother. Similarly, when the foul moisture oozing from the itches of Sanātana touches My body, I have no hatred for him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.191
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The body of a devotee is never material. It is considered to be transcendental, full of spiritual bliss.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"vaiṣṇava-deha 'prākṛta' kabhu naya
> 'aprākṛta' deha bhaktera 'cid-ānanda-maya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]] [[synonyms:d:deha]]---the body of a Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:p:prākṛta]]---material; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:n:naya]]---is never; [[synonyms:a:aprākṛta]]---transcendental; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of a devotee; [[synonyms:c:cit]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---full of transcendental bliss.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The body of a devotee is never material. It is considered to be transcendental, full of spiritual bliss.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is trying to convince Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī that a devotee whose life is dedicated to the service of the Lord is never in the material conception. Because he always engages in the service of the Lord, his body is transcendental and full of spiritual bliss. His body should never be considered material, just as the body of the Deity worshiped in the temple is never considered to be made of stone or wood. Factually, the Deity is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead, without a doubt. The injunctions of the //Padma Purāṇa// therefore state: //arcye viṣṇau śilādhīr guruṣu nara-matir vaiṣṇave jāti-buddhiḥ. ..yasya vā nārakī saḥ.// The Deity worshiped in the temple is never stone or wood. Similarly, the body of a Vaiṣṇava fully dedicated to the service of the Lord is never considered to belong to the material modes of nature.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.192

translation: "At the time of initiation, when a devotee fully surrenders unto the service of the Lord, Kṛṣṇa accepts him to be as good as Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.193

text:
> sei deha kare tāra cid-ānanda-maya

translation: "When the devotee's body is thus transformed into spiritual existence, the devotee, in that transcendental body, renders service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.194
description: " 'The living entity who is subjected to birth and death, when he gives up all material activities dedicating his life to Me for executing My order, and thus acts according to My direction, at that time he reaches the platform of immortality, and becomes fit to enjoy the spiritual bliss of exchange of loving mellows with Me.'
text:
> martyo yadā tyakta-samasta-karmā
> niveditātmā vicikīrṣito me
> tadāmṛtatvaṁ pratipadyamāno
> mayātma-bhūyāya ca kalpate vai
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:martyaḥ]]---the living entity subjected to birth and death; [[synonyms:y:yadā]]---as soon as; [[synonyms:t:tyakta]]---giving up; [[synonyms:s:samasta]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karmāḥ]]---fruitive activities; [[synonyms:n:nivedita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ātmā]]---a fully surrendered soul; [[synonyms:v:vicikīrṣitaḥ]]---desired to act; [[synonyms:m:me]]---by Me; [[synonyms:t:tadā]]---at that time; [[synonyms:a:amṛtatvam]]---immortality; [[synonyms:p:pratipadyamānaḥ]]---attaining; [[synonyms:m:mayā]]---with Me; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūyāya]]---for becoming of a similar nature; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:k:kalpate]]---is eligible; [[synonyms:v:vai]]---certainly.
translation: “ 'The living entity who is subjected to birth and death, when he gives up all material activities dedicating his life to Me for executing My order, and thus acts according to My direction, at that time he reaches the platform of immortality, and becomes fit to enjoy the spiritual bliss of exchange of loving mellows with Me.'
purport: This is a quotation from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (11.29.34). At the time of initiation, a devotee gives up all his material conceptions. Therefore, being in touch with the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he is situated on the transcendental platform. Thus having attained knowledge and the spiritual platform, he always engages in the service of the spiritual body of Kṛṣṇa. When one is freed from material connections in this way, his body immediately becomes spiritual, and Kṛṣṇa accepts His service. However, Kṛṣṇa does not accept anything from a person with a material conception of life. When a devotee no longer has any desire for material sense gratification, in his spiritual identity he engages in the service of the Lord, for his dormant spiritual consciousness awakens. This awakening of spiritual consciousness makes his body spiritual, and thus he becomes fit to render service to the Lord. //Karmīs// may consider the body of a devotee material, but factually it is not, for a devotee has no conception of material enjoyment. If one thinks that the body of a pure devotee is material, he is an offender, for that is a //vaiṣṇava-aparādha.// In this connection one should consult Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī's //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta// (1.3.45 and 2.3.139).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.195

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.196

text:

> kṛṣṇa-ṭhāñi aparādha-daṇḍa pāitāma tabe
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:ghṛṇā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---hating; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karitāma]]---I would not do; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---unto Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:aparādha]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---punishment for offenses; [[synonyms:p:pāitāma]]---I would have gotten; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then.
translation: "If I had hated Sanātana Gosvāmī and had not embraced him, I would certainly have been chastised for offenses to Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.197
description: "Sanātana Gosvāmī is one of the associates of Kṛṣṇa. There could not be any bad odor from his body. On the first day I embraced him, I smelled the aroma of catuḥsama [a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, aguru and musk]."
text:
> pāriṣada-deha ei, nā haya durgandha
> prathama divase pāiluṅ catuḥsama-gandha"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāriṣada]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]]---the body of Kṛṣṇa's associate; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is not; [[synonyms:d:durgandha]]---having a bad smell; [[synonyms:p:prathama]] [[synonyms:d:divase]]---on the first day; [[synonyms:p:pāiluṅ]]---I got; [[synonyms:c:catuḥsama]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]---the smell of //catuḥsama,// a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, aguru and musk.
translation: "Sanātana Gosvāmī is one of the associates of Kṛṣṇa. There could not be any bad odor from his body. On the first day I embraced him, I smelled the aroma of catuḥsama [a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, aguru and musk]."
purport:
An associate of the Lord is one whose body is fully engaged in the service of the Lord. A materialist might see Sanātana Gosvāmī's body as being full of itching sores that exuded foul moisture and a bad smell. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, said that actually the aroma of his body was the excellent scent of a mixture of sandalwood pulp, camphor, musk and aguru. In the //Garuḍa Purāṇa// this mixture, which is called //catuḥsama,// is described as follows:

> kastūrikāyā dvau bhāgau
> catvāraś candanasya tu
> kuṅkumasya trayaś caikaḥ
> śaśinaḥ syāt catuḥsamam

"Two parts of musk, four parts of sandalwood, three parts of //aguru// or saffron and one part of camphor, when mixed together, form //catuḥsama.//" he aroma of //catuḥsama// is very pleasing. It is also mentioned in the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// (6.115).

translation: In fact, however, when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced the body of Sanātana Gosvāmī, by the Lord's touch alone there was manifest a fragrance exactly like that of sandalwood pulp.
