> dekhi' haridāsa mane hailā camatkāra
> prabhure kahena,---"ei bhaṅgī ye tomāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:h:hailā]] [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---became astonished; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---spoke to the Lord; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]---transcendental activity; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your.
translation: Seeing the change, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, greatly astonished, told the Lord, "This is Your pastime.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.203
description: "My dear Lord, You made Sanātana Gosvāmī drink the water of Jhārikhaṇḍa, and You actually generated the consequent itching sores on his body.
text:
> sei jhārikhaṇḍera pānī tumi khāoyāilā
> sei pānī-lakṣye iṅhāra kaṇḍu upajāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:j:jhārikhaṇḍera]]---of Jhārikhaṇḍa; [[synonyms:p:pānī]]---water; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāilā]]---made to drink; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pānī]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣye]]---on account of this water; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]] [[synonyms:u:upajāilā]]---You generated the itching.
translation: "My dear Lord, You made Sanātana Gosvāmī drink the water of Jhārikhaṇḍa, and You actually generated the consequent itching sores on his body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.204
description: "After thus causing these itching sores, You examined Sanātana Gosvāmī. No one can understand Your transcendental pastimes."
text:
> kaṇḍu kari' parīkṣā karile sanātane
> ei līlā-bhaṅgī tomāra keha nāhi jāne"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---generating the itching sores; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣā]]---examination; [[synonyms:k:karile]]---You did; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---unto Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]]---trick; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---no one knows.
translation: "After thus causing these itching sores, You examined Sanātana Gosvāmī. No one can understand Your transcendental pastimes."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.205
description: After embracing both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. Then both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, in great ecstatic love, began to describe the Lord's transcendental attributes.
text:
> duṅhe āliṅgiyā prabhu gelā nijālaya
> prabhura guṇa kahe duṅhe hañā prema-maya
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgiyā]]---embracing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---departed; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:ā:ālaya]]---for His place; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---attributes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---discussed; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---overwhelmed by ecstasy.
translation: After embracing both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu returned to His residence. Then both Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī, in great ecstatic love, began to describe the Lord's transcendental attributes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.206
description: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and discussed the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> ei-mata sanātana rahe prabhu-sthāne
> kṛṣṇa-caitanya-guṇa-kathā haridāsa-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remained; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---at the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---of the attributes; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---discussion; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and discussed the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.207
description: After they saw the Dola-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī fully about what to do in Vṛndāvana and bade him farewell.
text:
> dola-yātrā dekhi' prabhu tāṅre vidāya dilā
> vṛndāvane ye karibena, saba śikhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dola]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the festival of Dola-yātrā; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bid farewell; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:y:yekaribena]]---whatever he would do; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---instructed.
translation: After they saw the Dola-yātrā festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Sanātana Gosvāmī fully about what to do in Vṛndāvana and bade him farewell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.208
description: The scene of separation that took place when Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took leave of one another is so piteous that it cannot be described herein.
text:
> ye-kāle vidāya hailā prabhura caraṇe
> dui-janāra viccheda-daśā nā yāya varṇane
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---when; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]]---farewell; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---there was; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:janāra]]---both of them; [[synonyms:v:viccheda]]-[[synonyms:d:daśā]]---condition of separation; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:v:varṇane]]---cannot be described.
translation: The scene of separation that took place when Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took leave of one another is so piteous that it cannot be described herein.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.209
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī decided to go to Vṛndāvana by the very forest path Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had traversed.
text:
> yei vana-pathe prabhu gelā vṛndāvana
> sei-pathe yāite mana kailā sanātana
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path in the forest; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gelā]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---went to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the very path; [[synonyms:y:yāite]]---to go; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī decided to go to Vṛndāvana by the very forest path Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had traversed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.21
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī by force. Thus the moisture oozing from the itching sores touched the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> balātkāre prabhu tāṅre āliṅgana kaila
> kaṇḍu-kleda mahāprabhura śrī-aṅge lāgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:balātkāre]]---by force; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---embraced; [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]]-[[synonyms:k:kleda]]---the moisture of weeping itches; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]---transcendental; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---body; [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---touched.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, however, embraced Sanātana Gosvāmī by force. Thus the moisture oozing from the itching sores touched the transcendental body of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.210
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī noted from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya all the villages, rivers and hills where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes.
text:
> ye-pathe, ye-grāma-nadī-śaila, yāhāṅ yei līlā
> balabhadra-bhaṭṭa-sthāne saba likhi' nilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on which path; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:g:grāma]]---villages; [[synonyms:n:nadī]]---rivers; [[synonyms:ś:śaila]]---hills; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:b:balabhadra]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:l:likhi']]---writing; [[synonyms:n:nilā]]---he took.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī noted from Balabhadra Bhaṭṭācārya all the villages, rivers and hills where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.211
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī met all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then, traveling by that same path, visited the places through which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had passed.
text:
> mahāprabhura bhakta-gaṇe sabāre miliyā
> sei-pathe cali' yāya se-sthāna dekhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all; [[synonyms:m:miliyā]]---meeting; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path; [[synonyms:c:cali']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---passed through; [[synonyms:s:se]]---those; [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---places; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---visiting.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī met all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and then, traveling by that same path, visited the places through which Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had passed.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura writes in a song (//Śaraṇāgati// 31.3):

> gaura āmāra, ye saba sthāne,
> karala bhramaṇa raṅge
> se-saba sthāna, heriba āmi,
> praṇayi-bhakata-saṅge.

"May I visit all the holy places associated with the //līlās// of Lord Caitanya and His devotees." A devotee should make a point of visiting all the places where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes. Indeed, pure devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu even want to see the places He simply visited for only hours or minutes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.212
description: As soon as Sanātana Gosvāmī visited a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes on the way, he was immediately filled with ecstatic love.
text:
> ye-ye-līlā prabhu pathe kailā ye-ye-sthāne
> tāhā dekhi' premāveśa haya sanātane
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the way; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in whatever places; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---those places; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---in Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: As soon as Sanātana Gosvāmī visited a place where Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had performed His pastimes on the way, he was immediately filled with ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.213
description: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī reached Vṛndāvana. Later Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met him.
text:
> ei-mate sanātana vṛndāvane āilā
> pāche āsi' rūpa-gosāñi tāṅhāre mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:pāche]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming after; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāre]]---him; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: In this way Sanātana Gosvāmī reached Vṛndāvana. Later Rūpa Gosvāmī came and met him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.214
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was delayed in Bengal for a year because he was dividing his money among his relatives to situate them in their proper positions.
text:
> eka-vatsara rūpa-gosāñira gauḍe vilamba haila
> kuṭumbera 'sthiti'-artha vibhāga kari' dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---for one year; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:v:vilamba]]---delay; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:k:kuṭumbera]]---of the relatives; [[synonyms:s:sthiti]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---wealth for maintenance; [[synonyms:v:vibhāga]]---shares; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was delayed in Bengal for a year because he was dividing his money among his relatives to situate them in their proper positions.
purport: Although Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī renounced his family life, he nevertheless was not unjust to his family members. Even after renunciation, he returned to Bengal, where he properly divided whatever money he had and gave it to his relatives so that they would not be inconvenienced.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.215
description: He collected whatever money he had accumulated in Bengal and divided it among his relatives, the brāhmaṇas and the temples.
text:
> gauḍe ye artha chila, tāhā ānāilā
> kuṭumba-brāhmaṇa-devālaye bāṅṭi' dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---money; [[synonyms:c:chila]]---there was; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:ānāilā]]---collected; [[synonyms:k:kuṭumba]]---to relatives; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---//brāhmaṇas//; [[synonyms:d:devālaye]]---temples; [[synonyms:b:bāṅṭi']] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---divided and distributed.
translation: He collected whatever money he had accumulated in Bengal and divided it among his relatives, the brāhmaṇas and the temples.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.216
description: Thus after finishing all the tasks he had on his mind, he returned to Vṛndāvana fully satisfied.
text:
> saba manaḥ-kathā gosāñi kari' nirvāhaṇa
> niścinta hañā śīghra āilā vṛndāvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---decisions; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:n:nirvāhaṇa]]---executing properly; [[synonyms:n:niścinta]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being freed from all anxiety; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---very soon returned; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---to Vṛndāvana.
translation: Thus after finishing all the tasks he had on his mind, he returned to Vṛndāvana fully satisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.217
description: The brothers met at Vṛndāvana, where they stayed to execute the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> dui bhāi mili' vṛndāvane vāsa kailā
> prabhura ye ājñā, duṅhe saba nirvāhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---both brothers; [[synonyms:m:mili']]---meeting; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---resided; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---whatever was ordered by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nirvāhilā]]---executed.
translation: The brothers met at Vṛndāvana, where they stayed to execute the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport:
//śrī-caitanya-mano-'bhīṣṭaṁ \\
sthāpitaṁ yena bhū-tale \\
svayaṁ rūpaḥ kadā mahyaṁ \\
dadāti sva-padāntikam//

"When will Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī Prabhupāda, who has established within the material world the mission to fulfill the desire of Lord Caitanya, give me shelter under his lotus feet?" Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī were previously ministers directly in charge of the government of Nawab Hussain Shah, and they were also householders, but later they became //gosvāmīs.// A //gosvāmī,// therefore, is one who executes the will of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The title "//gosvāmī//" is not an inherited designation; it is meant for a person who has controlled his sense gratification and dedicated his life to executing the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī and Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī became genuine //gosvāmīs// after dedicating their lives to the service of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.218
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī collected many revealed scriptures, and from the evidence in those scriptures they excavated all the lost sites of pilgrimage. Thus they established temples for the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> nānā-śāstra āni' lupta-tīrtha uddhārilā
> vṛndāvane kṛṣṇa-sevā prakāśa karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---different types of revealed scripture; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing together; [[synonyms:l:lupta]]-[[synonyms:t:tīrtha]]---the lost sites of the holy places; [[synonyms:u:uddhārilā]]---excavated; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---at Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa's direct service; [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---manifested.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī collected many revealed scriptures, and from the evidence in those scriptures they excavated all the lost sites of pilgrimage. Thus they established temples for the worship of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.219
description: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the Bhāgavatāmṛta. From this book one can understand who is a devotee, what is the process of devotional service, and who is Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth.
text:
> sanātana grantha kailā 'bhāgavatāmṛte'
> bhakta-bhakti-kṛṣṇa-tattva jāni yāhā haite
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---books; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:a:amṛte]]---in the //Bhāgavatāmṛta//; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---devotee; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:tattva]]---Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---we know; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from which.
translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the Bhāgavatāmṛta. From this book one can understand who is a devotee, what is the process of devotional service, and who is Kṛṣṇa, the Absolute Truth.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.22
description: The Lord introduced all the devotees to Sanātana Gosvāmī, who offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all.
text:
> saba bhakta-gaṇe prabhu milāilā sanātane
> sanātana kailā sabāra caraṇa vandane
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:milāilā]]---introduced; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---to Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandane]]---worshiping the lotus feet.
translation: The Lord introduced all the devotees to Sanātana Gosvāmī, who offered his respectful obeisances unto the lotus feet of them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.220
description: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī wrote a commentary on the Tenth Canto known as Daśama-ṭippanī, from which we can understand the transcendental pastimes and ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> siddhānta-sāra grantha kailā 'daśama-ṭippanī'
> kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa-prema yāhā haite jāni
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]---mature understanding; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---book; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:d:daśama]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭippanī]]---commentary on the Tenth Canto; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---of pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the transcendental mellow; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from which; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---we can understand.
translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī wrote a commentary on the Tenth Canto known as Daśama-ṭippanī, from which we can understand the transcendental pastimes and ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.221
description: He also compiled the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, from which we can understand the standard behavior of a devotee and the full extent of a Vaiṣṇava's duty.
text:
> 'hari-bhakti-vilāsa'-grantha kailā vaiṣṇava-ācāra
> vaiṣṇavera kartavya yāhāṅ pāiye pāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---of the name //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa//; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---book; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācāra]]---the standard behavior of a Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of a devotee; [[synonyms:k:kartavya]]---duty; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---in which; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]] [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---one can understand up to the extreme limit.
translation: He also compiled the Hari-bhakti-vilāsa, from which we can understand the standard behavior of a devotee and the full extent of a Vaiṣṇava's duty.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes: "The //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// was originally compiled by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī. Later, Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī produced a shortened version of it and added the //Dig-darśinī-ṭīkā.// In the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// there are so many quotations from the //sātvata// scriptures that sometimes it is inquired how the atheistic //smārtas// can refuse to accept them and instead imagine some other opinions. What is recorded in the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// strictly follows the Vedic scriptures and is certainly pure, but the attitude of the //karmīs// is always one of giving up the conclusion of pure Vaiṣṇava understanding. Because the //karmīs// are very much attached to the world and material activities, they always try to establish atheistic principles that oppose the understanding of the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.222
description: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī also compiled many other books. Who can enumerate them? The basic principle of all these books is to show us how to love Madana-mohana and Govindajī.
text:
> āra yata grantha kailā, tāhā ke kare gaṇana
> 'madana-gopāla-govindera sevā'-prakāśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all other; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---books; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇana]]---who can enumerate; [[synonyms:m:madana]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---the Deity named Madana-mohana; [[synonyms:g:govindera]]---of the Deity named Śrī Govinda; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:p:prakāśana]]---exhibition.
translation: Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī also compiled many other books. Who can enumerate them? The basic principle of all these books is to show us how to love Madana-mohana and Govindajī.
purport: The //Bhakti-ratnākara// refers to the following books by Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī: (1) //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta,// (2) //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// and his commentary known as //Dig-darśinī,// (3) //Līlā-stava// and (4) the commentary on the Tenth Canto of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// known as //Vaiṣṇava-toṣaṇī.// Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled many, many books, all with the aim of describing how to serve the principal Deities of Vṛndāvana-Govinda and Madana-gopāla. Later, other Deities were gradually established, and the importance of Vṛndāvana increased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.223
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also wrote many books, the most famous of which is Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu. From that book one can understand the essence of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa and the transcendental mellow one can derive from such service.
text:
> rūpa-gosāñi kailā 'rasāmṛta-sindhu' sāra
> kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rasera yāhāṅ pāiye vistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---compiled; [[synonyms:r:rasāmṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the book known as //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu//; [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence of knowledge in devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of the transcendental mellow in devotional service; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---wherein; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---we can get; [[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---elaboration.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also wrote many books, the most famous of which is Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu. From that book one can understand the essence of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa and the transcendental mellow one can derive from such service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.224
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the book named Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi, from which one can understand, to the fullest limits, the loving affairs of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> 'ujjvala-nīlamaṇi'-nāma grantha kaila āra
> rādhā-kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tāhāṅ pāiye pāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ujjvala]]-[[synonyms:n:nīla]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇi]]---//Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi//; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---scripture; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---compiled; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the transcendental mellow of the pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---we get; [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---the extreme limit.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled the book named Ujjvala-nīlamaṇi, from which one can understand, to the fullest limits, the loving affairs of Śrī Śrī Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.225
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled two important dramas named Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava, from which one can understand all the mellows derived from the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> 'vidagdha-mādhava', 'lalita-mādhava,---nāṭaka-yuga la
> kṛṣṇa-līlā-rasa tāhāṅ pāiye sakala
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vidagdha]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhava]]---//Vidagdha-mādhava//; [[synonyms:l:lalita]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhava]]---//Lalita-mādhava//; [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]-[[synonyms:y:yugala]]---two dramas; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the mellow derived from the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]] [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---we can understand all.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī also compiled two important dramas named Vidagdha-mādhava and Lalita-mādhava, from which one can understand all the mellows derived from the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.226
description: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 verses, beginning with the book Dāna-keli-kaumudī. In all these scriptures he elaborately explained the transcendental mellows of the activities of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> 'dāna-keli-kaumudī' ādi lakṣa-grantha kaila
> sei saba granthe vrajera rasa vicārila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dāna]]-[[synonyms:k:keli]]-[[synonyms:k:kaumudī]]---the book named //Dāna-keli-kaumudī//; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:l:lakṣa]]---100,000; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---verses; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---compiled; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:granthe]]---in scriptures; [[synonyms:v:vrajera]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:r:rasa]] [[synonyms:v:vicārila]]---elaborately explained the transcendental mellows.
translation: Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 verses, beginning with the book Dāna-keli-kaumudī. In all these scriptures he elaborately explained the transcendental mellows of the activities of Vṛndāvana.
purport: Referring to the words //lakṣa-grantha// ("100,000 verses"), Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that the total number of verses written by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī is 100,000 (//eka-lakṣa// or //lakṣa-grantha//). The copyists count both the verses and the prose sections of the Sanskrit works. One should not mistakenly think that Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī compiled 100,000 books. He actually wrote sixteen books, as mentioned in the First Wave of the //Bhakti-ratnākara// (//śrī-rūpa-gosvāmī grantha ṣoḍaśa karila//).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.227
description: The son of Śrī Vallabha, or Anupama, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's younger brother, was the great learned scholar named Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī.
text:
> tāṅra laghu-bhrātā---śrī-vallabha-anupama
> tāṅra putra mahā-paṇḍita---jīva-gosāñi nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:l:laghu]]-[[synonyms:b:bhrātā]]---younger brother; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:a:anupama]]---named Śrī Vallabha or Anupama; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:putra]]---his son; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---very learned scholar; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named.
translation: The son of Śrī Vallabha, or Anupama, Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī's younger brother, was the great learned scholar named Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.228
description: After renouncing everything, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī went to Vṛndāvana. Later he also wrote many books on devotional service and expanded the work of preaching.
text:
> sarva tyāji' teṅho pāche āilā vṛndāvana
> teṅha bhakti-śāstra bahu kailā pracāraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]] [[synonyms:t:tyāji']]---renouncing everything; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he (Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī); [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvana]]---came to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---books on devotional service; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---many; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:p:pracāraṇa]]---spreading.
translation: After renouncing everything, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī went to Vṛndāvana. Later he also wrote many books on devotional service and expanded the work of preaching.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.229
description: In particular, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī compiled the book named Bhāgavata-sandarbha, or Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, which is the essence of all scriptures. From this book one can obtain a conclusive understanding of devotional service and the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
text:
> 'bhāgavata-sandarbha'-nāma kaila grantha-sāra
> bhāgavata-siddhāntera tāhāṅ pāiye pāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:s:sandarbha]]---the //Bhāgavata-sandarbha,// which is also known as //Ṣaṭ-sandarbha//; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:g:grantha]]-[[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence of all scriptures; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:s:siddhāntera]]---of conclusive information about the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His service; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---we get; [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---the limit.
translation: In particular, Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī compiled the book named Bhāgavata-sandarbha, or Ṣaṭ-sandarbha, which is the essence of all scriptures. From this book one can obtain a conclusive understanding of devotional service and the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.23
description: The Lord and His devotees sat on a raised platform, and below that sat Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
text:
> prabhu lañā vasilā piṇḍāra upare bhakta-gaṇa
> piṇḍāra tale vasilā haridāsa sanātana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon the raised platform; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:t:tale]]---below the platform; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]] [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī.
translation: The Lord and His devotees sat on a raised platform, and below that sat Haridāsa Ṭhākura and Sanātana Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.230
description: He also compiled the book named Gopāla-campū, which is the essence of all Vedic literature. In this book he has exhibited the ecstatic loving transactions and pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.
text:
> 'gopāla-campū' nāma grantha sāra kaila
> vraja-prema-līlā-rasa-sāra dekhāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:c:campū]]---//Gopāla-campū//; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:g:grantha]] [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence of all Vedic literature; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]---of Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---of love; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---of pastimes; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of mellows; [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---essence; [[synonyms:d:dekhāila]]---exhibited.
translation: He also compiled the book named Gopāla-campū, which is the essence of all Vedic literature. In this book he has exhibited the ecstatic loving transactions and pastimes of Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.231
description: In the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī set forth the truths about the transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa. In this way he expanded 400,000 verses in all his books.
text:
> 'ṣaṭ sandarbhe' kṛṣṇa-prema-tattva prakāśila
> cāri-lakṣa grantha teṅho vistāra karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṭ]] [[synonyms:s:sandarbhe]]---in the //Ṣaṭ-sandarbha//; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:t:tattva]]---the truth about transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prakāśila]]---he exhibited; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:g:grantha]]---400,000 verses; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:v:vistāra]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---expanded.
translation: In the Ṣaṭ-sandarbha Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī set forth the truths about the transcendental love of Kṛṣṇa. In this way he expanded 400,000 verses in all his books.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.232
description: When Jīva Gosvāmī wanted to go to Mathurā from Bengal, he requested permission from Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu.
text:
> jīva-gosāñi gauḍa haite mathurā calilā
> nityānanda-prabhu-ṭhāñi ājñā māgilā
