translation: When Jīva Gosvāmī wanted to go to Mathurā from Bengal, he requested permission from Śrīla Nityānanda Prabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.233
description: Because of Jīva Gosvāmī's relationship with Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī, who were greatly favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu placed His feet on the head of Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī and embraced him.
text:
> prabhu prītye tāṅra māthe dharilā caraṇa
> rūpa-sanātana-sambandhe kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:p:prītye]]---because of the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:māthe]]---on the head; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---rested His lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]-[[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:s:sam]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhe]]---because of his relationship with Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced.
translation: Because of Jīva Gosvāmī's relationship with Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī, who were greatly favored by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu placed His feet on the head of Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.234
description: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "Yes, go soon to Vṛndāvana. That place has been awarded to your family, to your father and uncles, by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and therefore you must go there immediately."
text:
> ājñā dilā,---"śīghra tumi yāha vṛndāvane
> tomāra vaṁśe prabhu diyāchena sei-sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---He gave orders; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---to Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśe]]---to the family; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:diyāchena]]---has given; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---that place.
translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "Yes, go soon to Vṛndāvana. That place has been awarded to your family, to your father and uncles, by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and therefore you must go there immediately."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.235
description: By the order of Nityānanda Prabhu, he went and actually achieved the result of His order, for he compiled many books for a long time and preached the cult of bhakti from Vṛndāvana.
text:
> tāṅra ājñāya āilā, ājñā-phala pāilā
> śāstra kari' kata-kāla 'bhakti' pracārilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---by His order; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---the result of His order; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---got; [[synonyms:ś:śāstra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---compiling various scriptures; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:p:pracārilā]]---preached devotional service.
translation: By the order of Nityānanda Prabhu, he went and actually achieved the result of His order, for he compiled many books for a long time and preached the cult of bhakti from Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.236
description: These three-Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jīva Gosvāmī-are my spiritual masters, and so also is Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. I therefore offer prayers at their lotus feet, for I am their servant.
text:
> ei tina-guru, āra raghunātha-dāsa
> iṅhā-sabāra caraṇa vandoṅ, yāṅra muñi 'dāsa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:g:guru]]---three spiritual masters; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:v:vandoṅ]]---I worship; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---the servant.
translation: These three-Rūpa Gosvāmī, Sanātana Gosvāmī and Jīva Gosvāmī-are my spiritual masters, and so also is Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī. I therefore offer prayers at their lotus feet, for I am their servant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.237
description: Thus I have described the Lord's meeting again with Sanātana Gosvāmī. By hearing this I can understand the Lord's desire.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ punaḥ sanātana-saṅgame
> prabhura āśaya jāni yāhāra śravaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---thus I have described; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅgame]]---the meeting with Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āśaya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's desire; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I can understand; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---by hearing of which.
translation: Thus I have described the Lord's meeting again with Sanātana Gosvāmī. By hearing this I can understand the Lord's desire.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.238
description: These characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like sugar cane that one can chew to relish transcendental juice.
text:
> caitanya-caritra ei---ikṣu-daṇḍa-sama
> carvaṇa karite haya rasa-āsvādana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---the characteristics of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:i:ikṣu]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---exactly like sugar cane; [[synonyms:c:carvaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---chewing; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---a taste of juice.
translation: These characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are like sugar cane that one can chew to relish transcendental juice.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.239
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet of; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Fourth Chapter, describing Sanātana Gosvāmī's stay with the Lord at Jagannātha Purī.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.24
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Sanātana about news of his well-being. Sanātana replied, "Everything is auspicious because I have seen Your lotus feet."
text:
> kuśala-vārtā mahāprabhu puchena sanātane
> teṅha kahena,---'parama maṅgala dekhinu caraṇe'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kuśala]]---of well-being; [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:puchena]]---inquires; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---from Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---he said; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:m:maṅgala]]---everything is auspicious; [[synonyms:d:dekhinu]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---I have seen Your lotus feet.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from Sanātana about news of his well-being. Sanātana replied, "Everything is auspicious because I have seen Your lotus feet."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.25
description: When the Lord asked about all the Vaiṣṇavas at Mathurā, Sanātana Gosvāmī informed Him of their good health and fortune.
text:
> mathurāra vaiṣṇava-sabera kuśala puchilā
> sabāra kuśala sanātana jānāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurāra]]---of Mathurā; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:s:sabera]]---of all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:k:kuśala]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---inquired about the auspiciousness; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:k:kuśala]]---the well-being of all of them; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:j:jānāilā]]---informed.
translation: When the Lord asked about all the Vaiṣṇavas at Mathurā, Sanātana Gosvāmī informed Him of their good health and fortune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.26
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was here for ten months. He left for Bengal just ten days ago.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"ihāṅ rūpa chila daśa-māsa
> ihāṅ haite gauḍe gelā, haila dina daśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:c:chila]]---was; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:m:māsa]]---ten months; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from here; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---has gone to Bengal; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---it was; [[synonyms:d:dina]]---days; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]---ten.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu informed Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī was here for ten months. He left for Bengal just ten days ago.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.27
description: "Your brother Anupama is now dead. He was a very good devotee who had firm conviction in Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra]."
text:
> tomāra bhāi anupamera haila gaṅgā-prāpti
> bhāla chila, raghunāthe dṛḍha tāra bhakti"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---your brother; [[synonyms:a:anupamera]]---of Anupama; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---death; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:c:chila]]---he was a very good man; [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthe]]---unto Lord Raghunātha (Lord Rāmacandra); [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---firm; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---his devotion.
translation: "Your brother Anupama is now dead. He was a very good devotee who had firm conviction in Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra]."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.28
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "I was born in a low family, for my family commits all kinds of irreligious acts that violate the scriptural injunctions.
text:
> sanātana kahe,---"nīca-vaṁśe mora janma
> adharma anyāya yata,---āmāra kula-dharma
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī said; [[synonyms:n:nīca]]-[[synonyms:v:vaṁśe]]---in a low family; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:j:janma]]---my birth; [[synonyms:a:adharma]]---irreligion; [[synonyms:a:anyāya]]---sinful activities; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:k:kula]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---family business.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī said, "I was born in a low family, for my family commits all kinds of irreligious acts that violate the scriptural injunctions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.29
description: "My Lord, without hatred for my family You have accepted me as Your servant. Only by Your mercy is there good fortune in my family.
text:
> hena vaṁśa ghṛṇā chāḍi' kailā aṅgīkāra
> tomāra kṛpāya vaṁśe maṅgala āmāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]---such; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśa]]---family; [[synonyms:g:ghṛṇā]]---hatred; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---You have done; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---acceptance; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāya]]---by mercy; [[synonyms:v:vaṁśe]]---in the family; [[synonyms:m:maṅgala]]---auspiciousness; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my.
translation: "My Lord, without hatred for my family You have accepted me as Your servant. Only by Your mercy is there good fortune in my family.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.3
description: When Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, Sanātana Gosvāmī went from Mathurā to Jagannātha Purī to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> nīlācala haite rūpa gauḍe yabe gelā
> mathurā haite sanātana nīlācala āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Nīlācala (Jagannātha Purī); [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---to Bengal; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Mathurā; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nīlācala]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Jagannātha Purī.
translation: When Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī returned from Jagannātha Purī to Bengal, Sanātana Gosvāmī went from Mathurā to Jagannātha Purī to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.30
description: "From the very beginning of his childhood, my younger brother Anupama was a great devotee of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra], and he worshiped Him with great determination.
text:
> sei anupama-bhāi śiśu-kāla haite
> raghunātha-upāsanā kare dṛḍha-citte
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:a:anupama]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---brother named Anupama; [[synonyms:ś:śiśu]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the beginning of childhood; [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---of Lord Rāmacandra; [[synonyms:u:upāsanā]]---worship; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]-[[synonyms:c:citte]]---with great determination.
translation: "From the very beginning of his childhood, my younger brother Anupama was a great devotee of Raghunātha [Lord Rāmacandra], and he worshiped Him with great determination.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.31
description: "He always chanted the holy name of Raghunātha and meditated upon Him. He continuously heard about the activities of the Lord from the Rāmāyaṇa and chanted about them.
text:
> rātri-dine raghunāthera 'nāma' āra 'dhyāna'
> rāmāyaṇa niravadhi śune, kare gāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---day and night; [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthera]]---of Lord Rāmacandra; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---holy name; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:dhyāna]]---meditation; [[synonyms:r:rāmāyaṇa]]---the epic about the activities of Lord Rāmacandra known as the //Rāmāyaṇa//; [[synonyms:n:niravadhi]]---continuously; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---chants.
translation: "He always chanted the holy name of Raghunātha and meditated upon Him. He continuously heard about the activities of the Lord from the Rāmāyaṇa and chanted about them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.32
description: "Rūpa and I are his elder brothers. He stayed with us continuously.
text:
> āmi āra rūpa---tāra jyeṣṭha-sahodara
> āmā-doṅhā-saṅge teṅha rahe nirantara
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:j:jyeṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:s:sahodara]]---elder brothers; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:d:doṅhā]]---the two of us; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---continuously.
translation: "Rūpa and I are his elder brothers. He stayed with us continuously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.33
description: "He heard Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa with us, and both of us examined him.
text:
> āmā-sabā-saṅge kṛṣṇa-kathā, bhāgavata śune
> tāhāra parīkṣā kailuṅ āmi-dui-jane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabā]]---all of us; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]] [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣā]]---examination; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---did; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]-[[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of us.
translation: "He heard Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa with us, and both of us examined him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.34
description: " 'Dear Vallabha,' we said, 'please hear from us. Lord Kṛṣṇa is supremely attractive. His beauty, sweetness and pastimes of love are without limit.
text:
> śunaha vallabha, kṛṣṇa---parama-madhura
> saundarya, mādhurya, prema-vilāsa---pracura
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śunaha]]---please hear; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]---dear Vallabha; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:m:madhura]]---supremely attractive; [[synonyms:s:saundarya]]---beauty; [[synonyms:m:mādhurya]]---sweetness; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes of love; [[synonyms:p:pracura]]---without limitation.
translation: “ 'Dear Vallabha,' we said, 'please hear from us. Lord Kṛṣṇa is supremely attractive. His beauty, sweetness and pastimes of love are without limit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.35
description: " 'Engage yourself in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa with both of us. We three brothers shall stay together and enjoy discussing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.'
text:
> kṛṣṇa-bhajana kara tumi āmā-duṅhāra saṅge
> tina bhāi ekatra rahimu kṛṣṇa-kathā-raṅge"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhajana]]---devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---engage in; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---the two of us; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---three brothers; [[synonyms:e:ekatra]]---in one place; [[synonyms:r:rahimu]]---we shall stay; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---of the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in enjoyment.
translation: “ 'Engage yourself in devotional service to Kṛṣṇa with both of us. We three brothers shall stay together and enjoy discussing the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.36
description: "In this way we both spoke to him again and again, and because of this persuasion and his respect for us, his mind turned somewhat toward our instructions.
text:
> ei-mata bāra-bāra kahi dui-jana
> āmā-duṅhāra gaurave kichu phiri' gela mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---we speak; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of us both; [[synonyms:g:gaurave]]---out of respect; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---somewhat; [[synonyms:p:phiri']] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---turned; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: "In this way we both spoke to him again and again, and because of this persuasion and his respect for us, his mind turned somewhat toward our instructions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.37
description: "Vallabha replied, 'My dear brothers, how can I disobey your orders? Initiate me into the Kṛṣṇa mantra so that I may perform devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'
text:
> "tomā-duṅhāra ājñā āmi kemane laṅghimu?
> dīkṣā-mantra deha' kṛṣṇa-bhajana karimu"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---of you; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāra]]---of both; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:l:laṅghimu]]---shall disobey; [[synonyms:d:dīkṣā]]---initiation; [[synonyms:m:mantra]]---mantra; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---just give; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhajana]]---devotional service to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karimu]]---I shall perform.
translation: "Vallabha replied, 'My dear brothers, how can I disobey your orders? Initiate me into the Kṛṣṇa mantra so that I may perform devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.38
description: "After saying this, at night he began to think, 'How shall I give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha?'
text:
> eta kahi' rātri-kāle karena cintana
> kemane chāḍimu raghunāthera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at night; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:c:cintana]]---began to think; [[synonyms:k:kemane]]---how; [[synonyms:c:chāḍimu]]---shall I give up; [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha?'
translation: "After saying this, at night he began to think, 'How shall I give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha?'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.39
description: "He stayed up all night and cried. In the morning, he came to us and submitted the following plea.
text:
> saba rātri krandana kari' kaila jāgaraṇa
> prātaḥ-kāle āmā-duṅhāya kaila nivedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---throughout the whole night; [[synonyms:k:krandana]]---crying; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:j:jāgaraṇa]]---remained awake; [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:d:duṅhāya]]---to the two of us; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submission.
translation: "He stayed up all night and cried. In the morning, he came to us and submitted the following plea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.4
description: Sanātana Gosvāmī walked alone on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa Forest in central India. Sometimes he fasted, and sometimes he would eat.
text:
> jhārikhaṇḍa-vanapathe āilā ekelā caliyā
> kabhu upavāsa, kabhu carvaṇa kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhārikhaṇḍa]]---known as Jhārikhaṇḍa; [[synonyms:v:vana]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---through the path of the forest of central India; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:e:ekelā]]---alone; [[synonyms:c:caliyā]]---walking; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:u:upavāsa]]---fasting; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:c:carvaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---chewing.
translation: Sanātana Gosvāmī walked alone on the path through Jhārikhaṇḍa Forest in central India. Sometimes he fasted, and sometimes he would eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.40
description: " 'I have sold my head at the lotus feet of Lord Rāmacandra. I cannot take it away. That would be too painful for me.
text:
> 'raghunāthera pāda-padme veciyāchoṅ māthā
> kāḍite nā pāroṅ māthā, pāṅa baḍa vyathā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthera]]---of Lord Rāmacandra; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:padme]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:v:veciyāchoṅmāthā]]---I have sold my head; [[synonyms:k:kāḍite]]---to take away; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāroṅ]]---I am unable; [[synonyms:m:māthā]]---the head; [[synonyms:p:pāṅa]]---I get; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:v:vyathā]]---too much pain.
translation: “ 'I have sold my head at the lotus feet of Lord Rāmacandra. I cannot take it away. That would be too painful for me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.41
description: " 'Both of you please be merciful to me and order me in such a way so that life after life I may serve the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha.
text:
> kṛpā kari' more ājñā deha' dui-jana
> janme-janme sevoṅ raghunāthera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---give the order; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---both of you; [[synonyms:j:janme]]-[[synonyms:j:janme]]---life after life; [[synonyms:s:sevoṅ]]---let me serve; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha.
translation: “ 'Both of you please be merciful to me and order me in such a way so that life after life I may serve the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.42
description: " 'It is impossible for me to give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha. When I even think of giving them up, my heart breaks.'
text:
> raghunāthera pāda-padma chāḍāna nā yāya
> chāḍibāra mana haile prāṇa phāṭi' yāya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghu]]-[[synonyms:n:nāthera]]---of Lord Raghunātha; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:padma]]---lotus feet; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāna]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---it is impossible to give up; [[synonyms:c:chāḍibāra]]---of giving up; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:h:haile]]---when I think; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---my heart; [[synonyms:p:phāṭi']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---breaks.
translation: “ 'It is impossible for me to give up the lotus feet of Lord Raghunātha. When I even think of giving them up, my heart breaks.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.43
description: "Upon hearing this, both of us embraced him and encouraged him by saying, 'You are a great saintly devotee, for your determination in devotional service is fixed.' In this way we both praised him.
text:
> tabe āmi-duṅhe tāre āliṅgana kailuṅ
> 'sādhu, dṛḍha-bhakti tomāra '---kahi' praśaṁsiluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]-[[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of us; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---embraced; [[synonyms:s:sādhu]]---very good; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---very determined; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotion; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁsiluṅ]]---we praised.
translation: "Upon hearing this, both of us embraced him and encouraged him by saying, 'You are a great saintly devotee, for your determination in devotional service is fixed.' In this way we both praised him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.44
description: "My dear Lord, the family upon which You bestow even a little mercy is always fortunate, for such mercy makes all miseries disappear."
text:
> ye vaṁśera upare tomāra haya kṛpā-leśa
> sakala maṅgala tāhe khaṇḍe saba kleśa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:v:vaṁśera]]---which family; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:l:leśa]]---little mercy; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:m:maṅgala]]---all auspiciousness; [[synonyms:t:tāhe]]---on that; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍe]]---are destroyed; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kleśa]]---miserable conditions.
translation: "My dear Lord, the family upon which You bestow even a little mercy is always fortunate, for such mercy makes all miseries disappear."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.45
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "There was a similar incident concerning Murāri Gupta. Formerly I examined him, and his determination was similar.
text:
> gosāñi kahena,---"ei-mata murāri-gupta
> pūrve āmi parīkṣiluṅ tāra ei rīta
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]-[[synonyms:g:gupta]]---Murāri Gupta; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---formerly; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣiluṅ]]---examined; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:r:rīta]]---manner.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "There was a similar incident concerning Murāri Gupta. Formerly I examined him, and his determination was similar.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.46
description: "Glorious is that devotee who does not give up the shelter of his Lord, and glorious is that Lord who does not abandon His servant.
text:
> sei bhakta dhanya, ye nā chāḍe prabhura caraṇa
> sei prabhu dhanya, ye nā chāḍe nija-jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---that devotee; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorious; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---who; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]]---gives up; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of the Lord; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---that Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorious; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---who; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]]---gives up; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---His servant.
translation: "Glorious is that devotee who does not give up the shelter of his Lord, and glorious is that Lord who does not abandon His servant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.47
description: "If by chance a servant falls down and goes somewhere else, glorious is that master who captures him and brings him back by the hair.
text:
> durdaive sevaka yadi yāya anya sthāne
> sei ṭhākura dhanya tāre cule dhari' āne
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:durdaive]]---by chance; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---the servant; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:a:anya]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to another place; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---that master; [[synonyms:d:dhanya]]---glorified; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:c:cule]]---by the hair; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---capturing; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---brings back.
translation: "If by chance a servant falls down and goes somewhere else, glorious is that master who captures him and brings him back by the hair.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.48
description: "It is very good that you have arrived here. Now stay in this room with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
text:
> bhāla haila, tomāra ihāṅ haila āgamane
> ei ghare raha ihāṅ haridāsa-sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---it was very good; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:ā:āgamane]]---arrival; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in this room; [[synonyms:r:raha]]---remain; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.
translation: "It is very good that you have arrived here. Now stay in this room with Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.49
description: "Both of you are expert in understanding the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. Therefore you should both continue relishing the taste for such activities and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."
text:
> kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rase duṅhe parama pradhāna
> kṛṣṇa-rasa āsvādana kara, laha kṛṣṇa-nāma"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:r:rase]]---in the transcendental mellow of devotional service; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of you; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---highly expert; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the transcendental taste of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āsvādana]]---relishing; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:l:laha]] [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Both of you are expert in understanding the mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. Therefore you should both continue relishing the taste for such activities and chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.5
description: Because of bad water in Jhārikhaṇḍa and because of fasting, Sanātana Gosvāmī contracted a disease that made his body itch. Thus he was afflicted with itching sores from which fluid oozed.
text:
> jhārikhaṇḍera jalera doṣe, upavāsa haite
> gātre kaṇḍu haila, rasā paḍe khājuyāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhārikhaṇḍera]]---at the place known as Jhārikhaṇḍa; [[synonyms:j:jalera]]---of the water; [[synonyms:d:doṣe]]---by the fault; [[synonyms:u:upavāsa]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---by fasting; [[synonyms:g:gātre]]---on the body; [[synonyms:k:kaṇḍu]]---itches; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there were; [[synonyms:r:rasā]]---fluid; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---oozes out; [[synonyms:k:khājuyāite]]---by itching.
translation: Because of bad water in Jhārikhaṇḍa and because of fasting, Sanātana Gosvāmī contracted a disease that made his body itch. Thus he was afflicted with itching sores from which fluid oozed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.50
description: Having said this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and left, and through Govinda He sent prasāda for them to eat.
text:
> eta bali' mahāprabhu uṭhiyā calilā
> govinda-dvārāya duṅhe prasāda pāṭhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhiyā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---got up and left; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārāya]]---through Govinda; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---to both of them; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent //prasāda.//
translation: Having said this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and left, and through Govinda He sent prasāda for them to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.51
description: In this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He would see the wheel on the pinnacle of the Jagannātha temple and offer respectful obeisances.
text:
> ei-mata sanātana rahe prabhu-sthāne
> jagannāthera cakra dekhi' karena praṇāme
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:c:cakra]]---the wheel on the top of the temple; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:praṇāme]]---offers respectful obeisances.
translation: In this way, Sanātana Gosvāmī stayed under the care of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. He would see the wheel on the pinnacle of the Jagannātha temple and offer respectful obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.52
description: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go there to meet these two stalwart devotees and discuss topics of Kṛṣṇa with them for some time.
text:
> prabhu āsi' prati-dina milena dui-jane
> iṣṭa-goṣṭhī, kṛṣṇa-kathā kahe kata-kṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---every day; [[synonyms:m:milena]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---meets both of them; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---discussion; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---for some time.
translation: Every day Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go there to meet these two stalwart devotees and discuss topics of Kṛṣṇa with them for some time.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.53
description: The offerings of prasāda in the temple of Lord Jagannātha were of the highest quality. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would bring this prasāda and deliver it to both devotees.
text:
> divya prasāda pāya nitya jagannātha-mandire
> tāhā āni' nitya avaśya dena doṅhākāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:divya]]---first-class; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]---daily; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---at the temple of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing that; [[synonyms:n:nitya]]---daily; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---delivers; [[synonyms:d:doṅhākāre]]---to both of them.
translation: The offerings of prasāda in the temple of Lord Jagannātha were of the highest quality. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would bring this prasāda and deliver it to both devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.54
description: One day when the Lord came to meet them, He suddenly began speaking to Sanātana Gosvāmī.
text:
> eka-dina āsi' prabhu duṅhāre mililā
> sanātane ācambite kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:duṅhāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met both of them; [[synonyms:s:sanātane]]---unto Sanātana Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:ācambite]]---all of a sudden; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: One day when the Lord came to meet them, He suddenly began speaking to Sanātana Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.55
description: "My dear Sanātana," He said, "if I could attain Kṛṣṇa by committing suicide, I would certainly give up millions of bodies without a moment's hesitation.
text:
> "sanātana, deha-tyāge kṛṣṇa yadi pāiye
> koṭi-deha kṣaṇeke tabe chāḍite pāriye
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sanātana]]---My dear Sanātana; [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:t:tyāge]]---by committing suicide; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---I can get; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:d:deha]]---millions of bodies; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇeke]]---in a moment; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:c:chāḍite]] [[synonyms:p:pāriye]]---I can give up.
translation: "My dear Sanātana," He said, "if I could attain Kṛṣṇa by committing suicide, I would certainly give up millions of bodies without a moment's hesitation.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.56
description: "You should know that one cannot attain Kṛṣṇa simply by giving up the body. Kṛṣṇa is attainable by devotional service. There is no other meas to attain Him.
text:
> deha-tyāge kṛṣṇa nā paī, pāiye bhajane
> kṛṣṇa-prāptyera upāya kona nāhi 'bhakti' vine
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:t:tyāge]]---by giving up the body; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---I do not get; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---I get; [[synonyms:b:bhajane]]---by devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prāptyera]]---to get the shelter of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---means; [[synonyms:k:kona]]---any; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:v:vine]]---without devotional service.
translation: "You should know that one cannot attain Kṛṣṇa simply by giving up the body. Kṛṣṇa is attainable by devotional service. There is no other meas to attain Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.57
description: "Acts such as suicide are influenced by the mode of ignorance, and in ignorance and passion one cannot understand who Kṛṣṇa is.
text:
> deha-tyāgādi yata, saba---tamo-dharma
> tamo-rajo-dharme kṛṣṇera nā pāiye marma
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:t:tyāga]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with giving up the material body; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tamaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---performed under the mode of ignorance; [[synonyms:t:tamaḥ]]-[[synonyms:r:rajaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dharme]]---by remaining in the modes of ignorance and passion; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---I cannot attain; [[synonyms:m:marma]]---the truth.
translation: "Acts such as suicide are influenced by the mode of ignorance, and in ignorance and passion one cannot understand who Kṛṣṇa is.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.58
description: "Unless one discharges devotional service, one cannot awaken one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa, and there is no means to attain Him other than awakening that dormant love.
text:
> 'bhakti' vinā kṛṣṇe kabhu nahe 'premodaya'
> prema vinā kṛṣṇa-prāpti anya haite naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakti]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---at any time; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:u:udaya]]---development of dormant love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prema]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prāpti]]---attaining Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---anything else; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:n:naya]]---is not possible.
translation: "Unless one discharges devotional service, one cannot awaken one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa, and there is no means to attain Him other than awakening that dormant love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.59
description: [The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] " 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through austerities, charity or acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.'
text:
> na sādhayati māṁ yogo
> na sāṅkhyaṁ dharma uddhava
> na svādhyāyas tapas tyāgo
> yathā bhaktir mamorjitā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---never; [[synonyms:s:sādhayati]]---causes to remain satisfied; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---Me; [[synonyms:y:yogaḥ]]---the process of control; [[synonyms:n:na]]---nor; [[synonyms:s:sāṅkhyam]]---the process of gaining philosophical knowledge about the Absolute Truth; [[synonyms:d:dharmaḥ]]---such an occupation; [[synonyms:u:uddhava]]---My dear Uddhava; [[synonyms:n:na]]---nor; [[synonyms:s:svādhyāyaḥ]]---study of the //Vedas//; [[synonyms:t:tapaḥ]]---austerities; [[synonyms:t:tyāgaḥ]]---renunciation, acceptance of //sannyāsa,// or charity; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as much as; [[synonyms:b:bhaktiḥ]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:m:mama]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:ū:ūrjitā]]---developed.
translation: [The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, said:] " 'My dear Uddhava, neither through aṣṭāṅga-yoga [the mystic yoga system to control the senses], nor through impersonal monism or an analytical study of the Absolute Truth, nor through study of the Vedas, nor through austerities, charity or acceptance of sannyāsa can one satisfy Me as much as by developing unalloyed devotional service unto Me.'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (11.14.20).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.6
description: In disappointment, Sanātana Gosvāmī considered, "I am of a low caste, and my body is useless for devotional service.
text:
> nirveda ha-ila pathe, karena vicāra
> 'nīca-jāti, deha mora---atyanta asāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nirveda]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was disappointment; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---he considered; [[synonyms:n:nīca]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---of a lower caste; [[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my body; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]]---completely; [[synonyms:a:asāra]]---useless for devotional service.
translation: In disappointment, Sanātana Gosvāmī considered, "I am of a low caste, and my body is useless for devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.60
description: "Measures like suicide are causes for sin. A devotee never achieves shelter at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet by such actions.
text:
> deha-tyāgādi tamo-dharma---pātaka-kāraṇa
> sādhaka nā pāya tāte kṛṣṇera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deha]]-[[synonyms:t:tyāga]]---giving up the material body by suicide; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with; [[synonyms:t:tamaḥ]]-[[synonyms:d:dharma]]---on the platform of the mode of ignorance; [[synonyms:p:pātaka]]-[[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---cause of sinful activities; [[synonyms:s:sādhaka]]---the devotee; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---by that; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Measures like suicide are causes for sin. A devotee never achieves shelter at Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet by such actions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.61
description: "Because of feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, an exalted devotee sometimes wants to give up his life. By such ecstatic love, however, one attains the audience of Kṛṣṇa, and at that time he cannot give up his body.
text:
> premī bhakta viyoge cāhe deha chāḍite
> preme kṛṣṇa mile, seha nā pāre marite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:premī]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---a devotee attached to Kṛṣṇa by love; [[synonyms:v:viyoge]]---in separation; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wants; [[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍite]]---to give up the body; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---by such ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:m:mile]]---one meets Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---such a devotee; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:m:marite]]---cannot die.
translation: "Because of feelings of separation from Kṛṣṇa, an exalted devotee sometimes wants to give up his life. By such ecstatic love, however, one attains the audience of Kṛṣṇa, and at that time he cannot give up his body.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.62
description: "One who is deeply in love with Kṛṣṇa cannot tolerate separation from the Lord. Therefore such a devotee always desires his own death.
text:
> gāḍhānurāgera viyoga nā yāya sahana
> tāte anurāgī vāñche āpana maraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gāḍha]]-[[synonyms:a:anurāgera]]---of one who has deep attachment; [[synonyms:v:viyoga]]---separation; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:s:sahana]]---tolerated; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:a:anurāgī]]---a deeply attached devotee; [[synonyms:v:vāñche]]---desires; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]] [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]---death of himself.
translation: "One who is deeply in love with Kṛṣṇa cannot tolerate separation from the Lord. Therefore such a devotee always desires his own death.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.63
description: " 'O lotus-eyed one, great personalities like Lord Śiva desire to bathe in the dust of Your lotus feet to drive away ignorance. If I do not get the mercy of Your Lordship, I shall observe vows to reduce the duration of my life, and thus I shall give up bodies for hundreds of births if it is possible to get Your mercy in that way.'
text:
> yasyāṅghri-paṅkaja-rajaḥ-snapanaṁ mahānto
> vāñchanty umā-patir ivātma-tamo 'pahatyai
> yarhy ambujākṣa na labheya bhavat-prasādaṁ
> jahyām asūn vrata-kṛśāñ chata-janmabhiḥ syāt
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yasya]]---whose; [[synonyms:a:aṅghri]]---of feet; [[synonyms:p:paṅka]]-[[synonyms:j:ja]]---lotus; [[synonyms:r:rajaḥ]]---in the dust; [[synonyms:s:snapanam]]---bathing; [[synonyms:m:mahāntaḥ]]---great personalities; [[synonyms:v:vāñchanti]]---desire; [[synonyms:u:umāpatiḥ]]---Lord Śiva; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---like; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]---personal; [[synonyms:t:tamaḥ]]---ignorance; [[synonyms:a:apahatyai]]---to drive away; [[synonyms:y:yarhi]]---when; [[synonyms:a:ambuja]]-[[synonyms:a:akṣa]]---O lotus-eyed one; [[synonyms:n:na]] [[synonyms:l:labheya]]---I do not get; [[synonyms:b:bhavat]]-[[synonyms:p:prasādam]]---Your mercy; [[synonyms:j:jahyām]]---I shall give up; [[synonyms:a:asūn]]---life; [[synonyms:v:vrata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛśān]]---reduced by observing vows; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]-[[synonyms:j:janmabhiḥ]]---by hundreds of births; [[synonyms:s:syāt]]---if it is possible.
translation: “ 'O lotus-eyed one, great personalities like Lord Śiva desire to bathe in the dust of Your lotus feet to drive away ignorance. If I do not get the mercy of Your Lordship, I shall observe vows to reduce the duration of my life, and thus I shall give up bodies for hundreds of births if it is possible to get Your mercy in that way.'
purport: This verse was spoken by Rukmiṇīdevī in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.52.43). Rukmiṇīdevī, the daughter of King Bhīṣmaka, had heard about Kṛṣṇa's transcendental attributes, and thus she desired to get Kṛṣṇa as her husband. Unfortunately, her elder brother Rukmī was envious of Kṛṣṇa and therefore wanted her to be offered to Śiśupāla. When Rukmiṇī became aware of this, she was greatly aggrieved. Thus she wrote Kṛṣṇa a confidential letter, which was presented and read to Him by a //brāhmaṇa// messenger. This verse appeared in that letter.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.64
description: " 'O dear Kṛṣṇa, by Your smiling glances and melodious talk, You have awakened a fire of lusty desire in our hearts. Now You should extinguish that fire with a stream of nectar from Your lips by kissing us. Kindly do this. Otherwise, dear friend, the fire within our hearts will burn our bodies to ashes because of separation from You. Thus by meditation we shall claim shelter at Your lotus feet.' "
text:
> siñcāṅga nas tvad-adharāmṛta-pūrakeṇa
> hāsāvaloka-kala-gītaja-hṛc-chayāgnim
> no ced vayaṁ virahajāgny-upayukta-dehā
> dhyānena yāma padayoḥ padavīṁ sakhe te
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siñca]]---just sprinkle water; [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---O my dear Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:naḥ]]---our; [[synonyms:t:tvat]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:adhara]]---of the lips; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---of nectar; [[synonyms:p:pūrakeṇa]]---by the stream; [[synonyms:h:hāsa]]---smile; [[synonyms:a:avaloka]]---glancing; [[synonyms:k:kala]]---melodious; [[synonyms:g:gīta]]---speaking; [[synonyms:j:ja]]---produced by; [[synonyms:h:hṛt]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:ś:śaya]]---resting; [[synonyms:a:agnim]]---upon the fire; [[synonyms:n:nocet]]---if not; [[synonyms:v:vayam]]---we; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]---from separation; [[synonyms:j:ja]]---produced; [[synonyms:a:agni]]---by the fire; [[synonyms:u:upayukta]]---consumed; [[synonyms:d:dehāḥ]]---whose bodies; [[synonyms:d:dhyānena]]---by meditation; [[synonyms:y:yāma]]---shall go; [[synonyms:p:padayoḥ]]---of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:padavīm]]---to the site; [[synonyms:s:sakhe]]---O my dear friend; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your.
translation: “ 'O dear Kṛṣṇa, by Your smiling glances and melodious talk, You have awakened a fire of lusty desire in our hearts. Now You should extinguish that fire with a stream of nectar from Your lips by kissing us. Kindly do this. Otherwise, dear friend, the fire within our hearts will burn our bodies to ashes because of separation from You. Thus by meditation we shall claim shelter at Your lotus feet.' "
purport: This verse (//Bhāg.// 10.29.35) was spoken by the //gopīs// when they were attracted by the vibration of Kṛṣṇa's flute in the moonlight of autumn. All of them, being maddened, came to Kṛṣṇa, but to increase their ecstatic love, Kṛṣṇa gave them moral instructions to return home. The //gopīs// did not care for these instructions. They wanted to be kissed by Kṛṣṇa, for they had come there with lusty desires to dance with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.65
description: Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Give up all your nonsensical desires, for they are unfavorable for getting shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. Engage yourself in chanting and hearing. Then you will soon achieve the shelter of Kṛṣṇa without a doubt.
text:
> kubuddhi chāḍiyā kara śravaṇa-kīrtana
> acirāt pābe tabe kṛṣṇera caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ku]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhi]]---intelligence not favorable to discharging devotional service; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---giving up; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---just do; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]---hearing and chanting; [[synonyms:a:acirāt]]---very soon; [[synonyms:p:pābe]]---you will get; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Sanātana Gosvāmī, "Give up all your nonsensical desires, for they are unfavorable for getting shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa. Engage yourself in chanting and hearing. Then you will soon achieve the shelter of Kṛṣṇa without a doubt.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.66
description: "A person born in a low family is not unfit for discharging devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor is one fit for devotional service simply because he is born in an aristocratic family of brāhmaṇas.
text:
> nīca-jāti nahe kṛṣṇa-bhajane ayogya
> sat-kula-vipra nahe bhajanera yogya
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nīca]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---a lowborn person; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhajane]]---in discharging devotional service; [[synonyms:a:ayogya]]---unfit; [[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:k:kula]]-[[synonyms:v:vipra]]---a //brāhmaṇa// born in a very respectable aristocratic family; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:b:bhajanera]] [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---fit for discharging devotional service.
translation: "A person born in a low family is not unfit for discharging devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor is one fit for devotional service simply because he is born in an aristocratic family of brāhmaṇas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.67
description: "Anyone who takes to devotional service is exalted, whereas a nondevotee is always condemned and abominable. Therefore in the discharge of devotional service to the Lord, there is no consideration of the status of one's family.
text:
> yei bhaje sei baḍa, abhakta---hīna, chāra
> kṛṣṇa-bhajane nāhi jāti-kulādi-vicāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---anyone who takes to devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---exalted; [[synonyms:a:abhakta]]---nondevotee; [[synonyms:h:hīna]] [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---most condemned and abominable; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhajane]]---in discharging devotional service; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:j:jāti]]---caste; [[synonyms:k:kula]]---family; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---consideration of.
translation: "Anyone who takes to devotional service is exalted, whereas a nondevotee is always condemned and abominable. Therefore in the discharge of devotional service to the Lord, there is no consideration of the status of one's family.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.68
description: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, is always favorable to the humble and meek, but aristocrats, learned scholars and the wealthy are always proud of their positions.
text:
> dīnere adhika dayā kare bhagavān
> kulīna, paṇḍita, dhanīra baḍa abhimāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dīnere]]---to the humble; [[synonyms:a:adhika]]---more; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---shows; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:k:kulīna]]---aristocratic; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---learned scholar; [[synonyms:d:dhanīra]]---of rich man; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---great pride.
translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, is always favorable to the humble and meek, but aristocrats, learned scholars and the wealthy are always proud of their positions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.69
description: " 'One may be born in a brāhmaṇa family and have all twelve brahminical qualities, but if in spite of being thus qualified he is not devoted to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, who has a navel shaped like a lotus, he is not as good as a caṇḍāla who has dedicated his mind, words, activities, wealth and life to the service of the Lord. Simply to take birth in a brāhmaṇa family or to have brahminical qualities is not sufficient. One must be a pure devotee of the Lord. Thus if a śvapaca, or caṇḍāla, is a devotee, he delivers not only himself but his entire family as well, whereas a brāhmaṇa who is not a devotee but simply has brahminical qualifications cannot even purify himself, what to speak of his family.'
text:
> viprād dviṣaḍ-guṇa-yutād aravinda-nābha-
> pādāravinda-vimukhāt śvapacaṁ variṣṭham
> manye tad-arpita-mano-vacane 'hitārtha-
> prāṇaṁ punāti sa kulaṁ na tu bhūrimānaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viprāt]]---than a //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṭ]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]-[[synonyms:y:yutāt]]---who has twelve brahminical qualifications; [[synonyms:a:aravinda]]-[[synonyms:n:nābha]]---of Lord Viṣṇu, who has a lotuslike navel; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:a:aravinda]]---unto the lotus feet; [[synonyms:v:vimukhāt]]---than a person bereft of devotion; [[synonyms:ś:śva]]-[[synonyms:p:pacam]]---a //caṇḍāla,// or person accustomed to eating dogs; [[synonyms:v:variṣṭham]]---more glorified; [[synonyms:m:manye]]---I think; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:a:arpita]]---dedicated unto Him; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]---mind; [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---words; [[synonyms:a:ahita]]---activities; [[synonyms:a:artha]]---wealth; [[synonyms:p:prāṇam]]---life; [[synonyms:p:punāti]]---purifies; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kulam]]---his family; [[synonyms:n:na]] [[synonyms:t:tu]]---but not; [[synonyms:b:bhūri]]-[[synonyms:m:mānaḥ]]---a //brāhmaṇa// proud of possessing such qualities.
translation: “ 'One may be born in a brāhmaṇa family and have all twelve brahminical qualities, but if in spite of being thus qualified he is not devoted to the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa, who has a navel shaped like a lotus, he is not as good as a caṇḍāla who has dedicated his mind, words, activities, wealth and life to the service of the Lord. Simply to take birth in a brāhmaṇa family or to have brahminical qualities is not sufficient. One must be a pure devotee of the Lord. Thus if a śvapaca, or caṇḍāla, is a devotee, he delivers not only himself but his entire family as well, whereas a brāhmaṇa who is not a devotee but simply has brahminical qualifications cannot even purify himself, what to speak of his family.'
purport: This is a verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:7:9:9|(7.9.9)]].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.7
description: "When I go to Jagannātha Purī, I shall not be able to see Lord Jagannātha, nor shall I always be able to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> jagannāthe gele tāṅra darśana nā pāimu
> prabhura darśana sadā karite nārimu
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthe]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:g:gele]]---when I go; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---visit; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāimu]]---I shall not get; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---seeing Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:n:nārimu]]---I shall not be able.
translation: "When I go to Jagannātha Purī, I shall not be able to see Lord Jagannātha, nor shall I always be able to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.70
description: "Among the ways of executing devotional service, the nine prescribed methods are the best, for these processes have great potency to deliver Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him.
text:
> bhajanera madhye śreṣṭha nava-vidhā bhakti
> 'kṛṣṇa-prema', 'kṛṣṇa' dite dhare mahā-śakti
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhajanera]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in executing devotional service; [[synonyms:ś:śreṣṭha]]---the best; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---the nine prescribed methods of devotional service; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---and Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to deliver; [[synonyms:d:dhare]]---possess; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---great potency.
translation: "Among the ways of executing devotional service, the nine prescribed methods are the best, for these processes have great potency to deliver Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him.
purport:
The nine kinds of devotional service are mentioned in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:7:5:23|(7.5.23)]]:

> śravaṇaṁ kīrtanaṁ viṣṇoḥ
> smaraṇaṁ pāda-sevanam
> arcanaṁ vandanaṁ dāsyaṁ
> sakhyam ātma-nivedanam

These nine are hearing, chanting, remembering Kṛṣṇa, offering service to Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet, offering worship in the temple, offering prayers, working as a servant, making friendship with Kṛṣṇa and unreservedly surrendering to Kṛṣṇa. These nine processes of devotional service can grant one Kṛṣṇa and ecstatic love for Him. In the beginning one has to discharge devotional service according to regulative principles, but gradually, as devotional service becomes one's life and soul, one achieves the most exalted position of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. Ultimately, Kṛṣṇa is the goal of life. One need not have taken birth in an aristocratic //brāhmaṇa// family to attain the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, nor is a person born in a low family unfit to achieve Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. In //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:3:33:7|(3.33.7)]] Devahūti says to Kapiladeva:

> aho bata śva-paco 'to garīyān
> yaj-jihvāgre vartate nāma tubhyam
> tepus tapas te juhuvuḥ sasnur āryā
> brahmānūcur nāma gṛṇanti ye te

"O my Lord, even a person born in a low family of dog-eaters is glorious if he always chants the holy name of the Lord. Such a person has already performed all types of austerities, penances and Vedic sacrifices, has already bathed in the sacred rivers, and has also studied all the Vedic literature. Thus he has become an exalted personality." Similarly, Kuntīdevī says to Lord Kṛṣṇa:

> janmaiśvarya-śruta-śrībhir
> edhamāna-madaḥ pumān
> naivārhaty abhidhātuṁ vai
> tvām akiñcana-gocaram

"A person who is proud of his birth, opulence, knowledge and beauty cannot achieve Your lotus feet. You are available only to the humble and meek, not to the proud." [[books:sb:1:8:26|(Bhāg. 1.8.26)]].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.71
description: "Of the nine processes of devotional service, the most important is to always chant the holy name of the Lord. If one does so, avoiding the ten kinds of offenses, one very easily obtains the most valuable love of Godhead."
text:
> tāra madhye sarva-śreṣṭha nāma-saṅkīrtana
> niraparādhe nāma laile pāya prema-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---of the nine different types of devotional service; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śreṣṭha]]---the most important of all; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:n:niraparādhe]]---without offenses; [[synonyms:n:nāma]] [[synonyms:l:laile]]---if one chants the holy name; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---he gets; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the most valuable ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Of the nine processes of devotional service, the most important is to always chant the holy name of the Lord. If one does so, avoiding the ten kinds of offenses, one very easily obtains the most valuable love of Godhead."
purport:
Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī Prabhu gives the following directions in his //Bhakti-sandarbha// (270):

> iyaṁ ca kīrtanākhyā bhaktir bhagavato dravya-jāti-guṇa-kriyābhir dīna-janaika-viṣayāpāra-karuṇā-mayīti śruti-purāṇādi-viśrutiḥ. ataeva kalau svabhāvata evātidīneṣu lokeṣu āvirbhūya tān anāyāsenaiva tat tad yuga-gata-mahā-sādhanānāṁ sarvam eva phalaṁ dadānā sā kṛtārthayati. yata eva tayaiva kalau bhagavato viśeṣataś ca santoṣo bhavati.

"Chanting the holy name is the chief means of attaining love of Godhead. This chanting or devotional service does not depend on any paraphernalia, nor on one's having taken birth in a good family. By humility and meekness one attracts the attention of Kṛṣṇa. That is the verdict of all the //Vedas.// Therefore if one becomes very humble and meek, he can easily attain the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa in this age of Kali. That is the fulfillment of all great sacrifices, penances and austerities because when one achieves ecstatic love of Godhead, he attains the complete perfection of life. Therefore whatever one does in executing devotional service must be accompanied with the chanting of the holy name of the Lord." The chanting of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa-Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare-has been praised by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī in his //Nāmāṣṭaka// (verse 1):

> nikhila-śruti-mauli-ratna-mālā-
> dyuti-nīrājita-pāda-paṅkajānta
> ayi mukta-kulair upāsyamānaṁ
> paritas tvāṁ hari-nāma saṁśrayāmi

"O Hari-nāma! The tips of the toes of Your lotus feet are constantly being worshiped by the glowing radiance emanating from the string of gems known as the //Upaniṣads,// the crown jewels of all the //Vedas.// You are eternally adored by liberated souls such as Nārada and Śukadeva. O Hari-nāma! I take complete shelter of You."

Similarly, Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī has praised the chanting of the holy name as follows in his //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta// (Chapter One, verse 9):

> jayati jayati nāmānanda-rūpaṁ murārer
> viramita-nija-dharma-dhyāna-pūjādi-yatnam
> kathamapi sakṛd-āttaṁ muktidaṁ prāṇīnāṁ yat
> paramam amṛtam ekaṁ jīvanaṁ bhūṣaṇaṁ me

"All glories, all glories to the all-blissful holy name of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, which causes the devotee to give up all conventional religious duties, meditation and worship. When somehow or other uttered even once by a living entity, the holy name awards him liberation. The holy name of Kṛṣṇa is the highest nectar. It is my very life and my only treasure."

In //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:2:1:11|(2.1.11)]] Śukadeva Gosvāmī says:

> etan nirvidyamānānām
> icchatām akuto-bhayam
> yogināṁ nṛpa nirṇītaṁ
> harer nāmānukīrtanam

"O King, constant chanting of the holy name of the Lord after the ways of the great authorities is the doubtless and fearless way of success for all, including those who are free from all material desires, those who are desirous of all material enjoyment, and those who are self-satisfied by dint of transcendental knowledge."

Similarly, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has said in His //Śikṣāṣṭaka//(3):

> tṛṇād api sunīcena
> taror api sahiṣṇunā
> amāninā mānadena
> kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ

"One should chant the holy name of the Lord in a humble state of mind, thinking oneself lower than the straw in the street. One should be more tolerant than a tree, devoid of all sense of false prestige and ready to offer all respect to others. In such a state of mind one can chant the holy name of the Lord constantly." Regarding the ten offenses in chanting the holy name, one may refer to the //Ādi-līlā,// Chapter Eight, verse 24.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.81
description: "Mathurā-Vṛndāvana is My own very dear abode. I want to do many things there to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness.
text:
> nija-priya-sthāna mora---mathurā-vṛndāvana
> tāhāṅ eta dharma cāhi karite pracāraṇa

translation: "Mathurā-Vṛndāvana is My own very dear abode. I want to do many things there to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to accomplish many purposes through the exegetical endeavors of Śrīla Sanātana Gosvāmī. First Sanātana Gosvāmī compiled the book called //Bṛhad-bhāgavatāmṛta// to teach people how to become devotees, execute devotional service and attain love of Kṛṣṇa. Second, he compiled the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa,// wherein he collected authoritative statements from scriptural injunctions regarding how a Vaiṣṇava should behave. Only by the endeavors of Śrī Sanātana Gosvāmī were all the lost places of pilgrimage in the Vṛndāvana area excavated. He established Madana-mohana, the first Deity in the Vṛndāvana area, and by his personal behavior he taught how one should act in the renounced order, completely devoted to the service of the Lord. By his personal example, he taught people how to stay in Vṛndāvana to execute devotional service. The principal mission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was to preach Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Mathurā and Vṛndāvana are the abodes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore these two places are very dear to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and He wanted to develop their glories through Sanātana Gosvāmī.

translation: "The servants of Lord Jagannātha generally move about tending to their duties, but if they touch me I shall be an offender.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 4.98
description: "My body could not be used in the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore although it took birth in the land of India, this body has been useless."
text:
> āmāra ei deha prabhura kārye nā lāgila
> bhārata-bhūmite janmi' ei deha vyartha haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:deha]]---body; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kārye]]---in the service; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---could not be used; [[synonyms:b:bhārata]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūmite]]---in the land of India; [[synonyms:j:janmi']]---taking birth; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:deha]]---this body; [[synonyms:v:vyartha]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---has become useless.
translation: "My body could not be used in the service of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore although it took birth in the land of India, this body has been useless."
purport:
For a further explanation of the importance of Bhārata-bhūmi, one may refer to the //Ādi-līlā// (9.41) and also //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (5.19.19-27). The special feature of a birth in India is that a person born in India becomes automatically God conscious. In every part of India, and especially in the holy places of pilgrimage, even an ordinary uneducated man is inclined toward Kṛṣṇa consciousness, and as soon as he sees a Kṛṣṇa conscious person, he offers obeisances. India has many sacred rivers like the Ganges, Yamunā, Narmadā, Kāverī and Kṛṣṇā, and simply by bathing in these rivers people are liberated and become Kṛṣṇa conscious. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu therefore says:

> bhārata-bhūmite haila manuṣya-janma yāra
> janma sārthaka kari' kara para-upakāra

One who has taken birth in the land of Bhārata-bhūmi, India, should take full advantage of his birth. He should become completely well versed in the knowledge of the //Vedas// and spiritual culture and should distribute the experience of Kṛṣṇa consciousness all over the world. People all over the world are madly engaging in sense gratification and in this way spoiling their human lives, with the risk that in the next life they may become animals or less. Human society should be saved from such a risky civilization and the danger of animalism by awakening to God consciousness, Kṛṣṇa consciousness. The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement has been started for this purpose. Therefore unbiased men of the highest echelon should study the principles of the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement and fully cooperate with this movement to save human society.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.10

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.102
description: "In the writings of so-called poets there is generally a possibility of overlapping transcendental mellows. When the mellows thus go against the conclusive understanding, no one likes to hear such poetry.
text:
> 'yadvā-tadvā' kavira vākye haya 'rasābhāsa'
> siddhānta-viruddha śunite nā haya ullāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadvā]]-[[synonyms:t:tadvā]] [[synonyms:k:kavira]]---of any so-called poet; [[synonyms:v:vākye]]---in the words; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---overlapping of transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]-[[synonyms:v:viruddha]]---against the conclusive understanding; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:u:ullāsa]]---joy.
translation: "In the writings of so-called poets there is generally a possibility of overlapping transcendental mellows. When the mellows thus go against the conclusive understanding, no one likes to hear such poetry.
purport: //Yadvā-tadvā kavi// refers to anyone who writes poetry without knowledge of how to do so. Writing poetry, especially poetry concerning the Vaiṣṇava conclusion, is very difficult. If one writes poetry without proper knowledge, there is every possibility that the mellows will overlap. When this occurs, no learned or advanced Vaiṣṇava will like to hear it.

Moreover, the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are especially difficult to understand.

Moreover, the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are especially difficult to understand.

synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:se]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:v:varṇana]]---describes; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:padma]]---the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the life and soul.
translation: "One who has accepted the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as his life and soul can describe the pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa or the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.107
description: "Hearing the poetry of a person who has no transcendental knowledge and who writes about the relationships between man and woman simply causes unhappiness, whereas hearing the words of a devotee fully absorbed in ecstatic love causes great happiness.
text:
> grāmya-kavira kavitva śunite haya 'duḥkha'
> vidagdha-ātmīya-vākya śunite haya 'sukha'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:grāmya]]-[[synonyms:k:kavira]]---of a poet who writes poetry concerning man and woman; [[synonyms:k:kavitva]]---poetry; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:v:vidagdha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ātmīya]]---of a devotee fully absorbed in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:v:vākya]]---the words; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness.
translation: "Hearing the poetry of a person who has no transcendental knowledge and who writes about the relationships between man and woman simply causes unhappiness, whereas hearing the words of a devotee fully absorbed in ecstatic love causes great happiness.
purport: //Grāmya-kavi// refers to a poet or writer such as the authors of novels and other fiction who write only about the relationships between man and woman. //Vidagdha-ātmīya-vākya,// however, refers to words written by a devotee who fully understands pure devotional service. Such devotees, who follow the //paramparā// system, are sometimes described as //sajātīyāśaya-snigdha,// or "pleasing to the same class of people." Only the poetry and other writings of such devotees are accepted with great happiness by devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.108
description: "The standard for writing dramas has been set by Rūpa Gosvāmī. If a devotee hears the introductory portions of his two dramas, they enhance his transcendental pleasure."
text:
> rūpa yaiche dui nāṭaka kariyāche ārambhe
> śunite ānanda bāḍe yāra mukha-bandhe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:n:nāṭaka]]---dramas; [[synonyms:k:kariyāche]] [[synonyms:ā:ārambhe]]---has compiled; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]] [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---transcendental happiness increases; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:m:mukha]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhe]]---even the introductory portion.
translation: "The standard for writing dramas has been set by Rūpa Gosvāmī. If a devotee hears the introductory portions of his two dramas, they enhance his transcendental pleasure."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.109
description: Despite the explanation of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Bhagavān Ācārya requested, "Please hear the drama once. If you hear it, you can consider whether it is good or bad."
text:
> bhagavān-ācārya kahe,---'śuna eka-bāra
> tumi śunile bhāla-manda jānibe vicāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Bhagavān Ācārya; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---once; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:ś:śunile]]---if you hear; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]-[[synonyms:m:manda]]---good or bad; [[synonyms:j:jānibe]] [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---will be able to understand.
translation: Despite the explanation of Svarūpa Dāmodara, Bhagavān Ācārya requested, "Please hear the drama once. If you hear it, you can consider whether it is good or bad."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.11
description: Pradyumna Miśra, being thus advised by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went to the home of Rāmānanda Rāya. There the servant of Rāmānanda Rāya gave him a proper place to sit down.

> tabe pradyumna-miśra gelā rāmānandera sthāne
> rāyera sevaka tāṅre vasāila āsane

translation: Pradyumna Miśra, being thus advised by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, went to the home of Rāmānanda Rāya. There the servant of Rāmānanda Rāya gave him a proper place to sit down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.110
description: For two or three days Bhagavān Ācārya continually asked Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī to hear the poetry. Because of his repeated requests, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī wanted to hear the poetry written by the brāhmaṇa from Bengal.

> dui tina dina ācārya āgraha karila
> tāṅra āgrahe svarūpera śunite icchā ha-ila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---for two or three days; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Bhagavān Ācārya; [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---expressed his ardent desire; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ā:āgrahe]]---by his eagerness; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]]---of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was.
