> rāya-pāśa gela, rāya praṇati karila
> 'ājñā kara, ye lāgi' āgamana haila'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāya]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---to Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---he went; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:p:praṇati]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---offered his respects; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---please order me; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for what purpose; [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---have you come.
translation: Pradyumna Miśra went to Rāmānanda Rāya, who offered him respectful obeisances and said, "Please order me. For what purpose have you come?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.56
description: Pradyumna Miśra answered, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has sent me to hear topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa from you."
text:
> miśra kahe,---'mahāprabhu pāṭhāilā more
> tomāra sthāne kṛṣṇa-kathā śunibāra tare'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Pradyumna Miśra said; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]] [[synonyms:m:more]]---has sent me; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---from you; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śunibāra]] [[synonyms:t:tare]]---to hear.
translation: Pradyumna Miśra answered, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has sent me to hear topics about Lord Kṛṣṇa from you."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.57
description: Hearing this, Rāmānanda Rāya became absorbed in ecstatic love and began to speak with great transcendental pleasure.
text:
> śuni' rāmānanda rāya hailā premāveśe
> kahite lāgilā kichu manera hariṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---absorbed in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:m:manera]] [[synonyms:h:hariṣe]]---in transcendental pleasure.
translation: Hearing this, Rāmānanda Rāya became absorbed in ecstatic love and began to speak with great transcendental pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.58
description: "Following the instruction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, you have come to hear about Kṛṣṇa. This is my great fortune. How else would I get such an opportunity?"
text:
> "prabhura ājñāya kṛṣṇa-kathā śunite āilā ethā
> ihā va-i mahā-bhāgya āmi pāba kothā?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---under the instruction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---you have come here; [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:v:va]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---without this; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]---great fortune; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:pāba]]---will get; [[synonyms:k:kothā]]---where.
translation: "Following the instruction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, you have come to hear about Kṛṣṇa. This is my great fortune. How else would I get such an opportunity?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.59
description: Saying this, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya took Pradyumna Miśra to a secluded place and inquired from him, "What kind of kṛṣṇa-kathā do you want to hear from me?"
text:
> eta kahi tāre lañā nibhṛte vasilā
> 'ki kathā śunite cāha?' miśrere puchilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---saying this; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:n:nibhṛte]] [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat in a secluded place; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---what kind of topics; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]] [[synonyms:c:cāha]]---do you want to hear; [[synonyms:m:miśrere]] [[synonyms:p:puchilā]]---he inquired from Pradyumna Miśra.
translation: Saying this, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya took Pradyumna Miśra to a secluded place and inquired from him, "What kind of kṛṣṇa-kathā do you want to hear from me?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.6
description: "I wish to hear topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa constantly. Be merciful unto me and kindly tell me something about Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> kṛṣṇa-kathā śunibāre mora icchā haya
> kṛṣṇa-kathā kaha more hañā sadaya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---discussions on the subject of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śunibāre]]---to hear; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks about Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---kindly speak; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:d:daya]]---kind.
translation: "I wish to hear topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa constantly. Be merciful unto me and kindly tell me something about Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.60
description: Pradyumna Miśra replied, "Kindly tell me about the same topics you spoke about at Vidyānagara.
text:
> teṅho kahe,---"ye kahilā vidyānagare
> sei kathā krame tumi kahibā āmāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅho]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he replied; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---what; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---you spoke; [[synonyms:v:vidyā]]-[[synonyms:n:nagare]]---at Vidyānagara; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---those topics; [[synonyms:k:krame]]---according to the order; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kahibā]]---please speak; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---to me.
translation: Pradyumna Miśra replied, "Kindly tell me about the same topics you spoke about at Vidyānagara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.61
description: "You are an instructor even for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not to speak of others. I am but a beggar brāhmaṇa, and you are my maintainer.
text:
> ānera ki kathā, tumi---prabhura upadeṣṭā!
> āmi ta' bhikṣuka vipra, tumi---mora poṣṭā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānera]] [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---what to speak of others; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:u:upadeṣṭā]]---an instructor of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣuka]]---beggar; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---brāhmaṇa; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:p:poṣṭā]]---maintainer.
translation: "You are an instructor even for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not to speak of others. I am but a beggar brāhmaṇa, and you are my maintainer.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.62
description: "I do not know how to inquire, for I do not know what is good and what is bad. Seeing me to be poor in knowledge, kindly speak whatever is good for me by your own good will."
text:
> bhāla, manda---kichu āmi puchite nā jāni
> 'dīna' dekhi' kṛpā kari' kahibā āpani"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---good; [[synonyms:m:manda]]---bad; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:puchite]]---to inquire; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---do not know; [[synonyms:d:dīna]]---very poor in knowledge; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing (me); [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---very mercifully; [[synonyms:k:kahibā]]---please; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---by your own good will.
translation: "I do not know how to inquire, for I do not know what is good and what is bad. Seeing me to be poor in knowledge, kindly speak whatever is good for me by your own good will."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.63
description: Thereupon Rāmānanda Rāya gradually began speaking on topics of Kṛṣṇa. Thus the ocean of the transcendental mellow of those topics became agitated.
text:
> tabe rāmānanda krame kahite lāgilā
> kṛṣṇa-kathā-rasāmṛta-sindhu uthalilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:krame]]---gradually; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---of the topics of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rasāmṛta]]-[[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of transcendental mellow; [[synonyms:u:uthalilā]]---became agitated.
translation: Thereupon Rāmānanda Rāya gradually began speaking on topics of Kṛṣṇa. Thus the ocean of the transcendental mellow of those topics became agitated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.64
description: He began personally posing questions and then answering them with conclusive statements. When afternoon came, the topics still did not end.
text:
> āpane praśna kari' pāche karena siddhānta
> tṛtīya prahara haila, nahe kathā-anta
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:p:praśna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making the question; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---after that; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---gives the conclusion; [[synonyms:t:tṛtīya]] [[synonyms:p:prahara]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---it became afternoon; [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:a:anta]]---there was no end to such topics.
translation: He began personally posing questions and then answering them with conclusive statements. When afternoon came, the topics still did not end.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.65
description: The speaker and listener spoke and heard in ecstatic love. Thus they forgot their bodily consciousness. How, then, could they perceive the end of the day?
text:
> vaktā śrotā kahe śune duṅhe premāveśe
> ātma-smṛti nāhi, kāhāṅ jāniba dina-śeṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaktā]]---the speaker; [[synonyms:ś:śrotā]]---the listener; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśe]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:smṛti]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there was no bodily consciousness; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---where; [[synonyms:j:jāniba]]---can understand; [[synonyms:d:dina]]-[[synonyms:ś:śeṣe]]---the end of day.
translation: The speaker and listener spoke and heard in ecstatic love. Thus they forgot their bodily consciousness. How, then, could they perceive the end of the day?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.66
description: The servant informed them, "The day has already ended." Then Rāmānanda Rāya ended his discourses about Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> sevaka kahila,---'dina haila avasāna'
> tabe rāya kṛṣṇa-kathāra karilā viśrāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sevaka]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---the servant informed; [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the day; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:a:avasāna]]---has ended; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathāra]]---the talks of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]]---ended.
translation: The servant informed them, "The day has already ended." Then Rāmānanda Rāya ended his discourses about Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.67
description: Rāmānanda Rāya paid great respect to Pradyumna Miśra and bade him farewell. Pradyumna Miśra said, "I have become very satisfied." He then began to dance.
text:
> bahu-sammāna kari' miśre vidāya dilā
> 'kṛtārtha ha-ilāṅa' bali' miśra nācite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---much respectful behavior; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:m:miśre]]---unto Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---bade farewell; [[synonyms:k:kṛtārtha]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilāṅa]]---i have become very satisfied; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:n:nācite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to dance.
translation: Rāmānanda Rāya paid great respect to Pradyumna Miśra and bade him farewell. Pradyumna Miśra said, "I have become very satisfied." He then began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.68
description: After returning home, Pradyumna Miśra bathed and ate his meal. In the evening he came to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ghare giyā miśra kaila snāna, bhojana
> sandhyā-kāle dekhite āila prabhura caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---returning home; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---performed; [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bathing; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eating; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the evening; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: After returning home, Pradyumna Miśra bathed and ate his meal. In the evening he came to see the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.69
description: In great happiness he worshiped the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord inquired, "Have you heard topics about Kṛṣṇa?"
text:
> prabhura caraṇa vande ullasita-mane
> prabhu kake,---'kṛṣṇa-kathā ha-ila śravaṇe'?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:v:vande]]---he worships; [[synonyms:u:ullasita]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---in great happiness; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu says; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---did you hear.
translation: In great happiness he worshiped the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. The Lord inquired, "Have you heard topics about Kṛṣṇa?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.7
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not know about topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa. I think that only Rāmānanda Rāya knows, for I hear these topics from him.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---"kṛṣṇa-kathā āmi nāhi jāni
> sabe rāmānanda jāne, tāṅra mukhe śuni
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---the Lord replied; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks about Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---do not know; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---only; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---Rāmānanda Rāya knows; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from his mouth; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---I hear.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not know about topics concerning Lord Kṛṣṇa. I think that only Rāmānanda Rāya knows, for I hear these topics from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.70
description: Pradyumna Miśra said, "My dear Lord, You have made me extremely obliged to You because You have drowned me in a nectarean ocean of talks about Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> miśra kahe,---"prabhu, more kṛtārtha karilā
> kṛṣṇa-kathāmṛtārṇave more ḍubāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Pradyumna Miśra said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my dear Lord; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:k:kṛtārtha]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---You have made; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---of talks about Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]-[[synonyms:a:arṇave]]---in the ocean of the nectar; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍubāilā]]---You have drowned.
translation: Pradyumna Miśra said, "My dear Lord, You have made me extremely obliged to You because You have drowned me in a nectarean ocean of talks about Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.71
description: "I cannot properly describe the discourses of Rāmānanda Rāya, for he is not an ordinary human being. He is fully absorbed in the devotional service of the Lord.
text:
> rāmānanda rāya-kathā kahile nā haya
> 'manuṣya' nahe rāya, kṛṣṇa-bhakti-rasa-maya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---the speeches of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kahile]]---describing; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is not possible; [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---an ordinary human being; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---absorbed in the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "I cannot properly describe the discourses of Rāmānanda Rāya, for he is not an ordinary human being. He is fully absorbed in the devotional service of the Lord.
purport: One is forbidden to accept the guru, or spiritual master, as an ordinary human being (//guruṣu nara-matiḥ).// When Rāmānanda Rāya spoke to Pradyumna Miśra, Pradyumna Miśra could understand that Rāmānanda Rāya was not an ordinary human being. A spiritually advanced person who acts with authority, as the spiritual master, speaks as the Supreme Personality of Godhead dictates from within. Thus it is not he that is personally speaking. When a pure devotee or spiritual master speaks, what he says should be accepted as having been directly spoken by the Supreme Personality of Godhead in the //paramparā// system.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.72
description: "There is one other thing Rāmānanda Rāya said to me. 'Do not consider me the speaker in these talks about Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> āra eka kathā rāya kahilā āmāre
> 'kṛṣṇa-kathā-vaktā kari' nā jāniha more
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topic; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]] [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---said to me; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:v:vaktā]]---the speaker on the talks of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāniha]] [[synonyms:m:more]]---do not consider me.
translation: "There is one other thing Rāmānanda Rāya said to me. 'Do not consider me the speaker in these talks about Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.73
description: "Whatever I speak is personally spoken by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Like a stringed instrument, I vibrate whatever He causes me to speak.
text:
> mora mukhe kathā kahena āpane gauracandra
> yaiche kahāya, taiche kahi,---yena vīṇā-yantra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in my mouth; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---topics; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---speaks; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]] [[synonyms:k:kahāya]]---as He causes to speak; [[synonyms:t:taiche]] [[synonyms:k:kahi]]---so I speak; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:v:vīṇā]]-[[synonyms:y:yantra]]---the stringed instrument called the //vīṇā.//
translation: "Whatever I speak is personally spoken by Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Like a stringed instrument, I vibrate whatever He causes me to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.74
description: "In this way the Lord speaks through my mouth to preach the cult of Kṛṣṇa consciousness. Within the world, who will understand this pastime of the Lord?'
text:
> mora mukhe kahāya kathā, kare paracāra
> pṛthivīte ke jānibe e-līlā tāṅhāra?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in my mouth; [[synonyms:k:kahāya]]---causes to speak; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---words; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:paracāra]]---preaches; [[synonyms:p:pṛthivīte]]---in this world; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:j:jānibe]]---who will understand; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---this pastime; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]]---His.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.80
description: Although Rāmānanda Rāya was a householder, he was not under the control of the six kinds of bodily change. Although apparently a pounds-and-shillings man, he advised even persons in the renounced order.
text:
> 'gṛhastha' hañā nahe rāya ṣaḍ-vargera vaśe
> 'viṣayī' hañā sannyāsīre upadeśe
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gṛhastha]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being a householder; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṭ]]-[[synonyms:v:vargera]] [[synonyms:v:vaśe]]---under the control of the six kinds of bodily change; [[synonyms:v:viṣayī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being a pounds-and-shillings man; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīre]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---advises persons in the renounced order of life.
translation: Although Rāmānanda Rāya was a householder, he was not under the control of the six kinds of bodily change. Although apparently a pounds-and-shillings man, he advised even persons in the renounced order.
purport: Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya externally appeared to be a //gṛhastha// who was under the influence of the external, material energy, not a self-controlled //brahmacārī, vānaprastha// or //sannyāsī. Gṛhasthas// (householders) who are under the influence of the external energy accept householder life for the purpose of sense enjoyment, but a transcendentally situated Vaiṣṇava is not subjected to the influence of the senses by the Lord's material rule of the six kinds of bodily change (//kāma, krodha, lobha, moha, mada, and mātsarya),// even when he plays the part of a gṛhastha. Thus although Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya acted as a //gṛhastha// and was accepted as an ordinary pounds-and-shillings man, he was always absorbed in the transcendental pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore his mind was spiritually situated, and he was interested only in the subject of Kṛṣṇa. Rāmānanda Rāya was not among the Māyāvādī impersonalists or materialistic logicians who are opposed to the principles of Lord Kṛṣṇa's transcendental pastimes. He was already spiritually situated in the order of renounced life; therefore he was able to turn sand into gold by spiritual potency, or, in other words, to elevate a person from a material to a spiritual position.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.81
description: To demonstrate the transcendental attributes of Rāmānanda Rāya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Pradyumna Miśra to hear discourses about Kṛṣṇa from him.
text:
> ei-saba guṇa tāṅra prakāśa karite
> miśrere pāṭhāilā tāhāṅ śravaṇa karite

translation: To demonstrate the transcendental attributes of Rāmānanda Rāya, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sent Pradyumna Miśra to hear discourses about Kṛṣṇa from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.82
description: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, knows very well how to demonstrate the qualities of His devotees. Therefore, acting like an artistic painter, He does so in various ways and considers this His personal profit.
text:
> bhakta-guṇa prakāśite prabhu bhāla jāne
> nānā-bhaṅgīte guṇa prakāśi' nija-lābha māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---the attributes of a devotee; [[synonyms:p:prakāśite]]---to manifest; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows very well how; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṅgīte]]---by various ways; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---attributes; [[synonyms:p:prakāśi']]---manifesting; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:l:lābha]]---His profit; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---He considers.
translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, knows very well how to demonstrate the qualities of His devotees. Therefore, acting like an artistic painter, He does so in various ways and considers this His personal profit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.83
description: There is yet another characteristic of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O devotees, listen carefully to how He manifests His opulence and characteristics, although they are exceptionally deep.
text:
> āra eka 'svabhāva' gaurera śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
> aiśvarya-svabhāva gūḍha kare prakaṭana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---characteristic; [[synonyms:g:gaurera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---O devotees; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---opulences and characteristics; [[synonyms:g:gūḍha]]---very deep; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭana]]---manifestation.
translation: There is yet another characteristic of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O devotees, listen carefully to how He manifests His opulence and characteristics, although they are exceptionally deep.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.84
description: To vanquish the false pride of so-called renunciants and learned scholars, He spreads real religious principles, even through a śūdra, or lowborn fourth-class man.
text:
> sannyāsī paṇḍita-gaṇera karite garva nāśa
> nīca-śūdra-dvārā karena dharmera prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---persons in the renounced order; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the learned scholars; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:g:garva]]---pride; [[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---vanquishing; [[synonyms:n:nīca]]---lowborn; [[synonyms:ś:śūdra]]---a fourth-class man; [[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---through; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:d:dharmeraprakāśa]]---spreading of real religious principles.
translation: To vanquish the false pride of so-called renunciants and learned scholars, He spreads real religious principles, even through a śūdra, or lowborn fourth-class man.
purport:
When a man is greatly learned in the //Vedānta-sūtras,// he is known as //paṇḍita,// or a learned scholar. Generally this qualifications attributed to //brāhmaṇas// and //sannyāsīs. Sannyāsa,// the renounced order of life, is the topmost position for a //brāhmaṇa,// a member of the highest of the four //varṇas// (//brāhmaṇa, kṣatriya, vaiśya and śūdra).// According to public opinion, a person born in a //brāhmaṇa// family, duly reformed by the purificatory processes and properly initiated by a spiritual master, is an authority on Vedic literature. When such a person is offered the //sannyāsa// order, he comes to occupy the topmost position. The //brāhmaṇa// is supposed to be the spiritual master of the other three //varṇas,// namely //kṣatriya, vaiśya// and //śūdra,// and the //sannyāsī// is supposed to be the spiritual master even of the exalted //brāhmaṇas.//

Generally //brāhmaṇas// and //sannyāsīs// are very proud of their spiritual positions. Therefore, to cut down their false pride, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu preached Kṛṣṇa consciousness through Rāmānanda Rāya, who was neither a member of the renounced order nor a born //brāhmaṇa.// indeed, Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya was a //gṛhastha// belonging to the //śūdra// class, yet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arranged for him to be the master who taught Pradyumna Miśra, a highly qualified //brāhmaṇa// born in a //brāhmaṇa// family. Even Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself, although belonging to the renounced order, took instruction from Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited His opulence through Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya. That is the special significance of this incident.

According to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's philosophy, //yei kṛṣṇa-tattva-vettā, sei 'guru' haya:// anyone who knows the science of Kṛṣṇa can become a spiritual master, without reference to whether or not he is a //brāhmaṇa// or //sannyāsī.// Ordinary people cannot understand the essence of śāstra, nor can they understand the pure character, behavior and abilities of strict followers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's principles. The Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is creating pure, exalted Vaiṣṇavas even from those born in families considered lower than those of //śūdras.// This is proof that a Vaiṣṇava may appear in any family, as confirmed in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam://

> kirāta-hūṇāndhra-pulinda-pulkaśā
> ābhīra-śumbhā yavanāḥ khasādayaḥ
> ye 'nye ca pāpā yad-apāśrayāśrayāḥ
> śudhyanti tasmai prabhaviṣṇave namaḥ

"Kirāta, Hūṇa, Āndhra, Pulinda, Pulkaśa, Ābhīra, Śumbha, Yavana and the //Khasa// races, and even others addicted to sinful acts, can be purified by taking shelter of the devotees of the Lord, for He is the supreme power. I beg to offer my respectful obeisances unto Him." [[books:sb:2:4:18|(Bhāg. 2.4.18)]] By the grace of the Supreme Lord Viṣṇu, one can be completely purified, become a preacher of Kṛṣṇa consciousness, and become the spiritual master of the entire world. This principle is accepted in all Vedic literature. Evidence can be quoted from authoritative //śāstras// showing how a lowborn person can become the spiritual master of the entire world. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is to be considered the most munificent personality, for He distributes the real essence of Vedic //śāstras// to anyone who becomes qualified by becoming His sincere servant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.85
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu preached about devotional service, ecstatic love and the Absolute Truth by making Rāmānanda Rāya, a gṛhastha born in a low family, the speaker. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself, the exalted brāhmaṇa-sannyāsī, and Pradyumna Miśra, the purified brāhmaṇa, both became the hearers of Rāmānanda Rāya.
text:
> 'bhakti', 'prema', 'tattva' kahe rāye kari' 'vaktā'
> āpani pradyumna-miśra-saha haya 'śrotā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:t:tattva]]---truth; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---He says; [[synonyms:r:rāye]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---by making; [[synonyms:v:vaktā]]---the speaker; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---Himself; [[synonyms:p:pradyumna]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Pradyumna Miśra; [[synonyms:s:saha]]---with; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:ś:śrotā]]---becomes the listener.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu preached about devotional service, ecstatic love and the Absolute Truth by making Rāmānanda Rāya, a gṛhastha born in a low family, the speaker. Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu Himself, the exalted brāhmaṇa-sannyāsī, and Pradyumna Miśra, the purified brāhmaṇa, both became the hearers of Rāmānanda Rāya.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says in his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya// that //sannyāsīs// in the line of Śaṅkarācārya always think that they have performed all the duties of //brāhmaṇas// and that, furthermore, having understood the essence of //Vedānta-sūtra// and become //sannyāsīs,// they are the natural spiritual masters of all society. Similarly, persons born in brāhmaṇa families think that because they execute the ritualistic ceremonies recommended in the //Vedas// and follow the principles of //smṛti,// they alone can become spiritual masters of society. These highly exalted //brāhmaṇas// think that unless one is born in a //brāhmaṇa// family, one cannot become a spiritual master and teach the Absolute Truth. To cut down the pride of these birthright //brāhmaṇas// and Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu proved that a person like Rāmānanda Rāya, although born in a //śūdra// family and situated in the //gṛhastha-āśrama,// can become the spiritual master of such exalted personalities as Himself and Pradyumna Miśra. This is the principle of the Vaiṣṇava cult, as evinced in the teachings of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. A person who knows what is spiritual and what is material and who is firmly fixed in the spiritual position can be //jagad-guru,// the spiritual master of the entire world. One cannot become //jagad-guru// simply by advertising oneself as //jagad-guru// without knowing the essential principles for becoming //jagad-guru.// Even people who never see what a //jagad-guru// is and never talk with other people become puffed-up //sannyāsīs// and declare themselves //jagad-gurus.// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not like this. Any person who knows the science of Kṛṣṇa and who is fully qualified in spiritual life can become //jagad-guru.// Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally took lessons from Śrī Rāmānanda Rāya and also sent Pradyumna Miśra, an exalted //brāhmaṇa,// to take lessons from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.86
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited the glories of the holy name of the Lord through Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who was born in a Mohammedan family. Similarly, He exhibited the essence of devotional service through Sanātana Gosvāmī, who had almost been converted into a Mohammedan.
text:
> haridāsa-dvārā nāma-māhātmya-prakāśa
> sanātana-dvārā bhakti-siddhānta-vilāsa

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exhibited the glories of the holy name of the Lord through Haridāsa Ṭhākura, who was born in a Mohammedan family. Similarly, He exhibited the essence of devotional service through Sanātana Gosvāmī, who had almost been converted into a Mohammedan.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.87
description: The Lord also fully exhibited the ecstatic love and transcendental pastimes of Vṛndāvana through Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. Considering all this, who can understand the deep plans of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

translation: The Lord also fully exhibited the ecstatic love and transcendental pastimes of Vṛndāvana through Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī. Considering all this, who can understand the deep plans of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.88
description: The activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are just like an ocean of nectar. Even a drop of this ocean ca inundate all the three worlds.
text:
> śrī-caitanya-līlā ei---amṛtera sindhu
> trijagat bhāsāite pāre yāra eka bindu
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---transcendental activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]] [[synonyms:s:sindhu]]---the ocean of nectar; [[synonyms:t:tri]]-[[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the three worlds; [[synonyms:b:bhāsāite]]---to inundate; [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---is able; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of which; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:b:bindu]]---one drop.
translation: The activities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are just like an ocean of nectar. Even a drop of this ocean ca inundate all the three worlds.
purport: To inundate the three worlds with nectar is the purpose of the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. How this could be possible was exhibited by Śrīla Raghunātha Gosvāmī and later by Ṭhākura Narottama dāsa and Śyāmānanda Gosvāmī, who all represented the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Now that same mercy is overflooding the entire world through the Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement. The present Kṛṣṇa consciousness movement is nondifferent from the pastimes performed by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu when He was personally present, for the same principles are being followed and the same actions performed without fail.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 5.97
description: If there were a hint that transcendental mellows overlapped in a manner contrary to the principles of the bhakti cult, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not tolerate it and would become very angry.
text:

> sahite nā pāre prabhu, mane haya krodha
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---overlapping of transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]-[[synonyms:v:virodha]]---against the principles of the bhakti cult; [[synonyms:s:sahite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---cannot tolerate; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---anger.
translation: If there were a hint that transcendental mellows overlapped in a manner contrary to the principles of the bhakti cult, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would not tolerate it and would become very angry.
purport:
Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura quotes the following definition of //rasābhāsa// from the //Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu// (//Uttara-vibhāga,// Ninth Wave, 1-3,20,22,24):

> pūrvam evānuśiṣṭena
> vikalā rasa-lakṣaṇā
> rasā eva rasābhāsā
> rasajñair anukīrtitāḥ
>
> syus tridhoparasāś cānu-
> rasāś cāparasāś ca te
> uttamā madhyamāḥ proktāḥ
> kaniṣṭhāś cety amī kramāt
>
> prāptaiḥ sthāyi-vibhāvānu-
> bhāvādyais tu virūpatām
> śāntādayo rasā eva
> dvādaśoparasā matāḥ
>
> bhaktādibhir vibhāvādyaiḥ
> kṛṣṇa-sambandha-varjitaiḥ
> rasā hāsyādayaḥ sapta
> śāntaś cānurasā matāḥ
>
> kṛṣṇa-tat-pratipakṣaś ced
> viṣayāśrayatāṁ gatāḥ
> hāsādīnāṁ tadā te 'tra
> prājñair aparasā matāḥ
>
> bhāvāḥ sarve tadābhāsā
> rasābhāsāś ca kecana
> amī prokta-rasābhijñaiḥ
> sarve 'pi rasanād rasāḥ

A mellow temporarily appearing transcendental but contradicting mellows previously stated and lacking some of a mellow's necessities is called //rasābhāsa,// an overlapping mellow, by advanced devotees who know how to taste transcendental mellows. Such mellows are called //uparasa// (submellows), //anurasa// (imitation transcendental mellows) and //aparasa// (opposing transcendental mellows). Thus the overlapping of transcendental mellows is described as being first //grade,// second grade or third grade. When the twelve mellows-such as neutrality, servitorship and friendship-are characterized by adverse //sthāyi-bhāva, vibhāva// and //anubhāva// ecstasies, they are known as //uparasa,// submellows. When the seven indirect transcendental mellows and the dried up mellow of neutrality are produced by devotees and moods not directly related to Kṛṣṇa and devotional service in ecstatic love, they are described as //anurasa,// imitation mellows. If Kṛṣṇa and the enemies who harbor feelings of opposition toward Him are respectively the object and abodes of the mellow of laughter, the resulting feelings are called //aparasa,// opposing mellows. Experts in distinguishing one mellow from another sometimes accept some overlapping transcendental mellows (rasābhāsa) as //rasas// due to their being pleasurable and tasteful. Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura says, //paraspara-vairayor yadi yogas tadā rasābhāsaḥ:// "When two opposing transcendental mellows overlap, they produce //rasābhāsa,// or an overlapping of transcendental mellows."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.103
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was observing the dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Nityānanda Prabhu could see this, but the others could not.
text:
> mahāprabhu tāṅra nṛtya karena daraśana
> sabe nityānanda dekhe, nā dekhe anya-jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---sees; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---Nityānanda Prabhu sees; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---do not see; [[synonyms:a:anya]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---others.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was observing the dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu. Nityānanda Prabhu could see this, but the others could not.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.104
description: The dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, like the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, cannot be compared to anything within these three worlds.
text:
> nityānandera nṛtya,---yena tāṅhāra nartane
> upamā dibāra nāhi e-tina bhuvane
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānandera]] [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---the dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhāra]] [[synonyms:n:nartane]]---with the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:upamā]] [[synonyms:d:dibāra]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there cannot be any comparison; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:b:bhuvane]]---within these three worlds.
translation: The dancing of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, like the dancing of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, cannot be compared to anything within these three worlds.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.105
description: No one can properly describe the sweetness of Lord Nityānanda's dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally comes to see it.
text:
> nṛtyera mādhurī kebā varṇibāre pāre
> mahāprabhu āise yei nṛtya dekhibāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛtyera]] [[synonyms:m:mādhurī]]---the sweetness of the dancing; [[synonyms:k:kebā]]---who; [[synonyms:v:varṇibāre]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can describe; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu comes; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see.
translation: No one can properly describe the sweetness of Lord Nityānanda's dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally comes to see it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.106
description: After the dancing and after Lord Nityānanda had rested, Rāghava Paṇḍita submitted his request that the Lord take supper.
text:
> nṛtya kari' prabhu yabe viśrāma karilā
> bhojanera lāgi' paṇḍita nivedana kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after dancing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:v:viśrāma]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---took rest; [[synonyms:b:bhojanera]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for His eating; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nivedana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---submitted a request.
translation: After the dancing and after Lord Nityānanda had rested, Rāghava Paṇḍita submitted his request that the Lord take supper.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.107
description: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu sat down for supper with His personal associates and made a sitting place on His right side for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> bhojane vasilā prabhu nija-gaṇa lañā
> mahāprabhura āsana ḍāhine pātiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---to eat; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with His own personal associates; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsana]]---sitting place; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāhine]] [[synonyms:p:pātiyā]]---setting on the right side.
translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu sat down for supper with His personal associates and made a sitting place on His right side for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.108
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there and sat down at His place. Seeing this, Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness. Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness.
text:
> mahāprabhu āsi' sei āsane vasila
> dekhi' rāghavera mane ānanda bāḍila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ā:āsane]]---on that seat; [[synonyms:v:vasila]]---sat down; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---great happiness; [[synonyms:b:bāḍila]]---increased.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there and sat down at His place. Seeing this, Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness. Rāghava Paṇḍita felt increasing happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.109
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita brought the prasāda before the two brothers and thereafter distributed prasāda to all the other Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> dui-bhāi-āge prasāda āniyā dharilā
> sakala vaiṣṇave piche pariveśana kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of the two brothers; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the remnants of food offered to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---put; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇave]]---to all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:p:piche]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:p:pariveśana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---distributed.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita brought the prasāda before the two brothers and thereafter distributed prasāda to all the other Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.11
description: To describe the fortunate position of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is extremely difficult. They were renowned as intimately confidential friends of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei dui janāra saubhāgya kahana nā yāya
> prabhura 'antaraṅga' bali' yāṅre loke gāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:janāra]]---of these two personalities; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgya]]---fortune; [[synonyms:k:kahana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---cannot be described; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:antaraṅga]]---very intimate and confidential associates; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---as; [[synonyms:y:yāṅre]]---whom; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---people; [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---say.
translation: To describe the fortunate position of Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is extremely difficult. They were renowned as intimately confidential friends of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.110
description: There were varieties of cakes, sweet rice and fine cooked rice that surpassed the taste of nectar. There were also varieties of vegetables.
text:
> nānā-prakāra piṭhā, pāyasa, divya śālyanna
> amṛta nindaye aiche vividha vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāra]] [[synonyms:p:piṭhā]]---various types of cake; [[synonyms:p:pāyasa]]---sweet rice; [[synonyms:d:divya]] [[synonyms:ś:śālyanna]]---fine cooked rice; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar; [[synonyms:n:nindaye]]---surpassed; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:v:vividha]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---varieties of vegetables.
translation: There were varieties of cakes, sweet rice and fine cooked rice that surpassed the taste of nectar. There were also varieties of vegetables.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.111
description: The food prepared and offered to the Deity by Rāghava Paṇḍita was like the essence of nectar. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there again and again to eat such prasāda.
text:
> rāghava-ṭhākurera prasāda amṛtera sāra
> mahāprabhu yāhā khāite āise bāra bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurera]]---of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---food offered to the Deity; [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]] [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence of nectar; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]]---which; [[synonyms:k:khāite]]---to eat; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---came; [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again.
translation: The food prepared and offered to the Deity by Rāghava Paṇḍita was like the essence of nectar. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came there again and again to eat such prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.112
description: When Rāghava Paṇḍita offered the food to the Deity after cooking, he would make a separate offering for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> pāka kari' rāghava yabe bhoga lāgāya
> mahāprabhura lāgi' bhoga pṛthak bāḍaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after cooking; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava paṇḍita; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāya]]---offers food to the Deity; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---offering; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]]---separate; [[synonyms:b:bāḍaya]]---arranges.
translation: When Rāghava Paṇḍita offered the food to the Deity after cooking, he would make a separate offering for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.113
description: Every day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would eat at the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. Sometimes He would give Rāghava Paṇḍita the opportunity to see Him.
text:
> prati-dina mahāprabhu karena bhojana
> madhye madhye prabhu tāṅre dena daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---daily; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eats; [[synonyms:m:madhye]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:dena]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---gives His audience.
translation: Every day, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would eat at the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita. Sometimes He would give Rāghava Paṇḍita the opportunity to see Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.114
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita would bring and distribute prasāda to the two brothers, feeding Them with great attention. They ate everything, and therefore there were no remnants left.
text:
> dui bhāire rāghava āni' pariveśe
> yatna kari' khāoyāya, nā rahe avaśeṣe
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāire]]---to the two brothers; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:p:pariveśe]]---distributed; [[synonyms:y:yatna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great attention; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāya]]---fed Them; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]] [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣe]]---there were no remnants.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita would bring and distribute prasāda to the two brothers, feeding Them with great attention. They ate everything, and therefore there were no remnants left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.115
description: He brought so many presentations that no one could know them perfectly. Indeed, it was a fact that the supreme mother, Rādhārāṇī, personally cooked in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita.
text:
> kata upahāra āne, hena nāhi jāni
> rāghavera ghare rāndhe rādhā-ṭhākurāṇī
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:u:upahāra]]---many presentations; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---brings; [[synonyms:h:hena]]---such; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I cannot understand; [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at the house of Rāghava paṇḍita; [[synonyms:r:rāndhe]]---cooks; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurāṇī]]---the supreme mother, Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
translation: He brought so many presentations that no one could know them perfectly. Indeed, it was a fact that the supreme mother, Rādhārāṇī, personally cooked in the house of Rāghava Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.116
description: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī received from Durvāsā Muni the benediction that whatever She cooked would be sweeter than nectar. That is the special feature of Her cooking.
text:
> durvāsāra ṭhāñi teṅho pāñāchena vara
> amṛta ha-ite pāka tāṅra adhika madhura
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:durvāsāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Durvāsā Muni; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---She; [[synonyms:p:pāñāchena]] [[synonyms:v:vara]]---got the benediction; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---than nectar; [[synonyms:p:pāka]]---cooking; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---Her; [[synonyms:a:adhika]] [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---more sweet.
translation: Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī received from Durvāsā Muni the benediction that whatever She cooked would be sweeter than nectar. That is the special feature of Her cooking.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.117
description: Aromatic and pleasing to see, the food was the essence of all sweetness. Thus the two brothers, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, ate it with great satisfaction.
text:
> sugandhi sundara prasāda---mādhuryera sāra
> dui bhāi tāhā khāñā santoṣa apāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhi]]---fragrant; [[synonyms:s:sundara]]---beautiful; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---food; [[synonyms:m:mādhuryera]] [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence of all sweetness; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---eating; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]] [[synonyms:a:apāra]]---very, very happy.
translation: Aromatic and pleasing to see, the food was the essence of all sweetness. Thus the two brothers, Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, ate it with great satisfaction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.118
description: All the devotees present requested Raghunātha dāsa to sit down and take prasāda, but Rāghava Paṇḍita told them, "He will take prasāda later."
text:
> bhojane vasite raghunāthe kahe sarva-jana
> paṇḍita kahe,---iṅha pāche karibe bhojana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojane]]---to eat; [[synonyms:v:vasite]]---to sit down; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---unto Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---requested; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---everyone; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:i:iṅha]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---later; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---will take food.
translation: All the devotees present requested Raghunātha dāsa to sit down and take prasāda, but Rāghava Paṇḍita told them, "He will take prasāda later."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.119
description: All the devotees took prasāda, filling themselves to the brim. Thereafter, chanting the holy name of Hari, they stood up and washed their hands and mouths.
text:
> bhakta-gaṇa ākaṇṭha bhariyā karila bhojana
> 'hari' dhvani kari' uṭhi' kailā ācamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:ā:ākaṇṭha]]---up to the neck; [[synonyms:b:bhariyā]]---filling; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---took prasāda; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---chanting of the holy name of Hari; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---doing; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---washed their mouths and hands.
translation: All the devotees took prasāda, filling themselves to the brim. Thereafter, chanting the holy name of Hari, they stood up and washed their hands and mouths.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.12
description: The Lord thus enjoyed His life with His devotees. O devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, now hear how Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī met the Lord.
text:
> ei-mata vihare gaura lañā bhakta-gaṇa
> raghunātha-milana ebe śuna, bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:v:vihare]]---enjoys; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---keeping company with His devotees; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:m:milana]]---meeting with Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---O devotees.
translation: The Lord thus enjoyed His life with His devotees. O devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, now hear how Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī met the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.120
description: After eating, the two brothers washed Their hands and mouths. Then Rāghava Paṇḍita brought flower garlands and sandalwood pulp and decorated Them.
text:
> bhojana kari' dui bhāi kailā ācamana
> rāghava āni' parāilā mālya-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after eating; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]]---washed Their hands and mouths; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:p:parāilā]]---decorated Them with; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---flower garlands and sandalwood pulp.
translation: After eating, the two brothers washed Their hands and mouths. Then Rāghava Paṇḍita brought flower garlands and sandalwood pulp and decorated Them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.121
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita offered Them betel nuts and worshiped Their lotus feet. He also distributed betel nuts, flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to the devotees.
text:
> biḍā khāoyāilā, kailā caraṇa vandana
> bhakta-gaṇe dilā biḍā, mālya-candana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:biḍā]] [[synonyms:k:khāoyāilā]]---he offered betel nuts; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---prayed to the lotus feet; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto the devotees; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:b:biḍā]]---betel nuts; [[synonyms:m:mālya]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---garlands and sandalwood pulp.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita offered Them betel nuts and worshiped Their lotus feet. He also distributed betel nuts, flower garlands and sandalwood pulp to the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.122
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita, being very merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, offered him the dishes with the remnants of food left by the two brothers.
text:
> rāghavera kṛpā raghunāthera upare
> dui bhāiera avaśiṣṭa pātra dilā tāṅre
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghavera]]---of Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---unto Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāiera]]---of the two brothers; [[synonyms:a:avaśiṣṭa]]---of remnants of food; [[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the dishes; [[synonyms:d:dilā]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---offered to him.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita, being very merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, offered him the dishes with the remnants of food left by the two brothers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.123
description: He said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has eaten this food. If you take His remnants, you will be released from the bondage of your family."
text:
> kahilā,---"caitanya gosāñi kariyāchena bhojana
> tāṅra śeṣa pāile, tomāra khaṇḍila bandhana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---he said; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---has eaten; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]---His remnants; [[synonyms:p:pāile]]---if you take; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍila]]---will cease; [[synonyms:b:bandhana]]---bondage.
translation: He said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has eaten this food. If you take His remnants, you will be released from the bondage of your family."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.124
description: The Supreme Personality of Godhead always resides either in the heart or in the home of a devotee. This fact is sometimes hidden and sometimes manifest, for the Supreme Personality of Godhead is fully independent.
text:
> bhakta-citte bhakta-gṛhe sadā avasthāna
> kabhu gupta, kabhu vyakta, svatantra bhagavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the heart of a devotee; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhe]]---at the house of a devotee; [[synonyms:s:sadā]] [[synonyms:a:avasthāna]]---always resides; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:g:gupta]]---sometimes hidden; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:v:vyakta]]---sometimes manifest; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]]---fully independent; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead always resides either in the heart or in the home of a devotee. This fact is sometimes hidden and sometimes manifest, for the Supreme Personality of Godhead is fully independent.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.125
description: The Supreme Personality of Godhead is all-pervasive, and therefore He resides everywhere. Anyone who doubts this will be annihilated.
text:
> sarvatra 'vyāpaka' prabhura sadā sarvatra vāsa
> ihāte saṁśaya yāra, sei yāya nāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarvatra]]---everywhere; [[synonyms:v:vyāpaka]]---pervading; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:s:sarvatra]]---everywhere; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]]---residence; [[synonyms:i:ihāte]]---about this; [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---doubt; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---becomes annihilated.
translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead is all-pervasive, and therefore He resides everywhere. Anyone who doubts this will be annihilated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.126
description: In the morning, after taking His bath in the Ganges, Nityānanda Prabhu sat down with His associates beneath the same tree under which He had previously sat.
text:
> prāte nityānanda prabhu gaṅgā-snāna kariyā
> sei vṛkṣa-mūle vasilā nija-gaṇa lañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prāte]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]] [[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bathing in the Ganges; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---after doing; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:m:mūle]]---under that tree; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with His associates.
translation: In the morning, after taking His bath in the Ganges, Nityānanda Prabhu sat down with His associates beneath the same tree under which He had previously sat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.127
description: Raghunātha dāsa went there and worshiped Lord Nityānanda's lotus feet. Through Rāghava Paṇḍita, he submitted his desire.
text:
> raghunātha āsi' kailā caraṇa vandana
> rāghava-paṇḍita-dvārā kailā nivedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---worshiped His lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---through Rāghava paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submitted his desire.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa went there and worshiped Lord Nityānanda's lotus feet. Through Rāghava Paṇḍita, he submitted his desire.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.128
description: "I am the lowest of men, the most sinful, fallen and condemned. Nevertheless, I desire to attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> "adhama, pāmara mui hīna jīvādhama!
> mora icchā haya---pāṅa caitanya-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:adhama]]---the most fallen; [[synonyms:p:pāmara]]---the most sinful; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:h:hīna]]---condemned; [[synonyms:j:jīva]]-[[synonyms:a:adhama]]---the lowest of all living beings; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:pāṅa]]---I can get; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: "I am the lowest of men, the most sinful, fallen and condemned. Nevertheless, I desire to attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.129
description: "Like a dwarf who wants to catch the moon, I have tried my best many times, but I have never been successful.
text:
> vāmana hañā yena cānda dharibāre cāya
> aneka yatna kainu, tāte kabhu siddha naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāmana]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being a dwarf; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:c:cānda]]---the moon; [[synonyms:d:dharibāre]]---to catch; [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---wants; [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:y:yatna]]---many attempts; [[synonyms:k:kainu]]---I have made; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in that; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:s:siddha]] [[synonyms:n:naya]]---I have not been successful.
translation: "Like a dwarf who wants to catch the moon, I have tried my best many times, but I have never been successful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.13
description: When Raghunātha dāsa, during his family life, went to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Śāntipura, the Lord gave him worthy instructions by His causeless mercy.
text:
> pūrve śāntipure raghunātha yabe āilā
> mahāprabhu kṛpā kari' tāṅre śikhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:ś:śāntipure]]---to Śāntipura; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:y:yabe]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---when he came; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---showing causeless mercy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---gave him lessons.
translation: When Raghunātha dāsa, during his family life, went to meet Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu at Śāntipura, the Lord gave him worthy instructions by His causeless mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.130
description: "Every time I tried to go away and give up my home relationships, my father and mother unfortunately kept me bound.
text:
> yata-bāra palāi āmi gṛhādi chādiyā
> pitā, mātā---dui more rākhaye bāndhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yata]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---as many times; [[synonyms:p:palāi]]---go away; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:g:gṛha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---giving up my relationship with home; [[synonyms:p:pitā]] [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---father and mother; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---both of them; [[synonyms:m:more]]---me; [[synonyms:r:rākhaye]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]]---keep bound.
translation: "Every time I tried to go away and give up my home relationships, my father and mother unfortunately kept me bound.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.131
description: "No one can attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without Your mercy, but if You are merciful, even the lowest of men ca attain shelter at His lotus feet.
text:
> tomāra kṛpā vinā keha 'caitanya' nā pāya
> tumi kṛpā kaile tāṅre adhameha pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---Your mercy; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---anyone; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---cannot get; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kaile]]---if You are merciful; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Him; [[synonyms:a:adhameha]]---even the fallen soul; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---can get.
translation: "No one can attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without Your mercy, but if You are merciful, even the lowest of men ca attain shelter at His lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.132
description: "Although I am unfit and greatly afraid to submit this plea, I nevertheless request You, sir, to be especially merciful toward me by granting me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ayogya mui nivedana karite kari bhaya
> more 'caitanya' deha' gosāñi hañā sadaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ayogya]]---unfit; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nivedana]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to submit my desires; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---I am afraid; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---kindly give the shelter of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---O my Lord; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:d:daya]]---being merciful.
translation: "Although I am unfit and greatly afraid to submit this plea, I nevertheless request You, sir, to be especially merciful toward me by granting me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.133
description: "Placing Your feet on my head, give me the benediction that I may achieve the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without difficulty. I pray for this benediction."
text:
> mora māthe pada dhari' karaha prasāda
> nirvighne caitanya pāṅa---kara āśīrvāda"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:māthe]]---upon my head; [[synonyms:p:pada]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---keeping Your feet; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---bless me; [[synonyms:n:nirvighne]]---without difficulty; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:p:pāṅa]]---I may get the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:ā:āśīrvāda]]---give this benediction.
translation: "Placing Your feet on my head, give me the benediction that I may achieve the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without difficulty. I pray for this benediction."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.134
description: After hearing this appeal by Raghunātha dāsa, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and told all the devotees, "Raghunātha dāsa's standard of material happiness is equal to that of Indra, the King of heaven.
text:
> śuni' hāsi' kahe prabhu saba bhakta-gaṇe
> "ihāra viṣaya-sukha---indra-sukha-sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---smiling; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto all the devotees; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---material happiness; [[synonyms:i:indra]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]---the material happiness of the King of heaven, Indra; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---equal to.
translation: After hearing this appeal by Raghunātha dāsa, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and told all the devotees, "Raghunātha dāsa's standard of material happiness is equal to that of Indra, the King of heaven.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.135
description: "Because of the mercy bestowed upon him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, although situated in such material happiness, does not like it at all. Therefore let every one of you be merciful toward him and give him the benediction that he may very soon attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> caitanya-kṛpāte seha nāhi bhāya mane
> sabe āśīrvāda kara---pāuka caitanya-caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by the mercy of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---such a standard of material happiness; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:b:bhāya]]---he does not take as valuable; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---at mind; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:ā:āśīrvāda]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---give the benediction; [[synonyms:p:pāuka]]---let him get; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---the shelter of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: "Because of the mercy bestowed upon him by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa, although situated in such material happiness, does not like it at all. Therefore let every one of you be merciful toward him and give him the benediction that he may very soon attain shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.136
description: "One who experiences the fragrance of the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa does not even value the standard of happiness available in Brahmaloka, the topmost planet. And what to speak of heavenly happiness?
text:
> kṛṣṇa-pāda-padma-gandha yei jana pāya
> brahmaloka-ādi-sukha tāṅre nāhi bhāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:p:padma]]---of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---the fragrance; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---of Brahmaloka; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:b:bhāya]]---does not appear valuable.
translation: "One who experiences the fragrance of the lotus feet of Lord Kṛṣṇa does not even value the standard of happiness available in Brahmaloka, the topmost planet. And what to speak of heavenly happiness?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.137
description: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is offered sublime, poetic prayers by those trying to attain His favor. Thus He is known as Uttamaśloka. Being very eager to gain the association of Lord Kṛṣṇa, King Bharata, although in the prime of youth, gave up his very attractive wife, affectionate children, most beloved friends and opulent kingdom, exactly as one gives up stool after excreting it.' "
text:
> yo dustyajān dāra-sutān
> suhṛd-rājyaṁ hṛdi-spṛśaḥ
> jahau yuvaiva malavad
> uttama-śloka-lālasaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---who (Bharata Mahārāja); [[synonyms:d:dustyajān]]---difficult to give up; [[synonyms:d:dāra]]-[[synonyms:s:sutān]]---wife and children; [[synonyms:s:suhṛt]]---friends; [[synonyms:r:rājyam]]---kingdom; [[synonyms:h:hṛdi]]-[[synonyms:s:spṛśaḥ]]---dear to the core of the heart; [[synonyms:j:jahau]]---gave up; [[synonyms:y:yuvā]]---youth; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:malavat]]---like stool; [[synonyms:u:uttama]]-[[synonyms:ś:śloka]]-[[synonyms:l:lālasaḥ]]---being captivated by the transcendental qualities, pastimes and association of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "Lord Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is offered sublime, poetic prayers by those trying to attain His favor. Thus He is known as Uttamaśloka. Being very eager to gain the association of Lord Kṛṣṇa, King Bharata, although in the prime of youth, gave up his very attractive wife, affectionate children, most beloved friends and opulent kingdom, exactly as one gives up stool after excreting it.' "
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:5:14:43|(5.14.43)]].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.138
description: Then Lord Nityānanda Prabhu called Raghunātha dāsa near Him, placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head and began to speak.
text:
> tabe raghunāthe prabhu nikaṭe bolāila
> tāṅra māthe pada dhari' kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]] [[synonyms:b:bolāilā]]---called nearby; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:māthe]]---on his head; [[synonyms:p:pada]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---keeping His feet; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: Then Lord Nityānanda Prabhu called Raghunātha dāsa near Him, placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head and began to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.139
description: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa," He said, "since you arranged the feast on the bank of the Ganges, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came here just to show you His mercy.
text:
> "tumi ye karāilā ei pulina-bhojana
> tomāya kṛpā kari' gaura kailā āgamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---caused to do; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pulina]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---picnic on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---unto you; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---came.
translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa," He said, "since you arranged the feast on the bank of the Ganges, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu came here just to show you His mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.14
description: Instead of becoming a so-called renunciate, Raghunātha dāsa, foIlowing the instructions of the Lord, returned home and played exactly like a pounds-and-shillings man.
text:
> prabhura śikṣāte teṅho nija-ghare yāya
> markaṭa-vairāgya chāḍi' hailā 'viṣayi-prāya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ś:śikṣāte]]---by the instruction of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:y:yā]] [[synonyms:y:ya]]---returned to his home; [[synonyms:m:markaṭa]]-[[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---monkey renunciation; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became; [[synonyms:v:viṣayi]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like a pounds-and-shillings man.
translation: Instead of becoming a so-called renunciate, Raghunātha dāsa, foIlowing the instructions of the Lord, returned home and played exactly like a pounds-and-shillings man.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.140
description: "By His causeless mercy He ate the chipped rice and milk. Then, after seeing the dancing of the devotees at night, He took His supper.
text:
> kṛpā kari' kailā ciḍā-dugdha bhojana
> nṛtya dekhi' rātrye kailā prasāda bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---by His causeless mercy; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]-[[synonyms:d:dugdha]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eating of the chipped rice and milk; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing the dancing; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---ate the prasāda.
translation: "By His causeless mercy He ate the chipped rice and milk. Then, after seeing the dancing of the devotees at night, He took His supper.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.141
description: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gaurahari, came here personally to deliver you. Now rest assured that all the impediments meant for your bondage are gone.
text:
> tomā uddhārite gaura āilā āpane
> chuṭila tomāra yata vighnādi-bandhane
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---you; [[synonyms:u:uddhārite]]---to deliver; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gaurahari; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]] [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---came personally; [[synonyms:c:chuṭila]]---have gone; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all kinds of; [[synonyms:v:vighna]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhane]]---impediments for bondage.
translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gaurahari, came here personally to deliver you. Now rest assured that all the impediments meant for your bondage are gone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.142
description: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu will accept you and place you under the charge of His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara. You will thus become one of the most confidential internal servants and will attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> svarūpera sthāne tomā karibe samarpaṇe
> 'antaraṅga' bhṛtya bali' rākhibe caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---unto Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---you; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇe]]---He will give; [[synonyms:a:antaraṅga]]---very confidential; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---servant; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---as; [[synonyms:r:rākhibe]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---will keep under His lotus feet.
translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu will accept you and place you under the charge of His secretary, Svarūpa Dāmodara. You will thus become one of the most confidential internal servants and will attain the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.143
text:
> niścinta hañā yāha āpana-bhavana
> acire nirvighne pābe caitanya-caraṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:niścinta]]---without anxiety; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:b:bhavana]]---to your own place; [[synonyms:a:acire]]---very soon; [[synonyms:n:nirvighne]]---without impediments; [[synonyms:p:pābe]]---you will get; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the shelter of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: "Being assured of all this, return to your own home. Very soon, without impediments, you will attain the shelter of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.144
description: Lord Nityānanda had Raghunātha dāsa blessed by all the devotees, and Raghunātha dāsa offered his respects to their lotus feet.
text:
> saba bhakta-dvāre tāṅre āśīrvāda karāilā
> tāṅ-sabāra caraṇa raghunātha vandilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---by the devotees; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:ā:āśīrvāda]] [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---had him blessed; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghu nātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---worshiped.
translation: Lord Nityānanda had Raghunātha dāsa blessed by all the devotees, and Raghunātha dāsa offered his respects to their lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.145
description: After taking leave of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and then all the other Vaiṣṇavas, Srī Raghunātha dāsa consulted secretly with Rāghava Paṇḍita.
text:
> prabhu-ājñā lañā vaiṣṇavera ājñā la-ilā
> rāghava-sahite nibhṛte yukti karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the order of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the permission of all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---he took; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:s:sahite]]---with Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nibhṛte]]---in a solitary place; [[synonyms:y:yukti]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---he consulted.
translation: After taking leave of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and then all the other Vaiṣṇavas, Srī Raghunātha dāsa consulted secretly with Rāghava Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.146
description: After consulting with Rāghava Paṇḍita, he secretly delivered one hundred gold coins and about seven tolās of gold to the hand of Nityānanda Prabhu's treasurer.
text:
> yukti kari' śata mudrā, soṇā tolā-sāte
> nibhṛte dilā prabhura bhāṇḍārīra hāte
