synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yukti]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after consultation; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---one hundred coins; [[synonyms:s:soṇā]]---in gold pieces; [[synonyms:t:tolā]]-[[synonyms:s:sāte]]---about seven //tolās// (about two and a half ounces); [[synonyms:n:nibhṛte]]---secretly; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhāṇḍārīra]]---of the treasurer; [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---into the hand.
translation: After consulting with Rāghava Paṇḍita, he secretly delivered one hundred gold coins and about seven tolās of gold to the hand of Nityānanda Prabhu's treasurer.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.147
description: Raghunātha dāsa admonished the treasurer, "Do not speak about this to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu now, but when He returns home, kindly inform Him about this presentation."
text:
> tāṅre niṣedhilā,---"prabhure ebe nā kahibā
> nija-ghare yābena yabe tabe nivedibā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:niṣedhilā]]---he forbade; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahibā]]---do not speak; [[synonyms:n:nila]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to His home; [[synonyms:y:yābena]]---will return; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:n:nivedibā]]---kindly inform Him.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa admonished the treasurer, "Do not speak about this to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu now, but when He returns home, kindly inform Him about this presentation."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.148
description: Thereupon, Rāghava Paṇḍita took Raghunātha dāsa to his home. After inducing him to see the Deity, he gave Raghunātha dāsa a garland and sandalwood pulp.
text:
> tabe rāghava-paṇḍita tāṅre ghare lañā gelā
> ṭhākura darśana karāñā mālā-candana dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---took to his home; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:k:karāñā]]---after inducing him to see the Deity; [[synonyms:m:mālā]]-[[synonyms:c:candana]]---a garland and sandalwood pulp; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered.
translation: Thereupon, Rāghava Paṇḍita took Raghunātha dāsa to his home. After inducing him to see the Deity, he gave Raghunātha dāsa a garland and sandalwood pulp.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.149
description: He gave Raghunātha dāsa a large quantity of prasāda to eat on his way home. Then Raghunātha dāsa again spoke to Rāghava Paṇḍita.
text:
> aneka 'prasāda' dilā pathe khāibāre
> tabe punaḥ raghunātha kahe paṇḍitere
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---much //prasāda//; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered; [[synonyms:p:pathe]] [[synonyms:k:khāibāre]]---to eat on his way; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Raghunātha dāsa said; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitere]]---to Rāghava Paṇḍita.
translation: He gave Raghunātha dāsa a large quantity of prasāda to eat on his way home. Then Raghunātha dāsa again spoke to Rāghava Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.15
description: Raghunātha dāsa was inwardly completely renounced, even in family life, but he did not express his renunciation externally. Instead, he acted just like an ordinary businessman. Seeing this, his father and mother were satisfied.
text:
> bhitare vairāgya, bāhire kare sarva-karma
> dekhiyā ta' mātā-pitāra ānandita mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhitare]]---within his heart; [[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---complete renunciation; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karma]]---activities; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:p:pitāra]]---of the father and mother; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]]---satisfied; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa was inwardly completely renounced, even in family life, but he did not express his renunciation externally. Instead, he acted just like an ordinary businessman. Seeing this, his father and mother were satisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.150
description: "I want to give money," he said, "just to worship the lotus feet of all the great devotees, servants and subservants of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu.
text:
> "prabhura saṅge yata mahānta, bhṛtya āśrita jana
> pūjite cāhiye āmi sabāra caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:m:mahānta]]---great devotees; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---servants; [[synonyms:ā:āśrita]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---subservient people; [[synonyms:p:pūjite]]---to worship; [[synonyms:c:cāhiye]]---want; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of all of them.
translation: "I want to give money," he said, "just to worship the lotus feet of all the great devotees, servants and subservants of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.151
description: "As you think fit, give twenty, fifteen, twelve, ten or five coins to each of them."
text:
> biśa, pañca-daśa, bāra, daśa, pañca haya
> mudrā deha' vicāri' yāra yata yogya haya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:biśa]]---twenty; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:d:daśa]]---fifteen; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---twelve; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]---ten; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]---five; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---coins; [[synonyms:d:deha']]---give; [[synonyms:v:vicāri']]---considering; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much; [[synonyms:y:yogya]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is fit.
translation: "As you think fit, give twenty, fifteen, twelve, ten or five coins to each of them."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.152
description: Raghunātha dāsa drew up an account of the amount to be given and submitted it to Rāghava Paṇḍita, who then made up a list showing how much money was to be paid to each and every devotee.
text:
> saba lekhā kariyā rāghava-pāśa dilā
> yāṅra nāme yata rāghava ciṭhi lekhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:l:lekhā]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---writing; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered to Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]] [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---in whose name; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:ciṭhi]]---a list; [[synonyms:l:lekhāilā]]---had written.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa drew up an account of the amount to be given and submitted it to Rāghava Paṇḍita, who then made up a list showing how much money was to be paid to each and every devotee.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.153
description: With great humility, Raghunātha dāsa placed one hundred gold coins and about two tolās of gold before Rāghava Paṇḍita for all the other devotees.
text:
> eka-śata mudrā āra soṇā tolā-dvaya
> paṇḍitera āge dila kariyā vinaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---one hundred coins; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:s:soṇā]]---gold; [[synonyms:t:tolā]]-[[synonyms:d:dvaya]]---two //tolās//; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---presented; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---with great humility.
translation: With great humility, Raghunātha dāsa placed one hundred gold coins and about two tolās of gold before Rāghava Paṇḍita for all the other devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.154
description: After taking dust from the feet of Rāghava Paṇḍita, Raghunātha dāsa returned to his home, feeling greatly obligated to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu because of having received His merciful benediction.
text:
> tāṅra pada-dhūli lañā svagṛhe āilā
> nityānanda-kṛpā pāñā kṛtārtha mānilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---the dust of the feet; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:g:gṛhe]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---returned to his home; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:k:kṛtārtha]] [[synonyms:m:mānilā]]---he felt greatly obligated.
translation: After taking dust from the feet of Rāghava Paṇḍita, Raghunātha dāsa returned to his home, feeling greatly obligated to Lord Nityānanda Prabhu because of having received His merciful benediction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.155
description: From that day on, he did not go into the interior section of the house. Instead, he would sleep on the Durgā-maṇḍapa [the place where mother Durgā was worshiped].
text:
> sei haite abhyantare nā karena gamana
> bāhire durgā-maṇḍape yāñā karena śayana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from that day; [[synonyms:a:abhyantare]]---in the interior rooms; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---did not go; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:d:durgā]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇḍape]]---to the place where Durgā worship was performed; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---he sleeps.
translation: From that day on, he did not go into the interior section of the house. Instead, he would sleep on the Durgā-maṇḍapa [the place where mother Durgā was worshiped].

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.156
description: There, however, the watchmen alertly kept guard. Raghunātha dāsa was thinking of various means by which to escape their vigilance.
text:
> tāṅhā jāgi' rahe saba rakṣaka-gaṇa
> palāite karena nānā upāya cintana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there; [[synonyms:j:jāgi']]---keeping awake; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---stay; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:r:rakṣaka]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the watch men; [[synonyms:p:palāite]]---to go away; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---means; [[synonyms:c:cintana]]---thinking of.
translation: There, however, the watchmen alertly kept guard. Raghunātha dāsa was thinking of various means by which to escape their vigilance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.157
description: At that time, all the devotees of Bengal were going to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> hena-kāle gauḍa-deśera saba bhakta-gaṇa
> prabhure dekhite nīlācale karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:g:gauḍa]]-[[synonyms:d:deśera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---went.
translation: At that time, all the devotees of Bengal were going to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.158
description: Raghunātha dāsa could not accompany them, for they were so famous that he would immediately have been caught.
text:
> tāṅ-sabāra saṅge raghunātha yāite nā pāre
> prasiddha prakaṭa saṅga, tabahiṅ dharā paḍe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---all of them; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---could not go; [[synonyms:p:prasiddha]]---famous; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]]---known; [[synonyms:s:saṅga]]---group; [[synonyms:t:tabahiṅ]]---immediately; [[synonyms:d:dharā]] [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---he would be caught.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa could not accompany them, for they were so famous that he would immediately have been caught.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.159-160
description: Thus Raghunātha dāsa thought deeply about how to escape, and one night while he was sleeping on the Durgā-maṇḍapa, the priest Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house when only four daṇḍas remained until the end of the night.
text:
> ei-mata cintite daive eka-dine
> bāhire devī-maṇḍape kariyāchena śayane
>
> daṇḍa-cāri rātri yabe āche avaśeṣa
> yadunandana-ācārya tabe karilā praveśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:c:cintite]]---while he was thinking; [[synonyms:d:daive]]---by chance; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---one day; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside the house; [[synonyms:d:devī]]-[[synonyms:m:maṇḍape]]---on the Durgā platform; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:ś:śayane]]---was sleeping; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]]---four //daṇḍas// (ninety-six minutes); [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---night; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ā:āche]] [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]]---there remained; [[synonyms:y:yadunandana]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---the priest of the name Yadunandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:p:praveśa]]---entered.
translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa thought deeply about how to escape, and one night while he was sleeping on the Durgā-maṇḍapa, the priest Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house when only four daṇḍas remained until the end of the night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.16
description: When he received a message that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had returned from Mathurā City, Raghunātha dāsa endeavored to go to the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> 'mathurā haite prabhu āilā',---vārtā yabe pāilā
> prabhu-pāśa calibāre udyoga karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mathurā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from Mathurā; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has come back; [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---message; [[synonyms:y:yabe]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---when he received; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:calibāre]]---to go; [[synonyms:u:udyoga]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---made an endeavor.
translation: When he received a message that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had returned from Mathurā City, Raghunātha dāsa endeavored to go to the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.161
description: Yadunandana Ācārya was the priest and spiritual master of Raghunātha dāsa. Although born in a brāhmaṇa family, he had accepted the mercy of Vāsudeva Datta.
text:
> vāsudeva-dattera teṅha haya 'anugṛhīta'
> raghunāthera 'guru' teṅho haya 'purohita'
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]-[[synonyms:d:dattera]]---of Vāsudeva Datta; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:a:anugṛhīta]]---was given the mercy; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:g:guru]]---the spiritual master; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---was; [[synonyms:p:purohita]]---the priest.
translation: Yadunandana Ācārya was the priest and spiritual master of Raghunātha dāsa. Although born in a brāhmaṇa family, he had accepted the mercy of Vāsudeva Datta.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that although the atheists who have deviated from the order of Śrī Advaita Ācārya introduce themselves as followers of Advaita Ācārya, they do not accept Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa. Yadunandana Ācārya, one of the most confidential followers of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was the initiated disciple of Advaita Ācārya. He was not polluted by sentimental distinctions classifying Vaiṣṇavas according to birth. Therefore although Vāsudeva Datta had not been born in a //brāhmaṇa// family, Yadunandana Ācārya accepted Vāsudeva Datta as his spiritual master.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.162
description: Yadunandana Ācārya had been officially initiated by Advaita Ācārya. Thus he considered Lord Caitanya his life and soul.
text:
> advaita-ācāryera teṅha 'śiṣya antaraṅga'
> ācārya-ājñāte māne---caitanya 'prāṇa-dhana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācāryera]]---of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---Yadunandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:ś:śiṣya]]---disciple; [[synonyms:a:antaraṅga]]---very confidential; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāte]]---by the order of Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---he accepted; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as his life and soul.
translation: Yadunandana Ācārya had been officially initiated by Advaita Ācārya. Thus he considered Lord Caitanya his life and soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.163
description: When Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house of Raghunātha dāsa and stood in the courtyard, Raghunātha dāsa went there and fell down to offer his obeisances.
text:
> aṅgane āsiyā teṅho yabe dāṇḍāilā
> raghunātha āsi' tabe daṇḍavat kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅgane]]---in the courtyard; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---entering; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Yadunandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:d:dāṇḍāilā]]---stood up; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---offered his respects, falling down.
translation: When Yadunandana Ācārya entered the house of Raghunātha dāsa and stood in the courtyard, Raghunātha dāsa went there and fell down to offer his obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.164
description: One of Yadunandana Ācārya's disciples had been worshiping the Deity but had left that service. Yadunandana Ācārya wanted Raghunātha dāsa to induce the disciple to take up that service again.
text:
> tāṅra eka śiṣya tāṅra ṭhākurera sevā kare
> sevā chāḍiyāche, tāre sādhibāra tare
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ś:śiṣya]]---disciple; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākurera]]---of the Deity; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyāche]]---he has left that service; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:sādhibāra]] [[synonyms:t:tare]]---to induce.
translation: One of Yadunandana Ācārya's disciples had been worshiping the Deity but had left that service. Yadunandana Ācārya wanted Raghunātha dāsa to induce the disciple to take up that service again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.165
description: Yadunandana Ācārya requested Raghunātha dāsa, "Please induce the brāhmaṇa to resume the service, for there is no other brāhmaṇa to do it."
text:
> raghunāthe kahe,---"tāre karaha sādhana
> sevā yena kare, āra nāhika brāhmaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said to Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:sādhana]]---induce to accept the service; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---he does; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]]---there is no; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---brāhmaṇa.
translation: Yadunandana Ācārya requested Raghunātha dāsa, "Please induce the brāhmaṇa to resume the service, for there is no other brāhmaṇa to do it."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.166
description: After saying this, Yadunandana Ācārya took Raghunātha dāsa with him and went out. By that time all the watchmen were deeply asleep because it was the end of the night.
text:
> eta kahi' raghunāthe lañā calilā
> rakṣaka saba śeṣa-rātre nidrāya padilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---he went out; [[synonyms:r:rakṣaka]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the watch men; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣa]]-[[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at the end of night; [[synonyms:n:nidrāya]] [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell asleep.
translation: After saying this, Yadunandana Ācārya took Raghunātha dāsa with him and went out. By that time all the watchmen were deeply asleep because it was the end of the night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.167
description: East of the house of Raghunātha dāsa was the house of Yadunandana Ācārya. Yadunandana Ācārya and Raghunātha dāsa talked together as they went toward that house.
text:
> ācāryera ghara ihāra pūrva-diśāte
> kahite śunite duṅhe cale sei pathe
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryera]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---the house of Yadunandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:d:diśāte]]---to the east; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---talking; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---listening; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of them; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---go; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on that path.
translation: East of the house of Raghunātha dāsa was the house of Yadunandana Ācārya. Yadunandana Ācārya and Raghunātha dāsa talked together as they went toward that house.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.168
description: Halfway along the path, Raghunātha dāsa submitted at the lotus feet of his spiritual master, "I shall go to the home of that brāhmaṇa, induce him to return, and send him to your home.
text:
> ardha-pathe raghunātha kahe gurura caraṇe
> "āmi sei vipre sādhi' pāṭhāimu tomā sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---halfway along the path; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Raghunātha dāsa said; [[synonyms:g:gurura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---unto the lotus feet of his spiritual master; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vipre]]---brāhmaṇa; [[synonyms:s:sādhi']]---inducing; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāimu]]---shall send; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to your place.
translation: Halfway along the path, Raghunātha dāsa submitted at the lotus feet of his spiritual master, "I shall go to the home of that brāhmaṇa, induce him to return, and send him to your home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.169
description: "You may go home without anxiety. Following your order, I shall persuade the brāhmaṇa." On this plea, after asking permission, he decided to go away.
text:
> tumi sukhe ghare yāha---more ājñā haya"
> ei chale ājñā māgi' karilā niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:s:sukhe]]---in happiness; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go to your place; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to me; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:c:chale]]---on this plea; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---asking permission; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---decided.
translation: "You may go home without anxiety. Following your order, I shall persuade the brāhmaṇa." On this plea, after asking permission, he decided to go away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.17
description: At that time there was a Mohammedan official collecting the taxes of Saptagrāma.
text:
> hena-kāle mulukera eka mleccha adhikārī
> saptagrāma-mulukera se haya 'caudhurī'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:m:mulukera]]---of the country; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:m:mleccha]]---Mohammedan; [[synonyms:a:adhikārī]]---official; [[synonyms:s:saptagrāma]]-[[synonyms:m:mulukera]]---of the place known as Saptagrāma; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that person; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:c:caudhurī]]---tax collector.
translation: At that time there was a Mohammedan official collecting the taxes of Saptagrāma.
purport: Formerly, when the Mohammedan government was in power, the person appointed tax collector would collect the taxes of the local Zamindars, or landholders. He would keep one-fourth of the collection for himself as a profit, and the balance he would deliver to the treasury of the government.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.170
description: Raghunātha dāsa thought, "This is the greatest opportunity to go away because this time there are no servants or watchmen with me."
text:
> "sevaka rakṣaka āra keha nāhi saṅge
> palāite āmāra bhāla eita prasaṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servant; [[synonyms:r:rakṣaka]]---watchman; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is no one; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---along; [[synonyms:p:palāite]]---to go away; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---good; [[synonyms:e:eita]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prasaṅge]]---opportunity.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa thought, "This is the greatest opportunity to go away because this time there are no servants or watchmen with me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.171
description: Thinking in this way, he quickly proceeded toward the east. Sometimes he turned around and looked back, but no one was following him.
text:
> eta cinti' pūrva-mukhe karilā gamana
> ulaṭiyā cāhe pāche,---nāhi kona jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:c:cinti']]---thinking this; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---toward the east; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---began to proceed; [[synonyms:u:ulaṭiyā]]---turning around; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---looks; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---behind; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---there was no one.
translation: Thinking in this way, he quickly proceeded toward the east. Sometimes he turned around and looked back, but no one was following him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.172
description: Thinking of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, he left the general path and proceeded with great haste on the one not generally used.
text:
> śrī-caitanya-nityānanda-caraṇa cintiyā
> patha chāḍi' upapathe yāyena dhāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:c:cintiyā]]---thinking of; [[synonyms:p:patha]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up the general pathway; [[synonyms:u:upapathe]]---by the path not generally used; [[synonyms:y:yāyena]] [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---he went very swiftly.
translation: Thinking of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, he left the general path and proceeded with great haste on the one not generally used.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.173
description: Giving up the general path from village to village, he passed through the jungles, thinking with heart and soul about the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> grāme-grāmera patha chāḍi' yāya vane vane
> kāya-mano-vākye cinte caitanya-caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:grāme]]-[[synonyms:g:grāmera]]---from village to village; [[synonyms:p:patha]]---the general path; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:v:vane]] [[synonyms:v:vane]]---through the jungles; [[synonyms:k:kāya]]-[[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]-[[synonyms:v:vākye]]---with body, mind and words; [[synonyms:c:cinte]]---thinks; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---of the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Giving up the general path from village to village, he passed through the jungles, thinking with heart and soul about the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.174
description: He walked about thirty miles in one day, and in the evening he took rest in the cowshed of a milkman.
text:
> pañca-daśa-krośa-patha cali' gelā eka-dine
> sandhyā-kāle rahilā eka gopera bāthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:k:krośa]]---about thirty miles; [[synonyms:p:patha]] [[synonyms:c:cali']]---walking on the path; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---in one day; [[synonyms:s:sandhyā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the evening; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---remained; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:g:gopera]]---of a milkman; [[synonyms:b:bāthāne]]---in the cowshed.
translation: He walked about thirty miles in one day, and in the evening he took rest in the cowshed of a milkman.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.175
description: When the milkman saw that Raghunātha dāsa was fasting, he gave him some milk. Raghunātha dāsa drank the milk and lay down to rest there for the night.
text:
> upavāsī dekhi' gopa dugdha āni' dilā
> sei dugdha pāna kari' paḍiyā rahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:upavāsī]]---fasting; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:g:gopa]]---the milkman; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---milk; [[synonyms:a:ani']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---that milk; [[synonyms:p:pāna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---drinking; [[synonyms:p:paḍiyā]]---lying down; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]]---he remained.
translation: When the milkman saw that Raghunātha dāsa was fasting, he gave him some milk. Raghunātha dāsa drank the milk and lay down to rest there for the night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.176
description: At the house of Raghunātha dāsa, the servant and watchman, not seeing him there, immediately went to inquire about him from his spiritual master, Yadunandana Ācārya.
text:
> ethā tāṅra sevaka rakṣaka tāṅre nā dekhiyā
> tāṅra guru-pāśe vārtā puchilena giyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here, at his home; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servant; [[synonyms:r:rakṣaka]]---watchman; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---not seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśe]]---from his spiritual master; [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news; [[synonyms:p:puchilena]]---inquired; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going.
translation: At the house of Raghunātha dāsa, the servant and watchman, not seeing him there, immediately went to inquire about him from his spiritual master, Yadunandana Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.177
description: Yadunandana Ācārya said, "He has already asked my permission and returned home." Thus there arose a tumultuous sound, as everyone cried, "Now Raghunātha has gone away!"
text:
> teṅha kahe, 'ājñā māgi' gelā nija-ghara'
> 'palāila raghunātha'---uṭhila kolāhala
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---asking my permission; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to his home; [[synonyms:p:palāila]] [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa has gone away; [[synonyms:u:uṭhila]]---arose; [[synonyms:k:kolāhala]]---a tumultuous sound.
translation: Yadunandana Ācārya said, "He has already asked my permission and returned home." Thus there arose a tumultuous sound, as everyone cried, "Now Raghunātha has gone away!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.178
description: Raghunātha dāsa's father said, "Now all the devotees from Bengal have gone to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> tāṅra pitā kahe,---"gauḍera saba bhakta-gaṇa
> prabhu-sthāne nīlācale karilā gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---father; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha purī; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---have gone.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father said, "Now all the devotees from Bengal have gone to Jagannātha Purī to see Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.179
description: "Raghunātha dāsa has fled with them. Ten men should immediately go catch him and bring him back."
text:
> sei-saṅge raghunātha gela palāñā
> daśa jana yāha, tāre ānaha dhariyā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with them; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:g:gela]] [[synonyms:p:palāñā]]---has fled; [[synonyms:d:daśa]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---ten men; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:ānaha]]---bring; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---catching.
translation: "Raghunātha dāsa has fled with them. Ten men should immediately go catch him and bring him back."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.18
description: When Hiraṇya dāsa, Raghunātha dāsa's uncle, made an agreement with the government to collect taxes, the Mohammedan caudhurī, or tax collector, having lost his position, became extremely envious of him.
text:
> hiraṇya-dāsa muluka nila 'makrari' kariyā
> tāra adhikāra gela, mare se dekhiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hiraṇya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---the uncle of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:m:muluka]] [[synonyms:n:nila]]---took charge of the country; [[synonyms:m:makrari]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---by some agreement; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---the Mohammedan caudhurī lost his position; [[synonyms:m:mare]] [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---became extremely envious of Hiraṇya dāsa.
translation: When Hiraṇya dāsa, Raghunātha dāsa's uncle, made an agreement with the government to collect taxes, the Mohammedan caudhurī, or tax collector, having lost his position, became extremely envious of him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.180
description: Raghunātha dāsa's father wrote a letter to Śivānanda Sena, asking him with great humility, "Please return my son."
text:
> śivānande patrī dila vinaya kariyā
> 'āmāra putrere tumi dibā bāhuḍiyā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]]---unto Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:patrī]]---a letter; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---sent; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]] [[synonyms:k:kariya]]---with great humility; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:p:putrere]]---my son; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:d:dibā]]---please give; [[synonyms:b:bāhuḍiyā]]---returning.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father wrote a letter to Śivānanda Sena, asking him with great humility, "Please return my son."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.181
description: In Jhāṅkarā, the ten men caught up with the group of Vaiṣṇavas going to Nīlācala.
text:
> jhāṅkarā paryanta gela sei daśa jane
> jhāṅkarāte pāila giyā vaiṣṇavera gaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jhāṅkarā]] [[synonyms:p:paryanta]]---to the place known as Jhāṅkarā; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:d:daśa]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---those ten men; [[synonyms:j:jhāṅkarāte]]---at Jhāṅkarā; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---caught up to; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---the group of Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: In Jhāṅkarā, the ten men caught up with the group of Vaiṣṇavas going to Nīlācala.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.182
description: After delivering the letter, the men inquired from Śivānanda Sena about Raghunātha dāsa, but Śivānanda Sena replied, "He did not come here."
text:
> patrī diyā śivānande vārtā puchila
> śivānanda kahe,---'teṅha ethā nā āila'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:patrī]]---letter; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---delivering; [[synonyms:ś:śivānande]]---unto Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śivānanda said; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---did not come.
translation: After delivering the letter, the men inquired from Śivānanda Sena about Raghunātha dāsa, but Śivānanda Sena replied, "He did not come here."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.183
description: The ten men returned home, and Raghunātha dāsa's father and mother were filled with anxiety.
text:
> bāhuḍiyā sei daśa jana āila ghara
> tāṅra mātā-pitā ha-ila cintita antara
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhuḍiyā]]---returning; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---those; [[synonyms:d:daśa]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---ten men; [[synonyms:ā:āila]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---came back home; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:mātā]]-[[synonyms:p:pitā]]---mother and father; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became; [[synonyms:c:cintita]]---full of anxiety; [[synonyms:a:antara]]---within themselves.
translation: The ten men returned home, and Raghunātha dāsa's father and mother were filled with anxiety.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.184
description: Raghunātha dāsa, who had been resting at the milkman's house, got up early in the morning. Instead of going to the east, he turned his face south and proceeded.
text:
> ethā raghunātha-dāsa prabhāte uṭhiyā
> pūrva-mukha chāḍi' cale dakṣiṇa-mukha hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhāte]]---early in the morning; [[synonyms:u:uṭhiyā]]---rising; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]---facing the east; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---giving up; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---began to proceed; [[synonyms:d:dakṣiṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mukha]]---facing south; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa, who had been resting at the milkman's house, got up early in the morning. Instead of going to the east, he turned his face south and proceeded.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.185
description: He crossed Chatrabhoga, but instead of going on the general path, he proceeded on the path that went from village to village.
text:
> chatrabhoga pāra hañā chāḍiyā sarāṇa
> kugrāma diyā diyā karila prayāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chatra]]-[[synonyms:b:bhoga]]---the place named Chatrabhoga; [[synonyms:p:pāra]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---crossing; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---giving up; [[synonyms:s:sarāṇa]]---the royal road; [[synonyms:k:kugrāma]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---going through village pathways; [[synonyms:k:karilaprayāṇa]]---proceeded.
translation: He crossed Chatrabhoga, but instead of going on the general path, he proceeded on the path that went from village to village.
purport: Chatrabhoga, known now as Chāḍa-khāḍi, is in the district of twenty-four pargaṇās in West Bengal. It is situated near the celebrated village Jayanagara-majilapura. Formerly the Ganges or some of its branches flowed through this region. Sometimes Chatrabhoga is misunderstood to have been a village on the River Kāṅsāi-nadī in Benāpola.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.186
description: Not caring about eating, he traveled all day. Hunger was not an impediment, for his mind was concentrated upon obtaining shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> bhakṣaṇa apekṣā nāhi, samasta divasa gamana
> kṣudhā nāhi bādhe, caitanya-caraṇa-prāptye mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]] [[synonyms:a:apekṣā]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---did not care for eating; [[synonyms:s:samasta]] [[synonyms:d:divasa]]---all day; [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---traveling; [[synonyms:k:kṣudhā]]---hunger; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:b:bādhe]]---did not become an impediment; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prāptye]]---on obtaining; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind.
translation: Not caring about eating, he traveled all day. Hunger was not an impediment, for his mind was concentrated upon obtaining shelter at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.187
description: Sometimes he chewed fried grains, sometimes he cooked, and sometimes he drank milk. In this way he kept his life and soul together with whatever was available wherever he went.
text:
> kabhu carvaṇa, kabhu randhana, kabhu dugdha-pāna
> yabe yei mile, tāhe rākhe nija prāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:c:carvaṇa]]---sometimes chewing; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:r:randhana]]---sometimes cooking; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:p:pāna]]---sometimes drinking milk; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---whoever; [[synonyms:m:mile]]---meets; [[synonyms:t:tāhe]]---in that way; [[synonyms:r:rākhe]]---keeps; [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---his life.
translation: Sometimes he chewed fried grains, sometimes he cooked, and sometimes he drank milk. In this way he kept his life and soul together with whatever was available wherever he went.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.188
description: He reached Jagannātha Purī in twelve days but could only eat for three days on the way.
text:
> bāra dine cali' gelā śrī-puruṣottama
> pathe tina-dina mātra karilā bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---for twelve days; [[synonyms:c:cali']]---traveling; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---reached; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:puruṣottama]]---Jagannātha Purī, or Nīlācala, the place of Puruṣottama; [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the path; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---on three days; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---he ate.
translation: He reached Jagannātha Purī in twelve days but could only eat for three days on the way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.189
description: When Raghunātha dāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord was sitting with His companions, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> svarūpādi-saha gosāñi āchena vasiyā
> hena-kāle raghunātha milila āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---in the company of devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āchena]] [[synonyms:v:vasiyā]]---was sitting; [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:m:milila]]---met; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming.
translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord was sitting with His companions, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.19
description: Hiraṇya dāsa was collecting 2,000,000 coins and therefore should have delivered 1,500,000 to the government. Instead, he was giving only 1,200,000, thus making an extra profit of 300,000 coins. Seeing this, the Mohammedan caudhurī, who was a Turk, became his rival.
text:
> bāra lakṣa deya rājāya, sādhe biśa lakṣa
> se 'turuk' kichu nā pāñā haila pratipakṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]] [[synonyms:l:lakṣa]]---1,200,000 coins; [[synonyms:d:deya]]---delivers; [[synonyms:r:rājāya]]---unto the Mohammedan government; [[synonyms:s:sādhe]]---collects; [[synonyms:b:biśa]] [[synonyms:l:lakṣa]]---2,000,000 coins; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:t:turuk]]---that Turk; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:p:pratipakṣa]]---became his rival.
translation: Hiraṇya dāsa was collecting 2,000,000 coins and therefore should have delivered 1,500,000 to the government. Instead, he was giving only 1,200,000, thus making an extra profit of 300,000 coins. Seeing this, the Mohammedan caudhurī, who was a Turk, became his rival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.190
description: Staying at a distant place in the courtyard, he fell down to offer obeisances. Then Mukunda Datta said, "Here is Raghunātha."
text:
> aṅganete dūre rahi' karena praṇipāta
> mukunda-datta kahe,---'ei āila raghunātha'
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṅganete]]---in the courtyard; [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---keeping himself at a distant place; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:praṇipāta]]---offered his obeisances; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]-[[synonyms:d:datta]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Mukunda Datta said; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---has come; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa.
translation: Staying at a distant place in the courtyard, he fell down to offer obeisances. Then Mukunda Datta said, "Here is Raghunātha."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.191
description: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these words, He immediately welcomed Raghunātha dāsa. "Come here," He said. Raghunātha dāsa then clasped the lotus feet of the Lord, but the Lord stood up and embraced him out of His causeless mercy.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---'āisa;, teṅho dharilā caraṇa
> uṭhi' prabhu kṛpāya tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---the Lord said; [[synonyms:ā:āisa]]---come here; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---caught His lotus feet; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---standing up; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāya]]---out of mercy; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced.
translation: As soon as Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard these words, He immediately welcomed Raghunātha dāsa. "Come here," He said. Raghunātha dāsa then clasped the lotus feet of the Lord, but the Lord stood up and embraced him out of His causeless mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.192
description: Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. Seeing the special mercy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had bestowed upon Raghunātha dāsa, they embraced him also.
text:
> svarūpādi saba bhaktera caraṇa vandilā
> prabhu-kṛpā dekhi' sabe āliṅgana kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of all the devotees; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandilā]]---offered prayers to the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---embraced.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī. Seeing the special mercy Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had bestowed upon Raghunātha dāsa, they embraced him also.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.193
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is stronger than anything else. Therefore the Lord has delivered you from the ditch of materialistic life, which is like a hole into which people pass stool."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"kṛṣṇa-kṛpā baliṣṭha sabā haite
> tomāre kāḍila viṣaya-viṣṭhā-garta haite"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:baliṣṭha]]---more powerful; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than anything; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kāḍila]]---He has delivered; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---of material enjoyment; [[synonyms:v:viṣṭhā]]---of stool; [[synonyms:g:garta]]---the ditch; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is stronger than anything else. Therefore the Lord has delivered you from the ditch of materialistic life, which is like a hole into which people pass stool."
purport: According to the law of //karma,// everyone is destined to suffer or enjoy according to a certain material standard, but the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa is so powerful that the Lord can change all the reactions of one's past karma, or fruitive activities. Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu specifically drew attention to the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa. That mercy is more powerful than anything else, for it had saved Raghunātha dāsa from the strong bondage of materialistic life, which the Lord compared to a hole where people pass stool. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave His verdict that those addicted to the materialistic way of life are like worms that are living in stool but cannot give it up. A //gṛhavrata,// one who has decided to live in a comfortable home although it is actually miserable, is in a condemned position. Only the mercy of Kṛṣṇa can save one from such misery. Without Kṛṣṇa's mercy, one cannot get out of the filthy entanglement of materialistic life. The poor living entity cannot give up his materialistic position on his own; only when granted the special mercy of Kṛṣṇa can he give it up. Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew very well that Raghunātha dāsa was already liberated. Nevertheless He emphasized that Raghunātha dāsa's life of material comfort as a very rich man's son with a very beautiful wife and many servants to attend him was like a ditch of stool. The Lord thus specifically indicated that ordinary men who are very happy with material comforts and family life are in no better position than worms in stool.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.194
description: Raghunātha dāsa answered within his mind, "I do not know who Kṛṣṇa is. I simply know that Your mercy, O my Lord, has saved me from my family life."
text:
> raghunātha mane kahe,---'kṛṣṇa nāhi jāni
> tava kṛpā kāḍila āmā,---ei āmi māni'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:m:mane]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---answered within his mind; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kāḍila]]---has delivered; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---me; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:m:māni]]---I accept.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa answered within his mind, "I do not know who Kṛṣṇa is. I simply know that Your mercy, O my Lord, has saved me from my family life."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.195
description: The Lord continued, "Your father and his elder brother are both related as brothers to My grandfather, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī. Therefore I consider them My grandfathers.
text:
> prabhu kahena,---"tomāra pitā-jyeṭhā dui jane
> cakravarti-sambandhe hāma 'ājā' kari' māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:p:pitā]]-[[synonyms:j:jyeṭhā]]---father and his elder brother; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:jane]]---both of them; [[synonyms:c:cakravarti]]-[[synonyms:s:sambandhe]]---be cause of a relationship with Nīlāmbara Cakravartī; [[synonyms:h:hāma]]---I; [[synonyms:ā:ājā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as My grandfathers; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---consider.
translation: The Lord continued, "Your father and his elder brother are both related as brothers to My grandfather, Nīlāmbara Cakravartī. Therefore I consider them My grandfathers.
purport: Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, the grandfather of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, was very intimately related to Raghunātha dāsa's father and uncle. Nīlāmbara Cakravartī used to call them his younger brothers because both of them were very devoted to the //brāhmaṇas// and were very respectable gentlemen. Similarly, they used to call him Dādā Cakravartī, addressing him as an elder brother //brāhmaṇa.// Raghunātha dāsa, however, was almost the same age as Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Generally a grandchild may joke about his grandfather. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu took advantage of the relationship between His grandfather and Raghunātha dāsa's father and uncle to speak in a joking way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.196
description: "Since your father and his elder brother are younger brothers of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, I may joke about them in this way.
text:
> cakravartīra duhe haya bhrātṛ-rūpa dāsa
> ataeva tāre āmi kari parihāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cakravartīra]]---of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī; [[synonyms:d:duhe]]---both; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:b:bhrātṛ]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]] [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---servants as younger brothers; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto them; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---say something jokingly.
translation: "Since your father and his elder brother are younger brothers of Nīlāmbara Cakravartī, I may joke about them in this way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.197
description: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa, your father and his elder brother are just like worms in stool in the ditch of material enjoyment, for the great disease of the poison of material enjoyment is what they consider happiness.
text:
> tomāra bāpa-jyeṭhā---viṣaya-viṣṭhā-gartera kīḍā
> sukha kari' māne viṣaya-viṣera mahā-pīḍā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:b:bāpa]]---father; [[synonyms:j:jyeṭhā]]---his elder brother; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---of material enjoyment; [[synonyms:v:viṣṭhā]]---stool; [[synonyms:g:gartera]]---of the ditch; [[synonyms:k:kīḍā]]---worms; [[synonyms:s:sukha]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as happiness; [[synonyms:m:māne]]---they consider; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---of material enjoyment; [[synonyms:v:viṣera]]---of the poison; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:pīḍā]]---the great disease.
translation: "My dear Raghunātha dāsa, your father and his elder brother are just like worms in stool in the ditch of material enjoyment, for the great disease of the poison of material enjoyment is what they consider happiness.
purport: When a man is attached to material enjoyment, he is attached to many miserable conditions, but nevertheless he accepts his condemned position as one of happiness. Sense enjoyment is so strong for such a person that he cannot give it up, exactly as a worm in stool cannot give up the stool. From the spiritual point of view, when a person is too absorbed in material enjoyment, he is exactly like a worm in stool. Although such a position is utterly miserable to the eyes of liberated souls, the materialistic enjoyer is greatly attached to it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.198
description: "Although your father and uncle are charitable to brāhmaṇas and greatly help them, they are nevertheless not pure Vaishnavas. However, they are almost like Vaiṣṇavas.
text:
> yadyadi brahmaṇya kare brāhmaṇera sahāya
> 'śuddha-vaiṣṇava' nahe, haye 'vaiṣṇavera prāya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:b:brahmaṇya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---give charity to the brāhmaṇas; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇera]] [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---great helpers to the brāhmaṇas; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---pure Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---not; [[synonyms:h:haye]]---they are; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]] [[synonyms:p:prāya]]---almost like Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: "Although your father and uncle are charitable to brāhmaṇas and greatly help them, they are nevertheless not pure Vaishnavas. However, they are almost like Vaiṣṇavas.
purport: As stated by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya,// some people, usually very rich men, dress like Vaiṣṇavas and give charity to //brāhmaṇas.// They are also attached to Deity worship, but because of their attachment to material enjoyment, they cannot be pure Vaiṣṇavas. //Anyābhilāṣitā-śūnyaṁ jñāna-karmādy-anāvṛtam.// The pure Vaiṣṇava has no desire for material enjoyment. That is the basic qualification of a pure Vaiṣṇava. There are men, especially rich men, who regularly worship the Deity, give charity to //brāhmaṇas// and are pious in every respect, but they cannot be pure Vaiṣṇavas. Despite their outward show of Vaiṣṇavism and charity, their inner desire is to enjoy a higher standard of material life. Raghunātha dāsa's father, Govardhana, and uncle, Hiraṇya dāsa, were both very charitable to //brāhmaṇas.// Indeed, the //brāhmaṇas// from the Gauḍīya district were practically dependent upon them. Thus they were accepted as very pious gentlemen. However, they presented themselves as Vaiṣṇavas to the eyes of people in general, although from a purely spiritual point of view they were ordinary human beings, not pure Vaiṣṇavas. Actual Vaiṣṇavas considered them almost Vaiṣṇavas, not pure Vaiṣṇavas. In other words, they were //kaniṣṭha-adhikārīs,// for they were ignorant of higher Vaiṣṇava regulative principles. Nevertheless, they could not be called //viṣayīs,// or blind materialistic enjoyers.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.199
description: "Those who are attached to materialistic life and are blind to spiritual life must act in such a way that they are bound to repeated birth and death by the actions and reactions of their activities.
text:
> tathāpi viṣayera svabhāva---kare mahā-andha
> sei karma karāya, yāte haya bhava-bandha
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:v:viṣayera]] [[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---the potency of material enjoyment; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:a:andha]]---makes one completely blind; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:karma]] [[synonyms:k:karāya]]---causes one to act in that way; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:b:bhava]]-[[synonyms:b:bandha]]---the bondage of birth and death.
translation: "Those who are attached to materialistic life and are blind to spiritual life must act in such a way that they are bound to repeated birth and death by the actions and reactions of their activities.
purport:
As clearly stated in //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:3:9|(Bg. 3.9)]], //yajñārthāt karmaṇo 'nyatra loko 'yam-karma-bandhanaḥ:// if one does not act as a pure devotee, whatever acts he per forms will produce reactions of fruitive bondage //(karma-bandhanaḥ).// In //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// it is said:

> nūnaṁ pramattaḥ kurute vikarma
> yad-indriya-prīta ya āpṛṇoti
> na sādhu manye yata ātmano 'yam
> asann api kleśada āsa dehaḥ

"A materialistic person, madly engaged in activities for sense enjoyment, does not know that he is entangling himself in repeated birth and death and that his body, although temporary, is full of miseries." [[books:sb:5:5:4|(Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam 5.5.4)]] A viṣayī, a person blindly caught in a web of materialistic life, remains in the cycle of birth and death perpetually. Such a person cannot understand how to execute pure devotional service, and therefore he acts as a //karmī, jñānī, yogī// or something else, according to his desire, but he does not know that the activities of //karma, jñāna// and yoga simply bind one to the cycle of birth and death.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.2
description: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glory to Lord Nityānanda! All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya, jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra, jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glory to Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glory to Lord Nityānanda! All glory to Śrī Advaita Ācārya! And all glory to all the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.20
description: After sending a confidential account to the government treasury, the caudhurī brought the minister in charge. The caudhurī came, wanting to arrest Hiraṇya dāsa, but Hiraṇya dāsa had left home. Therefore the caudhurī arrested Raghunātha dāsa.
text:
> rāja-ghare kaiphiyat diyā ujīre ānila
> hiraṇya-dāsa palāila, raghunāthere bāndhila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to the government treasury; [[synonyms:k:kaiphiyat]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---sending a confidential account; [[synonyms:u:ujīre]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought the minister in charge; [[synonyms:h:hiraṇya]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]] [[synonyms:p:palāila]]---Hiraṇya dāsa fled; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthere]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhila]]---he arrested Raghunātha dāsa.
translation: After sending a confidential account to the government treasury, the caudhurī brought the minister in charge. The caudhurī came, wanting to arrest Hiraṇya dāsa, but Hiraṇya dāsa had left home. Therefore the caudhurī arrested Raghunātha dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.200
description: "By His own free will, Lord Kṛṣṇa has delivered you from such a condemned materialistic life. Therefore the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa's causeless mercy cannot be expressed."
text:
> hena 'viṣaya' haite kṛṣṇa uddhārilā tomā'
> kahana nā yāya kṛṣṇa-
> kṛpāra mahimā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]] [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---such a fallen condition of material enjoyment; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:u:uddhārilā]] [[synonyms:t:tomā']]---has delivered you; [[synonyms:k:kahana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---cannot be described; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpāra]]---of the mercy of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glories.
translation: "By His own free will, Lord Kṛṣṇa has delivered you from such a condemned materialistic life. Therefore the glories of Lord Kṛṣṇa's causeless mercy cannot be expressed."
purport:
in the //Brahma-saṁhitā// (5.54) it is said, //karmāṇi nirdahati kintu ca bhakti-bha-jām.// Lord Kṛṣṇa is so merciful that He can stop the reaction of //karma// for His devotee. Everyone-from a small insect called //indra-gopa// up to Indra, the King of heaven-is bound by the reactions of fruitive activities.

> yas tv indra-gopam athavendram aho sva-karma-
> bandhānurūpa-phala-bhājanam ātanoti
> karmāṇi nirdahati kintu ca bhakti-bhājāṁ
> govindam ādi-puruṣaṁ tam ahaṁ bhajāmi

Everyone, whether like an insect or the King of heaven, is entangled and bound by the actions and reactions of his //karma// However, when one becomes a pure devotee, free from material desires and from bondage to //karma, jñāna// and yoga, one is freed from material actions and reactions by the causeless mercy of Kṛṣṇa. One cannot express sufficient gratitude to Kṛṣṇa for being freed from the materialistic way of life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.201
description: Seeing Raghunātha dāsa skinny and dirty because of having traveled for twelve days and fasted, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His heart melting due to causeless mercy, spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> raghunāthera kṣīṇatā-mālinya dekhiyā
> svarūpere kahena prabhu kṛpārdra-citta hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kṣīṇatā]]---thinness; [[synonyms:m:mālinya]]---dirty condition of the body; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpere]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---said to Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---out of mercy; [[synonyms:ā:ārdra]]---melted; [[synonyms:c:citta]]---heart; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being.
translation: Seeing Raghunātha dāsa skinny and dirty because of having traveled for twelve days and fasted, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, His heart melting due to causeless mercy, spoke to Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.202
description: "My dear Svarūpa," He said, "I entrust this Raghunātha dāsa to you. Please accept him as your son or servant.
text:
> "ei raghunāthe āmi saṅpinu tomāre
> putra-bhṛtya-rūpe tumi kara aṅgīkāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---this Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:saṅpinu]] [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---am entrusting to you; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---son; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---servant; [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---as; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you (Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī); [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāre]]---please accept.
translation: "My dear Svarūpa," He said, "I entrust this Raghunātha dāsa to you. Please accept him as your son or servant.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.203
description: "There are now three Raghunāthas among My associates. From this day forward, this Raghunātha should be known as the Raghu of Svarūpa Dāmodara."
text:
> tina 'raghunātha'-nāma haya āmāra gaṇe
> 'svarūpera raghu'---āji haite ihāra nāme"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---three Raghunāthas; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---among My associates; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:r:raghu]]---the Raghunātha of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:ā:āji]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from this day; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this one; [[synonyms:n:nāme]]---the name.
translation: "There are now three Raghunāthas among My associates. From this day forward, this Raghunātha should be known as the Raghu of Svarūpa Dāmodara."
purport: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had three Raghus among His associates-Vaidya Raghunātha (vide //Ādi-līlā// 11.22), Bhaṭṭa Raghunātha and Dāsa Raghunātha. Dāsa Raghunātha became celebrated as the Raghunātha of Svarūpa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.204
description: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu grasped the hand of Raghunātha dāsa and entrusted him to the hands of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
text:
> eta kahi' raghunāthera hasta dharilā
> svarūpera haste tāṅre samarpaṇa kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:h:hasta]] [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---caught the hand; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:h:haste]]---in the hands of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---entrusted.
translation: Saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu grasped the hand of Raghunātha dāsa and entrusted him to the hands of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.205
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī accepted Raghunātha dāsa, saying, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whatever You order is accepted." He then embraced Raghunātha dāsa again.
text:
> svarūpa kahe,---'mahāprabhura ye ājñā haila'
> eta kahi' raghunāthe punaḥ āliṅgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara said; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---whatever; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there is; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:k:kahi']]---saying this; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgila]]---he embraced.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī accepted Raghunātha dāsa, saying, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, whatever You order is accepted." He then embraced Raghunātha dāsa again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.206
description: I cannot properly express the affection of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for His devotees. Being merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord spoke as follows to Govinda.
text:
> caitanyera bhakta-vātsalya kahite nā pāri
> govindere kahe raghunāthe dayā kari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanyera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]---affection for devotees; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I cannot express properly; [[synonyms:g:govindere]]---to Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---He said; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---upon Raghunātha; [[synonyms:d:dayā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being very merciful.
translation: I cannot properly express the affection of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu for His devotees. Being merciful toward Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord spoke as follows to Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.207
description: "On the way, Raghunātha dāsa has fasted and undergone hardships for many days. Therefore, take good care of him for some days so that he may eat to his satisfaction."
text:
> "pathe iṅha kariyāche bahuta laṅghana
> kata-dina kara ihāra bhāla santarpaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the way; [[synonyms:i:iṅha]]---this Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kariyāche]]---has done; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]]---much; [[synonyms:l:laṅghana]]---fasting and difficult endeavor; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---for some days; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of him; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---good; [[synonyms:s:santarpaṇa]]---attention.
translation: "On the way, Raghunātha dāsa has fasted and undergone hardships for many days. Therefore, take good care of him for some days so that he may eat to his satisfaction."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.208
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "Go bathe in the sea. Then see Lord Jagannātha in the temple and return here to take your meal."
text:
> raghunāthe kahe---"yāñā, kara sindhu-snāna
> jagannātha dekhi' āsi' karaha bhojana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---He said to Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:s:sindhu]]-[[synonyms:s:snāna]]---bathe in the sea; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---after coming; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---take your meal.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "Go bathe in the sea. Then see Lord Jagannātha in the temple and return here to take your meal."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.209
description: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and went to perform His midday duties, and Raghunātha met all the devotees present.
text:
> eta bali' prabhu madhyāhna karite uṭhilā
> raghunātha-dāsa saba bhaktere mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---after saying this; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhna]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---for performing His midday duties; [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]]---got up; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:b:bhaktere]]---devotees; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met.
translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu got up and went to perform His midday duties, and Raghunātha met all the devotees present.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.21
description: Every day, the Mohammedan would chastise Raghunātha dāsa and tell him, "Bring your father and his elder brother. Otherwise you will be punished."
text:
> prati-dina raghunāthe karaye bhartsanā
> 'bāpa-jyeṭhāre āna;, nahe pāibā yātanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---daily; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:b:bhartsanā]]---he chastised; [[synonyms:b:bāpa]]-[[synonyms:j:jyeṭhāre]] [[synonyms:ā:āna]]---bring your father and his elder brother; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---otherwise; [[synonyms:p:pāibā]] [[synonyms:y:yātanā]]---you will be punished.
translation: Every day, the Mohammedan would chastise Raghunātha dāsa and tell him, "Bring your father and his elder brother. Otherwise you will be punished."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.210
description: Having seen the causeless mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon Raghunātha dāsa, all the devotees, struck with wonder, praised his good fortune.
text:
> raghunāthe prabhura kṛpā dekhi, bhakta-gaṇa
> vismita hañā kare tāṅra bhāgya-praśaṁsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---unto Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---struck with wonder; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:b:bhāgya]]---fortune; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁsana]]---praise.
translation: Having seen the causeless mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu upon Raghunātha dāsa, all the devotees, struck with wonder, praised his good fortune.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.211
description: Raghunātha dāsa took his bath in the sea and saw Lord Jagannātha. Then he returned to Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> raghunātha samudre yāñā snāna karilā
> jagannātha dekhi' punaḥ govinda-pāśa āilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:s:samudre]]---to the sea; [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going; [[synonyms:s:snāna]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---took a bath; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---after seeing Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]] [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came to Govinda.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa took his bath in the sea and saw Lord Jagannātha. Then he returned to Govinda, the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.212
description: Govinda offered him a plate with the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and Raghunātha dāsa accepted the prasāda with great happiness.
text:
> prabhura avaśiṣṭa pātra govinda tāṅre dilā
> ānandita hañā raghunātha prasāda pāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:avaśiṣṭa]] [[synonyms:p:pātra]]---a plate of remnants of food; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the personal servant of the Lord; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---offered; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming very happy; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---accepted the prasāda.
translation: Govinda offered him a plate with the remnants of food left by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and Raghunātha dāsa accepted the prasāda with great happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.213
description: Raghunātha dāsa stayed under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and Govinda supplied him remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food for five days.
text:
> ei-mata rahe teṅha svarūpa-caraṇe
> govinda prasāda tāṅre dila pañca dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remained; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---under the shelter of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the remnants of the food of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:p:pañca]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---for five days.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa stayed under the care of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, and Govinda supplied him remnants of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's food for five days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.214
description: Beginning from the sixth day, Raghunātha dāsa would stand at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra to beg alms after the puṣpa-añjali ceremony, in which flowers were offered to the Lord.
text:
> āra dina haite 'puṣpa-añjali' dekhiyā
> siṁha-dvāre khāḍā rahe bhikṣāra lāgiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:a:añjali]]---the ceremony of offering flowers to the Lord; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after seeing; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the main gate; [[synonyms:k:khāḍā]] [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remains standing; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---for begging some alms.
translation: Beginning from the sixth day, Raghunātha dāsa would stand at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra to beg alms after the puṣpa-añjali ceremony, in which flowers were offered to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.215
description: After finishing their prescribed duties, the many servants of Lord Jagannātha, who are known as viṣayīs, return home at night.
text:
> jagannāthera sevaka yata---'viṣayīra gaṇa'
> sevā sāri' rātrye kare gṛhete gamana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]]---of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servants; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:v:viṣayīra]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---generally known as viṣayī; [[synonyms:s:sevā]] [[synonyms:s:sāri']]---after finishing their service; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:g:gṛhete]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---returning home.
translation: After finishing their prescribed duties, the many servants of Lord Jagannātha, who are known as viṣayīs, return home at night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.216
description: If they see a Vaiṣṇava standing at the Siṁha-dvāra begging alms, out of mercy they arrange with the shopkeepers to give him something to eat.
text:
> siṁha-dvāre annārthī vaiṣṇave dekhiyā
> pasārira ṭhāñi anna dena kṛpā ta' kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the Siṁha gate; [[synonyms:a:anna]]-[[synonyms:a:arthī]]---in need of some eatables; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇave]]---Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:pasārira]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:a:anna]] [[synonyms:d:dena]]---deliver some eatables; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---out of mercy.
translation: If they see a Vaiṣṇava standing at the Siṁha-dvāra begging alms, out of mercy they arrange with the shopkeepers to give him something to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.217
description: Thus it is a custom for all time that a devotee who has no other means of support stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to receive alms from the servants.
text:
> ei-mata sarva-kāla āche vyavahāra
> niṣkiñcana bhakta khāḍā haya siṁha-dvāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---for all time; [[synonyms:a:ache]]---is; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---the etiquette; [[synonyms:n:niṣkiñcana]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---a devotee who has no other support; [[synonyms:k:khāḍā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---stands; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra.
translation: Thus it is a custom for all time that a devotee who has no other means of support stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to receive alms from the servants.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.218
description: A completely dependent Vaiṣṇava thus chats the holy name of the Lord all day and sees Lord Jagannātha with full freedom.
text:
> sarva-dina karena vaiṣṇava nāma-saṅkīrtana
> svacchande karena jagannātha daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---the whole day; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---a Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:s:svacchande]]---with full freedom; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing Lord Jagannātha. freedom; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---does; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---seeing Lord Jagannātha.
translation: A completely dependent Vaiṣṇava thus chats the holy name of the Lord all day and sees Lord Jagannātha with full freedom.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.219
description: It is a custom for some Vaiṣṇavas to beg from the charity booths and eat whatever they obtain, whereas others stand at night at the Siṁha-dvāra gate, begging alms from the servants.
text:
> keha chatre māgi' khāya, yebā kichu pāya
> keha rātre bhikṣā lāgi' siṁha-dvāre raya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]]---some; [[synonyms:c:chatre]]---at the almshouse; [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eat; [[synonyms:y:yeba]]---whatever; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---little; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---they receive; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---some; [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for begging alms; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]] [[synonyms:r:raya]]---stand at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra.
translation: It is a custom for some Vaiṣṇavas to beg from the charity booths and eat whatever they obtain, whereas others stand at night at the Siṁha-dvāra gate, begging alms from the servants.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.22
description: The caudhurī wanted to beat him, but as soon as he saw Raghunātha's face, his mind changed, and he could not beat him.
text:
> mārite ānaye yadi dekhe raghunāthe
> mana phiri' yāya, tabe nā pāre mārite
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mārite]]---to beat; [[synonyms:ā:ānaye]]---brings; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---sees; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---Raghunātha //dāsa//; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---his mind; [[synonyms:p:phiri']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---becomes changed; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:m:mārite]]---he could not beat.
