translation: The caudhurī wanted to beat him, but as soon as he saw Raghunātha's face, his mind changed, and he could not beat him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.220
description: Renunciation is the basic principle sustaining the lives of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees. Seeing this renunciation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is extremely satisfied.
text:
> mahāprabhura bhakta-gaṇera vairāgya pradhāna
> yāhā dekhi' prīta hana gaura-bhagavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the devotees; [[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---renunciation; [[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---the basic principle; [[synonyms:y:yāhā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing which; [[synonyms:p:prīta]] [[synonyms:h:hana]]---becomes satisfied; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: Renunciation is the basic principle sustaining the lives of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees. Seeing this renunciation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, is extremely satisfied.
purport: Anyone, whether an ordinary materialistic person or a pure devotee, can understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees if he studies it minutely. One will thus find that the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are not at all attached to any kind of material enjoyment. They have completely given up sense enjoyment to engage fully in the service of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa and dedicate their lives and souls to serving Kṛṣṇa without material desires. Because their devotional service is free from material desires, it is unimpeded by material circumstances. Although ordinary men have great difficulty understanding this attitude of the devotees, it is greatly appreciated by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.221
description: Govinda said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa no longer takes prasāda here. Now he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra, where he begs some alms to eat."
text:
> prabhure govinda kahe,---"raghunātha 'prasāda' nā laya
> rātrye siṁha-dvāre khāḍā hañā māgi' khāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:govinda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Govinda said; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:l:laya]]---does not take prasāda; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the Siṁha-dvāra gate; [[synonyms:k:khāḍā]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---standing; [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---he eats.
translation: Govinda said to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa no longer takes prasāda here. Now he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra, where he begs some alms to eat."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.222
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, He was greatly satisfied. "Raghunātha dāsa has done well," He said."He has acted suitably for a person in the renounced order.
text:
> śuni' tuṣṭa hañā prabhu kahite lāgila
> "bhāla kaila, vairāgīra dharma ācarila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very satisfied; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---began to say; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---he has done well; [[synonyms:v:vairāgīra]]---of a person in the renounced order; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---the principles; [[synonyms:ā:ācarila]]---he has performed.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard this, He was greatly satisfied. "Raghunātha dāsa has done well," He said."He has acted suitably for a person in the renounced order.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.223
description: "A person in the renounced order should always chant the holy name of the Lord. He should beg some alms to eat, and he should sustain his life in this way.
text:
> vairāgī karibe sadā nāma-saṅkīrtana
> māgiyā khāñā kare jīvana rakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vairāgī]]---a person in the renounced order; [[synonyms:k:karibe]]---will do; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:m:māgiyā]]---by begging; [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---eating; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]] [[synonyms:r:rakṣaṇa]]---he sustains his life.
translation: "A person in the renounced order should always chant the holy name of the Lord. He should beg some alms to eat, and he should sustain his life in this way.
purport:
As stated in the //Hari-bhakti-vilāsa// at the end of the Twentieth //Vilāsa// (366, 379, 382):

> kṛtyānyetāni tu prāyo
> gṛhiṇāṁ dhanināṁ satām
> likhitāni na tu tyakta-
> parigraha-mahātmanām
>
> prabhāte cārdha-rātre ca
> madhyāhne divasa-kṣaye
> kīrtayanti hariṁ ye vai
> te taranti bhavārṇavam
>
> evam ekāntināṁ prāyaḥ
> kīrtanaṁ smaraṇaṁ prabhoḥ
> kurvatāṁ parama-prītyā
> kṛtyam anyan na rocate

A well-to-do householder Vaiṣṇava cannot live like a person in the renounced order who completely takes shelter of the holy name. Such a householder should chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa in the morning, at midday and in the evening. Then he will be able to cross beyond nescience. Pure devotees in the renounced order, however, who fully surrender to the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, should chant the holy name of the Lord with great love and faith, always thinking of Kṛṣṇa's lotus feet. They should have no other occupation than chanting the holy name of the Lord. In the //Bhakti-sandarbha,// Śrīla Jīva Gosvāmī says:

> yadyapi śrī-bhāgavata-mate pañca-rātrādivad-arcana-mārgasyāvaśyakatvaṁ nāsti, tad vināpi śaraṇāpattyādīnām ekatareṇāpi puruṣārtha-siddher abhihitatvāt.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.224
description: "A vairāgī [a person in the renounced order] should not depend on others. 'If he does so, he will be unsuccessful, and he will be neglected by Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> vairāgī hañā yebā kare parāpeksā
> kārya-siddhi nahe, kṛṣṇa karena upekṣā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vairāgī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being in the renounced order; [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:p:parāpekṣā]]---dependence on others; [[synonyms:k:kārya]]-[[synonyms:s:siddhi]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---he does not become successful; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upekṣā]]---neglects.
translation: "A vairāgī [a person in the renounced order] should not depend on others. 'If he does so, he will be unsuccessful, and he will be neglected by Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.225
description: "If a renunciant is eager for his tongue to taste different foods, his spiritual life will be lost, and he will be subservient to the tastes of his tongue.
text:
> vairāgī hañā kare jihvāra lālasa
> paramārtha yāya, āra haya rasera vaśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vairāgī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being in the renounced order; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:j:jihvāra]]---of the tongue; [[synonyms:l:lālasa]]---lust; [[synonyms:p:parama]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the goal of life; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:r:rasera]] [[synonyms:v:vaśa]]---dependent on taste.
translation: "If a renunciant is eager for his tongue to taste different foods, his spiritual life will be lost, and he will be subservient to the tastes of his tongue.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.226
description: "The duty of a person in the renounced order is to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra always. He should satisfy his belly with whatever vegetables, leaves, fruits and roots are available.
text:
> vairāgīra kṛtya---sadā nāma-saṅkīrtana
> śāka-patra-phala-mūle udara-bharaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vairāgīra]]---of a person in the renounced order; [[synonyms:k:kṛtya]]---duty; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:ś:śāka]]---vegetables; [[synonyms:p:patra]]---leaves; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---fruit; [[synonyms:m:mūle]]---by roots; [[synonyms:u:udara]]-[[synonyms:b:bharaṇa]]---filling the belly.
translation: "The duty of a person in the renounced order is to chant the Hare Kṛṣṇa mantra always. He should satisfy his belly with whatever vegetables, leaves, fruits and roots are available.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.227
description: "One who is subservient to the tongue and who thus goes here and there, devoted to the genitals and the belly, cannot attain Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> jihvāra lālase yei iti-uti dhāya
> śiśnodara-parāyaṇa kṛṣṇa nāhi pāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jihvāra]]---of the tongue; [[synonyms:l:lālase]]---because of greed; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:d:dhāya]]---goes; [[synonyms:ś:śiśna]]---genitals; [[synonyms:u:udara]]---belly; [[synonyms:p:parāyaṇa]]---devoted to; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---does not get.
translation: "One who is subservient to the tongue and who thus goes here and there, devoted to the genitals and the belly, cannot attain Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.228
description: The next day, Raghunātha dāsa inquired at the lotus feet of Svarūpa Dāmodara about his duty.
text:
> āra dina raghunātha svarūpa-caraṇe
> āpanāra kṛtya lāgi' kailā nivedane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---unto the lotus feet of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]]---his; [[synonyms:k:kṛtya]]---duty; [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---submitted.
translation: The next day, Raghunātha dāsa inquired at the lotus feet of Svarūpa Dāmodara about his duty.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.229
description: "I do not know why I have given up household life," he said."What is my duty? Kindly give me instructions."
text:
> "ki lāgi' chāḍāilā ghara, nā jāni uddeśa
> ki mora kartavya, prabhu kara upadeśa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for what reason; [[synonyms:c:chāḍāilā]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---have I been obliged to give up my household life; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:u:uddeśa]]---the purpose; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:k:kartavya]]---my duty; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my dear Lord; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]]---please give instruction.
translation: "I do not know why I have given up household life," he said."What is my duty? Kindly give me instructions."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.23
description: Indeed, the caudhurī was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because Raghunātha dāsa belong to the kāyastha community. Although the caudhurī would chastise him with oral vibrations, he was afraid to beat him.
text:
> viśeṣe kāyastha-buddhye antare kare ḍara
> mukhe tarje garje, mārite sabhaya antara
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśeṣe]]---specifically; [[synonyms:k:kāyastha]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhye]]---considering a kāyastha; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within his heart; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍara]]---is afraid; [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---with his mouth; [[synonyms:t:tarje]] [[synonyms:g:garje]]---threatens; [[synonyms:m:mārite]]---to beat; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---afraid; [[synonyms:a:antara]]---at heart.
translation: Indeed, the caudhurī was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because Raghunātha dāsa belong to the kāyastha community. Although the caudhurī would chastise him with oral vibrations, he was afraid to beat him.
purport:
Raghunātha dāsa belonged to a very aristocratic family of the //kāyastha// community. He had substantial influence with the local people, and therefore the //caudhurī,// or minister, was afraid to beat him. Superficially he would chastise Raghunātha dāsa with threatening vibrations, but he did not beat him. The members of the //kāyastha// community in India are generally very intelligent and expert in business management. Formerly they were mostly government officers. They were mentioned even by Yājñavalkya, as quoted by Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura in his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya://

> cāta-taṣkara-durvṛttair
> mahā-sāhasikādibhiḥ
> pīḍyamānā prajā rakṣet
> kāyasthaiś ca viśeṣṭaḥ

From this verse it appears that the governmental officials of the //kāyastha// community would sometimes chastise the citizens, and thus it was the duty of the king to protect the people in general from the atrocities of the //kāyasthas.// In Bengal the //kāyastha// community is honored almost as much as the //brāhmaṇa// community, but in the up-country of India the //kāyasthas// are considered //śūdras// because they generally eat meat and drink wine. In any case, from history the //kāyasthas// appear very intelligent. Thus the Mohammedan //caudhurī// was afraid of Raghunātha dāsa because he belonged to the //kāyastha// community.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.230
description: Raghunātha dāsa never even spoke a word before the Lord. Instead, he informed the Lord of his desires through Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Govinda.
text:
> prabhura āge kathā-mātra nā kahe raghunātha
> svarūpa-govinda-dvārā kahā ya nija-vāt
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---any speaking; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---does not say; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---through Govinda and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kahāya]]---he informs; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:v:vāt]]---his intention.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa never even spoke a word before the Lord. Instead, he informed the Lord of his desires through Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī and Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.231
description: The next day, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa has this to say at Your lotus feet.
text:
> prabhura āge svarūpa nivedilā āra dine
> raghunātha nivedaya prabhura caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:n:nivedilā]]---submitted; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the next day; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]] [[synonyms:n:nivedaya]]---Raghunātha dāsa inquires; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: The next day, Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī submitted to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "Raghunātha dāsa has this to say at Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.232
description: "I do not know my duty or the goal of my life. Therefore, please personally give me instructions from Your transcendental mouth.' "
text:
> "ki mora kartavya, muñi nā jāni uddeśa
> āpani śrī-mukhe more kara upadeśa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:k:kartavya]]---my duty; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---do not know; [[synonyms:u:uddeśa]]---the goal of my life; [[synonyms:ā:āpani]]---personally; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---through Your transcendental mouth; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]]---please give instructions.
translation: "I do not know my duty or the goal of my life. Therefore, please personally give me instructions from Your transcendental mouth.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.233
description: Smiling, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "I have already appointed Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī as your instructor.
text:
> hāsi' mahāprabhu raghunāthere kahila
> "tomāra upadeṣṭā kari' svarūpere dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---smiling; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthere]]---to Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---said; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:u:upadeṣṭā]]---instructor; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---as; [[synonyms:s:svarūpere]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---I have appointed Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
translation: Smiling, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu told Raghunātha dāsa, "I have already appointed Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī as your instructor.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.234
description: "You may learn from him what your duty is and how to discharge it. I do not know as much as he.
text:
> 'sādhya'-'sādhana'-tattva śikha iṅhāra sthāne
> āmi tata nāhi jāni, iṅho yata jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sādhya]]---duty; [[synonyms:s:sādhana]]---how to execute it; [[synonyms:t:tattva]]---truth; [[synonyms:ś:śikha]]---learn; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---from him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tata]]---so much; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---do not know; [[synonyms:i:iṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much as; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows.
translation: "You may learn from him what your duty is and how to discharge it. I do not know as much as he.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.235
description: "Nevertheless, if you want to take instructions from Me with faith and love, you may ascertain your duties from the following words.
text:
> tathāpi āmāra ājñā ya śraddhā yadi haya
> āmāra ei vākye tabe kariha niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:y:ya]]---in My instruction; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]]---faith; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---these; [[synonyms:v:vākye]]---by words; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kariha]] [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---you can ascertain.
translation: "Nevertheless, if you want to take instructions from Me with faith and love, you may ascertain your duties from the following words.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.236
description: "Do not talk like people in general or hear what they say. You should not eat very palatable food, nor should you dress very nicely.
text:
> grāmya-kathā nā śunibe, grāmya-vārtā nā kahibe
> bhāla nā khāibe āra bhāla nā paribe
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:grāmya]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---ordinary talks of common men; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ś:śunibe]]---never hear; [[synonyms:g:grāmya]]-[[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---ordinary news; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahibe]]---do not speak; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---well; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāibe]]---do not eat; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---nicely; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:paribe]]---do not dress.
translation: "Do not talk like people in general or hear what they say. You should not eat very palatable food, nor should you dress very nicely.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.237
description: "Do not expect honor, but offer all respect to others. Always chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and within your mind render service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.
text:
> amānī mānada hañā kṛṣṇa-nāma sadā la'be
> vraje rādhā-kṛṣṇa-sevā mānase karibe
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:amānī]]---not expecting any respect; [[synonyms:m:māna]]-[[synonyms:d:da]]---offering respect to others; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---becoming; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of the Lord; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:l:la'be]]---you should chant; [[synonyms:v:vraje]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:r:rādhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mānase]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:k:karibe]]---you should do.
translation: "Do not expect honor, but offer all respect to others. Always chant the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa, and within your mind render service to Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says in his //Amṛta-pravāha-bhāṣya// that when a man and woman are married, they beget children and are thus entangled in family life. Talk concerning such family life is called //grāmya-kathā.// A person in the renounced order never indulges in either hearing or talking about such subjects. He should not eat palatable dishes, since that is unfit for a person in the renounced order. He should show all respect to others, but should not expect respect for himself. In this way, one should chant the holy name of the Lord and think of how to serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa in Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.238
description: "I have briefly given you My instructions. Now you will get all details about them from Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> ei ta' saṅkṣepe āmi kailuṅ upadeśa
> svarūpera ṭhāñi ihāra pāibe viśeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:s:saṅkṣepe]]---in brief; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]]---have given instruction; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this instruction; [[synonyms:p:pāibe]]---you will get; [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---all details.
translation: "I have briefly given you My instructions. Now you will get all details about them from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.239
description: "One who thinks himself lower than grass, who is more tolerant tha a tree, and who does not expect personal honor but is always prepared to give respect to others, can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord."
text:
> tṛṇād api sunīcena
> taror iva sahiṣṇunā
> amāninā mānadena
> kīrtanīyaḥ sadā hariḥ"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tṛṇāt]] [[synonyms:a:api]]---than downtrodden grass; [[synonyms:s:sunīcena]]---being lower; [[synonyms:t:taroḥ]]---than a tree; [[synonyms:i:iva]]---indeed; [[synonyms:s:sahiṣṇunā]]---with more tolerance; [[synonyms:a:amāninā]]---without being puffed up by false pride; [[synonyms:m:mānadena]]---giving respect to all; [[synonyms:k:kīrtanīyaḥ]]---to be chanted; [[synonyms:s:sadā]]---always; [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]]---the holy name of the Lord.
translation: "One who thinks himself lower than grass, who is more tolerant tha a tree, and who does not expect personal honor but is always prepared to give respect to others, can very easily always chant the holy name of the Lord."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.24
description: While this was going on, Raghunātha dāsa thought of a tricky method of escape. Thus he humbly submitted this plea at the feet of the Mohammedan caudhurī.
text:
> tabe raghunātha kichu cintilā upāya
> vinati kariyā kahe sei mleccha-pāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:c:cintilā]]---thought of; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---means; [[synonyms:v:vinati]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---in great humility; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he says; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:mleccha]]---of that Mohammedan caudhurī; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---at the feet.
translation: While this was going on, Raghunātha dāsa thought of a tricky method of escape. Thus he humbly submitted this plea at the feet of the Mohammedan caudhurī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.240
description: Having heard this, Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord, with great mercy, embraced him.
text:
> eta śuni' raghunātha vandilā caraṇa
> mahāprabhu kailā tāṅre kṛpā-āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghu nātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:vandilā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---offered prayers to the lotus feet; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing out of mercy.
translation: Having heard this, Raghunātha dāsa offered prayers at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and the Lord, with great mercy, embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.241
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again entrusted him to Svarūpa Dāmodara. Thus Raghunātha dāsa rendered very confidential service with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
text:
> punaḥ samarpilā tāṅre svarūpera sthāne
> 'antaraṅga-sevā' kare svarūpera sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:s:samarpilā]]---handed over; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:a:antaraṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---very confidential service; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---he renders; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Svarūpa Dāmodara.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again entrusted him to Svarūpa Dāmodara. Thus Raghunātha dāsa rendered very confidential service with Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī.
purport: Antaraṅga-sevā refers to service performed in one's spiritual body. Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī was formerly Lalitādevī. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, who was among his assistants, now also began to serve Rādhā and Kṛṣṇa within his mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.242
description: At this time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived, and, as previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them with great feeling.
text:
> hena-kāle āilā saba gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa
> pūrvavat prabhu sabāya karilā milana
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees from Bengal; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as formerly; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---every one of them; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---met.
translation: At this time, all the devotees from Bengal arrived, and, as previously, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu met them with great feeling.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.243
description: As He had previously done, He cleansed the Guṇḍicā temple and held a picnic feast in the garden with the devotees.
text:
> sabā lañā kailā prabhu guṇḍicā-mārjana
> sabā lañā kailā prabhu vanya-bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:guṇḍicā]]-[[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---washing of the Guṇḍicā temple; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya; [[synonyms:v:vanya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eating in the garden.
translation: As He had previously done, He cleansed the Guṇḍicā temple and held a picnic feast in the garden with the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.244
description: The Lord again danced with the devotees during the Ratha-yātrā festival. Seeing this, Raghunātha dāsa was struck with wonder.
text:
> ratha-yātrāya sabā lañā karilā nartana
> dekhi' raghunāthera camatkāra haila mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrāya]]---during the Ratha-yātrā performance; [[synonyms:s:sabā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking all of them; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---danced; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---struck with wonder; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind.
translation: The Lord again danced with the devotees during the Ratha-yātrā festival. Seeing this, Raghunātha dāsa was struck with wonder.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.245
description: When Raghunātha dāsa met all the devotees, Advaita Ācārya showed him great mercy.
text:
> raghunātha-dāsa yabe sabāre mililā
> advaita-ācārya tāṅre bahu kṛpā kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met all the devotees; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did.
translation: When Raghunātha dāsa met all the devotees, Advaita Ācārya showed him great mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.246
description: He also met Śivānanda Sena, who informed him, "Your father sent ten men to take you away.
text:
> śivānanda-sena tāṅre kahena vivaraṇa
> tomā laite tomāra pitā pāṭhāila daśa jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:sena]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---says; [[synonyms:v:vivarana]]---description; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:l:laite]]---to take you; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---your father; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent; [[synonyms:d:daśa]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---ten men.
translation: He also met Śivānanda Sena, who informed him, "Your father sent ten men to take you away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.247
description: "He wrote me a letter asking me to send you back, but when those ten men received no information about you, they returned home from Jhāṅkarā."
text:
> tomāre pāṭhāite patrī pāṭhāila more
> jhāṅkarā ha-ite tomā nā pāñā gela ghare
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---you; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāite]]---to send back; [[synonyms:p:patrī]]---letter; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]] [[synonyms:m:more]]---sent to me; [[synonyms:j:jhāṅkarā]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---from Jhāṅkarā; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---you; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not getting; [[synonyms:g:gela]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---returned home.
translation: "He wrote me a letter asking me to send you back, but when those ten men received no information about you, they returned home from Jhāṅkarā."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.248
description: When all the devotees from Bengal returned home after staying at Jagannātha Purī for four months, Raghunātha dāsa's father heard about their arrival and therefore sent a man to Śivānanda Sena.
text:
> cāri māsa rahi' bhakta-gaṇa gauḍe gelā
> śuni' raghunāthera pitā manuṣya pāṭhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:m:māsa]]---for four months; [[synonyms:r:rahi']]---remaining; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned to Bengal; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---the father of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---a man; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---sent.
translation: When all the devotees from Bengal returned home after staying at Jagannātha Purī for four months, Raghunātha dāsa's father heard about their arrival and therefore sent a man to Śivānanda Sena.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.249
description: That man inquired from Śivānanda Sena, "Did you see anyone in the renounced order at the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?
text:
> se manuṣya śivānanda-senere puchila
> "mahāprabhura sthāne eka 'vairāgī' dekhila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---that messenger; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]-[[synonyms:s:senere]]---from Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---at the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:v:vairāgī]]---a person in the renounced order; [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---did you see.
translation: That man inquired from Śivānanda Sena, "Did you see anyone in the renounced order at the residence of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.25
description: "My dear sir, my father and his elder brother are both your brothers. All brothers always fight about something.
text:
> "āmāra pitā, jyeṭhā haya tomāra dui bhāi
> bhāi-bhāiye tomarā kalaha kara sarvadāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---my father; [[synonyms:j:jyeṭhā]]---and his elder brother; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---two brothers; [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāiye]]---between brother and brother; [[synonyms:t:tomarā]]---all of you; [[synonyms:k:kalaha]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---fight; [[synonyms:s:sarvadāi]]---always.
translation: "My dear sir, my father and his elder brother are both your brothers. All brothers always fight about something.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.250
description: "That person is Raghunātha dāsa, the son of Govardhana Majumadāra. Did you meet him in Nīlācala?"
text:
> govardhanera putra teṅho, nāma---'raghunātha'
> nīlācale paricaya āche tomāra sātha?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govardhanera]]---of Govardhana; [[synonyms:p:putra]]---the son; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---named; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---in Nīlācala; [[synonyms:p:paricayaāche]]---is there acquaintance; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sātha]]---with you.
translation: "That person is Raghunātha dāsa, the son of Govardhana Majumadāra. Did you meet him in Nīlācala?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.251
description: Śivānanda Sena replied, "Yes, sir. Raghunātha dāsa is with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and is a very famous man. Who does not know him?
text:
> śivānanda kahe,---"teṅho haya prabhura sthāne
> parama vikhyāta teṅho, kebā nāhi jāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śivānanda Sena replied; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:v:vikhyāta]]---very famous; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kebā]]---who; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---does not know.
translation: Śivānanda Sena replied, "Yes, sir. Raghunātha dāsa is with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and is a very famous man. Who does not know him?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.252
description: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has placed him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara. Raghunātha dāsa has become just like the life of all the Lord's devotees.
text:
> svarūpera sthāne tāre kariyāchena samarpaṇa
> prabhura bhakta-gaṇera teṅho haya prāṇa-sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---Lord Caitanya has given charge of; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of all the devotees; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---the life; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---like.
translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has placed him under the charge of Svarūpa Dāmodara. Raghunātha dāsa has become just like the life of all the Lord's devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.253
description: "He chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all day and night. He never gives up the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not even for a moment.
text:
> rātri-dina kare teṅho nāma-saṅkīrtana
> kṣaṇa-mātra nāhi chāḍe prabhura caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---all day and night; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---chanting of the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mantra//; [[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---even for a moment; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍe]]---does not give up; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: "He chants the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra all day and night. He never gives up the shelter of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, not even for a moment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.254
description: "He is in the supreme order of renounced life. Indeed, he does not care about eating or dressing. Somehow or other he eats and maintains his life.
text:
> parama vairāgya tāra, nāhi bhakṣya-paridhāna
> yaiche taiche āhāra kari' rākhaye parāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:parama]]---supreme; [[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---renunciation; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]---eating; [[synonyms:p:paridhāna]]---dressing; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]] [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---somehow or other; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---eating; [[synonyms:r:rākhaye]] [[synonyms:p:parāṇa]]---keeps life.
translation: "He is in the supreme order of renounced life. Indeed, he does not care about eating or dressing. Somehow or other he eats and maintains his life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.255
description: "After ten daṇḍas [four hours] of the night have passed and Raghunātha dāsa has seen the performance of puṣpāñjali, he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg some alms to eat.
text:
> daśa-daṇḍa rātri gele 'puṣpāñjali' dekhiyā
> siṁha-dvāre khāḍā haya āhāra lāgiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---ten //daṇḍas// (240 minutes); [[synonyms:r:rātri]]---night; [[synonyms:g:gele]]---having gone; [[synonyms:p:puṣpāñjali]]---the puṣpāñjali performance; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---after seeing; [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the Siṁha-dvāra gate; [[synonyms:k:khāḍā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---stands; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---to get some alms for eating.
translation: "After ten daṇḍas [four hours] of the night have passed and Raghunātha dāsa has seen the performance of puṣpāñjali, he stands at the Siṁha-dvāra gate to beg some alms to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.256
description: "He eats if someone gives him something to eat. Sometimes he fasts, and sometimes he chews fried grains."
text:
> keha yadi deya, tabe karaye bhakṣaṇa
> kabhu upavāsa, kabhu karaye carvaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:d:deya]]---offers; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---he eats; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:u:upavāsa]]---fasting; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:c:carvaṇa]]---he chews.
translation: "He eats if someone gives him something to eat. Sometimes he fasts, and sometimes he chews fried grains."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.257
description: After hearing this, the messenger returned to Govardhana Majumadāra and informed him all about Raghunātha dāsa.
text:
> eta śuni' sei manuṣya govardhana-sthāne
> kahila giyā saba raghunātha-vivaraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing this; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---that messenger; [[synonyms:g:govardhana]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Govardhana Majumadāra; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---spoke; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:v:vivaraṇe]]---the description of Raghunātha dāsa.
translation: After hearing this, the messenger returned to Govardhana Majumadāra and informed him all about Raghunātha dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.258
description: Hearing the description of Raghunātha dāsa's behavior in the renounced order, his father and mother were very unhappy. Therefore they decided to send him some men with goods for his comfort.
text:
> śuni' tāṅra mātā pitā duḥkhita ha-ila
> putra-ṭhāñi dravya-manuṣya pāṭhāite mana kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:mātā]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---father and mother; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhita]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became very unhappy; [[synonyms:p:putra]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to their son; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]-[[synonyms:m:manuṣya]]---articles and men; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāite]]---to send; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---decided.
translation: Hearing the description of Raghunātha dāsa's behavior in the renounced order, his father and mother were very unhappy. Therefore they decided to send him some men with goods for his comfort.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.259
description: Raghunātha dāsa's father immediately sent four hundred coins, two servants and one brāhmaṇa to Śivānanda Sena.
text:
> cāri-śata mudrā, dui bhṛtya, eka brāhmaṇa
> śivānandera ṭhāñi pāṭhāila tata-kṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---four hundred coins; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---two servants; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---one //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:ś:śivānandera]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent; [[synonyms:t:tata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---immediately.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa's father immediately sent four hundred coins, two servants and one brāhmaṇa to Śivānanda Sena.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.26
description: "Sometimes brothers fight among themselves, and sometimes they have very friendly dealings. There is no certainty when such changes will take place. Thus I am sure that although today you are fighting, tomorrow you three brothers will be sitting together in peace.
text:
> kabhu kalaha, kabhu prīti---ihāra niścaya nāi
> kāli punaḥ tina bhāi ha-ibā eka-ṭhāñi
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:k:kalaha]]---fight; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:p:prīti]]---very intimate friendly behavior; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of these things; [[synonyms:n:niścayanāi]]---there is no certainty; [[synonyms:k:kāli]]---the next day; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---three brothers; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibā]]---will be; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---at one place.
translation: "Sometimes brothers fight among themselves, and sometimes they have very friendly dealings. There is no certainty when such changes will take place. Thus I am sure that although today you are fighting, tomorrow you three brothers will be sitting together in peace.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.260
description: Śivānanda Sena informed them, "You cannot go to Jagannātha Purī directly. When I go there, you may accompany me.
text:
> śivānanda kahe,---"tumi saba yāite nāribā
> āmi yāi yabe, āmāra saṅge yāibā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śivānanda Sena said; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:y:yāite]] [[synonyms:n:nāribā]]---cannot go; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:y:yāi]]---I go; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with me; [[synonyms:y:yāibā]]---you will go.
translation: Śivānanda Sena informed them, "You cannot go to Jagannātha Purī directly. When I go there, you may accompany me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.261
description: "Now go home. When all of us go, I shall take all of you with me."
text:
> ebe ghara yāha, yabe āmi saba calimu
> tabe tomā sabākāre saṅge lañā yāmu
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:g:ghara]] [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go home; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---we; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:calimu]]---will go; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:s:sabākāre]]---all of you; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:y:yāmu]]---I shall go.
translation: "Now go home. When all of us go, I shall take all of you with me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.262
description: Describing this incident, the great poet Śrī Kavi-karṇapūra has written extensively about the glorious activities of Raghunātha dāsa in his book.
text:
> ei ta' prastāve śrī kavi-karṇapūra
> raghunātha-mahimā granthe likhilā pracura
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:p:prastāve]]---in this connection; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]] [[synonyms:k:kavi]]-[[synonyms:k:karṇapūra]]---the poet named Kavi-karṇapūra; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---the glories of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:g:granthe]]---in his book; [[synonyms:l:likhilā]]---wrote; [[synonyms:p:pracura]]---much.
translation: Describing this incident, the great poet Śrī Kavi-karṇapūra has written extensively about the glorious activities of Raghunātha dāsa in his book.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.263
description: "Raghunātha dāsa is a disciple of Yadunandana Ācārya, who is very gentle and is extremely dear to Vāsudeva Datta, a resident of Kāñcanapallī. Because of Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental qualities, he is always more dear than life for all of us devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Since he has been favored by the abundant mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he is always pleasing. Vividly providing a superior example for the renounced order, this very dear follower of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is the ocean of renunciation. Who among the residents of Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] does not know him very well?
text:
> ācāryo yadunandanaḥ sumadhuraḥ śrī-vāsudeva-priyas
> tac-chiṣyo raghunātha ity adhiguṇaḥ prāṇādhiko mādṛśām
> śrī-caitanya-kṛpātireka-satata-snigdhaḥ svarūpānugo
> vairāgyaika-nidhir na kasya vidito nīlācale tiṣṭhatām
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaḥ]] [[synonyms:y:yadunandanaḥ]]---Yadunandana Ācārya; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:m:madhuraḥ]]---very well behaved; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]-[[synonyms:p:priyaḥ]]---very dear to Śrī Vāsudeva Datta Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiṣyaḥ]]---his disciple; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthaḥ]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:a:adhiguṇaḥ]]---so qualified; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:adhikaḥ]]---more dear than life; [[synonyms:m:mā]]-[[synonyms:d:dṛśām]]---of all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu like me; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---by the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:atireka]]---excess; [[synonyms:s:satata]]-[[synonyms:s:snigdhaḥ]]---always pleasing; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:a:anugaḥ]]---following in the footsteps of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---of renunciation; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:n:nidhiḥ]]---the ocean; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kasya]]---by whom; [[synonyms:v:viditaḥ]]---known; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:t:tiṣṭhatām]]---of those who were staying.
translation: "Raghunātha dāsa is a disciple of Yadunandana Ācārya, who is very gentle and is extremely dear to Vāsudeva Datta, a resident of Kāñcanapallī. Because of Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental qualities, he is always more dear than life for all of us devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Since he has been favored by the abundant mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he is always pleasing. Vividly providing a superior example for the renounced order, this very dear follower of Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī is the ocean of renunciation. Who among the residents of Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] does not know him very well?
purport: This verse is from //Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka// (10.3) of Kavi-karṇapūra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.264
description: "Because he is very pleasing to all the devotees, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī easily became like the fertile earth of good fortune in which it was suitable for the seed of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be sown. At the same time that the seed was sown, it grew into a matchless tree of the love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and produced fruit."
text:
> yaḥ sarva-lokaika-manobhirucyā
> saubhāgya-bhūḥ kācid akṛṣṭa-pacyā
> yatrāyam āropaṇa-tulya-kālaṁ
> tat-prema-śākhī phalavān atulyaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---of all the devotees in Purī; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---foremost; [[synonyms:m:manaḥ]]---of the minds; [[synonyms:a:abhirucyā]]---by the affection; [[synonyms:s:saubhāgya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūḥ]]---the ground of good fortune; [[synonyms:k:kācit]]---indescribable; [[synonyms:a:akṛṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:p:pacyā]]---perfect without tilling or perfect without practice; [[synonyms:y:yatra]]---in which; [[synonyms:a:ayam]]---this; [[synonyms:ā:āropaṇa]]-[[synonyms:t:tulya]]-[[synonyms:k:kālam]]---at the same time as the sowing of the seed; [[synonyms:t:tat]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ś:śākhī]]---a tree of the love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:phalavān]]---fruitful; [[synonyms:a:atulyaḥ]]---the matchless.
translation: "Because he is very pleasing to all the devotees, Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī easily became like the fertile earth of good fortune in which it was suitable for the seed of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu to be sown. At the same time that the seed was sown, it grew into a matchless tree of the love of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and produced fruit."
purport: This is the next verse from //Śrī Caitanya-candrodaya-nāṭaka// (10.4).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.265
description: In these verses, the great poet Kavi-karṇapūra gives the same information that Śivānanda Sena conveyed to the messenger from Raghunātha dāsa's father.
text:
> śivānanda yaiche sei manuṣye kahilā
> karṇapūra sei-rūpe śloka varṇilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---unto the; [[synonyms:m:manuṣye]]---messenger; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---said; [[synonyms:k:karṇapūra]]---the great poet Kavi-karṇapūra; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:r:rūpe]]---in that way; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:v:varṇilā]]---composed verses.
translation: In these verses, the great poet Kavi-karṇapūra gives the same information that Śivānanda Sena conveyed to the messenger from Raghunātha dāsa's father.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.266
description: The next year, when Śivānanda Sena was going to Jagannātha Purī as usual, the servants and the brāhmaṇa, who was a cook, went with him.
text:
> varṣāntare śivānanda cale nīlācale
> raghunāthera sevaka, vipra tāṅra saṅge cale
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---the next year; [[synonyms:ś:śivānanda]]---Śivānanda Sena; [[synonyms:c:cale]] [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---was going to Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---the servants; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---and the brāhmaṇa; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with him; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---go.
translation: The next year, when Śivānanda Sena was going to Jagannātha Purī as usual, the servants and the brāhmaṇa, who was a cook, went with him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.267
description: The servants and brāhmaṇa brought four hundred coins to Jagannātha Purī, and there they met Raghunātha dāsa.
text:
> sei vipra bhṛtya, cāri-śata mudrā lañā
> nīlācale raghunāthe mililā āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---that //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:b:bhṛtya]]---the servants; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---four hundred coins; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---with Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming.
translation: The servants and brāhmaṇa brought four hundred coins to Jagannātha Purī, and there they met Raghunātha dāsa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.268
description: Raghunātha dāsa did not accept the money and men sent by his father. Therefore a servant and the brāhmaṇa stayed there with the money.
text:
> raghunātha-dāsa aṅgīkāra nā karila
> dravya lañā dui-jana tāhāṅi rahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---did not accept; [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking the wealth; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two persons; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅi]] [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---remained there.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa did not accept the money and men sent by his father. Therefore a servant and the brāhmaṇa stayed there with the money.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.269
description: At that time, Raghunātha dāsa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his house with great attention for two days every month.
text:
> tabe raghunātha kari' aneka yatana
> māse dui-dina kailā prabhura nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:a:aneka]] [[synonyms:y:yatana]]---with great attention; [[synonyms:m:māse]]---every month; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---two days; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---he made; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: At that time, Raghunātha dāsa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to his house with great attention for two days every month.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.27
description: "Just as I am my father's son, so I am also yours. I am your dependent, and you are my maintainer.
text:
> āmi yaiche pitāra, taiche tomāra bālaka
> āmi tomāra pālya, tumi āmāra pālaka

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.275
description: " 'My consciousness is impure because I accept all these goods from people who are interested only in pounds, shillings and pence. Therefore by this kind of invitation I only get some material reputation.

synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:c:citta]]---my consciousness; [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---to accept the goods; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is not; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---pure; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇe]]---by this invitation; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:p:pratiṣṭhā]]---reputation; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---the result.
translation: “ 'My consciousness is impure because I accept all these goods from people who are interested only in pounds, shillings and pence. Therefore by this kind of invitation I only get some material reputation.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura remarks that people who are under the bodily conception of life are called materialists. If we accept the offerings of such people, place them before the Lord and invite Vaiṣṇavas to partake of the prasāda, that attempt will gain us only a material reputation, not the actual benefit of service to a pure Vaiṣṇava. One should therefore try to serve the Supreme Personality of Godhead by fully surrendering at His lotus feet. If one engages for the service of the Lord whatever money one has honestly earned, that is spiritual service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the spiritual master and the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.276
description: " 'At my request Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepts the invitations because He knows that a foolish person like me would be unhappy if He did not accept them.'

synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uparodhe]]---by my request; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:m:mānena]]---accepts; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:m:mānile]]---if He does not accept; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]]---unhappy; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibeka]]---will become; [[synonyms:m:mūrkha]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---foolish person.
translation: “ 'At my request Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu accepts the invitations because He knows that a foolish person like me would be unhappy if He did not accept them.'
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura says that people who are advanced in learning but attached to material enjoyment, who are puffed up by material possessions, by birth in an elevated aristocratic family or by education, may offer showbottle devotional service to the Deity and also offer prasāda to Vaiṣṇavas. Because of their ignorance, however, they cannot understand that since their minds are materially polluted, neither the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Lord Kṛṣṇa, nor the Vaiṣṇavas accept their offerings. If one accepts money from such materialistic persons to offer food to the Deity and Vaiṣṇavas, a pure Vaiṣṇava does not accept it. This causes unhappiness for the materialists because they are fully absorbed in the bodily conception of life. Therefore they sometimes turn against the Vaiṣṇavas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.278
description: "When one eats food offered by a materialistic man, one's mind becomes contaminated, and when the mind is contaminated, one is unable to think of Kṛṣṇa properly.
text:
> "viṣayīra anna khāile malina haya mana
> malina mana haile nahe kṛṣṇera smaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viṣayīra]]---of materialistic persons; [[synonyms:a:anna]]---food; [[synonyms:k:khāile]]---if one eats; [[synonyms:m:malina]]---contaminated; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind becomes; [[synonyms:m:malina]]---contaminated; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:h:haile]]---when the mind becomes; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---remembrance.
translation:
"When one eats food offered by a materialistic man, one's mind becomes contaminated, and when the mind is contaminated, one is unable to think of Kṛṣṇa properly.


PURPORT

Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura suggests that people who are materialistically inclined and //sahajiyās,// or so-called Vaiṣṇavas who take everything very casually, are both //viṣayi// materialists. Eating food offered by them causes contamination, and as a result of such contamination, even a serious devotee becomes like a materialistic man. There are six kinds of association-giving charity, accepting charity, accepting food, offering food, talking confidentially and inquiring confidentially. One should very carefully avoid associating with both the //sahajiyās,// who are sometimes known as Vaiṣṇavas, and the non-Vaiṣṇavas, or avaiṣṇavas. Their association changes the transcendental devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa into sense gratification, and when sense gratification enters the mind of a devotee, he is contaminated. The materialistic person who aspires after sense gratification cannot properly think of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.279

translation: "When one accepts an invitation from a person contaminated by the material mode of passion, the person who offers the food and the person who accepts it are both mentally contaminated.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktivinoda Ṭhākura says that there are three varieties of invitations---those in the mode of goodness, those in passion and those in ignorance. An invitation accepted from a pure devotee is in the mode of goodness, an invitation accepted from a person who is pious but materially attached is in the mode of passion, and an invitation accepted from a person who is materially very sinful is in the mode of ignorance.

translation: After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu again bestowed His mercy upon Raghunātha dāsa by giving him a piece of stone from Govardhana Hill and a garland of small conchshells.

translation: Hearing Raghunātha dāsa's appealing voice, the Mohammedan's heart softened. He began to cry, and tears glided down his beard.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.291

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.292

translation: The stone from Govardhana was always moist with tears from His eyes. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would say, "This stone is directly the body of Lord Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.293
description: For three years He kept the stone and garland. Then, greatly satisfied by the behavior of Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord delivered both of them to him.
text:
> ei-mata tina-vatsara śilā-mālā dharilā
> tuṣṭa hañā śilā-mālā raghunāthe dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:v:vatsara]]---for three years; [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]]---the stone and the garland of conchshells; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---He kept; [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---when He became very happy; [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]]---the stone and the garland; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---to Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---He delivered.
translation: For three years He kept the stone and garland. Then, greatly satisfied by the behavior of Raghunātha dāsa, the Lord delivered both of them to him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.294
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Raghunātha dāsa, "This stone is the transcendental form of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Worship the stone with great eagerness."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"ei śilā kṛṣṇera vigraha
> iṅhāra sevā kara tumi kariyā āgraha
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]---this stone; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:v:vigraha]]---the form of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of this; [[synonyms:s:sevā]]---worship; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kariyā]] [[synonyms:ā:āgraha]]---with great eagerness.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed Raghunātha dāsa, "This stone is the transcendental form of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Worship the stone with great eagerness."
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura writes in his //Anubhāṣya// that in the opinion of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the //govardhana-śilā,// the stone from Govardhana Hill, was directly the form of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda. The Lord used the stone for three years, and then in the heart of Raghunātha dāsa the Lord awakened devotional service to the stone. The Lord then gave the stone to Raghunātha dāsa, accepting him as one of His most confidential servants. However, some envious people conclude that because Raghunātha dāsa had not taken birth in the family of a //brāhmaṇa,// Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not give him the right to worship the Deity directly, but instead gave him a stone from Govardhana. This kind of thought is //nārakī,// or hellish. As stated in the //Padma Purāṇa, arcye viṣṇau śilādhīr guruṣu nara-matir vaiṣṇave jāti-buddhiḥ. ..yasya vā nārakī saḥ:// "One who considers the //arcā-mūrti// (the worshipable Deity of Lord Viṣṇu) to be stone, the spiritual master to be an ordinary human being, or a Vaiṣṇava to belong to a particular creed is possessed of hellish intelligence." If one thinks that the worshipable //śālagrāma-śilā// is a mere stone, that the spiritual master is an ordinary human being or that a pure Vaiṣṇava preaching the //bhakti// cult all over the world is a member of a particular caste or material division of society, he is considered a //nārakī,// a candidate for hellish life. When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu instructed that the //govardhana-śilā,// the stone taken from Govardhana, is nondifferent from the body of Śrī Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, He indirectly advised such foolish persons that one should not be envious of a Vaiṣṇava who belongs to a different caste or sect. One should accept a Vaiṣṇava as transcendental. in this way one can be saved; otherwise, one is surely awaiting a hellish life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.295
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Worship this stone in the mode of goodness like a perfect brāhmaṇa, for by such worship you will surely attain ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa without delay.
text:
> ei śilāre kara tumi sāttvika pūjana
> acirāt pābe tumi kṛṣṇa-prema-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śilāra]]---of this stone; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:s:sāttvika]] [[synonyms:p:pūjana]]---worshiping like a perfect //brāhmaṇa,// or in the mode of goodness; [[synonyms:a:acirāt]]---very soon; [[synonyms:p:pābe]] [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you will get; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---wealth.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu continued, "Worship this stone in the mode of goodness like a perfect brāhmaṇa, for by such worship you will surely attain ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa without delay.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.296
description: "For such worship, one needs a jug of water and a few flowers from a tulasī tree. This is worship in complete goodness when performed in complete purity.
text:
> eka kuṅjā jala āra tulasī-mañjarī
> sāttvika-sevā ei---śuddha-bhāve kari
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:k:kuṅjā]]---jug; [[synonyms:j:jala]]---water; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:t:tulasī]]-[[synonyms:m:mañjarī]]---flowers of the tulasī tree; [[synonyms:s:sāttvika]]-[[synonyms:s:sevā]]---worship in goodness; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in complete purity; [[synonyms:k:kari]]---performing.
translation: "For such worship, one needs a jug of water and a few flowers from a tulasī tree. This is worship in complete goodness when performed in complete purity.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.297
description: "With faith and love, you should offer eight soft tulasī flowers, each with two tulasī leaves, one on each side of each flower."
text:
> dui-dike dui-patra madhye komala mañjarī
> ei-mata aṣṭa-mañjarī dibe śraddhā kari" '
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on two sides; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:p:patra]]---two //tulasī// leaves; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---within; [[synonyms:k:komala]] [[synonyms:m:mañjarī]]---very soft //tulasī// flower; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:m:mañjarī]]---eight //tulasī// flowers; [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---you should offer; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with faith and love.
translation: "With faith and love, you should offer eight soft tulasī flowers, each with two tulasī leaves, one on each side of each flower."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.298
description: After thus advising him how to worship, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally offered Raghunātha dāsa the govardhana-śilā with His transcendental hand. As advised by the Lord, Raghunātha dāsa worshiped the śilā in great transcendental jubilation.
text:

> ānande raghunātha sevā karite lāgilā

translation: After thus advising him how to worship, Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu personally offered Raghunātha dāsa the govardhana-śilā with His transcendental hand. As advised by the Lord, Raghunātha dāsa worshiped the śilā in great transcendental jubilation.

translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara gave Raghunātha dāsa two cloths, each about six inches long, a wooden platform and a jug in which to keep water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.3

> ei-mata gauracandra bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> nīlācale nānā līlā kare nānā-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhaktagaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His associates; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Nīlācala (Jagannātha Purī); [[synonyms:n:na]]-[[synonyms:n:na]]---various; [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in varieties of transcendental pleasure.
translation: Thus Lord Gauracandra performed various pastimes with His associates at Jagannātha Purī in varieties of transcendental pleasure.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.30

text:
> mleccha bale,---"āji haite tumi---mora'putra'

translation: The Mohammedan caudhurī told Raghunātha dāsa, "You are my son from this day on. Today, by some means, I shall have you released."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.300
description: Thus Raghunātha dāsa began worshiping the stone from Govardhana, and as he worshiped he saw the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, directly in the stone.
text:
> ei-mata raghunātha karena pūjana
> pūjā-kāle dekhe śilāya 'vrajendra-nandana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:pūjana]]---worships; [[synonyms:p:pūjā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---while worshiping; [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---he sees; [[synonyms:ś:śilāya]]---in the stone from Govardhana; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
translation: Thus Raghunātha dāsa began worshiping the stone from Govardhana, and as he worshiped he saw the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja, directly in the stone.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.301

text:
> 'prabhura svahasta-datta govardhana-śilā
> ei cinti' raghunātha preme bhāsi' gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:h:hasta]]---own hand; [[synonyms:d:datta]]---handed over by; [[synonyms:g:govardhana]]-[[synonyms:ś:śilā]]---the stone from Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:c:cinti']]---thinking this; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāsi']] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---became overflooded.
translation: Thinking of how he had received the govardhana-śilā directly from the hands of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was always overflooded with ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.302
description: The amount of transcendental bliss that Raghunātha dāsa enjoyed simply by offering water and tulasī is impossible to achieve even if one worships the Deity with sixteen kinds of paraphernalia.
text:
> jala-tulasīra sevāya tāṅra yata sukhodaya
> ṣoḍaśopacāra-pūjāya tata sukha naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jala]]-[[synonyms:t:tulasīra]] [[synonyms:s:sevāya]]---by worshiping with water and //tulasī//; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much as; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:u:udaya]]---rise of transcendental happiness; [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣoḍaśa]]-[[synonyms:u:upacāra]]-[[synonyms:p:pūjāya]]---by worshiping with sixteen kinds of paraphernalia; [[synonyms:t:tata]]---so much; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:n:naya]]---is not.
translation: The amount of transcendental bliss that Raghunātha dāsa enjoyed simply by offering water and tulasī is impossible to achieve even if one worships the Deity with sixteen kinds of paraphernalia.

> tabe svarūpa-gosāñi tāṅre kahilā vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---for some days; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:pūjana]]---he worshiped; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---said some words.
translation: After Raghunātha dāsa had thus worshiped the govardhana-śilā for some time, Svarūpa Dāmodara one day spoke to him as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.304
description: "Offer the Govardhana stone eight kauḍis worth of the first-class sweetmeats known as khājā and sandeśa. If you offer them with faith and love, they will be just like nectar."
text:
> "aṣṭa-kauḍira khājā-sandeśa kara samarpaṇa
> śraddhā kari' dile, sei amṛtera sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:k:kauḍira]]---costing eight //kauḍis//; [[synonyms:k:khājā]]-[[synonyms:s:sandeśa]]---//khājā// and //sandeśa// sweetmeats; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---offer; [[synonyms:ś:śraddhā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with love and faith; [[synonyms:d:dile]]---if you offer; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]] [[synonyms:s:sama]]---just like nectar.
translation: "Offer the Govardhana stone eight kauḍis worth of the first-class sweetmeats known as khājā and sandeśa. If you offer them with faith and love, they will be just like nectar."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.305
description: Raghunātha dāsa then began offering the costly sweetmeats known as khājā, which Govinda, following the order of Svarūpa Dāmodara, would supply.
text:
> tabe aṣṭa-kauḍira khājā kare samarpaṇa
> svarūpa-ājñāya govinda tāhā kare samādhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:k:kauḍira]]---costing eight kauḍis; [[synonyms:k:khājā]]---the sweetmeat named //khājā//; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:samarpaṇa]]---offers; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñāya]]---by the order of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the personal servant of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---arranges.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa then began offering the costly sweetmeats known as khājā, which Govinda, following the order of Svarūpa Dāmodara, would supply.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.306
description: When Raghunātha dāsa received from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the stone and the garland of conchshells, he could understand the Lord's intention. Thus he thought as follows.
text:
> raghunātha sei śilā-mālā yabe pāilā
> gosāñira abhiprāya ei bhāvanā karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:ś:śilā]]---that stone; [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---garland; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---he got; [[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:abhiprāya]]---intention; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:b:bhāvanā]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---he thought.
translation: When Raghunātha dāsa received from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu the stone and the garland of conchshells, he could understand the Lord's intention. Thus he thought as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.307
description: "By offering me the govardhana-śilā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has offered me a place near Govardhana Hill, and by offering me the garland of conch shells, He has offered me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."
text:
> "śilā diyā gosāñi samarpilā 'govardhane'
> guñjā-mālā diyā dilā 'rādhikā-caraṇe'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śilā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---by offering this stone; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:samarpilā]]---offered; [[synonyms:g:govardhane]]---a place near Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:g:guñjā]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---by offering the garland of small conchshells; [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---offered; [[synonyms:r:rādhikā]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---shelter at the lotus feet of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī.
translation: "By offering me the govardhana-śilā, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has offered me a place near Govardhana Hill, and by offering me the garland of conch shells, He has offered me shelter at the lotus feet of Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.308
description: Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental bliss was boundless. Forgetting everything external, he served the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with his body and mind.
text:
> ānande raghunāthera bāhya vismaraṇa
> kāya-mane sevilena gaurāṅga-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ānande]]---in transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]] [[synonyms:v:vismaraṇa]]---forgetting everything external; [[synonyms:k:kāya]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---by mind and body; [[synonyms:s:sevilena]]---served; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa's transcendental bliss was boundless. Forgetting everything external, he served the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with his body and mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.309
description: Who could list the unlimited transcendental attributes of Raghunātha dāsa? His strict regulative principles were exactly like lines on a stone.
text:
> ananta guṇa raghunāthera ke karibe lekhā?
> raghunāthera niyama,---yena pāṣāṇera rekhā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ananta]] [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---unlimited transcendental attributes; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:l:lekhā]]---can write; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:n:niyama]]---the strict regulative principles; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---like; [[synonyms:p:pāṣāṇera]] [[synonyms:r:rekhā]]---lines on a stone.
translation: Who could list the unlimited transcendental attributes of Raghunātha dāsa? His strict regulative principles were exactly like lines on a stone.
purport: The words //pāṣāṇerarekhā// are very significant. Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī followed the regulative principles so strictly and rigidly that they were compared to the lines on a stone. As such lines cannot be erased at any time, so the regulative principles observed by Śrī Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī could not be changed under any circumstances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.31
description: After informing the minister, the caudhurī released Raghunātha dāsa and then began to speak to him with great affection.
text:
> ujire kahiyā raghunāthe chāḍāila
> prīti kari' raghunāthe kahite lāgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:ujire]]---unto the minister; [[synonyms:k:kahiyā]]---speaking; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍāila]]---released Raghu nātha dāsa; [[synonyms:p:prīti]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great affection; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---unto Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---began to say.
translation: After informing the minister, the caudhurī released Raghunātha dāsa and then began to speak to him with great affection.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.310
description: Raghunātha dāsa spent more than twenty-two hours out of every twenty-four chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and remembering the lotus feet of the Lord. He ate and slept for less than an hour and a half, and on some days that also was impossible.
text:
> sāḍe sāta prahara yāya kīrtana-smaraṇe
> āhāra-nidrā cāri daṇḍa seha nahe kona dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sāḍe]] [[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:p:prahara]]---7.5 //praharas// (one //prahara// equals three hours); [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---is spent; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]]-[[synonyms:s:smaraṇe]]---in chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa //mahā-mantra// and remembering the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]]-[[synonyms:n:nidrā]]---eating and sleeping; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---four //daṇḍas// (one //daṇḍa// equals twenty-four minutes); [[synonyms:s:seha]]---that; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---some days.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa spent more than twenty-two hours out of every twenty-four chanting the Hare Kṛṣṇa mahā-mantra and remembering the lotus feet of the Lord. He ate and slept for less than an hour and a half, and on some days that also was impossible.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.311
description: Topics concerning his renunciation are wonderful. Throughout his life he never allowed his tongue sense gratification.
text:
> vairāgyera kathā tāṅra adbhuta-kathana
> ājanma nā dila jihvāya rasera sparśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vairāgyera]]---of the renunciation; [[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of him; [[synonyms:a:adbhuta]]-[[synonyms:k:kathana]]---wonderful topics; [[synonyms:ā:ā]]-[[synonyms:j:janma]]---from birth; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---did not allow; [[synonyms:j:jihvāya]]---to the tongue; [[synonyms:r:rasera]] [[synonyms:s:sparśana]]---tasting.
translation: Topics concerning his renunciation are wonderful. Throughout his life he never allowed his tongue sense gratification.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.312
description: He never touched anything to wear except a small torn cloth and a patchwork wrapper. Thus he very rigidly executed the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> chiṇḍā kāni kāṅthā vinā nā pare vasana
> sāvadhāne prabhura kailā ājñāra pālana
