synonyms: [[synonyms:c:chiṇḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kāni]]---a small torn cloth; [[synonyms:k:kāṅthā]]---a patchwork cotton wrapper; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---except; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pare]]---does not wear; [[synonyms:v:vasana]]---clothing; [[synonyms:s:sāvadhāne]]---with great care; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:ā:ājñāra]] [[synonyms:p:pālana]]---execution of the order.
translation: He never touched anything to wear except a small torn cloth and a patchwork wrapper. Thus he very rigidly executed the order of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
purport: The principle of very rigidly carrying out the order of the spiritual master must be observed. The spiritual master gives different orders to different people. For example, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Jīva Gosvāmī, Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī to preach, and He ordered Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī to strictly follow the rules and regulations of the renounced order. All six Gosvāmīs strictly followed the instructions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. This is the principle for progress in devotional service. After receiving an order from the spiritual master, one must strictly try to execute the order. That is the way of success.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.313
description: Whatever he ate was only to keep his body and soul together, and when he ate he would reproach himself thus.
text:
> prāṇa-rakṣā lāgi' yebā karena bhakṣaṇa
> tāhā khāñā āpanāke kahe nirveda-vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rakṣā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---to maintain life; [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---whatever; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---he ate; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---eating that; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāke]]---to himself; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:n:nirveda]]-[[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words of reproach.
translation: Whatever he ate was only to keep his body and soul together, and when he ate he would reproach himself thus.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.314
description: "If one's heart has been cleansed by perfect knowledge and one has understood Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Brahman, he then gains everything. Why should such a person act like a debauchee by trying very carefully to maintain his material body?"
text:
> ātmānaṁ ced vijānīyāt
> paraṁ jñāna-dhūtāśayaḥ
> kim icchan kasya vā hetor
> dehaṁ puṣṇāti lampaṭaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ātmānam]]---the soul; [[synonyms:c:cet]]---if; [[synonyms:v:vijānīyāt]]---one understands; [[synonyms:p:param]]---supreme; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---by knowledge; [[synonyms:d:dhūta]]---thrown off; [[synonyms:ā:āśayaḥ]]---material desires; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:i:icchan]]---desiring; [[synonyms:k:kasya]]---what; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:h:hetoḥ]]---for reason; [[synonyms:d:deham]]---the material body; [[synonyms:p:puṣṇāti]]---maintains; [[synonyms:l:lampaṭaḥ]]---debauchee.
translation: "If one's heart has been cleansed by perfect knowledge and one has understood Kṛṣṇa, the Supreme Brahman, he then gains everything. Why should such a person act like a debauchee by trying very carefully to maintain his material body?"
purport: This verse [[books:sb:7:15:40|(Bhāg. 7.15.40)]] was spoken by Nārada to Yudhiṣṭhira Mahārāja regarding a householder's liberation from material bondage. On the spiritual platform, one does not unnecessarily care for the body. Śrīla Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura has said, //deha-smṛti nāhi yāra, saṁsāra bandhana kāhāṅ tāra.// One who is spiritually situated does not think that he is the body. Therefore he can transcendentally execute severe penances in the renounced order of life. The best example of such renunciation is Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.315
description: Lord Jagannātha's prasāda is sold by shopkeepers, and that which is not sold decomposes after two or three days.
text:
> prasādānna pasārira yata nā vikāya
> dui-tina dina haile bhāta saḍi' yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]]---food of Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:pasārira]]---of the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much as; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:v:vikāya]]---is not sold; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---two and three days; [[synonyms:h:haile]]---after; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---the rice; [[synonyms:s:saḍi']] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---becomes decomposed.
translation: Lord Jagannātha's prasāda is sold by shopkeepers, and that which is not sold decomposes after two or three days.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.316
description: All the decomposed food is thrown before the cows from Tailaṅga at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Because of its rotten odor, even the cows cannot eat it.
text:
> siṁha-dvāre gābhī-āge sei bhāta ḍāre
> saḍā-gandhe tailaṅgī-gāi khāite nā pāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:siṁha]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---at the gate known as Siṁha-dvāra; [[synonyms:g:gābhī]]-[[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of the cows; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---that food; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāre]]---they throw; [[synonyms:s:saḍā]]-[[synonyms:g:gandhe]]---because of a rotten smell; [[synonyms:t:tailaṅgī]]-[[synonyms:g:gāi]]---the cows from Tailaṅga; [[synonyms:k:khāite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---cannot eat.
translation: All the decomposed food is thrown before the cows from Tailaṅga at the Siṁha-dvāra gate. Because of its rotten odor, even the cows cannot eat it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.317
description: At night Raghunātha dāsa would collect that decomposed rice, bring it home and wash it with ample water.
text:
> sei bhāta raghunātha rātre ghare āni'
> bhāta pākhāliyā phele ghare diyā bahu pāni
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---that rejected rice; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing home; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---the rice; [[synonyms:p:pākhāliyā]]---washing; [[synonyms:p:phele]]---throws; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---putting; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:p:pāni]]---much water.
translation: At night Raghunātha dāsa would collect that decomposed rice, bring it home and wash it with ample water.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.318
description: Then he ate the hard inner portion of the rice with salt.
text:
> bhitarera dṛḍha yei māji bhāta pāya
> lavaṇa diyā raghunātha sei anna khāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhitarera]]---within; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---the harder portion; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---which; [[synonyms:m:māji]]---the core; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---rice; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---he gets; [[synonyms:l:lavaṇa]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---with a little salt; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:a:anna]]---that rice; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eats.
translation: Then he ate the hard inner portion of the rice with salt.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.319
description: One day Svarūpa Dāmodara saw the activities of Raghunātha dāsa. Thus he smiled and asked for a small portion of that food and ate it.
text:
> eka-dina svarūpa tāhā karite dekhilā
> hāsiyā tāhāra kichu māgiyā khāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---doing; [[synonyms:d:dekhilā]]---saw; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:m:māgiyā]] [[synonyms:k:khāilā]]---he begged and ate.
translation: One day Svarūpa Dāmodara saw the activities of Raghunātha dāsa. Thus he smiled and asked for a small portion of that food and ate it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.32
description: "The elder brother of your father is less intelligent," he said. "He enjoys 800,000 coins, but since I am also a shareholder, he should give some portion of it to me.
text:
> "tomāra jyeṭhā nirbuddhi aṣṭa-lakṣa khāya
> āmi---bhāgī, āmāre kichu dibāre yuyāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:j:jyeṭhā]]---the elder brother of your father; [[synonyms:n:nirbuddhi]]---bereft of intelligence; [[synonyms:a:aṣṭa]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---enjoys 800,000 coins; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:b:bhāgī]]---shareholder; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---unto me; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:d:dibāre]]---to give; [[synonyms:y:yuyāya]]---is proper.
translation: "The elder brother of your father is less intelligent," he said. "He enjoys 800,000 coins, but since I am also a shareholder, he should give some portion of it to me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.320
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "You eat such nectar every day, but you never offer it to us. Where is your character?"
text:
> svarūpa kahe,---"aiche amṛta khāo niti-niti
> āmā-sabāya nāhi deha',---ki tomāra prakṛti?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara said; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:a:amṛta]]---nectar; [[synonyms:k:khāo]]---you eat; [[synonyms:n:niti]]-[[synonyms:n:niti]]---daily; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---to us; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---you do not offer; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:p:prakṛti]]---nature.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara said, "You eat such nectar every day, but you never offer it to us. Where is your character?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.321
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard news of this from the mouth of Govinda, He went there the next day and spoke as follows.
text:
> govindera mukhe prabhu se vārtā śunilā
> āra dina āsi' prabhu kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govindera]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouth of Govinda; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---that news; [[synonyms:ś:śunilā]]---heard; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to say.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu heard news of this from the mouth of Govinda, He went there the next day and spoke as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.322
description: "What nice things are you eating? Why don't you give anything to Me?" Saying this, He forcibly took a morsel and began to eat.
text:
> kāṅhā vastu khāo sabe, more nā deha' kene?'
> eta bali' eka grāsa karilā bhakṣaṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---what; [[synonyms:v:vastu]]---things; [[synonyms:k:khāo]]---you eat; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to Me; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']] [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why do you not give; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:g:grāsa]]---one morsel; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇe]]---ate.
translation: "What nice things are you eating? Why don't you give anything to Me?" Saying this, He forcibly took a morsel and began to eat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.323
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taking another morsel of food, Svarūpa Dāmodara caught Him by the hand and said, "It is not fit for You." Thus he forcibly took the food away.
text:
> āra grāsa laite svarūpa hātete dharilā
> 'tava yogya nahe' bali' bale kāḍi' nilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:g:grāsa]]---morsel; [[synonyms:l:laite]]---taking; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:h:hātete]]---the hand; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---caught; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---for You; [[synonyms:y:yogya]]---fit; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---by force; [[synonyms:k:kāḍi']]---snatching; [[synonyms:n:nilā]]---he took.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was taking another morsel of food, Svarūpa Dāmodara caught Him by the hand and said, "It is not fit for You." Thus he forcibly took the food away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.324
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Of course, every day I eat varieties of prasāda, but I have never tasted such nice prasāda as that which Raghunātha is eating."
text:
> prabhu bale,---"niti-niti nānā prasāda khāi
> aiche svāda āra kona prasāde nā pāi"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:n:niti]]-[[synonyms:n:niti]]---day after day; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---varieties of //prasāda//; [[synonyms:k:khāi]]---I eat; [[synonyms:a:aiche]] [[synonyms:s:svāda]]---such a nice taste; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:k:kona]]---any; [[synonyms:p:prasāde]]---in the remnants of Lord Jagannātha's food; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---I do not get.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Of course, every day I eat varieties of prasāda, but I have never tasted such nice prasāda as that which Raghunātha is eating."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.325
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed many pastimes at Jagannātha Purī. Seeing the severe penances performed by Raghunātha dāsa in the renounced order, the Lord was greatly satisfied.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu nānā līlā kare
> raghunāthera vairāgya dekhi' santoṣa antare
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---many pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---renunciation; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing; [[synonyms:s:santoṣa]] [[synonyms:a:antare]]---satisfied within.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed many pastimes at Jagannātha Purī. Seeing the severe penances performed by Raghunātha dāsa in the renounced order, the Lord was greatly satisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.326
description: In his own poem known as the Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa has described his personal deliverance.
text:
> āpana-uddhāra ei raghunātha-dāsa
> 'gaurāṅga-stava-kalpa-vṛkṣe' kariyāchena prakāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:u:uddhāra]]---his personal deliverance; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---this Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]-[[synonyms:s:stava]]-[[synonyms:k:kalpa]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛkṣe]]---in his poem known as //Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa//; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchena]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---has manifested.
translation: In his own poem known as the Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa, Raghunātha dāsa has described his personal deliverance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.327
description: "Although I am a fallen soul, the lowest of men, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered me from the blazing forest fire of great material opulence by His mercy. He handed me over in great pleasure to Svarūpa Dāmodara, His personal associate. The Lord also gave me the garland of small conchshells that He wore on His chest and a stone from Govardhana Hill, although they were very dear to Him. That same Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awakens within my heart and makes me mad after Him."
text:
> mahā-sampad-dāvād api patitam uddhṛtya kṛpayā
> svarūpe yaḥ svīye kujanam api māṁ nyasya muditaḥ
> uro-guñjā-hāraṁ priyam api ca govardhana-śilāṁ
> dadau me gaurāṅgo hṛdaya udayan māṁ madayati
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:s:sampat]]---of profuse material opulence; [[synonyms:d:dāvāt]]---from a forest fire; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:p:patitam]]---fallen; [[synonyms:u:uddhṛtya]]---delivering; [[synonyms:k:kṛpayā]]---by mercy; [[synonyms:s:svarūpe]]---unto Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---He who (Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu); [[synonyms:s:svīye]]---His personal associate; [[synonyms:k:ku]]-[[synonyms:j:janam]]---low person; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---me; [[synonyms:n:nyasya]]---having delivered; [[synonyms:m:muditaḥ]]---pleased; [[synonyms:u:uraḥ]]---of the chest; [[synonyms:g:guñjā]]-[[synonyms:h:hāram]]---the garland of conchshells; [[synonyms:p:priyam]]---dear; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:g:govardhana]]-[[synonyms:ś:śilām]]---a stone from Govardhana Hill; [[synonyms:d:dadau]]---delivered; [[synonyms:m:me]]---to me; [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅgaḥ]]---Lord Gaurāṅga; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in my heart; [[synonyms:u:udayan]]---by manifesting; [[synonyms:m:mām]]---me; [[synonyms:m:madayati]]---maddens.
translation: "Although I am a fallen soul, the lowest of men, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu delivered me from the blazing forest fire of great material opulence by His mercy. He handed me over in great pleasure to Svarūpa Dāmodara, His personal associate. The Lord also gave me the garland of small conchshells that He wore on His chest and a stone from Govardhana Hill, although they were very dear to Him. That same Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu awakens within my heart and makes me mad after Him."
purport: This verse is from //Śrī Gaurāṅga-stava-kalpavṛkṣa// (11), written by Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.328
description: Thus I have described the meeting of Raghunātha dāsa with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears about this incident attains the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ raghunāthera milana
> ihā yei śune pāya caitanya-caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---I have described; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---the meeting of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---gets; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Thus I have described the meeting of Raghunātha dāsa with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Anyone who hears about this incident attains the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.329
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa,
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Sixth Chapter, describing Lord Caitanya's meeting with Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.33
description: "Now you go arrange a meeting between me and your uncle. Let him do whatever he thinks best. I shall completely depend on his decision."
text:
> yāha tumi, tomāra jyeṭhāre milāha āmāre
> ye-mate bhāla haya karuna, bhāra diluṅ tāṅre
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:j:jyeṭhāre]]---the elder brother of your father; [[synonyms:m:milāha]] [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---arrange to meet with me; [[synonyms:y:ye]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in whatever way; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---good; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:karuna]]---let him do; [[synonyms:b:bhāra]] [[synonyms:d:diluṅ]] [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---I shall completely depend upon him.
translation: "Now you go arrange a meeting between me and your uncle. Let him do whatever he thinks best. I shall completely depend on his decision."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.34
description: Raghunātha dāsa arranged a meeting between his uncle and the caudhurī. He settled the matter, and everything was peaceful.
text:
> raghunātha āsi' tabe jyeṭhāre milāila
> mleccha-sahita vaśa kaila---saba śānta haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:j:jyeṭhāre]] [[synonyms:m:milāila]]---arranged a meeting between the caudhurī and the elder brother of his father; [[synonyms:m:mleccha]]-[[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with the Mohammedan; [[synonyms:v:vaśa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---he settled; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---everything; [[synonyms:ś:śānta]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became peaceful.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa arranged a meeting between his uncle and the caudhurī. He settled the matter, and everything was peaceful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.35
description: In this way Raghunātha dāsa passed one year exactly like a first-class business manager, but the next year he again decided to leave home.
text:
> ei-mata raghunāthera vatsareka gela
> dvitīya vatsare palāite mana kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]]---of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:vatsareka]]---one year; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:d:dvitīya]] [[synonyms:v:vatsare]]---the next year; [[synonyms:p:palāite]]---to go away from home; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---he decided.
translation: In this way Raghunātha dāsa passed one year exactly like a first-class business manager, but the next year he again decided to leave home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.36
description: He got up alone one night and left, but his father caught him in a distant place and brought him back.
text:
> rātre uṭhi' ekelā calilā palāñā
> dūra haite pitā tāṅre ānila dhariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātre]]---at night; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:e:ekelā]]---alone; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---left; [[synonyms:p:palāñā]]---running away; [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from a distant place; [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---his father; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought back; [[synonyms:d:dhariyā]]---catching.
translation: He got up alone one night and left, but his father caught him in a distant place and brought him back.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.37
description: This became almost a daily affair. Raghunātha would run away from home, and his father would again bring him back. Then Raghunātha dāsa's mother began speaking to his father.
text:
> ei-mate bāre bāre palāya, dhari' āne
> tabe tāṅra mātā kahe tāṅra pitā sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mate]]---in this way; [[synonyms:b:bāre]] [[synonyms:b:bāre]]---again and again; [[synonyms:p:palāya]]---he goes away; [[synonyms:d:dhari']] [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---brings him back; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mātā]]---his mother; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with his father.
translation: This became almost a daily affair. Raghunātha would run away from home, and his father would again bring him back. Then Raghunātha dāsa's mother began speaking to his father.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.38
description: "Our son has become mad," she said. "Just keep him by binding him with ropes." His father, being very unhappy, replied to her as follows.
text:
> "putra bātula' ha-ila, ihāya rākhaha bāndhiyā"
> tāṅra pitā kahe tāre nirviṇṇa hañā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:putra]]---son; [[synonyms:b:bātula]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---has become mad; [[synonyms:i:ihāya]]---him; [[synonyms:r:rākhaha]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]]---just keep by binding; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---his father; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---to her; [[synonyms:n:nirviṇṇa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being very unhappy.
translation: "Our son has become mad," she said. "Just keep him by binding him with ropes." His father, being very unhappy, replied to her as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.39
description: "Raghunātha dāsa, our son, has opulences like Indra, the heavenly King, and his wife is as beautiful as an angel. Yet all this could not tie down his mind.
text:
> "indra-sama aiśvarya, strī apsarā-sama
> e saba bāndhite nārileka yāṅra mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:indra]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like the heavenly King, Indra; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]---material opulence; [[synonyms:s:strī]]---wife; [[synonyms:a:apsarā]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---like an angel of heaven; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all this; [[synonyms:b:bāndhite]]---to bind; [[synonyms:n:nārileka]]---was not able; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---whose mind.
translation: "Raghunātha dāsa, our son, has opulences like Indra, the heavenly King, and his wife is as beautiful as an angel. Yet all this could not tie down his mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.4
description: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He did not manifest His feelings externally, for He feared the unhappiness of His devotees.
text:
> yadyapi antare kṛṣṇa-viyoga bādha ye
> bāhire nā prakāśaya bhakta-duḥkha-bhaye
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:viyoga]]---separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bādhye]]---obstructs; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---externally; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:prakāśaya]]---does not exhibit; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaye]]---fearing the unhappiness of the devotees.
translation: Although Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, He did not manifest His feelings externally, for He feared the unhappiness of His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.40
description: "How then could we keep this boy home by binding him with ropes? It is not possible even for one's father to nullify the reactions of one's past activities.
text:
> daḍira bandhane tāṅre rākhibā ke-mate?
> janma-dātā-pitā nāre 'prārabdha' khaṇḍāite
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daḍira]] [[synonyms:b:bandhane]]---by bonds of ropes; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:r:rākhibā]]---will you keep; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:m:mate]]---how; [[synonyms:j:janma]]-[[synonyms:d:dātā]] [[synonyms:p:pitā]]---the father who begets the child; [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---is not able; [[synonyms:p:prārabdha]]---the reaction of previous activities; [[synonyms:k:khaṇḍāite]]---to nullify.
translation: "How then could we keep this boy home by binding him with ropes? It is not possible even for one's father to nullify the reactions of one's past activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.41
description: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has fully bestowed His mercy on him. Who can keep home such a madman of Caitanyacandra?"
text:
> caitanya-candrera kṛpā hañāche iṅhāre
> caitanya-candrera 'bātula' ke rākhite pāre?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:candrera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]] [[synonyms:i:iṅhāre]]---has been bestowed upon him; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:candrera]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bātula]]---madman; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:r:rākhite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can keep.
translation: "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu has fully bestowed His mercy on him. Who can keep home such a madman of Caitanyacandra?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.42
description: Then Raghunātha dāsa considered something in his mind, and the next day he went to Nityānanda Gosāñi.
text:
> tabe raghunātha kichu vicārilā mane
> nityānanda-gosāñira pāśa calilā āra dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghu nātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:v:vicārilā]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---considered within his mind; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]] [[synonyms:p:pāśa]]---unto Nityānanda Gosāñi; [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---went; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---the next day.
translation: Then Raghunātha dāsa considered something in his mind, and the next day he went to Nityānanda Gosāñi.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.43
description: In the village of Pānihāṭi, Raghunātha dāsa obtained an interview with Nityānanda Prabhu, who was accompanied by many kīrtana performers, servants and others.
text:
> pānihāṭi-grāme pāilā prabhura daraśana
> kīrtanīyā sevaka saṅge āra bahu-jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pānihāṭi]]-[[synonyms:g:grāme]]---in the village known as Pānihāṭi; [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---got; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---the audience of Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:k:kīrtanīyā]] [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---performers of saṅkīrtana and servants; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---many other persons.
translation: In the village of Pānihāṭi, Raghunātha dāsa obtained an interview with Nityānanda Prabhu, who was accompanied by many kīrtana performers, servants and others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.44
description: Sitting on a rock under a tree on the bank of the Ganges, Lord Nityānanda seemed as effulgent as hundreds and thousands of rising suns.
text:
> gaṅgā-tīre vṛkṣa-mūle piṇḍāra upare
> vasiyachena---yena koṭī sūryodaya kare
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]-[[synonyms:m:mūle]]---underneath a tree; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on a rock; [[synonyms:v:vasiyāchena]]---was sitting; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:k:koṭī]] [[synonyms:s:sūrya]]---hundreds of thousands of suns; [[synonyms:u:udaya]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---rise.
translation: Sitting on a rock under a tree on the bank of the Ganges, Lord Nityānanda seemed as effulgent as hundreds and thousands of rising suns.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.45
description: Many devotees sat on the ground surrounding Him. Seeing the influence of Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was astonished.
text:
> tale upare bahu-bhakta hañāche veṣṭita
> dekhi' prabhura prabhāva raghunātha---vismita
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tale]]---the surface; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---many devotees; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]] [[synonyms:v:veṣṭita]]---He was surrounded; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---the influence of Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---astonished.
translation: Many devotees sat on the ground surrounding Him. Seeing the influence of Nityānanda Prabhu, Raghunātha dāsa was astonished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.46
description: Raghunātha dāsa offered his obeisances by falling prostrate at a distant place, and the servant of Nityānanda Prabhu pointed out, "There is Raghunātha dāsa, offering You obeisances."
text:
> daṇḍavat hañā sei paḍilā kata-dūre
> sevaka kahe,---'raghunātha daṇḍavat kare'
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---falling flat like a rod; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]] [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:d:dūre]]---fell down at a distant place; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the servant of Nityānanda Prabhu said; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavat]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---is offering obeisances.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa offered his obeisances by falling prostrate at a distant place, and the servant of Nityānanda Prabhu pointed out, "There is Raghunātha dāsa, offering You obeisances."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.47
description: Hearing this, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said, "You are a thief. Now you have come to see Me. Come here, come here. Today I shall punish you!"
text:
> śuni' prabhu kahe,---"corā dili daraśana
> āya, āya, āji tora karimu daṇḍana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said; [[synonyms:c:corā]]---thief; [[synonyms:d:dili]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---you have come to see Me; [[synonyms:ā:āya]] [[synonyms:ā:ā]] [[synonyms:y:ya]]---come here, come here; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:t:tora]]---your; [[synonyms:k:karimu]]---I shall do; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍana]]---punishment.
translation: Hearing this, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said, "You are a thief. Now you have come to see Me. Come here, come here. Today I shall punish you!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.48
description: The Lord called him, but Raghunātha dāsa did not go near the Lord. Then the Lord forcibly caught him and placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head.
text:
> prabhu bolāya, teṅho nikaṭe nā kare gamana
> ākarṣiyā tāṅra māthe prabhu dharilā caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:b:bolāya]]---the Lord calls; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---nearby; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:g:gamana]]---does not come; [[synonyms:ā:ākarṣiyā]]---bringing him near; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:māthe]]---on his head; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---placed His feet.
translation: The Lord called him, but Raghunātha dāsa did not go near the Lord. Then the Lord forcibly caught him and placed His lotus feet upon Raghunātha dāsa's head.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.49
description: Lord Nityānanda was by nature very merciful and funny. Being merciful, He spoke to Raghunātha dāsa as follows.
text:
> kautukī nityānanda sahaje dayāmaya
> raghunāthe kahe kichu hañā sadaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kautukī]]---very funny; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:s:sahaje]]---by nature; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---very merciful; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]]---unto Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:d:daya]]---being merciful.
translation: Lord Nityānanda was by nature very merciful and funny. Being merciful, He spoke to Raghunātha dāsa as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.5
description: The transformations undergone by the Lord when He manifested severe unhappiness due to separation from Kṛṣṇa cannot be described.
text:
> utkaṭa viraha-duḥkha yabe bāhirāya
> tabe ye vaikalya prabhura varṇana nā yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:utkaṭa]]---severe; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness of separation; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:b:bāhirāya]]---is manifested; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---what; [[synonyms:v:vaikalya]]---transformations; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of the Lord; [[synonyms:v:varṇana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---cannot be described.
translation: The transformations undergone by the Lord when He manifested severe unhappiness due to separation from Kṛṣṇa cannot be described.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.50
description: "You are just like a thief, for instead of coming near, you stay away at a distant place. Now that I have captured you, I shall punish you.
text:
> "nikaṭe nā āisa, corā, bhāga' dūre dūre
> āji lāg pāñāchi, daṇḍimu tomāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---nearby; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:āisa]]---you do not come; [[synonyms:c:corā]]---thief; [[synonyms:b:bhāga']]---you go away; [[synonyms:d:dūre]] [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---a long distance; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:l:lāg]] [[synonyms:p:pāñāchi]]---I have caught; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍimu]] [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---I shall punish you.
translation: "You are just like a thief, for instead of coming near, you stay away at a distant place. Now that I have captured you, I shall punish you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.51
description: "Make a festival and feed all My associates yogurt and chipped rice." Hearing this, Raghunātha dāsa was greatly pleased.
text:
> dadhi, ciḍā bhakṣaṇa karāha mora gaṇe"
> śuni' ānandita haila raghunātha mane
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:karāha]]---feed; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---My associates; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became very happy; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind.
translation: "Make a festival and feed all My associates yogurt and chipped rice." Hearing this, Raghunātha dāsa was greatly pleased.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.52
description: Raghunātha dāsa immediately sent his own men to the village to purchase all kinds of eatables and bring them back.
text:
> sei-kṣaṇe nija-loka pāṭhāilā grāme
> bhakṣya-dravya loka saba grāma haite āne
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇe]]---immediately; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]---his servants; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]] [[synonyms:g:grāme]]---he sent to the nearby village; [[synonyms:b:bhakṣya]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]]---eatables; [[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the persons; [[synonyms:g:grāma]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the village; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---bring.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa immediately sent his own men to the village to purchase all kinds of eatables and bring them back.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.53
description: Raghunātha dāsa brought chipped rice, yogurt, milk, sweetmeats, sugar, bananas and other eatables and placed them all around.
text:
> ciḍā, dadhi, dugdha, sandeśa, āra cini, kalā
> saba dravya ānāñā caudike dharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]---milk; [[synonyms:s:sandeśa]]---sweetmeats; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:c:cini]]---sugar; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---banana; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---materials; [[synonyms:ā:ānāñā]]---causing to be brought; [[synonyms:c:cau]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---all around; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---kept.
translation: Raghunātha dāsa brought chipped rice, yogurt, milk, sweetmeats, sugar, bananas and other eatables and placed them all around.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.54
description: As soon as they heard that a festival was going to be held, all kinds of brāhmaṇas and other gentlemen began to arrive. Thus there were innumerable people.
text:
> 'mahotsava'-nāma śuni' brāhmaṇa-sajjana
> āsite lāgila loka asaṅkhya-gaṇana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahotsava]]---festival; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---hearing; [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sat]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---brāhmaṇas and other gentlemen; [[synonyms:ā:āsite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgila]]---began to pour in; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:a:asaṅkhya]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇana]]---in numerable.
translation: As soon as they heard that a festival was going to be held, all kinds of brāhmaṇas and other gentlemen began to arrive. Thus there were innumerable people.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.55
description: Seeing the crowd increasing, Raghunātha dāsa arranged to get more eatables from other villages. He also brought two to four hundred large, round earthen pots.
text:
> āra grāmāntara haite sāmagrī ānila
> śata dui-cāri holnā tāṅhā ānāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:g:grāma]]-[[synonyms:a:antara]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from other villages; [[synonyms:s:sāmagrī]]---articles; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:ś:śata]]---hundred; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]]---two to four; [[synonyms:h:holnā]]---round earthen pots; [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]]---there; [[synonyms:ā:ānāila]]---caused to be brought.
translation: Seeing the crowd increasing, Raghunātha dāsa arranged to get more eatables from other villages. He also brought two to four hundred large, round earthen pots.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.56
description: He also obtained five or seven especially large earthen pots, and in these pots a brāhmaṇa began soaking chipped rice for the satisfaction of Lord Nityānanda.
text:
> baḍa baḍa mṛt-kuṇḍikā ānāila pāṅca sāte
> eka vipra prabhu lāgi' ciḍā bhijāya tāte
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]---big, big; [[synonyms:m:mṛt]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍikā]]---earthen basins; [[synonyms:ā:ānāila]]---arranged to be brought; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]] [[synonyms:s:sāte]]---five or seven; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---one brāhmaṇa; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---the chipped rice; [[synonyms:b:bhijāya]]---soaked; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in those.
translation: He also obtained five or seven especially large earthen pots, and in these pots a brāhmaṇa began soaking chipped rice for the satisfaction of Lord Nityānanda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.57
description: In one place, chipped rice was soaked in hot milk in each of the large pots. Then half the rice was mixed with yogurt, sugar and bananas.
text:
> eka-ṭhāñi tapta-dugdhe ciḍā bhijāñā
> ardheka chānila dadhi, cini, kalā diyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in one place; [[synonyms:t:tapta]]-[[synonyms:d:dugdhe]]---in hot milk; [[synonyms:c:ciḍa]]---the chipped rice; [[synonyms:b:bhijāñā]]---soaking; [[synonyms:a:ardheka]]---half of it; [[synonyms:c:chānila]]---mixed; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:c:cini]]---sugar; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---bananas; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---putting in.
translation: In one place, chipped rice was soaked in hot milk in each of the large pots. Then half the rice was mixed with yogurt, sugar and bananas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.58
description: The other half was mixed with condensed milk and a special type of banana known as cāṅpā-kalā. Then sugar, clarified butter and camphor were added.
text:
> āra ardheka ghanāvṛta-dugdhete chānila
> cāṅpā-kalā, cini, ghṛta, karpūra tāte dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:a:ardheka]]---the other half; [[synonyms:g:ghana]]-[[synonyms:ā:āvṛta]]---condensed; [[synonyms:d:dugdhete]]---in milk; [[synonyms:c:chānila]]---mixed; [[synonyms:c:cāṅpā]]-[[synonyms:k:kalā]]---a special type of banana; [[synonyms:c:cini]]---sugar; [[synonyms:g:ghṛta]]---clarified butter, //ghee//; [[synonyms:k:karpūra]]---camphor; [[synonyms:t:tāte]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---put into that.
translation: The other half was mixed with condensed milk and a special type of banana known as cāṅpā-kalā. Then sugar, clarified butter and camphor were added.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.59
description: After Nityānanda Prabhu had changed His cloth for a new one and sat on a raised platform, the brāhmaṇa brought before Him the seven huge pots.
text:
> dhuti pari' prabhu yadi piṇḍāte vasilā
> sāta-kuṇḍī vipra tāṅra āgete dharilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhuti]] [[synonyms:p:pari']]---putting on a new cloth; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍāte]] [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat on a high platform; [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍī]]---the seven big, big earthen pots; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---the brāhmaṇa,; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:ā:āgete]]---in front of Him; [[synonyms:d:dharilā]]---placed.
translation: After Nityānanda Prabhu had changed His cloth for a new one and sat on a raised platform, the brāhmaṇa brought before Him the seven huge pots.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.6
description: When the Lord acutely felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, only Śrī Rāma-nanda Rāya's talk about Kṛṣṇa and the sweet songs of Svarūpa Dāmodara kept Him alive.
text:
> rāmānandera kṛṣṇa-kathā, svarūpera gāna
> viraha-vedanāya prabhura rākhaye parāṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānandera]]---of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:k:kathā]]---talks of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:g:gāna]]---the songs of Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]-[[synonyms:v:vedanāya]]---at the time of pangs of separation; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rākhaye]]---keep; [[synonyms:p:parāṇa]]---the life.
translation: When the Lord acutely felt pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa, only Śrī Rāmananda Rāya's talk about Kṛṣṇa and the sweet songs of Svarūpa Dāmodara kept Him alive.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.60
description: On that platform, all the most important associates of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, as well as other important men, sat down in a circle around the Lord.
text:
> cabutarā-upare yata prabhura nija-gaṇe
> baḍa baḍa loka vasilā maṇḍalī-racane
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cabutarā]]-[[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the raised platform; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---very intimate associates of the Lord; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---big, big people; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍalī]]-[[synonyms:r:racane]]---in a circle.
translation: On that platform, all the most important associates of Śrī Nityānanda Prabhu, as well as other important men, sat down in a circle around the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.61
description: Among them were Rāmadāsa, Sundarānanda, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri, Kamalākara, Sadāśiva and Purandara.
text:
> rāmadāsa, sundarānanda, dāsa-gadādhara
> murāri, kamalākara, sadāśiva, purandara
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmadāsa]]---Rāmadāsa; [[synonyms:s:sundarānanda]]---Sundarānanda; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]-[[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara dāsa; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]---Murāri; [[synonyms:k:kamalākara]]---Kamalākara; [[synonyms:s:sadāśiva]]---Sadāśiva; [[synonyms:p:purandara]]---Purandara.
translation: Among them were Rāmadāsa, Sundarānanda, Gadādhara dāsa, Murāri, Kamalākara, Sadāśiva and Purandara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.62
description: Dhanañjaya, Jagadīśa, Parameśvara dāsa, Maheśa, Gaurīdāsa and Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa were also there.
text:
> dhanañjaya, jagadīśa, parameśvara-dāsa
> maheśa, gaurīdāsa, hoḍa-kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dhanañjaya]]---Dhanañjaya; [[synonyms:j:jagadīśa]]---Jagadīśa; [[synonyms:p:parameśvara]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Parameśvara dāsa; [[synonyms:m:maheśa]]---Maheśa; [[synonyms:g:gaurīdāsa]]---Gaurīdāsa; [[synonyms:h:hoḍa]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa.
translation: Dhanañjaya, Jagadīśa, Parameśvara dāsa, Maheśa, Gaurīdāsa and Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa were also there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.63
description: Similarly, Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura and many other personal associates of the Lord sat on the raised platform with Nityānanda Prabhu. No one could count them all.
text:
> uddhāraṇa datta ādi yata nija-gaṇa
> upare vasilā saba, ke kare gaṇana?
synonyms: [[synonyms:u:uddhāraṇa]] [[synonyms:d:datta]]---Uddhāraṇa Datta; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and similar other persons; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:n:nija]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all personal associates; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---above; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇana]]---can count.
translation: Similarly, Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura and many other personal associates of the Lord sat on the raised platform with Nityānanda Prabhu. No one could count them all.
purport: The devotees mentioned herein are described by Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura in his //Anubhāṣya.// For further information one may consult the following references in the //Ādi-līlā.// Rāmadāsa-Chapter Ten, texts 116 and 118, and Chapter Eleven, texts 13 and 16. Sundarānanda-11.23, Gadādhara dāsa-10.53, His full name is Murāri Caitanya dāsa, and he is a personal associate of Nityānanda Prabhu. Thus one should consult Chapter Eleven, text 20. Kamalākara-11.24. Sadāśiva-11.38. Purandara-11.28. Dhanañjaya-11.31. Jagadīśa-11.30. Parameśvara-11.29. Maheśa-11.32. Gaurīdāsa-11.26. Hoḍa Kṛṣṇadāsa-11.47. Uddhāraṇa Datta Ṭhākura-11.41.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.64
description: Hearing about the festival, all kinds of learned scholars, brāhmaṇas and priests went there. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu honored them and made them sit on the raised platform with Him.
text:
> śuni' paṇḍita bhaṭṭācārya yata vipra āilā
> mānya kari' prabhu sabāre upare vasāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]---learned scholars and priests; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---brāhmaṇas; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:m:mān]] [[synonyms:y:ya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---giving honor; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:u:upare]] [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---seated on the top.
translation: Hearing about the festival, all kinds of learned scholars, brāhmaṇas and priests went there. Lord Nityānanda Prabhu honored them and made them sit on the raised platform with Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.65
description: Everyone was offered two earthen pots. In one was put chipped rice with condensed milk and in the other chipped rice with yogurt.
text:
> dui dui mṛt-kuṇḍikā sabāra āge dila
> eke dugdha-ciḍā, āre dadhi-ciḍā kaila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two and two; [[synonyms:m:mṛt]]-[[synonyms:k:kuṇḍikā]]---earthen pots; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---before everyone; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---offered; [[synonyms:e:eke]]---in one; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice with condensed milk; [[synonyms:ā:āre]]---in the other; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]-[[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice with yogurt; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---put.
translation: Everyone was offered two earthen pots. In one was put chipped rice with condensed milk and in the other chipped rice with yogurt.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.66
description: All the other people sat in groups around the platform. No one could count how many people there were.
text:
> āra yata loka saba cotarā-talāne
> maṇḍalī-bandhe vasilā, tāra nā haya gaṇane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:cotarā]]-[[synonyms:t:talāne]]---at the base of the platform; [[synonyms:m:maṇḍalī]]-[[synonyms:b:bandhe]]---in groups; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of them; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇane]]---there was no counting.
translation: All the other people sat in groups around the platform. No one could count how many people there were.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.67
description: Each and every one of them was supplied two earthen pots-one of chipped rice soaked in yogurt and the other of chipped rice soaked in condensed milk.
text:
> ekeka janāre dui dui holnā dila
> dadhi-ciḍā dugdha-ciḍā, duite bhijāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ekeka]] [[synonyms:j:janāre]]---to each and every one of them; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two and two; [[synonyms:h:holnā]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---earthen pots were supplied; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]-[[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice with yogurt; [[synonyms:d:dugdha]]-[[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice with condensed milk; [[synonyms:d:duite]]---in the two pots; [[synonyms:b:bhijāila]]---were soaked.
translation: Each and every one of them was supplied two earthen pots-one of chipped rice soaked in yogurt and the other of chipped rice soaked in condensed milk.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.68
description: Some of the brāhmaṇas, not having gotten a place on the platform, went to the bank of the Ganges with their two earthen pots and soaked their chipped rice there.
text:
> kona kona vipra upare sthāna nā pāñā
> dui holnāya ciḍā bhijāya gaṅgā-tīre giyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:k:kona]]---some; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---brāhmaṇas; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the platform; [[synonyms:s:sthāna]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not having gotten a place; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:h:holnāya]]---in two earthen pots; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]] [[synonyms:b:bhijāya]]---soak chipped rice; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:g:giyā]]---going.
translation: Some of the brāhmaṇas, not having gotten a place on the platform, went to the bank of the Ganges with their two earthen pots and soaked their chipped rice there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.69
description: Others, who could not get a place even on the bank of the Ganges, got down into the water and began eating their two kinds of chipped rice.
text:
> tīre sthāna nā pāñā āra kata jana
> jale nāmi' dadhi-ciḍā karaye bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tīre]]---on the bank; [[synonyms:s:sthāna]]---place; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not having gotten; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:k:kata]]---some; [[synonyms:j:jana]]---persons; [[synonyms:j:jale]] [[synonyms:n:nāmi']]---getting down into the water; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]-[[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---yogurt and chipped rice; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---began to eat.
translation: Others, who could not get a place even on the bank of the Ganges, got down into the water and began eating their two kinds of chipped rice.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.7
description: Because the Lord associated with various devotees during the day, His mind was somewhat diverted, but at night the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa increased very rapidly.
text:
> dine prabhu nānā-saṅge haya anya mana
> rātri-kāle bāḍe prabhura viraha-vedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dine]]---during the daytime; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:na]]-[[synonyms:n:na]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---by different association; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:a:anya]]---diverted; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---His mind; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at night; [[synonyms:b:bāḍe]]---increase; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:viraha]]-[[synonyms:v:vedana]]---pangs of separation.
translation: Because the Lord associated with various devotees during the day, His mind was somewhat diverted, but at night the pangs of separation from Kṛṣṇa increased very rapidly.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.70
description: Thus some sat on the platform, some at the base of the platform, and some on the bank of the Ganges, and they were all supplied two pots each by the twenty men who distributed the food.
text:
> keha upare, keha tale, keha gaṅgā-tīre
> biśa-jana tina-ṭhāñi pariveśana kare
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---some on the platform; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:t:tale]]---some at the base of the platform; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---some on the bank of the Ganges; [[synonyms:b:biśa]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---twenty men; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in three places; [[synonyms:p:pariveśana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---distributed.
translation: Thus some sat on the platform, some at the base of the platform, and some on the bank of the Ganges, and they were all supplied two pots each by the twenty men who distributed the food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.71
description: At that time, Rāghava Paṇḍita arrived there. Seeing the situation, he began to laugh in great surprise.
text:
> hena-kāle āilā tathā rāghava paṇḍita
> hāsite lāgilā dekhi' hañā vismita
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]] [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---the great scholar named Rāghava paṇḍita; [[synonyms:h:hāsite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to laugh; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:h:hañā]] [[synonyms:v:vismita]]---being astonished.
translation: At that time, Rāghava Paṇḍita arrived there. Seeing the situation, he began to laugh in great surprise.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.72
description: He brought many other kinds of food cooked in ghee and offered to the Lord. This prasāda he first placed before Lord Nityānanda and then distributed among the devotees.
text:
> ni-sakḍi nānā-mata prasāda ānila
> prabhure āge diyā bhakta-gaṇe bāṅṭi dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:ni]]-[[synonyms:s:sakḍi]]---food cooked in ghee; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---various types; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of the Lord's food; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---he brought; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front of Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---placing; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:b:bāṅṭi]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---distributed.
translation: He brought many other kinds of food cooked in ghee and offered to the Lord. This prasāda he first placed before Lord Nityānanda and then distributed among the devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.73
description: Rāghava Paṇḍita said to Lord Nityānanda, "For You, sir, I have already offered food to the Deity, but You are engaged in a festival here, and so the food is lying there untouched."
text:
> prabhure kahe,---"tomā lāgi' bhoga lāgāila
> tumi ihāṅ utsava kara, ghare prasāda rahila"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he said to Lord Nityānanda prabhu; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for You; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāila]]---I have offered food to the Deity; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:u:utsava]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---are engaged in a festival; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the prasāda; [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---remained.
translation: Rāghava Paṇḍita said to Lord Nityānanda, "For You, sir, I have already offered food to the Deity, but You are engaged in a festival here, and so the food is lying there untouched."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.74
description: Lord Nityānanda replied, "Let Me eat all this food here during the day, and I shall eat at your home at night.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"e-dravya dine kariye bhojana
> rātrye tomāra ghare prasāda karimu bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu said; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]]---this food; [[synonyms:d:dine]]---during the daytime; [[synonyms:k:kariye]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---let Me eat; [[synonyms:r:rātrye]]---at night; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---in your house; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the prasāda; [[synonyms:k:karimu]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---I shall eat.
translation: Lord Nityānanda replied, "Let Me eat all this food here during the day, and I shall eat at your home at night.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.75
description: "I belong to a community of cowherd boys, and therefore I generally have many cowherd associates with Me. I am happy when we eat together in a picnic like this by the sandy bank of the river."
text:
> gopa-jāti āmi bahu gopa-gaṇa saṅge
> āmi sukha pāi ei pulina-bhojana-raṅge"
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopa]]-[[synonyms:j:jāti]]---belonging to the community of cowherd boys; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---many; [[synonyms:g:gopa]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---cowherd boys; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:sukha]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---become very happy; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:pulina]]---by the riverside; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---in the enjoyment of eating.
translation: "I belong to a community of cowherd boys, and therefore I generally have many cowherd associates with Me. I am happy when we eat together in a picnic like this by the sandy bank of the river."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.76
description: Lord Nityānanda made Rāghava Paṇḍita sit down and had two pots delivered to him also. There were two kinds of chipped rice soaked in them.
text:
> rāghave vasāñā dui kuṇḍī deoyāilā
> rāghava dvividha ciḍā tāte bhijāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāghave]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:v:vasāñā]]---making sit down; [[synonyms:d:dui]]---two; [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍī]]---earthen pots; [[synonyms:d:deoyāilā]]---arranged to be delivered to him; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:v:vidha]]---two kinds; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---in them; [[synonyms:b:bhijāilā]]---soaked.
translation: Lord Nityānanda made Rāghava Paṇḍita sit down and had two pots delivered to him also. There were two kinds of chipped rice soaked in them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.77
description: When chipped rice had been served to everyone, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, in meditation, brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> sakala-lokera ciḍā pūrṇa yabe ha-ila
> dhyāne tabe prabhu mahāprabhure ānila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakala]]-[[synonyms:l:lokera]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---full; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:d:dhyāne]]---in meditation; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: When chipped rice had been served to everyone, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, in meditation, brought Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.78
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu stood up. They then saw how the others were enjoying the chipped rice with yogurt and condensed milk.
text:
> mahāprabhu āilā dekhi' nitāi uṭhilā
> tāṅre lañā sabāra ciḍā dekhite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:n:nitāi]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:u:uṭhilā]]---stood up; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with Him; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to see.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu arrived, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu stood up. They then saw how the others were enjoying the chipped rice with yogurt and condensed milk.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.79
description: From each and every pot, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu took one morsel of chipped rice and pushed it into the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a joke.
text:
> sakala kuṇḍīra, holnāra ciḍāra eka eka grāsa
> mahāprabhura mukhe dena kari' parihāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍīra]]---from all the pots; [[synonyms:h:holnāra]]---from the big pots; [[synonyms:c:ciḍāra]]---of chipped rice; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:g:grāsa]]---one morsel; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---into the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---puts; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---making a joke.
translation: From each and every pot, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu took one morsel of chipped rice and pushed it into the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu as a joke.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.8
description: Two people-Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī-stayed with the Lord to pacify Him by reciting various verses about Kṛṣṇa's pastimes and by singing appropriate songs for His satisfaction.
text:
> tāṅra sukha-hetu saṅge rahe dui janā
> kṛṣṇa-rasa-śloka-gīte karena sāntvanā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:h:hetu]]---for His happiness; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---in His association; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remain; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:j:janā]]---two personalities; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the transcendental mellows of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śloka]]---verses; [[synonyms:g:gīte]]---by songs; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:s:sāntvanā]]---they pacified.
translation: Two people---Rāmānanda Rāya and Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī---stayed with the Lord to pacify Him by reciting various verses about Kṛṣṇa's pastimes and by singing appropriate songs for His satisfaction.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.80
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, also smiling, took a morsel of food, pushed it into the mouth of Nityānanda and laughed as He made Lord Nityānanda eat it.
text:
> hāsi' mahāprabhu āra eka grāsa lañā
> tāṅra mukhe diyā khāoyāya hāsiyā hāsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---smiling; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:g:grāsa]]---one morsel; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---taking; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---in the mouth of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---putting; [[synonyms:k:khāoyāya]]---makes eat; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]] [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---laughing.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, also smiling, took a morsel of food, pushed it into the mouth of Nityānanda and laughed as He made Lord Nityānanda eat it.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.81
description: In this way Lord Nityānanda was walking through all the groups of eaters, and all the Vaiṣṇavas standing there were seeing the fun.
text:
> ei-mata nitāi bule sakala maṇḍale
> dāṇḍāñā raṅga dekhe vaiṣṇava sakale
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:n:nitāi]] [[synonyms:b:bule]]---Lord Nityānanda was walking; [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:m:maṇḍale]]---through all the groups; [[synonyms:d:dāṇḍāñā]]---standing; [[synonyms:r:raṅga]] [[synonyms:d:dekhe]]---see the fun; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]] [[synonyms:s:sakale]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: In this way Lord Nityānanda was walking through all the groups of eaters, and all the Vaiṣṇavas standing there were seeing the fun.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.82
description: No one could understand what Nityānanda Prabhu was doing as He walked about. Some, however, who were very fortunate, could see that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also present.
text:
> ki kariyā beḍāya,---ihā keha nāhi jāne
> mahāprabhura darśana pā ya kona bhāgyavāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---doing what; [[synonyms:b:beḍāya]]---walks through; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---no one could understand; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavāne]]---some fortunate men.
translation: No one could understand what Nityānanda Prabhu was doing as He walked about. Some, however, who were very fortunate, could see that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also present.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.83
description: Then Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and sat down. On His right side He kept four pots of chipped rice that had not been made from boiled paddy.
text:
> tabe hāsi' nityānanda vasilā āsane
> cāri kuṇḍī āroyā ciḍā rākhilā ḍāhine
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]] [[synonyms:h:hāsi']]---thereupon smiling; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]] [[synonyms:ā:āsane]]---sat down on His seat; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍī]]---four earthen pots; [[synonyms:ā:āroyā]] [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice not made from boiled paddy; [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]] [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāhine]]---He kept on His right side.
translation: Then Nityānanda Prabhu smiled and sat down. On His right side He kept four pots of chipped rice that had not been made from boiled paddy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.84
description: Lord Nityānanda offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a place and had Him sit down. Then together the two brothers began eating chipped rice.
text:
> āsana diyā mahāprabhure tāhāṅ vasāilā
> dui bhāi tabe ciḍā khāite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āsana]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---offering a sitting place; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---made sit; [[synonyms:d:dui]] [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---the two brothers; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:k:khāite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to eat.
translation: Lord Nityānanda offered Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu a place and had Him sit down. Then together the two brothers began eating chipped rice.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.85
description: Seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating with Him, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu became very happy and exhibited varieties of ecstatic love.
text:
> dekhi' nityānanda-prabhu ānandita hailā
> kata kata bhāvāveśa prakāśa karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very happy; [[synonyms:k:kata]] [[synonyms:k:kata]]---so much; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:ā:āveśa]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:prakāśa]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---He manifested.
translation: Seeing Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu eating with Him, Lord Nityānanda Prabhu became very happy and exhibited varieties of ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.86
description: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "All of you eat, chanting the holy name of Hari." Immediately the holy names "Hari, Hari" resounded, filling the entire universe.
text:
> ājñā dilā,---'hari bali' karaha bhojana'
> 'hari' 'hari'-dhvani uṭhi' bharila bhuvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---He ordered; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying "Hari"; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---all of you eat; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the resounding of "Hari, Hari"; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---rising; [[synonyms:b:bharila]] [[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---filled the universe.
translation: Lord Nityānanda Prabhu ordered, "All of you eat, chanting the holy name of Hari." Immediately the holy names "Hari, Hari" resounded, filling the entire universe.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.87
description: When all the Vaiṣṇavas were chanting the holy names"Hari, Hari" and eating, they remembered how Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma ate with Their companions the cowherd boys on the bank of the Yamunā.
text:
> 'hari' 'hari' bali' vaiṣṇava karaye bhojana
> pulina-bhojana sabāra ha-ila smaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---chanting Hari, Hari; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eat; [[synonyms:p:pulina]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---eating on the bank of the Yamunā; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]] [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---everyone could remember.
translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas were chanting the holy names"Hari, Hari" and eating, they remembered how Kṛṣṇa and Balarāma ate with Their companions the cowherd boys on the bank of the Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.88
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu are extremely merciful and liberal. It was Raghunātha dāsa's good fortune that They accepted all these dealings.
text:
> nityānanda mahāprabhu---kṛpālu, udāra
> raghunāthera bhāgye eta kailā aṅgīkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]] [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Lord Nityānanda Prabhu and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpālu]]---merciful; [[synonyms:u:udāra]]---liberal; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthera]] [[synonyms:b:bhāgye]]---by the great fortune of Raghunātha dāsa; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---all this; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---They accepted.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Lord Nityānanda Prabhu are extremely merciful and liberal. It was Raghunātha dāsa's good fortune that They accepted all these dealings.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.89
description: Who can understand the influence and mercy of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu? He is so powerful that He induced Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to come eat chipped rice on the bank of the Ganges.
text:
> nityānanda-prabhāva-kṛpā jānibe kon jana?
> mahāprabhu āni' karā ya pulina-bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---of Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---influence and mercy; [[synonyms:j:jānibe]]---can know; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---who; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]] [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karāya]] [[synonyms:p:pulina]]-[[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---induces Him to eat on the river bank.
translation: Who can understand the influence and mercy of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu? He is so powerful that He induced Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to come eat chipped rice on the bank of the Ganges.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.9
description: Previously, when Lord Kṛṣṇa was personally present, Subala, one of His cowherd boy friends, gave Him happiness when He felt separation from Rādhārāṇī. Similarly, Rāmānanda Rāya helped give happiness to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> subala yaiche pūrve kṛṣṇa-sukhera sahāya
> gaura-sukha-dāna-hetu taiche rāma-rāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:subala]]---Subala, one of the cowherd boy friends of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---just as; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sukhera]]---to give happiness to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sahāya]]---helper; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:d:dāna]]-[[synonyms:h:hetu]]---for giving happiness to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---similarly; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya.
translation: Previously, when Lord Kṛṣṇa was personally present, Subala, one of His cowherd boy friends, gave Him happiness when He felt separation from Rādhārāṇī. Similarly, Rāmānanda Rāya helped give happiness to Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.90
description: All the confidential devotees who were cowherd boys, headed by Śrī Rāmadāsa, were absorbed in ecstatic love. They thought the bank of the Ganges to be the bank of the Yamunā.
text:
> śrī-rāmadāsādi gopa premāviṣṭa hailā
> gaṅgā-tīre 'yamunā-pulina' jñāna kailā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmadāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Śrī Rāmadāsa; [[synonyms:g:gopa]]---the cowherd boys; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:ā:āviṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became absorbed in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgā]]-[[synonyms:t:tīre]]---the bank of the Ganges River; [[synonyms:y:yamunā]]-[[synonyms:p:pulina]]---the bank of the Yamunā River; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---they thought.
translation: All the confidential devotees who were cowherd boys, headed by Śrī Rāmadāsa, were absorbed in ecstatic love. They thought the bank of the Ganges to be the bank of the Yamunā.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.91
description: When the shopkeepers of many other villages heard about the festival, they arrived there to sell chipped rice, yogurt, sweetmeats and bananas.
text:
> mahotsava śuni' pasāri nānā-grāma haite
> ciḍā, dadhi, sandeśa, kalā ānila vecite
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahotsava]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing about this festival; [[synonyms:p:pasāri]]---the shopkeepers; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:g:grāma]]---various villages; [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:s:sandeśa]]---sweetmeats; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---bananas; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:v:vecite]]---to sell.
translation: When the shopkeepers of many other villages heard about the festival, they arrived there to sell chipped rice, yogurt, sweetmeats and bananas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.92
description: As they came, bringing all kinds of food, Raghunātha dāsa purchased it all. He gave them the price for their goods and later fed them the very same food.
text:
> yata dravya lañā āise, saba mūlya kari' laya
> tāra dravya mūlya diyā tāhāre khāoyāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---all materials; [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---bringing; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---come; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:l:laya]]---Raghunātha purchased; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---of their goods; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving the price; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]] [[synonyms:k:khāoyāya]]---fed them.
translation: As they came, bringing all kinds of food, Raghunātha dāsa purchased it all. He gave them the price for their goods and later fed them the very same food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.93
description: Anyone who came to see how these funny things were going on was also fed chipped rice, yogurt and bananas.
text:
> kautuka dekhite āila yata yata jana
> sei ciḍā, dadhi, kalā karila bhakṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kautuka]]---these funny things; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---arrived; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---all kinds of men; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---they; [[synonyms:c:ciḍā]]---chipped rice; [[synonyms:d:dadhi]]---yogurt; [[synonyms:k:kalā]]---bananas; [[synonyms:k:karila]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---ate.
translation: Anyone who came to see how these funny things were going on was also fed chipped rice, yogurt and bananas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.94
description: After Lord Nityānanda Prabhu finished eating, He washed His hands and mouth and gave Raghunātha dāsa the food remaining in the four pots.
text:
> bhojana kari' nityānanda ācamana kailā
> cāri kuṇḍīra avaśeṣa raghunāthe dilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---after finishing eating; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:ā:ācamana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---washing His hands and mouth; [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍīra]]---of the four pots; [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]]---what was remaining; [[synonyms:r:raghunāthe]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---delivered to Raghunātha dāsa.
translation: After Lord Nityānanda Prabhu finished eating, He washed His hands and mouth and gave Raghunātha dāsa the food remaining in the four pots.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.95
description: There was food remaining in the three other big pots of Lord Nityānanda, and a brāhmaṇa distributed it to all the devotees, giving a morsel to each.
text:
> āra tina kuṇḍikāya avaśeṣa chila
> grāse-grāse kari' vipra saba bhakte dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:k:kuṇḍikāya]]---in three pots; [[synonyms:a:avaśeṣa]] [[synonyms:c:chila]]---there was food remaining; [[synonyms:g:grāse]]-[[synonyms:g:grāse]]---by morsel; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---delivering; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---a //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakte]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---delivered.
translation: There was food remaining in the three other big pots of Lord Nityānanda, and a brāhmaṇa distributed it to all the devotees, giving a morsel to each.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 6.96
description: Then a brāhmaṇa brought a flower garland, placed the garland on Nityānanda Prabhu's neck and smeared sandalwood pulp all over His body.
text:
> puṣpa-mālā vipra āni' prabhu-gale dila
> candana āniyā prabhura sarvāṅge lepila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:puṣpa]]-[[synonyms:m:mālā]]---a flower garland; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---one brāhmaṇa; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:p:prabhugale]]---on the neck of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---placed; [[synonyms:c:candana]] [[synonyms:ā:āniyā]]---bringing sandalwood pulp; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Lord Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:s:sarvāṅge]] [[synonyms:l:lepila]]---smeared all over the body.
