translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa Ācārya requested Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, "If You are actually pleased with me, please accept my invitation once again."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.139
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who had descended to deliver the entire universe, accepted the invitation of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa just to give him happiness.
text:
> prabhu avatīrṇa hailā jagat tārite
> mānilena nimantraṇa, tāre sukha dite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:avatīrṇa]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---made His advent; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the universe; [[synonyms:t:tārite]]---to deliver; [[synonyms:m:mānilena]]---He accepted; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---the invitation; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---to him; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:d:dite]]---to give.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who had descended to deliver the entire universe, accepted the invitation of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa just to give him happiness.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.14
description: "Without being especially empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot manifest ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, for Kṛṣṇa is the only one who gives ecstatic love. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.
text:
> prema-parakāśa nahe kṛṣṇa-śakti vine
> 'kṛṣṇa'---eka prema-dātā, śāstra-pramāṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prema]]---of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:parakāśa]]---manifestation; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---cannot be; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:ś:śakti]] [[synonyms:v:vine]]---without the power of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---the only one; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dātā]]---giver of prema; [[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]-[[synonyms:p:pramāṇe]]---the verdict of all revealed scriptures.
translation: "Without being especially empowered by Kṛṣṇa, one cannot manifest ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa, for Kṛṣṇa is the only one who gives ecstatic love. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.140
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is always eager to see everyone in the material world happy. Therefore sometimes He chastises someone just to purify his heart.
text:
> jagatera 'hita' ha-uka---ei prabhura mana
> daṇḍa kari' kare tāra hṛdaya śodhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagatera]]---of the entire world; [[synonyms:h:hita]]---welfare; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:u:uka]]---let there be; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the mind of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---punishing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]---heart; [[synonyms:ś:śodhana]]---purifying.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is always eager to see everyone in the material world happy. Therefore sometimes He chastises someone just to purify his heart.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.141
description: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates, the Lord was very pleased with him.
text:
> svagaṇa-sahita prabhura nimantraṇa kailā
> mahāprabhu tāre tabe prasanna ha-ilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with His associates; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invitation; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---upon him; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:p:prasanna]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ilā]]---became very pleased.
translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates, the Lord was very pleased with him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.142
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very deep. It can be compared to the love of Satyabhāmā, who always quarreled with Lord Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> jagadānanda-paṇḍitera śuddha gāḍha bhāva
> satyabhāmā-prāya prema 'vāmya-svabhāva'
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:g:gāḍha]]---deep; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:s:satyabhāmā]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like Satyabhāmā; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---his love for the Lord; [[synonyms:v:vāmya]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---quarrelsome nature.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very deep. It can be compared to the love of Satyabhāmā, who always quarreled with Lord Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.143
description: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was accustomed to provoking loving quarrels with the Lord. There was always some disagreement between them.
text:
> bāra-bāra praṇaya kalaha kare prabhu-sane
> anyonye khaṭmaṭi cale dui-jane
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]---loving; [[synonyms:k:kalaha]]---quarrel; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:anyonye]]---mutual; [[synonyms:k:khaṭmaṭi]]---picking a quarrel; [[synonyms:c:cale]]---goes on; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---between the two.
translation: Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was accustomed to provoking loving quarrels with the Lord. There was always some disagreement between them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.144
description: Gadādhara Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also very deep. It was like that of Rukmiṇīdevī, who was always especially submissive to Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> gadādhara-paṇḍitera śuddha gāḍha bhāva
> rukmiṇī-devīra yaiche 'dakṣiṇa-svabhāva'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:g:gāḍha]]---deep; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:r:rukmiṇī]]-[[synonyms:d:devīra]]---of Rukmiṇīdevī; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as; [[synonyms:d:dakṣiṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---submissive nature.
translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita's pure ecstatic love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was also very deep. It was like that of Rukmiṇīdevī, who was always especially submissive to Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.145
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes desired to see Gadādhara Paṇḍita's affectionate anger, but because of knowledge of the Lord's opulences, his anger was never invoked.
text:
> tāṅra praṇaya-roṣa dekhite prabhura icchā haya
> aiśvarya-jñāne tāṅra roṣa nāhi upajaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]-[[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---affectionate anger; [[synonyms:d:dekhite]]---to see; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:i:icchā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is a desire; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---due to knowledge of opulences; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---anger; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---not; [[synonyms:u:upajaya]]---is awakened.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes desired to see Gadādhara Paṇḍita's affectionate anger, but because of knowledge of the Lord's opulences, his anger was never invoked.
purport: Joking with Rukmiṇīdevī in Dvārakā, Kṛṣṇa once advised her to accept another husband because He thought Himself unfit for her. Rukmiṇīdevī, however, unable to understand His joking words, took them very seriously and immediately fell to the ground in fear of separation from Him. In the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita was always in disagreement with the Lord like Satyabhāmā, whereas Gadādhara Paṇḍita was always awed by the Lord's opulence and was therefore submissive to the Lord under all circumstances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.146
description: For this purpose Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes showed His apparent anger. Hearing of this anger inspired great fear in the heart of Gadādhara Paṇḍita.
text:
> ei lakṣya pāñā prabhu kailā roṣābhāsa
> śuni' paṇḍitera citte upajila trāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:l:lakṣya]]---aim; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---taking; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---made a semblance of anger; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:citte]]---in the heart; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---arose; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---fear.
translation: For this purpose Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sometimes showed His apparent anger. Hearing of this anger inspired great fear in the heart of Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.147
description: Previously, in kṛṣṇa-līlā, when Lord Kṛṣṇa wanted to joke with Rukmiṇīdevī, she took His words seriously, and fear awoke within her mind.
text:
> pūrve yena kṛṣṇa yadi parihāsa kaila
> śuni' rukmiṇīra mane trāsa upajila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---play a joke; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rukmiṇīra]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind of Rukmiṇīdevī; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---fear; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---arose.
translation: Previously, in kṛṣṇa-līlā, when Lord Kṛṣṇa wanted to joke with Rukmiṇīdevī, she took His words seriously, and fear awoke within her mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.148
description: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was accustomed to worshiping the Lord as child Kṛṣṇa. Therefore he had been initiated into the Bāla-gopāla mantra and was thus worshiping the Lord.
text:
> vallabha-bhaṭṭera haya vātsalya-upāsana
> bāla-gopāla-mantre teṅho karena sevana
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]-[[synonyms:u:upāsana]]---worship as a parent; [[synonyms:b:bāla]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]-[[synonyms:m:mantre]]---with the //mantra// of Bāla-gopāla, child Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---practices; [[synonyms:s:sevana]]---worship.
translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was accustomed to worshiping the Lord as child Kṛṣṇa. Therefore he had been initiated into the Bāla-gopāla mantra and was thus worshiping the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.149
description: In the association of Gadādhara Paṇḍita, his mind was converted, and he dedicated his mind to worshiping Kiśora-gopāla, Kṛṣṇa as a young boy.
text:
> paṇḍitera sane tāra mana phiri' gela
> kiśora-gopāla-upāsanāya mana dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---in the association of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:p:phiri']] [[synonyms:g:gela]]---became converted; [[synonyms:k:kiśora]]-[[synonyms:g:gopāla]]---of Kṛṣṇa as a young boy; [[synonyms:u:upāsanāya]]---to the worship; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:d:dila]]---he gave his mind.
translation: In the association of Gadādhara Paṇḍita, his mind was converted, and he dedicated his mind to worshiping Kiśora-gopāla, Kṛṣṇa as a young boy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.15
description: "There may be many all-auspicious incarnations of the Personality of Godhead, but who other than Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa can bestow love of God upon the surrendered souls?' "
text:
> santv avatārā bahavaḥ
> puṣkara-nābhasya sarvato-bhadrāḥ
> kṛṣṇād anyaḥ ko vā latāsv
> api premado bhavati"
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:santu]]---let there be; [[synonyms:a:avatārāḥ]]---incarnations; [[synonyms:b:bahavaḥ]]---many; [[synonyms:p:puṣkara]]-[[synonyms:n:nābhasya]]---of the Lord, from whose navel grows a lotus flower; [[synonyms:s:sarvataḥ]] [[synonyms:b:bhadrāḥ]]---completely auspicious; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇāt]]---than Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:anyaḥ]]---other; [[synonyms:k:kaḥ]] [[synonyms:v:vā]]---who possibly; [[synonyms:l:latāsu]]---on the surrendered souls; [[synonyms:a:api]]---also; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:daḥ]]---the bestower of love; [[synonyms:b:bhavati]]---is.
translation: "There may be many all-auspicious incarnations of the Personality of Godhead, but who other than Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa can bestow love of God upon the surrendered souls?' "
purport: This is a verse written by Bilvamaṅgala Ṭhākura. it is found in the //Laghu-bhāgavatāmṛta// (1.5.37).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.150
description: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but Gadādhara Paṇḍita refused, saying, "The work of acting as a spiritual master is not possible for me.
text:
> paṇḍitera ṭhāñi cāhe mantrādi śikhite
> paṇḍita kahe,---"ei karma nahe āmā haite
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---wanted; [[synonyms:m:mantra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]] [[synonyms:ś:śikhite]]---to be initiated; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:k:karma]]---this work; [[synonyms:n:nahe]] [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---is not possible for me.
translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but Gadādhara Paṇḍita refused, saying, "The work of acting as a spiritual master is not possible for me.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.151
description: "I am completely dependent. My Lord is Gauracandra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I cannot do anything independently, without His order.
text:
> āmi---paratantra, āmāra prabhu---gauracandra
> tāṅra ājñā vinā āmi nā ha-i 'svatantra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:p:paratantra]]---dependent; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]]---not; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---am; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]]---independent.
translation: "I am completely dependent. My Lord is Gauracandra, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. I cannot do anything independently, without His order.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.152
description: "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, your coming to me is not appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore He sometimes speaks to chastise me."
text:
> tumi ye āmāra ṭhāñi kara āgamana
> tāhātei prabhu more dena olāhana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---to me; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:ā:āgamana]]---come; [[synonyms:t:tāhātei]]---due to that; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto me; [[synonyms:d:dena]]---gives; [[synonyms:o:olāhana]]---punishment by words.
translation: "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, your coming to me is not appreciated by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Therefore He sometimes speaks to chastise me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.153-154
description: Some days passed, and when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, finally pleased with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, accepted his invitation, the Lord sent Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Govinda to call for Gadādhara Paṇḍita.
text:
> ei-mata bhaṭṭera katheka dina gela
> śeṣe yadi prabhu tāre suprasanna haila
>
> nimantraṇera dine paṇḍite bolāilā
> svarūpa, jagadānanda, govinde pāṭhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:k:katheka]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---some days; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:ś:śeṣe]]---at last; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---upon him; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:p:prasanna]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became very pleased; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇera]] [[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the day of invitation; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]] [[synonyms:b:bolāilā]]---He called for Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:g:govinde]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāilā]]---He sent.
translation: Some days passed, and when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, finally pleased with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, accepted his invitation, the Lord sent Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and Govinda to call for Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.155
description: On the way, Svarūpa Dāmodara said to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to test you. Therefore He neglected you.
text:
> pathe paṇḍitere svarūpa kahena vacana
> "parīkṣite prabhu tomāre kailā upekṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pathe]]---on the way; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitere]]---unto Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:k:kahena]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---said some words; [[synonyms:p:parīkṣite]]---to test; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:u:upekṣaṇa]]---neglected.
translation: On the way, Svarūpa Dāmodara said to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wanted to test you. Therefore He neglected you.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.156
description: "Why did you not retaliate by reproaching Him? Why did you fearfully tolerate His criticism?"
text:
> tumi kene āsi' tāṅre nā dilā olāhana?
> bhīta-prāya hañā kāṅhe karilā sahana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto Him; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---did not give; [[synonyms:o:olāhana]]---chastisement; [[synonyms:b:bhīta]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---as if fearful; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhe]]---why; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:s:sahana]]---did you tolerate.
translation: "Why did you not retaliate by reproaching Him? Why did you fearfully tolerate His criticism?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.157
description: Gadādhara Paṇḍita said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is completely independent. He is the topmost omniscient personality. It would not look well for me to talk to Him as if His equal.
text:
> paṇḍita kahena,---prabhu svatantra sarvajña-śiromaṇi
> tāṅra sane 'haṭha' kari,---bhāla nāhi māni
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita said; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:svatantra]]---independent; [[synonyms:s:sarvajña]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the best of the omniscient; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---with Him; [[synonyms:h:haṭha]] [[synonyms:k:kari]]---if I talk on an equal level; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---good; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māni]]---I do not think it is.
translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita said, "Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is completely independent. He is the topmost omniscient personality. It would not look well for me to talk to Him as if His equal.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.158
description: "I can tolerate whatever He says, bearing it upon my head. He will automatically be merciful to me after considering my faults and attributes."
text:
> yei kahe, sei sahi nija-śire dhari'
> āpane karibena kṛpā guṇa-doṣa vicāri' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---whatever He says; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:s:sahi]]---I tolerate that; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:ś:śire]]---on my head; [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---bearing; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---automatically; [[synonyms:k:karibena]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---He will be merciful; [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---attributes and faults; [[synonyms:v:vicāri']]---after considering.
translation: "I can tolerate whatever He says, bearing it upon my head. He will automatically be merciful to me after considering my faults and attributes."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.159
description: After saying this, Gadādhara Paṇḍita went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell down crying at the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> eta bali' paṇḍita prabhura sthāne āilā
> rodana kariyā prabhura caraṇe paḍilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:r:rodana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---crying; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down.
translation: After saying this, Gadādhara Paṇḍita went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and fell down crying at the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.16
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you are a learned scholar. Kindly listen to Me. I am a sannyāsī of the Māyāvāda school. Therefore I have no chance of knowing what kṛṣṇa-bhakti is.
text:
> mahāprabhu kahe---"śuna, bhaṭṭa mahā-mati
> māyāvādī sannyāsī āmi, nā jāni kṛṣṇa-bhakti
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:m:mati]]---learned scholar; [[synonyms:m:māyāvādī]]---in the Māyāvāda school; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---//sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I do not know; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service to Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "My dear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, you are a learned scholar. Kindly listen to Me. I am a sannyāsī of the Māyāvāda school. Therefore I have no chance of knowing what kṛṣṇa-bhakti is.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.160
description: Smiling slightly, the Lord embraced him and spoke sweet words so that others would also hear.
text:
> īṣat hāsiyā prabhu kailā āliṅgana
> sabāre śunāñā kahena madhura vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ī:īṣat]] [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling slightly; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all others; [[synonyms:ś:śunāñā]]---causing to hear; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---began to say; [[synonyms:m:madhura]] [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---sweet words.
translation: Smiling slightly, the Lord embraced him and spoke sweet words so that others would also hear.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.161
description: "I wanted to agitate you," the Lord said, "but you did not become agitated. Indeed, you could not say anything angry. Instead, you tolerated everything.
text:
> "āmi cālāiluṅ tomā, tumi nā calilā
> krodhe kichu nā kahilā, sakala sahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:c:cālāiluṅ]]---tried to agitate; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---you; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---did not become agitated; [[synonyms:k:krodhe]]---in anger; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---you did not say; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---everything; [[synonyms:s:sahilā]]---you tolerated.
translation: "I wanted to agitate you," the Lord said, "but you did not become agitated. Indeed, you could not say anything angry. Instead, you tolerated everything.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.162
description: "Your mind was not disturbed by My tricks. Rather, you stayed fixed in your simplicity. In this way you have purchased Me."
text:
> āmāra bhaṅgīte tomāra mana nā calilā
> sudṛḍha sarala-bhāve āmāre kinilā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgīte]]---by My trick; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---your mind; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:c:calilā]]---did not become disturbed; [[synonyms:s:sudṛḍha]]---firm; [[synonyms:s:sarala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---by simplicity; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---Me; [[synonyms:k:kinilā]]---you have purchased.
translation: "Your mind was not disturbed by My tricks. Rather, you stayed fixed in your simplicity. In this way you have purchased Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.163
description: No one can describe the characteristics and ecstatic love of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. Therefore another name for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Gadādhara-prāṇanātha, "the life and soul of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."
text:
> paṇḍitera bhāva-mudrā kahana nā yāya
> 'gadādhara-prāṇa-nātha' nāma haila yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---characteristics and ecstatic love; [[synonyms:k:kahana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---can not be described; [[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]-[[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the Lord of the life of Gadādhara; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---name; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---goes.
translation: No one can describe the characteristics and ecstatic love of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. Therefore another name for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is Gadādhara-prāṇanātha, "the life and soul of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.164
description: No one can say how merciful the Lord is to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but people know the Lord as Gadāira Gaura, "the Lord Gaurāṅga of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."
text:
> paṇḍite prabhura prasāda kahana nā yāya
> 'gadāira gaurāṅga' bali' yāṅre loke gāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍite]]---upon Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---mercy; [[synonyms:k:kahana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---no one can explain; [[synonyms:g:gadāira]] [[synonyms:g:gaurāṅga]]---the Gaurāṅga of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---as; [[synonyms:y:yāṅre]]---whom; [[synonyms:l:loke]] [[synonyms:g:gāya]]---people say.
translation: No one can say how merciful the Lord is to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, but people know the Lord as Gadāira Gaura, "the Lord Gaurāṅga of Gadādhara Paṇḍita."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.165
description: No one can understand the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They are like the Ganges, for hundreds and thousands of branches flow from even one of His activities.
text:
> caitanya-prabhura līlā ke bujhite pāre?
> eka-līlāya vahe gaṅgāra śata śata dhāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can understand; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:l:līlāya]]---in one activity; [[synonyms:v:vahe]]---flow; [[synonyms:g:gaṅgāra]]---of the Ganges; [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:ś:śata]] [[synonyms:d:dhāre]]---hundreds and hundreds of branches.
translation: No one can understand the pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. They are like the Ganges, for hundreds and thousands of branches flow from even one of His activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.166
description: Gadādhara Paṇḍita is celebrated all over the world for his gentle behavior, his brahminical attributes and his steady love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> paṇḍitera saujanya, brahmaṇyatā-guṇa
> dṛḍha prema-mudrā loke karilā khyāpana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:s:saujanya]]---the gentle behavior of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:b:brahmaṇyatā]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---the attributes of a perfect //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---firm; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:m:mudrā]]---characteristic of love; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---people; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:k:khyāpana]]---proclaimed.
translation: Gadādhara Paṇḍita is celebrated all over the world for his gentle behavior, his brahminical attributes and his steady love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.167
description: The Lord purified Vallabha Bhaṭṭa by cleansing him of the mud of false pride. By such activities the Lord also instructed others.
text:
> abhimāna-paṅka dhuñā bhaṭṭere śodhilā
> sei-dvārā āra saba loke śikhāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]-[[synonyms:p:paṅka]]---the mud of false pride; [[synonyms:d:dhuñā]]---washing; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭere]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhilā]]---purified Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---by that; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all other; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---persons; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---instructed.
translation: The Lord purified Vallabha Bhaṭṭa by cleansing him of the mud of false pride. By such activities the Lord also instructed others.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.168
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was actually always merciful within His heart, but He was sometimes externally negligent of His devotees. We should not be preoccupied with His external feature, however, for if we do so we shall be vanquished.
text:
> antare 'anugraha,' bāhye 'upekṣāra prāya'
> bāhyārtha yei laya, sei nāśa yāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:antare]]---within the heart; [[synonyms:a:anugraha]]---mercy; [[synonyms:b:bāhye]]---externally; [[synonyms:u:upekṣāra]] [[synonyms:p:prāya]]---like neglect; [[synonyms:b:bāhya]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the external meaning; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---takes; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nāśa]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---becomes vanquished.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was actually always merciful within His heart, but He was sometimes externally negligent of His devotees. We should not be preoccupied with His external feature, however, for if we do so we shall be vanquished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.169
description: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very deep. Who can understand them? Only one who has firm, deep devotion to His lotus feet.
text:
> nigūḍha caitanya-līlā bujhite kā'ra śakti?
> sei bujhe, gauracandre yāṅra dṛḍha bhakti
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nigūḍha]]---very deep; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---the pastimes of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]]---to understand; [[synonyms:k:kā'ra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---the power; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bujhe]]---he understands; [[synonyms:g:gauracandre]]---unto Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]] [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---fixed devotion.
translation: The pastimes of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are very deep. Who can understand them? Only one who has firm, deep devotion to His lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.17
description: "Nevertheless, My mind has become purified because I have associated with Advaita Ācārya, who is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
text:
> advaitācārya-gosāñi---'sākṣāt īśvara'
> tāṅra saṅge āmāra mana ha-ila nirmala
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]] [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---by His association; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---has become; [[synonyms:n:nirmala]]---purified.
translation: "Nevertheless, My mind has become purified because I have associated with Advaita Ācārya, who is directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.170
description: Another day, Gadādhara Paṇḍita invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dinner. The Lord took prasāda at his home with His personal associates.
text:
> dināntare paṇḍita kaila prabhura nimantraṇa
> prabhu tāhāṅ bhikṣā kaila lañā nija-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dina]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---another day; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---took //prasāda//; [[synonyms:l:lañā]] [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---with His personal associates.
translation: Another day, Gadādhara Paṇḍita invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dinner. The Lord took prasāda at his home with His personal associates.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu acted as a very merciful well-wisher toward Vallabha Bhaṭṭa by externally neglecting him in many ways to purify him of his false pride in being a learned scholar. The Lord neglected Gadādhara Paṇḍita for a few days because of his associating with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa. Actually He was not at all displeased with Gadādhara Paṇḍita. Indeed, because Gadādhara Paṇḍita is the personal potency of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, there is no chance of the Lord's being dissatisfied with him. However, a person who is too attracted to externals cannot understand the deep meaning of these dealings of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. If one therefore becomes disrespectful to Gadādhara Paṇḍita, he will surely be vanquished.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.171
description: There Vallabha Bhaṭṭa took permission from Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and his desire to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita was thus fulfilled.
text:
> tāhāṅi vallabha-bhaṭṭa prabhura ājñā laila
> paṇḍita-ṭhāñi pūrva-prārthita saba siddhi haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅi]]---there; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---the permission of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:laila]]---took; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:p:prārthita]]---as previously petitioned; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:s:siddhi]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---everything was perfectly executed.
translation: There Vallabha Bhaṭṭa took permission from Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and his desire to be initiated by Gadādhara Paṇḍita was thus fulfilled.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.172
description: I have thus explained the Lord's meeting with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa. By hearing of this incident, one can achieve the treasure of love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei ta' kahiluṅ vallabha-bhaṭṭera milana
> yāhāra śravaṇe pāya gaura-prema-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---thus I have explained; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]] [[synonyms:m:milana]]---the meeting of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---by hearing which; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---one can get; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the treasure of love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: I have thus explained the Lord's meeting with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa. By hearing of this incident, one can achieve the treasure of love for Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.173
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Seventh Chapter, describing the meeting of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.18
description: "He is unparalleled in His understanding of all the revealed scriptures and the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore He is called Advaita Ācārya.
text:
> sarva-śāstre kṛṣṇa-bhaktye nāhi yāṅra sama
> ataeva 'advaita-ācārya' tāṅra nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstre]]---in all revealed scriptures; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaktye]]---in the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---is not; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---of whom; [[synonyms:s:sama]]---equal; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---without a competitor; [[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---//ācārya//; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---His name.
translation: "He is unparalleled in His understanding of all the revealed scriptures and the devotional service of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore He is called Advaita Ācārya.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.19
description: "He is such a great personality that by His mercy He can convert even the meateaters [mlecchas] to the devotional service of Kṛṣṇa. Who, therefore, can estimate the power of His Vaiṣṇavism?
text:
> yāṅhāra kṛpāte mlecchera haya kṛṣṇa-bhakti
> ke kahite pāre tāṅra vaiṣṇavatā-śakti?
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yāṅhāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāte]]---by mercy; [[synonyms:m:mlecchera]]---of mlecchas; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can describe; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---His; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavatā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śakti]]---power of Vaiṣṇavism.
translation: "He is such a great personality that by His mercy He can convert even the meateaters [mlecchas] to the devotional service of Kṛṣṇa. Who, therefore, can estimate the power of His Vaiṣṇavism?
purport: It is extremely difficult to convert a //mleccha,// or meat-eater, into a devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. Therefore anyone who can do so is situated on the highest level of Vaiṣṇavism.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.2
description: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-caitanya jaya nityānanda
> jayādvaita-candra jaya gaura-bhakta-vṛnda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Nityānanda Prabhu; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛnda]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu! All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu! All glories to Advaitacandra! And all glories to the devotees of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.20
description: "Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, the avadhūta, is also directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He is always intoxicated with the madness of ecstatic love. Indeed, He is an ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> nityānanda-avadhūta---'sākṣāt īśvara'
> bhāvonmāde matta kṛṣṇa-premera sāgara
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:a:avadhūta]]---//paramahaṁsa//; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]] [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:u:unmāde]]---by the madness of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:matta]]---overwhelmed, intoxicated; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:premera]]---of love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sāgara]]---the ocean.
translation: "Lord Nityānanda Prabhu, the avadhūta, is also directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He is always intoxicated with the madness of ecstatic love. Indeed, He is an ocean of love of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.21
description: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya perfectly knows the six philosophical theses. He is therefore the spiritual master of the entire world in the six paths of philosophy. He is the best of devotees.
text:
> ṣaḍ-darśana-vettā bhaṭṭācārya-sārvabhauma
> ṣaḍ-darśane jagad-guru bhāgavatottama
synonyms: [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṭ]]-[[synonyms:d:darśana]]---of the six philosophical theses; [[synonyms:v:vettā]]---the knower; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭācārya]]-[[synonyms:s:sārvabhauma]]---Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya; [[synonyms:ṣ:ṣaṭ]]-[[synonyms:d:darśane]]---in six philosophical theses; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:g:guru]]---the spiritual master of the entire world; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---the best of the devotees.
translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya perfectly knows the six philosophical theses. He is therefore the spiritual master of the entire world in the six paths of philosophy. He is the best of devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.22
description: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya has shown Me the limit of devotional service. Only by his mercy have I understood that devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is the essence of all mystic yoga.
text:
> teṅha dekhāilā more bhakti-yoga-pāra
> tāṅra prasāde jāniluṅ 'kṛṣṇa-bhakti-yoga' sāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:d:dekhāilā]]---has shown; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to Me; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:y:yoga]]---of devotional service; [[synonyms:p:pāra]]---the limit; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:prasāde]]---by his mercy; [[synonyms:j:jāniluṅ]]---I have understood; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---of devotional service to Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yoga]]---of the //yoga// system; [[synonyms:s:sāra]]---the essence.
translation: "Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya has shown Me the limit of devotional service. Only by his mercy have I understood that devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is the essence of all mystic yoga.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.23
description: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya is the ultimate knower of the transcendental mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. He has instructed Me that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
text:
> rāmānanda-rāya kṛṣṇa-rasera 'nidhāna'
> teṅha jānāilā---kṛṣṇa---svayaṁ bhagavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:rasera]]---of the transcendental mellow of Kṛṣṇa's devotional service; [[synonyms:n:nidhāna]]---the mine; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:j:jānāilā]]---has given instruction; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:svayam]]---Himself; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "Śrīla Rāmānanda Rāya is the ultimate knower of the transcendental mellows of Lord Kṛṣṇa's devotional service. He has instructed Me that Lord Kṛṣṇa is the Supreme Personality of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.24
description: "Through the mercy of Rāmānanda Rāya, I have understood that ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest goal of life and that spontaneous love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest perfection.
text:
> tāte prema-bhakti---'puruṣārtha-śiromaṇi'
> rāga-mārge prema-bhakti 'sarvādhika' jāni
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:p:puruṣārtha]]---of all goals of human life; [[synonyms:ś:śiromaṇi]]---the crown jewel; [[synonyms:r:rāga]]-[[synonyms:m:mārge]]---on the path of spontaneous love; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:adhika]]---the highest of all; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I can understand.
translation: "Through the mercy of Rāmānanda Rāya, I have understood that ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest goal of life and that spontaneous love of Kṛṣṇa is the highest perfection.
purport: //Puruṣārtha// ("the goal of life") generally refers to religion, economic development, satisfaction of the senses and, finally, liberation. However, above these four kinds of //puruṣārthas,// love of Godhead stands supreme. It is called //parama-puruṣārtha// (the supreme goal of life) or //puruṣārtha-śiromaṇi// (the most exalted of all //puruṣārthas//). Lord Kṛṣṇa is worshiped by regulative devotional service, but the highest perfection of devotional service is spontaneous love of Godhead.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.25
description: "The servant, friend, superior and conjugal lover are the shelters of the transcendental mellows called dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and śṛṅgāra.
text:
> dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya, āra ye śṛṅgāra
> dāsa, sakhā, guru, kāntā,---'āśraya' yāhāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dāsya]]---servitude; [[synonyms:s:sakhya]]---friendship; [[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]---paternal love; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śṛṅgāra]]---conjugal love; [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---the servant; [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---friend; [[synonyms:g:guru]]---superior; [[synonyms:k:kāntā]]---lover; [[synonyms:ā:āśraya]]---the shelter; [[synonyms:y:yāhāra]]---of which.
translation: "The servant, friend, superior and conjugal lover are the shelters of the transcendental mellows called dāsya, sakhya, vātsalya and śṛṅgāra.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.26
description: "There are two kinds of emotion [bhāva]. Emotion with an understanding of the Lord's full opulences is called aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta, and pure, uncontaminated emotion is called kevala. One cannot achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, simply by knowing His opulences.
text:
> 'aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta', 'kevala'-bhāva āra
> aiśvarya-jñāne nā pāi vrajendra-kumāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]-[[synonyms:y:yukta]]---with understanding of the opulences; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]---pure; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---emotion; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---by understanding of the opulences; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---one does not get; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:k:kumāra]]---the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
translation: "There are two kinds of emotion [bhāva]. Emotion with an understanding of the Lord's full opulences is called aiśvarya-jñāna-yukta, and pure, uncontaminated emotion is called kevala. One cannot achieve shelter at the lotus feet of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Mahārāja Nanda, simply by knowing His opulences.
purport: Vide //Madhya-līlā,// Chapter Nineteen, text 192.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.27
description: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of mother Yaśodā, is accessible to those devotees engaged in spontaneous loving service, but He is not as easily accessible to mental speculators, to those striving for self-realization by severe austerities and penances, or to those who consider the body the same as the self.'
text:
> nāyaṁ sukhāpo bhagavān
> dehināṁ gopikā-sutaḥ
> jñānināṁ cātma-bhūtānāṁ
> yathā bhakti-matām iha
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:a:ayam]]---this Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āpaḥ]]---easily available; [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:d:dehinām]]---for materialistic persons who have accepted the body as the self; [[synonyms:g:gopikā]]-[[synonyms:s:sutaḥ]]---the son of mother Yaśodā; [[synonyms:j:jñāninām]]---for persons addicted to mental speculation; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūtānām]]---for persons performing severe austerities and penances or for personal associates; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]---as; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:m:matām]]---for persons engaged in spontaneous devotional service; [[synonyms:i:iha]]---in this world.
translation: "The Supreme Personality of Godhead, Kṛṣṇa, the son of mother Yaśodā, is accessible to those devotees engaged in spontaneous loving service, but He is not as easily accessible to mental speculators, to those striving for self-realization by severe austerities and penances, or to those who consider the body the same as the self.'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.9.21).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.28
description: "The word 'ātma-bhūta' means 'personal associates.' Through the understanding of opulence, the goddess of fortune could not receive the shelter of Kṛṣṇa; the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
text:
> 'ātma-bhūta'-śabde kahe 'pāriṣada-gaṇa'
> aiśvarya-jñāne lakṣmī nā pāilā vrajendra-nandana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:b:bhūta]]-[[synonyms:ś:śabde]]---the word //ātma-bhūta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---means; [[synonyms:p:pāriṣada]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---personal associates; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāne]]---in the understanding of opulence; [[synonyms:l:lakṣmī]]---the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāilā]]---could not get; [[synonyms:v:vrajendra]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---the shelter of Kṛṣṇa, the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
translation: "The word 'ātma-bhūta' means 'personal associates.' Through the understanding of opulence, the goddess of fortune could not receive the shelter of Kṛṣṇa; the son of Nanda Mahārāja.
purport: Lakṣmī, the goddess of fortune, has complete knowledge of Kṛṣṇa's opulences, but she could not achieve the association of Kṛṣṇa by dint of such knowledge. The devotees in Vṛndāvana, however, actually enjoy the association of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.29
description: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa was dancing with the gopīs in the rāsa-līlā, the gopīs were embraced by the arms of the Lord. This transcendental favor was never bestowed upon the goddess of fortune or the other consorts in the spiritual world. Indeed, never was such a favor even imagined by the most beautiful girls in the heavenly planets, whose bodily luster and aroma resemble those of lotus flowers. And what to speak of worldly women who are very beautiful according to the material estimation?'
text:
> nāyaṁ śriyo 'ṅga u nitānta-rateḥ prasādaḥ
> svar-yoṣitāṁ nalina-gandha-rucāṁ kuto 'nyāḥ
> rāsotsave 'sya bhuja-daṇḍa-gṛhīta-kaṇṭha-
> labdhāśiṣāṁ ya udagād vraja-sundarīṇām
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:a:ayam]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śriyaḥ]]---of the goddess of fortune; [[synonyms:a:aṅge]]---on the chest; [[synonyms:u:u]]---alas; [[synonyms:n:nitānta]]-[[synonyms:r:rateḥ]]---who is very intimately related; [[synonyms:p:prasādaḥ]]---the favor; [[synonyms:s:svaḥ]]---of the heavenly planets; [[synonyms:y:yoṣitām]]---of women; [[synonyms:n:nalina]]---of the lotus flower; [[synonyms:g:gandha]]---having the aroma; [[synonyms:r:rucām]]---and bodily luster; [[synonyms:k:kutaḥ]]---much less; [[synonyms:a:anyāḥ]]---others; [[synonyms:r:rāsa]]-[[synonyms:u:utsave]]---in the festival of the //rāsa// dance; [[synonyms:a:asya]]---of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhuja]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---by the arms; [[synonyms:g:gṛhīta]]---embraced; [[synonyms:k:kaṇṭha]]---their necks; [[synonyms:l:labdha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśiṣām]]---who achieved such a blessing; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---which; [[synonyms:u:udagāt]]---became manifest; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:s:sundarīṇām]]---of the beautiful //gopīs,// the transcendental girls of Vrajabhūmi.
translation: "When Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa was dancing with the gopīs in the rāsa-līlā, the gopīs were embraced by the arms of the Lord. This transcendental favor was never bestowed upon the goddess of fortune or the other consorts in the spiritual world. Indeed, never was such a favor even imagined by the most beautiful girls in the heavenly planets, whose bodily luster and aroma resemble those of lotus flowers. And what to speak of worldly women who are very beautiful according to the material estimation?'
purport: This is a verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.47.60).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.3
description: The next year, all the devotees of Bengal went to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and as previously, the Lord met each and every one of them.
text:
> varṣāntare yata gauḍera bhakta-gaṇa āilā
> pūrvavat mahāprabhu sabāre mililā
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:varṣa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---the next year; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāre]] [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met every one of them.
translation: The next year, all the devotees of Bengal went to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, and as previously, the Lord met each and every one of them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.30
description: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a friend mounts the shoulder of Kṛṣṇa, and mother Yaśodā binds the Lord.
text:
> śuddha-bhāve sakhā kare skandhe ārohaṇa
> śuddha-bhāve vrajeśvarī karena bandhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in pure consciousness; [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---friend; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:s:skandhe]]---on the shoulder; [[synonyms:ā:ārohaṇa]]---rising; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---in pure consciousness; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:ī:īśvarī]]---the Queen of Vraja; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bandhana]]---binds.
translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, a friend mounts the shoulder of Kṛṣṇa, and mother Yaśodā binds the Lord.
purport: //Śuddha-bhāva,// pure consciousness, is not dependent on an understanding of the Lord's opulences. Even without such opulences, the devotee in //śuddha-bhāva// is inclined to love Kṛṣṇa as a friend or son.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.31
description: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, without knowledge of the Lord's opulences, a devotee considers Kṛṣṇa his friend or son. Therefore this devotional attitude is praised even by Śukadeva Gosvāmī and Vyāsadeva, the supreme authority.
text:
> 'mora sakhā,' 'mora putra,'---ei 'śuddha' mana
> ataeva śuka-vyāsa kare praśaṁsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:s:sakhā]]---my friend; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:putra]]---my son; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]---pure; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---consciousness; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:ś:śuka]]-[[synonyms:v:vyāsa]]---Śukadeva Gosvāmī and Vyāsadeva; [[synonyms:k:karepraśaṁsana]]---praise.
translation: "In pure Kṛṣṇa consciousness, without knowledge of the Lord's opulences, a devotee considers Kṛṣṇa his friend or son. Therefore this devotional attitude is praised even by Śukadeva Gosvāmī and Vyāsadeva, the supreme authority.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.32
description: "Those who are engaged in self-realization, appreciating the Brahman effulgence of the Lord, and those engaged in devotional service, accepting the Supreme Personality of Godhead as master, as well as those who are under the clutches of māyā, thinking the Lord an ordinary person, cannot understand that certain exalted personalities-after accumulating volumes of pious activities-are now playing with the Lord in friendship as cowherd boys.'
text:
> itthaṁ satāṁ brahma-sukhānubhūtyā
> dāsyaṁ gatānāṁ para-daivatena
> māyāśritānāṁ nara-dārakeṇa
> sākaṁ vijahruḥ kṛta-puṇya-puñjāḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ittham]]---in this way; [[synonyms:s:satām]]---of persons who prefer the impersonal feature of the Lord; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]---of the impersonal effulgence; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---by the happiness; [[synonyms:a:anubhūtyā]]---who is realized; [[synonyms:d:dāsyam]]---the mode of servitude; [[synonyms:g:gatānām]]---of those who have accepted; [[synonyms:p:para]]-[[synonyms:d:daivatena]]---who is the supreme worshipable Deity; [[synonyms:m:māyā]]-[[synonyms:ā:āśritānām]]---for ordinary persons under the clutches of external energy; [[synonyms:n:nara]]-[[synonyms:d:dārakeṇa]]---with He who is like a boy of this material world; [[synonyms:s:sākam]]---in friendship; [[synonyms:v:vijahruḥ]]---played; [[synonyms:k:kṛta]]-[[synonyms:p:puṇya]]-[[synonyms:p:puñjāḥ]]---those who have accumulated volumes of pious activities.
translation: "Those who are engaged in self-realization, appreciating the Brahman effulgence of the Lord, and those engaged in devotional service, accepting the Supreme Personality of Godhead as master, as well as those who are under the clutches of māyā, thinking the Lord an ordinary person, cannot understand that certain exalted personalities-after accumulating volumes of pious activities-are now playing with the Lord in friendship as cowherd boys.'
purport: This verse is from the //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.12.11).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.33
description: "When mother Yaśodā saw all the universes within the mouth of Kṛṣṇa, she was certainly astonished for the time being. Nevertheless, she still considered the Lord her own son, although He is worshiped by great personalities who offer him sacrifices, great saints who understand the greatness of the Lord by studying the Upaniṣads, great philosophers who analytically study the universe, great yogīs who know him as the all-pervading Supersoul, and even devotees who accept the Lord as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'
text:
> trayyā copaniṣadbhiś ca
> sāṅkhya-yogaiś ca sātvataiḥ
> upagīyamāna-māhātmyaṁ
> hariṁ sāmanyatātmajam
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:trayyā]]---by followers of the three //Vedas// who perform great sacrifices like Indra and other demigods; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:u:upaniṣadbhiḥ]]---by the followers of the //Upaniṣads,// the topmost portion of Vedic knowledge; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:s:sāṅkhya]]---by the philosophers who analytically study the universe; [[synonyms:y:yogaiḥ]]---by mystic //yogīs//; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:s:sātvataiḥ]]---by devotees who follow the method of worship mentioned in the //Pañcarātra// and other Vedic literatures; [[synonyms:u:upagīyamāna]]---being sung; [[synonyms:m:māhātmyam]]---whose glories; [[synonyms:h:harim]]---unto the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:s:sā]]---she, mother Yaśodā; [[synonyms:a:amanyata]]---considered; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:j:jam]]---her own son, born out of her body.
translation: "When mother Yaśodā saw all the universes within the mouth of Kṛṣṇa, she was certainly astonished for the time being. Nevertheless, she still considered the Lord her own son, although He is worshiped by great personalities who offer him sacrifices, great saints who understand the greatness of the Lord by studying the Upaniṣads, great philosophers who analytically study the universe, great yogīs who know him as the all-pervading Supersoul, and even devotees who accept the Lord as the Supreme Personality of Godhead.'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.8.45).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.34
description: "O brāhmaṇa, what pious activities did Nanda Mahārāja perform to receive the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa as his son? And what pious activities did mother Yaśodā perform that made the Absolute Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa call her "mother" and suck her breasts?'
text:
> nandaḥ kim akarod brahman
> śreya evaṁ mahodayam
> yaśodā vā mahā-bhāgā
> papau yasyāḥ stanaṁ hariḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nandaḥ]]---Nanda Mahārāja; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:a:akarot]]---has performed; [[synonyms:b:brahman]]---O //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:ś:śreyaḥ]]---auspicious activities; [[synonyms:e:evam]]---thus; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:u:udayam]]---rising to such an exalted position as the father of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:yaśodā]]---mother Yaśodā; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgā]]---most fortunate; [[synonyms:p:papau]]---drank; [[synonyms:y:yasyāḥ]]---of whom; [[synonyms:s:stanam]]---the breasts; [[synonyms:h:hariḥ]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "O brāhmaṇa, what pious activities did Nanda Mahārāja perform to receive the Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa as his son? And what pious activities did mother Yaśodā perform that made the Absolute Supreme Personality of Godhead Kṛṣṇa call her "mother" and suck her breasts?'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.8.46).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.35
description: "Even if a pure devotee sees the opulence of Kṛṣṇa, he does not accept it. Therefore pure consciousness is more exalted than consciousness of the Lord's opulence.
text:
> aiśvarya dekhileha 'śuddhera' nahe aiśvarya-jñāna
> ataeva aiśvarya ha-ite 'kevala'-bhāva pradhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]---opulence; [[synonyms:d:dekhileha]]---even after seeing; [[synonyms:ś:śuddhera]]---of a pure devotee; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---knowledge of opulence; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ite]]---than the understanding of opulence; [[synonyms:k:kevala]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---pure emotion; [[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---more eminent.
translation: "Even if a pure devotee sees the opulence of Kṛṣṇa, he does not accept it. Therefore pure consciousness is more exalted than consciousness of the Lord's opulence.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.36
description: "Rāmānanda Rāya is extremely aware of transcendental mellows. He is incessantly absorbed in the happiness of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. It is he who has instructed Me all this.
text:
> e saba śikhāilā more rāya-rāmānanda
> anargala rasa-vettā prema-sukhānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all this; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---instructed; [[synonyms:m:more]]---unto Me; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]-[[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:a:anargala]]---incessantly; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:v:vettā]]---one who understands transcendental mellows; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---absorbed in the happiness of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: "Rāmānanda Rāya is extremely aware of transcendental mellows. He is incessantly absorbed in the happiness of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. It is he who has instructed Me all this.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.37
description: "It is impossible to describe the influence and knowledge of Rāmānanda Rāya, for only by his mercy have I understood the unalloyed love of the residents of Vṛndāvana.
text:
> kahana nā yāya rāmānandera prabhāva
> rāya-prasāde jāniluṅ vrajera 'śuddha' bhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kahana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---cannot be described; [[synonyms:r:rāmānandera]] [[synonyms:p:prabhāva]]---the influence of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:p:prasāde]]---by the mercy; [[synonyms:j:jāniluṅ]]---I have understood; [[synonyms:v:vrajera]]---of the inhabitants of Vraja; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]] [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---unalloyed love.
translation: "It is impossible to describe the influence and knowledge of Rāmānanda Rāya, for only by his mercy have I understood the unalloyed love of the residents of Vṛndāvana.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.38
description: "The transcendental mellow of ecstatic love is personified by Svarūpa Dāmodara. By his association I have understood Vṛndāvana's transcendental mellow of conjugal love.
text:
> dāmodara-svarūpa---'prema-rasa' mūrtimān
> yāṅra saṅge haila vraja-madhura-rasa-jñāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]-[[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---the transcendental mellows of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:m:mūrtimān]]---personified; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---by whose association; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]---of Vraja; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]-[[synonyms:r:rasa]]---of the mellow of conjugal love; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]---knowledge.
translation: "The transcendental mellow of ecstatic love is personified by Svarūpa Dāmodara. By his association I have understood Vṛndāvana's transcendental mellow of conjugal love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.39
description: "The unalloyed love of the gopīs and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is without any trace of material lust. The criterion of such transcendental love is that its only purpose is to satisfy Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> 'śuddha-prema' vraja-devīra---kāma-gandha-hīna
> 'kṛṣṇa-sukha-tātparya',---ei tāra cihna
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---unalloyed love; [[synonyms:v:vraja]]-[[synonyms:d:devīra]]---of the //gopīs// or Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]-[[synonyms:g:gandha]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]---without a scent of material lust; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:t:tātparya]]---the purpose; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:c:cihna]]---the symptom.
translation: "The unalloyed love of the gopīs and Śrīmatī Rādhārāṇī is without any trace of material lust. The criterion of such transcendental love is that its only purpose is to satisfy Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.4
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes with His devotees. Then a learned scholar named Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Jagannātha Purī to meet the Lord.
text:
> ei-mata vilāsa prabhura bhakta-gaṇa lañā
> hena-kāle vallabha-bhaṭṭa milila āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:v:vilāsa]]---pastimes; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with His devotees; [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---the greatly learned scholar named Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:m:milila]]---met; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu performed His pastimes with His devotees. Then a learned scholar named Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Jagannātha Purī to meet the Lord.
purport: For a description of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, one may refer to the //Madhya-līlā,// Chapter Nineteen, text 61.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.40
description: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our lives rest only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path.'
text:
> yat te sujāta-caraṇāmburuhaṁ staneṣu
> bhītāḥ śanaiḥ priya dadhīmahi karkaśeṣu
> tenāṭavīm aṭasi tad vyathate na kiṁ svit
> kūrpādibhir bhramati dhīr bhavad-āyuṣāṁ naḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yat]]---which; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your; [[synonyms:s:sujāta]]---very fine; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:a:ambu]]-[[synonyms:r:ruham]]---lotus feet; [[synonyms:s:staneṣu]]---on the breasts; [[synonyms:b:bhītāḥ]]---being afraid; [[synonyms:ś:śanaiḥ]]---gently; [[synonyms:p:priya]]---O dear one; [[synonyms:d:dadhīmahi]]---we place; [[synonyms:k:karkaśeṣu]]---rough; [[synonyms:t:tena]]---with them; [[synonyms:a:aṭavīm]]---the path; [[synonyms:a:aṭasi]]---You roam; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---they; [[synonyms:v:vyathate]]---are distressed; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:k:kim]] [[synonyms:s:svit]]---we wonder; [[synonyms:k:kūrpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādibhiḥ]]---by small stones and so on; [[synonyms:b:bhramati]]---flutters; [[synonyms:d:dhīḥ]]---the mind; [[synonyms:b:bhavat]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyuṣām]]---of those of whom Your Lordship is the very life; [[synonyms:n:naḥ]]---of us.
translation: "O dearly beloved! Your lotus feet are so soft that we place them gently on our breasts, fearing that Your feet will be hurt. Our lives rest only in You. Our minds, therefore, are filled with anxiety that Your tender feet might be wounded by pebbles as You roam about on the forest path.'
purport: This verse is spoken by the //gopīs// in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.19).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.41
description: "Obsessed with pure love, without knowledge of opulences, the gopīs sometimes chastised Kṛṣṇa. That is a symptom of pure ecstatic love.
text:
> gopī-gaṇera śuddha-prema aiśvarya-jñāna-hīna
> premete bhartsanā kare ei tāra cihna
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopī]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇera]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---unalloyed love; [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]]-[[synonyms:h:hīna]]---devoid of knowledge of opulences; [[synonyms:p:premete]]---of pure love; [[synonyms:b:bhartsanā]]---chastisement; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---do; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:c:cihna]]---the symptom.
translation: "Obsessed with pure love, without knowledge of opulences, the gopīs sometimes chastised Kṛṣṇa. That is a symptom of pure ecstatic love.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.42
description: "O dear Kṛṣṇa, we gopīs have neglected the order of our husbands, sons, family, brothers and friends and have left their company to come to You. You know everything about our desires. We have come only because we are attracted by the supreme music of Your flute. But You are a great cheater, for who else would give up the company of young girls like us in the dead of night?'
text:
> pati-sutānvaya-bhrātṛ-bāndhavān
> ativilaṅghya te 'nty acyutāgatāḥ
> gati-vidas tavodgīta-mohitāḥ
> kitava yoṣitaḥ kas tyajen niśi
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pati]]---husbands; [[synonyms:s:suta]]---sons; [[synonyms:a:anvaya]]---family; [[synonyms:b:bhrātṛ]]---brothers; [[synonyms:b:bāndhavān]]---friends; [[synonyms:a:ativilaṅghya]]---without caring for; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:anti]]---dear shelter; [[synonyms:a:acyuta]]---O infallible one; [[synonyms:ā:āgatāḥ]]---have come; [[synonyms:g:gati]]-[[synonyms:v:vidaḥ]]---who know everything of our activities; [[synonyms:t:tava]]---of You; [[synonyms:u:udgīta]]---by the singing flute; [[synonyms:m:mohitāḥ]]---being attracted; [[synonyms:k:kitava]]---O great cheater; [[synonyms:y:yoṣitaḥ]]---beautiful women; [[synonyms:k:kaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:t:tyajet]]---would give up; [[synonyms:n:niśi]]---in the dead of night.
translation: "O dear Kṛṣṇa, we gopīs have neglected the order of our husbands, sons, family, brothers and friends and have left their company to come to You. You know everything about our desires. We have come only because we are attracted by the supreme music of Your flute. But You are a great cheater, for who else would give up the company of young girls like us in the dead of night?'
purport: This verse is from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.31.16).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.43
description: "The conjugal love of the gopīs is the most exalted devotional service, surpassing all other methods of bhakti. Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa is obliged to say, 'My dear gopīs, I cannot repay you. Indeed, I am always indebted to you.'
text:
> sarvottama bhajana ei sarva-bhakti jini'
> ataeva kṛṣṇa kahe,---'āmi tomāra ṛṇī'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:u:uttama]]---above all; [[synonyms:b:bhajana]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---all types of bhakti; [[synonyms:j:jini']]---conquering; [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa says; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:ṛ:ṛṇī]]---debtor.
translation: "The conjugal love of the gopīs is the most exalted devotional service, surpassing all other methods of bhakti. Therefore Lord Kṛṣṇa is obliged to say, 'My dear gopīs, I cannot repay you. Indeed, I am always indebted to you.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.44
description: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation.'
text:
> na pāraye 'haṁ niravadya-saṁyujāṁ
> sva-sādhu-kṛtyaṁ vibudhāyuṣāpi vaḥ
> yā mābhajan durjaya-geha-śṛṅkhalāḥ
> saṁvṛścya tad vaḥ pratiyātu sādhunā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:p:pāraye]]---am able to make; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I; [[synonyms:n:niravadya]]-[[synonyms:s:saṁyujām]]---to those who are completely free from deceit; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:s:sādhu]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛtyam]]---proper compensation; [[synonyms:v:vibudha]]-[[synonyms:ā:āyuṣā]]---with a lifetime as long as that of the demigods; [[synonyms:a:api]]---although; [[synonyms:v:vaḥ]]---to you; [[synonyms:y:yāḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:m:mā]]---Me; [[synonyms:a:abhajan]]---have worshiped; [[synonyms:d:durjaya]]-[[synonyms:g:geha]]-[[synonyms:ś:śṛṅkhalāḥ]]---the chains of household life, which are difficult to overcome; [[synonyms:s:saṁvṛścya]]---cutting; [[synonyms:t:tat]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vaḥ]]---of you; [[synonyms:p:pratiyātu]]---let it be returned; [[synonyms:s:sādhunā]]---by the good activity itself.
translation: "O gopīs, I am not able to repay My debt for your spotless service, even within a lifetime of Brahmā. Your connection with Me is beyond reproach. You have worshiped Me, cutting off all domestic ties, which are difficult to break. Therefore please let your own glorious deeds be your compensation.'
purport: This is a quotation from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.32.22).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.45
description: "Completely distinct from love of Kṛṣṇa in opulence, pure love of Kṛṣṇa is on the highest level. On the surface of the world there is no devotee greater than Uddhava.
text:
> aiśvarya-jñāna haite kevalā-bhāva---pradhāna
> pṛthivīte bhakta nāhi uddhava-samāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:aiśvarya]]-[[synonyms:j:jñāna]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---than transcendental love in opulence; [[synonyms:k:kevalā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---pure love; [[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---more prominent; [[synonyms:p:pṛthivīte]]---on the surface of the world; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is no devotee; [[synonyms:u:uddhava]]-[[synonyms:s:samāna]]---like Uddhava.
translation: "Completely distinct from love of Kṛṣṇa in opulence, pure love of Kṛṣṇa is on the highest level. On the surface of the world there is no devotee greater than Uddhava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.46
description: "Uddhava desires to take on his head the dust of the gopīs' lotus feet. I have learned about all these transcendental loving affairs of Lord Kṛṣṇa from Svarūpa Dāmodara.
text:
> teṅha yāṅra pada-dhūli karena prārthana
> svarūpera saṅge pāiluṅ e saba śikṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:p:pada]]-[[synonyms:d:dhūli]]---dust of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:p:prārthana]]---desires; [[synonyms:s:svarūpera]] [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---from Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:p:pāiluṅ]]---I have gotten; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:ś:śikṣaṇa]]---instructions.
translation: "Uddhava desires to take on his head the dust of the gopīs' lotus feet. I have learned about all these transcendental loving affairs of Lord Kṛṣṇa from Svarūpa Dāmodara.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.47
description: "The gopīs of Vṛndāvana have given up the association of their husbands, sons and other family members, who are very difficult to give up, and they have forsaken the path of chastity to take shelter of the lotus feet of Mukunda, Kṛṣṇa, which one should search for by Vedic knowledge. Oh, let me be fortunate enough to be one of the bushes, creepers or herbs in Vṛndāvana because the gopīs trample them and bless them with the dust of their lotus feet.'
text:
> āsām aho caraṇa-reṇu-juṣām ahaṁ syāṁ
> vṛndāvane kim api gulma-latauṣadhīnām
> yā dustyajaṁ svajanam ārya-pathaṁ ca hitvā
> bhejur mukunda-padavīṁ śrutibhir vimṛgyām
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āsām]]---of the //gopīs//; [[synonyms:a:aho]]---oh; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:r:reṇu]]---the dust of the lotus feet; [[synonyms:j:juṣām]]---devoted to; [[synonyms:a:aham]] [[synonyms:s:syām]]---let me become; [[synonyms:v:vṛndāvane]]---in Vṛndāvana; [[synonyms:k:kim]] [[synonyms:a:api]]---anyone; [[synonyms:g:gulma]]-[[synonyms:l:latā]]-[[synonyms:a:auṣadhīnām]]---among bushes, creepers and herbs; [[synonyms:y:yā]]---they who; [[synonyms:d:dustyajam]]---very difficult to give up; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:j:janam]]---family members; [[synonyms:ā:ārya]]-[[synonyms:p:patham]]---the path of chastity; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---and; [[synonyms:h:hitvā]]---giving up; [[synonyms:b:bhejuḥ]]---worshiped; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]-[[synonyms:p:padavīm]]---the lotus feet of Mukunda, Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śrutibhiḥ]]---by the //Vedas//; [[synonyms:v:vimṛgyām]]---to be searched for.
translation: "The gopīs of Vṛndāvana have given up the association of their husbands, sons and other family members, who are very difficult to give up, and they have forsaken the path of chastity to take shelter of the lotus feet of Mukunda, Kṛṣṇa, which one should search for by Vedic knowledge. Oh, let me be fortunate enough to be one of the bushes, creepers or herbs in Vṛndāvana because the gopīs trample them and bless them with the dust of their lotus feet.'
purport: This verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.47.61) was spoken by Uddhava. When Uddhava was sent by Kṛṣṇa to see the condition of the //gopīs// in Vṛndāvana, he stayed there for a few months in their association and always talked with them about Kṛṣṇa. Although this greatly pleased the //gopīs// and other residents of Vrajabhūmi, Vṛndāvana, Uddhava saw that the //gopīs// were severely afflicted by their separation from Kṛṣṇa. Their hearts were so disturbed that their minds were sometimes deranged. Observing the unalloyed devotion and love of the //gopīs// for Kṛṣṇa, Uddhava desired to become a creeper, a blade of grass or an herb in Vṛndāvana so that sometimes the //gopīs// would trample him and he would receive the dust of their lotus feet on his head.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.48
description: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the teacher of the holy name, is among the most exalted of all devotees. Every day he chants 300,000 holy names of the Lord.
text:
> haridāsa-ṭhākura---mahā-bhāgavata-pradhāna
> prati dina laya teṅha tina-lakṣa nāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Haridāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:p:pradhāna]]---the topmost of all pure devotees; [[synonyms:p:prati]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---every day; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---chants; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:n:nāma]]---300,000 holy names of the Lord.
translation: "Haridāsa Ṭhākura, the teacher of the holy name, is among the most exalted of all devotees. Every day he chants 300,000 holy names of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.49
description: "I have learned about the glories of the Lord's holy name from Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and by his mercy I have understood these glories.
text:
> nāmera mahimā āmi tāṅra ṭhāñi śikhiluṅ
> tāṅra prasāde nāmera mahimā jāniluṅ

translation: "I have learned about the glories of the Lord's holy name from Haridāsa Ṭhākura, and by his mercy I have understood these glories.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.5
description: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa arrived, he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord. Accepting him as a great devotee, the Lord embraced him.
text:
> āsiyā vandila bhaṭṭa prabhura caraṇe
> prabhu 'bhāgavata-buddhye' kailā āliṅgane
