translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa arrived, he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of the Lord. Accepting him as a great devotee, the Lord embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.50-52
description: "Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara, Vakreśvara, Kāśīśvara, Mukunda, Vāsudeva, Murāri and many other devotees have descended in Bengal to preach to everyone the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and the value of love for Him. I have learned from them the meaning of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> ācāryaratna ācāryanidhi paṇḍita-gadādhara
> jagadānanda, dāmodara, śaṅkara, vakreśvara
>
> kāśīśvara, mukunda, vāsudeva, murāri
> āra yata bhakta-gaṇa gauḍe avatari'
>
> kṛṣṇa-nāma-prema kailā jagate pracāra
> iṅhā sabāra saṅge kṛṣṇa-bhakti ye āmāra"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ācāryaratna]]---Ācāryaratna; [[synonyms:ā:ācāryanidhi]]---Ācāryanidhi; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Dāmodara; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:m:mukunda]]---Mukunda; [[synonyms:v:vāsudeva]]---Vāsudeva; [[synonyms:m:murāri]]---Murāri; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as many as; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---in Bengal; [[synonyms:a:avatari']]---having descended; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:j:jagate]]---all over the world; [[synonyms:p:pracāra]]---preaching; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]] [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---by association; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotional service to Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My.
translation: "Ācāryaratna, Ācāryanidhi, Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Jagadānanda, Dāmodara, Śaṅkara, Vakreśvara, Kāśīśvara, Mukunda, Vāsudeva, Murāri and many other devotees have descended in Bengal to preach to everyone the glories of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa and the value of love for Him. I have learned from them the meaning of devotional service to Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.53
description: Knowing that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's heart was full of pride, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words, hinting at how one can learn about devotional service.
text:
> bhaṭṭera hṛdaye dṛḍha abhimāna jāni'
> bhaṅgī kari' mahāprabhu kahe eta vāṇī
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]] [[synonyms:h:hṛdaye]]---in the heart of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---fixed; [[synonyms:a:abhimāna]]---pride; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---understanding; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgī]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making a hint; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---spoke; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:v:vāṇī]]---these words.
translation: Knowing that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's heart was full of pride, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke these words, hinting at how one can learn about devotional service.
purport: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was greatly proud of his knowledge in devotional service, and therefore he wanted to speak about Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu without understanding the Lord's position. The Lord therefore hinted in many ways that if Vallabha Bhaṭṭa wanted to know what devotional service actually is, he would have to learn from all the devotees He mentioned, beginning with Advaita Ācārya, Lord Nityānanda, Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya and Rāmānanda Rāya. As Svarūpa Dāmodara has said, if one wants to learn the meaning of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam,// one must take lessons from a realized soul. One should not proudly think that one can understand the transcendental loving service of the Lord simply by reading books. One must become a servant of a Vaiṣṇava. As Narottama dāsa Ṭhākura has confirmed, //chāḍiyā vaiṣṇava-sevā nistāra pāyeche kebā:// one cannot be in a transcendental position unless one very faithfully serves a pure Vaiṣṇava. One must accept a Vaiṣṇava //guru (ādau gurv-āśrayam),// and then by questions and answers one should gradually learn what pure devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is. That is called the //paramparā// system.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.54
description: "I am a great Vaiṣṇava. Having learned all the conclusions of Vaiṣṇava philosophy, I can understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and explain it very well."
text:
> "āmi se'vaiṣṇava',---bhakti-siddhānta saba jāni
> āmi se bhāgavata-artha uttama vākhāni"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---Vaiṣṇava; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]-[[synonyms:s:siddhānta]]---conclusions of devotional service; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I know; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---meaning of the //Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:u:uttama]]---very well; [[synonyms:v:vākhāni]]---can explain.
translation: "I am a great Vaiṣṇava. Having learned all the conclusions of Vaiṣṇava philosophy, I can understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam and explain it very well."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.55
description: Such pride had existed for a long time within Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's mind, but as he heard the preaching of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his pride was cut down.
text:
> bhaṭṭera manete ei chila dīrgha garva
> prabhura vacana śuni' se ha-ila kharva
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]] [[synonyms:m:manete]]---in the mind of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:c:chila]]---was existing; [[synonyms:d:dīrgha]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:g:garva]]---pride; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---the words; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---by hearing; [[synonyms:s:se]]---that; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:k:kharva]]---cut down.
translation: Such pride had existed for a long time within Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's mind, but as he heard the preaching of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, his pride was cut down.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.56
description: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa heard from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the pure Vaiṣṇavism of all these devotees, he immediately desired to see them.
text:
> prabhura mukhe vaiṣṇavatā śuniyā sabāra
> bhaṭṭera icchā haila tāṅ-sabāre dekhibāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavatā]]---the standard of Vaiṣṇavism; [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]] [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---hearing of all the devotees; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---desire; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:d:dekhibāra]]---to see.
translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa heard from the mouth of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu about the pure Vaiṣṇavism of all these devotees, he immediately desired to see them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.57
description: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "Where do all these Vaiṣṇavas live, and how can I see them?"
text:
> bhaṭṭa kahe,---"e saba vaiṣṇava rahe kon sthāne?
> kon prakāre pāimu ihāṅ-sabāra darśane?
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---all these Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---live; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---where; [[synonyms:k:kon]] [[synonyms:p:prakāre]]---how; [[synonyms:p:pāimu]]---shall I attain; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---seeing all these Vaiṣṇavas.
translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "Where do all these Vaiṣṇavas live, and how can I see them?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.58
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Although some of them live in Bengal and some in other states, they have all come here to see the Ratha-yātrā festival.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"keha gauḍe, keha deśāntare
> saba āsiyāche ratha-yātrā dekhibāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:g:gauḍe]]---some in Bengal; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---some; [[synonyms:d:deśa]]-[[synonyms:a:antare]]---in other states; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:āsiyāche]]---have come; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see the car festival of Lord Jagannātha.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Although some of them live in Bengal and some in other states, they have all come here to see the Ratha-yātrā festival.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.59
description: "At present they are all living here. Their residences are in various quarters. Here you will get the audience of them all."
text:
> ihāṅi rahena sabe, vāsā---nānā-sthāne
> ihāṅi pāibā tumi sabāra darśane"
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅi]]---here; [[synonyms:r:rahena]] [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them are living; [[synonyms:v:vāsā]]---their residential places; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---in various quarters; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅi]]---here; [[synonyms:p:pāibā]]---will get; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---everyone's audience.
translation: "At present they are all living here. Their residences are in various quarters. Here you will get the audience of them all."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.6
description: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seated Vallabha Bhaṭṭa near Him. Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very humbly began to speak.
text:
> mānya kari' prabhu tāre nikaṭe vasāilā
> vinaya kariyā bhaṭṭa kahite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mānya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great respect; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:nikaṭe]]---near; [[synonyms:v:vasāilā]]---seated; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great humility; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: With great respect, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu seated Vallabha Bhaṭṭa near Him. Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very humbly began to speak.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.60
description: Thereafter, with great submission and humility, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dine at his home.
text:
> tabe bhaṭṭa kahe bahu vinaya vacana
> bahu dainya kari' prabhure kaila nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---very; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---humble; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:d:dainya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---in all humility; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invited to dine.
translation: Thereafter, with great submission and humility, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa invited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu to dine at his home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.61
description: The next day, when all the Vaiṣṇavas came to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord introduced Vallabha Bhaṭṭa to them all.
text:
> āra dina saba vaiṣṇava prabhu-sthāne āilā
> sabā-sane mahāprabhu bhaṭṭe milāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---the next day; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:s:sabā]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with all of them; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭe]] [[synonyms:m:milāilā]]---introduced Vallabha Bhaṭṭa.
translation: The next day, when all the Vaiṣṇavas came to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the Lord introduced Vallabha Bhaṭṭa to them all.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.62
description: He was surprised to see the brilliance of their faces. Indeed, among them Vallabha Bhaṭṭa seemed just like a glowworm.
text:
> 'vaiṣṇave'ra teja dekhi' bhaṭṭera camatkāra
> tāṅ-sabāra āge bhaṭṭa---khadyota-ākāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇavera]]---of the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:t:teja]]---the brilliance; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---surprised; [[synonyms:t:tāṅ]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:k:khadyota]]-[[synonyms:ā:ākāra]]---like a glowworm.
translation: He was surprised to see the brilliance of their faces. Indeed, among them Vallabha Bhaṭṭa seemed just like a glowworm.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.63
description: Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought in a great quantity of Lord Jagannātha's mahā-prasāda and sumptuously fed Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates.
text:
> tabe bhaṭṭa bahu mahā-prasāda ānāila
> gaṇa-saha mahāprabhure bhojana karāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---much; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---Lord Jagannātha's remnants; [[synonyms:ā:ānāila]]---brought in; [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]] [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu with His associates; [[synonyms:b:bhojana]] [[synonyms:k:karāila]]---he fed.
translation: Then Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought in a great quantity of Lord Jagannātha's mahā-prasāda and sumptuously fed Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and His associates.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.64
description: All the sannyāsī associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu headed by Paramānanda Purī, sat on one side and thus partook of the prasāda.

> paramānanda purī-saṅge sannyāsīra gaṇa
> eka-dike vaise saba karite bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paramānanda]] [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīra]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //sannyāsī// associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dike]]---on one side; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---sat down; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---to accept the //prasāda.//
translation: All the sannyāsī associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu headed by Paramānanda Purī, sat on one side and thus partook of the prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.65
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat in the midst of the devotees. Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda each sat on one side of the Lord. The other devotees sat in front of the Lord and behind Him.
text:
> advaita, nityānanda-rāya---pārśve dui-jana
> madhye mahāprabhu vasilā, āge-pāche bhakta-gaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:p:pārśve]]---on the sides; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---two personalities; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---in the middle; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]] [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat down; [[synonyms:ā:āge]]---in front; [[synonyms:p:pāche]]---behind; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu sat in the midst of the devotees. Advaita Ācārya and Lord Nityānanda each sat on one side of the Lord. The other devotees sat in front of the Lord and behind Him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.66
description: The devotees from Bengal, whom I am unable to count, all sat down in lines in the courtyard.
text:
> gauḍera bhakta yata kahite nā pāri
> aṅgane vasilā saba hañā sāri sāri
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gauḍera]]---of Bengal; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]] [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:k:kahite]]---to mention; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---i am unable; [[synonyms:a:aṅgane]]---in the courtyard; [[synonyms:v:vasilā]]---sat down; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being; [[synonyms:s:sāri]] [[synonyms:s:sāri]]---in lines.
translation: The devotees from Bengal, whom I am unable to count, all sat down in lines in the courtyard.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.67
description: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was greatly surprised, but in devotion he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of each and every one of them.
text:
> prabhura bhakta-gaṇa dekhi' bhaṭṭera camatkāra
> pratyeke sabāra pade kaila namaskāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---surprise; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:e:eke]]---unto each and every one; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:namaskāra]]---he offered obeisances.
translation: When Vallabha Bhaṭṭa saw all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, he was greatly surprised, but in devotion he offered his obeisances at the lotus feet of each and every one of them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.68
description: Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara, along with Rāghava and Dāmodara Paṇḍita, took charge of distributing the prasāda.
text:
> svarūpa, jagadānanda, kāśīśvara, śaṅkara
> pariveśana kare, āra rāghava, dāmodara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]---Svarūpa; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]---Jagadānanda; [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:ś:śaṅkara]]---Śaṅkara; [[synonyms:p:pariveśana]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---distribute; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]] [[synonyms:d:dāmodara]]---Rāghava and Dāmodara.
translation: Svarūpa Dāmodara, Jagadānanda, Kāśīśvara and Śaṅkara, along with Rāghava and Dāmodara Paṇḍita, took charge of distributing the prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.69
description: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa had brought a large quantity of mahā-prasāda offered to Lord Jagannātha. Thus all the sannyāsīs sat down to eat with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> mahā-prasāda vallabha-bhaṭṭa bahu ānāila
> prabhu-saha sannyāsi-gaṇa bhojane vasila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---food offered to Śrī Jagannātha; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:b:bahu]]---a large quantity; [[synonyms:ā:ānāila]]---brought; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:saha]]---with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:b:bhojane]] [[synonyms:v:vasila]]---sat down to accept the //prasāda.//
translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa had brought a large quantity of mahā-prasāda offered to Lord Jagannātha. Thus all the sannyāsīs sat down to eat with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.7
description: "For a long time," he said, "I have desired to see You, my Lord. Now Lord Jagannātha has fulfilled this desire; therefore I am seeing You.
text:
> "bahu-dina manoratha tomā' dekhibāre
> jagannātha pūrṇa kailā, dekhiluṅ tomāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bahu]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---for a long time; [[synonyms:m:manoratha]]---my desire; [[synonyms:t:tomā']] [[synonyms:d:dekhibāre]]---to see You; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---has fulfilled; [[synonyms:d:dekhiluṅ]] [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---I have seen You.
translation: "For a long time," he said, "I have desired to see You, my Lord. Now Lord Jagannātha has fulfilled this desire; therefore I am seeing You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.70
description: Accepting the prasāda, all the Vaiṣṇavas chanted the holy names Hari, Hari. The rising vibration of the holy name of Hari filled the entire universe.
text:
> prasāda pāya vaiṣṇava-gaṇa bale, 'hari' 'hari'
> hari hari dhvani uṭhe saba brahmāṇḍa bhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---the //prasāda//; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---accept; [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇava]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:b:bale]]---chant; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]]---Hari, Hari; [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:h:hari]] [[synonyms:d:dhvani]]---the vibration of Hari, Hari; [[synonyms:u:uṭhe]]---rises; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:brahmāṇḍa]]---the entire universe; [[synonyms:b:bhari']]---filling.
translation: Accepting the prasāda, all the Vaiṣṇavas chanted the holy names Hari, Hari. The rising vibration of the holy name of Hari filled the entire universe.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.71
description: When all the Vaiṣṇavas had finished eating, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought a large quantity of garlands, sandalwood pulp, spices and betel. He worshiped them very respectfully and became extremely happy.
text:
> mālā, candana, guvāka, pāna aneka ānila
> sabā' pūjā kari' bhaṭṭa ānandita haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mālā]]---garlands; [[synonyms:c:candana]]---sandalwood pulp; [[synonyms:g:guvāka]]---spices; [[synonyms:p:pāna]]---betel; [[synonyms:a:aneka]]---much; [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---brought; [[synonyms:s:sabā']] [[synonyms:p:pūjā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---worshiping all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:ā:ānandita]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became very happy.
translation: When all the Vaiṣṇavas had finished eating, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa brought a large quantity of garlands, sandalwood pulp, spices and betel. He worshiped them very respectfully and became extremely happy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.72
description: On the day of the car festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began the congregational chanting. As He had done previously, He divided all the devotees into seven groups.
text:
> ratha-yātrā-dine prabhu kīrtana ārambhilā
> pūrvavat sāta sampradāya pṛthak karilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---on the day of the car festival; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kīrtana]] [[synonyms:ā:ārambhilā]]---began the congregational chanting; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:s:sampradāya]]---in seven groups; [[synonyms:p:pṛthak]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---He divided.
translation: On the day of the car festival, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu began the congregational chanting. As He had done previously, He divided all the devotees into seven groups.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.73-74
description: Seven devotees-Advaita, Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Vakreśvara, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Gadādhara Paṇḍita-formed seven groups and began dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chanting "Hari bol," wandered from one group to another.
text:
> advaita, nityānanda, haridāsa, vakreśvara
> śrīvāsa, rāghava, paṇḍita-gadādhara
> sāta jana sāta-ṭhāñi karena nartana
> 'hari-bola' bali' prabhu karena bhramaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:h:haridāsa]]---Ṭhākura Haridāsa; [[synonyms:v:vakreśvara]]---Vakreśvara; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]---Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:r:rāghava]]---Rāghava; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gadādhara]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:s:sāta]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---seven persons; [[synonyms:s:sāta]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---in seven groups; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:n:nartana]]---dance; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:b:bola]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---uttering "Hari bol"; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:b:bhramaṇa]]---wanders.
translation: Seven devotees-Advaita, Nityānanda, Haridāsa Ṭhākura, Vakreśvara, Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura, Rāghava Paṇḍita and Gadādhara Paṇḍita-formed seven groups and began dancing. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, chanting "Hari bol," wandered from one group to another.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.75
description: Fourteen mṛdaṅgas resounded with the loud congregational chanting, and in each group was a dancer whose dance of ecstatic love inundated the entire world.
text:
> caudda mādala bāje ucca saṅkīrtana
> eka eka nartakera preme bhāsila bhuvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caudda]] [[synonyms:m:mādala]]---fourteen //mṛdaṅgas//; [[synonyms:b:bāje]]---were being played; [[synonyms:u:ucca]] [[synonyms:s:saṅkīrtana]]---loud congregational chanting; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:e:eka]]---of each group; [[synonyms:n:nartakera]]---of the dancer; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:b:bhāsila]] [[synonyms:b:bhuvana]]---inundated the entire world.
translation: Fourteen mṛdaṅgas resounded with the loud congregational chanting, and in each group was a dancer whose dance of ecstatic love inundated the entire world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.76
description: Seeing all this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was completely astonished. He was overwhelmed by transcendental bliss and lost himself.
text:
> dekhi' vallabha-bhaṭṭera haila camatkāra
> ānande vihvala nāhi āpana-sāmbhāla
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:v:vallabha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---was astonishment; [[synonyms:ā:ānande]] [[synonyms:v:vihvala]]---overwhelmed by transcendental happiness; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there was not; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:s:sāmbhāla]]---keeping his normal position.
translation: Seeing all this, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was completely astonished. He was overwhelmed by transcendental bliss and lost himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.77
description: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the dancing of the others, and as He had done previously, He personally began to dance.
text:
> tabe mahāprabhu sabāra nṛtya rākhilā
> pūrvavat āpane nṛtya karite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of them; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---stopped the dancing; [[synonyms:p:pūrvavat]]---as previously; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:n:nṛtya]]---dancing; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to perform.
translation: Then Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stopped the dancing of the others, and as He had done previously, He personally began to dance.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.78
description: Seeing the beauty of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the awakening of His ecstatic love, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa concluded, "Here is Lord Kṛṣṇa, without a doubt."
text:
> prabhura saundarya dekhi āra premodaya
> 'ei ta' sākṣāt kṛṣṇa' bhaṭṭera ha-ila niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saundarya]]---the beauty; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---seeing; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:u:udaya]]---arousing of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]---directly; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---was; [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---certainty.
translation: Seeing the beauty of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and the awakening of His ecstatic love, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa concluded, "Here is Lord Kṛṣṇa, without a doubt."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.79
description: Thus Vallabha Bhaṭṭa witnessed the car festival. He was simply astonished by the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> eta mata ratha-yātrā sakale dekhila
> prabhura caritre bhaṭṭera camatkāra haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:ratha]]-[[synonyms:y:yātrā]]---the car festival; [[synonyms:s:sakale]]---all; [[synonyms:d:dekhila]]---saw; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caritre]]---by the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was astonishment.
translation: Thus Vallabha Bhaṭṭa witnessed the car festival. He was simply astonished by the characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.8
description: "One who receives Your audience is fortunate indeed, for You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.
text:
> tomāra darśana ye pāya sei bhāgyavān
> tomāke dekhiye,---yena sākṣāt bhagavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:d:darśana]]---Your audience; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---anyone who gets; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---very fortunate; [[synonyms:t:tomāke]] [[synonyms:d:dekhiye]]---I see You; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]] [[synonyms:b:bhagavān]]---directly the Supreme Personality of Godhead.
translation: "One who receives Your audience is fortunate indeed, for You are the Supreme Personality of Godhead Himself.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.80
description: One day, after the festival was over, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted a request at the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> yātrānantare bhaṭṭa yāi mahāprabhu-sthāne
> prabhu-caraṇe kichu kaila nivedane
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yātrā]]-[[synonyms:a:anantare]]---after the Ratha-yātrā; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:y:yāi]]---going; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of the Lord; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---made; [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---submission.
translation: One day, after the festival was over, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted a request at the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.81
description: "I have written some commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said. "Would Your Lordship kindly hear it?"
text:
> "bhāgavatera ṭīkā kichu kariyāchi likhana
> āpane mahāprabhu yadi karena śravaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhāgavatera]]---on //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭīkā]]---commentary; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kariyāchi]] [[synonyms:l:likhana]]---I have written; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---You; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---would hear.
translation: "I have written some commentary on Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam," he said. "Would Your Lordship kindly hear it?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.82
description: The Lord replied, "I do not understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Indeed, I am not a suitable person to hear its meaning.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"bhāgavatārtha bujhite nā pāri
> bhāgavatārtha śunite āmi nahi adhikārī
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the meaning of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I cannot understand; [[synonyms:b:bhāgavata]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]---the purport of //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam//; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---to hear; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:n:nahi]] [[synonyms:a:adhikārī]]---I am not the proper person.
translation: The Lord replied, "I do not understand the meaning of Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. Indeed, I am not a suitable person to hear its meaning.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.83
description: "I simply sit and try to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and although I chant all day and night, I nevertheless cannot complete the chanting of my prescribed number of rounds."
text:
> vasi' kṛṣṇa-nāma mātra kariye grahaṇe
> saṅkhyā-nāma pūrṇa mora nahe rātri-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---sitting; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---simply; [[synonyms:k:kariye]] [[synonyms:g:grahaṇe]]---I chant; [[synonyms:s:saṅkhyā]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---a fixed number of rounds; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]---complete; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---throughout the entire day and night.
translation: "I simply sit and try to chant the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and although I chant all day and night, I nevertheless cannot complete the chanting of my prescribed number of rounds."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.84
description: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have tried to describe elaborately the meaning of Kṛṣṇa's holy name. Kindly hear the explanation."
text:
> bhaṭṭa kahe, "kṛṣṇa-nāmera artha-vyākhyāne
> vistāra kairāchi, tāhā karaha śravaṇe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmera]]---of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:a:artha]]-[[synonyms:v:vyākhyāne]]---description of the meaning; [[synonyms:v:vistāra]]---very elaborately; [[synonyms:k:kairāchi]]---I have made; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---kindly hear.
translation: Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have tried to describe elaborately the meaning of Kṛṣṇa's holy name. Kindly hear the explanation."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.85
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not accept many different meanings for the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I know only that Lord Kṛṣṇa is Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. That's all I know.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"kṛṣṇa-nāmera bahu artha nā māni
> "śyāma-sundara' 'yaśodā-nandana,'---ei-mātra jāni
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmera]]---of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---many meanings; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:m:māni]]---I do not accept; [[synonyms:ś:śyāma]]-[[synonyms:s:sundara]]---//Śyāmasundara//; [[synonyms:y:yaśodā]]-[[synonyms:n:nandana]]---Yaśodānandana; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only this; [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---I know.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "I do not accept many different meanings for the holy name of Kṛṣṇa. I know only that Lord Kṛṣṇa is Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. That's all I know.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.86
description: "The only purport of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is that He is dark blue like a tamāla tree and is the son of mother Yaśodā. This is the conclusion of all the revealed scriptures.'
text:
> tamāla-śyāmala-tviṣi
> śrī-yaśodā-stanandhaye
> kṛṣṇa-nāmno rūḍhir iti
> sarva-śāstra-vinirṇayaḥ
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tamāla]]-[[synonyms:ś:śyāmala]]-[[synonyms:t:tviṣi]]---whose complexion is dark blue, resembling a //tamāla// tree; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:y:yaśodā]]-[[synonyms:s:stanam]]-[[synonyms:d:dhaye]]---sucking the breast of mother Yaśodā; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāmnaḥ]]---of the name Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:r:rūḍhiḥ]]---the chief meaning; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:ś:śāstra]]---of all revealed scriptures; [[synonyms:v:vinirṇayaḥ]]---the conclusion.
translation: "The only purport of the holy name of Kṛṣṇa is that He is dark blue like a tamāla tree and is the son of mother Yaśodā. This is the conclusion of all the revealed scriptures.'
purport: This is a verse from the //Nāma-kaumuḍī//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.87
description: "I conclusively know these two names, Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. I do not understand any other meanings, nor have I the capacity to understand them."
text:
> ei artha āmi mātra jāniye nirdhāra
> āra sarva-arthe mora nāhi adhikāra"
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---this meaning; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:j:jāniye]]---know; [[synonyms:n:nirdhāra]]---conclusion; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---other; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---all; [[synonyms:a:arthe]]---meanings; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---is not; [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---capacity to understand.
translation: "I conclusively know these two names, Śyāmasundara and Yaśodānandana. I do not understand any other meanings, nor have I the capacity to understand them."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.88
description: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is omniscient. Therefore He could understand that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations of Kṛṣṇa's name and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam were useless. Therefore He did not care about them.
text:
> phalgu-prāya bhaṭṭera nāmādi saba-vyākhyā
> sarvajña prabhu jāni' tāre karena upekṣā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:phalgu]]-[[synonyms:p:prāya]]---generally useless; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]]---of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:n:nāma]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---the holy name and so on; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vyākhyā]]---explanations; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:j:jña]]---omniscient; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jāni']]---knowing; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:u:upekṣā]]---neglects.
translation: Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is omniscient. Therefore He could understand that Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations of Kṛṣṇa's name and Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam were useless. Therefore He did not care about them.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.89
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rigidly declined to hear his explanations, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went home feeling morose. His faith and devotion to the Lord changed.
text:
> vimanā hañā bhaṭṭa gelā nija-ghara
> prabhu-viṣaye bhakti kichu ha-ila antara
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:vimanā]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---feeling morose; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to his home; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaye]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---devotion; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---somewhat; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---became; [[synonyms:a:antara]]---different.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu rigidly declined to hear his explanations, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went home feeling morose. His faith and devotion to the Lord changed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.9
description: "Since one who remembers You is purified, why should it be astonishing that one becomes purified by seeing You?
text:
> tomāre ye smaraṇa kare, se haya pavitra
> darśane pavitra habe,---ithe ki vicitra?
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---You; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---remembers; [[synonyms:s:se]]---he; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---becomes; [[synonyms:p:pavitra]]---purified; [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---by seeing; [[synonyms:p:pavitra]]---purified; [[synonyms:h:habe]]---will be; [[synonyms:i:ithe]]---in this; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:v:vicitra]]---what astonishment.
translation: "Since one who remembers You is purified, why should it be astonishing that one becomes purified by seeing You?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.90
description: Thereafter, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the home of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. He kept coming and going, showing affection in various ways, and thus maintained a relationship with him.
text:
> tabe bhaṭṭa gelā paṇḍita-gosāñira ṭhāñi
> nānā mate prīti kari' kare āsā-yāi
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]] [[synonyms:t:thāñi]]---to Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:m:mate]]---in various ways; [[synonyms:p:prīti]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---showing affection; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ā:āsā]]-[[synonyms:y:yāi]]---comes and goes.
translation: Thereafter, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to the home of Gadādhara Paṇḍita. He kept coming and going, showing affection in various ways, and thus maintained a relationship with him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.91
description: Because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously, none of the people in Jagannātha Purī would hear any of his explanations.
text:
> prabhura upekṣāya saba nīlācalera jana
> bhaṭṭera vyākhyāna kichu nā kare śravaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:upekṣāya]]---because of neglect; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:n:nīlācalera]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---people in Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭera]] [[synonyms:v:vyākhyāna]]---explanation of Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---do not hear.
translation: Because Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously, none of the people in Jagannātha Purī would hear any of his explanations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.92
description: Ashamed, insulted and unhappy, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Gadādhara Paṇḍita.
text:
> lajjita haila bhaṭṭa, haila apamāne
> duḥkhita hañā gela paṇḍitera sthāne
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:lajjita]]---ashamed; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:a:apamāne]]---felt insulted; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhita]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being unhappy; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---went; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]] [[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to Gadādhara Paṇḍita.
translation: Ashamed, insulted and unhappy, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa went to Gadādhara Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.93
description: Approaching him with great humiIity, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have taken shelter of you, my dear sir. Kindly be merciful to me and save my life.
text:
> dainya kari' kahe,---"niluṅ tomāra śaraṇa
> tumi kṛpā kari' rākha āmāra jīvana
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dainya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great humility; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:n:niluṅ]]---I have taken; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:ś:śaraṇa]]---shelter of you; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---being merciful; [[synonyms:r:rākha]]---keep; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:j:jīvana]]---my life.
translation: Approaching him with great humiIity, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa said, "I have taken shelter of you, my dear sir. Kindly be merciful to me and save my life.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.94
description: "Please hear my explanation of the meaning of Lord Kṛṣṇa's name. In that way the mud of the shame that has come upon me will be washed off."
text:
> kṛṣṇa-nāma-vyākhyā yadi karaha śravaṇa
> tabe mora lajjā-paṅka haya prakṣālana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---of the name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vyākhyā]]---explanation; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---you hear; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:l:lajjā]]-[[synonyms:p:paṅka]]---the mud of shame; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:p:prakṣālana]]---washing.
translation: "Please hear my explanation of the meaning of Lord Kṛṣṇa's name. In that way the mud of the shame that has come upon me will be washed off."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.95
description: Thus Paṇḍita Gosāñi fell into a dilemma. Be was in such doubt that he could not decide alone what to do.
text:
> saṅkaṭe paḍila paṇḍita, karaye saṁśaya
> ki karibena,---eko, karite nā pāre niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:saṅkaṭe]]---into a dilemma; [[synonyms:p:paḍila]] [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Paṇḍita Gosāñi fell; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:s:saṁśaya]]---felt doubts; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:karibena]]---what he will do; [[synonyms:e:eko]]---alone; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]] [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---cannot make a decision.
translation: Thus Paṇḍita Gosāñi fell into a dilemma. Be was in such doubt that he could not decide alone what to do.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not take Vallabha Bhaṭṭa very seriously. Therefore Paṇḍita Gosāñi, or Gadādhara Gosāñi, fell into perplexity. What would be his position if he heard Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanation of Śrī Kṛṣṇa's name? Certainly Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would be displeased. Therefore Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi could not make a decision.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.96
description: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi did not want to hear it, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa began to read his explanation with great force.
text:
> yadyapi paṇḍita āra nā kailā aṅgīkāra
> bhaṭṭa yāi' tabu paḍe kari' balātkāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---also; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---did not accept; [[synonyms:b:bhaṭṭa]]---Vallabha Bhaṭṭa; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:p:paḍe]]---reads; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:b:balātkāra]]---forcibly.
translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi did not want to hear it, Vallabha Bhaṭṭa began to read his explanation with great force.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.97
description: Because Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was a learned brāhmaṇa, Gadādhara Paṇḍita could not forbid him. Thus he began to think of Lord Kṛṣṇa. "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa," he requested, "please protect me in this danger. I have taken shelter of You.
text:
> ābhijātye paṇḍita karite nāre niṣedhana
> "e saṅkaṭe rākha, kṛṣṇa la-ilāṅa śaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ābhijātye]]---because of his aristocracy; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:k:karite]] [[synonyms:n:nāre]] [[synonyms:n:niṣedhana]]---could not forbid; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saṅkaṭe]]---in this danger; [[synonyms:r:rākha]]---please protect; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---O Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ilāṅa]]---I have taken; [[synonyms:ś:śaraṇa]]---shelter.
translation: Because Vallabha Bhaṭṭa was a learned brāhmaṇa, Gadādhara Paṇḍita could not forbid him. Thus he began to think of Lord Kṛṣṇa. "My dear Lord Kṛṣṇa," he requested, "please protect me in this danger. I have taken shelter of You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.98
description: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is present in everyone's heart, and He will certainly know my mind. Therefore I do not fear Him. His associates, however, are extremely critical."
text:
> antaryāmī prabhu jānibena mora mana
> tāṅre bhaya nāhi kichu, 'viṣama' tāṅra gaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:antaryāmī]]---existing in everyone's heart; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:j:jānibena]]---will know; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---my mind; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---of Him; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---fear; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:v:viṣama]]---very critical; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---his associates.
translation: "Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is present in everyone's heart, and He will certainly know my mind. Therefore I do not fear Him. His associates, however, are extremely critical."
purport: As the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu exists in everyone's heart. Therefore He would know the circumstances under which Paṇḍita Gosāñi agreed to hear Vallabha Bhaṭṭa's explanations, and certainly He would not be angry. However, the Vaiṣṇavas who were always with Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu might not understand Gadādhara Paṇḍita's inner consciousness, and they might accuse him of having compromised with Vallabha Bhaṭṭa, despite his having been neglected by Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was seriously thinking in this way.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 7.99
description: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was not in the least at fault, some of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees showed affectionate anger toward him.
text:
> yadyapi vicāre paṇḍitera nāhi kichu doṣa
> tathāpi prabhura gaṇa tāṅre kare praṇaya-roṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:v:vicāre]]---conclusively; [[synonyms:p:paṇḍitera]]---of Gadādhara Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---there was no fault; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---associates of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]-[[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---showed affectionate anger.
translation: Although Gadādhara Paṇḍita Gosāñi was not in the least at fault, some of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's devotees showed affectionate anger toward him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.1
description: Let me offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who reduced His eating due to fear of the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī.
text:
> taṁ vande kṛṣṇa-caitanyaṁ
> rāmacandra-purī-bhayāt
> laukikāhārataḥ svaṁ yo
> bhikṣānnaṁ samakocayat
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tam]]---to Him; [[synonyms:v:vande]]---I offer my respectful obeisances; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanyam]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:b:bhayāt]]---due to fear of Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:l:laukika]]---ordinary; [[synonyms:ā:āhārataḥ]]---from eating; [[synonyms:s:svam]]---His own; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---who; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]-[[synonyms:a:annam]]---quantity of food; [[synonyms:s:samakocayat]]---reduced.
translation: Let me offer my respectful obeisances to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who reduced His eating due to fear of the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.10
description: The three of them talked about Kṛṣṇa for some time, and then Jagadānanda came and extended an invitation to Rāmacandra Purī.
text:
> tina-jane iṣṭha-goṣṭhī kailā kata-kṣaṇa
> jagadānanda-paṇḍita tāṅre kailā nimantraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tina]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---three persons; [[synonyms:i:iṣṭha]]-[[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---discussion on Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---performed; [[synonyms:k:kata]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for some time; [[synonyms:j:jagadānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇḍita]]---Jagadānanda Paṇḍita; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invited.
translation: The three of them talked about Kṛṣṇa for some time, and then Jagadānanda came and extended an invitation to Rāmacandra Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.100
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not consider the offenses of Rāmacandra Purī, for the Lord considered him His spiritual master. However, his character instructed everyone about the result of offending the spiritual master.
text:
> yadyapi guru-buddhye prabhu tāra doṣa nā la-ila
> tāra phala-dvārā loke śikṣā karāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadyapi]]---although; [[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhye]]---due to considering him a spiritual master; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---offense; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---did not accept; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:d:dvārā]]---by; [[synonyms:l:loke]]---the general populace; [[synonyms:ś:śikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karāila]]---He instructed.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu did not consider the offenses of Rāmacandra Purī, for the Lord considered him His spiritual master. However, his character instructed everyone about the result of offending the spiritual master.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.101
description: The character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is full of nectar. Hearing about it is pleasing to the ear and mind.
text:
> caitanya-caritra---yena amṛtera pūra
> śunite śravaṇe mane lāgaye madhura
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as if; [[synonyms:a:amṛtera]] [[synonyms:p:pūra]]---filled with nectar; [[synonyms:ś:śunite]]---hearing; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇe]]---to the ear; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---to the mind; [[synonyms:l:lāgaye]]---feels; [[synonyms:m:madhura]]---pleasing.
translation: The character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu is full of nectar. Hearing about it is pleasing to the ear and mind.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.102
description: I write about the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O readers, please hear with attention, for thus you will easily receive ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> caitanya-caritra likhi, śuna eka-mane
> anāyāse pābe prema śrī-kṛṣṇa-caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:l:likhi]]---I write; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---please hear; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:m:mane]]---with attention; [[synonyms:a:anāyāse]]---easily; [[synonyms:p:pābe]]---you will get; [[synonyms:p:prema]]---ecstatic love; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.
translation: I write about the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. O readers, please hear with attention, for thus you will easily receive ecstatic love for the lotus feet of Lord Śrī Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.103
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha-pade yāra āśa
> caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Eighth Chapter, describing how the Lord reduced His eating in fear of the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.11
description: A large quantity of the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha was brought in for distribution. Rāmacandra Purī ate sumptuously, and then he wanted to find faults in Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.
text:
> jagannāthera prasāda ānilā bhikṣāra lāgiyā
> yatheṣṭa bhikṣā karilā teṅho nindāra lāgiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]] [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---remnants of the food of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---brought; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---for feeding; [[synonyms:y:yatheṣṭa]] [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---ate sumptuously; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:n:nindāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---to find some fault.
translation: A large quantity of the remnants of food from Lord Jagannātha was brought in for distribution. Rāmacandra Purī ate sumptuously, and then he wanted to find faults in Jagadānanda Paṇḍita.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.12
description: After finishing the meal, Rāmacandra Purī requested, "My dear Jagadānanda, please listen. You eat the food that is left."
text:
> bhikṣā kari' kahe purī,---"śuna, jagadānanda
> avaśeṣa prasāda tumi karaha bhakṣaṇa"

translation: After finishing the meal, Rāmacandra Purī requested, "My dear Jagadānanda, please listen. You eat the food that is left."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.13
description: With great eagerness Rāmacandra Purī seated Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and personally served him prasāda.
text:

translation: With great eagerness Rāmacandra Purī seated Jagadānanda Paṇḍita and personally served him prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.14
description: Encouraging him again and again, Rāmacandra Purī fed him sumptuously, but when Jagadānanda had washed his hands and mouth, Rāmacandra Purī began criticizing him.
text:
> āgraha kariyā punaḥ punaḥ khāoyāila

translation: Encouraging him again and again, Rāmacandra Purī fed him sumptuously, but when Jagadānanda had washed his hands and mouth, Rāmacandra Purī began criticizing him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.15
description: "I have heard," he said, "that the followers of Caitanya Mahāprabhu eat more than necessary. Now I have directly seen that this is true.
text:

> 'satya' sei vākya,---sākṣāt dekhiluṅ ekhana

translation: "I have heard," he said, "that the followers of Caitanya Mahāprabhu eat more than necessary. Now I have directly seen that this is true.

description: "Feeding a sannyāsī too much breaks his regulative principles, for when a sannyāsī eats too much, his renunciation is destroyed."
text:
> sannyāsīre eta khāoyāñā kare dharma nāśa

translation: "Feeding a sannyāsī too much breaks his regulative principles, for when a sannyāsī eats too much, his renunciation is destroyed."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.17
description: The characteristic of Rāmacandra Purī was that first he would induce someone to eat more than necessary and then he would criticize him.

translation: The characteristic of Rāmacandra Purī was that first he would induce someone to eat more than necessary and then he would criticize him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.18

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.19
description: Mādhavendra Purī was chanting the holy name of Kṛṣṇa, and sometimes he would cry, "O my Lord, I did not get shelter at Mathurā."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.2

translation: All glories to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the incarnation of the ocean of mercy. His lotus feet are worshiped by demigods like Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva.

translation: Then Rāmacandra Purī was so foolish that he fearlessly dared to instruct his spiritual master.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.21
description: "If you are in full transcendental bliss," he said, "you should now remember only Brahman. Why are you crying?"
text:
> "tumi---pūrṇa-brahmānanda, karaha smaraṇa
> brahmavit hañā kene karaha rodana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:p:pūrṇa]]-[[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---full in transcendental bliss; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---you should remember; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:v:vit]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being fully aware of Brahman; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:karaha]] [[synonyms:r:rodana]]---are you crying.
translation: "If you are in full transcendental bliss," he said, "you should now remember only Brahman. Why are you crying?"
purport: As stated in //Bhagavad-gītā, brahma-bhūtaḥ prasannātmā:// a Brahman realized person is always happy. //Na śocati na kāṅkṣati:// he neither laments nor aspires for anything. Not knowing why Mādhavendra Purī was crying, Rāmacandra Purī tried to become his advisor. Thus he committed a great offense, for a disciple should never try to instruct his spiritual master.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.22
description: Hearing this instruction, Mādhavendra Purī, greatly angry, rebuked him by saying, "Get out, you sinful rascal!
text:
> śuni' mādhavendra-mane krodha upajila
> 'dūra, dūra, pāpiṣṭha' bali' bhartsanā karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mādhavendra]]---of Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---anger; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---arose; [[synonyms:d:dūra]] [[synonyms:d:dūra]]---get out; [[synonyms:p:pāpiṣṭha]]---you sinful rascal; [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying; [[synonyms:b:bhartsanā]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---he chastised.
translation: Hearing this instruction, Mādhavendra Purī, greatly angry, rebuked him by saying, "Get out, you sinful rascal!
purport: Rāmacandra Purī could not understand that his spiritual master, Mādhavendra Purī, was feeling transcendental separation. His lamentation was not material. Rather, it proceeded from the highest stage of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa. When he was crying in separation, "I could not achieve Kṛṣṇa! I could not reach Mathurā!" this was not ordinary material lamentation. Rāmacandra Purī was not sufficiently expert to understand the feelings of Mādhavendra Purī, but nevertheless he thought himself very advanced. Therefore, regarding Mādhavendra Purī's expressions as ordinary material lamentation, he advised him to remember Brahman because he was latently an impersonalist. Mādhavendra Purī understood Rāmacandra Purī's position as a great fool and therefore immediately rebuked him. Such a reprimand from the spiritual master is certainly for the betterment of the disciple.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.23
description: "O my Lord Kṛṣṇa, I could not reach You, nor could I reach Your abode, Mathurā. I am dying in my unhappiness, and now this rascal has come to give me more pain.
text:

> āpana-duḥkhe maroṅ---ei dite āila jvālā

translation: "O my Lord Kṛṣṇa, I could not reach You, nor could I reach Your abode, Mathurā. I am dying in my unhappiness, and now this rascal has come to give me more pain.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.25
