text:
> kṛṣṇa nā pāinu muñi maroṅ āpanāra duḥkhe
> more 'brahma' upadeśe ei chāra mūrkhe"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]---Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāinu]]---could not get; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:m:maroṅ]]---I die; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]] [[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---in my own unhappiness; [[synonyms:m:more]]---to me; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]---Brahman; [[synonyms:u:upadeśe]]---instructs; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---condemned; [[synonyms:m:mūrkhe]]---fool.
translation: "I am dying without achieving the shelter of Kṛṣṇa, and therefore I am greatly unhappy. Now this condemned foolish rascal has come to instruct me about Brahman."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.26
description: Rāmacandra Purī was thus denounced by Mādhavendra Purī. Due to his offense, gradually material desire appeared within him.
text:
> ei ye śrī-mādhavendra śrī-pāda upekṣā karila
> sei aparādhe iṅhāra 'vāsanā, janmila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---that; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:m:mādhavendra]] [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]---His Lordship Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:u:upekṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---neglected or denounced; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:a:aparādhe]]---because of the offense; [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]]---of Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:v:vāsanā]]---material desire; [[synonyms:j:janmila]]---arose.
translation: Rāmacandra Purī was thus denounced by Mādhavendra Purī. Due to his offense, gradually material desire appeared within him.
purport:
The word //vāsanā// ("material desires") refers to dry speculative knowledge. Such speculative knowledge is only material. As confirmed in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.14.4), a person without devotional service who simply wants to know things //(kevala-bodha-labdhaye//) gains only dry speculative knowledge but no spiritual profit. This is also confirmed in the //Bhakti-sandarbha// (111), wherein it is said:

> jīvan-muktā api punar
> yānti saṁsāra-vāsanām
> yady acintya-mahā-śaktau
> bhagavaty aparādhinaḥ

"Even though one is liberated in this life, if one offends the Supreme Personality of Godhead he falls down in the midst of material desires, of which dry speculation about spiritual realization is one."

In his //Laghu-toṣaṇī// commentary on //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:10:2:32|(10.2.32)]], Jīva Gosvāmī says;

> jīvan-muktā api punar
> bandhanaṁ yānti karmabhiḥ
> yady acintya-mahā-śaktau
> bhagavaty aparādhinaḥ

"Even if one is liberated in this life, he becomes addicted to material desires because of offenses to the Supreme Personality of Godhead."

A similar quotation from one of the //Purāṇas// also appears in the //Viṣṇu-bhakti-candrodaya://

> jīvan-muktāḥ prapadyante
> kvacit saṁsāra-vāsanām
> yogino na vilipyante
> karmabhir bhagavat-parāḥ

"Even liberated souls sometimes fall down to material desires, but those who fully engaged in devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead are not affected by such desires."

These are references from authoritative revealed scriptures. If one becomes an offender to his spiritual master or the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he falls down to the material platform to merely speculate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.27
description: One who is attached to dry speculative knowledge has no relationship with Kṛṣṇa. His occupation is criticizing Vaiṣṇavas. Thus he is situated in criticism.
text:
> śuṣka-brahma-jñānī, nāhi kṛṣṇera 'sambandha'
> sarva loka nindā kare, nindāte nirbandha
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]---dry; [[synonyms:b:brahma]]-[[synonyms:j:jñānī]]---impersonalist philosopher; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]]---with Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sambandha]]---relationship; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]---all; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---persons; [[synonyms:n:nindā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---criticizes; [[synonyms:n:nindāte]] [[synonyms:n:nirbandha]]---fixed in blaspheming.
translation: One who is attached to dry speculative knowledge has no relationship with Kṛṣṇa. His occupation is criticizing Vaiṣṇavas. Thus he is situated in criticism.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura has explained in his //Anubhāṣya// that the word //nirbandha// indicates that Rāmacandra Purī had a steady desire to criticize others. Impersonalist Māyāvādīs who have no relationship with Kṛṣṇa, who cannot take to devotional service and who simply engage in material arguments to understand Brahman regard devotional service to Kṛṣṇa as //karma-kāṇḍa,// or fruitive activities. According to them, devotional service to Kṛṣṇa is but another means for attaining //dharma, artha, kāma// and //mokṣa.// Therefore they criticize the devotees for engaging in material activities. They think that devotional service is //māyā// and that Kṛṣṇa or Viṣṇu is also //māyā.// Therefore they are called Māyāvādīs. Such a mentality awakens in a person who is an offender to Kṛṣṇa and His devotees.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.28
description: Īśvara Purī, the spiritual master of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, performed service to Mādhavendra Purī, cleaning up his stool and urine with his own hand.
text:
> īśvara-purī gosāñi kare śrī-pāda-sevana
> svahaste karena mala-mūtrādi mārjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Īśvara Purī; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:pāda]]-[[synonyms:s:sevana]]---service to Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:h:haste]]---with his own hand; [[synonyms:k:karena]]---performs; [[synonyms:m:mala]]-[[synonyms:m:mūtra]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---stool, urine, and so on; [[synonyms:m:mārjana]]---cleaning.
translation: Īśvara Purī, the spiritual master of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, performed service to Mādhavendra Purī, cleaning up his stool and urine with his own hand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.29
description: Īśvara Purī was always chanting the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa for Mādhavendra Purī to hear. In this way he helped Mādhavendra Purī remember the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa at the time of death.
text:
> nirantara kṛṣṇa-nāma karāya smaraṇa
> kṛṣṇa-nāma, kṛṣṇa-līlā śunāya anukṣaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nirantara]]---always; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the name of Lord Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:karāya]] [[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]---was reminding; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:n:nāma]]---the holy name of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:l:līlā]]---pastimes of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:ś:śunāya]] [[synonyms:a:anukṣaṇa]]---was always causing to hear.
translation: Īśvara Purī was always chanting the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa for Mādhavendra Purī to hear. In this way he helped Mādhavendra Purī remember the holy name and pastimes of Lord Kṛṣṇa at the time of death.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.3
description: All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, the greatest of mendicants, who bound the entire world with a knot of ecstatic love for God.
text:
> jaya jaya avadhūta-candra nityānanda
> jagat bāṅdhila yeṅha diyā prema-phāṅda
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:avadhūta]]-[[synonyms:c:candra]]---to the moon of mendicants; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]---the world; [[synonyms:b:bāṅdhila]]---bound; [[synonyms:y:yeṅha]]---who; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---by; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:p:phāṅda]]---the noose of ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: All glories to Nityānanda Prabhu, the greatest of mendicants, who bound the entire world with a knot of ecstatic love for God.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.30
description: Pleased with Īśvara Purī, Mādhavendra Purī embraced him and gave him the benediction that he would be a great devotee and lover of Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> tuṣṭa hañā purī tāṅre kailā āliṅgana
> vara dilā---'kṛṣṇe tomāra ha-uka prema-dhana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tuṣṭa]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being pleased; [[synonyms:p:purī]]---Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embraced; [[synonyms:v:vara]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---gave the benediction; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇe]]---unto Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:u:uka]]---let there be; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the wealth of love.
translation: Pleased with Īśvara Purī, Mādhavendra Purī embraced him and gave him the benediction that he would be a great devotee and lover of Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.31
description: Thus Īśvara Purī became like an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, whereas Rāmacandra Purī became a dry speculator and a critic of everyone else.
text:
> sei haite īśvara-purī---'premera sāgara'
> rāmacandra-purī haila sarva-nindākara
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from that; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Īśvara Purī; [[synonyms:p:premera]] [[synonyms:s:sāgara]]---the ocean of ecstatic love; [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:n:nindākara]]---critic of all others.
translation: Thus Īśvara Purī became like an ocean of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa, whereas Rāmacandra Purī became a dry speculator and a critic of everyone else.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.32
description: Īśvara Purī received the blessing of Mādhavendra Purī, whereas Rāmacandra Purī received a rebuke from him. Therefore these two persons, Īśvara Purī and Rāmacandra Purī, are examples of the objects of a great personality's benediction and punishment. Mādhavendra Purī instructed the entire world by presenting these two examples.
text:
> mahad-anugraha-nigrahera 'sākṣī' dui-jane
> ei dui-dvāre śikhāilā jaga-jane
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahat]]---of an exalted personality; [[synonyms:a:anugraha]]---of the blessing; [[synonyms:n:nigrahera]]---of chastisement; [[synonyms:s:sākṣī]]---giving evidence; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---two persons; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]]---by these two; [[synonyms:ś:śikhāilā]]---instructed; [[synonyms:j:jaga]]-[[synonyms:j:jane]]---the people of the world.
translation: Īśvara Purī received the blessing of Mādhavendra Purī, whereas Rāmacandra Purī received a rebuke from him. Therefore these two persons, Īśvara Purī and Rāmacandra Purī, are examples of the objects of a great personality's benediction and punishment. Mādhavendra Purī instructed the entire world by presenting these two examples.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.33
description: His Divine Grace Mādhavendra Purī, the spiritual master of the entire world, thus distributed ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. While passing away from the material world, he chanted the following verse.
text:
> jagad-guru mādhavendra kari' prema dāna
> ei śloka paḍi' teṅho kaila antardhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:g:guru]]---the spiritual master of the entire world; [[synonyms:m:mādhavendra]]---Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:p:prema]] [[synonyms:d:dāna]]---giving ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa as charity; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloka]] [[synonyms:p:paḍi']]---reciting this verse; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:a:antardhāna]]---passed away from this material world.
translation: His Divine Grace Mādhavendra Purī, the spiritual master of the entire world, thus distributed ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. While passing away from the material world, he chanted the following verse.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.34
description: "O my Lord! O most merciful master! O master of Mathurā! When shall I see You again? Because of my not seeing You, my agitated heart has become unsteady. O most beloved one, what shall I do now?"
text:
> ayi dīna-dayārdra nātha he
> mathurā-nātha kadāvalokyase
> hṛdayaṁ tvad-aloka-kātaraṁ
> dayita bhrāmyati kiṁ karomy aham
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ayi]]---O my Lord; [[synonyms:d:dīna]]---on the poor; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:ā:ārdra]]---compassionate; [[synonyms:n:nātha]]---O master; [[synonyms:h:he]]---O; [[synonyms:m:mathurā]]-[[synonyms:n:nātha]]---the master of Mathurā; [[synonyms:k:kadā]]---when; [[synonyms:a:avalokyase]]---I shall see you; [[synonyms:h:hṛdayam]]---my heart; [[synonyms:t:tvat]]---of You; [[synonyms:a:aloka]]---without seeing; [[synonyms:k:kātaram]]---very much aggrieved; [[synonyms:d:dayita]]---O most beloved; [[synonyms:b:bhrāmyati]]---becomes overwhelmed; [[synonyms:k:kim]]---what; [[synonyms:k:karomi]]---shall do; [[synonyms:a:aham]]---I.
translation: "O my Lord! O most merciful master! O master of Mathurā! When shall I see You again? Because of my not seeing You, my agitated heart has become unsteady. O most beloved one, what shall I do now?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.35
description: In this verse Mādhavendra Purī instructs how to achieve ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. By feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, one becomes spiritually situated.
text:
> ei śloke kṛṣṇa-prema kare upadeśa
> kṛṣṇera virahe bhaktera bhāva-viśeṣa
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:ś:śloke]]---in this verse; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]---love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:u:upadeśa]]---instructs; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇera]] [[synonyms:v:virahe]]---by feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:bhaktera]]---of the devotee; [[synonyms:b:bhāva]]-[[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---transcendental situation.
translation: In this verse Mādhavendra Purī instructs how to achieve ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. By feeling separation from Kṛṣṇa, one becomes spiritually situated.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.36
description: Mādhavendra Purī sowed the seed of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa within this material world and then departed. That seed later became a great tree in the form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> pṛthivīte ropaṇa kari' gelā premāṅkura
> sei premāṅkurera vṛkṣa---caitanya-ṭhākura
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pṛthivīte]]---within this material world; [[synonyms:r:ropaṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---sowing; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅkura]]---the seed of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:a:aṅkurera]]---of that seed of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:v:vṛkṣa]]---the tree; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhākura]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Mādhavendra Purī sowed the seed of ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa within this material world and then departed. That seed later became a great tree in the form of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.37
description: I have incidentally described the passing away of Mādhavendra Purī. Anyone who hears this must be considered very fortunate.
text:
> prastāve kahiluṅ purī-gosāñira niryāṇa
> yei ihā śune, sei baḍa bhāgyavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prastāve]]---incidentally; [[synonyms:k:kahiluṅ]]---i have described; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñira]]---of Mādhavendra Purī; [[synonyms:n:niryāṇa]]---the passing away; [[synonyms:y:yei]]---one who; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:b:bhāgyavān]]---very fortunate.
translation: I have incidentally described the passing away of Mādhavendra Purī. Anyone who hears this must be considered very fortunate.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.38
description: Thus Rāmacandra Purī stayed at Jagannātha Purī. As customary for those in the renounced order, he would sometimes stay someplace and then go away.
text:
> rāmacandra-purī aiche rahilā nīlācale
> virakta svabhāva, kabhu rahe kona sthale
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---in this way; [[synonyms:r:rahilā]] [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---remained at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:v:virakta]]---renounced; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---as is the custom; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]]---sometimes; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---he remained; [[synonyms:k:kona]] [[synonyms:s:sthale]]---at a particular place.
translation: Thus Rāmacandra Purī stayed at Jagannātha Purī. As customary for those in the renounced order, he would sometimes stay someplace and then go away.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.39
description: There was no certainty of where Rāmacandra Purī would take his meal, for he would do so even uninvited. Nevertheless, he was very particular to keep account of how others were taking their meals.
text:
> animantraṇa bhikṣā kare, nāhika nirṇaya
> anyera bhikṣāra sthitira layena niścaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:animantraṇa]]---without being invited; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---accepts food; [[synonyms:n:nāhika]] [[synonyms:n:nirṇaya]]---there is no certainty; [[synonyms:a:anyera]]---of others; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣāra]]---of acceptance of //prasāda//; [[synonyms:s:sthitira]]---of the situation; [[synonyms:l:layena]] [[synonyms:n:niścaya]]---takes account.
translation: There was no certainty of where Rāmacandra Purī would take his meal, for he would do so even uninvited. Nevertheless, he was very particular to keep account of how others were taking their meals.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.4
description: All glories to Advaita Prabhu, the incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He induced Kṛṣṇa to descend and thus delivered the entire world.
text:
> jaya jaya advaita īśvara avatāra
> kṛṣṇa avatāri' kaila jagat-nistāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:a:avatāra]]---incarnation; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:a:avatāri']]---inducing Kṛṣṇa to descend; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:j:jagat]]-[[synonyms:n:nistāra]]---deliverance of the entire world.
translation: All glories to Advaita Prabhu, the incarnation of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He induced Kṛṣṇa to descend and thus delivered the entire world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.40
description: To invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would cost 320 kauḍis [small conchshells]. This would provide lunch for three people, including Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and sometimes Kāśīśvara and Govinda.
text:
> prabhura nimantraṇe lāge kauḍi cāri paṇa
> kabhu kāśīśvara, govinda khāna tina jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇe]]---for invitation; [[synonyms:l:lāge]]---is required; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:cāri]] [[synonyms:p:paṇa]]---four times eighty small conchshells; [[synonyms:k:kabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kāśīśvara]]---sometimes Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the personal servant of Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:khāna]]---eat; [[synonyms:t:tina]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---three persons.
translation: To invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would cost 320 kauḍis [small conchshells]. This would provide lunch for three people, including Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and sometimes Kāśīśvara and Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.41
description: Every day the Lord would take His meal at a different place, and if someone was prepared to pay for a meal, the price was fixed at only four paṇas.
text:
> pratyaha prabhura bhikṣā iti-uti haya
> keha yadi mūlya āne, cāri-paṇa-nirṇaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:a:aha]]---daily; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]---alms; [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:k:keha]]---someone; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---pays; [[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:p:paṇa]]---four times eighty small conchshells; [[synonyms:n:nirṇaya]]---as a fixed amount.
translation: Every day the Lord would take His meal at a different place, and if someone was prepared to pay for a meal, the price was fixed at only four paṇas.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.42
description: Rāmacandra Purī concerned himself with gathering all sorts of information about how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was situated, including His regulative principles, His lunch, His sleep and His movements.
text:
> prabhura sthiti, rīti, bhikṣā, śayana, prayāṇa
> rāmacandra-purī kare sarvānusandhāna
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sthiti]]---situation; [[synonyms:r:rīti]]---regulative principles; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]]---accepting lunch; [[synonyms:ś:śayana]]---sleeping; [[synonyms:p:prayāṇa]]---movement; [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:a:anusandhāna]]---takes all information of.
translation: Rāmacandra Purī concerned himself with gathering all sorts of information about how Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was situated, including His regulative principles, His lunch, His sleep and His movements.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.43
description: Because Rāmacandra Purī was interested only in finding faults, he could not understand the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. His only concern was finding faults, but still he could not find any.
text:
> prabhura yateka guṇa sparśite nārila
> chidra cāhi' bule, kāṅhā chidra nā pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yateka]] [[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---all the transcendental attributes; [[synonyms:s:sparśite]] [[synonyms:n:nārila]]---could not touch or understand; [[synonyms:c:chidra]] [[synonyms:c:cāhi']]---looking for faults; [[synonyms:b:bule]]---he goes about; [[synonyms:k:kāṅhā]]---anywhere; [[synonyms:c:chidra]]---fault; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---he could not find.
translation: Because Rāmacandra Purī was interested only in finding faults, he could not understand the transcendental qualities of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. His only concern was finding faults, but still he could not find any.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.44
description: At last he found a fault."How can a person in the renounced order eat so many sweetmeats?" he said. "If one eats sweets, controlling the senses is very difficult."
text:
> 'sannyāsī hañā kare miṣṭānna bhakṣaṇa
> ei bhoge haya kaiche indriya-vāraṇa'?
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:m:miṣṭānna]] [[synonyms:b:bhakṣaṇa]]---eats sweetmeats; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:b:bhoge]]---by this eating; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:k:kaiche]]---how; [[synonyms:i:indriya]]-[[synonyms:v:vāraṇa]]---controlling the senses.
translation: At last he found a fault."How can a person in the renounced order eat so many sweetmeats?" he said. "If one eats sweets, controlling the senses is very difficult."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.45
description: In this way Rāmacandra Purī blasphemed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu before everyone, but nevertheless he would regularly come to see the Lord every day.
text:
> ei nindā kari' kahe sarva-loka-sthāne
> prabhure dekhiteha avaśya āise prati-dine
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---this criticism; [[synonyms:k:kari']]---making; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to everyone; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dekhiteha]]---to see, still; [[synonyms:a:avaśya]]---certainly; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---comes; [[synonyms:p:prati]]-[[synonyms:d:dine]]---daily.
translation: In this way Rāmacandra Purī blasphemed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu before everyone, but nevertheless he would regularly come to see the Lord every day.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.46
description: When they met, the Lord would offer him respectful obeisances, considering him a Godbrother of His spiritual master. Rāmacandra Purī's business, however, was to search for faults in the Lord.
text:
> prabhu guru-buddhye karena sambhrama, sammāna
> teṅho chidra cāhi' bule,---ei tāra kāma
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:guru]]-[[synonyms:b:buddhye]]---accepting him as a Godbrother of His spiritual master; [[synonyms:k:karena]] [[synonyms:s:sambhrama]] [[synonyms:s:sammāna]]---offers full respect and obeisances; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:c:chidra]] [[synonyms:c:cāhi']]---trying to find fault; [[synonyms:b:bule]]---goes about; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:k:kāma]]---business.
translation: When they met, the Lord would offer him respectful obeisances, considering him a Godbrother of His spiritual master. Rāmacandra Purī's business, however, was to search for faults in the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.47
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew that Rāmacandra Purī was criticizing Him before everyone, but whenever Rāmacandra Purī came to see Him, the Lord offered him respects with great attention.
text:
> yata nindā kare tāhā prabhu saba jāne
> tathāpi ādara kaṛe baḍa-i sambhrame
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yata]]---whatever; [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---blasphemy; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:ā:ādara]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---offers respect; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]]-[[synonyms:i:i]] [[synonyms:s:sambhrame]]---with great attention.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu knew that Rāmacandra Purī was criticizing Him before everyone, but whenever Rāmacandra Purī came to see Him, the Lord offered him respects with great attention.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.48
description: One day Rāmacandra Purī came in the morning to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Seeing many ants, he said something to criticize the Lord.
text:
> eka-dina prātaḥ-kāle āilā prabhura ghara
> pipīlikā dekhi' kichu kahena uttara
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:p:prātaḥ]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---in the morning; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:g:ghara]]---to the place of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:pipīlikā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing many ants; [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:k:kahena]] [[synonyms:u:uttara]]---began to say something critical.
translation: One day Rāmacandra Purī came in the morning to the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Seeing many ants, he said something to criticize the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.49
description: "Last night there was sugar candy here," he said. "Therefore ants are wandering about. Alas, this renounced sannyāsī is attached to such sense gratification!" After speaking in this way, he got up and left.
text:
>    "rātrāv atra aikṣavam āsīt, tena
> pipīlikāḥ sañcaranti aho! viraktānāṁ
> sannyāsinām iyam indriya-lālaseti
> bruvann utthāya gataḥ."
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rātrau]]---at night; [[synonyms:a:atra]]---here; [[synonyms:a:aikṣavam]]---sugar candy; [[synonyms:ā:āsīt]]---was; [[synonyms:t:tena]]---by that; [[synonyms:p:pipīlikāḥ]]---ants; [[synonyms:s:sañcaranti]]---wander about; [[synonyms:a:aho]]---alas; [[synonyms:v:viraktānām]]---renounced; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsinām]]---of //sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:i:iyam]]---this; [[synonyms:i:indriya]]---to the senses; [[synonyms:l:lālasa]]---attachment; [[synonyms:i:iti]]---thus; [[synonyms:b:bruvan]]---speaking; [[synonyms:u:utthāya]]---getting up; [[synonyms:g:gataḥ]]---left.
translation: "Last night there was sugar candy here," he said. "Therefore ants are wandering about. Alas, this renounced sannyāsī is attached to such sense gratification!" After speaking in this way, he got up and left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.5
description: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu is their life and soul.
text:
> jaya jaya śrīvāsādi yata bhakta-gaṇa
> śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya prabhu---yāṅra prāṇa-dhana
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrīvāsa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to all the devotees; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]] [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---life and soul.
translation: All glories to all the devotees, headed by Śrīvāsa Ṭhākura. Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu is their life and soul.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.50
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had heard rumors about Rāmacandra Purī's blasphemy. Now He directly heard his fanciful accusations.
text:
> prabhu paramparāya nindā kairāchena śravaṇa
> ebe sākṣāt śunilena 'kalpita' nindana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:paramparāya]]---by hearsay; [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---blasphemy; [[synonyms:k:kairāchena]] [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---had heard; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:s:sākṣāt]]---directly; [[synonyms:ś:śunilena]]---He heard; [[synonyms:k:kalpita]]---imaginary; [[synonyms:n:nindana]]---blasphemy.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had heard rumors about Rāmacandra Purī's blasphemy. Now He directly heard his fanciful accusations.
purport: Rāmacandra Purī could find no faults in the character of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, for He is situated in a transcendental position as the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Ants are generally found everywhere, but when Rāmacandra Purī saw ants crawling in the abode of the Lord, he took for granted that they must have been there because Caitanya Mahāprabhu had been eating sweetmeats. He thus discovered imaginary faults in the Lord and then left.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.51
description: Ants generally crawl about here, there and everywhere, but Rāmacandra Purī, looking for imaginary faults, criticized Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by alleging that there had been sweetmeats in His room.
text:
> sahajei pipīlikā sarvatra beḍāya
> tāhāte tarka uṭhāñā doṣa lāgāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sahajei]]---generally; [[synonyms:p:pipīlikā]]---ants; [[synonyms:s:sarvatra]]---everywhere; [[synonyms:b:beḍāya]]---loiter; [[synonyms:t:tāhāte]]---by that; [[synonyms:t:tarka]] [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---raising a controversy; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāya]]---find faults.
translation: Ants generally crawl about here, there and everywhere, but Rāmacandra Purī, looking for imaginary faults, criticized Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu by alleging that there had been sweetmeats in His room.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.52
description: After hearing this criticism, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was doubtful and apprehensive. Therefore He called Govinda and instructed him as follows.
text:
> śuni' tāhā prabhura saṅkoca-bhaya mane
> govinde bolāñā kichu kahena vacane
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya; [[synonyms:s:saṅkoca]]---doubt; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---fear; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:g:govinde]] [[synonyms:b:bolāñā]]---calling for Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kahena]]---spoke; [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---words.
translation: After hearing this criticism, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was doubtful and apprehensive. Therefore He called Govinda and instructed him as follows.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.53
description: "From today on it will be a rule that I shall accept only one-fourth of a pot of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda and five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables.
text:
> "āji haite bhikṣā āmāra ei ta' niyama
> piṇḍā-bhogera eka cauṭhi, pāṅca-gaṇḍāra vyañjana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āji]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from today; [[synonyms:b:bhikṣā]] [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---My accepting //prasāda//; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:n:niyama]]---the rule; [[synonyms:p:piṇḍā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhogera]]---of Lord Jagannātha's //prasāda//; [[synonyms:e:eka]] [[synonyms:c:cauṭhi]]---one-fourth of a pot; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables costing five //gaṇḍās// (one //gaṇḍā// equals four //kauḍis//).
translation: "From today on it will be a rule that I shall accept only one-fourth of a pot of Lord Jagannātha's prasāda and five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.54
description: "If you bring any more than this, you will not see Me here anymore."
text:
> ihā ba-i adhika āra kichu nā ānibā
> adhika ānile āmā ethā nā dekhibā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihā]] [[synonyms:b:ba]]-[[synonyms:i:i]]---except for this; [[synonyms:a:adhika]]---more; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---extra; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---anything; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ā:ānibā]]---do not bring; [[synonyms:a:adhika]] [[synonyms:ā:ānile]]---if more is brought; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]]---Me; [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dekhibā]]---you will not see.
translation: "If you bring any more than this, you will not see Me here anymore."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.55
description: Govinda relayed this message to all the devotees. When they heard it, they felt as if their heads had been struck by thunderbolts.
text:
> sakala vaiṣṇave govinda kahe ei vāt
> śuni' sabāra māthe yaiche haila vajrāghāta
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sakala]] [[synonyms:v:vaiṣṇave]]---to all the Vaiṣṇavas; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---informs; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:v:vāt]]---this message; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:m:māthe]]---on everyone's head; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---as if; [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was; [[synonyms:v:vajra]]-[[synonyms:ā:āghāta]]---striking of lightning.
translation: Govinda relayed this message to all the devotees. When they heard it, they felt as if their heads had been struck by thunderbolts.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.56
description: All the devotees condemned Rāmacandra Purī, saying, "This sinful man has come here and taken our lives."
text:
> rāmacandra-purīke sabāya deya tiraskāra
> 'ei pāpiṣṭha āsi' prāṇa la-ila sabāra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purīke]]---unto Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:d:deya]] [[synonyms:t:tiraskāra]]---offer chastisement; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:pāpiṣṭha]]---this sinful man; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---has taken; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone.
translation: All the devotees condemned Rāmacandra Purī, saying, "This sinful man has come here and taken our lives."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.57-58
description: That day, a brāhmaṇa extended an invitation to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. When Govinda accepted only five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables and a fourth of a pot of rice, the brāhmaṇa, in great despair, struck his head with his hand and cried, "Alas! Alas!"
text:
> sei-dina eka-vipra kaila nimantraṇa
> eka-cauṭhi bhāta, pāṅca-gaṇḍāra vyañjana
>
> ei-mātra govinda kaila aṅgīkāra
> māthāya ghā māre vipra, kare hāhākāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---that day; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:v:vipra]]---one //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]]---invited; [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:c:cauṭhi]] [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---one-fourth of a pot of rice; [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇḍāra]] [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetables worth only five //gaṇḍās//; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only this; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---the servant of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:a:aṅgīkāra]]---accepted; [[synonyms:m:māthāya]]---his head; [[synonyms:g:ghā]] [[synonyms:m:māre]]---struck; [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---the //brāhmaṇa//; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:h:hāhā]]-[[synonyms:k:kāra]]---began to say, "alas, alas."
translation: That day, a brāhmaṇa extended an invitation to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. When Govinda accepted only five gaṇḍās worth of vegetables and a fourth of a pot of rice, the brāhmaṇa, in great despair, struck his head with his hand and cried, "Alas! Alas!"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.59
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate only half of the rice and vegetables, and whatever remained was taken by Govinda.
text:
> sei bhāta-vyañjana prabhu ardheka khāila
> ye kichu rahila, tāhā govinda pāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:b:bhāta]]---rice; [[synonyms:v:vyañjana]]---vegetable; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:ardheka]] [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---ate half; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:r:rahila]]---whatever remained; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]---that; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---got.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ate only half of the rice and vegetables, and whatever remained was taken by Govinda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.6
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, at Jagannātha Purī, performed His various pastimes with His own devotees in the waves of love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei-mata gauracandra nija-bhakta-saṅge
> nīlācale krīḍā kare kṛṣṇa-prema-taraṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:g:gauracandra]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---with His own devotees; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:k:krīḍā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---executes different pastimes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:t:taraṅge]]---in the waves of love of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, at Jagannātha Purī, performed His various pastimes with His own devotees in the waves of love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.60
description: Thus both Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Govinda ate only half the food they needed. Because of this, all the other devotees gave up eating.
text:
> ardhāśana karena prabhu, govinda ardhāśana
> saba bhakta-gaṇa tabe chāḍila bhojana
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:a:aśana]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---eats half; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:g:govinda]]---Govinda; [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:a:aśana]]---eats half; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---all the devotees; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:c:chāḍila]] [[synonyms:b:bhojana]]---gave up eating.
translation: Thus both Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and Govinda ate only half the food they needed. Because of this, all the other devotees gave up eating.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.61
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Govinda and Kāśīśvara, "You may both take alms elsewhere to fill your bellies."
text:
> govinda-kāśīśvare prabhu kailā ājñāpana
> 'duṅhe anyatra māgi' kara udara bharaṇa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:govinda]]-[[synonyms:k:kāśīśvare]]---unto Govinda and Kāśīśvara; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made; [[synonyms:ā:ājñāpana]]---order; [[synonyms:d:duṅhe]]---both of you; [[synonyms:a:anyatra]]---elsewhere; [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:u:udara]] [[synonyms:b:bharaṇa]]---fill your bellies.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu ordered Govinda and Kāśīśvara, "You may both take alms elsewhere to fill your bellies."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.62
description: In this way, some days passed in great unhappiness. Hearing of all this, Rāmacandra Purī went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> ei-rūpa mahā-duḥkhe dina kata gela
> śuni, rāmacandra-purī prabhu-pāśa āila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---in great unhappiness; [[synonyms:d:dina]] [[synonyms:k:kata]]---some days; [[synonyms:g:gela]]---passed; [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rāmacandra]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:p:pāśa]] [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: In this way, some days passed in great unhappiness. Hearing of all this, Rāmacandra Purī went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.63
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His obeisances to Rāmacandra Purī, worshiping his feet. Then Rāmacandra Purī smiled and spoke to the Lord.
text:
> praṇāma kari' prabhu kailā caraṇa vandana
> prabhure kahaye kichu hāsiyā vacana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:praṇāma]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---offered respect at his feet; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahaye]]---he says; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:h:hāsiyā]]---smiling; [[synonyms:v:vacana]]---words.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered His obeisances to Rāmacandra Purī, worshiping his feet. Then Rāmacandra Purī smiled and spoke to the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.64
description: Rāmacandra Purī advised, "It is not the business of a sannyāsī to gratify his senses. He should fill his belly some way or other.
text:
> "sannyāsīra dharma nahe 'indriya-tarpaṇa'
> yaiche taiche kare mātra udara bharaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīra]]---of a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---religious principle; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:i:indriya]]-[[synonyms:t:tarpaṇa]]---to gratify the senses; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]] [[synonyms:t:taiche]]---some way or other; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:u:udara]] [[synonyms:b:bharaṇa]]---filling the belly.
translation: Rāmacandra Purī advised, "It is not the business of a sannyāsī to gratify his senses. He should fill his belly some way or other.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.65
description: "I have heard that You have cut Your eating in half. Indeed, I see that You are skinny. Such dry renunciation is also not the religion of a sannyāsī.
text:
> tomāre kṣīṇa dekhi, śuni,---kara ardhāśana
> ei 'śuṣka-vairāgya' nahe sannyāsīra 'dharma'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---You; [[synonyms:k:kṣīṇa]]---skinny; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---I see; [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---I have heard; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:a:ardha]]-[[synonyms:a:aśana]]---You are eating half; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śuṣka]]-[[synonyms:v:vairāgya]]---dry renunciation; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsīra]] [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---the religion of a //sannyāsī.//
translation: "I have heard that You have cut Your eating in half. Indeed, I see that You are skinny. Such dry renunciation is also not the religion of a sannyāsī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.66
description: "A sannyāsī eats as much as necessary to maintain his body, but he does not enjoy satisfying his senses materially. Thus a sannyāsī becomes perfect in his spiritual advancement in knowledge.
text:
> yathā-yogya udara bhare, nā kare 'viṣaya' bhoga
> sannyāsīra tabe siddha haya jñāna-yoga

translation: "A sannyāsī eats as much as necessary to maintain his body, but he does not enjoy satisfying his senses materially. Thus a sannyāsī becomes perfect in his spiritual advancement in knowledge.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.67-68
description: "My dear Arjuna, one cannot perform mystic yoga if he eats more than necessary or needlessly fasts, sleeps and dreams too much or does not sleep enough. One should eat and enjoy his senses as much as necessary, one should properly endeavor to execute his duties, and one should regulate his sleep and wakefulness. Thus one can become freed from material pains by executing mystic yoga.' "
text:
> nātyaśnato 'pi yogo 'sti
> na caikāntam anaśnataḥ
> na cāti-svapna-śīlasya
> jāgrato naiva cārjuna
>
> yuktāhāra-vihārasya
> yukta-ceṣṭasya karmasu
> yukta-svapnāvabodhasya
> yogo bhavati duḥkha-hā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:a:aśnataḥ]]---of one who eats too much; [[synonyms:a:api]]---certainly; [[synonyms:y:yogaḥ]]---linking with the Supreme; [[synonyms:a:asti]]---there is; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:e:ekāntam]]---solely; [[synonyms:a:anaśnataḥ]]---of one who abstains from eating; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:a:ati]]-[[synonyms:s:svapna]]-[[synonyms:ś:śīlasya]]---of one who dreams too much in sleep; [[synonyms:j:jāgrataḥ]]---of one who keeps awake; [[synonyms:n:na]]---not; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:c:ca]]---also; [[synonyms:a:arjuna]]---O Arjuna; [[synonyms:y:yukta]]---as much as necessary; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]]---eating; [[synonyms:v:vihārasya]]---of one whose sense enjoyment; [[synonyms:y:yukta]]---proper; [[synonyms:c:ceṣṭasya]]---of one whose endeavor; [[synonyms:k:karmasu]]---in executing duties; [[synonyms:y:yukta]]---as much as necessary; [[synonyms:s:svapna]]---dreaming while asleep; [[synonyms:a:avabodhasya]]---of one whose keeping awake; [[synonyms:y:yogaḥ]]---practice of yoga; [[synonyms:b:bhavati]]---is; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]-[[synonyms:h:hā]]---diminishing sufferings.
translation: "My dear Arjuna, one cannot perform mystic yoga if he eats more than necessary or needlessly fasts, sleeps and dreams too much or does not sleep enough. One should eat and enjoy his senses as much as necessary, one should properly endeavor to execute his duties, and one should regulate his sleep and wakefulness. Thus one can become freed from material pains by executing mystic yoga.' "
purport: This is a quotation from //Bhagavad-gītā// (6.16-17).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.69
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then humbly submitted, "I am just like an ignorant boy and am like your disciple. It is My great fortune that you are instructing Me."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"ajña bālaka mui 'śiṣya' tomāra
> more śikṣā deha',---ei bhāgya āmāra"

translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu then humbly submitted, "I am just like an ignorant boy and am like your disciple. It is My great fortune that you are instructing Me."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.7
description: Then a sannyāsī named Rāmacandra Purī Gosāñi came to see Paramānanda Purī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

> hena-kāle rāmacandra-purī-gosāñi āilā
> paramānanda-purīre āra prabhure mililā

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.70
description: Hearing this, Rāmacandra Purī got up and left. He also heard from various sources that all the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu were eating half as much as usual.
text:
> eta śuni' rāmacandra-purī uṭhi' gelā
> bhakta-gaṇa ardhāśana kare,---purī gosāñi śunilā

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.71

> prabhu-pāśe nivedilā dainya-vinaya kari'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.72
description: Paramānanda Purī said, "My Godbrother Rāmacandra Purī is by nature a bad critic. If You give up eating because of his words, what will be the profit?

> "rāmacandra-purī haya ninduka-svabhāva
> tāra bole anna chāḍi' kibā habe lābha?

translation: Paramānanda Purī said, "My Godbrother Rāmacandra Purī is by nature a bad critic. If You give up eating because of his words, what will be the profit?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.73
description: "It is the nature of Rāmacandra Purī that first he lets one eat as much as desired, and if one does not eat more than necessary, with great attention he makes him eat more.
text:
> purīra svabhāva,---yatheṣṭa āhāra karāñā
> ye nā khāya, tāre khāoyāya yatana kariyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:purīra]] [[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---Rāmacandra Purī's character; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:i:iṣṭa]]---as much as desired; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]] [[synonyms:k:karāñā]]---getting someone to eat; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---what; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---one does not eat; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:k:khāoyāya]]---causes him to eat; [[synonyms:y:yatana]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---with great attention.
translation: "It is the nature of Rāmacandra Purī that first he lets one eat as much as desired, and if one does not eat more than necessary, with great attention he makes him eat more.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.74
description: "In this way he induces one to eat more than necessary, and then he directly criticizes him, saying,'You eat so much. How much money do you have in your treasury?
text:
> khāoyāñā punaḥ tāre karaye nindana
> 'eta anna khāo,---tomāra kata āche dhana?

translation: "In this way he induces one to eat more than necessary, and then he directly criticizes him, saying,'You eat so much. How much money do you have in your treasury?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.75

text:
> sannyāsīke eta khāoyāñā kara dharma nāśa!
> ataeva jāninu,---tomāra kichu nāhi bhāsa'

translation: "Also, by inducing sannyāsīs to eat so much, you spoil their religious principles. Therefore I can understand that you have no advancement.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.76
description: "It is Rāmacandra Purī's business to inquire always about how others are eating and conducting their daily affairs.
text:
> ke kaiche vyavahāre, kebā kaiche khāya

translation: "It is Rāmacandra Purī's business to inquire always about how others are eating and conducting their daily affairs.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.77
description: "The two kinds of activity rejected in the revealed scriptures constitute his daily affairs.

> śāstre yei dui dharma kairāche varjana

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.78
description: "One should see that because of the meeting of material nature and the living entity, the universe is acting uniformly. Thus one should neither praise nor criticize the characteristics or activities of others.'
text:
> para-svabhāva-karmāṇi
> na praśaṁsen na garhayet
> viśvam ekātmakaṁ paśyan
> prakṛtyā puruṣeṇa ca

translation: "One should see that because of the meeting of material nature and the living entity, the universe is acting uniformly. Thus one should neither praise nor criticize the characteristics or activities of others.'
purport: This verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (11.28.1) was spoken by Lord Kṛṣṇa to Uddhava.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.79
description: "Of the two rules, Rāmacandra Purī obeys the first by abandoning praise, but although he knows that the second is more prominent, he neglects it by criticizing others.
text:
> tāra madhye pūrva-vidhi 'praśaṁsā' chāḍiyā
> para-vidhi 'nindā' kare 'baliṣṭha' jāniyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---between the two; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---the former rule; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁsā]]---praising; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---giving up; [[synonyms:p:para]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhi]]---the other rule; [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---criticizing; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:b:baliṣṭha]] [[synonyms:j:jāniyā]]---knowing it to be more prominent.
translation: "Of the two rules, Rāmacandra Purī obeys the first by abandoning praise, but although he knows that the second is more prominent, he neglects it by criticizing others.
purport: The above-mentioned verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// gives two injunctions. The first, called //pūrva-vidhi,// is that one should not praise, and the second, //para-vidhi,// is that one should not criticize. As will be apparent from the following verse, the injunction against praise is less important than the injunction against blasphemy. One should carefully observe the //para-vidhi,// although one may neglect the //pūrva-vidhi.// Thus the actual injunction is that one may praise but should not criticize. This is called //śleṣokti,// or a statement having two meanings. Rāmacandra Purī, however, acted in just the opposite way, for he neglected the //para-vidhi// but strictly observed the //pūrva-vidhi.// Since he avoided following the principle of not criticizing, Rāmacandra Purī broke both the rules.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.8
description: Paramānanda Purī offered respects at the feet of Rāmacandra Purī, and Rāmacandra Purī strongly embraced him.
text:
> paramānanda-purī kaila caraṇa vandana
> purī-gosāñi kaila tāṅre dṛḍha āliṅgana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paramānanda]]-[[synonyms:p:purī]]---Paramānanda Purī; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---unto the feet; [[synonyms:v:vandana]]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:p:purī]]-[[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:dṛḍha]]---strong; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]]---embracing.
translation: Paramānanda Purī offered respects at the feet of Rāmacandra Purī, and Rāmacandra Purī strongly embraced him.
purport: Because Rāmacandra Purī was a disciple of Mādhavendra Purī, both Paramānanda Purī and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered him respectful obeisances. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that although Rāmacandra Purī was naturally very envious and although he was against the principles of Vaiṣṇavism-or, in other words, against the principles of the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His devotees-common people nevertheless addressed him as //Gosvāmī// or //Gosāñi// because he was superficially in the renounced order and dressed like a //sannyāsī.// In the modern age the title //gosvāmī// is used by a caste of //gṛhasthas,// but formerly it was not. Rūpa Gosvāmī and Sanātana Gosvāmī, for example, were called //gosvāmī// because they were in the renounced order. Similarly, because Paramānanda Purī was a //sannyāsī,// he was called Purī Gosvāmī. By careful scrutiny, therefore, one will find that gosvāmī is not the title for a certain caste; rather, it is properly the title for a person in the renounced order.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.80
description: "Between the former rule and the latter rule, the latter is more important.'
text: > pūrva-parayor madhye para-vidhir balavān
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:p:parayoḥ]]---the former and the latter; [[synonyms:m:madhye]]---between; [[synonyms:p:para]]-[[synonyms:v:vidhiḥ]]---the latter rule; [[synonyms:b:balavān]]---more prominent.
translation: "Between the former rule and the latter rule, the latter is more important.'
purport: This is a verse from the //nyāya// literatures.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.81

text:
> yāhāṅ guṇa śata āche, tāhā nā kare grahaṇa
> guṇa-madhye chale kare doṣa-āropaṇa

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.82
description: "One should not, therefore, follow the principles of Rāmacandra Purī. Nevertheless, I have to say something against him because he is making our hearts unhappy.
text:
> iṅhāra svabhāva ihāṅ karite nā yuyāya
> tathāpi kahiye kichu marma-duḥkha pāya

translation: "One should not, therefore, follow the principles of Rāmacandra Purī. Nevertheless, I have to say something against him because he is making our hearts unhappy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.83
description: "Why have you given up proper eating due to the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī? Please accept invitations as before. This is the request of us all."
text:
> iṅhāra vacane kene anna tyāga kara?
> pūrvavat nimantraṇa māna',---sabāra bola dhara"
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:iṅhāra]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---by his words; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:a:anna]]---food; [[synonyms:t:tyāga]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---You give up; [[synonyms:p:pūrva]]-[[synonyms:v:vat]]---as before; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]] [[synonyms:m:māna']]---please accept the invitation; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of everyone; [[synonyms:b:bola]]---the words; [[synonyms:d:dhara]]---accept.
translation: "Why have you given up proper eating due to the criticism of Rāmacandra Purī? Please accept invitations as before. This is the request of us all."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.84
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are all of you angry at Rāmacandra Purī? He is expounding the natural principles of sannyāsa life. Why are you accusing him?
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"sabe kene purīre kara roṣa?
> 'sahaja' dharma kahe teṅho, tāṅra kibā doṣa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of you; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:p:purīre]]---at Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kara]] [[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---are angry; [[synonyms:s:sahaja]]---natural; [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---religious principles; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---speaks; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---he; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---of him; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---what; [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---fault.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied, "Why are all of you angry at Rāmacandra Purī? He is expounding the natural principles of sannyāsa life. Why are you accusing him?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.85
description: "For a sannyāsī to indulge in satisfying the tongue is a great offense. The duty of a sannyāsī is to eat only as much as needed to keep body and soul together."
text:
> yati hañā jihvā-lāmpaṭya---atyanta anyāya
> yatira dharma,---prāṇa rākhite āhāra-mātra khāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yati]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:j:jihvā]]-[[synonyms:l:lāmpaṭya]]---indulging in satisfying the tongue; [[synonyms:a:atyanta]] [[synonyms:a:anyāya]]---grievous offense; [[synonyms:y:yatira]] [[synonyms:d:dharma]]---the religious principle of a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]] [[synonyms:r:rākhite]]---to maintain life; [[synonyms:ā:āhāra]]---food; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---only; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---eats.
translation: "For a sannyāsī to indulge in satisfying the tongue is a great offense. The duty of a sannyāsī is to eat only as much as needed to keep body and soul together."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.86
description: When they all requested very fervently that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu take a full meal, He still would not do so. Instead, He responded to their request by accepting half as much as usual.
text:
> tabe sabe meli' prabhure bahu yatna kailā
> sabāra āgrahe prabhu ardheka rākhilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereafter; [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:m:meli']]---when all the devotees came together; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---unto Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:y:yatna]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---requested fervently; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:ā:āgrahe]]---due to the eagerness of all of them; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:a:ardheka]] [[synonyms:r:rākhilā]]---accepted half.
translation: When they all requested very fervently that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu take a full meal, He still would not do so. Instead, He responded to their request by accepting half as much as usual.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.87
description: The cost for the food needed to invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fixed at two paṇas of kauḍis [160 conchshells], and that food would be taken by two men and sometimes three.
text:

translation: The cost for the food needed to invite Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was fixed at two paṇas of kauḍis [160 conchshells], and that food would be taken by two men and sometimes three.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.88
description: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could not be accepted invited the Lord, he would pay two paṇas of conchshells to purchase the prasāda.
text:

translation: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could not be accepted invited the Lord, he would pay two paṇas of conchshells to purchase the prasāda.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.89
description: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could be accepted invited Him, the brāhmaṇa would purchase part of the prasāda and cook the rest at home.
text:
> bhojyānna vipra yadi nimantraṇa kare
> kichu 'prasāda' āne, kichu pāka kare ghare
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhojya]]-[[synonyms:a:anna]] [[synonyms:v:vipra]]---a //brāhmaṇa// at whose place an invitation could be accepted; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:n:nimantraṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---invites; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---//prasāda//; [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---brings; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:p:pāka]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---cooks; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at home.
translation: When a brāhmaṇa at whose home an invitation could be accepted invited Him, the brāhmaṇa would purchase part of the prasāda and cook the rest at home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.9
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also offered obeisances unto Rāmacandra Purī, who then embraced Him and thus remembered Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> mahāprabhu kailā tāṅre daṇḍavat nati
> āliṅgana kari' teṅho kaila kṛṣṇa-smṛti
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:daṇḍavatnati]]---offering obeisances; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---embracing; [[synonyms:t:teṅho]]---Rāmacandra Purī; [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---did; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:smṛti]]---remembrance of Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu also offered obeisances unto Rāmacandra Purī, who then embraced Him and thus remembered Kṛṣṇa.
purport: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu offered obeisances to Rāmacandra Purī in consideration of his being a disciple of Śrīla Mādhavendra Purī, the spiritual master of His own spiritual master, Īśvara Purī. When a Vaiṣṇava //sannyāsī// meets another Vaiṣṇava //sannyāsī,// they both remember Kṛṣṇa. Even Māyāvādī //sannyāsīs// generally remember Nārāyaṇa, who is also Kṛṣṇa, by saying //oṁ namo bhagavate nārāyaṇa// or //namo nārāyaṇa.// Thus it is the duty of a //sannyāsī// to remember Kṛṣṇa. According to //smṛti-śāstra,// a //sannyāsī// does not offer obeisances or blessings to anyone. it is said, //sannyāsī nirāśīr nirnamaṣkriyaḥ:// a //sannyāsī// should not offer anyone blessings or obeisances.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.90-91

text:
> paṇḍita-gosāñi, bhagavān-ācārya, sārvabhauma
> nimantraṇera dine yadi kare nimantraṇa
>
> tāṅ-sabāra icchāya prabhu karena bhojana
> tāhāṅ prabhura svātantrya nāi, yaiche tāṅra mana

translation: Even on a day when Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was invited to dine by others, if Gadādhara Paṇḍita, Bhagavān Ācārya or Sārvabhauma Bhaṭṭācārya invited Him, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu had no independence. He would accept their invitations as they desired.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 8.92
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu actually descended to give happiness to the devotees. Thus He behaved in whatever way fit the time and circumstances.
text:

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.1

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.10
description: Prahlāda Mahārāja, Bali Mahārāja, Vyāsadeva, Śukadeva Gosvāmī and other great sages came to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing Him, they became unconscious in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> prahlāda, bali, vyāsa, śuka ādi muni-gaṇa
> āsi' prabhu dekhi' preme haya acetana
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prahlāda]]---Prahlāda Mahārāja; [[synonyms:b:bali]]---Bali Mahārāja; [[synonyms:v:vyāsa]]---Vyāsadeva; [[synonyms:ś:śuka]]---Śukadeva Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and so on; [[synonyms:m:muni]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---great sages; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---by seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:p:preme]]---in ecstatic love of Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:h:haya]] [[synonyms:a:acetana]]---became unconscious.
translation: Prahlāda Mahārāja, Bali Mahārāja, Vyāsadeva, Śukadeva Gosvāmī and other great sages came to visit Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Upon seeing Him, they became unconscious in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
purport:
According to the opinion of some historians, Prahlāda Mahārāja was born in Tretā-yuga in the city of Mūlatāna in the state of Punjab. He was born of Hiraṇyakaśipu, a king of the dynasty of Kaśyapa. Prahlāda Mahārāja was a great devotee of Lord Viṣṇu, but his father was very much against Viṣṇu. Because the father and son thus differed in their consciousness, the demon father inflicted all kinds of bodily pain upon Prahlāda. When this torture became intolerable, the Supreme Lord appeared as Nṛsiṁhadeva and killed the great demon Hiraṇyakaśipu.

Bali Mahārāja was the grandson of Prahlāda Mahārāja. The son of Prahlāda Mahārāja was Virocana, and his son was known as Bali. Appearing as Vāmana and begging Bali Mahārāja for three feet of land, the Lord took possession of the entire three worlds. Thus Bali Mahārāja became a great devotee of Lord Vāmana. Bali Mahārāja had one hundred sons, of whom Mahārāja Bāṇa was the eldest and most famous.

Vyāsadeva was the son of the great sage Parāśara. Other names for him are Sātyavateya and Kṛṣṇa-dvaipāyana Bādarāyaṇa Muni. As one of the authorities on the //Vedas,// he divided the original //Veda,// for convenience, into four divisions-//Sāma, Yajur, Ṛg// and //Atharva.// He is the author of eighteen //Purāṇas// as well as the theosophical thesis //Brahma-sūtra// and its natural commentary, //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.// He belongs to the Brahma-sampradāya and is a direct disciple of Nārada Muni.

Śukadeva Gosvāmī is the son of Vyāsadeva. He was a //brahmacārī// fully conscious of Brahman realization, but later he became a great devotee of Lord Kṛṣṇa. He narrated //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// to Mahārāja Parīkṣit.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.100
description: "Go personally to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and keep Him at Jagannātha Purī with great attention. I shall excuse Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka from all his debts."
text:
> tumi yāha, prabhure rākhaha yatna kari'
> ei mui tāhāre chāḍinu saba kauḍi"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rākhaha]]---keep; [[synonyms:y:yatna]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---with great attention; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mui]]---as far as I am concerned; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:c:chāḍinu]]---I abandon; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---all dues.
translation: "Go personally to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and keep Him at Jagannātha Purī with great attention. I shall excuse Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka from all his debts."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.101
description: Kāśī Miśra said, "Excusing Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts will not make the Lord happy, for that is not His intention."
text:
> miśra kahe, "kauḍi chāḍibā,---nahe prabhura mane
> kauḍi chāḍile prabhu kadācit duḥkha māne"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Kāśī Miśra said; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍibā]]---you will excuse all dues; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mane]]---the thought of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍile]]---if you excuse all the dues; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kadācit]]---certainly; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---will be sorry.
translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "Excusing Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts will not make the Lord happy, for that is not His intention."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.102
description: The King said, "I shall absolve Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts, but don't speak of this to the Lord. Simply let Him know that all the family members of Bhavānanda Rāya and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka are naturally my dear friends.
text:
> rājā kahe, "kauḍi chāḍimu,---ihā nā kahibā
> sahaje mora priya tā'rā,---ihā jānāibā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King said; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍimu]]---I shall excuse all the dues; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kahibā]]---do not speak; [[synonyms:s:sahaje]]---naturally; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:priya]]---my dear friends; [[synonyms:t:tā'rā]]---they; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:j:jānāibā]]---let Him know.
translation: The King said, "I shall absolve Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts, but don't speak of this to the Lord. Simply let Him know that all the family members of Bhavānanda Rāya and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka are naturally my dear friends.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.103
description: "Bhavānanda Rāya is worthy of my worship and respect. Therefore I am always naturally affectionate to his sons."
text:
> bhavānanda-rāya---āmāra pūjya-garvita
> tāṅra putra-gaṇe āmāra sahajei prīta"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhavānanda]] [[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---by me; [[synonyms:p:pūjya]]---worshipable; [[synonyms:g:garvita]]---honorable; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:putra]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇe]]---unto sons; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]]---my; [[synonyms:s:sahajei]]---naturally; [[synonyms:p:prīta]]---affection.
translation: "Bhavānanda Rāya is worthy of my worship and respect. Therefore I am always naturally affectionate to his sons."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.104
description: After offering obeisances to Kāśī Miśra, the King returned to his palace and called for both Gopīnātha and the eldest prince.
text:
> eta bali' miśre namaskari' rājā ghare gelā
> gopīnāthe 'baḍa jānāya' ḍākiyā ānilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:m:miśre]] [[synonyms:n:namaskari']]---after offering obeisances to Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---returned to his palace; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthe]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:j:jānāya]]---the eldest prince; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍākiyā]] [[synonyms:ā:ānilā]]---called forth.
translation: After offering obeisances to Kāśī Miśra, the King returned to his palace and called for both Gopīnātha and the eldest prince.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.105
description: The King told Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, "You are excused for all the money you owe the treasury, and the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāṭa is again given to you for collections.
text:
> rājā kahe,---"saba kauḍi tomāre chāḍiluṅ
> sei mālajāṭhyā daṇḍa pāṭa tomāre ta' diluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King said; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---money; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---unto you; [[synonyms:c:chāḍiluṅ]]---I excuse; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:mālajāṭhyā]] [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]] [[synonyms:p:pāṭa]]---the place called Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāṭa; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]]---to you; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:d:diluṅ]]---I give.
translation: The King told Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, "You are excused for all the money you owe the treasury, and the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāṭa is again given to you for collections.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.106
description: "Do not again misappropriate the revenue of the government. In case you think your salary insufficient, henceforward it will be doubled."
text:
> āra bāra aiche nā khāiha rāja-dhana
> āji haite diluṅ tomāya dviguṇa vartana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:b:bāra]]---another time; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---like this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:khāiha]]---do not misappropriate; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---government revenue; [[synonyms:ā:āji]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from today; [[synonyms:d:diluṅ]]---I award; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]]---unto you; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vartana]]---twice the salary.
translation: "Do not again misappropriate the revenue of the government. In case you think your salary insufficient, henceforward it will be doubled."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.107
description: After saying this, the King appointed him by offering him a silken wrapper for his body. "Go to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu," he said."After taking permission from Him, go to your home. I bid you farewell. Now you may go."
text:
> eta bali' 'neta-dhaṭī' tāre parāila
> "prabhu-ājñā lañā yāha, vidāya tomā dila"
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:n:neta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhaṭī]]---silken wrapper; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:p:parāila]]---put on him; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]-[[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---after taking permission from Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yāha]]---go; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]]---farewell; [[synonyms:t:tomā]]---to you; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---I give.
translation: After saying this, the King appointed him by offering him a silken wrapper for his body. "Go to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu," he said."After taking permission from Him, go to your home. I bid you farewell. Now you may go."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.108
description: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, one can certainly become spiritually advanced. Indeed, no one can estimate the results of His mercy.
text:
> paramārthe prabhura kṛpā, seha rahu dūre
> ananta tāhāra phala, ke balite pāre?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:paramārthe]]---for spiritual advancement; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:seha]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rahu]] [[synonyms:d:dūre]]---let alone; [[synonyms:a:ananta]]---unlimited; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:b:balite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can estimate.
translation: By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, one can certainly become spiritually advanced. Indeed, no one can estimate the results of His mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.109
description: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka achieved the result of kingly opulence due to but a glimpse of the Lord's mercy. Therefore no one can calculate the full value of His mercy.
text:
> 'rājya-viṣaya'-phala ei---kṛpāra 'ābhāse'!
> tāhāra gaṇanā kāro mane nāhi āise!
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājya]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---kingly opulence; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kṛpāra]] [[synonyms:ā:ābhāse]]---by only a glimpse of such mercy; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]]---of that; [[synonyms:g:gaṇanā]]---calculation; [[synonyms:k:kāro]]---of anyone; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---within the mind; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---does not come.
translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka achieved the result of kingly opulence due to but a glimpse of the Lord's mercy. Therefore no one can calculate the full value of His mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.11
description: Being unable to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the populace outside His room would make a tumultuous sound. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go outside and tell them, "Chant Hare Kṛṣṇa."
text:
> bāhire phukāre loka, darśana nā pāñā
> 'kṛṣṇa kaha' balena prabhu bāhire āsiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---outside; [[synonyms:p:phu]]-[[synonyms:k:kāre]]---with a tumultuous sound; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:d:darśana]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---not being able to see; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]] [[synonyms:k:kaha]]---chant Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:b:balena]]---says; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bāhire]] [[synonyms:ā:āsiyā]]---coming outside.
translation: Being unable to see Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the populace outside His room would make a tumultuous sound. Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu would go outside and tell them, "Chant Hare Kṛṣṇa."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.110
description: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga to be killed, and all his money was taken away, but instead his debts were excused, and he was appointed collector in the same place.
text:
> kāhāṅ cāṅge caḍāñā laya dhana-prāṇa!
> kāhāṅ saba chāḍi' sei rājyādi-pradāna!
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on one hand; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]]---on the cāṅga; [[synonyms:c:caḍāñā]]---raising; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---takes; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---wealth; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on the other hand; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---excusing; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:r:rājya]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:p:pradāna]]---awarding the same government post and so on.
translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga to be killed, and all his money was taken away, but instead his debts were excused, and he was appointed collector in the same place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.111
description: On one hand Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was unable to clear his debt even by selling all his possessions, but on the other his salary was doubled, and he was honored with the silken wrapper.
text:
> kāhāṅ sarvasva veci' laya, deyā nā yāya kauḍi!
> kāhāṅ dviguṇa vartana, parāya neta-dhaḍi!
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on one hand; [[synonyms:s:sarvasva]]---all possessions; [[synonyms:v:veci']]---selling; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---takes; [[synonyms:d:deyā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---cannot be paid; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---the debt; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on the other hand; [[synonyms:d:dviguṇa]] [[synonyms:v:vartana]]---twice the salary; [[synonyms:p:parāya]]---puts on; [[synonyms:n:neta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhaḍi]]---the silken cover.
translation: On one hand Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was unable to clear his debt even by selling all his possessions, but on the other his salary was doubled, and he was honored with the silken wrapper.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.112
description: It was not the desire of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka be excused of his debt to the government, nor was it His desire that his salary be doubled or that he be reappointed collector at the same place.
text:
> prabhura icchā nāhi, tāre kauḍi chāḍāibe
> dviguṇa vartana kari' punaḥ 'viṣaya' dibe
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---the wish of the Lord; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---was not; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍāibe]]---he be excused from the dues; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---twice as much; [[synonyms:v:vartana]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---increasing the salary; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---he should be appointed to the post.
translation: It was not the desire of Lord Caitanya Mahāprabhu that Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka be excused of his debt to the government, nor was it His desire that his salary be doubled or that he be reappointed collector at the same place.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.113
description: When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's servant went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed the Lord of his plight, the Lord was somewhat agitated and dissatisfied.
text:
> tathāpi tāra sevaka āsi' kaila nivedana
> tāte kṣubdha haila yabe mahāprabhura mana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tathāpi]]---still; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---his servant; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submitted; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---by that; [[synonyms:k:kṣubdha]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was agitated; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind.
translation: When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's servant went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed the Lord of his plight, the Lord was somewhat agitated and dissatisfied.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.114
description: The Lord had no intention to award His devotee the happiness of material opulence, yet simply because of His being informed, such a great result was obtained.
text:
> viṣaya-sukha dite prabhura nāhi manobala
> nivedana-prabhāveha tabu phale eta phala
