synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---of material opulence; [[synonyms:s:sukha]]---happiness; [[synonyms:d:dite]]---award; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---is not; [[synonyms:m:manobala]]---desire; [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhāveha]]---simply because He was informed about it; [[synonyms:t:tabu]]---still; [[synonyms:p:phale]] [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:p:phala]]---so much of a result was obtained.
translation: The Lord had no intention to award His devotee the happiness of material opulence, yet simply because of His being informed, such a great result was obtained.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.115
description: No one can estimate the wonderful characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva cannot understand the intentions of the Lord.
text:
> ke kahite pāre gaurera āścarya svabhāva?
> brahmā-śiva ādi yāṅra nā pāya antarbhāva
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kahite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---can estimate; [[synonyms:g:gaurera]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:ā:āścarya]] [[synonyms:s:svabhāva]]---wonderful characteristics; [[synonyms:b:brahmā]]-[[synonyms:ś:śiva]]---Lord Brahmā, Lord Śiva; [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---and others; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---cannot understand; [[synonyms:a:antarbhāva]]---the intention.
translation: No one can estimate the wonderful characteristics of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Even Lord Brahmā and Lord Śiva cannot understand the intentions of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.116
description: Kāśī Miśra went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him in detail of all the King's intentions.
text:
> ethā kāśī-miśra āsi' prabhura caraṇe
> rājāra caritra saba kailā nivedane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---to the feet; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:c:caritra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the behavior; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---informed.
translation: Kāśī Miśra went to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him in detail of all the King's intentions.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.117
description: Upon hearing about Kāśī Miśra's tactics with the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Kāśī Miśra, what have you done? You have made Me indirectly take help from the King."
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"kāśī-miśra, ki tumi karilā?
> rāja-pratigraha tumi āmā' karāilā?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---My dear Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:k:ki]]---what; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---have you done; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:pratigraha]]---taking from the King; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:ā:āmā']]---me; [[synonyms:k:karāilā]]---have made to do.
translation: Upon hearing about Kāśī Miśra's tactics with the King, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "Kāśī Miśra, what have you done? You have made Me indirectly take help from the King."
purport: When the King heard the details of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's unfortunate condemnation, he was induced to excuse his debt, in particular because he felt that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very sorry about this incident. The Lord did not like the idea that the money forfeited to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was indirectly a contribution to Him. Therefore He immediately protested.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.118
description: Kāśī Miśra said, "My dear Lord, the King has done this without reservations. Kindly hear his statement.
text:
> miśra kahe,---"śuna, prabhu, rājāra vacane
> akapaṭe rājā ei kailā nivedane
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Kāśī Miśra said; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---kindly hear; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my dear Lord; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---to the statement of the King; [[synonyms:a:akapaṭe]]---without duplicity; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedane]]---has submitted.
translation: Kāśī Miśra said, "My dear Lord, the King has done this without reservations. Kindly hear his statement.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.119
description: "The King said, 'Speak to the Lord in such a way that He will not think, "For My sake the King has forfeited 200,000 kāhanas of kauḍis."
text:
> 'prabhu yena nāhi jānena,---rājā āmāra lāgiyā
> dui-lakṣa kāhana kauḍi dileka chāḍiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---so that; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jānena]]---may not think; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgiyā]]---for Me; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣakāhana]] [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---200,000 //kāhanas// of //kauḍis//; [[synonyms:d:dileka]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍiyā]]---has remitted.
translation: "The King said, 'Speak to the Lord in such a way that He will not think, "For My sake the King has forfeited 200,000 kāhanas of kauḍis."
purport: The //kauḍi// is like an American cent or Japanese yen. In the old medium of exchange, the first unit of currency was a small conchshell called a //kauḍi.// Four //kauḍis// made one //gaṇḍā,// twenty //gaṇḍās// made one //paṇa,// and sixteen //paṇas// made one //kāhana.// Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka owed the government 200,000 //kāhanas.// The King absolved him of this debt, reappointed him to his post and doubled his salary.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.12
description: All kinds of people would come to see the Lord, and upon seeing Him they would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed His days and nights.
text:
> prabhura darśane saba loka preme bhāse
> ei-mata yāya prabhura rātri-divase
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:darśane]]---by seeing Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---all the people; [[synonyms:p:preme]] [[synonyms:b:bhāse]]---became inundated in ecstatic love; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---passes; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rātri]]-[[synonyms:d:divase]]---night and day.
translation: All kinds of people would come to see the Lord, and upon seeing Him they would be overwhelmed with ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa. In this way Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu passed His days and nights.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.120
description: "Inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya are especially dear to me. I consider them like members of my family.
text:
> bhavānandera putra saba---mora priyatama
> iṅhā-sabākāre āmi dekhi ātma-sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhavānandera]]---of Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:p:putra]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all the sons; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---to me; [[synonyms:p:priyatama]]---very dear; [[synonyms:i:iṅhā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabākāre]]---all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:d:dekhi]]---see; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]]---as my relatives.
translation: "Inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu that all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya are especially dear to me. I consider them like members of my family.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.121
description: "Therefore I have appointed them collectors in various places, and although they spend the government's money, eat, drink, plunder and distribute it as they like, I do not take them very seriously.
text:
> ataeva yāhāṅ yāhāṅ dei adhikāra
> khāya, piye, luṭe, vilāya, nā karoṅ vicāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ataeva]]---therefore; [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]] [[synonyms:y:yāhāṅ]]---wherever; [[synonyms:d:dei]] [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---I appoint them; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---they eat; [[synonyms:p:piye]]---drink; [[synonyms:l:luṭe]]---plunder; [[synonyms:v:vilāya]]---distribute; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:karoṅ]] [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---I do not consider.
translation: "Therefore I have appointed them collectors in various places, and although they spend the government's money, eat, drink, plunder and distribute it as they like, I do not take them very seriously.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.122
description: "I made Rāmānanda Rāya the governor of Rājamahendrī. There is practically no account of whatever money he took and distributed in that position.
text:
> rājamahindāra 'rājā' kainu rāma-rāya
> ye khāila, yebā dila, nāhi lekhā-dāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājamahindāra]]---of the place known as Rājamahendrī; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---governor; [[synonyms:k:kainu]]---I made; [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:khāila]]---whatever money he took; [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---whatever; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---distributed; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:l:lekhā]]-[[synonyms:d:dāya]]---there is no account.
translation: "I made Rāmānanda Rāya the governor of Rājamahendrī. There is practically no account of whatever money he took and distributed in that position.
purport: Near Rājamahendrī is a famous railway station. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī notes that the present Rājamahendrī City is located on the northern bank of the Godāvarī. At the time when Rāmānanda Rāya was governor, however, the state capital, which was known as Vidyānagara or Vidyāpura, was located on the southern side of the Godāvarī, at the confluence of the Godāvarī and the sea. That was the part of the country which at that time was known as Rājamahendrī. North of Kaliṅga-deśa is Utkaliṅga, or the state of Orissa. The capital of southern Orissa was known as Rājamahendrī, but now the location of Rājamahendrī has changed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.123
description: "Having been appointed collector, Gopīnātha, in the same way, also generally spends two to four hundred thousand kāhanas as he likes.
text:
> gopīnātha ei-mata 'viṣaya' kariyā
> dui-cāri-lakṣa kāhana rahe ta' khāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]---Gopīnātha; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:k:kariyā]]---doing business; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:c:cāri]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:k:kāhana]]---two to four hundred thousand //kāhanas//; [[synonyms:r:rahe]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:khāñā]]---spends as he likes.
translation: "Having been appointed collector, Gopīnātha, in the same way, also generally spends two to four hundred thousand kāhanas as he likes.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.124
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka would collect some and pay some, spending it at will, but I would not consider this very seriously. This time, however, he was put in trouble because of a misunderstanding with the prince.
text:
> kichu deya, kichu nā deya, nā kari vicāra
> jānā'-sahita aprītye duḥkha pāila ei-bāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:d:deya]]---he pays; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deya]]---he does not pay; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kari]] [[synonyms:v:vicāra]]---I do not consider; [[synonyms:j:jānā]] [[synonyms:s:sahita]]---with the prince; [[synonyms:a:aprītye]]---due to some unfriendliness; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:p:pāila]]---has gotten so much trouble; [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---this time.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka would collect some and pay some, spending it at will, but I would not consider this very seriously. This time, however, he was put in trouble because of a misunderstanding with the prince.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.125
description: "The prince created this situation without my knowledge, but actually I consider all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya to be like my relatives.
text:
> 'jānā' eta kailā,---ihā mui nāhi jānoṅ
> bhavānandera putra-sabe ātma-sama mānoṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jānā]]---the prince; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---such; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---has done; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mui]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jānoṅ]]---did not know; [[synonyms:b:bhavānandera]] [[synonyms:p:putra]]---the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:s:sama]] [[synonyms:m:mānoṅ]]---I considered like my relatives.
translation: "The prince created this situation without my knowledge, but actually I consider all the sons of Bhavānanda Rāya to be like my relatives.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.126
description: "Because of my intimate relationship with them, I have absolved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu does not know this fact. Whatever I have done is because of my intimate relationship with the family of Bhavānanda Rāya.' "
text:
> tāṅhā lāgi' dravya chāḍi'---ihā māt jāne
> 'sahajei mora prīti haya tāhā-sane' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāṅhā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for them; [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---I remit the debt; [[synonyms:i:ihā]]---this; [[synonyms:m:māt]] [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---He does not know; [[synonyms:s:sahajei]]---naturally; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:p:prīti]]---my affection; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with them all.
translation: "Because of my intimate relationship with them, I have absolved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka of all his debts. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu does not know this fact. Whatever I have done is because of my intimate relationship with the family of Bhavānanda Rāya.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.127
description: Having heard from Kāśī Miśra all these statements concerning the King's mentality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy. At that time, Bhavānanda Rāya also arrived there.
text:
> śuniyā rājāra vinaya prabhura ānanda
> hena-kāle āilā tathā rāya bhavānanda
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:v:vinaya]]---submission; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:ā:ānanda]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu became very happy; [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---arrived; [[synonyms:t:tathā]]---there; [[synonyms:r:rāya]] [[synonyms:b:bhavānanda]]---Bhavānanda Rāya.
translation: Having heard from Kāśī Miśra all these statements concerning the King's mentality, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was very happy. At that time, Bhavānanda Rāya also arrived there.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.128
description: Bhavānanda Rāya, along with his five sons, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who lifted him up and embraced him.
text:
> pañca-putra-sahite āsi' paḍilā caraṇe
> uṭhāñā prabhu tāṅre kailā āliṅgane
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]-[[synonyms:s:sahite]]---with five sons; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---fell down at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:u:uṭhāñā]]---getting him up; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgane]]---embraced.
translation: Bhavānanda Rāya, along with his five sons, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who lifted him up and embraced him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.129
description: Thus Rāmānanda Rāya, all his brothers, and their father met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then Bhavānanda Rāya began speaking.
text:
> rāmānanda-rāya ādi sabāi mililā
> bhavānanda-rāya tabe balite lāgilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]] [[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---Rāmānanda Rāya and other brothers; [[synonyms:s:sabāi]]---all; [[synonyms:m:mililā]]---met; [[synonyms:b:bhavānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:b:balite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to speak.
translation: Thus Rāmānanda Rāya, all his brothers, and their father met Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Then Bhavānanda Rāya began speaking.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.13
description: One day people suddenly came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the son of Bhavānanda Rāya, has been condemned to death by the baḍa-jānā, the eldest son of the King, and has been raised on the cāṅga.
text:
> eka-dina loka āsi' prabhure nivedila
> gopīnāthere 'baḍa jānā' cāṅge caḍāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:d:dina]]---one day; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---people; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nivedila]]---informed; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthere]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:b:baḍa]] [[synonyms:j:jānā]]---the eldest son of King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]] [[synonyms:c:caḍāila]]---was raised on the //cāṅga.//
translation: One day people suddenly came to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and informed Him, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the son of Bhavānanda Rāya, has been condemned to death by the baḍa-jānā, the eldest son of the King, and has been raised on the cāṅga.
purport: The //cāṅga// was a device for killing a condemned person. It consisted of a raised platform on which the condemned was made to stand. Underneath the platform, there were stationary upright swords. The condemned man would be pushed down onto the swords, and in this way he would die. For some reason, Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka had been condemned to death and had therefore been raised upon the //cāṅga.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.130
description: "All these members of my family," he said, "are Your eternal servants. You have saved us from this great danger. Therefore You have purchased us for a proper price.
text:
> "tomāra kiṅkara ei saba mora kula
> e vipade rākhi' prabhu, punaḥ nilā mūla
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:k:kiṅkara]]---your servants; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:m:mora]] [[synonyms:k:kula]]---my family; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:v:vipade]]---in this great danger; [[synonyms:r:rākhi']]---by saving; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:n:nilā]] [[synonyms:m:mūla]]---have purchased.
translation: "All these members of my family," he said, "are Your eternal servants. You have saved us from this great danger. Therefore You have purchased us for a proper price.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.131
description: "You have now demonstrated Your love for Your devotees, just as when You previously saved the five Pāṇḍavas from great danger."
text:
> bhakta-vātsalya ebe prakaṭa karilā
> pūrve yena pañca-pāṇḍave vipade tārilā"
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]---love for Your devotees; [[synonyms:e:ebe]]---now; [[synonyms:p:prakaṭa]] [[synonyms:k:karilā]]---You have demonstrated; [[synonyms:p:pūrve]]---previously; [[synonyms:y:yena]]---as; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:p:pāṇḍave]]---the five Pāṇḍavas; [[synonyms:v:vipade]]---from danger; [[synonyms:t:tārilā]]---You saved.
translation: "You have now demonstrated Your love for Your devotees, just as when You previously saved the five Pāṇḍavas from great danger."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.132
description: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, his head covered with the silken wrapper, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described in detail the King's mercy toward him.
text:
> 'netadhaṭī'-māthe gopīnātha caraṇe paḍilā
> rājāra kṛpā-vṛttānta sakala kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:netadhaṭī]]-[[synonyms:m:māthe]]---with the silken cover on the head; [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]] [[synonyms:p:paḍilā]]---fell down at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:v:vṛttānta]]---story of the mercy; [[synonyms:s:sakala]]---all; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---narrated.
translation: Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, his head covered with the silken wrapper, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and described in detail the King's mercy toward him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.133
description: "The King has excused me for the balance due," he said."He has reappointed me to my post by honoring me with this silken cloth and has doubled my salary.
text:
> "bākī-kauḍi bāda, āra dviguṇa vartana kailā
> punaḥ 'viṣaya' diyā 'neta-dhaṭī' parāilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:bākī]]-[[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:b:bāda]]---excusing the balance due; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:d:dvi]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---double; [[synonyms:v:vartana]] [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---made the salary; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving the post; [[synonyms:n:neta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhaṭī]] [[synonyms:p:parāilā]]---decorated with the silken cloth.
translation: "The King has excused me for the balance due," he said."He has reappointed me to my post by honoring me with this silken cloth and has doubled my salary.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.134
description: "I was lifted upon the cāṅga to be killed, but on the contrary I was honored with this silken cloth. This is all Your mercy.
text:
> kāhāṅ cāṅgera upara sei maraṇa-pramāda!
> kāhāṅ 'neta-dhaṭī' punaḥ,---e-saba prasāda!
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on one hand; [[synonyms:c:cāṅgera]] [[synonyms:u:upara]]---on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:m:maraṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:pramāda]]---danger of death; [[synonyms:k:kāhāṅ]]---on the other hand; [[synonyms:n:neta]]-[[synonyms:d:dhaṭī]]---the silken cloth; [[synonyms:p:punaḥ]]---again; [[synonyms:e:e]]-[[synonyms:s:saba]]---all this; [[synonyms:p:prasāda]]---mercy.
translation: "I was lifted upon the cāṅga to be killed, but on the contrary I was honored with this silken cloth. This is all Your mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.135
description: "On the cāṅga I began meditating upon Your lotus feet, and the power of that remembrance has yielded all these results.
text:
> cāṅgera upare tomāra caraṇa dhyāna kailuṅ
> caraṇa-smaraṇa-prabhāve ei phala pāiluṅ
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:cāṅgera]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---on Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:d:dhyāna]] [[synonyms:k:kailuṅ]]---I meditated; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:smaraṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prabhāve]]---by the power of remembering Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:p:phala]]---these results; [[synonyms:p:pāiluṅ]]---I have got.
translation: "On the cāṅga I began meditating upon Your lotus feet, and the power of that remembrance has yielded all these results.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.136
description: "Struck with wonder by my affairs, the populace is glorifying the greatness of Your mercy.
text:
> loke camatkāra mora e saba dekhiyā
> praśaṁse tomāra kṛpā-mahimā gāñā
synonyms: [[synonyms:l:loke]]---among the people; [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---great wonder; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---my; [[synonyms:e:e]] [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all these; [[synonyms:d:dekhiyā]]---by seeing; [[synonyms:p:praśaṁse]]---they glorify; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---of mercy; [[synonyms:m:mahimā]]---greatness; [[synonyms:g:gāñā]]---chanting.
translation: "Struck with wonder by my affairs, the populace is glorifying the greatness of Your mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.137
description: "However, my Lord, these are not the principal results of meditating upon Your lotus feet. Material opulence is very flickering. Therefore it is simply a glimpse of the result of Your mercy.
text:
> kintu tomāra smaraṇera nahe ei 'mukhya-phala'
> 'phalābhāsa' ei,---yāte 'viṣaya' cañcala
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kintu]]---but; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:s:smaraṇera]]---of remembrance; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---not; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mukhya]]-[[synonyms:p:phala]]---chief result; [[synonyms:p:phala]]-[[synonyms:ā:ābhāsa]]---a glimpse of the result; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---because; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---material opulence; [[synonyms:c:cañcala]]---flickering.
translation: "However, my Lord, these are not the principal results of meditating upon Your lotus feet. Material opulence is very flickering. Therefore it is simply a glimpse of the result of Your mercy.
purport: One can achieve the highest perfection of life simply by meditating upon the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu. Generally people are concerned with the four religious principles, namely religion, material opulence, sense gratification and liberation. However, as indicated in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam (dharmaḥ projjhita-kaitavo 'tra),// success in these four kinds of material and spiritual gain are not the true results of devotional service. The true result of devotional service is the actual development of one's dormant love for Kṛṣṇa in every circumstance. By the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka could understand that the material benefits he had achieved were not the ultimate result of meditating upon His lotus feet. The true result comes when one is detached from material opulences. Therefore Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka prayed to the Lord for such detachment.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.138
description: "Your real mercy has been granted to Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya, for You have detached them from all material opulence. I think that I have not been favored by such mercy.
text:
> rāma-rāye, vāṇīnāthe kailā 'nirviṣaya'
> sei kṛpā mote nāhi, yāte aiche haya!
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāma]]-[[synonyms:r:rāye]]---Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnāthe]]---Vāṇīnātha; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---You have made; [[synonyms:n:nirviṣaya]]---free from all material attachment; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---that mercy; [[synonyms:m:mote]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---I have not received; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:a:aiche]]---such; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is.
translation: "Your real mercy has been granted to Rāmānanda Rāya and Vāṇīnātha Rāya, for You have detached them from all material opulence. I think that I have not been favored by such mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.139
description: "Kindly bestow upon me Your pure mercy so that I may also become renounced. I am no longer interested in material enjoyment."
text:
> śuddha kṛpā kara, gosāñi, ghucāha 'viṣaya'
> nirviṇṇa ha-inu, mote 'viṣaya' nā haya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]] [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---pure mercy; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---kindly bestow; [[synonyms:g:gosāñi]]---my Lord; [[synonyms:g:ghucāha]] [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---let me be free from all these material opulences; [[synonyms:n:nirviṇṇa]]---detached; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:inu]]---I have become; [[synonyms:m:mote]] [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---I am no longer interested in material opulences.
translation: "Kindly bestow upon me Your pure mercy so that I may also become renounced. I am no longer interested in material enjoyment."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.14
description: "He has placed swords beneath the platform," they said, "and will throw Gopīnātha upon them. O Lord, only if You protect him will he be saved.
text:
> tale khaḍga pāti' tāre upare ḍāribe
> prabhu rakṣā karena yabe, tabe nistāribe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tale]]---underneath; [[synonyms:k:khaḍga]]---swords; [[synonyms:p:pāti']]---setting; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāribe]]---he will throw; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rakṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---will protect; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:n:nistāribe]]---he will be saved.
translation: "He has placed swords beneath the platform," they said, "and will throw Gopīnātha upon them. O Lord, only if You protect him will he be saved.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.140
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you all adopt the renounced order and lose interest in dealing with pounds, shillings and pence, who will take charge of maintaining your large family?
text:
> prabhu kahe,---sannyāsī yabe ha-ibā pañca-jana
> kuṭumba-bāhulya tomāra ke kare bharaṇa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---//sannyāsīs//; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ibā]]---will be; [[synonyms:p:pañca]]-[[synonyms:j:jana]]---five persons; [[synonyms:k:kuṭumba]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhulya]]---the many members of the family; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your; [[synonyms:k:ke]]---who; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:b:bharaṇa]]---will maintain.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "If you all adopt the renounced order and lose interest in dealing with pounds, shillings and pence, who will take charge of maintaining your large family?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.141
description: "Whether you are involved in material activities or become completely renounced, you five brothers are all My eternal servants, birth after birth.
text:
> mahā-viṣaya kara, kibā virakta udāsa
> janme-janme tumi pañca---mora 'nija-dāsa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---great material engagements; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---you perform; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---or; [[synonyms:v:virakta]]---renounced; [[synonyms:u:udāsa]]---free from attachment; [[synonyms:j:janme]]-[[synonyms:j:janme]]---birth after birth; [[synonyms:t:tumi]] [[synonyms:p:pañca]]---you five; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---own servants.
translation: "Whether you are involved in material activities or become completely renounced, you five brothers are all My eternal servants, birth after birth.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that one should remember that he is eternally a servant of Kṛṣṇa. Whether one is engaged in material activity involving pounds, shillings and pence or is in the renounced order, he should always think that he is an eternal servant of God, for that is the real position of the living being. Taking //sannyāsa// and dealing in pounds, shillings and pence are both external affairs. One should always consider how to please and satisfy Kṛṣṇa. Thus even if one is involved in great material affairs, he will not become attached. As soon as one forgets that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he becomes involved in material attachments. However, if one is always conscious that Kṛṣṇa is always the supreme master and that he is an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he is a liberated person in any condition. Entangling material activities will not affect him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.142
description: "However, just obey one order from Me. Do not spend any of the King's revenue.
text:
> kintu mora kariha eka 'ājñā' pālana
> 'vyaya nā kariha kichu rājāra mūla-dhana'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kintu]]---but; [[synonyms:m:mora]]---My; [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---just carry out; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]]---order; [[synonyms:p:pālana]]---obedience to; [[synonyms:v:vyaya]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---never spend; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]] [[synonyms:m:mūla]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---capital of the King.
translation: "However, just obey one order from Me. Do not spend any of the King's revenue.
purport: When a person forgets his position as an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa, he commits many sinful activities, but one who maintains his position as an eternal servant of Kṛṣṇa cannot deviate from the path of morality, religion and ethics. At the present, people all over the world, especially in India, have forgotten their relationship with the Supreme Personality of Godhead and His eternal servants. Therefore the principles of morality, religion and ethics have almost disappeared. This situation is most unprofitable for human society. Therefore everyone should try to accept Kṛṣṇa consciousness and follow the principles of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.143
description: "First you should pay the revenue due the King, and then you may spend the balance for religious and fruitive activities.
text:
> rājāra mūla-dhana diyā ye kichu labhya haya
> sei dhana kariha nānā dharme-karme vyaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:m:mūla]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---revenue; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---after paying; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:l:labhya]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---whatever is obtained; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---money; [[synonyms:k:kariha]] [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:d:dharme]]-[[synonyms:k:karme]] [[synonyms:v:vyaya]]---spend in various types of religious and fruitive activities.
translation: "First you should pay the revenue due the King, and then you may spend the balance for religious and fruitive activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.144
description: "Don't spend a farthing for sinful activities for which you will be the loser both in this life and the next." After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade them farewell.
text:
> asad-vyaya nā kariha,---yāte dui-loka yāya"
> eta bali' sabākāre dilena vidāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:asat]]-[[synonyms:v:vyaya]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:k:kariha]]---do not spend for sinful activities; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---by which; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:loka]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---one loses this life and the next; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:s:sabākāre]]---to all of them; [[synonyms:d:dilena]] [[synonyms:v:vidāya]]---bade farewell.
translation: "Don't spend a farthing for sinful activities for which you will be the loser both in this life and the next." After saying this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu bade them farewell.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.145
description: Thus the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was spoken of in the family of Bhavānanda Rāya. That mercy was clearly demonstrated, although it appeared to be something different.
text:
> rāyera ghare prabhura 'kṛpā-vivarta' kahila
> bhakta-vātsalya-guṇa yāte vyakta haila
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāyera]]---of Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---at the home; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]-[[synonyms:v:vivarta]]---mercy appearing as something else; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---spoke; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]-[[synonyms:g:guṇa]]---the quality of being very affectionate to the devotees,; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---in which; [[synonyms:v:vyakta]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---was revealed.
translation: Thus the mercy of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was spoken of in the family of Bhavānanda Rāya. That mercy was clearly demonstrated, although it appeared to be something different.
purport: The result of advancement in spiritual knowledge is not material improvement, but Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu advised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka how to use material opulence without incurring reactions to sinful life. From this advice, it appeared that the Lord encouraged Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka to enhance his material condition. Actually, however, He did not. In fact, this was but a manifestation of His great affection for His devotee.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.146
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and bade them farewell. Then all the devotees got up and left, loudly chanting the holy name of Hari.
text:
> sabāya āliṅgiyā prabhu vidāya yabe dilā
> hari-dhvani kari' saba bhakta uṭhi' gelā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sabāya]]---all of them; [[synonyms:ā:āliṅgiyā]]---embracing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vidāya]]---farewell; [[synonyms:y:yabe]] [[synonyms:d:dilā]]---when He gave; [[synonyms:h:hari]]-[[synonyms:d:dhvani]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---chanting the holy name of Hari; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---all devotees; [[synonyms:u:uṭhi']]---getting up; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---left.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu embraced them all and bade them farewell. Then all the devotees got up and left, loudly chanting the holy name of Hari.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.147
description: Seeing the extraordinary mercy the Lord granted to the family of Bhavānanda Rāya, everyone was struck with wonder. They could not understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> prabhura kṛpā dekhi' sabāra haila camatkāra
> tāhārā bujhite nāre prabhura vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]] [[synonyms:h:haila]] [[synonyms:c:camatkāra]]---everyone became struck with wonder; [[synonyms:t:tāhārā]]---they; [[synonyms:b:bujhite]] [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---could not understand; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Seeing the extraordinary mercy the Lord granted to the family of Bhavānanda Rāya, everyone was struck with wonder. They could not understand the behavior of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.148
description: Indeed, when all the devotees had requested the Lord to bestow His mercy upon Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the Lord had replied that He could do nothing.
text:
> tārā sabe yadi kṛpā karite sādhila
> 'āmā' haite kichu nahe---prabhu tabe kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tārā]]---they; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to show mercy; [[synonyms:s:sādhila]]---requested; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---I cannot do anything; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---replied.
translation: Indeed, when all the devotees had requested the Lord to bestow His mercy upon Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the Lord had replied that He could do nothing.
purport: When a person is sinful, he loses both the chance for spiritual advancement and the chance for material opulence. If one enjoys the material world for sense gratification, he is certainly doomed. Advancement in material opulence is not the direct mercy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead; nevertheless, it indicates the indirect mercy of the Lord, for even a person too attached to material prosperity can gradually be detached and raised to the spiritual platform. Then he can offer causeless, purified service to the Lord. When Śrī Caitanya said, //āmā haite kichu nahe// ("It is not My business to do anything"), He set the ideal example for a person in the renounced order. If a //sannyāsī// takes the side of a //viṣayī,// a person engaged in mater al activities, his character will be criticized. A person in the renounced order should not take interest in material activities, but if he does so out of affection for a particular person, that should be considered his special mercy.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.149
description: I have simply described the chastisement of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's indifference. But the deep meaning of this behavior is very difficult to understand.
text:
> gopīnāthera nindā, āra āpana-nirveda
> ei-mātra kahila---ihāra nā bujhibe bheda
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthera]] [[synonyms:n:nindā]]---the chastisement of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:ā:āpana]]-[[synonyms:n:nirveda]]---His indifference; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mātra]]---simply; [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---I have described; [[synonyms:i:ihāra]]---of this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:b:bujhibe]] [[synonyms:b:bheda]]---one cannot understand the depth of meaning.
translation: I have simply described the chastisement of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's indifference. But the deep meaning of this behavior is very difficult to understand.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.15
description: "Bhavānanda Rāya and his entire family are your servants. Therefore it is quite fitting for You to save the son of Bhavānanda Rāya."
text:
> savaṁśe tomāra sevaka---bhavānanda-rāya
> tāṅra putra---tomāra sevake rākhite yuyāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:v:vaṁśe]]---with his family; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---servant; [[synonyms:b:bhavānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāya]]---Bhavānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:putra]]---his son; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevake]]---Your servant; [[synonyms:r:rākhite]]---to protect; [[synonyms:y:yuyāya]]---is quite fit.
translation: "Bhavānanda Rāya and his entire family are your servants. Therefore it is quite fitting for You to save the son of Bhavānanda Rāya."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.150
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave so much to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka without directly making requests of either Kāśī Miśra or the King.
text:
> kāśī-miśre nā sādhila, rājāre nā sādhila
> udyoga vinā mahāprabhu eta phala dila
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśre]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:s:sādhila]]---He did not request; [[synonyms:r:rājāre]]---the King; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:s:sādhila]]---He did not request; [[synonyms:u:udyoga]] [[synonyms:v:vinā]]---without endeavor; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eta]]---such; [[synonyms:p:phala]]---result; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu gave so much to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka without directly making requests of either Kāśī Miśra or the King.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.151
description: The intentions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are so deep that one can understand them only if he has complete faith in service to the lotus feet of the Lord.
text:
> caitanya-caritra ei parama gambhīra
> sei bujhe' tāṅra pade yāṅra mana 'dhīra'
synonyms: [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritra]]---behavior of Lord Caitanya; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:p:parama]] [[synonyms:g:gambhīra]]---very grave; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:b:bujhe]]---he understands; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:p:pade]]---upon His lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]]---whose; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:d:dhīra]]---sober.
translation: The intentions of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu are so deep that one can understand them only if he has complete faith in service to the lotus feet of the Lord.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.152
description: Whether or not one understands it, if one hears of this incident concerning Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's activities and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy upon him, certainly he will be promoted to the platform of ecstatic love for the Lord, and for him all dangers will be nullified.
text:
> yei ihāṅ śune prabhura vātsalya-prakāśa
> prema-bhakti pāya, tāṅra vipada yāya nāśa
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]]---one who; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---this; [[synonyms:ś:śune]]---hears; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:v:vātsalya]]-[[synonyms:p:prakāśa]]---manifestation of special affection; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakti]]---loving devotional service; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---attains; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]]---his; [[synonyms:v:vipada]]---dangerous condition of life; [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:n:nāśa]]---is destroyed.
translation: Whether or not one understands it, if one hears of this incident concerning Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka's activities and Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy upon him, certainly he will be promoted to the platform of ecstatic love for the Lord, and for him all dangers will be nullified.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.153
description: Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.
text:
> śrī-rūpa-raghunātha pade yāra āśa
> śrī-caitanya-caritāmṛta kahe kṛṣṇadāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:r:rūpa]]---Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:r:raghunātha]]---Śrīla Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī; [[synonyms:p:pade]]---at the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yāra]]---whose; [[synonyms:ā:āśa]]---expectation; [[synonyms:c:caitanya]]-[[synonyms:c:caritāmṛta]]---the book named //Caitanya-caritāmṛta//; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---describes; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇadāsa]]---Śrīla Kṛṣṇadāsa Kavirāja Gosvāmī.
translation:
Praying at the lotus feet of Śrī Rūpa and Śrī Raghunātha, always desiring their mercy, I, Kṛṣṇadāsa, narrate Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, following in their footsteps.


//Thus end the Bhaktivedanta purports to Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā,  Ninth Chapter, describing the deliverance of Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and the manifestation of Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's causeless mercy to His devotee.//

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.16
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "Why is the King chastising him?" Thereupon the people described the entire incident.
text:
> prabhu kahe,---'rājā kene karaye tāḍana?'
> tabe sei loka kahe saba vivaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:k:karaye]] [[synonyms:t:tāḍana]]---punishes; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---thereupon; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:l:loka]]---those persons; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---stated; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---all of the description.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired, "Why is the King chastising him?" Thereupon the people described the entire incident.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.17
description: They said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, has always been a treasurer for the government.
text:
> "gopīnātha-paṭṭanāyaka---rāmānanda-bhāi
> sarva-kāla haya teṅha rāja-viṣayī
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭṭanāyaka]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---a brother of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:s:sarva]]-[[synonyms:k:kāla]]---always; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣayī]]---treasurer of the King.
translation: They said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka, the brother of Rāmānanda Rāya, has always been a treasurer for the government.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.18
description: "He served in the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāta, soliciting and collecting money there and depositing it in the government treasury.
text:
> 'mālajāṭhyā-daṇḍapāṭe' tāra adhikāra
> sādhi' pāḍi' āni' dravya dila rāja-dvāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:mālajāṭhyā]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍapāṭe]]---in the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāta; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:a:adhikāra]]---authority; [[synonyms:s:sādhi']]---soliciting; [[synonyms:p:pāḍi']]---collecting; [[synonyms:ā:āni']]---bringing; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---the money; [[synonyms:d:dila]]---gave; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāra]]---to the door of the King.
translation: "He served in the place known as Mālajāṭhyā Daṇḍapāta, soliciting and collecting money there and depositing it in the government treasury.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.19
description: "Once when he deposited the collection, however, a balance of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells was due from him. Therefore the King demanded this sum.
text:
> dui-lakṣa kāhana tāra ṭhāñi bākī ha-ila
> dui-lakṣa kāhana kauḍi rājā ta' māgila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]]---200,000 //kāhanas// of //kauḍis// (one //kāhana// equals 1280 //kauḍis//); [[synonyms:t:tāraṭhāñi]]---from him; [[synonyms:b:bākī]] [[synonyms:h:ha]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---there was a balance due; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:k:kāhana]]---200,000 //kāhanas//; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---conchshells; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:t:ta']]---certainly; [[synonyms:m:māgila]]---demanded.
translation: "Once when he deposited the collection, however, a balance of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells was due from him. Therefore the King demanded this sum.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.2
description: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the most merciful incarnation! All glories to Lord Nityānanda, whose heart is always compassionate!
text:
> jaya jaya śrī-kṛṣṇa-caitanya dayāmaya
> jaya jaya nityānanda karuṇa-hṛdaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:c:caitanya]]---to Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---merciful; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:n:nityānanda]]---to Lord Nityānanda; [[synonyms:k:karuṇa]]-[[synonyms:h:hṛdaya]]---whose heart is very compassionate.
translation: All glories to Śrī Kṛṣṇa Caitanya Mahāprabhu, the most merciful incarnation! All glories to Lord Nityānanda, whose heart is always compassionate!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.20
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka replied,'There is no money I can immediately give you in cash. Please give me time. Gradually I shall purchase and sell my gross goods and in this way fill your treasury.
text:
> teṅha kahe,---"sthūla-dravya nāhi ye gaṇi' diba
> krame-krame veci' kini' dravya bhariba
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---he replied; [[synonyms:s:sthūla]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]]---cash money; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]]---there is not; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---which; [[synonyms:g:gaṇi']]---counting; [[synonyms:d:diba]]---I can give; [[synonyms:k:krame]]-[[synonyms:k:krame]]---gradually; [[synonyms:v:veci']] [[synonyms:k:kini']]---purchasing and selling; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---goods; [[synonyms:b:bhariba]]---I shall fill.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka replied,'There is no money I can immediately give you in cash. Please give me time. Gradually I shall purchase and sell my gross goods and in this way fill your treasury.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.21
description: "There are ten to twelve good horses. Take them immediately for a proper price.' After saying this, he brought all the horses to the door of the King.
text:
> ghoḍā daśa-bāra haya, laha' mūlya kari' "
> eta bali' ghoḍā āne rāja-dvāre dhari'
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]]---horses; [[synonyms:d:daśa]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---ten to twelve; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there are; [[synonyms:l:laha']]---take; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---on the proper value; [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]] [[synonyms:ā:āne]]---he brought the horses; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dvāre]] [[synonyms:d:dhari']]---keeping at the door of the King.
translation: "There are ten to twelve good horses. Take them immediately for a proper price.' After saying this, he brought all the horses to the door of the King.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.22
description: "One of the princes knew how to estimate the price of horses very well. Thus the King sent for him to come with his ministers and friends.
text:
> eka rāja-putra ghoḍāra mūlya bhāla jāne
> tāre pāṭhāila rājā pātra-mitra sane
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]---prince; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍāra]] [[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---the price of horses; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---well; [[synonyms:j:jāne]]---knows; [[synonyms:t:tāre]] [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent for him; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:p:pātra]]-[[synonyms:m:mitra]] [[synonyms:s:sane]]---accompanied by ministers and friends.
translation: "One of the princes knew how to estimate the price of horses very well. Thus the King sent for him to come with his ministers and friends.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.23
description: "The prince, however, purposely gave a reduced estimate for the value of the horses. When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka heard the price quoted, he was very angry.
text:
> sei rāja-putra mūlya kare ghāṭāñā
> gopīnāthera krodha haila mūlya śuniyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---that; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]---prince; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---price; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---estimates; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭāñā]]---reducing; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthera]]---of Gopīnātha; [[synonyms:k:krodha]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---there was anger; [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing the price.
translation: "The prince, however, purposely gave a reduced estimate for the value of the horses. When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka heard the price quoted, he was very angry.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.24
description: "That prince had a personal idiosyncrasy of turning his neck and facing the sky, looking here and there again and again.
text:
> sei rāja-putrera svabhāva,---grīvā phirāya
> ūrdhva-mukhe bāra-bāra iti-uti cāya
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:putrera]]---of that prince; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāva]]---characteristic; [[synonyms:g:grīvā]] [[synonyms:p:phirāya]]---turns his neck; [[synonyms:ū:ūrdhva]]-[[synonyms:m:mukhe]]---with his face toward the sky; [[synonyms:b:bāra]]-[[synonyms:b:bāra]]---again and again; [[synonyms:i:iti]]-[[synonyms:u:uti]]---here and there; [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---looks.
translation: "That prince had a personal idiosyncrasy of turning his neck and facing the sky, looking here and there again and again.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.25
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka criticized the prince. He was unafraid of the prince because the King was very kind toward him.
text:
> tāre nindā kari' kahe sagarva vacane
> rājā kṛpā kare tāte bhaya nāhi māne
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:n:nindā]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---criticizing; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---said; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:g:garva]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---words full of pride; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---was very kind to him; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:b:bhaya]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:m:māne]]---he was not afraid.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka criticized the prince. He was unafraid of the prince because the King was very kind toward him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.26
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka said, 'My horses never turn their necks or look upward. Therefore the price for them should not be reduced.'
text:
> 'āmāra ghoḍā grīvā nā phirāya ūrdhve nāhi cāya
> tāte ghoḍāra mūlya ghāṭi karite nā yuyāya'
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āmāra]] [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]]---my horses; [[synonyms:g:grīvā]]---the neck; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:p:phirāya]]---do not turn; [[synonyms:ū:ūrdhve]]---upward; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:c:cāya]]---do not look; [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---because of this; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍāra]] [[synonyms:m:mūlya]]---the price of the horse; [[synonyms:g:ghāṭi]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to reduce; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yuyāya]]---is not proper.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka said, 'My horses never turn their necks or look upward. Therefore the price for them should not be reduced.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.27
description: "Hearing this criticism, the prince became very angry. Going before the King, he made some false allegations against Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.
text:
> śuni' rājaputra-mane krodha upajila
> rājāra ṭhāñi yāi' bahu lāgāni karila
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]---of the prince; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:k:krodha]]---anger; [[synonyms:u:upajila]]---arose; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---before the King; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:b:bahu]] [[synonyms:l:lāgāni]] [[synonyms:k:karila]]---made many false allegations.
translation: "Hearing this criticism, the prince became very angry. Going before the King, he made some false allegations against Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.28
description: "This Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka,' he said,'is unwilling to pay the money due. Instead, he is squandering it under some pretext. If you issue an order, I can put him on the cāṅga and thus realize the money.'
text:
> "kauḍi nāhi dibe ei, beḍāya chadma kari'
> ājñā deha yadi,---'cāṅge caḍāñā la-i kauḍi'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---the money; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---will not pay; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this man; [[synonyms:b:beḍāya]]---wanders; [[synonyms:c:chadma]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---on some pretext; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha]] [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if you order; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]] [[synonyms:c:caḍāñā]]---raising on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:i]] [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---I shall get the money.
translation: "This Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka,' he said,'is unwilling to pay the money due. Instead, he is squandering it under some pretext. If you issue an order, I can put him on the cāṅga and thus realize the money.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.29
description: "The King replied, 'You can adopt whatever means you think best. Any device by which you can somehow or other realize the money is all right.'
text:
> rājā bale,---"yei bhāla, sei kara yāya
> ye upāye kauḍi pāi, kara se upāya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:b:bale]]---the King said; [[synonyms:y:yei]] [[synonyms:b:bhāla]]---whatever is best; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do that; [[synonyms:y:yāya]]---going; [[synonyms:y:ye]] [[synonyms:u:upāye]]---by whatever means; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:p:pāi]]---I can get back our money; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---do; [[synonyms:s:se]] [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---such means.
translation: "The King replied, 'You can adopt whatever means you think best. Any device by which you can somehow or other realize the money is all right.'

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.3
description: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is very merciful! All glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who are always overwhelmed by transcendental bliss!
text:
> jayādvaitācārya jaya jaya dayāmaya
> jaya gaura-bhakta-gaṇa saba rasamaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:a:advaita]]-[[synonyms:ā:ācārya]]---to Advaita Ācārya; [[synonyms:j:jaya]] [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:d:dayā]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---merciful; [[synonyms:j:jaya]]---all glories; [[synonyms:g:gaura]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:r:rasa]]-[[synonyms:m:maya]]---overwhelmed by transcendental bliss.
translation: All glories to Advaita Ācārya, who is very merciful! All glories to the devotees of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, who are always overwhelmed by transcendental bliss!

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.30
description: "Thus the prince went back, raised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka onto the platform of the cāṅga and spread swords below upon which to throw him."
text:
> rāja-putra āsi' tāre cāṅge caḍāila
> khaḍaga-upare phelāite tale khaḍaga pātila"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:p:putra]]---the prince; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]]---on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:c:caḍāila]]---raised; [[synonyms:k:khaḍaga]]-[[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon the swords; [[synonyms:p:phelāite]]---to throw; [[synonyms:t:tale]]---below; [[synonyms:k:khaḍaga]] [[synonyms:p:pātila]]---he spread swords.
translation: "Thus the prince went back, raised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka onto the platform of the cāṅga and spread swords below upon which to throw him."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.31
description: After hearing this explanation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied with affectionate anger. "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka does not want to pay dues to the King," the Lord said."How then is the King at fault in punishing him?
text:
> śuni' prabhu kahe kichu kari' praṇaya-roṣa
> "rāja-kauḍi dite nāre, rājāra kibā doṣa?
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---some; [[synonyms:k:kari']] [[synonyms:p:praṇaya]]-[[synonyms:r:roṣa]]---displaying anger in affection; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---money due the government; [[synonyms:d:dite]] [[synonyms:n:nāre]]---does not wish to pay; [[synonyms:r:rājāra]]---of the King; [[synonyms:k:kibā]] [[synonyms:d:doṣa]]---what is the fault.
translation: After hearing this explanation, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied with affectionate anger. "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka does not want to pay dues to the King," the Lord said."How then is the King at fault in punishing him?

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.32
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is in charge of collecting money on behalf of the government, but he misappropriates it. Not fearing the King, he squanders it to see dancing girls.
text:
> rāja-bilāt sādhi' khāya, nāhi rāja-bhaya
> dārī-nāṭuyāre diyā kare nānā vyaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:b:bilāt]]---money due the King; [[synonyms:s:sādhi']]---collecting; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---he uses; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:b:bhaya]]---without fear of the King; [[synonyms:d:dārī]]-[[synonyms:n:nāṭuyāre]]---to dancing girls; [[synonyms:d:diyā]]---giving; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---makes; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]---various; [[synonyms:v:vyaya]]---expenditures.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is in charge of collecting money on behalf of the government, but he misappropriates it. Not fearing the King, he squanders it to see dancing girls.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.33
description: "If one is intelligent, let him perform service to the government, and after paying the government, he can spend whatever money is left."
text:
> yei catura, sei kuruka rāja-viṣaya
> rāja-dravya śodhi' pāya, tāra karuka vyaya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yei]]---one who; [[synonyms:c:catura]]---intelligent; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---such a person; [[synonyms:k:kuruka]]---let him do; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---government service; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:ś:śodhi']]---after paying the dues of the government; [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---whatever he gets; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:k:karuka]] [[synonyms:v:vyaya]]---let him spend that.
translation: "If one is intelligent, let him perform service to the government, and after paying the government, he can spend whatever money is left."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.34
description: At that time another person came there in great haste, bringing the news that Vāṇīnātha Rāya and his entire family had been arrested.
text:
> hena-kāle āra loka āila dhāñā
> 'vāṇīnāthādi savaṁśe lañā gela bāndhiyā'
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---person; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---in great haste; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with Vāṇīnātha; [[synonyms:s:sa]]-[[synonyms:v:vaṁśe]] [[synonyms:l:lañā]]---with his family; [[synonyms:g:gela]] [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]]---was arrested.
translation: At that time another person came there in great haste, bringing the news that Vāṇīnātha Rāya and his entire family had been arrested.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.35
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The King must personally realize the dues. I am but a sannyāsī, a member of the renounced order. What can I do?"
text:
> prabhu kahe,---"rājā āpane lekhāra dravya la-iba
> āmi---virakta sannyāsī, tāhe ki kariba?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:ā:āpane]]---personally; [[synonyms:l:lekhāra]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---dues of the proper account; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:iba]]---will take; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:v:virakta]] [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---a renounced //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:t:tāhe]]---about that; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kariba]]---what can I do.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, "The King must personally realize the dues. I am but a sannyāsī, a member of the renounced order. What can I do?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.36
description: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted the following plea.
text:
> tabe svarūpādi yata prabhura bhakta-gaṇa
> prabhura caraṇe sabe kailā nivedana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:s:svarūpa]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]---beginning with Svarūpa Dāmodara; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---devotees; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of the Lord; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all of them; [[synonyms:k:kailā]] [[synonyms:n:nivedana]]---submitted.
translation: Then all the devotees, headed by Svarūpa Dāmodara Gosvāmī, fell at the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and submitted the following plea.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.37
description: "All the members of Rāmānanda Rāya's family are Your eternal servants. Now they are in danger. It is not befitting for You to be indifferent to them in this way."
text:
> "rāmānanda-rāyera goṣṭhī, saba---tomāra 'dāsa'
> tomāra ucita nahe aichana udāsa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānanda]]-[[synonyms:r:rāyera]]---of Rāmānanda Rāya; [[synonyms:g:goṣṭhī]]---family; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:d:dāsa]]---Your servants; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---for You; [[synonyms:u:ucita]]---befitting; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:a:aichana]]---such; [[synonyms:u:udāsa]]---indifference.
translation: "All the members of Rāmānanda Rāya's family are Your eternal servants. Now they are in danger. It is not befitting for You to be indifferent to them in this way."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.38
description: After hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke in an angry mood. "You want to order Me to go to the King," He said.
text:
> śuni' mahāprabhu kahe sakrodha vacane
> "more ājñā deha' sabe, yāṅa rāja-sthāne!
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---says; [[synonyms:s:sakrodha]] [[synonyms:v:vacane]]---angry words; [[synonyms:m:more]]---Me; [[synonyms:ā:ājñā]] [[synonyms:d:deha']]---you order; [[synonyms:s:sabe]]---all; [[synonyms:y:yāṅa]]---I shall go; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:s:sthāne]]---to the place of the King.
translation: After hearing this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu spoke in an angry mood. "You want to order Me to go to the King," He said.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.39
description: "Your opinion is that I should go to the King's palace and spread My cloth to beg money from him.
text:
> tomā-sabāra ei mata,---rāja-ṭhāñi yāñā
> kauḍi māgi' laṅ muñi āṅcala pātiyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomā]]-[[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all of you; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:m:mata]]---this is the opinion; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]] [[synonyms:y:yāñā]]---going to the King; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging //kauḍis//; [[synonyms:l:laṅ]]---shall take; [[synonyms:m:muñi]]---I; [[synonyms:ā:āṅcala]] [[synonyms:p:pātiyā]]---spreading My cloth.
translation: "Your opinion is that I should go to the King's palace and spread My cloth to beg money from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.4
description: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived at Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] with His personal devotees, always merged in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.
text:
> ei-mata mahāprabhu bhakta-gaṇa-saṅge
> nīlācale vāsa karena kṛṣṇa-prema-raṅge
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ei]]-[[synonyms:m:mata]]---in this way; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:b:bhakta]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]-[[synonyms:s:saṅge]]---along with His devotees; [[synonyms:n:nīlācale]]---at Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:v:vāsa]] [[synonyms:k:karena]]---resides; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:r:raṅge]]---overwhelmed by the ecstatic love of Lord Kṛṣṇa.
translation: Thus Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu lived at Nīlācala [Jagannātha Purī] with His personal devotees, always merged in ecstatic love for Kṛṣṇa.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.40
description: "Of course, a sannyāsī or brāhmaṇa may beg for up to five gaṇḍās, but why should he be granted the inappropriate sum of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells?"
text:
> pāṅca-gaṇḍāra pātra haya sannyāsī brāhmaṇa
> māgile vā kene dibe dui-lakṣa kāhana?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pāṅca]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇḍāra]]---of five //gaṇḍās//; [[synonyms:p:pātra]]---due recipients; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---are; [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]] [[synonyms:b:brāhmaṇa]]---//sannyāsīs// and //brāhmaṇas//; [[synonyms:m:māgile]]---by begging; [[synonyms:v:vā]]---or; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---shall give; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:k:kāhana]]---200,000 //kāhanas// of //kauḍis.//
translation: "Of course, a sannyāsī or brāhmaṇa may beg for up to five gaṇḍās, but why should he be granted the inappropriate sum of 200,000 kāhanas of conchshells?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.41
description: Then another person came with the news that Gopīnātha had already been set up to be thrown upon the points of the swords.
text:
> hena-kāle āra loka āila dhāñā
> khaḍegara upare gopīnāthe diteche ḍāriyā
synonyms: [[synonyms:h:hena]]-[[synonyms:k:kāle]]---at this time; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:l:loka]]---person; [[synonyms:ā:āila]]---came; [[synonyms:d:dhāñā]]---running; [[synonyms:k:khaḍegara]] [[synonyms:u:upare]]---upon the swords; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthe]]---Gopīnātha; [[synonyms:d:diteche]] [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍāriyā]]---they are throwing.
translation: Then another person came with the news that Gopīnātha had already been set up to be thrown upon the points of the swords.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.42
description: Hearing this news, all the devotees again appealed to the Lord, but the Lord replied, "I am a beggar. It is impossible for Me to do anything about this.
text:
> śuni' prabhura gaṇa prabhure kare anunaya
> prabhu kahe,---"āmi bhikṣuka, āmā haite kichu naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---the devotees of the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:a:anunaya]]---entreated the Lord; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]] [[synonyms:b:bhikṣuka]]---I am a beggar; [[synonyms:ā:āmā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]] [[synonyms:k:kichu]] [[synonyms:n:naya]]---it is not possible for Me to do anything.
translation: Hearing this news, all the devotees again appealed to the Lord, but the Lord replied, "I am a beggar. It is impossible for Me to do anything about this.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.43
description: "Therefore if you want to save him, you should all pray together at the lotus feet of Jagannātha.
text:
> tāte rakṣā karite yadi haya sabāra mane
> sabe meli' jānāha jagannāthera caraṇe
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāte]]---therefore; [[synonyms:r:rakṣā]] [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to save; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sabāra]]---of all; [[synonyms:m:mane]]---in the mind; [[synonyms:s:sabe]] [[synonyms:m:meli']]---all together; [[synonyms:j:jānāha]]---pray; [[synonyms:j:jagannāthera]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇe]]---at the lotus feet of Lord Jagannātha.
translation: "Therefore if you want to save him, you should all pray together at the lotus feet of Jagannātha.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.44
description: "Lord Jagannātha is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He possesses all potencies. Therefore He is able to act freely and can do and undo whatever He likes."
text:
> īśvara jagannātha,---yāṅra hāte sarva 'artha'
> kartum akartum anyathā karite samartha"
synonyms: [[synonyms:ī:īśvara]]---the Supreme Personality of Godhead; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:y:yāṅra]] [[synonyms:h:hāte]]---within His hands; [[synonyms:s:sarva]] [[synonyms:a:artha]]---all potencies; [[synonyms:k:kartum]]---to do; [[synonyms:a:akartum]]---not to do; [[synonyms:a:anyathā]]---and otherwise; [[synonyms:k:karite]]---to do; [[synonyms:s:samartha]]---able.
translation: "Lord Jagannātha is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. He possesses all potencies. Therefore He is able to act freely and can do and undo whatever He likes."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.45
description: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied in this way, an officer named Haricandana Pātra went to the King and spoke with him.
text:
> ihāṅ yadi mahāprabhu eteka kahilā
> haricandana-pātra yāi' rājāre kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---when; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:e:eteka]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---spoke like this; [[synonyms:h:haricandana]]-[[synonyms:p:pātra]]---the officer named Haricandana Pātra; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:r:rājāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---informed the King.
translation: When Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu replied in this way, an officer named Haricandana Pātra went to the King and spoke with him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.46
description: "After all," he said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is your faithful servant. To condemn a servant to death is not good behavior.
text:
> "gopīnātha-paṭṭanāyaka---sevaka tomāra
> sevakera prāṇa-daṇḍa nahe vyavahāra
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭṭanāyaka]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]] [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---your servant; [[synonyms:s:sevakera]] [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---to condemn a servant to death; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]]---good behavior.
translation: "After all," he said, "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is your faithful servant. To condemn a servant to death is not good behavior.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.47
description: "His only fault is that he owes some money to the government. If he is killed, however, what profit will there be? The government will be the loser, for it will not get the money.
text:
> viśeṣa tāhāra ṭhāñi kauḍi bākī haya
> prāṇa nile kibā lābha? nija dhana-kṣaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:v:viśeṣa]]---particular; [[synonyms:t:tāhāra]] [[synonyms:ṭ:ṭhāñi]]---from him; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---of //kauḍis//; [[synonyms:b:bākī]]---debt; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---there is; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]] [[synonyms:n:nile]]---if he is killed; [[synonyms:k:kibā]]---what; [[synonyms:l:lābha]]---profit; [[synonyms:n:nija]]---own; [[synonyms:d:dhana]]---wealth; [[synonyms:k:kṣaya]]---loss.
translation: "His only fault is that he owes some money to the government. If he is killed, however, what profit will there be? The government will be the loser, for it will not get the money.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.48
description: "It would be better to take the horses for a proper price and let him gradually repay the balance. Why are you killing him unnecessarily?"
text:
> yathārtha mūlye ghoḍā laha, yebā bākī haya
> krame krame dibe, vyartha prāṇa kene laya"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]] [[synonyms:m:mūlye]]---for the proper price; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]] [[synonyms:l:laha]]---accept the horses; [[synonyms:y:yebā]]---whatever; [[synonyms:b:bākī]] [[synonyms:h:haya]]---balance is due; [[synonyms:k:krame]] [[synonyms:k:krame]]---gradually; [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---he will give; [[synonyms:v:vyartha]]---unnecessarily; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---his life; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:l:laya]]---are you taking.
translation: "It would be better to take the horses for a proper price and let him gradually repay the balance. Why are you killing him unnecessarily?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.49
description: The King answered in surprise, "I did not know about all this. Why should his life be taken? I only want the money from him.
text:
> rājā kahe,---"ei vāt āmi nāhi jāni
> prāṇa kene la-iba, tāra dravya cāhi āmi
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King replied; [[synonyms:e:ei]] [[synonyms:v:vāt]]---this news; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:j:jāni]]---do not know; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---his life; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:iba]]---should I take; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---money; [[synonyms:c:cāhi]] [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I want.
translation: The King answered in surprise, "I did not know about all this. Why should his life be taken? I only want the money from him.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.5
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always felt waves of separation from Kṛṣṇa, externally and internally. His mind and body were agitated by various spiritual transformations.
text:
> antare-bāhire kṛṣṇa-viraha-taraṅga
> nānā-bhāve vyākula prabhura mana āra aṅga
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:antare]]-[[synonyms:b:bāhire]]---internally and externally; [[synonyms:k:kṛṣṇa]]-[[synonyms:v:viraha]]-[[synonyms:t:taraṅga]]---the waves of separation from Kṛṣṇa; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāve]]---by various ecstasies; [[synonyms:v:vyākula]]---agitated; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:m:mana]] [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:a:aṅga]]---mind and body.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu always felt waves of separation from Kṛṣṇa, externally and internally. His mind and body were agitated by various spiritual transformations.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.50
description: "Go there and adjust everything. I want only the payment, not his life."
text:
> tumi yāi' kara tāhāṅ sarva samādhāna
> dravya yaiche āise, āra rahe tāra prāṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---you; [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going; [[synonyms:k:kara]]---make; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:s:sarva]] [[synonyms:s:samādhāna]]---all adjustments; [[synonyms:d:dravya]]---goods; [[synonyms:y:yaiche]]---so that; [[synonyms:ā:āise]]---come; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---keeps; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]]---life.
translation: "Go there and adjust everything. I want only the payment, not his life."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.51
description: Haricandana then returned and informed the prince of the King's desire, and immediately Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was taken down from the cāṅga.
text:
> tabe haricandana āsi' jānāre kahila
> cāṅge haite gopīnāthe śīghra nāmāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:h:haricandana]]---Haricandana Pātra; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:j:jānāre]] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---informed the prince; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from the //cāṅga// platform; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthe]]---Gopīnātha; [[synonyms:ś:śīghra]]---very soon; [[synonyms:n:nāmāila]]---took down.
translation: Haricandana then returned and informed the prince of the King's desire, and immediately Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was taken down from the cāṅga.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.52
description: Then he was told that the King demanded the money due him and asked what means he would adopt to pay it. "Kindly take my horses," he replied, "for a proper price.
text:
> 'dravya deha' rājā māge---upāya puchila
> 'yathārtha-mūlye ghoḍā laha', teṅha ta' kahila
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:d:deha]]---pay the dues; [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:m:māge]]---the King asks; [[synonyms:u:upāya]]---the means; [[synonyms:p:puchila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]]-[[synonyms:m:mūlye]]---at a proper price; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]] [[synonyms:l:laha]]---take the horses; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]] [[synonyms:t:ta']] [[synonyms:k:kahila]]---he replied.
