translation: Then he was told that the King demanded the money due him and asked what means he would adopt to pay it. "Kindly take my horses," he replied, "for a proper price.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.53
description: "I shall gradually pay the balance as I can. Without consideration, however, you were going to take my life. What can I say?"
text:
> 'krame krame dimu, āra yata kichu pāri
> avicāre prāṇa laha,---ki balite pāri?'
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:krame]] [[synonyms:k:krame]]---gradually; [[synonyms:d:dimu]]---I shall pay; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---more; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---as much; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---any; [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---I can; [[synonyms:a:avicāre]]---without consideration; [[synonyms:p:prāṇa]] [[synonyms:l:laha]]---you take my life; [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:b:balite]] [[synonyms:p:pāri]]---what can I say.
translation: "I shall gradually pay the balance as I can. Without consideration, however, you were going to take my life. What can I say?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.54
description: Then the government took all the horses for a proper price, a time was set for payment of the balance, and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was released.
text:
> yathārtha mūlya kari' tabe saba ghoḍā la-ila
> āra dravyera muddatī kari' ghare pāṭhāila
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yathā]]-[[synonyms:a:artha]] [[synonyms:m:mūlya]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---estimating the proper price; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---then; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:g:ghoḍā]]---horses; [[synonyms:l:la]]-[[synonyms:i:ila]]---took; [[synonyms:ā:āra]] [[synonyms:d:dravyera]]---of the balance; [[synonyms:m:muddatī]] [[synonyms:k:kari']]---setting a time for payment; [[synonyms:g:ghare]] [[synonyms:p:pāṭhāila]]---sent home.
translation: Then the government took all the horses for a proper price, a time was set for payment of the balance, and Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was released.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.55
description: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the messenger, "What was Vāṇīnātha doing when he was arrested and brought there?"
text:
> ethā prabhu sei manuṣyere praśna kaila
> "vāṇīnātha ki kare, yabe bāndhiyā ānila?"
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:m:manuṣyere]]---unto that person who brought the message; [[synonyms:p:praśna]] [[synonyms:k:kaila]]---inquired; [[synonyms:v:vāṇīnātha]] [[synonyms:k:ki]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---what was Vāṇīnātha doing; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:b:bāndhiyā]] [[synonyms:ā:ānila]]---he was arrested and brought there.
translation: Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu inquired from the messenger, "What was Vāṇīnātha doing when he was arrested and brought there?"

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.56
description: The messenger replied, "He was fearlessly, incessantly chanting the mahā-mantra-Hare Kṛṣṇa, Hare Kṛṣṇa, Kṛṣṇa Kṛṣṇa, Hare Hare Hare Rāma, Hare Rāma, Rāma Rāma, Hare Hare.
text:
> se kahe---"vāṇīnātha nirbhaye laya kṛṣṇa-nāma
> 'hare kṛṣṇa, hare kṛṣṇa' kahe aviśrāma

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.65
description: "Jagannātha has saved him once from death today, but if tomorrow he again does not pay what he owes the treasury, who will give him protection?
text:
> āji tāre jagannātha karilā rakṣaṇa
> kāli ke rākhibe, yadi nā dibe rāja-dhana?
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]---Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:karilā]] [[synonyms:r:rakṣaṇa]]---protected; [[synonyms:k:kāli]]---tomorrow; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:r:rākhibe]]---who will protect; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:dibe]]---he will not pay; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the King's money.
translation: "Jagannātha has saved him once from death today, but if tomorrow he again does not pay what he owes the treasury, who will give him protection?
purport:
The Supreme Personality of Godhead will certainly protect a devotee who does something sinful accidentally. As the Lord says in //Bhagavad-gītā// [[books:bg:9:30|(9.30-31)]]:

> api cet sudurācāro
> bhajate mām ananya-bhāk
> sādhur eva sa mantavyaḥ
> saṁyag vyavasito hi saḥ
>
> kṣipraṁ bhavati dharmātmā
> śaśvac-chāntiṁ nigacchati
> kaunteya pratijānīhi
> na me bhaktaḥ praṇaśyati

"Even if one commits the most abominable actions, if he is engaged in devotional service, he is to be considered saintly because he is properly situated. He quickly becomes righteous and attains lasting peace. O son of Kuntī, declare it boldly that My devotee never perishes." However, if a devotee or so-called devotee purposefully commits sinful activities continually in the hope that Kṛṣṇa will give him protection, Kṛṣṇa will not protect him. Therefore Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu said, //kāli ke rākhibe, yadi nā dibe rāja-dhana?:// "Jagannātha has saved Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka from being killed by the King today, but if he commits the same offense again, who will give him protection?" Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu thus warns all such foolish devotees that Jagannātha will not protect them if they continue to commit offenses.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.68
description: "You are a renounced sannyāsī. What connections do You have? One who worships You for some material purpose is blind to all knowledge."
text:
> sannyāsī virakta tomāra kā-sane sambandha?
> vyavahāra lāgi' tomā bhaje, sei jñāna-andha
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sannyāsī]]---a //sannyāsī//; [[synonyms:v:virakta]]---one who has given up all connections with everyone; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:k:kā]]-[[synonyms:s:sane]]---with whom; [[synonyms:s:sambandha]]---relationship; [[synonyms:v:vyavahāra]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for some material purpose; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---worships You; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:j:jñāna]]-[[synonyms:a:andha]]---blind to all knowledge.
translation: "You are a renounced sannyāsī. What connections do You have? One who worships You for some material purpose is blind to all knowledge."
purport:
Becoming a devotee of the Lord to serve material purposes is a great mistake. Many people become showbottle devotees for material profits. indeed materialistic persons sometimes take to professional devotional service and keep Viṣṇu, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, as a means of livelihood. None of this, however, is approved. In the book known as //Sapta-śatī,// as mentioned by Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura, one can discover how a person worshiping the goddess Durgā begs her for different varieties of material profit. Such activities are very popular among people in general, but they are the attempts of foolish, blind people (//sei jñāna-andha).//

A materialist does not actually know why one should become a devotee. A devotee's only concern is to satisfy the Supreme Personality of Godhead. Pure devotional service is defined by Śrīla Rūpa Gosvāmī:

> anyābhilāṣitā-śūnyaṁ
> jñāna-karmādy-anāvṛtam
> ānukūlyena kṛṣṇānu-
> śīlanaṁ bhaktir uttamā

One should be completely free from all material desires and should serve Kṛṣṇa simply to please Him. When people become interested in their own sense gratification (//bhukti mukti siddhi kāmī),// some of them desire to enjoy the material world to the fullest extent, some of them desire to be liberated and merge into the existence of Brahman, and others want to perform magic through mystic power and thus become incarnations of God. These are all against the principles of devotional service. One must be free from all material desires. The desire of the impersonalist to merge into the existence of Brahman is also material because such an impersonalist wants to gratify his senses by merging into the existence of Kṛṣṇa instead of serving His lotus feet. Even if such a person merges into the Brahman effulgence, he falls down again into material existence. As stated in //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// [[books:sb:10:2:32|(10.2.32)]]:

> āruhya kṛcchreṇa paraṁ padaṁ tataḥ
> patanty adho 'nādṛta-yuṣmad-aṅghrayaḥ

Because Māyāvādī philosophers have no information regarding the transcendental service of the Lord, even after attaining liberation from material activities and merging in the Brahman effulgence, they must come down again to this material world.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.69
description: Kāśī Miśra continued, "If one engages in devotional service for Your satisfaction, this will result in his increasingly awakening his dormant love for You. But if one engages in Your devotional service for material purposes, he should be considered a number-one fool.
text:
> tomāra bhajana-phale tomāte 'prema-dhana'
> viṣaya lāgi' tomāya bhaje, sei mūrkha jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:b:bhajana]]---devotional service; [[synonyms:p:phale]]---by the result of; [[synonyms:t:tomāte]]---unto You; [[synonyms:p:prema]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---wealth of love; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for material profit; [[synonyms:t:tomāya]] [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---one engages in Your service; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:m:mūrkha]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---a fool.
translation: Kāśī Miśra continued, "If one engages in devotional service for Your satisfaction, this will result in his increasingly awakening his dormant love for You. But if one engages in Your devotional service for material purposes, he should be considered a number-one fool.
purport: Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura comments that there are many materialistic persons who become preachers, //gurus,// religionists or philosophers only for the sake of maintaining a high standard of living and sense gratification for themselves and their families. Sometimes they adopt the dress of a //sannyāsī// or preacher. They train some of their family members as lawyers and continually seek help from a high court to acquire riches on the plea of maintaining temples. Although such persons may call themselves preachers, live in Vṛndāvana or Navadvīpa, and also print many religious books, it is all for the same purpose, namely to earn a living to maintain their wives and children. They may also professionally recite the //Bhāgavatam// or other scriptures, worship the Deity in the temple and initiate disciples. Making a show of devotional paraphernalia, they may also collect money from the public and use it to cure the disease of some family member or near relative. Sometimes they become //bābājīs// or collect money on the plea of worshiping the poor, whom they call //daridra-nārāyaṇa,// or for social and political upliftment. Thus they spread a network of business schemes to collect money for sense gratification by cheating people in general who have no knowledge of pure devotional service. Such cheaters cannot understand that by offering devotional service to the Supreme Personality of Godhead, one can be elevated to a position of eternal servitude to the Lord, which is even greater than the position of Brahmā and other demigods. Unfortunately, fools have no understanding of the perpetual pleasure of devotional service.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.72
description: "However, because he has received the mercy of Your lotus feet, he does not even accept his father's money. Instead he eats by begging alms from centers for the distribution of food.

> tomāra caraṇa-kṛpā hañāche tāhāre
> chatre māgi' khāya, 'viṣaya' sparśa nāhi kare
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---of Your lotus feet; [[synonyms:k:kṛpā]]---the mercy; [[synonyms:h:hañāche]]---has been; [[synonyms:t:tāhāre]]---upon him; [[synonyms:c:chatre]]---from centers for the distribution of food; [[synonyms:m:māgi']]---begging; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---he eats; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---money; [[synonyms:s:sparśa]] [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---he does not touch.
translation: "However, because he has received the mercy of Your lotus feet, he does not even accept his father's money. Instead he eats by begging alms from centers for the distribution of food.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.73
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a good gentleman. He does not desire material benefits from You.
text:
> rāmānandera bhāi gopīnātha-mahāśaya
> tomā haite viṣaya-vāñchā, tāra icchā naya
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāmānandera]]---of Rāmānanda; [[synonyms:b:bhāi]]---brother; [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:m:mahāśaya]]---a great gentleman; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:h:haite]]---from You; [[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]-[[synonyms:v:vāñchā]]---desire for material advantage; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:i:icchā]]---his desire; [[synonyms:n:naya]]---is not.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a good gentleman. He does not desire material benefits from You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.74
description: "It is not Gopīnātha who sent all those men so that You would release him from his plight. Rather, his friends and servants, seeing his distressed condition, informed You because they all knew that Gopīnātha is a soul surrendered unto You.
text:
> tāra duḥkha dekhi' tāra sevakādi-gaṇa
> tomāre jānāila,---yāte 'ananya-śaraṇa'
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---distressed condition; [[synonyms:d:dekhi']]---seeing; [[synonyms:t:tāra]]---his; [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]-[[synonyms:ā:ādi]]-[[synonyms:g:gaṇa]]---servants and friends; [[synonyms:t:tomāre]] [[synonyms:j:jānāila]]---informed You; [[synonyms:y:yāte]]---because; [[synonyms:a:ananya]]---no other; [[synonyms:ś:śaraṇa]]---shelter.
translation: "It is not Gopīnātha who sent all those men so that You would release him from his plight. Rather, his friends and servants, seeing his distressed condition, informed You because they all knew that Gopīnātha is a soul surrendered unto You.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.75
description: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a pure devotee who worships You only for Your satisfaction. He does not care about his personal happiness or distress, for that is the business of a materialist.
text:
> sei 'śuddha-bhakta', ye tomā bhaje tomā lāgi'
> āpanāra sukha-duḥkhe haya bhoga-bhogī'
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:ś:śuddha]]-[[synonyms:b:bhakta]]---a pure devotee; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---who; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:b:bhaje]]---worships You; [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:l:lāgi']]---for Your satisfaction; [[synonyms:ā:āpanāra]] [[synonyms:s:sukha]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkhe]]---for personal happiness and distress; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]]-[[synonyms:b:bhogī]]---one who wants to enjoy this material world.
translation: "Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a pure devotee who worships You only for Your satisfaction. He does not care about his personal happiness or distress, for that is the business of a materialist.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.76
description: "One who engages in Your devotional service twenty-four hours a day, desiring only Your mercy, will very soon attain shelter at Your lotus feet.
text:
> tomāra anukampā cāhe, bhaje anukṣaṇa
> acirāt mile tāṅre tomāra caraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:anukampā]]---mercy; [[synonyms:c:cāhe]]---desires; [[synonyms:b:bhaje]] [[synonyms:a:anukṣaṇa]]---engages in devotional service twenty-four hours a day; [[synonyms:a:acirāt]]---very soon; [[synonyms:m:mile]]---meet; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---him; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]] [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---Your lotus feet.
translation: "One who engages in Your devotional service twenty-four hours a day, desiring only Your mercy, will very soon attain shelter at Your lotus feet.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.77
description: "One who seeks Your compassion and thus tolerates all kinds of adverse conditions due to the karma of his past deeds, who engages always in Your devotional service with his mind, words and body, and who always offers obeisances unto You is certainly a bona fide candidate for becoming Your unalloyed devotee.'
text:
> tat te 'nukampāṁ susamīkṣamāṇo
> bhuñjāna evātma-kṛtaṁ vipākam
> hṛd-vāg-vapurbhir vidadhan namas te
> jīveta yo mukti-pade sa dāya-bhāk
synonyms: [[synonyms:t:tat]]---therefore; [[synonyms:t:te]]---Your; [[synonyms:a:anukampām]]---compassion; [[synonyms:s:su]]-[[synonyms:s:samīkṣamāṇaḥ]]---hoping for; [[synonyms:b:bhuñjānaḥ]]---enduring; [[synonyms:e:eva]]---certainly; [[synonyms:ā:ātma]]-[[synonyms:k:kṛtam]]---done by himself; [[synonyms:v:vipākam]]---fruitive results; [[synonyms:h:hṛt]]---with the heart; [[synonyms:v:vāk]]---words; [[synonyms:v:vapurbhiḥ]]---and body; [[synonyms:v:vidadhat]]---offering; [[synonyms:n:namaḥ]]---obeisances; [[synonyms:t:te]]---unto You; [[synonyms:j:jīveta]]---may live; [[synonyms:y:yaḥ]]---anyone who; [[synonyms:m:mukti]]-[[synonyms:p:pade]]---in devotional service; [[synonyms:s:saḥ]]---he; [[synonyms:d:dāya]]-[[synonyms:b:bhāk]]---a bona fide candidate.
translation: "One who seeks Your compassion and thus tolerates all kinds of adverse conditions due to the karma of his past deeds, who engages always in Your devotional service with his mind, words and body, and who always offers obeisances unto You is certainly a bona fide candidate for becoming Your unalloyed devotee.'
purport: This is a verse from //Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam// (10.14.8).

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.78
description: "Kindly stay here at Jagannātha Purī. Why should You go to Ālālanātha? Henceforward, no one will approach You about material affairs."
text:
> ethā tumi vasi' raha, kene yābe ālālanātha?
> keha tomā nā śunābe viṣayīra vāt
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---here; [[synonyms:t:tumi]]---You; [[synonyms:v:vasi']]---residing; [[synonyms:r:raha]]---kindly stay; [[synonyms:k:kene]]---why; [[synonyms:y:yābe]]---shall You go; [[synonyms:ā:ālālanātha]]---to Ālālanātha; [[synonyms:k:keha]] [[synonyms:t:tomā]] [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ś:śunābe]]---no one will inform You; [[synonyms:v:viṣayīra]] [[synonyms:v:vāt]]---about the affairs of materialistic persons.
translation: "Kindly stay here at Jagannātha Purī. Why should You go to Ālālanātha? Henceforward, no one will approach You about material affairs."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.79
description: Finally Kāśī Miśra told the Lord, "If You want to give protection to Gopīnātha, then Lord Jagannātha, who protected him today, will also protect him in the future."
text:
> yadi vā tomāra tāre rākhite haya mana
> āji ye rākhila, sei karibe rakṣaṇa"
synonyms: [[synonyms:y:yadi]] [[synonyms:v:vā]]---if somehow or other; [[synonyms:t:tomāra]]---of You; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---him; [[synonyms:r:rākhite]]---to protect; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:m:mana]]---mind; [[synonyms:ā:āji]]---today; [[synonyms:y:ye]]---He who; [[synonyms:r:rākhila]]---protected; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:k:karibe]] [[synonyms:r:rakṣaṇa]]---will give protection.
translation: Finally Kāśī Miśra told the Lord, "If You want to give protection to Gopīnātha, then Lord Jagannātha, who protected him today, will also protect him in the future."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.8
description: The inhabitants of the seven higher planetary systems-including the demigods, the Gandharvas and the Kinnaras-and the inhabitants of the seven lower planetary systems [Pātālaloka], including the demons and serpentine living entities, all visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the dress of human beings.
text:
> manuṣyera veśe deva-gandharva-kinnara
> sapta-pātālera yata daitya viṣadhara
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:manuṣyera]] [[synonyms:v:veśe]]---in the dress of human beings; [[synonyms:d:deva]]-[[synonyms:g:gandharva]]-[[synonyms:k:kinnara]]---the demigods, the Gandharvas and the Kinnaras; [[synonyms:s:sapta]]-[[synonyms:p:pātālera]]---of the seven lower planetary systems; [[synonyms:y:yata]]---all kinds of; [[synonyms:d:daitya]]---demons; [[synonyms:v:viṣa]]-[[synonyms:d:dhara]]---serpentine living entities.
translation: The inhabitants of the seven higher planetary systems-including the demigods, the Gandharvas and the Kinnaras-and the inhabitants of the seven lower planetary systems [Pātālaloka], including the demons and serpentine living entities, all visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu in the dress of human beings.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.80
description: After saying this, Kāśī Miśra left the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and returned to his own temple. At noon King Pratāparudra came to Kāśī Miśra's home.
text:
> eta bali' kāśī-miśra gelā sva-mandire
> madhyāhne pratāparudra āilā tāṅra ghare
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:b:bali']]---saying this; [[synonyms:k:kāśī]]-[[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:g:gelā]]---went; [[synonyms:s:sva]]-[[synonyms:m:mandire]]---to his own temple; [[synonyms:m:madhyāhne]]---at noon; [[synonyms:p:pratāparudra]]---King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:ā:āilā]]---came; [[synonyms:t:tāṅra]] [[synonyms:g:ghare]]---to his home.
translation: After saying this, Kāśī Miśra left the abode of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu and returned to his own temple. At noon King Pratāparudra came to Kāśī Miśra's home.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.81
description: As long as King Pratāparudra stayed in his capital, Puruṣottama, he performed one regular duty.
text:
> pratāparudrera eka āchaye niyame
> yata dina rahe teṅha śrī-puruṣottame
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:pratāparudrera]]---of King Pratāparudra; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:ā:āchaye]]---is; [[synonyms:n:niyame]]---a regular duty; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:d:dina]]---as long as; [[synonyms:r:rahe]]---remained; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:ś:śrī]]-[[synonyms:p:puruṣottame]]---at Jagannātha Purī.
translation: As long as King Pratāparudra stayed in his capital, Puruṣottama, he performed one regular duty.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.82
description: He would come daily to the house of Kāśī Miśra to massage his lotus feet. The King would also hear from him about how opulently Lord Jagannātha was served.
text:
> nitya āsi' kare miśrera pāda saṁvāhana
> jagannātha-sevāra kare bhiyāna śravaṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nitya]] [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming daily; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---performs; [[synonyms:m:miśrera]]---of Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:p:pāda]]---the feet; [[synonyms:s:saṁvāhana]]---massaging; [[synonyms:j:jagannātha]]-[[synonyms:s:sevāra]]---for the service of Lord Jagannātha; [[synonyms:k:kare]]---does; [[synonyms:b:bhiyāna]]---arrangements; [[synonyms:ś:śravaṇa]]---hearing.
translation: He would come daily to the house of Kāśī Miśra to massage his lotus feet. The King would also hear from him about how opulently Lord Jagannātha was served.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.83
description: When the King began pressing his lotus feet, Kāśī Miśra informed him about something through hints.
text:
> rājā miśrera caraṇa yabe cāpite lāgilā
> tabe miśra tāṅre kichu bhaṅgīte kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rāja]]---the King; [[synonyms:m:miśrera]]---of Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:c:caraṇa]]---the lotus feet; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:c:cāpite]] [[synonyms:l:lāgilā]]---began to press; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that opportunity; [[synonyms:m:miśra]]---Kāśī Miśra; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:k:kichu]]---something; [[synonyms:b:bhaṅgīte]]---by a hint; [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---informed.
translation: When the King began pressing his lotus feet, Kāśī Miśra informed him about something through hints.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.84
description: "My dear King," he said, "please hear one uncommon item of news. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wants to leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha."
text:
> "deva, śuna āra eka aparūpa vāt!
> mahāprabhu kṣetra chāḍi' yābena ālālanātha!"
synonyms: [[synonyms:d:deva]]---my dear King; [[synonyms:ś:śuna]]---hear; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---another; [[synonyms:e:eka]]---one; [[synonyms:a:aparūpa]]---uncommon; [[synonyms:v:vāt]]---news; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:k:kṣetra]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍi']]---leaving Jagannātha Purī; [[synonyms:y:yābena]]---will go; [[synonyms:ā:ālālanātha]]---to Ālālanātha.
translation: "My dear King," he said, "please hear one uncommon item of news. Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu wants to leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.85
description: When the King heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to Ālālanātha, he was very unhappy and inquired about the reason. Then Kāśī Miśra informed him of all the details.
text:
> śuni rājā duḥkhī hailā, puchilena kāraṇa
> tabe miśra kahe tāṅre saba vivaraṇa
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuni]]---hearing; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:d:duḥkhī]] [[synonyms:h:hailā]]---became very unhappy; [[synonyms:p:puchilena]]---inquired; [[synonyms:k:kāraṇa]]---the reason; [[synonyms:t:tabe]]---at that time; [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Miśra said; [[synonyms:t:tāṅre]]---to him; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:v:vivaraṇa]]---details.
translation: When the King heard that Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was going to Ālālanātha, he was very unhappy and inquired about the reason. Then Kāśī Miśra informed him of all the details.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.86
description: "When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga," he said, "all his servants went to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> "gopīnātha-paṭṭanāyake yabe cāṅge caḍāilā
> tāra sevaka saba āsi' prabhure kahilā
synonyms: [[synonyms:g:gopīnātha]]-[[synonyms:p:paṭṭanāyake]]---Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka; [[synonyms:y:yabe]]---when; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]]---on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:c:caḍāilā]]---they lifted; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:sevaka]]---his servants; [[synonyms:s:saba]]---all; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:p:prabhure]] [[synonyms:k:kahilā]]---informed Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: "When Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka was lifted onto the cāṅga," he said, "all his servants went to inform Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.87
description: "Hearing about this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely sorry at heart, and in anger He chastised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.
text:
> śuniyā kṣobhita haila mahāprabhura mana
> krodhe gopīnāthe kailā bahuta bhartsana
synonyms: [[synonyms:ś:śuniyā]]---hearing; [[synonyms:k:kṣobhita]] [[synonyms:h:haila]]---became agitated; [[synonyms:m:mahāprabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu's mind; [[synonyms:k:krodhe]]---in anger; [[synonyms:g:gopīnāthe]]---unto Gopīnātha //Paṭṭanāyaka//; [[synonyms:k:kailā]]---did; [[synonyms:b:bahuta]] [[synonyms:b:bhartsana]]---much chastisement.
translation: "Hearing about this, Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu was extremely sorry at heart, and in anger He chastised Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.88
description: "Because he is mad after sense gratification,' the Lord said, 'he acts as a government servant but spends the government's revenue for various sinful activities.
text:
> 'ajitendriya hañā kare rāja-viṣaya
> nānā asat-pathe kare rāja-dravya vyaya
synonyms: [[synonyms:a:ajitendriya]] [[synonyms:h:hañā]]---being mad after sense gratification; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:v:viṣaya]]---serves the government; [[synonyms:n:nānā]] [[synonyms:a:asat]]-[[synonyms:p:pathe]]---in various sinful activities; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:v:vyaya]]---spends the revenue of government.
translation: "Because he is mad after sense gratification,' the Lord said, 'he acts as a government servant but spends the government's revenue for various sinful activities.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.89
description: "The revenue of the government is more sacred than the property of a brāhmaṇa. One who misappropriates the government's money and uses it to enjoy sense gratification is most sinful.
text:
> brahmasva-adhika ei haya rāja-dhana
> tāhā hari' bhoga kare mahā-pāpī jana
synonyms: [[synonyms:b:brahmasva]]---a //brāhmaṇa's// property; [[synonyms:a:adhika]]---more than; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:dhana]]---the revenue of the government; [[synonyms:t:tāhā]] [[synonyms:h:hari']]---stealing that; [[synonyms:b:bhoga]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---enjoys sense gratification; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:p:pāpī]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---a most sinful person.
translation: "The revenue of the government is more sacred than the property of a brāhmaṇa. One who misappropriates the government's money and uses it to enjoy sense gratification is most sinful.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.9
description: Dressed in different ways, people from the seven islands and nine khaṇḍas visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
text:
> sapta-dvīpe nava-khaṇḍe vaise yata jana
> nānā-veśe āsi' kare prabhura daraśana
synonyms: [[synonyms:s:sapta]]-[[synonyms:d:dvīpe]]---in seven islands; [[synonyms:n:nava]]-[[synonyms:k:khaṇḍe]]---in nine //khaṇḍas//; [[synonyms:v:vaise]]---reside; [[synonyms:y:yata]] [[synonyms:j:jana]]---all persons; [[synonyms:n:nānā]]-[[synonyms:v:veśe]]---in different dresses; [[synonyms:ā:āsi']]---coming; [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.
translation: Dressed in different ways, people from the seven islands and nine khaṇḍas visited Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.90
description: "One who serves the government but misappropriates the government's revenue is liable to be punished by the king. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.
text:
> rājāra vartana khāya, āra curi kare
> rāja-daṇḍya haya sei śāstrera vicāre
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājāra]] [[synonyms:v:vartana]]---the salary of the King; [[synonyms:k:khāya]]---he takes; [[synonyms:ā:āra]]---and; [[synonyms:c:curi]] [[synonyms:k:kare]]---steals; [[synonyms:r:rāja]]-[[synonyms:d:daṇḍya]]---liable to be punished by the King; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:s:sei]]---he; [[synonyms:ś:śāstrera]] [[synonyms:v:vicāre]]---the verdict of the revealed scripture.
translation: "One who serves the government but misappropriates the government's revenue is liable to be punished by the king. That is the verdict of all revealed scriptures.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.91
description: "The King wanted his revenue paid and did not want to enforce punishment. Therefore the King is certainly very religious. But Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a great cheat.
text:
> nija-kauḍi māge, rājā nāhi kare daṇḍa
> rājā---mahā-dhārmika, ei haya pāpī bhaṇḍa!
synonyms: [[synonyms:n:nija]]-[[synonyms:k:kauḍi]]---his own money; [[synonyms:m:māge]]---demands; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:k:kare]] [[synonyms:d:daṇḍa]]---does not punish; [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:dhārmika]]---very religious; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this man; [[synonyms:h:haya]]---is; [[synonyms:p:pāpī]]---sinful; [[synonyms:b:bhaṇḍa]]---cheat.
translation: "The King wanted his revenue paid and did not want to enforce punishment. Therefore the King is certainly very religious. But Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka is a great cheat.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.92
description: "He does not pay the revenue to the King, but he wants My help for release. This is a greatly sinful affair. I cannot tolerate it here.
text:
> rājā-kaḍi nā deya, āmāre phukāre
> ei mahā-duḥkha ihāṅ ke sahite pāre?
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]]-[[synonyms:k:kaḍi]]---the revenue of the King; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:d:deya]]---does not pay; [[synonyms:ā:āmāre]]---to Me; [[synonyms:p:phu]]-[[synonyms:k:kāre]]---cries; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:m:mahā]]-[[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---great unhappiness; [[synonyms:i:ihāṅ]]---here; [[synonyms:k:ke]] [[synonyms:s:sahite]] [[synonyms:p:pāre]]---who can tolerate.
translation: "He does not pay the revenue to the King, but he wants My help for release. This is a greatly sinful affair. I cannot tolerate it here.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.93
text:
> ālālanātha yāi' tāhāṅ niścinte rahimu
> viṣayīra bhāla manda vārtā nā śunimu' "
synonyms: [[synonyms:ā:ālālanātha]] [[synonyms:y:yāi']]---going to Ālālanātha; [[synonyms:t:tāhāṅ]]---there; [[synonyms:n:niścinte]] [[synonyms:r:rahimu]]---I shall live peacefully; [[synonyms:v:viṣayīra]]---of materialistic persons; [[synonyms:b:bhāla]] [[synonyms:m:manda]]---good and bad; [[synonyms:v:vārtā]]---news; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:ś:śunimu]]---I shall not hear.
translation: "Therefore I shall leave Jagannātha Purī and go to Ālālanātha, where I shall live peacefully and not hear about all these affairs of materialistic people.' "

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.94
description: When King Pratāparudra heard all these details, he felt great pain in his mind."I shall give up all that is due from Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka," he said, "if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stays here at Jagannātha Purī.
text:
> eta śuni' kahe rājā pāñā mane vyathā
> "saba dravya chāḍoṅ, yadi prabhu rahena ethā
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eta]] [[synonyms:ś:śuni']]---hearing all these details; [[synonyms:k:kahe]] [[synonyms:r:rājā]]---the King said; [[synonyms:p:pāñā]]---getting; [[synonyms:m:mane]] [[synonyms:v:vyathā]]---pain in his mind; [[synonyms:s:saba]] [[synonyms:d:dravya]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍoṅ]]---I shall give up all the dues; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:p:prabhu]]---Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:r:rahena]] [[synonyms:e:ethā]]---remains here.
translation: When King Pratāparudra heard all these details, he felt great pain in his mind."I shall give up all that is due from Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka," he said, "if Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu stays here at Jagannātha Purī.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.95
description: "If even for a moment I could get an interview with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, I would not care for the profit of millions of cintāmaṇi stones.
text:
> eka-kṣaṇa prabhura yadi pāiye daraśana
> koṭi-cintāmaṇi-lābha nahe tāra sama
synonyms: [[synonyms:e:eka]]-[[synonyms:k:kṣaṇa]]---for a moment; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]]---of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:y:yadi]]---if; [[synonyms:p:pāiye]]---I get; [[synonyms:d:daraśana]]---an interview; [[synonyms:k:koṭi]]-[[synonyms:c:cintāmaṇi]]-[[synonyms:l:lābha]]---obtaining millions of //cintāmaṇi// stones; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:t:tāra]] [[synonyms:s:sama]]---equal to that.
translation: "If even for a moment I could get an interview with Lord Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu, I would not care for the profit of millions of cintāmaṇi stones.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.96
description: "I do not care about this small sum of 200,000 kāhanas. Not to speak of this, I would indeed sacrifice everything at the lotus feet of the Lord, including my life and kingdom."
text:
> kon chāra padārtha ei dui-lakṣa kāhana?
> prāṇa-rājya karoṅ prabhu-pade nirmañchana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:k:kon]]---what; [[synonyms:c:chāra]]---little; [[synonyms:p:padārtha]]---matter; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:d:dui]]-[[synonyms:l:lakṣa]] [[synonyms:k:kāhana]]---the lotus feet of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:n:nirmañchana]]---sacrificing.
translation: "I do not care about this small sum of 200,000 kāhanas. Not to speak of this, I would indeed sacrifice everything at the lotus feet of the Lord, including my life and kingdom."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.97
description: Kāśī Miśra hinted to the King, "It is not the Lord's desire that you forfeit the payment. He is unhappy only because the whole family is troubled."
text:
> miśra kahe, "kauḍi chāḍibā,---nahe prabhura mana
> tārā duḥkha pāya,---ei nā yāya sahana"
synonyms: [[synonyms:m:miśra]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---Kāśī Miśra said; [[synonyms:k:kauḍi]] [[synonyms:c:chāḍibā]]---you shall abandon the money; [[synonyms:n:nahe]]---is not; [[synonyms:p:prabhura]] [[synonyms:m:mana]]---the desire of Śrī Caitanya Mahāprabhu; [[synonyms:t:tārā]]---they; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]] [[synonyms:p:pāya]]---get unhappiness; [[synonyms:e:ei]]---this; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:y:yāya]] [[synonyms:s:sahana]]---is intolerable.
translation: Kāśī Miśra hinted to the King, "It is not the Lord's desire that you forfeit the payment. He is unhappy only because the whole family is troubled."

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.98
description: The King replied, "I have no desire to give pain to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and his family, nor did I know about his being lifted on the cāṅga to be thrown on the swords and killed.
text:
> rājā kahe,---"tāre āmi duḥkha nāhi diye
> cāṅge caḍā, khaḍge ḍārā,---āmi nā jāniye
synonyms: [[synonyms:r:rājā]] [[synonyms:k:kahe]]---the King replied; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---to him; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:d:duḥkha]]---unhappiness; [[synonyms:n:nāhi]] [[synonyms:d:diye]]---have no desire to give; [[synonyms:c:cāṅge]] [[synonyms:c:caḍā]]---the raising on the //cāṅga//; [[synonyms:k:khaḍge]]---on the swords; [[synonyms:ḍ:ḍārā]]---the throwing; [[synonyms:ā:āmi]]---I; [[synonyms:n:nā]] [[synonyms:j:jāniye]]---did not know.
translation: The King replied, "I have no desire to give pain to Gopīnātha Paṭṭanāyaka and his family, nor did I know about his being lifted on the cāṅga to be thrown on the swords and killed.

title: Śrī Caitanya-caritāmṛta, Antya-līlā 9.99
description: "He sneered at Puruṣottama Jānā. Therefore the prince tried to scare him as a punishment.
text:
> puruṣottama-jānāre teṅha kaila parihāsa
> sei 'jānā' tāre dekhāila mithyā trāsa
synonyms: [[synonyms:p:puruṣottama]]-[[synonyms:j:jānāre]]---at Puruṣottama Jānā, the prince; [[synonyms:t:teṅha]]---he; [[synonyms:k:kaila]] [[synonyms:p:parihāsa]]---made a joke; [[synonyms:s:sei]] [[synonyms:j:jānā]]---that prince; [[synonyms:t:tāre]]---unto him; [[synonyms:d:dekhāila]]---showed; [[synonyms:m:mithyā]]---false; [[synonyms:t:trāsa]]---scare.
translation: "He sneered at Puruṣottama Jānā. Therefore the prince tried to scare him as a punishment.
